parameters.name: NodeB Function Name
parameters.description: Indicates the NodeB function name.

parameters.name: Application Reference
parameters.description: This parameter indicates the ID of the Application MO that is referenced by the NodeBFunction MO. The Application MO provides operating environments for the NodeBFunction MO.

parameters.name: NeRM Version
parameters.description: Indicates the NodeB NE resource model version. In the same model version, all MO types, attributes, and configuration rules in the model are defined in the same way. If the model definition (MOC definition, attribute definition, and configuration rules) for different NE software is the same, these NE software uses the same model version. Generally, a software version uniquely corresponds to a mode

parameters.name: User Label
parameters.description: Indicates the user label. If a user requires multiple information, the format is "%Name1::Value1%Name2::Value2%other description".

parameters.name: NodeB Identifier
parameters.description: Indicates the NodeB ID.

parameters.name: Product Version
parameters.description: Indicates the product software version of the NodeBFunction.

parameters.name: Sector ID
parameters.description: Indicates the number of the sector.

parameters.name: Sector Name
parameters.description: Indicates the name of the sector.

parameters.name: Location Name
parameters.description: Indicates the location name of the base station. Generally, the LocationName parameter is set to the same value for all sectors in an RF site, and base station can acquire the location information of RF modules through this parameter. However, if the LocationName parameter of the RF module is set in the RRU or AAS MO, the base station will acquire the location information of RF modules through the

parameters.name: User Label
parameters.description: Indicates the user-defined information of a sector. The value of this parameter consists of xx::yy and common character strings, which are separated by percentage signs (%), for example, %tel::88888888%owner::huawei%20130101. xx::yy indicates that the value of xx is yy.

parameters.name: Antenna Azimuth
parameters.description: Indicates the azimuth of the sector antenna main lobe, which is an angle rotating clockwise from the due north to the direction of the sector antenna main lobe. For example, this parameter is set to 0 for the due north and to 900 for the due east (the unit is 0.1 degrees). This parameter is only for directional antennas. The value 65535 indicates that this parameter is invalid.

parameters.name: Sector Antenna
parameters.description: Indicates the information about the sector antenna.

parameters.name: Mode
parameters.description: Indicates the mode in which the RRU channel connected to a sector antenna is working.

parameters.name: RX Frequency Range
parameters.description: Indicates the range of RX frequencies supported by the RRU channel connected to a sector antenna.

parameters.name: TX Frequency Range
parameters.description: Indicates the range of TX frequencies supported by the RRU channel connected to a sector antenna.

parameters.name: Sector License
parameters.description: Indicates the license to be requested for a sector.

parameters.name: License State
parameters.description: Indicates the license status of a sector.

parameters.name: Sector Equipment ID
parameters.description: Indicates the number of the sector equipment.

parameters.name: Sector ID
parameters.description: Indicates the number of the sector in which the sector equipment is located.

parameters.name: Sector Equipment Antenna
parameters.description: Indicates the information about the sector equipment antenna.

parameters.name: Antenna Config Mode
parameters.description: Indicates the antenna configuration mode of sector equipment. If this parameter is set to ANTENNAPORT, the antenna port list must be configured. If this parameter is set to BEAM, RRU and beamforming parameters must be configured.

parameters.name: RRU Cabinet No.
parameters.description: Indicates the cabinet number of the RRU corresponding to the sector equipment when ANTCFGMODE of the sector equipment is set to BEAM.

parameters.name: RRU Subrack No.
parameters.description: Indicates the subrack number of the RRU corresponding to the sector equipment when ANTCFGMODE of the sector equipment is set to BEAM.

parameters.name: RRU Slot No.
parameters.description: Indicates the slot number of the RRU corresponding to the sector equipment when ANTCFGMODE of the sector equipment is set to BEAM.

parameters.name: Beam Shape
parameters.description: Indicates the beam coverage shape of sector equipment, specified by the expanding angle of a sector.

parameters.name: Beam Layer Split
parameters.description: Indicates the vertical beam split. If this parameter is set to None, the vertical coverage area is not split. If this parameter is set to INNER_LAYER, the inner sector is covered after a beam layer split. If this parameter is set to OUTER_LAYER, the outer sector is covered after a beam layer split.

parameters.name: Beam Azimuth Offset
parameters.description: Indicates the azimuth offset of the main lobe direction of horizontal beam coverage and the RF module direction. If this parameter is set to None, the main lobe of beams and RF module are in the same direction. If this parameter is set to LEFT_HALF, the azimuth deflects 1/2 sector angle counterclockwise. If this parameter is set to RIGHT_HALF, the azimuth deflects 1/2 sector angle clockwise. For e

parameters.name: Local Cell ID
parameters.description: Indicates the local ID of the cell. It uniquely identifies a cell within a BS.

parameters.name: Cell Name
parameters.description: Indicates the name of the cell.

parameters.name: Csg indicator
parameters.description: Indicates whether the cell is a closed subscriber group (CSG) cell. A CSG cell has restrictions on UE access. It broadcasts a specific CSG ID in the SIB and only those UEs of the group can access the CSG cell. BOOLEAN_FALSE indicates that the cell is not a CSG cell, and BOOLEAN_TRUE indicates that the cell is a CSG cell. Currently, Huawei eNodeBs do not support CSG cells. This parameter applies on

parameters.name: Uplink cyclic prefix length
parameters.description: Indicates the UL cyclic prefix length of a cell. A cyclic prefix can be a common or extended cyclic prefix. An extended cyclic prefix is generally used in a complex environment with a strong multi-path effect and long delay. In a cell, the UL cyclic prefix length can be different from the DL one. In addition, the UL or DL cyclic prefix length of a cell must be the same as that of the cell using th

parameters.name: Downlink cyclic prefix length
parameters.description: Indicates the length of the DL cyclic prefix of a cell. A DL cyclic prefix can be a common or extended cyclic prefix. An extended cyclic prefix is generally used in a complex environment with a strong multi-path effect and long delay. In a cell, the UL cyclic prefix length can be different from the DL one. In addition, the UL or DL cyclic prefix length of a cell must be the same as that of the cel

parameters.name: Frequency band
parameters.description: Indicates the frequency band in which a cell operates. For details about this parameter, see 3GPP TS 36.104. The LTE-U function has been removed, and the values in the range of 252 to 255 are invalid. Although the configuration interface in this version supports synchronization and delivery of the values in this range, the system does not use these values. Therefore, avoid setting this parameter t

parameters.name: Uplink EARFCN indication
parameters.description: Indicates whether to configure the uplink EARFCN of the cell. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: Uplink EARFCN
parameters.description: Indicates the UL EARFCN of the cell. It is optional, depending on the setting of the UL EARFCN configuration indicator (UlEarfcnCfgInd). If the value of this parameter is not specified, the default UL EARFCN is used, which is calculated based on the DL EARFCN. For details, see 3GPP TS 36.104. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: Downlink EARFCN
parameters.description: Indicates the DL EARFCN of a cell. For details about this parameter, see the 3GPP TS 36.104. The LTE-U function has been removed, and the values in the ranges of 255144 to 256143 and 260894 to 262143 are invalid. Although the configuration interface in this version supports synchronization and delivery of the values in these ranges, the system does not use these values. Therefore, avoid setting th

parameters.name: Uplink bandwidth
parameters.description: Indicates the uplink bandwidth of the cell. The bandwidth is expressed in the number of RBs. For example, the value CELL_BW_N25 indicates a cell bandwidth of 25 RBs and the value CELL_BW_N50 indicates a cell bandwidth of 50 RBs. For details, see 3GPP TS 36.104. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: Downlink bandwidth
parameters.description: Indicates the downlink bandwidth of the cell. The bandwidth is expressed in the number of RBs. For example, the value CELL_BW_N25 indicates a cell bandwidth of 25 RBs and the value CELL_BW_N50 indicates a cell bandwidth of 50 RBs. For details, see 3GPP TS 36.104. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: Cell ID
parameters.description: Indicates the ID of the E-UTRAN cell. The combination of this parameter and the eNodeB ID forms the E-UTRAN cell identity. The combination of the E-UTRAN cell identity and the PLMN identity forms the ECGI. For details, see 3GPP TS 36.413.

parameters.name: Physical cell ID
parameters.description: Indicates the physical cell ID. For details, see 3GPP TS 36.331.

parameters.name: Standby Cell SFN Recovery Time
parameters.description: Indicates the automatic SFN recovery time of the inter-BBU cell on the secondary BBU after inter-BBU SFN faults are rectified. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: Additional spectrum emission
parameters.description: Indicates the additional spectrum emission, which restricts the emission power of the UEs in the cell. For details, see 3GPP TS 36.101.

parameters.name: Cell active state
parameters.description: Indicates the activation state of the cell. It consists of the activated and deactivated states.

parameters.name: Cell admin state
parameters.description: Indicates the administrative state of the cell. If this parameter is set to CELL_HIGH_BLOCK, the cell is deactivated immediately. If this parameter is set to CELL_MIDDLE_BLOCK, new UEs are not allowed to access the cell, and the cell is immediately deactivated when it has no user to serve within the period specified by the CellMidBlkTimer parameter or is deactivated when the timer expires irrespec

parameters.name: Cell Blocking Duration
parameters.description: Indicates the cell blocking duration. During the specified duration, new UEs are not allowed to access the cell. If there are no UEs in the cell, the cell is deactivated immediately. If there are UEs in the cell, the cell is deactivated after the cell blocking duration ends. In hitless cell blocking, UEs are not allowed to be handed over to the cell either within the specified cell blocking durati

parameters.name: Cell FDD TDD indication
parameters.description: Indicates the duplex mode of the cell. CELL_FDD indicates the FDD mode, and CELL_TDD indicates the TDD mode.

parameters.name: Subframe assignment
parameters.description: Indicates the ratio of UL subframes to DL subframes for an LTE TDD cell. For details, see 3GPP TS 36.211. This parameter applies only to LTE TDD.

parameters.name: Special subframe patterns
parameters.description: Indicates the ratio of special UL subframes to special DL subframes for an LTE TDD cell. For details, see 3GPP TS 36.211. This parameter applies only to LTE TDD.

parameters.name: Cell specific offset
parameters.description: Indicates the cell specific offset for the serving cell. It affects the probability of triggering handovers from the serving cell to its neighboring cells. A smaller value of this parameter leads to a higher probability. For details, see 3GPP TS 36.331. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: Frequency offset
parameters.description: Indicates the specific frequency offset of the serving cell. This parameter is contained in the measurement configuration and is related to the handover difficulty between the serving cell and the neighboring cell. For details, see 3GPP TS 36.331. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: Root sequence index
parameters.description: Indicates the index of the start logical root sequence used to generate preamble sequences for PRACH configuration set type A in a low-speed, high-speed, or ultra-high speed cell. Each logical root sequence maps one physical root sequence. For details about the mapping relationships, see 3GPP TS 36.211. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: High speed flag
parameters.description: Indicates the speed flag of the cell. Set this parameter to HIGH_SPEED or ULTRA_HIGH_SPEED if the cell is used to provide coverage for high-speed railways. Set this parameter to LOW_SPEED in other scenarios. This parameter can be set only to LOW_SPEED for TDD 5 MHz cells. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: Preamble format
parameters.description: Indicates the preamble format used in the cell. For details, see 3GPP TS 36.211. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: Cell radius
parameters.description: Indicates the radius of the cell, that is, the farthest distance that a cell can cover under the condition of keeping certain network performance. If this parameter is set to a value greater than 100 km, the Extended Cell Access Radius Beyond 100km feature takes effect. Only FDD cells can be configured with a radius more than 100 km. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: Customized bandwidth configure indicator
parameters.description: Indicates whether to configure a compact bandwidth for a cell. A compact bandwidth can be configured only when a standard bandwidth 1.4 MHz, 5 MHz, 10 MHz, 15 MHz, or 20 MHz has been configured. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD.

parameters.name: Customized uplink bandwidth
parameters.description: Indicates a customized uplink bandwidth configured for a cell. A compact bandwidth can be configured only when a standard bandwidth 1.4 MHz, 5 MHz, 10 MHz, 15 MHz, or 20 MHz has been configured. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD.

parameters.name: Customized downlink bandwidth
parameters.description: Indicates a customized downlink bandwidth configured for a cell. A compact bandwidth can be configured only when a standard bandwidth 1.4 MHz, 5 MHz, 10 MHz, 15 MHz, or 20 MHz has been configured. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD.

parameters.id: Ue max power allowed configure indicator
parameters.name: Ue max power allowed configure indicator
parameters.description: Indicates whether to configure the maximum TX power of the UE in the cell. If the value of this parameter is not specified, the maximum power is subject to the UE capability.

parameters.name: Max transmit power allowed
parameters.description: Indicates the maximum transmit power that a UE can apply to uplink transmission in the cell. It is used in cell selection criterion S to calculate the compensated power. If the value of this parameter is not specified, the maximum power is subject to the UE capability. For details, see 3GPP TS 36.304.

parameters.name: Flag of Multi-RRU Cell
parameters.description: Indicates whether to enable or disable the multi-RRU cell feature.

parameters.name: Mode of Multi-RRU Cell
parameters.description: Indicates the type of the multi-RRU cell.

parameters.name: CPRI Compression
parameters.description: Indicates the CPRI compression type of the cell. CPRI compression is used in RRU cascading scenarios to enable more RRUs to be cascaded without changing the CPRI data rate. The parameter can be set to NO_COMPRESSION, NORMAL_COMPRESSION, ENHANCED_COMPRESSION, QUADPLEX_COMPRESSION, TRIPLEX_COMPRESSION_10M, or 3_2_COMPRESSION. The parameter value NO_COMPRESSION indicates that CPRI compression is not

parameters.id: Physical Cell Number of SFN Cell
parameters.name: Physical Cell Number of SFN Cell
parameters.description: Indicates the number of physical cells constituting an SFN cell. In macro eNodeBs, this parameter value equals the number of sector equipment sets serving an SFN cell. In LampSite eNodeBs, this parameter value equals the number of sector equipment groups serving an SFN cell. In macro + LampSite eNodeBs, the parameter value equals the total number of sector equipment sets and sector equipment group

parameters.name: CRS Port Number
parameters.description: Indicates the number of ports for transmitting cell-specific reference signal (CRS). As defined in 3GPP specifications, this parameter can be set to CRS_PORT_1, CRS_PORT_2, or CRS_PORT_4. The value CRS_PORT_1 indicates that one CRS port (port 0) is configured. The value CRS_PORT_2 indicates that two CRS ports (ports 0 and 1) are configured. The value CRS_PORT_4 indicates that four CRS ports (ports

parameters.name: Cell transmission and reception mode
parameters.description: Indicates the transmission and reception mode of the cell.

parameters.name: User label
parameters.description: Indicates the user label of the cell.

parameters.name: Work mode
parameters.description: Indicates the work mode of the cell. The DL_ONLY mode applies only to the carrier aggregation scenario.

parameters.name: Cell Standby Mode
parameters.description: Indicates the active or standby mode of the cell. A cell is in active mode by default. If this parameter is set to STANDBY, an inter-BBU SFN auxiliary cell can switch back to the standby mode to provide services if inter-BBU faults occur. Only common cells, SFN cells or MPRU_AGGREGATION cells support the standby mode.

parameters.name: CRS Antenna Port Mapping
parameters.description: Indicates the mapping between a cell-specific reference signal (CRS) port and a transmit (TX) channel in an RRU. In cells with one or two TX channels, this parameter cannot be set. In cells with four or eight TX channels, this parameter can be set. As defined in 3GPP specifications, the CrsPortNum parameter can be set to CRS_PORT_1, CRS_PORT_2, or CRS_PORT_4. The value CRS_PORT_1 indicates that on

parameters.name: CPRI Ethernet Compression Ratio
parameters.description: Indicates the compression ratio of data transmitted on the CPRI port over Ethernet for an MPRU aggregation cell. Data compression on the CPRI port over Ethernet reduces the bandwidth of LTE data on the Ethernet cable between the RHUB and MPRUs, and therefore the Ethernet cable supports more carriers of different RATs. The parameter values NO_COMPRESSION, 2_TO_1, 3_TO_1, and 4_TO_1 indicate non-com

parameters.name: Downlink Punctured RB Number
parameters.description: Indicates the number of downlink RBs blocked in a cell. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD.

parameters.name: Coverage Level Type
parameters.description: Indicates the NB-IoT cell coverage level. A maximum of three coverage levels are supported, corresponding to 0 dB, 10 dB, and 20 dB coverage enhancement. This parameter is valid only when the NbCellFlag parameter is set to TRUE. COVERAGE_LEVEL_0: The NB-IoT cell supports 0 dB coverage enhancement only when this option is selected. This option applies only to NB-IoT. COVERAGE_LEVEL_1: The NB-IoT ce

parameters.name: NB-IoT Cell Flag
parameters.description: Indicates whether a local cell is an NB-IoT cell. When this parameter is set to TRUE, the local cell is an NB-IoT cell. When this parameter is set to FALSE, the local cell is not an NB-IoT cell. This parameter applies only to NB-IoT.

parameters.name: Compact Bandwidth Control Interference Mode
parameters.description: Indicates the interference control mode for scenarios where compact bandwidth is used. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD.

parameters.name: Uplink Punctured RB Number Offset
parameters.description: Indicates the offset for the number of RBs blocked in a cell in the uplink. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD.

parameters.name: SFN Master Cell Label
parameters.description: Used to maintain and query the information about the primary cell to which SFN secondary cells belong. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD.

parameters.name: Cell Slave Band
parameters.description: Indicates slave frequency bands of a cell. If the operating frequency of a cell belongs to multiple frequency bands, the frequency band with the highest priority is configured by the FreqBand parameter, and frequency bands with other priorities are configured by the CellSlaveBand parameter and added in descending order based on frequency band priorities. The frequency band priorities of a cell are

parameters.name: CN Operator Sharing Group ID
parameters.description: Indicates the ID of the eNodeB operator group that shares the cell. This parameter must be set to a value within the range of 0 to 5 if the eNodeB works in hybrid RAN sharing mode. This parameter must be set to 255 (an invalid value) in independent RAN sharing, RAN sharing with dedicated carrier, or RAN sharing with common carrier mode.

parameters.name: Intra Frequency RAN Sharing Indication
parameters.description: Indicates whether an intra-frequency neighboring cell is a shared neighboring cell. If this parameter is set to BOOLEAN_TRUE, the serving frequency is a shared frequency, and the shared operator information must be checked on the OSS before all intra-frequency neighboring cells are added. If this parameter is set to BOOLEAN_FALSE, the serving frequency is not a shared frequency, and the shared ope

parameters.name: IntraFreq ANR Indication
parameters.description: Indicates whether to enable ANR on intra-frequency neighboring cells. The value ALLOWED indicates that this type of ANR is allowed. The value NOT_ALLOWED indicates that this type of ANR is not allowed. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: SSP6 DwPTS Mode
parameters.description: Indicates whether the DwPTS is truncated for transmission in LTE TDD cells when SSP6 is used. This parameter applies only to LTE TDD cells that work on band 39 or band 34 and use SA2+SSP6. This parameter applies only to LTE TDD.

parameters.name: Cell Radius Start Location
parameters.description: Indicates the start location of the cell coverage. This parameter is used to calculate the hysteresis in uplink timing when the Extended Cell Access Radius Beyond 100km feature takes effect. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: Specified Cell Flag
parameters.description: Indicates whether the local cell is a specified-service cell. This parameter is configured based on the operator's policies. If this parameter is set to SPECSERCELL, the local cell is a WBB service-dedicated cell and preferentially serves WBB UEs. In this case, UEs identified as non-WBB UEs will be transferred out from the cell. This function is under license control. If this parameter is set to M

parameters.name: Multi Cell Share Mode
parameters.description: Indicates the co-RRU mode for multiple cells. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.id: Ultra High-Speed Cell Root Sequence Index
parameters.name: Ultra High-Speed Cell Root Sequence Index
parameters.description: Indicates the index of the start logic root sequence of the preamble sequences generated by class-2 PRACH configuration sets in an ultra-high speed cell. Each logic root sequence maps one physical root sequence. For details about the mapping relationships, see 3GPP TS 36.211. This parameter is valid only when the HighSpeedFlag parameter is set to ULTRA_HIGH_SPEED and the HighSpeedR14Switch option

parameters.name: LAA Configuration Reference Cell ID
parameters.description: Indicates the local cell ID of the reference cell whose FCS and coexistence parameter configurations are referenced by the LAA cell. This parameter applies only to LTE TDD.

parameters.name: MPT information
parameters.description: Indicates the location information of the MPT used by a cell. The value of this parameter is expressed as cabinet number - subrack number - slot number. The value "-" (hyphen) indicates an invalid value.

parameters.name: Cell instance state
parameters.description: Indicates the state of the cell instance. In the case of access barring, the state can be CELL_INST_BARRED(Barred), CELL_INST_EMTC_BARRED(eMTC Barred), or CELL_INST_LTE_EMTC_BARRED(LTE and eMTC Barred). If NB-IoT or LTE UEs are barred from accessing the cell, CELL_INST_BARRED(Barred) is displayed as the state of the cell instance. If eMTC UEs are barred from accessing the cell, CELL_INST_EMTC_BARR

parameters.name: Reason for latest state change
parameters.description: Indicates the reason for the latest state change of the cell, which can be a cell activation success or a cell setup failure.

parameters.name: Cell latest setup time
parameters.description: Indicates the latest setup time of the cell.

parameters.name: Cell latest setup operate type
parameters.description: Indicates the latest setup type of the cell.

parameters.name: Cell latest remove time
parameters.description: Indicates the latest removal time of the cell.

parameters.name: Cell latest remove operate type
parameters.description: Indicates the latest removal type of the cell.

parameters.name: Cell power save state
parameters.description: Indicates the energy saving status of the cell.

parameters.name: Primary BBP information
parameters.description: Indicates the cabinet number, subrack number, and slot number of the primary BBP that serves the cell.

parameters.name: Cell topology type
parameters.description: Indicates the topology of the cell.

parameters.name: RF module cabinet number
parameters.description: Indicates the cabinet number of the RF module that serves the cell.

parameters.name: RF module subrack number
parameters.description: Indicates the subrack number of the RF module that serves the cell.

parameters.name: RF module slot number
parameters.description: Indicates the slot number of the RF module that serves the cell.

parameters.name: Symbol shutdown state
parameters.description: Indicates whether the cell is in the symbol power saving state.

parameters.name: Maximum transmit power
parameters.description: Indicates the theoretical maximum transmit power of a single antenna channel of the cell. The value 65535 indicates that this parameter is invalid, and the maximum transmit power can be adjusted by modifying the PDSCH configuration or the PA-related parameters for PDSCH power control. The maximum transmit power of LTE and NB-IoT physical cells in the extension information is the same as that in th

parameters.name: eNodeB ID
parameters.description: Indicates the ID of the eNodeB.

parameters.name: BBP Cabinet No.
parameters.description: Indicates the cabinet number of the BBP that serves the cell.

parameters.name: BBP Subrack No.
parameters.description: Indicates the subrack number of the BBP that serves the cell.

parameters.name: BBP Slot No.
parameters.description: Indicates the slot number of the BBP that serves the cell.

parameters.name: Work Status
parameters.description: Indicates the work status of the RF module and BBP that serves the cell.

parameters.name: Coordinating Local Cell ID
parameters.description: Indicates the local cell ID of the cell that functions as a cooperating cell in UL CoMP (DSP CELLULCOMPCLUSTER is used to query the ID), the local cell ID of the cell that functions as a cooperating cell in uplink IC (DSP CELLULICCLUSTER is used to query the ID), or the local cell ID of the cell that functions as a cooperating cell in uplink interference detection (DSP ULINTRFDETECTNCELLINFO is us

parameters.name: RF Module Information
parameters.description: Indicates the cabinet, subrack, and slot where the RF module serves the cell is located.

parameters.name: Served BBP Information
parameters.description: Indicates the cabinet, subrack, and slot of the baseband processing unit on which the cell is set up is located.

parameters.name: 1 RRU Cell Number
parameters.description: Indicates the number of cells (each cell is served by one RRU) supported by the remaining resources on the primary baseband processing board.

parameters.name: 2 RRU Cell Number
parameters.description: Indicates the number of cells (each cell is served by two RRUs) supported by the remaining resources on the primary baseband processing board.

parameters.name: 3 RRU Cell Number
parameters.description: Indicates the number of cells (each cell is served by three RRUs) supported by the remaining resources on the primary baseband processing board.

parameters.name: 4 RRU Cell Number
parameters.description: Indicates the number of cells (each cell is served by four RRUs) supported by the remaining resources on the primary baseband processing board.

parameters.name: 5 RRU Cell Number
parameters.description: Indicates the number of cells (each cell is served by five RRUs) supported by the remaining resources on the primary baseband processing board.

parameters.name: 6 RRU Cell Number
parameters.description: Indicates the number of cells (each cell is served by six RRUs) supported by the remaining resources on the primary baseband processing board.

parameters.name: 7 RRU Cell Number
parameters.description: Indicates the number of cells (each cell is served by seven RRUs) supported by the remaining resources on the primary baseband processing board.

parameters.name: SectorEqm(SectorEqmGroup) Number
parameters.description: Indicates the quantity of resources occupied by the cell on the primary baseband processing board. The resource quantity is indicated by the number of RRUs.

parameters.id: Number of Cells Where Adjustment Fails
parameters.name: Number of Cells Where Adjustment Fails
parameters.description: Indicates the number of cells for which the adjustment fails in the one-click manner.

parameters.id: Number of Cells Where Adjustment Succeeds
parameters.name: Number of Cells Where Adjustment Succeeds
parameters.description: Indicates the number of cells for which the adjustment is successful in the one-click manner.

parameters.name: Connected BBP Port Information
parameters.description: Indicates the information about the CPRI port on the baseband processing board that is directly connected to the RF unit serving a cell. The information includes the cabinet, subrack, slot, and CPRI port numbers. A hyphen (-) represents an invalid value.

parameters.name: TX Channel No.
parameters.description: Indicates information about the TX channel of a cell.

parameters.name: RX Channel No.
parameters.description: Indicates information about the RX channel of a cell.

parameters.name: Served Bbp Primary Secondary Mode
parameters.description: Indicates whether a BBP serving the cell is a primary or secondary BBP. If the value of this parameter is PRIMARY for a slot, the BBP in this slot is the primary BBP, which carries the MAC layer resources of the cell. If the value of this parameter is SECONDARY for a slot, the BBP in this slot is a secondary BBP, which carries the physical layer resources of the cell.

parameters.name: Coordinating Cell Route Type
parameters.description: Indicates the type of route between the serving BBPs of the serving and cooperating cells in UL CoMP (DSP CELLULCOMPCLUSTER is used to query the type), the type of route between the primary BBPs of the benefited and interfering cells in uplink IC (DSP CELLULICCLUSTER is used to query the type), the type of route between the serving and cooperating cells in uplink interference detection (DSP ULINTR

parameters.name: Coordinating Cell eNodeB ID
parameters.description: Indicates the ID of the eNodeB serving the coordinating cell.

parameters.name: Coordinating Sector Equipment(group) ID
parameters.description: Indicates the ID of the coordinating sector equipment (group).

parameters.name: Coordinating Sector Equipment(group) eNB ID
parameters.description: Indicates the ID of the eNodeB equipped with the coordinating sector equipment (group).

parameters.id: Anti Interfere Status in High Speed Scenario
parameters.name: Anti Interfere Status in High Speed Scenario
parameters.description: Indicates the status of interference coordination in high-speed railway scenarios. The value of this parameter can be InterfHighSpeedStatus_NO_OP~0(Disable), InterfHighSpeedStatus_ACT~1(Run), or InterfHighSpeedStatus_RENEW~2(Restore). When interference coordination in high-speed railway scenarios is disabled for a cell, the value of this parameter is InterfHighSpeedStatus_NO_OP~0(Disable) in the c

parameters.name: Serving Sector Equipment(group) ID
parameters.description: Indicates the ID of the serving sector equipment(group).

parameters.name: Serving Sector Equipment(Group) eNB ID
parameters.description: Indicates the ID of the eNodeB equipped with the serving sector equipment(group).

parameters.name: Coordinating Sector Equipment Type
parameters.description: Indicates the type of sector equipment in the coordinating cell.

parameters.name: Serving Sector Equipment Type
parameters.description: Indicates the type of sector equipment in the serving cell.

parameters.name: Calibration Result
parameters.description: Indicates the cell-level channel calibration result. If channel calibration fails (for example, due to a low SINR) in cells served by combined RRUs, the antenna system must be adjusted.

parameters.name: Calibration Time
parameters.description: Indicates the end time of a cell-level channel calibration.

parameters.name: Calibration Type
parameters.description: Indicates the cell-level channel calibration type.

parameters.name: Calibration Index
parameters.description: Indicates the cell-level channel calibration index. Results of a maximum of 10 channel calibrations can be displayed in the DSP CELLCALIBRATION command output.

parameters.name: Cell Check Time
parameters.description: Indicates the health check time of the cell. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: Fault Unit Info
parameters.description: Indicates the cabinet, subrack, slot, and port of the faulty unit. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: Fault Unit Type
parameters.description: Indicates the type of the faulty unit. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: RF Loop Result
parameters.description: Indicates the RF loopback verification result of each channel of the cell.

parameters.name: eNodeB Du ID
parameters.description: Indicates the ID of the eNodeB DU. A hyphen (-) indicates an invalid value.

parameters.name: Probe End Time
parameters.description: Indicates the end time of detecting the pairing relationship between RRU and radio phase calibration unit (RPCU).

parameters.name: Probe Index
parameters.description: Indicates the index for detection of the pairing relationship between RRU and radio phase calibration unit (RPCU). The DSP EUCELLRPCURRURELATION command output includes a maximum of 10 latest detection results.

parameters.name: Probe Result
parameters.description: Indicates the detection result of the pairing relationship between RRU and radio phase calibration unit (RPCU).

parameters.name: RPCU Information
parameters.description: Indicates information about the cabinet, subrack, and slot of the radio phase calibration unit (RPCU) used by the cell.

parameters.name: RRU Information
parameters.description: Indicates information about cabinet, subrack, and slot of the RF module serving the cell.

parameters.name: Cell Tx Power Offset
parameters.description: Indicates the offset to the maximum transmit power of a single antenna channel of the cell. This parameter is related to the power allocation algorithm for each control channel and traffic channel of the eNodeB. The value 65535 indicates that this parameter is invalid. When the actually used power is less than or equal to the configured power, the value 65535 is used. If the cell is a LampSite cel

parameters.name: eNodeB Function Name
parameters.description: Indicates the name of an eNodeB function, which uniquely identifies the eNodeB function.

parameters.name: Application Reference
parameters.description: Indicates the ID of the application referenced by an eNodeB function. The application provides an operating environment for the eNodeB function.

parameters.name: eNodeB ID
parameters.description: Indicates the eNodeB ID defined in the service protocol interface, which uniquely identifies an eNodeB within a PLMN. For details, see 3GPP TS 36.300.

parameters.name: User Label
parameters.description: Indicates user-defined remarks.

parameters.name: NeRM Version
parameters.description: Indicates model definition version of eNodeB resources, including the management object (MO) definition, attribute definition, and configuration rules.

parameters.name: Product Version
parameters.description: Indicates the version of the product. This parameter is valid for version query.

parameters.name: gNodeB Function Name
parameters.description: Indicates the name of a gNodeB function, which uniquely identifies the gNodeB function.

parameters.name: Referenced Application ID
parameters.description: Indicates the ID of the application referenced by the gNodeB function. The application provides operating environment for the gNodeB function.

parameters.name: User Label
parameters.description: Indicates the user label related to the gNodeB function.

parameters.name: Network Resource Model Version
parameters.description: Indicates the model version of gNodeB resources, including MO definition, attribute definition, and configuration rules.

parameters.name: Product Version
parameters.description: Indicates the product version.

parameters.name: gNodeB ID
parameters.description: Indicates the gNodeB ID defined in the service protocol interface, which is unique within a PLMN.

parameters.name: gNodeB ID Length
parameters.description: Indicates the length of the gNodeB ID. The gNBIdLength parameter specifies the number of bits occupied by the gNBId in the NR cell identity (NCI), which uniquely identifies the NCI. For details about the parameter, see 3GPP TS 38.423. This parameter must be planned and the values for all gNodeBs must be the same within a PLMN.

parameters.name: NR Cell ID
parameters.description: Indicates the ID of an NR cell, which uniquely identifies the NR cell within a gNodeB.

parameters.name: Cell Name
parameters.description: Indicates the name of an NR cell.

parameters.name: Cell ID
parameters.description: Indicates the cell ID of an NR cell. A cell ID and a gNodeB ID compose a 3GPP-defined NR Cell Identity (NCI). A 3GPP-defined NCI and a PLMN ID compose an NR cell global identifier (NCGI). For details, see 3GPP TS 38.413.

parameters.name: Frequency Band
parameters.description: Indicates the frequency band in which an NR cell operates. For details, see 3GPP TS 38.104.

parameters.name: Duplex Mode
parameters.description: Indicates the duplex mode of an NR cell. CELL_FDD indicates the FDD mode, and CELL_TDD indicates the TDD mode.

parameters.name: User Label
parameters.description: Indicates the user label of an NR cell.

parameters.name: Cell Activate State
parameters.description: Indicates the activation state of an NR cell.

parameters.name: NR DU Cell ID
parameters.description: Indicates the ID of an NR DU cell, which uniquely identifies the NR DU cell within a gNodeB.

parameters.name: NR DU Cell Name
parameters.description: Indicates the name of an NR DU cell.

parameters.name: Frequency Band
parameters.description: Indicates the frequency band in which an NR DU cell operates. For details, see 3GPP TS 38.104.

parameters.name: Uplink Bandwidth
parameters.description: Indicates the uplink bandwidth of an NR DU cell. For details about this parameter, see 3GPP TS 38.104.

parameters.name: Downlink Bandwidth
parameters.description: Indicates the downlink bandwidth of an NR DU cell. For details, see 3GPP TS 38.104.

parameters.name: Duplex Mode
parameters.description: Indicates the duplex mode of an NR DU cell. The value CELL_FDD indicates the FDD mode, the value CELL_TDD indicates the TDD mode, and the value CELL_SUL indicates the SUL mode.

parameters.name: Cell Radius
parameters.description: Indicates the radius of an NR DU cell, which is the farthest distance that the cell can cover under the condition of keeping certain network performance.

parameters.name: Subcarrier Spacing
parameters.description: Indicates the subcarrier spacing. For details about this parameter, see 3GPP TS 38.331. The default value is 15KHZ for FDD and 30KHZ for TDD.

parameters.name: Cyclic Prefix Length
parameters.description: Indicates the cyclic prefix length of an NR DU cell. A cyclic prefix can be a normal or extended cyclic prefix. An extended cyclic prefix is used in complex environment, for example, with strong multipath effect or long delay. For details, see 3GPP TS 38.211. The current version supports only the normal cyclic prefix.

parameters.name: Cell ID
parameters.description: Indicates the ID of an NR cell. This cell ID and the gNodeB ID compose the 3GPP-defined NR cell ID. The 3GPP-defined NR cell ID and the PLMN ID compose the NR CGI. For details, see 3GPP TS 38.413.

parameters.name: Downlink NARFCN
parameters.description: Indicates the downlink NARFCN of an NR DU cell. For details, see 3GPP TS 38.104.

parameters.name: Physical Cell ID
parameters.description: Indicates the physical cell ID. For details, see 3GPP TS 38.331.

parameters.name: Uplink NARFCN
parameters.description: Indicates the uplink NARFCN of an NR DU cell. The value 0 indicates that the uplink NARFCN is not configured. This parameter is optional when DuplexMode is set to CELL_FDD or CELL_TDD. This parameter is mandatory when DuplexMode is set to CELL_SUL. If DuplexMode is set to CELL_FDD and the uplink NARFCN is not configured, the system calculates the uplink NARFCN based on the default uplink and downl

parameters.name: Slot Assignment
parameters.description: Indicates the slot assignment. This parameter applies only to TDD. The value 4_1_DDDSU indicates that the ratio of downlink timeslots to uplink timeslots is 4:1. The value 8_2_DDDDDDDSUU indicates that the ratio of downlink timeslots to uplink timeslots is single-period 8:2. The value 7_3_DDDSUDDSUU indicates that the ratio of downlink timeslots to uplink timeslots is dual-period 7:3. The value 8_

parameters.name: Slot Structure
parameters.description: Indicates the timeslot structure. This parameter applies only to TDD. SS1: When the ratio of low-frequency downlink timeslots to uplink timeslots is 4:1, the downlink symbols/GPs/uplink symbols in the self-contained timeslot are 11/1/2, and the corresponding parameters are X=2.5 ms, x1=3, x2=11, y2=2, and y1=1. SS2: When the ratio of low-frequency downlink timeslots to uplink timeslots is 4:1, the

parameters.name: NR DU Cell Networking Mode
parameters.description: Indicates the networking mode of an NR DU cell. The value NORMAL_CELL indicates that the cell is a common cell, the value HYPER_CELL indicates that the cell is a hyper cell, and the value HYPER_CELL_COMBINE_MODE indicates that the cell is a combined cell. This parameter applies only to low-frequency TDD cells.

parameters.name: RAN Notification Area ID
parameters.description: Indicates the RAN notification area ID of a cell. This parameter is used for UEs in the RRC_INACTIVE state. This parameter is invalid when being set to 65535.

parameters.name: LampSite Cell Flag
parameters.description: Indicates the LampSite cell flag. If this parameter is set to YES, the cell is a LampSite cell and works with LampSite-specific RF modules. If this parameter is set to NO, the cell is a macro cell and works with RF modules of macro base stations.

parameters.name: Tracking Area ID
parameters.description: Indicates the ID of a tracking area, which uniquely identifies an entry of tracking area information. This parameter is used only within the gNodeB and is not used in the information exchanged with the CN. This parameter is different from the TAI configured in the CN TAL.

parameters.name: TA Offset
parameters.description: Indicates the TA offset, which is used to set the offset of the TA value used by the UE to send uplink data relative to the TA value measured by the gNodeB. The value for FDD NR FR1 can be 25600TC or 0TC and the value for TDD NR FR1 can be 39936TC or 25600TC. For details about the parameter, see 3GPP TS 38.133.

parameters.name: Cell Administration State
parameters.description: Indicates the administrative state of a cell. The setting of this parameter affects the working state of the cell. If this parameter is set to CELL_HIGH_BLOCK, CELL_MID_BLOCK, or CELL_LOW_BLOCK, new UEs are not allowed to access the cell. If there is no RRC_CONNECTED UE in the cell, the cell is deactivated immediately. If the cell is serving RRC_CONNECTED UEs, the base station checks the number of

parameters.name: SSB Period
parameters.description: Indicates the SSB period. For details about this parameter, see 3GPP TS 38.331.

parameters.name: SIB1 Period
parameters.description: Indicates the SIB1 transmission period.

parameters.name: SSB Frequency Position Describe Method
parameters.description: Indicates the description method of the SSB frequency domain position of a cell.

parameters.name: SSB Frequency Position
parameters.description: Indicates the frequency domain location of the cell SSB. When SsbDescMethod is set to SSB_DESC_TYPE_GSCN(Global Synchronization Channel Number), this parameter indicates the global synchronization channel number corresponding to the cell SSB. When SsbDescMethod is set to SSB_DESC_TYPE_NARFCN(Absolute Frequency), this parameter indicates the absolute frequency number corresponding to the cell SSB.

parameters.name: Logical Root Sequence Index
parameters.description: Indicates the index of the start logical root sequence used to generate the cell preamble sequence. Each logical root sequence maps one physical root sequence. For details, see 3GPP TS 38.211.

parameters.name: PRACH Frequency Start Position
parameters.description: Indicates the starting frequency-domain position of PRACH resources relative to the initial BWP. For details, see 3GPP TS 38.321.The values 0 to 272 indicate that the starting frequency-domain position of PRACH equals the parameter value. The value 65535 indicates that the starting frequency-domain position of PRACH is automatically generated. This parameter does not take effect when LTE FDD and N

parameters.name: SIB Config ID
parameters.description: Indicates the ID of a set of system information configuration, including the system information type, system information transmission period, and system information transmission mode.

parameters.name: High Speed Flag
parameters.description: Indicates the speed flag of a cell. Set this parameter to HIGH_SPEED if the cell is used to provide coverage for a high-speed railway. Set this parameter to LOW_SPEED in other scenarios.

parameters.name: SSB Subcarrier Spacing
parameters.description: Indicates the SSB subcarrier spacing. For details about this parameter, see 3GPP TS 38.331.

parameters.name: Supplementary Cell Indicator
parameters.description: Indicates whether a high-frequency cell is a supplementary cell for CA. The value NORMAL_CELL indicates a common cell. The value SUPPLEMENTARY_CELL indicates a supplementary cell, which can serve only as an SCell for CA. A maximum of four NR DU cells of the NORMAL_CELL type and a maximum of four NR DU cells of the SUPPLEMENTARY_CELL type can be configured under the same sector. For an NR DU cell i

parameters.name: SMTC Period
parameters.description: Indicates the intra-frequency SMTC measurement period for an NR cell. For details, see 3GPP TS 38.331.

parameters.name: SMTC Duration
parameters.description: Indicates the intra-frequency SMTC duration for an NR cell. For details, see 3GPP TS 38.331. This parameter applies only to low-frequency TDD and FDD cells.

parameters.name: Additional Frequency Band
parameters.description: Indicates the additional frequency band of a cell. If this parameter is set to NULL, no additional frequency band is configured. For details, see 3GPP TS 38.104.

parameters.name: Transmission Resource ID
parameters.description: Indicates the identity of the transmission resource over the Abis interface.

parameters.id: End Node Object Homing Group ID
parameters.name: End Node Object Homing Group ID
parameters.description: Indicates the identity of an end node object homing group used over the Abis interface. The end node object homing group can be configured by running the ADD EPGROUP command.

parameters.name: User Label
parameters.description: Indicates a user-defined message. Users can add remarks for the Abis interface using this parameter.

parameters.name: Control Port ID
parameters.description: Indicates the ID of a control port for a GBTS function. It is used together with CPBEARID to uniquely identify an Abis control port.

parameters.name: CP Bear No.
parameters.description: Indicates the control port bearing ID used by the GBTS function.

parameters.name: Control Port Bearing Status
parameters.description: Indicates the transmission bearing status of the control port: AVAILABLE and UNAVAILABLE. When this parameter is set to AVAILABLE, the control port can bear control data transmission. When this parameter is set to UNAVAILABLE, the control port cannot bear control data transmission.

parameters.name: GBTS Baseband Resource Identifier
parameters.description: Indicates the identity of a GBTS baseband resource. If the BBWS parameter in the MO of the baseband processing unit is set to GSM, the GBTS automatically creates a GBTSBBRES MO on the board and allocates a unique identity to the MO.

parameters.name: Cabinet Number
parameters.description: Indicates the No. of the cabinet accommodating the baseband processing unit associated to the GBTS baseband resources. The GBTS assigns a value to a GBTSBBRES MO created automatically based on the cabinet number in the MO of the baseband processing unit.

parameters.name: Subrack Number
parameters.description: Indicates the No. of the subrack accommodating the baseband processing unit associated to the GBTS baseband resources. The GBTS assigns a value to a GBTSBBRES MO created automatically based on the subrack number in the MO of the baseband processing unit.

parameters.name: Slot Number
parameters.description: Indicates the No. of the slot accommodating the baseband processing unit associated to the GBTS baseband resources. The GBTS assigns a value to a GBTSBBRES MO created automatically based on the slot number in the MO of the baseband processing unit.

parameters.name: Capacity
parameters.description: Indicates the baseband resource capacity of the baseband processing unit required in GSM mode. The GBTS assigns a value to a GBTSBBRES MO created automatically based on the BBWS parameter in the MO of the baseband processing unit.

parameters.name: Administrative State
parameters.description: Indicates the administration state of GBTS baseband resources: BLOCKED and UNBLOCKED. If this parameter is set to BLOCKED, GSM services cannot be established on the baseband resources. If this parameter is set to UNBLOCKED, GSM services can be established on the baseband resources.

parameters.name: Operational State
parameters.description: Indicates the operating status of GBTS baseband resources: ENABLED and DISABLED. If the BBWS parameter value on a board does not match the board capability, the operating status will be unavailable.

parameters.name: Backup Power Saving Method
parameters.description: Indicates the method of saving the GBTS function backup power. When this parameter is set to BYOFF, the backup power saving function is disabled. When this parameter is set to BYTRX, the GBTS function preferentially shuts down TRXs when the GBTS function experiences a power failure. When this parameter is set to BYPWR, the GBTS function saves the power according to the configured BAKPWRSAVPOLICY w

parameters.name: Backup Power Saving Policy
parameters.description: Indicates the backup power saving policy of a GBTS function. When this parameter is set to BYCOVER, the GBTS function preferentially shuts down TRXs that can be shut down, waits for a certain period specified by SECPHRASESTARTTIME, and then decreases the power of TRXs that are not shut down at an interval specified by DROPPWRINTERVAL. When this parameter is set to BYCAP, the GBTS function preferen

parameters.name: Phase 2 Start Time
parameters.description: If BAKPWRSAVPOLICY is set to BYCAP, this parameter indicates the delay time in disabling TRXs. If BAKPWRSAVPOLICY is set to BYCOVER, this parameter indicates the delay time in reducing TRX power.

parameters.name: Drop Power Time Interval
parameters.description: Indicates the interval at which the power of a TRX is continually decreased.

parameters.name: Power-off Protect Start Time
parameters.description: Indicates the time interval between the time when the GBTS function detects that the external power supply is shut down and the time when the backup power decrease function is started. There is no time delay when this parameter is set to 0.

parameters.name: PA Intelligent Adjust Voltage
parameters.description: Indicates whether the multi-carrier transceiver unit supports the Multi-Carrier Intelligent Voltage Regulation feature. When this parameter is set to YES, the multi-carrier transceiver unit automatically regulates its working voltage according to the power requirements of a service. When this parameter is set to NO, the multi-carrier transceiver unit works at a fixed working voltage.

parameters.name: Shutdown TRX Optimize Switch
parameters.description: Indicates the switch of TRX PA shutdown optimization for backup battery and energy conservation. If this parameter is set to ON and all TRXs on a channel are shut down, the RF PA is shut down to save energy and prolong the power backup period.

parameters.name: GBTS Function Name
parameters.description: Indicates the GBTS function name. This parameter uniquely identifies an instance of a GBTS function.

parameters.name: Application Reference
parameters.description: Indicates the ID referenced by an application object for the GBTS function. This parameter must be consistent with AID in the ADD APP command.

parameters.name: User Label
parameters.description: Indicates a user-defined message. Users can add remarks for the GBTS function using this parameter.

parameters.name: NeRM Version
parameters.description: Indicates the model version of the NE software. For different NE software, if their model definitions are the same, their model versions are also the same. In most cases, a software version uniquely corresponds to a model version. That is, the mapping between a software version and a model version is one-to-one. In few cases, their mapping is many-to-many. For example, the software version has bee

parameters.name: Product Version
parameters.description: Indicates the product version.

parameters.name: GSM Multi-Carrier BTS Standards
parameters.description: Indicates the GSM multi-carrier BTS standards.

parameters.name: Path ID
parameters.description: Indicates the ID of the IP path used by the GBTS function. This parameter uniquely identifies an IP path.

parameters.name: Power Sharing Group ID
parameters.description: Indicates the identity of a power sharing group. It uniquely identifies a power sharing group in a GBTS function.

parameters.name: Power Sharing Type
parameters.description: Indicates the GX power sharing type. The values of this parameter are OFF(Off), GUPWRSHR(GU Power Sharing), and GLPWRSHR(GL Power Sharing). OFF indicates that the multi-mode dynamic power sharing algorithm is disabled. GUPWRSHR indicates that GSM and UMTS dynamic power sharing algorithm is enabled. GLPWRSHR indicates that GSM and LTE dynamic power sharing algorithm is enabled. GX dynamic power sha

parameters.name: Sector Equipment ID 1
parameters.description: Indicates the sector equipment identity 1 for a power sharing group.

parameters.name: Sector Equipment ID 2
parameters.description: Indicates the sector equipment identity 2 for a power sharing group.

parameters.id: Min. Number of GSM Non-BCCH TRXs
parameters.name: Min. Number of GSM Non-BCCH TRXs
parameters.description: Indicates the minimum number of GSM non-BCCH TRXs configured on the sector equipment of the power sharing group during power sharing between GSM and another RAT (UMTS or LTE). Power sharing between GSM and another RAT is allowed only when the number of GSM non-BCCH TRXs on the sector equipment bound to the power sharing group is greater than or equal to the value of this parameter.

parameters.id: GSM Single PA Power Threshold for GX Power Sharing
parameters.name: GSM Single PA Power Threshold for GX Power Sharing
parameters.description: Indicates the allowed maximum power of single RF channel in GSM and UMTS or GSM and LTE power sharing mode. GX power sharing is supported only when the power of single RF channel is lower than the value of this parameter. This ensures that the GSM network quality is not affected.

parameters.id: Power Reserve Coef. Claiming GSM Single PA Power
parameters.name: Power Reserve Coef. Claiming GSM Single PA Power
parameters.description: Indicates the threshold that the GSM network decides to reduce the shared power. When the residual power of the current timeslot of the GSM network is less than the product of PWRSHAREGSMIDLERSVPWR and PWRSHARERSVFACTOR, the GSM network reduces the shared power.

parameters.id: GSM Idle Channel Threshold for GX Power Sharing
parameters.name: GSM Idle Channel Threshold for GX Power Sharing
parameters.description: Determines the number of idle channels for PWRSHAREGSMIDLERSVPWR or PWRSHAREGSMBUSYRSVPWR.

parameters.id: GSM Idle Channel Hysteresis for GX Power Sharing
parameters.name: GSM Idle Channel Hysteresis for GX Power Sharing
parameters.description: Indicates the number of protection idle channels. It is used in parallel with PWRSHAREGSMIDLETH to prevent the system from being handed over frequently between busy and idle status.

parameters.id: GSM Idle Power Reserve for GX Power Sharing
parameters.name: GSM Idle Power Reserve for GX Power Sharing
parameters.description: Indicates the GSM power reserve when the GX power sharing mode is used during off-peak hours. If the number of current idle channels is greater than or equal to the sum of PWRSHAREGSMIDLETH and PWRSHAREGSMIDLEHS, the GSM network has a low traffic load. This parameter can be used to reduce the power reserve and increase the power sharing range. 65535 indicates that no power is reserved.

parameters.id: GSM Busy Power Reserve for GX Power Sharing
parameters.name: GSM Busy Power Reserve for GX Power Sharing
parameters.description: Indicates the GSM power reserve when the GX power sharing mode is used during peak hours. If the number of current idle channels is less than the difference between PWRSHAREGSMIDLETH and PWRSHAREGSMIDLEHS, the GSM network has a high traffic load. This parameter can be used to increase the power reserve and avoid GSM peak clipping. 65535 indicates that no power is reserved.

parameters.id: Max. Shared Power Accepted by Target Network
parameters.name: Max. Shared Power Accepted by Target Network
parameters.description: Indicates the maximum shared power that the target network can accept according to the RF channel power configuration of the target network. The GSM network power shared with the target network cannot exceed the value of this parameter. 65535 indicates that the target network does not support power sharing.

parameters.id: Max. Power Shared by GSM in a Period
parameters.name: Max. Power Shared by GSM in a Period
parameters.description: Indicates the maximum power shared by the GSM network in each period. This prevents the power of the target network from being increased overly fast, which results in a sharp decrease in network coverage. In each GX power sharing period, the power shared by the GSM network must be less than or equal to PWRSHARERCVPWRPD. 65535 indicates that the target network does not support power sharing.

parameters.id: Time for Enabling GX Power Sharing
parameters.name: Time for Enabling GX Power Sharing
parameters.description: Indicates the time when the GU or GL power sharing function needs to be enabled according to the GX traffic distribution on the live network.

parameters.name: Power Sharing Group Status
parameters.description: Indicates the actual status of a power sharing group: UNEFFECTIVE, START, and STOP. UNEFFECTIVE indicates that the current configuration data of the power sharing group does not meet requirements and therefore the power sharing function cannot be performed. START indicates that the power sharing function is being performed. STOP indicates that the power sharing function is disabled or it is not ti

parameters.name: Local Cell ID
parameters.description: Indicates the identity of a local cell. It uniquely identifies a local cell served by a GBTS function.

parameters.name: Baseband Policy
parameters.description: Indicates the policy used by a baseband processing unit serving the local cell. When this parameter is set to EMBEDBBONLY, the local cell can use only the baseband processing unit (BPU) in an RF module. When this parameter is set to BBEQMFST, the local cell preferentially uses the baseband processing unit in the baseband equipment

parameters.name: Baseband Equipment ID
parameters.description: Indicates the ID of the baseband equipment deployed in the local cell. This parameter identifies the physical deployment for the baseband processing unit (BPU) in the local cell. 255 is an invalid value, indicating that the BPU is deployed on the RF module.

parameters.name: User Label
parameters.description: Indicates a user-defined message. Users can add remarks for the local cell using this parameter.

parameters.name: Local Cell Type
parameters.description: Indicates the local cell type. NORMAL_CELL indicates a common cell, and MULTISITE_CELL indicates a multi-site cell.

parameters.name: Baseband Equipment Policy
parameters.description: Indicates the policy used by the baseband equipment serving the local cell. When this parameter is set to ALLBBEQM, the local cell can use only the baseband processing unit in the baseband equipment. When this parameter is set to LOWFREQBBEQMONLY, only low-frequency TRXs (PGSM, EGSM, RGSM, GSM850, and GT810) of the local cell can use the baseband processing unit in the baseband equipment. TRXs at

parameters.name: Local Cell Status
parameters.description: Indicates the state of the local cell: AVAILABLE and UNAVAILABLE. Note: AVAILABLE indicates that the baseband and RF resource of the local cell are normal and can provide services. UNAVAILABLE indicates that the baseband and RF resource of the local cell cannot provide services.

parameters.name: Local Cell Administration Status
parameters.description: Indicates the administration status of a local cell: LOCK and UNLOCK. Note: LOCK indicates that both the local cell and its logical cell are unavailable. MSs that have accessed the logical cell bound to the local cell are forcibly handed over to other normal cells. UNLOCK indicates that the local cell is available.

parameters.name: Cell Index
parameters.description: Indicates the index of the logical cell corresponding to the local cell. If the local cell is not bound to a logical cell, this parameter displays as NULL.

parameters.name: Cell No.
parameters.description: Indicates the number of the logical cell corresponding to the local cell. If the local cell is not bound to a logical cell, this parameter displays as NULL.

parameters.name: Cell Status
parameters.description: Indicates the status of a logical cell: AVAILABLE and UNAVAILABLE. If the local cell is not bound to a logical cell, this parameter displays as NULL. Note: AVAILABLE indicates that the logical cell is normal. UNAVAILABLE indicates that users cannot access the logical cell.

parameters.name: Cell Administration Status
parameters.description: Indicates the administration status of a logical cell: LOCK and UNLOCK. If no logical cell is bound to the local cell, this parameter displays as NULL. Note: LOCK indicates that the logical cell is blocked and unavailable, and MSs that have accessed the cell are forcibly handed over to other normal cells. UNLOCK indicates that the logical cell is available.

parameters.name: Baseband Deployment
parameters.description: Indicates the actual baseband deployment in the local cell. It falls into three types: embedded baseband deployment, baseband equipment deployment and baseband equipment and embedded baseband deployment.

parameters.name: Cell TRX Cooperation Supported
parameters.description: Indicates whether the TRX cooperation has been enabled in the logical cell. The parameter values are YES and NO.

parameters.name: Frequency Band
parameters.description: Indicates the frequency band supported by a cell. A cell supports a maximum of two frequency bands. The frequency bands include PGSM, RGSM, GSM850, DCS1800, PCS1900, and GT810. When a cell supports two frequency bands, use & between the two frequency bands.

parameters.name: Frequency List
parameters.description: Indicates the list of frequencies on which the scan test is started.

parameters.name: Frequency
parameters.description: Indicates the cell frequency list.

parameters.name: Receiving Frequency
parameters.description: Indicates the uplink frequencies of the cell working frequencies. The unit is 0.1MHz.

parameters.name: Sector List
parameters.description: Indicates the sector list for a local cell. When multiple sector IDs are specified, use & between two sector IDs. A maximum of 30 sectors can be configured for a local cell.

parameters.name: Local Cell ID
parameters.description: Indicates the identity of a local cell. It uniquely identifies a local cell served by a GBTS function.

parameters.name: Frequency-based Power Control
parameters.description: Indicates whether to enable the frequency-based power control algorithm. If the frequency spacing between the GSM and UMTS networks is less than or equal to 2.2 MHz, the frequency-based power control algorithm can be enabled to reduce the power on GSM interfering frequencies and therefore reduce the interference on the UMTS network.

parameters.name: Interference Coordination Policy
parameters.description: Indicates the frequency-based power control policy. If this parameter is set to GSM(GSM), the policy preferentially ensures the GSM network quality when minimizing the interference on the UMTS network. If this parameter is set to UMTS(UMTS), the policy preferentially ensures the UMTS network quality.

parameters.id: Max. Power Decrease for GU2.0 MHz Interfering Frequency
parameters.name: Max. Power Decrease for GU2.0 MHz Interfering Frequency
parameters.description: Indicates the maximum power decrease for the GSM interfering frequencies when there is a 2.0 MHz frequency spacing between the GSM and UMTS networks. The related formula is as follows: Expected transmit power of the interfering frequency on the GSM side = Maximum TRX transmit power - GU2000KHZMAXVAL.

parameters.id: Max. Power Decrease for GU2.2 MHz Interfering Frequency
parameters.name: Max. Power Decrease for GU2.2 MHz Interfering Frequency
parameters.description: Indicates the maximum power decrease for the GSM interfering frequencies when there is a 2.2 MHz frequency spacing between the GSM and UMTS networks. The related formula is as follows: Expected transmit power of the interfering frequency on the GSM side = Maximum TRX transmit power - GU2200KHZMAXVAL.

parameters.name: UMTS Center Frequency 1
parameters.description: Indicates the UMTS downlink frequency that has a 2.0 MHz or 2.2 MHz spacing with the frequency in the logical cell bound to the local cell.

parameters.name: UMTS Center Frequency 2
parameters.description: Indicates the UMTS downlink frequency that has a 2.0 MHz or 2.2 MHz spacing with the frequency in the logical cell bound to the local cell. 65535 indicates UMTS center frequency 2 is not used.

parameters.name: Non-AHR Power Compensation Proportion
parameters.description: Indicates the proportion of power compensation on the GSM non-interfering frequencies to the power decrease on the interfering frequencies for EFR, FR, HR, and AMR FR services. When this parameter is set to 0, power compensation is not performed on the GSM non-interfering frequencies.

parameters.name: Non-AHR Power Compensation Offset
parameters.description: Indicates the offset of power compensation for GSM non-interfering frequencies in EFR, FR, HR, and AMR FR services. Power compensation offset for GSM non-interfering frequencies = Power decrease on interfering frequencies x NAHRCOMPCOEFF + NAHRCOMPOFFVAL.

parameters.name: AHR Power Compensation Proportion
parameters.description: Indicates the proportion of power compensation on the non-interfering frequencies on the GSM side to the power decrease on the interfering frequencies for AMR HR services. When this parameter is set to 0, power compensation is not performed on the non-interfering frequencies.

parameters.name: AHR Power Compensation Offset
parameters.description: Indicates the offset of power compensation for the non-interfering frequencies on the GSM side for AMR HR services. Power compensation for non-interfering frequencies on the GSM side = Power decrease on interfering frequencies x AHRCOMPCOEFF + AHRCOMPOFFVAL.

parameters.name: Diversity Transmitter GMSK Delay
parameters.description: Indicates the delay of transmit diversity when GMSK is used. Generally, the parameter is used in general fading environments. The transmit diversity can bring a gain of 3 dB to 5 dB. The fading degrees vary with environments. With a fixed delay, different UEs obtain different gains. In addition, a fixed delay has negative impacts on some EDGE service coding. Therefore, the delay of transmit divers

parameters.name: Diversity Transmitter 8PSK Delay
parameters.description: Indicates the delay of transmit diversity when 8PSK is used. Generally, the parameter is used in general fading environments. The transmit diversity can generally bring a gain of 3 dB to 5 dB. The fading degrees vary with environments. With a fixed delay, different UEs obtain different gains. In addition, a fixed delay has negative impacts on some EDGE service coding. Therefore, the delay of trans

parameters.name: Diversity Transmitter 16QAM Delay
parameters.description: Indicates the delay of transmit diversity when 16QAM is used. Generally, the parameter is used in general fading environments. The transmit diversity can generally bring a gain of 3 dB to 5 dB. The fading degrees vary with environments. With a fixed delay, different UEs obtain different gains. In addition, a fixed delay has negative impacts on some EDGE service coding. Therefore, the delay of tran

parameters.name: Diversity Transmitter 32QAM Delay
parameters.description: Indicates the delay of transmit diversity when 32QAM is used. Generally, the parameter is used in general fading environments. The transmit diversity can generally bring a gain of 3 dB to 5 dB. The fading degrees vary with environments. With a fixed delay, different UEs obtain different gains. In addition, a fixed delay has negative impacts on some EDGE service coding. Therefore, the delay of tran

parameters.name: Dynamic GMSK Delay Adjustment Switch
parameters.description: Indicates Whether to enable dynamic adjustment of the transmit diversity GMSK delay. If this parameter is set to ON, the dynamic change of delay between timeslots is supported. If this parameter is set to OFF, this function is disabled.

parameters.name: Local Cell ID
parameters.description: Indicates the identity of a local cell. It uniquely identifies a local cell served by a GBTS function.

parameters.id: Power Derating for BCCH TRX Non-BCCH TS Allowed
parameters.name: Power Derating for BCCH TRX Non-BCCH TS Allowed
parameters.description: Indicates whether the logical cell bound to the local cell enables the Enhanced BCCH Power Consumption Optimization feature. If this parameter is set to YES, the GBTS function is allowed to decrease the transmitting power of the idle non-BCCH timeslots on the BCCH TRX in the logical cell and to perform power control on occupied non-BCCH timeslots on the BCCH TRX. Consequently, the power of the BCC

parameters.id: Power Derating Start Time for BCCH TRX Non-BCCH TS
parameters.name: Power Derating Start Time for BCCH TRX Non-BCCH TS
parameters.description: Indicates the start time of the transmitting power derating for non-BCCH timeslots on the BCCH TRX.

parameters.id: Power Derating Terminal Time for BCCH TRX Non-BCCH TS
parameters.name: Power Derating Terminal Time for BCCH TRX Non-BCCH TS
parameters.description: Indicates the end time of the transmitting power derating for non-BCCH timeslots on the BCCH TRX.

parameters.id: Power Derating Range for BCCH TRX Non-BCCH TS
parameters.name: Power Derating Range for BCCH TRX Non-BCCH TS
parameters.description: Indicates the derating range of transmitting power for non-BCCH timeslots on the BCCH TRX.

parameters.name: Local Cell ID
parameters.description: Indicates the identity of a local cell. It uniquely identifies a local cell served by a GBTS function.

parameters.id: MultiTRX Brd Stable Channel Monitor Switch
parameters.name: MultiTRX Brd Stable Channel Monitor Switch
parameters.description: Indicates whether a multi-carrier board performs a channel self-check when the board operates in the steady state. When this parameter is set to ON, the board performs a channel self-check. When this parameter is set to OFF, the board does not perform a channel self-check. This parameter is an advanced parameter. To change the parameter settings, ask Huawei Customer Center for help.

parameters.id: MultiTRX Brd Unstable Channel Monitor Switch
parameters.name: MultiTRX Brd Unstable Channel Monitor Switch
parameters.description: Indicates whether a multi-carrier board performs a channel self-check when the board is started. When this parameter is set to ON, the board performs a channel self-check. When this parameter is set to OFF, the board does not perform a channel self-check. This parameter is an advanced parameter. To change the parameter settings, ask Huawei Customer Center for help.

parameters.id: Immediate Assign Message Occupy PCH Opt Switch
parameters.name: Immediate Assign Message Occupy PCH Opt Switch
parameters.description: Indicates whether to enable the optimization of PCH preemption by immediate assignment messages. When this parameter is set to ON, immediate assignment messages can preempt PCHs occupied by paging messages only after the cache time of the immediate assignment messages is longer than or equal to the specified delay. When this parameter is set to OFF, immediate assignment messages can preempt PCHs o

parameters.id: Immediate Assignment Message Occupy PCH Delay
parameters.name: Immediate Assignment Message Occupy PCH Delay
parameters.description: Indicates the delay used for protecting PCHs occupied by paging messages from being preempted by immediate assignment messages. When the cache time of immediate assignment messages is greater than or equal to the value of this parameter, the immediate assignment messages can preempt PCHs occupied by paging messages.

parameters.id: Paging Expire Report Overload Prohibit Switch
parameters.name: Paging Expire Report Overload Prohibit Switch
parameters.description: Indicates whether the BTS sends paging overload messages to the BSC when the paging timer expires. When this parameter is set to ON, the BTS does not send paging overload messages to the BSC upon detecting that the paging timer expires. When this parameter is set to OFF, the BTS sends paging overload messages to the BSC upon detecting that the paging timer expires.

parameters.name: PTCCH Power Optimization Switch
parameters.description: Indicates whether to enable the PTCCH power optimization function. When this parameter is set to ON, no signals are transmitted or received on downlink PTCCHs on non-BCCH TRXs when no services are ongoing. When this parameter is set to OFF, signals are transmitted or received on downlink PTCCHs on non-BCCH TRXs even when no services are ongoing.

parameters.name: First MR Optimization Switch
parameters.description: Indicates whether to enable the first MR optimization function. When this parameter is set to ON, the BSC optimizes the first MR to ensure that the MR reflects the actual measurement result. When this parameter is set to OFF, the BSC does not optimize the first MR. This parameter is an advanced parameter. To change the parameter settings, ask Huawei Customer Center for help.

parameters.name: Speech Delay Optimize Switch
parameters.description: Indicates whether to enable the speech delay optimization function. When this parameter is set to ON, the speech delay optimization function is enabled. In this case, the BTS decreases the size of downlink receive jitter buffer to decrease the E2E delay. When this parameter is set to OFF, the speech delay optimization function is disabled.

parameters.name: Speech Bad Frame Optimize Switch
parameters.description: Indicates whether to enable the speech bad frame optimization function. When this parameter is set to ON, the speech bad frame optimization function is enabled. In this case, the BTS optimizes the method for sending frames on the Um interface when receiving downlink speech bad frames, resolving the noise problem that occurs with a low probability during AMR-WB services. When this parameter is set

parameters.name: Paging Overload Optimization Switch
parameters.description: Indicates whether to enable the paging overload optimization function. When this parameter is set to ON, the paging overload optimization function is enabled. If the congestion is caused by paging for PS services, the BTS only reports PS congestion and does not perform flow control on CS services. When this parameter is set to OFF, the paging overload optimization function is disabled.

parameters.name: RF Module State Detect Switch
parameters.description: Indicates whether the BTS checks the status of RF module components. If this parameter is set to ON, the BTS checks the status of RF module components. If this parameter is set to OFF, the BTS does not check the status of RF module components. This parameter is valid only for MRFU V2 and GRFU V2.

parameters.id: RF Module State Detect PN Threshold
parameters.name: RF Module State Detect PN Threshold
parameters.description: Indicates the phase noise variance threshold for reporting an RF module state detection alarm. If RFMODULESTDETECTSW is set to ON and the phase noise variance is greater than or equal to the value of this parameter, the ALM-26532 RF Unit Hardware Fault alarm is reported. This parameter is valid only when RFMODULESTDETECTSW is set to ON.

parameters.name: No Traffic Self-Healing Switch
parameters.description: Indicates whether the BTS performs self-healing when a no-traffic fault occurs.
