If this parameter is set to ON, the BTS performs self-healing upon a no-traffic fault in the sequence of TRX reconfiguration, RF unit level-2 reset, and RF unit warm reset based on the historical maximum no-traffic duration. If this parameter is set to OFF, the BTS does not perform level-by-level self-healing.

parameters.name: Local Cell ID
parameters.description: Indicates the identity of a local cell. It uniquely identifies a local cell served by a GBTS function.

parameters.name: Abnormal Release Alarm Threshold
parameters.description: Indicates the threshold for reporting an abnormal channel release alarm. If the percentage of the abnormal channel releases exceeds this threshold, the GBTS function reports a radio link failure alarm.

parameters.name: Abnormal Release Alarm Clearing Threshold
parameters.description: Indicates the threshold for clearing the abnormal channel release alarm. If the percentage of the abnormal channel releases is equal to or less than this threshold, the corresponding radio link failure alarm is cleared.

parameters.name: No-traffic Measurement Period
parameters.description: Indicates the measurement period when there is no traffic for TRXs. When the no-traffic measurement period is greater than or equal to the value of this parameter, the GBTS function reports a radio link failure alarm.

parameters.name: Start Time of Alarm Detection
parameters.description: Indicates the time when the GBTS function starts detecting the abnormal channel release and TRX no-traffic duration.

parameters.name: End Time of Alarm Detection
parameters.description: Indicates the time when the GBTS function stops detecting the abnormal channel release and TRX no-traffic duration.

parameters.name: Up Down Balance Threshold
parameters.description: Indicates a proportion of measurement reports for imbalanced uplink and downlink receive levels to the total valid measurement reports. If the actual proportion is greater than or equal to this threshold, the GBTS function reports a radio link failure alarm.

parameters.name: Service Failure Detect Switch
parameters.description: Indicates the switch for detecting a service failure by the GBTS. The causes of service failures include high call drop rate, bad uplink/downlink quality, abnormal activation, and abnormal release. When this switch is set to ON, the service failure detection is enabled on the GBTS. When detecting a service failure caused by high call drop rate or bad uplink/downlink quality, the GBTS reports an al

parameters.id: High Call Drop Rate Fault Detect Threshold
parameters.name: High Call Drop Rate Fault Detect Threshold
parameters.description: Indicates the threshold for detecting a fault alarm due to a high call drop rate. When the call drop rate is greater than this threshold, the GBTS function reports a corresponding radio link failure alarm.

parameters.id: High Call Drop Rate Fault Clear Threshold
parameters.name: High Call Drop Rate Fault Clear Threshold
parameters.description: Indicates the threshold for clearing a high call drop rate alarm. When the call drop rate is smaller than this threshold, the corresponding radio link failure alarm is cleared.

parameters.name: Bad Quality Failure Check Threshold
parameters.description: Indicates the threshold for checking a failure due to bad channel receive quality. When the proportion of bad channel receive quality exceeds this threshold, the GBTS function reports a corresponding radio link failure alarm.

parameters.name: Bad Quality Failure Clear Threshold
parameters.description: Indicates the threshold for clearing the failure alarm due to bad channel receive quality. When the proportion of the number of times when the channel receive quality is poor is smaller than this threshold, the corresponding radio link failure alarm is cleared.

parameters.name: RSSI Unbalanced Alarm Threshold
parameters.description: Indicates the threshold for triggering ALM-26522 RF Unit RX Channel RTWP/RSSI Unbalanced. The value of this parameter is the difference between the receive main and diversity RSSI values for a GSM TRX. If 80% of the difference for GSM TRXs in the uplink occupation state is greater than the value of this parameter, ALM-26522 RF Unit RX Channel RTWP/RSSI Unbalanced is reported. If 80% of the differe

parameters.name: Local Cell ID
parameters.description: Indicates the identity of a local cell. It uniquely identifies a local cell served by a GBTS function.

parameters.name: Reserved Parameter 1
parameters.description: Indicates reserved parameter 1 that is reserved for future requirements. Note on parameter replacement: Reserved parameters are temporarily used in patch versions and will be replaced with new parameters. For example, the ID of a new parameter can signify the parameter function. Therefore, avoid using this parameter.

parameters.name: Reserved Parameter 2
parameters.description: Indicates reserved parameter 2 that is reserved for future requirements. Note on parameter replacement: Reserved parameters are temporarily used in patch versions and will be replaced with new parameters. For example, the ID of a new parameter can signify the parameter function. Therefore, avoid using this parameter.

parameters.name: Reserved Parameter 3
parameters.description: Indicates reserved parameter 3 that is reserved for future requirements. Note on parameter replacement: Reserved parameters are temporarily used in patch versions and will be replaced with new parameters. For example, the ID of a new parameter can signify the parameter function. Therefore, avoid using this parameter.

parameters.name: Reserved Parameter 4
parameters.description: Indicates reserved parameter 4 that is reserved for future requirements. Note on parameter replacement: Reserved parameters are temporarily used in patch versions and will be replaced with new parameters. For example, the ID of a new parameter can signify the parameter function. Therefore, avoid using this parameter.

parameters.name: Reserved Parameter 5
parameters.description: Indicates reserved parameter 5 that is reserved for future requirements. Note on parameter replacement: Reserved parameters are temporarily used in patch versions and will be replaced with new parameters. For example, the ID of a new parameter can signify the parameter function. Therefore, avoid using this parameter.

parameters.name: Reserved Parameter 6
parameters.description: Indicates reserved parameter 6 that is reserved for future requirements. Note on parameter replacement: Reserved parameters are temporarily used in patch versions and will be replaced with new parameters. For example, the ID of a new parameter can signify the parameter function. Therefore, avoid using this parameter.

parameters.name: TRX Group ID
parameters.description: Indicates the identity of a TRX group. It uniquely identifies a TRX group for a GBTS function.

parameters.name: Local Cell ID
parameters.description: Indicates the identity of a local cell. It uniquely identifies a local cell served by a GBTS function.

parameters.name: Sending Mode
parameters.description: Indicates the sending mode of the TRX in the TRX group.

parameters.name: Receiving Mode
parameters.description: Indicates the receiving mode of the TRX group.

parameters.name: Working Mode
parameters.description: Indicates the working mode of a TRX group. If each sector equipment serving the TRX group meets the requirements for the frequency and power of TRXs in the TRX group, this parameter is set to INDEPENDENT. If the bandwidth of the frequency set in the TRX group exceeds the maximum transmitting bandwidth of its serving sector equipment and all sector equipment serving the TRX group need to cooperate

parameters.name: User Label
parameters.description: Indicates a user-defined message. Users can add remarks for the TRX group using this parameter.

parameters.name: TRX Group ID
parameters.description: Indicates the identity of a TRX group. It uniquely identifies a TRX group served by a GBTS function.

parameters.name: Sector Equipment ID
parameters.description: Indicates the identity of sector equipment served by a TRX group.

parameters.name: Maximum Power
parameters.description: Indicates the maximum power provided for the TRX group by the sector equipment which needs to share the antenna system with the logical cell in the same mode provided by other operators. 65535 indicates that the maximum allowed transmitting power provided by the sector equipment.

parameters.name: Serve Type
parameters.description: Indicates the serving type of the sector equipment bound to the TRX group. When this parameter is set to NORMAL, a TRX group is bound to sector equipment. When this parameter is set to AUX, a TRX group is bound to auxiliary sector equipment for power increase.

parameters.name: Adjacent Node ID
parameters.description: Indicates an AAL2 adjacent node ID.

parameters.name: SAAL Link No.
parameters.description: Indicates the SAAL link number of an AAL2 adjacent node.

parameters.name: ATM Address
parameters.description: Indicates the ATM address of an AAL2 adjacent node. The value of this parameter is a 40-character hexadecimal character string with or without the prefix H' or h'. For example, H'3902030405060708090001020304050607080900. The ATM address must begin with 39, 45, 47, or 49 in compliance with the protocol.

parameters.name: AAL2 Node Status
parameters.description: Indicates the status of an AAL2 adjacent node.

parameters.name: SAAL Link No.
parameters.description: Indicates the SAAL link number of an AAL2 node.

parameters.name: ATM Address
parameters.description: Indicates the ATM address of an AAL2 node. The value of this parameter is a string of 40 hexadecimal characters with or without the prefix H' (or h'). For example, this parameter can be set to H'3902030405060708090001020304050607080900 or 3902030405060708090001020304050607080900. The ATM address must begin with 39, 45, 47, or 49 to comply with the protocol.

parameters.name: Node Type
parameters.description: Indicates the type of an AAL2 node. If this parameter is set to LOCAL, the AAL2 node is used to control the local services on the BS. If this parameter is set to HUB, the AAL2 node is used to control services of the lower-level BS cascaded to the hub BS.

parameters.name: Belong Flag
parameters.description: Indicates the type of controller to which an AAL2 node is connected. The controller is either a master controller or a slave controller.

parameters.name: Transport Channel Flag
parameters.description: Indicates the transport channel of an AAL2 node, which can be master or slave.

parameters.name: AAL2 Node State
parameters.description: Indicates the state of an AAL2 node.

parameters.name: Used Status
parameters.description: Indicates whether an AAL2 node is in use.

parameters.name: Path ID
parameters.description: Indicates the number of an AAL2 path.

parameters.name: Cabinet No.
parameters.description: Indicates the number of the cabinet where an AAL2 path is located.

parameters.name: Subrack No.
parameters.description: Indicates the number of the subrack where an AAL2 path is located.

parameters.name: Slot No.
parameters.description: Indicates the number of the slot where an AAL2 path is located.

parameters.name: Bearer Service Type
parameters.description: Indicates the type of the service carried on an AAL2 path. From the perspective of flow control, services carried by an AAL2 path are classified into five categories: the constant bit rate (CBR) service, real-time variable bit rate (RTVBR) service, non-real-time variable bit rate (NRTVBR) service, unspecified bit rate plus (UBR+) service, and unspecified bit rate (UBR) service.

parameters.name: Join Transmission Resource Group
parameters.description: Indicates whether an AAL2 path joins a transmission resource group.

parameters.name: Transmission Resource Group ID
parameters.description: Indicates the number of the transmission resource group to which an AAL2 path is added.

parameters.name: Bearer Port Type
parameters.description: Indicates the type of port on which an AAL2 path is carried.

parameters.name: Bearer Port No.
parameters.description: Indicates the number of the port on which an AAL2 path is carried.

parameters.name: VPI
parameters.description: Indicates the virtual path identifier (VPI) of an AAL2 path.

parameters.name: VCI
parameters.description: Indicates the virtual channel identifier (VCI) of an AAL2 path.

parameters.name: Peak Cell Rate
parameters.description: Indicates the peak cell rate (PCR) of an AAL2 path, which is the maximum cell burst rate supported by the AAL2 path. The value of this parameter is subject to the actual network. Setting the parameter to an improper value affects the service quality.

parameters.name: Sustain Cell Rate
parameters.description: Indicates the Sustainable Cell Rate (SCR) of the AAL2 path. The value of this parameter is subject to the actual network. Setting the parameter to an improper value affects the service quality. The SCR value determines the average rate at which cells are sent over a Variable Bit Rate (VBR) connection.

parameters.name: Min Cell Rate
parameters.description: Indicates the minimum cell rate (MCR) of an AAL2 path. The value of this parameter is subject to the actual network. Setting the parameter to an improper value affects the service quality. The MCR is the minimum cell transmission rate acceptable by the user.

parameters.name: Max Burst Size
parameters.description: Indicates the maximum burst size (MBS). The value of this parameter is subject to the actual network. Setting the parameter to an improper value affects the service quality.

parameters.name: Receive Cell Rate
parameters.description: Indicates the rate at which cells are received. This parameter must be consistent with the TX bandwidth configured on the controller. Otherwise, the RX bandwidth in the flow control algorithm will be inaccurate, affecting flow control.

parameters.name: Cell Delay Variation Tolerance
parameters.description: Indicates the cell delay variation tolerance. The value of this parameter is subject to the actual network. Setting the parameter to an improper value affects the service quality.

parameters.name: Subboard Type
parameters.description: Indicates the type of sub-board on the board where an AAL2 path is established.

parameters.name: Node Type
parameters.description: Indicates the type of an AAL2 path. If the local end node is selected, the AAL2 path is used by local services. If the switching node is selected, the AAL2 path is used to connect to the controller through the hub BS. If the adjacent node is selected, the AAL2 path is used to connect to the lower-level BS through the hub BS.

parameters.name: Adjacent Node ID
parameters.description: Indicates the adjacent node ID of an AAL2 path.

parameters.name: Rate Unit
parameters.description: Indicates the unit of the peak cell rate (PCR), minimum cell rate (MCR), sustainable cell rate (SCR), and receive cell rate (RCR). 1 cell/s is equal to 0.424 kbit/s. If the rate is converted from cell/s to kbit/s, the result value must be rounded down to the nearest integer. For example, 73 cell/s is converted to 30 kbit/s.

parameters.name: User Label
parameters.description: Indicates the user-defined information about an AAL2 path.

parameters.name: AAL2 Path Status
parameters.description: Indicates the status of an AAL2 path.

parameters.name: Cabinet No.
parameters.description: Indicates the number of the cabinet where the AARU is located.

parameters.name: Subrack No.
parameters.description: Indicates the number of the subrack where the AARU is located.

parameters.name: Slot No.
parameters.description: Indicates the slot number of the AARU.

parameters.name: AARU Name
parameters.description: Indicates the AARU name.

parameters.name: Administrative State
parameters.description: Indicates the administrative state of the AARU.The administrative state of the AARU can be blocked, unblocked, or shutting down.

parameters.name: Frequency Min Bandwidth
parameters.description: Indicates the minimum effective bandwidth of the carrier.

parameters.name: Intermediate Frequency Offset
parameters.description: Indicates the intermediate frequency offset of the AARU. This parameter is set during the network planning to avoid the external signal interference around the current received frequency, and accordingly improve the receiver sensitivity of the system.

parameters.name: Number of RX channels
parameters.description: Indicates the number of logical RX channels of the AARU. For details, see AAS Feature Parameter Description.

parameters.name: Number of TX channels
parameters.description: Indicates the number of logical TX channels of the AARU. For details, see AAS Feature Parameter Description.

parameters.name: Logical Switch of TX Channel
parameters.description: Indicates whether to enable TX channels on the AARU, ON indicates that TX channels are enabled and OFF indicates that TX channels are disabled. On the AARU, all TX channels must be simultaneously enabled or disabled.

parameters.name: AARU Work Standard
parameters.description: Indicates the working standard of the AARU.

parameters.name: VRET No.
parameters.description: Indicates the number of a virtual antenna corresponding to the AARU.

parameters.name: Power Supply Group ID
parameters.description: Indicates the ID of a group which consists of one or multiple AARUs served by the same power supply system. This parameter must be set to the same value for AARUs served by the same power supply system. This parameter must be set to different values for AARUs served by different power supply systems.

parameters.name: Max Beam Azimuth
parameters.description: Indicates the maximum horizontal azimuth supported by the virtual antenna subunit corresponding to the AARU.

parameters.name: Min Beam Azimuth
parameters.description: Indicates the minimum horizontal azimuth supported by the virtual antenna subunit corresponding to the AARU.

parameters.name: Max Beam Width
parameters.description: Indicates the maximum horizontal beamwidth supported by the virtual antenna subunit corresponding to the AARU.

parameters.name: Min Beam Width
parameters.description: Indicates the minimum horizontal beamwidth supported by the virtual antenna subunit corresponding to the AARU.

parameters.name: Max Tilt
parameters.description: Indicates the maximum tilt supported by the virtual antenna subunit corresponding to the AARU.

parameters.name: Min Tilt
parameters.description: Indicates the minimum tilt supported by the virtual antenna subunit corresponding to the AARU.

parameters.name: Max Tilt Difference Between Carriers
parameters.description: Indicates the maximum tilt difference between carriers supported by the virtual antenna subunit corresponding to the AARU.

parameters.id: The length of the fiber optic cable between the BBU and RF module
parameters.name: The length of the fiber optic cable between the BBU and RF module
parameters.description: Indicates the length of the fiber optic cable between the BBU and RF module. When the RF module works in cold backup mode, the parameter indicates the length of the fiber optic cable that carries RF data. When the RF module works in hot backup or load sharing mode, there are two fiber optic cables between the BBU and RF module, and the parameter indicates the length of the shorter one. The paramet

parameters.name: Cabinet No.
parameters.description: Indicates the number of the cabinet where the AAS is located.

parameters.name: Subrack No.
parameters.description: Indicates the number of the subrack where the AAS is located.

parameters.name: AAS Name
parameters.description: Indicates the AAS name.

parameters.name: AAU Specification
parameters.description: Indicates the type of an AAS. This parameter must be set to the hardware type of the AAS. After this parameter is specified, the MAE-Deployment checks the configurations of power, carrier, and receive and transmit capabilities based on the value of this parameter. This ensures that these configurations are correct before they take effect. If the user does not need to forcibly verify the AAS specif

parameters.name: Location Name
parameters.description: Indicates the location information of an AAS. Set this parameter to the location name of the site. The location name of the site is configured in the Location object. LocationName must be set to the same value for RF modules serving the same sector.

parameters.name: Access Direction
parameters.description: Indicates the access direction of the services.

parameters.name: ACL ID
parameters.description: Indicates the ID of the access control list (ACL) to which an access control rule belongs. An ACL rule with an ACL ID ranging from 3000 to 3999 indicates a high-level rule based on the layer 3 and layer 4 information configured by users. An ACL rule with an ACL ID ranging from 4000 to 4999 indicates a layer 2 rule based on the MAC layer information configured by users. An ACL rule with an ACL ID r

parameters.name: VRF Index
parameters.description: Indicates the index of a VRF instance. UMTS currently supports the default routing domain only (the VRF index is 0).

parameters.name: Description
parameters.description: Indicates the brief description of an ACL.

parameters.name: Control Mode
parameters.description: Indicates whether an object can be modified or deleted by the system. The value MANUAL_MODE means that only users can modify or delete the object. The value AUTO_MODE means only the system can modify or delete the object.

parameters.name: Auto Config Flag
parameters.description: Indicates whether an object is created by the system. The value MANUAL_CREATED means that the object is manually configured by users. The value AUTO_CREATED means that the object is created by the system.

parameters.name: Number of ACL Rules
parameters.description: Indicates the number of rules in the ACL.

parameters.name: Maximum ACL Rule ID
parameters.description: Indicates the largest rule ID in the ACL. This parameter takes effect only when the number of rules in an ACL is greater than 0.

parameters.name: Minimum ACL Rule ID

parameters.name: Destination Port 2

parameters.name: DSCP

parameters.name: Control Mode
parameters.description: Indicates whether an object can be modified or deleted by the system. The value MANUAL_MODE means that only the user can modify or delete the object. The value AUTO_MODE means only the system can modify or delete the object.

parameters.name: VLAN ID Operate
parameters.description: Indicates the filter criteria for VLAN IDs. This parameter is valid only when the ACL ID ranges from 4000 to 4999. When this parameter is set to OP_EQ, only the VLAN ID specified by VLANID1 is a valid. When this parameter is set to OP_RANGE, all the VLAN IDs within the range of VLANID1 to VLANID2 are valid. When this parameter is set to OP_NOVLAN, only packets without VLAN tags are valid.

parameters.name: VLAN ID 1

parameters.name: VLAN ID 2
parameters.description: Indicates the ID of a VLAN to which service data belongs. When Source Port Operate is set to OP_RANGE, this parameter specifies the largest ID of the matching VLANs. This parameter is valid only when Source Port Operate is set to OP_RANGE.

parameters.name: Auto Config Flag
parameters.description: Indicates whether the object is created by the system. MANUAL_CREATED means that the object is configured by the user manually. AUTO_CREATED means that the object is created by the system.

parameters.description: Indicates the alarm level. This parameter specifies whether alarms generated by the sensor over the port are in high or low voltage. The alarm level is set according to the type of external sensor. This parameter is valid only if the port switch is turned on.

parameters.name: Sensor Type
parameters.description: Indicates the sensor type. The user can set the sensor type to current type or voltage type according to the actual external sensor.

parameters.name: Sensor Measurement Upper Limit
parameters.description: Indicates the measurement upper limit of the analog port. The range is set based on the actual situations such as the temperature and humidity. The temperature is measured in the unit of degree Celsius, the voltage is measured in the unit of volt, and the current is measured in the unit of milliampere.

parameters.name: Sensor Measurement Lower Limit
parameters.description: Indicates the measurement lower limit of the analog port. The range is set based on the actual situations such as the temperature and humidity. The temperature is measured in the unit of degree Celsius, the voltage is measured in the unit of volt, and the current is measured in the unit of milliampere.

parameters.name: Sensor Output Upper Limit
parameters.description: Indicates the upper limit of the output signals from the analog port. For sensors of either the current type or voltage type, the upper limit should be set according to the specifications of the sensor.

parameters.name: Sensor Output Lower Limit
parameters.description: Indicates the lower limit of the output signals from the analog port. For sensors of either the current type or voltage type, the lower limit should be set according to the specifications of the sensor.

parameters.name: Detection Period
parameters.description: Indicates the alarm detecting period of an environment signal input port. When this parameter is set to 255, the default alarm detecting period is used.

For the RRU that works in TDD or FDD mode and has eight channels to be connected to the antenna, the service channels are ANT1 to ANT8 and the corresponding ports on the antenna are R0A to R0H. For other RRUs/RFUs, the service channels are numbered from ANT0 and the corresponding port on the antenna is R0A.

parameters.name: Installation Type
parameters.description: Indicates the installation type of battery. This parameter can be set to INNER or OUTER. The value INNER indicates that batteries are installed in a power cabinet. The value OUTER indicates that batteries are installed in a standalone battery cabinet. For lithium batteries, this parameter is set to INNER. For lead-acid batteries, this parameter can be set to either INNER or OUTER, depending on the

parameters.name: Boost-Charging Duration
parameters.description: Indicates the scheduled boost charging interval. Batteries are boost-charged at this interval (in the unit of day), which keeps the batteries fully charged. This parameter is configured according to the instructions provided by manufacturers.

parameters.name: Boost-Charging Voltage
parameters.description: Indicates the boost charging voltage. Boost charge is used to quickly recover the capacity of batteries. During the boost charge, the charging voltage is relatively high. After the batteries are discharged, the system automatically starts boost charge on the batteries. This parameter is configured according to the instructions provided by manufacturers.

parameters.name: Battery 1 Capacity
parameters.description: Indicates the capacity of battery 1. This parameter should be set according to the actual situation. Incorrect configuration may reduce the life span of the battery.

parameters.name: Battery Current Limiting Coefficient
parameters.description: Indicates the battery charging current limiting coefficient. Charging coefficient x Storage capacity = Maximum charging current. When the charging current is not smaller than the maximum charging current plus 5 A, an ALM-25625 Battery Current Abnormal alarm is reported. This parameter is configured according to the instructions provided by manufacturers.

parameters.name: Float-Charging Voltage
parameters.description: Indicates the floating charging voltage. Floating charge is used to compensate for the power loss of the batteries due to self-discharge. The floating charging voltage is lower than the boost charging voltage. This parameter is configured according to the instructions provided by manufacturers.

parameters.name: High Temperature Shutdown Flag
parameters.description: Indicates whether to enable battery disconnection against high temperature.

parameters.name: Shutdown Temperature
parameters.description: Indicates the temperature above which the battery is powered off automatically under the condition that HtempShutdownFlg is enabled.

parameters.name: Low Voltage Shutdown Flag
parameters.description: Indicates whether to enable battery power-off against low voltage.

parameters.name: Shutdown Voltage
parameters.description: Indicates the voltage below which the battery is powered off automatically under the condition that low voltage shutdown flag is enabled.

parameters.name: Temperature Compensation Coefficient
parameters.description: Indicates the increased or reduced charging voltage of every battery when the ambient temperature is 1 degree Celsius (2 degree Fahrenheit) higher or lower than the standard temperature specified by manufacturers. This parameter should be set according to the instructions provided by manufacturers.

parameters.name: Temperature Alarm Lower Threshold
parameters.description: Indicates the lower limit of the temperature alarm. When the storage battery temperature is below the lower limit, ALM-25654 Battery Temperature Unacceptable is reported.

parameters.name: Temperature Alarm Upper Threshold
parameters.description: Indicates the upper limit of the temperature alarm. When the storage battery temperature exceeds the upper limit, ALM-25654 Battery Temperature Unacceptable is reported.

parameters.name: Number Of Battery Groups
parameters.description: Indicates the number of battery groups.

parameters.name: Battery Type
parameters.description: Indicates the type of the battery.

parameters.name: Battery 2 Capacity
parameters.description: Indicates the capacity of battery 2. This parameter should be set according to the actual situation. Incorrect configuration may reduce the life span of the battery.

parameters.name: Number Of Lithium Batteries
parameters.description: Indicates the number of lithium batteries in a PMU.

parameters.name: Power Cut Times
parameters.description: Indicates the number of times that the Mains Input is powered off.

parameters.id: Charge Times In Half an Hour
parameters.name: Charge Times In Half an Hour
parameters.description: Indicates the number of times that the battery is charged in half an hour.

parameters.name: Charge Times In 1 Hour
parameters.description: Indicates the number of times that the battery is charged when the battery is charged for more than half an hour and less than one hour or for one hour.

parameters.name: Charge Times In 2 Hours
parameters.description: Indicates the number of times that the battery is charged when the battery is charged for more than one hour and less than two hours or for two hours.

parameters.name: Charge Times In 3 Hours
parameters.description: Indicates the number of times that the battery is charged when the battery is charged for more than two hours and less than three hours or for three hours.

parameters.name: Charge Times In 4 Hours
parameters.description: Indicates the number of times that the battery is charged when the battery is charged for more than three hours and less than four hours or for four hours.

parameters.name: Charge Times In 5 Hours
parameters.description: Indicates the number of times that the battery is charged when the battery is charged for more than four hours and less than five hours or for five hours.

parameters.name: Charge Times In 6 Hours
parameters.description: Indicates the number of times that the battery is charged when the battery is charged for more than five hours and less than six hours or for six hours.

parameters.name: Charge Times In 7 Hours
parameters.description: Indicates the number of times that the battery is charged when the battery is charged for more than six hours and less than seven hours or for seven hours.

parameters.name: Charge Times In 8 Hours
parameters.description: Indicates the number of times that the battery is charged when the battery is charged for more than seven hours and less than eight hours or for eight hours.

parameters.id: Charge Times In More than 8 Hours
parameters.name: Charge Times In More than 8 Hours
parameters.description: Indicates the number of times that the battery is charged in more than eight hours.

parameters.id: Discharge Times In Half an Hour
parameters.name: Discharge Times In Half an Hour
parameters.description: Indicates the number of times that the battery is discharged in half an hour.

parameters.name: Discharge Times In 1 Hour
parameters.description: Indicates the number of times that the battery is discharged when the battery is discharged for more than half an hour and less than one hour or for one hour.

parameters.name: Discharge Times In 2 Hours
parameters.description: Indicates the number of times that the battery is discharged when the battery is discharged for more than one hour and less than two hours or for two hours.

parameters.name: Discharge Times In 3 Hours
parameters.description: Indicates the number of times that the battery is discharged when the battery is discharged for more than two hours and less than three hours or for three hours.

parameters.name: Discharge Times In 4 Hours
parameters.description: Indicates the number of times that the battery is discharged when the battery is discharged for more than three hours and less than four hours or for four hours.

parameters.name: Discharge Times In 5 Hours
parameters.description: Indicates the number of times that the battery is discharged when the battery is discharged for more than four hours and less than five hours or for five hours.

parameters.name: Discharge Times In 6 Hours
parameters.description: Indicates the number of times that the battery is discharged when the battery is discharged for more than five hours and less than six hours or for six hours.

parameters.name: Discharge Times In 7 Hours
parameters.description: Indicates the number of times that the battery is discharged when the battery is discharged for more than six hours and less than seven hours or for seven hours.

parameters.name: Discharge Times In 8 Hours
parameters.description: Indicates the number of times that the battery is discharged when the battery is discharged for more than seven hours and less than eight hours or for eight hours.

parameters.id: Discharge Times In More than 8 Hours
parameters.name: Discharge Times In More than 8 Hours
parameters.description: Indicates the number of times that the battery is discharged in more than eight hours.

parameters.name: Installation Date
parameters.description: Indicates the date when the battery is installed. The scheduled tests for the battery are dependent on the installation date.

parameters.name: Lithium Battery Rated Capacity
parameters.description: Indicates the capacity that all lithium batteries in a PMU can discharge under a specified condition, such as the specified temperature, discharge rate, or end voltage.

parameters.name: Lithium Battery Efficiency
parameters.description: Indicates the ratios of charge capacity to rated capacity of lithium batteries that are fully charged.

parameters.name: Cabinet No.
parameters.description: Indicates the cabinet number of the baseband processing board.

parameters.name: Subrack No.
parameters.description: Indicates the subrack number of the baseband processing board.

parameters.name: Slot No.
parameters.description: Indicates the slot number of the baseband processing board. Baseband processing boards can be configured only in slots 0 to 5 and the multimode digital unit can be configured only in slot 6.

parameters.name: Board Type
parameters.description: Indicates the type of the board.

parameters.name: Board Overload Alarm Report Threshold
parameters.description: Indicates the threshold for reporting the board overload alarm. If the usage of the processing chip on the board is greater than or equal to this parameter value, ALM-26202 Board Overload is reported.

parameters.name: Board Overload Alarm Clear Threshold
parameters.description: Indicates the threshold for clearing the board overload alarm. If the usage of the processing chip on the board is less than this parameter value, ALM-26202 Board Overload is cleared.

parameters.name: Work Mode
parameters.description: Indicates the working mode of the baseband processing board. There are sixteen working modes: FDD, TDD, HYBRID, TDD_ENHANCE, TDD_8T8R, TDD_TL, FDD_ATG, FDD_NBIOT, NBIOT, FDD_NBIOT_ENHANCE , FDD_NBIOT_CUSTOM, NORMAL, HYBRID_BALANCE, HYBRID_MMCELL_ENHANCE, HYBRID_NORMALCELL_ENHANCE, SPEC_MODE1. The Frequency Division Duplex (FDD) mode carries the traditional voice and data services. TDD is short for

parameters.name: Administrative State
parameters.description: Indicates the administrative state of the board. The administrative state of the board can be blocked, unblocked, or shutting down. This parameter is valid only for baseband processing boards and RF modules, and the value of this parameter is NULL for all other types of boards.

parameters.id: Duration of the shutting down state
parameters.name: Duration of the shutting down state
parameters.description: Indicates the scheduled duration before a board is blocked.

parameters.name: Block Type
parameters.description: Indicates the block type of the board. IMMEDIATE(Immediate) means that the board is blocked and services carried on the board are interrupted immediately after the command is executed. SHUTDOWN(Shutdown) means that the board is blocked when no service is carried on the board. DELAY(Delay) means that the board is blocked when no service is carried on the board or after the time specified by the Dur

parameters.name: Hardware Capacity Enhance
parameters.description: Indicates the hardware capabilities of the baseband processing board. For a WBBP, NORMAL indicates basic hardware capabilities, and FULL indicates full hardware capabilities. For a UBBP, NORMAL indicates basic hardware capabilities, PARTIAL indicates partial hardware capabilities, and FULL indicates full hardware capabilities. This parameter takes effect only for UMTS.

parameters.name: CPRI Extension
parameters.description: Indicates the CPRI extension switch of a BBP. This parameter takes effect only on LBBPd(excluding LBBPd5) boards.

parameters.name: Board Specification
parameters.description: Indicates the type of a board. If the user does not need to forcibly verify the board specifications using the MAE-Deployment, this parameter can be left unspecified. Leaving this parameter unspecified has no impact on the base station. If the user needs to forcibly verify the board specifications using the MAE-Deployment, this parameter must be set to the hardware type of the board. For example,

parameters.name: Cell Channel Number Extension
parameters.description: Indicates the cell channel number extension switch. When this parameter is set to ON, more cell channels are supported and the distance between channels decreases. Only the UBBP supports this parameter and it takes effect only to the UBBPd9 or UBBPdc. In addition, the UBBPd9 or UBBPdc is reset after this parameter is modified. The parameter takes effect only in LTE.

parameters.name: Base Band Work Standard
parameters.description: Indicates the modes for which the UBBP, LCOP, UMDU or UBBP-W provides baseband processing resources. If the UBBP, UMDU or UBBP-W provides only CPRI ports for a mode, you do not need to select this mode for the UBBP, UMDU or UBBP-W.

parameters.name: Standard Ratio
parameters.description: Indicates the resource ratio of each mode. Currently, only UBBP boards support this parameter. If other baseband processing boards are used, this parameter is invalid. When the Working Standard parameter of a UBBP is set to multiple modes the Standard Ratio parameter is set to FDD_ENHANCE(FDD Enhance), TDD_ENHANCE(TDD Enhance), NBIOT_ENHANCE(NB-IoT Enhance), or NR_ENHANCE(NR Enhance), compared wit

parameters.name: CPRI Extension Mode
parameters.description: Indicates the CPRI extension mode. If this parameter is set to FRONTPANELEXTENSION, the transmission capability of a single fiber optic cable is enhanced. If this parameter is set to BACKPANELEXTENSION, the forwarding capability of the backplane is enhanced. This parameter takes effect only for LBBPd(excluding LBBPd5) boards. The value FRONTPANELEXTENSION can take effect for a board in any of slot

parameters.name: CPRI Interface Type
parameters.description: When this parameter is set to CPRI_SFP, the port type is CPRI and the port is interconnected to the SFP module. If this parameter is set to XCI_QSFP, the port type is XCI and the port is interconnected to the QSFP module. parameters.name: LTE Flexible Specification Switch
parameters.description: Indicates whether the specifications for LTE FDD and LTE TDD cells supported by a baseband processing board can be flexibly adjusted. When this switch is turned on, the RAT resource proportion can be flexibly allocated. In this case, a cell must be bound to a baseband processing board. parameters.name: BBP Capacity
parameters.description: Indicates the BBP capability. If NULL is displayed, the BBP capability fails to be queried.

parameters.name: Alarm Status(from RU)
parameters.description: Indicates the alarm status of the board hardware, which can be set to Normal, Warning, Minor, Major, or Critical. The alarm status of the PSU, PDB, and BDU is in the alarm status of the PMU.

parameters.name: Operational State(from RU)
parameters.description: Indicates the operational state of the board, which can be set to Enabled or Disabled. Enabled indicates that services can be carried on the board. Disabled indicates that no service can be carried on the board.

parameters.name: Availability Status(from RU)
parameters.description: Indicates the physical status of a board, which can be Uninstalled, Starting up, Normal, Inconsistent, Unconfigured, Power off, Fault, Communication lost, In test, or the combination of multiple states. parameters.name: Electronic Label(from RU)
parameters.description: Indicates the electronic label, which is a text file with a maximum of 2 KB used to record the manufacturing information about equipment such as the board, sub-board, and optical module. "BoardType" indicates the type of the board. "BarCode" indicates the bar code of the board and is the same as the code labeled on the board. "Item" indicates the BOM code. parameters.description: Indicates the type of the board or the cabinet.

parameters.name: Serial Number(from RU)

parameters.description: Indicates the description about the services and functions provided by the board or the cabinet.

parameters.name: Date of Manufacture(from RU)
parameters.description: Indicates the manufacturing date of the board or the cabinet.

parameters.name: Vendor(from RU)

parameters.name: Issue Number(from RU)

parameters.name: Config Type(from RU)

parameters.name: Board Temperature(from RU)
parameters.description: Indicates the temperature of a board.

parameters.name: HPA Temperature(from RU)
parameters.description: Indicates the temperature of the power amplifier. A power amplifier is a component on an RF module. If there is no power amplifier on an RF module, this parameter value is NULL.

parameters.name: DEVTYPE(from RU)
parameters.description: Indicates the type of the device.

parameters.name: Software Version(from RU)
parameters.description: Indicates the software version of the board.

parameters.name: Hardware Version(from RU)
parameters.description: Indicates the hardware version of the board.

parameters.name: BootROM Version(from RU)
parameters.description: Indicates the BootROM version of the board.

parameters.description: Indicates the working mode of the board. the value SINGLEOM indicates that the GTMU works as the main control board and provides the main control, transmission, and RF port functions. The value EVOLUTION indicates that the GTMU works as the evolved board and provides the transmission and RF port functions. parameters.name: Cabinet No.
parameters.description: Indicates the number of the cabinet where the BDU is located.

parameters.name: Subrack No.
parameters.description: Indicates the number of the subrack where the BDU is located.

parameters.name: Slot No.
parameters.description: Indicates the number of the slot where the BDU is located.

parameters.name: BDU Type
parameters.description: Indicates the device type of the BDU. If this parameter is set to DEFAULT, the system does not check the consistency between the configuration type and the physical type of the device. The device runs according to the actual type. If this parameter is set to SDU, HSU, or BDU, the system checks whether the type of the SDU, HSU or BDU in use is consistent with the configuration.

parameters.name: Voltage Adjustment Mode
parameters.description: Indicates the voltage adjustment mode of the SDU. The value ADAPTIVE indicates that the system adaptively adjusts the output voltage based on the actual load of the system. The value FIXED indicates that the output voltage is always 57 V.

parameters.name: Running Status
parameters.description: Indicates the running status of the BDU.

parameters.name: BDURunType
parameters.description: Indicates the type of the BDU in use. The value NULL indicates that the type of the BDU in use cannot be obtained.

parameters.name: Output Current
parameters.description: Indicates the output current of the BDU. When the value of BDURunType is BDU, the value NULL is displayed for this parameter.

parameters.name: PCB Version
parameters.description: Indicates the PCB version of the BDU.

parameters.name: EPLD Version
parameters.description: Indicates the erasable programmable logic device (EPLD) version of the BDU.

parameters.name: Output Voltage
parameters.description: Indicates the output voltage of the BDU. When the output voltage is displayed by port, for example, 0:570 and 1:570, the number before the colon (:) indicates the output port number, and the number after the colon indicates the output voltage (0.1 V) of the port.

parameters.name: Beam Cell Group ID
parameters.description: Indicates the ID of beam cell group.

parameters.name: Beam Cell Group Type
parameters.description: Indicates the type of beam cell group.

parameters.name: Beam Option Period
parameters.description: Indicates the beam selection period.

parameters.name: Beam Cell Group ID
parameters.description: Indicates the ID of beam cell group.

parameters.name: Local Cell ID
parameters.description: Indicates the ID of local cell in a beam cell group.

parameters.name: Beam Azimuth
parameters.description: Indicates the beam azimuth of a local cell in a beam cell group. When this parameter is set to LEFT(left), the cell coverage direction is relatively left to the beam azimuth of the antennas, and the cell can only select the four predefined left beams in Massive Beam 8T8R scenarios and use the left beam of two predefined beams in Massive Beam 4T4R scenarios. When this parameter is set to RIGHT(Righ

parameters.name: Beam Option Mode
parameters.description: Indicates the beam selection mode of a local cell in a beam cell group.

parameters.name: Session ID
parameters.description: Indicates the ID of a BFD.

parameters.name: VRF Index
parameters.description: Indicates the index of a VRF instance. UMTS currently supports the default routing domain only (the VRF index is 0).

parameters.name: Source IP
parameters.description: Indicates the source IP address of a BFD. The source IP address of a BFD must be a device IP address of a specified board (for example, the IP address of an Ethernet port or a port that carries a PPP link or MP group) or a logical IP address (for example, the IP address of a loopback port), but cannot be set to the same value as the IP address of a remote maintenance channel or a negotiated IP add

parameters.name: Destination IP
parameters.description: Indicates the destination IP address of a BFD. The destination IP address must be a valid IP address, and cannot be set to 0.0.0.0 or any existing IP addresses in the system. If Virtual Router Redundancy Protocol (VRRP) is used in the network, two BFDs must be configured with the destination IP addresses set to the active and standby physical IP addresses of the virtual router, respectively.

parameters.name: My Discriminator
parameters.description: Indicates the local discriminator of a BFD session. The local discriminator must be the same as the peer discriminator.

parameters.name: Hop Type
parameters.description: Indicates the hop type of a BFD. The single-hop BFD is used to perform point-to-point detection at the data link layer, and often used in layer 2 networking scenarios. The multi-hop BFD is used to perform end-to-end connectivity checks at the transport layer, and often used in layer 3 networking scenarios.

parameters.name: Min TX Interval
parameters.description: Indicates the minimum interval at which a BFD transmits control packets.

parameters.name: Min RX Interval
parameters.description: Indicates the minimum interval at which a BFD receives control packets.

parameters.name: Detection Multiplier
parameters.description: Indicates the detection multiplier of a BFD.

parameters.name: Session Catalog
parameters.description: Indicates the type of a BFD. If this parameter is set to MAINTENANCE, this BFD is used only for continuity check (CC). If this parameter is set to RELIABILITY, the BFD is used to trigger route interlock. Route interlock enables the standby route to take over once the active route becomes faulty, and therefore prevents service interruption caused by route failures.

parameters.name: DSCP
parameters.description: Indicates the Differentiated Services Code Point (DSCP). The priority has a positive correlation with the value of this parameter.

parameters.name: Protocol Version
parameters.description: Indicates the protocol version of a BFD session.

parameters.name: BFD Authentication Switch
parameters.description: Indicates whether a BFD supports BFD authentication. You are advised to enable the BFD Authentication Switch.

parameters.name: BFD Authentication Algorithm
parameters.description: Indicates the algorithm used during BFD authentication.

parameters.name: BFD Authentication Key Chain ID
parameters.description: Indicates the ID of a configured BFD key chain.

parameters.name: Cabinet No.
parameters.description: Indicates the cabinet No. to which a BFD belongs.

parameters.name: Subrack No.
parameters.description: Indicates the subrack No. to which a BFD belongs.

parameters.name: Slot No.
parameters.description: Indicates the slot No. to which a BFD belongs.

parameters.name: Session State
parameters.description: Indicates the state of a BFD.

parameters.name: Active Detecting Mode
parameters.description: Indicates the effective detection mode through negotiation.

parameters.name: Active Minimum Tx Interval
parameters.description: Indicates the effective minimum TX interval through negotiation.

parameters.name: Active Minimum Rx Interval
parameters.description: Indicates the effective minimum RX interval through negotiation.

parameters.name: Active Detection Time
parameters.description: Indicates the detection time when the negotiation takes effect.

parameters.name: Your Discriminator
parameters.description: Indicates the peer discriminator of a BFD.

parameters.name: Number of Transmit PDUs
parameters.description: Indicates the number of transmitted packets of a BFD.

parameters.name: Number of Receive PDUs
parameters.description: Indicates the number of received packets of a BFD.

parameters.name: Number of Up-to-Down Sessions
parameters.description: Indicates the number of times of up-to-down detected by a BFD.

parameters.name: Session Diagnosis
parameters.description: Indicates the diagnostic field of a BFD, that is, the cause of the latest failure.

parameters.id: Discard Pkt Qty for One-Way Authenticate
parameters.name: Discard Pkt Qty for One-Way Authenticate
parameters.description: Indicates the number of packets discarded due to unidirectional BFD authentication.

parameters.id: Discard Pkt Qty for Authenticate Type Mismatch
parameters.name: Discard Pkt Qty for Authenticate Type Mismatch
parameters.description: Indicates the number of packets discarded due to authentication type inconsistency during BFD authentication.

parameters.id: Discard Pkt Qty for Invalid Packet Sequence No.
parameters.name: Discard Pkt Qty for Invalid Packet Sequence No.
parameters.description: Indicates the number of packets discarded because the sequence number is invalid in BFD authentication packets.

parameters.id: Discard Pkt Qty for Packet Length Mismatch
parameters.name: Discard Pkt Qty for Packet Length Mismatch
parameters.description: Indicates the number of packets discarded due to key length inconsistency during BFD authentication.

parameters.id: Discard Pkt Qty for Key ID Mismatch
parameters.name: Discard Pkt Qty for Key ID Mismatch
parameters.description: Indicates the number of packets discarded because the key indexes do not match between the two ends during BFD authentication.

parameters.id: Discard Pkt Qty for Abstract or Hash Fail
parameters.name: Discard Pkt Qty for Abstract or Hash Fail
parameters.description: Indicates the number of packets discarded because the BFD authentication digest check or Hash algorithm execution fails.

parameters.name: BFD Authentication Key Chain ID
parameters.description: Indicates the ID of a configured BFD key chain.

parameters.name: KEY Identity
parameters.description: Indicates the index of a key in a BFD key chain, which must be consistent with the index of the key at the peer end.

parameters.name: KEY String
parameters.description: Indicates the key settings in a BFD key chain, which must be consistent with the key settings at the peer end.

parameters.name: BFD Authentication Key Chain ID
parameters.description: Indicates the ID of a configured BFD key chain.

parameters.name: Key Chain Description
parameters.description: Indicates the description of a BFD key chain.

parameters.description: Indicates the subrack No. to which a BFD session belongs.

parameters.description: Indicates the ID of a BFD session. The session ID plus 1 is the local discriminator of the BFD session. The local discriminator must be consistent with the configuration at the peer end.
