parameters.description: Indicates the destination IP address of a BFD session. The destination IP address must be a valid IP address, and cannot be set to 0.0.0.0 or any existing IP addresses in the system. If Virtual Router Redundancy Protocol (VRRP) is used in the network, two BFD sessions must be configured with the destination IP addresses set to the active and standby physical IP addresses of the virtual router, res

parameters.name: Hop Type
parameters.description: Indicates the hop type of a BFD session. The single-hop BFD session is used to perform point-to-point detection at the data link layer, and often used in layer 2 networking scenarios. The multi-hop BFD session is used to perform end-to-end connectivity checks at the transport layer, and often used in layer 3 networking scenarios.

parameters.name: Min TX Interval
parameters.description: Indicates the minimum interval at which a BFD session transmits control packets.

parameters.name: Min RX Interval
parameters.description: Indicates the minimum interval at which a BFD session receives control packets.

parameters.name: Detection Multiplier
parameters.description: Indicates the detection multiplier of a BFD session.

parameters.name: Session Catalog
parameters.description: Indicates the type of a BFD session. If this parameter is set to MAINTENANCE, this BFD session is used only for continuity check (CC). If this parameter is set to RELIABILITY, the BFD session is used to trigger route interlock. Route interlock enables the standby route to take over once the active route becomes faulty, and therefore prevents service interruption caused by route failures.

parameters.name: DSCP
parameters.description: Indicates the Differentiated Services Code Point (DSCP). The priority has a positive correlation with the value of this parameter.

parameters.name: Protocol Version
parameters.description: Indicates the protocol version of a BFD session.

parameters.name: BFD Authentication Switch
parameters.description: Indicates whether a BFD session supports BFD authentication. You are advised to enable the BFD Authentication Switch.

parameters.name: BFD Authentication Algorithm
parameters.description: Indicates the algorithm used during BFD authentication.

parameters.name: BFD Authentication Key Chain ID
parameters.description: Indicates the ID of a configured BFD key chain.

parameters.name: Clear Statistic
parameters.description: Indicates whether to delete the historical statistics. If this parameter is set to YES, the historical statistics are deleted and a new round of statistics collecting starts upon completion of the query.

parameters.name: Session State
parameters.description: Indicates the state of a BFD session.

parameters.name: Active Detecting Mode
parameters.description: Indicates the effective detection mode through negotiation.

parameters.name: Active Minimum Tx Interval
parameters.description: Indicates the effective minimum TX interval through negotiation.

parameters.name: Active Minimum Rx Interval
parameters.description: Indicates the effective minimum RX interval through negotiation.

parameters.name: Active Detection Time
parameters.description: Indicates the detection time when the negotiation takes effect.

parameters.name: My Discriminator
parameters.description: Indicates the local discriminator of a BFD session. The value of this parameter is equal to the session number plus 1.

parameters.name: Your Discriminator
parameters.description: Indicates the peer discriminator of a BFD session.

parameters.name: Number of TX PDUs
parameters.description: Indicates the number of transmitted packets of a BFD session.

parameters.id: Drop Packets of Authentication Switch Unmacth
parameters.name: Drop Packets of Authentication Switch Unmacth
parameters.description: Indicates the number of packets discarded due to unidirectional BFD authentication.

parameters.id: Drop Packets of Authentication Type Unmacth
parameters.name: Drop Packets of Authentication Type Unmacth
parameters.description: Indicates the number of packets discarded due to authentication type inconsistency during BFD authentication.

parameters.id: Drop Packets of Authentication Length Unmacth
parameters.name: Drop Packets of Authentication Length Unmacth
parameters.description: Indicates the number of packets discarded due to key length inconsistency during BFD authentication.

parameters.id: Drop Packets of Authentication Key ID Unmacth
parameters.name: Drop Packets of Authentication Key ID Unmacth
parameters.description: Indicates the number of packets discarded because the key indexes do not match between the two ends during BFD authentication.

parameters.id: Drop Packets of Authentication Packets Sequence Unmacth
parameters.name: Drop Packets of Authentication Packets Sequence Unmacth
parameters.description: Indicates the number of packets discarded because the sequence number is invalid in BFD authentication packets.

parameters.id: Drop Packets of Authentication Abstract or Hash Fail
parameters.name: Drop Packets of Authentication Abstract or Hash Fail
parameters.description: Indicates the number of packets discarded because the BFD authentication digest check or Hash algorithm execution fails.

parameters.name: Number of RX PDUs
parameters.description: Indicates the number of received packets of a BFD session.

parameters.id: Total Number of Up to Down Sessions
parameters.name: Total Number of Up to Down Sessions
parameters.description: Indicates the number of times of up-to-down detected by a BFD session.

parameters.name: Session Diagnosis
parameters.description: Indicates the diagnostic field of a BFD session, that is, the cause of the latest failure.

parameters.name: BITS Clock No.
parameters.description: Indicates the number of the BITS clock link.

parameters.name: Cabinet No.
parameters.description: Indicates the number of the cabinet where the BITS clock link is configured.

parameters.name: Subrack No.
parameters.description: Indicates the number of the subrack where the BITS clock link is configured.

parameters.name: Slot No.
parameters.description: Indicates the number of the slot where the BITS clock link is configured.

parameters.name: Priority
parameters.description: Indicates the priority of the clock source. The value 1 indicates that the current clock source has the highest priority, and the value 4 indicates that the current clock source has the lowest priority.

parameters.name: Link Active State
parameters.description: Indicates the activation status of the BITS clock link. If the link is active, the BITS clock link is the current clock source of the system.

parameters.name: Link Available State
parameters.description: Indicates the availability of a BITS clock link. Only an available clock link can serve as the current clock source. Otherwise, the clock link cannot be locked even if it is activated.

parameters.name: VRF Index
parameters.description: Indicates the index of a VRF instance. UMTS currently supports the default routing domain only (the VRF index is 0).

parameters.name: Peer IPv4 Address
parameters.description: Indicates the peer IPv4 address of a blocked SCTP link.

parameters.name: Cabinet No.
parameters.description: Indicates the cabinet number of the board.

parameters.name: Subrack No.
parameters.description: Indicates the subrack number of the board.

parameters.name: Slot No.
parameters.description: Indicates the slot number of the board.

parameters.name: Board Resource Assignment Mode
parameters.description: Indicates the board resource assignment mode. If this parameter is set to MODE1, the default transmission and signaling specifications are used. If this parameter is set to MODE2, the signaling specifications increase by 20% to 25% and the transmission specifications decrease by 20% to 25% in comparison with the default specifications. If this parameter is set to MODE3, the 5G traffic split mode i

parameters.name: Certificate Authority Name
parameters.description: Indicates the name of the CA. The CA name except item "ORGANIZATIONNAME" must not contain the following invalid characters: backslash (\), slash (/), colon (:), asterisk (*), question mark (?), double quotation marks ("), left angle bracket (<), right angle bracket (>), bar (|) and underscore (_). Otherwise, an error occurs when you run the REQ DEVCERT command to apply for a device certificate.

parameters.name: Certificate Authority URL
parameters.description: Indicates the URL of the CA. The URL can be either an http or https URL. The IP address in the URL must be a valid IP address. The default port number is 80 for http or 443 for https.

parameters.name: Certificate Registration Name
parameters.description: Indicates the name of a certificate registration authority (RA). The available character set of an RA name is the same as that of a CA name. This parameter is mandatory if the certificate registration server of the customer requires that the recipient in the received certificate request message be the name of the certificate registration server.

parameters.name: IP Version
parameters.description: Indicates the IP protocol version.

parameters.name: Signature Algorithm
parameters.description: Indicates the signature algorithm for message of CMP. The signature algorithm can be Secure Hash Algorithm 1 (SHA1), Secure Hash Algorithm 256 (SHA256) or Secure Hash Algorithm 384 (SHA384).

parameters.name: Certificate Fetch Mode
parameters.description: If this parameter is set to DEFAULT_MODE, the UPDSIP, INITREQURL, and INITREQSIP parameters do not need to be set. The base station uses the O&M IP address and URL as the source and destination IP addresses, respectively, for routine certificate management. Routine certificate management involves certificate application and certificate update, both of which can be done performed automatically or m

parameters.name: Certificate Update Source IP
parameters.description: Indicates the source address for certificate management, such as automatic certificate update, manual certificate update, and manual certificate application. If the source address for certificate application in site deployment is not configured, the address will be used as the source address for acquiring the certificate for the first time.

parameters.name: CA URL During Site Deployment
parameters.description: Indicates the URL of the CA that is used during site deployment. The URL can be either an http or https URL. In the URL, the IP address must be a valid IP address, and the default port number is 80 for http or 443 for https. This parameter is mandatory when the CA uses different URLs during site deployment or certificate update.

parameters.id: Source IP for Applying for a Certificate During Site Deployment
parameters.name: Source IP for Applying for a Certificate During Site Deployment
parameters.description: Indicates the source IP address for the BS to access the CA and to initially obtain a certificate. This parameter is mandatory when the CA uses different URLs in the following scenarios: -The BS initially obtains a certificate during site deployment. -A certificate is updated.

parameters.id: Source IPv6 Address for Applying for a Certificate During Site Deployment
parameters.name: Source IPv6 Address for Applying for a Certificate During Site Deployment
parameters.description: Indicates the source IPv6 address for the BS to access the CA and to initially obtain a certificate. This parameter is mandatory when the CA uses different URLs in the following scenarios: -The BS initially obtains a certificate during site deployment. -A certificate is updated.

parameters.name: Certificate Update Source IPv6 Address
parameters.description: Indicates the source IPv6 address for certificate management, such as automatic certificate update, manual certificate update, and manual certificate application. If the source address for certificate application in site deployment is not configured, the address will be used as the source address for acquiring the certificate for the first time.

parameters.name: Slave Certificate Authority URL
parameters.description: Indicates the slave URL of the CA. The URL can be either an HTTP or HTTPS URL. The IP address in the URL must be a valid IP address. The default port number is 80 for HTTP or 443 for HTTPS. If the certificate fails to be obtained using the CA URL, the slave CA URL can be used to obtain the certificate only when this parameter is set.

parameters.id: Slave CA URL During Site Deployment
parameters.name: Slave CA URL During Site Deployment
parameters.description: Indicates the slave URL of the CA that is used during site deployment. The URL can be either an HTTP or HTTPS URL. In the URL, the IP address must be a valid IP address, and the default port number is 80 for HTTP or 443 for HTTPS. If the certificate fails to be obtained using the CA URL during site deployment, the slave CA URL during site deployment can be used to obtain the certificate only when

parameters.name: Certificate Request Switch
parameters.description: Indicates the switch of certificate request configuration information. When this parameter is set to DEFAULT, the CA uses the request information configured in the CERTREQ MO. When this parameter is set to USERDEFINE, the CA requires the customized certificate request information.

parameters.name: Common Name
parameters.description: Indicates the common name of the certificate request file, which can be the electronic serial number (ESN), media access control (MAC) address, or IP address of a board.

parameters.name: Common Name Additional Info.
parameters.description: Indicates the additional information about a certificate common name. The information will be added behind the value of the COMMNAME parameter to compose a complete common name for a certificate request file. The default value is .huawei.com. A space is not supported before the value of this parameter, that is, a space is not supported before the character string. However, to meet requirements of

parameters.name: Country
parameters.description: Indicates the country where a BS is located.

parameters.name: Organization
parameters.description: Indicates the organization that owns a BS.

parameters.name: Organizational Unit
parameters.description: Indicates the organization unit that owns a BS.

parameters.name: State or Province
parameters.description: Indicates the state or province where a BS is located.

parameters.name: Locality
parameters.description: Indicates the location of a BS.

parameters.name: Key Usage
parameters.description: Indicates the usage for a key, including KEY_AGREEMENT (key negotiation), DATA_ENCIPHERMENT (data encryption), KEY_ENCIPHERMENT (key encryption), and DIGITAL_SIGNATURE (digital signature). This parameter can be set to one or multiple values.

parameters.name: Certificate Request Signature Algorithm
parameters.description: Indicates the signature algorithm for a certificate request file.

parameters.name: Key Size
parameters.description: Indicates the length of a key, which can be 1024 bits, 2048 bits, 3072 bits or 4096 bits.

parameters.name: Local Name
parameters.description: Indicates the local name of a BS. This parameter is used to generate the DNS name of the subject alternative name of a certificate, so as to verify the peer's identification in IKE negotiation. If this parameter is not configured, the BS automatically uses the common name and its additional information to generate the DNS name.

parameters.name: Local IP
parameters.description: Indicates the IP address of the subject alternative name of a certificate.

parameters.name: Local IPv6 Address
parameters.description: Indicates the IPv6 address of the subject alternative name of a certificate. This parameter is invalid in the old transmission model.

parameters.name: Policy ID
parameters.description: Indicates the ID of TLS policy configured.

parameters.id: VRF Index for Applying for a Certificate During Site Deployment
parameters.name: VRF Index for Applying for a Certificate During Site Deployment
parameters.description: Indicates the index of the VRF instance on which the IP address that is used to apply for a certificate during base station deployment depends.

parameters.id: VRF Index for Update a Certificate
parameters.name: VRF Index for Update a Certificate
parameters.description: Indicates the index of the VRF instance on which the source IP address used in routine certificate management (automatic certificate update, manual certificate update, and manual certificate application) depends.

parameters.name: Key Type
parameters.description: Indicates type of key of one certificate, which can be RSA or ECDSA.

parameters.name: ECC Curve
parameters.description: Indicates the name of the elliptic curve used by the key when the certificate key type is ECDSA. The elliptic curve allows P256 (secp256r1), P384 (secp384r1), and ED25519. ED25519 indicates the EdDSA signature scheme using SHA-512 and Curve25519.

parameters.name: TLS Secure Cipher Suite Switch
parameters.description: Indicates the TLS security algorithm switch. When the switch is off, it is compatible with non-AEAD (Authenticated Encryption with Associated Data) and non-PFS (Perfect Forward Secrecy) weak security algorithm sets, which poses a security risk. When the switch is turned on, TLS does not support weak security algorithm sets other than AEAD and non-PFS, and only negotiates the security algorithm set

parameters.name: Cabinet No.
parameters.description: Indicates the cabinet number.

parameters.name: Cabinet Type
parameters.description: Type of a cabinet. This parameter is set to VIRTUAL when the type of a cabinet is not within the value range of this parameter.

parameters.name: Cabinet Description
parameters.description: Indicates a brief description of the cabinet, which can be the function, location, and some other information of the cabinet. If the value of this parameter for the cabinet housing the root BBU includes tlmmpsw, both the MLPPP group fault detection period and PPP link fault detection period are automatically set to 1s.

parameters.name: Location Name
parameters.description: Indicates the location information of a cabinet. Set this parameter to the location name of the site. The location name of the site is configured in the Location object. LocationName must be set to the same value for RF modules serving the same sector.

parameters.name: Model
parameters.description: Indicates the physical type of cabinet.

parameters.name: Cabinet No.
parameters.description: Indicates the cabinet number of the board where the interconnection port is located.

parameters.name: Subrack No.
parameters.description: Indicates the subrack number of the board where the interconnection port is located.

parameters.name: Slot No.
parameters.description: Indicates the slot number of the board where the interconnection port is located.

parameters.name: Port No.
parameters.description: Indicates the number of the port that carries the interconnection link.

parameters.name: Port Type
parameters.description: Indicates the type of the cascading port.

parameters.name: Switch
parameters.description: Indicates the enabled/disabled state of the port. Alarms (except interconnection port failure alarms caused by abnormal port negotiations) can be detected and reported for a port only if the port is enabled.

parameters.name: Port Mode
parameters.description: Indicates the application mode of the port. The application mode is set based on the actual physical networking. Value NULL indicates that a negotiation is being performed over the port or the negotiation is failed.

parameters.name: Cabinet No.
parameters.description: Indicates the cabinet number of the CCU.

parameters.name: Subrack No.
parameters.description: Indicates the subrack number of the CCU.

parameters.name: Slot No.
parameters.description: Indicates the slot number of the CCU.

parameters.name: Manager Cabinet No.
parameters.description: Indicates the cabinet number of the manager unit of the CCU.

parameters.name: Manager Subrack No.
parameters.description: Indicates the subrack number of the manager unit of the CCU.

parameters.name: Manager Port No.
parameters.description: Indicates the number of the serial port where the CCU is connected. The serial port is the port through which the CCU is connected to the manager unit.

parameters.name: DirectConnectFlag
parameters.description: Indicates whether the CCU is directly connected to its manager unit.

parameters.name: Cascade No.
parameters.description: Indicates the position of the CCU on a CCU chain. On a CCU chain, the FE_R port on the upper-level CCU is connected to the FE_L port on the lower-level CCU. A CCU whose FE_L port is left unconnected is the first-level CCU and the CCU directly connected to the first-level CCU is the second-level CCU and so on.

parameters.name: Connected RAT
parameters.description: Indicates the working standard of the manager unit to which the CCU is connected.LTE TDD needs to be added to the working standard of the manager unit to which the CCU is connected only when the working mode of an NE to which the CCU is connected is LTE TDD. The working mode is LTE TDD only when Product Type is set to DBS3900, BTS3900, BTS3900A, BTS3900L, BTS3900AL, DBS3900_LampSite, DBS5900, BTS5

parameters.name: Special Boolean Alarm Flag
parameters.description: Indicates whether to allow the reporting of a dedicated Boolean alarm. If the shield flag for a Boolean alarm is enabled, the Boolean alarm cannot be reported.

parameters.name: Number of eBAT
parameters.description: Indicates the number of eBATs connected to a CCU. If this parameter is set to 0, no eBAT provides the monitoring function.

parameters.name: Battery Inner Resistance Alarm Threshold
parameters.description: Indicates the internal resistance alarm threshold of the battery monitored by the eBAT to which a CCU is connected.

parameters.name: Left Port Status
parameters.description: Indicates whether the FE_L port on the CCU is connected to the upper-level CCU.

parameters.name: Right Port Status
parameters.description: Indicates whether the FE_R port on the CCU is connected to the lower-level CCU.

parameters.name: Software Version
parameters.description: Indicates the software version of the CCU.

parameters.name: PCB Version
parameters.description: Indicates the PCB version of the CCU.

parameters.name: EPLD Version
parameters.description: Indicates the erasable programmable logic device (EPLD) version of the CCU.

parameters.name: Logical No.
parameters.description: Indicates the logical number of the battery sensor to which a CCU is connected.

parameters.name: Type
parameters.description: Indicates the type of the battery sensor to which a CCU is connected. eBAT is a cell status monitoring unit. eBOX is a radio access unit.

parameters.name: Bar Code
parameters.description: Indicates the bar code of the battery sensor to which a CCU is connected.

parameters.name: Inner Resistance
parameters.description: Indicates the internal resistance of the battery monitored by the eBAT to which a CCU is connected. This parameter is invalid for the eBOX.

parameters.name: Voltage
parameters.description: Indicates the voltage of the battery monitored by the eBAT to which a CCU is connected. This parameter is invalid for the eBOX.

parameters.name: IKE Check Switch
parameters.description: Indicates the whitelist check switch for an IKE digital certificate. If an IKE peer uses the RSA digital signature to authenticate an IKE proposal, authentication of the peer identity fails, resulting in an IKE negotiation failure when the following conditions are met: this parameter is set to ON; the base station digital certificate whitelist file has been activated but the common name of the pee

parameters.name: Configuration Status
parameters.description: Indicates the configuration status of digital certificate whitelist record.

parameters.name: Activation Time
parameters.description: Indicates the activation time of a digital certificate whitelist file.

parameters.name: Activation State
parameters.description: Indicates the activation state of a digital certificate whitelist file.

parameters.name: Certificate Validity Period Checking
parameters.description: Indicates whether a task of certificate validity checking is started.

parameters.name: Checking Period
parameters.description: Indicates the interval between certificate validity checking tasks.

parameters.name: Alarm Threshold
parameters.description: Indicates the threshold for a certificate expiration alarm. If the base station detects that the interval between its current time and the expiration date of an activated device certificate is shorter than the threshold, an Imminent Certificate Expiry alarm is reported.

parameters.name: Update Method
parameters.description: Indicates the method for updating a certificate that has expired or is about to expire. There are three methods: PROXY, CMP and MANUAL. If the PROXY method is used, the BS uses the MAE as the proxy to update the certificate from the Certificate Authority (CA). If the CMP method is used, the BS directly updates the certificate from the CA. If the MANUAL method is used, the certificate needs to be u

parameters.name: Automatic Certificate Reapplication Switch
parameters.description: Indicates whether automatic certificate application is supported during a certificate server switchover. If this switch is turned on, the base station automatically applies for a certificate when detecting a certificate server switchover in the case of site deployment or IKE negotiation failure.

parameters.name: Preconfigured Certificate Expire Threshold
parameters.description: Indicates the threshold for the preconfigured certificate to expire. When the interval between the expiration time of a preconfigured device certificate in use and the current time of the base station is less than the threshold, the base station reports an alarm indicating that the certificate is about to expire.

parameters.name: Preconfigured Certificate Verification Switch
parameters.description: Indicates whether to perform a validity check on a Huawei preconfigured certificate. For example, check whether a preconfigured certificate is about to expire, has expired, is damaged, or is lost, and whether the certificate on an RRU is about to expire. When this parameter is set to OFF, the system does not check the validity of a preconfigured certificate. The system does not report an alarm ind

parameters.name: Certification Deploy Position Type
parameters.description: Indicates the deployment position of a digital certificate. If this parameter is set to DEFAULT, the certificate is configured on the main control board. If this parameter is set to SPECIFIC, the certificate is configured on the board in the specified slot. If this parameter is set to NULL, no certificate is configured on the BS.

parameters.description: Indicates the number of the cabinet where a board is located.

parameters.name: Subrack No.

parameters.name: Slot No.

parameters.name: Certificate File Name
parameters.description: Indicates the file name of a device certificate. The file name cannot include any of the following characters: backslash (\), slash (/), colon (:), asterisk (*), question mark (?), double quotation marks ("), left angle bracket (<), right angle bracket (>), and bar (|).

parameters.name: CA Switch
parameters.description: Indicates whether a CA server is specified for a device certificate. When this parameter is set to OFF, only one CA is configured or no CA is configured (the device certificate can be configured only in the offline mode). When this parameter is set to ON, a CA needs to be specified.

parameters.name: Certificate Authority Name
parameters.description: Indicates the name of the CA server specified by the certificate.

parameters.name: Status
parameters.description: Indicates the status of a device certificate.

parameters.name: Serial Number
parameters.description: Indicates the serial number of a device certificate.

parameters.name: Common Name
parameters.description: Indicates the common name of a device certificate.

parameters.name: Issuer
parameters.description: Indicates the issuer of a device certificate.

parameters.name: Expiration Date
parameters.description: Indicates the expiration date of a device certificate.

parameters.name: Effective Date
parameters.description: Indicates the date when a device certificate begins to take effect.

parameters.name: CA URL Last Used
parameters.description: Indicates the CA URL used to successfully obtain the certificate for the last time. After a system reset, version upgrade, or manual configuration of the device certificate, the value of this parameter is NULL.

parameters.name: Last Update Time of Certificate
parameters.description: Indicates the time when the certificate is successfully obtained for the last time. After a system reset, version upgrade, or manual configuration of the device certificate, the value of this parameter is NULL.

parameters.name: Key Type
parameters.description: Indicates type of key of one certificate, which can be RSA or ECDSA.

parameters.name: Key Size
parameters.description: Indicates the key length, which can be 1024 bits, 2048 bits, 3072 bits or 4096 bits. The key length of 1024 bits is not recommended. Otherwise, the security is undermined. If this parameter is set to KEYSIZE1024, the RRU still uses the value KEYSIZE2048 as the key length.

parameters.name: ECC Curve
parameters.description: Indicates the name of the elliptic curve used by the key when the certificate key type is ECDSA. The elliptic curve allows P256 (secp256r1), P384 (secp384r1), ED25519 and P521(secp521r1). ED25519 indicates the EdDSA signature scheme using SHA-512 and Curve25519.

parameters.name: Common Name
parameters.description: Indicates the common name of the certificate request file, which can be the electronic serial number (ESN), media access control (MAC) address, or IP address of a board. If this parameter is set to MAC or IP, the RRU still uses the ESN as the common name of the certificate request file.

parameters.name: Common Name Additional Info.
parameters.description: Indicates the additional information about a certificate common name. The information will be added behind the value of the COMMNAME parameter to compose a complete common name for a certificate request file. The default value is .huawei.com. A space is not supported before the value of this parameter, that is, a space is not supported before the character string. However, to meet requirements of

parameters.name: Country
parameters.description: Indicates the country where a BS is located.

parameters.name: Organization
parameters.description: Indicates the organization that owns a BS.

parameters.name: Organizational Unit
parameters.description: Indicates the organization unit that owns a BS.

parameters.name: State or Province
parameters.description: Indicates the state or province where a BS is located.

parameters.name: Locality
parameters.description: Indicates the location of a BS.

parameters.name: Key Usage
parameters.description: Indicates the usage for a key, including KEY_AGREEMENT (key negotiation), DATA_ENCIPHERMENT (data encryption), KEY_ENCIPHERMENT (key encryption), and DIGITAL_SIGNATURE (digital signature). This parameter can be set to one or multiple values. NON_REPUDIATION, KEY_CERT_SIGN, CRL_SIGN, ENCIPHER_ONLY and DECIPHER_ONLY are supported when query information.

parameters.description: Indicates the signature algorithm for a certificate request file. If this parameter is set to SHA1, the RRU still uses the SHA256 algorithm as the signature algorithm for the certificate request file.

parameters.name: Local Name
parameters.description: Indicates the local name of a BS. This parameter is used to generate the DNS name of the subject alternative name of a certificate, to verify the peer's identification in IKE negotiation. If this parameter is not configured, the BS automatically uses the common name and its additional information to generate the DNS name. This parameter does not take effect for RRUs.

parameters.name: Local IP
parameters.description: Indicates the IP address of the subject alternative name of a certificate. This parameter does not take effect for RRUs.

parameters.name: Local IPv6

parameters.name: RMEP ID

parameters.description: Indicates the index of a VRF instance. UMTS currently supports the default routing domain only (the VRF index is 0).

parameters.name: IP Address
parameters.description: Indicates the IP address of the Ethernet port or Ethernet trunk corresponding to an RMEP. The binding IP address must be different from the existing local IP address or the IP address of any effective port (including the physical port and loopback port). parameters.name: MD Name
parameters.description: Indicates the name of the MD to which the MEP belongs.

parameters.name: MA Name
parameters.description: Indicates the name of the MA to which the MEP belongs.

parameters.name: MEP ID
parameters.description: Indicates the MEP ID.

parameters.name: Port Type
parameters.description: Indicates the port type of MEP.

parameters.name: Port ID
parameters.description: Indicates the ID of the port to which the MEP belongs.

parameters.name: CC Switch
parameters.description: Indicates whether to enable the continuity check (CC) of the CFM.

parameters.name: Binding VLAN
parameters.description: Indicates whether the MA to which the MEP belongs is bound to a VLAN.

parameters.name: VLAN ID

parameters.description: Indicates the MAC address of the RMEP. It must be a valid unicast address in the format of XXXX-XXXX-XXXX. The MAC address of the RMEP can be obtained from the MAC address field carried in the CCM message. If the MAC address configured by the user is different from that carried in the CCM message, the MAC address carried in the MAC message prevails.

parameters.name: Status
parameters.description: Indicates the status of the RMEP. When CC Switch in the CFMMA MO is set to DISABLE, this status is normal.

parameters.name: Actual MAC Address
parameters.description: Indicates the actual MAC address of the RMEP. The format is XXXX-XXXX-XXXX.

parameters.name: Number of Bound IPs
parameters.description: Indicates the number of the IP addresses bound to the RMEP.

parameters.name: IP Address List
parameters.description: Indicates the list of the IP addresses bound to the RMEP.

parameters.name: CP Bear No.
parameters.description: Indicates the number of a Control Port (CP) bearer. The value of CPBEARID in the CPBEARER MOs configured by users ranges from 0 to 65535. The value of CPBEARID in the CPBEARER MOs configured by the system ranges from 70000 to 79999.

parameters.name: Flag
parameters.description: Indicates whether the transport channel carried on the CP bearer is a master or slave channel.

parameters.name: Bear Type
parameters.description: Indicates the type of CP bearer. The LTE and NR do not support SAAL.

parameters.name: Link No.
parameters.description: Indicates the number of a link carried on the CP bearer.

parameters.name: Control Mode
parameters.description: Indicates whether the object can be modified or deleted by the system. The value MANUAL_MODE means that only the user can modify or delete the object. The value AUTO_MODE means only the system can modify or delete the object. The NR does not support MANUAL_MODE.

parameters.name: Auto Config Flag
parameters.description: Indicates whether the object is created by the system. MANUAL_CREATED means that the object is configured by the user manually. AUTO_CREATED means that the object is created by the system. The NR does not support MANUAL_CREATED.

parameters.name: Port Status
parameters.description: Indicates the status of a CP bearer.

parameters.name: Used Status
parameters.description: Indicates whether the CP bearer is in use.

parameters.name: Cabinet No.
parameters.description: Indicates the cabinet number of the board where the CPRI port is located. This parameter is configured automatically when the CPRI port is created. The CPRI port is used for the configuration check when an RRU chain/ring is added.

parameters.name: Subrack No.
parameters.description: Indicates the subrack number of the board where the CPRI port is located. This parameter is configured automatically when the CPRI port is created. The CPRI port is used for the configuration check when an RRU chain/ring is added.

parameters.name: Slot No.
parameters.description: Indicates the slot number of the board where the CPRI port is located. This parameter is configured automatically when the CPRI port is created. The CPRI port is used for the configuration check when an RRU chain/ring is added.

parameters.name: Port No.
parameters.description: Indicates the port number of the board where the CPRI port is located. This parameter is configured automatically when the CPRI port is created. A CPRI port is created automatically when a board with CPRI ports is added by running the ADD BRD command. The CPRI port is used for the configuration check when an RRU chain/ring is added.

parameters.name: Administrative Status
parameters.description: Indicates the administrative state of a CPRI port. The administrative state of a CPRI port can be BLOCKED or UNBLOCKED. The value BLOCKED indicates that the CPRI port is blocked or a breakpoint is configured near the CPRI port at the local or peer mode. The value UNBLOCKED indicates that the CPRI port is unblocked and no breakpoint is configured near the CPRI port at the local or peer mode. If CPR

parameters.name: Port Type
parameters.description: Indicates the type of the CPRI port.

parameters.name: Sub Port No.
parameters.description: Indicates the number of a sub-port on a CPRI port. This parameter is valid only when the port mode of XCI on the RMU is 2x10GE or the port is on the baseband processing board. The value NULL indicates that the connected port of the device has no subport.

parameters.name: SFP Switch
parameters.description: Indicates whether to enable the TX function of the optical module on the port. When this switch is turned on, the optical laser of the optical module works properly. When this switch is turned off, the optical laser of the optical module stops transmitting optical signals. This parameter is invalid when the board type is RHUB or RMU.

parameters.name: CPRI Bit Rate
parameters.description: Indicates the rate at the CPRI port. The optical or electrical module where the port located is securely installed and a CPRI link has not been established, the queried value of this parameter is UNKNOWN. If the optical or electrical module is incorrectly installed, the queried value of this parameter is NULL. For details about the CPRI, see the CPRI specifications.

parameters.name: Install Status
parameters.description: Indicates the in-position state of the CPRI port. If CPRI MUX/eCPRI MUX is deployed in separate-MPT scenarios, the queried value of this parameter is NULL on the converged party side.

parameters.name: CPRI Port Mode
parameters.description: Indicates the mode of the CPRI port. There are two modes: Maser and Slave.

parameters.name: SFP Module Type
parameters.description: Indicates the type of the optical or electrical module. If CPRI MUX/eCPRI MUX is deployed in separate-MPT scenarios, the queried value of this parameter is NULL on the converged party. If the optical or electrical module is incorrectly installed, the queried value of this parameter is NULL.

parameters.name: CPRI Port Mux Status
parameters.description: Indicates the multiplexing status of a CPRI port. When the channel between the converged party and the converged party fails, "UNKNOWN" is displayed if you query the status of a CPRI port of the aggregated party and "NULL" is displayed if you query the status of a CPRI port on an RRU. The value of the CpriMuxStatus parameter for an RMU port connecting to a lower-level node is NORMAL(Normal).

parameters.name: Availability Status
parameters.description: Indicates the availability state of a CPRI port. The availability state of a CPRI port can be NORMAL, INBREAKPOIT, or NULL. The value INBREAKPOIT indicates that a breakpoint is configured on the chain/ring. In this case, the CPRI link is disconnected although fiber optic cables are connected. The breakpoint is configured to prevent temporary alarms from being reported during network operations. Th

parameters.name: Remaining Continuous Bandwidth
parameters.description: Indicates the bandwidth that has not been occupied. If the optical module is not in position or the type of the optical module is QSFP, this parameter value is NULL.

parameters.name: Remaining Discontinuous Bandwidth
parameters.description: Indicates the bandwidth that is fragmented after bandwidth usage changes due to cell deletion or configuration modification and cannot be used by other cells. If the optical module is not in position or the type of the optical module is QSFP, this parameter value is NULL.

parameters.name: Protocol Type
parameters.description: Indicates the effective protocol type of the port.

parameters.name: Cable Reservation Status
parameters.description: Indicates whether network cables are reserved for the RRU downstream port. Only certain pRRUs support this parameter. If this parameter is not supported or no network cable is reserved, the queried value of this parameter is NULL.

parameters.name: Network Cable Length Level
parameters.description: Indicates the length level of the Ethernet cable between the electrical RHUB branch chain port and the first-level RRU. Level 1 indicates that the tested Ethernet cable supports a maximum data rate of 10.1 Gbit/s within the specified length range. Level 2 indicates that the tested Ethernet cable supports a maximum data rate of 3.0 Gbit/s within the specified length range. NULL indicates that the t

parameters.name: CP Switch Flag
parameters.description: Indicates whether to enable active/standby switchover between CPs.

parameters.name: CRL File Name
parameters.description: Indicates the file name of a CRL. The file name cannot include any of the following characters: backslash (\), slash (/), colon (:), asterisk (*), question mark (?), double quotation marks ("), left angle bracket (<), right angle bracket (>), and bar (|).

parameters.name: Status
parameters.description: Indicates the loading status of a CRL.

parameters.name: Issuer
parameters.description: Indicates the issuer of a CRL.

parameters.name: Next Update
parameters.description: Indicates the next update time of the CRL.

parameters.name: This Update
parameters.description: Indicates the current update time of the CRL.

parameters.id: CRL Server IP Address Last Used
parameters.name: CRL Server IP Address Last Used
parameters.description: Indicates the CRL server IP address used to successfully apply or update the certificate for the last time. After a system reset, version upgrade, or manually configuration of the CRL file, the value of this parameter is NULL.

parameters.name: Last Update Time of CRL
parameters.description: Indicates the time when the certificate is successfully applied or updated. After a system reset, version upgrade, or manually configuration of the CRL file, the value of this parameter is NULL.

parameters.name: Key Usage
parameters.description: Indicates the usage for a key, including KEY_AGREEMENT (key negotiation), DATA_ENCIPHERMENT (data encryption), KEY_ENCIPHERMENT (key encryption), and DIGITAL_SIGNATURE (digital signature). This parameter can be set to one or multiple values. NON_REPUDIATION, KEY_CERT_SIGN, CRL_SIGN, ENCIPHER_ONLY and DECIPHER_ONLY are supported when query information.

parameters.name: CRL Using Policy
parameters.description: Indicates the policy type. There are three policies using CRLs: NOVERIFY(No Verifying), ALARM(Send an Alarm If Verifying CRL Failed), and DISCONNECT(Disconnect If Verifying CRL Failed). The value NOVERIFY indicates that the BS does not perform CRL-based certificate checks on the peer device. The value ALARM indicates that the BS performs CRL-based certificate checks on the peer device and reports

parameters.name: IP Address
parameters.description: Indicates the IP address of the master FTP server or master LDAP server.

parameters.name: User Name
parameters.description: Indicates the user name used to log in to an FTP server or LDAP server.

parameters.name: Password
parameters.description: Indicates the password used to log in to an FTP server or LDAP server.

parameters.name: Port No.
parameters.description: Indicates the port number of an LDAP server.

parameters.name: File Name
parameters.description: Indicates the file name of a CRL. A file name specified with its path is supported when the access method is set to FTP.

parameters.name: Using CRL's Next Update
parameters.description: Indicates whether to update the CRL at the next update time specified in the CRL that is obtained during the latest update. If this parameter is set to ENABLE, the BS automatically updates the CRL when the next update time specified in the CRL arrives. If this parameter is set to DISABLE, the BS automatically updates the CRL based on the configured updating period.

parameters.name: CRL Updating Period
parameters.description: Indicates the interval at which the BS automatically obtains the CRL from the FTP server or LDAP server.

parameters.name: Task ID
parameters.description: Indicates the ID of the task for periodically obtaining the CRL.

parameters.name: Access Method
parameters.description: Indicates the method using which the BS periodically obtains a CRL.

parameters.name: Distinguish Name
parameters.description: Indicates the name of a node found in an LDAP server.

parameters.name: Source IP
parameters.description: Indicates the source IP address for downloading CRLs. When this parameter is set to 0.0.0.0, the effective local OM IP address serves as the source IP address to access the CRL server for updating CRL files.

parameters.name: Slave IP Address
parameters.description: Indicates the IP address of the slave FTP server or slave LDAP server. If the certificate fails to be obtained using the IP address of the master CRL server, the IP address of the slave CRL server is used only when this parameter is not set to 0.0.0.0. If the IP address of the slave CRL server is used, the slave port number, slave user name, and slave password need be configured.

parameters.name: Slave User Name
parameters.description: Indicates the user name for logging in to the slave FTP server or slave LDAP server.

parameters.name: Slave Password
parameters.description: Indicates the password for logging in to the slave FTP server or slave LDAP server.

parameters.name: Slave Port No.
parameters.description: Indicates the port number of a slave LDAP server.

parameters.name: Connection Mode
parameters.description: Indicates whether to use the SSL to protect the security of the connection.

parameters.name: Authenticate Peer
parameters.description: Indicates whether to authenticate the certificate of the peer end when SSL connection is used. This parameter does not take effect for TLS1.3.

parameters.name: Minimum DH Length
parameters.description: Indicates the minimum length of the Diffie-Hellman (DH) group allowed on the NE side when SSL connection is used and the peer certificate is authenticated. If the length of the DH key sent by the peer end is less than the value of this parameter when the DH is used as the key exchange algorithm in the algorithm set for authentication and negotiation, the SSL connection-based negotiation fails. The

parameters.name: IP Version
parameters.description: Indicates the IP protocol version.

parameters.name: IPv6 Address
parameters.description: Indicates the source IPv6 address of the master FTP server or master LDAP server.

parameters.name: IPv6 Source Address
parameters.description: Indicates the source IPv6 address for downloading CRLs. When this parameter is set to 0:0:0:0:0:0:0:0, the effective local OM IP address serves as the source IPv6 address to access the CRL server for updating CRL files.

parameters.name: Slave IPv6 Address
parameters.description: Indicates the IPv6 address of the slave FTP server or slave LDAP server. If the certificate fails to be obtained using the IP address of the master CRL server, the IP address of the slave CRL server is used only when this parameter is not set to 0:0:0:0:0:0:0:0. If the IP address of the slave CRL server is used, the slave port number, slave user name, and slave password need be configured.

parameters.name: Policy ID
parameters.description: Indicates the ID of TLS policy configured.

parameters.name: VRF Index
parameters.description: Indicates the index of a VRF instance.

parameters.name: TLS Secure Cipher Suite Switch
parameters.description: Indicates the TLS security algorithm switch. When the switch is off, it is compatible with non-AEAD (Authenticated Encryption with Associated Data) and non-PFS (Perfect Forward Secrecy) weak security algorithm sets, which poses a security risk. When the switch is turned on, TLS does not support weak security algorithm sets other than AEAD and non-PFS, and only negotiates the security algorithm set

parameters.name: Certificate File Name
parameters.description: Indicates the name of the cross-certificate. The file name cannot include any of the following characters: backslash (\), slash (/), colon (:), asterisk (*), question mark (?), double quotation marks ("), left angle bracket (<), right angle bracket (>), and bar (|).

parameters.name: Serial Number
parameters.description: Indicates the serial number of the cross-certificate.

parameters.name: Common Name
parameters.description: Indicates the common name of the cross-certificate.

parameters.name: Issuer Name
parameters.description: Indicates the issuer of the cross-certificate.

parameters.name: Expiring Date
parameters.description: Indicates the expiration date of the cross-certificate.

parameters.name: Status
parameters.description: Indicates the loading status of the cross-certificate.

parameters.name: Effective Date
parameters.description: Indicates the date when the cross-certificate begins to take effect.

parameters.name: Local Link No.
parameters.description: Indicates the number of the control link at the local end.

parameters.name: Local Cabinet No.
parameters.description: Indicates the cabinet number of the local node at one end of the control link.

parameters.name: Local Subrack No.
parameters.description: Indicates the subrack number of the local node at one end of the control link.

parameters.name: Local Slot No.
parameters.description: Indicates the slot number of the local node at one end of the control link.

parameters.name: Upper Cabinet No.
parameters.description: Indicates the cabinet number of the upper-level node at the other end of the control link.

parameters.name: Upper Subrack No.
parameters.description: Indicates the subrack number of the upper-level node at the other end of the control link.

parameters.name: Upper Slot No.
parameters.description: Indicates the slot number of the upper-level node at the other end of the control link.

parameters.name: Upper Port No.
parameters.description: Indicates the port number of the upper-level node at the other end of the control link. Values 0 to 4 indicate the ports M0 to M4 on the UCIU, Values 6 to 7 indicate the HEI ports HEI0 to HEI1 on the UMDU, and value 8 indicates the CI port on the UMPT.

parameters.name: MACSec Negotiation Failure Times
parameters.description: Indicates the number of failed MACSec (MAC Security) negotiations. The number is counted from the time a link becomes normal. The number falls to zero after the link becomes abnormal but is counted again after the link becomes normal.

parameters.name: MACSec Negotiation Failure Phase
parameters.description: Indicates the phase in which the latest failed MACSec negotiation occurs. The values of this parameter include Identity Authentication, MKA Negotiation, and NULL. MKA is short for MACsec key agreement protocol. The value NULL indicates that a negotiation succeeds or no negotiation is performed.

parameters.name: MACSec Negotiation State
parameters.description: Indicates the states of MACSec (MAC Security) negotiations. The values of this parameter include Succeeded, Failed, and None.

parameters.name: MACSec Negotiation Success Times
parameters.description: Indicates the number of successful MACSec (MAC Security) negotiations. The number is counted from the time a link becomes normal. The number falls to zero after the link becomes abnormal but is counted again after the link becomes normal.

parameters.name: Local Port Rate
parameters.description: Indicates the port rate of the local node. NULL indicates that the link is disconnected over the port.

parameters.name: Cabinet No.
parameters.description: Indicates the number of the cabinet where the CXU is located.

parameters.name: Subrack No.
parameters.description: Indicates the number of the subrack where the CXU is located.

parameters.name: Slot No.
parameters.description: Indicates the number of the slot where the CXU is located.

parameters.name: CXU Type
parameters.description: Indicates the type of the CXU.

parameters.name: Chain/Ring No.
parameters.description: Indicates the ID of the RRU or RFU chain/ring where the CXU is located.

parameters.name: CXU Position
parameters.description: Indicates the position of the CXU on the RRU chain/ring. It is calculated from the start port one by one.

parameters.name: CXU Name
parameters.description: Indicates the CXU name.

parameters.name: Remote Flag
parameters.description: Indicates whether a CXU is far away from the BBU. You can define whether a CXU is far away from the BBU as required. If you do not need to define this information, use the default value.

parameters.name: User Label
parameters.description: Indicates the user-defined CXU descriptions. You can use this parameter to record the information about the CXU.

parameters.name: CXU Work Standard
parameters.description: Indicates the working standard of the CXU. This parameter takes effect only for the RMU.

parameters.name: Maintenance Mode
parameters.description: Indicates the maintenance mode of a CXU. The value INSTALL indicates device creation caused by network capability expansion, device reparenting, or access of a new device to the network. The value EXPAND indicates the subrack or carrier capacity expansion of a device. The value UPGRADE indicates a device upgrade. The value TESTING indicates that an installed device is being commissioned. ExpandSta

parameters.name: Start Time of Status Setting
parameters.description: Indicates the start time of maintenance status of the CXU. If this parameter is not specified, the start time of the maintenance status is 2000-01-01 00:00:00.

parameters.name: End Time of Status Setting
parameters.description: Indicates the end time of the maintenance mode for the CXU. If this parameter is not specified, the maintenance mode ends at 2037-12-31 23:59:59.

parameters.name: Maintenance Mode Setting Remark
parameters.description: Indicates the remarks of maintenance status of the CXU.

parameters.name: Administrative State
parameters.description: Indicates the administrative state of the CXU. The CGPS does not support the value BLOCKED(Blocked).

parameters.name: Location Name
parameters.description: Indicates the location information of a CXU. Set this parameter to the location name of the site. The location name of the site is configured in the Location object. This parameter must be set to the same value for RF modules serving the same sector.

parameters.name: Access Direction
parameters.description: Indicates the access direction of the service plane.

parameters.name: Current Maintenance Mode
parameters.description: Indicates the current maintenance mode of the CXU.

parameters.id: The length of the fiber optic cable
parameters.name: The length of the fiber optic cable
parameters.description: Indicates the length of the fiber optic cable between the BBU and CXU. If the cable length cannot be obtained, the value NULL is displayed.

parameters.name: Alarm Status(from RU)
parameters.description: Indicates the alarm status of the board hardware, which can be set to Normal, Warning, Minor, Major, or Critical. The alarm status of the PSU, PDB, and BDU is in the alarm status of the PMU.

parameters.name: Operational State(from RU)
parameters.description: Indicates the operational state of the board, which can be set to Enabled or Disabled. Enabled indicates that services can be carried on the board. Disabled indicates that no service can be carried on the board.

parameters.name: Availability Status(from RU)
parameters.description: Indicates the physical status of a board, which can be Uninstalled, Starting up, Normal, Inconsistent, Unconfigured, Power off, Fault, Communication lost, In test, or the combination of multiple states. For example, if a board is not configured and fails to communicate with the main control and transmission board, the availability status of the board is "Unconfigured, Communication lost." If a boa

parameters.name: Electronic Label(from RU)
parameters.description: Indicates the electronic label, which is a text file with a maximum of 2 KB used to record the manufacturing information about equipment such as the board, sub-board, and optical module. "BoardType" indicates the type of the board. "BarCode" indicates the bar code of the board and is the same as the code labeled on the board. "Item" indicates the BOM code. "Description" indicates the board descrip

parameters.name: Type(from RU)
parameters.description: Indicates the type of the board or the cabinet.

parameters.name: Serial Number(from RU)
parameters.description: Indicates the bar code of the board or the cabinet.

parameters.name: Description(from RU)
parameters.description: Indicates the description about the services and functions provided by the board or the cabinet.

parameters.name: Date of Manufacture(from RU)
parameters.description: Indicates the manufacturing date of the board or the cabinet.

parameters.name: Vendor(from RU)
parameters.description: Indicates the manufacturer of the board or the cabinet.

parameters.name: Issue Number(from RU)
parameters.description: Indicates the issue number of the board.

parameters.name: Config Type(from RU)
parameters.description: Indicates the type of a board.

parameters.name: Board Temperature(from RU)
parameters.description: Indicates the temperature of a board.

parameters.name: HPA Temperature(from RU)
parameters.description: Indicates the temperature of the power amplifier. A power amplifier is a component on an RF module. If there is no power amplifier on an RF module, this parameter value is NULL.

parameters.name: DEVTYPE(from RU)
parameters.description: Indicates the type of the device.

parameters.name: Software Version(from RU)
parameters.description: Indicates the software version of the board.

parameters.name: Hardware Version(from RU)
parameters.description: Indicates the hardware version of the board.

parameters.name: BootROM Version(from RU)

parameters.description: Indicates the status of the IPv4 address. If Valid is displayed, it indicates that the IP address is available. If Invalid is displayed, it indicates that the port corresponding to the IP address is not activated. parameters.description: Indicates whether to turn on the base station VLAN scan function, the VLAN scanning function is refers, when the network element enters the detect detection, on the Ethernet port, carries on the IPv4 DHCP detection to the VLAN identity range to 0~4094.

parameters.description: Indicates whether intelligent control of the diesel generator is enabled. When intelligent control is enabled, the PMU automatically controls the diesel generator according to the preset parameters, thus reducing the operation cost of the diesel generator.

parameters.description: Indicates the priority of signaling. The priority has a positive correlation with the value of this parameter.

parameters.description: Indicates the priority of the high-level OM data. The priority has a positive correlation with the value of this parameter.

parameters.name: OM Low Priority
parameters.description: Indicates the priority of the low-level OM data, such as the data to be uploaded or downloaded. The priority has a positive correlation with the value of this parameter. The low-level OM data includes the packets related to File Transfer Protocol (FTP).

parameters.description: Indicates the priority of the IP clock. If the IP clock that follows the PTP is used, this parameter is set to the DSCP of the PTP packets. parameters.description: Indicates the background noise threshold of the delay jitter above which the DL flow control algorithm is enabled. A link is considered to be non-congested if the delay jitter on the link is below the threshold.

parameters.description: Indicates the port frame loss rate threshold of the DL flow control algorithm switch. When the frame loss rate is less than or equal to this threshold, the base station determines that the link is not congested.

parameters.description: Indicates the adjustment protection switch for the available DL bandwidth. parameters.description: Indicates the minimum protection ratio of downlink fairness flow control. When the fairness flow control switch is turned on whereas the flow control is based on unfairness, the system guarantees the minimum UMTS transmission bandwidth based on the value of this parameter.

parameters.description: Indicates the switch for controlling the enhanced downlink flow control feature. parameters.name: User Label
parameters.description: Indicates the description of an end point group.

parameters.name: Type
parameters.description: Indicates the type of an end point group. When this parameter is set to COMMON, the local end point group is a common group. When this parameter is set to CENTRALIZED_EX2, the local end point group is dedicated group for the centralized eX2. The parameter takes effect only in LTE.

parameters.name: Link Performance Statistics Switch
parameters.description: Indicates the switch controlling link performance measurement for user plane. parameters.name: Control Mode
parameters.description: Indicates whether the object can be modified or deleted by the system. The value MANUAL_MODE means that both the system and the user can modify or delete the object. The value AUTO_MODE means that only the system can modify or delete the object.

parameters.name: Auto Config Flag
parameters.description: Indicates whether the object is created by the system. The value MANUAL_CREATED means that the object is configured by the user manually. The value AUTO_CREATED means that the object is created by the system.

parameters.name: Static Check Switch
parameters.description: Indicates whether the GTP-U static detection function takes effect on user-plane links in an endpoint group. When this parameter is set to ENABLE(Enable), the GTP-U static detection function is enabled on all user-plane links in an endpoint group. parameters.id: IP PM Automatic Setup and Deletion Switch
parameters.name: IP PM Automatic Setup and Deletion Switch
parameters.description: Indicates whether to enable the IP PM session self-configuration function. If this parameter is set to ENABLE(Enable), the system will automatically generate IP PM sessions for links related to the local and peer end points. If this parameter is set to DISABLE(Disable), the system will not automatically generate IP PM sessions. If the value of this parameter is changed from ENABLE(Enable) to DISAB

parameters.name: IP PM DSCP
parameters.description: Indicates the differentiated services code point (DSCP) of an IP PM session that is automatically generated by a base station. The parameter takes effect only in LTE.

parameters.name: Application Type
parameters.description: Indicates the type of the application referenced by a DFU. The application provides the running environment for the DFU.

parameters.name: eNodeB Interface
parameters.description: Indicates the eNodeB interface that uses the endpoint group. When this parameter is set to DUX2_U, the endpoint group is used by the eNodeB to automatically generate the DUX2 object. Only the DUX2_U and DUEX2_NON_IDEAL options can be selected together. Other options must be selected separately. This parameter takes effect only for CU-DU Split.

parameters.name: gNodeB Interface
parameters.description: Indicates the gNodeB interface that uses the endpoint group. When this parameter is set to GNBDUF1, the endpoint group is used by the gNodeB to automatically generate the GNBDUF1 object. Currently, only one option can be selected. This parameter takes effect only for CU-DU Split.

parameters.name: IP Protocol Version Preference
parameters.description: Indicates the IP protocol version that is preferentially used to automatically establish a control-plane link or user-plane path when the SCTP local IP address or user-plane local IP address in an EPGROUP MO is dual-stack and the IP address of the peer device is also dual-stack. parameters.name: SCTP Host List
parameters.description: Indicates the list of all SCTP hosts in the end point group. This parameter takes effect only in UMTS, LTE, and NR.

parameters.name: SCTP Peer List
parameters.description: Indicates the list of all SCTP peers in the end point group. This parameter takes effect only in UMTS, LTE and NR.

parameters.name: User Plane Host List

parameters.name: User Plane Peer List

parameters.description: Indicates whether there is an end point group configuration conflict.

parameters.description: Indicates the information about an end point group configuration conflict.

parameters.name: Peer IP Address
parameters.description: Indicates the IPv4 Address of the user-plane peer to an end point group.

parameters.name: Peer IPv6 Address
parameters.description: Indicates the IPv6 Address of the user-plane peer to an end point group. This parameter takes effect only in LTE and NR.

parameters.name: Unused SCTP Peer List
parameters.description: Indicates the list of SCTP peers that are not added to any end point group. This parameter takes effect only in UMTS, LTE and NR.

parameters.name: Unused User Plane Peer List
parameters.description: Indicates the list of user plane peers that are not added to the end point group.

parameters.name: Unused Security Peer List
parameters.description: Indicates the list of security peers that are not referenced by a signaling peer or a user plane peer. This parameter takes effect only in LTE and NR.

parameters.name: Battery Intelligent Management Switch
parameters.description: Indicates the battery intelligent management switch status, which can be set to ON or OFF. ON indicates that this switch is set to on and OFF indicates that this switch is set to off. Intelligent battery power management prolongs the lifespan of a battery.

parameters.name: Power Lose Redundancy Alarm Enabled
parameters.description: Indicates whether the base station reports ALM-25636 Loss of Power Supply Redundancy. The base station reports ALM-25636 Loss of Power Supply Redundancy if the PSUs are not configured in N+1 backup mode and this parameter is set to ON.

parameters.name: DCU SDR Enhanced Switch
parameters.description: Indicates whether to support the DCU 3900/3910 and inter-BBU co-SDR enhanced networking. When this switch is turned on, DCU 3900/3910 and inter-BBU co-SDR enhanced networking is supported. When this switch is turned off, this networking is not supported.

parameters.name: Inter Subrack Clock Alignment Mode
parameters.description: Indicates the inter-BBU clock synchronization mode when the SDR interconnection switch is turned off. This parameter is valid only when the SDR interconnection switch is turned off. If this parameter is set to INDEPENDENT_GNSS_CLK, two BBUs use their own GNSS clock sources to ensure clock alignment. This parameter applies to C+L scenarios where CI interconnection is not used. If this parameter is

parameters.id: RF Abnormal Power Supply Protect Switch
parameters.name: RF Abnormal Power Supply Protect Switch
parameters.description: Indicates the power supply protection switch for an RF module. This switch is turned on to protect the RF module against power failures and other exceptions.

parameters.name: Hardware Fault Self-healing Switch
parameters.description: Indicates whether to enable the hardware fault self-healing function. When a hardware fault that may affect services or functions is detected, the base station is authorized to perform self-healing actions at different levels to quickly rectify the fault. This helps reduce the fault duration and maintenance workload caused by manual intervention and shortens the fault impact duration. This paramet

parameters.name: Direct Voltage Alarm Switch
parameters.description: Indicates the direct voltage alarm switch. The switch controls whether to report the ALM-26113 Base Station DC Power Supply Abnormal in the case of low DC input voltage.

parameters.name: Direct Voltage Alarm Occurred Threshold
parameters.description: Indicates the DC voltage alarm occurrence threshold. When the load voltage is lower than the DC voltage alarm occurred threshold and the direct voltage alarm switch is set to ENABLE, ALM-26113 Base Station DC Power Supply Abnormal is reported.

parameters.name: Direct Voltage Alarm Restored Threshold
parameters.description: Indicates the DC voltage alarm Restoration threshold. When the load voltage is higher than the DC voltage alarm restored threshold and the direct voltage alarm switch is set to ENABLE, an ALM-26113 Base Station DC Power Supply Abnormal is cleared.

parameters.name: Open DU Interface ID
parameters.description: Indicates the ID of the open DU interface (ODI). If this parameter is set to 0, no ID is configured for the ODI and this base station cannot communicate with other base stations. This parameter applies only to Cloud BB scenarios. In non-Cloud BB scenarios, the parameter should be set to 0.

parameters.id: RF DC Power Off Alarm Enhanced Detect Switch
parameters.name: RF DC Power Off Alarm Enhanced Detect Switch
parameters.description: Indicates whether to enable the enhanced DC power failure detection function for RF modules. When this switch is turned on, the system checks the power supply of RF modules based on the power failure characteristics. parameters.name: Abnormal Power Supply Thld
parameters.description: Indicates the abnormal power supply threshold in the algorithm for abnormal power supply. When the voltage decreases to a value less than this threshold, the system considers power supply abnormal. NULL is displayed in the output of the LST EQUIPMENT command when the parameter is set to 65535 and the system calculates the threshold based on the onsite running status.

parameters.name: Normal Power Supply Thld
parameters.description: Indicates the normal power supply threshold in the algorithm for abnormal power supply. When the voltage increases to a value greater than this threshold, the system considers power supply normal. NULL is displayed in the output of the LST EQUIPMENT command when the parameter is set to 65535 and the system calculates the threshold based on the onsite running status.

parameters.name: SDR Connection Switch
parameters.description: Indicates the BBU interconnection switch when SDR is enabled for an RF module connecting to two BBUs. If this switch is turned on, the BBUs are interconnected. If this switch is turned off, the BBUs are not interconnected. This switch is turned on when the RF module connects to only one BBU. During the reconstruction of the SDR interconnection mode, set this parameter to ADJUSTING to reduce the im

parameters.name: Auto CPRI Resource Defragment Switch
parameters.description: Indicates the CPRI resource defragment switch. If this switch is turned on, the system automatically defragments CPRI resources in specific scenarios. CPRI resource defragmentation may temporarily interrupt ongoing services of the system. This parameter does not take effect in eCPRI scenarios.

parameters.id: Enhanced OM Link Setup Switch for Power Failure
parameters.name: Enhanced OM Link Setup Switch for Power Failure
parameters.description: Indicates the OMCH setup enhancement switch upon abnormal power supply. If this switch is turned on, OMCH setup is delayed after an abnormal power-off reset which is not caused by manual operations.

parameters.id: Time Controlled by Enhanced OM Link Setup SW
parameters.name: Time Controlled by Enhanced OM Link Setup SW
parameters.description: Indicates the time controlled by the OMCH setup enhancement switch. This parameter is valid only if the switch controlling OMCH setup enhancement upon abnormal power supply is turned on. After an NE experiences an abnormal power-off reset which is not caused by manual operations, the OMCH between the NE and the EMS are not set up within the time specified by the value of this parameter.

parameters.name: Equipment Type
parameters.description: Indicates the physical state of the NE.

parameters.name: PSU Fault Shutdown TRX Enabled
parameters.description: Indicates whether the BS enters the energy saving mode when some PSUs become faulty. If this parameter is set to ON, the BS enters the energy saving mode to reduce power consumption when some PSUs become faulty and the remaining PSUs cannot meet the BS's power requirements.

parameters.name: Protocol Type
parameters.description: Indicates the communication protocol used between the BBU and RF units. CPRI indicates the common public radio interface, and TDL_IR indicates the IR communication protocol defined by China Mobile Communication Corporation (CMCC). This parameter must be correctly set according to the network plan. Otherwise, the base station services may be unavailable.

parameters.name: Smart TRX Switch
parameters.description: Indicates whether to enable the smart TRX energy saving function. This function is supported only when an XMU is installed or when a board is installed to monitor primary power supply. If this function is disabled, the base station does not process signals of the smart TRX function provided by the XMU or primary power supply. For a separate-MPT base station, to make this function effective, ensure

parameters.name: Equipment Serial Number
parameters.description: Indicates the equipment serial number (ESN) of an NE.

parameters.id: Shut Down BBU Boards in Load Power Off
parameters.name: Shut Down BBU Boards in Load Power Off
parameters.description: Indicates whether BBU boards are shut down when load power-off is performed on a base station. BBU boards include baseband processing boards and UBRI. If BBU boards are shut down, the power consumption is reduced and the power backup duration of storage batteries is prolonged.

parameters.name: HA Switch
parameters.description: Indicates the HA switch. When this switch is turned off, switchovers cannot be performed between active and standby main control boards.

parameters.name: CANbus Master/Slave Status
parameters.description: Indicates the master/slave status of the CAN bus on the main control board. This parameter is displayed as NULL for the boards other than main control boards.

parameters.name: Enable Flag
parameters.description: Indicates whether hardware self-detection is enabled.

parameters.name: Forced Reset Flag
parameters.description: Indicates whether to forcibly reset an NE. When this parameter is set to NO, an NE cannot be forcibly reset if the NE is downloading, supplementing, or activating software, and if the command is RST BRDPWROFF, the system performs a security exit and then a power-off reset on the board. When this parameter is set to YES, an NE is forcibly reset no matter what kind of operations this NE is performin

parameters.name: Forced Power-off Flag
parameters.description: Indicates whether to forcibly power off a board. When this parameter is set to NO, the system performs a security exit on this board and then powers off this board. When this parameter is set to YES, the system forcibly resets this board. It is recommended that this parameter be set to NO in normal scenarios.

parameters.name: Ethernet Port ID

parameters.description: Indicates the work mode of the IEEE802.3ah Ethernet OAM. If this parameter is set to ACTIVE, the local end initiates the IEEE802.3ah Ethernet OAM negotiation. If this parameter is set to PASSIVE, the local end does not initiate the negotiation; instead, the local end waits for receiving negotiation packets from the peer end.

parameters.name: Detection Period
parameters.description: Indicates the internal at which a Protocol Data Unit (PDU) is transmitted for fault detection. A shorter interval indicates that Ethernet link faults can be detected more quickly.

parameters.name: Maximum PDU Size
parameters.description: Indicates the maximum size of a protocol data unit (PDU).

parameters.name: Fault Report Flag
parameters.description: Indicates whether to enable indication of link faults.

parameters.name: Error Frame Event Duration
parameters.description: Indicates the duration of the erroneous frame event.

parameters.name: Error Frame Event Threshold
parameters.description: Indicates the threshold for the erroneous frame event. If the number of erroneous frames within a second exceeds the threshold, an erroneous frame event occurs. This event is checked every other second.

parameters.id: Error Frame Seconds Summary Event Duration
parameters.name: Error Frame Seconds Summary Event Duration
parameters.description: Indicates the duration of the Error Frame Seconds Summary Event. An error frame second refers to a second within which one or more error frames are detected.

parameters.id: Error Frame Seconds Summary Event Threshold
parameters.name: Error Frame Seconds Summary Event Threshold
parameters.description: Indicates the threshold for the accumulated erroneous frame event. If the length of time that erroneous frames occupy within a sampling period specified through the ERRFRMSCDEVTPRD parameter exceeds the threshold, an accumulated erroneous frame event occurs.

parameters.description: Indicates the Finite State Machine (FSM) status of an Ethernet OAM 3AH.

parameters.description: Indicates the number of discarded OAM PDUs on the RX channel.
