parameters.name: Number of RX Fault OAMPDUs
parameters.description: Indicates the number of received Fault OAM PDUs.

parameters.name: Number of RX Information OAMPDUs
parameters.description: Indicates the number of Info OAM PDUs received on a port.

parameters.id: Number of RX Loopback Control OAMPDUs
parameters.name: Number of RX Loopback Control OAMPDUs
parameters.description: Indicates the number of received Loopback Control OAM PDUs.

parameters.name: Total Number of RX OAMPDUs
parameters.description: Indicates the total number of received OAM PDUs, including the information OAM PDUs, event OAM PDUs, loopback OAM PDUs, and discarded OAM PDUs.

parameters.name: Number of TX Dropped OAMPDUs
parameters.description: Indicates the number of discarded OAM PDUs on the TX channel.

parameters.name: Number of TX Event OAMPDUs
parameters.description: Indicates the number of transmitted Event OAM PDUs. The Event OAM PDUs are used to notify the peer end of a link event.

parameters.name: Number of TX Fault OAMPDUs
parameters.description: Indicates the number of transmitted Fault OAM PDUs. The Fault OAM PDUs are used to notify the peer end of a link failure.

parameters.name: Number of TX Information OAMPDUs
parameters.description: Indicates the number of transmitted Info OAM Protocol Data Units (PDUs). The Info OAM PDUs are used to finish the search process.

parameters.id: Number of TX Loopback Control OAMPDUs
parameters.name: Number of TX Loopback Control OAMPDUs
parameters.description: Indicates the number of transmitted loopback OAM PDUs. The loopback OAM PDUs are used for remote loopback control.

parameters.name: Total Number of TX OAMPDUs
parameters.description: Indicates the total number of transmitted OAM PDUs, including the information OAM PDUs, event OAM PDUs, loopback OAM PDUs, and discarded OAM PDUs.

parameters.description: Indicates whether remote loopback can be enabled at the port where 3AH detection is activated. If remote loopback is enabled, the OAM 3AH loopback is allowed. For details, see the STR ETHOAMLOOPTST command. During the loopback, only 3AH packets rather than other types of packet can be transmitted. If remote loopback is disabled, the local end cannot initiate the loopback.

parameters.name: Fault Report Flag
parameters.description: Indicates whether to enable indication of link faults.

parameters.name: Error Frame Event Duration
parameters.description: Indicates the duration of the erroneous frame event.

parameters.name: Error Frame Event Threshold
parameters.description: Indicates the threshold for the erroneous frame event. If the number of erroneous frames within a second exceeds the threshold, an erroneous frame event occurs. This event is checked every other second.

parameters.id: Error Frame Seconds Summary Event Duration
parameters.name: Error Frame Seconds Summary Event Duration
parameters.description: Indicates the duration of the Error Frame Seconds Summary Event. An error frame second refers to a second within which one or more error frames are detected.

parameters.id: Error Frame Seconds Summary Event Threshold
parameters.name: Error Frame Seconds Summary Event Threshold
parameters.description: Indicates the threshold for the accumulated erroneous frame event. If the length of time that erroneous frames occupy within a sampling period specified through the ERRFRMSCDEVTPRD parameter exceeds the threshold, an accumulated erroneous frame event occurs.

parameters.name: Current State
parameters.description: Indicates the Finite State Machine (FSM) status of an Ethernet OAM 3AH.

parameters.name: Number of RX Dropped OAMPDUs
parameters.description: Indicates the number of discarded OAM PDUs on the RX channel.

parameters.name: Number of RX Event OAMPDUs
parameters.description: Indicates the number of received Event OAM PDUs.

parameters.name: Number of RX Fault OAMPDUs
parameters.description: Indicates the number of received Fault OAM PDUs.

parameters.name: Number of RX Information OAMPDUs
parameters.description: Indicates the number of Info OAM PDUs received on a port.

parameters.id: Number of RX Loopback Control OAMPDUs
parameters.name: Number of RX Loopback Control OAMPDUs
parameters.description: Indicates the number of received Loopback Control OAM PDUs.

parameters.name: Total Number of RX OAMPDUs
parameters.description: Indicates the total number of received OAM PDUs, including the information OAM PDUs, event OAM PDUs, loopback OAM PDUs, and discarded OAM PDUs.

parameters.name: Number of TX Dropped OAMPDUs
parameters.description: Indicates the number of discarded OAM PDUs on the TX channel.

parameters.name: Number of TX Event OAMPDUs
parameters.description: Indicates the number of transmitted Event OAM PDUs. The Event OAM PDUs are used to notify the peer end of a link event.

parameters.name: Number of TX Fault OAMPDUs
parameters.description: Indicates the number of transmitted Fault OAM PDUs. The Fault OAM PDUs are used to notify the peer end of a link failure.

parameters.name: Number of TX Information OAMPDUs
parameters.description: Indicates the number of transmitted Info OAM Protocol Data Units (PDUs). The Info OAM PDUs are used to finish the search process.

parameters.id: Number of TX Loopback Control OAMPDUs
parameters.name: Number of TX Loopback Control OAMPDUs
parameters.description: Indicates the number of transmitted loopback OAM PDUs. The loopback OAM PDUs are used for remote loopback control.

parameters.name: Total Number of TX OAMPDUs
parameters.description: Indicates the total number of transmitted OAM PDUs, including the information OAM PDUs, event OAM PDUs, loopback OAM PDUs, and discarded OAM PDUs.

parameters.name: Cabinet No.
parameters.description: Indicates the cabinet number of the board where the Ethernet port is located.

parameters.name: Subrack No.
parameters.description: Indicates the subrack number of the board where the Ethernet port is located.

parameters.name: Slot No.
parameters.description: Indicates the slot number of the board where the Ethernet port is located.

parameters.name: Subboard Type
parameters.description: Indicates the type of sub-board on the board where the Ethernet port is located.

parameters.name: Port No.
parameters.description: Indicates the number of the Ethernet port.

parameters.name: Port ID
parameters.description: Indicates the ID of an Ethernet port, which uniquely identifies the Ethernet port. When the system automatically creates an Ethernet port, the most significant bit to the least significant bit of this parameter value indicate the cabinet number, subrack number, slot number, and port number of the Ethernet port, respectively. When Transmission Configuration Mode in the GTRANSPARA MO is set to OLD,

parameters.name: Port Attribute
parameters.description: Indicates whether an Ethernet port is an electrical port or optical port. When the system starts, the system binds an Ethernet port to an electrical port preferentially if the default value of the port attribute is AUTO. If the BS does not support cascading, the port attribute is set to AUTO. If this parameter is incorrectly set, services of a base station will be interrupted after the base statio

parameters.name: Maximum Transmission Unit
parameters.description: Indicates the maximum IPv4 packet size (including the IP header) at the Ethernet port. For the UMPTa/b, UMDU, LMPT, UCCU, and UTRPc, the value of this parameter ranges from 46 to 1800. For the WMPT, GTMUb, GTMUc, UQEC, and UEOC, the value of this parameter ranges from 46 to 1500. For the UMPTe, the value of this parameter ranges from 46 to 2000. For the UMPTg and UMPTga, the value of this paramete

parameters.name: Speed
parameters.description: Indicates the speed mode of the Ethernet port. This parameter must be set to the same value as that of the peer port. GE electrical ports of base board support 1000 Mbit/s only when working in auto-negotiation mode. When Port Attribute is set to FIBER and Speed is set to AUTO for a GE optical port, the port works at a rate of 1000 Mbit/s in auto-negotiation mode. In this case, the base station can

parameters.name: Duplex
parameters.description: Indicates the duplex mode of the Ethernet port.

parameters.name: ARP Proxy
parameters.description: Indicates whether to enable the ARP proxy function on the Ethernet port. If the ARP proxy function is enabled, the system serves as an ARP proxy for a loopback interface address of the base station or for an interface IP address of a lower-level base station. If this function is disabled, the system does not serve as an ARP proxy for the loopback interface IP address of the base station or for the

parameters.name: Flow Control
parameters.description: Indicates whether to enable flow control on the Ethernet port. Flow control is implemented to prevent congestion. When flow control is enabled, the RX end repeatedly sends PAUSE frames to the TX end, instructing the TX end to lower the TX rate if congestion occurs on the RX end. Upon receiving PAUSE frames, the TX end stops sending data during a period of time to prevent congestion.

parameters.id: MAC Frame Error Rate Occur Threshold
parameters.name: MAC Frame Error Rate Occur Threshold
parameters.description: Indicates the generation threshold for the MAC Excessive Frame Error Rate alarm (ID: 25881). When the number of erroneous MAC frames exceeds this threshold, the MAC Excessive Frame Error Rate alarm is reported.

parameters.id: MAC Frame Error Rate Clear Threshold
parameters.name: MAC Frame Error Rate Clear Threshold
parameters.description: Indicates the clearance threshold for the MAC Excessive Frame Error Rate alarm (ID: 25881). When the number of erroneous MAC frames falls below this threshold, the MAC Excessive Frame Error Rate alarm is cleared.

parameters.id: Rx Broadcast Pkts Alarm Occur Thd
parameters.name: Rx Broadcast Pkts Alarm Occur Thd
parameters.description: Indicates the generation threshold for the excessive RX broadcast packet alarm. If the average number of broadcast packets that are received on the Ethernet port keeps above the threshold for 30 seconds, an excessive RX broadcast packet alarm is reported.

parameters.id: Rx Broadcast Pkts Alarm Clear Thd
parameters.name: Rx Broadcast Pkts Alarm Clear Thd
parameters.description: Indicates the clearance threshold for the excessive RX broadcast packet alarm. If the average number of broadcast packets that are received on the Ethernet port keeps below the threshold for 30 seconds, the excessive RX broadcast packet alarm is cleared.

parameters.name: Fiber Speed Match
parameters.description: Indicates the method of obtaining the data rate for an optical Ethernet port. When this switch is turned on, an optical Ethernet port uses the configured rate if its rate cannot be obtained. When this switch is turned off, an optical Ethernet port obtains its rate from the Ethernet chip.

parameters.name: User Label
parameters.description: Indicates the user-defined information about an Ethernet port. PeerPortLocation is contained in the UserLabel field. The format of UserLabel is UserLabel="%PeerPortLocation::XXXX%ssssss", where "XXXX" indicates the value of PeerPortLocation, and "ssssss" indicates the value of UserLabel.

parameters.name: FEC Mode
parameters.description: Indicates the forward error correction (FEC) mode of the Ethernet port when it is a 25 Gbit/s optical port. When this parameter is set to RS-FEC, the transmit end adds error correction information to the data packet. The receive end uses the error correction information to correct the bit error generated during the transmission of the data packet, so as to improve the signal quality. When this par

parameters.name: Auto Config Flag
parameters.description: Indicates whether the object is created by the system. MANUAL_CREATED means that the object is configured by the user manually. AUTO_CREATED means that the object is created by the system.

parameters.name: MAC Address
parameters.description: Indicates the MAC address (six bytes) configured for the Ethernet port. The format is XXXX-XXXX-XXXX.

parameters.name: Port Status
parameters.description: Indicates the status of the Ethernet port.

parameters.name: Loopback Status
parameters.description: Indicates the loopback status of the Ethernet port.

parameters.name: In Loopback Mode or Not
parameters.description: Indicates whether the Ethernet port is in the steady state of the OAM 3AH loopback response. For details, see IEEE 802.3ah.

parameters.name: Ethernet OAM 3AH Flag
parameters.description: Indicates whether the Ethernet OAM 3AH is enabled.

parameters.name: Number of RX Packets
parameters.description: Indicates the number of packets received at the Ethernet port.

parameters.name: Number of RX Bytes
parameters.description: Indicates the number of bytes received at the Ethernet port.

parameters.id: Number of RX CRC Error Packets
parameters.name: Number of RX CRC Error Packets
parameters.description: Indicates the number of CRC error packets received at the Ethernet port.

parameters.name: RX Traffic
parameters.description: Indicates the traffic received at the Ethernet port.

parameters.name: Number of TX Packets
parameters.description: Indicates the number of packets transmitted at the Ethernet port.

parameters.name: Number of TX Bytes
parameters.description: Indicates the number of bytes transmitted at the Ethernet port.

parameters.name: TX Traffic
parameters.description: Indicates the traffic transmitted at the Ethernet port.

parameters.name: Number of IPs
parameters.description: Indicates the number of IP addresses configured for the Ethernet port. This parameter is valid only when Transmission Configuration Mode in the GTRANSPARA MO is set to OLD. This parameter is invalid when Transmission Configuration Mode in the GTRANSPARA MO is set to NEW.

parameters.name: IP Address List
parameters.description: Indicates the IP address and mask list configured for the Ethernet port. This parameter is valid only when Transmission Configuration Mode in the GTRANSPARA MO is set to OLD. This parameter is invalid when Transmission Configuration Mode in the GTRANSPARA MO is set to NEW.

parameters.name: Local Negotiation Mode
parameters.description: Indicates the negotiation mode of the Ethernet port.

parameters.name: Local Speed
parameters.description: Indicates the speed mode of the Ethernet port. This parameter must be set to the same value as that of the peer port.

parameters.name: Local Duplex
parameters.description: Indicates the duplex mode of the Ethernet port. If an Ethernet electrical port is used, this parameter is valid when SPEED is not set to AUTO. If an Ethernet optical port is used, this parameter must be set to FULL.

parameters.name: Peer Actual Negotiation Mode
parameters.description: Indicates the negotiation mode of the NE connecting to the Ethernet port.

parameters.name: Peer Speed
parameters.description: Indicates the speed mode of the NE connecting to the Ethernet port.

parameters.name: Peer Duplex
parameters.description: Indicates the duplex mode of the NE connecting to the Ethernet port.

parameters.name: Physical Layer Status
parameters.description: Indicates the physical layer status of the Ethernet port.

parameters.name: Cabinet No.
parameters.description: Indicates the cabinet number of the board where the Ethernet trunk is established.

parameters.name: Subrack No.
parameters.description: Indicates the number of the subrack housing the board where the Ethernet trunk is established.

parameters.name: Slot No.
parameters.description: Indicates the number of the slot housing the board where the Ethernet trunk is established.

parameters.name: Trunk No.
parameters.description: Indicates the number of the Ethernet trunk. When the board is a UTRPc board, the value of this parameter ranges from 0 to 2. When the board is a board other than the UTRPc board, the value of this parameter ranges from 0 to 1.

parameters.name: Trunk Type
parameters.description: Indicates the type of Ethernet trunk. When this parameter is set to DISABLE, the Ethernet trunk is in manual mode, and its status cannot be notified to the peer end. In this case, you need to manually configure the member ports of the Ethernet trunk. The base station considers these member ports as valid member ports of the Ethernet trunk. If this parameter is set to ENABLE, the Ethernet trunk is

parameters.name: ARP Proxy
parameters.description: Indicates whether to enable the ARP proxy function on the Ethernet trunk. If this parameter is set to ENABLE, the BS performs the ARP proxy on the IP addresses of its loopback interfaces (or of the lower-level BS). parameters.name: Subboard Type
parameters.description: Indicates the type of subboard on the board where the Ethernet trunk is established.

parameters.description: Indicates the size of the IPv4 maximum transmission unit for an Ethernet trunk. parameters.name: Ethernet Trunk Status
parameters.description: Indicates the status of the Ethernet trunk. The state of the Ethernet trunk depends on the state of the member ports. If the state of the member ports of the existing Ethernet trunk is activated, the state of the Ethernet trunk is activated.

parameters.name: Local MAC Address
parameters.description: Indicates the MAC address of the Ethernet trunk. The format is XXXX-XXXX-XXXX. The MAC address of an Ethernet port is that of the first Ethernet port added to the Ethernet trunk.

parameters.description: Indicates the MAC address of the Ethernet trunk at the peer end. The format is XXXX-XXXX-XXXX. If the Ethernet trunk type is set to ENABLE, this parameter specifies the MAC address of the peer end, which is negotiated between the BS and the peer end by using the LACP protocol. For details, see IEEE 802.3ad.

parameters.name: Defend Switch
parameters.description: Indicates whether to enable the protection against excessive flood packets.

parameters.name: Defend Threshold
parameters.description: Indicates the threshold for starting the protection against excessive flood packets. If the DFDSW parameter is set to ENABLE, the system discards the extra packets when the RX rate of flood packets exceeds the threshold. It is recommended that the difference between Defend Threshold and Alarm Threshold is greater than 3% of Defend Threshold.

parameters.name: Alarm Switch
parameters.description: Indicates whether to report an alarm when the local end receives excessive flood packets from the peer end.

parameters.name: Alarm Threshold
parameters.description: Indicates the threshold for the excessive flood packet alarm. If the ALMSW parameter is set to ENABLE, the system measures the RX rate of flood packets every 10 seconds. If the measured value exceeds the threshold, an excessive flood packet alarm is reported. The alarm is cleared if the RX rate of flood packets keeps below the threshold for five consecutive minutes. parameters.name: Number of Flood Dropped Packets
parameters.description: Indicates the number of packets discarded because the total number of flood packets exceeds the specified threshold.

parameters.name: Manager Cabinet No.
parameters.description: Indicates the cabinet number of the manager. The manager of the FMU is usually a BBU, RRU or CCU.

parameters.name: Manager Subrack No.
parameters.description: Indicates the subrack number of the manager. The manager of the FMU is usually a BBU, RRU or CCU.

parameters.name: Manager Port No.
parameters.description: Indicates the number of the serial port where the FMU is connected. The serial port is the port through which the FMU is connected to the manager unit.

parameters.name: Address
parameters.description: Indicates the communication address of the FMU. The manager establishes communication with the FMU through the communication address.

parameters.name: Special Boolean Alarm Flag
parameters.description: Indicates whether to allow the reporting of a dedicated Boolean alarm. If the shield flag for a Boolean alarm is enabled, the Boolean alarm cannot be reported.

parameters.name: Smart Temperature Control
parameters.description: Indicates the switch of smart temperature control. When the smart temperature control is enabled, the rotation speed of the fan is adjusted by the FMU according to the temperature control parameters delivered by the BBU. When the smart temperature control is disabled, the rotation speed of the fan is adjusted by the FMU automatically according to the temperature.

parameters.name: Temperature Control Mode
parameters.description: Indicates the mode that the fan speed adjustment adopts. Mode 0 is the default mode, which achieves balance in system power consumption, noise, and temperature control. It applies to most scenarios. Mode 9 is the synchronization mode, which brings low noise but poor temperature control. Inappropriate configuration of this parameter may lead to serious results such as high noise or service interrup

parameters.name: Temperature Alarm Detection Enh Switch
parameters.description: Indicates whether to enable the alarm detection enhancement function for the temperature exception of the air exhaust vent and air intake vent of an FMU. If this switch is turned on, the alarm threshold of the temperature difference between the air exhaust vent and air intake vent and the upper limit of the temperature alarm for the air intake vent can be configured. parameters.name: Temperature Delta Alarm Threshold
parameters.description: Indicates the alarm threshold of the temperature difference between the air exhaust vent and air intake vent. When the temperature difference between the air exhaust vent and air intake vent is higher than this threshold, ALM-25655 Cabinet Air Outlet Temperature Unacceptable is reported.

parameters.name: Inlet Temperature Alarm Threshold
parameters.description: Indicates the upper limit of the temperature alarm for the air intake vent. When the temperature of the air intake vent is higher than this threshold, ALM-25656 Cabinet Air Inlet Temperature Unacceptable is reported.

parameters.name: Fan Speed Rate

parameters.name: Temperature at Fan Air Inlet

parameters.name: Fan Average Speed

parameters.name: Operational State(from RU)
parameters.description: Indicates the operational state of the board, which can be set to Enabled or Disabled. Enabled indicates that services can be carried on the board. Disabled indicates that no service can be carried on the board.

"BoardType" indicates the type of the board. "BarCode" indicates the bar code of the board and is the same as the code labeled on the board. "Item" indicates the BOM code. parameters.name: Internal Cable Len

parameters.name: Alarm Status(from RU)
parameters.description: Indicates the alarm status of the board hardware, which can be set to Normal, Warning, Minor, Major, or Critical. The alarm status of the PSU, PDB, and BDU is in the alarm status of the PMU.

parameters.name: Operational State(from RU)
parameters.description: Indicates the operational state of the board, which can be set to Enabled or Disabled. Enabled indicates that services can be carried on the board. Disabled indicates that no service can be carried on the board.

parameters.name: Availability Status(from RU)

When this parameter is set to UPPEERSTATICCHK(User-Plane Peer Static Check), the user-plane peer static detection switch takes effect. parameters.description: Indicates the timer for deleting a direct IPsec tunnel that is faulty due to failed IKE negotiations. parameters.name: GPM ID
parameters.description: Indicates the No. of a GPM detection.

parameters.name: Detect Direction
parameters.description: Indicates the direction of a GPM detection.

parameters.name: Delay Detect Method
parameters.description: Indicates the delay detection method at the bottom layer used by the GPM detection.

parameters.name: Detect Object
parameters.description: Indicates the object to be detected by the GPM on the base station side. If the detection object is RSCGRP, the GPM detects congestion on transmission links of users in the transmission resource group.

parameters.name: Cabinet No.
parameters.description: Indicates the cabinet No. of the board where the transmission resource group detected by the GPM is located.

parameters.name: Subrack No.

parameters.name: Slot No.
parameters.description: Indicates the slot No. of the board where the transmission resource group detected by the GPM is located.

parameters.name: Port No.
parameters.description: Indicates the No. of the port where a transmission resource group detected by the GPM is carried.

parameters.name: Transmission Resource Group ID
parameters.description: Indicates the No. of the transmission resource group detected by the GPM.

parameters.name: Work State
parameters.description: Indicates the working state of a GPM detection. If the number of samples within a GPM detection period is 0, the working state of the GPM detection is "NO_MEASUREMENT". If the number of samples within a GPM detection period is greater than 0, the working state of the GPM detection is "IN_MEASUREMENT".

parameters.name: GPS Clock No.
parameters.description: Indicates the number of the GPS clock link.

parameters.description: Indicates the cabinet number of the board where the satellite card is attached.

parameters.name: Subrack No.

parameters.name: Slot No.
parameters.description: Indicates the slot number of the board where the satellite card is attached.

parameters.name: Way to Get Position
parameters.description: Indicates the method of obtaining the position of the GPS satellite.

parameters.name: Antenna Longitude
parameters.description: Indicates the longitude of the GPS antenna. A negative value indicates the west longitude, and a positive value indicates the east longitude.

parameters.name: Antenna Latitude
parameters.description: Indicates the latitude of the GPS antenna. A negative value indicates the south latitude, and a positive value indicates the north latitude.

parameters.name: Antenna Altitude
parameters.description: Indicates the altitude of the GPS antenna. A negative value indicates that the GPS antenna is below the sea level, and a positive value indicates that the GPS antenna is above the sea level.

parameters.name: Antenna Angle
parameters.description: Indicates the antenna angle, which is the angle with the horizontal line. If the clock source has not been activated, the value NULL will be displayed. If the clock source has been activated, the value NULL indicates that this parameter is not supported by the hardware or the hardware is faulty.

parameters.name: Duration
parameters.description: Indicates the duration for tracing the position of the GPS satellite.

parameters.name: Precision
parameters.description: Indicates the precision requirement for tracing the position of the GPS satellite.

parameters.name: Cable Length
parameters.description: Indicates the length of the GPS feeder. The actual feeder length is the one between the GPS antenna and the board connected to the GPS antenna. Based on the feeder length, the feeder delay is calculated to ensure the clock accuracy. Ensure that the value of this parameter is the same as the actual length of the feeder. If the difference between the value of this parameter and the actual feeder len

parameters.name: GPS Work Mode
parameters.description: Indicates the working mode of the satellite card. Satellite cards are classified into dual-mode satellite cards and single-mode satellite cards. parameters.name: Priority
parameters.description: Indicates the priority of the clock source. Value 1 indicates the current clock source has the highest priority, and Value 4 indicates the current clock source has the lowest priority.

parameters.name: Position Check Switch
parameters.description: Indicates the position check switch of a satellite card. If this switch is turned on, the NE records the position where a satellite card is locked as the initial position and calculates the deviation between this initial position and the current position. If the deviation is excessively large, the NE regards the output signals of the satellite card unreliable and reports ALM-26120 GPS Clock Output

parameters.name: Feeder Delay
parameters.description: Indicates the feeder delay of the GPS clock link. The value is NULL when the clock source is not activated.

parameters.name: GPS Version
parameters.description: Indicates the software version and hardware version of the satellite card. NULL is displayed for the software or hardware version which does not support query. The software version and the hardware version are separated by a hyphen "-". If the connected satellite card does not support the version query or the query fails, the value is NULL.

parameters.name: GPS Position Fixed
parameters.description: Indicates whether the position of the GPS reference receiver is locked.

parameters.name: Almanac Validity
parameters.description: Indicates whether the calendar information of the GPS reference receiver is valid.

parameters.name: Position Solution
parameters.description: Indicates whether the GPS satellite positioned by the GPS reference receiver is valid.

parameters.name: Fixed Position
parameters.description: Indicates whether the position of the GPS satellite is set on the GPS reference receiver.

parameters.name: Clock Steering
parameters.description: Indicates the clock adjusting state of the GPS reference receiver, Enabled indicates that the clock adjusting state is enabled and Disabled indicates that the clock adjusting state is disabled.

parameters.name: Clock Model Validity
parameters.description: Indicates whether the clock mode of the GPS reference receiver is valid.

parameters.name: GLONASS Satellites Traced
parameters.description: Indicates the number of traced GLONASS satellites.

parameters.name: GPS Card State
parameters.description: Indicates the physical status of the satellite card, which is specified by the value NOTEXIST (Inexistent), ANTENNASHORTED (Antenna Shorted), ANTENNAOPENED (Antenna Opened), SELF_CHECK_FAILURE (Self-check Failure), COMEXCEPTION (Star Card Communication Fault), NORMAL (Normal), UNKNOWN (Unknown Exception), USCUINVALID (USCU Invalid), or UNKNOWN_STAR_CARD (Unknown Star Card). The value of this param

parameters.name: GPS Card Type
parameters.description: Indicates the physical type of the satellite card.

parameters.name: GPS Satellites Traced
parameters.description: Indicates the number of traced GPS satellites.

parameters.name: BDS Satellites Traced
parameters.description: Indicates the number of traced BDS satellites.

parameters.name: Link Active State
parameters.description: Indicates the activation status of the GPS clock link. If the link is active, the GPS clock link is the current clock source of the system.

parameters.name: Hold Status
parameters.description: Indicates the holding status of a satellite card.

parameters.name: Position Deviation
parameters.description: Indicates the deviation between the current position and the initial position.

parameters.name: GALILEO Satellites Traced
parameters.description: Indicates the number of traced GALILEO satellites.

parameters.name: Resource Group Scheduling Weight Switch
parameters.description: Indicates the switch used to control whether to allocate bandwidths to transmission resource groups on the physical port based on their scheduling weights. parameters.name: Rate Config Type
parameters.description: Indicates the rate configuration mode of transmission resource groups in the BS, which can be set to SINGLE_RATE or DUAL_RATE. The dual rate configuration refers to the hybrid of the peak information rate (PIR) and committed information rate (CIR). If this parameter is set to SINGLE_RATE, the transmission resource group performs traffic shaping based on its transmit bandwidth. If this parameter is

parameters.name: Switch Back Time
parameters.description: Indicates the period during which the active and standby routes are switched over twice. This period indicates the interval between the time single-hop BFD detects that an active route changes from DOWN to UP and the time the active route becomes available. parameters.name: ARP Aging Time
parameters.description: Indicates the aging time of a dynamic ARP item of the BS. This parameter does not change the ARP aging time of the local maintenance Ethernet port.

parameters.name: Ping Filter Mode
parameters.description: Indicates the mode of the ping filtering. When the whitelist is used, only the network segments or hosts specified by the ping filter can ping the NE. When the blacklist is used, the network segments or hosts specified by the ping filter cannot ping the NE.

parameters.name: Ethernet OAM Type
parameters.description: Indicates the type of Ethernet OAM. The current Ethernet OAM type includes IEEE 802.1ag or ITU-T Y.1731 ETHOAM.

parameters.name: Monitor Policy
parameters.description: Indicates the ITU-T Y.1731 monitoring policy. The monitoring policy includes the following values: PORTID_VLANID (based on PortID and VLANID), PORTID_VLANID_VLANPRI (based on PortID, VLANID, and VLAN PRI), SA_DA_VLANID (based on PortID, source MAC address, destination MAC address, and VLANID), SA_DA_VLANID_VLANPRI (based on PortID, source MAC address, destination MAC address, VLANID, and VLAN PRI)

parameters.name: IPSec Bypass Switch
parameters.description: Indicates whether to enable the switchover of IPSec Bypass. If this parameter is set to DISABLE, the base station cannot switch between an IPSec network and a non-IPSec network.

parameters.name: IPSec Bypass Code
parameters.description: Indicates the password used for switching the base station between an IPSec network and a non-IPSec network.

parameters.name: IPSec Status
parameters.description: Indicates the state of IPSec Bypass.

parameters.name: OMCH Switch Back
parameters.description: Indicates whether the OM channel supports switchback. This parameter is valid only when the OM channel is bound to a UDP session, UDP session group, or automatic UDP session detection. parameters.name: OMCH Switch Back Wait Time
parameters.description: Indicates the duration for the detection switching from the standby remote maintenance channel to the active remote maintenance channel.

parameters.name: Control Port Load Balance Switch
parameters.description: Indicates whether load sharing is enabled among control ports on multiple multi-core transmission boards. parameters.name: Control Port Listening Mode
parameters.description: Indicates whether the control port supports the listening mode. If this parameter is set to ENABLE, the base station listens to the initial link establishment request of the peer SCTP for creating the control plane link. This parameter needs to be used with the EndPoint.

parameters.name: SCTP Fault Real-time Reporting Switch
parameters.description: Indicates whether to report an SCTP link fault alarm in real time. If this parameter is set to ENABLE, the base station considers an SCTP link faulty when it detects that the SCTP link is disconnected. parameters.name: Direct IPSec Priorities Match Switch
parameters.description: Indicates the switch for preferentially matching the IPSec policy of the directly connected IPv4 IPSec in end point mode. The IPSec policy of a direct IPSec tunnel is automatically generated and the IKE peer on which the IPSec policy depends is also automatically generated. parameters.name: Transmission Configuration Mode
parameters.description: Indicates the configuration mode of the transmission model. The transmission model can be configured in old or new mode. In old mode, the transmission model contains information such as cabinet, subrack, and slot numbers. Transmission configurations are bound to device boards. parameters.id: IP Frame Error Rate Alarm Switch
parameters.name: IP Frame Error Rate Alarm Switch
parameters.description: Indicates the switch controlling ALM-25897 IP Excessive Frame Error Rate. When this switch is set to ENABLE, this alarm is detected and reported when the reporting conditions are met.

parameters.id: IP Frame Error Rate Occur Threshold
parameters.name: IP Frame Error Rate Occur Threshold
parameters.description: Indicates the generation threshold of ALM-25897 IP Excessive Frame Error Rate. If IP Frame Error Rate Alarm Switch is set to ENABLE, this alarm is reported when the number of errored IP frames exceeds this threshold within ten minutes.

parameters.id: IP Frame Error Rate Clear Threshold
parameters.name: IP Frame Error Rate Clear Threshold
parameters.description: Indicates the clearance threshold of ALM-25897 IP Excessive Frame Error Rate. If this alarm is reported, this alarm is cleared when the number of errored IP frames is less than this threshold within ten minutes.

parameters.name: VLAN ID
parameters.description: Indicates the VLAN tag used by an NE in the Cloud BB network for communicating with other NEs.

parameters.name: Forward Mode
parameters.description: Indicates the forwarding mode flag. If this parameter is set to HOST, inter-port data routing and forwarding is disabled on the panel, and intra-port data routing and forwarding is also disabled on the panel. If this parameter is set to ROUTE, inter-port data routing and forwarding is enabled on the panel.

parameters.name: Same Port Forward Switch
parameters.description: Indicates whether to enable intra-port data routing and forwarding on the panel. Intra-port forwarding means that after being routed and forwarded, the packets received through a port are transmitted from the same port.

parameters.id: Enable Access to NE Using Maintenance IP Addresses Only
parameters.name: Enable Access to NE Using Maintenance IP Addresses Only
parameters.description: Indicates whether to enable only the maintenance of IP (OMCH IP and local IP) access to the network is enabled under the IPV4 group network. This parameter does not take effect when OMCH IP is not configured. It is recommended to enable only the maintenance of IP access elements, or there may be security risks. parameters.name: DNS Period
parameters.description: Indicates the period of DNS check. If this parameter value is not 0, the system adds a random time of 0 minutes to 30 minutes to the DNS check period. If this parameter value is 0, the system does not perform DNS check. This parameter takes effect only for LTE and NR.

parameters.name: Endpoint Object Auto-configure Switch
parameters.description: Indicates whether to enable the automatic configuration function of the end point-related MOs.

parameters.name: End Point Configure Mode
parameters.description: Indicates the configuration mode of an end point object, including S1SIMPLE_MODE(S1 Simple Mode), X2SIMPLE_MODE(X2 Simple Mode) and EX2SIMPLE_MODE(eX2 Simple Mode). This parameter can be set to one or multiple values. The parameter takes effect only in LTE.

parameters.name: Port Mode Auto Switch
parameters.description: Indicates whether to enable the port mode (data rate and duplex mode) adaptation function for an optical Ethernet port that carries traffic through the remote maintenance channel. parameters.description: Indicates which transmission configuration MOs and parameters are to be used. When the system supports extended NEs or when the OM model must be consistent with that of extended NEs, set this parameter to HOSTGW(Host-Gateway Mode). parameters.id: Number of Packets Discarded Due to Fragmentation Failures
parameters.name: Number of Packets Discarded Due to Fragmentation Failures

parameters.name: Total Number of Encrypted Packets Received at the IP Layer of the Receiver
parameters.description: Indicates the number of received packets that have been encrypted.

parameters.id: Number of Packets Successfully Decrypted at the IP Layer of the Receiver
parameters.name: Number of Packets Successfully Decrypted at the IP Layer of the Receiver
parameters.description: Indicates the number of packets that have been successfully decrypted at the receiver.

parameters.id: Total Number of Packets Failed in ESP Decryption at the IP Layer of the Receiver Hardware
parameters.name: Total Number of Packets Failed in ESP Decryption at the IP Layer of the Receiver Hardware
parameters.description: Indicates the number of received packets that fail the ESP-based decryption.

parameters.id: Total Number of Packets Failed in ESP Authentication at the IP Layer of the Receiver Hardware
parameters.name: Total Number of Packets Failed in ESP Authentication at the IP Layer of the Receiver Hardware
parameters.description: Indicates the number of received packets that fail the ESP-based authentication. The parameter takes effect only in UMPT.

parameters.id: Total Number of Packets Failed in AH Authentication at the IP Layer of the Receiver Hardware
parameters.name: Total Number of Packets Failed in AH Authentication at the IP Layer of the Receiver Hardware

parameters.id: Number of Failing Decrypted Packets at the Receiver

parameters.description: Indicates the number of encrypted packets received by the IP layer of the receiver from invalid IP addresses.

parameters.id: Total Number of Packets Discarded at the IP Layer of the Receiver Due to Replay Attacks
parameters.name: Total Number of Packets Discarded at the IP Layer of the Receiver Due to Replay Attacks

parameters.id: Total Number of Packets Discarded at the IP Layer of the Receiver Due to No Inbound SA
