parameters.description: Indicates the total number of plain packets received at the IP layer of the receiver.

parameters.id: Number of Packets Discarded at the IP Layer of the Receiver Due to not Being Encrypted
parameters.name: Number of Packets Discarded at the IP Layer of the Receiver Due to not Being Encrypted
parameters.description: Indicates the number of packets received at the IP layer that comply with ACL rules and should have been encrypted.

parameters.id: Number of Packets Successfully Encrypted at the IP Layer of the Transmitter
parameters.name: Number of Packets Successfully Encrypted at the IP Layer of the Transmitter
parameters.description: Indicates the number of transmitted packets that are successfully encrypted.

parameters.id: Total Number of Packets Failed to Be Encrypted at the IP Layer of the Transmitter
parameters.name: Total Number of Packets Failed to Be Encrypted at the IP Layer of the Transmitter
parameters.description: Indicates the number of packets that fail to be encrypted at the transmitter.

parameters.id: Total Number of Packets Received by the Encryption Module of the Transmitter
parameters.name: Total Number of Packets Received by the Encryption Module of the Transmitter
parameters.description: Indicates the total number of packets received by the encryption module of the transmitter.

parameters.id: Number of Packets That Should be Encrypted at the Transmitter
parameters.name: Number of Packets That Should be Encrypted at the Transmitter
parameters.description: Indicates the number of packets that need to be encrypted at the transmitter.

parameters.id: Total Number of Packets Discarded at the IP Layer of the Transmitter due to No Outbound SA
parameters.name: Total Number of Packets Discarded at the IP Layer of the Transmitter due to No Outbound SA
parameters.description: Indicates the number of packets discarded at the transmitter because the outbound SAs do not exist.

parameters.id: Total Number of Packets Discarded at the IP Layer of the Transmitter Due to Unsupported AH Algorithm
parameters.name: Total Number of Packets Discarded at the IP Layer of the Transmitter Due to Unsupported AH Algorithm
parameters.description: Indicates the number of packets discarded because the transmitter does not support the AH algorithm.

parameters.id: Total Number of Packets Discarded at the IP Layer of the Transmitter Due to Unsupported ESP Algorithm
parameters.name: Total Number of Packets Discarded at the IP Layer of the Transmitter Due to Unsupported ESP Algorithm
parameters.description: Indicates the number of packets discarded because the transmitter does not support the ESP algorithm.

parameters.id: Total Number of Packets Failed in AH Authentication at the IP Layer of the Transmitter Hardware
parameters.name: Total Number of Packets Failed in AH Authentication at the IP Layer of the Transmitter Hardware
parameters.description: Indicates the number of packets that fail the AH-based authentication at the transmitter.

parameters.id: Total Number of Packets Failed in ESP Encryption at the IP Layer of the Transmitter
parameters.name: Total Number of Packets Failed in ESP Encryption at the IP Layer of the Transmitter
parameters.description: Indicates the number of transmitted packets that fail ESP encryption.

parameters.id: Total Number of Packets Discarded at the IP Layer of the Transmitter Due to SN Overflow
parameters.name: Total Number of Packets Discarded at the IP Layer of the Transmitter Due to SN Overflow
parameters.description: Indicates the number of packets discarded due to transmitting sequence number overflow.

parameters.id: Total Number of Packets That Should Not Have Been Encrypted at the IP Layer of the Transmitter
parameters.name: Total Number of Packets That Should Not Have Been Encrypted at the IP Layer of the Transmitter
parameters.description: Indicates the number of packets that do not need to be encrypted at the transmitter.

parameters.name: Master SeGW IP
parameters.description: Indicates the IP address of the active security gateway when the base station is located in an IPSec network.

parameters.name: Slave SeGW IP
parameters.description: Indicates the IP address of the standby security gateway when the base station is located in an IPSec network.

parameters.id: Number of Received ICMP Port Unreachable Packets
parameters.name: Number of Received ICMP Port Unreachable Packets
parameters.description: Indicates the number of received ICMP port unreachable packets.

parameters.id: Number of Received ICMP Request Packets
parameters.name: Number of Received ICMP Request Packets
parameters.description: Indicates the number of received ICMP echo request packets.

parameters.id: Number of Received ICMP Reply Packets
parameters.name: Number of Received ICMP Reply Packets
parameters.description: Indicates the number of received ICMP echo reply packets.

parameters.id: Number of Transmitted ICMP Port Unreachable Packets
parameters.name: Number of Transmitted ICMP Port Unreachable Packets
parameters.description: Indicates the number of transmitted ICMP port unreachable packets.

parameters.id: Number of Transmitted ICMP Request Packets
parameters.name: Number of Transmitted ICMP Request Packets
parameters.description: Indicates the number of transmitted ICMP echo request packets.

parameters.id: Number of Transmitted ICMP Reply Packets
parameters.name: Number of Transmitted ICMP Reply Packets
parameters.description: Indicates the number of transmitted ICMP echo reply packets.

parameters.id: Number of Received UDP Ping Packets
parameters.name: Number of Received UDP Ping Packets
parameters.description: Indicates the number of received UDP ping packets. This parameter is valid only in GSM and UMTS modes.

parameters.id: Number of Transmitted UDP Ping Loop Packets
parameters.name: Number of Transmitted UDP Ping Loop Packets
parameters.description: Indicates the number of transmitted UDP ping loop packets. This parameter is valid only in GSM and UMTS modes.

parameters.name: Number of Bypass Packets
parameters.description: Indicates the number of bypass packets at the IP layer.

parameters.name: Priority Rule
parameters.description: Indicates the rule for prioritizing traffic to meet service requirements. If this parameter is set to IPPRECEDENCE, the protocol stack of the earlier version is adopted, which first converts a Type of Service (TOS) to a DSCP and then prioritizes traffic.

parameters.name: Resource Group Scheduling Weight Switch
parameters.description: Indicates the switch used to control whether to allocate bandwidths to transmission resource groups on the physical port based on their scheduling weights. When RATECFGTYPE (rate configuration type) is set to SINGLE_RATE and Physical Port Up Link OverBooking Switch or Physical Port Down Link OverBooking Switch is set to OFF, different values of this parameter lead to different bandwidth allocation

parameters.name: Rate Config Type
parameters.description: Indicates the rate configuration mode of transmission resource groups in the BS, which can be set to SINGLE_RATE or DUAL_RATE. The dual rate configuration refers to the hybrid of the peak information rate (PIR) and committed information rate (CIR). If this parameter is set to SINGLE_RATE, the transmission resource group performs traffic shaping based on its transmit bandwidth. If this parameter is

parameters.name: Switch Back Time
parameters.description: Indicates the period during which the active and standby routes are switched over twice. This period indicates the interval between the time single-hop BFD detects that an active route changes from DOWN to UP and the time the active route becomes available. During the switchover, if the previous standby route becomes faulty, the system waits for 10 seconds and then switches back to the active rout

parameters.name: ARP Aging Time
parameters.description: Indicates the aging time of a dynamic ARP item of the BS. This parameter does not change the ARP aging time of the local maintenance Ethernet port.

parameters.name: Ping Filter Mode
parameters.description: Indicates the mode of the ping filtering. When the whitelist is used, only the network segments or hosts specified by the ping filter can ping the NE. When the blacklist is used, the network segments or hosts specified by the ping filter cannot ping the NE.

parameters.name: Ethernet OAM Type
parameters.description: Indicates the type of Ethernet OAM. The current Ethernet OAM type can be either IEEE 802.1ag or ITU-T Y.1731 ETHOAM.

parameters.name: Monitor Policy
parameters.description: Indicates the ITU-T Y.1731 monitoring policy. The monitoring policy includes the following values: PORTID_VLANID (based on PortID and VLANID), PORTID_VLANID_VLANPRI (based on PortID, VLANID, and VLAN PRI), SA_DA_VLANID (based on PortID, source MAC address, destination MAC address, and VLANID), SA_DA_VLANID_VLANPRI (based on PortID, source MAC address, destination MAC address, VLANID, and VLAN PRI)

parameters.id: IP Frame Error Rate Alarm Switch
parameters.name: IP Frame Error Rate Alarm Switch
parameters.description: Indicates the switch controlling ALM-25897 IP Excessive Frame Error Rate. When this switch is set to ENABLE, this alarm is detected and reported when the reporting conditions are met.

parameters.id: IP Frame Error Rate Occur Threshold
parameters.name: IP Frame Error Rate Occur Threshold
parameters.description: Indicates the generation threshold of ALM-25897 IP Excessive Frame Error Rate. If IP Frame Error Rate Alarm Switch is set to ENABLE, this alarm is reported when the number of errored IP frames exceeds this threshold within ten minutes.

parameters.id: IP Frame Error Rate Clear Threshold
parameters.name: IP Frame Error Rate Clear Threshold
parameters.description: Indicates the clearance threshold of ALM-25897 IP Excessive Frame Error Rate. If this alarm is reported, this alarm is cleared when the number of errored IP frames is less than this threshold within ten minutes.

parameters.name: Forward Mode
parameters.description: Indicates the forwarding mode flag. If this parameter is set to HOST, inter-port data routing and forwarding is disabled on the panel, and intra-port data routing and forwarding is also disabled on the panel. If this parameter is set to ROUTE, inter-port data routing and forwarding is enabled on the panel.

parameters.name: Same Port Forward Switch
parameters.description: Indicates whether to enable intra-port data routing and forwarding on the panel. Intra-port forwarding means that after being routed and forwarded, the packets received through a port are transmitted from the same port.

parameters.name: Port Mode Auto Switch
parameters.description: Indicates whether to enable the port mode (data rate and duplex mode) adaptation function for an optical Ethernet port that carries traffic through the remote maintenance channel. When this switch is enabled, the base station uses the port mode adaptation function to restore the remote maintenance channel if the inconsistent port modes between the local and peer ends cause the remote maintenance c

parameters.name: IP Clock Priority
parameters.description: Indicates the priority of the IP clock. If the IP clock that follows the Precision Time Protocol (PTP) is used, set this parameter to the DSCP of the PTP packets. If the IP clock that follows the Huawei proprietary protocol is used, set this parameter to the DSCP of these packets that follow the Huawei proprietary protocol.

parameters.id: Physical Port Up Link OverBooking Switch
parameters.name: Physical Port Up Link OverBooking Switch
parameters.description: Indicates the switch that is used to determine whether to enable UL overbooking admission control. It is used to determine the admission bandwidth of the resource group and facilitate admission control. The parameter takes effect only for LTE.

parameters.id: Physical Port Down Link OverBooking Switch
parameters.name: Physical Port Down Link OverBooking Switch
parameters.description: Indicates the switch that is used to determine whether to enable DL overbooking admission control. It is used to determine the admission bandwidth of the resource group and facilitate admission control. The parameter takes effect only for LTE.

parameters.id: Physical Port Up Link Admission Switch
parameters.name: Physical Port Up Link Admission Switch
parameters.description: Indicates the switch that is used to determine whether to apply UL admission control over a physical port. If this parameter is set to ON, UL admission control is applied to the physical port. If this parameter is set to OFF, UL admission control is not applied to the physical port. The parameter takes effect only for LTE.

parameters.id: Physical Port Down Link Admission Switch
parameters.name: Physical Port Down Link Admission Switch
parameters.description: Indicates the switch that is used to determine whether to apply DL admission control over a physical port. If this parameter is set to ON, DL admission control is applied to the physical port. If this parameter is set to OFF, DL admission control is not applied to the physical port. The parameter takes effect only for LTE.

parameters.name: Cabinet No.
parameters.description: Indicates the number of the cabinet housing the board where the HA group is established.

parameters.name: Subrack No.
parameters.description: Indicates the number of the subrack housing the board where the HA group is established.

parameters.name: Logic Slot No.
parameters.description: Indicates the logical slot number of the HA group. The logical slot number of an HA group is the number of the physical slot housing one of the two boards constituting the HA group.

parameters.name: Cabinet No.
parameters.description: Indicates the number of the cabinet where the TCU is located.

parameters.name: Subrack No.
parameters.description: Indicates the number of the subrack where the TCU is located.

parameters.name: Slot No.
parameters.description: Indicates the number of the slot where the TCU is located.

parameters.name: Low Temperature Critical Point
parameters.description: Indicates the threshold of the low temperature state.

parameters.name: High Temperature Critical Point
parameters.description: Indicates the threshold of the high temperature state.

parameters.name: Temperature Limit at Air Outlet
parameters.description: Indicates the expected lowest temperature at the air outlet.

parameters.name: Dead Band
parameters.description: Indicates the tolerable error value of temperature control.

parameters.name: Normal Temperature Delta Tin
parameters.description: Indicates the difference between the temperature at the air inlet and that of the environment at the normal temperature.

parameters.name: Normal Temperature Delta Tout
parameters.description: Indicates the difference between the temperature at the air outlet and that of the air inlet at the normal temperature.

parameters.name: High Temperature Delta Tout
parameters.description: Indicates the difference between the temperature at the air outlet and that of the environment at the high temperature.

parameters.name: Hybrid Clock Number
parameters.description: Indicates the number of the hybrid reference clock.

parameters.id: Time Synchronization Clock Reference Source Type
parameters.name: Time Synchronization Clock Reference Source Type
parameters.description: Indicates the type of the reference clock for time synchronization.

parameters.id: Time Synchronization Clock Reference Source Number
parameters.name: Time Synchronization Clock Reference Source Number
parameters.description: Indicates the number of the reference clock for time synchronization.

parameters.id: Frequency Synchronization Clock Reference Source Type
parameters.name: Frequency Synchronization Clock Reference Source Type
parameters.description: Indicates the type of the reference clock for frequency synchronization.

parameters.id: Frequency Synchronization Clock Reference Source Number
parameters.name: Frequency Synchronization Clock Reference Source Number
parameters.description: Indicates the number of the reference clock for frequency synchronization.

parameters.name: Link Active State
parameters.description: Indicates the activation status of a hybrid reference clock.

parameters.name: Link Available State
parameters.description: Indicates the availability status of a hybrid reference clock.

parameters.name: Cabinet No.
parameters.description: Indicates the cabinet number of the board where the port is located.

parameters.name: Subrack No.
parameters.description: Indicates the subrack number of the board where the port is located.

parameters.name: Slot No.
parameters.description: Indicates the slot number of the board where the port is located.

parameters.name: Subboard Type
parameters.description: Indicates the type of sub-board on the board where a port is located.

parameters.name: Port Type
parameters.description: Indicates the type of the physical port. The UMTS currently does not support SUBIF.

parameters.name: Port No.
parameters.description: Indicates the number of a port.

parameters.name: VRF Index
parameters.description: Indicates the index of a VRF instance. UMTS currently supports the default routing domain only (the VRF index is 0).

parameters.name: IP Address
parameters.description: Indicates the IP address configured for the port.

parameters.name: Mask
parameters.description: Indicates the subnet mask of the interface IP address configured on the port.

parameters.name: User Label
parameters.description: Indicates the user-defined information about an interface IP address.

parameters.name: Address Status
parameters.description: Indicates the status of the IP address. If Valid is displayed, it indicates that the IP address is available. If Invalid is displayed, it indicates that the port corresponding to the IP address is not activated. If Duplicate is displayed, it indicates that the IP address conflicts with the IP address of an external interface.

parameters.name: Local Name
parameters.description: Indicates the IKE local name.

parameters.name: Interval for Sending Keepalive Packets
parameters.description: Indicates the interval for sending keepalive packets. When this parameter is set to 0, keepalive packets are not sent. When this parameter is not set to 0, check the timer for waiting for keepalive packets on the peer end. It is recommended that the timer length be greater than or equal to a value three times of this parameter value.

parameters.name: Keepalive Timeout
parameters.description: Indicates the timeout duration for waiting for the keepalive packets. If this parameter is set to 0, keepalive packets are not sent.

parameters.id: Interval for Sending NAT Keepalive Packets
parameters.name: Interval for Sending NAT Keepalive Packets
parameters.description: Indicates the interval for sending network address translation (NAT) keepalive packets. This parameter is valid only when the NAT traversal function of IPsec is enabled.

parameters.name: DSCP
parameters.description: Indicates the DSCP for IKE negotiation packets.

parameters.name: IPSec Redundancy Switch Back
parameters.description: Indicates whether to allow a switchback to the master IKE peer after its negotiation recovers when the IPSec redundancy function is enabled. If this parameter is set to OFF, the base station automatically stops the negotiation with the master IKE peer (IPv4 or IPv6) when the negotiation with the master IKE peer fails and the negotiation with a slave IKE peer succeeds. In this case, the IKE negotia

parameters.id: IPSec Redundancy Switch Back Wait Time
parameters.name: IPSec Redundancy Switch Back Wait Time
parameters.description: Indicates the duration before a switchover from the slave IKE peer to the master IKE peer in the IPSec redundancy function. If the master IKE peer that has been switched over to the slave IKE peer due to failed negotiation succeeds in the negotiation again, the duration from the negotiation success to the back switchover equals the duration specified by this parameter plus a random delay generated

parameters.id: IPSec Redundancy Switch Back Random Delay Time
parameters.name: IPSec Redundancy Switch Back Random Delay Time
parameters.description: Indicates the random delay before a switchover from the slave IKE peer to the master IKE peer in the IPSec redundancy function. When this parameter is set to N, a random delay that ranges from 0 to N is added to the duration before a back switchover. When this parameter is set to 0, no random delay is added to the duration before a back switchover. If the master IKE peer that has been switched ove

parameters.name: IPSec Redundancy Switchover Wait Time
parameters.description: Indicates the duration before a switchover from the master IKE peer to the slave IKE peer in the IPSec redundancy function. If a master IKE peer fails the negotiation, the slave IKE peer initiates negotiation after a period that equals the duration specified by this parameter plus a random delay generated with the IPSec Redundancy Switchover Random Delay Time parameter specified. If the SET IKECFG

parameters.id: IPSec Redundancy Switchover Random Delay Time
parameters.name: IPSec Redundancy Switchover Random Delay Time
parameters.description: Indicates the random delay before a switchover from the masker IKE peer to the slave IKE peer in the IPSec redundancy function. If a master IKE peer fails the negotiation, the slave IKE peer initiates negotiation after a period that equals the duration specified by the IPSec Redundancy Switchover Wait Time parameter plus a random delay generated with this parameter specified. When this parameter i

parameters.name: IPSec Bind Mode
parameters.description: Indicates the binding mode of an IPsec policy group, which can be global mode and single-interface mode. The two modes are mutually exclusive. In global mode, an IPsec policy group and packet filtering policies can be bound only to a normal interface, and the IPsec and packet filtering policies take effect on the normal interface and all VLAN subinterfaces in the default routing domain of the phys

parameters.name: Cabinet No.
parameters.description: Indicates the cabinet number of the IKE local board.

parameters.name: Subrack No.
parameters.description: Indicates the subrack number of the IKE local board.

parameters.name: Slot No.
parameters.description: Indicates the slot number of the IKE local board.

parameters.name: IKE Peer Name
parameters.description: Indicates the name of the IKE peer.

parameters.name: IKE Proposal ID
parameters.description: Indicates the ID of the IKE proposal in use.

parameters.name: Version
parameters.description: Indicates the IKE protocol version.

parameters.name: Exchange Mode
parameters.description: Indicates the IKE exchange mode. In main mode, keys are exchanged independently from identity authentications. This protects identity information and hence enhances security. The aggressive mode does not have identity authentication protection.

parameters.name: Local ID Type
parameters.description: Indicates the type of the identification payload that the local end transmits. The authentication can be performed based on IPv4 address, IPv6 address, fully qualified domain name (FQDN) or distinguished name (DN).

parameters.name: IP Version
parameters.description: Indicates the IP protocol version.

parameters.name: Remote IP Address
parameters.description: Indicates the IP address of the peer end.

parameters.name: Remote Name
parameters.description: Indicates the name of the peer end.

parameters.name: Pre-shared Key
parameters.description: Indicates the pre-shared key. The two negotiation ends must be configured with the same authenticator. This parameter takes effect only when Authentication Method in the corresponding IKEPROPOSAL is set to PRE_SHARED_KEY.

parameters.name: NAT Traversal
parameters.description: Indicates whether to enable the Network Address Translation (NAT) traversal function. The NAT traversal function is not supported by IKE SA in IPv6 scenarios.

parameters.name: DPD Mode
parameters.description: Indicates whether to enable the dead peer detection (DPD) function. When the IPSec redundancy function is enabled, it is recommended that the DPD detection function also be enabled. Otherwise, an active or standby IKE peer has to wait for a long time before the switchover.

parameters.name: DPD Idle Time
parameters.description: Indicates the dead peer detection (DPD) idle time. If the total time during which the local end does not receive encrypted packets reaches the value specified by the DPD Idle Time parameter, the local end sends the DPD packet to perform DPD. However, the exact time at which the eNodeB sends DPD messages varies depending on network environment.

parameters.name: DPD Retransmission Interval
parameters.description: Indicates the interval at which DPD detection frames are sent. The interval at which DPD detection frames are sent may slightly vary in various network environments such as network congestion, delay, and jitter.

parameters.name: DPD Retransmission Count
parameters.description: Indicates the number of retransmission attempts after a DPD detection fails.

parameters.name: Control Mode
parameters.description: Indicates whether the object can be modified or deleted by the system. The value MANUAL_MODE means that only the user can modify or delete the object. The value AUTO_MODE means only the system can modify or delete the object.

parameters.name: Local IP Address
parameters.description: Indicates the IP address of the local end, which is used in IKE negotiation. This IP address can be set to 0.0.0.0 or a configured interface IP address at the local end. If this parameter is set to 0.0.0.0, the BS automatically uses the interface IP address to negotiate with the peer. If multiple IP addresses are configured at the port, it is recommended that you specify one IP address for the neg

parameters.name: Auto Config Flag
parameters.description: Indicates whether the object is created by the system. MANUAL_CREATED means that the object is configured by the user manually. AUTO_CREATED means that the object is created by the system.

parameters.name: Redundancy Flag
parameters.description: Indicates the redundancy attribute of an IKE peer. If this parameter is set to NONE(Non-redundancy), the IKE peer does not use the IPSec redundancy function. If this parameter is set to MASTER(Master) or SLAVE(Slave), the IPSec policy group that references the IKE peer has been bound to an interface, the security configurations of the IPSec redundancy group to which the IKE peer belongs are modifi

parameters.name: Master Peer Name
parameters.description: Indicates the name of the master IKE peer to which the current slave IKE peer corresponds.

parameters.name: Priority
parameters.description: Indicates the priority of the current slave IKE peer. A small value indicates a high priority of the slave IKE peer.

parameters.name: Certificate Source
parameters.description: Indicates the source of the certificate used for IKE negotiation in the multi-PKI scenario. When this parameter is set to APPCERT, the certificate configured by the APPCERT MO is used. When this parameter is set to CERTMK, the certificate configured by the CERTMK MO is used.

parameters.name: Certificate File Name
parameters.description: Indicates the name of the certificate file used in the IKE negotiation in the multi-PKI scenario.

parameters.name: IKEv2 Redirect Switch
parameters.description: Indicates whether to enable the IKEv2 redirection function. When this parameter is set to OFF, the base station does not support the IKEv2 redirection function, and will discard the redirection packets sent from the peer end. When this parameter is set to ON, the base station supports the IKEv2 redirection function. When the IKEv2 redirection function is enabled, the negotiation must be initiated

parameters.name: IPSec PreFragment Switch
parameters.description: Indicates whether packets can be fragmented before being encrypted. If this parameter is set to OFF and the IPVERSION parameter is set to IPv4 for an IKE peer, the IPv4 traffic is not fragmented, and the IPv6 traffic is fragmented based on the maximum MTU capability of the internal ports. If IPVERSION is set to IPv6 for an IKE peer, the internal system sets the MTU used by IPv4 and IPv6 traffic to

parameters.name: Maximum Transmission Unit
parameters.description: Indicates the MTU of IPv4 or IPv6 before packets are encrypted when the IP protocol version of an IKE peer is IPv4. This parameter takes effect for both IPv4 and IPv6 traffic when the ACL type of the IPsec policy that references the IKE peer is IPv4+IPv6. If the length of a packet before encryption exceeds the value of this parameter, the system fragments the packet based on the value of this para

parameters.name: Remote IPv6 Address
parameters.description: Indicates the IPv6 address of the peer end.

parameters.name: Local IPv6 Address
parameters.description: Indicates the IPv6 address that is used by the local end in IPv6 IKE negotiation. This IP address must be set to a device IPv6 address configured at the local end. If multiple IPv6 addresses are configured for an interface, this parameter can be set to one of the IPv6 addresses to negotiate with the peer end.

parameters.name: Cabinet No.
parameters.description: Indicates the cabinet number of the IKE peer board.

parameters.name: Subrack No.
parameters.description: Indicates the subrack number of the IKE peer board.

parameters.name: Slot No.
parameters.description: Indicates the slot number of the IKE peer board.

parameters.name: VRF Index
parameters.description: Indicates the index of a VRF instance. UMTS currently supports the default routing domain only (the VRF index is 0).

parameters.name: Proposal ID
parameters.description: Indicates the ID of the IKE proposal.

parameters.name: Encryption Algorithm
parameters.description: Indicates the encryption algorithm used in the IKE proposal. The Data Encryption Standard (DES) is an internationally used data encryption algorithm, which uses a 56-bit key. The 3DES is also an internationally used encryption algorithm, which uses a 168-bit key. The Advanced Encryption Standard (AES) is an advanced encryption algorithm, which provides three types of key of different lengths: 128,

parameters.name: Authentication Algorithm
parameters.description: Indicates the authentication algorithm used in the IKE proposal. IKE uses hashed message authentication code (HMAC) or cipher block chaining (CBC) for identity authentication and data integrity check. For details about HMAC, see RFC4306. HMAC currently supports four hash functions: message digest algorithm 5 (MD5), secure hash algorithm 1 (SHA1), secure hash algorithm 256 (SHA256), and secure hash

parameters.name: Authentication Method
parameters.description: Indicates the authentication mode used in the IKE proposal. For details, see RFC2409 and RFC7427.

parameters.name: Diffie-Hellman Group
parameters.description: Indicates the Diffie-Hellman (DH) group of the IKE proposal. The core technology used in an IKE proposal is the Diffie-Hellman (DH) exchange technology. The DH exchange technology is used to calculate private information based on public information. It is mathematically proven that decrypting the DH information is impractical due to calculation complexity. The Diffie-Hellman group specified by the

parameters.name: ISAKMP SA Duration
parameters.description: Indicates the life cycle of an ISAKMP SA. ISAKMP refers to Internet Security Association and Key Management Protocol, and SA refers to security association. IKE negotiation requires a long time to calculate Diffie-Hellman (DH) keys. It is recommended that this parameter be set to greater than 10 minutes so that the update of the ISAKMP SA does not affect the secure communication. Before the SA lif

parameters.name: PRF Algorithm
parameters.description: Indicates the Pseudo-random Function (PRF) algorithm used in IKEv2. The PRF algorithm is used to generate the materials required for IKE authentication and encryption. For details about how to generate materials, see RFC4306. The value HMAC_SHA384 is supported only by the UMPTg, UMPTga, UBBPg2, UBBPg3, UBBPg4, UBBPg5, UBBPg6, UBBPg7 and UBBPg9 boards.

parameters.name: IKE Reauthentication Switch
parameters.description: Indicates whether to enable the IKEv2 re-authentication. Reauthentication is done by creating a new IKE SA from scratch, creating new Child SAs within the new IKE SA, and finally deleting the old IKE SA (which deletes the old Child SAs as well). For details, see RFC5996. When this parameter is set to OFF, the BS starts the IKEv2 re-authentication only when the BS serves as the initiation end and r

parameters.name: IKE Reauthentication Lifetime
parameters.description: Indicates the life cycle of IKEv2 re-authentication. It is recommended that this parameter be set to a value greater than that of the ISAKMP SA Duration parameter. Otherwise, the ISAKMP SA Duration parameter becomes invalid. This parameter is invalid for IKEv1.

parameters.name: Signature Hash Algorithm Negotiation Switch
parameters.description: Indicates whether to enable the digital signature authentication method (see RFC7427) and support signature hash algorithm negotiation. If this parameter is set to ENABLE, the digital signature authentication method is used, signature hash algorithm negotiation is supported, and the base station sends a SIGNATURE_HASH_ALGORITHMS notification packet when initiating negotiation. If this parameter is

parameters.name: RSA Padding
parameters.description: Indicates the RSA padding mode when the digital signature authentication method (see RFC7427) is used. If this parameter is set to PKCS1V15, the RSASSA_PKCS1V15 padding mode is used for RSA signatures. If this parameter is set to PSS, the RSASSA_PSS padding mode is used for RSA signatures.

parameters.name: Cabinet No.
parameters.description: Indicates the cabinet number of the board that adopts the IKE security proposal.

parameters.name: Subrack No.
parameters.description: Indicates the subrack number of the board that adopts the IKE security proposal.

parameters.name: Slot No.
parameters.description: Indicates the slot number of the board that adopts the IKE security proposal.

parameters.name: Cabinet No.
parameters.description: Indicates the cabinet number of the board where the IMA group is located.

parameters.name: Subrack No.
parameters.description: Indicates the subrack number of the board where the IMA group is located.

parameters.name: Slot No.
parameters.description: Indicates the slot number of the board where the IMA group is located.

parameters.name: Group No.
parameters.description: Indicates the number of the IMA group.

parameters.name: IMA Protocol Version
parameters.description: Indicates the version of the IMA protocol. If this parameter is set to V1.0, the position of RX link information in an IMA Control Protocol (ICP) cell is determined by the TX Link ID (LID) transmitted by the local end. If this parameter is set to V1.1, the position of RX link information in an ICP cell is determined by the TX LID transmitted by the peer end.

parameters.name: Clock Mode
parameters.description: Indicates the clock mode of the IMA group. Links in an IMA group may pass through different transport networks. As a result, links in the IMA group may use different clock sources for synchronization. It is recommended that the IMA group work in Independent Transmit Clock (ITC) mode.

parameters.name: Tx Frame Length
parameters.description: Indicates the length of the frame used for data transmission on the IMA link in the IMA group. A larger value of this parameter results in higher efficiency but lower sensitivity to bit errors.

parameters.name: Min Number of Links Activated
parameters.description: Indicates the minimum number of active links that must be contained in an available IMA group. If the number of active links contained in the IMA group is smaller than the minimum number, the IMA group is unavailable.

parameters.name: Diff Max Delay
parameters.description: Indicates the allowed maximum differentiated delay of the IMA group.

parameters.name: Scramble Mode
parameters.description: Indicates whether scrambling is applied to the IMA group.

parameters.name: 16th Time Slot Support
parameters.description: Indicates whether to enable E1 timeslot 16.

parameters.name: Subboard Type
parameters.description: Indicates the type of sub-board on the board where the IMA group is established.

parameters.name: NE State
parameters.description: Indicates the near end status of the IMA group. The near end inversely multiplexes one ATM cell stream (unit: cell) to enable the cells to be transmitted on multiple physical links.

parameters.name: FE State
parameters.description: Indicates the remote group status of the IMA group. The far end multiplexes the cell streams transmitted on multiple physical connections into a single cell stream.

parameters.name: Group Failure Status
parameters.description: Indicates the failure status of the IMA group.

parameters.name: Tx Available Bandwidth
parameters.description: Indicates the available TX bandwidth of the IMA group. The number of activated RX links may be greater than that of activated TX links only when IMA links are connected improperly or the TX or RX link is disconnected. At this time, available TX and RX bandwidths in the listed result of the IMA group status are calculated according to the number of activated TX links.

parameters.name: Rx Available Bandwidth
parameters.description: Indicates the RX bandwidth of the IMA group. The number of activated RX links will be greater than that of activated TX links only when IMA links are connected improperly or the TX or RX link is disconnected. At this time, available TX and RX bandwidths in the listed result of the IMA group status are calculated according to the number of activated TX links.

parameters.name: Number of Tx Links Configured
parameters.description: Indicates the configured TX link numbers of the IMA group.

parameters.name: Number of Rx Links Configured
parameters.description: Indicates the configured RX link numbers of the IMA group.

parameters.name: Number of Tx Links Activated
parameters.description: Indicates the activated TX link numbers of the IMA group. Generally, the number of activated TX links should be equal to the number of configured TX links. If the number of activated TX links is less than the number of configured TX links, you can infer that one or more links are faulty. The number of activated RX links may be greater than that of activated TX links only when IMA links are connect

parameters.name: Number of Rx Links Activated
parameters.description: Indicates the activated RX link numbers of the IMA group.

parameters.name: IMA Link No.
parameters.description: Indicates the number of the IMA link under test.

parameters.name: Test Picture
parameters.description: Indicates the picture of the IMA test. If the system sends a test picture from an IMA link in an IMA group, it expects to receive the picture on another link in the same IMA group to check the connectivity of the IMA links in the IMA group. When this parameter is not specified, the user-defined IMA group number plus 1 is used as the test picture by default. You can set this parameter to any number

parameters.name: Test Result
parameters.description: Indicates the result of the IMA group test.

parameters.name: Number of Tx Cells
parameters.description: Indicates the number of cells sent by the IMA group.

parameters.name: Number of Rx Cells
parameters.description: Indicates the number of cells received by the IMA group.

parameters.name: Number of Tx Filler Cells
parameters.description: Indicates the number of filler cells transmitted by the IMA group.

parameters.name: Number of Rx Filler Cells
parameters.description: Indicates the number of filler cells received by the IMA group.

parameters.name: Number of Rx Dropped Cells
parameters.description: Indicates the number of user received cells that are discarded due to congestion at the ATM layer.

parameters.name: Number of Tx Discarded Cells
parameters.description: Indicates the number of user transmitted cells that are discarded due to congestion at the ATM layer.

parameters.name: IMA Group Subboard Type
parameters.description: Indicates the type of sub-board on the board where the IMA link is established.

parameters.id: Number of Deleted IMA Links Caused by Loopback
parameters.name: Number of Deleted IMA Links Caused by Loopback
parameters.description: Indicates the number of IMA links that are removed due to loopbacks.

parameters.name: Cabinet No.
parameters.description: Indicates the cabinet number of the board of the IMA link.

parameters.name: Subrack No.
parameters.description: Indicates the subrack number of the board of the IMA link.

parameters.name: Slot No.
parameters.description: Indicates the slot number of the board of the IMA link.

parameters.name: Link No.
parameters.description: Indicates the number of the IMA link, or indicates the E1/T1 port number of the board of the IMA link.

parameters.name: IMA Group No.
parameters.description: Indicates the IMA group number of the IMA link.

parameters.name: Subboard Type
parameters.description: Indicates the type of sub-board on the board where the IMA link is established.

parameters.name: IMA Group Subboard Type
parameters.description: Indicates the type of sub-board on the board where the IMA group containing an IMA link is established.

parameters.name: NE TX Link State
parameters.description: Indicates the TX status of the IMA link at the near end. The near end inversely multiplexes one ATM cell stream (unit: cell) to enable the cells to be transmitted on multiple physical links.

parameters.name: NE RX Link State
parameters.description: Indicates the RX status of the IMA link at the near end.

parameters.name: FE TX Link State
parameters.description: Indicates the TX status of the IMA link at the far end. The far end multiplexes the cell streams transmitted on multiple physical connections into a single cell stream.

parameters.name: FE RX Link State
parameters.description: Indicates the RX status of the IMA link at the far end.

parameters.id: NE IMA RX Link Invalid State
parameters.name: NE IMA RX Link Invalid State
parameters.description: Indicates the invalid RX status of the local IMA link at the near end.

parameters.id: FE IMA RX Link Invalid State
parameters.name: FE IMA RX Link Invalid State
parameters.description: Indicates the invalid RX status of the IMA link at the far end.

parameters.name: Number of Tx User Cells
parameters.description: Indicates the number of user cells transmitted by the IMA link.

parameters.name: Number of Rx User Cells
parameters.description: Indicates the number of user cells received by the IMA link.

parameters.name: Number of Rx Filtered Cells
parameters.description: Indicates the number of incorrect user cells discarded by the IMA link.

parameters.name: Number of Rx Dropped Cells
parameters.description: Indicates the number of discarded idle cells received by the IMA link.

parameters.id: Number of Rx Abnormal Synchronized frame Cells
parameters.name: Number of Rx Abnormal Synchronized frame Cells
parameters.description: Indicates the number of cells with abnormal frame synchronization on the IMA link.

parameters.name: Number of Violation ICP Cells
parameters.description: Indicates the number of invalid IMA Control Protocol (ICP) cells received by the IMA link.

parameters.name: Number of Correct ICP Cells
parameters.description: Indicates the number of valid IMA Control Protocol (ICP) cells received by an IMA link.

parameters.name: Number of HEC Failure Cells
parameters.description: Indicates the number of Header Error Control (HEC) error cells received by the IMA link.

parameters.name: Number of Tx Stuff Cells
parameters.description: Indicates the number of stuff cells transmitted by the IMA link.

parameters.name: Number of Rx Stuff Cells
parameters.description: Indicates the number of stuff cells received by the IMA link.

parameters.name: Number of Rx Filler Cells
parameters.description: Indicates the number of filler cells received by the IMA link.

parameters.name: File Integrity Check Switch
parameters.description: Indicates the file integrity check switch.

parameters.name: File Integrity Check Time
parameters.description: Indicates the time of a daily file integrity check. The value must be an integer ranging from 00:00 to 23:00.

parameters.name: File Integrity Check Item
parameters.description: Indicates the file integrity check item.

parameters.name: Interconnection Clock No.
parameters.description: Indicates the number of the interconnection reference clock link.

parameters.name: Priority
parameters.description: Indicates the priority of the clock source. The value 1 indicates that the current clock source has the highest priority, and the value 4 indicates that the current clock source has the lowest priority.

parameters.name: Link Active State
parameters.description: Indicates the activation status of the interconnection reference clock link. If the link is active, the interconnection reference clock link is the current clock source of the system.

parameters.name: Link Available State
parameters.description: Indicates the availability of the interconnection reference clock link. Only an available clock link can serve as the current clock source. Otherwise, the clock link cannot be locked even if it is activated.

parameters.name: Reference Clock Synchronization Type
parameters.description: Indicates the clock synchronization mode of the interconnection reference clock link, which can be frequency synchronization or time synchronization. When the clock source is unavailable, the clock synchronization mode is unknown.

parameters.name: Cabinet No
parameters.description: Indicates the cabinet number of the board where the interconnection clock is located.

parameters.name: Subrack No
parameters.description: Indicates the subrack number of the board where the interconnection clock is located.

parameters.name: Slot No
parameters.description: Indicates the slot number of the board where the interconnection clock is located.

parameters.name: Port No
parameters.description: Indicates the input port of the interconnection clock. When an NE serves as the reference clock source for the Cloud BB, the NE outputs interconnection clock signals. In this case, the interconnection clock signals are from a non-interconnection reference clock source and there is no input port, and therefore the parameter value is NULL.

parameters.name: Time
parameters.description: Indicates the time when the input port is changed.

parameters.name: Interface ID
parameters.description: Indicates the ID of an interface. The value of ITFID in the INTERFACE MOs configured by users ranges from 0 to 1499. The value of ITFID in the INTERFACE MOs configured by the system ranges from 10000 to 19999.

parameters.name: Interface Type
parameters.description: Indicates the type of an interface, which can be normal or VLAN.

parameters.name: Port Type
parameters.description: Indicates the type of the port to which an interface belongs.

parameters.name: IPv6 Switch
parameters.description: This parameter indicates whether the ability to interface IPV6 functionality is enabled.

parameters.name: Port ID
parameters.description: Indicates the ID of the port to which an interface belongs.

parameters.name: VLAN Tagged Switch
parameters.description: Indicates whether the interface processes VLAN tagged packets. When this parameter is set to DISABLE, the interface of the normal type can receive only untagged packets. When this parameter is set to ENABLE, the interface of the normal type can receive both untagged and tagged packets.

parameters.name: VLAN ID
parameters.description: Indicates the VLAN ID of an interface.

parameters.name: DSCP-to-PCP Mapping ID
parameters.description: Indicates the ID of a mapping between DSCP values and VLAN priorities, which is used by an interface.

parameters.name: DSCP-to-Queue Mapping ID
parameters.description: Indicates the ID of a mapping between DSCP values and queue, which is used by an interface.

parameters.name: VRF Index
parameters.description: Indicates the index of a VRF instance. UMTS currently supports the default routing domain only (the VRF index is 0).

parameters.name: IPv4 Maximum Transmission Unit
parameters.description: Indicates the maximum IPv4 transmission unit supported by an interface.

parameters.name: IPv6 Maximum Transmission Unit
parameters.description: Indicates the maximum IPv6 transmission unit supported by an interface.

parameters.name: ARP Proxy
parameters.description: Indicates whether to enable the ARP proxy function. If the ARP proxy function is enabled, the base station serves as an ARP proxy for a loopback interface address included in the interface address segment of the base station or for an interface IP address of a lower-level base station. If this function is disabled, the base station does not serve as an ARP proxy for the loopback interface IP addre

parameters.name: User Label
parameters.description: Indicates the user-defined information about an interface.

parameters.name: Control Mode
parameters.description: Indicates whether the object can be automatically modified or removed by the system. When this parameter is set to MANUAL_MODE, only users can perform operations on the object. When this parameter is set to AUTO_MODE, only the system can perform operations on the object.

parameters.name: Cabinet No.
parameters.description: Indicates the cabinet number of the board to which an interface belongs.

parameters.name: Subrack No.
parameters.description: Indicates the subrack number of the board to which an interface belongs.

parameters.name: Slot No.
parameters.description: Indicates the slot number of the board to which an interface belongs.

parameters.name: Interface Status
parameters.description: Indicates whether an interface is activated. The status of an interface which bears on Tunnel Interface is up only after it is binded with an IPSec Policy Group.

parameters.name: Number of IPv4 Addresses
parameters.description: Indicates the number of IPv4 addresses that have taken effect on the interface.

parameters.name: IPv4 Address List
parameters.description: Indicates the list of IPv4 addresses and masks that have taken effect on the interface.

parameters.name: Link-Local Address
parameters.description: Indicates the link-local address that has taken effect on the interface.

parameters.id: Number of Globally Scoped Unicast Addresses
parameters.name: Number of Globally Scoped Unicast Addresses
parameters.description: Indicates the number of globally scoped unicast addresses that have taken effect on the interface.

parameters.name: Globally Scoped Unicast Address List
parameters.description: Indicates the list of globally scoped unicast addresses that have taken effect on the interface.

parameters.name: Number of Multicast Addresses
parameters.description: Indicates the number of multicast addresses that have taken effect on the interface.

parameters.name: Multicast Address List
parameters.description: Indicates the list of multicast addresses that have taken effect on the interface.

parameters.id: IP to IP Transmission Resource Group ID
parameters.name: IP to IP Transmission Resource Group ID
parameters.description: Indicates the ID of the mapping between an IP address and an IP transmission resource group.

parameters.name: IP Transmission Resource Group ID
parameters.description: Indicates the ID of the IP transmission resource group.

parameters.name: VRF Index
parameters.description: Indicates the index of a VRF instance. UMTS currently supports the default routing domain only (the VRF index is 0).

parameters.name: IP Version
parameters.description: Indicates the destination IP protocol version of the service flow that is bound to an IP transmission resource group.

parameters.name: Destination IPv4 Address
parameters.description: Indicates the destination IPv4 address of the service flow that is bound to an IP transmission resource group.

parameters.name: Subnet Mask
parameters.description: Indicates the subnet mask of the destination IPv4 address of the service traffic bound to an IP transmission resource group.

parameters.name: Destination IPv6 Address
parameters.description: Indicates the destination IPv6 address of the service flow that is bound to an IP transmission resource group.

parameters.name: Prefix Length
parameters.description: Indicates the prefix length of the destination IPv6 address of the service flow that is bound to an IP transmission resource group.

parameters.name: Mapping Index
parameters.description: Indicates the mapping between IP addresses and Transport Resource Groups.

parameters.name: Cabinet No.
parameters.description: Indicates the number of the cabinet housing the board where a transmission resource group is established.

parameters.name: Subrack No.
parameters.description: Indicates the number of the subrack that houses the board where a transmission resource group is established.

parameters.name: Slot No.
parameters.description: Indicates the number of the slot housing the board where a transmission resource group is established.

parameters.name: Transmission Resource Group Bear Type
parameters.description: Indicates the bearer type of a transmission resource group.

parameters.name: Subboard Type
parameters.description: Indicates the type of sub-board on the board where a transmission resource group is established.

parameters.name: Bearing Port Type
parameters.description: Indicates the type of port where a transmission resource group is carried.

parameters.name: Bearing Port No.
parameters.description: Indicates the number of the port where a transmission resource group is carried.

parameters.name: Transmission Resource Group ID
parameters.description: Indicates the ID of a transmission resource group.

parameters.name: VRF Index
parameters.description: Indicates the index of a VRF instance. UMTS currently supports the default routing domain only (the VRF index is 0).

parameters.name: Destination IP
parameters.description: Indicates the destination IP address of the service flow that is bound to a transmission resource group.

parameters.name: Mask
parameters.description: Indicates the subnet mask of the destination IP address of the service traffic bound to a transmission resource group.

parameters.name: Interface ID
parameters.description: Indicates the ID of an interface.

parameters.name: IP Address
parameters.description: Indicates the IP address configured on the port.

parameters.name: Mask
parameters.description: Indicates the subnet mask for the IP address configured on the port.

parameters.name: VRF Index
parameters.description: Indicates the index of a VRF instance. UMTS currently supports the default routing domain only (the VRF index is 0).

parameters.name: User Label
parameters.description: Indicates the user-defined information of an IP address.

parameters.name: Address Status
parameters.description: Indicates the status of the IPv4 address. If Valid is displayed, it indicates that the IP address is available. If Invalid is displayed, it indicates that the port corresponding to the IP address is not activated. If Duplicate is displayed, it indicates that the IP address conflicts with the IP address of an external device.

parameters.name: Cabinet No.
parameters.description: Indicates the cabinet number of the board to which the IP address belongs.

parameters.name: Subrack No.

parameters.name: Port Type
parameters.description: Indicates the type of the port.

parameters.name: Port No.
parameters.description: Indicates the number of the port.

parameters.id: IP Downlink Flow Control Algorithm ID
parameters.name: IP Downlink Flow Control Algorithm ID
parameters.description: Indicates the ID of the IP DL flow control algorithm.

parameters.name: Port Type
parameters.description: Indicates the type of port where the IP DL flow control algorithm is configured.

parameters.name: Port ID
parameters.description: Indicates the ID of a port where the IP DL flow control algorithm is configured.

parameters.name: Flow Control Switch
parameters.description: Indicates the switch for the IP DL flow control algorithm. If this parameter is set to STATIC_BW_SHAPING, the available HSDPA bandwidth equals the total bandwidth minus the R99 bandwidth. If this parameter is set to DYNAMIC_BW_SHAPING, flow allocation for HSDPA users is performed according to the delay and packet loss of the transmission interface board in STATIC_BW_SHAPING mode. This function req

parameters.name: Delay Variation Noise Floor Threshold
parameters.description: Indicates the background noise threshold of the delay jitter above which the IP DL flow control algorithm is enabled. A link is considered to be non-congested if the delay jitter on the link is below the threshold.

parameters.name: Frame Loss Rate Threshold
parameters.description: Indicates the port frame loss rate threshold of the IP DL flow control algorithm switch. When the frame loss rate is less than or equal to this threshold, the base station determines that the link is not congested.

parameters.name: Transmission Mode
parameters.description: Indicates the transport mode of the port.

parameters.name: Downlink Flow Control Enhancement Switch
parameters.description: Indicates the switch for controlling the enhanced IP downlink flow control feature. When the switch is set to on, the enhanced downlink flow control prevents downlink available bandwidth from sharply decreasing and downlink throughput from abruptly deteriorating when bit-error packet loss occurs on the transport network. The packet loss rate may increase when the incoming port is congested. Howeve

parameters.name: Bandwidth Adjustment Protection Switch
parameters.description: Indicates the adjustment protection switch for the IP available DL bandwidth. When this parameter is set to ON, the BS stops adjusting the available DL bandwidth of the physical port if bit error occurs on the transmission line and the bit error rate (BER) exceeds the specified alarm threshold. This parameter does not take effect for loopback ports or tunnels because the error MAC frame reporting

parameters.name: Fair Flow Control Switch
parameters.description: Indicates the switch for the IP downlink fairness flow control. If multiple modes share transmission bandwidth and congestion occurs, the UMTS data rate may decrease due to downlink flow control and the LTE data rate may increase due to bandwidth preemption when the Flow Control Switch parameter is set to DYNAMIC_BW_SHAPING or is set to BW_SHAPING_ONOFF_TOGGLE but actually takes effect using the D

parameters.id: Minimum Fair Flow Control Protection Ratio
parameters.name: Minimum Fair Flow Control Protection Ratio
parameters.description: Indicates the minimum protection ratio of IP downlink fairness flow control. When the fairness flow control switch is turned on whereas the flow control is based on unfairness, the system guarantees the minimum UMTS transmission bandwidth based on the value of this parameter.

parameters.id: Minimum DL Available Bandwidth of Logical Port
parameters.name: Minimum DL Available Bandwidth of Logical Port
parameters.description: Indicates the minimum DL bandwidth of a logical port.

parameters.id: Min DL BW Protection Ratio of Iub Interface
parameters.name: Min DL BW Protection Ratio of Iub Interface
parameters.description: Indicates the minimum ratio of reducing the available downlink bandwidth over the Iub interface.

parameters.description: Indicates the cabinet number of the IP DL flow control algorithm switch.

parameters.name: Subrack No.
parameters.description: Indicates the subrack number of the IP DL flow control algorithm switch.

parameters.name: Slot No.
parameters.description: Indicates the slot number of the IP DL flow control algorithm switch.

parameters.name: IP GPM Detection ID
parameters.description: Indicates the ID of an IP GPM detection.

parameters.name: Detection Direction
parameters.description: Indicates the direction of an IP GPM detection.

parameters.name: Delay Detection Method
parameters.description: Indicates the delay detection method at the bottom layer used by the IP GPM detection.

parameters.name: Detection Object
parameters.description: Indicates the object to be detected by the IP GPM on the base station side. If the detection object is IPRSCGRP, the IP GPM detects congestion on transmission links of users in the IP transmission resource group.

parameters.name: Port Type
parameters.description: Indicates the type of the port where an IP transmission resource group detected by the IP GPM is carried.

parameters.name: Port ID
parameters.description: Indicates the ID of the port where an IP transmission resource group detected by the IP GPM is carried.

parameters.name: IP Transmission Resource Group ID
parameters.description: Indicates the ID of the IP transmission resource group detected by the IP GPM.

parameters.name: Cabinet No.
parameters.description: Indicates the cabinet No. of the board where the IP transmission resource group detected by the IP GPM is located.

parameters.name: Subrack No.
parameters.description: Indicates the subrack No. of the board where the IP transmission resource group detected by the IP GPM is located.

parameters.name: Slot No.
parameters.description: Indicates the slot No. of the board where the IP transmission resource group detected by the IP GPM is located.

parameters.name: Working State
parameters.description: Indicates the working state of an IP GPM detection. If the number of samples within an IP GPM detection period is 0, the working state of the IP GPM detection is "NO_MEASUREMENT". If the number of samples within an IP GPM detection period is greater than 0, the working state of the IP GPM detection is "IN_MEASUREMENT".

parameters.name: ARP Spoofing Check Switch
parameters.description: Indicates whether to perform an ARP spoofing check. If this parameter is set to ENABLE, an alarm is reported when an ARP spoofing attack occurs. If this parameter is set to DISABLE, no alarm is reported when an ARP spoofing attack occurs.

parameters.name: ARP Spoofing Alarm Threshold
parameters.description: Indicates the ARP spoofing alarm threshold. When the ARP spoofing check switch is turned on, an ARP spoofing alarm is reported if the number of ARP update attempts reaches this threshold within one minute. Note that the number of ARP update attempts from trusted MAC addresses is not counted. This alarm is cleared if no request for updating the MAC address mapping to the IP address indicated by the

parameters.name: ARP Learning Strict Switch
parameters.description: Indicates whether to enable ARP strict learning. ARP learning strict is a function that enables a BS to learn the acknowledgement packets in response to only ARP request packets sent by itself. With ARP strict learning, the BS can reject most ARP request and acknowledge packet attacks.

parameters.name: Invalid Packet Check Switch
parameters.description: Indicates whether to report an alarm when the number of invalid packets received by a BS exceeds a specified threshold. If this parameter is set to ENABLE, an alarm is reported when the number of invalid packets received by a BS exceeds the specified threshold. If this parameter is set to DISABLE, no alarm is reported when the number of invalid packets received by a BS exceeds the specified thresh

parameters.name: Invalid Packet Alarm Threshold
parameters.description: Indicates the threshold for the excessive flood packet alarm. When Invalid Packet Check Switch is set to ENABLE, the system measures the RX rate of invalid packets every 10 seconds. If the measured value exceeds this threshold, an excessive invalid packet alarm is reported. The alarm is cleared if the RX rate of invalid packets keeps below the threshold for 5 consecutive minutes.

parameters.name: IPSec Replay Alarm Switch
parameters.description: Indicates whether to report an IPSec packet replay alarm.

parameters.name: IPSec Replay Alarm Threshold
parameters.description: Indicates the IPSec anti-replay alarm threshold.

parameters.name: IKEv2 Redirect DOS Check Switch
parameters.description: Indicates the switch for checking IKEv2 redirection DOS attacks. When this parameter is set to ENABLE, ALM-25950 Base Station Being Attacked is reported when the number of IKEv2 redirections received by the base station exceeds the IKEv2 redirection DOS attack threshold in 300 consecutive seconds, with Specific Problem set to DOS Attack. After the number of IKEv2 redirections received by the base

parameters.name: Max Redirects Number
parameters.description: Indicates the IKEv2 redirection DOS attack threshold. ALM-25950 Base Station Being Attacked is reported when the number of IKEv2 redirections received by the base station exceeds the IKEv2 redirection DOS attack threshold in 300 consecutive seconds, with Specific Problem set to DOS Attack. After the number of IKEv2 redirections received by the base station exceeds the IKEv2 redirection DOS attack

parameters.name: ND Spoofing Check Switch
parameters.description: Indicates whether to detect ND spoofing. If this parameter is set to ENABLE, an alarm is reported when ND spoofing occurs. If this parameter is set to DISABLE, no alarm is reported when ND spoofing occurs.

parameters.name: ND Spoofing Alarm Threshold
parameters.description: Indicates the threshold for reporting an ND spoofing alarm. When the number of ND spoofing times reaches the threshold, an alarm is reported. After ND spoofing detection is enabled, an ND spoofing alarm is reported if the number of ND update attempts exceeds the threshold within one minute. If any trusted MAC address exists, the update requests initiated by the trusted MAC address is not counted.

parameters.name: Port Type

parameters.description: Indicates the number of a port.

parameters.name: Destination MAC Address of Invalid Packet
parameters.description: Indicates the destination MAC address of an invalid packet.

parameters.description: Indicates the VLAN ID of an invalid packet.

parameters.name: Source IP Address of Invalid Packet
parameters.description: Indicates the source IP address of an invalid packet.

parameters.id: Destination IP Address of Invalid Packet
parameters.name: Destination IP Address of Invalid Packet
parameters.description: Indicates the destination IP address of an invalid packet.

parameters.description: Indicates the protocol used at the IP layer of an invalid packet. A BS interprets only the supported IP-layer protocols and only displays the protocol numbers of other IP-layer protocols.

parameters.description: Indicates the source port number of an invalid packet.

parameters.name: Destination Port of Invalid Packet
parameters.description: Indicates the destination port number of an invalid packet.

parameters.name: Invalid Packet Data
parameters.description: Indicates at most the first 64 bytes of an invalid packet.

parameters.description: Indicates the ID of an IP path.

parameters.name: Subrack No.
parameters.description: Indicates the subrack number of the board where the IP path is located.

parameters.description: Indicates the slot number of the board where the IP path is located.
