parameters.description: Indicates the type of the IP path. FIXED indicates that this IP path is used to carry the service with specified Quality of Service (QoS), that is, with a specified DSCP. ANY indicates that this IP path can be used to carry services of any QoS and hence is used to carry the service without a specified DSCP.

parameters.name: DSCP
parameters.description: Indicates the differentiated services code point (DSCP) of the services carried on an IP path.

parameters.name: Local IP Address
parameters.description: Indicates the local IP address of an IP path. The value 0.0.0.0 indicates that the local IP address needs to be negotiated.

parameters.name: Peer IP Address
parameters.description: Indicates the peer IP address of the IP path.

parameters.name: Transmission Resource Type
parameters.description: Indicates the type of transport resource for the IP path. The value HQ indicates high-quality transport resources, and the value LQ indicates low-quality transport resources. This parameter must be set in the hybrid transmission scenario. In other scenarios, the default value of this parameter is used. The parameter takes effect only in LTE.

parameters.name: IP MUX Switch
parameters.description: Indicates whether the IP MUX function is enabled on IP paths. LTE currently does not support this function.

parameters.name: MUX Timer
parameters.description: Indicates the length of the IP MUX timer, which defines the maximum buffer time for IP MUX packets. The LTE currently does not support the IP MUX function.

parameters.id: Maximum Length of IP MUX Multiframe
parameters.name: Maximum Length of IP MUX Multiframe
parameters.description: Indicates the maximum multiframe length of IP MUX. The LTE currently does not support the IP MUX function.

parameters.id: Maximum Length of IP MUX Subframe
parameters.name: Maximum Length of IP MUX Subframe
parameters.description: Indicates the maximum subframe length of IP MUX. The LTE currently does not support the IP MUX function.

parameters.name: Transmission Resource Group ID
parameters.description: Indicates the ID of the transmission resource group established on an IP path.

parameters.name: Description
parameters.description: Indicates the description about the peer of the IP path.

parameters.name: Subboard Type
parameters.description: Indicates the type of sub-board on the board where the IP path is established.

parameters.name: VRF Index
parameters.description: Indicates the index of a VRF instance. UMTS currently supports the default routing domain only (the VRF index is 0).

parameters.name: Join Transmission Resource Group
parameters.description: Indicates whether the IP path joins a transmission resource group. If this parameter is set to DISABLE, the IP path is established on the default IP transmission resource group on a specific physical port.

parameters.name: Static Check Switch
parameters.description: Indicates whether to enable the GTP-U static detection function for a link. When this parameter is set to ENABLE, the GTP-U static detection function is enabled for a link. When this parameter is set to DISABLE, the GTP-U static detection function is disabled for a link. When this parameter is set to FOLLOW_GLOBAL, the setting of the switch for the GTP-U static detection function is the same as th

parameters.name: Transmission Configuration Mode
parameters.description: Indicates the configuration mode of the transmission model. The transmission model can be configured in old or new mode. In old mode, the transmission model contains information such as cabinet, subrack, and slot numbers. Transmission configurations are bound to device boards. In new mode, the transmission model has decoupled transmission and device models. That is, transmission configuration remo

parameters.name: Join IP Transmission Resource Group
parameters.description: Indicates whether the IP path is added to an IP transmission resource group. When this parameter is set to DISABLE, the IP path is established on the default IP transmission resource group on a specified physical port.

parameters.name: IP Transmission Resource Group ID
parameters.description: Indicates the ID of the IP transmission resource group to which the IP path belongs.

parameters.name: Bearing Port Type
parameters.description: Indicates the physical port type of the IP path.

parameters.name: Port ID
parameters.description: Indicates the ID of the port to which the IP path belongs.

parameters.name: Realtime TX Bandwidth
parameters.description: Indicates the actual real-time traffic transmitted on the IP path. The parameter takes effect only in LTE.

parameters.name: Realtime RX Bandwidth
parameters.description: Indicates the actual real-time traffic received on the IP path. The parameter takes effect only in LTE.

parameters.name: Non-Realtime TX Bandwidth
parameters.description: Indicates the actual non-real-time traffic transmitted on the IP path. The parameter takes effect only in LTE.

parameters.name: Non-Realtime RX Bandwidth
parameters.description: Indicates the actual non-real-time traffic received on the IP path. The parameter takes effect only in LTE.

parameters.name: Non-Realtime Reserved TX Bandwidth
parameters.description: Indicates the actual TX bandwidth reserved for the non-real-time service transmitted on the IP path. The parameter takes effect only in LTE.

parameters.name: Non-Realtime Reserved RX Bandwidth
parameters.description: Indicates the actual RX bandwidth reserved for the non-real-time service received on the IP path. The parameter takes effect only in LTE.

parameters.name: IP Path Check Result
parameters.description: Indicates the check result for the GTP-U static detection of an IP path. The parameter takes effect only in LTE.

parameters.name: RX Bandwidth
parameters.description: Indicates the actual total traffic received on the IP path.

parameters.name: TX Bandwidth
parameters.description: Indicates the actual total traffic transmitted on the IP path.

parameters.name: Service Type
parameters.description: Indicates the service type of an IP path.

parameters.name: Fault Generation Time
parameters.description: Indicates the time when an IP path becomes faulty.

parameters.name: Session ID
parameters.description: Indicates the ID of an IP PM session of an NE. An IP PM session with an ID ranging from 0 to 65535 is configured by users. An IP PM session with an ID ranging from 70000 to 79999 is configured by the system.

parameters.name: Local IP
parameters.description: Indicates the local IP address of an IP PM session. This IP address must be configured on an Ethernet port, an Ethernet trunk, a PPP link, an MP link or a loopback port, and cannot be set to 0.0.0.0.

parameters.name: Peer IP
parameters.description: Indicates the peer IP address of an IP PM session. This IP address must be a valid IP address of Class A, B, or C and different from any existing IP address of the local end. In addition, it cannot be set to 0.x.x.x or 127.x.x.x.

parameters.name: DSCP
parameters.description: Indicates the differentiated services code point (DSCP) of an IP PM session.

parameters.name: Activate Direction
parameters.description: Indicates that the activation direction of an IP PM session. For this parameter to be valid, the peer must also support the IP PM session. If this parameter is set to UP, the IP PM session initiated by the BS is activated. If this parameter is set to BIDIR, the IP PM sessions initiated by BS and the peer are activated. The activation direction is specified by the DIR parameter. The WMPT and UTRP d

parameters.name: IP PM Type
parameters.description: Indicates the type of IP PM session. A triplet consists of the local IP address, peer IP address, and protocol type; a quad bit consists of the local IP address, peer IP address, protocol type, and DSCP. The WMPT and UTRP do not support the triplets configuration mode.

parameters.name: Bind IP Path
parameters.description: Indicates whether to bind the IP PM session to an IP path. If the IP PM session is bound to an IP path, the IP PM session uses the local and peer IP addresses of the IP path in data transmission. In addition, if TXBWASW or RXBWASW is set to ON and TCSW is set to ENABLE in the algorithm for the transmission resource group associated with the IP path, the system dynamically adjusts the TX or RX band

parameters.name: IP Path ID
parameters.description: Indicates the ID of the IP path to which an IP PM session is bound.

parameters.name: VRF Index
parameters.description: Indicates the index of a VRF instance. UMTS currently supports the default routing domain only (the VRF index is 0).

parameters.id: Associate with UP Path Packet Loss Rate Alarm
parameters.name: Associate with UP Path Packet Loss Rate Alarm
parameters.description: Indicates whether an IP PM session is associated with ALM-25959 User Plane Path Excessive Packet Loss Rate. If this parameter is set to YES and the local and peer IP addresses of an IP PM session are the local and peer IP addresses of a user-plane link in the endpoint model, the packet loss rate measured during the IP PM session is used to determine whether the packet loss rate for the user-plane

parameters.name: Control Mode
parameters.description: Indicates whether the system can automatically operate on an object. When this parameter is set to MANUAL_MODE(Manual Mode), only users can operate on the object. When this parameter is set to AUTO_MODE(Auto Mode), only the system can operate on the object.

parameters.name: Round Trip Time
parameters.description: Indicates the round-trip delay calculated by an IP PM session detection. The round-trip delay is the time consumed to transmit IP PM detection packets to and fro between the local and peer ends. This parameter is valid only when Activate State(UP) is set to IP PM UP.

parameters.name: RX Jitter
parameters.description: Indicates the DL jitter calculated by an IP PM session detection. This parameter is valid only when Activate State(Down) is set to IP PM UP.

parameters.name: TX Jitter
parameters.description: Indicates the UL jitter calculated by an IP PM session detection. This parameter is valid only when Activate State(UP) is set to IP PM UP.

parameters.name: RX Loss Rate
parameters.description: Indicates the DL packet loss rate calculated by an IP PM session detection. This parameter is valid only when Activate State(Down) is set to IP PM UP.

parameters.name: TX Loss Rate
parameters.description: Indicates the UL packet loss rate calculated by an IP PM session detection. This parameter is valid only when Activate State(UP) is set to IP PM UP.

parameters.name: Activate State(Up)
parameters.description: Indicates the UL activation status of an IP PM session. The UL activation status of an IP PM session can be IDLE, ACTING, IP PM UP, DEACTING, or UNKNOWN.

parameters.name: Activate State(Down)
parameters.description: Indicates the DL activation status of an IP PM session. The DL activation status of an IP PM session can be IDLE, ACTING, IP PM UP, DEACTING, or UNKNOWN.

parameters.name: DSCP Change Flag(Down)
parameters.description: Indicates whether the DSCP value of a DL IP PM session changes.

parameters.name: DSCP Initial Value(Down)
parameters.description: Indicates the initial DSCP value of a DL IP PM session.

parameters.name: DSCP Changed Value(Down)
parameters.description: Indicates the modified DSCP value of a DL IP PM session.

parameters.name: DSCP Changed Date And Time(Down)
parameters.description: Indicates the time when the DSCP value of a DL IP PM session changes.

parameters.name: DSCP Change Flag(Up)
parameters.description: Indicates whether the DSCP value of an UL IP PM session changes.

parameters.name: DSCP Initial Value(Up)
parameters.description: Indicates the initial DSCP value of an UL IP PM session.

parameters.name: DSCP Changed Value(Up)
parameters.description: Indicates the modified DSCP value of an UL IP PM session.

parameters.name: DSCP Changed Date And Time(Up)
parameters.description: Indicates the time when the DSCP value of an UL IP PM session changes.

parameters.name: IP PM Protocol Version
parameters.description: Indicates the version of the negotiated data, when the status of IP PM is UP.

parameters.name: High Precision Round Trip Time
parameters.description: Indicates the high-precision round-trip delay calculated by an IP PM session detection. The high-precision round-trip delay is the time consumed to transmit IP PM detection packets to and fro between the local and peer ends. This parameter is valid only when Activate State(UP) is set to IP PM UP and the protocol version for an IP PM session supports high-precision delay detection.

parameters.name: One Way Delay
parameters.description: Indicates the one-way delay calculated by an IP PM session detection. The one-way delay is the time consumed to transmit IP PM detection packets from the local end to the peer end. This parameter is valid only when Active State(UP) is set to IP PM UP and the protocol version for an IP PM session supports one-way delay detection. This parameter is valid only when the time is synchronized between bo

parameters.name: Route Index
parameters.description: Indicates the index of an IPv4 route.

parameters.name: VRF Index
parameters.description: Indicates the index of a VRF instance. UMTS currently supports the default routing domain only (the VRF index is 0).

parameters.name: Destination IP
parameters.description: Indicates the destination IP address of the IPv4 route.

parameters.name: Mask
parameters.description: Indicates the destination subnet mask of the IPv4 route.

parameters.name: Route Type
parameters.description: Indicates the type of an IPv4 route. The value NEXTHOP indicates that IP packets transmitted through the route are forwarded to a specified next-hop IP address. The value IF indicates that IP packets transmitted through the route are forwarded to a specified outbound interface.

parameters.name: Next Hop IP
parameters.description: Indicates the next-hop IP address.

parameters.name: Port Type
parameters.description: Indicates the type of the port.

parameters.name: Port ID
parameters.description: Indicates the port ID of an IPv4 route.

parameters.name: Peer IP
parameters.description: Indicates the peer IP address of an air interface link. Only UMPT/LMPT/UMDU boards for LTE support IP routes of the air interface link type.

parameters.name: MTU Switch
parameters.description: Indicates the MTU configuration switch.

parameters.name: Maximum Transmission Unit
parameters.description: Indicates the maximum transmission unit of a transmission link. The smaller value between this parameter value and the maximum transmission unit configured for interface corresponding to the routed interface prevails on the base station.

parameters.name: Preference
parameters.description: Indicates the priority of the routing entry. A smaller parameter value indicates a higher priority.

parameters.name: User Label
parameters.description: Indicates the user-defined information.

parameters.name: Cabinet No.
parameters.description: Indicates the cabinet number of the board to which an IPv4 route belongs.

parameters.name: Subrack No.
parameters.description: Indicates the subrack number of the board to which an IPv4 route belongs.

parameters.name: Slot No.
parameters.description: Indicates the slot number of the board to which an IPv4 route belongs.

parameters.name: Actual Port Type
parameters.description: Indicates the type of the actual port.

parameters.name: Actual Port No.
parameters.description: Indicates the number of the actual port. When the actual port type is Ethernet trunk, the actual port number indicates the port ID of the Ethernet trunk. When the actual port type is tunnel, the actual port number indicates the port ID of the backplane tunnel.

parameters.name: Route Protocol
parameters.description: Indicates the type of the router entry of an IPv4 route. A static host route is a manually configured route with the subnet mask set to 255.255.255.255. A static gateway route is a manually configured route with the subnet mask not being 255.255.255.255. A direct host route is a dynamically generated IPv4 route with the subnet mask being 255.255.255.255. A direct gateway route is a dynamically gen

parameters.name: Valid State
parameters.description: Indicates the validity state of an IPv4 route.

parameters.name: IP Transmission Resource Group ID
parameters.description: Indicates the ID of the IP transmission resource group.

parameters.name: Bearing Port Type
parameters.description: Indicates the type of port where an IP transmission resource group is carried.

parameters.name: Bearing Port ID
parameters.description: Indicates the ID of the port where the IP transmission resource group is configured.

parameters.name: Resource Group Number
parameters.description: Indicates the number of an IP transmission resource group on a port. When you use an MML command to add a PPP link, an MP group, an Ethernet port, an Ethernet trunk, a tunnel, or a PPPoE link, the system automatically creates an IP transmission resource group with Transmission Resource Group ID set to DEFAULTPORT(Default Port). When you remove any of the preceding objects, the system automatically

parameters.name: Rate Unit
parameters.description: Indicates the rate unit of the TX bandwidth, RX bandwidth, TX CIR, RX CIR, TX PIR and RX PIR of the IP transmission resource group.

parameters.name: TX Bandwidth
parameters.description: Indicates the maximum uplink bandwidth of an IP transmission resource group at the MAC layer. This parameter value is used as the uplink transport admission bandwidth and TX traffic shaping bandwidth. The minimum rate supported by the UMPTa, UMPTb, UMDU, GTMUb or GTMUc is 64 kbit/s. The LMPT can be configured with a maximum of 360 Mbit/s TX bandwidth. The WMPT, GTMUb or GTMUc can be configured wit

parameters.name: RX Bandwidth
parameters.description: Indicates the RX bandwidth of an IP transmission resource group. To LTE, this parameter value is also used as the downlink transport admission bandwidth. The LMPT can be configured with a maximum of 540 Mbit/s RX bandwidth. The WMPT, GTMUb or GTMUc can be configured with a maximum of 300 Mbit/s RX bandwidth. The UMPTa, UMPTb, UMDU or UTRPc can be configured with a maximum of 1 Gbit/s RX bandwidth.

parameters.name: TX Committed Burst Size
parameters.description: Indicates the TX committed burst size of an IP transmission resource group. The LMPT can be configured with a maximum of 400 Mbit/s TX committed burst size. The WMPT can be configured with a maximum of 600 Mbit/s TX committed burst size. The WMPT, GTMUb or GTMUc can be configured with a maximum of 600 Mbit/s TX committed burst size. The UMPTa, UMPTb, UMDU or UTRPc can be configured with a maximum

parameters.name: TX Excessive Burst Size
parameters.description: Indicates the TX excessive burst size of an IP transmission resource group. The LMPT can be configured with a maximum of 450 Mbit/s TX excessive burst size. The WMPT, GTMUb or GTMUc can be configured with a maximum of 600 Mbit/s TX excessive burst size. The UMPTa, UMPTb, UMDU or UTRPc can be configured with a maximum of 1 Gbit/s TX excessive burst size. The UMPTe, UMPTga or UCCU can be configured

parameters.name: Operator ID
parameters.description: Indicates the index of the operator. This parameter is used to differentiate between operators. This parameter is reserved for future extension and does not take effect currently.

parameters.name: Scheduling Weight
parameters.description: Indicates the scheduling weight of an IP transmission resource group. This parameter is used in calculating the bandwidth scheduled to a resource group, which helps achieve the user admission control.

parameters.name: TX Committed Information Rate
parameters.description: Indicates the transmit CIR of the IP transmission resource group. The LMPT can be configured with a maximum of 360 Mbit/s TX committed information rate. The UMPTa, UMPTb, UMDU or UTRPc can be configured with a maximum of 1 Gbit/s TX committed information rate. The GTMUb or GTMUc can be configured with a maximum of 300 Mbit/s TX committed information rate. The UMPTe, UMPTga or UCCU can be configure

parameters.name: RX Committed Information Rate
parameters.description: Indicates the receive CIR of the IP transmission resource group. This parameter value is used as the downlink transport admission bandwidth for non-flow-control services. The LMPT can be configured with a maximum of 540 Mbit/s RX committed information rate. The UMPTa, UMPTb, UMDU or UTRPc can be configured with a maximum of 1 Gbit/s RX committed information rate. The UMPTe, UMPTga or UCCU can be c

parameters.name: TX Peak Information Rate
parameters.description: Indicates the transmit PIR of the IP transmission resource group. The LMPT can be configured with a maximum of 360 Mbit/s TX peak information rate. The UMPTa, UMPTb, UMDU or UTRPc can be configured with a maximum of 1 Gbit/s TX peak information rate. The GTMUb or GTMUc can be configured with a maximum of 300 Mbit/s TX peak information rate. The UMPTe, UMPTga or UCCU can be configured with a maximu

parameters.name: RX Peak Information Rate
parameters.description: Indicates the receive PIR of the IP transmission resource group. This parameter value is used as the downlink transport admission bandwidth. The LMPT can be configured with a maximum of 540 Mbit/s RX peak information rate. The UMPTa, UMPTb, UMDU or URTPc can be configured with a maximum of 1 Gbit/s RX peak information rate. The UMPTe, UMPTga or UCCU can be configured with a maximum of 10 Gbit/s RX

parameters.name: TX Peak Burst Size
parameters.description: Indicates the size of the peak burst transmitted from the IP transmission resource group. The LMPT can be configured with a maximum of 540 Mbit/s TX peak burst size. The UMPTa, UMPTb, UMDU or UTRPc can be configured with a maximum of 1 Gbit/s TX peak burst size. The GTMUb or GTMUc can be configured with a maximum of 300 Mbit/s TX peak burst size. The UMPTe, UMPTga or UCCU can be configured with a

parameters.name: User Label
parameters.description: Indicates the user-defined information about an IP transmission resource group.

parameters.name: Bearing Port No.
parameters.description: Indicates the number of the bearing that houses the board where an IP transmission resource group is established.

parameters.name: Cabinet No.
parameters.description: Indicates the number of the cabinet that houses the board where an IP transmission resource group is established.

parameters.name: Subrack No.
parameters.description: Indicates the number of the subrack that houses the board where an IP transmission resource group is established.

parameters.name: Slot No.
parameters.description: Indicates the number of the slot corresponding to the board where an IP transmission resource group is established.

parameters.name: Subboard Type
parameters.description: Indicates the type of sub-board on the IP transmission group. The LTE and NR do not support UNCHANNELLED_COVERBOARD.

parameters.name: Realtime TX Bandwidth
parameters.description: Indicates the local real-time traffic that is transmitted in an IP transmission resource group. The local traffic includes only the local traffic stream exclusive of the passing-by data flow and non-traffic stream. The parameter takes effect only in LTE.

parameters.name: Realtime RX Bandwidth
parameters.description: Indicates the local real-time traffic that is received in an IP transmission resource group. The local traffic includes only the local traffic stream exclusive of the passing-by data flow and non-traffic stream. The parameter takes effect only in LTE.

parameters.name: Non-Realtime TX Bandwidth
parameters.description: Indicates the local non-real-time traffic that is transmitted in an IP transmission resource group. The local traffic includes only the local traffic stream exclusive of the passing-by data flow and non-traffic stream. The parameter takes effect only in LTE.

parameters.name: Non-Realtime RX Bandwidth
parameters.description: Indicates the local non-real-time traffic that is received in an IP transmission resource group. The local traffic includes only the local traffic stream exclusive of the passing-by data flow and non-traffic stream. The parameter takes effect only in LTE.

parameters.name: Non-Realtime Reserved TX Bandwidth
parameters.description: Indicates the TX bandwidth reserved for non-real-time services in an IP transmission resource group. The parameter takes effect only in LTE and NR.

parameters.name: Non-Realtime Reserved RX Bandwidth
parameters.description: Indicates the RX bandwidth reserved for non-real-time services in an IP transmission resource group. The parameter takes effect only in LTE and NR.

parameters.name: TX Bandwidth Used
parameters.description: Indicates the TX bandwidth that is already used by an IP transmission resource group.

parameters.name: RX Bandwidth Used
parameters.description: Indicates the RX bandwidth that are already used by an IP transmission resource group.

parameters.name: TX Bandwidth Usable
parameters.description: Indicates the TX bandwidth that can be used by an IP transmission resource group.

parameters.name: RX Bandwidth Usable
parameters.description: Indicates the RX bandwidth that can be used by an IP transmission resource group.

parameters.name: GBR TX Bandwidth
parameters.description: Indicates the GBR service traffic that is transmitted by the IP transmission resource group. The parameter takes effect only in LTE and NR.

parameters.name: GBR RX Bandwidth
parameters.description: Indicates the GBR service traffic received by the IP transmission resource group. The parameter takes effect only in LTE and NR.

parameters.name: Rate Configuration Type
parameters.description: Indicates the rate configuration mode of the IP transmission resource group.

parameters.name: UL Admission Bandwidth
parameters.description: Indicates the uplink admission bandwidth of the IP transmission resource group. When Physical Port Up Link OverBooking Switch is ON in the command output of the LST TACALG command, the value of this parameter can exceed the uplink bandwidth of the physical port. The parameter takes effect only in LTE and NR.

parameters.name: DL Admission Bandwidth
parameters.description: Indicates the downlink admission bandwidth of the IP transmission resource group. When Physical Port Down Link OverBooking Switch is ON in the command output of the LST TACALG command, the value of this parameter can exceed the downlink bandwidth of the physical port. The parameter takes effect only in LTE and NR.

parameters.name: UL CIR Admission Bandwidth
parameters.description: Indicates the UL Committed Information Rate (CIR) admission bandwidth for the IP transmission resource group. The parameter takes effect only in LTE and NR.

parameters.name: DL CIR Admission Bandwidth
parameters.description: Indicates the CIR admission bandwidth of the IP transmission resource group in DL. The parameter takes effect only in LTE and NR.

parameters.name: UL PIR Admission Bandwidth
parameters.description: Indicates the UL PIR admission bandwidth of the IP transmission resource group. The parameter takes effect only in LTE and NR.

parameters.name: DL PIR Admission Bandwidth
parameters.description: Indicates the PIR admission bandwidth of the IP transmission resource group in DL. The parameter takes effect only in LTE and NR.

parameters.name: Realtime TX Traffic
parameters.description: Indicates the realtime traffic sent on an IP transmission resource group.

parameters.name: IP Transmission Resource Group ID
parameters.description: Indicates the ID of an IP transmission resource group. When you add a PPP link, an MP group, an Ethernet port, an Ethernet trunk, a tunnel, or a PPPoE link, the system automatically creates an algorithm for the IP transmission resource group with IP Transmission Resource Group ID set to DEFAULTPORT(Default Port). When you remove any of the preceding objects, the system automatically removes the al

parameters.name: TX Traffic Shaping Switch
parameters.description: Indicates whether to enable traffic shaping for an IP transmission resource group. If this parameter is set to ON, traffic shaping is performed according to the TX bandwidth so that the transmit traffic would not exceed the capability of downstream routers, therefore avoiding unnecessary packet loss and congestion. If this parameter is set to OFF, traffic shaping is not performed during data trans

parameters.name: TX Bandwidth Adjustment Switch
parameters.description: Indicates whether to enable the dynamic adjustment of the TX bandwidth of an IP transmission resource group. If this parameter is set to ON, the TX bandwidth is adjusted according to the network performance and dynamic bandwidth adjustment parameters (Packet Loss Ratio Down Threshold and Delay Variation Down Threshold). The network performance is monitored through IP PM sessions, which can be enab

parameters.name: RX Bandwidth Adjustment Switch
parameters.description: Indicates whether to enable the dynamic adjustment of the RX bandwidth of an IP transmission resource group. If this parameter is set to ON, the RX bandwidth is adjusted according to the network performance and dynamic bandwidth adjustment parameters (Packet Loss Ratio Down Threshold and Delay Variation Down Threshold). The network performance is monitored through IP PM sessions, which can be enab

parameters.name: Packet Loss Ratio Down Threshold
parameters.description: Indicates the rate downsizing packet loss rate threshold for bandwidth adjustment. When RXBWASW or TXBWASW is set to ON, the estimated available transport bandwidth is reduced if the packet loss rate detected through IP Performance Monitoring (IP PM) is higher than this threshold. If the packet loss rate detected through IP PM is lower than this threshold, the estimated available transport bandwid

parameters.name: Delay Variation Down Threshold
parameters.description: Indicates the rate downsizing packet loss rate threshold for bandwidth adjustment. When RXBWASW or TXBWASW is set to ON, the estimated available transport bandwidth will be reduced if the packet loss rate detected by an IP PM session is higher than this threshold; the estimated available transport bandwidth will be increased if the packet loss rate detected by an IP PM session is lower than this t

parameters.name: TX Bandwidth Adjust Minimum
parameters.description: Indicates the minimum amount of adjusted TX bandwidth. If TXBWASW is set to ON, the adjusted bandwidth should be at least greater than this minimum. This parameter does not take effect in UMTS.

parameters.name: RX Bandwidth Adjust Minimum
parameters.description: Indicates the minimum amount of adjusted RX bandwidth. If RXBWASW is set to ON, the adjusted bandwidth must be at least greater than this minimum. This parameter does not take effect in UMTS.

parameters.name: Traffic Control Switch
parameters.description: Indicates whether to enable the backpressure algorithm of an IP transmission resource group. The BS monitors the data buffered in the queues of each IP transmission resource group, determines whether the IP transmission resource group is congested, and transmits the backpressure signals (the ID and congestion status of the IP transmission resource group) to each flow control service. If the size o

parameters.name: PQ Number
parameters.description: Indicates the number of PQs in an IP transmission resource group. The queues in an IP transmission resource group are classified into PQs and non-PQs. The scheduling priority of any PQ is higher than that of any non-PQ. The queues numbered from 0 to the result after this parameter value minus 1 are PQs. PQ scheduling is used between PQs. A smaller PQ number indicates a higher scheduling priority.

parameters.name: Congestion Time Threshold
parameters.description: Indicates the congestion time threshold of an IP transmission resource group. When TCSW is set to ENABLE, if the buffer time of non-real-time service data in an IP transmission resource group exceeds the threshold, the IP transmission resource group is congested, and backpressure signals are transmitted.

parameters.name: Congestion Clear Time Threshold
parameters.description: Indicates the congestion clear time threshold of an IP transmission resource group. When TCSW is set to ENABLE, if the buffer time of non-real-time service data in an IP transmission resource group is less than the threshold, the IP transmission resource group is not congested, and congestion clear signals are transmitted.

parameters.name: TX Reserved Bandwidth
parameters.description: Indicates the TX bandwidth reserved for signaling data, OM data, or real-time services. This parameter should be set to a value less than the TX bandwidth of an IP transmission resource group. It is recommended that the reserved TX bandwidth be set to a value less than or equal to 3% of the TX bandwidth of an IP transmission resource group. The UMTS currently does not support this function.

parameters.name: RX Reserved Bandwidth
parameters.description: Indicates the reserved RX bandwidth, which should be set to a value less than or equal to the RX bandwidth of an IP transmission resource group. This parameter does not take effect in UMTS.

parameters.name: Drop Packet Number Threshold
parameters.description: Indicates the threshold for the number of discarded packets. This parameter indicates the capability of the queue in an IP transmission resource group to buffer packets. A greater parameter value indicates a stronger capability. If this parameter is set to 0, the queue in an IP transmission resource group cannot buffer packets, and therefore all the delayed packets on the TX channel are discarded.

parameters.name: Route Index
parameters.description: Indicates the index of an IP route.

parameters.name: Cabinet No.
parameters.description: Indicates the cabinet number of the board where the IP route is located.

parameters.name: Subrack No.
parameters.description: Indicates the subrack number of the board where the IP route is located.

parameters.name: Slot No.
parameters.description: Indicates the slot number of the board where the IP route is located.

parameters.name: Subboard Type
parameters.description: Indicates the type of sub-board on the board where the IP route is established.

parameters.name: Port Type
parameters.description: Indicates the port type.

parameters.name: Port No.
parameters.description: Indicates the port number.

parameters.name: Route Type
parameters.description: Indicates the type of route. If this parameter is set to NEXTHOP, all the IP packets that meet the route direction are first forwarded to the specified next hop IP address. If this parameter is set to IF, all the IP packets that meet the route direction are first forwarded to the specified egress port.

parameters.name: VRF Index
parameters.description: Indicates the index of a VRF instance. UMTS currently supports the default routing domain only (the VRF index is 0).

parameters.name: Destination IP
parameters.description: Indicates the destination IP address of the route.

parameters.name: Mask
parameters.description: Indicates the subnet mask for the destination IP address of the route.

parameters.name: Next Hop IP
parameters.description: Indicates the IP address of the next hop.

parameters.name: Peer IP
parameters.description: Indicates the peer IP address of the link on the air interface. Only the UMPT, LMPT and UMDU support IP routes whose Port Type is Air Link.

parameters.name: MTU Switch
parameters.description: Indicates the switch for configuring the maximum transmission unit (MTU).

parameters.name: Maximum Transmission Unit
parameters.description: Indicates the MTU on a link. The smaller one between this value and the MTU on the Ethernet port takes effect for the base station.

parameters.name: Preference

parameters.description: Indicates the perfect forward secrecy (PFS) value. In the second phase of IPSec negotiation, PFS enables the BS to use a key that is not derived from the first-phase key, ensuring that the two keys are independent of each other. parameters.description: Indicates the security protocol used in an IPSec proposal. The value AH indicates the Authentication Header (AH) protocol specified in RFC2402. The value ESP indicates the Encapsulating Security Payload (ESP) protocol specified in RFC2406. The value AH_ESP indicates that the ESP protocol is preferentially used to protect packets, but not the AH protocol.

parameters.name: AH Authentication Algorithm
parameters.description: Indicates the AH authentication algorithm used by an IPSec proposal. parameters.name: Latitude With Second Format
parameters.description: Indicates the latitude of the base station in the WGS-84 coordinate system.

parameters.name: Location Id

parameters.name: Location Name

parameters.description: Indicates the longitude of the base station. A negative value indicates the west and a positive value indicates the east.

parameters.name: Longitude With Second Format
parameters.description: Indicates the longitude of the base station in the WGS-84 coordinate system.

parameters.name: Office

parameters.name: Range

parameters.name: Region

parameters.description: Indicates the telephone number of the maintenance personnel of the base station.

parameters.name: User Label
parameters.description: Indicates the user-defined information of the location.

parameters.name: Precise

In automatic mode, the base station longitude and altitude are obtained from the GPS antenna or UE, and the configured longitude and latitude information is overwritten. In manual mode, the base station longitude and altitude are configured manually.

parameters.description: Indicates the location type. The value BTSSITE indicates a traditional site deployed with both BBUs and RF modules. parameters.description: Indicates whether an MLPPP group supports the multi-class feature. If this parameter is set to ENABLE, the MLPPP group supports the Class of Service (CoS) feature and four or eight service types of different priorities.

parameters.name: Authentication Type
parameters.description: Indicates the authentication type of the MLPPP group.

parameters.name: User Name
parameters.description: Indicates the authentication user name of an MLPPP group.

parameters.name: Password
parameters.description: Indicates the authentication password.

parameters.name: Local IP
parameters.description: Indicates the local IP address. If this parameter is set to 0.0.0.0, this IP address needs to be negotiated. If this parameter is not set to 0.0.0.0, it must be set to a valid IP address of class A, B, or C but must not be the reserved address 0.x.x.x or 127.x.x.x.

parameters.name: Mask
parameters.description: Indicates the subnet mask of the local IP address. If this parameter is set to 0.0.0.0, it needs to be negotiated.

parameters.name: Peer IP
parameters.description: Indicates the peer IP address. When the BS is connected to a peer equipment, the peer IP address can be either user-specified or set to 0.0.0.0. If this parameter is set to 0.0.0.0, this IP address is obtained by means of negotiation.

parameters.name: MP/MC Header Option
parameters.description: Indicates the MP/MC head option of the MLPPP.

parameters.name: PPPMUX
parameters.description: Indicates whether to enable PPP multi-frame multiplexing.

parameters.name: MLPPP Fragment Size
parameters.description: Indicates the fragment size of an MLPPP group.

parameters.name: PPP Mux Subframe Max Length
parameters.description: Indicates the maximum length of the PPP MUX subframe.

parameters.name: PPP Muxframe Max Length
parameters.description: Indicates the maximum length of the PPP MUX frame.

parameters.name: PPPMUX Combine Timeout
parameters.description: Indicates the timeout duration of a PPP MUX combination. If the PPP MUX combination takes longer time than this parameter value, an alarm related to the PPP MUX combination timeout is reported.

parameters.name: MCPPP Class
parameters.description: Indicates the number of classes of service.

parameters.name: IP Header Compression
parameters.description: Indicates whether to enable IP header compression.

parameters.id: MLPPP Packets Discard Alarm Appear Threshold
parameters.name: MLPPP Packets Discard Alarm Appear Threshold
parameters.description: Indicates the threshold above which the MLPPP packet loss alarm is generated.

parameters.id: MLPPP Packets Discard Alarm Disappear Threshold
parameters.name: MLPPP Packets Discard Alarm Disappear Threshold
parameters.description: Indicates the threshold below which the MLPPP packet loss alarm is cleared.

parameters.name: IPHC SubOption
parameters.description: Indicates whether to enable IPHC suboption negotiation.

parameters.name: Subboard Type
parameters.description: Indicates the type of sub-board on the board where an MLPPP group is established.

parameters.name: Port ID
parameters.description: Indicates the ID of an MLPPP group, which uniquely identifies the MLPPP group. In the old model, this parameter is optional. If this parameter is not set, the default value 4294967295 is used. In the new model, this parameter is mandatory and must be unique in the system.

parameters.name: Number of TX Drop Packets
parameters.description: Indicates the number of discarded packets transmitted.

parameters.name: User Label
parameters.description: Indicates the user-defined information of the NE.

parameters.name: NeRM Version
parameters.description: Indicates the version of the NE resource model which includes the MOC, attributes, and configuration rules.

parameters.name: Product InterfaceID
parameters.description: Indicates the ID of the product interface.

parameters.name: Product Version
parameters.description: Indicates the product software version of the base station.

parameters.name: LMT Version
parameters.description: Indicates the LMT version.

parameters.name: Deployment Identifier
parameters.description: Indicates the deployment identifier that specifies the site of the NE. When multiple NEs are deployed at the same site, these NEs have the same deployment identifier.

parameters.name: Site Name
parameters.description: Indicates the site name. When multiple NEs are at the same site, these NEs are configured with the same site name.

parameters.name: Network Element Name
parameters.description: Indicates the NE name.

parameters.name: Hot Patch Version
parameters.description: Indicates the software hot patch version of the NE.

parameters.name: Cloud BB Identifier
parameters.description: Indicates the Cloud BB identifier that specifies the Cloud BB to which the NE belongs. When multiple NEs are deployed under the same Cloud BB, these NEs have the same Cloud BB identifier. The default value 0 cannot be used as a Cloud BB identifier.

parameters.name: Product Type
parameters.description: Indicates the type of an NE.

parameters.name: User Label
parameters.description: Indicates the user-defined information of a node.

parameters.name: NeRM Version
parameters.description: Indicates the resource model version of the node.

parameters.name: Node Identifier
parameters.description: Indicates the unique identifier of a node within a base station.

parameters.name: Node Name
parameters.description: Indicates the node name.

parameters.name: Working Mode
parameters.description: Indicates the working mode of a base station. The value of this parameter can only be Non-ConCurrent when the product type of the NE is not DBS3900, BTS3900, BTS3900A, BTS3900L, BTS3900AL, DBS3900 LampSite, DBS5900, BTS5900, BTS5900A, BTS5900L, BTS5900AL, or DBS5900 LampSite.

parameters.name: Software Version
parameters.description: Indicates the software version of the node.

parameters.name: Hot Patch Version
parameters.description: Indicates the software hot patch version of the node.

parameters.name: Product Version
parameters.description: Indicates the product software version of the node.

parameters.name: Product InterfaceID
parameters.description: Indicates the ID of the product interface of the node.

parameters.name: LMT Version
parameters.description: Indicates the LMT version of the node.

parameters.name: Application Version
parameters.description: Indicates the application version of the node.

parameters.name: Application Hot Patch Version
parameters.description: Indicates the application hot patch version of the node.

parameters.name: LTE Mode
parameters.description: Indicates the LTE mode. This parameter can be set to LTE_TDD only in separate-MPT LTE FDD and LTE TDD dual-mode base stations. This parameter is valid when either of the following conditions is met: (1) Product Type is set to DBS3900, BTS3900, BTS3900A, BTS3900L, BTS3900AL, DBS3900_LampSite, DBS5900, BTS5900, BTS5900A, BTS5900L, BTS5900AL, or DBS5900_LampSite, Working Mode is set to NON-CONCURRENT

parameters.name: Working Mode Extension
parameters.description: Indicates the extended deployment type of an NE. COMM and COMM2 are used when two SingleRAN base stations form a separate-MPT base station. For example, if a GU co-MPT base station and an LNR co-MPT base station form a separate-MPT base station, set the NE deployment type to COMM and COMM2 respectively. For details about the mapping between extended deployment types and apps, see the note in the A

parameters.name: 2ms User Minimum Admission CE
parameters.description: Indicates the minimum number of CEs for admitting 2 ms users when CE Overbooking is enabled.

parameters.name: CCPIC Phase Switch
parameters.description: Indicates the switch for selecting the CCPIC phase. The value DEFAULT indicates that CCPIC Phase 3 and CCPIC Phase 4 are disabled. The value CCPICPHASE3 indicates that CCPIC Phase 3 is enabled and CCPIC Phase 4 is disabled. The value CCPICPHASE4 indicates that CCPIC Phase 3 and CCPIC Phase 4 is enabled.

parameters.name: Hsdpa Scheduler Pool Switch
parameters.description: Indicates whether to enable HSDPA scheduler pool.

parameters.name: Power Configuration Check Switch
parameters.description: Indicates whether to enable the power configuration check.

parameters.id: CCPIC Phase SIR Target Correction SW
parameters.name: CCPIC Phase SIR Target Correction SW
parameters.description: Indicates whether to correct the SIR outer loop power control target value when CCPIC is enabled. If CCPIC Phase 2 is enabled, this parameter controls only the value corresponding to CCPIC phase 2. If CCPIC Phase 3 is enabled, this parameter controls both the value corresponding to CCPIC phase 2 and the value corresponding to CCPIC phase 3.

parameters.name: HSUPA AdaRetransSwitch
parameters.description: Indicates the HSUPA Adaptive Retransmission Control Switch. The function will be enabled if this parameter is set to OPEN. The function will be disabled if this parameter is set to CLOSE. If this parameter is set to OPEN and there are adequate channel elements (CEs), this improves uplink HSUPA capacity and uplink HSUPA coverage.

parameters.name: First Reject Threshold
parameters.description: Indicates the control plane congestion first reject threshold.

parameters.id: Inter-board cancellation gain switch between the WBBPa and WBBPb boards
parameters.name: Inter-board cancellation gain switch between the WBBPa and WBBPb boards
parameters.description: Indicates the inter-board cancellation gain switch between the WBBPa/WBBPb board and a board supporting IC. This parameter is valid when features related to inter-board cancellation take effect. The features related to inter-board cancellation include HSUPA IC, Turbo IC, CCPIC Phase2 and CCPIC Phase3.

parameters.name: CNBAP Capacity Extension Using UTRPc
parameters.description: Indicates whether to extend the CNBAP capacity using the UTRPc. When the value of this parameter changes, the base station needs to be manually reset.

parameters.name: RTWP Quantitative Accuracy Optimization
parameters.description: Indicates the RTWP quantitative accuracy optimization switch. It improves RTWP accuracy for multicarrier RRU3804 modules or WRFUs. This parameter is recommended to set to OFF when RTWP values are similar among carriers.

parameters.id: 2ms TTI HSUPA Users CE Callback Detect Period Level
parameters.name: 2ms TTI HSUPA Users CE Callback Detect Period Level
parameters.description: Indicates the callback detection period of CEs for 2 ms TTI HSUPA users.

parameters.name: UL Resource Work Mode
parameters.description: Indicates the uplink resource allocation mode of a NodeB. If NORMAL is selected, the same uplink resources are allocated to one set of uplink baseband equipment. If AUTO_CHAIN is selected, the uplink resources allocated to one set of uplink baseband equipment are connected in chain mode to share the resources. If MANUAL_CHAIN is selected, the uplink resources can be manually specified for the upli

parameters.name: HSUPA 2ms CE Efficiency Improvement Switch
parameters.description: Indicates the switch for CE efficiency improvement for 2 ms TTI HSUPA users.

parameters.id: Initial Single HARQ Switch for 2ms HSUPA Users
parameters.name: Initial Single HARQ Switch for 2ms HSUPA Users
parameters.description: Indicates the switch for initial activation of single HARQ for 2 ms TTI HSUPA users. If this switch is turned on, single HARQ takes effect on newly admitted users.

parameters.name: HSUPA High throughput Scheduling SW
parameters.description: Indicates the switch for scheduling HSUPA services.

parameters.name: KPI Fault auto Recover Para
parameters.description: Indicates the self-healing level of potential KPI faults. Self-healing operations vary with the value of this parameter.If this parameter is set to NONE(NONE), the NodeB does not perform any operations. If this parameter is set to BBRESOURCERESET(BBRESOURCERESET), the NodeB supports self-healing at the BBRESOURCERESET(BBRESOURCERESET) level. Currently, self-healing operations at the CELLRESTART(BB

parameters.id: Fixed CE Reserved for HSUPA 2ms TTI
parameters.name: Fixed CE Reserved for HSUPA 2ms TTI
parameters.description: Indicates the fixed number of CEs reserved for each 2 ms TTI user if CE Overbooking is enabled. Value 0 indicates that CE Overbooking takes effect separately and CE reservation for 2 ms TTI users does not take effect. A value ranging from 1 to 8 indicates that CE reservation for 2 ms TTI users takes effect and the corresponding parameter values specifies the fixed number of CEs reserved for each 2

parameters.id: DL Carrier Transmit Pwr Measurement Prd
parameters.name: DL Carrier Transmit Pwr Measurement Prd
parameters.description: Indicates the period of measuring the average downlink transmit carrier power and average downlink non-HSPA transmit carrier power in the power congestion-based E2E flow control algorithm.

parameters.name: Pwr Predict Switch for CAC
parameters.description: Indicates the switch used to predict the power of power congestion-based E2E flow control users. This parameter is valid when the power congestion-based E2E flow control algorithm takes effect. If this switch is turned on, admission decision is based on a comparison between the sum of access user initial power and measured cell power in the measurement period and the threshold. If this switch is t

parameters.name: Downlink FP Window Adjustment Switch
parameters.description: Indicates the switch used to adjust the FP window. The soft handover success rate between a Huawei NodeB and few neighboring vendor's NodeBs is low because the vendors' NodeBs have poor performance. Turning on this switch increases the soft handover success rate.

parameters.name: MC Inter-Board Joint Scheduling Switch
parameters.description: Indicates whether the HSDPA multicarrier cell supports inter-board joint scheduling. If this parameter is set to ON, the HSDPA multicarrier cell supports inter-board joint scheduling, thereby improving the balance of baseband resources between boards and reducing the number of capability decline alarms for the following features: DC-HSDPA, DC-HSDPA+MIMO, Flexible Dual Carrier HSDPA, MC-HSDPA+MIMO,

parameters.name: R99 User Fault Detect Threshold
parameters.description: Indicates the threshold for determining whether an R99 user has a high BLER.

parameters.name: UPA User Fault Detect Threshold
parameters.description: Indicates the threshold for determining whether an HSUPA user has a high BLER.

parameters.name: Process Unit Fault Detect Threshold
parameters.description: Indicates the threshold for determining whether a processing unit has a high proportion of abnormal users.

parameters.name: Traffic Fault Detect Threshold protection
parameters.description: Indicates the threshold of fault detection protection. The configured R99 User Fault Detect Threshold, UPA User Fault Detect Threshold, or Process Unit Fault Detect Threshold cannot be less than the difference between the corresponding default threshold and the fault detection protection threshold.

parameters.name: Process Unit Fault Clear Threshold
parameters.description: Indicates the threshold of determining whether a processing unit is restored after its faults are rectified.

parameters.id: Board Invisible Fault Alarm Occur Period
parameters.name: Board Invisible Fault Alarm Occur Period
parameters.description: Indicates the time segment during which invisible fault alarms are detected on the board through the service function.

parameters.id: Board Invisible Fault Alarm Clear Period
parameters.name: Board Invisible Fault Alarm Clear Period
parameters.description: Indicates the number of times invisible fault alarms are cleared on the board through the service function within a measurement period.

parameters.name: Propagation Delay Measure Matrix Switch
parameters.description: Indicates whether to collect the propagation delay measurement matrix for the CCO feature.

parameters.id: Uplink Control Channel OLPC Minimum SIR Target
parameters.name: Uplink Control Channel OLPC Minimum SIR Target
parameters.description: Indicates the minimum SIR target for uplink control channel-based OLPC. Relationship between the GUI value and actual value: Actual value = (GUI value - 40) x 0.1.

parameters.name: Hsupa Scheduler Pool Switch
parameters.description: Indicates whether to enable HSUPA Scheduler Pool.

parameters.id: Coverage Expansion Neighbour Cell Configure Mode
parameters.name: Coverage Expansion Neighbour Cell Configure Mode
parameters.description: Indicates the mode to establish neighboring cells (coordinating cells) when the Coverage Expansion Under Interference feature is enabled. If this parameter is set to AUTOMATIC, the coordination relationship is automatically identified by the NodeB and does not need to be configured. If this parameter is set to MANUAL, the coordination relationship must be manually configured.

parameters.name: Power Configuration Protection Switch
parameters.description: Indicates whether to enable power configuration protection. If this switch is turned on, the RRU checks the sum of power on the carrier served by the RRU. If the check fails, the power configuration will be limited to be below the power specifications, and the carrier fails to be set up.

parameters.id: Uplink CE Improvement for AMR-WB Switch
parameters.name: Uplink CE Improvement for AMR-WB Switch
parameters.description: Indicates whether to enable uplink CE efficiency improvement for AMR-WB.

parameters.name: NBIS Adaptive Switch
parameters.description: Indicates the adaptive NBIS switch.

parameters.name: uX2 SON Setup Switch
parameters.description: Indicates whether to enable the uX2 automatic setup function. If this parameter is set to ON, the NodeB supports automatic uX2 setup by the OSS. If this parameter is set to OFF, uX2 links must be manually set up.

parameters.name: Sleeping Cell Alarm Report Switch
parameters.description: Indicates whether to enable the sleeping cell alarm report function.

parameters.name: Sleeping Cell Detection Option
parameters.description: Indicates the scope of detecting sleeping cells.

parameters.name: CPC F-DPCH DTX Switch
parameters.description: Indicates whether to enable the CPC F-DPCH DTX function.

parameters.name: Iub Congestion KPI Improvement Switch
parameters.description: Indicates the switch for improving the RRC connection setup success rate in transmission congestion scenarios. When this parameter is set to ON, the RRC connection setup success rate increases in transmission congestion scenarios.

parameters.name: VAM Power Saving Switch
parameters.description: Indicates whether to enable the VAM Power Saving feature. If this parameter is set to ON, the VAM Power Saving feature is enabled to save energy.

parameters.name: VAM Power Saving Start Time
parameters.description: Indicates the time at which the VAM Power Saving feature takes effect. When the system time reaches the time specified by this parameter, the VAM Power Saving feature takes effect. The parameter value is in the format of HH:MM:SS. For example, 10:20:05, indicating that the VAM Power Saving feature takes effect at 10:20:05.

parameters.name: VAM Power Saving Stop Time
parameters.description: Indicates the time at which the VAM Power Saving feature becomes ineffective. When the system time reaches the time specified by this parameter, the VAM Power Saving feature becomes ineffective. The parameter value is in the format of HH:MM:SS. For example, 10:20:05, indicating that the VAM Power Saving feature becomes ineffective at 10:20:05.

parameters.id: VAM Power Saving TX Power Low Threshold
parameters.name: VAM Power Saving TX Power Low Threshold
parameters.description: Indicates the threshold of the output power percentage for cells to use the VAM Power Saving feature. If the average output power percentage of each VAM cell served by an RF module is lower than this threshold, one power amplifier is disabled and all VAM cells emit power over only one power amplifier.

parameters.id: VAM Power Saving TX Power High Threshold
parameters.name: VAM Power Saving TX Power High Threshold
parameters.description: Indicates the threshold of the output power percentage for cells to stop the VAM Power Saving feature. If the average output power percentage of any VAM cell served by an RF module is greater than this threshold, the disabled power amplifier is enabled to equally share the power emitted by VAM cells between two working power amplifiers.

parameters.id: HSDPA Serving Cell Change Optimization Switch
parameters.name: HSDPA Serving Cell Change Optimization Switch
parameters.description: Indicates the switch for HSDPA serving cell change optimization. When this switch is turned on, the data transmission policy during the HSDPA serving cell change is improved, increasing the user throughput and user experience. When this switch is turned off, the original algorithm applies.

parameters.name: DL Cell Auto Reshuffle Switch
parameters.description: Indicates the switch for automatic downlink hitless cell reshuffling.

parameters.name: Adjusting E-Tilt Flag
parameters.description: Indicates whether the electrical tilt of the antenna can be adjusted automatically.

parameters.name: AMR Transmission Bandwidth Compression
parameters.description: Indicates AMR transmission bandwidth compression switch. When this switch is turned on, the AMR transmission bandwidth compression function is enabled for all cells served by a NodeB. When this switch is turned off, the AMR transmission bandwidth compression function is disabled for all cells served by a NodeB. It is good practice to turn on this switch in satellite transmission over Iub scenarios

parameters.name: Soft Fault Self-healing Switch
parameters.description: Indicates whether to enable soft failure self-healing. If BBPRESETSWITCH is set to ON, the NodeB determines whether a soft failure occurs based on the baseband processing unit check result and the number of random access messages. If the soft failure affects services, the baseband processing unit is restarted to recover services. When BBPRESETSWITCH is set to ON, if BBPRESETDELAYSWITCH is set to O

parameters.name: KPI Fault Detection
parameters.description: Indicates the switch for potential KPI fault detection and reporting of related alarms. The items to be detected include the baseband resource R99 user BLER, baseband resource HSUPA user BLER, cell R99 user BLER, cell HSUPA user BLER, cell HSDPA user BLER, and Iub interface failure rate. If an option under this parameter is set to ON, the NodeB performs fault detection on the related detection ite

parameters.name: RRU Intelligent Dormancy Frequency Band
parameters.description: Frequency band that supports RRU Intelligent Dormancy. If this option is selected for all the frequency bands supported by the RRU or RFU, the RRU or RFU supports RRU Intelligent Dormancy.

parameters.id: Mode of the CE Sharing for the Operator
parameters.name: Mode of the CE Sharing for the Operator
parameters.description: Indicates the CE sharing mode of the common group when MOCN is enabled. When this parameter is set to FULLSHARE, private operators can use the CE resources in the common group. When this parameter is set to OPTIONALSHARE, whether private operators can use the CE resources in the common group depends on the settings of the OPERATORINDEXSELECTION parameter.

parameters.name: Selection of the Operator Index
parameters.description: Indicates the index of operators not allowed to use the license CE resources in the common group. When MOCN is enabled and OPERATORSHARECEMODE is set to OPTIONALSHARE, the operator specified by this parameter cannot use the license CE resources in the common group.

parameters.name: NBIS Reselection Period
parameters.description: Indicates the reselection period of Narrowband Interference Suppression (NBIS). When this parameter is set to a proper value, the NodeB disables the NBIS function on the current carrier and checks whether the narrowband interference is cleared on the current carrier or choose another carrier to perform the NBIS function. When this parameter is set to 0, the NodeB does not perform the reselection o

parameters.name: RTWP Imbalance Alarm Threshold
parameters.description: Indicates the RTWP imbalance alarm threshold. When the difference between the RTWP of the uplink channel of RRU and the RTWP of the uplink channel of the RFU exceeds the threshold, ALM-26522 RF Unit RX Channel RTWP/RSSI Unbalanced is reported.

parameters.id: Cell RTWP Excessive Alarm Report Switch
parameters.name: Cell RTWP Excessive Alarm Report Switch
parameters.description: Indicates whether to enable the Cell RTWP Excessive alarm report function.

parameters.name: Cell RTWP Excessive Alarm Threshold
parameters.description: Indicates the Cell RTWP Excessive alarm threshold. When Cell RTWP Excessive Alarm Report Switch is set to ON, the NodeB measures the RTWP of each uplink channel in a cell every second. In the alarm reporting period (2 hours), if more than 80% of the measured value on the uplink channel is higher than or equal to the threshold, the Cell RTWP Excessive alarm is reported. After the alarm is reported,

parameters.name: NBIS Initial Startup Threshold
parameters.description: Indicates the NBIS initial startup threshold when NBIS Adaptive Switch is set to ON. If the average no-service RTWP of all cells working on a frequency within half an hour is greater than the threshold, NBIS is started. Otherwise, NBIS is not started.

parameters.id: ACK Field Detect Threshold Opt Switch
parameters.name: ACK Field Detect Threshold Opt Switch
parameters.description: Indicates whether to enable ACK field detection threshold optimization. When this switch is turned on, the NodeB optimizes the detection threshold of the ACK field. When this switch is turned off, the NodeB does not optimize the detection threshold of the ACK field.

parameters.name: Smart Scheduling Learning Mode
parameters.description: Indicates the machine leaning mode for smart scheduling. If this parameter is set to LEARNING, the NodeB performs real-time machine learning and activates the Machine Learning based Scheduling feature. If this parameter is set to HOLD, the NodeB suspends the learning and uses the current optimal learning result to activate the Machine Learning based Scheduling feature.

parameters.id: UMTS and LTE Dynamic Power Sharing Time Period
parameters.name: UMTS and LTE Dynamic Power Sharing Time Period
parameters.description: Indicates the time period in which the UMTS and LTE Dynamic Power Sharing feature is effective on a multimode base station.

parameters.name: Private Operator License Alarm Policy
parameters.description: Indicates whether to optimize reporting of ALM-26812 System Dynamic Traffic Exceeding Licensed Limit for a private operator. With the optimization, ALM-26812 System Dynamic Traffic Exceeding Licensed Limit is reported when the number of licenses used by the private operator exceeds the total licensed threshold for the private operator and the common operator. This threshold is specified using the

parameters.name: Shutdown Fault Detection Switch
parameters.description: Indicates whether the NodeB shutdown fault identification function is enabled. When this parameter is set to ON, the cause of the NodeB shutdown fault can be promptly identified.

parameters.name: Inter Board Fault Detect Switch
parameters.description: Indicates whether to perform inter-board service link failure detection and report ALM-26215 Inter-Board Service Link Failure. When this switch is turned on, inter-board link failure detection is required. If an exception occurs, ALM-26215 Inter-Board Service Link Failure is reported. When this switch is turned off, inter-board link failure detection is not required. This parameter is valid only w

parameters.id: RL Detection and Demodulation Optimization Switch
parameters.name: RL Detection and Demodulation Optimization Switch
parameters.description: Indicates whether to enable RL detection and demodulation algorithm optimization. When this switch is turned on, the RL detection and demodulation functions are optimized to ensure that the SIR estimation is more accurate when the CS Voice Precise Power Control feature takes effect. When this switch is turned off, the RL detection and demodulation algorithm optimization does not take effect.

parameters.name: Power Control Performance Optimization Switch
parameters.description: Indicates whether to enable power control performance optimization in a cell. When this parameter is set to ON(ON), the power control performance in the cell on the board where this function takes effect improves. Currently, this parameter takes effect only on the UBBPg board.

parameters.id: Switch of Invalid TFCI Demodulation and Decoding Optimization Algorithm
parameters.name: Switch of Invalid TFCI Demodulation and Decoding Optimization Algorithm
parameters.description: Indicates whether the TFCI demodulation and decoding optimization algorithm does not take effect. If this parameter is set to ON(ON), the demodulation and decoding optimization algorithm does not take effect. If this parameter is set to OFF(OFF), the demodulation and decoding optimization algorithm takes effect.

parameters.name: VAM Power Saving State
parameters.description: Indicates whether the VAM Power Saving feature is enabled. Enable indicates that the feature is enabled. Disable indicates that the feature is disabled.

parameters.name: VAM Power Saving Time
parameters.description: Indicates the effective duration of the VAM Power Saving feature from the time specified by the latest setting of the VAM Power Saving Start Time parameter to the current time. The parameter value is in the format of HH:MM:SS. For example, 10:20:05, indicating that the effective duration of the VAM Power Saving feature is 10 hours 20 minutes and 5 seconds.

parameters.name: Baseband Equipment ID
parameters.description: Indicates the ID of the baseband equipment.

parameters.name: Uplink Baseband Equipment Work Mode
parameters.description: Indicates the working mode of the uplink baseband equipment.

parameters.name: NodeB Baseband Resource Identifier
parameters.description: Indicates the ID of a NodeB baseband resource. If the BBWS parameter in the BBP/MDU MO is set to UMTS, the NodeB automatically creates a NODEBBBRES MO on the board and allocates a unique identifier to the MO.

parameters.name: Cabinet Number
parameters.description: Indicates the number of the cabinet that houses the referenced multimode baseband board. The NodeB assigns a value to a NODEBBBRES MO created automatically based on the cabinet number in the BBP/MDU MO.

parameters.name: Subrack Number
parameters.description: Indicates the number of the subrack that houses the referenced multimode baseband board. The NodeB assigns a value to a NODEBBBRES MO created automatically based on the subrack number in the BBP/MDU MO.

parameters.name: Slot Number
parameters.description: Indicates the number of the slot that houses the referenced multimode baseband board. The NodeB assigns a value to a NODEBBBRES MO created automatically based on the slot number in the BBP/MDU MO.

parameters.name: Capacity
parameters.description: Indicates the required baseband resource capability if the NodeB needs to use a multimode baseband board. The NodeB assigns a value to a NODEBBBRES MO created automatically based on the BBWS in the BBP/MDU MO.

parameters.name: Administrative State
parameters.description: Indicates the management status of a NodeB baseband resource. Its value can be BLOCKED(Blocked) or UNBLOCKED(Unblocked). BLOCKED means that the baseband resource cannot be used to provide UMTS services. UNBLOCKED means that the baseband resource can be used to provide UMTS services.

parameters.name: Hardware Capacity Enhance
parameters.description: Indicates the hardware capability provided by the baseband board to the system. If this parameter is set to NORMAL, the baseband board provides the basic capability. If this parameter is set to PARTIAL, the baseband board provides the partial hardware capability. If this parameter is set to FULL, the baseband board provides the complete hardware capability. The NodeB assigns a value to a NODEBBBRE

parameters.name: Operational State
parameters.description: Indicates the operating status of a NodeB baseband resource. Its value can be ENABLED (Enabled) or DISABLED (Disabled). If the BBWS parameter value on a board does not match the board capability, the operating status will be Disabled.

parameters.name: Used Hardware Capacity Enhance
parameters.description: Indicates the hardware capability the baseband board actually provides to the system. The value Normal indicates that the baseband board actually provides basic hardware capability to the system. The value Partial indicates that the baseband board actually provides partial hardware capability to the system. The value Full indicates that the baseband board actually provides complete hardware capabi

parameters.name: UL CE
parameters.description: Indicates the number of uplink CEs provided by a baseband processing unit.

parameters.name: DL CE
parameters.description: Indicates the number of downlink CEs provided by a baseband processing unit.

parameters.name: Scheduled UL CE
parameters.description: Indicates the number of uplink CEs scheduled by a baseband processing unit.

parameters.name: Baseband Unit ID
parameters.description: Indicates the number of the BBU.

parameters.name: Cabinet No.
parameters.description: Indicates the number of the cabinet where the BBU is located.

parameters.name: Subrack No.
parameters.description: Indicates the number of the subrack where the BBU is located.

parameters.name: Slot No.
parameters.description: Indicates the number of the slot where the BBU is located.

parameters.name: Common CHR Event Switch
parameters.description: Indicates the type of common CHR events. If an option is selected, corresponding contents will be automatically logged.

parameters.name: User CHR Event Switch
parameters.description: Indicates the type of user-level CHR events. If an option is selected, corresponding contents will be automatically logged.

parameters.name: Common CHR Period Event Switch
parameters.description: Indicates the type of common periodic CHR events. If an option is selected, corresponding contents will be automatically logged.

parameters.name: User CHR Period Event Switch
parameters.description: Indicates the type of user-level periodic CHR events. If an option is selected, corresponding contents will be automatically logged.

parameters.name: HSDPA KQI Diagnosis Throughput Threshold
parameters.description: Specifies whether the HSDPA throughput of a user is lower than the specified threshold.

parameters.name: HSUPA KQI Diagnosis Throughput Threshold
parameters.description: Specifies whether the HSUPA throughput of a user is lower than the specified threshold.

parameters.name: Minimum Timer Value
parameters.description: Indicates the minimum value of the timer for shutting down a transmitter in a cell.

parameters.name: Maximum Timer Value
parameters.description: Indicates the maximum value of the timer for shutting down a transmitter in a cell.

parameters.name: Local Cell ID
parameters.description: Indicates the primary cell in the extend secondary cell group.

parameters.name: Extend Secondary Local Cell ID
parameters.description: Indicates the secondary cell in the extend secondary cell group.

parameters.name: Alarm Occur Threshold
parameters.description: Indicates the threshold of triggering ALM-26812 System Dynamic Traffic Exceeding Licensed Limit.

parameters.name: Alarm Detect Period
parameters.description: Indicates the interval for detecting ALM-26812 System Dynamic Traffic Exceeding Licensed Limit.

parameters.name: Alarm Recover Threshold
parameters.description: Indicates the threshold of clearing ALM-26812 System Dynamic Traffic Exceeding Licensed Limit.

parameters.name: Alarm Recover Period
parameters.description: Indicates the interval for clearing ALM-26812 System Dynamic Traffic Exceeding Licensed Limit.

parameters.name: Multiple Carrier Cell Group ID
parameters.description: Uniquely identifies a multiple carrier cell group.

parameters.name: Multiple Carrier Cell Group Type
parameters.description: Specifies the type of a multiple carrier cell group.

parameters.name: Local Cell Ref
parameters.description: Indicates the list of local cells in the multi-carrier cell group.

parameters.name: Dynamic Voltage Adjustment Switch
parameters.description: Indicates the dynamic voltage adjustment switch. When this switch is turned on, the dynamic voltage adjustment function is enabled and energy conservation is achieved.

parameters.name: Start Time
parameters.description: Indicates the time when the optimization algorithm for dynamic voltage adjustment starts working. This parameter is set on the hour. When the current time is later than this parameter, the dynamic voltage adjustment function takes effect.

parameters.name: End Time
parameters.description: Indicates the time when the optimization algorithm for dynamic voltage adjustment stops working. This parameter is set on the hour. When the current time is later than this parameter, the dynamic voltage adjustment function stops taking effect.

parameters.name: PATH ID
parameters.description: Indicates the IP path used for the NodeB.

parameters.name: Intelligent Shutdown Switch
parameters.description: Indicates whether to enable intelligent power-off. If this switch is turned on, some cells or all cells can be disabled when a Mains Input Out of Range alarm or a customized alarm is generated. If this switch is turned off, some cells or all cells cannot be disabled when a Mains Input Out of Range alarm or a customized alarm is generated.

parameters.name: Standby Power Saving Policy
parameters.description: Indicates the standby power saving policy when there is no mains power and storage batteries provide standby power. parameters.name: Level 1 Shutdown Delay
parameters.description: Indicates the level 1 power-off delay. When the level 1 power-off delay is terminated, all non-reserved cells of the NodeB are disabled. Whether a cell is reserved or non-reserved can be set in the cell configuration.

parameters.name: Level 2 Shutdown Delay
parameters.description: Indicates the level 2 power-off delay. When the level 2 power-off delay is terminated, all reserved cells of the NodeB are disabled. Whether a cell is reserved or non-reserved can be set in the cell configuration.

parameters.name: Remote Cell Group No.
parameters.description: Indicates the number of the resource group of remote coverage cells.

parameters.name: Remote Cell Group Name
parameters.description: Indicates the name of the resource group of remote coverage cells.

parameters.name: Resource Allocate Rule
parameters.description: Indicates the BB Resource Allocate Rule. Handover Performance First Rule: The local cells of the same frequency are allocated to the same processing chip. Capacity First Rule: The local cells are allocated to different processing chips in order that processing chips are used averagely.

parameters.name: Auto Rebuild Cell Switch
parameters.description: Indicates the automatic cell reestablishment switch.

parameters.name: Cs User Number Threshold
parameters.description: Indicates the threshold for the number of CS users. If the number of CS users in the downlink resource group is smaller than or equal to the threshold, cells are reestablished automatically.

parameters.name: Ps User Number Threshold
parameters.description: Indicates the threshold for the number of PS users. If the number of CELL_DCH PS users in the downlink resource group is smaller than or equal to the threshold, cells are reestablished automatically.

parameters.name: Resource Reave Switch
parameters.description: Indicates the BB Resource Reave Switch.

parameters.id: Immediate Rebuilding Switch for Degraded Multi-Cell

parameters.name: NodeB Maximum CNBAP Usage

parameters.name: Resource Group Maximum UL CE

parameters.name: Maximum Resource Group Gain
parameters.description: Indicates the maximum capacity gain achieved after all WBBPb or WBBPd boards are replaced by UBBPd boards in the uplink resource group in a measurement period. The maximum capacity gain calculated in a measurement period is adopted. The capacity gain is evaluated in scenarios where HSUPA 2 ms TTI is used. The replacement may lead to no gains in other scenarios.

parameters.name: Minimum Resource Group Gain
parameters.description: Indicates the minimum capacity gain achieved after all WBBPb or WBBPd boards are replaced by UBBPd boards in the uplink resource group in a measurement period. The minimum capacity gain calculated in a measurement period is adopted. The capacity gain is evaluated in scenarios where HSUPA 2 ms TTI is used. The replacement may lead to no gains in other scenarios.

parameters.name: Traffic Over Load Alarm Recover Threshold
parameters.description: Indicates the ratio of the number of times the system does not provide services to the number of attempts. The Base Station Traffic Overload alarm is cleared when the ratio is smaller than the preset threshold.

parameters.id: Traffic Over Load Alarm Recover Period
parameters.name: Traffic Over Load Alarm Recover Period
parameters.description: Indicates the period of clearing traffic overload alarms.
