parameters.description: Indicates whether to configure the coordination relationship for the Uplink CoMP (Joint Reception) based on Coordinated BBU feature. If this parameter is set to TRUE, the coordination relationship configured using the ADD NODEBULCOMPGRP command is used for the Uplink CoMP (Joint Reception) based on Coordinated BBU feature.

parameters.name: Coverage Expansion Neighbour Cell Configure
parameters.description: Indicates whether to configure the coordination relationship for the Coverage Expansion Under Interference feature. If this parameter is set to TRUE, the coordination relationship configured using the ADD NODEBULCOMPGRP command is used for the Coverage Expansion Under Interference feature.

parameters.description: Indicates the bearer type of an OM channel. If this parameter is set to IPV4, the EMS uses the IPv4-based transmission network to maintain the device. parameters.description: Indicates the Minimum Cell Rate (MCR) of a remote maintenance channel. If the cell rate of the remote maintenance channel is less than the MCR, a cell rate error alarm is reported.

For example, 73 cell/s is converted to 30 kbit/s.

parameters.name: Bytes of RX Packets

If MB is set to PERMIT, this parameter measures the number of bytes contained in the accessed packets. parameters.description: Indicates the packet filtering policy mode. The NE can filter packets based on the advanced ACL or layer-2 ACL.

parameters.name: ACL Type
parameters.description: Indicates the type of the ID of the access control list.

parameters.name: Port Type
parameters.description: Indicates the port type on which the packet filtering policy depends.

parameters.name: Port ID
parameters.description: Indicates the port ID or interface ID. When Port Type is set to Interface, this parameter indicates the interface ID. When Port Type is set to other values, this parameter indicates the port ID. When Port Type is set to Interface, the following are true: if IPsec Policy Group Binding Mode in the IKECFG MO is set to ALL, packet filtering policies can be bound only to a normal interface and take eff

parameters.name: ACL ID
parameters.description: Indicates the ID of an ACL. The value of this parameter ranges from 3000 to 4999. A value in the range of 3000 to 3999 indicates that the ACL rules in this ACL are advanced ACL rules. A value in the range of 4000 to 4999 indicates that the ACL rules in this ACL are layer 2 ACL rules.

parameters.name: Match Behavior
parameters.description: Indicates whether to permit or reject access of the data that does not match the ACL rule. If this parameter is set to PERMIT, data that does not match the ACL rule is allowed to pass. If this parameter is set to DENY, data that does not match the ACL rule is discarded.

parameters.id: ACL Rule Automatic Setup and Deletion Switch
parameters.name: ACL Rule Automatic Setup and Deletion Switch
parameters.description: Indicates whether to enable automatic setup of advanced ACL rules for packet filtering policy. When this switch is turned on, the system creates advanced ACL rules that match the following items in the ACL group referenced by the packet filtering policy object: OM data flows, manually created SCTP links, manually created IP paths, time services, clock services, manually created IKE peers, and PKI

parameters.name: OMCH Peer IP Limit Switch
parameters.description: Indicates whether the peer IP address is limited by the ACL rules that have been automatically generated for the OM channel when the ACL rule automatic setup and deletion function is enabled. When this parameter is set to ON(ON), the peer IP address must be the IP address of the MAE. In this case, if any one of the NetEco, TraceServer, and NIC is independently deployed, the ACL rules must be manua

parameters.name: Cabinet No.
parameters.description: Indicates the cabinet number of the board where the packet filtering policy is used.

parameters.name: Subrack No.
parameters.description: Indicates the subrack number of the board where the packet filtering policy is used.

parameters.name: Slot No.
parameters.description: Indicates the slot number of the board where the packet filtering policy is used.

parameters.name: Number of TX Packets
parameters.description: Indicates the number of transmitted packets. This parameter is reserved for further extension.

parameters.name: Number of RX Packets
parameters.description: Indicates the number of received packets.

parameters.name: Number of TX Permit Packets
parameters.description: Indicates the number of permitted packets on the TX channel. This parameter is reserved for further extension.

parameters.name: Number of TX Deny Packets
parameters.description: Indicates the number of rejected packets on the TX channel. This parameter is reserved for further extension.

parameters.name: Number of RX Permit Packets
parameters.description: Indicates the number of permitted packets on the RX channel.

parameters.name: Number of RX Deny Packets
parameters.description: Indicates the number of rejected packets on the RX channel.

parameters.id: Number of RX Packets Matched Default Behavior
parameters.name: Number of RX Packets Matched Default Behavior
parameters.description: Indicates the number of the packets that do not match the ACL rules for packet filtering policy. If MB is set to PERMIT, this parameter measures the number of accessed packets. If MB is set to DENY, this parameter measures the number of discarded packets. This parameter is valid only when CATALOG is set to PORT.

parameters.name: Bytes of TX Packets
parameters.description: Indicates the number of bytes contained in transmitted packets. This parameter is reserved for further extension.

parameters.name: Bytes of RX Packets
parameters.description: Indicates the number of bytes contained in received packets.

parameters.name: Bytes of TX Permit Packets
parameters.description: Indicates the number of bytes contained in permitted packets on the TX channel. This parameter is reserved for further extension.

parameters.name: Bytes of TX Deny Packets
parameters.description: Indicates the number of bytes contained in rejected packets on the TX channel. This parameter is reserved for further extension.

parameters.name: Bytes of RX Permit Packets
parameters.description: Indicates the number of bytes contained in permitted packets on the RX channel.

parameters.name: Bytes of RX Deny Packets
parameters.description: Indicates the number of bytes contained in rejected packets on the RX channel.

parameters.id: Bytes of RX Packets Matched Default Behavior
parameters.name: Bytes of RX Packets Matched Default Behavior
parameters.description: Indicates the number of bytes contained in the packets that do not match the ACL rules for packet filtering policy. If MB is set to PERMIT, this parameter measures the number of bytes contained in the accessed packets. If MB is set to DENY, this parameter measures the number of bytes contained in the discarded packets. This parameter is valid only when CATALOG is set to PORT.

parameters.name: Peer Clock No.
parameters.description: Indicates the number of the peer reference clock link.

parameters.name: Peer Standard
parameters.description: Indicates the standard of the peer reference clock. The value DEFAULT indicates the other standard in the same BBU. If two main control boards are configured in the same BBU, this parameter can be set to DEFAULT.

parameters.name: Peer Clock Node Type
parameters.description: Indicates the node type of the peer reference clock.

parameters.name: DCU Node No.
parameters.description: Indicates the number of DCU node.

parameters.name: Cabinet No.
parameters.description: Indicates the cabinet of MRRU.

parameters.name: Subrack No.
parameters.description: Indicates the subrack of MRRU.

parameters.name: Slot No.
parameters.description: Indicates the slot of MRRU.

parameters.name: Priority
parameters.description: Indicates the priority of the clock source. The value 1 indicates that the current clock source has the highest priority, and the value 4 indicates that the current clock source has the lowest priority.

parameters.name: Link Active State
parameters.description: Indicates the activation status of the peer reference clock link. If the link is active, the peer reference clock link is the current clock source of the system.

parameters.name: Link Available State
parameters.description: Indicates the availability of the peer reference clock link. Only an available clock link can serve as the current clock source. Otherwise, the clock link cannot be locked even if it is activated.

parameters.name: Cabinet No.
parameters.description: Indicates the cabinet number of the board where the physical port is located.

parameters.name: Subrack No.
parameters.description: Indicates the subrack number of the board where the physical port is located.

parameters.name: Slot No.
parameters.description: Indicates the slot number of the board where the physical port is located.

parameters.name: Port Type
parameters.description: Indicates the type of the physical port.

parameters.name: Port No.
parameters.description: Indicates the number of the physical port.

parameters.name: Administrative State
parameters.description: Indicates the management status of a physical port, including blocking and unblocking.

parameters.name: IP Address
parameters.description: Indicates the IP address in a ping filter entry. This address must be a valid IP address of class A, B, or C. It can also be a network segment address.

parameters.name: Mask
parameters.description: Indicates the subnet mask corresponding to the IP address in a ping filter entry. The subnet mask cannot be 0.0.0.0.

parameters.name: VRF Index
parameters.description: Indicates the index of a VRF instance. UMTS currently supports the default routing domain only (the VRF index is 0).

parameters.name: PLR Appear Threshold
parameters.description: Indicates the packet loss rate threshold above which the excessive packet loss rate alarm for the user plane is reported. When the packet loss rate on the user plane exceeds this threshold, the user-plane excessive packet loss rate alarm is reported.

parameters.name: PLR Disappear Threshold
parameters.description: Indicates the packet loss rate threshold below which the excessive packet loss rate alarm for the user plane is cleared. When the packet loss rate on the user plane is lower than this threshold, the user-plane excessive packet loss rate alarm is cleared.

parameters.name: Cabinet No.
parameters.description: Indicates the number of the cabinet where the PMU is located.

parameters.name: Subrack No.
parameters.description: Indicates the number of the subrack where the PMU is located.

parameters.name: Slot No.
parameters.description: Indicates the number of the slot where the PMU is located.

parameters.name: Manager Cabinet No.
parameters.description: Indicates the cabinet number of the manager. The manager of the PMU is usually a BBU, RRU or CCU.

parameters.name: Manager Subrack No.
parameters.description: Indicates the subrack number of the manager. The manager of the PMU is usually a BBU, RRU or CCU.

parameters.name: Manager Port No.
parameters.description: Indicates the number of the serial port where the PMU is connected. The serial port is the port through which the PMU is connected to the manager unit.

parameters.name: Address
parameters.description: Indicates the communication address of the PMU, which is determined by the settings of the 4-bit dual in-line package (DIP) switch on the PMU. The communication address is used by the PMU to communicate with the main control and transmission board. The value of this parameter must be consistent with the actual settings of the DIP switch. The 4-bit DIP switch can be treated as a 4-bit binary number

parameters.name: Power System Type
parameters.description: Indicates the type of the power system for the PMU.

parameters.name: AC Voltage Alarm Lower Threshold
parameters.description: Indicates the lower threshold of AC input voltage. When the AC input voltage is lower than the value, an ALM-25622 Mains Input Out of Range alarm is reported.

parameters.name: AC Voltage Alarm Upper Threshold
parameters.description: Indicates the higher threshold of AC input voltage. When the AC input voltage is higher than the value, an ALM-25622 Mains Input Out of Range alarm is reported.

parameters.name: DC Voltage Alarm Lower Threshold
parameters.description: Indicates the lower threshold of the DC voltage. When the output voltage of the busbar is lower than the value, an ALM-25621 Power Supply DC Output Out of Range alarm is reported.

parameters.name: DC Voltage Alarm Upper Threshold
parameters.description: Indicates the upper threshold of the DC voltage. When the output voltage of the busbar is higher than the value, an ALM-25621 Power Supply DC Output Out of Range alarm is reported.

parameters.name: Load Shutdown Flag
parameters.description: Indicates the flag for power-off against low voltage, which determines whether the load is powered off in the case of low voltage.

parameters.name: Load Shutdown Voltage
parameters.description: Indicates the load voltage below which the load is powered off automatically when load power-off against low voltage is enabled.

parameters.name: Cabinet Temperature Alarm Lower Threshold
parameters.description: Indicates the lower threshold of the cabinet temperature. If the cabinet temperature is lower than the value, an ALM-25652 Cabinet Temperature Unacceptable alarm is reported. This parameter is valid only for the APM100 and APM200 cabinets.

parameters.name: Cabinet Temperature Alarm Upper Threshold
parameters.description: Indicates the upper threshold of the cabinet temperature. If the cabinet temperature is higher than the value, an ALM-25652 Cabinet Temperature Unacceptable alarm is reported. This parameter is valid only for the APM100 and APM200 cabinets.

parameters.name: Cabinet Humidity Alarm Lower Threshold
parameters.description: Indicates the lower threshold of the cabinet humidity. If the cabinet humidity is lower than the value, an ALM-25653 Cabinet Humidity Unacceptable alarm is reported.

parameters.name: Cabinet Humidity Alarm Upper Threshold
parameters.description: Indicates the upper threshold of the cabinet humidity. If the cabinet humidity is higher than the value, an ALM-25653 Cabinet Humidity Unacceptable alarm is reported.

parameters.name: Special Analog Alarm Flag
parameters.description: Indicates whether to allow the report of a dedicated analog alarm. If the shield flag for an analog alarm is enabled, the analog alarm cannot be reported.

parameters.name: Special Boolean Alarm Flag
parameters.description: Indicates whether to allow the reporting of a dedicated Boolean alarm. If the shield flag for a Boolean alarm is enabled, the Boolean alarm cannot be reported.

parameters.name: Load Shutdown Time Flag
parameters.description: This parameter determines whether the load is powered off based on time in a base station. When this parameter is set to DISABLE, the load is powered off only when the battery voltage is less than Load Shutdown Voltage. When this parameter is set to ENABLE, the load is powered off when the duration of AC power shutdown exceeds Load Shutdown Time or the battery voltage is less than Load Shutdown Vo

parameters.name: Load Shutdown Time
parameters.description: Indicates the duration after which the load is powered off. When both the flag for power-off against time and the flag for power-off against low voltage are enabled, the load is powered off when the duration of AC power shutdown exceeds Load Shutdown Time or the battery voltage is less than Load Shutdown Voltage.

parameters.name: Power Distribution Slot No-Backup Flag
parameters.description: Indicates whether to enable the no-backup capability of the power distribution slots for a power system.If this parameter is set to DISABLE, the power system retains the backup power capability of the storage batteries in the power distribution slots when an AC power failure occurs. If this parameter is set to ENABLE, the power system powers off the load that is powered by the power distribution s

parameters.name: HVDU Number
parameters.description: Indicates the number of 225-400 V DC power distribution units (HVDUs). Set this parameter based on site conditions. An incorrect configuration will affect the reporting of the alarm related to the safety of 225-400 V DC power distribution..

parameters.name: HVDC Insulation Resistance Alarm Threshold
parameters.description: Indicates the insulation resistance alarm threshold. The insulation resistance is that between the positive/negative bus bar and the ground, which retains the default value. If the load resistance value is less than the threshold, contact Huawei technical support to check the threshold.

parameters.name: HVDC Output Voltage
parameters.description: Indicates the 225-400 V direct current (DC) output voltage. Set this parameter based on site conditions. An incorrect parameter value may lead to overvoltage protection or even damage. If this parameter is set to a value greater than 300 V, disable the DC output of the DC power supply unit (HSU) and then enable the DC output to make the parameter setting take effect.

parameters.name: AC Current Limiting Flag
parameters.description: Indicates whether the AC power system limits the AC input current. When this switch is turned on, the AC power system limits the AC input current to prevent the entire base station from being powered off due to the upper-level circuit breaker tripping. When this switch is turned off, the AC power system does not limit the AC input current. The maximum AC input current depends on the hardware capab

parameters.id: AC Air Switch Current Limiting Threshold
parameters.name: AC Air Switch Current Limiting Threshold
parameters.description: Indicates the AC input current threshold of the AC power system. After the AC current limiting function takes effect, the AC power system limits the AC input current so that the AC input current does not exceed the AC current threshold.

parameters.name: AC Phase Type
parameters.description: Indicates the external AC phase type of the AC power system.

parameters.name: Mains Intrusion Test Result
parameters.description: Indicates the mains intrusion test result of the test port on the subboard.

parameters.id: IR Test Result for Positive Electrode to GND
parameters.name: IR Test Result for Positive Electrode to GND
parameters.description: Indicates the insulation resistance test result for the positive electrode to the ground of the test port on the subboard.

parameters.id: IR Test Result for Negative Electrode to GND
parameters.name: IR Test Result for Negative Electrode to GND
parameters.description: Indicates the insulation resistance test result for the negative electrode to the ground of the test port on the subboard.

parameters.name: Power Distribution Slot No-Backup Capability
parameters.description: Indicates whether the power distribution slots support the no-backup capability.

parameters.name: Inner Cycle Fan Average Speed
parameters.description: Indicates the average rotation speed of the inner circulation fan per minute.The value 0 indicates that the fan stops rotating or the hardware is faulty. The value NULL indicates that the hardware capability query does not apply to this parameter.

parameters.name: Outer Cycle Fan Average Speed
parameters.description: Indicates the average rotation speed of the outer circulation fan per minute.The value 0 indicates that the fan stops rotating or the hardware is faulty. The value NULL indicates that the hardware capability query does not apply to this parameter.

parameters.name: AC Voltage
parameters.description: Indicates the current AC voltage, that is, the input mains voltage to the rectifier.

parameters.name: Busbar Voltage
parameters.description: Indicates the DC output voltage of the busbar.

parameters.name: Load Total Current
parameters.description: Indicates the total load current. The total load current is the sum of current supplied by all the DC output terminals on the power subrack.

parameters.name: Temperature
parameters.description: Indicates the internal ambient temperature of the cabinet. Value NULL indicates that this parameter is not supported by the hardware or the hardware is faulty.

parameters.name: Cabinet Humidity
parameters.description: Indicates the internal ambient humidity of the cabinet. Value NULL indicates that this parameter is not supported by the hardware or the hardware is faulty.

parameters.name: Secondary Load Power State
parameters.description: Indicates the power-on status of the secondary load. The secondary load can be set to automatically powered off in the following modes: HighTemperaturePowerOff(High temperature power off), LowTemperaturePowerOff(Low temperature power off), and LowVoltagePowerOff(Low voltage power off).

parameters.name: Charging/Discharging State
parameters.description: Indicates the charging or discharging management state of batteries, which is determined by the power supply system. The charging or discharging management state can be equalized charging, float charging, force equalized charging, sleeping, or discharging. Equalized charging quickly recovers the battery capacity. During equalized charging, the charging voltage is relatively high. Generally, the po

parameters.name: Battery Current
parameters.description: Indicates the charging or discharging current of batteries.

parameters.name: Current Limiting State
parameters.description: Indicates whether the batteries that are being charged are in the current limiting status.Value NULL indicates that this parameter is not supported by the hardware or the hardware is faulty.

parameters.name: Battery Power State
parameters.description: Indicates the power state of the battery. The battery can be powered off manually, or automatically for protection purpose based on the environment. A battery powered off cannot provide power for the load.

parameters.name: Remaining Capacity
parameters.description: Indicates the remaining capacity of the battery by displaying the percentage of the current capacity to the total capacity. When the battery is powered off, this parameter indicates the latest remaining capacity before it is powered off.

parameters.name: Battery Temperature
parameters.description: Indicates the current temperature of the battery.

parameters.name: Battery Test Phase
parameters.description: Indicates the phase of the battery test.

parameters.name: Photovoltaic Array Total Current
parameters.description: Indicates the total current of the photovoltaic array of the PMU.

parameters.name: Diesel Generator Current
parameters.description: Indicates the current of the diesel generator which is managed by the PMU.

parameters.name: Auxiliary Battery Cabinet Temperature
parameters.description: Indicates the temperature of auxiliary battery cabinet which is connected to the PMU.Value NULL indicates that this parameter is not supported by the hardware or the hardware is faulty.

parameters.name: Software Version
parameters.description: Indicates the software version of the PMU.

parameters.name: PCB Version
parameters.description: Indicates the PCB version of the PMU.

parameters.name: EPLD Version
parameters.description: Indicates the erasable programmable logic device version of the PMU.

parameters.name: Software Build Time
parameters.description: Indicate the software compiling time of the PMU.

parameters.name: Version Description
parameters.description: Indicates the version description of the PMU.

parameters.name: Produce Date
parameters.description: Indicates the manufacturing date of the PMU.

parameters.name: Manufacturer
parameters.description: Indicates the manufacturer of the PMU.

parameters.name: PSU Intelligent Shutdown Capability
parameters.description: Indicates the PSU intelligent shutdown capability of the PMU.

parameters.name: PSU Intelligent Shutdown Switch
parameters.description: Indicates the status of the PSU intelligent shutdown switch of the PMU.

parameters.name: Remaining Time
parameters.description: Indicates the remaining discharging time of a battery, essentially, the duration in which the battery can provide power supply when the mains supply is abnormal.

parameters.name: Battery Accumulated Charge Time
parameters.description: Indicates the accumulated charging time of a battery, including floating charging time and equalized charging time.

parameters.name: Battery Accumulated Sleeping Time
parameters.description: Indicates the accumulated sleeping time of a battery. Battery sleeping effectively prolongs the battery lifespan.

parameters.name: Battery Intelligent Management Capability
parameters.description: Indicates the battery intelligent management capability of the PMU.

parameters.name: Battery Intelligent Management Mode
parameters.description: Indicates the battery intelligent management mode of the PMU.Value NULL indicates that this parameter is not supported by the hardware or the hardware is faulty.

parameters.name: Load Shutdown Time Capability
parameters.description: Indicates whether the PMU supports powering off the load against time.

parameters.name: AC Current Limiting Capability
parameters.description: Indicates the capability of the PMU to limit the AC input current.

parameters.name: BDU Management Capability
parameters.description: Indicates the management capability of the BDU.

parameters.name: Alarm Status(from RU)
parameters.description: Indicates the alarm status of the board hardware, which can be set to Normal, Warning, Minor, Major, or Critical. The alarm status of the PSU, PDB, and BDU is in the alarm status of the PMU.

parameters.name: Operational State(from RU)
parameters.description: Indicates the operational state of the board, which can be set to Enabled or Disabled. Enabled indicates that services can be carried on the board. Disabled indicates that no service can be carried on the board.

parameters.name: Availability Status(from RU)
parameters.description: Indicates the physical status of a board, which can be Uninstalled, Starting up, Normal, Inconsistent, Unconfigured, Power off, Fault, Communication lost, In test, or the combination of multiple states. For example, if a board is not configured and fails to communicate with the main control and transmission board, the availability status of the board is "Unconfigured, Communication lost." If a boa

parameters.name: Electronic Label(from RU)
parameters.description: Indicates the electronic label, which is a text file with a maximum of 2 KB used to record the manufacturing information about equipment such as the board, sub-board, and optical module. "BoardType" indicates the type of the board. "BarCode" indicates the bar code of the board and is the same as the code labeled on the board. "Item" indicates the BOM code. "Description" indicates the board descrip

parameters.name: Type(from RU)
parameters.description: Indicates the type of the board or the cabinet.

parameters.name: Serial Number(from RU)
parameters.description: Indicates the bar code of the board or the cabinet.

parameters.name: Description(from RU)
parameters.description: Indicates the description about the services and functions provided by the board or the cabinet.

parameters.name: Date of Manufacture(from RU)
parameters.description: Indicates the manufacturing date of the board or the cabinet.

parameters.name: Vendor(from RU)
parameters.description: Indicates the manufacturer of the board or the cabinet.

parameters.name: Issue Number(from RU)
parameters.description: Indicates the issue number of the board.

parameters.name: Config Type(from RU)
parameters.description: Indicates the type of a board.

parameters.name: Board Temperature(from RU)
parameters.description: Indicates the temperature of a board.

parameters.name: HPA Temperature(from RU)
parameters.description: Indicates the temperature of the power amplifier. A power amplifier is a component on an RF module. If there is no power amplifier on an RF module, this parameter value is NULL.

parameters.name: DEVTYPE(from RU)
parameters.description: Indicates the type of the device.

parameters.name: Software Version(from RU)
parameters.description: Indicates the software version of the board.

parameters.name: Hardware Version(from RU)
parameters.description: Indicates the hardware version of the board.

parameters.name: BootROM Version(from RU)
parameters.description: Indicates the BootROM version of the board.

parameters.name: WorkMode(from RU)
parameters.description: Indicates the working mode of the board. the value SINGLEOM indicates that the GTMU works as the main control board and provides the main control, transmission, and RF port functions. The value EVOLUTION indicates that the GTMU works as the evolved board and provides the transmission and RF port functions. NORMAL indicates that the main control and transmission board works in normal mode. TDS-EVOL

parameters.name: Port Rate Limit ID
parameters.description: Indicates the port rate limit ID.

parameters.name: Port Type
parameters.description: Indicates the port type.

parameters.name: Port ID
parameters.description: Indicates the port ID.

parameters.name: UL Committed Information Rate
parameters.description: Indicates the UL committed information rate after rate limitation is configured at a port. The precision of the UL committed information rate supported by the UMPTa, UMPTb, UMPTe, UMPTg, UMPTga, UMDU or GTMUc is 64 kbit/s, the precision supported by the other board is 32 kbit/s. If the configured UL committed information rate is not a multiple of the precision, the UL committed information rate is

parameters.name: Committed Burst Size
parameters.description: Indicates the Committed Burst Size (CBS) after rate limitation is configured at a port. The minimum rate supported by the UMPTa, UMPTb, UMPTe, UMPTg, UMPTga, UMDU or GTMUc is 64 kbit/s. For the GTMUb, the value of CBS ranges from 63 kbit to 256 kbit. If this parameter is set to a value greater than the maximum allowed value or less than the minimum allowed value, the maximum or the minimum allowed

parameters.name: Excessive Burst Size
parameters.description: Indicates the Excess Burst Size (EBS) after rate limitation is configured at a port.

parameters.name: DL Committed Information Rate
parameters.description: Indicates the DL committed information rate after rate limitation is configured at a port. The parameter does not take effect in GSM and NR. For UMTS, if the downlink flow control switch is set to DYNAMIC_BW_SHAPING or STATIC_BW_SHAPING, this parameter is valid. If the downlink flow control switch is set to BW_SHAPING_ONOFF_TOGGLE, this parameter is valid when traffic congestion is detected. In ot

parameters.name: USB Access Security Policy
parameters.description: Indicates the access security policy of a USB port. When the USB Access Security Policy parameter is set to DISABLE, all USB ports are disabled but the enable flag configuration of each port remains unchanged. When the parameter is set to ENABLE, the enable flag configuration of each port prevails.

parameters.name: Cabinet No.
parameters.description: Indicates the number of the cabinet that houses the board where port security is enabled.

parameters.name: Subrack No.
parameters.description: Indicates the number of the subrack that houses the board where port security is enabled.

parameters.name: Slot No.
parameters.description: Indicates the number of the slot corresponding to the board where port security is enabled.

parameters.name: Subboard Type
parameters.description: Indicates the type of sub-board on the board where port security is enabled.

parameters.name: Port Type
parameters.description: Indicates the type of port on which port security is enabled.

parameters.name: Port No.
parameters.description: Indicates the number of the port on which port security is configured.

parameters.name: Enable Flag
parameters.description: Indicates whether to enable services on a specified port to implement port security. If this parameter is set to DISABLE, running services on the port is prohibited, thereby guaranteeing the security of the port.

parameters.name: Cabinet No.
parameters.description: Indicates the cabinet number of the board where the PPP link is located.

parameters.name: Subrack No.
parameters.description: Indicates the subrack number of the board where the PPP link is located.

parameters.name: Slot No.
parameters.description: Indicates the slot number of the board where the PPP link is located.

parameters.name: Link No.
parameters.description: Indicates the number of the PPP link.

parameters.name: Port No.
parameters.description: Indicates the number of the E1/T1 port that carries the PPP link.

parameters.name: Authentication Type
parameters.description: Indicates the mode in which the local end of a PPP link authenticates the peer end. The authentication mode is classified into No authentication, Password Authentication Protocol(PAP) authentication, and Challenge and shake Authentication Protocol(CHAP) authentication. In PAP mode, user names and passwords are transmitted explicitly on the network. If they are intercepted during transmission, a gr

parameters.name: User Name
parameters.description: Indicates the authentication user name of the PPP link.

parameters.name: Password
parameters.description: Indicates the password for authenticating a PPP link.

parameters.name: Time Slot No.
parameters.description: Indicates the number of the ET/T1 timeslot that carries the PPP link.

parameters.name: Local IP
parameters.description: Indicates the local IP address. If this parameter is set to 0.0.0.0, this parameter needs to be negotiated.

parameters.name: Mask
parameters.description: Indicates the subnet mask of the local IP address. If this parameter is set to 0.0.0.0, it needs to be negotiated.

parameters.name: Peer IP
parameters.description: Indicates the peer IP address. If the BS is connected to an upper-level node, this address is specified according to the upper-level node. If the BS is cascaded to a lower-level node, this address must be specified. This parameter can be set to 0.0.0.0.

parameters.name: PPPMUX
parameters.description: Indicates whether to enable the PPP multiframe multiplexing function. If this parameter is set to ENABLE, multiple PPP frames are multiplexed on the PPP link to reduce the bandwidth overhead.

parameters.id: Maximum Length of PPP Mux Subframe
parameters.name: Maximum Length of PPP Mux Subframe
parameters.description: Indicates the maximum length of the PPP Multiplexing (MUX) subframe.

parameters.name: Maximum Length of PPP Muxframe
parameters.description: Indicates the maximum length of the PPP MUX frame.

parameters.name: PPP Muxframe Combination Timeout
parameters.description: Indicates the timeout duration of the PPP MUX combination.

parameters.name: IP Header Compression
parameters.description: Indicates whether to enable IP header compression.

parameters.name: IPHC SubOption
parameters.description: Indicates whether to enable IPHC suboption negotiation.

parameters.name: Maximum Receive Unit
parameters.description: Indicates the Maximum Receive Unit (MRU). If the size of a received packet is greater than the MRU value, the packet is discarded.

parameters.name: Protocol Field Compression
parameters.description: Indicates whether to enable protocol field compression.

parameters.name: Address and Control Field Compression
parameters.description: Indicates whether to enable the compression of the address field and control field.

parameters.name: Negotiation Time
parameters.description: Indicates the timeout duration for the PPP link negotiation.

parameters.name: PPP Fault Frame Occurrence Threshold
parameters.description: Indicates the PPP frame error rate threshold above which the related alarm is generated.

parameters.name: PPP Fault Frame Clear Threshold
parameters.description: Indicates the PPP frame error rate threshold below which the related alarm is cleared.

parameters.name: Subboard Type
parameters.description: Indicates the type of sub-board on the board where a PPP link is located.

parameters.name: Port ID
parameters.description: Indicates the ID of a PPP link, which uniquely identifies the PPP link. In the old model, this parameter is optional. If this parameter is not set, the default value 4294967295 is used. In the new model, this parameter is mandatory and must be unique in the system.

parameters.name: Link Status

WiFi users' passwords must comply with this policy.

parameters.description: Indicates whether to enable the TX branch duplication function. This function is designed for specific MPMU modules and does not take effect for RF modules of other types. It is recommended that this function be disabled in MIMO scenarios and enabled in SISO scenarios.

parameters.name: Calibration Port Connection Status
parameters.description: Indicates the connection status of the RF module calibration port.

parameters.name: PIM3 Hit Configuration Control Switch
parameters.description: Indicates whether the RF module allows the configuration of the cell with PIM3 hit. If this switch is turned on, the configuration of the cell with PIM3 hit takes effect. If this switch is turned off, the configuration of the cell with PIM3 hit does not take effect. In the PIM3 hit scenario, the third-order intermodulation products of downlink signals of cells configured on the same antenna port o

parameters.name: Remote Flag
parameters.description: Indicates whether an RRU is far away from the BBU. You can define whether an RRU is far away from the BBU as required. If you do not need to define this information, use the default value.

parameters.name: User Label
parameters.description: Indicates the user-defined RRU descriptions.

parameters.id: RF DC Power Off Alarm Detect Switch
parameters.name: RF DC Power Off Alarm Detect Switch
parameters.description: Indicates the switch for detecting the abnormal input of the power supply. Some RF modules need to check the DC voltage to determine whether they are about to be powered off. If this switch is turned on, RF modules detect the voltage. If the voltage is abnormal, ALM-26564 RF Unit DC Input Power Failure is reported. This parameter takes effect only for the RF modules for which the value of DC Input

parameters.name: Battery Output Undervoltage Threshold
parameters.description: Indicates the output undervoltage threshold of storage batteries. This parameter is valid only if the switch controlling the detection of the RF Unit DC Input Power Failure alarm. The value NULL indicates that RF modules do not support this parameter. This parameter takes effect only for the RF modules for which the value of DC Input Voltage is not NULL in the output of the DSP RRU command.

parameters.name: Location Name
parameters.description: Indicates the location information of an RRU. Set this parameter to the location name of the site. The location name of the site is configured in the Location object. LocationName must be set to the same value for RF modules serving the same sector.

parameters.id: The Value of The Circuit Breaker
parameters.name: The Value of The Circuit Breaker
parameters.description: Indicates the circuit breaker value of the power module that is connected to an RF module. The value NULL indicates that the queried RF module does not support querying of this parameter and is displayed only in the DSP RRU command output.

parameters.name: Administrative State(from RE)
parameters.description: Indicates the administrative state.

parameters.name: Interference Frequency(from RE)
parameters.description: Indicates the interference frequency. This parameter is set by the user during network planning to avoid the external signal interference around the current received frequency, and accordingly improve the receiver sensitivity of the system. It is recommended that you leave this parameter unspecified if there is no external signal interference.

parameters.name: VSWR alarm post-processing switch(from RE)
parameters.description: Indicates the VSWR alarm post-processing switch. The pRRU (pRRU3801) does not support this parameter. When the switch is set to on and the VSWR is greater than the VSWR alarm post-processing threshold: (1) The TX channel will be shut down if the transmit power is greater than or equal to the hardware maximum output power of the TX channel minus 3 dB. (2) The TX channel will not be shut down if the

parameters.name: RF Specifications Customization Switch(from RE)
parameters.description: Indicates whether to enable customization of RF specifications. Select customized RF specifications as required. This specification is customized for a specific RF module and does not take effect for RF modules that do not support this specification.

parameters.name: VSWR alarm post-processing threshold(from RE)
parameters.description: Indicates the VSWR alarm post-processing threshold. If the VSWR alarm post-processing switch is set to ON and the VSWR is greater than the threshold, post-processing is performed to shut down the TX channel. In this case, the TX channel cannot be open automatically after the VSWR is normal. If this parameter is set to different values in different modes of a multimode base station, the smallest va

parameters.name: VSWR alarm threshold(from RE)
parameters.description: Indicates the VSWR alarm threshold. When the current VSWR is greater than the threshold, a VSWR Abnormal alarm is reported. It is recommended that the VSWR alarm threshold be set according to the VSWR required by the engineering quality to reduce the probability that the VSWR alarm is reported falsely. To stabilize the false alarm probability to 1%, 0.1%, and 0.01%, you need to set the VSWR alarm

parameters.name: RRU Position(from RE)
parameters.description: Indicates the position of the RRU, RFU, or RHUB on the chain/ring. It is calculated from the start port one by one.

parameters.name: RRU Chain No.(from RE)
parameters.description: Indicates the ID of the RRU or RFU chain/ring.

parameters.name: Topo Position(from RE)
parameters.description: Indicates the position where the RRU or RFU is installed in the topology. There are two types of positions for the RRU or RFU: TRUNK and BRANCH. BRANCH indicates that the RRU is connected to the RHUB. TRUNK indicates that the RRU or RFU is located on the main chain/ring. The main chain/ring is connected to the optical port on the baseband processing board.The LampSite high-power modules must be co

parameters.name: RF Unit Working Mode(from RE)
parameters.description: Indicates the working standard of the RRU or RFU. For an eCPRI AAU, modifying the working mode of the AAU may cause the AAU to reset.

parameters.name: Number of RX channels(from RE)
parameters.description: Indicates the number of RX channels of the RRU or RFU. Set this parameter to the number of antenna ports on the RF module. The system creates RX channels based on the number of configured channels. For 8-channel TDD or FDD RRUs, the RX channels are numbered from 1 in ascending order, and channels 1 to 8 corresponds to antenna ports A to H. For other RRUs/RFUs, RX channels are numbered from 0 in as

parameters.name: Number of TX channels(from RE)
parameters.description: Indicates the number of TX channels of the RRU or RFU. Set this parameter to the number of antenna ports on the RF module. The system creates TX channels based on the number of configured channels. For 8-channel TDD or FDD RRUs, the TX channels are numbered from 1 in ascending order, and channels 1 to 8 corresponds to antenna ports A to H. For other RRUs/RFUs, TX channels are numbered from 0 in as

parameters.id: DL Signal Quality Detection Switch(from RE)
parameters.name: DL Signal Quality Detection Switch(from RE)
parameters.description: Indicates the downlink signal quality detection switch for the RF module. Downlink signal quality can be detected when this parameter is set to ON.

parameters.id: DL Signal Quality Detection Period(from RE)
parameters.name: DL Signal Quality Detection Period(from RE)
parameters.description: Indicates the downlink signal quality detection period for the RF module. This parameter takes effect only when DL Signal Quality Detection Switch is set to ON.

parameters.id: DL Signal Quality Detection Sensitivity(from RE)
parameters.name: DL Signal Quality Detection Sensitivity(from RE)
parameters.description: Indicates the downlink signal quality detection sensitivity for the RF module. This parameter takes effect only when DL Signal Quality Detection Switch is set to ON.

parameters.name: RF Desensitivity(from RE)
parameters.description: Indicates the RF desensitization intensity of the RRU or RFU. When the air interface is under the impact of strong blocking or interference, the anti-interference capability of RF modules can be improved by decreasing the gain on RX channels and lowering the receiver sensitivity. For example, when the parameter is set to 10 dB, the uplink receiver sensitivity is lowered by 10 dB. Therefore, the an

parameters.name: Frequency Min Bandwidth(from RE)
parameters.description: Indicates the minimum effective bandwidth of the carrier. This parameter takes effect only to UMTS.

parameters.name: Low Current Protect Switch(from RE)
parameters.description: Indicates the undercurrent protection switch. If an undercurrent alarm is generated, the ALD power switch for this RRU or RFU is automatically turned off only when this parameter is set to ENABLE. If this parameter is set to NULL, the RRU/RFU undercurrent protection function setting is not changed. If NULL is displayed in the DSP RRU command output, the RRU/RFU does not support undercurrent protec

parameters.name: ALD Reuse Flag(from RE)
parameters.description: Indicates whether the ALD is reused. Value 0 indicates that the ALD is not reused. Value 1 indicates that the ALD is reused. This parameter takes effect only to UMTS.

parameters.name: RU Specification(from RE)
parameters.description: Indicates the type of an RF module. If the user does not need to forcibly verify the RU specifications using the MAE-Deployment, this parameter can be left unspecified. Leaving this parameter unspecified has no impact on the base station. If the user needs to forcibly verify the RU specifications using the MAE-Deployment, this parameter must be set to the hardware type of the RF module. After this

parameters.name: Cabinet No. of RRU2(from RE)
parameters.description: Indicates the cabinet number of RRU2/RFU2 for RF interconnection. For RF interconnection in outer interconnection mode, value NULL is displayed because the cabinet No., subrack No., and slot No. of the peer RRU remain unknown.

parameters.name: Slot No. of RRU2(from RE)
parameters.description: Indicates the slot number of RRU2/RFU2 for RF interconnection. For RF interconnection in outer interconnection mode, value NULL is displayed because the cabinet No., subrack No., and slot No. of the peer RRU remain unknown.

parameters.name: Subrack No. of RRU2(from RE)
parameters.description: Indicates the subrack number of RRU2/RFU2 for RF interconnection. For RF interconnection in outer interconnection mode, value NULL is displayed because the cabinet No., subrack No., and slot No. of the peer RRU remain unknown.

parameters.name: RF Connect Type(from RE)
parameters.description: Indicates the RF interconnection type. Intra interconnection means the interconnection between two RRUs or RFUs managed by the same main control board. Outer connection means the interconnection between two RRUs or RFUs managed by different main control boards.

parameters.name: Dormancy Switch(from RE)
parameters.description: Indicates the RRU deep dormancy switch. RRU deep dormancy is enabled if this switch is turned on. RRU deep dormancy is disabled if this switch is turned off. This parameter is NULL when the RRU does not support deep dormancy. The effective status of RRU deep dormancy can be queried using the DSP RRU command. When Dormancy Switch is set to ON, you need to set the start time and end time of the dorm

parameters.name: Dormancy Start Time(from RE)
parameters.description: Indicates the start time of RRU deep dormancy. A start time later than an end time indicates that RRU deep dormancy ends in the next day.

parameters.name: Dormancy Stop Time(from RE)
parameters.description: Indicates the end time of RRU deep dormancy.

parameters.name: Dormancy Waiting Timer(from RE)
parameters.description: Indicates the waiting time before a cell enters the forcible dormancy state. After the start time of the dormancy period is reached, new users are not allowed to access the cell and online users are handed over to other cells. If there is no UE in the cell, the cell is deactivated immediately. Otherwise, the cell is deactivated when the waiting time expires. This parameter takes effect only for MR

parameters.name: PA Efficiency Improvement Switch(from RE)
parameters.description: Indicates the power amplifier efficiency improvement switch for an RF module. When this parameter is set to ON, the power amplifier efficiency of an RF module is improved. When this parameter is set to OFF, the power amplifier efficiency of an RF module is not improved. You can run the DSP RRU command to check whether an RF module supports the power amplifier efficiency improvement. This parameter

parameters.id: RRU Slave CPRI Line Rate(from RE)
parameters.name: RRU Slave CPRI Line Rate(from RE)
parameters.description: Indicates the slave CPRI line rate of an RRU. If this parameter is set to a fixed value, this configuration takes effect only when the CPRI line rate of the RRU chain/ring where the RRU is located is set to MANUAL. In other scenarios, the slave CPRI line rate is negotiated and the negotiated result can be queried using the DSP CPRILBR .

parameters.id: RX Hardware Alarm Detection Switch(from RE)
parameters.name: RX Hardware Alarm Detection Switch(from RE)
parameters.description: Indicates the hardware alarm detection switch for the RX channel. When this parameter is set to ON, the hardware alarm detection switch is turned on for the RX channel. In this case, if the RX channel hardware is faulty, ALM-26532 RF Unit Hardware Fault is reported. When this parameter is set to OFF, the hardware alarm detection switch is turned off for the RX channel.

parameters.id: Receive Frequency Band Mutual Aid Switch(from RE)
parameters.name: Receive Frequency Band Mutual Aid Switch(from RE)
parameters.description: Indicates whether to enable the receive frequency band mutual aid function on an RF module. When this switch is set to off, the RF module can receive signals from a single frequency band. When this switch is set to on, the RF module can receive signals from multiple frequency bands.

parameters.name: Maintenance Mode(from RE)
parameters.description: Indicates the maintenance mode of an RRU. The value INSTALL indicates device creation caused by network capability expansion, device reparenting, or access of a new device to the network. The value EXPAND indicates the subrack or carrier capacity expansion of a device. The value UPGRADE indicates a device upgrade. The value TESTING indicates that an installed device is being commissioned. ExpandSt

parameters.id: Start Time of Status Setting(from RE)
parameters.name: Start Time of Status Setting(from RE)
parameters.description: Indicates the start time of maintenance status of the RRU. This time refers to the local time (including the DST offset) on the NE. If this parameter is not specified, the start time of the maintenance status is 2000-01-01 00:00:00.

parameters.id: End Time of Status Setting(from RE)
parameters.name: End Time of Status Setting(from RE)
parameters.description: Indicates the end time of maintenance status of the RRU. This time refers to the local time (including the DST offset) on the NE. If this parameter is not specified, the maintenance status ends at 2037-12-31 23:59:59.

parameters.name: Maintenance Mode Setting Remark(from RE)
parameters.description: Indicates the remarks of maintenance status of the RRU.

parameters.name: LED Switch(from RE)
parameters.description: Indicates the led switch of the RRU. This parameter takes effect only for MPMUs and some MRRUs. This parameter can be set but is invalid for the RRUs that do not support LED configuration.

parameters.name: Power Supply Group ID(from RE)
parameters.description: Indicates the ID of a group which consists of one or multiple RRUs/RFUs served by the same power supply system. This parameter must be set to the same value for RRUs/RFUs served by the same power supply system. This parameter must be set to different values for RRUs/RFUs served by different power supply systems. The value NULL indicates that the RF module does not support this parameter.

parameters.name: WiFi Switch(from RE)
parameters.description: Indicates the switch for the Wi-Fi function of an RRU. If the value of this parameter is changed from OFF(OFF) to ON(ON) for an RRU, the RRU needs to be manually reset.Only the MPMU board supports this function. GSM and NR do not support this function.

parameters.id: Slot Number of the Locked Board
parameters.name: Slot Number of the Locked Board
parameters.description: Indicates the slot number of the baseband processing board or RMU which provides clock signals for the RRU.

parameters.id: Port Number of the Locked Board
parameters.name: Port Number of the Locked Board
parameters.description: Indicates the port number of the baseband processing board or RMU which provides clock signals for the RRU.

parameters.id: Port Number of the Locked RRU
parameters.name: Port Number of the Locked RRU
parameters.description: Indicates the number of the RRU port through which clock signals are obtained.

parameters.name: Calibration Type
parameters.description: Indicates the effective channel calibration mode of the RF module. The value NULL indicates that the RF units do not support the query of this parameter.

parameters.id: The length of the fiber optic cable between the BBU and RF module
parameters.name: The length of the fiber optic cable between the BBU and RF module
parameters.description: Indicates the length of the fiber optic cable between the BBU and RF module. NULL indicates an invalid value.

parameters.name: DC Input Voltage
parameters.description: Indicates the DC input voltage of the RF module. The value NULL indicates that the DC input voltage of the RF module cannot be queried.

parameters.name: Power Supply Type
parameters.description: Indicates the power supply type of the RF module. The value UNKNOWN indicates that the power supply type of the RF module cannot be queried.

parameters.name: Fan Installation Status
parameters.description: Indicates the installation status of the fan in the RF module, which can be Uninstalled, Installed, and Unknown. When the base station supports the fan installation but the fan is not installed, Uninstalled is displayed. When the base station supports the fan installation and the fan is installed, Installed is displayed. When the RF module does not support the fan, or the base station does not sup

parameters.name: Install Type
parameters.description: Indicates the AAU installation mode, including horizontal installation and vertical installation. The value NULL indicates that the installation mode of the AAU cannot be queried.

parameters.name: Alarm Status(from RU)
parameters.description: Indicates the alarm status of the board hardware, which can be set to Normal, Warning, Minor, Major, or Critical. The alarm status of the PSU, PDB, and BDU is in the alarm status of the PMU.

parameters.name: Operational State(from RU)
parameters.description: Indicates the operational state of the board, which can be set to Enabled or Disabled. Enabled indicates that services can be carried on the board. Disabled indicates that no service can be carried on the board.

parameters.name: Availability Status(from RU)
parameters.description: Indicates the physical status of a board, which can be Uninstalled, Starting up, Normal, Inconsistent, Unconfigured, Power off, Fault, Communication lost, In test, or the combination of multiple states. For example, if a board is not configured and fails to communicate with the main control and transmission board, the availability status of the board is "Unconfigured, Communication lost." If a boa

parameters.name: Electronic Label(from RU)
parameters.description: Indicates the electronic label, which is a text file with a maximum of 2 KB used to record the manufacturing information about equipment such as the board, sub-board, and optical module. "BoardType" indicates the type of the board. "BarCode" indicates the bar code of the board and is the same as the code labeled on the board. "Item" indicates the BOM code. "Description" indicates the board descrip

parameters.name: Type(from RU)
parameters.description: Indicates the type of the board or the cabinet.

parameters.name: Serial Number(from RU)
parameters.description: Indicates the bar code of the board or the cabinet.

parameters.name: Description(from RU)
parameters.description: Indicates the description about the services and functions provided by the board or the cabinet.

parameters.name: Date of Manufacture(from RU)
parameters.description: Indicates the manufacturing date of the board or the cabinet.

parameters.name: Vendor(from RU)
parameters.description: Indicates the manufacturer of the board or the cabinet.

parameters.name: Issue Number(from RU)
parameters.description: Indicates the issue number of the board.

parameters.name: Config Type(from RU)
parameters.description: Indicates the type of a board.

parameters.name: Board Temperature(from RU)
parameters.description: Indicates the temperature of a board.

parameters.name: HPA Temperature(from RU)
parameters.description: Indicates the temperature of the power amplifier. A power amplifier is a component on an RF module. If there is no power amplifier on an RF module, this parameter value is NULL.

parameters.name: DEVTYPE(from RU)
parameters.description: Indicates the type of the device.

parameters.id: Number of carriers on the RX channel(from RE)
parameters.name: Number of carriers on the RX channel(from RE)
parameters.description: Indicates the number of carriers on each RX channel.

parameters.id: Number of carriers on the TX channel(from RE)
parameters.name: Number of carriers on the TX channel(from RE)
parameters.description: Indicates the number of carriers on each TX channel.

parameters.id: Maximum output power on the TX channel(from RE)
parameters.name: Maximum output power on the TX channel(from RE)
parameters.description: Indicates the total output power of TX channels in the RRU/RFU. The precision deviation is ±0.5 dB. For details, see the description of Output Power in the product description of the corresponding RRU/RFU.

parameters.name: UL channel gain(from RE)
parameters.description: Indicates the UL channel gain.

parameters.name: Trunk Level(from RE)
parameters.description: Indicates the RRU/RFU level on the trunk of the chain/ring.

parameters.name: Physical device serial No.(from RE)
parameters.description: Indicates the equipment serial number (ESN) of the board on the RRU chain/ring. Value NULL indicates obtaining the ESN fails. A maximum of 16 digits of the ESN can be displayed for a module compliant with the IR protocol.

parameters.name: Standard Capability(from RE)
parameters.description: Indicates the standards that are supported by the RRU or RFU. The value NULL indicates that obtaining the supported modes fails or the board does not support the query of supported modes. The parameter values consist of different RATs. LO, LF, and L indicate LTE-FDD, T and TD indicate LTE-TDD, W and WO indicate WiMAX, C and CO indicate CDMA, G and GO indicate GSM, U and UO indicate UMTS, R and RO

parameters.name: Access Direction(from RE)
parameters.description: Indicates the access direction of the service plane.

parameters.name: UL Support Feature(from RE)
parameters.description: Indicates whether the RRU or RFU supports the UL features. This parameter takes effect for UMTS only.

parameters.name: Antenna ID(from RE)
parameters.description: Indicates the serial number of the RU in the AAU. The serial numbers of antennas on other RF modules are invalid.

parameters.name: Antenna Location(from RE)
parameters.description: Indicates the slot number of the RU in the AAU. The value of this parameter is NULL for other RF modules. The slots of RUs are numbered from 0 in ascending order from bottom to top.

parameters.name: Software Version(from RU)
parameters.description: Indicates the software version of the board.

parameters.name: Hardware Version(from RU)
parameters.description: Indicates the hardware version of the board.

parameters.name: BootROM Version(from RU)
parameters.description: Indicates the BootROM version of the board.

parameters.name: PA Efficiency Improvement Capability(from RE)
parameters.description: Indicates whether an RF module supports the power amplifier efficiency improvement. This parameter takes effect in UMTS, LTE or NR.

parameters.id: RRU/RFU Maximum Delay of Its Channel(from RE)
parameters.name: RRU/RFU Maximum Delay of Its Channel(from RE)
parameters.description: Indicates the maximum compensation in antenna delay supported by an RF module. The propagation delay from the output port of an RF unit to the antenna port is compensated. If no TMA is configured, this parameter is set to the propagation delay of the feeder. If the TMA is configured, this parameter also includes the delay of the TMA. NULL indicates that the compensation in antenna delay cannot be

parameters.name: Current Maintenance Mode(from RE)
parameters.description: Indicates the current maintenance mode of the RRU.

parameters.name: Carrier Index(from RE)
parameters.description: Indicates the carrier index of the RRU/RFU.

parameters.id: Carrier DL Freq. Band Higher Limit(from RE)
parameters.name: Carrier DL Freq. Band Higher Limit(from RE)
parameters.description: Indicates the upper limit of the downlink frequency band used by the carrier of the RRU/RFU.

parameters.id: Set of TRX DL Freq. Band Higher Limits(from RE)
parameters.name: Set of TRX DL Freq. Band Higher Limits(from RE)
parameters.description: Indicates the set of the upper limits of the downlink frequency bands used by the TRXs of the RRU/RFU.

parameters.id: Carrier DL Freq. Band Lower Limit(from RE)
parameters.name: Carrier DL Freq. Band Lower Limit(from RE)
parameters.description: Indicates the lower limit of the downlink frequency band used by the carrier of the RRU/RFU.

parameters.id: Set of TRX DL Freq. Band Lower Limits(from RE)
parameters.name: Set of TRX DL Freq. Band Lower Limits(from RE)
parameters.description: Indicates the set of the lower limits of the downlink frequency bands used by the TRXs of the RRU/RFU.

parameters.name: Carrier RAT(from RE)
parameters.description: Indicates the carrier RAT of the RRU/RFU.

parameters.name: Carrier Power(from RE)
parameters.description: Indicates the carrier power of the RRU/RFU.

parameters.name: TRX Power Set(from RE)
parameters.description: Indicates the TRX power set of the RRU/RFU.

parameters.id: Carrier UL Freq. Band Higher Limit(from RE)
parameters.name: Carrier UL Freq. Band Higher Limit(from RE)
parameters.description: Indicates the upper limit of the uplink frequency band used by the carrier of the RRU/RFU.

parameters.id: Set of TRX UL Freq. Band Higher Limits(from RE)
parameters.name: Set of TRX UL Freq. Band Higher Limits(from RE)
parameters.description: Indicates the set of the upper limits of the uplink frequency bands used by the TRXs of the RRU/RFU.

parameters.id: Carrier UL Freq. Band Lower Limit(from RE)
parameters.name: Carrier UL Freq. Band Lower Limit(from RE)
parameters.description: Indicates the lower limit of the uplink frequency band used by the carrier of the RRU/RFU.

parameters.id: Set of TRX UL Freq. Band Lower Limits(from RE)
parameters.name: Set of TRX UL Freq. Band Lower Limits(from RE)
parameters.description: Indicates the set of the lower limits of the uplink frequency bands used by the TRXs of the RRU/RFU.

parameters.name: WorkMode(from RU)
parameters.description: Indicates the working mode of the board. the value SINGLEOM indicates that the GTMU works as the main control board and provides the main control, transmission, and RF port functions. The value EVOLUTION indicates that the GTMU works as the evolved board and provides the transmission and RF port functions. NORMAL indicates that the main control and transmission board works in normal mode. TDS-EVOL

parameters.name: Chain No.
parameters.description: Indicates the ID of the RRU chain/ring. It uniquely identifies a chain within a base station.

parameters.name: Topo Type
parameters.description: Indicates the type of the topology. In a ring topology, service data is transmitted on the fiber optic cable that carries the HDLC link. In a load sharing topology, service data is transmitted on two fiber optic cables simultaneously, which enhances the transmission capability. The physical connection in the ring topology is similar to that in the load sharing topology. The trunk chain enables mul

parameters.name: Backup Mode
parameters.description: Indicates the backup mode of the RRU chain/ring. There are two modes: cold backup and hot backup. Cold backup indicates that when the link on one end of the chain/ring fails, services are interrupted for a short period of time, and then re-established on the other end of the chain/ring. Hot backup indicates that when the link on one end of the chain/ring fails, services are taken over by the other

parameters.name: Head Cabinet No.
parameters.description: Indicates the cabinet number of the board where the head CPRI port is located.

parameters.name: Head Subrack No.
parameters.description: Indicates the subrack number of the board where the head CPRI port is located.

parameters.name: Head Slot No.
parameters.description: Indicates the slot number of the board where the head CPRI port is located.

parameters.name: Head Port No.
parameters.description: Indicates the number of the head CPRI port.

parameters.name: Tail Cabinet No.
parameters.description: Indicates the cabinet number of the board where the tail CPRI port is located. If there is no tail, the value of this parameter is NULL.

parameters.name: Tail Subrack No.
parameters.description: Indicates the subrack number of the board where the tail CPRI port is located. If there is no tail, the value of this parameter is NULL.

parameters.name: Tail Slot No.
parameters.description: Indicates the slot number of the board where the tail CPRI port is located. If there is no tail, the value of this parameter is NULL.

parameters.name: Tail Port No.
parameters.description: Indicates the number of the tail CPRI port. If there is no tail, the value of this parameter is NULL.

parameters.name: BreakPoint Position1
parameters.description: Indicates breakpoint position 1 on the chain/ring. When this parameter is set to 255, the breakpoint is disabled.

parameters.name: BreakPoint Position2
parameters.description: Indicates breakpoint position 2 on the chain/ring. When this parameter is set to 255, the breakpoint is disabled.

parameters.name: Access Type
parameters.description: Indicates the access type of the board on an RRU chain/ring. When Access Type is set to LOCALPORT, the BBP connects to the board on an RRU chain/ring through CPRI ports. When Access Type is set to PEERPORT, the local BBP connects to the peer BBP through a IDX2 ports and the peer BBP connects to a board on an RRU chain/ring.

parameters.name: CPRI Line Rate
parameters.description: Indicates the user-defined rate. The value AUTO indicates that auto-negotiation is used. The value MANUAL indicates that the rate is set manually and the rate must be set to a fixed value for each board on the RRU chain/ring. Other values indicate the corresponding fixed rates. If the CPRI link fails with this parameter set to a fixed rate, the RRU cannot work with this CPRI rate.

parameters.name: Local Slot No.
parameters.description: Indicates the slot number of the converged party in CPRI MUX/eCPRI MUX. If this parameter is set to 255, the slot number of the converged party is not specified. When the converging party is in a BBU3900, this parameter can be left unspecified. When the converging party is in a BBU3910, BBU5900 or BBU5900A, this parameter must be specified.

parameters.name: Protocol Type
parameters.description: Indicates the communication protocol used by the chain/ring. The value DEFAULT indicates that the chain/ring uses the protocol specified in the Equipment MO. The protocol specified by this parameter prevails when it differs from that specified in the Equipment MO.

parameters.name: Severely Errored Second Threshold
parameters.description: Indicates the threshold for a SES in CPRI link performance measurement results. A second is an SES if the bit error rate on a CPRI link is greater than the value of this parameter within this second.

parameters.name: Connect Port Num
parameters.description: Indicates the number of ports used for a trunk chain.

parameters.name: Port 1 Cabinet No.
parameters.description: Indicates the cabinet number of the board a port of which works as port 1 of the trunk chain.

parameters.name: Port 1 Subrack No.
parameters.description: Indicates the subrack number of the board a port of which works as port 1 of the trunk chain.

parameters.name: Port 1 Slot No.
parameters.description: Indicates the slot number of the board a port of which works as port 1 of the trunk chain.

parameters.name: Port 1 Port No.
parameters.description: Indicates the port number of the board a port of which works as port 1 of the trunk chain.

parameters.name: Port 1 CPRI Line Rate
parameters.description: Indicates the line rate of port 1 of the trunk chain. The value AUTO indicates that the auto-negotiation mode is used. The value MANUAL indicates that the rate is set manually and the rate must be set to a fixed value for each board on the RRU chain/ring. Other values indicate the corresponding fixed rates.

parameters.name: Port 1 Severely Errored Second Threshold
parameters.description: Indicates the threshold for a severely errored second (SES) in CPRI link performance measurement results. A second is an SES if the bit error rate on a CPRI link is greater than the value of this parameter within this second.

parameters.name: Port 2 Cabinet No.
parameters.description: Indicates the cabinet number of the board a port of which works as port 2 of the trunk chain. The value of this parameter is NULL if the current port is not used.

parameters.name: Port 2 Subrack No.

parameters.name: Port 2 Slot No.
parameters.description: Indicates the slot number of the board a port of which works as port 2 of the trunk chain. The value of this parameter is NULL if the current port is not used.

parameters.name: Port 2 Port No.
parameters.description: Indicates the port number of the board a port of which works as port 2 of the trunk chain. The value of this parameter is NULL if the current port is not used.

parameters.name: Port 4 Port No.

parameters.name: User-Defined Rate Negotiation Switch
parameters.description: Indicates the user-defined rate negotiation switch. If this switch is turned on, users can specify a bit rate set and a rate change period for automatic rate negotiation.

parameters.name: Bit Rate Set
parameters.description: Indicates the bit rate set for rate negotiation. This parameter takes effect only when the user-defined rate negotiation switch is turned on. If this bit rate set does not overlap with the rate set supported by the port, the rate set supported by the port is used for rate negotiation by default.

parameters.name: Rate Change Period
parameters.description: Indicates the duration of a port working in each negotiated rate. This parameter takes effect only when the user-defined rate negotiation switch is turned on.

parameters.name: Reserved Bandwidth
parameters.description: Indicates the bandwidth reserved for other applications.

parameters.name: Local Cabinet No.
parameters.description: Indicates the cabinet number of the converged party in CPRI MUX/eCPRI MUX. The Local Cabinet No. parameter and the Local Subrack No. parameter must be both set to 255 or neither set to 255. If they are both set to 255, the converging party and converged party are deployed in the same subrack. If they are not set to 255, the deployment depends on the configurations.

parameters.name: Local Subrack No.
parameters.description: Indicates the subrack number of the converged party in CPRI MUX/eCPRI MUX. The Local Cabinet No. parameter and the Local Subrack No. parameter must be both set to 255 or neither set to 255. If they are both set to 255, the converging party and converged party are deployed in the same subrack. If they are not set to 255, the deployment depends on the configurations.

parameters.name: Head SubPort No.
parameters.description: Indicates the number of the head CPRI sub-port.

parameters.name: Tail SubPort No.
parameters.description: Indicates the number of the tail CPRI sub-port. If there is no tail or the tail has no sub-ports, the value of this parameter is NULL.

parameters.name: Port 1 SubPort No.
parameters.description: Indicates the number of the sub-port through which port 1 connects to the trunk chain.

parameters.name: Port 2 SubPort No.
parameters.description: Indicates the number of the sub-port through which port 2 connects to the trunk chain.

parameters.name: Port 3 SubPort No.
parameters.description: Indicates the number of the sub-port through which port 3 connects to the trunk chain.

parameters.name: Port 4 SubPort No.
parameters.description: Indicates the number of the sub-port through which port 4 connects to the trunk chain.

parameters.name: Chain Level
parameters.description: Indicates the level of the RRU chain.

parameters.name: Board Number
parameters.description: Indicates the number of boards on the RRU chain/ring.

parameters.name: Cabinet No.
parameters.description: Indicates the number of the cabinet that houses the board where a transmission resource group is established.

parameters.name: Subrack No.
parameters.description: Indicates the number of the subrack that houses the board where a transmission resource group is established.

parameters.name: Slot No.
parameters.description: Indicates the number of the slot corresponding to the board where a transmission resource group is established.

parameters.name: Transmission Resource Group Bear Type
parameters.description: Indicates the bearer type of the transmission group. The LTE and NR do not support ATM.

parameters.name: Subboard Type
parameters.description: Indicates the type of sub-board on the transmission group. The LTE and NR do not support UNCHANNELLED_COVERBOARD.

parameters.name: Bearing Port Type
parameters.description: Indicates the type of port where a transmission resource group is carried. The LTE and NR do not support STM1, IMA, UNI, or FRAATM.

parameters.name: Bearing Port No.
parameters.description: Indicates the number of the port where the transmission resource group is configured.

parameters.name: Transmission Resource Group ID
parameters.description: Indicates the ID of a transmission resource group. When you use an MML command to add a PPP link, an MP group, an Ethernet port, an Ethernet trunk, a tunnel, or a PPPoE link, the system automatically creates a transmission resource group with Transmission Resource Group ID set to DEFAULTPORT(Default Port). parameters.name: Rate Unit
parameters.description: Indicates the rate unit of the TX bandwidth, RX bandwidth, TX CIR, RX CIR, TX PIR and RX PIR of the transmission resource group. The LTE and NR do not support CELL/S.

parameters.name: Tx Bandwidth
parameters.description: Indicates the maximum uplink bandwidth of a transmission resource group at the MAC layer when the transmission resource group is carried over IP. This parameter value is used as the uplink transport admission bandwidth and TX traffic shaping bandwidth. The minimum rate supported by the UMPTa, UMPTb, UMDU, GTMUb or GTMUc is 64 kbit/s. parameters.name: Rx Bandwidth
parameters.description: Indicates the RX bandwidth of a transmission resource group. To LTE, this parameter value is also used as the downlink transport admission bandwidth. The LMPT can be configured with a maximum of 540 Mbit/s RX bandwidth. The WMPT, GTMUb or GTMUc can be configured with a maximum of 300 Mbit/s RX bandwidth. parameters.name: TX Committed Burst Size
parameters.description: Indicates the TX committed burst size of a transmission resource group. The LMPT can be configured with a maximum of 400 Mbit/s TX committed burst size. The WMPT can be configured with a maximum of 600 Mbit/s TX committed burst size. The WMPT, GTMUb or GTMUc can be configured with a maximum of 600 Mbit/s TX committed burst size. The UMPTa, UMPTb, UMDU or UTRPc can be configured with a maximum of 1

parameters.name: TX Excessive Burst Size
parameters.description: Indicates the TX excessive burst size of a transmission resource group. The LMPT can be configured with a maximum of 450 Mbit/s TX excessive burst size. The WMPT, GTMUb or GTMUc can be configured with a maximum of 600 Mbit/s TX excessive burst size. The UMPTa, UMPTb, UMDU or UTRPc can be configured with a maximum of 1 Gbit/s TX excessive burst size. The UMPTe, UMPTga or UCCU can be configured with

parameters.name: Operator ID
parameters.description: Indicates the index of the operator. This parameter is used to differentiate between operators. This parameter is reserved for future extension and does not take effect currently.

parameters.name: Scheduling Weight
parameters.description: Indicates the scheduling weight of a transmission resource group. This parameter is used in calculating the bandwidth scheduled to a resource group, which helps achieve the user admission control.

parameters.name: TX Committed Information Rate
parameters.description: Indicates the transmit CIR of the transmission resource group. The LMPT can be configured with a maximum of 360 Mbit/s TX committed information rate. The UMPTa, UMPTb, UMDU or UTRPc can be configured with a maximum of 1 Gbit/s TX committed information rate. The GTMUb or GTMUc can be configured with a maximum of 300 Mbit/s TX committed information rate. The UMPTe, UMPTga or UCCU can be configured w

parameters.name: RX Committed Information Rate
parameters.description: Indicates the receive CIR of the transmission resource group. This parameter value is used as the downlink transport admission bandwidth for non-flow-control services. The LMPT can be configured with a maximum of 540 Mbit/s RX committed information rate. The UMPTa, UMPTb, UMDU or UTRPc can be configured with a maximum of 1 Gbit/s RX committed information rate. The UMPTe, UMPTga or UCCU can be conf

parameters.name: TX Peak Information Rate
parameters.description: Indicates the transmit PIR of the transmission resource group. The LMPT can be configured with a maximum of 360 Mbit/s TX peak information rate. The UMPTa, UMPTb, UMDU or UTRPc can be configured with a maximum of 1 Gbit/s TX peak information rate. The GTMUb or GTMUc can be configured with a maximum of 300 Mbit/s TX peak information rate.
