parameters.name: RX Peak Information Rate
parameters.description: Indicates the receive PIR of the transmission resource group. This parameter value is used as the downlink transport admission bandwidth. The LMPT can be configured with a maximum of 540 Mbit/s RX peak information rate. The UMPTa, UMPTb, UMDU or URTPc can be configured with a maximum of 1 Gbit/s RX peak information rate. The UMPTa, UMPTb, UMDU or UTRPc can be configured with a maximum of 1 Gbit/s TX peak burst size. The GTMUb or GTMUc can be configured with a maximum of 300 Mbit/s TX peak burst size. parameters.name: User Label
parameters.description: Indicates the user-defined information about a transmission group.

parameters.name: Realtime TX Bandwidth
parameters.description: Indicates the local real-time traffic that is transmitted in a transmission resource group. The local traffic includes only the local traffic stream exclusive of the passing-by data flow and non-traffic stream. The parameter takes effect only in LTE and NR.

parameters.name: Realtime RX Bandwidth
parameters.description: Indicates the local real-time traffic that is received in a transmission resource group. The local traffic includes only the local traffic stream exclusive of the passing-by data flow and non-traffic stream. The parameter takes effect only in LTE and NR.

parameters.name: Non-Realtime TX Bandwidth
parameters.description: Indicates the local non-real-time traffic that is transmitted in a transmission resource group. The local traffic includes only the local traffic stream exclusive of the passing-by data flow and non-traffic stream. The parameter takes effect only in LTE and NR.

parameters.name: Non-Realtime RX Bandwidth
parameters.description: Indicates the local non-real-time traffic that is received in a transmission resource group. The local traffic includes only the local traffic stream exclusive of the passing-by data flow and non-traffic stream. The parameter takes effect only in LTE and NR.

parameters.name: Non-Realtime Reserved TX Bandwidth
parameters.description: Indicates the TX bandwidth reserved for non-real-time services in a transmission resource group. The parameter takes effect only in LTE and NR.

parameters.name: Non-Realtime Reserved RX Bandwidth
parameters.description: Indicates the RX bandwidth reserved for non-real-time services in a transmission resource group. The parameter takes effect only in LTE and NR.

parameters.name: Tx Bandwidth Used
parameters.description: Indicates the TX bandwidth that is already used by a transmission resource group.

parameters.name: Rx Bandwidth Used
parameters.description: Indicates the RX bandwidth that are already used by a transmission resource group.

parameters.name: Tx Bandwidth Usable
parameters.description: Indicates the TX bandwidth that can be used by a transmission resource group.

parameters.name: Rx Bandwidth Usable
parameters.description: Indicates the RX bandwidth that can be used by a transmission resource group.

parameters.name: GBR Tx Bandwidth
parameters.description: Indicates the GBR service traffic that is transmitted by the transmission resource group. The parameter takes effect only in LTE and NR.

parameters.name: GBR Rx Bandwidth
parameters.description: Indicates the GBR service traffic received by the transmission resource group. The parameter takes effect only in LTE and NR.

parameters.name: Rate Configuration Type
parameters.description: Indicates the rate configuration mode of the transmission resource group.

parameters.name: UL Admission Bandwidth
parameters.description: Indicates the uplink admission bandwidth of the transmission resource group. When Physical Port Up Link OverBooking Switch is ON in the command output of the LST TACALG command, the value of this parameter can exceed the uplink bandwidth of the physical port. The parameter takes effect only in LTE and NR.

parameters.name: DL Admission Bandwidth
parameters.description: Indicates the downlink admission bandwidth of the transmission resource group. When Physical Port Down Link OverBooking Switch is ON in the command output of the LST TACALG command, the value of this parameter can exceed the downlink bandwidth of the physical port. The parameter takes effect only in LTE and NR.

parameters.name: UL CIR Admission Bandwidth
parameters.description: Indicates the UL Committed Information Rate (CIR) admission bandwidth for the transmission resource group. The parameter takes effect only in LTE and NR.

parameters.name: DL CIR Admission Bandwidth
parameters.description: Indicates the CIR admission bandwidth of the transmission resource group in DL. The parameter takes effect only in LTE and NR.

parameters.name: UL PIR Admission Bandwidth
parameters.description: Indicates the UL PIR admission bandwidth of the transmission resource group. The parameter takes effect only in LTE and NR.

parameters.name: DL PIR Admission Bandwidth
parameters.description: Indicates the PIR admission bandwidth of the transmission resource group in DL. The parameter takes effect only in LTE and NR.

parameters.name: Realtime Tx Traffic
parameters.description: Indicates the realtime traffic sent on a transmission resource group.

parameters.name: Cabinet No.
parameters.description: Indicates the number of the cabinet that houses the board where a transmission resource group is established.

parameters.name: Subrack No.
parameters.description: Indicates the number of the subrack that houses the board where a transmission resource group is established.

parameters.name: Slot No.
parameters.description: Indicates the number of the slot that houses the board where a transmission resource group is established.

parameters.name: Subboard Type
parameters.description: Indicates the subboard type of the board where a transmission group is established. This parameter cannot be set to UNCHANNELLED_COVERBOARD for LTE and NR.

parameters.name: Transmission Resource Group Bear Type
parameters.description: Indicates the bearer type of a transmission group. This parameter cannot be set to ATM for LTE and NR.

parameters.name: Bearing Port Type
parameters.description: Indicates the type of port where a transmission resource group is carried. This parameter cannot be set to STM1, IMA, UNI, or FRAATM for LTE and NR.

parameters.name: Bearing Port No.
parameters.description: Indicates the number of the port where the transmission resource group is configured.

parameters.description: Indicates the ID of a transmission resource group. When you add a PPP link, an MP group, an Ethernet port, an Ethernet trunk, a tunnel, or a PPPoE link, the system automatically creates an algorithm for the transmission resource group with Transmission Resource Group ID set to DEFAULTPORT(Default Port). When you remove any of the preceding objects, the system automatically removes the algorithm fo

parameters.name: TX Traffic Shaping Switch
parameters.description: Indicates whether to enable traffic shaping for a transmission resource group. If this parameter is set to ON, traffic shaping is performed according to the TX bandwidth so that the transmit traffic would not exceed the capability of downstream routers, therefore avoiding unnecessary packet loss and congestion. If this parameter is set to OFF, traffic shaping is not performed during data transmiss

parameters.name: TX Bandwidth Adjustment Switch
parameters.description: Indicates whether to enable the dynamic adjustment of the TX bandwidth of a transmission resource group. If this parameter is set to ON, the TX bandwidth is adjusted according to the network performance and dynamic bandwidth adjustment parameters (Packet Loss Ratio Down Threshold and Delay Variation Down Threshold). The network performance is monitored through IP PM sessions, which can be enabled

parameters.name: RX Bandwidth Adjustment Switch
parameters.description: Indicates whether to enable the dynamic adjustment of the RX bandwidth of a transmission resource group. If this parameter is set to ON, the RX bandwidth is adjusted according to the network performance and dynamic bandwidth adjustment parameters (Packet Loss Ratio Down Threshold and Delay Variation Down Threshold). The network performance is monitored through IP PM sessions, which can be enabled

parameters.name: Packet Loss Ratio Down Threshold
parameters.description: Indicates the rate downsizing packet loss rate threshold for bandwidth adjustment. When RXBWASW or TXBWASW is set to ON, the estimated available transport bandwidth is reduced if the packet loss rate detected through IP Performance Monitoring (IP PM) is higher than this threshold. If the packet loss rate detected through IP PM is lower than this threshold, the estimated available transport bandwid

parameters.name: Delay Variation Down Threshold
parameters.description: Indicates the rate downsizing packet loss rate threshold for bandwidth adjustment. When RXBWASW or TXBWASW is set to ON, the estimated available transport bandwidth will be reduced if the packet loss rate detected by an IP PM session is higher than this threshold; the estimated available transport bandwidth will be increased if the packet loss rate detected by an IP PM session is lower than this t

parameters.name: TX Bandwidth Adjust Minimum
parameters.description: Indicates the minimum amount of adjusted TX bandwidth. If TXBWASW is set to ON, the adjusted bandwidth should be at least greater than this minimum. This parameter does not take effect in UMTS and NR.

parameters.name: RX Bandwidth Adjust Minimum
parameters.description: Indicates the minimum amount of adjusted RX bandwidth. If RXBWASW is set to ON, the adjusted bandwidth must be at least greater than this minimum. This parameter does not take effect in UMTS and NR.

parameters.name: Traffic Control Switch
parameters.description: Indicates whether to enable the backpressure algorithm of a transmission resource group. The BS monitors the data buffered in the queues of each transmission resource group, determines whether the transmission resource group is congested, and transmits the backpressure signals (number and congestion status of the transmission resource group) to each flow control service. If the size of buffered da

parameters.name: PQ Number
parameters.description: Indicates the number of PQs in a transmission resource group. The queues in a transmission resource group are classified into PQs and non-PQs. The scheduling priority of any PQ is higher than that of any non-PQ. The queues numbered from 0 to the result after this parameter value minus 1 are PQs. PQ scheduling is used between PQs. A smaller PQ number indicates a higher scheduling priority. The queu

parameters.name: Congestion Time Threshold
parameters.description: Indicates the congestion time threshold of a transmission resource group. When TCSW is set to ENABLE, if the buffer time of non-real-time service data in a transmission resource group exceeds the threshold, the transmission resource group is congested, and backpressure signals are transmitted.

parameters.name: Congestion Clear Time Threshold
parameters.description: Indicates the congestion clear time threshold of a transmission resource group. When TCSW is set to ENABLE, if the buffer time of non-real-time service data in a transmission resource group is less than the threshold, the transmission resource group is not congested, and congestion clear signals are transmitted.

parameters.name: TX Reserved Bandwidth
parameters.description: Indicates the TX bandwidth reserved for signaling data, OM data, or real-time services. This parameter should be set to a value less than the TX bandwidth of a transmission resource group. It is recommended that the reserved TX bandwidth be set to a value less than or equal to 3% of the TX bandwidth of a transmission resource group. The UMTS currently does not support this function.

parameters.name: RX Reserved Bandwidth
parameters.description: Indicates the reserved RX bandwidth, which should be set to a value less than or equal to the RX bandwidth of a transmission resource group. This parameter does not take effect in UMTS.

parameters.name: Drop Packet Number Threshold
parameters.description: Indicates the number threshold of discarded packets. This parameter indicates the capability of the queue in an enhanced transmission resource group to buffer packets. A greater parameter value indicates a stronger capability. If this parameter is set to 0, the queue in an enhanced transmission resource group cannot buffer packets, and therefore all the delayed packets on the TX channel are discar

parameters.name: Antenna Scenario
parameters.description: Indicates the connection scenario of the antenna. This parameter must be set based on the hardware installation. The vendor code and serial number of the device must be correctly configured in a non-regular scenario. This parameter can be set to REGULAR or DAISY_CHAIN.

parameters.name: Number of RVD Subunits
parameters.description: Indicates the number of configured RVD subunits.

parameters.name: Device No.(from ALD)
parameters.description: Indicates the device number of the ALD. The device number of the ALD must be unique.

parameters.name: Device Name(from ALD)
parameters.description: Indicates the device name of the ALD, which identifies the ALD. It is recommended that you set the device name in the following format: sector_device type_network type. The meanings of the parts are as follows: Sector indicates the number of the sector. Device type indicates the type of currently connected device. The device type can be SINGLE_RET (Single-antenna Remote Electrical Tilt Unit), MULT

parameters.name: Control Port Cabinet No.(from ALD)
parameters.description: Indicates the cabinet number of the RRU or RFU that controls the ALD.

parameters.name: Control Port Subrack No.(from ALD)
parameters.description: Indicates the subrack number of the RRU or RFU that controls the ALD.

parameters.name: Control Port Slot No.(from ALD)
parameters.description: Indicates the slot number of the RRU or RFU that controls the ALD.

parameters.name: Vendor Code(from ALD)
parameters.description: Indicates the vendor code.

parameters.name: Serial No.(from ALD)
parameters.description: Indicates the serial number of the ALD. The vendor code and the serial number uniquely identify an ALD.

parameters.name: Actual Vendor Code(from ALD)
parameters.description: Indicates the vendor code of the device in the scanning result.

parameters.name: Actual Device Serial No.(from ALD)
parameters.description: Indicates the serial number of the device in the scanning result.

parameters.name: Protocol Version(from ALD)
parameters.description: Indicates the actual protocol version of the ALD. NULL means that the protocol version information fails to be obtained.

parameters.name: Actual Number of Subunits(from ALD)
parameters.description: Indicates the total number of ALD subunits.

parameters.name: Hardware Version(from ALD)
parameters.description: Indicates the version information about the ALD hardware.

parameters.name: Software Version(from ALD)
parameters.description: Indicates the version information about the ALD software.

parameters.name: Device Model(from ALD)
parameters.description: Indicates the device model of the ALD.

parameters.name: Device Type(from ALD)
parameters.description: Indicates the device type of the ALD, which can be SINGLE_RET, STMA, SASU, MULTI_RET, RAE, RVD or RAS.

parameters.name: Control Port No.(from ALD)
parameters.description: Indicates the port number of the RRU or RFU that controls the ALD. It will be NULL if the RRU or RFU is not able to report this parameter.

parameters.name: Device No.
parameters.description: Indicates the device number of the RVD.

parameters.name: Subunit No.
parameters.description: Indicates the number of the RVD subunit, which starts from 1.

parameters.name: Antenna Model Number
parameters.description: Indicates the model of the RVD module.

parameters.name: Antenna Serial No.
parameters.description: Indicates the serial number of the RVD module.

parameters.name: Band1
parameters.description: Indicates band 1 supported by the antenna.

parameters.name: Beamwidth1
parameters.description: Indicates the beamwidth of band 1. This parameter is valid only if band 1 is in use. Beamwidth is used to describe the capability of the antenna to transmit RF signals. It is also used to measure the antenna pattern.

parameters.name: Gain1
parameters.description: Indicates the gain of band 1. This parameter is valid only if band 1 is in use.

parameters.name: Band2
parameters.description: Indicates band 2 supported by the antenna.

parameters.name: Beamwidth2
parameters.description: Indicates the beamwidth of band 2. This parameter is valid only if band 2 is in use. Beamwidth is used to describe the capability of the antenna to transmit RF signals. It is also used to measure the antenna pattern.

parameters.name: Gain2
parameters.description: Indicates the gain of band 2. This parameter is valid only if band 2 is in use.

parameters.name: Band3
parameters.description: Indicates band 3 supported by the antenna.

parameters.name: Beamwidth3
parameters.description: Indicates the beamwidth of band 3. This parameter is valid only if band 3 is in use. Beamwidth is used to describe the capability of the antenna to transmit RF signals. It is also used to measure the antenna pattern.

parameters.name: Gain3
parameters.description: Indicates the gain of band 3. This parameter is valid only if band 3 is in use.

parameters.name: Band4
parameters.description: Indicates band 4 supported by the antenna.

parameters.name: Beamwidth4
parameters.description: Indicates the beamwidth of band 4. This parameter is valid only if band 4 is in use. Beamwidth is used to describe the capability of the antenna to transmit RF signals. It is also used to measure the antenna pattern.

parameters.name: Gain4
parameters.description: Indicates the gain of band 4. This parameter is valid only if band 4 is in use.

parameters.name: Installation Date
parameters.description: Indicates the date when the antenna is installed.

parameters.name: Installer's ID
parameters.description: Indicates the ID of the installation technician who installed the antenna.

parameters.name: Base Station ID
parameters.description: Indicates the base station ID. AISG1.1-based RVD antennas support a maximum length of 12 characters for the base station ID. If the input base station ID has more than 12 characters, only the first 12 characters are saved on the RVD antenna.

parameters.name: AISG Sector ID
parameters.description: Indicates the AISG sector ID. An AISG1.1-based RVD unit supports the longest sector ID of 4 characters. If the input sector ID has more than 4 characters, only the first 4 characters are saved on the RVD.

parameters.name: Antenna Bearing
parameters.description: Indicates the antenna azimuth. If this parameter is set to 4294967295, the parameter value is not delivered to the device. In this case, the parameter value in the LST RVDDEVICEDATA command output is NULL.

parameters.name: Installed Mechanical Tilt
parameters.description: Indicates the mechanical tilt of the installation. If this parameter is set to 2147483647, the parameter value is not delivered to the device. In this case, the parameter value in the LST RVDDEVICEDATA command output is NULL.

parameters.name: Max Tilt
parameters.description: Indicates the maximum tilt supported by the RVD subunit.

parameters.name: Min Tilt
parameters.description: Indicates the minimum tilt supported by the RVD subunit.

parameters.name: Device No.
parameters.description: Indicates the device number of the RVD.

parameters.name: Subunit No.
parameters.description: Indicates the number of the RVD subunit, which starts from 1.

parameters.name: Connect Port 1 Cabinet No.
parameters.description: Indicates the cabinet number of the RRU or RFU that is connected to antenna port 1.

parameters.name: Connect Port 1 Subrack No.
parameters.description: Indicates the subrack number of the RRU or RFU that is connected to antenna port 1.

parameters.name: Connect Port 1 Slot No.

parameters.name: Connect Port 1 Port No.
parameters.description: Indicates the port number of the RRU or RFU that is connected to antenna port 1.

parameters.name: Connect Port 2 Cabinet No.
parameters.description: Indicates the cabinet number of the RRU or RFU that is connected to antenna port 2. This parameter is valid when a dual-polarized antenna is used.

parameters.name: Connect Port 2 Subrack No.
parameters.description: Indicates the subrack number of the RRU or RFU that is connected to antenna port 2. This parameter is valid when a dual-polarized antenna is used.

parameters.name: Connect Port 2 Slot No.
parameters.description: Indicates the slot number of the RRU or RFU that is connected to antenna port 2. This parameter is valid when a dual-polarized antenna is used.

parameters.name: Connect Port 2 Port No.
parameters.description: Indicates the port number of RRU or RFU that is connected to antenna port 2. This parameter is valid when a dual-polarized antenna is used.

parameters.name: Vertical BeamWidth
parameters.description: Indicates the vertical beamwidth of RVD subunit.

parameters.name: Software-defined Antenna Mode
parameters.description: Indicates the working mode of the programmable antenna.

parameters.name: Subunit Name
parameters.description: Indicates the name of the RVD subunit. The name of the RVD subunit is optional, but the name configured for each RVD subunit must be unique.

parameters.name: Online Status
parameters.description: Indicates the online status of the subunit.

parameters.name: Actual Sector ID
parameters.description: Indicates the sector ID of the RVD subunit.

parameters.name: Actual Vertical BeamWidth
parameters.description: Indicates the actual vertical beamwidth of RVD subunit.

parameters.name: Available Range of Vertical Beamwidth
parameters.description: Indicates the vertical beamwidth range supported by the RVD subunit.

parameters.name: Actual Software-defined Antenna Mode
parameters.description: Indicates the operating mode actual value of the programmable antenna.

parameters.name: Supported SDA Mode
parameters.description: The working mode supported by the programmable antenna.

parameters.name: RVD Configuration Data File Name
parameters.description: Indicates the name of the RVD configuration data file that is loaded last time.

parameters.name: Configuration Data File Load Time
parameters.description: Indicates the time when the RVD configuration data file is loaded last time.

parameters.name: Cabinet No.
parameters.description: Indicates the cabinet number of the RRU or RFU where the RX channel is located.

parameters.name: Subrack No.
parameters.description: Indicates the subrack number of the RRU or RFU where the RX channel is located.

parameters.name: Slot No.
parameters.description: Indicates the slot number of the RRU or RFU where the RX channel is located.

parameters.name: RX Channel No.
parameters.description: Indicates the number of the RX channel of the RRU or RFU.

parameters.name: Logical Switch of RX Channel
parameters.description: Indicates the logical switch of the RX channel of the RRU or RFU, which can be set to ON or OFF. ON indicates that the logical switch of the RX channel is set to on and OFF indicates that the logical switch of the RX channel is set to off. This parameter is set to ON by default. The switch can be set by running the MOD RXBRANCH command.

parameters.name: Attenuation
parameters.description: Indicates the attenuation of the RX channel of the RRU or RFU.

parameters.name: RTWP Initial0
parameters.description: Indicates the initial correction value of the Received Total Wideband Power (RTWP) for carrier 0. The big offset between the RTWP in empty load and the theoretical background noise can be adjusted through the setting of initial correction value of the RTWP.

parameters.name: RTWP Initial1
parameters.description: Indicates the initial correction value of the RTWP for carrier 1.

parameters.name: RTWP Initial2
parameters.description: Indicates the initial correction value of the RTWP for carrier 2.

parameters.name: RTWP Initial3
parameters.description: Indicates the initial correction value of the RTWP for carrier 3.

parameters.name: RTWP Initial4
parameters.description: Indicates the initial correction value of the RTWP for carrier 4.

parameters.name: RTWP Initial5
parameters.description: Indicates the initial correction value of the RTWP for carrier 5.

parameters.name: RTWP Initial6
parameters.description: Indicates the initial correction value of the RTWP for carrier 6.

parameters.name: RTWP Initial7
parameters.description: Indicates the initial correction value of the RTWP for carrier 7.

parameters.name: Physical Switch of RX Channel
parameters.description: Indicates the actual physical status of the RX channel of the RRU or RFU, the switch of which is set to ON by default. When the logical switch of the RX channel is OFF, the physical switch of the RX channel must be OFF. When the logical switch of the RX channel is ON and the RRU is running properly, the physical switch of the RX channel of the RRU can be ON.

parameters.name: Band 1 UL Minimum Frequency
parameters.description: Indicates the minimum uplink frequency supported by the RRU or RFU band 1. For example, if this parameter is set to 9250, the minimum uplink frequency of the RRU is 9250 x 0.1 MHz, which equals to 925 MHz.

parameters.name: Band 1 UL Maximum Frequency
parameters.description: Indicates the maximum uplink frequency supported by the RRU or RFU band 1. For example, if this parameter is set to 9450, the maximum uplink frequency of the RRU is 9450 x 0.1 MHz, which equals to 945 MHz.

parameters.name: Band 1 UL Bandwidth
parameters.description: Indicates the bandwidth supported by each RX channel band 1 in the uplink. This bandwidth is an instantaneous bandwidth.

parameters.name: Band 2 UL Minimum Frequency
parameters.description: Indicates the minimum uplink frequency supported by the RRU or RFU band 2.This parameter is NULL,when the RRU does not support multiple bands. For example, if this parameter is set to 9250, the minimum uplink frequency of the RRU is 9250 x 0.1 MHz, which equals to 925 MHz.

parameters.name: Band 2 UL Bandwidth

parameters.name: Band 3 UL Minimum Frequency
parameters.description: Indicates the minimum uplink frequency supported by the RRU or RFU band 3.This parameter is NULL,when the RRU does not support multiple bands. For example, if this parameter is set to 9250, the minimum uplink frequency of the RRU is 9250 x 0.1 MHz, which equals to 925 MHz.

parameters.name: Band 3 UL Maximum Frequency
parameters.description: Indicates the maximum uplink frequency supported by the RRU or RFU band 3.This parameter is NULL,when the RRU does not support multiple bands. For example, if this parameter is set to 9850, the maximum uplink frequency of the RRU is 9850 x 0.1 MHz, which equals to 985 MHz.

parameters.name: Band 3 UL Bandwidth
parameters.description: Indicates the bandwidth supported by each RX channel band 3 in the uplink. This bandwidth is an instantaneous bandwidth. This parameter is NULL when the RRU does not support multiple bands.

parameters.name: Band 4 UL Minimum Frequency
parameters.description: Indicates the minimum uplink frequency supported by the RRU or RFU band 4.This parameter is NULL,when the RRU does not support multiple bands. For example, if this parameter is set to 9250, the minimum uplink frequency of the RRU is 9250 x 0.1 MHz, which equals to 925 MHz.

parameters.name: Band 4 UL Maximum Frequency
parameters.description: Indicates the maximum uplink frequency supported by the RRU or RFU band 4.This parameter is NULL,when the RRU does not support multiple bands. For example, if this parameter is set to 9850, the maximum uplink frequency of the RRU is 9850 x 0.1 MHz, which equals to 985 MHz.

parameters.name: Band 4 UL Bandwidth
parameters.description: Indicates the bandwidth supported by each RX channel band 4 in the uplink. This bandwidth is an instantaneous bandwidth. This parameter is NULL when the RRU does not support multiple bands.

parameters.name: Band 5 UL Minimum Frequency
parameters.description: Indicates the minimum uplink frequency supported by the RRU or RFU band 5.This parameter is NULL,when the RRU does not support multiple bands. For example, if this parameter is set to 9250, the minimum uplink frequency of the RRU is 9250 x 0.1 MHz, which equals to 925 MHz.

parameters.name: Band 5 UL Maximum Frequency
parameters.description: Indicates the maximum uplink frequency supported by the RRU or RFU band 5.This parameter is NULL,when the RRU does not support multiple bands. For example, if this parameter is set to 9850, the maximum uplink frequency of the RRU is 9850 x 0.1 MHz, which equals to 985 MHz.

parameters.name: Band 5 UL Bandwidth
parameters.description: Indicates the bandwidth supported by each RX channel band 5 in the uplink. This bandwidth is an instantaneous bandwidth. This parameter is NULL when the RRU does not support multiple bands.

parameters.name: Band 1 Carrier Number
parameters.description: Indicates the number of carriers operating on band 1.

parameters.name: Band 2 Carrier Number
parameters.description: Indicates the number of carriers operating on band 2.

parameters.description: Indicates the number of carriers operating on band 3.

parameters.description: Indicates the number of carriers operating on band 4.

parameters.name: Band 5 Carrier Number

parameters.name: Band 6 Carrier Number

parameters.name: Band 6 UL Bandwidth
parameters.description: Indicates the bandwidth supported by each RX channel band 6 in the uplink. This bandwidth is an instantaneous bandwidth. This parameter is NULL when the RRU does not support multiple bands.

parameters.name: Band 6 UL Maximum Frequency
parameters.description: Indicates the maximum uplink frequency supported by the RRU or RFU band 6.This parameter is NULL,when the RRU does not support multiple bands. For example, if this parameter is set to 9850, the maximum uplink frequency of the RRU is 9850 x 0.1 MHz, which equals to 985 MHz.

parameters.name: Band 6 UL Minimum Frequency
parameters.description: Indicates the minimum uplink frequency supported by the RRU or RFU band 6.This parameter is NULL,when the RRU does not support multiple bands. For example, if this parameter is set to 9250, the minimum uplink frequency of the RRU is 9250 x 0.1 MHz, which equals to 925 MHz.

parameters.name: Link No.
parameters.description: Indicates the number of the SAAL link.

parameters.name: Cabinet No.
parameters.description: Indicates the cabinet number of the SAAL link.

parameters.name: Subrack No.
parameters.description: Indicates the subrack number of the SAAL link.

parameters.name: Slot No.
parameters.description: Indicates the slot number of the SAAL link.

parameters.name: Bearer Port Type
parameters.description: Indicates the port type of the SAAL link.

parameters.name: Bearer Port No.
parameters.description: Indicates the number of the port that carries the SAAL link.

parameters.name: Join Transmission Resource Group
parameters.description: Indicates whether the SAAL link joins a transmission resource group.

parameters.name: Transmission Resource Group ID
parameters.description: Indicates the number of the transmission resource group to which the SAAL link is added.

parameters.name: VPI
parameters.description: Indicates the Virtual Path Identifier (VPI), which is used for VP routing. A virtual path contains multiple virtual channels.

parameters.name: VCI
parameters.description: Indicates the Virtual Channel Identifier (VCI), which is used for VC routing.

parameters.name: Bearer Service Type
parameters.description: Indicates the type of the service carried by the SAAL link. In flow control, services are classified into five categories: the Constant Bit Rate (CBR) service, Real-Time Variable Bit Rate (RTVBR) service, Non-Real-Time Variable Bit Rate (NRTVBR) service, Unspecified Bit Rate Plus (UBR+) service, and Unspecified Bit Rate (UBR) service. If this parameter is set to CBR, the bandwidth is calculated ba

parameters.name: Peak Cell Rate
parameters.description: Indicates the Peak Cell Rate (PCR) of the SAAL link. The PCR is an ATM service-related parameter defined by the ATM forum for ATM communication management. In CBR transmission, the PCR value determines the frequency at which sampled data is transmitted. In ABR transmission, the PCR value determines the maximum value of Allowed Cell Rate (ACR).

parameters.name: Min Cell Rate
parameters.description: Indicates the Minimum Cell Rate (MCR) of the SAAL link. The MCR is the minimum cell transmission rate acceptable by the user.

parameters.name: Sustain Cell Rate
parameters.description: Indicates the Sustainable Cell Rate (SCR) of the SAAL link. The SCR value determines the average rate at which cells are transmitted over a Variable Bit Rate (VBR) connection.

parameters.name: Timer_CC
parameters.description: Indicates the length of the SSCOP timer Timer_Cc. This timer specifies the time interval between transmissions of an SAAL PDU during link establishment or connection release. An SAAL PDU is retransmitted if no ACK to the PDU is received.

parameters.name: Timer_Poll
parameters.description: Indicates the length of the SSCOP timer Timer_Poll. If this timer expires, the SAAL protocol stack must send a POLL PDU to the peer end. The POLL PDU is used to query the status information about the peer end through an SSCOP connection.

parameters.name: Timer_Idle
parameters.description: Indicates the duration of the SSCOP timer Timer_Idle based on the SAAL protocol. This timer is used to guarantee the duration during which the SAAL protocol is in IDLE mode.

parameters.name: Timer_No_Response
parameters.description: Indicates the length of the SSCOP timer Timer_No_Response. This timer specifies the maximum time interval for receiving STAT PDUs.

parameters.name: Timer_Keep_Alive
parameters.description: Indicates the length of the SSCOP timer Timer_Keep_Alive. This timer is used to guarantee the inactivity duration for the SAAL link.

parameters.name: Max Connection Control Count
parameters.description: Indicates the maximum number of SAAL PDUs that are sent during SAAL link establishment or release.

parameters.name: Max Poll Data Count
parameters.description: Indicates the maximum number of data transmissions during a polling period of the SAAL protocol.

parameters.name: Max STAT Count
parameters.description: Indicates the maximum number of elements in an STAT PDU. This parameter must be set to an odd number within the range of 3 to 65535. STAT PDUs are used to respond to POLL PDUs.

parameters.name: Subboard Type
parameters.description: Indicates the type of subboard where an SAAL link is established.

parameters.name: Rate Unit
parameters.description: Indicates the unit of the Peak Cell Rate (PCR), Minimum Cell Rate (MCR), and Sustainable Cell Rate (SCR). Rate units are converted according to the following principle: 1 cell/s is equal to 0.424 kbit/s. If the rate is converted from cell/s to kbit/s, the result value must be rounded down to the nearest integer. For example, 73 cell/s is converted into 30 kbit/s.

parameters.name: SAAl Link State
parameters.description: Indicates the status of the SAAL link. The status is either normal or abnormal. If the status is normal, this link can receive and transmit upper-layer user data properly. If the status is abnormal, this link cannot receive or transmit upper-layer user data.

parameters.name: DC Switch
parameters.description: Indicates the status of the DC power supply switch for the antenna port. The value range of this parameter is BS (GSM antenna power supply), UMTS (UMTS antenna power supply), OFF (Off), or DEVICE_DEFAULT_VALUE (Device default value). If this parameter is set to DEVICE_DEFAULT_VALUE, it is invalid and the actual DC Load switch is not changed. When the SASU is connected to a TMA, this parameter must

parameters.name: Device No.(from ALD)
parameters.description: Indicates the device number of the ALD. The device number of the ALD must be unique.

parameters.name: Device Name(from ALD)
parameters.description: Indicates the device name of the ALD, which identifies the ALD. It is recommended that you set the device name in the following format: sector_device type_network type. The meanings of the parts are as follows: Sector indicates the number of the sector. Device type indicates the type of currently connected device. The device type can be SINGLE_RET (Single-antenna Remote Electrical Tilt Unit), MULT

parameters.name: Control Port Cabinet No.(from ALD)
parameters.description: Indicates the cabinet number of the RRU or RFU that controls the ALD.

parameters.name: Control Port Subrack No.(from ALD)
parameters.description: Indicates the subrack number of the RRU or RFU that controls the ALD.

parameters.name: Control Port Slot No.(from ALD)
parameters.description: Indicates the slot number of the RRU or RFU that controls the ALD.

parameters.name: Vendor Code(from ALD)
parameters.description: Indicates the vendor code.

parameters.name: Serial No.(from ALD)
parameters.description: Indicates the serial number of the ALD. The vendor code and the serial number uniquely identify an ALD.

parameters.name: Realtime DC Switch
parameters.description: Indicates the status of the DC power supply switch for the antenna port. The value range of this parameter is BS (GSM antenna power supply), UMTS (UMTS antenna power supply), or OFF (Off).

parameters.name: Actual Vendor Code(from ALD)
parameters.description: Indicates the vendor code of the device in the scanning result.

parameters.name: Actual Device Serial No.(from ALD)
parameters.description: Indicates the serial number of the device in the scanning result.

parameters.name: Protocol Version(from ALD)
parameters.description: Indicates the actual protocol version of the ALD. NULL means that the protocol version information fails to be obtained.

parameters.name: Actual Number of Subunits(from ALD)
parameters.description: Indicates the total number of ALD subunits.

parameters.name: Hardware Version(from ALD)
parameters.description: Indicates the version information about the ALD hardware.

parameters.name: Software Version(from ALD)
parameters.description: Indicates the version information about the ALD software.

parameters.name: Device Model(from ALD)
parameters.description: Indicates the device model of the ALD.

parameters.name: Device Type(from ALD)
parameters.description: Indicates the device type of the ALD, which can be SINGLE_RET, STMA, SASU, MULTI_RET, RAE, RVD or RAS.

parameters.name: Control Port No.(from ALD)
parameters.description: Indicates the port number of the RRU or RFU that controls the ALD. It will be NULL if the RRU or RFU is not able to report this parameter.

parameters.name: Device No.
parameters.description: Indicates the device number of the SASU.

parameters.name: Subunit No.
parameters.description: Indicates the number of the subunit, which starts from 1.

parameters.name: Connect Port Cabinet No.
parameters.description: Indicates the cabinet number of the RRU or RFU to which the SASU subunit is connected.

parameters.name: Connect Port Subrack No.
parameters.description: Indicates the subrack number of the RRU or RFU to which the SASU subunit is connected.

parameters.name: Connect Port Slot No.
parameters.description: Indicates the slot number of the RRU or RFU to which the SASU subunit is connected.

parameters.name: Connect Port No.
parameters.description: Indicates the number of the antenna port to which the SASU subunit is connected.

parameters.name: Work Mode
parameters.description: Indicates the working mode of an SASU. If this parameter is set to DEVICE_DEFAULT_VALUE, it is invalid and the actual mode is not changed.

parameters.name: GSM Gain
parameters.description: Indicates the gain on the GSM channel. Uplink signals (indicated by amplification multiples) can be amplified by the SASU, and the gain of the uplink signals is configurable. If this parameter is set to 65535, it is invalid and the actual gain is not changed.

parameters.name: UMTS Gain
parameters.description: Indicates the gain on the UMTS channel. Uplink signals can be amplified by the SASU, and the gain of the uplink signals is configurable. If this parameter is set to 65535, it is invalid and the actual gain is not changed.

parameters.name: DC Load
parameters.description: Indicates the DC-powered load of the SASU subunit. If this parameter is set to 65535, it is invalid and the actual DC load is not changed.

parameters.id: LNA Current Normal Alarm Clear Threshold
parameters.name: LNA Current Normal Alarm Clear Threshold
parameters.description: Indicates the normal alarm clear threshold for the Low Noise Amplifier (LNA) current.

parameters.id: LNA Current Normal Alarm Occur Threshold
parameters.name: LNA Current Normal Alarm Occur Threshold
parameters.description: Indicates the normal alarm occur threshold for the Low Noise Amplifier (LNA) current.

parameters.id: LNA Current Serious Alarm Clear Threshold
parameters.name: LNA Current Serious Alarm Clear Threshold
parameters.description: Indicates the serious alarm clear threshold for the Low Noise Amplifier (LNA) current.

parameters.id: LNA Current Serious Alarm Occur Threshold
parameters.name: LNA Current Serious Alarm Occur Threshold
parameters.description: Indicates the serious alarm occur threshold for the Low Noise Amplifier (LNA) current.

parameters.name: LNA DC Current
parameters.description: Indicates the DC current of the Low Noise Amplifier (LNA).

parameters.name: GSM Realtime Gain
parameters.description: Indicates the gain on the BS channel.

parameters.name: Realtime Work Mode
parameters.description: Indicates the actual working mode of an SASU, Value range: NORMAL(NORMAL), BYPASS(BYPASS).

parameters.name: Actual Sector ID
parameters.description: Indicates the sector ID of an SASU subunit.

parameters.name: UMTS Realtime Gain
parameters.description: Indicates the actual gain on the UMTS channel.

parameters.name: VSWR Current Alarm Clear Threshold
parameters.description: Indicates the Voltage Standing Wave Ratio (VSWR) alarm clear threshold.

parameters.name: VSWR Current Alarm Occur Threshold
parameters.description: Indicates the Voltage Standing Wave Ratio (VSWR) alarm occur threshold.

parameters.name: Online Status
parameters.description: Indicates the status of the SASU subunit.

parameters.name: Realtime DC Load
parameters.description: Indicates the real-time DC load for the SASU.

parameters.name: Link No.
parameters.description: Indicates the number of the SCTP link. The value of SCTPNO in the SCTPLNK MOs configured by users ranges from 0 to 65535. The value of SCTPNO in the SCTPLNK MOs configured by the system ranges from 70000 to 79999.

parameters.name: Cabinet No.
parameters.description: Indicates the cabinet number of the SCTP link.

parameters.name: Subrack No.
parameters.description: Indicates the subrack number of the SCTP link.

parameters.name: Slot No.
parameters.description: Indicates the slot number of the SCTP link.

parameters.name: Maximum Stream No.
parameters.description: Indicates the maximum stream number of the SCTP link.

parameters.name: Control Mode
parameters.description: Indicates whether an object can be modified or deleted by the system. The value MANUAL_MODE means that only the user can modify or delete the object. The value AUTO_MODE means only the system can modify or delete the object. The NR does not support MANUAL_MODE.

parameters.name: First Local IP Address
parameters.description: Indicates the first local IP address of the SCTP link.

parameters.name: Second Local IP Address
parameters.description: Indicates the second local IP address of the SCTP link.

parameters.name: Local SCTP Port No.
parameters.description: Indicates the local port number of the SCTP link.

parameters.name: First Peer IP Address
parameters.description: Indicates the first peer IP address of the SCTP link.

parameters.name: Second Peer IP Address
parameters.description: Indicates the second peer IP address of the SCTP link.

parameters.name: Peer SCTP Port No.
parameters.description: Indicates the peer port number of the SCTP link.

parameters.name: RTO Min Value
parameters.description: Indicates the minimum RTO value for an SCTP link. A smaller value of this parameter indicates a shorter period required for checking link connectivity. The new RTO ranges from the minimum RTO value to the maximum RTO value.

parameters.name: RTO Max Value
parameters.description: Indicates the maximum RTO value of an SCTP link. A larger value indicates a longer period required for checking link connectivity.

parameters.name: RTO Initial Value
parameters.description: Indicates the initial RTO value of an SCTP link. A larger value indicates a longer period required for checking link connectivity.

parameters.name: RTO Alpha Value
parameters.description: Indicates the RTO alpha value of an SCTP link. A larger value indicates less sensitivity to the link delay.

parameters.name: RTO Beta Value
parameters.description: Indicates the RTO beta value of an SCTP link. A larger value indicates more sensitivity to the link delay.

parameters.name: Heart-beat Interval
parameters.description: Indicates the heartbeat interval for an SCTP link. The heartbeat check is independently initiated by each end of an association and then confirmed by the peer end through the HB ACK packet. When no services are carried, a link disconnection is determined if the number of heartbeat check attempts reaches the maximum retransmission attempts on an association but the HB ACK packet is not received fro

parameters.name: Max Association Retransmission
parameters.description: Indicates the maximum number of retransmissions for the SCTP association. When the number of retransmissions for the association exceeds the value of this parameter, the SCTP link is disconnected and a link failure alarm is reported.

parameters.name: Max Path Retransmission
parameters.description: Indicates the maximum number of retransmissions over a path. When the number of retransmissions over a path exceeds the value of this parameter, the path is regarded as failed if no heartbeat acknowledgment is received. If multiple paths are used, path switching is automatically performed.

parameters.name: Checksum Algorithm Type
parameters.description: Indicates the type of checksum algorithm. The checksum algorithms at both ends of an SCTP link must be the same.

parameters.name: Switch Back Flag
parameters.description: Indicates whether the SCTP link switches back to the primary path when it is restored and reachable. If the primary path is not reachable, the SCTP link switches to the secondary path. When this parameter is set to ENABLE, the SCTP link switches to the primary path if the primary path is restored and reachable. When this parameter is set to DISABLE and the primary path is restored and reachable, t

parameters.name: Heart-beat Times When Switch Back
parameters.description: Indicates the number of heartbeats to be detected before the transmission switches back to the primary path. After the primary path is restored, the transmission switches back to the primary path when the number of heartbeats detected reaches this value.

parameters.name: Block Flag
parameters.description: Indicates whether the SCTP link is blocked or not.

parameters.name: SACK Timeout
parameters.description: Indicates the time interval that one end of an SCTP link has to wait before it can send an SACK message in response to the reception of data. A larger value of this parameter indicates a longer time interval between the reception of data and the sending of the corresponding SACK message.

parameters.name: Description Info
parameters.description: Indicates the peer description information of the SCTP link.

parameters.name: Auto Config Flag
parameters.description: Indicates whether the object is created by the system. MANUAL_CREATED means that the object is configured by the user manually. AUTO_CREATED means that the object is created by the system. The NR does not support MANUAL_CREATED.

parameters.name: VRF Index
parameters.description: Indicates the index of a VRF instance. UMTS currently supports the default routing domain only (the VRF index is 0).

parameters.name: IP Version
parameters.description: Indicates the IP protocol version.

parameters.name: First Local IPv6 Address
parameters.description: Indicates the first local IPv6 address of an IPv6 SCTP link.

parameters.name: Second Local IPv6 Address
parameters.description: Indicates the second local IPv6 address of an IPv6 SCTP link.

parameters.name: First Peer IPv6 Address
parameters.description: Indicates the first peer IPv6 address of an IPv6 SCTP link.

parameters.name: Second Peer IPv6 Address
parameters.description: Indicates the second peer IPv6 address of an IPv6 SCTP link.

parameters.name: Maximum SCTP PDU Size
parameters.description: Indicates the maximum size of an IPv4 SCTP PDU (Protocol Data Unit). It specifies the maximum length of an SCTP PDU (excluding the IP header) transmitted on an SCTP link. If the value of this parameter is greater than the size of the IP layer MTU of the base station or intermediate transmission equipment, SCTP packets are fragmented at the IP layer. This causes a large number of fragments and affe

parameters.name: DTLS Policy ID
parameters.description: Indicates the sequence number of a DTLS configuration policy. The parameter takes effect only in NR.

parameters.name: DTLS Connection Policy
parameters.description: Indicates the DTLS connection policy. DTLS_ONLY indicates that the local end uses only DTLS connections. If the peer end does not support or is not configured with DTLS, the negotiation fails. DTLS_PRIORITY indicates that the local end attempts to establish a DTLS connection for the first time. If the peer end does not support or is not configured with DTLS, the local end uses the SCTP connection.

parameters.name: SCTP Authentication Chunk List
parameters.description: Indicates the list of SCTP chunk types for which the local end requires the peer end to support authentication. The IDs of SCTP chunks that can be authenticated by the base station are 0, and 3 to 9. For details, see RFC4895 and RFC4960. Currently, SCTP block authentication is supported only in DTLS over SCTP scenarios. This parameter applies only to NR.

parameters.name: SCTP Link Status
parameters.description: Indicates the status of the SCTP link.

parameters.name: Status Change Cause
parameters.description: Indicates the reason why the operational state of the SCTP or DTLS link changes from available to unavailable or from unavailable to available for the last time.

parameters.name: Status Change Time
parameters.description: Indicates the last time when the operational state of the SCTP or DTLS link changes from available to unavailable or from unavailable to available.

parameters.name: Out Stream Number
parameters.description: Indicates the number of outbound streams negotiated for the SCTP link.

parameters.name: In Stream Number
parameters.description: Indicates the number of inbound streams negotiated for the SCTP link.

parameters.name: Work Address Flag
parameters.description: Indicates the working address flag of the SCTP link.

parameters.name: Deployment Cabinet No.
parameters.description: Indicates the deployment cabinet number of an SCTP link.

parameters.name: Deployment Subrack No.
parameters.description: Indicates the deployment subrack number of an SCTP link.

parameters.name: Deployment Slot No.
parameters.description: Indicates the deployment slot number of an SCTP link.

parameters.name: Exchange Mode
parameters.description: Indicates the IKE V1 exchange mode. There are two exchange modes: main mode and aggressive mode. In main mode, keys are exchanged separately from identity information, which protects identity information and hence enhances security. In aggressive mode, identity information is not protected, but requirements of specific network environments can be met.

parameters.name: Pre-shared Key
parameters.description: Indicates the preshared key. Both ends must use the same preshared key in negotiation.

parameters.name: DPD Mode
parameters.description: Indicates whether to enable the dead peer detection (DPD) function. When this parameter is set to DISABLE, the local end does not perform DPD. When this parameter is set to PERIODIC, the local end periodically sends DPD packets to perform DPD if the total time during which the local end does not receive encrypted packets reaches the value specified by the DPD Idle Time parameter.

parameters.name: DPD Idle Time
parameters.description: Indicates the dead peer detection (DPD) idle time. If the total time during which the local end does not receive encrypted packets reaches the value specified by the DPD Idle Time parameter, the local end sends the DPD packet to perform DPD. However, the exact time at which the eNodeB sends DPD messages varies depending on network environment.

parameters.name: DPD Retransmission Interval
parameters.description: Indicates the interval at which the eNodeB sends DPD frames. However, the exact interval at which the eNodeB sends DPD frames varies depending on the network environment.

parameters.name: DPD Retransmission Count
parameters.description: Indicates the maximum allowed number of DPD frame retransmissions after a dead peer detection (DPD) failure.

parameters.name: Perfect Forward Security
parameters.description: Indicates the perfect forward secrecy (PFS) value. In the second phase of an IPSec negotiation, PFS enables the system to use a key that is not derived from the first-phase key. Therefore, the two keys are independent of each other. According to PFS, each key protects a unique set of data. The elements used to generate a key cannot be reused, preventing the disclosure of a key from affecting secur

parameters.name: SA Duration Mode
parameters.description: Indicates the configuration mode of the IPSec SA life cycle. If this parameter is set to GLOBAL, the default SA life cycle is used. In this case, LTS and LTKB are set to the default values 3600 and 69120000, respectively. If this parameter is set to LOCAL, the SA life cycle is configurable.

parameters.name: Lifetime Based On Time
parameters.description: Indicates the life cycle of an IPSec SA. An IPSec SA becomes invalid when its life cycle elapses. Before an IPSec SA becomes invalid, IKE establishes a new IPSec SA based on negotiation. Before a new IPSec SA is established, the old IPSec SA is still used to ensure communication security. parameters.name: Lifetime Based On Traffic
parameters.description: Indicates the traffic volume threshold for the IPSec policy. The value 0 indicates that the function, which initiates negotiation for a new IPSec SA based on the traffic volume, is disabled. However, when BS acts as initiator in IKEv1 and this value is set to 0, if the responder insists or enforces the IPSec SA traffic lifetime to BS, BS will enable this function to avoid service breakdown.

parameters.name: Anti-Replay Window Size
parameters.description: Indicates the size of the IPSec packet anti-replay window. If the value of this parameter is set to 0, the IPSec packet anti-replay function is disabled. If the value of this parameter is set to 32, 64, 128, 256, 512, 1024, 2048 or 4096, the system checks whether the packets are duplicate in the window. A packet is discarded if it has a duplicate packet or its sequence number is smaller than any p

parameters.name: Narrow Down Switch
parameters.description: Indicates whether to reduce the ACL rule scope. When this parameter is set to ON, if the ACL rule scope of the NE differs from that of the peer end, the NE attempts to reduce the range of data flows protected by the ACL rules. In this way, the NE and the peer end can successfully negotiate an IPSec SA. This parameter is invalid when the version of the IKE peer specified by IKE Peer Name in the IPS

parameters.name: Temperature Alarm Upper Threshold
parameters.description: Indicates the upper threshold of the temperature. If the cabinet air outlet temperature is higher than the value, the ALM-25655 Cabinet Air Outlet Temperature Unacceptable is reported.

parameters.name: Special Boolean Alarm Flag
parameters.description: Indicates whether to allow the reporting of a dedicated Boolean alarm. If the shield flag for a Boolean alarm is enabled, the Boolean alarm cannot be reported.

parameters.name: Temperature Control Mode
parameters.description: Indicates the mode that the fan speed adjustment adopts. Mode 0 is the default mode, which achieves balance in system power consumption, noise, and temperature control. It applies to most scenarios. Inappropriate configuration of this parameter may lead to serious results such as high noise or service interruption on the RF modules due to overtemperature. parameters.description: Indicates the device type of the TCU.

parameters.name: Temperature In

parameters.name: Temperature Out

parameters.name: Temperature Inner

parameters.name: Inner Cycle Fan Average Speed

parameters.name: Outer Cycle Fan Average Speed

parameters.name: Power
parameters.description: This parameter indicates the actual working power of the HAU. Value NULL indicates that this parameter is not supported by the antenna or the antenna is faulty.

parameters.name: Software Version
parameters.description: Indicates the software version of the TCU.

parameters.name: PCB Version

parameters.name: EPLD Version
parameters.description: Indicates the erasable programmable logic device (EPLD) version of the TCU.

parameters.description: Indicates the compiling time of the software program in the TCU.

parameters.name: Version Description
parameters.description: Indicates the version description of the TCU.

parameters.name: Manufacturer

parameters.name: Alarm Status(from RU)
parameters.description: Indicates the alarm status of the board hardware, which can be set to Normal, Warning, Minor, Major, or Critical. The alarm status of the PSU, PDB, and BDU is in the alarm status of the PMU.

parameters.name: Operational State(from RU)
parameters.description: Indicates the operational state of the board, which can be set to Enabled or Disabled. Enabled indicates that services can be carried on the board. Disabled indicates that no service can be carried on the board.

parameters.name: Availability Status(from RU)
parameters.description: Indicates the physical status of a board, which can be Uninstalled, Starting up, Normal, Inconsistent, Unconfigured, Power off, Fault, Communication lost, In test, or the combination of multiple states. For example, if a board is not configured and fails to communicate with the main control and transmission board, the availability status of the board is "Unconfigured, Communication lost." If a boa

parameters.name: Electronic Label(from RU)
parameters.description: Indicates the electronic label, which is a text file with a maximum of 2 KB used to record the manufacturing information about equipment such as the board, sub-board, and optical module. "BoardType" indicates the type of the board. "BarCode" indicates the bar code of the board and is the same as the code labeled on the board. "Item" indicates the BOM code. "Description" indicates the board descrip

parameters.name: Type(from RU)
parameters.description: Indicates the type of the board or the cabinet.

parameters.description: Indicates the temperature of the power amplifier. A power amplifier is a component on an RF module. If there is no power amplifier on an RF module, this parameter value is NULL.

parameters.name: Hardware Version(from RU)
parameters.description: Indicates the hardware version of the board.

parameters.name: BootROM Version(from RU)

parameters.name: WorkMode(from RU)
parameters.description: Indicates the working mode of the board. the value SINGLEOM indicates that the GTMU works as the main control board and provides the main control, transmission, and RF port functions. The value EVOLUTION indicates that the GTMU works as the evolved board and provides the transmission and RF port functions. parameters.name: Time Source
parameters.description: Indicates the external reference time source of the NE.

parameters.name: Automatic Switch
parameters.description: Indicates whether to enable automatic time source switchover. When the switch is turned on, the system switches over the time source when time synchronization fails. When the switch is turned off, the system does not switch over the time source.

parameters.name: Latest Successful Synchronization Time
parameters.description: Indicates the date and time of the last successfully-synchronized time of the NE. The format is as follows: YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS.

parameters.name: Threshold Value
parameters.description: Indicates the threshold value for the difference between the NE time and the time provided by the time source.

parameters.name: Time Hopping Detection Switch
parameters.description: Indicates whether to detect time hopping on the NE.

parameters.name: POLICY ID
parameters.description: Indicates the ID of a TLS configuration policy.

parameters.name: Key Update Switch
parameters.description: Indicates whether to enable the TLS key update function. This function updates the key in current use. For details, see RFC 8446.

parameters.name: Key Update Lifetime
parameters.description: Indicates the TLS key update period.

parameters.name: Diffie-Hellman Group
parameters.description: Indicates the Diffie-Hellman group for TLS key negotiation.

parameters.name: Signature Algorithm
parameters.description: Indicates the TLS signature algorithm.

parameters.name: Cipher Suite

parameters.description: Indicates the number of configured TMA subunits.

parameters.name: TMA Type
parameters.description: Indicates the TMA type. The value NORMAL_TMA indicates a normal TMA. The value VIRTUAL_TMA indicates a device other than a TMA which amplifies signals between an RF port and an antenna port.

parameters.name: Device No.(from ALD)
parameters.description: Indicates the device number of the ALD. The device number of the ALD must be unique.

parameters.name: Device Name(from ALD)
parameters.description: Indicates the device name of the ALD, which identifies the ALD. It is recommended that you set the device name in the following format: sector_device type_network type. The meanings of the parts are as follows: Sector indicates the number of the sector. Device type indicates the type of currently connected device. The device type can be SINGLE_RET (Single-antenna Remote Electrical Tilt Unit), MULT

parameters.name: Control Port Cabinet No.(from ALD)
parameters.description: Indicates the cabinet number of the RRU or RFU that controls the ALD.

parameters.name: Control Port Subrack No.(from ALD)
parameters.description: Indicates the subrack number of the RRU or RFU that controls the ALD.

parameters.name: Control Port Slot No.(from ALD)

parameters.name: Vendor Code(from ALD)

parameters.name: Actual Device Serial No.(from ALD)

parameters.name: Actual Number of Subunits(from ALD)

parameters.name: Device Type(from ALD)
parameters.description: Indicates the device type of the ALD, which can be SINGLE_RET, STMA, SASU, MULTI_RET, RAE, RVD or RAS.

parameters.name: Control Port No.(from ALD)
parameters.description: Indicates the port number of the RRU or RFU that controls the ALD. It will be NULL if the RRU or RFU is not able to report this parameter.

parameters.name: Device No.
parameters.description: Indicates the device number of the TMA.

parameters.name: Subunit No.
parameters.description: Indicates the number of the TMA subunit, which starts from 1.

parameters.name: Antenna Bearing
parameters.description: Indicates the antenna azimuth. If this parameter is set to 4294967295, the parameter value is not delivered to the device. In this case, the parameter value in the LST TMADEVICEDATA command output is NULL.

parameters.name: Base Station ID
parameters.description: Indicates the base station ID. AISG1.1-based TMA supports a maximum base station ID length of 12 characters. If the input base station ID has more than 12 characters, only the first 12 characters are saved on the TMA.

parameters.name: Beamwidth1
parameters.description: Indicates the beamwidth of band 1. This parameter is valid only if band 1 is in use. Beamwidth is used to describe the capability of the antenna to transmit RF signals. It is also used to measure the antenna pattern.

parameters.name: Beamwidth2
parameters.description: Indicates the beamwidth of band 2. This parameter is valid only if band 2 is in use. Beamwidth is used to describe the capability of the antenna to transmit RF signals. It is also used to measure the antenna pattern.

parameters.name: Beamwidth3
parameters.description: Indicates the beamwidth of band 3. This parameter is valid only if band 3 is in use. Beamwidth is used to describe the capability of the antenna to transmit RF signals. It is also used to measure the antenna pattern.

parameters.name: Beamwidth4
parameters.description: Indicates the beamwidth of band 4. This parameter is valid only if band 4 is in use. Beamwidth is used to describe the capability of the antenna to transmit RF signals. It is also used to measure the antenna pattern.

parameters.name: Gain1
parameters.description: Indicates the gain of band 1. This parameter is valid only if band 1 is in use.

parameters.name: Gain2
parameters.description: Indicates the gain of band 2. This parameter is valid only if band 2 is in use.

parameters.name: Gain3
parameters.description: Indicates the gain of band 3. This parameter is valid only if band 3 is in use.

parameters.name: Gain4
parameters.description: Indicates the gain of band 4. This parameter is valid only if band 4 is in use.

parameters.name: Installation Date
parameters.description: Indicates the date when the antenna is installed.

parameters.name: Installed Mechanical Tilt
parameters.description: Indicates the mechanical tilt of the installation. If this parameter is set to 2147483647, the parameter value is not delivered to the device. In this case, the parameter value in the LST TMADEVICEDATA command output is NULL.

parameters.name: Installer's ID
parameters.description: Indicates the ID of the installation technician who installed the antenna.

parameters.name: Band1
parameters.description: Indicates band 1 supported by the antenna.

parameters.name: Band2
parameters.description: Indicates band 2 supported by the antenna.

parameters.name: Band3
parameters.description: Indicates band 3 supported by the antenna.

parameters.name: Band4
parameters.description: Indicates band 4 supported by the antenna.

parameters.name: AISG Sector ID
parameters.description: Indicates the AISG sector ID. An AISG1.1-based TMA unit supports the longest sector ID of 4 characters. If the input sector ID has more than 4 characters, only the first 4 characters are saved on the TMA.

parameters.name: Serial No.
parameters.description: Indicates the serial number of the ALD.

parameters.name: Connect Antenna Model Number
parameters.description: Indicates the model of the RET antenna connected to the TMA.

parameters.description: Indicates the maximum gain supported by the TMA.

parameters.name: Min Supported Gain
parameters.description: Indicates the minimum gain supported by the TMA.

parameters.name: Real Subunit Type
parameters.description: Indicates the type of TMA subunit. It indicates whether the voltage standing wave ratio (VSWR) measurement and the bypass mode are supported.

parameters.name: Real Gain Resolution
parameters.description: Indicates the step for the TMA gain change.

parameters.name: Real Received Min Frequency Band
parameters.description: Indicates the minimum RX frequency band supported by the TMA.

parameters.name: Real Transmit Max Frequency Band
parameters.description: Indicates the maximum TX frequency band supported by the TMA.

parameters.name: Real Transmit Min Frequency Band
parameters.description: Indicates the minimum TX frequency band supported by the TMA.

parameters.name: Real Received Max Frequency Band
parameters.description: Indicates the maximum RX frequency band supported by the TMA.

parameters.description: Indicates the device number of the TMA.

parameters.name: Subunit No.
parameters.description: Indicates the number of the TMA subunit, which starts from 1.

parameters.description: Indicates the number of the antenna port to which the TMA subunit is connected.

parameters.name: Connect Port Cabinet No.
parameters.description: Indicates the cabinet number of the RRU or RFU that provides the antenna port to which the TMA subunit is connected.

parameters.name: Connect Port Slot No.
parameters.description: Indicates the slot number of the RRU or RFU that provides the antenna port to which the TMA subunit is connected.

parameters.name: Connect Port Subrack No.
parameters.description: Indicates the subrack number of the RRU or RFU that provides the antenna port to which the TMA subunit is connected.

parameters.name: Gain
parameters.description: Indicates the gain of the TMA subunit. If this parameter is set to 255, it is invalid and the actual gain is not changed.

parameters.name: Work Mode
parameters.description: Indicates the working mode of the TMA subunit. The value NORMAL indicates that the TMA subunit works in normal mode and properly amplifies uplink signals. The value BYPASS indicates that the TMA subunit works in bypass mode and does not amplify uplink signals. The value DEVICE_DEFAULT_VALUE indicates that the TMA subunit works in default mode.

parameters.name: Actual Sector ID
parameters.description: Indicates the sector ID of the TMA subunit.

parameters.name: Actual Gain
parameters.description: Indicates the actual gain of the TMA subunit.

parameters.name: Actual Work Mode
parameters.description: Indicates the actual working mode of the TMA subunit.

parameters.name: Online Status
parameters.description: Indicates the online status of the TMA subunit.

parameters.name: TOD Clock No.
parameters.description: Indicates the number of a TOD clock link. When TOD clock links are configured on a USCUb board, the numbers of the TOD clock links have a one-to-one relationship with the numbers of the TOD ports on the USCUb. For example, TOD clock link 0 corresponds to port 0, and TOD clock link 1 to port 1.

parameters.name: TOD Type
parameters.description: Indicates the type of a TOD clock link. It indicates whether the corresponding TOD port is an input or output port. An input port is used to input clock signals to the NE, and an output port is used to provide clock signals for other NEs. Only the TOD clock of input type can serve as a clock source.

parameters.name: Cabinet No.
parameters.description: Indicates the number of the cabinet where the TOD clock link is configured.

parameters.name: Subrack No.
parameters.description: Indicates the number of the subrack where the TOD clock link is configured.

parameters.name: Slot No.
parameters.description: Indicates the number of the slot where the TOD clock link is configured.

parameters.name: Cable Length
parameters.description: Indicates the length of the TOD feeder. The feeder delay is calculated on the basis of the TOD feeder length to ensure the clock accuracy. The clock accuracy is affected if there is an excessively large difference [more than 20 m (66 ft)] between the value of this parameter and the actual feeder length.

parameters.name: Priority
parameters.description: Indicates the priority of the clock source. The value 1 indicates that the current clock source has the highest priority, and the value 4 indicates that the current clock source has the lowest priority.

parameters.name: Link Active State
parameters.description: Indicates the activation status of a TOD clock link. If the link is active, the TOD clock link is the current clock source of the system.

parameters.name: Link Available State
parameters.description: Indicates the availability of a TOD clock link. Only an available clock link can serve as the current clock source. Otherwise, the clock link cannot be locked even if it is activated.

parameters.name: Delay
parameters.description: Indicates the feeder delay of the TOD clock link. The value is NULL when the clock source is not activated.

parameters.name: IP PM Passive Activation Switch
parameters.description: Indicates whether to support IP PM passive activation. When this parameter is set to ENABLE, only user-plane IP addresses can respond to IP PM activation requests sent from the peer end and the peer end can activate IP PM sessions. parameters.name: IP MUX Demultiplexing Switch
parameters.description: Indicates whether to support IP MUX demultiplexing. When this parameter is set to ENABLE, only user-plane IP addresses support demultiplexing of IPMUX frames. When this parameter is set to DISABLE, none of IP addresses support demultiplexing of IPMUX frames. This parameter takes effect only for UMTS and GSM.

parameters.name: IP Loopback Detection Response Switch
parameters.description: Indicates whether to support the IP loopback detection response function. If this parameter is set to ENABLE, only the IP addresses used by the IPPATH or EPGROUP MOs subscribed to by GSM and UMTS support responding to IP loopback detection UDP packets sent by the peer end. The destination UDP port number is 65040. If this parameter is set to DISABLE, none of the IP addresses support responding to

parameters.name: Path Ping Detection Response Switch
parameters.description: Indicates whether to support the UDP path ping detection response function. If this parameter is set to ENABLE, only the IP addresses used by the IPPATH or EPGROUP MOs subscribed to by GSM and UMTS support responding to path ping detection packets sent by the peer end. The destination UDP port number is 65042. If this parameter is set to DISABLE, none of the IP addresses support responding to path

parameters.name: ICMP Port Unreachable Send Switch
parameters.description: Indicates whether to send ICMP destination unreachable response packets. Generally, if the base station fails to find the corresponding interface after receiving the TCP/UDP packets, it sends ICMP destination unreachable response packets. The response packets will expose the equipment. If a large number of ICMP response packets are sent to the network, the network equipment may be overloaded. You

parameters.name: SCTP Server Switch
parameters.description: Indicates whether the server function is supported for SCTP of any of the following service types: RSL, NCP, CCP, S1-AP, R6-AP, R8-AP, ALCAP-AP, M2-AP, Se-AP, So-AP, gNodeB NG-AP, DSA S1-AP, and M3-AP. When this switch is turned on, the SCTP server function is supported. When this switch is turned off, the SCTP server function is disabled.

parameters.name: Downlink Rate Limiting Switch
parameters.description: Indicates whether to support priority-based downlink rate limiting. If this parameter is set to ENABLE, the rate of downlink data flows is limited based on the default priority. If this parameter is set to DISABLE, the rate of downlink data flows is not limited. This parameter is valid only for the UMPTe board.

parameters.name: Downlink Transmission Algorithm Optimization Switch
parameters.description: Indicates whether to optimize the scheduling algorithm for downlink transmission services to support higher downlink throughput. This parameter is valid only for the UMPTe board.

parameters.name: IP Receive Switch
parameters.description: Indicates whether the interface receives IP packets when the IPv4 address is not configured. If this parameter is set to ENABLE, the interface can receive IPv4 packets when the IPv4 address is not configured. If this parameter is set to DISABLE, the interface cannot receive IPv4 packets when the IPv4 address is not configured. This parameter is valid only for the UMPT board.

parameters.name: Tree Link PVC No.
parameters.description: Indicates the treelink PVC number.

parameters.name: Join Transmission Resource Group
parameters.description: Indicates whether the treelink PVC joins a transmission resource group.

parameters.name: Tree Link PVC Switch Type
parameters.description: Indicates the switching type of a treelink PVC, which is classified into VC_SWITCH and VP_SWITCH.

parameters.name: Cabinet No.
parameters.description: Indicates the number of the cabinet where the board is located.

parameters.name: Source Subrack No.
parameters.description: Indicates the subrack number of the source port for the treelink PVC.

parameters.name: Source Slot No.
parameters.description: Indicates the slot number of the source port for the treelink PVC.

parameters.description: Indicates the type of the source port for the treelink PVC.

parameters.name: Source Port No.
parameters.description: Indicates the number of the source port for the treelink PVC.

parameters.name: Source Transmission Resource Group ID
parameters.description: Indicates the number of the transmission resource group to which the source port for the treelink PVC belongs.

parameters.description: Indicates the virtual path identifier (VPI) of the source port for the treelink PVC.

parameters.name: Source Port VCI
parameters.description: Indicates the virtual channel identifier (VCI) of the source port for the treelink PVC.

parameters.description: Indicates the number of the transmission resource group to which the destination port for the treelink PVC belongs.

parameters.name: Destination Port VCI
parameters.description: Indicates the virtual channel identifier (VCI) of the destination port for the treelink PVC.

parameters.name: Bearer Service Type
parameters.description: In terms of flow control, services are classified into four categories: the Real-Time Variable Bit Rate (RTVBR) service, Non-Real-Time Variable Bit Rate (NRTVBR) service, Unspecified Bit Rate Plus (UBR+) service, and Unspecified Bit Rate (UBR) service.

parameters.name: Peak Cell Rate
parameters.description: Indicates the peak rate of transmitting cells on an ATM connection, such as a VPC or VCC.

parameters.name: Sustain Cell Rate
parameters.description: Indicates the average cell rate that is measured in a certain period of time.

parameters.name: Min Cell Rate
parameters.description: Indicates the rate of transmitting cells on an ATM connection while ensuring the transmission quality.

parameters.name: Max Burst Size
parameters.description: Indicates the maximum number of cells transmitted at the PCR.

parameters.name: Cell Delay Variation Tolerance
parameters.description: Indicates the time delay for transmitting a cell burst from the source port to the destination port.

parameters.description: Indicates the subboard type of the board providing the source port for the treelink PVC.

parameters.name: Destination Subboard Type
parameters.description: Indicates the subboard type of the board providing the destination port for the treelink PVC.

parameters.name: Rate Unit
parameters.description: Indicates the rate unit of the peak cell rate (PCR), minimum cell rate (MCR), and sustainable cell rate (SCR). 1 cell/s is equal to 0.424 kbit/s. If the rate is converted from cell/s to kbit/s, the result value must be rounded down to the nearest integer. For example, 73 cell/s is converted into 30 kbit/s.

parameters.description: Indicates the description of the treelink PVC.
