parameters.name: Expiring Date
parameters.description: Indicates the expiration date of a trust certificate.

parameters.name: Status

parameters.name: Effective Date
parameters.description: Indicates the date when a trust certificate begins to take effect.

parameters.name: Tunnel Type

parameters.name: Number of RX Bytes

parameters.name: Number of RX Packets

parameters.name: Number of TX Bytes

parameters.name: Number of TX Packets
parameters.description: Indicates the actual number of packets sent through the tunnel.

parameters.name: Client Index

parameters.name: Local IP Address

parameters.name: Peer IP Address

parameters.name: VRF Index
parameters.description: Indicates the index of a VRF instance. UMTS currently supports the default routing domain only (the VRF index is 0).

parameters.name: DSCP
parameters.description: Indicates the DSCP of TCP negotiation packets sent by a TWAMP client. This parameter is valid only when the TWAMP client is deployed in the full architecture.

parameters.name: Peer TCP Port No.
parameters.description: Indicates the peer TCP port number of a TWAMP client. This parameter is valid only when the TWAMP client is deployed in the full architecture.

parameters.name: IP Version
parameters.description: Indicates the IP protocol version of a TWAMP client.

parameters.name: Local IPv6 Address
parameters.description: Indicates the local IPv6 address of a TWAMP client.

parameters.name: Peer IPv6 Address
parameters.description: Indicates the peer IPv6 address of a TWAMP client.

parameters.name: TWAMP Architecture
parameters.description: Indicates the architecture of a TWAMP client.

parameters.name: Negotiation Status
parameters.description: Indicates the negotiation status of a TWAMP client. This parameter is valid only when the TWAMP client is deployed in the full architecture.

parameters.name: Negotiation Failure Cause
parameters.description: Indicates the negotiation failure cause of a TWAMP client with a TWAMP server. This parameter is valid only when the TWAMP client is deployed in the full architecture.

parameters.name: Negotiated Working Mode
parameters.description: Indicates the negotiation mode of a TWAMP client. TWAMP supports three negotiation modes: non-authentication, authentication, and encryption. Currently, only the non-authentication mode is supported. This parameter is valid only when the TWAMP client is deployed in the full architecture.

parameters.name: Local TCP Port No.
parameters.description: Indicates the local TCP port number of a TWAMP client. This parameter is valid only when the TWAMP client is deployed in the full architecture.

parameters.name: Responder Index
parameters.description: Indicates the index of a TWAMP responder.

parameters.name: TWAMP Architecture
parameters.description: Indicates the architecture of a TWAMP responder.

parameters.name: IP Version
parameters.description: Indicates the IP version of a TWAMP responder.

parameters.name: Local IP Address
parameters.description: Indicates the local IPv4 address of a TWAMP responder.

parameters.name: VRF Index
parameters.description: Indicates the index of a VRF instance. UMTS currently supports the default routing domain only (the VRF index is 0).

parameters.name: DSCP for TCP Packets
parameters.description: Indicates the DSCP of TCP negotiation packets sent by a TWAMP responder. This parameter takes effect only when TWAMPARCH for TWAMP responders is set to FULL.

parameters.name: Measurement Wait Time
parameters.description: Indicates the measurement wait time of a TWAMP responder. The REFWAIT timer is started to monitor the status of a measurement session between the server and client. When this timer expires, the server releases the measurement session and returns to the link establishment state.

parameters.name: Negotiation Wait Time
parameters.description: Indicates the negotiation wait time of a TWAMP responder. The SERVWAIT timer is started to monitor the establishment status of a control connection between the server and client. When this timer expires, the server releases the control connection.

parameters.name: Local IPv6 Address
parameters.description: Indicates the local IPv6 address of a TWAMP responder.

parameters.name: Local TCP Port No.
parameters.description: Indicates the local TCP port number of a TWAMP responder. This parameter takes effect only when TWAMPARCH for TWAMP responders is set to FULL.

parameters.id: Light Architecture Local UDP Port No.
parameters.name: Light Architecture Local UDP Port No.
parameters.description: Indicates the local UDP port number used when TWAMP responders work in light-architecture mode. This parameter takes effect only when TWAMPARCH for TWAMP responders is set to LIGHT. This parameter is invalid when the parameter is set to 4294967295.

parameters.name: Light Architecture Mode
parameters.description: Indicates the working mode of a TWAMP responder deployed in the light architecture. The working mode of the TWAMP responder must be the same as that of the TWAMP sender. This parameter takes effect only when the TWAMP responder is deployed in the light architecture.

parameters.name: Negotiation Status
parameters.description: Indicates the negotiation status of a TWAMP responder. This parameter takes effect only when TWAMPARCH for TWAMP responders is set to FULL.

parameters.name: Peer IP Address
parameters.description: Indicates the peer IPv4 address of a TWAMP responder.

parameters.name: Peer IPv6 Address
parameters.description: Indicates the peer IPv6 address of a TWAMP responder.

parameters.name: Negotiated Working Mode
parameters.description: Indicates the negotiated working mode of a TWAMP responder. This parameter takes effect only when TWAMPARCH for TWAMP responders is set to FULL.

parameters.name: Local UDP Port No.
parameters.description: Indicates the local UDP port number of a TWAMP responder.

parameters.name: Session Start Time
parameters.description: Indicates the start time of a session for a TWAMP responder.

parameters.name: Peer TCP Port No.
parameters.description: Indicates the peer TCP port number of a TWAMP responder. This parameter takes effect only when TWAMPARCH for TWAMP responders is set to FULL.

parameters.name: Initial DSCP Value
parameters.description: Indicates the DSCP value of a TWAMP responder in light-architecture mode or the initial DSCP value of a TWAMP responder in full-architecture mode.

parameters.name: Peer UDP Port No.
parameters.description: Indicates the peer UDP port number of a TWAMP responder.

parameters.name: Changed DSCP Value
parameters.description: Indicates the changed DSCP value of a TWAMP responder. This parameter takes effect only when TWAMPARCH for TWAMP responders is set to FULL. If the DSCP value has not been changed, the value of this parameter is displayed as NULL.

parameters.id: Number of TCP Rejection Packets Sent
parameters.name: Number of TCP Rejection Packets Sent
parameters.description: Indicates the number of packets sent by a TWAMP responder to reject TCP connection requests. This parameter takes effect only when TWAMPARCH for TWAMP responders is set to FULL.

parameters.id: Number of TCP Setup Request Packets Received
parameters.name: Number of TCP Setup Request Packets Received
parameters.description: Indicates the number of TCP packets received by a TWAMP responder. This parameter takes effect only when TWAMPARCH for TWAMP responders is set to FULL.

parameters.id: Number of Greeting Message Packets Sent
parameters.name: Number of Greeting Message Packets Sent
parameters.description: Indicates the number of Greeting Message packets sent by a TWAMP responder. This parameter takes effect only when TWAMPARCH for TWAMP responders is set to FULL.

parameters.name: Number of Set-up-response Packets Received
parameters.description: Indicates the number of Set-up-response packets received by a TWAMP responder. This parameter takes effect only when TWAMPARCH for TWAMP responders is set to FULL.

parameters.id: Number of Set-up-response Rejection Packets Sent
parameters.name: Number of Set-up-response Rejection Packets Sent
parameters.description: Indicates the number of packets sent by a TWAMP responder to reject Set-up-response packets. This parameter takes effect only when TWAMPARCH for TWAMP responders is set to FULL.

parameters.name: Number of Server-start Packets Sent
parameters.description: Indicates the number of Server-start packets sent by a TWAMP responder. This parameter takes effect only when TWAMPARCH for TWAMP responders is set to FULL.

parameters.name: Number of Request-TW-Session Packets Received
parameters.description: Indicates the number of Request-TW-Session packets received by a TWAMP responder. This parameter takes effect only when TWAMPARCH for TWAMP responders is set to FULL.

parameters.id: Number of Request-TW-Session Rejection Packets Sent
parameters.name: Number of Request-TW-Session Rejection Packets Sent
parameters.description: Indicates the number of packets sent by a TWAMP responder to reject Request-TW-Session packets. This parameter takes effect only when TWAMPARCH for TWAMP responders is set to FULL.

parameters.name: Number of Accept-Session Packets Sent
parameters.description: Indicates the number of Accept-Session packets sent by a TWAMP responder. This parameter takes effect only when TWAMPARCH for TWAMP responders is set to FULL.

parameters.name: Number of Start-Session Packets Received
parameters.description: Indicates the number of Start-Session packets received by a TWAMP responder. This parameter takes effect only when TWAMPARCH for TWAMP responders is set to FULL.

parameters.name: Number of Stop-Session Packets Received
parameters.description: Indicates the number of Stop-Session packets received by a TWAMP responder. This parameter takes effect only when TWAMPARCH for TWAMP responders is set to FULL.

parameters.id: Number of Start-Session Rejection Packets Sent
parameters.name: Number of Start-Session Rejection Packets Sent
parameters.description: Indicates the number of packets sent by a TWAMP responder to reject Start-Session packets. This parameter takes effect only when TWAMPARCH for TWAMP responders is set to FULL.

parameters.id: Number of Start-session Ack Packets Sent
parameters.name: Number of Start-session Ack Packets Sent
parameters.description: Indicates the number of Start-session Ack packets sent by a TWAMP responder. This parameter takes effect only when TWAMPARCH for TWAMP responders is set to FULL.

parameters.name: Number of Received Measurement Packets
parameters.description: Indicates the number of UDP packets received by a TWAMP responder from measurement session.

parameters.name: Number of Sent Measurement Packets
parameters.description: Indicates the number of UDP packets sent by a TWAMP responder to measurement session.

parameters.name: Client Index
parameters.description: Indicates the client index of a TWAMP sender.

parameters.name: Sender Index
parameters.description: Indicates the index of a TWAMP sender.

parameters.name: DSCP
parameters.description: Indicates the DSCP of UDP measurement packets sent by a TWAMP sender.

parameters.name: Packet Size Type
parameters.description: Indicates the type of the packet size sent by a TWAMP sender. If this parameter is set to RANDOM, the NE randomly selects a packet length ranging from 69 to 1500 bytes for sending measurement packets in IPv4 scenarios, and a packet length ranging from 89 to 1500 bytes to send measurement packets in IPv6 scenarios.

parameters.name: Packet Size
parameters.description: Indicates the length of a packet sent by a TWAMP sender, including the IP header. If the TWAMP sender uses the IPv6 protocol, the packet length including the IP header must be greater than 89 bytes.

parameters.name: Packet Send Interval Type
parameters.description: Indicates the type of the interval at which packets are sent by a TWAMP sender. If this parameter is set to RANDOM, the NE sends measurement packets at a random interval of 10 to 1000 ms.

parameters.name: Packet Send Interval
parameters.description: Indicates the interval at which packets are sent by a TWAMP sender.

parameters.name: TWAMP Architecture
parameters.description: Indicates the architecture of a TWAMP sender.

parameters.name: Light Architecture Mode
parameters.description: Indicates the working mode of a TWAMP sender deployed in the light architecture. The working mode of the TWAMP sender must be the same as that of the TWAMP responder. This parameter takes effect only when the TWAMP sender is deployed in the light architecture.

parameters.name: Local UDP Port No.
parameters.description: Indicates the local UDP port number of a TWAMP sender.

parameters.name: Peer UDP Port No.
parameters.description: Indicates the peer UDP port number of a TWAMP sender.

parameters.name: Negotiation Status
parameters.description: Indicates the negotiation status of a TWAMP sender. This parameter is valid only when the TWAMP sender is deployed in the full architecture.

parameters.name: Negotiation Failure Cause
parameters.description: Indicates the negotiation failure cause of a TWAMP sender. This parameter is valid only when the TWAMP sender is deployed in the full architecture.

parameters.name: Initial DSCP Value
parameters.description: Indicates the initial DSCP value of a TWAMP sender.

parameters.name: Changed DSCP Value
parameters.description: Indicates the changed DSCP value of a TWAMP sender. If the DSCP value has not been changed, the value of this parameter is displayed as NULL.

parameters.description: Indicates the number of packets received by a TWAMP sender.

parameters.id: Number of Packets Sent by the Local End
parameters.name: Number of Packets Sent by the Local End
parameters.description: Indicates the number of packets sent by a TWAMP sender.

parameters.id: Number of Packets Received by the Peer End
parameters.name: Number of Packets Received by the Peer End
parameters.description: Indicates the number of packets received by the peer of a TWAMP sender. This parameter is valid only when the TWAMP sender is deployed in the full architecture, or stateful mode in the light architecture.

parameters.id: Number of Packets Sent by the Peer End
parameters.name: Number of Packets Sent by the Peer End
parameters.description: Indicates the number of packets sent by the peer of a TWAMP sender. This parameter is valid only when the TWAMP sender is deployed in the full architecture, or stateful mode in the light architecture.

parameters.name: Average Round-Trip Delay
parameters.description: Indicates the average round trip delay on a TWAMP sender in the last sampling period. The sampling period is 5s. The value of this parameter in the current sampling period indicates the average round trip delay in the last sampling period.

parameters.name: Average Forward Jitter
parameters.description: Indicates the average forward jitter on a TWAMP sender in the last sampling period. The sampling period is 5s. The value of this parameter in the current sampling period indicates the average forward jitter in the last sampling period.

parameters.name: Average Backward Jitter
parameters.description: Indicates the average backward jitter on a TWAMP sender in the last sampling period. The sampling period is 5s. The value of this parameter in the current sampling period indicates the average backward jitter in the last sampling period.

parameters.name: Forward Average Packet Loss Rate
parameters.description: Indicates the average forward packet loss rate of a TWAMP sender in the last sampling period. The sampling period is 30 seconds. In the current sampling period, this parameter indicates the average forward packet loss rate in the previous sampling period. This parameter is valid only when the TWAMP sender is deployed in the full architecture, or stateful mode in the light architecture.

parameters.name: Backward Average Packet Loss Rate
parameters.description: Indicates the average backward packet loss rate of a TWAMP sender in the last sampling period. The sampling period is 30 seconds. In the current sampling period, this parameter indicates the average backward packet loss rate in the previous sampling period. This parameter is valid only when the TWAMP sender is deployed in the full architecture, or stateful mode in the light architecture.

parameters.name: Round-Trip Average Packet Loss Rate
parameters.description: Indicates the average round-trip packet loss rate of a TWAMP sender in the last sampling period. The sampling period is 30 seconds. In the current sampling period, this parameter indicates the average round-trip packet loss rate in the previous sampling period. This parameter is valid only when the TWAMP sender is deployed in stateless mode in the light architecture.

parameters.name: Slot No.
parameters.description: Indicates the slot number of the RRU or RFU where the TX channel is located.

parameters.name: TX Channel No.
parameters.description: Indicates the number of the TX channel of the RRU or RFU.

parameters.name: Logical Switch of TX Channel
parameters.description: Indicates the logical switch of the TX channel of the RRU or RFU. This switch is used to open or close the TX channel. The logical switch of the TX channel and the ARFCNs(absolute radio frequency channel numbers) on the TX channel determine the state of the physical switch of the TX channel: When this switch is ON and the TX channel is configured with ARFCNs(absolute radio frequency channel number

parameters.name: VSWR
parameters.description: Indicates the current VSWR of the TX channel. When the TX power is relatively low , the S/N of the reflected signal passing through the detector channel is relatively low, which leads to the inaccuracy of the VSWR calculation, the value of this field will be displayed as NULL.

parameters.name: Physical Switch of TX Channel
parameters.description: Indicates the actual physical status of the TX channel of the RRU or RFU. The logical switch of the TX channel and the ARFCN on the TX channel determine the state of the physical switch of the TX channel: If the logical switch of a TX channel is ON and the ARFCN is configured for the TX channel, the physical switch of the TX channel is ON. In other cases, the physical switch is OFF.

parameters.id: Maximum Output Power of the TX Channel
parameters.name: Maximum Output Power of the TX Channel
parameters.description: Indicates the maximum output power supported by the TX channel after the maximum output power locking is enabled for this TX channel or the circuit breaker value is configured for the corresponding RF module. When the maximum output power locking is disabled for this TX channel, the value of this parameter is the same as that of Hardware Maximum Output Power of the TX Channel. If this TX channel b

parameters.id: Maximum Output Power of TX Unit (Single Carrier)
parameters.name: Maximum Output Power of TX Unit (Single Carrier)
parameters.description: Indicates the maximum output power of the RRU or RFU TX unit (single carrier).

parameters.id: Maximum Output Power of TX Unit (Multiple Carriers)
parameters.name: Maximum Output Power of TX Unit (Multiple Carriers)
parameters.description: Indicates the maximum output power of the RRU or RFU TX unit (multiple carriers).

parameters.id: Hardware Maximum Output Power of the TX Channel
parameters.name: Hardware Maximum Output Power of the TX Channel
parameters.description: Indicates the maximum output power supported by the TX channel hardware. This parameter value can have a 0.5 dB difference from the actual maximum output power.

parameters.name: Band 1 DL Minimum Frequency
parameters.description: Indicates the minimum downlink frequency supported by the RRU or RFU band 1. For example, if this parameter is set to 9650, the minimum downlink frequency of the RRU or RFU is 9650 x 0.1 MHz, which equals to 965 MHz.

parameters.name: Band 1 DL Maximum Frequency
parameters.description: Indicates the maximum downlink frequency supported by the RRU or RFU band 1. For example, if this parameter is set to 9850, the maximum downlink frequency of the RRU or RFU is 9850 x 0.1 MHz, which equals to 985 MHz.

parameters.name: Band 1 DL Bandwidth
parameters.description: Indicates the bandwidth in band 1 supported by each TX channel in the downlink. This bandwidth is an instantaneous bandwidth.

parameters.description: Indicates the minimum downlink frequency supported by the RRU or RFU band 2. This parameter is NULL, when the RRU or RFU does not support multiple bands. For example, if this parameter is set to 9650, the minimum downlink frequency of the RRU is 9650 x 0.1 MHz, which equals to 965 MHz.

parameters.name: Frequency Band
parameters.description: Indicates the frequency band supported by sector antennas.

parameters.description: Indicates the number of carriers operating on band 2.

parameters.description: Indicates the number of carriers operating on band 4.

parameters.name: Time Zone
parameters.description: Indicates the time zone of the NE.

parameters.name: DST Tag Information
parameters.description: Indicates whether DST is enabled.

parameters.name: DST Start Mode
parameters.description: Indicates the mode in which the DST start date is specified. There are three formats: date format, for example, April 1st; week format, for example, the first Sunday in April; date and week format, for example, April 1st and Sunday. If it is Sunday on April 1st, April 1st is the date. Otherwise, the first Sunday after April 1st is the date.

parameters.name: DST Start Month
parameters.description: Indicates the month in which the NE DST starts.

parameters.name: DST Start Day
parameters.description: Indicates the day on which the NE DST starts.

parameters.name: DST Start Week Sequence
parameters.description: Indicates in which week the NE DST starts.

parameters.name: DST Start Weekday
parameters.description: Indicates the week in which the NE DST starts.

parameters.name: DST Start Time
parameters.description: Indicates the time when the NE DST starts. The value of this parameter observes the standard time.

parameters.name: DST End Mode
parameters.description: Indicates the end date mode of the NE DST. There are three formats: date format, for example, April 1st; week format, for example, the first Sunday in April; date and week format, for example, April 1st and Sunday. If it is Sunday on April 1st, April 1st is the date. Otherwise, the first Sunday after April 1st is the date.

parameters.name: DST End Month
parameters.description: Indicates the month in which the NE DST ends.

parameters.name: DST End Day
parameters.description: Indicates the day on which the NE DST ends.

parameters.name: DST End Week Sequence
parameters.description: Indicates the week in which DST ends.

parameters.name: DST End Weekday
parameters.description: Indicates the week in which the NE DST ends.

parameters.name: DST End Time
parameters.description: Indicates the time when the DST of the NE ends. The value of this parameter observes DST.

parameters.name: DST Offset
parameters.description: Indicates the DST time offset of the NE. This parameter can be set to a negative value. A negative value indicates that the NE time is earlier than the DST time, and a positive value indicates that the NE time is later than the DST time.

parameters.name: Time Difference
parameters.description: Indicates the offset of time zone. This parameter can be set to a negative value.

parameters.name: Timeout Duration of Echo Frames
parameters.description: Indicates the timeout duration of waiting for echo responses in the UDP Ping detection mechanism. If no echo response is received after the duration specified by this parameter, echo response times out.

parameters.name: Number of Echo Frame Timeouts
parameters.description: Indicates the maximum number of echo response timeouts during UDP Ping detection. When the number of times that echo responses time out reaches the value of this parameter, the UDP Ping detection path is considered faulty.

parameters.name: DSCP
parameters.description: Indicates the differentiated services code point (DSCP) for UDP Ping control packets.

parameters.name: UDP Session ID
parameters.description: Indicates the UDP session number.

parameters.name: UDP Session Group ID
parameters.description: Indicates the UDP session group number.

parameters.name: Cabinet No.
parameters.description: Indicates the cabinet number of the board where UDP detection is performed.

parameters.name: Subrack No.
parameters.description: Indicates the subrack number of the board where UDP detection is performed.

parameters.name: Slot No.
parameters.description: Indicates the slot number of the board where UDP detection is performed.

parameters.name: Local IP Address
parameters.description: Indicates the local IP address. The local IP address must be the device IP address configured on the board such as the Ethernet port IP address, or logical IP address such as the IP address on the loopback port. The address of the local maintenance Ethernet port cannot be used.

parameters.name: Peer IP Address
parameters.description: Indicates the peer IP address. The IP address cannot be 0.0.0.0, broadcast IP address, multicast IP address, loopback IP address, or any existing IP address in the system.

parameters.name: DSCP
parameters.description: Indicates the differentiated services code point (DSCP) of a packet. The priority has a positive correlation with the value of this parameter.

parameters.name: Interval
parameters.description: Indicates the interval at which UDP session detection packets are sent.

parameters.name: Check Count
parameters.description: Indicates the number of times that UDP ping packets time out. If this number is greater than the number of times that detection packets time out, the UDP session detection is considered faulty.

parameters.name: Response Messages
parameters.description: Indicates the statistics of the UDPECHO response messages, including RTT information.

parameters.name: Check Status
parameters.description: Indicates the UDP session status. If the UDP session detection finds interruption, the status is abnormal.

parameters.name: Cabinet No.
parameters.description: Indicates the number of the cabinet housing the board on whose port the UL flow control algorithm is configured.

parameters.name: Subrack No.
parameters.description: Indicates the number of the subrack housing the board on whose port the UL flow control algorithm is configured.

parameters.name: Slot No.
parameters.description: Indicates the number of the slot holding the board on whose port the UL flow control algorithm is configured.

parameters.name: Subboard Type
parameters.description: Indicates the type of sub-board on whose port the UL flow control algorithm is configured.

parameters.name: Bear Type
parameters.description: Indicates the bearer type of the physical port on which the UL flow control algorithm is configured. This parameter can be set to ATM or IP.

parameters.name: Port Type
parameters.description: Indicates the type of port where the UL flow control algorithm is configured.

parameters.name: Port No.
parameters.description: Indicates the number of the port where the UL flow control algorithm is configured.

parameters.name: BW Adjust Protection Switch
parameters.description: Indicates whether to adjust the available UL bandwidth. When this parameter is set to ON, the BS stops adjusting the available UL bandwidth of the physical port if the bit error rate (BER) on the transmission line exceeds the specified alarm threshold. This parameter does not take effect for loopback ports or tunnels because the error MAC frame reporting function is not implemented for loopback po

parameters.name: Congestion Ctrl Switch
parameters.description: Indicates whether to perform congestion control. When this switch is turned on, the BS lowers the TX rate if the BS detects that links experience transmission delay or packet loss.

When this switch is turned on, the Enhanced Inter-NodeB Uplink CoMP (Joint Reception) feature takes effect, improving the demodulation and decoding performance. When this switch is turned off, the Enhanced Inter-NodeB Uplink CoMP (Joint Reception) feature does not take effect.

parameters.name: Cell Algorithm Optimization Switch
parameters.description: Indicates the switch for cell algorithm optimization. UNSTABLEUSERSCHOPTSW: This option is used to control the HSDPA scheduling optimization function for UEs in the unstable state. When this option is selected, the HSDPA scheduling mechanism is optimized in unstable scenarios such as H2F state transition and call reestablishment. When this option is deselected, the optimized HSDPA scheduling mecha

parameters.name: Co-Polarization Port Mapping Configuration
parameters.description: Indicates the co-polarization mapping configuration of antenna ports onto the RF channels in a cell. Value 4T4P_abcd indicates that a cell has four TX channels and four antenna ports (a, b, c, and d) with signals of a and c and those of b and d separately belonging to a co-polarization group. For example value 4T4P_0132 indicates that signals of antenna ports 0 and 3 and those of antenna ports 1 a

parameters.id: Machine Learning based PCPICH Power Optimization Switch
parameters.name: Machine Learning based PCPICH Power Optimization Switch
parameters.description: Indicates whether the Machine Learning based PCPICH Power Optimization feature takes effect. When this switch is turned on, the Machine Learning based PCPICH Power Optimization feature takes effect, and the RNC adaptively adjusts the pilot power based on the cell load and coverage. When this switch is turned off, the Machine Learning based PCPICH Power Optimization feature does not take effect, an

parameters.name: OM Switch
parameters.description: Indicates whether to enable the operation and maintenance functions of the NodeB. CELLHSPAFULLBUFFERSW(Cell HSPA Full Buffer O&M Switch): When this option is selected, the NodeB checks the buffered data volume of UEs. If the buffered data volume of a UE is greater than the transmission capability of the air interface, the NodeB identifies the UE as a full buffer UE and sends the identification res

parameters.id: RRM Parameters Optimization Based on Machine Learning Switch
parameters.name: RRM Parameters Optimization Based on Machine Learning Switch
parameters.description: Indicates whether the RRM Parameters Optimization Based on Machine Learning feature takes effect. When this parameter is set to ON, the RRM Parameters Optimization Based on Machine Learning feature takes effect. In this case, the network side performs policy optimization in the compressed mode, soft handover threshold optimization, and uplink target RoT optimization. When this parameter is set to

parameters.name: Spectrum Share Capacity Optimization Switch
parameters.description: Indicates whether the spectrum sharing capacity optimization algorithm for UMTS and LTE Spectrum Sharing Phase 2 or UMTS and LTE Spectrum Sharing Based on DC-HSDPA takes effect. When this parameter is set to ON(ON), the cell spectrum sharing capacity optimization algorithm takes effect. When this parameter is set to OFF(OFF), the cell spectrum sharing capacity optimization algorithm does not take

parameters.name: Capacity Optimization Load Threshold
parameters.description: Indicates the threshold for enabling capacity optimization for UMTS and LTE Spectrum Sharing Phase 2 or UMTS and LTE Spectrum Sharing Based on DC-HSDPA. When UMTS and LTE Spectrum Sharing Phase 2 is enabled, if the downlink TCP load of a cell is no less than this threshold, the UMTS side informs that the LTE side cannot use the shared spectrum or can use only some shared spectrum. If the downlink

parameters.name: Dynamic PCPICH Power Switch
parameters.description: Indicates whether the dynamic PCPICH power adjustment algorithm for UMTS and LTE Spectrum Sharing Phase 2 takes effect. When this parameter is set to ON, the cell dynamic pilot power adjustment algorithm takes effect. When this parameter is set to OFF, the cell dynamic pilot power adjustment algorithm does not take effect.

parameters.id: Cell Sw-off Based on Auto Co-cvge Ident Switch
parameters.name: Cell Sw-off Based on Auto Co-cvge Ident Switch
parameters.description: Indicates whether cell shutdown based on automatic co-coverage identification takes effect. If this parameter is set to ON, cell shutdown based on automatic co-coverage identification takes effect. In this case, the RAN identifies co-coverage cells and determines whether to shut down cells in a frequency band based on the status of co-coverage cells. If this parameter is set to OFF, cell shutdown

parameters.id: Shared Bandwidth Periodic Shrink Time Ratio
parameters.name: Shared Bandwidth Periodic Shrink Time Ratio
parameters.description: Indicates the percentage of time for rolling back the downlink adaptive filter within a one-second period for a UMTS cell when the UMTS and LTE Spectrum Sharing Phase 2 feature is enabled. When this parameter is set to default value 0, the function of rolling back the downlink adaptive filter bandwidth with a one-second period is disabled. When this parameter is set to a value other than 0 (for ex

parameters.name: Core Bandwidth Sharing Outage Mode
parameters.description: Indicates the mode of disabling spectrum sharing based on the proportion of abnormal UEs. When this parameter is set to FIXED, UMTS cell notifies LTE cell not to use the UMTS core bandwidth (the bandwidth within 1.92 MHz from the UMTS center frequency) for 2 ms within a 6-ms period. When this parameter is set to AUTO, UMTS cell checks the proportion of abnormal UEs. If the proportion exceeds the t

parameters.id: Initial Single HARQ Demodulation Optimization Switch for HSUPA 2ms TTI UEs
parameters.name: Initial Single HARQ Demodulation Optimization Switch for HSUPA 2ms TTI UEs
parameters.description: Indicates whether to enable the algorithm for optimizing the demodulation of initial single HARQ for HSUPA 2 ms TTI UEs. When this parameter is set to OFF, the algorithm for optimizing the demodulation of initial single HARQ for HSUPA 2 ms TTI UEs is disabled. When this parameter is set to ON, the algorithm for optimizing the demodulation of initial single HARQ for HSUPA 2 ms TTI UEs is enabled, i

parameters.name: Multi-RAT Coordinated Channel Shutdown Switch
parameters.description: Indicates whether to enable the Multi-RAT Coordinated Channel Shutdown (UMTS) feature. When this parameter is set to ON(ON), the Multi-RAT Coordinated Channel Shutdown (UMTS) feature is enabled to save energy during off-peak hours.

parameters.name: Power Saving Start Time
parameters.description: Indicates the time at which the cell power saving algorithm starts to take effect. When the system time reaches the time specified by this parameter, the feature algorithm starts to take effect. The parameter value is in the format of HH:MM:SS. For example, 10:20:05.

parameters.name: Power Saving Stop Time
parameters.description: Indicates the time at which the cell power saving algorithm stops. When the system time reaches the time specified by this parameter, the feature algorithm becomes ineffective. The parameter value is in the format of HH:MM:SS. For example, 10:20:05.

parameters.id: Power Saving TX Power High Threshold
parameters.name: Power Saving TX Power High Threshold
parameters.description: Indicates the threshold of the output power percentage for a cell to stop power saving. If the average output power percentage of a cell is higher than this threshold, the cell stops power saving.

parameters.id: Power Saving TX Power Low Threshold
parameters.name: Power Saving TX Power Low Threshold
parameters.description: Indicates the threshold of the output power percentage for a cell to start power saving. If the average output power percentage of a cell is lower than this threshold, the cell starts power saving.

parameters.id: Voice Quality Improvement in CloudAIR Scenario Switch
parameters.name: Voice Quality Improvement in CloudAIR Scenario Switch
parameters.description: Indicates whether to enable the Voice Quality Improvement in CloudAIR Scenario feature. If this switch is turned on, the NodeB compensates the maximum and minimum downlink transmit power for voice services based on the shared UMTS bandwidth in CloudAIR scenarios to improve downlink voice quality. If this switch is turned off, the NodeB does not compensate the maximum and minimum downlink transmit

parameters.name: DC-HSDPA UEs Ratio Threshold
parameters.description: Indicates the DC-HSDPA UEs ratio threshold of the UMTS and LTE Spectrum Sharing Based on DC-HSDPA feature. In the HSDPA multi-carrier cell group where the spectrum sharing cell is located, if the downlink TCP load of the primary carrier cell is no less than the capacity optimization load threshold (specified by CAPOPTLOADTHD) and the DC-HSDPA UEs ratio of the cell is no less than the value of this

parameters.name: Cell Digital Tilt
parameters.description: Indicates the digital tilt of a cell. This parameter takes effect only for cells served by the AAU5726.

parameters.name: Multi-RAT Coordinated Channel Shutdown State
parameters.description: Indicates the state of the Multi-RAT Coordinated Channel Shutdown (UMTS) feature. Enable indicates that the Multi-RAT Coordinated Channel Shutdown (UMTS) feature is enabled. Disable indicates that the Multi-RAT Coordinated Channel Shutdown (UMTS) feature is disabled.

parameters.name: Multi-RAT Coordinated Channel Shutdown Time
parameters.description: Indicates the effective duration of the Multi-RAT Coordinated Channel Shutdown (UMTS) feature from the time specified by the latest setting of the PWRSAVSTARTTIME parameter to the current time. The parameter value is in the format of HH:MM:SS. For example, 10:20:05.

parameters.id: Cause of Multi-RAT Coordinated Channel Shutdown Failure
parameters.name: Cause of Multi-RAT Coordinated Channel Shutdown Failure
parameters.description: Indicates the cause why the Multi-RAT Coordinated Channel Shutdown(UMTS) feature does not take effect.

parameters.name: Local Cell ID
parameters.description: Indicates the Local Cell ID.

parameters.name: MAC-e Schedule Para
parameters.description: Indicates whether setting Mac-e scheduling parameters.

parameters.name: OverLoad Schedule Switch
parameters.description: Indicates the HSUPA overload scheduling switch. The function will be enabled if this parameter is set to OPEN. When this switch is turned on and the guaranteed bit rates (GBRs) of users are not met, the cell load will exceed the planned target and reach the congestion threshold, thereby guaranteeing users' GBRs.

parameters.id: Max Target RoT Difference Before and After IC
parameters.name: Max Target RoT Difference Before and After IC
parameters.description: Indicates the max target RoT difference before and after IC.

parameters.name: E-AGCH HPC Parameters
parameters.description: Indicates whether setting E-AGCH power control parameters.

parameters.name: E-AGCH HPC Mode
parameters.description: Indicates the E-AGCH power control policy. Fixed Tx power: The E-AGCH uses fixed transmit power. Tx Pwr Ctr based on Pilot or Tx Pwr Ctr based on TPC: The transmit power of the E-AGCH is reduced, and the downlink capacity is improved. Tx Pwr Ctr based on CQI or Tx Pwr Ctr based on HS-SCCH: The transmit power of the E-AGCH is further lowered, and the downlink capacity is further improved.

parameters.name: E-AGCH Power Offset
parameters.description: Indicates the Power offset between the E-AGCH and the TPC. The GUI value range and actual value range of this parameter are set according to 3GPP TS 25.433. For details, see the description of E-AGCH Power Offset in 3GPP TS 25.433.

parameters.name: E-AGCH Power
parameters.description: Indicates the power offset of the E-AGCH from the power of the Common Pilot Channel.

parameters.name: E-AGCH Max Power
parameters.description: Indicates the E-AGCH Max Power.

parameters.name: E-AGCH Min Power
parameters.description: Indicates the E-AGCH Min Power.

parameters.id: E-RGCH HPC Parameters for Service Radio Links Set
parameters.name: E-RGCH HPC Parameters for Service Radio Links Set
parameters.description: Indicates whether to set E-RGCH power control parameters for Serving E-DCH RLS and E-HICH power control parameters for RLS containing the Serving E-DCH cell.

parameters.id: E-RGCH HPC Mode for Service Radio Links Set
parameters.name: E-RGCH HPC Mode for Service Radio Links Set
parameters.description: Indicates the E-RGCH power control policy for Serving E-DCH RLS and E-HICH power control policy for RLS containing the Serving E-DCH cell. Fixed TX power: The E-RGCH for Serving E-DCH RLS and the E-HICH for RLS containing the Serving E-DCH cell use fixed transmit power. TX Pwr Ctr based on Pilot or TX Pwr Ctr based on TPC: The E-RGCH and E-HICH occupy less transmit power, and the downlink capacity

parameters.id: E-RGCH Power Offset for Service Radio Links Set
parameters.name: E-RGCH Power Offset for Service Radio Links Set
parameters.description: Indicates the E-RGCH power offset for service radio link set from the associated DPCCH TPC field. The GUI value range and actual value range of this parameter are set according to 3GPP TS 25.433. For details, see the description of E-RGCH Power Offset in 3GPP TS 25.433.

parameters.id: E-RGCH Power for Service Radio Links Set
parameters.name: E-RGCH Power for Service Radio Links Set
parameters.description: Indicates the power offset of the E-RGCH serving RLS from the power of the Common Pilot Channel.

parameters.id: E-RGCH HPC Parameters for Non-service Radio Links
parameters.name: E-RGCH HPC Parameters for Non-service Radio Links
parameters.description: Indicates whether to set E-RGCH power control parameters for Non-serving E-DCH RL and E-HICH power control parameters for RLS not containing the Serving E-DCH cell.

parameters.id: E-RGCH HPC Mode for Non-service Radio Links
parameters.name: E-RGCH HPC Mode for Non-service Radio Links
parameters.description: Indicates the E-RGCH power control policy for Non-serving E-DCH RL and E-HICH power control policy for RLS not containing the Serving E-DCH cell. Fixed TX power: The E-RGCH for Non-serving E-DCH RL and the E-HICH for RLS not containing the Serving E-DCH cell use fixed transmit power. TX Pwr Ctr based on Pilot or TX Pwr Ctr based on TPC: The E-RGCH and E-HICH occupy less transmit power, and the dow

parameters.id: E-RGCH Power Offset for Non-service Radio Links
parameters.name: E-RGCH Power Offset for Non-service Radio Links
parameters.description: Indicates the E-RGCH power offset from associated DPCCH TPC field for non-service radio links. The GUI value range and actual value range of this parameter are set according to 3GPP TS 25.433. For details, see the description of E-RGCH Power Offset in 3GPP TS 25.433.

parameters.id: E-RGCH Power for Non-service Radio Links
parameters.name: E-RGCH Power for Non-service Radio Links
parameters.description: Indicates the power offset of the E-RGCH non-serving RL from the power of the Common Pilot Channel.

parameters.id: E-HICH Power Offset for Service Radio Links Set
parameters.name: E-HICH Power Offset for Service Radio Links Set
parameters.description: Indicates the E-HICH power offset for service radio link set from the associated DPCH_TPC field. The GUI value range and actual value range of this parameter are set according to 3GPP TS 25.433. For details, see the description of E-HICH Power Offset in 3GPP TS 25.433.

parameters.id: E-HICH Power for Service Radio Links Set
parameters.name: E-HICH Power for Service Radio Links Set
parameters.description: Indicates the power offset of the E-HICH serving RLS from the power of the Common Pilot Channel.

parameters.id: E-HICH Power Offset for Single Radio Link
parameters.name: E-HICH Power Offset for Single Radio Link
parameters.description: Indicates the E-HICH Power Offset for Single Radio Link Set. The GUI value range and actual value range of this parameter are set according to 3GPP TS 25.433. For details, see the description of E-HICH Power Offset in 3GPP TS 25.433.

parameters.id: E-HICH Power for Single Radio Link
parameters.name: E-HICH Power for Single Radio Link
parameters.description: Indicates the E-HICH Power for Single Radio Link Set.

parameters.id: E-HICH Power Offset for Non-service Radio Links Set
parameters.name: E-HICH Power Offset for Non-service Radio Links Set
parameters.description: Indicates the E-HICH power offset for non-service radio link set from associated DPCCH TPC field. The GUI value range and actual value range of this parameter are set according to 3GPP TS 25.433. For details, see the description of E-HICH Power Offset in 3GPP TS 25.433.

parameters.id: E-HICH Power for Non-service Radio Links Set
parameters.name: E-HICH Power for Non-service Radio Links Set
parameters.description: Indicates the power offset of the E-HICH non-serving RLS from the power of the Common Pilot Channel.

parameters.name: Anti-Interference Scheduling Switch
parameters.description: Indicates the ratio of the cell load resources that needs to be guaranteed. When this switch is turned on, in scenarios where strong external interference exists, a large value for this parameter improves the throughput of the cell. At the same time, however, the cell coverage severely shrinks.

parameters.name: Own Cell UL Load Ratio
parameters.description: Indicates the uplink load of the local cell required when the anti-interference scheduling algorithm is enabled. Increasing the parameter value helps increase cell throughput rate in strong interference scenarios.

parameters.name: RTWP Measurement Optimization Algorithm Switch
parameters.description: Indicates the Rtwp Measure Optimize Switch. The function will be enabled if this parameter is set to OPEN. When this switch is turned on, this improves the number of users that can be simultaneously admitted into the system and raises the access success rate.

parameters.name: Min UL Cover Load Threshold
parameters.description: Indicates the uplink load threshold for ensuring minimum cell coverage. That is, if a site has strong interference, the uplink load cannot exceed the threshold to ensure minimum cell coverage.

parameters.name: Hsupa Time Division Scheduling Switch
parameters.description: Indicates the HSUPA Time Division Scheduling Switch.

parameters.name: Chip Offset 2ms UE Number
parameters.description: Indicates the chip offset 2 ms UE number in HSUPA Time Division Scheduling.

parameters.name: TDM Schedule Enhance Switch
parameters.description: Indicates the switch for TDM scheduling enhance for HSUPA cells.

parameters.id: Secondary DC-HSUPA Cell Activation and Deactivation Switch Based on RTWP
parameters.name: Secondary DC-HSUPA Cell Activation and Deactivation Switch Based on RTWP
parameters.description: Indicates to enable RTWP-based secondary DC-HSUPA cell activation and deactivation.

parameters.id: Secondary DC-HSUPA Cell Deactivation Rate Threshold
parameters.name: Secondary DC-HSUPA Cell Deactivation Rate Threshold
parameters.description: Indicates the minimum rate threshold supported by the uplink transmit power for ensuring the minimum coverage of activated DC-HSUPA UEs on the secondary carrier. To be specific, to meet the minimum coverage requirements of activated DC-HSUPA cell edge UEs (CEUs) on the secondary carrier, the maximum rate threshold supported by the uplink transmit power cannot be lower than this threshold. Otherwis

parameters.name: HSUPA Total Throughput Guarantee Switch
parameters.description: Indicates the total HSUPA throughput guarantee switch. When this switch is turned on, the algorithm for increasing total HSUPA throughput is enabled.

parameters.name: HSUPA Total Throughput Threshold
parameters.description: Indicates the total throughput to be guaranteed when HSUPA Total Throughput Guarantee Switch is set to ON.

parameters.name: HSUPA TTI 2ms User SG Algorithm
parameters.description: Indicates the minimum SG that the SG reclaiming algorithm uses during the data transmission of HSUPA 2 ms TTI users. When this parameter is set to SGALGFIRSTFOR2MSUSER, the minimum SG during data transmission of HSUPA 2 ms TTI users is three RLC PDUs. When this parameter is set to SGALGSECONDFOR2MSUSER, the minimum SG during data transmission of HSUPA 2 ms TTI users is one RLC PDU.

parameters.name: Local Cell ID
parameters.description: Indicates the Local Cell ID.

parameters.name: Resource Allocate Method
parameters.description: Indicates the Resource Allocate Method. Radio resources indicate HSDPA available power resources and code resources. Code Priority: The code resource priority allocation scheme mainly applies to scenarios where power resources are limited. In scenarios where power resources are not limited, this scheme lowers the system throughput. Power Priority: The power resource priority allocation scheme main

parameters.name: Scheduling Method
parameters.description: Indicates the HSDPA Scheduling Method. PF: The differences between channel environments of users are considered in order to ensure equity among users. Enhanced PF: This algorithm is an enhancement to PF. Channel quality is considered in order to reach high resource efficiency and gain a high system capacity. Round Robin: Scheduling opportunities are allocated among users simply and effectively on

parameters.name: Power Margin
parameters.description: Indicates the power margin reserved for R99 channels. It specifies the power percentage relative to the maximum cell transmit power.

parameters.id: HS-SCCH Power Control Method in CELL DCH state
parameters.name: HS-SCCH Power Control Method in CELL DCH state
parameters.description: Indicates the HS-SCCH Power Control Method in CELL DCH state. Fixed Power-based Power Control: The HS-SCCH transmit power is determined depending on CEUs. This helps to save power resources. CQI-based Adaptive Power Control: The HS-SCCH transmit power is adjusted based on the CQIs and ACK/NACK feedback from users. This lowers the average HS-SCCH transmit power and improves the average throughput o

parameters.name: HS-SCCH Power
parameters.description: Indicates the power of the HS-SCCH is an offset in dB to the transmit power of the PCPICH. Relationship between the GUI value and actual value: Actual value = (GUI value - 40) x 0.25.

parameters.id: HS-SCCH FER Target in CELL DCH State
parameters.name: HS-SCCH FER Target in CELL DCH State
parameters.description: Indicates the HS-SCCH FER Target in CELL DCH State.

parameters.name: Resource Limiting Switch
parameters.description: Indicates the Resource Limiting Switch. The function will be enabled if this parameter is set to OPEN. When the resource usage is above the threshold, the throughput may be improved (for example, large GBRs configured for users at the cell edge).

parameters.name: Dynamic Code Switch
parameters.description: Indicates the Dynamic Code Switch. The function will be enabled if this parameter is set to OPEN. When this switch is turned on, the cell codes are used efficiently, and the system capacity is improved.

parameters.name: 16QAM Switch
parameters.description: Indicates the 16QAM Switch. The function will be enabled if this parameter is set to OPEN. When this switch is turned on, the cell throughput improves.

parameters.name: Max Power Per Hs-user
parameters.description: Indicates the ratio of the maximum instantaneous transmit power of a single HSDPA UE to the actual maximum transmit power of the cell.

parameters.name: CQI Filter Alpha
parameters.description: Indicates the Channel Quality Indicator(CQI) Filter Alpha.

parameters.name: MAX EFACH HARQ Retransmission Times
parameters.description: Indicates the maximum number of blind HARQ retransmissions for E-FACH users.

parameters.id: MAX HARQ Retransmission Times of Non-Conversational service in CELL DCH state
parameters.name: MAX HARQ Retransmission Times of Non-Conversational service in CELL DCH state
parameters.description: Indicates the MAX HARQ Retransmission Times of Non-Conversational service in CELL DCH state.

parameters.id: HS-SCCH Power Control Method in CELL FACH state
parameters.name: HS-SCCH Power Control Method in CELL FACH state
parameters.description: Indicates the HS-SCCH Power Control Method in CELL FACH state. Fixed Power-based Power Control: The HS-SCCH transmit power is determined considering the CEUs of the cell. Reliable HS-SCCH transmission can be ensured but the downlink power cannot efficiently used. CQI-based Adaptive Power Control: The HS-SCCH transmit power is adjusted based on the CQIs and ACK/NACK feedback from users. The probabi

parameters.id: CQI Adjust Algorithm Switch of Conversational Service
parameters.name: CQI Adjust Algorithm Switch of Conversational Service
parameters.description: Indicates the Channel Quality Indicator(CQI) Adjust Algorithm Switch of Conversational Service. Not CQI Adjust Algorithm: CQI correction is not performed. CQI Adjusted by RBLER: CQI correction is performed for conversational services based on the target value of the residual BLER. The residual BLER will converge to the target value.

parameters.id: CQI Adjust Algorithm Switch of non-Conversational Service
parameters.name: CQI Adjust Algorithm Switch of non-Conversational Service
parameters.description: Indicates the Channel Quality Indicator(CQI) Adjust Algorithm Switch of non-Conversational Service. Not CQI Adjust Algorithm: CQI correction is not performed. CQI Adjusted by IBLER: CQI correction is performed for non-conversational services based on the fixed IBLER. The IBLER will converge to this target value. CQI Adjusted by Dynamic BLER: CQI correction is performed for non-conversational servi

parameters.name: Residual Bler Target
parameters.description: Indicates the residual block error rate (RBLER) target.

parameters.name: IBler Target
parameters.description: Indicates the Initial Block Error Rate(IBLER) Target.

parameters.name: Secondary DC-HSDPA,DB-HSDPA Cell Activation Switch
parameters.description: This parameter specifies whether to enable Traffic-Based Activation and Deactivation of the Supplementary Carrier in Multi-carrier HSDPA. Multi-carrier HSDPA cells fall into DC-HSDPA cells, DC-HSDPA+MIMO cells, DB-HSDPA cells, DB-HSDPA+MIMO cells, 3C-HSDPA cells, and 4C-HSDPA cells. If this parameter is set to ON, this function takes effect. If this parameter is set to OFF, this function does not

parameters.name: IIC Switch
parameters.description: Indicates the Intelligent Interference Control Switch. The function will be enabled if this parameter is set to OPEN. For MIMO+HSDPA co-carrier cells, when this switch is turned on, performance for HSDPA users is boosted but performance for MIMO users slightly decreases. When this switch is close, performance for MIMO users remains unchanged and performance for HSDPA users decreases.

parameters.name: SE Hsscch DTX Switch
parameters.description: Indicates the SE Hsscch DTX Switch. When this switch is turned on, Sony Ericsson terminals no longer experience PS call drops. However, it is possible to decrease the cell capacity.

parameters.name: MIMO Prime Switch
parameters.description: Indicates the MIMO Prime Switch. The function will be enabled if this parameter is set to OPEN.

parameters.name: Location Weight
parameters.description: Indicates the weight of the EPF_LOC (user location-based EPF) algorithm. A larger parameter value indicates more location factors should be considered in the user location-based HSDPA scheduling scheme that uses the EPF_LOC algorithm.

parameters.name: Extra Power
parameters.description: Indicates the maximum power used for scheduled users after the scheduling.

parameters.id: Maximum HARQ Retransmission Number for EFACH over HS-DPCCH
parameters.name: Maximum HARQ Retransmission Number for EFACH over HS-DPCCH
parameters.description: Indicates the maximum number of HARQ retransmissions when the UE in CELL_FACH supports the feedbacks over the HS-DPCCH.

parameters.id: Optimization Switch for BLER of HSDPA Burst service
parameters.name: Optimization Switch for BLER of HSDPA Burst service
parameters.description: When this switch is turned on, estimated channel environment errors are corrected for burst services and full buffer services at the startup of data transmission to optimize the BLER.

parameters.id: DL BE Schedule When UL Unreliable Switch
parameters.name: DL BE Schedule When UL Unreliable Switch
parameters.description: Indicates the switch used to control whether scheduling and Transport Format Resource Combination (TFRC) are allowed for best effort (BE) services when the uplink signal quality of HSDPA users is not reliable. If this switch is turned off, scheduling and TFRC are not allowed for BE services when the uplink signal quality of HSDPA users is not reliable. If this switch is turned on, scheduling and T

parameters.name: Extra Power For SRB
parameters.description: Indicates the extra power for the SRB queue. If SRBs are carried over HSDPA, the transmit power increases when there is remaining cell power or the data volume to be transmitted decreases when there is no remaining cell power. This reduces the BLER of the SRB queue, decreases the HSDPA service drop rate, and increases the HSDPA handover success rate.

parameters.name: Code Utilization Optimization Switch
parameters.description: Indicates the switch for code utilization optimization. If this switch is turned on, the HSDPA code utilization rate increases but the power usage decreases. If this switch is turned off, code utilization optimization does not take effect.

parameters.name: Preallocation BW Optimization Switch
parameters.description: Indicates the switch used to optimize the pre-allocation bandwidth algorithm. If the switch is turned on, the NodeB optimizes the pre-allocation bandwidth algorithm, improving HSDPA throughput. If this switch is turned off, the pre-allocation bandwidth algorithm does not take effect.

parameters.name: SFDC MAC-ehs Discard Timer
parameters.description: Indicates the length of the SFDC MAC-ehs discard timer, which defines the maximum duration within which an MAC-d PDU of the inter-NodeB SFDC-HSDPA service is transmitted after it is added to an MAC-ehs queue. If the timer expires, the MAC-d PDU will be discarded. Otherwise, the MAC-d PDU will be blocked in a NodeB, which causing a UE to receive an incorrect PDU at the RLC layer. For details about

parameters.name: DF3C MAC-ehs Discard Timer
parameters.description: Indicates the length of the DF3C MAC-ehs discard timer, which defines the maximum duration within which an MAC-d PDU of the inter-NodeB DF3C-HSDPA service is transmitted after it is added to an MAC-ehs queue. If the timer expires, the MAC-d PDU will be discarded. Otherwise, the MAC-d PDU will be blocked in a NodeB, which causing a UE to receive an incorrect PDU at the RLC layer. For details about

parameters.name: HSDPA L2 Optition Switch
parameters.description: Indicates whether to enable Layer 2 optimization for HSDPA services. If this switch is turned on, Layer 2 optimization for HSDPA services is enabled. If this switch is turned off, Layer 2 optimization for HSDPA services is disabled.

parameters.id: Power Margin Delta For Platinum User
parameters.name: Power Margin Delta For Platinum User
parameters.description: Indicates an adjustment to the reserved power margin for R99 channels when the Platinum User Prioritizing feature has been enabled. The reserved power margin for R99 channels of a cell serving platinum users in the CS domain equals the smaller value between 100 and the sum of PWRMGN and PWRMGNDELTAFORPT. The parameter value is a percentage relative to the maximum cell transmit power.

parameters.name: Video CQI Threshold
parameters.description: Indicates the CQI threshold for scheduling video users. If SM is set to EPF and the CQI after filtering for an HSDPA video user is below the specified threshold, absolute guarantee does not apply to the video user.

parameters.name: HSDPA Fullbuffer Data Threshold
parameters.description: Indicates the full buffer service traffic threshold for HSDPA UEs.

parameters.name: HSDPA Fullbuffer Throughput Threshold
parameters.description: Indicates the full buffer service throughput threshold for HSDPA UEs.

parameters.id: Optimization Switch for HS-SCCH CQI-based Adaptive Power Control in CELL_DCH State
parameters.name: Optimization Switch for HS-SCCH CQI-based Adaptive Power Control in CELL_DCH State
parameters.description: Indicates whether to optimize HS-SCCH CQI-based adaptive power control for UEs in CELL_DCH state. If this switch is turned on, the NodeB optimizes HS-SCCH CQI-based adaptive power control for UEs in CELL_DCH state.

parameters.id: MAX Extra Power for HS-SCCH in CELL_DCH State
parameters.name: MAX Extra Power for HS-SCCH in CELL_DCH State
parameters.description: Indicates the maximum extra power for HS-SCCH in CELL_DCH state.

parameters.description: Indicates the service CQI threshold for preferential service scheduling. If the CQI value of an HSDPA service is less than the threshold, preferential scheduling does not apply to the service.

parameters.name: E-FACH DTCH Resource Alloc Mode
parameters.description: Indicates the power resource allocation mode for E-FACH DTCH data. If this parameter is set to JOINTALLOC, power resources are jointly allocated to E-FACH DTCH data within multiple TTIs. If this parameter is set to INDALLOC, power resources are independently allocated to E-FACH DTCH data within each TTI.

When this parameter is set to OFF, the algorithm specified by CQI_ADJ_BY_IBLER under CQIADJALGOFNONCON has optimized performance of the mainstream terminals on the live network. parameters.id: Adjustment Switch for CQI Adjusted By Dynamic BLER
parameters.name: Adjustment Switch for CQI Adjusted By Dynamic BLER
parameters.description: Indicates performance adjustment for the algorithm specified by CQI_ADJ_BY_DYN_BLER under CQIADJALGOFNONCON . In the single-user scenario, if this parameter is set to ON, the system optimizes the algorithm specified by CQI_ADJ_BY_DYN_BLER to improve downlink throughput.

parameters.id: Throughput Threshold for Activating Secondary Cell
parameters.name: Throughput Threshold for Activating Secondary Cell
parameters.description: Indicates the throughput threshold for activating the secondary cell. If the UE throughput is greater than the threshold, the secondary cell is activated.

parameters.id: Throughput Threshold for Deactivating Secondary Cell
parameters.name: Throughput Threshold for Deactivating Secondary Cell
parameters.description: Indicates the throughput threshold for deactivating the secondary cell. If the UE throughput is lower than the threshold, and the size of buffered user data is greater than the value of DEASECCELLDATABUFTHD , the secondary cell is deactivated.

parameters.id: Data Buffer Threshold for Activating Secondary Cell
parameters.name: Data Buffer Threshold for Activating Secondary Cell
parameters.description: Indicates the data buffer threshold for activating the secondary cell. When the size of buffered user data is lower than the threshold, the secondary cell is activated.

parameters.id: Data Buffer Threshold for Deactivating Secondary Cell
parameters.name: Data Buffer Threshold for Deactivating Secondary Cell
parameters.description: Indicates the data buffer threshold for deactivating the secondary cell. When the size of buffered user data is greater than the threshold and the user throughput is lower than the value of DEASECCELLTHPTHD , the secondary cell is deactivated.

parameters.name: Independent Carrier Scheduling Switch
parameters.description: Indicates the switch for independent carrier scheduling of multi-carrier HSDPA users. If this switch is turned on, only the rate of a carrier for a multi-carrier HSDPA user is used as the input of the carrier scheduling weight. If this switch is turned off, the total rate of several carriers for a multi-carrier user is used as the input of the carrier scheduling weight.

parameters.name: Buffer-based Scheduling Algorithm Switch
parameters.description: Indicates the switch of buffer-based HSDPA user scheduling algorithm. If this switch is turned on, the buffer-based scheduling algorithm is enabled and users with few queue buffers are preferentially scheduled. If this switch is turned off, the scheduling algorithm is not enabled. Buffer means the data in a NodeB user queue.

parameters.name: Dynamic Code Optimization Switch
parameters.description: Indicates the switch for HSDPA dynamic code optimization. When this parameter is set to ON, the HSDPA dynamic code optimization algorithm takes effect. When this parameter is set to OFF, the HSDPA dynamic code optimization algorithm does not take effect.

parameters.name: HARQ Retransmission Schedule Optimization Switch
parameters.description: Indicates the switch for HARQ retransmission schedule optimization. When this parameter is set to ON, the HARQ retransmission schedule optimization algorithm takes effect. When this parameter is set to OFF, the HARQ retransmission schedule optimization algorithm does not take effect.

parameters.name: Delta CQI Threshold for MC
parameters.description: Indicates the CQI difference threshold for multi-carrier HSDPA UEs. For a multi-carrier HSDPA UE that uses the local call as the primary well, if the result of subtracting carrier 2 CQI from carrier 1 CQI is greater than this threshold, the UE is scheduled with the lowest scheduling priority in carrier 2. (Carrier 1 is the carrier with the highest CQI, and carrier 2 is the one with the lowest CQI)

parameters.name: Combined TFRC Switch

parameters.description: Indicates the threshold of the number of UEs for which the Machine Learning based Scheduling feature is effective. parameters.description: Indicates the period of no services in a cell. Value 0 means that the timer is disabled. For details about how to clear the alarm ALM-28209 Cell No Traffic, see the alarm reference.

parameters.name: Timer Length Of Cell Without RL Setup (First RLS)

If there are no initial access requests in the cell for a period longer than the duration specified by this parameter value, the NodeB reports the alarm ALM-28209 Cell No Traffic. For details about how to clear the alarm ALM-28209 Cell No Traffic, see the alarm reference.
