parameters.name: IMEISV SVN
parameters.description: Indicates the software version number (SVN) in the IMEISVs of UEs. Each SVN identifies a software version of UEs. For details about IMEISVs, see section 6.2.2 in 3GPP TS 23.003 V10.1.0 or later releases. Do not change the setting of this parameter without the guidance from Huawei Customer Service Center.

parameters.name: IMEISV Description
parameters.description: Indicates the user-defined description of the UE type.

parameters.name: Interface Protocol Name
parameters.description: Indicates the interface or protocol type of the debugging message. Do not change the setting of this parameter without the guidance from Huawei Customer Service Center.

parameters.name: Message Type
parameters.description: Indicates the number of the message transmitted over 3GPP-defined interfaces. Do not change the setting of this parameter without the guidance from Huawei Customer Service Center.

parameters.name: Operate Type
parameters.description: Indicates the operation performed by the eNodeB on a matched message. Do not change the setting of this parameter without the guidance from Huawei Customer Service Center.

parameters.name: Match Count
parameters.description: Indicates the number of items in the debugging message for matching. Each item contains the offset, length, and content. The value ZERO indicates that the eNodeB discards or modifies the messages with a specific ID. The value ONE indicates that the eNodeB discards or modifies the messages with the matching result of one item to be positive. The value TWO indicates that the eNodeB discards or modif

parameters.name: Match Field Offset 1
parameters.description: Indicates the offset for the matching field used when the eNodeB compares each message received or to be sent by the eNodeB with the debugging message. Do not change the setting of this parameter without the guidance from Huawei Customer Service Center.

parameters.name: Match Length 1
parameters.description: Indicates the length of information used by the eNodeB to compare each message received or to be sent by the eNodeB with the debugging message. Do not change the setting of this parameter without the guidance from Huawei Customer Service Center.

parameters.name: Match Content 1
parameters.description: Indicates the content with which the eNodeB compares each message received or to be sent by the eNodeB. The content consists of 0 to 100 hexadecimal digits. Do not change the setting of this parameter without the guidance from Huawei Customer Service Center.

parameters.name: Match Field Offset 2
parameters.description: Indicates the offset for the matching field used when the eNodeB compares each message received or to be sent by the eNodeB with the debugging message. Do not change the setting of this parameter without the guidance from Huawei Customer Service Center.

parameters.name: Match Length 2
parameters.description: Indicates the length of information used by the eNodeB to compare each message received or to be sent by the eNodeB with the debugging message. Do not change the setting of this parameter without the guidance from Huawei Customer Service Center.

parameters.name: Match Content 2
parameters.description: Indicates the content with which the eNodeB compares each message received or to be sent by the eNodeB. The content consists of 0 to 100 hexadecimal digits. Do not change the setting of this parameter without the guidance from Huawei Customer Service Center.

parameters.name: Match Field Offset 3
parameters.description: Indicates the offset for the matching field used when the eNodeB compares each message received or to be sent by the eNodeB with the debugging message. Do not change the setting of this parameter without the guidance from Huawei Customer Service Center.

parameters.name: Match Length 3
parameters.description: Indicates the length of information used by the eNodeB to compare each message received or to be sent by the eNodeB with the debugging message. Do not change the setting of this parameter without the guidance from Huawei Customer Service Center.

parameters.name: Match Content 3
parameters.description: Indicates the content with which the eNodeB compares each message received or to be sent by the eNodeB. The content consists of 0 to 100 hexadecimal digits. Do not change the setting of this parameter without the guidance from Huawei Customer Service Center.

parameters.name: Modify Count
parameters.description: Indicates the number of items in the debugging message for modification. Each item contains the offset, length, and content. The value ZERO indicates that the eNodeB does not modify the messages with a positive matching result. The value ONE indicates that the eNodeB makes one modification to the messages with a positive matching result. The value TWO indicates that the eNodeB makes two modificati

parameters.name: Modify Field Offset 1
parameters.description: Indicates the offset for the modification field used when the eNodeB modifies a message received or to be sent by the eNodeB. Do not change the setting of this parameter without the guidance from Huawei Customer Service Center.

parameters.name: Modify Length 1
parameters.description: Indicates the modification length used when the eNodeB modifies a message received or to be sent by the eNodeB. Do not change the setting of this parameter without the guidance from Huawei Customer Service Center.

parameters.name: Modify Content 1
parameters.description: Indicates the modification content used when the eNodeB modifies a message received or to be sent by the eNodeB. The modification content consists of 0 to 100 hexadecimal digits. Do not change the setting of this parameter without the guidance from Huawei Customer Service Center.

parameters.name: Modify Field Offset 2
parameters.description: Indicates the offset for the modification field used when the eNodeB modifies a message received or to be sent by the eNodeB. Do not change the setting of this parameter without the guidance from Huawei Customer Service Center.

parameters.name: Modify Length 2
parameters.description: Indicates the modification length used when the eNodeB modifies a message received or to be sent by the eNodeB. Do not change the setting of this parameter without the guidance from Huawei Customer Service Center.

parameters.name: Modify Content 2
parameters.description: Indicates the modification content used when the eNodeB modifies a message received or to be sent by the eNodeB. The modification content consists of 0 to 100 hexadecimal digits. Do not change the setting of this parameter without the guidance from Huawei Customer Service Center.

parameters.name: Modify Field Offset 3
parameters.description: Indicates the offset for the modification field used when the eNodeB modifies a message received or to be sent by the eNodeB. Do not change the setting of this parameter without the guidance from Huawei Customer Service Center.

parameters.name: Modify Length 3
parameters.description: Indicates the modification length used when the eNodeB modifies a message received or to be sent by the eNodeB. Do not change the setting of this parameter without the guidance from Huawei Customer Service Center.

parameters.name: Modify Content 3
parameters.description: Indicates the modification content used when the eNodeB modifies a message received or to be sent by the eNodeB. The modification content consists of 0 to 100 hexadecimal digits. Do not change the setting of this parameter without the guidance from Huawei Customer Service Center.

parameters.name: UE Capability Index
parameters.description: Indicates the UE capability index. This parameter is mapped to the UeCapIndex parameter in the UeInfo MO. The index must be set if the UeInfoType parameter is set to UE_CAPABILITY.

parameters.name: Match Content Extension
parameters.description: Indicates the extended content with which the eNodeB compares each message received or to be sent by the eNodeB. This parameter is an advanced parameter. Do not change the setting of this parameter without the guidance from Huawei Customer Service Center.

parameters.name: Local Cell ID
parameters.description: Indicates the local ID of the cell. It uniquely identifies a cell within the local or peer base station. This parameter applies only to NB-IoT.

parameters.name: Access Period
parameters.description: Indicates the period of abnormal RRC connection setup. This parameter applies only to NB-IoT.

parameters.name: Access Period Offset
parameters.description: Indicates the offset to the period of abnormal RRC connection setup. This parameter applies only to NB-IoT.

parameters.name: TA
parameters.description: Indicates the TA value of abnormal RRC connection setup. This parameter applies only to NB-IoT.

parameters.name: TA Offset
parameters.description: Indicates the offset to the TA value of abnormal RRC connection setup. This parameter applies only to NB-IoT.

parameters.name: IPv6 ACL ID
parameters.description: Indicates the ID of the IPv6 ACL to which an IPv6 ACL rule belongs. An IPv6 ACL rule with an ACL ID ranging from 3000 to 3999 indicates a high-level rule based on the layer 3 and layer 4 information configured by users. An IPv6 ACL rule with an ACL ID ranging from 7000 to 7999 indicates a high-level rule based on the layer 3 and layer 4 information configured by the system.

parameters.name: Description
parameters.description: Indicates the brief description of an IPv6 ACL.

parameters.name: Control Mode
parameters.description: Indicates whether an object can be modified or deleted by the system. The value MANUAL_MODE means that only users can modify or delete the object. The value AUTO_MODE means only the system can modify or delete the object.

parameters.name: Auto Config Flag
parameters.description: Indicates whether an object is created by the system. The value MANUAL_CREATED means that the object is manually configured by a user. The value AUTO_CREATED means that the object is created by the system.

parameters.name: IPv6 ACL ID
parameters.description: Indicates the ID of an IPv6 access control list (ACL) to which the IPv6 access control rule belongs.

parameters.name: IPv6 Rule ID
parameters.description: Indicates the ID of an IPv6 ACL rule. The values 1 to 65535 indicate IPv6 ACL rules configured by users. The values 65431 to 65536 indicate the IPv6 ACL rules automatically generated during DHCP detection. The values 70000 to 79999 indicate packet filtering IPv6 ACL rules configured by the system (packet filtering ACL rules are not supported in IPv6 configuration currently). The values 80000 to 89

parameters.name: IPv6 ACL Action
parameters.description: Indicates the action taken on the data that matches an IPv6 ACL rule. When the IPv6 ACL rule is referenced by an IPv6 IPSec policy, the BS encrypts or decrypts the data that matches the rule if this parameter is set to PERMIT, and does not encrypt or decrypt the data if this parameter is set to DENY.

parameters.name: Protocol Type
parameters.description: Indicates the protocol type of the data to which an IPv6 ACL rule is applied.

parameters.name: Source IPv6 Address
parameters.description: Indicates the source IPv6 address of data to which an IPv6 ACL rule is applied.

parameters.name: Source Address Prefix Length
parameters.description: Indicates the prefix length of a source IPv6 address. The prefix length is used to determine which bits must be compared for matching when IPv6 address matching is being performed.

parameters.name: Match Source Port
parameters.description: Indicates whether to check the source port number of each data stream before applying an ACL rule.

parameters.name: Source Port Operate
parameters.description: Indicates the filter criteria for a source port. If this parameter is set to OP_LT, the ACL rule is applied to the data stream whose source port number is smaller than or equal to the configured port number. If this parameter is set to OP_GT, the ACL rule is applied to the data stream whose source port number is larger than or equal to the configured port number. If this parameter is set to OP_EQ,

parameters.name: Source Port 1
parameters.description: Indicates the source port number used when SMPT is set to YES. If SOP is set to OP_RANGE, this parameter indicates the smallest source port number. If SOP is not set to OP_RANGE, this parameter indicates a specific source port number.

parameters.name: Source Port 2
parameters.description: Indicates the source port number used when SMPT is set to YES. If SOP is set to OP_RANGE, this parameter indicates the largest source port number. This parameter is valid only when SOP is set to OP_RANGE.

parameters.name: Destination IPv6 Address
parameters.description: Indicates the destination IPv6 address of the data to which an IPv6 ACL rule is applied.

parameters.name: Destination Address Prefix Length
parameters.description: Indicates the prefix length of a destination IPv6 address. The prefix length is used to determine which bits must be compared for matching when IPv6 address matching is being performed.

parameters.name: Match Destination Port
parameters.description: Indicates whether to check the destination port number of each data stream before applying an ACL rule.

parameters.name: Destination Port Operate
parameters.description: Indicates the filter criteria for a destination port. This parameter is valid only when DMPT is set to YES. If this parameter is set to OP_LT, the ACL rule is applied to the data stream whose destination port number is smaller than or equal to the configured port number. If this parameter is set to OP_GT, the ACL rule is applied to the data stream whose destination port number is larger than or eq

parameters.name: Destination Port 1
parameters.description: Indicates the destination port number used when DMPT is set to YES. If DOP is set to OP_RANGE, this parameter indicates the smallest destination port number. If DOP is not set to OP_RANGE, this parameter indicates a specific destination port number.

parameters.name: Destination Port 2
parameters.description: Indicates the destination port number used when DMPT is set to YES. If DOP is set to OP_RANGE, this parameter indicates the largest destination port number. This parameter is valid only when DOP is set to OP_RANGE.

parameters.name: Match DSCP
parameters.description: Indicates whether to check the DSCP of each data stream before applying an IPv6 ACL rule.

parameters.name: DSCP
parameters.description: Indicates the DSCP that complies with an IPv6 ACL rule.

parameters.name: Control Mode
parameters.description: Indicates whether an object can be modified or deleted by the system. The value MANUAL_MODE means that only the user can modify or delete the object. The value AUTO_MODE means only the system can modify or delete the object.

parameters.name: Auto Config Flag
parameters.description: Indicates whether the object is created by the system. MANUAL_CREATED means that the object is configured by the user manually. AUTO_CREATED means that the object is created by the system.

parameters.name: Number of ACL6 Rules
parameters.description: Indicates the number of rules in the ACL6.

parameters.name: Minimum ACL6 Rule ID
parameters.description: Indicates the smallest rule ID in the ACL6. This parameter takes effect only when the number of rules in an ACL6 is greater than 0.

parameters.name: Maximum ACL6 Rule ID
parameters.description: Indicates the largest rule ID in the ACL6. This parameter takes effect only when the number of rules in an ACL6 is greater than 0.

parameters.name: ANR delete cell threshold
parameters.description: Indicates the threshold for removing a neighbor relationship with a cell by ANR based on the handover success rate. The threshold is the percentage of the number of successful handovers to the total number of handovers from the local cell to the neighboring cell. For example, an external cell has been configured as a neighboring cell for each cell served by the eNodeB, automatic removal of these n

parameters.name: Least Handover Num for Statistic
parameters.description: Indicates the threshold (expressed as the total number of handover attempts to a neighboring cell) above which ANR determines whether to remove the neighbor relationship with this cell from the NRT or set the NoHoFlag parameter for this cell to FORBID_HO_ENUM on the basis of the handover success rate. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: Statistic cycle
parameters.description: Indicates the length of a measurement period within which the handover success rate is collected for ANR to determine whether to remove neighbor relationships or set NoHoFlag for neighboring cells to FORBID_HO_ENUM. It is recommended that this parameter be set to a multiple of 5. If this parameter is not set to a multiple of 5, the actually effective parameter value is extended to a multiple of 5.

parameters.name: Specified Service Cell Query Switch
parameters.description: Indicates whether to query specified-service cells for ANR. Set this parameter based on the operator policy. SPEC_CELL_FLAG_QUERY_SW: Indicates whether the eNodeB checks with the MAE whether a newly added external cell is a specified-service cell. If this option is selected, the eNodeB checks with the MAE whether a newly added external cell is a specified-service cell. If this option is deselected

parameters.name: Fast ANR PCI report amount
parameters.description: Indicates the number of periodic measurement reports sent for fast ANR. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: Fast ANR PCI report interval
parameters.description: Indicates the interval at which periodic measurement reports are sent for fast ANR. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: Fast ANR checking period
parameters.description: Indicates the fast ANR checking timer. When the timer is expired, the eNodeB automatically checks whether to disable fast ANR. It is recommended that this parameter be set to a multiple of 5. If this parameter is not set to a multiple of 5, the actually effective parameter value is extended to a multiple of 5. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: Fast ANR measurement RSRP threshold
parameters.description: Indicates the RSRP threshold for intra-RAT fast ANR. If the signal quality in a neighboring E-UTRAN cell reported by a UE is lower than this threshold, the cell is not automatically added as an external cell of the eNodeB. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.id: IntraRat Fast ANR measurement UE number
parameters.name: IntraRat Fast ANR measurement UE number
parameters.description: Indicates the maximum allowed number of UEs performing intra-RAT measurements for fast ANR. After the number of UEs performing intra-RAT measurements for fast ANR reaches the maximum number, no more UEs will perform intra-RAT measurements for fast ANR. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.id: InterRat Fast ANR measurement UE number
parameters.name: InterRat Fast ANR measurement UE number
parameters.description: Indicates the maximum allowed number of UEs performing inter-RAT measurements for fast ANR. After the number of UEs performing inter-RAT measurements for fast ANR reaches the maximum number, no more UEs will perform inter-RAT measurements for fast ANR. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.id: IntraRat Fast ANR valid measurement min UE number
parameters.name: IntraRat Fast ANR valid measurement min UE number
parameters.description: Indicates the threshold above which the eNodeB enters the monitoring state for intra-RAT fast ANR. The threshold is expressed as the number of UEs that have performed measurements for intra-RAT fast ANR. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.id: InterRat Fast ANR valid measurement min UE number
parameters.name: InterRat Fast ANR valid measurement min UE number
parameters.description: Indicates the threshold above which the eNodeB enters the monitoring state for inter-RAT fast ANR. The threshold is expressed as the number of UEs that have performed measurements for inter-RAT fast ANR. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: Optimization Mode
parameters.description: Indicates the mode in which the ANR algorithm works. If this parameter is set to FREE, the eNodeB automatically optimizes neighbor relationships using ANR. If this parameter is set to CONTROLLED, the eNodeB reports the neighbor relationships to be optimized to the MAE and the optimization is subject to manual confirmation. However, whether the eNodeB reports neighbor relationships with E-UTRAN cel

parameters.name: Statistic Cycle For Delete NRT
parameters.description: Indicates the intra-RAT neighbor relationship removal evaluation period during which the eNodeB collects statistics on whether an intra-RAT neighboring cell has been detected by UEs and the number of handovers to the intra-RAT neighboring cell. The eNodeB uses the statistics to determine whether to remove the neighbor relationship when the number of neighbor relationships in the intra-RAT NRT has

parameters.name: Statistic Number For Delete NRT
parameters.description: Indicates the threshold of the total number of handovers from the local cell to all intra-RAT neighboring cells, above which the eNodeB determines whether to remove neighbor relationships from a full intra-RAT NRT or whether to periodically remove redundant neighbor relationships from an intra-RAT NRT. parameters.id: ANR Active PCI Conflict Detection Switch
parameters.name: ANR Active PCI Conflict Detection Switch
parameters.description: Indicates the switch used to enable or disable proactive PCI conflict detection. Within a specified duration after this switch is turned on, the eNodeB delivers measurement configurations for proactive PCI conflict detection to UEs that meet specific requirements. Then, the eNodeB starts the detection based on the measurement reports from the UEs. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD

parameters.name: Start time
parameters.description: Indicates the time the eNodeB starts PCI conflict detection or neighboring cell blacklist management. If the end time is the same as or earlier than the start time, the detection or management ends at the specified end time on the next day. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: Stop time
parameters.description: Indicates the time the eNodeB stops PCI conflict detection or neighboring cell blacklist management. If the end time is the same as or earlier than the start time, the detection or management ends at the specified end time on the next day. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: UTRAN Fast ANR RSCP threshold
parameters.description: Indicates the received signal code power (RSCP) threshold for fast ANR with UTRAN. If the signal quality in a neighboring UTRAN cell reported by a UE is lower than this threshold, the cell is not automatically added as an external cell of the eNodeB. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: GERAN Fast ANR RSSI threshold
parameters.description: Indicates the received signal strength indicator (RSSI) threshold for fast ANR with GERAN. If the signal quality in a neighboring GERAN cell reported by a UE is lower than this threshold, the cell is not automatically added as an external cell of the eNodeB. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: Set not handover attribute threshold
parameters.description: Indicates the handover success rate threshold based on which ANR automatically sets NoHoFlag of a neighboring cell to FORBID_HO_ENUM. The threshold is the ratio of the number of successful handovers to the total number of handover attempts from the local cell to the neighboring cell. parameters.name: Handover threshold for delete NRT
parameters.description: Indicates a threshold for removing a neighbor relationship from an E-UTRAN NRT. When the NRT reaches its capacity and ANR needs to add a new neighbor relationship to the NRT, ANR removes an old neighbor relationship with a cell from the NRT if the number of handovers to this cell is less than the threshold. parameters.name: Fast ANR Mode
parameters.description: Indicates the policy based on which fast ANR adds detected cells to NCLs and NRTs. If this parameter is set to NCL_MODE, fast ANR adds a detected cell that meets certain conditions to an NCL only. parameters.name: Event ANR Mode
parameters.description: Indicates the policy based on which intra-RAT event-triggered ANR and event-triggered ANR with NR add neighbor relationships to NRTs. If this parameter is set to BASED_NCL, intra-RAT event-triggered ANR and event-triggered ANR with NR add neighbor relationships to NRTs based on NCLs. parameters.name: CA UE Chose Mode
parameters.description: Indicates the policy based on which the eNodeB selects CA UEs to perform CGI reading for ANR (excluding event-triggered ANR based on CA measurements or NSA DC measurements). If this parameter is set to CA_UE_CAP, the eNodeB does not select the CA UEs that support the CA bands in the CA band combinations supported by the eNodeB. parameters.name: Anr Controlled Handover Strategy
parameters.description: Indicates whether the eNodeB can initiate handovers to a newly detected neighboring cell, with which the neighbor relationship is to be processed by the MAE. When the OptMode parameter in the ANR MO is set to CONTROLLED, the eNodeB reports the newly detected neighboring cell to the MAE for manual confirmation. parameters.name: Smart Preallocation Mode
parameters.description: Indicates whether smart preallocation takes effect during ANR-triggered CGI reading. When SmartPreAllocationSwitch of the UlSchSwitch parameter is on, setting this parameter to DISABLE indicates that smart preallocation does not take effect, and setting this parameter to ENABLE indicates that smart preallocation takes effect. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: No Handover Set Mode
parameters.description: Indicates whether the eNodeB directly sets NoHoFlag to FORBID_HO_ENUM for an intra-RAT neighboring cell or a neighboring NG-RAN cell if the neighboring cell meets the requirements on the number of handover attempts from the local cell to the neighboring cell and the handover success rate within a specified measurement period. parameters.name: Utran Event ANR Mode
parameters.description: Indicates the policy based on which event-triggered ANR with UTRAN adds neighbor relationships to NRTs. If this parameter is set to BASED_NCL, this type of ANR adds neighbor relationships to NRTs based on NCLs. If this parameter is set to NOT_BASED_NCL, this type of ANR adds neighbor relationships to NRTs based on CGIs reported by UEs. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: Geran Event ANR Mode
parameters.description: Indicates the policy based on which inter-RAT event-triggered ANR with GERAN adds neighbor relationships to NRTs. If this parameter is set to BASED_NCL, event-triggered ANR with GERAN adds neighbor relationships to NRTs based on the NCL. parameters.name: Event ANR With VoIP Mode
parameters.description: Indicates whether the eNodeB selects VoLTE UEs to perform ANR-related measurements. This parameter includes the following options: UTRAN_EVENT_ANR_WITH_VOIP_MODE: The eNodeB selects UEs with QCI 1 bearers to perform measurements for event-triggered ANR with UTRAN only if this option is selected. parameters.name: UTRAN Event ANR CGI Timer
parameters.description: Indicates the length of the timer of CGI reading for event-triggered ANR with UTRAN. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: GERAN Event ANR CGI Timer
parameters.description: Indicates the length of the timer of CGI reading for event-triggered ANR with GERAN. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: Utran Handover Threshold for Delete NRT
parameters.description: Indicates a threshold for removing a neighbor relationship from a UTRAN NRT. When the NRT reaches its capacity and ANR needs to add a new neighbor relationship to the NRT, ANR removes an old neighbor relationship with a cell from the NRT if the number of handovers to this cell is less than the threshold. parameters.id: Geran Handover Threshold for Delete NRT
parameters.name: Geran Handover Threshold for Delete NRT
parameters.description: Indicates a threshold for removing a neighbor relationship from a GERAN NRT. When the NRT reaches its capacity and ANR needs to add a new neighbor relationship to the NRT, ANR removes an old neighbor relationship with a cell from the NRT if the number of handovers to this cell is less than the threshold. parameters.name: Neighbor Cell Deletion Punish Period
parameters.description: Indicates the penalty evaluation period for removed neighbor relationships with E-UTRAN, NG-RAN, or UTRAN cells. It is recommended that this parameter be set to a multiple of 5. If this parameter is not set to a multiple of 5, the actually effective parameter value is extended to a multiple of 5. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.id: EUTRAN Neighbor Cell Deletion Punish Number
parameters.name: EUTRAN Neighbor Cell Deletion Punish Number
parameters.description: Indicates the number of penalties on an E-UTRAN cell after the neighbor relationship with the cell is removed. The cell can be added to the NRT again if the number of attempts to add back the neighbor relationship is greater than or equal to the value of this parameter. This parameter is also valid for the penalty on NG-RAN neighboring cells in inter-RAT ANR. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD

parameters.id: UTRAN Neighbor Cell Deletion Punish Number
parameters.name: UTRAN Neighbor Cell Deletion Punish Number
parameters.description: Indicates the number of times penalty statistics about neighboring UTRAN cell deletion are collected. When a neighbor relationship with a UTRAN cell is deleted, it can be added to the NRT again if the number of times neighboring UTRAN cell addition is triggered is greater than or equal to the value of this parameter. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: CA Threshold for NRT Deletion
parameters.description: Indicates the threshold (expressed as a number of times a cell has been configured as an SCell) used for neighbor relationship removal when the number of NRT entries has reached its maximum and a new neighbor relationship needs to be added. parameters.id: Handover Success Rate for CGI Reading
parameters.name: Handover Success Rate for CGI Reading
parameters.description: Indicates the handover success rate threshold for reading the CGI of a neighboring cell. If the handover success rate from the local cell to a neighboring cell is less than or equal to this parameter value, the function of automatically setting the No HO attribute instructs UEs to read the CGI of the neighboring cell. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.id: Stat Period For Inter-RAT Nrt Deletion
parameters.name: Stat Period For Inter-RAT Nrt Deletion

parameters.name: Period for Neighboring Cell Ranking
parameters.description: Indicates the period for automatic optimization on neighboring cell measurement priorities. The neighboring cell measurement priorities are determined based on the number of times each neighboring cell is measured within the optimization period. parameters.name: Statistic Cycle Coefficient
parameters.description: Indicates the number of consecutive evaluation periods, specified by the StaPeriodForIRatNRTDel or StatisticPeriodForNRTDel parameter, for removal of redundant neighbor relationships. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: Fast ANR Monitoring State Period
parameters.description: Indicates the monitoring state period of fast ANR. During monitoring state periods, the eNodeB does not select new UEs for fast ANR measurements. If a neighboring cell with an unknown PCI is reported for event-triggered ANR during a monitoring state period, fast ANR exits the monitoring state and a new measurement period for fast ANR starts. If this parameter is set to 0, fast ANR does not enter t

parameters.name: NR Fast ANR RSRP Threshold
parameters.description: Indicates the RSRP threshold used in fast ANR with NR. If the UE-reported RSRP of an NR cell is lower than this threshold, the eNodeB does not automatically add this NR cell to the NCL or NRT. If this parameter is set to a value other than 0, fast ANR with NR is enabled, and an NR NRT is created and optimized based on the results of periodic NR measurements. If this parameter is set to 0, fast ANR

parameters.name: NR FR2 CGI Reading Timer
parameters.description: Indicates the length of the timer for ANR-triggered CGI reading of cells on the FR2 frequency of the NR system. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.id: Intrafreq Measure Time to Trigger for ANR
parameters.name: Intrafreq Measure Time to Trigger for ANR
parameters.description: Indicates the time-to-trigger for the ANR-based intra-frequency measurement event A3. When a UE detects that the signal quality in the serving cell and that in at least one intra-frequency neighboring cell meets the entering condition, it does not immediately send an ANR-based measurement report to the eNodeB. Instead, the UE sends a report only when the signal quality meets the entering condition

parameters.name: Intrafreq Hysteresis for ANR
parameters.description: Indicates the hysteresis for the ANR-based intra-frequency measurement event. This parameter is used to decrease the number of invalid decisions on triggering intra-frequency ANR due to radio signal fluctuations. This parameter must be set to a value less than or equal to the hysteresis for intra-frequency handovers. This parameter applies only to LTE TDD.

parameters.name: Intrafreq Measure Offset for ANR
parameters.description: Indicates the offset for the signal quality in a neighboring cell relative to that in the serving cell in the ANR-based intra-frequency measurement. A large value indicates that a neighboring cell must have a noticeably better quality than the serving cell before ANR measurement reports can be sent. This parameter must be set to a value less than or equal to the offset for intra-frequency handover

parameters.id: Interfreq Measure Time to Trigger for ANR
parameters.name: Interfreq Measure Time to Trigger for ANR
parameters.description: Indicates the time-to-trigger for the ANR-based inter-frequency measurement event. When a UE detects that the signal quality in the serving cell and that in at least one inter-frequency neighboring cell meets the entering condition, it does not immediately send an ANR-based measurement report to the eNodeB. Instead, the UE sends a report only when the signal quality meets the entering condition th

parameters.name: Interfreq Hysteresis for ANR
parameters.description: Indicates the hysteresis for the ANR-based inter-frequency measurement event. This parameter is used to decrease the number of invalid decisions on triggering inter-frequency ANR due to radio signal fluctuations. This parameter must be set to a value smaller less than or equal to the InterFreqHoA4Hyst parameter. This parameter applies only to LTE TDD.

parameters.name: Interfreq RSRP Threshold for ANR
parameters.description: Indicates the RSRP threshold for triggering the ANR-based inter-frequency measurement event. When the measured RSRP value exceeds this threshold, an ANR-based inter-frequency measurement report is sent. This parameter must be set to a value less than or equal to the RSRP threshold for coverage-based inter-frequency handovers. This parameter applies only to LTE TDD.

parameters.name: Accelerate Service Para Group ID
parameters.description: Indicates the acceleration service guarantee parameter group ID. Acceleration service guarantee parameters differ depending on acceleration service guarantee parameter groups.

parameters.name: Accelerate Service Prealloc Duration
parameters.description: Indicates the maximum duration for the preallocation of acceleration services. When this parameter is used for air interface acceleration guarantee, it indicates the preallocation duration for guaranteed UEs. When this parameter is set to a value within the range of 0-60000, it indicates the actual preallocation duration. When this parameter is set to 65535, preallocation is not stopped until guar

parameters.name: Accelerate Service Prealloc Min Period
parameters.description: Indicates the minimum preallocation interval for acceleration services.

parameters.name: Accelerate Service Prealloc Pkt Size
parameters.description: Indicates the amount of data pre-allocated for acceleration services.

parameters.name: Accelerate Service Schedule Priority Factor
parameters.description: Indicates the weighting factor used to calculate scheduling priorities for acceleration services. This parameter is used to preferentially guarantee services for acceleration guarantee UEs. This parameter is shared in the uplink and downlink. For FDD cells: If this parameter is set to a value in the range of 1 to 999, the priority is calculated using the specified weighting factor. If this paramet

parameters.id: Accelerate Service NACK CQI Adj Value
parameters.name: Accelerate Service NACK CQI Adj Value
parameters.description: Indicates the decrease in the CQI adjustment value when an acceleration guarantee UE returns an NACK message. If this parameter is set to a non-zero value, the outer-loop CQI adjustment value decreases by the value of this parameter. If this parameter is set to 0, the optimization does not take effect. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: Acceleration Service Optimization Switch
parameters.description: Indicates whether to enable the acceleration service optimization algorithm. ENTER_DRX_SWITCH: Indicates whether to enable DRX for acceleration guarantee UEs. If this option is deselected, DRX is disabled for acceleration guarantee UEs. If this option is selected, the eNodeB does not perform special processing on the DRX function for acceleration guarantee UEs. This option applies only to LTE FDD

parameters.name: Acceleration Service UE Inactivity Timer
parameters.description: Indicates the length of the UE inactivity timer for only acceleration-involved UEs that do not have QCI-1 services and which this parameter group applies to. If the eNodeB detects that such a UE has neither received nor sent data throughout a period specified by this timer, the eNodeB releases the RRC connection for the UE. If the parameter is set to 0, the eNodeB does not release the RRC connecti

parameters.name: BBP Assist Group Id
parameters.description: Indicates the ID of an LTE BBP assistance group. It uniquely identifies an LTE BBP assistance group. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: Master Board Cabinet No.
parameters.description: Indicates the cabinet number of the master baseband processing unit (BBP) in a user-created LTE BBP assistance group. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: Master Board Subrack No.
parameters.description: Indicates the subrack number of the master baseband processing unit (BBP) in a user-created LTE BBP assistance group. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: Master Board Slot No.
parameters.description: Indicates the slot number of the master baseband processing unit (BBP) in a user-created LTE BBP assistance group. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: Assist Board Cabinet No.
parameters.description: Indicates the cabinet number of the assistant baseband processing unit (BBP) in a user-created LTE BBP assistance group. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: Assist Board Subrack No.
parameters.description: Indicates the subrack number of the assistant baseband processing unit (BBP) in a user-created LTE BBP assistance group. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: Assist Board Slot No.
parameters.description: Indicates the slot number of the assistant baseband processing unit (BBP) in a user-created LTE BBP assistance group. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: Assist Start Time
parameters.description: Indicates the assistance start time of a user-created LTE BBP assistance group. When the time specified by this parameter arrives, the eNodeB transfers a cell from the master BBP in the assistance group to the assistant BBP to assist the master BBP. When the start time arrives, a cell on the master BBP will be deactivated and reactivated. You are advised to set this parameter to a time when there

parameters.name: Cell Load Stat Period
parameters.description: Indicates the period of collecting load statistics of the cells established on the master BBP in an LTE BBP assistance group. When the specified assistance start time arrives and load statistics of the cells established on the master BBP have been collected for at least one period, the eNodeB selects one cell on the master BBP based on the load statistics and related algorithm and transfers the se

parameters.name: Assist Status
parameters.description: Indicates the status of an LTE BBP assistance group. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: Failed Reason
parameters.description: Indicates the cause of the last failure to transfer a cell from the master BBP to the assistant BBP in an LTE BBP assistance group. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: BBP Collaboration Group ID
parameters.description: Indicates the BBP collaboration group ID. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: Inventory Baseband Equipment ID
parameters.description: Indicates the ID of the inventory baseband equipment associated with a BBP collaboration group. When a BBP collaboration group is created, an inventory BBP in a BBU is added to the inventory baseband equipment and the ID of the inventory baseband equipment is associated with the ID of the BBP collaboration group. In this way, an inventory BBP is added to the BBP collaboration group. This parameter

parameters.name: Collaborating Baseband Equipment ID
parameters.description: Indicates the ID of the collaborating baseband equipment associated with a BBP collaboration group. When a BBP collaboration group is created, a collaborating BBP in a BBU is added to the collaborating baseband equipment and the ID of the collaborating baseband equipment is associated with the ID of the BBP collaboration group. In this way, a collaborating BBP is added to the BBP collaboration gro

parameters.name: Collaborating Features
parameters.description: Indicates the feature that a BBP collaboration group supports. The feature is specified when the group is created. Currently, only the Turbo Receiver feature is supported. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: Collaboration Group Block Indication
parameters.description: Indicates the blocking method of a baseband processing unit (BBP) collaboration group. If this parameter is set to HIGH_PRIORITY_BLOCK(HIGH_PRIORITY_BLOCK), the UEs transferred from inventory BBPs to collaborating BBPs for assistance are immediately released. parameters.name: Collaborating Group Status
parameters.description: Indicates the status of a BBP collaboration group. The status can be normal, blocked, being blocked, or being punished, or the group may experience board faults, configuration errors, or board blocking. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: Local cell ID
parameters.description: Indicates the local ID of the cell. It uniquely identifies a cell within a BS.

parameters.name: Modification period coefficient
parameters.description: Indicates the modification period coefficient for the BCCH. The BCCH modification period is equal to Modification period coefficient multiplied by Default paging cycle, where the BCCH modification period and default paging cycle are measured in unit of radio frames, and the modification period coefficient is specified by this parameter. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: NB-IoT Modification Period Coefficient
parameters.description: Indicates the BCCH modification period coefficient of an NB-IoT cell. The BCCH modification period is equal to Modification period coefficient of an NB-IoT cell multiplied by Default paging cycle, where the BCCH modification period and default paging cycle are measured in unit of radio frames, and the modification period coefficient of an NB-IoT cell is specified by this parameter. This parameter

parameters.name: Device No.
parameters.description: Indicates the device number of a beamforming antenna. It uniquely identifies a beamforming antenna within an eNodeB. This parameter is associated with the WeightNO parameter in the eUCellSectorEqm MO. If the WeightNO parameter in the eUCellSectorEqm MO is set to 255, the weight corresponding to the smallest DeviceNo parameter value is used. This parameter applies only to LTE TDD.

parameters.name: Manufactory
parameters.description: Indicates the manufacturer of a beamforming antenna. This parameter applies only to LTE TDD.

parameters.name: CRS Split Beam Indicator
parameters.description: Indicates a split beam for the CRS of a cell from a split. If this parameter is set to a value ranging from 0 to 7, the eNodeB uses the split beam specified by this parameter to transmit the CRS of the soft split cell. parameters.name: Vertical Beam Width
parameters.description: Indicates the vertical beam width. This parameter only applies to LTE TDD cells.

parameters.name: Connect RRU cabinet No.
parameters.description: Indicates the cabinet number of the RRU to which a beamforming antenna is connected. This parameter applies only to LTE TDD.

parameters.name: Connect RRU subrack No.
parameters.description: Indicates the subrack number of the RRU to which a beamforming antenna is connected. This parameter applies only to LTE TDD.

parameters.name: Connect RRU slot No.
parameters.description: Indicates the slot number of the RRU to which a beamforming antenna is connected. This parameter applies only to LTE TDD.

parameters.name: Antenna model number
parameters.description: Indicates the model of a beamforming antenna. Set this parameter to RAE if the antenna weight must be queried on the RAE. The value RAE is case-insensitive, while other values are case-sensitive. In massive MIMO broadcast scenarios, this parameter must be set to MassiveAntenna. For details about this parameter setting in split-related and other scenarios, see related FPD documents. This parameter

parameters.name: Tilt
parameters.description: Indicates the integral part of the tilt corresponding to the beamforming weighting value. This parameter is used with the TiltFractionalPart parameter, which indicates the fractional part (tenths) of the tilt. This parameter applies only to LTE TDD.

parameters.name: Beamwidth
parameters.description: Indicates the horizontal beamwidth formed after beamforming. This parameter is not used in massive MIMO scenarios. This parameter applies only to LTE TDD networks.

parameters.name: Band
parameters.description: Indicates the frequency band used by a beamforming antenna. The value 0 is a broad frequency band, indicating that the object weight is applicable to all frequency bands. This parameter applies only to LTE TDD.

parameters.name: Antenna Type
parameters.description: Indicates the type of a beamforming antenna. This parameter applies only to LTE TDD.

parameters.name: BFANTBEARING
parameters.description: Indicates angle at which an antenna deflects the horizontal azimuth of the beam (weight-based deflection relative to the mechanical azimuth). In non-massive MIMO scenarios, this parameter indicates only the degree at which a smart antenna deflects. In massive MIMO scenarios, this parameter indicates the degree at which an antenna deflects. With the mechanical azimuth of the antenna as the normal l

parameters.name: Coverage Scenario
parameters.description: Indicates the coverage scenario of a massive MIMO antenna. This parameter is used to adjust the antenna beam pattern. The values EXPANDSCENARIO_1, EXPANDSCENARIO_2, and EXPANDSCENARIO_3 indicate user-defined coverage scenarios. For 64T64R cells: The vertical beamwidth of a massive MIMO antenna is equivalent to the vertical beamwidth of a single channel, and adjusting the TILT parameter in the BfAn

parameters.name: Tilt Fractional Part
parameters.description: Indicates the fractional part (tenths) of the tilt corresponding to the beamforming weighting value. This parameter is used with the Tilt parameter, which indicates the integral part of the tilt. This parameter applies only to massive MIMO scenarios. This parameter applies only to LTE TDD.

parameters.name: Polar Mode
parameters.description: Indicates the polarization mode of a beamforming antenna. This parameter applies only to LTE TDD.

parameters.name: Element Beamform Width
parameters.description: Indicates the beamwidth of the antenna element.

parameters.name: Number of Port
parameters.description: Indicates the number of antenna ports to which a beamforming antenna is connected. This parameter applies only to LTE TDD.

parameters.id: Amplitude Offset of Physical Port 1 for CRS2
parameters.name: Amplitude Offset of Physical Port 1 for CRS2
parameters.description: Indicates the amplitude offset at physical antenna port 1 when the BF antenna is used and cell-specific reference signals are transmitted from two ports. Each port may consist of multiple physical antenna ports.

parameters.id: Phase of Physical Port 1 for CRS2
parameters.name: Phase of Physical Port 1 for CRS2
parameters.description: Indicates the phase offset at physical antenna port 1 when the BF antenna is used and cell-specific reference signals are transmitted from two ports. Each port may consist of multiple physical antenna ports.

parameters.id: Amplitude Offset of Physical Port 2 for CRS2
parameters.name: Amplitude Offset of Physical Port 2 for CRS2
parameters.description: Indicates the amplitude offset at physical antenna port 2 when the BF antenna is used and cell-specific reference signals are transmitted from two ports. Each port may consist of multiple physical antenna ports.

parameters.id: Phase of Physical Port 2 for CRS2
parameters.name: Phase of Physical Port 2 for CRS2
parameters.description: Indicates the phase offset at physical antenna port 2 when the BF antenna is used and cell-specific reference signals are transmitted from two ports. Each port may consist of multiple physical antenna ports.

parameters.id: Amplitude Offset of Physical Port 3 for CRS2
parameters.name: Amplitude Offset of Physical Port 3 for CRS2
parameters.description: Indicates the amplitude offset at physical antenna port 3 when the BF antenna is used and cell-specific reference signals are transmitted from two ports. Each port may consist of multiple physical antenna ports.

parameters.id: Phase of Physical Port 3 for CRS2
parameters.name: Phase of Physical Port 3 for CRS2
parameters.description: Indicates the phase offset at physical antenna port 3 when the BF antenna is used and cell-specific reference signals are transmitted from two ports. Each port may consist of multiple physical antenna ports.

parameters.id: Amplitude Offset of Physical Port 4 for CRS2
parameters.name: Amplitude Offset of Physical Port 4 for CRS2
parameters.description: Indicates the amplitude offset at physical antenna port 4 when the BF antenna is used and cell-specific reference signals are transmitted from two ports. Each port may consist of multiple physical antenna ports.

parameters.id: Phase of Physical Port 4 for CRS2
parameters.name: Phase of Physical Port 4 for CRS2
parameters.description: Indicates the phase offset at physical antenna port 4 when the BF antenna is used and cell-specific reference signals are transmitted from two ports. Each port may consist of multiple physical antenna ports.

parameters.id: Amplitude Offset of Physical Port 1 for CRS4
parameters.name: Amplitude Offset of Physical Port 1 for CRS4
parameters.description: Indicates the amplitude offset at physical antenna port 1 when the BF antenna is used and cell-specific reference signals are transmitted from four ports. Each port may consist of multiple physical antenna ports.

parameters.id: Phase of Physical Port 1 for CRS4
parameters.name: Phase of Physical Port 1 for CRS4
parameters.description: Indicates the phase offset at physical antenna port 1 when the BF antenna is used and cell-specific reference signals are transmitted from four ports. Each port may consist of multiple physical antenna ports.

parameters.id: Amplitude Offset of Physical Port 2 for CRS4
parameters.name: Amplitude Offset of Physical Port 2 for CRS4
parameters.description: Indicates the amplitude offset at physical antenna port 2 when the BF antenna is used and cell-specific reference signals are transmitted from four ports. Each port may consist of multiple physical antenna ports.

parameters.id: Phase of Physical Port 2 for CRS4
parameters.name: Phase of Physical Port 2 for CRS4
parameters.description: Indicates the phase offset at physical antenna port 2 when the BF antenna is used and cell-specific reference signals are transmitted from four ports. Each port may consist of multiple physical antenna ports.

parameters.name: Channel No.
parameters.description: Indicates the antenna channel information of the cell. This parameter applies only to LTE TDD.

parameters.name: CRS Port No.
parameters.description: Indicates the CRS port number. This parameter applies only to LTE TDD.

parameters.name: Session ID
parameters.description: Indicates the ID of the file transfer session.

parameters.name: Amplitude Offset for CRS
parameters.description: Indicates the amount of amplitude adjustment for cell-specific reference signals when a beamforming antenna is used. This parameter applies only to LTE TDD.

parameters.name: Phase for CRS
parameters.description: Indicates the amount of phase adjustment for cell-specific reference signals when a beamforming antenna is used. This parameter applies only to LTE TDD.

parameters.name: Antenna Weight Information
parameters.description: Indicates the antenna weight information of a beamforming antenna. This parameter applies only to LTE TDD.

parameters.description: Indicates the statistic period for blind neighboring cell optimization. The statistic period is seven days by default. It is recommended that

parameters.description: Indicates the sampling number threshold of handovers from an E-UTRAN cell to neighboring cells. parameters.name: Handover Success Ratio Threshold
parameters.description: Indicates the outgoing handover success rate threshold for determining whether a neighboring cell can be selected as a candidate cell in blind handovers. parameters.name: CSFB Handover Attemption Ratio Threshold
parameters.description: Indicates the CSFB-triggered measurement-based handover attempt ratio threshold for determining whether a neighboring cell can be selected as a candidate cell in blind handovers. parameters.description: Indicates the blind handover success rate threshold for determining whether a neighboring cell selected as a candidate cell in blind handovers can remain as a candidate cell in blind handovers. parameters.description: Indicates the mode of blind-handover priority optimization. parameters.name: VRF Index
parameters.description: Indicates the index of a VRF instance.

parameters.name: Peer IPv6 Address
parameters.description: Indicates the peer IPv6 address of a blocked SCTP link.

parameters.name: CA Group Identity
parameters.description: Indicates the identity of the CA group. It uniquely identifies a CA group within an eNodeB. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: CA Group Type Indication
parameters.description: Indicates the type of the CA group. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.description: Indicates the operators of which CA is allowed in cells of the group specified by the CaGroup.CaGroupId parameter. The characters in sequence in the parameter value correspond to the operator indexes of the local eNodeB. A character can be either 0 or 1.
