parameters.name: CA Group Identity
parameters.description: Indicates the identity of the CA group. It uniquely identifies a CA group within an eNodeB. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: Local Cell ID
parameters.description: Indicates the local cell ID. It uniquely identifies a cell within an eNodeB. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: eNodeB ID
parameters.description: Indicates the ID of the eNodeB serving the cell. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: Preferred PCell Priority
parameters.description: Indicates the priority of the cell being treated as a primary serving cell (PCell). A larger parameter value represents a higher priority level. This parameter is valid only if the IdleModePccAnchorSwitch(IdleModePccAnchorSwitch), PccAnchorSwitch(PccAnchorSwitch), or EnhancedPccAnchorSwitch(EnhancedPccAnchorSwitch) option of the CaAlgoSwitch parameter is selected. This parameter applies only to LT

parameters.name: PCell A4 RSRP Threshold
parameters.description: Indicates the reference signal received power (RSRP) threshold for triggering event A4 during higher-priority cell evaluation for PCell selection in scenarios where CA is configured based on CA groups. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: PCell A4 RSRQ Threshold
parameters.description: Indicates the reference signal received quality (RSRQ) threshold for triggering event A4 during higher-priority cell evaluation for PCell selection in scenarios where CA is configured based on CA groups. If the measured RSRQ of an inter-frequency neighboring cell in the CA group is greater than this parameter value, the CA UE reports event A4. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: Carrier Aggregation for Downlink 3CC(TDD)
parameters.description: Indicates whether the license value of the license control item "Carrier Aggregation for Downlink 3CC(TDD)" is consumed for a cell specified by the local cell ID and eNodeB ID. This parameter applies only to LTE TDD.

parameters.name: Flexible CA from Multiple Carriers(TDD)
parameters.description: Indicates whether the license value of the license control item "Flexible CA from Multiple Carriers(TDD)" is consumed for a cell specified by the local cell ID and eNodeB ID. This parameter applies only to LTE TDD.

parameters.name: CA for Downlink 4CC and 5CC (TDD)
parameters.description: Indicates whether the license value of the license control item "Carrier Aggregation for Downlink 4CC and 5CC(TDD)" is consumed for a cell specified by the local cell ID and eNodeB ID. This parameter applies only to LTE TDD.

parameters.name: Carrier Aggregation for Uplink(TDD)
parameters.description: Indicates whether the license value of the license control item "Uplink Carrier Aggregation(TDD)" is consumed for a cell specified by the local cell ID and eNodeB ID. This parameter applies only to LTE TDD.

parameters.name: FDD+TDD Downlink Carrier Aggregation(LTE TDD)
parameters.description: Indicates whether the license value of the license control item "FDD+TDD Downlink Carrier Aggregation(LTE TDD)" is consumed for a cell specified by the local cell ID and eNodeB ID. This parameter applies only to LTE TDD.

parameters.name: FDD+TDD Downlink Carrier Aggregation(LTE FDD)
parameters.description: Indicates whether the license "FDD+TDD Downlink Carrier Aggregation(LTE FDD)" is used by the cell specified by the eNodeB ID and Local Cell ID parameters. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD.

parameters.name: Downlink Carrier Aggregation(TDD)
parameters.description: Indicates whether the license "Downlink Carrier Aggregation(TDD)" is used by the cell specified by the eNodeB ID and Local Cell ID parameters. This parameter applies only to LTE TDD cells.

parameters.name: FDD+TDD Uplink Carrier Aggregation(LTE FDD)
parameters.description: Indicates whether the license "FDD+TDD Uplink Carrier Aggregation(LTE FDD)" is used by the cell specified by the eNodeB ID and Local Cell ID parameters. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD.

parameters.name: FDD+TDD Uplink Carrier Aggregation(LTE TDD)
parameters.description: Indicates whether the license value of the license control item "FDD+TDD Uplink Carrier Aggregation(LTE TDD)" is consumed for a cell specified by the local cell ID and eNodeB ID. This parameter applies only to LTE TDD.

parameters.name: CA for Downlink 4CC and 5CC(FDD)
parameters.description: Indicates whether the license "Carrier Aggregation for Downlink 4CC and 5CC (FDD)" is used by the cell specified by the eNodeB ID and Local Cell ID parameters. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD.

parameters.name: Local cell ID
parameters.description: Indicates the local ID of the cell, which uniquely identifies a cell within an eNodeB. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: SCell eNodeB ID
parameters.description: Indicates the ID of the eNodeB serving the candidate SCell. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: SCell Local Cell ID
parameters.description: Indicates the local cell ID of the candidate SCell. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: SCell Blind Configuration Flag
parameters.description: Indicates whether the candidate SCell can be configured as an SCell for CA UEs in a blind manner. In CA-group-based configuration mode, this parameter takes effect if the SccBlindCfgSwitch option of the CaAlgoSwitch parameter is selected. In adaptive configuration mode, this parameter takes effect regardless of the SccBlindCfgSwitch setting. If this parameter is set to TRUE, the eNodeB can configu

parameters.name: SCell Priority
parameters.description: Indicates the priority of the cell being configured as an SCell. A larger value of this parameter indicates a higher priority level. The value 0 indicates that this cell cannot be configured as an SCell for CA UEs. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: SCell A4 Offset
parameters.description: Indicates the offset to CarrAggrA4ThdRsrp in CA-group-based configuration mode. When a CA UE treats the cell specified by the LocalCellId parameter in the local eNodeB as its PCell, the UE reports event A4 pertaining to the candidate SCell specified by the SCelleNodeBId and SCellLocalCellId parameters to the eNodeB if the RSRP for the candidate SCell exceeds the sum of the CarrAggrA4ThdRsrp and SC

parameters.name: SCell A2 Offset
parameters.description: Indicates the offset to CarrAggrA2ThdRsrp in CA-group-based configuration mode. When a CA UE treats the cell specified by the LocalCellId parameter in the local eNodeB as its PCell, the UE reports event A2 pertaining to the SCell specified by the SCelleNodeBId and SCellLocalCellId parameters to the eNodeB if the RSRP for the SCell falls below the sum of the CarrAggrA2ThdRsrp and SCellA2Offset para

parameters.name: SPID Group ID
parameters.description: Indicates the ID of an SPID group. If this parameter is set to a value ranging from 0 to 255, the candidate SCell cannot be configured as an SCell for UEs in this SPID group. If this parameter is set to 65535, this cell can be configured as an SCell for these UEs. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: Local cell ID
parameters.description: Indicates the local ID of the cell. It uniquely identifies a cell within an eNodeB. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: Carrier Aggregation A2 RSRP threshold
parameters.description: Indicates the RSRP threshold for CA event A2. When the measured RSRP of an SCell is lower than this threshold, event A2 is reported. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: Carrier Aggregation A4 RSRP threshold
parameters.description: Indicates the RSRP threshold for CA event A4. When the measured RSRP of a candidate SCell is greater than this threshold, event A4 is reported. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: Carrier Management Switch
parameters.description: Indicates whether to enable carrier management. If this parameter is set to ON, the eNodeB deactivates SCells for a CA UE when the traffic volume of the CA UE is small or the channel quality of the SCells is poor. If this parameter is set to OFF, an SCell is always active after being activated, unless a radio link failure (RLF) is detected on the SCell. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and L

parameters.name: CA Active Buffer Length Threshold
parameters.description: Indicates the buffer length threshold used to evaluate the activation of an SCell. The SCell can be activated for a CA UE only when its buffered data on the eNodeB exceeds this threshold. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: CA Deactive Buffer Length Threshold
parameters.description: Indicates the buffer length threshold used to evaluate the deactivation of an SCell. The SCell can be deactivated for a CA UE only when its buffered data on the eNodeB is less than this threshold. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: CA Active Buffer Delay Threshold
parameters.description: Indicates the buffer delay threshold used to evaluate the activation of an SCell. The SCell can be activated for a CA UE only when its buffer delay on the eNodeB exceeds this threshold. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: CA Deactive Throughput Threshold
parameters.description: Indicates the throughput threshold used to evaluate the deactivation of an SCell. The SCell can be deactivated for a CA UE only when its throughput is less than the value of this parameter. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: Carrier Aggregation A6 Offset
parameters.description: Indicates the offset for CA event A6. This offset is the difference between the quality of a neighboring cell and that of an SCell. A larger value indicates that a neighboring cell must have a better quality than the SCell before event A6 can be reported. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: SCell Aging Time
parameters.description: Indicates the length of aging time of the SCells that are dynamically configured for CA UEs in a cell in adaptive CA configuration scenarios. If there is no carrier aggregation between an SCell and the PCell within the aging time, the eNodeB cancels the association between the SCell and the PCell. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: CA A6 Report Amount
parameters.description: Indicates the number of periodic measurement reports sent after CA event A6 is triggered. For details, see 3GPP TS 36.331. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: CA A6 Report Interval
parameters.description: Indicates the interval between periodic measurement reports that are sent after CA event A6 is triggered. For details, see 3GPP TS 36.331. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: SCC Deactive CQI Threshold
parameters.description: Indicates the Release-8-equivalent CQI threshold used to evaluate the deactivation of an SCell for a CA UE based on channel quality. If the channel quality of the CA UE is lower than that corresponding to the CQI threshold in single-codeword transmission, the eNodeB deactivates the SCell for the UE. If this parameter is set to 0, the eNodeB does not deactivate SCells based on channel quality. This

parameters.name: SCC Configuration Interval
parameters.description: Indicates the minimum interval after which the eNodeB attempts to configure an SCell again for a CA UE. The interval at which the eNodeB attempts to configure an SCell again for a CA UE must be greater than this value. The eNodeB makes the attempt only if the traffic volume of the UE always meets the SCell activation condition throughout a certain time and the eNodeB fails to configure an SCell fo

parameters.name: Cell Level CA Algorithm Switch
parameters.description: Indicates whether to enable cell-level CA. This parameter provides the following options: CaDl3CCSwitch: Indicates whether to enable aggregation of three component carriers in the downlink. This type of aggregation works only if this option is selected and at least two SccFreqCfg MOs or three CaGroupCell MOs are configured. This option applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD. CaUl2CCSwitch: Indicates

parameters.name: UL CA Time To Trigger
parameters.description: Indicates the time-to-trigger for activating an SCell for a UE in the uplink. If the uplink traffic volume of a CA UE is greater than the ActiveBufferLenThd parameter value throughout the period specified by the UlCaActiveTimeToTrigger parameter, the eNodeB initiates the SCell activation procedure. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: Measurement Cycle of SCell
parameters.description: Indicates the sampling period of the radio resource measurement on SCells by CA UEs when the SCells are deactivated. If the sampling period is not configured, the measurement configuration messages that the eNodeB sends to CA UEs do not contain the IE measCycleSCell. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: Cell Maximum PCC Number
parameters.description: Indicates the maximum number of UEs that are allowed to treat the cell as their PCell. If the number of CA UEs that treat the cell as their PCell has reached the parameter value, no more CA UEs can treat the cell as their PCell. A smaller value of this parameter results in fewer CA UEs that are allowed to treat the cell as their PCell. If this parameter is set to 0, the eNodeB cannot configure the

parameters.id: Offload Threshold of PCC User Number
parameters.name: Offload Threshold of PCC User Number
parameters.description: Indicates the threshold used to determine the PCell high load state for cells. This threshold is used for load-based PCC anchoring and is expressed as a percentage of UEs that treat the cell as their PCell. If the percentage is greater than the threshold, the cell is in the PCell high load state. Otherwise, the cell is in the PCell low load state. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD

parameters.id: A1 RSRP Threshold for Enhanced PCC Anchor
parameters.name: A1 RSRP Threshold for Enhanced PCC Anchor
parameters.description: Indicates the RSRP threshold for event A1 used in enhanced PCC anchoring for RRC_CONNECTED UEs. Event A1 is reported if the measured RSRP value exceeds the threshold. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: Additional Measurement Configuration
parameters.description: Indicates whether the eNodeB can instruct UEs to perform additional measurements to provide more samples for collecting statistics. During Auto Neighbor Group Configuration (ANGC) for CA, if the number of collected samples is insufficient, the eNodeB instructs UEs to perform additional measurements so that the number of samples may reach the preset quantity threshold. If this parameter is set to A

parameters.name: Blind Scell Sample Number
parameters.description: Indicates the minimum required number of A4 and A5 report samples for starting coverage evaluation during ANGC for CA. The eNodeB starts coverage evaluation only if the number of samples reaches or exceeds the value of this parameter. Based on the samples, the eNodeB will calculate the coverage overlap proportion and adds, changes, or clears blind SCell configuration flag settings for neighboring

parameters.name: Optimization Mode
parameters.description: Indicates the working mode of ANGC for CA. If this parameter is set to FREE, the eNodeB automatically adds, changes, or clears blind SCell configuration flag settings for neighboring cells. If this parameter is set to CONTROLLED, the eNodeB reports the optimization advice on the flag settings to the MAE, and operators determine whether to take the advice. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and

parameters.name: Sleep Period
parameters.description: Indicates the sleep period during which ANGC for CA stops working after one round of statistics collection and configuration. The function resumes after the sleep period if the network topology changed during the sleep period. If this parameter is set to 65535, ANGC for CA does not enter the sleep period but periodically works. You are advised to set this parameter to a multiple of 5. If this para

parameters.name: Statistic Period
parameters.description: Indicates the measurement period of ANGC for CA. If the number of samples collected in a period meets the requirement, the eNodeB calculates the coverage overlap proportion and adds, changes, or clears blind SCell configuration flag settings for neighboring cells within the period. If the number of samples collected in the period does not meet the requirement, the eNodeB automatically extends a se

parameters.id: Relaxed Backhaul SCC Deactive CQI Threshold
parameters.name: Relaxed Backhaul SCC Deactive CQI Threshold
parameters.description: Indicates the Release-8-equivalent CQI threshold used to evaluate the deactivation of an SCell for a CA UE based on channel quality in relaxed-backhaul-based CA. If the channel quality of the CA UE is lower than that corresponding to the CQI threshold in single-codeword transmission, the eNodeB deactivates the SCell for the UE. If this parameter is set to 0, the eNodeB does not deactivate SCells b

parameters.id: Relaxed Backhaul Ca Max Component Carrier Number
parameters.name: Relaxed Backhaul Ca Max Component Carrier Number
parameters.description: Indicates the maximum number of component carriers (CCs) that can be aggregated in relaxed backhaul scenarios. If this parameter is set to DL_MASSIVE_CA, the maximum number is eight. This parameter value takes effect only in LTE FDD. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.id: Distribute Cloud BB CA Max Component Carrier Number
parameters.name: Distribute Cloud BB CA Max Component Carrier Number
parameters.description: Indicates the maximum number of component carriers (CCs) that can be aggregated in the distributed Cloud BB architecture. If this parameter is set to DL_MASSIVE_CA, the maximum number is eight. This parameter value takes effect only in LTE FDD. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: CA A2 Time To Trigger
parameters.description: Indicates the time-to-trigger for CA event A2. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: CA A6 Time To Trigger
parameters.description: Indicates the time-to-trigger for CA event A6. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: CA A1 Time To Trigger
parameters.description: Indicates the time-to-trigger for CA event A1. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: CA A4 Time To Trigger
parameters.description: Indicates the time-to-trigger for CA event A4. If the measurement result meets the entering condition of event A4 throughout the time specified by this parameter, the UE reports CA event A4. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: SCC Quiet Time
parameters.description: Indicates the SCC unavailability duration. Some multi-mode UEs (for example, SRLTE/SLTE UEs) periodically stop receiving signals of SCells but detect signals of another RAT in CA scenarios. This causes an increase in the number of residual erroneous blocks in the SCells, triggering SCell deactivation. This parameter is used to ensure that the SCells are not deactivated when such UEs are detecting

parameters.id: FDD TDD Relaxed BH CA DL Max CC Num
parameters.name: FDD TDD Relaxed BH CA DL Max CC Num
parameters.description: Indicates the maximum number of FDD and TDD component carriers (CCs) that can be aggregated in the downlink for FDD+TDD CA in relaxed backhaul scenarios. If this parameter is set to DL0CC, relaxed-backhaul-based downlink FDD+TDD CA is not supported. If this parameter is set to DL2CC, the maximum number is two. If this parameter is set to DL_MASSIVE_CA, the maximum number is eight. This parameter v

parameters.id: FDD TDD CA UL Max CC Number
parameters.name: FDD TDD CA UL Max CC Number
parameters.description: Indicates the maximum number of FDD and TDD component carriers that can be aggregated in the uplink. FDD+TDD CA in the uplink is not supported when this parameter is set to 0CC. If this parameter is set to 2CC(2CC), the maximum number is two. This parameter must be configured only for the PCell. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.id: FDD TDD CA DL Max CC Number
parameters.name: FDD TDD CA DL Max CC Number
parameters.description: Indicates the maximum number of FDD and TDD component carriers (CCs) that can be aggregated in the downlink. If this parameter is set to 2CC, the maximum number is two. If this parameter is set to DL_MASSIVE_CA, the maximum number is eight. The value DL_MASSIVE_CA takes effect only in LTE FDD. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.id: LAA Carrier Aggregation A1 RSRP Threshold
parameters.name: LAA Carrier Aggregation A1 RSRP Threshold
parameters.description: Indicates the RSRP threshold for event A1 of the PCell in LAA CA. If the measured RSRP value exceeds this threshold, an A1 measurement report will be sent. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD. Disuse statement: This parameter will be removed in later versions. Although the configuration interface in this version supports synchronization and delivery of the setting of this parameter, the system

parameters.id: LAA Carrier Aggregation A2 RSRP Threshold
parameters.name: LAA Carrier Aggregation A2 RSRP Threshold
parameters.description: Indicates the RSRP threshold for event A2 of the PCell in LAA CA. If the measured RSRP value is less than this threshold, an A2 measurement report will be sent. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD. Disuse statement: This parameter will be removed in later versions. Although the configuration interface in this version supports synchronization and delivery of the setting of this parameter, the sy

parameters.id: Anchor Policy for FDD and TDD 2CC
parameters.name: Anchor Policy for FDD and TDD 2CC
parameters.description: Indicates whether to prioritize an FDD or TDD CC in PCC anchoring for FDD+TDD 2CC CA. For FDD+TDD 2CC CA, if a TDD CC serves as the PCC for a UE, the UE can obtain the gains brought by downlink beamforming, increasing downlink UE throughput. Therefore, it is recommended that this parameter be set to TDD(TDD). If this parameter is set to NULL(NULL), FDD and TDD CCs are not prioritized in PCC anchor

parameters.id: Anchor Policy for FDD and TDD Multi CC
parameters.name: Anchor Policy for FDD and TDD Multi CC
parameters.description: Indicates whether to prioritize an FDD or TDD CC in PCC anchoring for FDD+TDD multi-CC CA, where the number of CCs is greater than or equal to three. For FDD+TDD multi-CC CA, if a TDD CC serves as the PCC for a UE, information about downlink data is limited, decreasing downlink throughput. Therefore, it is recommended that this parameter be set to FDD(FDD). If this parameter is set to NULL(NULL),

parameters.id: UL Heavy Traffic MLB Optimize Switch
parameters.name: UL Heavy Traffic MLB Optimize Switch
parameters.description: Indicates whether to trigger an uplink traffic-based blind handover of an FDD+TDD CA UE for MLB from its TDD PCell to an FDD cell that is acting as one of its SCells. This parameter applies only to LTE TDD.

parameters.name: SCC Reactivation Time
parameters.description: Indicates the minimum interval to reactivate an SCell based on the traffic volume after the eNodeB deactivates the SCell based on the CQI or RBLER. The recommended value is 5s for a commercial network. In a benchmark test, if the channel quality is occasionally poor, a small value, for example, 1s is recommended. This can increase the duration within which the SCell stays active. This parameter ap

parameters.id: FDD and TDD Relaxed Backhaul CA UL Max CC Num
parameters.name: FDD and TDD Relaxed Backhaul CA UL Max CC Num
parameters.description: Indicates the maximum number of carriers that can be aggregated in the uplink for FDD+TDD CA in relaxed backhaul scenarios. Relaxed-backhaul-based FDD+TDD CA in the uplink is not supported when this parameter is set to 0CC. The maximum number is two when this parameter is set to 2CC. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.id: Relaxed Backhaul CA UL Max CC Num
parameters.name: Relaxed Backhaul CA UL Max CC Num
parameters.description: Indicates the maximum number of carriers that can be aggregated in the uplink for CA in relaxed backhaul scenarios. Relaxed-backhaul-based CA in the uplink is not supported when this parameter is set to 0CC. The maximum number is two when this parameter is set to 2CC. This parameter needs to be configured only for the PCell. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: CA Traffic Direction Preference
parameters.description: Indicates the policy according to which the eNodeB selects band combinations when configuring SCells for CA. If this parameter is set to DL_FIRST, the eNodeB preferentially selects a band combination with the maximum downlink CA capability when a candidate SCell is a multi-band cell. This band combination may not support uplink CA. If this parameter is set to UL_FIRST, the eNodeB preferentially se

parameters.id: CA and MIMO Priority Strategy Switch
parameters.name: CA and MIMO Priority Strategy Switch
parameters.description: Indicates whether CA or MIMO takes precedence over each other for CA- and MIMO-capable UEs that select between CA and MIMO. CA_PRIOR: CA takes precedence over MIMO. MIMO_PRIOR: High-order MIMO takes precedence over CA. PEAK_RATE_PRIOR: The feature providing the highest peak data rate takes precedence over the other feature. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.id: A1 RSRP Threshold for Enhanced SCC Selection
parameters.name: A1 RSRP Threshold for Enhanced SCC Selection
parameters.description: Indicates the RSRP threshold of event A1 related to A1-based enhanced SCell selection. A1-based enhanced SCell selection is disabled if this parameter is set to -40. Event A1 is reported if the measured RSRP value exceeds the threshold. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.id: Fast SCell Selection After SCell Removal
parameters.name: Fast SCell Selection After SCell Removal
parameters.description: Indicates whether to start SCell selection immediately after all SCells of a UE are removed based on coverage. The immediate selection is enabled only if this parameter is set to ON. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.id: SRS-based Low Efficiency UE SINR Threshold
parameters.name: SRS-based Low Efficiency UE SINR Threshold
parameters.description: Indicates the SINR threshold for SRSs of UEs. This threshold is used to determine whether a UE is a low-efficiency UE. If this parameter is set to a value other than 255, the eNodeB checks the SINR of a UE's SRSs to determine whether the UE is a low-efficiency UE when FDD+TDD CA is performed for the UE with an LTE TDD cell serving as the PCell. If the SINR of SRSs of the UE is less than this thres

parameters.name: RSRP Offset
parameters.description: Indicates the offset used to evaluate whether to trigger RSRP-based PCC and SCC switchover. RSRP-based PCC and SCC switchover is disabled if this parameter is set to 0. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: Spectrum Coordination SINR Threshold
parameters.description: Indicates the uplink SINR threshold used in scheduling for triggering spectrum coordination. If the uplink SINR used in scheduling of a serving cell is less than this threshold, PCell change for spectrum coordination is triggered. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.id: Min DL Average To-Be-Scheduled UE Number
parameters.name: Min DL Average To-Be-Scheduled UE Number
parameters.description: Indicates the minimum allowed number of UEs to be scheduled in the downlink in the formula that flexible CA and Multi-Carrier Unified Scheduling use for evaluating the cell capability. If this parameter is set to 0, the eNodeB does not consider the average number of UEs to be scheduled in the downlink when calculating the cell capability. If this parameter is set to 255, the eNodeB uses the eNodeB

parameters.name: Smart CA PCC Anchoring Hysteresis
parameters.description: Indicates the minimum amount of gain required by PCC anchoring for intelligent selection of serving cell combinations. When evaluating a candidate serving cell combination that will trigger PCC anchoring, this intelligent selection function selects this combination only if the amount of gain brought by the PCC anchoring exceeds the value of this parameter. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD an

parameters.id: SCell Heavy Load UE Number Threshold
parameters.name: SCell Heavy Load UE Number Threshold
parameters.description: Indicates the threshold of the number of UEs for identifying heavy-load cells. This threshold is used to determine whether to activate a massive MIMO SCell based on the cell load. If the average number of UEs that can be paired in a massive MIMO cell exceeds this threshold, the eNodeB determines that the cell is heavily loaded. In this case, this massive MIMO cell cannot be activated as an SCell f

parameters.name: CA Preallocation SCC UE Count
parameters.description: Indicates the minimum number of UEs in the SCell for massive MIMO cell preallocation pairing in CA scenarios. If this parameter is set to 0, preallocation pairing is disabled. If this parameter is set to a value other than 0, preallocation pairing is enabled. This parameter applies only to LTE TDD.

parameters.name: Massive MIMO Gain Coefficient
parameters.description: Indicates the gain coefficient for massive MIMO cells. After smart carrier selection takes effect, the eNodeB multiplies the capability of a candidate massive MIMO cell by the value of this parameter when it calculates this capability for a UE that can benefit from UE pairing for MU-MIMO. The function of this parameter does not take effect when this parameter is set to 10, which indicates an actua

parameters.id: SCell Not Active UE Number Threshold
parameters.name: SCell Not Active UE Number Threshold
parameters.description: Indicates whether to prohibit SCell activation when the specified cell is heavily loaded. When the number of UEs in the cell is greater than the load threshold, the eNodeB determines that the cell is in the high load state and does not activate this cell as an SCell for any new CA UE. If this parameter is set to 0, this function is disabled. If this parameter is set to a value other than 0, this p

parameters.id: Heavy-Load UE Count Thld for SCell Config
parameters.name: Heavy-Load UE Count Thld for SCell Config
parameters.description: Indicates the UE number threshold for determining whether a cell is a high-load cell, the result of which is used to evaluate SCell configuration for CA UEs. If the number of UEs in a cell exceeds this threshold, the eNodeB determines that the cell is a high-load cell. If this cell is a massive MIMO cell, it cannot be configured as an SCell for CA UEs for which this SCell does not work in the upli

parameters.id: CA SCC Freq Measurement Optimization Switch
parameters.name: CA SCC Freq Measurement Optimization Switch
parameters.description: Indicates gap-assisted measurement parameters is required to be configured during the measurement of frequencies configured as CA SCCs. When this parameter is set to ON, gap-assisted measurement parameters are not configured during the measurement of frequencies configured as CA SCCs. If this parameter is set to OFF, gap-assisted measurement parameter needs to be configured during the measurement

parameters.name: VoLTE CA A2 RSRP Thld
parameters.description: Indicates the RSRP threshold for event A2 of the PCell for VoLTE UEs. When the RSRP of the PCell measured by a UE is less than this threshold, event A2 is reported. If this parameter is set to 0, SCell configuration and PCC anchoring are disabled for VoLTE UEs, regardless of the VolteSupportCaInterFreqMeasSw setting of the CellCaAlgoSwitch parameter in the CaMgtCfg MO. If this parameter is set to

parameters.id: Min Rsv Route Number for CA with LAA
parameters.name: Min Rsv Route Number for CA with LAA
parameters.description: Indicates the minimum number of routes between the cell and LAA cells for CA. If this parameter is set to 0, routes are not reserved for LAA cells. If this parameter is set to a non-zero value, this value is the number of routes reserved for LAA cells. This number should not exceed the maximum number of routes supported by the cell. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.id: High Load Cell Type Not As SCell
parameters.name: High Load Cell Type Not As SCell
parameters.description: Indicates which type of high-load cells cannot be configured as SCells. If this parameter is set to MASSIVE_MIMO_CELL, a high-load massive MIMO cell cannot be configured as an SCell when this massive MIMO cell cannot be configured as an uplink SCell for a CA UE or the CA UE cannot be paired with other UEs in this massive MIMO cell. If this parameter is set to NORMAL_CELL, high-load common cells (e

parameters.name: SCC Detection CQI Decrease Step
parameters.description: Indicates the CQI decrease step used during SCell deactivation evaluation. If this parameter is set to a non-zero value, the outer-loop CQI adjustment value for CQI decrease is further extended by the value of this parameter. If this parameter or the CaMgtCfg.SccQuietTime parameter is set to 0, the further decrease does not take effect. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: Serial Number
parameters.description: Indicates the optimal sorting order of a serving cell (PCell and SCell) combination in intelligent selection of serving cell combinations for CA UEs. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: PCell eNodeB ID
parameters.description: Indicates the eNodeB ID of the PCell. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: PCell Cell ID
parameters.description: Indicates the cell ID of the PCell. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: PCell Downlink EARFCN
parameters.description: Indicates the downlink EARFCN of the PCell. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: First SCell eNodeB ID
parameters.description: Indicates the eNodeB ID of the first candidate SCell. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: First SCell Cell ID
parameters.description: Indicates the cell ID of the first candidate SCell. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: First SCell Downlink EARFCN
parameters.description: Indicates the downlink EARFCN of the first candidate SCell. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: Second SCell eNodeB ID
parameters.description: Indicates the eNodeB ID of the second candidate SCell. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: Second SCell Cell ID
parameters.description: Indicates the cell ID of the second candidate SCell. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: Second SCell Downlink EARFCN
parameters.description: Indicates the downlink EARFCN of the second candidate SCell. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: Third SCell eNodeB ID
parameters.description: Indicates the eNodeB ID of the third candidate SCell. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: Third SCell Cell ID
parameters.description: Indicates the cell ID of the third candidate SCell. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: Third SCell Downlink EARFCN
parameters.description: Indicates the downlink EARFCN of the third candidate SCell. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: Fourth SCell eNodeB ID
parameters.description: Indicates the eNodeB ID of the fourth candidate SCell. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: Fourth SCell Cell ID
parameters.description: Indicates the cell ID of the fourth candidate SCell. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: Fourth SCell Downlink EARFCN
parameters.description: Indicates the downlink EARFCN of the fourth candidate SCell. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: CDMA20001XRTT cell ID
parameters.description: Indicates the cell ID of the external CDMA2000 1xRTT cell. The cell ID and sector ID together uniquely identify a CDMA2000 cell in the mobile switching center (MSC). In the CDMA2000 1xRTT network, a cell ID uniquely identifies a cell within the mobile switching center (MSC). A cell ID consists of 12 bits. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: CDMA20001XRTT sector ID
parameters.description: Indicates the sector ID of the external CDMA2000 1xRTT cell. The cell ID and sector ID together uniquely identify a CDMA2000 cell in the mobile switching center (MSC). A sector ID is unique in a CDMA2000 cell and consists of four bits. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: Band class
parameters.description: Indicates the band class on which the external CDMA2000 1x radio transmission technology (1xRTT) cell operates. For details about this parameter, see 3GPP TS 36.331. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: Frequency
parameters.description: Indicates the frequency on which the external CDMA2000 1xRTT cell operates. For details about this parameter, see 3GPP TS 36.331. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: System ID
parameters.description: Indicates the system ID of the external CDMA2000 1xRTT cell. A system ID is assigned to each local mobile network and is used to determine whether a UE is in the roaming state. For details about this parameter, see 3GPP TS 36.331. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: Network ID
parameters.description: Indicates the ID of the network to which the external CDMA2000 1xRTT cell belongs. A base station is a cellular system and a member of the network. A network is a subset of a system that is identified by a system ID. A network in a system is identified by a network ID. A system ID and a network ID together uniquely identify a network. System ID 0 and network ID 0 indicate all base stations outside

parameters.name: Mobile country code
parameters.description: Indicates the mobile country code (MCC) of the external CDMA2000 1xRTT cell. A public land mobile network (PLMN) ID is comprised of an MCC and a mobile network code (MNC). The MCC consists of three digits. The MNC consists of two or three digits. For example, if the MCC is 123 and the MNC is 45, the PLMN ID is 12345. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: Mobile network code
parameters.description: Indicates the mobile network code (MNC) of the external CDMA2000 1xRTT cell. A public land mobile network (PLMN) ID is comprised of a mobile country code (MCC) and an MNC. The MCC consists of three digits. The MNC consists of two or three digits. For example, if the MCC is 123 and the MNC is 45, the PLMN ID is 12345. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: MSC ID
parameters.description: Indicates the ID of the MSC to which the reference CDMA2000 1xRTT cell belongs. If the average number of WBB UEs in a cell is less than or equal to this threshold, turbo beamforming does not take effect. This parameter applies only to LTE TDD.

parameters.name: MUBF Power Normalization Adaptive Factor
parameters.description: Indicates the control factor of the switching threshold for adaptive MU beamforming power normalization. This parameter is used to calculate the SNR threshold for switching between NEBF and PEBF for pairing UEs. parameters.name: Adaptive MUBF Start Threshold
parameters.description: Indicates the threshold of the downlink PRB usage in a cell for adaptive entry to or exit from space-domain-preferred MU beamforming. If this parameter is set to 255, adaptive MU beamforming does not take effect. parameters.name: Dual-Stream BF Algorithm Switch
parameters.description: Indicates whether to enable dual-stream beamforming. ACK_FEEDBACK_IN_MUX_MODE_SW: Indicates whether to support the multiplexing mode for ACK feedback during dual-stream beamforming. If this option is selected, the multiplexing mode is supported by ACK feedback during dual-stream beamforming. If this option is deselected, the multiplexing mode is not supported by ACK feedback during dual-stream bea

parameters.name: Heavy-Load Switch to BF Optimization
parameters.description: Indicates whether to enable the optimization of switching to beamforming in heavy-load scenarios. If this parameter is set to 255, the optimization does not take effect. For massive MIMO cells, if this parameter is set to a value other than 255 and the MultiLayerThdSwitchToTM7 or WaitPairingLayerThd parameter in the CellBf MO is set to a value other than 0, online WBB UEs are allowed to be switche

parameters.name: UE Identification Switch
parameters.description: Indicates whether to enable status identification for different types of UEs. SRS_LMT_AND_ABN_UE_IDENT_SW: Indicates whether to enable identification of SRS-restricted UEs and UEs suffering from abnormal downlink scheduling. If this option is selected, the eNodeB identifies UEs with poor downlink performance or suffering from abnormal downlink scheduling due to delayed SRS updates. If this option

parameters.name: MUBF Algorithm Optimization Switch
parameters.description: Indicates whether to enable MU beamforming optimization algorithms. ABN_UE_PRI_SUPPRESSION_SW: Indicates whether to restrict the priorities of abnormal UEs. If this option is selected, the function takes effect. If this option is deselected, the function does not take effect. This option applies only to 8T8R cells. This option applies only to LTE TDD.

parameters.name: eNodeB ID
parameters.description: Indicates the identity of an eNodeB. This parameter applies only to LTE TDD.

parameters.name: RF Module Information
parameters.description: Indicates the cabinet, subrack, and slot numbers of the RF unit serving the cell. This parameter applies only to LTE TDD.

parameters.name: RX Channel No.
parameters.description: Indicates an RX channel number of an RF module that serves a cell. This parameter applies only to LTE TDD.

parameters.name: TX Channel No.
parameters.description: Indicates a TX channel number of an RF module that serves a cell. This parameter applies only to LTE TDD.

parameters.name: Rx Channel CINR
parameters.description: Indicates the CINR of an RX channel.

parameters.name: Tx Channel CINR
parameters.description: Indicates the CINR of a TX channel.

parameters.name: Local cell ID
parameters.description: Indicates the local cell ID. It uniquely identifies a cell within an eNodeB. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: BfMIMO adaptive switch
parameters.description: Indicates the type of adaptive selection between beamforming and MIMO for a multi-antenna eNodeB. The values are described as follows: NO_ADAPTIVE: A fixed beamforming or MIMO transmission mode is used. That is, transmission mode switching is not supported. TxD_BF_ADAPTIVE: The transmission mode changes adaptively between TM2 and TM7 or between TM2 and TM8, depending on the 3GPP release with which

parameters.name: Fixed BfMIMO mode
parameters.description: Indicates the fixed beamforming or MIMO transmission mode configured for a multi-antenna eNodeB. This parameter is valid only when the BfMimoAdaptiveSwitch parameter is set to NO_ADAPTIVE. This parameter applies only to LTE TDD. The values are described as follows: TM2: Transmission mode 2 is always used for UEs. TM3: Transmission mode 3 is always used for UEs. TM7: Transmission mode 7 is always u

parameters.name: Bf Mimo Adaptive Without Tm2
parameters.description: Indicates whether TM2 can be selected during adaptation between beamforming and MIMO when the BfMimoAdaptiveSwitch parameter is set to MIMO_BF_ADAPTIVE. This parameter applies only to LTE TDD. If this parameter is set to ON and the BfMimoAdaptiveSwitch parameter is set to MIMO_BF_ADAPTIVE: 1. When the BfMimoAdapWithTm4Switch parameter in the CellBfMimoParaCfg MO is set to OFF, TM3 is initially use

parameters.id: Single to Dual Streaming Beamforming Threshold Offset
parameters.name: Single to Dual Streaming Beamforming Threshold Offset
parameters.description: Indicates the offset to the threshold for switching of the UE transmission mode from single-stream beamforming mode to dual-stream beamforming mode. This parameter applies only to LTE TDD.

parameters.id: TM3 Rank2 To Dual Streaming Beamforming Threshold Offset
parameters.name: TM3 Rank2 To Dual Streaming Beamforming Threshold Offset
parameters.description: Indicates the offset to the threshold for switching the UE transmission mode from TM3 dual-stream mode to dual-stream beamforming mode. This parameter applies only to LTE TDD.

parameters.id: AS UE Dual BF To TM3 Rank2 Offset
parameters.name: AS UE Dual BF To TM3 Rank2 Offset
parameters.description: Indicates the offset to the threshold for triggering switching of the transmission mode of UEs supporting antenna selection from dual-stream beamforming to TM3 rank 2. This parameter applies only to LTE TDD.

parameters.id: AS UE TM3 Rank2 To Dual BF Offset
parameters.name: AS UE TM3 Rank2 To Dual BF Offset
parameters.description: Indicates the offset to the threshold for switching the transmission mode of an antenna selection-enabled UE from TM3 dual-stream mode to dual-stream beamforming mode. This parameter applies only to LTE TDD.

parameters.id: AS UE Single to Dual BF Offset
parameters.name: AS UE Single to Dual BF Offset
parameters.description: Indicates the offset to the threshold for switching the transmission mode of an antenna selection-enabled UE from single-stream beamforming mode to dual-stream beamforming mode. This parameter applies only to LTE TDD.

parameters.id: Dual Streaming Beamforming To TM3 Rank2 Offset
parameters.name: Dual Streaming Beamforming To TM3 Rank2 Offset
parameters.description: Indicates the offset to the threshold for switching the UE transmission mode from dual-stream beamforming mode to TM3 dual-stream mode. This parameter applies only to LTE TDD.

parameters.name: Offset Of In Statistics
parameters.description: Indicates whether the measured weight has a gain. When the difference between the measured weight and the instantaneous weight is greater than the offset, the measured weight is used as the beamforming weight. This parameter applies only to LTE TDD.

parameters.name: Offset Of Out Statistics
parameters.description: Indicates the offset to the difference between the instantaneous weight and the measured weight. This parameter is used to identify whether the instantaneous weight has a gain. If the difference between the instantaneous weight and the measured weight is less than this offset, the instantaneous weight is used for beamforming. This parameter applies only to LTE TDD.

parameters.id: Antenna Type-based BF and MIMO Algo Selection
parameters.name: Antenna Type-based BF and MIMO Algo Selection
parameters.description: Indicates the antenna type on which adaptive selection between beamforming and MIMO can be performed. This parameter applies only to LTE TDD. Value 0(0) indicates 8T8R cross polarization antennas. Value 1(1) indicates 8T8R omnidirectional circular antennas. Value 2(2) indicates other antenna types. Set this parameter based on the antenna type in use.

parameters.id: The Switch of Tm3 Direct to DualBF
parameters.name: The Switch of Tm3 Direct to DualBF
parameters.description: Indicates whether to allow transmission mode switching directly from TM3 to dual-stream beamforming when adaptation between MIMO and beamforming is enabled. If this parameter is set to ON, the transmission mode can change directly from TM3 to dual-stream beamforming. If this parameter is set to OFF, TM3 must be changed to single-stream beamforming and then to dual-stream beamforming when the dual-

parameters.name: Scc Bf Mimo Adaptive Switch
parameters.description: Indicates whether to enable transmission mode adaptation for the SCC. If this parameter is set to ON the eNodeB selects a transmission mode for the SCC based on the beamforming and MIMO mode of the SCell. If this parameter is set to OFF for non-multi-RRU cells, the transmission mode of the SCC is fixed to TM3 in multi-antenna scenarios and TM1 in single-antenna scenarios. If this parameter is set

parameters.id: High and Low Speed UE TM Switch Thld Offset
parameters.name: High and Low Speed UE TM Switch Thld Offset
parameters.description: Indicates the difference between the threshold for triggering low-speed UE switching between beamforming mode and MIMO mode and that for triggering high-speed UE switching between beamforming mode and MIMO mode. This parameter takes effect only when adaptation between beamforming and MIMO is enabled. This parameter can be used for optimization if low-speed UEs cannot select an optimal transmission

parameters.name: Transmission Mode Acceleration Switch
parameters.description: Indicates whether to accelerate the determination of transmission mode switching for UEs when adaptation between beamforming and MIMO is enabled. If this parameter is set to ON, the eNodeB adaptively accelerates the determination of transmission mode switching for all UEs based on their signal quality. In this way, the spectral efficiency improves in scenarios with traffic burst. If it is set to O

parameters.name: BfMIMO Adaptive with TM4
parameters.description: Indicates whether TM4 can be selected during the adaptation between beamforming and MIMO when the BfMimoAdaptiveSwitch parameter is set to MIMO_BF_ADAPTIVE. If this parameter is set to ON, TM4 can be selected during the adaptation between beamforming and MIMO. If this parameter is set to OFF, TM4 cannot be selected during the adaptation between beamforming and MIMO. This parameter applies only to

parameters.id: TM3 and TM9 Switching Threshold Offset
parameters.name: TM3 and TM9 Switching Threshold Offset
parameters.description: Indicate the offset to the threshold for switching the UE transmission mode between TM9 with PMI and TM3 when adaptation between TM3, TM8, and TM9 is enabled in a cell. This parameter applies only to LTE TDD.

parameters.id: BF to Two Layer MUBF Threshold Offset
parameters.name: BF to Two Layer MUBF Threshold Offset
parameters.description: Indicates the offset to the threshold for triggering UE pairing in dual-stream MU BF mode for beamforming UEs. In omnidirectional antenna-based or directional antenna-based MU BF pairing scenarios, you are advised to set this parameter to the recommended value. A value that is close to the recommended value is also applicable. This parameter applies only to LTE TDD.

parameters.id: BF to Four Layer MUBF Threshold Offset
parameters.name: BF to Four Layer MUBF Threshold Offset
parameters.description: Indicates the offset to the threshold for triggering UE pairing in four-stream MU BF mode for beamforming UEs. In omnidirectional antenna-based or directional antenna-based high-order MU BF pairing scenarios, you are advised to set this parameter to the recommended value. A value that is close to the recommended value is also applicable. This parameter applies only to LTE TDD.

parameters.id: TM3 Rank2 To TM9 Rank4 Offset
parameters.name: TM3 Rank2 To TM9 Rank4 Offset
parameters.description: Indicates the offset to the threshold for switching from TM3 rank 2 to 4-layer TM9. This parameter controls the probability of switching the UE transmission mode from TM3 rank 2 to 4-layer TM9. This parameter applies only to LTE TDD.

parameters.id: TM9 Rank4 To TM3 Rank2 Offset
parameters.name: TM9 Rank4 To TM3 Rank2 Offset
parameters.description: Indicates the offset to the threshold for switching from TM9 quadruple-stream mode to TM3 dual-stream mode. This parameter controls the probability of switching the UE transmission mode from TM9 quadruple-stream mode to TM3 dual-stream mode. This parameter applies only to LTE TDD.

parameters.name: Handover BF Threshold Adjust Switch
parameters.description: If this parameter is set to ON and the source cell and target cell for an intra-frequency handover have the same calculation result of PCI mod 3, the eNodeB increases the probability of the handover UE entering the beamforming mode in the target cell, therefore increasing the downlink throughput. If this parameter is set to OFF, the original mechanism is used. This parameter applies only to LTE TD

parameters.name: Volte MIMO Adaptive Switch
parameters.description: Indicates the adaptive MIMO transmission mode of voice UEs. If this parameter is set to ADAPTIVE and the BfMimoAdaptiveSwitch parameter in the CellBfMimoParaCfg MO is set to NO_ADAPTIVE(NO_ADAPTIVE), a fixed beamforming transmission mode specified by the FixedBfMimoMode parameter in the CellBfMimoParaCfg MO is used for both voice and other UEs. If this parameter is set to ADAPTIVE and the MimoAdap

parameters.name: CA SCC Add Threshold Offset
parameters.description: Indicates the channel quality threshold for adding an SCC for a CA UE. When the channel quality is good, a quadruple-stream-capable CA UE can achieve a higher peak transmission rate when fewer carriers are aggregated than when more carriers are aggregated. parameters.name: CA SCC Delete Threshold Offset
parameters.description: Indicates the channel quality threshold for removing an SCC for a CA UE. When the channel quality is good, a quadruple-stream-capable CA UE can achieve a higher peak transmission rate when fewer carriers are aggregated than when more carriers are aggregated. If the channel quality is higher than this threshold, the eNodeB triggers removal of an SCC. Then, the remaining SCCs can enter the quadruple

parameters.name: BfMimo Algorithm Optimization Switch
parameters.description: BFTOMIMOALGOOPTSWITCH: Indicates whether to optimize switching from beamforming to MIMO and rank detection for MIMO. If this option is selected, switching from beamforming to MIMO and rank detection for MIMO are optimized to increase the rank 2 success rate. If this option is deselected, switching from beamforming to MIMO or rank detection for MIMO is not optimized. This option applies only to LTE

parameters.name: Initial BFMIMO Mode
parameters.description: Indicates the beamforming and MIMO mode used during initial network access. This parameter applies only to LTE TDD. When the CrsPortNum parameter in the Cell MO is set to CRS_PORT_4(4 ports) and the BfMimoAdapWithTm4Switch parameter in the CellBfMimoParaCfg MO is set to ON(On), the value TM3(TM3) of this parameter does not take effect. If this value is set in this case, TM2 is used as the beamform

parameters.name: Multi-Layer Pairing Isolation Threshold
parameters.description: Indicates the UE isolation threshold for triggering multi-layer pairing. This parameter must be set based on UE conditions in the cell. This parameter applies only to LTE TDD.

parameters.name: UE Access Transmission Mode
parameters.description: Indicates the transmission mode during an E-RAB setup procedure and an incoming handover procedure for a UE in a massive MIMO cell with the BfMimoAdaptiveSwitch parameter of the CellBfMimoParaCfg MO set to MIMO_BF_ADAPTIVE. If this parameter is set to TM7, TM7 is used. If this parameter is set to AUTOMATIC, MIMO is used. This parameter applies only to LTE TDD.

parameters.id: 256QAM TM3 to TM9 Switching Spectral Eff Offset
parameters.name: 256QAM TM3 to TM9 Switching Spectral Eff Offset
parameters.description: Indicates the spectral efficiency offset for switching the UE transmission mode from TM3 to TM9 if 256QAM is used. This parameter applies only to LTE TDD.

parameters.id: 256QAM TM9 to TM3 Switching Spectral Eff Offset
parameters.name: 256QAM TM9 to TM3 Switching Spectral Eff Offset
parameters.description: Indicates the spectral efficiency offset for switching the UE transmission mode from TM9 to TM3 if 256QAM is used. This parameter applies only to LTE TDD.

parameters.id: Heavy Load Average UE Count Threshold
parameters.name: Heavy Load Average UE Count Threshold
parameters.description: Indicates the threshold of the number of UEs for identifying heavy-load cells and triggering enhanced transmission mode adaptation in heavy-load scenarios. If the average number of UEs in a cell exceeds this threshold in an evaluation period and the average downlink PRB usage in the cell exceeds the PRB usage threshold, the cell is considered heavily loaded. If the average number of UEs in a cell

parameters.id: Heavy Load Downlink PRB Usage Threshold
parameters.name: Heavy Load Downlink PRB Usage Threshold
parameters.description: Indicates the PRB usage threshold for identifying heavy-load cells and triggering enhanced transmission mode adaptation in heavy-load scenarios. If the average downlink PRB usage in the cell exceeds this threshold in an evaluation period and the average number of UEs in the cell exceeds the UE quantity threshold, the cell is considered heavily loaded. If the average downlink PRB usage in the cell

parameters.name: Heavy Load Target Trans Mode
parameters.description: Indicates the target transmission mode for enhanced transmission mode adaptation in heavy-load scenarios. If this parameter is set to TM7, the eNodeB automatically implements transmission mode adaptation or uses TM7 mode to achieve optimal spectral efficiency in a heavy-load cell. parameters.id: Heavy Load Trans Mode Evaluation Period
parameters.name: Heavy Load Trans Mode Evaluation Period
parameters.description: Indicates the transmission mode evaluation period for enhanced transmission mode adaptation. This period is a multiple of 30s. The eNodeB evaluates the cell load in this period and updates statistics of cell spectral efficiency. This parameter applies only to LTE TDD.

parameters.id: WTTx UE TM3 to TM9 Rank4 Ofs
parameters.name: WTTx UE TM3 to TM9 Rank4 Ofs
parameters.description: Indicates the offset to the threshold for switching the transmission mode of WTTx UEs from TM3 to 4-layer TM9. The value 127 indicates that the function does not take effect. This parameter applies only to LTE TDD.

parameters.name: TM9 DL 4-Layer MIMO Enhancement Switch
parameters.description: Indicates whether to enabled enhanced downlink 4-layer MIMO based on TM9. TM9_DL_4LAYER_BOOST_SWL Indicates whether to enable enhanced downlink 4-layer TM9. If this option is selected, UEs near the cell center can quickly enter TM9 mode. If this option is deselected, UEs near the cell center cannot quickly enter TM9 mode. This option applies only to LTE TDD.

parameters.id: 4R or 8R UE BF MIMO Adaptation Opt Sw
parameters.name: 4R or 8R UE BF MIMO Adaptation Opt Sw
parameters.description: Indicates whether to enable optimization of adaptive switching between beamforming and MIMO for 4R and 8R UEs. This parameter applies only to LTE TDD.

parameters.name: Local Cell ID
parameters.description: Indicates the local ID of a cell, which uniquely identifies a cell within an eNodeB. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: Coverage Level
parameters.description: Indicates the cell coverage level. A maximum of four levels are supported, corresponding to 0 dB, 5 dB, 10 dB, and 15 dB coverage enhancements. When this parameter is set to COVERAGE_LEVEL_0, COVERAGE_LEVEL_1, COVERAGE_LEVEL_2, and COVERAGE_LEVEL_3, the maximum coverage level supported by the cell is coverage level 0, coverage level 1, coverage level 2, and coverage level 3, respectively. If the v

parameters.name: RACH RSRP First Threshold
parameters.description: Indicates the RSRP level-1 threshold. When the measured RSRP value of a UE is higher than the RSRP level-1 threshold, the UE initiates random access in the cell at coverage level 0. This parameter takes effect only when the CoverageLevel parameter is set to COVERAGE_LEVEL_0, COVERAGE_LEVEL_1, COVERAGE_LEVEL_2, or COVERAGE_LEVEL_3. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: RACH RSRP Second Threshold
parameters.description: Indicates the RSRP level-2 threshold. When the measured RSRP value of a UE is between the RSRP level-1 threshold and RSRP level-2 threshold, the UE initiates random access in the cell at coverage level 1. This parameter takes effect only when the CoverageLevel parameter is set to COVERAGE_LEVEL_2 or COVERAGE_LEVEL_3. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: RACH RSRP Third Threshold
parameters.description: Indicates the RSRP level-3 threshold. When the measured RSRP value of a UE is between the RSRP level-2 threshold and RSRP level-3 threshold, the UE initiates random access in the cell at coverage level 2. parameters.description: Indicates the number of times the eNodeB repeatedly sends the SIB-BR message in a period in the current coverage enhancement mode of a cell. If this parameter corresponding to the maximum coverage level supported by the cell is modified, eMTC UEs that already accessed the cell will be proactively released. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.id: Max Number of PDSCH Repetitions in Mode A
parameters.name: Max Number of PDSCH Repetitions in Mode A
parameters.description: Indicates the maximum number of times the eNodeB repeatedly uses a PDSCH for a UE in coverage enhancement mode A. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.id: Max Number of PDSCH Repetitions in Mode B
parameters.name: Max Number of PDSCH Repetitions in Mode B
parameters.description: Indicates the maximum number of times the eNodeB repeatedly uses a PDSCH for a UE in coverage enhancement mode B. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.id: Max Number of PUSCH Repetitions in Mode A
parameters.name: Max Number of PUSCH Repetitions in Mode A
parameters.description: Indicates the maximum number of times the eNodeB repeatedly uses a PUSCH for a UE in coverage enhancement mode A. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.id: Max Number of PUSCH Repetitions in Mode B
parameters.name: Max Number of PUSCH Repetitions in Mode B
parameters.description: Indicates the maximum number of times the eNodeB repeatedly uses a PUSCH for a UE in coverage enhancement mode B. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.id: Max Number of MPDCCH Repetitions for Paging
parameters.name: Max Number of MPDCCH Repetitions for Paging
parameters.description: Indicates the maximum number of repetitions of the type-1 CSS MPDCCH for scheduling in the cell.. When LTE Flexible Bandwidth or GSM and LTE Spectrum Concurrency feature is activated in the cell, the eNodeB increases the number of repetitions based on the SIB1 interruption state. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.id: Max Number of MPDCCH Repetitions in Mode A
parameters.name: Max Number of MPDCCH Repetitions in Mode A
parameters.description: Indicates the maximum number of times the eNodeB repeatedly uses the MTC physical downlink control channel (MPDCCH) for a UE in mode A. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.id: Max Number of MPDCCH Repetitions in Mode B
parameters.name: Max Number of MPDCCH Repetitions in Mode B
parameters.description: Indicates the maximum number of times the eNodeB repeatedly uses the MTC physical downlink control channel (MPDCCH) for a UE in mode B. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.id: Effective Code Rate for SI Transmission
parameters.name: Effective Code Rate for SI Transmission
parameters.description: Indicates the target code rate of system information transmission. If this parameter corresponding to the maximum coverage level supported by the cell is modified, eMTC UEs that already accessed the cell will be proactively released. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: Paging Group Number

According to 3GPP specifications, the value of nB must be a positive integer. parameters.name: Local cell ID
parameters.description: Indicates the local ID of the cell. It uniquely identifies a cell within a BS. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: PCFICH power
parameters.description: Indicates the offset of the PCFICH transmit power relative to the reference signal power. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: PBCH power
parameters.description: Indicates the offset of the PBCH transmit power relative to the reference signal power. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: SCH power
parameters.description: Indicates the offset of the transmit power for the cell synchronization signals relative to the reference signal power. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: DBCH power
parameters.description: Indicates the offset of the transmit power for broadcast information on the PDSCH channel relative to the reference signal power. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: PCH power
parameters.description: Indicates the offset of the transmit power for the paging information on the PDSCH channel relative to the reference signal power. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: Rach response power
parameters.description: Indicates the offset of the transmit power for the random access responses on the PDSCH channel relative to the reference signal power. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: Prs power
parameters.description: Indicates the offset of the pilot power relative to the reference signal power. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: Antenna Output Power
parameters.description: Indicates the transmit power for the entire channel bandwidth at the antenna port. This parameter is valid only when the AntRsPwrSwitch option of the RepeaterSwitch parameter in the CellAlgoSwitch MO is selected. This parameter is used to calculate the reference signal (RS) power to be delivered in system information block type 2 (SIB2).

parameters.name: PMCH Power Offset
parameters.description: Indicates the offset of PMCH power to the maximum PDSCH power. The maximum PDSCH power is calculated by using the following formula: Max(P_PDSCH_A, P_PDSCH_B). For details about formulas to calculate P_PDSCH_A and P_PDSCH_B, see section "Basics of PDSCH Power Calculation" in Power Control Feature Parameter Description. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: Handover RAR Power Enhanced Switch
parameters.description: Indicates whether the eNodeB increases the transmit power of the Random Access Response (RAR) message when a UE is being handed over to the target cell and repeatedly sends dedicated preambles. If this parameter is set to OFF(OFF), the eNodeB does not increase the transmit power of the RAR message sent to the UE that is being handed over to the target cell. parameters.name: Output Power Rate
parameters.description: Indicates the cell output power usage. This parameter is valid only when the AntRsPwrSwitch option is selected. The eNodeB calculates the reference signal (RS) transmit power to be delivered in system information block type 2 (SIB2) based on OutputPowerRate and AntOutputPwr. parameters.name: PDCCH Power Increase Offset
parameters.description: Indicates the power increase offset of the PDCCH in a cell. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: Local cell ID
parameters.description: Indicates the local ID of the cell. It uniquely identifies a cell within an eNodeB. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: Uplink Ibler Optimization Switch
parameters.description: Indicates whether to enable uplink IBLER optimization. If this parameter is set to ON, for LTE TDD cells, the TBs not received are not taken into account for the IBLER calculation if DTX is detected based on the PUSCH. parameters.name: Cell Counter Algorithm Switch
parameters.description: Indicates whether to enable cell-level algorithms related to performance counters. This parameter includes the following options: BasedA3EdgeUserSwitch: Indicates whether to enable A3-based cell edge user (CEU) identification. parameters.description: Indicates whether to enable CQI reporting period adaptation. If this parameter is set to ON, the CQI reporting period adaptively changes based on the air interface load of the cell. If this parameter is set to OFF, the CQI reporting period is specified by the UserCqiPeriod parameter in the CellCqiAdaptiveCfg MO. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: User CQI period
parameters.description: Indicates the fixed CQI reporting period. This parameter takes effect only if the CqiPeriodAdaptive parameter is set to OFF(Off). If the UserCqiPeriod parameter is set to ms2(2ms), the period is automatically changed to 5ms for the TDD cell. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

This parameter is valid only if the CqiPeriodAdaptive parameter is set to ON. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD.

parameters.name: Enhanced SCC CQI Reporting Switch

If this parameter is set to OFF, the UEs send SCell periodic and aperiodic CQI reports following the common process. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD.

parameters.name: CQI Filter Coefficient for MCS
parameters.description: Indicates the CQI filtering coefficient in the CQI adjustment algorithm. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.id: VoLTE CQI Report Difference Limit Value

The value 0 indicates that no limit is imposed on the maximum difference. A non-0 value indicates the maximum difference. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: CsiRs State

parameters.name: Local cell ID
parameters.description: Indicates the local ID of the cell. It uniquely identifies a cell within an eNodeB. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.id: eCSPC PC Adjustment UE Number Threshold
parameters.name: eCSPC PC Adjustment UE Number Threshold
parameters.description: Indicates the UE number threshold for power coordination to take effect. The eNodeB samples the number of activated UEs in the downlink in a cell multiple times and calculates the average number. If the average number is not 0 and greater than or equal to the threshold, power coordination takes effect. If the average number is 0 or less than the threshold, power coordination does not take effect.

parameters.name: Cell CSPC Switch
parameters.description: Indicates whether to enable CSPC in the cell. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.id: CSPC UE SRS Config Rapid Report Switch
parameters.name: CSPC UE SRS Config Rapid Report Switch
parameters.description: Indicates whether to report the changed sounding reference signal (SRS) configurations of UEs with CSPC applied in the serving cell to the centralized control node immediately after the configurations are changed. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD.

parameters.id: CSPC UE SRS Config Report Period
parameters.name: CSPC UE SRS Config Report Period
parameters.description: Indicates the interval at which the local cell reports its UE-specific SRS configurations to the centralized control node. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD.

parameters.name: Uplink RSRP Measurement Report Period
parameters.description: Indicates the interval at which neighboring cells report their uplink reference signal received power (RSRP) measurement results to the local cell. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD.

parameters.name: CSPC CQI Filter Coefficient
parameters.description: Indicates the filtering coefficient for channel quality indicators (CQIs) in CSPC-based power optimization. This filtering makes the reported CQIs more stable. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: eCSPC A3 Offset
parameters.description: Indicates the A3 offset for eCSPC. If the parameter value is increased, the probability of UEs reporting event A3 is reduced. A larger value of this parameter indicates a smaller number of cell edge users, and a smaller value of this parameter indicates a larger number of cell edge users. For details, see 3GPP TS 36.331. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: Cell eCSPC Switch
parameters.description: Indicates whether to enable cell-level enhanced CSPC (eCSPC). eCSPC is enabled only when this parameter is set to ON. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: eCSPC Power Control Adjustment Range

parameters.description: Indicates whether to enable intra-eNodeB CSPC. Intra-eNodeB CSPC is enabled only when this parameter is set to ON(On). This parameter applies only to LTE FDD.

parameters.name: Cell DL CoMP Property

parameters.name: DL CoMP Coordinate Cell ID

parameters.name: DL CoMP Coordinate Cell Type
parameters.description: Indicates the type (macro or micro) of a cooperating cell in DL CoMP. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD.

parameters.name: DL CoMP Coordinate eNodeB ID
parameters.description: Indicates the ID of the eNodeB that serves a cooperating cell in DL CoMP. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD.

parameters.name: Cell CSPC Status
parameters.description: Indicates whether CSPC has been enabled in the cell. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: Remarks
parameters.description: Indicates the reason why CSPC is disabled in a cell. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: Macro Or Micro Cell
parameters.description: Indicates the Cell type is Macro Cell or Micro Cell in CSPC. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: Cell Inter-eNodeB DL CoMP Status
parameters.description: Indicates the inter-eNodeB DL CoMP status. This parameter applies only to LTE TDD.

parameters.id: eCspc Coordinate Cell Link Delay Status
parameters.name: eCspc Coordinate Cell Link Delay Status
parameters.description: Indicates whether the delay on links between the coordinating cells in eCSPC exceeds the delay threshold. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: eCspc Coordinate Cell Type
parameters.description: Indicates the type (macro or micro) of the cooperating cell in eCSPC. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: eCspc Coordinate eNodeB ID
parameters.description: Indicates the ID of the eNodeB that serves a cooperating cell in eCSPC. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: eCspc Coordinate Local Cell ID
parameters.description: Indicates the ID of the local cell that functions as a cooperating cell in eCSPC. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: eCspc Data Link Status
parameters.description: Indicates the status of the data link to a cooperating cell in eCSPC. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.id: Intra Cspc Coordinate Local Cell ID
parameters.name: Intra Cspc Coordinate Local Cell ID
parameters.description: Indicates the ID of a local coordinating cell in intra-eNodeB CSPC. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD.

parameters.name: Cell Intra-eNodeB DL CoMP Status
parameters.description: Indicates the intra-eNodeB DL CoMP status. This parameter applies only to LTE TDD.

parameters.name: Local Cell ID
parameters.description: Indicates the local ID of a cell. It uniquely identifies a cell within an eNodeB. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: Standard UDC Switch
parameters.description: Indicates standardized uplink data compression (UDC) switches. For details about the descriptions of functions controlled by this parameter, see 3GPP TS 36.323. UL_DEFLATE_DATA_COMPRESSION_SW: Indicates whether to enable the DEFLATE-based uplink data compression. If this option is selected, DEFLATE-based uplink data compression is initiated for DEFLATE-capable UEs. If this option is deselected, DE

parameters.name: Standard UDC Buffer Size
parameters.description: Indicates the size of the standard uplink data compression (UDC) buffer. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: LocalCellId
parameters.description: Indicates the local ID of the cell. It uniquely identifies a cell within an eNodeB. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: DlCompA3Offset
parameters.description: Indicates the offset for reporting the DL CoMP measurement event. This offset is the difference between the signal quality of a neighboring cell and that of the serving cell. A larger value indicates that a neighboring cell must have better quality for reporting the event. For details, see 3GPP TS 36.331. This parameter applies only to LTE TDD.

parameters.id: DPS Coordinating Cell User Ratio Threshold
parameters.name: DPS Coordinating Cell User Ratio Threshold
parameters.description: Indicates the threshold for the ratio of the number of uplink synchronized UEs in a dynamic point selection (DPS) serving cell to a DPS coordinating cell when DL CoMP is enabled.
