parameters.name: DPS Load Difference Threshold
parameters.description: Indicates the threshold of the difference between the PRB usage of a DPS serving cell and that of a DPS coordinating cell when DL CoMP is enabled. When the difference between the PRB usage of the serving cell and the coordinating cell exceeds this threshold, the coordinating cell can function as the target cell of DPS UEs. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD cells.

parameters.id: DPS Serving cell download PRB Threshold
parameters.name: DPS Serving cell download PRB Threshold
parameters.description: Indicates the threshold of the downlink PRB usage for a DPS serving cell when DL CoMP is enabled. When the PRB usage of a candidate cell exceeds this threshold, the cell can be selected as a DPS serving cell. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD cells.

parameters.id: HetNet DPS Coordinating Cell RSRP Threshold
parameters.name: HetNet DPS Coordinating Cell RSRP Threshold
parameters.description: Indicates the RSRP offset threshold for DPS UEs in selecting a coordinating cell in a HetNet. A large value of this parameter indicates a high requirement on neighboring cell quality for reporting measurement events and a small number of DPS UEs selecting a coordinating cell in a HetNet. A small value of this parameter indicates a large number of DPS UEs selecting a coordinating cell in a HetNet.

parameters.id: HomNet DPS Coordinating Cell RSRP Threshold
parameters.name: HomNet DPS Coordinating Cell RSRP Threshold
parameters.description: Indicates the RSRP offset threshold for DPS UEs in selecting a coordinating cell in a HomNet. A large value of this parameter indicates a high requirement on neighboring cell quality for reporting measurement events and a small number of DPS UEs selecting a coordinating cell in a HomNet. A small value of this parameter indicates a large number of DPS UEs selecting a coordinating cell in a HomNet.

parameters.id: JT Coordinating Cell DL PRB Threshold
parameters.name: JT Coordinating Cell DL PRB Threshold
parameters.description: Indicates the threshold of the downlink PRB usage for selecting a candidate cell as a coordinating cell when DL CoMP is enabled. When the PRB usage of a candidate cell is lower than this threshold, the cell can be selected as a coordinating cell for joint transmission. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD.

parameters.name: JT Coordinating Cell RSRP Threshold
parameters.description: Indicates the RSRP offset threshold for joint transmission UEs in selecting a coordinating cell. A large value of this parameter indicates a high requirement on neighboring cell quality for reporting measurement events and a small number of joint transmission UEs. A small value of this parameter indicates a large number of joint transmission UEs. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD.

parameters.id: JT Serving Cell DL PRB Threshold
parameters.name: JT Serving Cell DL PRB Threshold
parameters.description: Indicates the threshold of the downlink PRB usage for a serving cell for joint transmission when DL CoMP is enabled. When the PRB usage of a candidate cell is smaller than this threshold, the cell can be selected as a serving cell for joint transmission. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD cells.

parameters.name: DL CoMP Scheduling Priority Factor
parameters.description: Indicates the scheduling priority for DL CoMP UEs. This parameter takes effect only for downlink non-GBR services of DL CoMP UEs. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD.

parameters.name: DL CoMP Report Interval
parameters.description: Indicates the interval at which TM9- or TM10-capable UEs periodically send A3 or A6 measurement reports when at least one of DL CoMP with TM 10 and joint transmission with TM9 takes effect. For details about the reporting interval, see 3GPP TS 36.331. If this parameter is set to OFF, the A3 or A6 reporting interval is the same as the reporting interval (specified by the ReportInterval parameter in

parameters.name: Local cell ID
parameters.description: Indicates the local ID of the cell. It uniquely identifies a cell within a BS. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: Downlink band division scheme
parameters.description: Indicates the band division scheme used in downlink ICIC. The band division in the cell is adjusted according to the setting of this parameter so that the edge bands for neighboring cells do not overlap. If this parameter is set to INVALID, the cell does not distinguish center and edge bands. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: User Attribution Gfactor Threshold
parameters.description: Indicates the G factor threshold for user attribute determination in downlink adaptive Inter-Cell Interference Coordination (ICIC). If downlink adaptive ICIC is enabled, the eNodeB selects cell edge users (CEUs) from the users whose G factors are less than this threshold. Determine the parameter value based on the distribution of UEs' modulation and coding scheme (MCS) indexes within an area so th

parameters.name: Noise User RSRP Threshold
parameters.description: Indicates the RSRP threshold used to determine noise-limited UEs on the network. If none of the neighboring-cell RSRP values included in A3 reports sent by a UE exceeds this threshold, the eNodeB does not consider these A3 reports when calculating interference. In most cases, the recommended RSRP threshold is -102. In tests on small-scale networks, this parameter can be set to other values. (The a

parameters.name: AICIC Plus A3 Offset
parameters.description: Indicates the A3 offset for enhanced AICIC. A large value of this parameter indicates a small number of cell edge users and a small value of this parameter indicates a large number of cell edge users. If the parameter value is increased, the probability of UEs reporting event A3 is reduced. For details, see 3GPP TS 36.331. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD cells.

parameters.id: AICIC Plus Power Control Adjustment Range
parameters.name: AICIC Plus Power Control Adjustment Range
parameters.description: Indicates the cell power adjustment range in enhanced AICIC. This parameter must be set to a PDSCH PA value that is less than the value of the PaPcOff parameter. At most two values can be selected for the AIcicPlusPCAdjRange parameter. If one value is selected for the AIcicPlusPCAdjRange parameter, the power can be changed to the selected value and the PDSCH PA value specified by the PaPcOff param

parameters.name: AICIC Plus Coordinate Cell Type
parameters.description: Indicates the type of coordinating cells in enhanced AICIC. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD.

parameters.name: AICIC Plus Coordinate eNodeB ID
parameters.description: Indicates the ID of the eNodeB that serves a coordinating cell in enhanced AICIC. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD.

parameters.id: AICIC Plus Coordinate Local Cell ID
parameters.name: AICIC Plus Coordinate Local Cell ID
parameters.description: Indicates the ID of a local coordinating cell in enhanced AICIC. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD.

parameters.name: Local cell ID
parameters.description: Indicates the local ID of the cell. It uniquely identifies a cell within a BS. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.id: DCI power offset for dedicated control
parameters.name: DCI power offset for dedicated control
parameters.description: Indicates the offset of the DCI power relative to the reference signal power when the PDCCH channel carries dedicated control information. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: Local cell ID
parameters.description: Indicates the local ID of the cell. It uniquely identifies a cell within a BS. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: Center UE PA
parameters.description: Indicates the PA value of cell center UEs when DL ICIC is enabled. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: Edge UE PA
parameters.description: Indicates the PA value of cell edge UEs when DL ICIC is enabled. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: Cell Edge Load Evaluation Period
parameters.description: Indicates the interval for evaluating the cell edge load when the BFModeUserAdptPwrSwitch check box is selected under the DlPcAlgoSwitch parameter. This parameter applies only to LTE TDD networks.

parameters.name: Neighboring Cell Edge Load Threshold
parameters.description: Indicates the threshold of the neighboring cell edge load for determining whether to increase the power of beamforming UEs at the edge of the local cell when the BFModeUserAdptPwrSwitch check box is selected under the DlPcAlgoSwitch parameter. If the neighboring cell edge load is greater than the threshold specified by this parameter, the power of corresponding beamforming UEs in the local cell ed

parameters.id: Ratio of Cells Exceeding Neighboring Cell Edge Load Threshold
parameters.name: Ratio of Cells Exceeding Neighboring Cell Edge Load Threshold
parameters.description: Indicates the percentage of the number of neighboring cells whose cell edge load meets the specified threshold. If the percentage of the number of neighboring cells meeting the cell edge load threshold is greater than the v

parameters.name: BF User Power Boost Period
parameters.description: Indicates the period during which the increased value of the beamforming UE power remains unchanged when the BFModeUserAdptPwrSwitch check box is selected under the DlPcAlgoSwitch parameter. This parameter applies only to LTE TDD cells.

parameters.id: BF Mode User Adaptive Power A3 offset
parameters.name: BF Mode User Adaptive Power A3 offset
parameters.description: Indicates the offset for event A3 reporting when the BFModeUserAdptPwrSwitch check box is selected under the DlPcAlgoSwitch parameter. parameters.id: BF Mode User Adaptive Power A6 offset
parameters.name: BF Mode User Adaptive Power A6 offset
parameters.description: Indicates the offset for event A6 reporting in CA scenarios when the BFModeUserAdptPwrSwitch check box is selected under the DlPcAlgoSwitch parameter. parameters.name: Remaining Power Use Strategy
parameters.description: Indicates whether to use the remaining power. If this parameter is set to OFF, the remaining power is not used. If this parameter is set to PORT_PWR_BALANCING and the CrsPortNum parameter is set to CRS_PORT_4, power is balanced among the ports. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD.

parameters.name: Local cell ID
parameters.description: Indicates the local ID of the cell. It uniquely identifies a cell within an eNodeB. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: PA for even power distribution
parameters.description: Indicates the PA to be used when PA adjustment for PDSCH power control is disabled, DL ICIC is disabled, and the even power distribution is used for the PDSCH. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: Nominal PDSCH-to-RS-EPRE Offset
parameters.description: Indicates the power offset of the PDSCH EPRE relative to the reference signal (RS) EPRE. If this parameter is set to -1 to 6, nomPDSCH-RS-EPRE-Offset is set to -1 to 6. The parameter is set to 0 by default. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: EPRE Offset Adjustment Threshold
parameters.description: Indicates the threshold for triggering the adjustment of the PDSCH power offset relative to the reference signal power. If this parameter is set to a value within the range of 0 to 26, the PDSCH power offset adjustment is triggered when the absolute value of the CQI adjustment is greater than this threshold. parameters.name: TM9 Rank Correct Threshold
parameters.description: Indicates the threshold for triggering rank correction for 4R TM9 UEs. If this parameter is set to a value within the range of 0 to 28, a codebook subset constraint is activated so that high-rank UEs report a maximum of rank 2 when their MCS indexes are lower than this threshold. parameters.description: Indicates the threshold used for starting the cell-level NPREO (the IE nomPDSCH-RS-EPRE-Offset) adjustment algorithm. If this parameter is set to 255, this algorithm does not take effect. If this parameter is not set to 255, the parameter value indicates the predicted gain threshold for searching for the optimal cell-level NPREO. When the algorithm searches for the optimal cell-level NPREO, if the

parameters.name: UE-Level NPREO Adjustment Threshold
parameters.description: Indicates the threshold used for starting the UE-level NPREO (the IE nomPDSCH-RS-EPRE-Offset) adjustment algorithm. If this parameter is set to 127, this algorithm does not take effect. If this parameter is not set to 127, the parameter value indicates the compensation value used in the UE-level NPREO adjustment algorithm. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD.

parameters.name: Local cell ID
parameters.description: Indicates the local ID of the cell. It uniquely identifies a cell within a BS. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: Phich Pc Off Power Offset
parameters.description: Indicates the power offset between the PHICH transmit(TX) power and the reference signal(RS) power. This offset is used when PHICH power control is disabled. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: Local cell ID
parameters.description: Indicates the local ID of the cell. It uniquely identifies a cell within a BS.

parameters.name: Maximum Number of MIMO Layers
parameters.description: Indicates the maximum number of layers (the rank) in the implementation of multiple-input multiple-output (MIMO) in DL scheduling. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: Downlink CA Schedule Strategy
parameters.description: Indicates the downlink scheduling policy used when CA is applied, which can be basic scheduling or differentiated scheduling. parameters.id: Reserved resource ratio for non-GBR services
parameters.name: Reserved resource ratio for non-GBR services
parameters.description: Indicates the proportion of resources reserved for non-GBR services. A proportion of resources is reserved periodically to prevent non-GBR services from failing to be allocated resources. parameters.name: Intra-Pole RRU Identification Period
parameters.description: Indicates the interval at which intra-pole RRU identification is triggered for downlink offset pre-correction. When this parameter is set to 0, intra-pole RRU identification is not triggered periodically. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: Downlink EPF capacity factor
parameters.description: Indicates the capacity factor for downlink enhanced proportional fair (EPF) scheduling. This factor affects the scheduling priorities of UEs running services with the QCI of 6, 7, 8, or 9, and accordingly can be used to adjust the cell capacity and fairness among users. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.id: RB Priority MCS Select Ratio Threshold
parameters.name: RB Priority MCS Select Ratio Threshold
parameters.description: Indicates the selection ratio threshold for the function of lowering the modulation and coding scheme (MCS) index to increase the number of resource blocks (RBs) with priority for UEs running small-packet services. parameters.id: Cell Edge User RB Allocation Mode

parameters.name: Intra-Pole RRU Identification Duration
parameters.description: Indicates the maximum sampling duration in which intra-pole RRU identification is performed for downlink offset pre-correction. When this parameter is set to 0, intra-pole RRU identification is disabled. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.id: Downlink Low Load SDMA Threshold Offset
parameters.name: Downlink Low Load SDMA Threshold Offset
parameters.description: Indicates the offset to the low load isolation threshold in the downlink of an adaptive SFN cell. The isolation is the ratio of the RSRP sum of working RRUs to the RSRP sum of non-working RRUs in an adaptive SFN cell. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: Neighbor RRU Identification Threshold
parameters.description: Indicates the threshold for determining that two RRUs are neighboring RRUs. The threshold is the ratio (expressed as a percentage) of the number of times that the target RRU changes between an RRU (for example, RRU A) and another specified RRU (for example, RRU B) in the uplink to the total number of times that the target RRU changes between RRU A and all other RRUs in the uplink. parameters.name: Downlink HARQ Maximum Transmission Number
parameters.description: Indicates the maximum number of downlink hybrid automatic repeat request (HARQ) transmissions. For details, see 3GPP TS 36.331. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: NonGBR Traffic Delay Weight
parameters.description: Indicates the weight for scheduling non-GBR services with long scheduling delay. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: Inter-Pole RRU Identification Threshold

parameters.id: RB Damage Cell Near Point User IBLER Thd
parameters.name: RB Damage Cell Near Point User IBLER Thd

This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: Breathing Pilot Switch
parameters.description: BreathingPilotSwitch: Indicates whether to enable the Breathing Pilot function. This function is enabled only if this option is selected. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.id: Handover UE Static MCS Scheduling Timer
parameters.name: Handover UE Static MCS Scheduling Timer

If this parameter is set to ADAPTIVE, the eNodeB adaptively uses the interval of 20 or 40 ms. The value ADAPTIVE takes effect only for TDD eNodeBs. parameters.name: Code Rate for Random Access Response and Paging Message
parameters.description: Indicates the code rate for Random Access Response messages and paging messages. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: Frequency Select Judge Period
parameters.description: Indicates the determination period for frequency selective scheduling. This parameter is invalid if the FreqSelSwitch option of the DlSchSwitch parameter is deselected. If the FreqSelSwitch option of the DlSchSwitch parameter is selected, the FreqSelJudgePeriod parameter takes effect. A smaller value of this parameter allows UEs meeting frequency selective scheduling conditions to more easily ente

parameters.name: Downlink Enhanced Voip Schedule Switch
parameters.description: Indicates whether to enhance downlink scheduling for VoLTE services. DlVoIPLoadBasedSchSwitch: Indicates whether to enable cell-load-based adaptive selection of dynamic scheduling and semi-persistent scheduling for VoLTE UEs. If this option is deselected, adaptive selection of dynamic and semi-persistent scheduling cannot be performed for VoLTE UEs based on the cell load. If this option is selecte

parameters.name: UE Attribute Judge Period
parameters.description: Indicates the period of determining UE attributes in adaptive SFN. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD.

parameters.name: UE Attribute Judge RSRP Hysteresis
parameters.description: Indicates the hysteresis threshold for determining UE attributes in adaptive SFN. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD.

parameters.id: FD UE Enhanced Aperiodic CQI Trigger Period
parameters.name: FD UE Enhanced Aperiodic CQI Trigger Period
parameters.description: Indicates the period of triggering enhanced aperiodic CQI reporting for UEs for which frequency diversity scheduling is used or the period of triggering aperiodic CQI reporting for UEs for which TM9-based joint transmission is used. This parameter can be set to 5ms, 10ms, 20ms, 40ms, 80ms, 160ms, or inf. The parameter value inf indicates that aperiodic CQI reporting is not triggered. This paramete

parameters.name: SFN Downlink High Load Threshold
parameters.description: Indicates the PRB usage threshold used to determine the change from low load to high load in the downlink. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: SFN Downlink Low Load Threshold
parameters.description: Indicates the PRB usage threshold used to determine the change from high load to low load in the downlink. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.id: Downlink High Load SDMA Threshold Offset
parameters.name: Downlink High Load SDMA Threshold Offset
parameters.description: Indicates the offset to the high load isolation threshold in the downlink of an adaptive SFN cell. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: Listen Before Talk Switch
parameters.description: Indicates whether to enable the LBT function. This parameter applies only to LTE TDD.

parameters.name: Noise Interference High Threshold
parameters.description: Indicates the noise interference threshold for disabling downlink transmission. If the noise interference received by the transmitter is greater than this threshold, downlink transmission is disabled. This parameter applies only to LTE TDD.

parameters.name: Noise Interference Low Threshold
parameters.description: Indicates the noise interference threshold for enabling downlink transmission. If the noise interference received by the transmitter is less than this threshold, downlink transmission is enabled. This parameter applies only to LTE TDD cells.

parameters.name: Enhanced Aperiodic CQI Trigger Strategy
parameters.description: Indicates the policy for triggering enhanced aperiodic CQI reporting. This parameter takes effect only if the EnAperiodicCqiRptSwitch option of the DlSchSwitch parameter or the CaEnhAperiodicCqiRptSwitch option of the CellCaAlgoSwitch parameter is selected. If the EnAperiodicCqiTrigStrategy parameter is set to CQI_PERIOD_BASED(CQI_PERIOD_BASED), aperiodic CQI reporting is triggered only when the p

parameters.id: DL CA UE Capability Allocation Strategy
parameters.name: DL CA UE Capability Allocation Strategy
parameters.description: Indicates the policy of allocating CA UE capability in downlink CA. The allocation policies include equal allocation and adaptive allocation. If this parameter is set to EQUALLY_DIVIDED(EQUALLY_DIVIDED), the eNodeB equally allocates CA UE capabilities among all activated carriers. If this parameter is set to ADAPTIVELY_DIVIDED(ADAPTIVELY_DIVIDED), the eNodeB adaptively allocates CA UE capabilities

parameters.name: DL CA User Scheduling Switch
parameters.description: Indicates whether to enable functions related to downlink scheduling of CA UEs. DlCaUserRbPriMcsSelSwitch: Indicates whether to enable the policy of MCS selection with prioritized RBs. If this option is selected, the policy of MCS selection with prioritized RBs is used for any CA UE for which the traffic volume to be transmitted in the cell is larger than or equal to the maximum traffic volume all

parameters.name: DL 256QAM CQI Table Adaptive Period
parameters.description: Indicates the adaptive configuration period for 256QAM CQI tables. This parameter takes effect only when the Dl256QamCqiTblCfgStrategy parameter is set to ADAPTIVE_CONFIG or CQI_BASED_ADAPTIVE_CONFIG. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: DL 256QAM CQI Table Configure Strategy
parameters.description: Indicates the configuration policy of the CQI table with 256QAM. The configuration policies include fixed configuration, adaptive configuration, and CQI-based adaptive configuration. If this parameter is set to FIX_CONFIG, the CQI table with 256QAM is always configured for UEs supporting 256QAM in downlink scheduling. If this parameter is set to ADAPTIVE_CONFIG, the CQI table with 256QAM or the CQ

parameters.name: Benefit User MCS Threshold
parameters.description: Indicates the MCS threshold for triggering UE transmit power increase. UE transmit power can be increased to obtain performance gains only when the MCS index is less than or equal to this threshold. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and takes effect only when the Cell Coverage Enhancement feature is enabled.

parameters.id: DL SPS MCS Decrease IBLER Threshold
parameters.name: DL SPS MCS Decrease IBLER Threshold
parameters.description: Indicates the IBLER threshold for lowering the MCS index and reactivating downlink semi-persistent scheduling. If the IBLER is greater than or equal to the specified threshold in the measurement period, the MCS index is lowered and semi-persistent scheduling is reactivated. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: Downlink AFC Max Frequency
parameters.description: Indicates the maximum frequency adjustment value during downlink automatic frequency control (AFC) in high-speed railway scenarios. For railways where trains travel at a specific speed, a smaller value of this parameter leads to a smaller frequency adjustment value during downlink AFC and better performance protection in abnormal frequency adjustment scenarios. If the value of this parameter is gr

parameters.id: SRS RSRP Filtering Coefficient for DL AFC
parameters.name: SRS RSRP Filtering Coefficient for DL AFC
parameters.description: Indicates the RSRP filtering coefficient for SRSs that are used during downlink AFC in high-speed railway scenarios. A larger value of this parameter leads to a larger impact of the RSRP value measured this time on the filtered value. A smaller value of this parameter leads to a larger impact of the previous RSRP value on the filtered value. The setting of this parameter is related to the train sp

parameters.name: RLC-MAC Joint Scheduling Switch
parameters.description: Indicates whether to enable RLC and MAC joint scheduling. RetransOptSwitch(RetransOptSwitch): Indicates whether to enable retransmission optimization of RLC/MAC joint scheduling. If this option is selected, retransmission optimization of RLC and MAC joint scheduling is enabled. If this option is deselected, retransmission optimization of RLC and MAC joint scheduling is disabled. This option applie

parameters.id: No Scheduling Stop Triggering ACqi Thd
parameters.name: No Scheduling Stop Triggering ACqi Thd
parameters.description: Indicates the threshold for stopping aperiodic CQI reporting. If the time interval between a UE's last downlink scheduling and current TTI is greater than or equal to this threshold, the eNodeB instructs the UE to stop aperiodic CQI reporting in the current TTI. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.id: Breathing Pilot Ue Drx OD Align Thd
parameters.name: Breathing Pilot Ue Drx OD Align Thd
parameters.description: Indicates the threshold of the number of UEs with the DRX On Duration Timer aligned in the cell when Breathing Pilot is enabled. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.id: Cell PRB Usage Upper Thld for Video Res Ctrl
parameters.name: Cell PRB Usage Upper Thld for Video Res Ctrl
parameters.description: Indicates the downlink PRB usage threshold for determining whether congestion occurs. If the downlink PRB usage exceeds this threshold, the eNodeB considers that congestion occurs in the cell. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.id: User Speed Downlink Scheduling Priority Weight
parameters.name: User Speed Downlink Scheduling Priority Weight
parameters.description: Indicates the downlink scheduling priority weight for low-speed UEs in high-speed or ultra-high-speed cells. The actual downlink scheduling priority weight factor equals the value of this parameter multiplied by the DlschPriorityFactor parameter.

parameters.name: Virtual 4T4R Cell RB Ratio
parameters.description: Indicates the RB usage threshold for allowing independent scheduling of UEs whose isolation degree is between the Virtual 4T4R Joint Scheduling Threshold and Virtual 4T4R Independent Scheduling Threshold in a Virtual 4T4R-enabled cell. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: Virtual 4T4R Joint Scheduling Threshold
parameters.description: Indicates the isolation threshold for determining the joint scheduling area. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: Virtual 4T4R Independent Scheduling Threshold
parameters.description: Indicates the isolation threshold for determining the independent scheduling area. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.id: Virtual 4T4R Joint Independent Sch Thd Offset
parameters.name: Virtual 4T4R Joint Independent Sch Thd Offset
parameters.description: Indicates the offset against the isolation thresholds for determining the joint scheduling area and independent scheduling area of a cell with virtual 4T4R enabled. This offset is used to reduce UE ping-pong switches from and to the joint or independent scheduling area. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD.

parameters.name: Start Rank Detect Efficiency Threshold
parameters.description: Indicates the modulation and coding efficiency threshold for starting downlink rank detection. When the DetectRank2AdjSwitch option of the DlRankDetectSwitch parameter in the CellDlschAlgo MO is selected and a UE reports rank 1, the eNodeB starts rank 2 detection if the modulation and coding efficiency reaches the value of the StartRankDetectEffThd parameter. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD

parameters.name: Start Rank Detect Count Threshold
parameters.description: Indicates the threshold for the number of times of scheduling for starting downlink rank detection. When the DetectRank2AdjSwitch option of the DlRankDetectSwitch parameter in the CellDlschAlgo MO is selected, the eNodeB starts rank 2 detection if the number of times of downlink scheduling using rank 1 reaches the value of the StartRankDetectCntThd parameter. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD

parameters.name: Rank Detect Success Count Threshold
parameters.description: Indicates the threshold for determining downlink rank detection success. When the DetectRank2AdjSwitch option of the DlRankDetectSwitch parameter in the CellDlschAlgo MO is selected, rank 2 detection is considered successful if the consecutive number of times of successful scheduling (without error packets) using rank 2 reaches the value of the RankDetectSuccessCntThd parameter. This parameter app

parameters.name: Rank Reverse Detect Count Threshold
parameters.description: Indicates the scheduling number threshold for starting downlink rank detection in reverse order. When the DetectRank2AdjSwitch option of the DlRankDetectSwitch parameter in the CellDlschAlgo MO is selected and rank 2 detection succeeds, the eNodeB starts rank 1 detection if the consecutive number of times of scheduling using rank 2 reaches the value of the RankReverseDetectSchCntTh parameter. This

parameters.name: DL UE-AMBR Judge Period
parameters.description: Indicates the interval at which the eNodeB controls the downlink UE-AMBR. When this parameter is set to AMBR_50_MS(AMBR_50_MS), AMBR_100_MS(AMBR_100_MS), AMBR_200_MS(AMBR_200_MS), or AMBR_500_MS(AMBR_500_MS), the eNodeB controls the downlink UE-AMBR at an interval of 50, 100, 200, or 500 ms in downlink scheduling. When this parameter is set to AMBR_1000_MS(AMBR_1000_MS), the eNodeB does not contro

parameters.name: CA Scheduling Weight Factor
parameters.description: Indicates the weight used for differentiated scheduling of CA UEs. A larger parameter value results in more significant scheduling differentiation between CA UEs and non-CA UEs. A smaller parameter value results in fairer scheduling. This parameter takes effect only in the downlink. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.id: Positive and Negative Freq Offset Ratio Threshold
parameters.name: Positive and Negative Freq Offset Ratio Threshold
parameters.description: Indicates the threshold of the positive and negative frequency offset ratio for downlink frequency correction. The eNodeB performs downlink frequency correction only when the positive or negative frequency offset ratio of a UE exceeds this threshold. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.id: Frequency Offset Threshold for DL AFC
parameters.name: Frequency Offset Threshold for DL AFC
parameters.description: Indicates the threshold for the frequency offset of UEs for downlink frequency correction amount calculation. The frequency correction amount of UEs whose frequency offset is greater than this threshold is calculated. If no UE in the cell has a frequency offset greater than this threshold, downlink frequency correction is not performed. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: User Ratio Threshold
parameters.description: Indicates the threshold of the UE quantity ratio in different areas of the same cell served by multiple eNodeBs for downlink frequency correction. The eNodeBs perform downlink frequency correction when the UE quantity ratio in both of the areas where the largest and second largest number of UEs reside exceeds this threshold. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: IBLER-based PDCCH SINR Offset
parameters.description: Indicates the PDCCH SINR compensation value based on the target IBLER. This parameter applies only to LTE TDD.

parameters.id: CRS Full Bandwidth Post On Duration TTI Number
parameters.name: CRS Full Bandwidth Post On Duration TTI Number
parameters.description: Indicates the number of TTIs in which CRS is transmitted across the entire bandwidth after DRX On Duration in the Breathing Pilot and Coordinated Pilot Scheduling functions. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.id: CRS Full Bandwidth Pre On Duration TTI Number
parameters.name: CRS Full Bandwidth Pre On Duration TTI Number
parameters.description: Indicates the number of TTIs in which CRS is transmitted across the entire bandwidth before DRX On Duration in the Breathing Pilot and Coordinated Pilot Scheduling functions. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.id: CRS Full Bandwidth Pre SIB Paging TTI Number
parameters.name: CRS Full Bandwidth Pre SIB Paging TTI Number
parameters.description: Indicates the number of TTIs in which CRS is transmitted across the entire bandwidth before system information broadcast and paging in the Breathing Pilot and Coordinated Pilot Scheduling functions. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.id: FS UE Aperiodic CQI Triggering Period
parameters.name: FS UE Aperiodic CQI Triggering Period
parameters.description: Indicates the interval at which aperiodic CQI reporting is triggered for UEs in frequency selective scheduling. In high-load or heavy-traffic scenarios, if downlink frequency selective scheduling has a strong impact on uplink performance, the parameter value can be increased to reduce the impact at the cost of lower gains of frequency selective scheduling. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD an

parameters.id: FS UE Aperiodic Subband CQI Validity Period
parameters.name: FS UE Aperiodic Subband CQI Validity Period
parameters.description: Indicates the validity period of subband CQIs aperiodically reported by UEs in frequency selective scheduling. If the validity period of such a CQI expires, the CQI becomes invalid. In high-load or heavy-traffic scenarios, if UEs are motionless or move at low speeds, the parameter value can be increased at the cost of possible degraded downlink performance. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD a

parameters.name: Interference Randomization PCI Offset
parameters.description: Indicates the PCI offset used to determine the start location for resource allocation in the cell. The start location for RBG resource allocation is the result of (PCI + the value of this parameter) mod the interference randomization modulus. If this parameter is set to the default value 0, only the PCI is used to determine the start location for RBG resource allocation. This parameter applies onl

parameters.name: Pilot Off Strategy
parameters.description: Indicates the CRS shutdown policy. PILOTOFFPORT_SELECT_SWITCH: specifies the CRS shutdown mode used after Breathing Pilot (BP) or Coordinated Pilot Scheduling (CPS) are enabled. If this option is selected for cells with BP enabled, CRS is not shut down on port 0 with CRS transmitted across the entire bandwidth and CRS can be shut down on port 1. If this option is selected for cells with CPS enable

parameters.name: CRS Compensate Period
parameters.description: Indicates the CRS compensation period after breathing pilot (BP) and coordinated pilot scheduling (CPS) are enabled. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.id: DL First HARQ Tx TBS Index Increase Num
parameters.name: DL First HARQ Tx TBS Index Increase Num
parameters.description: Indicates the increase in the TBS index used for the first downlink HARQ retransmission. When this parameter is set to 0, the eNodeB does not increase the TBS index used for the first downlink HARQ retransmission. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD. This parameter takes effect only when the PreciseMcsAdaptSwitch option of the CqiAdjAlgoSwitch parameter in the CellAlgoSwitch MO is selected.

parameters.id: NB-IoT Downlink HARQ Max Transmission Count
parameters.name: NB-IoT Downlink HARQ Max Transmission Count
parameters.description: Indicates the maximum number of downlink HARQ transmissions. This parameter applies only to NB-IoT.

parameters.id: Max Rate of Video UEs During Congestion
parameters.name: Max Rate of Video UEs During Congestion
parameters.description: Indicates the rate threshold of UEs running video services when congestion occurs. If the rate of a UE running a video service exceeds this threshold, the scheduling priority of the UE will be reduced. The rate of a UE is related to the cell PRB usage and the UE spectral efficiency. Therefore, the eNodeB cannot ensure that the rates of UEs running video services are always lower than this threshol

parameters.id: Cell UE Num Upper Thld for Video Res Ctrl
parameters.name: Cell UE Num Upper Thld for Video Res Ctrl
parameters.description: Indicates the synchronized-UE quantity threshold for determining whether congestion occurs. If the number of synchronized UEs exceeds this threshold, the eNodeB considers that congestion occurs in the cell. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.id: Pilot Off DRX Parameter Group ID
parameters.name: Pilot Off DRX Parameter Group ID
parameters.description: Indicates the ID of the dedicated DRX parameter group for CRS transmission disabling. The parameter value of 255 indicates that this parameter is invalid. This parameter must be associated with the DrxParaGroupId parameter in the DrxParaGroup MO. That is, the DRX parameter group ID set in the DrxParaGroup MO is used to configure the dedicated DRX parameters for CRS transmission disabling. This par

parameters.name: Multi-Carrier Co-Scheduling CQI Period Thld
parameters.description: Indicates the threshold of the CQI period for triggering the multi-carrier coordinated scheduling feature. If the CQI periods of all UEs in the cell are less than or equal to this threshold and the uplink and downlink PRB usages of the cell are less than or equal to the MccsPrbRateThld parameter in the CellDlschAlgo MO, the multi-carrier coordinated scheduling feature takes effect. This parameter

parameters.name: Multi-Carrier Co-Scheduling PRB Rate Thld
parameters.description: Indicates the threshold of the PRB usage for triggering the multi-carrier coordinated scheduling feature. If both the uplink and downlink PRB usages of the cell are less than or equal to this threshold and the CQI periods of all UEs in the cell are less than or equal to the MccsCqiPeriodThld parameter in the CellDlschAlgo MO, the multi-carrier coordinated scheduling feature takes effect. This para

parameters.name: Multi-Carrier Co-Scheduling Algo Switch
parameters.description: Indicates whether to enable the multi-carrier coordinated scheduling algorithm. MULTI_CARRIER_COSCH_SW: Indicates whether to enable the multi-carrier coordinated scheduling algorithm. If this option is selected, multi-carrier coordinated scheduling is enabled. If this option is deselected, multi-carrier coordinated scheduling is disabled. ADAPTIVE_FREQ_PRIORITY_SW: Indicates whether to adaptively

parameters.name: Overlap RSRP Isolation Threshold
parameters.description: Indicates the isolation threshold for performing TM9 4-port joint transmission to UEs in the overlapping area in a common 2T2R SFN cell. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.id: DL Scheduling MCS Upper Limit for CBTC
parameters.name: DL Scheduling MCS Upper Limit for CBTC
parameters.description: Indicates the upper limit on the MCS index used for downlink CBTC scheduling. This parameter applies only to LTE TDD.

parameters.id: DL MU-MIMO Cell Average CQI Thld
parameters.name: DL MU-MIMO Cell Average CQI Thld
parameters.description: Indicates the average cell CQI threshold for 4TX TM9 MU-MIMO and WTTx MU-MIMO. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD.

parameters.name: DL MU-MIMO Judge Timer
parameters.description: Indicates the 4TX TM9 MU-MIMO and WTTx MU-MIMO mode judgment timer. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD.

parameters.id: TBS Index Threshold for High Target IBLER
parameters.name: TBS Index Threshold for High Target IBLER
parameters.description: Indicates the threshold for the TBS index based on which the high target IBLER value takes effect when channel quality fluctuates significantly. When channel quality fluctuates significantly, the high target IBLER value takes effect only when the TBS index is less than or equal to this parameter value, the DlEnVarIblerTargetSwitch option is selected, and LowIblerTargetTbsIdxThld is not set to 255.

parameters.id: TBS Index Threshold for Low Target IBLER
parameters.name: TBS Index Threshold for Low Target IBLER
parameters.description: Indicates whether to enable TBS-index-based enhanced downlink target IBLER adaptation. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD. The value 255 indicates that the enhanced downlink target IBLER adaptation algorithm does not adjust the target IBLER based on the TBS index. Instead, the UE number is used as the admission condition for the enhanced downlink target IBLER adaptation algorithm.

parameters.id: DL MU-MIMO Candidate Paired UE Count Thld
parameters.name: DL MU-MIMO Candidate Paired UE Count Thld
parameters.description: Indicates the candidate paired UE number threshold in each TTI. This parameter applies to 4TX TM9 MU-MIMO and WTTx MU-MIMO. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD.

parameters.name: PDSCH Maximum Code Rate
parameters.description: Indicates the maximum PDSCH code rate for UEs compliant with 3GPP Release 12 or later, as defined in 3GPP TS 36.213. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD. The values R12_0DOT930 and R12_0DOT931 indicate the maximum PDSCH code rates of 0.930 and 0.931, respectively, for UEs compliant with 3GPP Release 12 or later. The value R14_0DOT932 indicates the maximum PDSCH code rate of 0.931 fo

parameters.name: Steady Phase Target Rate Ratio
parameters.description: Indicates the target rate ratio of stably running video services. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: Independent Beam PMI Threshold
parameters.description: Indicates the PMI reporting probability threshold for the eNodeB to determine UEs in Virtual 4T4R cells as independently scheduled UEs. Set this parameter based on site conditions when the function of determining UE attributes based on PMI reporting is enabled. When this parameter is set to 255, the function of determining UE attributes based on PMI reporting is disabled. This parameter applies on

parameters.name: Downlink User Data Threshold
parameters.description: Indicates the downlink data volume threshold used to determine UEs that are running large-packet services. If the to-be-scheduled downlink data volume of a UE is greater than or equal to this threshold, the UE is running large-packet services. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: Pilot Off Rate Increase Switch
parameters.description: Indicates whether to increase the probability of CRS transmission disabling. If this parameter is set to OFF, the eNodeB does not increase the probability of CRS transmission disabling. If this parameter is set to BASED_ON_MEASUREMENT, the eNodeB increases the probability of CRS transmission disabling in neighboring cells based on UE measurement results. This value applies only to LTE FDD and LTE

parameters.id: MCS Thld for Rank Change Attempt
parameters.name: MCS Thld for Rank Change Attempt
parameters.description: Indicates the MCS index threshold for switching between rank 1 or 2 measurement and rank 3 or 4 measurement by 4R UEs. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: DL First Retransmission RB Ratio
parameters.description: Indicates the proportion of RBs allocated for initial downlink retransmission to those allocated for initial transmission. The value 100 indicates that this parameter does not take effect. This parameter applies only to LTE TDD.

parameters.name: Estimated DL MU-MIMO Gain Thld
parameters.description: Indicates the estimated gain threshold for using 4TX TM9 MU-MIMO and WTTx MU-MIMO in the cell. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD.

parameters.name: CQI Only Outer Loop Switch
parameters.description: Indicates the switch for outer-loop control of CQI-only scheduling. If this parameter is set to ON, the eNodeB adjusts the number of RBs used by CQI-only scheduling based on the CRC result of CQI-only transmission and prohibits CQI-only scheduling for UEs with high IBLERs. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD.

parameters.name: Interference Filter Coefficient
parameters.description: Indicates the interference filtering coefficient used in precise AMC. The coefficient is used to smooth the interference values to be exchanged with interfering neighboring cells. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: SRB1 Scheduling Enhancement Switch
parameters.description: Indicates whether to continue delivering RRC Connection Release signaling carried by SRB1 when the number of SRB1 retransmissions has reached the maximum at the RLC layer. If this parameter is set to OFF, the eNodeB stops SRB1 scheduling and no longer delivers the RRC Connection Release signaling when the number of SRB1 retransmissions has reached the maximum at the RLC layer. If this parameter is

parameters.id: Max Number of Aperiodic CSI Reporting
parameters.name: Max Number of Aperiodic CSI Reporting
parameters.description: Indicates the allowed maximum number of aperiodic CSI reporting times per second when the CSI feedback enhancement function is used. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD.

parameters.id: UE Proportion with Increased DL SCH Priority
parameters.name: UE Proportion with Increased DL SCH Priority
parameters.description: Indicates the proportion of UEs (running small-packet services) for which the downlink scheduling priority is raised during inter-cell D-MIMO and massive MIMO. The value 0 indicates that the eNodeB does not raise the downlink scheduling priority for any UEs. This parameter applies only to LTE TDD.

parameters.name: MCG High Load Threshold
parameters.description: Indicates the high-load threshold of MCG cells. If the load of an MCG cell is higher than this threshold, the eNodeB takes a downlink scheduling protection measure for NSA UEs in this MCG cell by decreasing the scheduling priority of non-GBR services to the lowest level for these UEs. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: EPF Enhanced Scheduling Optimization Switch
parameters.description: Indicates whether to optimize EPF enhanced scheduling. If this parameter is set to ON, the eNodeB optimizes the scheduling to promptly update the scheduling priorities of UEs that treat the cell as an SCell in inter-BBP CA. If this parameter is set to OFF, the eNodeB does not optimize the scheduling. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: Downlink Joint AMC Algorithm Switch
parameters.description: Indicates whether to enable downlink joint AMC. DL_INTRA_JAMC_ALGO_SW: Indicates whether to enable intra-board downlink joint AMC. If this option is selected, intra-board downlink joint AMC is enabled. If this option is deselected, intra-board downlink joint AMC is disabled. This option applies only to LTE TDD.

parameters.id: DL 2D FSS User Data Volume Thld
parameters.name: DL 2D FSS User Data Volume Thld
parameters.description: Indicates the downlink data volume threshold for identifying large-packet UEs for two-dimensional frequency selective scheduling. If the to-be-scheduled downlink data volume of a UE is greater than or equal to this threshold, the UE will be identified as a large-packet UE for two-dimensional frequency selective scheduling. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD.

parameters.id: Upper Limit on PDSCH Code Rate
parameters.name: Upper Limit on PDSCH Code Rate
parameters.description: Indicates the upper limit on the PDSCH code rate for special UEs. If the CODE_RATE_RISE_SWITCH_ON option of the WhiteLstCtrlSwitch parameter in the UeCompat MO is selected, the maximum code rate specified by the PdschCodeRateUpperLimit parameter is used for special UEs. If this option is deselected, the rate specified by the PdschMaxCodeRate parameter in the CellDlschAlgo MO is used for special UE

parameters.id: RB Priority MCS Select Max Decrease in TBS Index
parameters.name: RB Priority MCS Select Max Decrease in TBS Index
parameters.description: Indicates the maximum decrease in the TBS index when the policy of MCS selection with prioritized RBs is single-user policy or multi-user policy. If this parameter is set to 255, the optimized algorithm for MCS selection with prioritized RBs does not take effect. If this parameter is set to a value other than 255, the value indicates the maximum decrease in the TBS index when the single-user polic

parameters.name: Edge Beam Threshold
parameters.description: Indicates the edge beam range threshold for a massive MIMO cell. The range of horizontal beams approaching the edge of a massive MIMO cell that is smaller than this threshold indicates the range of edge beams. The value 255 indicates that this parameter does not take effect. This parameter applies only to LTE TDD.

parameters.name: Downlink Min Expected Bit Rate
parameters.description: Indicates the expected minimum downlink rate when equivalent Max C/I is used as the scheduling policy. If this parameter is set to 65535, equivalent Max C/I cannot be used as the scheduling policy. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: Adaptive Pilot Off PRB Thld
parameters.description: Indicates the downlink PRB usage threshold for dynamically adjusting the CRS transmission disabling policy. If the downlink PRB usage of the cell is less than or equal to this threshold, the CRS transmission disabling policy can be dynamically adjusted. If the downlink PRB usage of the cell is greater than the sum of this threshold and the corresponding offset, the CRS transmission disabling polic

parameters.name: Listen Before Talk Detect Time
parameters.description: Indicates the duration of listen before talk (LBT) for detecting interference and noise. This parameter applies only to LTE TDD.

parameters.name: Listen Before Talk Transmit Status
parameters.description: Indicates whether downlink transmission is enabled. This parameter applies only to LTE TDD.

parameters.id: Listen Before Talk Noise Interfere Power
parameters.name: Listen Before Talk Noise Interfere Power
parameters.description: Indicates the noise interference power detected by LBT. This parameter applies only to LTE TDD.

parameters.name: Local Cell ID
parameters.description: Indicates the local ID of a cell, which uniquely identifies a cell within an eNodeB. This parameter applies to LTE FDD, LTE TDD, and NB-IoT.

parameters.name: DMRS Six Tone Base Sequence
parameters.description: Indicates the DMRS six tone base sequence of a cell. This parameter and the SixToneCyclicShift parameter are used together to generate the DMRS sequence for the NPUSCH when six tone transmission is used. This parameter applies only to NB-IoT.

parameters.name: DMRS Twelve Tone Base Sequence
parameters.description: Indicates the DMRS twelve tone base sequence of a cell, which is used to generate the DMRS sequence for the NPUSCH when twelve tone transmission is used. This parameter applies only to NB-IoT.

parameters.name: DMRS Three Tone Base Sequence
parameters.description: Indicates the DMRS three tone base sequence of a cell. This parameter and the ThreeToneCyclicShift parameter are used together to generate the DMRS sequence for the NPUSCH when three tone transmission is used. This parameter applies only to NB-IoT.

parameters.name: DMRS Six Tone Cyclic Shift
parameters.description: Indicates the six tone cyclic shift for the uplink DMRS. The DMRS sequence is generated by using the base sequence and cyclic shift. With cyclic shift used, the number of DMRS sequences is increased to 56 (14 multiplied by 4) from 14 when six tone transmission is used. This decreases the possibility of interference among intra-frequency neighboring cells. For details, see 3GPP TS 36.331. This para

parameters.name: DMRS Three Tone Cyclic Shift
parameters.description: Indicates the three tone cyclic shift for the uplink DMRS. The DMRS sequence is generated by using the base sequence and cyclic shift. With cyclic shift used, the number of DMRS sequences is increased to 36 (3 multiplied by 12) from 12 when three tone transmission is used. This decreases the possibility of interference among intra-frequency neighboring cells. For details, see 3GPP TS 36.331. This

parameters.name: Local cell ID
parameters.description: Indicates the local ID of the cell. It uniquely identifies a cell within a BS.

parameters.name: FDD enter DRX threshold
parameters.description: Indicates the threshold for UEs to enter the discontinuous reception (DRX) mode in a cell that operates in FDD mode. This threshold is used in the DRX algorithm. It is expressed as a proportion of the transmission time intervals (TTIs) with data transmission to the total TTIs. parameters.name: FDD exit DRX threshold
parameters.description: Indicates the threshold for UEs to exit the discontinuous reception (DRX) mode in a cell that operates in FDD mode. This threshold is used in the DRX algorithm. It is expressed as a proportion of the transmission time intervals (TTIs) with data transmission to the total TTIs. If the measurement result of UE traffic is higher than this threshold, the eNodeB determines that the UE should remain in t

parameters.name: TDD enter DRX threshold Uplink
parameters.description: Indicates the uplink traffic volume threshold for UEs to enter DRX mode in a cell that operates in LTE TDD mode. This threshold is used in the DRX algorithm. It is expressed as a proportion of the TTIs with uplink data transmission to the total TTIs. parameters.name: TDD exit DRX threshold Uplink
parameters.description: Indicates the uplink traffic volume threshold for UEs to exit DRX mode in a cell that operates in LTE TDD mode. This threshold is used in the DRX algorithm. parameters.name: TDD enter DRX threshold Downlink
parameters.description: Indicates the downlink traffic volume threshold for UEs to enter DRX mode in a cell that operates in LTE TDD mode. This threshold is used in the DRX algorithm. parameters.name: TDD exit DRX threshold Downlink
parameters.description: Indicates the downlink traffic volume threshold for UEs to exit DRX mode in a cell that operates in LTE TDD mode. This threshold is used in the DRX algorithm. parameters.name: Data amount Statistic timer
parameters.description: Indicates the length of the UE traffic measurement period. The traffic volume of a UE during this period is measured. Based on the measurement result, the DRX algorithm decides whether the UE should enter or exit DRX. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: DRX Power Saving Measurement Switch
parameters.description: Indicates whether DRX active-time measurement is supported in an LTE TDD cell. If this parameter is set to ON, DRX active-time measurement is supported in the cell. If this parameter is set to OFF, DRX active-time measurement is not supported in the cell. This parameter applies only to LTE TDD.

parameters.name: DRX Power Saving Measurement Period
parameters.description: Indicates the duration of the UE active-time measurement period for an LTE TDD cell. The eNodeB uses the measurement result in the DRX algorithm to determine whether the UE should enter or exit DRX mode. This parameter applies only to LTE TDD.

parameters.id: DRX Power Saving Measurement Enter DRX Threshold
parameters.name: DRX Power Saving Measurement Enter DRX Threshold
parameters.description: Indicates the active-time measurement threshold for UEs to enter DRX mode in an LTE TDD cell. This threshold is used in the DRX algorithm. If the measurement result of a UE is less than this threshold, the eNodeB determines that the UE should retain its DRX state or enter DRX mode. This parameter applies only to LTE TDD.

parameters.id: DRX Power Saving Measurement Exit DRX Threshold
parameters.name: DRX Power Saving Measurement Exit DRX Threshold
parameters.description: Indicates the active-time measurement threshold for UEs to exit DRX mode in an LTE TDD cell. This threshold is used in the DRX algorithm. If the measurement result of a UE is greater than this threshold, the eNodeB determines that the UE should retain its non-DRX state or exit DRX mode. This parameter applies only to LTE TDD.

parameters.name: UnSync Long DRX Cycle
parameters.description: Indicates the length of the long DRX cycle for a UE in the uplink out-of-synchronization state. Set this parameter to a value greater than the value of LongDrxCycle; otherwise, the power saving gain of the DRX for UEs in the uplink out-of-synchronization state may decrease. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: Cqi-Mask Config Switch
parameters.description: Indicates whether the cqi-Mask IE can be set. The cqi-Mask IE is an optional IE introduced in 3GPP Release 9. If the cqi-Mask IE is set to Setup, the UE can send CQI/PMI/RI/PTI reports on PUCCH only in the onDuration period of discontinuous reception (DRX). If the cqi-Mask IE is not set, the UE can send CQI/PMI/RI/PTI reports on PUCCH in the active period of DRX. This parameter applies only to LTE

parameters.name: Onduration Timer Unsync
parameters.description: Indicates the DRX onduration timer for UEs when the eNodeB does not maintain synchronization for UEs. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: DRX Inactivity Timer Unsync
parameters.description: Indicates the DRX inactivity timer for UEs when the eNodeB does not maintain synchronization for UEs. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: DRX Policy Mode
parameters.description: Indicates the policy for selecting a DRX parameter group and the policy for enabling DRX for a UE whose bearers have different QCIs. parameters.name: DRX Start Offset Optimization Switch
parameters.description: Indicates whether to enable optimized random distribution of DrxStartOffset values for UEs that are configured with only sounding reference signal (SRS) resources, or periodic channel quality indicator (CQI), or neither. parameters.name: DRX Receive DTX Process Switch
parameters.description: If this parameter is set to ON and two consecutive discontinuous transmissions (DTXs) are detected in the downlink, the eNodeB continues the scheduling within the valid inactivity timer period. parameters.name: DRX for Measurement Switch
parameters.description: Indicates whether to deliver measurement-dedicated DRX parameters to a UE when GERAN measurements are triggered for CSFB of the UE. If this parameter is set to ON, the eNodeB delivers both DRX parameters and gap-assisted GERAN measurement configurations to the UE. parameters.name: Long DRX Cycle for Measurement
parameters.description: Indicates the length of the long DRX cycle dedicated to GERAN measurement. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: On Duration Timer for Measurement
parameters.description: Indicates the length of the On Duration Timer dedicated to GERAN measurement. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: DRX Inactivity Timer for Measurement
parameters.description: Indicates the length of the DRX Inactivity Timer dedicated to GERAN measurement. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: DRX Retransmission Timer for Measurement
parameters.description: Indicates the length of the DRX Retransmission Timer dedicated to GERAN measurement. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: Short DRX Switch for Measurement
parameters.description: Indicates whether to enable the short DRX cycle dedicated to GERAN measurement. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: Short DRX Cycle for Measurement
parameters.description: Indicates the length of the short DRX cycle dedicated to GERAN measurement. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: Short Cycle Timer for Measurement
parameters.description: Indicates the length of the DRX Short Cycle Timer dedicated to GERAN measurement. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: SR Detect Optimize Switch
parameters.description: For TDD, this parameter indicates whether to optimize the identification of false SR detection for UEs in the DRX state and the subsequent handling. parameters.name: Measurement DRX Special Schedule Switch
parameters.description: Indicates whether to enable special scheduling for UEs to which the eNodeB has delivered measurement-dedicated DRX parameters. If this parameter is set to ON, special scheduling is enabled so that the sleep time, during which GERAN measurements can be performed, is maximized for UEs that are running services. As a result, the measurement reporting delay is shortened for such UEs. If this parameter

parameters.id: Coverage based GSM Measurement DRX Configure Switch
parameters.name: Coverage based GSM Measurement DRX Configure Switch
parameters.description: Indicates whether to deliver measurement-dedicated DRX parameters to a UE when GERAN measurements are triggered for a coverage-based handover of the UE. If this parameter is set to ON, the eNodeB delivers both DRX parameters and gap-assisted GERAN measurement configurations to the UE. If this parameter is set to OFF, the eNodeB delivers only gap-assisted GERAN measurement configurations to the UE.

parameters.id: DRX On Duration Timer Unextend Opt Sw
parameters.name: DRX On Duration Timer Unextend Opt Sw

parameters.id: DRX State During UL HARQ Retrans
parameters.name: DRX State During UL HARQ Retrans
parameters.description: Indicates whether to allow only retransmission during an uplink HARQ retransmission period. If this parameter is set to DRX_ACTIVE_FOR_RETX, for UEs in DRX mode, the eNodeB performs only retransmission during an uplink HARQ retransmission period. parameters.name: DRX Algorithm Switch
parameters.description: Indicates whether to enable DRX. This parameter does not control dynamic DRX. In FDD and TDD cells, DRX takes effect on a CA UE only when this parameter is set to ON for both eNodeBs serving the PCell and SCells of the CA UE. In NB-IoT cells, DRX takes effect when this parameter is set to ON.

parameters.name: Short DRX Cycle Switch
parameters.description: Indicates whether to enable or disable short DRX cycles. Short DRX cycles reduce the traffic delay. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.id: VoLTE Gap and DRX Exclusive Switch
parameters.name: VoLTE Gap and DRX Exclusive Switch
parameters.description: Indicates whether the eNodeB delivers the intra-RAT gap-assisted measurement configuration and DRX configuration to a UE performing a voice service at the same time. If this parameter is set to OFF(Off), the eNode

parameters.name: DRX Stop SR Pending Switch
parameters.description: Indicates whether to stop the SR pending triggered by a false SR detection. If this parameter is set to ON, the eNodeB stops the SR pending triggered by a false SR detection to prevent the impact on performance. If this parameter is set to OFF, the function of stopping the SR pending triggered by a false SR detection does not take effect. This option applies only to LTE FDD.

parameters.name: GAP and DRX Exclusive Switch
parameters.description: Indicates whether the eNodeB delivers the gap-assisted measurement configuration and DRX configuration to a UE at the same time. parameters.name: NB-IoT DRX Inactivity Timer
parameters.description: Indicates the length of the DRX Inactivity Timer in an NB-IoT cell. The unit is the PDCCH period of the coverage level corresponding to a UE. This parameter applies only to NB-IoT.

parameters.name: NB-IoT DRX Retransmission Timer
parameters.description: Indicates the length of the DRX Retransmission Timer in an NB-IoT cell. The unit is the PDCCH period of the coverage level corresponding to a UE. This parameter applies only to NB-IoT.

parameters.name: NB-IoT DRX Uplink Retransmission Timer
parameters.description: Indicates the length of the DRX uplink retransmission timer in an NB-IoT cell. The unit is the PDCCH period of the coverage level corresponding to a UE. This parameter applies only to NB-IoT.

parameters.name: NB-IoT Long DRX Cycle
parameters.description: Indicates the length of the long DRX cycle in an NB-IoT cell. This parameter applies only to NB-IoT.

parameters.name: NB-IoT On Duration Timer
parameters.description: Indicates the length of the On Duration Timer in an NB-IoT cell. The unit is the PDCCH period of the coverage level corresponding to a UE. This parameter applies only to NB-IoT.

parameters.name: DRX OnDuration Pre-Scheduling Switch
parameters.description: Indicates whether to guarantee preallocation when the On Duration Timer is running. If this parameter is set to ON, the eNodeB performs at least one preallocation when the On Duration Timer is running in a long DRX cycle. This aims to obtain a longer DRX active time. parameters.name: DRX UE SRS Optimization Switch
parameters.description: Indicates whether to perform SRS optimization for DRX UEs. DrxUeSrsDtxDetectionSwitch: Indicates whether to perform DTX detection on SRSs of DRX UEs. If this option is selected, the eNodeB performs DTX detection on SRSs of DRX UEs. If this option is deselected, the eNodeB does not perform DTX detection on SRSs of DRX UEs. This option applies only to LTE TDD.

parameters.id: SINR Threshold for VoLTE DRX Control
parameters.name: SINR Threshold for VoLTE DRX Control
parameters.description: Indicates the SINR threshold for disabling DRX for VoLTE services. If the uplink SINR of VoLTE UEs is less than this threshold, the eNodeB disables DRX to lower the probability of deterioration in VoLTE experience due to packet loss and delay. If this parameter is set to -100, SINR-based DRX control for VoLTE services does not take effect. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: CA DRX Optimization Switch
parameters.description: Indicates the DRX optimization algorithms in CA scenarios. PCC_SCC_DRX_STATE_SYNC_SW: If this option is selected, a PCC or SCC informs other CCs of its DRX status change. If this option is deselected, each CC maintains its own DRX status. This option applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD. parameters.id: VoLTE Packet Loss Rate Thld for Exiting DRX
parameters.name: VoLTE Packet Loss Rate Thld for Exiting DRX
parameters.description: Indicates the VoLTE packet loss rate threshold for exiting DRX, which is used by the DRX algorithm to determine whether UEs exit DRX. parameters.id: Cell Load Thld for Forbidding Voice UE DRX Entry
parameters.name: Cell Load Thld for Forbidding Voice UE DRX Entry
parameters.description: Indicates the cell load threshold for forbidding newly accessed voice UEs to enter the DRX mode. The algorithm does not take effect when this parameter is set to 0. parameters.name: Local Cell ID
parameters.description: Indicates the local cell ID. It uniquely identifies a cell within an eNodeB. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: Long DRX Cycle for Special UE

This timer takes effect only on non-power-saving UEs configured with a specific SPID or UEs whose capability information indicates that they do not support power saving. parameters.id: DRX Inactivity Timer for Special UE
parameters.name: DRX Inactivity Timer for Special UE
parameters.description: Indicates the length of the SPID-specific DRX Inactivity Timer. This timer takes effect only on non-power-saving UEs configured with a specific SPID or UEs whose capability information indicates that they do not support power saving. For details about this timer, see 3GPP TS 36.321. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.id: Short DRX Cycle Switch for Special UE
parameters.name: Short DRX Cycle Switch for Special UE
parameters.description: Indicates whether to enable the SPID-specific short DRX cycle. This parameter takes effect only on UEs configured with a specific SPID or UEs whose capability information indicates that they do not support power saving. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.id: Short DRX Cycle for Special UE
parameters.name: Short DRX Cycle for Special UE
parameters.description: Indicates the length of the SPID-specific short DRX cycle. The short DRX cycle takes effect only on non-power-saving UEs configured with a specific SPID or UEs whose capability information indicates that they do not support power saving. parameters.id: Long DRX Cycle for Intra-RAT ANR
parameters.name: Long DRX Cycle for Intra-RAT ANR
parameters.description: Indicates the long DRX cycle for intra-RAT ANR. If intra-RAT ANR is enabled, this parameter takes effect regardless of whether DRX is enabled. parameters.id: Long DRX Cycle for Inter-RAT ANR
parameters.name: Long DRX Cycle for Inter-RAT ANR
parameters.description: Indicates the long DRX cycle for inter-RAT ANR. If inter-RAT ANR is enabled, this parameter is valid regardless of whether DRX is enabled. If there are multiple RAT systems and all of them are involved in inter-RAT ANR measurements, it is recommended that this parameter be set to the maximum value of the long DRX cycles required by inter-RAT ANR measurements. Otherwise, the success rate for inter-

parameters.id: DRX Inactivity Timer For FDD ANR
parameters.name: DRX Inactivity Timer For FDD ANR
parameters.description: Indicates the length of the DRX Inactivity Timer for LTE FDD automatic neighbor relation (ANR). If ANR is enabled, this parameter takes effect regardless of whether the DRX feature is enabled. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD.

parameters.id: DRX Inactivity Timer for TDD ANR
parameters.name: DRX Inactivity Timer for TDD ANR
parameters.description: Indicates the length of the DRX Inactivity Timer for automatic neighbor relation (ANR). If ANR is enabled, this parameter takes effect regardless of whether the DRX feature is enabled. This parameter applies only to LTE TDD.

parameters.id: DRX Short Cycle Timer for Special UE
parameters.name: DRX Short Cycle Timer for Special UE
parameters.description: Indicates the length of the SPID-specific DRX Short Cycle Timer. This timer takes effect only on non-power-saving UEs configured with a specific SPID or UEs whose capability information indicates that they do not support power saving. parameters.name: BF Specific DRX Parameter Switch
parameters.description: Indicates whether TM7, TM8, and PMI feedback-independent TM9 UEs use the same set of DRX parameters dedicated to beamforming UEs. If this parameter is set to ON, these UEs use the same set of DRX parameters dedicated to beamforming UEs. If this parameter is set to OFF, these UEs use cell-level DRX parameters. This parameter applies only to LTE TDD.

parameters.name: Local cell ID
parameters.description: Indicates the local ID of the cell. It uniquely identifies a cell within an eNodeB. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: Mute RE Switch
parameters.description: Indicates whether to send REs if the corresponding REs in the shared spectrum are being used by GSM when the GSM and LTE FDD Dynamic Spectrum Sharing feature and the GSM and LTE Zero Bufferzone feature are enabled. If this switch is on, the eNodeB cannot send these REs. If this switch is off, the eNodeB can send these REs. This parameter applies only to FDD.

parameters.description: Indicates the UL narrowband interference restriction mode used in the GSM and LTE FDD Dynamic Spectrum Sharing(LTE FDD) feature and GSM and LTE Zero Bufferzone feature.
