parameters.name: Ssac Trigger Condition Satisfied Periods
parameters.description: Indicates the number of consecutive periods for triggering intelligent access barring on specific services. If related triggering conditions are met for the specified number of consecutive periods, intelligent access barring on specific services is triggered. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: Ssac Cancel Condition Satisfied Periods
parameters.description: Indicates the number of consecutive periods for canceling intelligent access barring on specific services. If related cancellation conditions are met for the specified number of consecutive periods, intelligent access barring on specific services is canceled. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: Disaster Reference Indication
parameters.description: Indicates the disaster reference indications used for determining whether a cell is in the disaster state. If all options included in this parameter are deselected, the disaster state of the cell does not need to be determined. ETWS_PN: Indicates whether Primary notifications (PNs) in the earthquake and tsunami warning system (ETWS) are used in the disaster state determination. The PNs for ETWS do

parameters.name: Disaster Duration
parameters.description: Indicates the duration that the cell is in the disaster state. The cell is out of the disaster state after the duration specified by this parameter ends. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: MO Trigger Condition Satisfied Periods
parameters.description: Indicates the number of consecutive periods for triggering intelligent access class control on mobile-originated (MO) calls or signaling if related triggering conditions are met. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: MO Cancel Condition Satisfied Periods
parameters.description: Indicates the number of consecutive periods for canceling intelligent access class control on mobile-originated (MO) calls or signaling if related cancellation conditions are met. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: MO Factor Adjusting Step
parameters.description: Indicates the MO factor adjustment step used after intelligent AC control is triggered. The adjustment target factor is the factor that is ahead of the current factor by the value of this parameter. For example, if this parameter is set to 2 and the current factor is p95, the target factor is p85, which is ahead of p95 by two factors. If the adjustment step required for adjusting the current facto

parameters.name: MO Factor Retreating Step
parameters.description: Indicates the MO factor retreating step used after the conditions for canceling intelligent AC control are met but the number of consecutive periods in which the conditions are met has not reached the value of the MoCancelCondSatiPeriods parameter. The retreating target factor is the factor that is behind the current factor by the value of the MO Factor Retreating Step parameter. For example, if t

parameters.name: SSAC Factor Adjusting Step
parameters.description: Indicates the service specific access control (SSAC) factor adjustment step used after SSAC is triggered. The adjustment target factor is the factor that is ahead of the current factor by the value of this parameter. For example, if this parameter is set to 2 and the current factor is p95, the target factor is p85, which is ahead of p95 by two factors. If the adjustment step required for adjusting

parameters.name: SSAC Factor Retreating Step
parameters.description: Indicates the service specific access control (SSAC) factor retreating step used after the conditions for canceling SSAC are met but the number of consecutive periods in which the conditions are met has not reached the value of the SsacCancelCondSatiPeriods parameter. The retreating target factor is the factor that is behind the current factor by the value of the SSAC Factor Retreating Step parame

parameters.name: MO Factor Initial Value
parameters.description: Indicates the initial value of the probability factor used after dynamic AC barring on mobile-originated calls or signaling is started. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.id: RRC Reject Rate Congestion Trigger Thld
parameters.name: RRC Reject Rate Congestion Trigger Thld
parameters.description: Indicates the threshold of RRC connection reject rate for triggering access control. If the RRC connection reject rate of a cell is continuously higher than this threshold for N (N = the value of the MoTriggerCondSatiPeriods parameter) consecutive statistic periods specified by the DynAcBarStatPeriod parameter, the cell enters the automatic AC barring control process. This parameter applies only t

parameters.name: Ue-Number-based Congestion Clear Thld
parameters.description: Indicates the UE number threshold for relieving the congestion state of a cell. If the number of UEs in a cell in the UE number congestion state becomes less than the value of this parameter, the cell exits this congestion state. If this parameter is set to 0, the function of this parameter does not take effect. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: UE-Number-based Congestion Thld
parameters.description: Indicates the UE number threshold for entering the congestion state of a cell. If the number of UEs in a cell not in the UE number congestion state exceeds the value of this parameter, the cell enters the UE number congestion state. If this parameter is set to 0, the function of this parameter does not take effect. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: Local Cell ID
parameters.description: Indicates the local ID of a cell, which uniquely identifies the cell within an eNodeB. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: Dynamic Power Sharing Switch
parameters.description: Indicates whether to enable dynamic power sharing. This parameter consists of the following options: LTE_DYN_POWER_SHARING_SW: Indicates whether to enable power sharing between LTE carriers. These LTE carriers can be FDD carriers or TDD carriers, but cannot be any combination of FDD and TDD carriers. When this option is selected, power can be shared between LTE carriers. This option applies only t

parameters.name: Max Power Sharing Rate
parameters.description: Indicates the maximum percentage of power that the LTE carrier can share from other carriers. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: Interference Control Switch
parameters.description: Indicates whether to enable interference control. If this parameter is set to ON, interference control is enabled. The eNodeB periodically predicts the impact of the local cell's reception of shared power on neighboring cells in terms of interference. If the prediction results indicate that the overall performance of the local and neighboring cells will be better after power sharing, the eNodeB al

parameters.name: Power Adjustment Mode
parameters.description: Indicates the power adjustment mode of the cell that receives shared power. If this parameter is set to PDSCH_ONLY, the eNodeB increases only PDSCH power in the cell. If this parameter is set to CRS_AND_PDSCH, the eNodeB increases both CRS power and PDSCH power in the cell. This option applies only to LTE FDD.

parameters.name: Power Insufficiency Time Rate Threshold
parameters.description: Indicates the threshold, which is a percentage of the scheduling time with power insufficiency, for LTE extreme power sharing to take effect. The larger the value of this parameter, the longer the allowed duration of power insufficiency and the higher the probability that power sharing takes effect. The smaller the value of this parameter, the shorter the allowed duration of power insufficiency an

parameters.name: Local cell ID
parameters.description: Indicates the local ID of a cell, which uniquely identifies a cell within a base station.

parameters.name: EAB Control Trigger Threshold
parameters.description: Indicates the threshold for triggering extended access barring (EAB). The threshold is denoted by a percentage of cell congestion duration. If the percentage of time when the cell is in a congestion state is greater than or equal to the value of this parameter within a statistics collection period (specified by the EABStatPeriod parameter), the conditions for triggering EAB are met.

parameters.name: EAB Control Statistic Periods
parameters.description: Indicates the period for measuring the percentage of cell congestion duration for extended access barring (EAB). An eNodeB periodically determines the cell status based on the setting of this parameter.

parameters.name: EAB Category
parameters.description: Indicates the category of UEs to which EAB information is applied. If this parameter is set to CATEGORY_A, EAB information is applied to all EAB-applicable UEs. If this parameter to CATEGORY_B, EAB information is applied to EAB-applicable UEs that are not in the HPLMN and EHPLMN. If this parameter is set to CATEGORY_C, EAB information is applied to EAB-applicable UEs that are not in the HPLMN, EHP

parameters.name: EAB Control Cancel Threshold
parameters.description: Indicates the threshold for canceling extended access barring (EAB). The threshold is denoted by a percentage of cell congestion duration. If the percentage of time when the cell is in a congestion state is less than or equal to the value of this parameter within a statistics collection period (specified by the EABStatPeriod parameter), the conditions for canceling EAB are met.

parameters.name: EAB Cancel Condition Satisfied Period
parameters.description: Indicates the number of consecutive periods in which the conditions for canceling extended access barring (EAB) are met. EAB can be canceled only when the number of consecutive periods in which the conditions for canceling EAB are met reaches the value of this parameter.

parameters.id: NB-IoT Access Barring For Exception Data
parameters.name: NB-IoT Access Barring For Exception Data
parameters.description: Indicates the access barring status of abnormal data. This parameter specifies whether NB-IoT UEs can initiate access with the cause value being mo-ExceptionData. When this parameter is set to BOOLEAN_TRUE, NB-IoT UEs are not allowed to initiate access with the cause value being mo-ExceptionData. When this parameter is set to BOOLEAN_FALSE, NB-IoT UEs can initiate access with the cause value being

parameters.name: NB-IoT Access Barring For AC11-15
parameters.description: Indicates the access barring status of UEs with access classes 11 to 15. This parameter specifies whether NB-IoT UEs with access classes 11 to 15 can initiate access. AC11BARSTATE: If this option is selected, access initiated by NB-IoT UEs of AC 11 in idle mode is barred. This option applies only to NB-IoT. AC12BARSTATE: If this option is selected, access initiated by NB-IoT UEs of AC 12 in idle m

parameters.id: Access Class Count for Manual Access Barring
parameters.name: Access Class Count for Manual Access Barring
parameters.description: Indicates the number of barred access classes for AC0-AC9 UEs indicated in SIB14. When this parameter is set to the invalid value 255, the number of barred access classes in SIB14 is dynamically controlled by the access barring algorithm.

parameters.name: Local Cell ID
parameters.description: Indicates the local ID of the cell. It uniquely identifies a cell within a base station. This parameter applies only to NB-IoT.

parameters.name: EDT DL Data Waiting Timer
parameters.description: Indicates the length of the timer governing the period during which the eNodeB waits for downlink data from the core network when a UE initiates an EDT service. The timer length specified by this parameter must be less than the timer length specified by the CellRachCECfg.EdtContentionResTimer parameter when the EDT service does not use early contention resolution. Otherwise, the UE EDT service can

parameters.name: EDT Early Contention Resolution Mode
parameters.description: Indicates the early contention resolution mode used for EDT in a cell. If this parameter is set to OFF, early contention resolution is not supported. In this case, SRB0 and the contention resolution MCE must be delivered at the same time. If this parameter is set to SRB0_CONTENTION_RES_SPLIT_SCH, SRB0 and the contention resolution MCE are separately scheduled. If this parameter is set to ADAPTIVE,

parameters.id: Preferential Tone Num for EDT Multi-tone Sch
parameters.name: Preferential Tone Num for EDT Multi-tone Sch
parameters.description: Indicates the number of tones preferentially used when multi-tone scheduling is used for EDT services. This parameter takes effect only for UEs at coverage level 0. Single-tone scheduling is used for UEs at coverage levels 1 and 2. This parameter applies only to NB-IoT.

parameters.name: EDT Sch Strategy
parameters.description: Indicates the scheduling policy used when there are EDT services in a cell. If this parameter is set to NON_EDT_PRIORITY, scheduling of non-EDT services is preferentially guaranteed. If this parameter is set to DEFAULT, scheduling is based on fairness without differentiating between service types. If this parameter is set to EDT_PREFERRED, scheduling of EDT services is preferentially guaranteed. T

parameters.name: Number of EDT TBS Type
parameters.description: Indicates the number of different TBSs that can be used for the transmission of Msg3 for EDT. If this parameter is set to ONE, the TBS used for the transmission of Msg3 for EDT initiated by a UE must be the same as that used for the transmission of system information. If this parameter is set to TWO, a maximum of two different TBSs can be used for the transmission of Msg3 for EDT. If this paramete

parameters.name: EDT Algorithm Switch
parameters.description: Indicates whether to enable EDT. EDT_SWITCH: Indicates whether to enable EDT in the cell. If this option is selected, the cell supports EDT and UEs can perform EDT services in the cell. If this option is deselected, the cell does not support EDT. This option applies only to NB-IoT. EDT_L_VALUE_COMPAT_SWITCH: Indicates whether to determine the value of L based on Msg3 for EDT. If this option is sel

parameters.name: Local cell ID
parameters.description: Indicates the local cell identity. It uniquely identifies a cell within an eNodeB. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: Abs pattern
parameters.description: Indicates the ABS pattern when static TDM-based eICIC is enabled. This parameter is valid only if static TDM-based eICIC is enabled. Different ABS patterns indicate different ABS quantities and ABS numbers in the same period. An ABS pattern is a 40-bit bitmap. parameters.name: Eicic Measure Enable
parameters.description: Indicates whether UEs are allowed to send measurement reports for event A3 during enhanced inter-cell interference coordination (eICIC). The parameter value ENABLE indicates that UEs are allowed to send measurement reports for event A3 during eICIC. The parameter value DISABLE indicates that UEs are not allowed to send measurement reports for event A3 during eICIC, and in this case the eNodeB cann

parameters.name: eICIC A3 Offset
parameters.description: Indicates the offset for event A3 during enhanced inter-cell interference coordination (eICIC). This offset is the difference between the signal quality of a neighboring cell and that of the serving cell. A larger value indicates that a neighboring cell must have better signal quality for the reporting of event A3. A smaller value indicates that the requirement on the neighboring cell signal quali

parameters.name: Abs Adjustment Period
parameters.description: Indicates the period of adjusting the ABS pattern of a macro cell in dynamic eICIC. This parameter must be configured based on the number of cells and the load of X2 interfaces. It is recommended that the ABS adjustment period (unit: s) be equal to the number of macro cells of the local eNodeB multiplied by the number of micro cells in the local macro cell. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD.

parameters.name: Sample Number Target
parameters.description: Indicates the minimum required number of samples for starting automatic configuration of macro-micro associations. A micro cell collects the sample statistics in a measurement period only when the number of sample macro-cell measurement reports received by the micro cell within the period exceeds or equals the value of this parameter. This parameter takes effect only in micro cells. This parameter

parameters.name: Attach Cell Add Threshold
parameters.description: Indicates the threshold used to trigger automatic configuration of macro-micro associations. The macro-micro association is updated only if the percentage of the strongest macro cell exceeds or equals the threshold. This parameter takes effect only in micro cells. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: Work Mode
parameters.description: Indicates the working mode for automatic configuration of macro-micro associations. If this parameter is set to AUTO, macro-micro associations are automatically configured with no need for manual confirmation. If this parameter is set to CONTROLLED, the strongest macro cell is reported to the MAE for manual confirmation each time before the associations can be configured. This parameter takes effe

parameters.name: Statistical Period
parameters.description: Indicates the measurement period for automatic configuration of macro-micro associations. The micro cell counts the number of times each macro cell is included in measurement reports within each period. To prevent network performance deterioration for UEs, the macro-micro associations are not updated immediately when a measurement period approaches its end. Instead, the update is triggered at the

parameters.name: CRE Adjustment Period
parameters.description: Indicates the period of CRE configuration adjustment by a macro cell based on statistics when Adaptive eICIC is enabled. This parameter applies only to FDD.

parameters.name: eICIC Config User Ratio Threshold
parameters.description: Indicates the threshold of the penetration rate of eICIC UEs required for configuring a large CRE offset (6 dB or 9 dB) when eICIC adaptation is enabled. If the penetration rate of eICIC UEs is greater than or equal to this threshold, a large CRE offset can be configured. This parameter applies only to FDD.

parameters.name: eICIC UnConfig User Ratio Threshold
parameters.description: Indicates the threshold of the penetration rate of eICIC UEs required for no longer using a large CRE offset (6 dB or 9 dB) when eICIC adaptation is enabled. If the penetration rate of eICIC UEs is less than this threshold, a large CRE offset cannot be configured. This parameter applies only to FDD.

parameters.id: Large CRE Micro Cell Number Threshold
parameters.name: Large CRE Micro Cell Number Threshold
parameters.description: Indicates the threshold of the number of micro cells homed to a macro cell. This parameter is used to determine whether to configure a large CRE offset (6 dB or 9 dB) when Adaptive eICIC is enabled. If the actual number is greater than or equal to this threshold, a large CRE offset can be set. Otherwise, a large CRE offset cannot be set. This parameter applies only to FDD.

parameters.name: eICIC Adaptive Switch
parameters.description: Indicates whether to allow automatic adjustment of a CRE offset based on statistics. If this switch is on, Adaptive eICIC is enabled. If this switch is off, Adaptive eICIC is disabled. This parameter takes effect only when dynamic eICIC or FeICIC is enabled. This parameter applies only to FDD.

parameters.id: Neighboring Cell Statistic Period for NAIC
parameters.name: Neighboring Cell Statistic Period for NAIC
parameters.description: Indicates the period for collecting statistics on intra-frequency neighboring cells that cause interference to the local cell after network-assisted interference cancellation is enabled. Assistant information of eight neighboring cells causing the strongest interference is delivered to UEs after the period ends. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: High-Speed ICS CCE Threshold
parameters.description: Indicates the threshold of the equivalent CCE usage for enabling interference coordination for handover zones along high-speed railways. If the equivalent CCE usage exceeds this threshold, interference coordination is enabled for handover zones along high-speed railways. This parameter applies only to LTE TDD.

parameters.name: High-Speed ICS DTX Threshold
parameters.description: Indicates the threshold of the DTX rate for enabling interference coordination for handover zones along high-speed railways. If the DTX rate exceeds this threshold, interference coordination is enabled for handover zones along high-speed railways. This parameter applies only to LTE TDD.

parameters.name: High-Speed Enhanced Optimization Switch
parameters.description: Indicates whether to enable network enhancement and optimization in high-speed railway scenarios. HighSpeedCoorSwitch: Indicates whether to enable interference coordination for UEs in handover zones along high-speed railways. If this option is selected, the eNodeB enables interference coordination for UEs in handover zones along high-speed railways. If this option is deselected, the eNodeB disable

parameters.name: High-Speed Incoming Handover Threshold
parameters.description: Indicates the threshold of the number of incoming handovers for enabling interference coordination for handover zones along high-speed railways. If the number of incoming handovers performed in handover zones along high-speed railways is greater than or equal to this threshold, interference coordination is enabled for such handover zones. This parameter applies only to LTE TDD.

parameters.name: Local Cell ID
parameters.description: Indicates the local primary cell ID. It uniquely identifies a cell within an eNodeB. This option applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: Emergency Area ID
parameters.description: Indicates the ID of an emergency area in which an alarm message is to be broadcast. The emergency area ID is defined by the operator. An emergency area consists of one or several cells. For details about this parameter, see 3GPP TS 36.413. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: Local Cell ID
parameters.description: Indicates the local cell ID. It uniquely identifies a cell within an eNodeB. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: eMTC Target UL RB Usage
parameters.description: Indicates the target uplink RB usage of eMTC UEs in the cell. If the UlLteRsvNbCount parameter in the CellEmtcAlgo MO is set to a large value, the actual RB usage of eMTC UEs may fail to reach the value specified by the EmtcUlRbTargetRatio parameter. parameters.name: eMTC Aperiodic CQI Trigger Period
parameters.description: Indicates the period of triggering aperiodic CQI reporting by eMTC UEs. The period can be 5 ms, 10 ms, 20 ms, 40 ms, 80 ms, 160 ms, and infinite (that is, no aperiodic CQI reporting is triggered). This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: eMTC Target DL RB Usage
parameters.description: Indicates the target downlink RB usage of eMTC UEs in the cell. If the DlLteRsvNbCount parameter in the CellEmtcAlgo MO is set to a large value, the actual RB usage of eMTC UEs may fail to reach the value specified by the EmtcDlRbTargetRatio parameter. Modification of this parameter has no impact on the network if the EMTC_ONLY_CELL_SWITCH option of the EmtcAlgoSwitch parameter is selected. This p

parameters.name: eMTC Algorithm Switch
parameters.description: Indicates whether to enable eMTC-related algorithms. EMTC_SWITCH: Indicates whether to enable eMTC. If this option is selected, eMTC UEs can access the cell and perform services normally. If this option is deselected, eMTC UEs cannot access the cell to perform services. This option applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD. IDLE_EDRX_SWITCH: Indicates whether to enable eDRX in idle mode. If this option

parameters.name: DL LTE Reserved NB Count
parameters.description: Indicates the number of narrowbands reserved for LTE UEs when the eNodeB schedules eMTC UEs in the downlink in the cell. These reserved narrowbands cannot be allocated to the MPDCCH and PDSCH for eMTC services. This parameter must be set to 2 for a 5 MHz cell. The value range is 2 to 5 for a 10 MHz cell, 2 to 9 for a 15 MHz cell, and 2 to 13 for a 20 MHz cell. If the cell uses a non-standard bandw

parameters.name: UL LTE Reserved NB Count
parameters.description: Indicates the number of narrowbands reserved for LTE UEs when the eNodeB schedules eMTC UEs in the uplink in the cell. These reserved narrowbands cannot be used for eMTC service data sent on the PUSCH. This parameter must be set to 2 for a 5 MHz cell. The value range is 2 to 5 for a 10 MHz cell, 2 to 9 for a 15 MHz cell, and 2 to 13 for a 20 MHz cell. If the cell uses a non-standard bandwidth, the

parameters.name: eMTC Cell VoLTE Capability Switch
parameters.description: Indicates whether to enable VoLTE for an eMTC cell. If this parameter is set to ON, VoLTE is enabled for the eMTC cell. If this parameter is set to OFF, VoLTE is disabled for the eMTC cell. This parameter is invalid when the EutranVoipSupportSwitch parameter is set to OFF. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.id: eMTC No Service Aperiodic CQI Trigger Period
parameters.name: eMTC No Service Aperiodic CQI Trigger Period
parameters.description: Indicates the triggering period for aperiodic CQI reporting when eMTC UEs are not performing services. The value INF indicates infinite, which means that aperiodic CQI reporting will not be triggered. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: eMTC Downlink Frequency Hopping Interval
parameters.description: Indicates the downlink frequency hopping interval for eMTC in CE mode A or CE mode B. If the MPDCCH_PDSCH_FREQ_HOPPING_SW option is selected, the downlink frequency hopping interval is the value specified by this parameter. parameters.name: eMTC Uplink Frequency Hopping Interval
parameters.description: Indicates the uplink frequency hopping interval for eMTC in CE mode A or CE mode B. If the PUSCH_FREQ_HOPPING_SW option is selected, the uplink frequency hopping interval is the value specified by this parameter. If CE mode B is used, the value INTERVAL1 does not take effect. parameters.name: MPDCCH/PDSCH Frequency Hopping Offset
parameters.description: Indicates the MPDCCH/PDSCH frequency hopping offset for eMTC UEs. This parameter can be set to 1 or 2 for 3 MHz cells. The value range is [1, 4] for 5 MHz cells, [1, 8] for 10 MHz cells, [1, 12] for 15 MHz cells, and [1, 16] for 20 MHz cells. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: MPDCCH/PDSCH Frequency Hopping NB Count
parameters.description: Indicates the number of NBs for MPDCCH/PDSCH frequency hopping for eMTC UEs. NB is short for narrowband, and an NB consists of six contiguous RBs. The value NB2 indicates two NBs for frequency hopping, and the value NB4 indicates four NBs for frequency hopping. parameters.name: PUSCH Frequency Hopping Offset
parameters.description: Indicates the PUSCH frequency hopping offset for eMTC UEs. This parameter can be set to 1 or 2 for 3 MHz cells. The value range is [1, 4] for 5 MHz cells, [1, 8] for 10 MHz cells, [1, 12] for 15 MHz cells, and [1, 16] for 20 MHz cells. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: PRACH Frequency Hopping Offset
parameters.description: Indicates the PRACH frequency hopping offset for eMTC UEs. The PRACH frequency hopping offset for eMTC UEs can be manually or automatically configured. If the PRACH frequency hopping offset is automatically configured, the GUI value of this parameter does not take effect. parameters.name: eMTC Frequency Hopping Switch
parameters.description: Indicates whether to enable frequency hopping for eMTC UEs. PRACH_FREQ_HOPPING_SW: Indicates whether to enable PRACH frequency hopping for eMTC UEs. If this option is selected, PRACH frequency hopping is enabled for eMTC UEs, and PRACH is transmitted based on the PRACH frequency-domain offset for eMTC UEs in accordance with a protocol-specified spectrum bitmap. For details, see section 5.7.1 in 3G

parameters.name: eMTC PDSCH/PUSCH Enhancement Switch
parameters.description: Indicates whether to enable PDSCH/PUSCH enhancement for eMTC UEs. If this parameter is set to ON, PDSCH/PUSCH enhancement is enabled for eMTC UEs. For UEs in CE mode A, a new set of PUSCH repetition counts (1, 2, 4, 8, 12, 16, 24, and 32) is used and optimization of PDSCH/PUSCH modulation constraints is supported. parameters.name: eMTC Dynamic HARQ-ACK Delay Parameter
parameters.description: Indicates whether to enable dynamic HARQ-ACK delay for eMTC UEs. If this parameter is set to RANGE1 or RANGE2, dynamic HARQ-ACK delay is enabled for eMTC UEs. For eMTC UEs in CE mode A, the value of HARQ-ACK delay for the PDSCH is one of the values corresponding to RANGE1 or RANGE2, and the DCI is used to inform the eMTC UEs of the delay value. The values corresponding to RANGE1 are 4, 5, 7, 9, 11

parameters.name: eMTC DL Schedule Strategy
parameters.description: Indicates the downlink scheduling policy for eMTC UEs. Round robin (RR) ensures scheduling fairness between UEs in a cell. However, it delivers low system throughput. Generally, RR is used to verify a system's best performance in scheduling fairness. parameters.name: eMTC Enhanced VoLTE Algorithm Switch
parameters.description: Indicates whether to enable the algorithms related to enhanced VoLTE over eMTC. VOLTE_REPETITION_OPT_SWITCH: Indicates whether to optimize repetitions for VoLTE UEs. If this option is selected, the eNodeB dynamically selects the number of repetitions, MCS indexes, and RBs for the PDSCH and PUSCH based on voice packet sizes and channel conditions. If this option is deselected, the optimization does

parameters.id: eMTC Initial Aggregation Level Adj Value
parameters.name: eMTC Initial Aggregation Level Adj Value
parameters.description: Indicates the initial adjustment value of the MPDCCH aggregation level for eMTC UEs. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: eMTC Initial CQI Adjustment Value
parameters.description: Indicates the initial CQI adjustment value for eMTC UEs. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.id: eMTC SRI Repetition UE Maximum SRI Usage
parameters.name: eMTC SRI Repetition UE Maximum SRI Usage
parameters.description: Indicates the maximum SRI resource usage allowed for eMTC UEs in the cell to transmit SRIs repeatedly. If this parameter is set to 0, eMTC UEs that need to transmit SRIs repeatedly cannot access the cell. This option applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: eMTC RACH Algorithm Switch
parameters.description: Indicates whether to enable the algorithms related to eMTC random access. EXCEED_RADIUS_CRA_DETECTION_SW: Indicates whether to detect contention-based random access by eMTC UEs located beyond the cell radius. If this option is selected, the eNodeB can detect contention-based random access by UEs located beyond the cell radius. If this option is deselected, the eNodeB does not detect contention-bas

parameters.name: Local Cell ID
parameters.description: Indicates the local ID of the cell. It uniquely identifies a cell within a base station.

parameters.name: Channel Coverage Enhancement Switch
parameters.description: Indicates whether to enable channel coverage enhancement. PRACH_PUCCH_COVERAGE_ENH_SW: Indicates whether to enable coverage enhancement for the PRACH and PUCCH. This option is valid when the UlCoverageEnhancementSw parameter is set to ON. This option applies only to LTE FDD. PUSCH_JR_COVERAGE_ENH_SW: Indicates whether to enable UL CoMP for UEs for which coverage is enhanced. This option is valid w

parameters.name: Local Cell ID
parameters.description: Indicates the local ID of a cell. It uniquely identifies a cell within an eNodeB.

parameters.name: Frame Offset Mode
parameters.description: Indicates the frame offset configuration mode for the cell. The value CustomFrameOffset(User-defined frame offset) indicates that the frame offset is user-defined. Only this value applies to FDD cells and NB-IoT cells. parameters.name: Frame Offset
parameters.description: Indicates the offset of the start time of a cell frame against a reference clock source.

parameters.name: Frame Offset Effect Value
parameters.description: Indicates the offset of the cell start frame against a reference clock source. If the parameter value is a hyphen (-), the cell has not been activated.

parameters.name: Local cell ID
parameters.description: Indicates the local identity of the cell. It uniquely identifies a cell within an eNodeB. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: BlindHO A1A2 RSRP trigger threshold
parameters.description: Indicates the RSRP threshold for events A1 and A2 related to coverage-based inter-frequency blind handover and coverage-based inter-RAT blind handover. If the RSRP of the serving cell exceeds the threshold, event A1 is reported. If the RSRP of the serving cell is lower than the threshold, event A2 is reported. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: BlindHO A1A2 RSRQ trigger threshold
parameters.description: Indicates the RSRQ threshold for events A1 and A2 related to coverage-based inter-frequency blind handover and coverage-based inter-RAT blind handover. If the RSRQ of the serving cell exceeds the threshold, event A1 is reported. If the RSRQ of the serving cell is lower than the threshold, event A2 is reported. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: High Speed Handover Threshold
parameters.description: Indicates the threshold that determines whether a UE moves at a high or low speed. If the UE moves at a speed lower than this threshold, the UE is a low-speed UE. Otherwise, it is a high-speed UE. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: Handover Mode switch
parameters.description: Indicates the handover method switches based on which the eNodeB determines handover policies. BlindHoSwitch: This option specifies whether to enable blind handover for CSFB. Bind handover for CSFB is enabled only if this option is selected. parameters.name: SRVCC Handover Optimization Switch

SRVCCWITHPSCSRETRYSWITCH(SrvccWithPsCsRetrySwitch): Assume that a PS+CS handover preparation for SRVCC fails. parameters.id: Uplink Bad Quality Handover MCS Threshold
parameters.name: Uplink Bad Quality Handover MCS Threshold

parameters.id: Uplink Bad Quality Handover IBLER Threshold
parameters.name: Uplink Bad Quality Handover IBLER Threshold
parameters.description: Indicates the IBLER threshold for triggering uplink-quality-based handovers. If the uplink IBLER of a UE minus the target IBLER is greater than the UlBadQualHoIblerThd parameter value, an uplink-quality-based handover is triggered for the UE. parameters.name: Speed Evaluated Period
parameters.description: Indicates the period during which the number of handovers is used to determine whether a UE in RRC_CONNECTED mode moves at a high speed. If the number of handovers of a UE in an evaluation period specified by SpeedEvaluatedPeriod is greater than SpeedEvaluatedNum, the eNodeB determines that the UE moves at a high speed and initiates a measurement-based redirection to a high-speed frequency. parameters.id: HO Num in Speed Evaluated Period
parameters.name: HO Num in Speed Evaluated Period

parameters.id: LTE To UTRAN CSFB Measurement Processing Mode
parameters.name: LTE To UTRAN CSFB Measurement Processing Mode
parameters.description: Indicates how measurement reports are handled in measurement-based CSFB to UTRAN. If this parameter is set to HANDOVER_IMMEDIATELY, the eNodeB immediately performs handover decision after receiving a measurement report for CSFB to UTRAN. parameters.name: CSFB Measurement Waiting Timer
parameters.description: Indicates the length of the timer that the eNodeB waits for the next measurement report after receiving the first measurement report for measurement-based CSFB to UTRAN. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: Handover Algo Switch
parameters.description: Indicates whether to enable handover algorithms. This parameter provides the following options: InterFreqCoverHoSwitch: If this option is selected, coverage-based inter-frequency handovers are enabled to ensure service continuity. If this option is deselected, coverage-based inter-frequency handovers are disabled. This option applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD. EmcInterFreqBlindHoSwitch: If this

parameters.id: Speed Evaluated Number For Fast UE
parameters.name: Speed Evaluated Number For Fast UE
parameters.description: Indicates the number of handovers used to determine whether a UE in RRC_CONNECTED mode moves at a high speed during a specified period. If the number of handovers of a UE within the time specified by the SpeedEvaluatedPeriod parameter exceeds the value of this parameter, the eNodeB identifies the UE as a high-speed one and performs a speed-based inter-frequency handover for the UE. parameters.id: Handover Use UE Inactive Timer Switch
parameters.name: Handover Use UE Inactive Timer Switch
parameters.description: HoUseInactiveTimerSwitch: Indicates whether the source cell delivers information of the elapsed time of the inactivity timer of a UE to the target cell in a handover or an RRC connection reestablishment and the target cell inherits the elapsed time. parameters.id: High Speed Cell Sleep User Number
parameters.name: High Speed Cell Sleep User Number
parameters.description: Indicates the UE quantity threshold for triggering blind redirection in a high-speed railway cell when the train leaves the cell. This parameter is used for interference coordination in high-speed railway scenarios. parameters.id: Low Speed Users Selection Protection Timer
parameters.name: Low Speed Users Selection Protection Timer
parameters.description: Indicates the protection timer for low-speed UEs used in the Handover Enhancement at Speed Mobility feature. After a high-speed or ultra-high-speed cell hands over low-speed UEs to other cells, the cell does not hand over more low-speed UEs until the protection timer expires. parameters.id: High Speed Cell Handover-in Protect Timer
parameters.name: High Speed Cell Handover-in Protect Timer
parameters.description: Indicates the period during which a UE's handover back to the source cell is not allowed after the UE is handed over to a high-speed cell. This parameter suppresses ping-pong handovers. If this parameter is set to 0, UEs' handover back to the source cell is not suppressed after they are handed over to high-speed cells. This parameter applies to high speed railway scenarios. This parameter can be s

parameters.name: Flash SRVCC Switch
parameters.description: Indicates whether to enable the flash SRVCC algorithm. If this parameter is set to ON(On), the flash SRVCC algorithm is enabled. parameters.id: Ul Poor Coverage Path Loss Threshold
parameters.name: Ul Poor Coverage Path Loss Threshold
parameters.description: Indicates the path loss threshold for uplink weak coverage identification in the flash SRVCC algorithm. parameters.name: Ul Poor Coverage SINR Threshold
parameters.description: Indicates the SINR threshold for uplink weak coverage identification in the flash SRVCC algorithm. If the FlashSrvccSwitch parameter in the CellHoParaCfg MO is set to ON(On), the eNodeB determines that the UE resides in a weak coverage area when the uplink SINR of the UE is less than the UlPoorCoverSinrThd parameter value or the uplink path loss is greater than the UlPoorCoverPathLossThd parameter

parameters.id: PLR Evaluate Period for VoLTE Quality HO
parameters.name: PLR Evaluate Period for VoLTE Quality HO
parameters.description: Indicates the period of evaluating the voice packet loss rate for speech-quality-based handovers. If the period of measuring the voice packet loss rate is longer than this threshold, decisions of triggering speech-quality-based handovers can be made for UEs suffering from low voice quality. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.id: Measurement Report Delay Timer for QCI 1
parameters.name: Measurement Report Delay Timer for QCI 1
parameters.description: Indicates the duration of the handover processing timer started after a dedicated QCI 1 bearer is set up. If this parameter is set to 0, the timer does not take effect. If this parameter is set to a value other than 0, the eNodeB does not process a received handover-oriented measurement report or start the handover processing until the timer expires. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE

parameters.name: VoLTE Quality Handover Algo Switch
parameters.description: Indicates whether to turn on switches related to the speech-quality-based handover algorithm. GeranVolteQualityHoSwitch: If this option is selected, UEs suffering from low speech quality can be handed over to GERAN cells. parameters.name: High Speed UE Judge Mode
parameters.description: Indicates the mode for determining whether a UE moves at a high speed. If this parameter is set to HANDOVERNUMBASED, the eNodeB determines whether a UE moves at a high speed based on the number of handovers during a specified period. parameters.name: Ringing Message Check Switch
parameters.description: Indicates whether to check the SIP Ringing message when the processing delay of SRVCC measurement reports is enabled. The eNodeB identifies the SIP Ringing message and stops the timer defined by SrvccMrDelayTimer after the identification is successful if this parameter is set to ON(On). The eNodeB does not identify the message if this parameter is set to OFF(Off).

parameters.name: SRVCC Measurement Report Delay Timer
parameters.description: Indicates the length of the processing delay timer of inter-RAT handover measurement reports that UEs send when running QCI-1 services. This timer starts when a VoLTE service is successfully set up. It is used to avoid SRVCC before phones ring or users answer calls. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.id: VoLTE Qual Based Inter-Freq HO QCI1 PLR Thld
parameters.name: VoLTE Qual Based Inter-Freq HO QCI1 PLR Thld
parameters.description: Indicates the threshold of the QCI-1 packet loss rate for triggering speech-quality-based inter-frequency handovers. If the QCI-1 packet loss rate is greater than this threshold, UEs are allowed to trigger speech-quality-based inter-frequency handovers. If the QCI-1 packet loss rate is less than VolteQualRecoveryQci1PlrThld, speech-quality-based inter-frequency handovers are stopped. This paramete

parameters.id: VoLTE Quality Recovery QCI1 PLR Thld
parameters.name: VoLTE Quality Recovery QCI1 PLR Thld
parameters.description: Indicates the threshold of the QCI-1 packet loss rate for evaluating whether the speech quality is recovered. When the QCI-1 packet loss rate is less than or equal to this threshold, UEs' speech quality is recovered and speech quality-based inter-frequency and inter-RAT handovers are terminated. parameters.id: Inter-RAT Uu Handover Failure Retry Times
parameters.name: Inter-RAT Uu Handover Failure Retry Times
parameters.description: Indicates the number of inter-RAT handover retries initiated to the same target cell after the handover fails over the air interface in the target cell. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: E-UTRAN RSRP Filter Coefficient
parameters.description: Indicates the upper-layer filtering coefficient for the RSRP of E-UTRAN. For details, see 3GPP TS 36.331. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: E-UTRAN RSRQ Filter Coefficient
parameters.description: Indicates the upper-layer filtering coefficient for the RSRQ of E-UTRAN. For details, see 3GPP TS 36.331. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.id: Emerg Blind Redirect A1 A2 RSRP Thld for CE Mode A
parameters.name: Emerg Blind Redirect A1 A2 RSRP Thld for CE Mode A
parameters.description: Indicates the RSRP threshold for events A1 and A2 related to coverage-based inter-frequency and inter-RAT emergency blind redirections for UEs in coverage enhancement (CE) mode A. If the measured RSRP value of the serving cell exceeds the threshold, event A1 is reported. If the measured RSRP value of the serving cell is lower than the threshold, event A2 is reported. parameters.id: Emerg Blind Redirect A1 A2 RSRQ Thld for CE Mode A
parameters.name: Emerg Blind Redirect A1 A2 RSRQ Thld for CE Mode A
parameters.description: Indicates the RSRQ threshold for events A1 and A2 related to coverage-based inter-frequency and inter-RAT emergency blind redirections for UEs in coverage enhancement (CE) mode A. If the measured RSRQ value of the serving cell exceeds the threshold, event A1 is reported. If the measured RSRQ value of the serving cell is lower than the threshold, event A2 is reported. parameters.name: Inter-RAT Measurement Report Delay Timer
parameters.description: Indicates the length of the timer for delaying processing measurement reports related to inter-RAT interoperations (excluding interoperations to NR) involving QCI 5. This timer starts after a QCI-5 bearer is set up for a VoLTE UE. parameters.name: Service-based NR Measurement Timer
parameters.description: Indicates the length of the timer for NR measurements for service-based handovers from E-UTRAN to NG-RAN. If this parameter is set to 0, periodic NR measurements for service-based handovers from E-UTRAN to NG-RAN are disabled. If this parameter is set to a value in the range of 5 to 60, the value indicates the length of the timer for NR measurements for service-based handovers from E-UTRAN to NG-R

parameters.name: CQI-based Inter-Freq HO Thld
parameters.description: Indicates the threshold for triggering CQI-based inter-frequency handovers. This parameter is equivalent to the Release-8 CQI threshold. When the channel quality of the serving cell reported by a UE is worse than or equal to the channel quality corresponding to the threshold in the case of single-codeword transmission, a CQI-based inter-frequency handover is triggered. If this parameter is set to

parameters.id: VoLTE Handover to NR Delay Timer
parameters.name: VoLTE Handover to NR Delay Timer
parameters.description: Indicates the length of the timer during which the eNodeB does not process the coverage-based or service-based LTE-to-NR measurement report that is received before a QCI 1 bearer is set up. If this parameter is set to 0, this parameter does not take effect. If this parameter is set to a non-zero value, the eNodeB performs the following operations: 1. parameters.id: Intra-eNodeB Freq-Pri-based HO DL PRB Thld
parameters.name: Intra-eNodeB Freq-Pri-based HO DL PRB Thld
parameters.description: Indicates the downlink PRB usage threshold for the cell to become a candidate target cell for intra-eNodeB frequency-priority-based handovers when frequency-priority-based inter-frequency handover is enabled for the cell. parameters.id: Intra-eNodeB Freq-Pri-based HO UL PRB Thld
parameters.name: Intra-eNodeB Freq-Pri-based HO UL PRB Thld
parameters.description: Indicates the uplink PRB usage threshold for the cell to become a candidate target cell for intra-eNodeB frequency-priority-based handovers when frequency-priority-based inter-frequency handover is enabled for the cell. The cell can be selected as a candidate target cell only when the uplink PRB usage of the cell is less than this threshold. Otherwise, the cell cannot be selected as a candidate ta

parameters.name: Period update switch
parameters.description: Indicates the switch for the algorithm for periodically updating cell IDs. If this parameter is set to BOOLEAN_TRUE, cell IDs are periodically updated, inserted into the system information, and broadcast to the associated UEs once the time at which the algorithm begins to take effect is reached. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: Action time
parameters.description: Indicates the time at which the algorithm for periodically updating cell IDs begins to take effect. If the switch for the algorithm is turned on, cell IDs are periodically updated, inserted into the system information, and broadcast to the associated UEs once the time specified by this parameter is reached. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: Period
parameters.description: Indicates the period of updating cell IDs. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: Local cell ID
parameters.description: This parameter has been added to specify the local ID of a cell. It uniquely identifies a cell within an eNodeB. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD.

parameters.name: Intermediate Frequency DL Center Frequency
parameters.description: Indicates the downlink center frequency of the intermediate frequency. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD.

parameters.name: Intermediate Frequency Output Power
parameters.description: Indicates the output power of the intermediate frequency. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD.

parameters.name: Intermediate Frequency Power Offset
parameters.description: Indicates the output power offset of the intermediate frequency. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD.

parameters.name: Intermediate Frequency RX Channel Gain
parameters.description: Indicates the RX channel gains of the intermediate frequency. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD.

parameters.name: Intermediate Frequency UL Center Frequency
parameters.description: Indicates the uplink center frequency of the intermediate frequency. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD.

parameters.name: Local Cell Id
parameters.description: Indicates the local ID of the cell. It uniquely identifies a cell within a base station. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: Intelligent AMC Switch
parameters.description: Indicates whether to enable intelligent MCS selection. DL_INTEL_AMC_SELECTION_SW: Indicates whether to enable downlink intelligent selection. Downlink intelligent selection is enabled only if this option is selected. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: Downlink Prediction Error Upper Limit
parameters.description: Indicates the upper limit on the error of the IBLER predicted for downlink scheduling. When the error of the predicted IBLER exceeds the upper limit, the prediction is recorded as incorrect. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: Downlink Data Collection Interval
parameters.description: Indicates the interval at which data is collected for downlink intelligent AMC model training. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: Downlink Model Min Update Period
parameters.description: Indicates the minimum period of updating the downlink intelligent AMC model. The value 0MIN indicates that the model is updated continuously. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: Local Cell ID
parameters.description: Indicates the local cell ID. It uniquely identifies a cell within an eNodeB.

parameters.name: Downlink RB Allocation Direction
parameters.description: Indicates the RB allocation direction. If this parameter is set to HIGH_TO_LOW, RB allocation starts from the high end of the frequency band. If this parameter is set to LOW_TO_HIGH, RB allocation starts from the low end of the frequency band. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD.

parameters.name: High Intrf State Duration
parameters.description: Indicates the duration in which the cell is in the high interference state. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD.

parameters.id: High Intrf State DL RB Usage Threshold
parameters.name: High Intrf State DL RB Usage Threshold
parameters.description: Indicates the upper limit to the downlink wideband RB usage when the cell is in the high interference state. In this cell, the downlink RB usage in each TTI cannot exceed this limit. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD.

parameters.name: Low Intrf State Duration
parameters.description: Indicates the duration in which the cell is in the low interference state. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD.

parameters.id: Low Intrf State DL RB Usage Threshold
parameters.name: Low Intrf State DL RB Usage Threshold
parameters.description: Indicates the upper limit to the downlink wideband RB usage when the cell is in the low interference state. In this cell, the downlink RB usage in each TTI cannot exceed this limit. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD.

parameters.name: Local cell ID
parameters.description: This parameter has been added to specify the local ID of a cell. It uniquely identifies a cell within an eNodeB. This parameter applies only to LTE TDD.

parameters.name: Coexist Mode
parameters.description: Indicates the coexistence mode of an LAA cell. The value ALWAYS_ON indicates that the LAA cell is always enabled and does not share channels with other equipment. The values LBT_TYPEA and LBT_TYPEB indicate two LBT types for coordination between LAA SCells when these cells are served by one RRU. parameters.name: High Interference Duty Threshold
parameters.description: Indicates the threshold of the severe interference duty ratio in an LAA cell. parameters.name: High Interference Duration Threshold
parameters.description: Indicates the threshold of the duration in which severe continuous interference occurs to an LAA cell. parameters.name: LBT Priority
parameters.description: Indicates the channel access priority class for using the listen before talk (LBT) coexistence technology. An RRU uses different LBT parameters to implement channel clear access (CCA) based on channel access priority classes. parameters.name: CCA Threshold Offset
parameters.description: Indicates the offset against the energy detection threshold set for an LAA cell. The listen before talk (LBT) energy detection threshold is the sum of the value of this parameter and the value of the FcsInterfThd parameter in the CellLaaFcsPara MO. For details about the energy detection threshold, see section 15.1.4 of 3GPP TS 36.213. This parameter applies only to LTE TDD.

parameters.name: LSB Switch
parameters.description: Indicates whether to implement the LBT synchronization boundary (LSB) algorithm by using RHUB-based coordination between MPMUs involved in RF combination of an LAA cell. If this parameter is set to ON, the RHUB is used to implement the LSB algorithm to synchronize channel occupation between the MPMUs involved in RF combination. If this parameter is set to OFF, the LBT procedure is independently im

parameters.name: TPC Power Adjustment CQI Threshold
parameters.description: Indicates the CQI threshold for triggering TPC for the LAA cell in the specified frequency range. This parameter applies only to LTE TDD.

parameters.name: Local cell ID
parameters.description: Indicates the local cell ID. It uniquely identifies a cell within an eNodeB. This parameter applies only to LTE TDD.

parameters.name: FCS Start Frequency
parameters.description: Indicates the starting frequency of spectrum scanning for FCS of LAA cells. The unlicensed spectrum ranging from the starting frequency to the cut-off frequency is scanned for FCS. The operating frequency of an LAA cell is selected from this frequency range. This parameter applies only to LTE TDD.

parameters.name: FCS Stop Frequency
parameters.description: Indicates the cut-off frequency of spectrum scanning for FCS of LAA cells. The unlicensed spectrum ranging from the starting frequency to the cut-off frequency is scanned for FCS The operating frequency of an LAA cell is selected from this frequency range. This parameter applies only to LTE TDD.

parameters.name: FCS Interference Threshold
parameters.description: Indicates the threshold of the interference level detected in an LAA cell. If the interference level exceeds this threshold, the channel is considered occupied. Otherwise, the channel is considered available. This parameter applies only to LTE TDD.

parameters.name: DFS Switch
parameters.description: Indicates whether to enable dynamic frequency selection (DFS). This parameter includes the DfsFreqSwitch option. DfsFreqSwitch: Indicates whether to enable DFS detection. If this option is selected, frequencies in the frequency bands specified by the FcsStartFreq and FcsStopFreq parameters in the CellLaaFcsPara MO are detected for DFS. parameters.name: Cell TPC Maximum Power
parameters.description: Indicates the maximum power during TPC for the LAA cell in the specified frequency range. Set this parameter based on local radio regulations. This parameter applies only to LTE TDD.

parameters.name: Cell TPC Power Adjustment Range
parameters.description: Indicates the power adjustment range of TPC for the LAA cell in the specified frequency range. Set this parameter based on local radio regulations. This parameter applies only to LTE TDD.

parameters.name: Downlink TPC Algorithm Switch
parameters.description: Indicates whether to enable TPC for the LAA cell in the specified frequency range. DL_TPC_SWITCH: Indicates whether to enable downlink TPC for an LAA cell. If this option is selected, downlink TPC is enabled. If this option is deselected, downlink TPC is disabled. This option applies only to LTE TDD.

parameters.name: Local Cell ID
parameters.description: Indicates the local ID of a cell, which uniquely identifies the cell within an eNodeB.

parameters.name: NB-IoT E-CID-based Positioning UE Count
parameters.description: Indicates the maximum number of UEs that can simultaneously perform measurements for E-CID-based positioning in a cell. E-CID-based positioning is enabled in a cell only if this parameter is set to a non-zero value. This parameter applies only to NB-IoT.

parameters.name: Cell LCS Switch
parameters.description: Indicates whether to enable location service (LCS) functions in the cell. NB_OTDOA_SWITCH: Indicates whether to enable OTDOA-based positioning for NB-IoT cells. OTDOA-based positioning is enabled for NB-IoT cells only if this option is selected. For FDD and TDD cells, OTDOA-based positioning is enabled when either this option or the OtdoaSwitch option of the LcsSwitch parameter in the ENodeBAlgoSw

parameters.name: Local cell ID
parameters.description: Indicates the local ID of the cell. It uniquely identifies a cell within a BS. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: Low power consumption mode switch
parameters.description: Indicates the switch for the functionality of the low power consumption mode. The cell can enter the low power consumption mode only when this parameter is set to ON and specific conditions are met. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: Low power consumption mode order
parameters.description: Indicates the switch for forcibly entering the low power consumption mode. When both this switch and the functionality switch are set to ON, the cell enters the low power consumption mode as soon as the wait time for entering the mode elapses, regardless of whether the cell is within the low power consumption period. When the functionality switch is set to ON but this switch is set to OFF and if a

parameters.name: Start time
parameters.description: Indicates the start time of the low power consumption mode. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: Stop time
parameters.description: Indicates the stop time of the low power consumption mode. If the stop time is earlier than or the same as the start time, the stop time is assumed to be a time of the next day. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.id: Cell used power reduce time length
parameters.name: Cell used power reduce time length
parameters.description: Indicates the duration in which the transmit power for services is reduced in the cell in low power consumption mode. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.id: Reference signal power reduce time length
parameters.name: Reference signal power reduce time length
parameters.description: Indicates the duration in which the reference signal transmit power is reduced in the cell in low power consumption mode. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: RF shutdown time length
parameters.description: Indicates the duration in which RF channels are shut down in the cell in low power consumption mode. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: Cell used power ratio
parameters.description: Indicates the percentage of the transmit power for services to the total transmit power for services when the low power consumption mode is implemented by means of reducing the transmit power for services. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: Reference signal power adjust offset
parameters.description: Indicates the amount by which the reference signal transmit power is reduced in the cell in low power consumption mode. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.id: Time length for entering the low power consumption mode
parameters.name: Time length for entering the low power consumption mode
parameters.description: Indicates the duration when the cell stays in normal mode before entering the low power consumption mode. In low power consumption mode, a cell automatically takes the following actions in sequence: 1. lowers the transmit power for services; 2. lowers the transmit power for reference signals; 3. shuts down some RF channels in the cell; 4. shuts down the cell. This duration smooths the transition f

parameters.name: Back power save policy
parameters.description: Indicates the backup power saving policy of the eNodeB when the mains supply is cut off and the eNodeB is powered by storage batteries. parameters.name: Local cell ID
parameters.description: Indicates the local cell ID. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD.

parameters.name: Flexible Bandwidth Optimization Switch
parameters.description: Indicates whether to enable flexible bandwidth optimization. LTE_FB_CFG_SWITCH: Indicates whether to enable the LTE flexible bandwidth algorithm. This option applies only to LTE FDD. PDCCH_CAPACITY_OPT_SWITCH: Indicates whether to enable the PDCCH capacity improvement algorithm. This option applies only to LTE FDD. UL_WEAK_GSM_ITF_PROCESS_SW: Indicates the uplink weak GSM interference processing s

parameters.name: Downlink Customized Starting PRB Index
parameters.description: Indicates the downlink customized start PRB number. The parameter value of 255 indicates an invalid value. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD.

parameters.name: Downlink Customized Ending PRB Index
parameters.description: Indicates the downlink customized end PRB number. The parameter value of 255 indicates an invalid value. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD.

parameters.name: Uplink Customized Starting PRB Index
parameters.description: Indicates the uplink customized start PRB number. The parameter value of 255 indicates an invalid value. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD.

parameters.name: Uplink Customized Ending PRB Index
parameters.description: Indicates the uplink customized end PRB number. The parameter value of 255 indicates an invalid value. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD.

parameters.name: Local Cell ID
parameters.description: Indicates the local cell ID. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD.

parameters.name: High Interference GSM ARFCN
parameters.description: Indicates the ARFCN of a high-interference GSM cell adjacent to the LTE cell. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD.

parameters.name: GSM Carrier Frequency
parameters.description: Indicates the carrier bearing GSM signals of a cell adjacent to the LTE cell. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD.

parameters.name: Local Cell ID
parameters.description: Indicates the local ID of a cell, which uniquely identifies a cell within an eNodeB. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: Cell Synthetical Rate Handover Hysteresis
parameters.description: Indicates the hysteresis for the overall cell data rate gain that must be met to trigger an outgoing inter-carrier handover for a non-CA UE or serving cell combination change for a CA UE. If the estimated overall cell data rate gain brought by the handover or combination change is greater than the hysteresis, the eNodeB triggers the handover or combination change. This parameter applies only to LT

parameters.name: Cell Traffic Load Threshold
parameters.description: Indicates the service load threshold of the cell for triggering optimal carrier selection. If the estimated service data transmission duration of the cell is greater than or equal to this threshold, the eNodeB triggers optimal carrier selection. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: Inter-Freq Measurement Load Ratio Threshold
parameters.description: Indicates the UE load ratio threshold for triggering inter-frequency measurement. A UE is allowed to perform inter-frequency measurement when the ratio of the service load of the UE to the total service load of the cell is less than or equal to this threshold. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: Inter-Freq Measurement MCS Threshold
parameters.description: Indicates the MCS threshold for triggering inter-frequency measurement. A UE is allowed to perform inter-frequency measurement when the average MCS used for single-codeword transmission of a UE is less than this threshold. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: Inter-Freq Measurement Service Threshold
parameters.description: Indicates the UE traffic volume threshold for triggering inter-frequency measurement. A UE is allowed to trigger inter-frequency measurement when the traffic volume of the UE is greater than this threshold. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: Measurement Information Update Interval
parameters.description: Indicates the interval for updating UE measurement information. UEs periodically report intra-frequency measurement information at this interval. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: UE Spectral Efficiency Handover Hysteresis
parameters.description: Indicates the hysteresis for the spectral efficiency gain that must be met to trigger an outgoing inter-carrier handover for a non-CA UE or serving cell combination change for a CA UE. If the estimated spectral efficiency gain brought by the handover or combination change is greater than the hysteresis, the eNodeB triggers the handover or combination change. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD

parameters.name: Load Difference Ratio Threshold
parameters.description: Indicates the ratio threshold of the load difference between the serving cell and an inter-frequency neighboring cell. A neighboring cell can be a target cell for optimal carrier selection when the following condition is met: (Serving cell load - Neighboring cell load)/Serving cell load >= LoadDiffRatioThld. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: MBOCS Algorithm Switch
parameters.description: Indicates whether to enable multi-band optimal carrier selection (MBOCS). DL_CA_UE_ENH_SWITCH: Indicates whether to allow MBOCS between FDD and TDD and controls the scope of downlink CA UEs that can be selected for MBOCS. parameters.name: Local cell ID
parameters.description: Indicates the local cell identity. It uniquely identifies a cell within an eNodeB. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: MBSFN synchronization Area ID
parameters.description: Indicates the ID of an MBSFN synchronization area to which a cell belongs. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: MBMS switch
parameters.description: Indicates whether to enable the MBMS function. MBMSSwitch: If this option is selected, the MBMS function is enabled, and the cell supports the MBMS service. If this option is deselected, the MBMS function is disabled. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: Service Area ID List
parameters.description: Indicates the list of MBMS service areas to which cells belong. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: MBMS Service Switch
parameters.description: SERVICECONTINUITYSWITCH: Indicates whether MBMS service continuity can be maintained. MBMS service continuity can be maintained in inter-frequency networking by selecting this option. If this option is selected, MBMS service continuity can be maintained. parameters.name: Neighbor Cell MBMS Config Switch
parameters.description: NEIGHCELLCONFIGADAPTIVESWITCH: Indicates whether the neighboring cell configurations take effect adaptively. In the eMBMS feature, the MBSFN subframe configuration for a cell dynamically changes based on the MBMS session setups. Neighboring cell configurations can be dynamically updated based on the changes of MBSFN subframe configurations of neighboring cells. If this option is selected, neighbor

parameters.name: MBSFN Area ID
parameters.description: Indicates the ID of an MBSFN area to which a cell belongs. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: MBMS Session TMGI
parameters.description: Indicates the TMGI of an MBMS session. The TMGI consists of the MCC, MNC, and ServiceID with each two parts connected by a hyphen (-). TMGIs are separated by comma (,). This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: Dynamic Service Area ID List
parameters.description: Indicates the dynamic list of MBSFN service areas to which cells belong. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: Local Cell ID
parameters.description: Indicates the local ID of the cell. It uniquely identifies a cell within a base station.

parameters.name: Subframe Allocation Mode
parameters.description: Indicates whether one radio frame or four consecutive radio frames contain MBSFN subframes. For details, see 3GPP TS 36.331. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD.

parameters.name: One Frame Allocation
parameters.description: Indicates the MBSFN subframes allocated in one radio frame. For an FDD cell, the subframes that can be allocated for MBSFN in a radio frame are SF1, SF2, SF3, SF6, SF7, and SF8. These subframes are represented by bit 5 to bit 0 in sequence. If a bit is set to 1, the corresponding subframe is allocated for MBSFN. When you set this parameter, change the binary value into a decimal value and set this

parameters.name: Four Frame Allocation
parameters.description: Indicates the MBSFN subframes allocated in four consecutive radio frames. For an FDD cell, the subframes that can be allocated for MBSFN in each radio frame include SF1, SF2, SF3, SF6, SF7, and SF8. These subframes in the four radio frames are represented by bit 23 to bit 0 in sequence starting from the first radio frame. If a bit is set to 1, the corresponding subframe is allocated for MBSFN. parameters.name: Radio Frame Allocation Period
parameters.description: Indicates the allocation period of the radio frames that contain MBSFN subframes. For details, see 3GPP TS 36.331. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD.

parameters.name: Radio Frame Allocation Offset
parameters.description: Indicates the frame offset used for MBSFN subframe configuration. This parameter and the RadioFrameAllocPrd parameter together determine the radio frame that contains MBSFN subframes. For details, see 3GPP TS 36.331. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD.

parameters.name: Local cell ID
parameters.description: Indicates the local ID of the cell, which uniquely identifies a cell within an eNodeB. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: A3 Offset
parameters.description: Indicates the offset for event A3. This offset is the difference between the signal quality of a neighboring cell and that of the serving cell. A larger value indicates a higher requirement on neighboring cell quality for reporting event A3. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: Hysteresis
parameters.description: Indicates the hysteresis for reporting event A3 or A6. This parameter is used to prevent frequent entering or leaving of event A3 or A6 and decision errors due to radio signal fluctuation. For details, see 3GPP TS 36.331. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: Time to Trigger
parameters.description: Indicates the time-to-trigger for reporting event A3 or A6. When the entering condition of the event is met, the UE does not report the event to the eNodeB immediately. Instead, the UE reports the event only when the entering condition is continuously met throughout the time-to-trigger. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: Max Report Cell Number
parameters.description: Indicates the maximum number of cells to be included in each measurement report after event A3 or A6 is triggered. For details, see 3GPP TS 36.331. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: Report Amount
parameters.description: Indicates the number of periodic measurement reports that are sent after event A3 or A6 is triggered. For details, see 3GPP TS 36.331. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: Report Interval
parameters.description: Indicates the interval between periodic measurement reports that are sent after event A3 or A6 is triggered. For details, see 3GPP TS 36.331. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: Report Quantity
parameters.description: Indicates the type of the value to be included in the measurement report after event A3 or A6 is triggered, which can be set to SAME_AS_TRIG_QUAN or BOTH. The value SAME_AS_TRIG_QUAN indicates that the type of the value to be included in the measurement report is the same as that specified by the TriggerQuantity parameter. The value BOTH indicates that both RSRP and RSRQ values are to be included

parameters.name: Trigger Quantity
parameters.description: Indicates whether event A3 or A6 is triggered based on RSRP or RSRQ values. The measured RSRP values are stable, slightly varying with the load, and therefore there is little signal fluctuation. The measured RSRQ values vary with the load and are likely to reflect the signal quality of the cell in real time. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: A6 Offset
parameters.description: Indicates the offset for event A6. This offset is the difference between the signal quality of a neighboring cell and that of the serving cell. A larger value indicates a higher requirement on neighboring cell quality for reporting event A6. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.id: IntraFreq Period MR Max Report Cell
parameters.name: IntraFreq Period MR Max Report Cell
parameters.description: Indicates the maximum number of cells to be included in each intra-frequency periodic measurement report. For details, see 3GPP TS 36.331. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: IntraFreq Period MR Trigger Quantity
parameters.description: Indicates the type of value used to evaluate the triggering condition for the intra-frequency periodic measurement. The type of value can be RSRP or RSRQ. The measured RSRP values are stable, slightly varying with the load, and therefore there is little signal fluctuation. parameters.id: InterFreq Period MR Max Report Cell
parameters.name: InterFreq Period MR Max Report Cell
parameters.description: Indicates the maximum number of cells to be included in each inter-frequency periodic measurement report. For details, see 3GPP TS 36.331. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: InterFreq Period MR Trigger Quantity
parameters.description: Indicates the type of value used to evaluate the triggering condition for the inter-frequency periodic measurement. The type of value can be RSRP or RSRQ. parameters.name: A3 Measurement Control Adaptive Switch
parameters.description: Indicates whether parameter configurations related to A3 measurement report can be adaptively modified. This parameter provides the following options: UlCoMPA3RptIntervalAdapt: If this option is selected, parameter configurations related to A3 measurement report can be adaptively modified. If this option is deselected, parameter configurations related to A3 measurement report cannot be adaptively

parameters.name: AoA Detect Threshold
parameters.description: Indicates the channel quality threshold for measuring the angle of arrival (AOA) of UE signals to the eNodeB. When the channel quality of a UE reaches this threshold, the AOA is measured and the measurement results are reported periodically. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: E-CID Report Amount
parameters.description: Indicates the number of times periodic measurement reports are sent after an E-CID-based OnDemand positioning request is triggered.

parameters.name: E-CID Report Interval
parameters.description: Indicates the interval at which periodic measurement reports are sent after an E-CID-based OnDemand positioning request is triggered.

parameters.name: Local cell ID
parameters.description: Indicates the local cell ID. It uniquely identifies a cell within an eNodeB. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: MIMO Adaptive Switch
parameters.description: Indicates the type of adaptive MIMO for a multi-antenna eNodeB. The values are described as follows: NO_ADAPTIVE: A fixed MIMO transmission mode is used. That is, transition between MIMO transmission modes is not supported. OL_ADAPTIVE: Open-loop transmission modes are adaptively selected. UEs report rank and CQI values but do not report PMI values. parameters.name: Fixed MIMO Mode
parameters.description: Indicates the fixed MIMO mode for a multi-antenna eNodeB. This parameter is valid only when MimoAdaptiveSwitch is set to NO_ADAPTIVE. There are four values. TM2: Transmission mode 2 is always used for UEs. TM3: Transmission mode 3 is always used for UEs. TM4: Transmission mode 4 is always used for UEs. TM6: Transmission mode 6 is always used for UEs. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE

parameters.name: Initial Mimo Type
parameters.description: Indicates the MIMO transmission mode used during initial network access. If this parameter is set to TM2, the MIMO transmission mode used during initial network access is TM2. If this parameter is set to ADAPTIVE, the MIMO transmission mode used during initial network access is determined by the settings of the MimoAdaptiveSwitch and FixedMimoMode parameters. parameters.name: MIMO Switch
parameters.description: Indicates MIMO algorithm switches. 8T_TM9_MU-MIMO_SW: Indicates whether to enable 8T TM9 MU-MIMO. The function is enabled only if this option is selected. This option applies only to LTE FDD. MM_SCC_TM9_MU_MIMO_SW: Indicates whether to enable TM9 MU-MIMO in a massive MIMO SCell.
