parameters.id: MU Pairing Gain Threshold For TM9
parameters.name: MU Pairing Gain Threshold For TM9
parameters.description: Indicates the gain threshold related to UE pairing in MU-MIMO in TM9. If the gain from UE pairing exceeds the threshold, UE pairing is allowed. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD.

parameters.name: MU Pairing TBS Index Threshold
parameters.description: Indicates the TBS index threshold for downlink multi-user pairing. For LTE FDD, this parameter specifies the TBS index threshold for TM9 MU-MIMO pairing. If the TBS index of a UE exceeds the threshold, the UE can participate in multi-user pairing. For LTE TDD, this parameter specifies the TBS index threshold for MU beamforming pairing. parameters.id: PRB Ratio Threshold For TM9 SU-MIMO
parameters.name: PRB Ratio Threshold For TM9 SU-MIMO
parameters.description: Indicates the PRB ratio threshold related to SU-MIMO in TM9. If the ratio of the number of PRBs scheduled for TM9-capable UEs in the cell to the total number of PRBs scheduled in the cell exceeds the threshold, SU-MIMO in TM9 takes effect. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD.

parameters.name: MU-MIMO Max Pair Layer
parameters.description: Indicates the maximum number of layers that can be paired for MU-MIMO in an FDD massive MIMO cell. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD.

parameters.name: MU-MIMO Weight Adjustment Strategy
parameters.description: Indicates the strategy for adjusting data transmission weight values for MU-MIMO. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD.

parameters.id: MCS Index Thld for Adaptive TM9
parameters.name: MCS Index Thld for Adaptive TM9
parameters.description: Indicates the MCS index threshold for TM9 adaptation. If this parameter is set to 255, the adaptation does not take effect. A UE can exit TM9 only if the MCS index of the UE exceeds this threshold. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD.

parameters.id: Pairing Probability Thld for Adaptive TM9
parameters.name: Pairing Probability Thld for Adaptive TM9
parameters.description: Indicates the UE pairing (for MU-MIMO) probability threshold for TM9 adaptation. A UE can exit TM9 only if the pairing probability for the UE is lower than this threshold. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD.

parameters.name: High Order MIMO Pairing Strategy
parameters.description: Indicates the UE pairing policy for high-order MIMO. If this parameter is set to DEFAULT, UEs using rank 3 or rank 4 can be directly paired. If this parameter is set to FALLBACK_SU, UEs using rank 3 or rank 4 cannot be paired and therefore can perform only SU-MIMO. parameters.name: RAN Sharing Sch Opt Switch
parameters.description: Indicates the algorithm for allocating RB resources for different operators proportionally in multi-user pairing scenarios. If this parameter is set to OFF, the eNodeB does not allocate RB resources for different operators proportionally in multi-user pairing scenarios. If this parameter is set to MU_PAIRING_RB_ALLOC, the operator-specific scheduling priority takes effect for all UEs. If this para

parameters.name: MU-MIMO Pairing Strategy
parameters.description: Indicates the UE pairing policy for MU-MIMO. If this parameter is set to DEFAULT, the eNodeB uses the correlation policy for UE pairing. If this parameter is set to EPF_FIRST, the eNodeB selects UEs to be paired based on the pairing efficiency maximization policy and preferentially considers scheduling fairness. parameters.id: UTRAN Idle Mode Mobility Load Balancing Initial Valid Period
parameters.name: UTRAN Idle Mode Mobility Load Balancing Initial Valid Period
parameters.description: Indicates the standard valid duration for load sharing with universal terrestrial radio access network (UTRAN) for UEs in idle mode. The actual duration increases on the basis of a standard valid duration with the increase of the number of uplink-synchronized UEs. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: Load Transfer Factor
parameters.description: Indicates the control factor for the amount of load transferred in a single MLB procedure. The value of this parameter has an impact on the efficiency of the MLB algorithm and the algorithm used to prevent ping-pong load transfer.

parameters.name: Mobility Load Balancing Trigger Mode

In MLB with load information exchange, if this parameter is set to PRB_ONLY, PRB usage is used as a trigger and the number of UEs is used as a supplementary trigger; PRB usage difference between cells is used as a UE transfer condition; the aim of MLB is to achieve the same number of remaining PRBs between cells. parameters.name: Inter-frequency Mobility Load Balancing UE Number Threshold
parameters.description: Indicates the UL-sync UE number threshold for triggering inter-frequency MLB. Assume that the MlbTriggerMode parameter is set to UE_NUMBER_ONLY or PRB_OR_UE_NUMBER. Inter-frequency MLB is triggered when the number of UL-sync UEs is greater than or equal to the sum of the InterFreqMlbUeNumThd and MlbUeNumOffset parameter values. parameters.description: Indicates the maximum number of UEs that can be transferred for inter-frequency MLB triggered by every variable within an MLB period. Inter-frequency MLB triggered by every variable independently uses this parameter. parameters.id: Mobility Load Balancing UE Selection PRB Usage Threshold
parameters.name: Mobility Load Balancing UE Selection PRB Usage Threshold
parameters.description: Indicates the UE PRB usage threshold for selecting UEs for MLB. If the MlbTriggerMode parameter is set to PRB_ONLY: (1) When downlink MLB is triggered, the eNodeB selects UEs whose downlink PRB usage is greater than this threshold and uplink PRB usage is less than the sum of this threshold and the UeUlPrbLowThdOffset parameter value. (2) When uplink MLB is triggered, the eNodeB selects UEs whose u

parameters.name: Downlink Data-transfer MLB mode
parameters.description: Indicates whether MLB is performed based on the number of downlink data transmission UEs. If this parameter is set to UENUMBASED(UENUMBASED), MLB is performed based on the number of downlink data transmission UEs. If it is set to NON_TRIGGERED(NON_TRIGGERED), MLB is not performed based on the number of downlink data transmission UEs. This parameter applies only to LTE TDD.

parameters.name: Inter-Frequency MLB RAN Sharing Mode
parameters.description: Indicates whether to enable operator-level and operator-group-level inter-frequency MLB. If this parameter is set to NON_SHARING, the eNodeB performs cell-level inter-frequency MLB without distinguishing resources between operators or operator groups. parameters.name: Hot Spot UE Mode
parameters.description: Indicates whether only UEs at hotspots can be transferred to UTRAN for inter-RAT load balancing. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.description: Indicates the ARP threshold for selecting UEs to be transferred for MLB. A UE is selected only if the ARPs of all the UE's services is higher than or equal to this threshold. parameters.name: Inter-Freq MLB UE Select DL MCS Threshold

A UE is selected only if the downlink MCS index of the UE is greater than or equal to this threshold. If this parameter is set to a large value, UEs with favorable downlink channel quality are selected for MLB. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.id: MM Load Steering UE PRB Thld
parameters.name: MM Load Steering UE PRB Thld
parameters.description: Indicates the PRB usage threshold for selecting UEs to be transferred after massive MIMO load transfer is triggered for non-massive MIMO cells. If the downlink PRB usage of a UE is greater than or equal to this threshold, the UE can be selected for load steering. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.id: UL-Exp-oriented Serv Steering UE Sel MCS Thld

parameters.name: Massive MIMO Initial Delta CQI
parameters.description: Indicates the initial CQI adjustment value for UEs paired for massive MIMO. This parameter applies only to LTE TDD.

parameters.id: Adaptive Split SDMA SRS Limit UE Prop Thld
parameters.name: Adaptive Split SDMA SRS Limit UE Prop Thld
parameters.description: Indicates the threshold of the proportion of UEs with insufficient SRSs in a cell for adaptation between entry to and exit from split SDMA in massive MIMO scenarios. If the SplitSdmaAdaptionPeriod parameter is set to FORCE_SPLIT_SDMA, split SDMA takes effect regardless of the setting of this parameter. This parameter applies only to LTE TDD.

parameters.id: Adaptive Split SDMA TM9 UE Proportion Thld
parameters.name: Adaptive Split SDMA TM9 UE Proportion Thld
parameters.description: Indicates the threshold of the proportion of closed-loop TM9 UEs in a cell for triggering adaptation between entry to and exit from split SDMA in massive MIMO scenarios. If the SplitSdmaAdaptionPeriod parameter is set to FORCE_SPLIT_SDMA, split SDMA takes effect regardless of the setting of this parameter. This parameter applies only to LTE TDD.

parameters.id: Split SDMA UE Identification SRS SINR Thld
parameters.name: Split SDMA UE Identification SRS SINR Thld
parameters.description: Indicates the SRS SINR threshold for identifying UEs available for split SDMA in massive MIMO scenarios. A UE is identified as available for split SDMA only if the SRS SINR of the UE is smaller than this threshold for a specific number of consecutive times. This parameter applies only to LTE TDD.

parameters.name: MM VMIMO Outer-Loop Initial Offset
parameters.description: Indicates an offset used to determine the initial outer-loop SINR adjustment value after uplink MU-MIMO pairing in massive MIMO cells or in 8T8R cells with the space-domain-preferred pairing algorithm enabled. This parameter applies only to LTE TDD.

parameters.id: MUBF SINR Thld Ofs Before SRS Balance
parameters.name: MUBF SINR Thld Ofs Before SRS Balance
parameters.description: Indicates the offset to the SINR threshold before SRS balancing for downlink MU beamforming pairing in cells. A UE can participate in MU beamforming pairing only if the SINR of the UE reaches the sum of the SINR threshold before SRS balancing and this offset. This parameter applies only to LTE TDD.

parameters.name: Beamforming Weight Type
parameters.description: Indicates the massive MIMO beamforming weight type. If this parameter is set to PEBF, the PE beamforming weight selection algorithm is used. If this parameter is set to ADAPT, the adaptive weight selection algorithm is used. This parameter applies only to LTE TDD.

parameters.name: Precise MUBF Optimization Switch
parameters.description: Indicates whether to enable the precise MU beamforming optimization algorithm. PRECISE_PAIRING_OPT_SW: Indicates whether to enable the precise UE pairing optimization algorithm. parameters.id: BF Gain Thld for Saturated UE Identification
parameters.name: BF Gain Thld for Saturated UE Identification
parameters.description: Indicates the beamforming gain threshold for identifying UEs with saturated power in massive MIMO scenarios. This parameter applies only to LTE TDD.

parameters.id: Outloop Thld for Saturated UE Identification
parameters.name: Outloop Thld for Saturated UE Identification
parameters.description: Indicates the SU beamforming outer-loop threshold for identifying UEs with saturated power in massive MIMO scenarios. The default value 127 indicates that the power saturation avoidance algorithm does not take effect. This parameter applies only to LTE TDD.

parameters.id: Split SDMA Beam RSRP Isolation Threshold
parameters.name: Split SDMA Beam RSRP Isolation Threshold
parameters.description: Indicates the RSRP isolation threshold for split SDMA UEs in massive MIMO scenarios. If the RSRP isolation between the target beams of two UEs is greater than this threshold, split SDMA can be performed for the two UEs. If the RSRP isolation between the target beams of two UEs is less than or equal to this threshold, split SDMA cannot be performed for the two UEs. This parameter applies only to LT

parameters.name: MUBF TBS Forecast Pairing Layer Thld

parameters.id: MM Param Intel Selection UL User Exp Thld
parameters.name: MM Param Intel Selection UL User Exp Thld
parameters.description: Indicates the uplink experience threshold for intelligent massive MIMO parameter selection. This parameter applies only to LTE TDD.

parameters.id: Low SRS SINR UE Pairing Layer Thld
parameters.name: Low SRS SINR UE Pairing Layer Thld

parameters.name: Abnormal UE Packet Delay Thld

parameters.name: Active UE Number Thld
parameters.description: Indicates the threshold for the number of UEs to be scheduled used in the function of downlink scheduling interval protection for defective UEs. parameters.name: CIO adjustment upper limit

This parameter needs to be set only when the CioAdjLimitCfgInd parameter is set to CFG. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: CIO adjustment lower limit
parameters.description: Indicates the lower limit of intra-frequency cell individual offset (CIO) adjustment range for the cell in mobility robustness optimization (MRO). This parameter needs to be set only when the CioAdjLimitCfgInd parameter is set to CFG. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: Interfreq A2 RSRP Upper Limit

parameters.description: Indicates the number of consecutive subframes in which NPRSs in part B mode are transmitted in an NB-IoT cell. For details about the parameter, see 3GPP TS 36.455. This parameter applies only to NB-IoT.

parameters.name: NPRS Start Subframe Offset
parameters.description: Indicates the start subframe offset in the NPRS of an NB-IoT cell in Part B mode. For details about the parameter, see 3GPP TS 36.455. This parameter applies only to NB-IoT.

parameters.name: Number of NPRS Muting Bits
parameters.description: Indicates the number of PRS muting bits in the cell. If the cell is an NB-IoT cell, this parameter indicates the number of NPRS muting bits. This parameter applies only to NB-IoT.

If the downlink PRB usage of PTT services is greater than the value of this parameter, PTT services are not admitted. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: Operator PTT DL RB Utilization Low Thd
parameters.description: Indicates the lower usage threshold of the downlink PRBs that an operator allocates to PTT services in a cell. Based on the parameter value, the eNodeB determines whether to admit PTT services in the downlink. If the downlink PRB usage of PTT services is less than the parameter value, PTT services are admitted. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: Operator Non-GBR Resource Reservation Ratio
parameters.description: Indicates the proportion of resources that an operator reserves for downlink non-GBR services to the total resources of the operator when RAN sharing is enabled on the eNodeB and the RanShareModeSwitch parameter of the CellAlgoSwitch MO is set to ON(On). If this parameter is set to 0 for all operators in a cell, this parameter does not take effect. The proportion of resources reserved for downlink

parameters.name: Operator PLMN Round Period
parameters.description: Indicates the operator-specific interval for changing the PLMN at the top of the broadcast PLMN list in round robin mode.

parameters.name: Operator Resource Group Index
parameters.description: Indicates the index of the resource group to which the operator belongs. The default value is 255, which indicates an invalid value. The OpPrbGroupshareSwitch option takes effect only when the OpResourceGroupIndex parameter is set to a valid value.

parameters.name: RAT Frequency Priority Group ID
parameters.description: Indicates the eNodeB-level inter-frequency or inter-RAT frequency priority group ID for LTE UEs of an operator. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: Uplink Rate Control Mode
parameters.description: Indicates the uplink voice rate control mode for the operator. This parameter is valid only if RAN sharing with common carriers mode or hybrid RAN sharing mode is used and there is more than one CellOp MO instance for the cell. If this parameter is set to INVALID, this parameter does not take effect. If this parameter is set to ULRATECTRL_OFF, voice rate control does not take effect. If RTP packet

parameters.id: RB Sharing Ratio with Other Operator
parameters.name: RB Sharing Ratio with Other Operator
parameters.description: Indicates the proportion of RBs that can be shared by the operator with other operators to the total number of RBs in the cell when the operators share cell RB resources. The value 255 indicates that there is no restriction on the proportion of RBs that can be shared by the operator with other operators. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: Operator-Level MLB Thld Adj Value
parameters.description: Indicates the adjustment value of the inter-frequency MLB threshold for operator-level PRB-usage-based MLB. If this parameter is set to a value in the range of -50 to -1, the value indicates a decrease in the original threshold. If this parameter is set to a value in the range of 1 to 50, the value indicates an increase in the original threshold. If this parameter is set to 0, the original thresho

parameters.id: NSA DC RAT Frequency Priority Group ID
parameters.name: NSA DC RAT Frequency Priority Group ID
parameters.description: Indicates the ID of a RAT-specific frequency priority group for NSA DC UEs served by a base-station-level operator. The parameter value 65535 indicates that this parameter has not been set. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: Operator Max Available RB Ratio
parameters.description: Indicates the proportion of the maximum number of RBs available for the operator to the total number of RBs available in the cell when operators share the cell RB resources. This parameter is valid only when the RbSharingRatioWithOtherOp parameter is set to a value other than 255 for an operator of the cell. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: Broadcast CN operator ID
parameters.description: Indicates the operator index that is broadcast in the cell system information.

parameters.name: Local cell ID
parameters.description: Indicates the local ID of the cell. It uniquely identifies a cell within an eNodeB. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: CN Operator ID
parameters.description: Indicates the ID of the operator. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: Highest Priority InterRAT
parameters.description: Indicates the highest-priority target RAT for handovers. It is UTRAN by default. If this parameter is set to UTRAN, GERAN, or CDMA2000, the highest-priority target RAT is UTRAN, GERAN, or CDMA2000, respectively. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: Second Priority InterRAT
parameters.description: Indicates the medium-priority target RAT for handovers. It is GERAN by default. If this parameter is set to UTRAN, GERAN, or CDMA2000, the medium-priority target RAT is UTRAN, GERAN, or CDMA2000, respectively. If this parameter is set to NULL, no medium-priority target RAT is specified and only the highest-priority target RAT can be selected for handovers. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD an

parameters.name: Lowest Priority InterRAT
parameters.description: Indicates the lowest-priority target RAT for handovers. It is CDMA2000 by default. If this parameter is set to UTRAN, GERAN, or CDMA2000, the lowest-priority target RAT is UTRAN, GERAN, or CDMA2000, respectively. If this parameter is set to NULL, no lowest-priority target RAT is specified and only the highest- or medium-priority target RAT can be selected for handovers. This parameter applies only

parameters.id: CSFB Highest Priority InterRAT for Idle UE
parameters.name: CSFB Highest Priority InterRAT for Idle UE
parameters.description: Indicates the highest-priority target RAT for CSFB initiated by UEs in idle mode. It is UTRAN by default. If this parameter is set to UTRAN, GERAN, or CDMA2000, the highest-priority target RAT is UTRAN, GERAN, or CDMA2000, respectively. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.id: CSFB Second Priority InterRAT for Idle UE
parameters.name: CSFB Second Priority InterRAT for Idle UE
parameters.description: Indicates the medium-priority target RAT for CSFB initiated by UEs in idle mode. It is GERAN by default. If this parameter is set to UTRAN, GERAN, or CDMA2000, the medium-priority target RAT is UTRAN, GERAN, or CDMA2000, respectively. parameters.id: CSFB Lowest Priority InterRAT for Idle UE
parameters.name: CSFB Lowest Priority InterRAT for Idle UE
parameters.description: Indicates the lowest-priority target RAT for CSFB initiated by UEs in idle mode. It is CDMA2000 by default. If this parameter is set to UTRAN, GERAN, or CDMA2000, the lowest-priority target RAT is UTRAN, GERAN, or CDMA2000, respectively. If this parameter is set to NULL, no lowest-priority target RAT is specified and only the highest- or medium-priority target RAT can be selected for CSFB initiate

parameters.name: First RAT Priority
parameters.description: Indicates the priority of E-UTRAN TDD or E-UTRAN FDD in inter-frequency blind handover or blind redirection scenarios. To prioritize E-UTRAN TDD or E-UTRAN FDD, set this parameter to EUTRAN_TDD or EUTRAN_FDD, respectively. To treat E-UTRAN TDD and E-UTRAN FDD equally, set this parameter to EUTRAN. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.id: LTE TDD Inter-Freq A2 Thd RSRP Offset
parameters.name: LTE TDD Inter-Freq A2 Thd RSRP Offset
parameters.description: Indicates the offset for LTE TDD inter-frequency event A2 relative to the RSRP threshold for A3-based inter-frequency event A2 (specified by the A3InterFreqHoA2ThdRsrp parameter) and the RSRP threshold for A4/A5-based inter-frequency event A2 (specified by the InterFreqHoA2ThdRsrp parameter). The value of this parameter plus the value of the A3InterFreqHoA2ThdRsrp parameter is taken as the RSRP th

parameters.id: LTE FDD Inter-Freq A2 Thd RSRP Offset
parameters.name: LTE FDD Inter-Freq A2 Thd RSRP Offset
parameters.description: Indicates the offset for LTE FDD inter-frequency event A2 relative to the RSRP threshold for A3-based inter-frequency event A2 (specified by the A3InterFreqHoA2ThdRsrp parameter) and the RSRP threshold for A4/A5-based inter-frequency event A2 (specified by the InterFreqHoA2ThdRsrp parameter). The value of this parameter plus the value of the A3InterFreqHoA2ThdRsrp parameter is taken as the RSRP th

parameters.name: Handover Mode Switch
parameters.description: Indicates whether to enable different types of handovers for a specific operator, based on which the base station determines handover policies. REDIRECTION_TO_NR_SW: Redirection to NR is supported only when this option is selected. This option takes effect only when the NrRedirectSwitch option of the CellHoParaCfg.HoModeSwitch parameter is selected. This option applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: Serving Frequency Reselection Priority
parameters.description: Indicates the PLMN-specific dedicated cell-reselection priority for the serving frequency. 0 indicates the lowest priority, 7 indicates the highest priority, and 255 indicates that the parameter is invalid. parameters.name: Local Cell ID
parameters.description: Indicates the local cell ID. It uniquely identifies a cell within an eNodeB. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: Srs Power Control Strategy
parameters.description: Indicates the SRS power control algorithm, which can be the SINR-based SRS power control algorithm, SRS power control algorithm based on the converged SINR and RSRP, and SINR-based adaptive SRS power control algorithm. This parameter applies only to LTE TDD.

parameters.id: PUCCH Close Loop Power Control Type
parameters.name: PUCCH Close Loop Power Control Type
parameters.description: Indicates whether the P0NominalPUCCH parameter affects closed-loop power control (CL PC) for the PUCCH. If this parameter is set to NOT_USE_P0NOMINALPUCCH, the P0NominalPUCCH parameter does not affect CL PC for the PUCCH. If this parameter is set to USE_P0NOMINALPUCCH, the reference signal received power (RSRP) cannot exceed the P0NominalPUCCH parameter value in CL PC for the PUCCH. This parameter

parameters.name: Pucch Power Control Period
parameters.description: Indicates the period of power control for the PUCCH. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.id: Pucch Power Control Target Sinr Offset
parameters.name: Pucch Power Control Target Sinr Offset
parameters.description: Indicates the offset to the target signal to interference plus noise ratio (SINR) in power control for the PUCCH. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: PUSCH RSRP High Threshold
parameters.description: Indicates the upper limit of RSRP in closed-loop power control for the PUSCH. This parameter takes effect only when PuschRsrpHighThdSwitch of the UlPcAlgoSwitch parameter in the CellAlgoSwitch MO is on. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: Pusch IoT Control A3Offset
parameters.description: Indicates the offset of signal quality of a neighboring cell to that of the serving cell. This parameter is used to report a measurement event for PUSCH IoT-based power control. A large value of this parameter indicates that the event can be reported only when a UE receives signals of good quality from a neighboring cell. parameters.name: IoT NearPoint Optimization Switch
parameters.description: Indicates whether to enable IoT-based optimization for UEs at the cell center. If this parameter is set to OFF(Off), the eNodeB does not deliver event A3-based measurement configurations to optimize the uplink throughput of UEs at the cell center when strong interference occurs (the IoT is greater than 7 dB). If this parameter is set to ON(On), the eNodeB delivers event A3-based measurement config

parameters.name: IoT NearPoint PathLoss Threshold
parameters.description: Indicates the path loss threshold of a UE for delivering event A3-based measurement configurations for IoT-based power control if the cell has strong interference (the IoT is greater than 7 dB). This threshold is used for IoT-based optimization for UEs at the cell center. This parameter applies only to LTE TDD. If the path loss of a UE is less than this threshold, the eNodeB delivers event A3-base

parameters.name: SRS Power Control SINR Target
parameters.description: Indicates the target SINR for SRS power control. If this parameter is set to a large value, the transmit power of UEs increases, causing interference to neighboring cells. If this parameter is set to a small value, the transmit power of UEs decreases, causing poor uplink SRS receive performance in the local cell. If inter-cell interference is strong, set this parameter to a small value. If SRS rec

parameters.name: SRS Power Control RSRP Target
parameters.description: Indicates the target RSRP for SRS power control. If this parameter is set to a large value, the transmit power of UEs increases, causing interference to neighboring cells. If this parameter is set to a small value, the transmit power of UEs decreases, causing poor uplink SRS receive performance in the local cell. If inter-cell interference is strong, set this parameter to a small value. If SRS rec

parameters.name: PUSCH PSD Control Target
parameters.description: Indicates the transmit power spectral density (PSD) for the PUSCH of normal UEs when the SchedulerCtrlPowerSwitch(SchedulerCtrlPowerSwitch) option of the UlSchSwitch parameter is selected. The larger the value of this parameter, the higher the transmit PSD for the PUSCH of normal UEs. If this parameter is set to ADAPTIVE, the eNodeB automatically adjusts the transmit PSD of these UEs based on the

parameters.name: Close Loop Optimization PUSCH Type
parameters.description: Indicates the scope of UEs near the cell center for which optimized closed-loop power control for the PUSCH is enabled. If this parameter is set to Normal, optimized closed-loop power control is enabled for all UEs near the cell center. If this parameter is set to Us, optimized closed-loop power control is enabled only for UEs near the cell center running unlimited services. If this parameter is s

parameters.name: PUSCH Optimization IBLER Threshold
parameters.description: Indicates the target BLER when PUSCH power control is optimized for UEs at the cell center. This parameter applies only to LTE TDD.

parameters.id: PUSCH PSD Control Target for Unlimited Service
parameters.name: PUSCH PSD Control Target for Unlimited Service
parameters.description: Indicates the transmit power spectral density (PSD) for the PUSCH of UEs running unlimited services when the SchedulerCtrlPowerSwitch(SchedulerCtrlPowerSwitch) check box under the UlSchSwitch parameter is selected. The larger the value of this parameter, the higher the transmit PSD for the PUSCH of UEs running unlimited services. If this parameter is set to SAME AS NS, the transmit PSD of these UE

parameters.name: IoT Control IN Correct Switch
parameters.description: Indicates whether to enable noise and interference correction for interference-based uplink power control. This parameter applies only to LTE TDD.

parameters.id: IoT Control Edge UE Pathloss Threshold
parameters.name: IoT Control Edge UE Pathloss Threshold
parameters.description: Indicates the path loss threshold for identifying CEUs for interference coordination in the interference-based uplink power control function. If this parameter is set to 140, the function of determining whether a UE is a CEU during interference coordination is disabled, and the eNodeB does not distinguish edge bands from center bands. This parameter applies only to LTE TDD.

parameters.name: IoT Control NI Threshold
parameters.description: Indicates the interference threshold for triggering interference-based uplink power control. This parameter applies only to LTE TDD.

parameters.name: Near Point PUSCH User Type
parameters.description: Indicates the type of UEs near the cell center to which the PUSCH power increase applies. If this parameter is set to AllUser(AllUser), the PUSCH power increase applies to all UEs near the cell center. If this parameter is set to UlBigPktUser(UlBigPktUser), the PUSCH power increase applies to all large-packet UEs near the cell center. This option applies only to LTE FDD.

parameters.name: VoLTE SINR High Threshold Offset
parameters.description: Indicates the offset of the PUSCH SINR high threshold of UEs running voice services against the PUSCH SINR high threshold of UEs running data services. This parameter takes effect only when closed-loop PUSCH power control is enabled. In a heavily loaded network with a large number of UEs, setting this parameter to a proper value decreases interference in neighboring cells caused by CCUs running vo

parameters.id: PUSCH RSRP High Threshold Offset for VoIP
parameters.name: PUSCH RSRP High Threshold Offset for VoIP
parameters.description: Indicates the offset of the upper limit of PUSCH RSRP used for voice (VoLTE and PTT) service users relative to the upper limit of PUSCH RSRP used for data service users. If this parameter is set to a value in the range of 0 to 30, the value of this parameter plus the upper limit of PUSCH RSRP used for data service users is the upper limit of PUSCH RSRP used for voice service users. If this paramet

parameters.name: VoLTE PUSCH Power Offset
parameters.description: Indicates the offset of the uplink PUSCH power of VoLTE UEs to that of non-VoLTE UEs. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.id: D-MIMO Srs Power Control Offset for Sinr Target
parameters.name: D-MIMO Srs Power Control Offset for Sinr Target
parameters.description: Indicates the offset to the target SINR for beamforming UEs during SRS power control in D-MIMO scenarios. If this parameter is set to 0, the target SINR of SRS power control for beamforming UEs is not adjusted. If this parameter is set to another value, the target SINR of SRS power control for beamforming UEs equals the configured target SINR plus this offset. This parameter applies only to LTE TD

parameters.name: Power Checking Function Switch
parameters.description: Indicates whether to enable power checking. If this parameter is set to ON, the eNodeB checks the power of physical downlink channels. If the power exceeds the maximum power allowed by the single-channel capability of the RRU, the eNodeB discards some data to ensure that the configured power is not higher than the maximum power. If this parameter is set to OFF, the eNodeB does not check the power

parameters.id: Massive MIMO Cell Center SINR Thld Adj Value
parameters.name: Massive MIMO Cell Center SINR Thld Adj Value
parameters.description: Indicates the adjustment value of the SINR threshold for UEs near the cell center during uplink power control in massive MIMO scenarios. This parameter applies only to LTE TDD.

parameters.id: PUCCH RSRP High Threshold Offset for Voice UE
parameters.name: PUCCH RSRP High Threshold Offset for Voice UE
parameters.description: Indicates the offset of the PUCCH RSRP upper limit for voice service UEs relative to that for data service UEs. If this parameter is set to 0, the PUCCH RSRP upper limit for voice service UEs is the same as that for data service UEs. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: PUSCH Interference RSRP High Threshold
parameters.description: Indicates the upper limit on the RSRP of interference signals from UEs in their serving cells to neighboring cells. This parameter takes effect only when the PUSCH_INTRF_RSRP_HIGH_THLD_SW option of the HeavyLoadPrfmOptSwitch parameter in the CellAlgoExtSwitch MO is selected.

parameters.id: SRS Power Control RSRP Target for UL Subframe
parameters.name: SRS Power Control RSRP Target for UL Subframe
parameters.description: Indicates the target RSRP for SRS power control in common uplink subframes. This parameter applies only to LTE TDD.

parameters.id: SRS Power Control SINR Target for UL Subframe
parameters.name: SRS Power Control SINR Target for UL Subframe
parameters.description: Indicates the target SINR for SRS power control in common uplink subframes. This parameter applies only to LTE TDD.

parameters.name: Power Control Algorithm Optimization Switch
parameters.description: Indicates whether to optimize the power control algorithm. OUTER_LOOP_PUCCH_PC_OPT_SW: Indicates whether to enable PUCCH outer-loop power control optimization. If this option is selected, PUCCH power decrease is allowed when there is no data transmission. If this option is deselected, PUCCH power decrease is not allowed when there is no data transmission. This option applies only to LTE TDD.

parameters.name: Local cell ID
parameters.description: Indicates the Local ID of the cell. It uniquely identifies a cell within a BS. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: PDCCH Power Boost Upper Limit
parameters.description: Indicates the upper limit for the power increase during enhanced PDCCH power control, which is determined by the PdcchPowerEnhancedSwitch parameter. When the PdcchPowerBoostUpperLimit parameter is set to NULL, the default power increase upper limit of enhanced PDCCH power control is used. When the PdcchPowerBoostUpperLimit parameter is set to another value, the parameter value is used as the upper

parameters.name: SignalCongregateLevel
parameters.description: Indicates the CCE aggregation level for common control signaling. If the HOSuccRateBoostOptSwitch option of the HoSignalingOptSwitch parameter is selected, the PDCCH CCE aggregation level is changed to level 8 when an RAR message for a handover is retransmitted. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: Cce Ratio Adjust Switch
parameters.description: Indicates the CCE ratio adjustment switch for the PDCCH. If this parameter is set to ENHANCED_CCE_RATIO_ADJUSTMENT, the uplink-downlink CCE ratio is not dynamically adjusted in the event of uplink CCE allocation failure not caused by CCE resource insufficiency. parameters.name: SFN Pdcch DCS Threshold
parameters.description: Indicates the threshold of isolation for determining whether to enable PDCCH selective transmission in adaptive SFN/SDMA scenarios. parameters.name: PDCCH Initial Symbol Number
parameters.description: Indicates the number of OFDM symbols initially occupied by the PDCCH. If the switch for dynamic adjustment of the number of OFDM symbols occupied by the PDCCH is turned off, this parameter indicates the fixed number of OFDM symbols occupied by the PDCCH. parameters.name: PDCCH Virtual Loading Proportion
parameters.description: Indicates the percentage of the number of virtually loaded PDCCH CCEs when the PDCCH power control switch is turned off, or indicates the percentage of the power of virtually loaded PDCCH CCEs when the PDCCH power control switch is turned on. This parameter is used to analyze the impact of the parameter values on PDCCH demodulation performance and provide reference to intra-frequency networking in

parameters.name: PDCCH Initial Cce Adjustment Value
parameters.description: Indicates the PDCCH initial aggregation level adjustment. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD.

parameters.name: PDCCH Symbol Number Adjust Switch
parameters.description: Indicates whether to enable dynamic adjustment on the number of OFDM symbols occupied by the PDCCH. If this parameter is set to OFF, the number of OFDM symbols occupied by the PDCCH is fixed. If this parameter is set to ON, the number of OFDM symbols occupied by the PDCCH is dynamically adjusted based on the required number of control channel elements (CCEs). parameters.name: CCE use ratio
parameters.description: Indicates the upper limit of the CCE usage within each transmission time interval (TTI). When the PdcchSymNumSwitch parameter in the CellPdcchAlgo MO is set to ON(On), the parameter setting is invalid, that is, the CCE usage cannot be limited within each TTI. This parameter applies only to LTE TDD.

parameters.name: PDCCH Aggregation Level CL Switch
parameters.description: Indicates the switch used to enable or disable closed-loop adjustment to the PDCCH aggregation level. If this switch is turned on, PDCCH aggregation level is adjusted based on the block error rate (BLER) of the PDCCH. If this switch is turned off, PDCCH aggregation level is not adjusted based on the BLER of the PDCCH. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: DPD Virtual Load Switch
parameters.description: Indicates whether to enable virtual loading for digital predistortion (DPD). This parameter applies only to LTE TDD.

parameters.name: DPD Virtual Load Type
parameters.description: Indicates the virtual loading type for digital predistortion (DPD). This parameter applies only to LTE TDD.

parameters.id: Aggregation Level Strategy for Dual Codewords
parameters.name: Aggregation Level Strategy for Dual Codewords
parameters.description: For FDD, this parameter indicates the PDCCH CCE aggregation level selection policy used in dual-codeword transmission scenarios. The capacity-based selection policy is the default policy. If this policy is used, a low CCE aggregation level is selected in dual-codeword transmission scenarios, allowing PDCCH resources to be allocated to more UEs. parameters.name: PDCCH Capacity Improve Switch
parameters.description: Indicates whether to enable optimization on PDCCH capacity expansion. If this par

parameters.name: PDCCH Max Code Rate
parameters.description: Indicates the maximum coding rate on the PDCCH. The coding rate on the PDCCH cannot exceed this parameter value. Otherwise, the PDCCH aggregation level must be increased. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.id: Uplink and Downlink PDCCH Symbols Configuration
parameters.name: Uplink and Downlink PDCCH Symbols Configuration
parameters.description: Indicates the number of OFDM symbols initially occupied by the PDCCH in the downlink subframe in which uplink and downlink scheduling control information is transmitted. parameters.id: The Strategy Of PDCCH Aggregation Level Adaptation
parameters.name: The Strategy Of PDCCH Aggregation Level Adaptation
parameters.description: Indicates the adaptation strategy of the CCE aggregation level for the PDCCH. For LTE TDD cells, the coverage-based PDCCH aggregation level adaptation strategy is used by default. The capacity-based PDCCH aggregation level adaptation strategy leads to a lower

parameters.id: Hysteresis for CFI increase based on PreSch
parameters.name: Hysteresis for CFI increase based on PreSch

parameters.description: Indicates the threshold of isolation for determining whether to enable PDCCH SDMA in adaptive SFN/SDMA scenarios. CCE resources in the common search space are reserved for the uplink only when this switch is on. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: PDCCH Power Enhanced Switch
parameters.description: Indicates whether to enable PDCCH power control enhancement and specifies the enhancement scope. If this parameter is set to ON_ALL, ON_EXPANDED_RANGE, or ON_BASIC_RANGE, the eNodeB selects an appropriate power value based on the PDCCH quality to increase the PDCCH capacity. parameters.name: PDCCH BLER Target
parameters.description: Indicates the target BLER in PDCCH link adaptation. The PDCCH BLER must converge on this target BLER. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.id: HL Net Access Signal Aggregation Lvl Select Enhance Switch
parameters.name: HL Net Access Signal Aggregation Lvl Select Enhance Switch
parameters.description: Indicates whether to enable enhanced aggregation level selection for access signaling on high load networks. parameters.name: EPDCCH Algorithm Switch
parameters.description: Indicates whether to enable algorithms related to the EPDCCH. EpdcchFunctionSwitch: Indicates whether to support EPDCCH. If this option is selected, EPDCCH is supported. This option applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.description: Indicates the CCE usage threshold for configuring the EPDCCH. If the CCE usage is greater than this parameter value, the eNodeB configures EPDCCH resources for newly accessed UEs. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: RB Usage Threshold To Enable EPDCCH
parameters.description: Indicates the downlink RB usage threshold for configuring EPDCCH. If the downlink RB usage is less than this parameter value, the eNodeB configures EPDCCH resources for newly accessed UEs. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.id: CCE Usage Threshold To Disable EPDCCH
parameters.name: CCE Usage Threshold To Disable EPDCCH
parameters.description: Indicates the CCE usage threshold for disabling EPDCCH. If the CCE usage is lower than this parameter value, the eNodeB disables the EPDCCH. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.id: ECCE Usage Threshold To Disable EPDCCH
parameters.name: ECCE Usage Threshold To Disable EPDCCH
parameters.description: Indicates the ECCE usage threshold for disabling EPDCCH. If the ECCE usage is lower than this parameter value, the eNodeB disables the EPDCCH. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.id: RB Usage Threshold To Disable EPDCCH
parameters.name: RB Usage Threshold To Disable EPDCCH
parameters.description: Indicates the downlink RB usage threshold for disabling EPDCCH. If the downlink RB usage is greater than this parameter value, the eNodeB disables the EPDCCH. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.id: High Load Net Access Signal Attempt
parameters.name: High Load Net Access Signal Attempt
parameters.description: Indicates whether to enable functions related to enhanced aggregation level selection for access signaling on high load networks. MSG5Attempt: Indicates whether to enable enhanced aggregation level selection for MSG5. If this option is selected, enhanced aggregation level selection is enabled for MSG5. If this option is deselected, enhanced aggregation level selection is disabled for MSG5. This op

parameters.name: EPDCCH Subframe Configuration
parameters.description: Indicates whether the enhanced physical downlink control channel (EPDCCH) is configured only on downlink subframes that carry the uplink and downlink scheduling control information or in all downlink subframes after the EPDCCH is started. This parameter takes effect only in LTE TDD cells that use uplink-downlink subframe configuration 2. This parameter applies only to LTE TDD.

parameters.id: UL DL ECCE Initial Ratio Adjustment Switch
parameters.name: UL DL ECCE Initial Ratio Adjustment Switch
parameters.description: Indicates whether to enable adaptive adjustment of the initial ratios of the uplink and downlink enhanced control channel elements (eCCEs). If this parameter is set to ON(On), the initial ratios of uplink and downlink eCCEs can be dynamically adjusted in the range from 1 to Max(CceMaxInitialRatio, 1) based on the uplink and downlink loads. If this parameter is set to OFF(Off), the initial ratios o

parameters.id: BF Opt for Capacity-based PDCCH Aggregation
parameters.name: BF Opt for Capacity-based PDCCH Aggregation
parameters.description: Indicates whether to optimize the calculation of the beamforming gain for capacity-based PDCCH aggregation level adaptation. This parameter applies only to LTE TDD cells.

parameters.name: Flow Control Enable CCE Threshold
parameters.description: Indicates the upper threshold of CCE usage. If the percentage of CCEs consumed by SRBs is larger than this threshold, the eNodeB triggers MSG3 flow control. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: Flow Control Disable CCE Threshold
parameters.description: Indicates the lower threshold of CCE usage. If the percentage of CCEs consumed by SRBs is smaller than this threshold, the eNodeB cancels MSG3 flow control, or does not trigger MSG3 flow control. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.id: PDCCH Power Upper Limit Optimization Switch
parameters.name: PDCCH Power Upper Limit Optimization Switch
parameters.description: Indicates whether to raise the PDCCH power increase limit. If this parameter is set to ON(On), the eNodeB raises the PDCCH power increase limit in the subframes allocated uplink and downlink CCEs when the CceMaxInitialRatio parameter in the CellPdcchAlgo is set to a large value. If this parameter is set to OFF(Off), the eNodeB does not raise the PDCCH power increase limit in the subframes allocate

parameters.name: PDCCH Spare Power Allocation Strategy
parameters.description: Indicates the spare PDCCH power allocation strategy. When this parameter is set to NONE, spare PDCCH power is not allocated. When this parameter is set to WEAKCOVERAGEUSER, spare power of the PDCCH with the current CFI is allocated to UEs with weak coverage. When this parameter is set to BIGPKTUSER, spare power of the PDCCH with the current CFI is allocated to UEs with large-packet transmission. T

parameters.name: Volte PDCCH SINR Offset
parameters.description: Indicates the PDCCH SINR offset of voice UEs. This parameter is used to adjust the PDCCH aggregation level and PDCCH power for such UEs. If this parameter is set to 0, adjustment of the PDCCH aggregation level and PDCCH power does not take effect. It is recommended that this parameter be set to 30 for cells with few voice UEs. This helps improve the transmission reliability of the control channel

parameters.id: Enhanced PDCCH DL Agg Lev Selection
parameters.name: Enhanced PDCCH DL Agg Lev Selection
parameters.description: Indicates whether to optimize PDCCH aggregation level selection. The PDCCH BLER caused due to no responses from the UE is used as a reference for PDCCH aggregation level selection only when this parameter is set to ON. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.id: PDCCH Out Loop Adjustment Baseline Step
parameters.name: PDCCH Out Loop Adjustment Baseline Step
parameters.description: Indicates the baseline step used for outer-loop adjustment of the PDCCH. The selection of an appropriate step for the adjustment is dependent on this baseline step. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.id: PDCCH Out Loop Adjustment Value Lower Thld
parameters.name: PDCCH Out Loop Adjustment Value Lower Thld
parameters.description: For FDD: indicates the lower limit of the adjustment amount for outer-loop adjustment of the PDCCH. For TDD: indicates the lower limit of the initial adjustment amount for outer-loop adjustment of the PDCCH. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: PDCCH Adjust Algorithm Switch
parameters.description: Indicates whether to enable optimization functions related to the PDCCH adjustment algorithm. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD. CCE8PcOptSwitch: Indicates the basis of performing dynamic power control for UEs with a CCE aggregation level of 8 when the CCE aggregation level is adjusted based on capacity. If this option is selected, the PDCCH power for UEs with a CCE aggregation le

parameters.name: PDCCH Split Beam SDMA Threshold
parameters.description: Indicates the threshold of isolation for deciding whether to perform SDMA for PDCCH transmission in beam splitting scenarios. parameters.name: NACK and DTX Ratio Threshold
parameters.description: Indicates the threshold, which is the proportion of the sum of NACKs and DTXs to the sum of ACKs, NACKs, and DTXs of uplink HARQ feedback for downlink scheduling, for stopping scheduling a UE. If the proportion of the sum of NACKs and DTXs to the sum of ACKs, NACKs, and DTXs for downlink scheduling of a UE is higher than this threshold, the eNodeB stops initial transmission and retransmission of D

parameters.name: PDCCH Split Beam SDMA Switch
parameters.description: Indicates whether to perform SDMA for PDCCH split beams. MASSIVE_MIMO_PDCCH_SDMA_SW: If this option is selected, SDMA is performed for PDCCH split beams. If this option is deselected, joint transmission is always performed for PDCCH split beams. This option applies only to LTE TDD. MASSIVE_MIMO_PDCCH_MEAS_SW: If this option is selected, PDCCH beam association measurement is performed for UEs in ma

parameters.id: PDCCH Power Control User Num Threshold
parameters.name: PDCCH Power Control User Num Threshold
parameters.description: Indicates whether to perform PDCCH power optimization for heavy-load networks, and specifies the threshold of the number of UEs for triggering the optimization. If this parameter is set to 65535, PDCCH power optimization is disabled for heavy-load networks. If this parameter is set to a value ranging from 0 to 1050, PDCCH power optimization is enabled for heavy-load networks, and the eNodeB uses t

parameters.name: PDCCH Beamforming Gain Offset
parameters.description: Indicates the PDCCH beamforming gain offset for D-MIMO cells when the PDCCH aggregation level is selected based on coverage. If this parameter is set to -127, optimization of PDCCH beamforming gain offset is disabled. If this parameter is set to a value ranging from -10 to 10, optimization of PDCCH beamforming gain offset is enabled, and the offset is specified by this parameter. This parameter ap

parameters.name: VoLTE PDCCH Optimize Switch
parameters.description: Indicates whether to optimize the PDCCH for VoLTE UEs. VOLTE_PDCCH_CCE_SELECT_SWITCH: Indicates whether to optimize the selection of PDCCH CCE aggregation levels. If this option is deselected, the eNodeB does not optimize selection of the PDCCH CCE aggregation levels for VoLTE UEs. If this option is selected, the eNodeB optimizes the selection of PDCCH CCE aggregation levels for VoLTE UEs. This pa

parameters.name: CFI Adjustment CCE Threshold
parameters.description: Indicates the CCE threshold of enhanced CFI adaptation. This parameter is valid only when the PdcchSymNumSwitch parameter is set to ECFIADAPTIONON. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD.

parameters.id: Voice UE PDCCH Outer-Loop Adj Lower Limit
parameters.name: Voice UE PDCCH Outer-Loop Adj Lower Limit
parameters.description: Indicates the lower limit of outer-loop adjustment to the PDCCH aggregation level and whether to enable optimized CCE aggregation level selection for PDCCH for voice and air interface acceleration UEs. For FDD, if this parameter is set to 255, the value of the PdcchOutLoopAdjLowerLimit parameter in the CellPdcchAlgo MO is used as the lower limit of outer-loop adjustment to the PDCCH aggregation le

parameters.name: PDCCH Optimization Switch
parameters.description: Indicates whether to enable PDCCH optimization for TDD macro cells. LOW_AGG_PREFERENTIAL_SCH_SW: If this option is selected, preferential scheduling for UEs with a low aggregation level is enabled. If this option is deselected, preferential scheduling for UEs with a low aggregation level is disabled. This option applies only to LTE TDD. HEAVY_LOAD_BIG_PKT_SCH_OPT_SW: Indicates whether to enable th

parameters.id: Split Beam PDCCH SDMA Threshold Offset
parameters.name: Split Beam PDCCH SDMA Threshold Offset
parameters.description: Indicates the offset to the isolation threshold for UEs with PDCCH aggregation levels of 4 and 8 when SDMA is performed for PDCCH transmission in beam splitting scenarios. The actual isolation threshold for UEs with PDCCH aggregation levels of 4 and 8 is the sum of this offset and the SplitBeamPdcchSdmaThd parameter. The value THRESHOLD_OFFSET_0 indicates that the offset is 0 dB. The value THRESHO

parameters.name: PDCCH SDMA Weight Type
parameters.description: Indicates the weight type for PDCCH SDMA in massive MIMO scenarios. If this parameter is set to PREFERENTIAL_COV_GUARANTEE, a weight type guaranteeing coverage is preferred. If this parameter is set to PREFERENTIAL_ENHANCED_SDMA, a weight type guaranteeing space division gains is preferred. This parameter value is valid only when the CoverageScenario parameter is set to SCENARIO_2(HBW 65 Degree, V

parameters.name: PDCCH Power Check Switch
parameters.description: Indicates whether to enable PDCCH symbol power check. If this parameter is set to OFF, the eNodeB does not check the PDCCH symbol power. If this parameter is set to SYMBOL_0_POWER_CHECK, the eNodeB checks the power of PDCCH symbol 0 to ensure that the power of this symbol does not exceed the RRU single-channel power. If the power of this symbol exceeds the RRU single-channel power, CCE allocation

parameters.name: HARQ-ACK Feedback Mode Optimization Thld
parameters.description: Indicates the threshold for optimizing the HARQ-ACK feedback mode. If HARQ-ACK feedback mode optimization is enabled, the PDCCH load in the cell is greater than this threshold, and the single-frame scheduling mode is used for the UEs, the HARQ-ACK feedback mode of the UEs is reconfigured to the multiplexing mode. This parameter applies only to LTE TDD.

parameters.name: PDCCH Beamforming Switch
parameters.description: Indicates whether to enable PDCCH beamforming. MASSIVE_MIMO_PDCCH_BF_SW: If this option is selected, UE-specific beam weighting is performed to transmit the PDCCH data in massive MIMO scenarios. If this option is deselected, broadcast beam is performed to transmit the PDCCH data in massive MIMO scenarios. This option applies only to LTE TDD.

parameters.id: Abnormal UE PDCCH Opt CCE Usage Thld
parameters.name: Abnormal UE PDCCH Opt CCE Usage Thld
parameters.description: Indicates the equivalent CCE usage threshold used for evaluating whether to enable the function of PDCCH optimization for defective UEs. If this parameter is set to a non-zero value, the function is enabled. If this parameter is set to 0, the function is disabled. This parameter applies only to LTE TDD.

parameters.id: Abnormal UE PDCCH Opt CQI Thld
parameters.name: Abnormal UE PDCCH Opt CQI Thld
parameters.description: Indicates the CQI threshold of UEs used for evaluating whether to enable the function of PDCCH optimization for defective UEs. This parameter applies only to LTE TDD.

parameters.name: Local Cell ID
parameters.description: Indicates the local cell ID. It uniquely identifies a cell within an eNodeB. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: PRB Valuation MLB Trigger Threshold
parameters.description: Indicates the threshold of the PRB evaluation value for triggering MLB based on the PRB evaluation value. This parameter takes effect only when the MlbTriggerMode parameter in the CellMLB MO is set to PRB_ONLY or PRB_OR_UE_NUMBER and the PrbLoadCalcMethod parameter in the CellMLB MO is set to PRB_VALUATION_WITH_CTRL or PRB_VALUATION_NO_CTRL. If the number of UEs meets the minimum UE quantity condi

parameters.name: PRB Valuation MLB Admit Threshold
parameters.description: Indicates the threshold of the PRB evaluation value for determining a target neighboring cell for inter-frequency MLB. This parameter takes effect only when the MlbTriggerMode parameter in the CellMLB MO is set to PRB_ONLY or PRB_OR_UE_NUMBER and the PrbLoadCalcMethod parameter in the CellMLB MO is set to PRB_VALUATION_WITH_CTRL or PRB_VALUATION_NO_CTRL. If the PRB evaluation value of a neighborin

parameters.id: Mlb UE Selection PRB Valuation Threshold
parameters.name: Mlb UE Selection PRB Valuation Threshold
parameters.description: Indicates the threshold of the UE-specific PRB evaluation value for selecting UEs for MLB. A UE is transferred for MLB based on PRB evaluation only when the downlink or uplink PRB evaluation value of the UE is higher than the value of this parameter. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: PRB Valuation Filter Factor
parameters.description: Indicates the filtering coefficient used to calculate the PRB evaluation value. The filtering value is calculated by weighting the measured PRB evaluation value and historical filtering value based on the filtering coefficient. If this parameter is set to a smaller value, the filtering value is more close to the historical filtering value. If this parameter is set to a larger value, the filtering

parameters.name: Local cell ID
parameters.description: Indicates the local ID of the cell. It uniquely identifies a cell within an eNodeB. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: Preallocation Parameter Group ID
parameters.description: Indicates the ID of the parameter group related to preallocations. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: Preallocation Switch
parameters.description: Indicates whether to enable or disable preallocation for a bearer with a specified preallocation parameter group ID. If this parameter is set to ON(On), preallocation is enabled for this bearer. If this parameter is set to OFF(Off), preallocation is disabled for this bearer. This switch is a bearer-level switch and takes effect when the cell-level switch PreAllocationSwitch in the CellAlgoSwitch M

parameters.name: Smart Preallocation Switch
parameters.description: Indicates whether smart preallocation is enabled or disabled for a bearer with a specified preallocation parameter group ID when PreAllocationSwitch is turned on. If both PreAllocationSwitch and SmartPreAllocationSwitch are turned on, and SmartPreAllocationDuration is set to a value greater than 0, uplink smart preallocation is enabled; otherwise, uplink smart preallocation is disabled. This switc

parameters.name: Minimal Period of Preallocation
parameters.description: Indicates the minimum interval between two preallocations, that is, the interval between two times that a UE is preallocated must be greater than or equal to this parameter value. When the DRX algorithm switch is on and the UE is in DRX mode, the actual value of this parameter cannot be greater than the DrxInactivityTimer parameter value. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: Data Size of Preallocation
parameters.description: Indicates the data amount preallocated to each UE. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: Smart Preallocation Duration
parameters.description: Indicates the duration of each smart preallocation. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: Local Cell ID
parameters.description: Indicates the local ID of a cell. It uniquely identifies a cell within an eNodeB. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: PRS Bandwidth
parameters.description: Indicates the transmission bandwidth of PRS. This parameter corresponds to the PRS Bandwidth parameter defined in 3GPP TS 36.455. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: PRS Configuration Index
parameters.description: Indicates the PRS period and the start subframe. This parameter corresponds to the PRS Configuration Index parameter defined in 3GPP TS 36.455. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.id: Number of DL Frames for PRS
parameters.name: Number of DL Frames for PRS
parameters.description: Indicates the number of consecutive downlink subframes for PRSs. This parameter corresponds to the Number of DL Frames parameter specified in 3GPP TS 36.455. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: Num of PRS Muting Bit
parameters.description: Indicates the number of PRS muting bits in the cell. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: PRS Muting Configuration
parameters.description: Indicates the PRS muting configuration. See 3GPP TS 36.455 to learn details about this parameter. The value range of this parameter is determined by the value of the NumofPRSMutingBit parameter. The NumofPRSMutingBit values 2_BITS, 4_BITS, 8_BITS, and 16_BITS indicate that the value ranges of PrsMutingConfiguration are 0-3, 0-15, 0-255, and 0-65535, respectively. This parameter applies only to LTE

parameters.name: Local cell ID
parameters.description: Indicates the local ID of the cell. It uniquely identifies a cell within a BS. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: SRI Low Load Threshold
parameters.description: Indicates the threshold for the low load state of the SRI resources. The SRI resources enter the low load state if the PUCCH resource allocation algorithm detects that the number of admitted UEs is smaller than the value of this parameter. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: SRI Reconfiguration Indicator
parameters.description: Indicates whether the cell supports scheduling request indicator (SRI) reconfiguration. This parameter setting takes effect only when the PucchSwitch option of the PucchAlgoSwitch parameter is selected and the SriPeriodAdaptive parameter is set to a value other than OFF. If the SriReCfgInd parameter is set to TRUE, the cell supports SRI reconfiguration. In large traffic scenarios, SRI reconfigurat

parameters.name: SRI Algorithm Switch
parameters.description: Indicates the working modes for SRI reporting period configuration. SriAdaptiveHoldForVoIPSW: Indicates whether to enable SRI reporting period adaptation for VoLTE UEs during resource adjustment for SRI reporting. If this option is selected, SRI reporting periods are configured based on the cell load. If the number of UEs is small, adaptively configured SRI reporting periods are shorter than the f

parameters.name: Local Cell ID
parameters.description: Indicates the local ID of a cell. It uniquely identifies a cell within an eNodeB. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: QoS Class Indication
parameters.description: Indicates the QoS class identifier (QCI), which is an attribute of evolved packet system (EPS) bearers. Different QCIs indicate different QoS requirements, such as the packet delay budget, packet loss rate (PLR) and packet error rate (PER), and resource type (whether the service is a GBR service or not). For details, see Table 6.1.7 in 3GPP TS 23.203. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE

parameters.name: Interfreq Handover Group ID
parameters.description: Indicates the ID of a parameter group related to inter-frequency handovers. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.id: InterRAT Handover to CDMA20001xRTT Group ID
parameters.name: InterRAT Handover to CDMA20001xRTT Group ID
parameters.description: Indicates the ID of a parameter group related to inter-RAT handover to CDMA2000 1xRTT. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.id: InterRAT Handover to CDMA2000HRPD Group ID
parameters.name: InterRAT Handover to CDMA2000HRPD Group ID
parameters.description: Indicates the ID of a parameter group related to inter-RAT handover to CDMA2000 HRPD. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: InterRAT Handover Common Group ID
parameters.description: Indicates the ID of a common parameter group related to inter-RAT handover. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.id: InterRAT Handover to GERAN Group ID
parameters.name: InterRAT Handover to GERAN Group ID
parameters.description: Indicates the ID of a parameter group related to inter-RAT handover to GERAN. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.id: InterRAT Handover to UTRAN Group ID
parameters.name: InterRAT Handover to UTRAN Group ID
parameters.description: Indicates the ID of a parameter group related to inter-RAT handover to UTRAN. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: Intrafreq Handover Group ID
parameters.description: Indicates the ID of a parameter group related to intra-frequency handover. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: DRX Parameter Group ID
parameters.description: Indicates the ID of a DRX parameter group. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: SRI Period
parameters.description: Indicates the interval at which scheduling request indicators are sent. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: RLF Timer and Constants Indication
parameters.description: Indicates the RLF timer and constant configuration indication. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.id: RLF Timer and Constants Group ID
parameters.name: RLF Timer and Constants Group ID
parameters.description: Indicates the RLF timer and constant group ID. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: Traffic Release Delay
parameters.description: Indicates the time that the eNodeB waits to release services with a specific QCI after the eNodeB detects that the radio link is abnormal. When the eNodeB detects that the radio link is abnormal, the eNodeB waits for the UE to initiate an RRC connection reestablishment procedure to restore services. If the waiting duration times out, the eNodeB releases the services. This parameter applies only to

parameters.name: QCI Priority For Handover
parameters.description: Indicates the QCI priority used by each QCI-based handover algorithm. A larger value of this parameter indicates a lower priority. This parameter applies to handover parameter selection based on QCI priorities, target frequency selection in service-based inter-frequency handovers, and inter-RAT handover policy selection. For a service that involves all the preceding selection, the setting of this

parameters.name: Mlb QCI Group ID
parameters.description: Indicates the ID of a mobility load balancing (MLB) parameter group for a QCI. The value 255 is invalid. If this parameter is set to a value ranging from 0 to 9, the ID must be set in the associated MlbQciGroup MO. This parameter is valid only when the Qci parameter in the CellQciPara MO is set to 6, 7, 8, or 9. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: Preallocation Parameter Group ID
parameters.description: Indicates the ID of the parameter group related to preallocations. The value 255 indicates an invalid preallocation parameter group. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: QCI Priority For DRX
parameters.description: Indicates the QCI-specific priority for selecting a DRX parameter group. A larger value of this parameter indicates a lower priority. If the bearers for a UE have multiple QCIs and the DrxPolicyMode parameter is set to QCIPRIORITY(QCI priority), the eNodeB selects the DRX parameter group for the UE based on the QCI-specific priorities. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: QCI Algorithm Switch
parameters.description: Indicates whether to enable QCI-specific algorithms. INTER_FREQ_MLB_ALLOWED: If this option is selected, inter-frequency mobility load balancing (MLB) can be performed for UEs with bearers of this QCI. parameters.name: QCI EUTRAN Frequency Relation ID
parameters.description: Indicates the ID of the QCI and E-UTRAN frequency relationship group. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: QCI UTRAN Frequency Relation ID
parameters.description: Indicates the ID of the QCI and UTRAN frequency relationship group. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: QCI GERAN Frequency Relation ID
parameters.description: Indicates the ID of the QCI and GERAN frequency relationship group. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.id: eMTC Mode A CL 1 DRX Parameter Group ID
parameters.name: eMTC Mode A CL 1 DRX Parameter Group ID
parameters.description: Indicates the ID of a DRX parameter group used for eMTC UEs in CE mode A at coverage level 1. This parameter is invalid when it is set to 255. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.id: eMTC Mode B CL 3 DRX Parameter Group ID
parameters.name: eMTC Mode B CL 3 DRX Parameter Group ID
parameters.description: Indicates the ID of a DRX parameter group used for eMTC UEs in CE mode B at coverage level 3. This parameter is invalid when it is set to 255. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: Service Flag
parameters.description: Indicates the service type of the bearers of the QCI. This parameter is set based on the operator's policy. Bearers of the QCI carry WBB services if this parameter is set to WBB_SERVICE. Bearers of the QCI carry non-WBB services if this parameter is set to NONE. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: DL AMBR Rate Limiting Factor
parameters.description: Indicates the downlink AMBR limit factor for QCI-identified UEs whose rate is limited in DACQ scenarios. When DACQ is performed, the actual maximum data rate of a specific direction limited at a specific level equals the product of the following items: the maximum data rate of the corresponding direction limited at the corresponding level in the CellDacqCfg MO, the AMBR limit factor of the corresp

parameters.name: QCI-specific AMBR Limit Flag
parameters.description: Indicates whether to limit or protect the AMBR of QCI-specific UEs when dynamic AMBR control by QCI (DACQ) or enhanced DACQ is performed. When a cell meets the DACQ or enhanced DACQ triggering criteria, the AMBR of UEs with the specified QCI is processed based on the value of this parameter. parameters.name: UL AMBR Limit Factor
parameters.description: Indicates the uplink AMBR limit factor for QCI-identified UEs whose rate is limited in DACQ scenarios. When DACQ is performed, the actual maximum data rate of a specific direction limited at a specific level equals the product of the following items: the maximum data rate of the corresponding direction limited at the corresponding level in the CellDacqCfg MO, the AMBR limit factor of the correspon

parameters.name: Congestion Threshold
parameters.description: Indicates the QCI-specific service congestion threshold. This threshold applies to both the uplink and downlink. If the service QoS satisfaction rate of the QCI in the cell is lower than the threshold, the services of this QCI are congested. If the QoS satisfaction rate is higher than the sum of the threshold and the CongRelOffset parameter value, the service congestion is relieved. This parameter

parameters.name: Handover Admission Threshold
parameters.description: Indicates the QCI-specific handover admission threshold. This threshold applies to both the uplink and downlink. Handovers of such services can be admitted only if the service QoS satisfaction rate of the QCI in the cell is greater than or equal to the threshold. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD. Parameter relationship with conditions: When Qci is set to a value in the range of 1

parameters.name: Initial Downlink Target IBLER
parameters.description: Indicates the initial downlink target IBLER for UEs with bearers of the QCI. If this parameter is set to 0, this parameter does not take effect. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: SINR Adjustment Target IBLER
parameters.description: Indicates the target IBLER of the SINR adjustment algorithm for UEs with bearers of the QCI. If this parameter is set to 0, this parameter does not take effect. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: eMTC SRI Period
parameters.description: Indicates the SRI reporting period of eMTC UEs. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: Max Queue Duration
parameters.description: Indicates the longest time during which QCI-65 bearers that failed to be admitted due to insufficient cell resources can queue. If there are not sufficient cell resources after the time specified by this parameter, the eNodeB rejects admission requests of QCI-65 bearers.
