parameters.name: US UE Control Rate
parameters.description: Indicates the maximum QCI-specific data rate controlled for UEs. If this parameter is set to 65535, this parameter is invalid. This parameter takes effect only for QCIs 1 to 4. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: QCI PDCCH SINR Offset
parameters.description: Indicates the PDCCH SINR offset of UEs having bearers with the QCI. This parameter is used to adjust the PDCCH aggregation level and PDCCH power for such UEs. If this parameter is set to 0, adjustment of the PDCCH aggregation level and PDCCH power does not take effect. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: Decrease in NACK CQI Adjustment
parameters.description: Indicates the decrease in the CQI adjustment value when a UE returns a NACK message. If this parameter is set to a non-zero value, the CQI adjustment value decreases by the value of this parameter. If this parameter is set to 0, the CQI adjustment value is not modified. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: CEU Uplink Path Loss Threshold
parameters.description: Indicates the uplink path loss threshold of CEUs used in the measurement of the number of expected to-be-received uplink PDCP SDUs for services carried on DRBs for UEs far away from the cell center in a cell and the number of lost uplink PDCP SDUs for services carried on DRBs for the same UEs. When the uplink path loss of a UE is greater than or equal to the threshold, the corresponding counter is

parameters.name: NR Handover Parameter Group ID
parameters.description: Indicates the ID of a parameter group related to inter-RAT handovers to NR cells. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.id: SINR Thld for Triggering QCI TTI Bundling
parameters.name: SINR Thld for Triggering QCI TTI Bundling
parameters.description: Indicates the SINR threshold for UEs to enter QCI-specific TTI bundling. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD.

parameters.name: Low Latency Flag
parameters.description: Indicates whether bearers of this QCI are used for low-latency services. If this parameter is set to TRUE, bearers of this QCI are used for low-latency services. If this parameter is set to FALSE, bearers of this QCI are not used for low-latency services. This parameter does not take effect for QCI 1, QCI 2, QCI 5, and PTT-related QCIs (including QCI 65, QCI 66, QCI 69, and QCI 70). This parameter

parameters.name: NSA DC Default Bearer Mode
parameters.description: Indicates the type of bearers to be set up for UEs that access the cell or are handed over to the cell in the LTE-NR NSA DC architecture. If this parameter is set to SCG_SPLIT_BEARER, SCG split bearers are set up for UEs by default. If this parameter is set to MCG_SPLIT_BEARER, MCG split bearers are set up for UEs by default. If this parameter is set to MCG_BEARER, MCG bearers using the NR PDCP ar

parameters.id: Low Delay CEU Preallocation Opt Thld
parameters.name: Low Delay CEU Preallocation Opt Thld
parameters.description: Indicates whether to enable short-period preallocation optimization for cell edge users (CEUs) running low-latency services and the threshold for the optimization to take effect. If this parameter is set to -51, this function does not take effect. If this parameter is set to a value other than -51, the parameter value is the SINR threshold for short-period preallocation optimization for CEUs runni

parameters.id: Low Delay UE SR-based Sch Min Data Volume
parameters.name: Low Delay UE SR-based Sch Min Data Volume
parameters.description: Indicates the minimum amount of data transmitted by SR-based scheduling for UEs running low-latency services. If this parameter is set to 0, the function does not take effect. If this parameter is set to another value, the parameter value is the minimum amount of data transmitted by SR-based scheduling for UEs running low-latency services. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.id: NSA DC GERAN HO Group ID
parameters.name: NSA DC GERAN HO Group ID
parameters.description: Indicates the ID of the parameter group related to inter-RAT handovers to GERAN for NSA DC UEs. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.id: NSA DC Inter-Frequency HO Group ID
parameters.name: NSA DC Inter-Frequency HO Group ID
parameters.description: Indicates the ID of the parameter group related to inter-frequency handovers for NSA DC UEs. This parameter is invalid when it is set to 255. In this case, the inter-frequency handover parameter group specified by the InterFreqHoGroupId parameter, rather than an independent one, is configured for NSA DC UEs. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.id: NSA DC Inter-RAT HO Common Group ID
parameters.name: NSA DC Inter-RAT HO Common Group ID
parameters.description: Indicates the ID of the parameter group related to inter-RAT handovers for NSA DC UEs. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.id: NSA DC Intra-Frequency HO Group ID
parameters.name: NSA DC Intra-Frequency HO Group ID
parameters.description: Indicates the ID of the parameter group related to intra-frequency handovers for NSA DC UEs. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.id: NSA DC UTRAN HO Group ID
parameters.name: NSA DC UTRAN HO Group ID
parameters.description: Indicates the ID of the parameter group related to inter-RAT handovers to UTRAN for NSA DC UEs. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: NSA DC Optimization Switch
parameters.description: Indicates whether to enable NSA DC optimization functions. SERV_BASED_INTER_FREQ_HO_SW: Indicates whether to enable service-based inter-frequency handover for NSA DC UEs. If this option is selected, service-based inter-frequency handover is enabled for NSA DC UEs. If this option is deselected, service-based inter-frequency handover is disabled for NSA DC UEs. This option applies only to LTE FDD an

parameters.id: NSA DC DRX Parameter Group ID
parameters.name: NSA DC DRX Parameter Group ID
parameters.description: Indicates the group ID of a DRX parameter group used for an NSA DC UE with an SCG configured. This parameter is invalid when it is set to 255. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: Uplink HARQ Maximum Transmission Number
parameters.description: Indicates the maximum number of uplink HARQ transmissions, excluding the HARQ transmission based on TTI bundling. For details, see 3GPP TS 36.331. This parameter takes effect only if QCI-1 bearers exist and the UlVoipCrosslayerOptSwitch option is deselected. This parameter has coupling relationships with the ENodeBAmReorderingTimer and ENodeBUmReorderingTimer parameters. If the UlHarqMaxTxNum para

parameters.id: eMTC Mode A CL 0 DRX Parameter Group ID
parameters.name: eMTC Mode A CL 0 DRX Parameter Group ID
parameters.description: Indicates the ID of a DRX parameter group used for eMTC UEs in CE mode A at coverage level 0. This parameter is invalid when it is set to 255. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.id: eMTC Mode B CL 2 DRX Parameter Group ID
parameters.name: eMTC Mode B CL 2 DRX Parameter Group ID
parameters.description: Indicates the ID of a DRX parameter group used for eMTC UEs in CE mode B at coverage level 2. This parameter is invalid when it is set to 255. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.id: NSA DC QCI Parameter Group ID
parameters.name: NSA DC QCI Parameter Group ID
parameters.description: Indicates the ID of a QCI-specific NSA DC parameter group.

parameters.name: Local cell ID
parameters.description: Indicates the local ID of a cell, which uniquely identifies the cell within an eNodeB.

parameters.id: PRACH False Alarm Detect Radius Threshold
parameters.name: PRACH False Alarm Detect Radius Threshold
parameters.description: Indicates the threshold of the distance between a UE and the eNodeB for determining whether a contention-based preamble sent by the UE is a PRACH false alarm. If this parameter is set to 0, the eNodeB does not consider a preamble as a false alarm based on the distance. If this parameter is set to a non-zero value and the eNodeB detects that the distance is longer than this parameter value, the pre

parameters.name: RACH Threshold Boosting Ratio
parameters.description: This parameter indicates the percentage by which the PRACH false alarm detection threshold increases. For example, the value x indicates that the configured PRACH false alarm detection threshold increases by x%, and the value -x indicates that the configured PRACH false alarm detection threshold decreases by x%.

parameters.name: Prach Interference Period
parameters.description: Indicates the period for an eNodeB to avoid PRACH interference. This parameter is used to control the speed of PRACH frequency domain position adjustment to prevent ping-pong adjustments due to interference fluctuation. This parameter applies only to the TDLOFD-081217 Interference Detection and Restraining Enhancement feature. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: Prach Interference Threshold
parameters.description: Indicates the threshold for an eNodeB to determine whether PRACH interference is severe. When the value of PRACH interference (per PRB) is greater than or equal to the value of this parameter, an eNodeB determines that PRACH interference is severe. This parameter applies only to the TDLOFD-081217 Interference Detection and Restraining Enhancement feature. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and

parameters.name: Prach Interference Hysteresis
parameters.description: Indicates the hysteresis for an eNodeB to determine PRACH interference. This parameter is used to reduce the number of ping-pong adjustments due to interference fluctuation. This parameter is used with the Prach Interference Threshold parameter to determine weak PRACH interference and moderate PRACH interference. When the value of PRACH interference is less than the value of Prach Interference Thr

parameters.name: Conflict Cell Mobile Network Code
parameters.description: Indicates the MNC of a conflict cell. A PLMN ID is composed of an MCC and an MNC. The MCC consists of three digits. The MNC consists of two to three digits. For example, if the MCC is 123 and the MNC is 45, the PLMN ID is 12345. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: Conflict eNodeB ID
parameters.description: Indicates the eNodeB ID of a conflict cell located in the same PLMN as the local cell. A local cell ID and an eNodeB ID compose a 28-bit E-UTRAN cell ID, where the eNodeB ID is represented by the 20 most significant bits. An E-UTRAN cell ID and a PLMN ID compose an E-UTRAN CGI (ECGI). For details about this parameter, see 3GPP TS 36.413. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: Conflict Cell ID
parameters.description: Indicates the ID of the cell that conflicts with the local cell. It uniquely identifies a cell within an eNodeB. The 28-bit E-UTRAN cell identity is comprised of the cell ID in the most significant eight bits and the eNodeB ID. The E-UTRAN cell identity and the PLMN ID form the E-UTRAN cell global identifier (ECGI). For details about this parameter, see 3GPP TS 36.413. This parameter applies only

parameters.name: Conflict Cell Mobile Country Code
parameters.description: Indicates the MCC of a conflict cell. A PLMN ID is composed of an MCC and an MNC. The MCC consists of three digits. The MNC consists of two to three digits. For example, if the MCC is 123 and the MNC is 45, the PLMN ID is 12345. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: Local Cell ID
parameters.description: Indicates the local ID of a cell, which uniquely identifies a cell within an eNodeB.

parameters.name: Coverage Level
parameters.description: Indicates the cell coverage level for random access. The value COVERAGE_LEVEL_0 indicates coverage level 0. The value COVERAGE_LEVEL_1 indicates coverage level 1. The value COVERAGE_LEVEL_2 indicates coverage level 2. This parameter applies only to NB-IoT.

parameters.name: Contention Resolution Timer
parameters.description: Indicates the length of the timer that governs the period in which a UE waits for message 4 (Msg4) during a random access (RA) procedure. This timer starts when a UE initially sends or resends message 3 (Msg3). This timer stops when the UE receives Msg4 or NACK to Msg3 within the length of the timer. If the UE does not receive either message until the timer expires, the RA fails, and the UE must r

parameters.name: Maximum Number of Preamble Attempt
parameters.description: Indicates the maximum number of preamble transmissions for random access attempts at the corresponding cell coverage level. This parameter applies only to NB-IoT.

parameters.name: EDT Contention Resolution Timer
parameters.description: Indicates the timer governing the period in which a UE waits for Msg4 after sending Msg3 for EDT to the eNodeB during an RA procedure initiated by the UE using contention-based PRACH resources. This timer starts when a UE initially transmits or retransmits Msg3. If the UE receives Msg4 or NACK to Msg3 before the timer expires, the timer stops. If the timer expires, the RA fails. In this case, the

parameters.name: RA Response Window Size
parameters.description: Indicates the random access response (RAR) window size. This parameter can be set to different values for different coverage levels of a cell. This parameter applies only to NB-IoT.

parameters.name: Local cell ID
parameters.description: Indicates the local cell ID. It uniquely identifies a cell within a BS. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: Gold service arp threshold
parameters.description: Indicates the Allocation and Retention Priority (ARP) threshold for the Gold-level services. A service is defined as a Gold-level service if its ARP value is smaller than or equal to this threshold. The service priority has a negative correlation with the ARP value. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: Silver service arp threshold
parameters.description: Indicates the ARP threshold of silver-level services. An ARP value less than or equal to this threshold but greater than the ARP threshold of gold-level services corresponds to silver-level services. A smaller ARP value indicates a higher priority. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.id: Gold new service admission threshold offset
parameters.name: Gold new service admission threshold offset
parameters.description: Indicates the offset for admission of new gold-level services. This parameter applies to both downlink and uplink. New gold-level services with QCI N are admitted if both the following conditions are met: (1) The satisfaction rate of services with QCI N is higher than or equal to the sum of this offset and the admission threshold for the handed-over services with QCI N. (2) The satisfaction rate o

parameters.id: Silver new service admission threshold offset
parameters.name: Silver new service admission threshold offset
parameters.description: Indicates the offset for admission of new silver-level services. This parameter applies to both downlink and uplink. New silver-level services with QCI N are admitted if both the following conditions are met: (1) The satisfaction rate of services with QCI N is higher than or equal to the sum of this offset and the admission threshold for the handed-over services with QCI N. (2) The satisfaction ra

parameters.id: Bronze new service admission threshold offset
parameters.name: Bronze new service admission threshold offset
parameters.description: Indicates the offset for admission of new bronze-level services. This parameter applies to both downlink and uplink. New bronze-level services with QCI N are admitted if both the following conditions are met: (1) The satisfaction rate of services with QCI N is higher than or equal to the sum of this offset and the admission threshold for the handed-over services with QCI N. (2) The satisfaction ra

parameters.name: Offset for service congest relieving
parameters.description: Indicates the congestion release offset. The service of a specific QCI exits the congestion state if the satisfaction rate of the service exceeds the sum of this congestion release offset and the congestion threshold for the QCI. The service retains the congestion state if the satisfaction rate is below or equal to the sum of this congestion release offset and the congestion threshold for the QCI.

parameters.name: High RB Usage Thld
parameters.description: Indicates the threshold for deciding on whether the UL and DL RB usages are high. This threshold applies to UL and DL admission decision. If the UL RB usage reported by the MAC layer is above this threshold, the UL RB usage is assumed to be high. If the DL RB usage reported by the MAC layer is above this threshold, the DL RB usage is assumed to be high. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and L

parameters.name: Low RB Usage Thld
parameters.description: Indicates the threshold for deciding on whether the UL and DL RB usages are low. It applies to UL and DL admission decision. If the UL RB usage reported by the MAC layer is below this threshold, the UL RB usage is assumed to be low. If the DL RB usage reported by the MAC layer is below this threshold, the DL RB usage is assumed to be low. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: Admission Control Reserved User Number
parameters.description: Indicates the UE number reserved for UEs initiating emergency calls and high-priority UEs. If this parameter is set to 0, no UE number is reserved for UEs initiating emergency calls and high-priority UEs. A non-zero value of this parameter represents the maximum UE number reserved for UEs initiating emergency calls and high-priority UEs. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: VoLTE Reserved Number
parameters.description: Indicates the reserved number of VoLTE UEs that can be preferentially admitted. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: VoLTE Preferential Admission Timer
parameters.description: Indicates a timer used for determining whether a user is a VoLTE user. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: Cell Capacity Mode
parameters.description: Indicates the cell capacity mode, which is used to set the maximum number of UEs that can access a single cell. The parameter value can be SMALLCAPACITY, NORMALCAPACITY, or LARGECAPACITY, indicating the number of UEs that can access a cell in ascending order. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD. The SMALLCAPACITY value applies to FDD SFN or LampSite cells. A cell with a bandwidth of 5 MHz or lo

parameters.name: Load-based Handover Admission Offset
parameters.description: Indicates load-based handover admission offset. If the satisfaction rate of a service with a QCI is greater than or equal to the sum of the LoadHoAdmitOffset parameter value and the corresponding admission threshold of handover services with the QCI, load-based handover services with the QCI are admitted; otherwise, load-based handover services with the QCI are rejected. This parameter applies onl

parameters.name: VoIP Over Admission Offset
parameters.description: Indicates the offset for excessive admission of VoIP services. When the VoIPOffloadSwitch option is selected, if the satisfaction rate of VoIP is greater than or equal to the value of the admission threshold of new VoIP services minus this parameter value, the new VoIP services are admitted; if the satisfaction rate of VoIP is greater than or equal to the value of the admission threshold of VoIP s

parameters.name: Admission Control User Number
parameters.description: Indicates the maximum number of UEs that can be admitted to the cell.

parameters.name: MO Signaling ARP Override
parameters.description: Indicates whether to modify the ARP value of a bearer that is requested to be set up as indicated in the initial UE context setup request message for a UE that attempts to access a cell with the cause value of "mo-Signalling". If this parameter is set to 0, the ARP value is not to be changed. If this parameter is set to a non-zero value, the ARP value can be changed to the parameter value and serv

parameters.name: CCE Usage Threshold
parameters.description: Indicates the high CCE usage threshold used in resource-based admission for high-priority UEs. When this parameter is set to 0, PRB- and CCE-based admission does not take effect, and the UlRbHighThd and UlRbLowThd parameters in the CellRacThd MO are used only to specify the high and low RB usage thresholds for uplink admission. When this parameter is set to a value other than 0, PRB- and CCE-based

parameters.name: Preempt Resource Need Tuning Factor
parameters.description: Indicates the tuning factor used to determine whether to allow high-priority UEs to preempt resources of low-priority UEs when the resources that can be provided by low-priority UEs in the cell are insufficient. If the result of the amount of resources required by a high-priority UE that has initiated preemption multiplied by this parameter value is less than or equal to the amount of resources th

parameters.name: CCE Allocation Failure High Threshold
parameters.description: Indicates the threshold of the CCE allocation failure rate for determining resource congestion in the uplink and downlink. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD. If the CCE allocation failure rate of the cell is greater than or equal to this threshold, CCE resources of the cell are congested.

parameters.name: CQI Threshold for Far Users
parameters.description: Indicates the CQI threshold for identifying UEs at the cell edge in both uplink and downlink. If the CQI of a UE exceeds or equals this threshold, the UE is near the cell center. If the CQI of the UE is smaller than this threshold, the UE is at the cell edge. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: DL Experience Rate Threshold
parameters.description: Indicates the threshold of the downlink user-experienced rate. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD. If the downlink user-experienced rate is lower than this threshold and resources are congested in the cell, the cell is congested in the downlink. If the downlink experience rate is greater than or equal to this threshold, cell congestion is relieved in the downlink.

parameters.name: RB Congestion High Threshold
parameters.description: Indicates the threshold of the RB usage for determining resource congestion in the uplink and downlink. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD. If the uplink RB usage exceeds or equals this threshold, cell resources are congested in the uplink. If the downlink RB usage exceeds or equals this threshold, cell resources are congested in the downlink.

parameters.name: UL Experience Rate Threshold
parameters.description: Indicates the threshold of the uplink user-experienced rate. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD. If the uplink user-experienced rate is lower than this threshold and resources are congested in the cell, the cell is congested in the uplink. If the uplink experience rate equals or exceeds this threshold, uplink cell congestion is relieved.

parameters.name: VoLTE UE ARP Override
parameters.description: Indicates whether to change the ARP in an initial context setup request for bearer setup for a UE with an RRC connection setup cause of mo-VoiceCall-v1280. The ARP will be changed to the value of this parameter when the cell capacity in terms of the number of UEs is limited and the MME-delivered ARP is greater than the value of this parameter. If this parameter is set to 0, the ARP will not be cha

parameters.id: CCE Usage Thld for VoLTE Load Rate Control
parameters.name: CCE Usage Thld for VoLTE Load Rate Control
parameters.description: Indicates the threshold of the CCE usage for GBR services in the cell. If the value of this parameter is less than or equal to 10, the threshold does not take effect. If the value is greater than 10 and the CCE usage for GBR services exceeds this threshold or if the RB usage for uplink GBR services exceeds the UlRbThdforVolteLoadAmrc parameter in the CellRacThd MO, the uplink cell load over the ai

parameters.id: UL RB Usage Thld for VoLTE Load Rate Control
parameters.name: UL RB Usage Thld for VoLTE Load Rate Control
parameters.description: Indicates the threshold of the RB usage for uplink GBR services in the cell. If the value of this parameter is less than or equal to 10, the threshold does not take effect. If the value is greater than 10 and the RB usage for uplink GBR services in the cell exceeds this threshold or if the CCE usage for GBR services exceeds the CceThdforVolteLoadAmrc parameter in the CellRacThd MO, the uplink cell

parameters.name: Congestion Bearer Release Period
parameters.description: Indicates the bearer releasing period during congestion control. This parameter takes effect only when both the MCPTT QoS Management and Congestion Control for Public Safety features are enabled. Otherwise, the parameter value is 15. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: Preemptable Bearer Number
parameters.description: Indicates the maximum number of bearers that can be preempted per second after satisfaction-rate-based admission fails. This number is shared among all operators in this cell. The setting of this parameter takes effect only when both the MCPTT QoS Management and Congestion Control for Public Safety features are enabled. If the average number of bearers that can be preempted by each operator is sma

parameters.name: Congestion Bearer Release Count
parameters.description: Indicates the maximum number of low-priority bearers that can be released per period during congestion control. The setting of this parameter takes effect only when both MCPTT QoS management and congestion control for public safety are enabled. Otherwise, the number of bearers to be released due to congestion is permanently 1.

parameters.name: Copper Service ARP Threshold
parameters.description: Indicates the ARP threshold of copper-level services. An ARP value less than or equal to this threshold but greater than the ARP threshold of silver-level services corresponds to copper-level services. An ARP value greater than this threshold corresponds to iron-level services. A smaller ARP value indicates a higher priority. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.id: Iron New Service Admission Threshold Offset
parameters.name: Iron New Service Admission Threshold Offset
parameters.description: Indicates the admission threshold offset of new iron-level services. This offset applies to both the uplink and downlink. When the satisfaction rate for services with a QCI is greater than or equal to the sum of this parameter value and the handover admission threshold for services with the QCI, and satisfaction rates for services with other QCIs are all greater than or equal to corresponding hand

parameters.name: eMTC Admission Control UE Count
parameters.description: Indicates the number of eMTC UEs that can be admitted to the cell. An eMTC UE is admitted if an RRC connection is successfully set up for this UE. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: UE Number Reserved for Handover
parameters.description: Indicates the reserved number of UEs that can be admitted in incoming RRC connection reestablishments and necessary incoming handovers. Necessary handovers include coverage-based intra-frequency handovers, coverage-based inter-frequency handovers, uplink-quality-based inter-frequency handovers, and distance-based inter-frequency handovers. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: Admission Control Policy
parameters.description: Indicates the radio access control policy. VOLTE_UNCONDITIONAL_ADMISSION: Indicates whether to allow unconditional VoLTE service admission when the service admission function is enabled. If this option is selected, VoLTE services are admitted unconditionally. If network congestion occurs due to VoLTE service admission, low-priority services will be released. If this option is deselected, VoLTE ser

parameters.name: NSA User ARP Override
parameters.description: Indicates whether to change the ARP value of a bearer that is requested to be set up as indicated in the initial UE context setup request message for a UE that supports NSA networking. If this parameter is set to 0, the ARP value will not be changed. If this parameter is set to a value in the range of 1 to 15, the ARP value will be changed to the value of this parameter or the ARP value delivered

parameters.name: Local cell ID
parameters.description: Indicates the local cell ID, which uniquely identifies a cell within an eNodeB.

parameters.name: Index
parameters.description: Indicates the index of a reserved RB configuration for the cell.

parameters.name: RB Reserve Mode
parameters.description: Indicates the purpose for reserving RBs. The value NB_RESERVED indicates that the specified RBs are reserved not for NB-IoT deployment but as a guard band in the uplink or to reduce the interference between LTE and NB-IoT cells in the downlink. This value applies only to NB-IoT. The value NB_DEPLOYMENT indicates that the specified RBs are used for NB-IoT deployment. This value applies only to NB-I

parameters.name: RB Reserve Type
parameters.description: Indicates whether the PRBs to be reserved at the physical layer are uplink or downlink ones.

parameters.name: RB Reserve Start Index
parameters.description: Indicates the index of the start PRB of the physical-layer reserved PRBs. The PRBs are numbered starting from 0 in sequence from low to high frequencies. For details, see 3GPP TS 36.211.

parameters.name: RB Reserve End Index
parameters.description: Indicates the index of the end PRB of the physical-layer reserved PRBs.

parameters.name: Local cell ID
parameters.description: Indicates the Local ID of the cell. It uniquely identifies a cell within a BS. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: Uplink Relay Subframe Ratio
parameters.description: Indicates the ratio of uplink subframes used as relay subframes. The total number of subframes in each radio frame is 10. For example, the value 2/10 indicates that two uplink subframes in each radio frame are used as relay subframes. In the LTE FDD system, the number of uplink subframes used for common UEs is 8, which is the result of subtracting 2 from 10. In the LTE TDD system, the number of up

parameters.name: Downlink Relay Subframe Ratio
parameters.description: Indicates the ratio of downlink subframes used as relay subframes in out-of-band relay and in-band relay scenarios. In out-of-band relay scenarios, the parameter value takes 10 (the number of subframes in one radio frame) as the denominator. For example, the value 2/10 indicates that two downlink subframes in each radio frame are used as relay subframes. In the LTE FDD system, the number of downli

parameters.name: Rrn Pre-Allocation Minimum Period
parameters.description: Indicates the minimum interval between uplink preallocations for a relay remote node (RRN). The interval between two preallocations for the same RRN cannot be smaller than the value of this parameter. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: Rrn Pre-Allocation Size
parameters.description: Indicates the uplink preallocation data volume of a relay remote node (RRN), that is, the data volume that can be transmitted during an RRN preallocation. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: Uplink SINR Adjustment Target IBLER
parameters.description: Indicates the target IBLER used in the SINR adjustment algorithm for uplink dynamic scheduling of RRNs. A larger value of this parameter leads to a greater SINR adjustment value, and therefore a higher MCS index is used. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: Downlink SINR Adjustment Target IBLER
parameters.description: Indicates the target IBLER used in the SINR adjustment algorithm for downlink dynamic scheduling of RRNs. A larger value of this parameter leads to a greater SINR adjustment value, and therefore a higher MCS index is used. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: Uplink Enhanced Relay Schedule Switch
parameters.description: Indicates whether to enable the enhanced uplink scheduling function related to RRNs. UlSPSDegradeSwitch: If this option is selected, the uplink SPS priority of normal UEs becomes lower than the uplink scheduling priority of RRNs in uplink relay subframes. If this option is deselected, the uplink SPS priority is not lowered. This option applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: Downlink Enhanced Relay Schedule Switch
parameters.description: Indicates whether to enable the enhanced downlink scheduling function related to RRNs. DlSPSDegradeSwitch: If this option is selected, downlink SPS does not take effect in downlink relay subframes. If this option is deselected, downlink SPS is not affected. This option applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: In Band Relay Concatenation Count
parameters.description: Indicates the position of the RRN for the cell in a concatenation when RRNs are concatenated in in-band relay scenarios. The value NON_CON indicates that concatenation is not supported. The other values affect the subframe scheduling template. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: Local cell ID

parameters.description: Indicates the hysteresis for the measured RSRP of the serving cell, which is used for cell reselection evaluation. This parameter must be set based on the slow fading characteristic of the area covered by the cell. The greater the slow fading variance is, the larger the value of this parameter must be set to. parameters.name: Speed-dependent reselection parameter configure indicator
parameters.description: Indicates whether to set the parameters related to speed-dependent cell reselection. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.id: The duration for evaluating criteria to enter mobility states
parameters.name: The duration for evaluating criteria to enter mobility states
parameters.description: Indicates the duration in which the mobility status of the UE is evaluated. This parameter is one of the key parameters in deciding on the UE mobility state. A smaller value of this parameter may lead to more frequent state transitions and lower decision accuracy. A larger value of this parameter leads to the opposite effect. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.id: Additional time hysteresis for normal speed
parameters.name: Additional time hysteresis for normal speed
parameters.description: Indicates the extra duration required in the evaluation before the UE can enter the normal-mobility state. This parameter can prevent UEs from frequently switching from the high- or medium-mobility state to the normal-mobility state, and is one of the key parameters in deciding on the UE mobility. A larger value of this parameter leads to a lower probability of transition from the high- or medium-

parameters.id: The number of cell changes to enter medium mobility state
parameters.name: The number of cell changes to enter medium mobility state
parameters.description: Indicates the threshold of the number of cell reselections, which is used for a UE to enter the medium-mobility state. This parameter is one of the key parameters in determining the mobility state of the UE. parameters.id: The number of cell changes to enter high mobility state
parameters.name: The number of cell changes to enter high mobility state
parameters.description: Indicates the threshold of the number of cell reselections, which is used for a UE to enter the high-mobility state. This parameter is one of the key parameters in determining the mobility state of the UE. During the UE mobility evaluation, if the number of cell reselections is greater than this parameter value, the UE enters the high-mobility state. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE

parameters.name: Additional hysteresis for medium speed
parameters.description: Indicates the scaling factor (or known as additional hysteresis) applied to Qhyst for medium-mobility UEs. For details, see 3GPP TS 36.304 and 3GPP TS 36.331. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: Additional hysteresis for high speed
parameters.description: Indicates the scaling factor (or known as additional hysteresis) applied to Qhyst for high-mobility UEs. For details, see 3GPP TS 36.304 and 3GPP TS 36.331. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.id: Threshold for non-intra freq measurements configure indicator
parameters.name: Threshold for non-intra freq measurements configure indicator
parameters.description: Indicates whether to configure the measurement triggering threshold for cell reselection to inter-frequency or inter-RAT cells. If this parameter is set to NOT_CFG and the QQualMinCfgInd parameter is set to NOT_CFG, the UE continuously measures intra-frequency and inter-RAT cells, regardless of the signal quality of the serving cell.

parameters.name: Threshold for non-intra frequency measurements

If the cell reselection priority of a frequency or RAT is higher than that of the serving frequency, the UEs always start inter-frequency or inter-RAT measurements. parameters.name: Serving frequency lower priority threshold
parameters.description: Indicates the threshold used in the evaluation of reselection to a cell on a lower priority E-UTRAN frequency or on an inter-RAT frequency. parameters.name: Cell reselection priority
parameters.description: Indicates the absolute cell reselection priority of the serving frequency. The value 0 indicates the lowest priority, and the value 7 indicates the highest priority. The value of this parameter must be determined together with the priorities of other frequencies during network planning. parameters.name: Minimum required RX level
parameters.description: Indicates the minimum receive level required for an intra-frequency E-UTRAN cell to become a candidate for cell reselection. This parameter corresponds to the IE q-RxLevMin in SIB3. The level is included in the cell reselection criteria and used in the evaluation of cell reselection. parameters.id: Ue max power allowed configure indicator
parameters.name: Ue max power allowed configure indicator
parameters.description: Indicates whether to configure the maximum TX power of the UE in the intra-frequency neighboring cell. If the value of this parameter is not specified, the maximum power is subject to the UE capability.

parameters.name: Max transmit power allowed
parameters.description: Indicates the maximum power that the UE can apply to transmission in the intra-frequency neighboring cell. It is used in cell reselection criteria to calculate the compensated power. If the value of this parameter is not specified, the maximum power is subject to the UE capability. For details, see 3GPP TS 36.304.

parameters.id: Threshold for intra freq measurements configure indicator
parameters.name: Threshold for intra freq measurements configure indicator
parameters.description: Indicates whether to set the measurement triggering threshold for reselection to intra-frequency cells.

parameters.name: Threshold for intra frequency measurements

parameters.name: Measurement bandwidth configure indicator
parameters.description: Indicates whether to set the measurement bandwidth.

parameters.name: Measurement bandwidth
parameters.description: Indicates the measurement bandwidth on the serving frequency on which the UE camps. It is used in intra-frequency measurements for cell reselection and those by UEs in RRC_CONNECTED mode. This parameter is optional; if it is not set, the downlink bandwidth of the serving cell is used by default. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.id: Cell reselection timer value for EUTRAN

If the signal quality of a new E-UTRAN cell is better than that of the serving cell within the period specified by this parameter and a UE camps on the serving cell for more than 1s, the UE initiates cell reselections to the new E-UTRAN cell. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and

parameters.id: Speed state scale factor configure indicator
parameters.name: Speed state scale factor configure indicator
parameters.description: Indicates whether to set the scaling parameters for rate-dependent cell reselection within E-UTRAN. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.id: Scaling factor of TReselEutran in medium mobility state
parameters.name: Scaling factor of TReselEutran in medium mobility state
parameters.description: Indicates the scaling factor applied to TReselEutran for medium-mobility UEs. The actual duration of cell reselection for medium-mobility UEs to E-UTRAN is equal to the product of TReselEutran and TReselEutranSfMedium. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.id: Scaling factor of TReselEutran in high mobility state
parameters.name: Scaling factor of TReselEutran in high mobility state
parameters.description: Indicates the scaling factor applied to TReselEutran for high-mobility UEs. The actual duration of cell reselection of high-mobility UEs to E-UTRAN is equal to TReselEutran multiplied by TReselEutranSfHigh. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.description: Indicates the information related to MBSFN and TDD UL/DL configurations of intra-frequency neighboring cells of the serving cell. The value 00 indicates that some neighboring cells have the same MBSFN subframe configuration as the serving cell. parameters.description: Indicates whether all the intra-frequency neighboring cells are configured with at least two antenna ports. Set this parameter to BOOLEAN_TRUE when all the intra-frequency neighboring cells are configured with at least two antenna ports. Set this parameter to BOOLEAN_FALSE when one of the intra-frequency neighboring cells is configured with only one antenna port. It is recommended that PresenceAnt

parameters.id: RSRQ Threshold for intra frequency measurements
parameters.name: RSRQ Threshold for intra frequency measurements
parameters.description: Indicates the RSRQ threshold for starting intra-frequency measurements. It determines the probability of triggering cell reselection to an intra-frequency neighboring cell. For details, see 3GPP TS 36.304. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.id: RSRQ Threshold for non-intra frequency measurements
parameters.name: RSRQ Threshold for non-intra frequency measurements
parameters.description: Indicates the RSRQ threshold for starting inter-frequency or inter-RAT measurements. It determines the probability of triggering cell reselection to an inter-frequency or inter-RAT neighboring cell. For details, see 3GPP TS 36.304. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.id: Serving frequency lower priority RSRQ threshold configure indicator
parameters.name: Serving frequency lower priority RSRQ threshold configure indicator
parameters.description: Indicates whether to set the RSRQ threshold for reselection to cells on the serving frequency. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.id: Serving frequency lower priority RSRQ threshold
parameters.name: Serving frequency lower priority RSRQ threshold
parameters.description: Indicates the RSRQ threshold for cell reselection to cells on lower-priority frequencies. It determines the probability of triggering cell reselection to inter-frequency or inter-RAT neighboring cells on lower-priority frequencies. For details, see 3GPP TS 36.304. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.id: Minimum required quality level configure indicator
parameters.name: Minimum required quality level configure indicator
parameters.description: Indicates whether to configure the parameters related to received signal quality for cell reselection in SIB3.

parameters.name: Minimum required quality level
parameters.description: Indicates the minimum required RX signal quality used in intra-frequency E-UTRAN cell reselection, which corresponds to the IE q-QualMin in SIB3. This value is included in R criteria and used in the evaluation of cell reselection. For details, see 3GPP TS 36.304.

parameters.name: NB-IoT Intra-Freq Reselection Time
parameters.description: Indicates the evaluation period for a UE to determine whether to perform cell reselections to an NB-IoT cell. If the signal quality of a new cell is better than that of the serving cell within the period specified by this parameter and a UE camps on the serving cell for more than 1s, the UE initiates cell reselections to the new cell. parameters.name: NB-IoT Inter-Freq Reselection Time
parameters.description: Indicates the evaluation period for a UE to determine whether to perform cell reselections to an inter-frequency NB-IoT cell. parameters.id: Cell Reselection Time for E-UTRAN CE

parameters.description: Indicates the duration for determining whether to reselect an E-UTRAN cell with enhanced coverage. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: eMTC Cell Reselection Priority
parameters.description: Indicates the reselection priority of a cell on the serving frequency for eMTC UEs. The value 0 indicates the lowest priority. The value of this parameter must be determined together with the priorities of other frequencies during network planning. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.id: Power Offset for Resel to Intra Freq NB-IoT Cell
parameters.name: Power Offset for Resel to Intra Freq NB-IoT Cell
parameters.description: Indicates the power offset for intra-frequency cell reselection of an NB-IoT UE with a power level of 14 dBm. When set to NULL, this parameter will not be delivered in the system information, and the UE takes 0 dB as the power offset by default. For details, see 3GPP TS 36.331. This parameter applies only to NB-IoT.

parameters.id: Min Required Quality Level for CE Mode A
parameters.name: Min Required Quality Level for CE Mode A
parameters.description: Indicates the minimum received signal quality required by UEs in CE mode A for cell reselection to intra-frequency neighboring E-UTRAN cells. It is used as an input parameter for cell reselection criterion. If this parameter is set to 0, SIB3 does not contain the q-QualMin IE, and UEs use the default value negative infinity. parameters.description: Indicates the network synchronization status. If this parameter is set to BOOLEAN_TRUE, the E-UTRAN and the CDMA2000 RAN are synchronized without drifts. parameters.id: CDMA search window size configure indicator
parameters.name: CDMA search window size configure indicator
parameters.description: Indicates whether to set the search window size. For details, see 3GPP TS 36.331. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: Search window size
parameters.description: Indicates the size of the CDMA2000 search window, which can be used to assist in searching for the neighboring pilots. For details, see 3GPP TS 36.331. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: HRPD parameters configure indicator
parameters.description: Indicates whether the eNodeB includes the information about CDMA2000 HRPD in SIB8. If this parameter is set to CFG, the eNodeB includes the parametersHRPD field in SIB8. If this parameter is set to NOT_CFG, the eNodeB does not include the parametersHRPD field in SIB8. For details, see 3GPP TS 36.331. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.description: Indicates whether the parameters applicable only for cell reselection to CDMA2000 1xRTT need to be set. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.description: Indicates the scaling factor applicable to cell reselection of high-mobility UEs to CDMA2000 1xRTT. For details, see 3GPP TS 36.331. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: Dual Rx CSFB configure indicator
parameters.description: Indicates whether to configure the network capability of dual-receiver enhanced circuit switched fallback (CSFB). For details, see 3GPP TS 36.331. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: RF Channel Shutdown Power Check Switch
parameters.description: Indicates whether to enable power check for RF channel shutdown. SYMBOL_0_POWER_CHECK_OPT_SW: Indicates whether to enable symbol 0 power check optimization for RF channel shutdown. If this option is selected, symbol 0 power check optimization is performed after RF channel shutdown takes effect, preventing continuous PDCCH allocation failures. If this option is deselected, symbol 0 power check opti

parameters.name: Multi-RAT Joint Channel Shutdown Switch
parameters.description: Indicates whether to enable multi-RAT joint channel shutdown. If this parameter is set to ON for a cell, multi-RAT joint channel shutdown takes effect in the cell under certain conditions. If this parameter is set to OFF, the function does not take effect. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD.

parameters.name: Penalty Duration
parameters.description: Indicates the duration of penalty imposed on a cell that has exited RF channel intelligent shutdown and meets the penalty condition. In the penalty period, the conditions for triggering RF channel intelligent shutdown will not be checked for the cell.

parameters.id: Current status about RF intelligent shutdown
parameters.name: Current status about RF intelligent shutdown
parameters.description: Indicates the current status of RF channel intelligent shutdown for a cell.

parameters.id: Latest exiting cause about RF intelligent shutdown
parameters.name: Latest exiting cause about RF intelligent shutdown
parameters.description: Indicates the cause for the latest exiting from RF channel intelligent shutdown of the cell.

parameters.name: Local cell ID
parameters.description: Indicates the local identity of the cell. It uniquely identifies a cell within an eNodeB. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: RIC algorithm switch
parameters.description: Indicates the switch for the remote interference cancellation algorithm. If this switch is turned on, the eNodeB performs remote interference detection and records in call history record (CHR) logs if any interference is detected. If this switch is turned off, the eNodeB does not perform remote interference detection. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: Mute UpPTS Symbol Number
parameters.description: Indicates the number of symbols during which no SRSs are transmitted in an uplink pilot timeslot (UpPTS). If this parameter is set to a non-zero value N, no SRSs are transmitted within N symbols starting from the first symbol during which SRS transmission is allowed in the UpPTS. For any given special subframe configuration, the value of this parameter must not be greater than the total number of

parameters.name: Whether to mute UL symbol
parameters.description: Indicates whether to mute the last symbol in an uplink subframe. If this parameter is set to ON, the last symbol in an uplink subframe is muted. If this parameter is set to OFF, the last symbol in an uplink subframe is not muted. This parameter applies only to LTE TDD cells using uplink-downlink subframe configuration 1. This parameter applies only to LTE TDD.

parameters.name: UL Interference Threshold
parameters.description: Indicates the relative threshold used to determine whether uplink interference occurs in a cell. If the average uplink interference and noise received on each PRB in a cell is at least 15 dBm greater than this threshold or the average UpPTS interference is at least 15 dBm greater than this threshold minus 10, it is considered that severe interference has occurred in the cell. At this point, the eN

parameters.name: Ducting Remote Interfer Threshold
parameters.description: Indicates the threshold for identifying remote interference caused by an atmospheric duct by detecting characteristic sequences. This parameter applies only to LTE TDD cells.

parameters.name: Interfer Avoid Detect Period Num
parameters.description: Indicates the number of characteristic sequence detection periods in which the detection results are used to determine whether to perform remote interference avoidance. This parameter applies only to LTE TDD cells.

parameters.id: Interf Avoid Recovery Detect Period Num
parameters.name: Interf Avoid Recovery Detect Period Num
parameters.description: Indicates the number of characteristic sequence detection periods in which the detection results are used to determine whether to stop remote interference avoidance. This parameter applies only to LTE TDD cells.

parameters.name: Remote Interfer Adaptive Avoid Switch
parameters.description: Indicates whether to enable adaptive avoidance of remote interference. If this parameter is set to ON(On), characteristic sequences are sent and detected to adaptively avoid remote interference. This parameter applies only to LTE TDD cells.

parameters.id: Max Difference of UL Inter-Symbol RX Power
parameters.name: Max Difference of UL Inter-Symbol RX Power
parameters.description: Indicates the threshold of the difference between the maximum and minimum receive power of uplink symbols measured in the full time domain. If the difference between the maximum and minimum receive power of uplink symbols exceeds this threshold, the eNodeB determines that abnormal interference occurs. This parameter can be used only to trigger automatic recording of one interference record and rev

parameters.id: Atmospheric Duct DL Subframe Shutdown Switch
parameters.name: Atmospheric Duct DL Subframe Shutdown Switch
parameters.description: Indicates whether to enable atmospheric duct DL subframe shutdown. If this parameter is set to ON(On), the eNodeB shuts down downlink subframes. If this parameter is set to OFF(Off), the eNodeB does not shut down downlink subframes. This parameter applies only to LTE TDD.

parameters.name: UL Interference Duration
parameters.description: Indicates the threshold of the number of consecutive monitoring periods (5s for each period) during which abnormal interference meets the related threshold criteria, for interference recording. For example, if this parameter is set to 12 and the eNodeB detects interference that meets the criteria for 1 minute, the eNodeB records interference for maintenance. This parameter can be used only to trig

parameters.id: Duct DL Subframe Shutoff Opt Inf Thld
parameters.name: Duct DL Subframe Shutoff Opt Inf Thld
parameters.description: Indicates the absolute interference threshold for determining whether atmospheric duct interference occurs in an uplink subframe. The eNodeB may optimize downlink subframe shutdown due to atmospheric duct interference only when interference occurring in an uplink subframe on the 72 subcarriers in the middle of the frequency domain exceeds this threshold. This parameter applies only to LTE TDD.

parameters.id: Duct DL Subframe Shutoff Opt Sw
parameters.name: Duct DL Subframe Shutoff Opt Sw
parameters.description: DUCT_DL_SUBFRM_SHUTOFF_OPT_SW: If this option is selected, the eNodeB automatically detects atmospheric duct interference and shuts down downlink subframes when the interference meets the preset condition. If this option is deselected, the eNodeB does not detect atmospheric duct interference or shut down downlink subframes. This option applies only to LTE TDD. DUCT_DL_SF_SCHED_SHUTOFF_SW: If this

parameters.name: Duct Inf Det Period Count
parameters.description: Indicates the number of interference detection periods for determining whether to optimize downlink subframe shutdown when atmospheric duct interference occurs. This parameter applies only to LTE TDD.

parameters.id: Duct DL Subfrm Shutoff Opt Inf Pwr Diff In Thld
parameters.name: Duct DL Subfrm Shutoff Opt Inf Pwr Diff In Thld
parameters.description: For 2T2R, 4T4R and 8T8R cells: Indicates the threshold of receive power difference between the first half slot and the second half slot of a TDD uplink subframe on the 72 subcarriers in the middle of the frequency domain. This threshold is used to determine whether there is atmospheric duct interference. Optimized atmospheric duct downlink subframe shutdown takes effect only when the receive power

parameters.id: Duct DL Subfrm Shutoff Opt Inf Pwr Diff Out Thld
parameters.name: Duct DL Subfrm Shutoff Opt Inf Pwr Diff Out Thld
parameters.description: For 2T2R, 4T4R and 8T8R cells: Indicates the threshold of receive power difference between the first half slot and the second half slot of a TDD uplink subframe on the 72 subcarriers in the middle of the frequency domain. This threshold is used to determine whether atmospheric duct interference meets the conditions for terminating optimized atmospheric duct downlink subframe shutdown. If the recei

parameters.name: Atmospheric Duct Subframe Shutoff Depth
parameters.description: Indicates which downlink subframes to shut down and how to shut them down when atmospheric duct interference occurs. If this parameter is set to DWPTS_SHUTOFF(DWPTS_SHUTOFF), the eNodeB shuts down only special subframes 1 and 6 and stops scheduling services in DwPTSs. parameters.id: Atmospheric Duct UL Average Intrf Pwr Thld
parameters.name: Atmospheric Duct UL Average Intrf Pwr Thld
parameters.description: Indicates the threshold of average uplink interference for identifying atmospheric duct interference. The eNodeB can send characteristic sequences only if the average uplink interference is greater than this threshold. This parameter applies only to LTE TDD.

parameters.id: Atmospheric Duct UL Pwr Difference Thld
parameters.name: Atmospheric Duct UL Pwr Difference Thld
parameters.description: For 4T4R and 8T8R cells: Indicates the threshold of the power difference between symbols 0 and 11 in a TDD uplink subframe. This threshold is used to determine whether there is atmospheric duct interference. The characteristic sequence can be sent only when the power difference exceeds this threshold. This parameter applies only to LTE TDD. For 32T32R and 64T64R cells: Indicates the threshold of t

parameters.id: Duct DL Subframe Shutdown Detection Start Time
parameters.name: Duct DL Subframe Shutdown Detection Start Time
parameters.description: Indicates the start time of a detection period for the function of scheduled atmospheric-duct-based downlink subframe shutdown. If this function is enabled, the eNodeB automatically detects atmospheric duct interference in the cell within the specified detection period, and shuts down downlink subframes when the interference condition is met. If this function is disabled, the eNodeB neither detect

parameters.id: Duct DL Subframe Shutdown Detection End Time
parameters.name: Duct DL Subframe Shutdown Detection End Time
parameters.description: Indicates the end time of a detection period for the function of scheduled atmospheric-duct-based downlink subframe shutdown. If this function is enabled, the eNodeB automatically detects atmospheric duct interference in the cell within the specified detection period, and shuts down downlink subframes when the interference condition is met. parameters.name: Time
parameters.description: Indicates the time when interference is generated. This parameter applies only to LTE TDD networks.

parameters.name: UL Average Interference Power
parameters.description: Indicates the average uplink interference power when interference is generated. This parameter applies only to LTE TDD networks.

parameters.name: UpPTS Average Interference Power
parameters.description: Indicates the average uplink interference power on the UpPTS when interference is generated. This parameter applies only to LTE TDD networks.

parameters.id: First UL Frame First Symbol Power
parameters.name: First UL Frame First Symbol Power
parameters.description: Indicates the power of the first symbol in the first UL subframe when interference is generated. This parameter applies only to LTE TDD cells.

parameters.id: First UL Seventh (or Fifth) Symbol Power
parameters.name: First UL Seventh (or Fifth) Symbol Power
parameters.description: Indicates the receive power of the seventh (or fifth when extended CP is used) symbol in the first UL subframe when interference is generated. This parameter applies only to LTE TDD cells.

parameters.id: Last UL Frame First Symbol Power
parameters.name: Last UL Frame First Symbol Power
parameters.description: Indicates the power of the first symbol in the last UL subframe when interference is generated. This parameter applies only to LTE TDD cells.

parameters.id: Last UL Twelfth (or Tenth) Symbol Power
parameters.name: Last UL Twelfth (or Tenth) Symbol Power
parameters.description: Indicates the receive power of the twelfth (or tenth when extended CP is used) symbol in the last UL subframe when interference is generated. This parameter applies only to LTE TDD cells.

parameters.name: Idle GP Interference Power
parameters.description: Indicates the interference power in an idle GP. This parameter applies only to LTE TDD.

parameters.name: Inter-RRU Channel Calibration Interf Power
parameters.description: Indicates the interference power in a GP during inter-RRU channel calibration. This parameter applies only to LTE TDD.

parameters.name: Intra-RRU Channel Calibration Interf Power
parameters.description: Indicates the interference power in a GP during intra-RRU channel calibration. This parameter applies only to LTE TDD.

parameters.name: Local cell ID
parameters.description: Indicates the local ID of the cell. It uniquely identifies a cell within an eNodeB.

parameters.name: Minimum required RX level
parameters.description: Indicates the minimum receive level required for a cell to become a candidate for cell selection. The level is included in S criteria and used in the evaluation of cell selection. The value range of this parameter is -70 to -22 for LTE FDD and TDD, and -78 to -22 for LTE NB-IoT. For details, see 3GPP TS 36.304.

parameters.name: Minimum required RX level offset
parameters.description: Indicates the offset to the minimum required receive level. This value is included in criteria S and used in the evaluation of cell selection. This parameter is valid only when the cell selection is triggered by periodic searches for higher-priority PLMNs and the UE is served by a Visited Public Land Mobile Network (VPLMN). For details, see 3GPP TS 36.304. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD an

parameters.name: Minimum required RX quality level
parameters.description: Indicates the minimum required received signal quality, which corresponds to the q-QualMin IE in system information block type 1 (SIB1) and is used to calculate the Squal value for the serving cell involved in cell selection and reselection. If this parameter is set to 0, SIB1 does not contain the q-QualMin IE. If this parameter is set to a value other than 0, SIB1 contains the q-QualMin IE with t

parameters.id: Minimum required RX quality level offset configure indicator
parameters.name: Minimum required RX quality level offset configure indicator
parameters.description: Indicates whether to set the offset to the minimum required receive level for the cell. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.id: Minimum required RX quality level offset
parameters.name: Minimum required RX quality level offset
parameters.description: Indicates the offset to the minimum required received signal quality for the cell. It is included in criteria S and used in the evaluation of cell selection. This parameter is required only when the cell selection is triggered by periodic searches for higher-priority PLMNs and the UE is served by a Visited Public Land Mobile Network (VPLMN). For details, see 3GPP TS 36.304. This parameter applies

parameters.id: Minimum Required RX Level for CE
parameters.name: Minimum Required RX Level for CE
parameters.description: Indicates the minimum receive level required for coverage enhancement mode A of a cell. It is included in criterion S for cell selection. For details, see 3GPP TS 36.304. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.id: Minimum Required Quality Level for CE
parameters.name: Minimum Required Quality Level for CE
parameters.description: Indicates the minimum received signal quality used in cell selection criterion S for coverage enhancement mode A. This parameter corresponds to the q-QualMinRSRQ-CE-r13 IE in SIB1-BR. For details, see 3GPP TS 36.304. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.id: Min Signal Quality Level for CE Mode B
parameters.name: Min Signal Quality Level for CE Mode B
parameters.description: Indicates the minimum received signal quality required for coverage enhancement mode B of a cell. It is used as an input parameter for cell selection criterion S. If this parameter is set to 0, SIB1-BR does not contain the q-QualMinRSRQ-CE1-r13 IE. In this case, the value -∞ is used by default and the eNodeB performs cell selection and reselection for UEs based only on the signal level. For detail

parameters.id: Min RX Level for CE Mode B
parameters.name: Min RX Level for CE Mode B
parameters.description: Indicates the minimum receive level required for coverage enhancement mode B of a cell. It is used as an input parameter for cell selection criterion S. For details, see 3GPP TS 36.304. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.id: Power Offset for Selection to NB-IoT Cell
parameters.name: Power Offset for Selection to NB-IoT Cell
parameters.description: Indicates the power offset for cell selection of an NB-IoT UE with a power level of 14 dBm. When set to NULL, this parameter will not be delivered in the system information, and the UE takes 0 dB as the power offset by default. For details, see 3GPP TS 36.331. This parameter applies only to NB-IoT.

parameters.name: Local cell ID
parameters.description: Indicates the local cell identity. It uniquely identifies a cell within an eNodeB. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: Service differentiation switch
parameters.description: Indicates the switches related to service differentiation in a cell. CellConStaReportSwitch: Indicates the switch used to control whether the RLC-buffered-based cell congestion information is reported using the extended GTP-U headers to the EPC. The guideline can be found in documents related to the EPC feature, which is Wireless Optimization Based on Flow Priority. This option applies only to LTE

parameters.name: Cell Congestion State PRB Threshold
parameters.description: Indicates the threshold for determining the cell congestion status based on the physical resource block (PRB) usage. The eNodeB generates a cell congestion indicator based on this parameter and the CellConStateUeNumThd parameter and then sends the indicator to the EPC. If both the downlink PRB usage and the number of UL-sync UEs are greater than or equal to their respective congestion thresholds b

parameters.name: Cell Overload State PRB Threshold
parameters.description: Indicates the threshold for determining the cell overload status based on the PRB usage. The eNodeB generates a cell overload indicator based on this parameter and the CellOverloadStateUeNumThd parameter and then sends the indicator to the EPC. If both the downlink PRB usage and the number of UL-sync UEs are greater than or equal to their respective overload thresholds, the eNodeB sends a cell ove

parameters.id: Cell Congestion State UE Number Threshold
parameters.name: Cell Congestion State UE Number Threshold
parameters.description: Indicates the threshold for determining the cell congestion status based on the number of UL-sync UEs. The eNodeB generates a cell congestion indicator based on this parameter and the CellConStatePrbThd parameter and then sends the indicator to the EPC. If both the downlink PRB usage and the number of UL-sync UEs are greater than or equal to their respective congestion thresholds but do not exceed

parameters.id: Cell Overload State UE Number Threshold
parameters.name: Cell Overload State UE Number Threshold
parameters.description: Indicates the threshold for determining the cell overload status based on the number of UL-sync UEs. The eNodeB generates a cell overload indicator based on this parameter and the CellOverloadStatePrbThd parameter and then sends the indicator to the EPC. If both the downlink PRB usage and UL-sync UEs are greater than or equal to their respective overload thresholds, the eNodeB sends a cell overloa

parameters.name: Weight of queue 0
parameters.description: Indicates the weight of the queue, which is used in service differentiation scheduling. The value of this parameter is used in calculating the priority of a UE during scheduling and therefore determines the scheduling probability of this UE. The scheduling probability and priority of services in a queue has a positive correlation with the value of this parameter. This parameter is valid only if FP

parameters.name: Weight of queue 1
parameters.description: Indicates the weight of the queue, which is used in service differentiation scheduling. The value of this parameter is used in calculating the priority of a UE during scheduling and therefore determines the scheduling probability of this UE. The scheduling probability and priority of services in a queue has a positive correlation with the value of this parameter. This parameter is valid only if FP

parameters.description: Indicates the weight of the queue, which is used in service differentiation scheduling. parameters.id: Max Number of GTPU Extension Header Retrans
parameters.name: Max Number of GTPU Extension Header Retrans
parameters.description: Indicates the maximum number of times that the eNodeB sends a proprietary GTP-U extension header during a negotiation process. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: Local Cell ID
parameters.description: Indicates the local ID of a cell, which uniquely identifies the cell within an eNodeB. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD.

parameters.id: DL SRBG Count Reserved for Short TTI
parameters.name: DL SRBG Count Reserved for Short TTI
parameters.description: Indicates the number of short resource block groups (SRBGs) reserved for SPDSCH scheduling in short TTI mode. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD.

parameters.name: DeltaF for SPUCCH Format 1 and 1a
parameters.description: Indicates the delta of subslot SPUCCH formats 1 and 1a. For details, see 3GPP TS 36.213. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD.

parameters.name: DeltaF for SPUCCH Format 1b
parameters.description: Indicates the delta of subslot SPUCCH format 1b. For details, see 3GPP TS 36.213. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD.

parameters.name: SPUCCH RB Count
parameters.description: Indicates the number of RBs that can be used by the SPUCCH. This parameter is valid only when the PucchSwitch option of the PucchAlgoSwitch parameter is deselected. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD.

parameters.id: UL SRBG Count Reserved for Short TTI
parameters.name: UL SRBG Count Reserved for Short TTI
parameters.description: Indicates the number of uplink short resource block groups (SRBGs) reserved for UEs in short TTI mode. When the NttiSttiRbAdjStrategy parameter is set to STATIC, it is recommended that the value of this parameter be smaller than or equal to the value calculated by using the formula: (Number of RBs allowed by the system bandwidth - 4)/4. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD.

parameters.id: Normal TTI and Short TTI RB Adjustment Strategy
parameters.name: Normal TTI and Short TTI RB Adjustment Strategy
parameters.description: Indicates the policy of adjusting the maximum number of RBs available to the PDSCH/PUSCH. When this parameter is set to STATIC, the maximum number of RBs always equals the configured value. When this parameter is set to DYNAMIC, the maximum number of RBs is adaptively adjusted by the algorithm. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD.

parameters.name: SPDCCH RB Count
parameters.description: Indicates the number of RBs occupied by the SPDCCH. This parameter affects the maximum aggregation level available to the SPDCCH. When this parameter is set to RB_4, the SPDCCH occupies 4 RBs and the maximum aggregation level for the SPDCCH is 1. When this parameter is set to RB_8, the SPDCCH occupies 8 RBs and the maximum aggregation level for the SPDCCH is 2. When this parameter is set to RB_16,

parameters.name: Beta Offset Subslot ACK Index1
parameters.description: Indicates the index 1 mapped to the MCS offset for ACKs transmitted on subslot-based SPUSCH. For details, see 3GPP TS 36.213. Some values are reserved, for example, value 15 is reserved in 3GPP TS 36.213 Release 9. When this parameter is set to a reserved value, a UE initiates an RRC connection reestablishment or fails to access the network. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD.

parameters.name: Beta Offset Subslot ACK Index2
parameters.description: Indicates the index 2 mapped to the MCS offset for ACKs transmitted on subslot-based SPUSCH. For details, see 3GPP TS 36.213. Some values are reserved, for example, value 15 is reserved in 3GPP TS 36.213 Release 9. When this parameter is set to a reserved value, a UE initiates an RRC connection reestablishment or fails to access the network. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD.

parameters.name: Beta Offset Subslot CQI Index
parameters.description: Indicates the index mapped to the MCS offset for CQIs transmitted on subslot-based SPUSCH. For details, see 3GPP TS 36.213. Some values are reserved, for example, values 0 and 1 are reserved in 3GPP TS 36.213 Release 9. When this parameter is set to a reserved value, a UE initiates an RRC connection reestablishment or fails to access the network. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD.

parameters.name: Beta Offset Subslot RI Index1
parameters.description: Indicates the index 1 mapped to the MCS offset for RIs transmitted on subslot-based SPUSCH. For details, see 3GPP TS 36.213. Some values are reserved, for example, values 13, 14, and 15 are reserved in 3GPP TS 36.213 Release 9. When this parameter is set to a reserved value, a UE initiates an RRC connection reestablishment or fails to access the network. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD.

parameters.id: Short TTI DL HARQ Maximum Transmission Count
parameters.name: Short TTI DL HARQ Maximum Transmission Count
parameters.description: Indicates the maximum number of downlink HARQ transmissions of a UE in short TTI mode. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD.

parameters.name: Short TTI SRI Period
parameters.description: Indicates the scheduling request indicator (SRI) reporting period of UEs in subslot-based Short TTI mode. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD.

parameters.name: Beta Offset Subslot RI Index2
parameters.description: Indicates the index 2 mapped to the MCS offset for RIs transmitted on subslot-based SPUSCH. For details, see 3GPP TS 36.213. Some values are reserved, for example, values 13, 14, and 15 are reserved in 3GPP TS 36.213 Release 9. When this parameter is set to a reserved value, a UE initiates an RRC connection reestablishment or fails to access the network. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD.

parameters.id: PDCCH CCE Count Reserved for Short TTI
parameters.name: PDCCH CCE Count Reserved for Short TTI
parameters.description: Indicates the maximum number of CCEs on the PDCCH reserved for UEs in short TTI mode. The short downlink control information (SDCI) carried in the first subslot in a subframe is transmitted on the PDCCH, and therefore CCEs on the PDCCH need to be reserved for UEs in short TTI mode. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD.

parameters.name: Short TTI Algorithm Switch
parameters.description: Indicates whether to enable short TTI in a cell. SHORT_TTI_SW: Indicates whether to enable short TTI. This option applies only to LTE FDD. SHORT_TTI_PREALLOCATION_SW: Indicates whether to enable preallocation for the short TTI mode. This option applies only to LTE FDD. parameters.id: Short TTI Entry DL RB Usage Threshold
parameters.name: Short TTI Entry DL RB Usage Threshold
parameters.description: Indicates the downlink RB usage threshold for entering the short TTI mode. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD.

parameters.id: Short TTI Entry UL RB Usage Threshold
parameters.name: Short TTI Entry UL RB Usage Threshold
parameters.description: Indicates the uplink RB usage threshold for entering the short TTI mode. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD.

parameters.id: Short TTI Entry UL SINR Threshold
parameters.name: Short TTI Entry UL SINR Threshold
parameters.description: Indicates the uplink SINR threshold for entering the short TTI mode. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD.

parameters.name: Short TTI Preallocation Duration
parameters.description: Indicates the maximum preallocation duration for a UE in short TTI mode. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD.

parameters.name: Short TTI Preallocation Minimum Period
parameters.description: Indicates the minimum interval between preallocations for UEs in Short TTI mode. The interval between two consecutive preallocations for a UE in Short TTI mode must not be less than the value of this parameter. One subframe is divided into six subslots. Each subslot contains two or three OFDM symbols. For details, see 3GPP TS 36.211. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD.

parameters.name: Short TTI Preallocation Size
parameters.description: Indicates the size of data in each preallocation for UEs in Short TTI mode. The number of RBs in each preallocation is calculated based on the value of this parameter. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD.

parameters.id: Short TTI UL HARQ Maximum Transmission Count
parameters.name: Short TTI UL HARQ Maximum Transmission Count
parameters.description: Indicates the maximum number of uplink HARQ transmissions of a UE in Short TTI mode. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD.

parameters.id: Short TTI Entry DCCH Quality Hysteresis
parameters.name: Short TTI Entry DCCH Quality Hysteresis
parameters.description: Indicates the downlink control channel quality hysteresis used for configuring short TTIs for UEs. The eNodeB configures short TTIs for a UE only if the downlink control channel quality for the UE is higher than the sum of the demodulation threshold for the maximum aggregation level of the SPDCCH and this hysteresis. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD.

parameters.name: Local cell ID
parameters.description: Indicates the local ID of the cell. It uniquely identifies a cell within a base station.

parameters.name: Intelligent power-off of carriers switch
parameters.description: Indicates whether to enable intelligent power-off of carriers. If this parameter is set to ON and the cell meets specific conditions, intelligent power-off of carriers is performed and the eNodeB does not identify co-coverage cells automatically.
