parameters.name: Start time
parameters.description: Indicates the start time of intelligent power-off of carriers.

parameters.name: Stop time
parameters.description: Indicates the stop time of intelligent power-off of carriers. If the stop time is earlier than or the same as the start time, the stop time is assumed to be a time of the next day.

parameters.name: Downlink PRB threshold
parameters.description: For FDD and TDD cells, this parameter indicates the downlink PRB usage threshold for starting intelligent power-off of carriers. For NB-IoT cells, this parameter indicates the downlink subcarrier usage threshold.

parameters.name: Downlink PRB offset
parameters.description: For FDD and TDD cells, this parameter indicates the offset to the downlink PRB usage for stopping intelligent power-off of carriers. The downlink PRB usage threshold for stopping intelligent power-off of carriers is equal to the sum of the value of this parameter and the value of the DlPrbThd parameter in the CellShutdown MO. parameters.name: Uplink PRB threshold

parameters.description: Indicates the local ID of the cell. It uniquely identifies a cell within a BS. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: Uplink ICIC A3 offset
parameters.description: Indicates the offset for the UL ICIC measurement event. If this parameter is set to a large value, the signal quality of the neighboring cell must be significantly better than that of the serving cell before a UL ICIC measurement event is triggered. For details, see 3GPP TS 36.331. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: Local cell ID
parameters.description: Indicates the local ID of a cell, which uniquely identifies a cell within a base station. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: UpLink SU-MIMO Rank
parameters.description: Indicates the rank selection method when the uplink transmission mode is TM2. If this parameter is set to FixRank1(FixRank1), only rank 1 transmission can be performed for all UEs in the network. If this parameter is set to FixRank2(FixRank2), only rank 2 transmission can be performed for all UEs in the network. If this parameter is set to RankAdaptive(RankAdaptive), the eNodeB adaptively selects

parameters.name: Local cell ID
parameters.description: Indicates the local ID of the cell. It uniquely identifies a cell within a BS.

parameters.name: Path loss coefficient
parameters.description: Indicates the compensation factor for path loss. It is used in UL power control. For details, see 3GPP TS 36.213.

parameters.name: P0 nominal PUCCH
parameters.description: Indicates the target UE transmit power for the PUCCH expected by the eNodeB on condition that normal demodulation can be performed. For details, see 3GPP TS 36.213. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: P0 nominal PUSCH
parameters.description: Indicates the nominal P0 value of the PUSCH. It is used in UL power control. For details, see 3GPP TS 36.213.

parameters.name: DeltaF for PUCCH format 1
parameters.description: Indicates the Delta value corresponding to PUCCH format 1. For details, see 3GPP TS 36.213. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: DeltaF for PUCCH format 1b
parameters.description: Indicates the Delta value corresponding to PUCCH format 1b. For details, see 3GPP TS 36.213. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: DeltaF for PUCCH format 2
parameters.description: Indicates the Delta value corresponding to PUCCH format 2. For details, see 3GPP TS 36.213. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: DeltaF for PUCCH format 2a
parameters.description: Indicates the Delta value corresponding to PUCCH format 2a. For details, see 3GPP TS 36.213. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: DeltaF for PUCCH format 2b
parameters.description: Indicates the Delta value corresponding to PUCCH format 2b. For details, see 3GPP TS 36.213. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: Delta preamble value for msg3
parameters.description: Indicates the power offset (delta value) of message 3 relative to the preamble. This power offset has a step size of 2. For details, see 3GPP TS 36.213.

parameters.name: Delta Message 2
parameters.description: Indicates the power offset of Msg3 transmitted during uplink random access. This parameter is also used to set the initial power of the PUSCH or PUCCH for closed-loop power control. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: PUCCH Format 1bcs Delta
parameters.description: Indicates the delta of PUCCH format 1bcs. For details about how to use this parameter, see 3GPP TS 36.213. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: PUCCH Format 3 Delta
parameters.description: Indicates the delta of PUCCH format 3. For details about how to use this parameter, see 3GPP TS 36.213. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: Local cell ID
parameters.description: Indicates the local ID of the cell. It uniquely identifies a cell within a BS. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: Delta-MCS enable or disable indication
parameters.description: Indicates whether a UE needs to adjust the transmit power based on the MCS. The indication is sent to the UE through an RRC message. The indication is denoted by a bit. Bit 0 indicates that both Ks and ΔTF are equal to 0. Bit 1 indicates that Ks is equal to 1.25 and ΔTF is calculated. UU_DISABLE and UU_ENABLE indicate bits 0 and 1, respectively. For details, see 3GPP TS 36.213. This parameter appl

parameters.id: Power Offset of SRS When DeltaMcsEnabled Off
parameters.name: Power Offset of SRS When DeltaMcsEnabled Off
parameters.description: Indicates the power offset of the sounding reference signal to the PUSCH when DeltaMcsEnabled is set to UU_DISABLE. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.id: Power Offset of SRS When DeltaMcsEnabled On
parameters.name: Power Offset of SRS When DeltaMcsEnabled On
parameters.description: Indicates the power offset of the sounding reference signal to the PUSCH when DeltaMcsEnabled is set to UU_ENABLE. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: RSRP filtering coefficient
parameters.description: Indicates the alpha filtering coefficient used by the UE during RSRP measurement for path loss estimation. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: Pathloss Reference Link
parameters.description: Indicates whether to use the radio link in the PCell or SCell for evaluation of downlink path loss in the cell. For details about how to use this parameter, see 3GPP TS 36.213. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: Local cell ID
parameters.description: Indicates the local ID of the cell. It uniquely identifies a cell within a BS.

parameters.name: Uplink Scheduling Strategy
parameters.description: Indicates the UL scheduling policy, which determines the scheduling priority order in which UEs are arranged in UL. There are four UL scheduling strategies: MAX C/I, proportional fair (PF), round Robin (RR), and enhanced proportional fair (EPF). The MAX C/I policy schedules UEs in descending order of average signal to interference plus noise ratio (SINR). The PF policy schedules UEs in ascending o

parameters.name: adaptive HARQ switch
parameters.description: Indicates the switch that is used to determine whether to enable or disable UL adaptive HARQ. If this switch is set to ADAPTIVE_HARQ_SW_OFF, UL data is retransmitted by non-adaptive synchronous HARQ. If this switch is set to ADAPTIVE_HARQ_SW_ON, UL data is retransmitted by adaptive synchronous HARQ. If this switch is set to ADAPTIVE_HARQ_SW_SEMI_ON, adaptive HARQ is triggered when a UL grant is de

parameters.name: SINR target IBLER adjustment
parameters.description: Indicates the target IBLER of the SINR adjustment algorithm. A greater parameter value indicates a greater SINR adjustment value, and thus an MCS of a higher index is used. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.id: System Bandwidth Ratio Used By Pre-schedule user per TTI
parameters.name: System Bandwidth Ratio Used By Pre-schedule user per TTI
parameters.description: Indicates the ratio of the maximum bandwidth resources that the uplink scheduler can allocate to preallocation UEs to the total system bandwidth. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: minimal period of pre-allocation
parameters.description: Indicates the minimum interval between two pre-allocations. That is, the actual interval between two pre-allocations of one UE must be longer than or equal to the value of this parameter. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: data size of pre-allocation
parameters.description: Indicates the data amount pre-allocated to each user. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: Uplink hopping type
parameters.description: Indicates whether frequency hopping (FH) is enabled or disabled and which FH type is used. Hopping_OFF: indicates that FH is disabled. Hopping_Type1: indicates that adaptive FH is enabled and FH type 1 is used. In this scenario, UEs in the cell can determine whether to use FH based on the actual situation. Hopping_Type2: indicates that adaptive FH is enabled and FH type 2 is used. In this scenario

parameters.name: Free Users Uplink RB Ratio
parameters.description: Indicates the percentage of PUSCH RBs used by free UEs when both free and paying UEs are scheduled. The rest of RBs used as the PUSCH are allocated to paying UEs. When UEs have a large amount of data to be sent, the percentage of RBs allocated to free UEs and that allocated to paying UEs will reach the preset values. Changing this parameter affects the percentage of RBs allocated to free UEs and t

parameters.id: UL scheduling request user data length
parameters.name: UL scheduling request user data length
parameters.description: Indicates the data amount that the uplink scheduler assigns to UEs that have sent scheduling requests. The uplink scheduler allocates resources to these UEs for them to report their buffer status and transmit some of the data.

parameters.name: Semi-persistent resource implicit release threshold
parameters.description: Indicates the threshold for the number of consecutive zero-payload packets received by the eNodeB. After receiving consecutive zero-payload packets of a number that is equal to the value of this parameter, the eNodeB performs implicit release of semi-persistent resources. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: Smart pre-allocation duration
parameters.description: Indicates the duration of uplink smart preallocation triggered by downlink scheduling. If SmartPreAllocationSwitch is set to On and this parameter is set to 0, neither smart preallocation nor preallocation takes effect. If SmartPreAllocationSwitch is set to Off, this parameter is invalid. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: Uplink EPF capacity factor
parameters.description: Indicates the capacity factor for uplink enhanced proportional fair (EPF) scheduling. When the eNodeB schedules UEs with unsatisfied GBR, this factor affects the scheduling priorities of UEs running services with the QCI of 1, 2, 3, or 4. When the eNodeB schedules UEs running Non-GBR services, this factor affects the scheduling priorities of UEs running services with the QCI of 6, 7, 8, or 9. In t

parameters.name: Uplink Resource Block Allocation Strategy
parameters.description: Indicates the strategy for allocating resource blocks (RBs) in the uplink of the cell. If this parameter is set to FS_NONFS_ADAPTIVE, this strategy adaptively switches between frequency selective scheduling and non-frequency selective scheduling. If this parameter is set to FS_INRANDOM_ADAPTIVE, this strategy adaptively switches between frequency selective scheduling and interference-randomization

parameters.name: Doppler Measurement Level
parameters.description: Indicates the Doppler measurement level, which is used for selecting a Doppler measurement policy. If this parameter is set to CLASS_0, the demodulation reference signals (DMRSs) whose signal to interference plus noise ratios (SINRs) are greater than or equal to 5 dB are used in Doppler measurements. If this parameter is set to CLASS_1, the DMRSs whose SINRs are greater than or equal to -5 dB are

parameters.name: Uplink HARQ Maximum Transmission Number
parameters.description: Indicates the maximum number of uplink HARQ transmissions, excluding the HARQ transmission based on TTI bundling. For details, see 3GPP TS 36.331. When a UE runs services with a QCI of 1, the smaller value between the parameter value and 5 is used as the maximum number of uplink HARQ transmissions. When the UE does not run services with a QCI of 1, the parameter value is used as the maximum number

parameters.name: Sparse Smart Pre-allocation Duration
parameters.description: Indicates the smart preallocation duration for sparse packets. The larger value between this parameter and the SmartPreAllocationDuration parameter is selected as the actual smart preallocation duration for sparse packets. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: Uplink Semi-persistent Scheduling Interval
parameters.description: Indicates the semi-persistent scheduling period in the uplink. The parameter value can be 20ms, 40ms, or ADAPTIVE in LTE TDD mode. If this parameter is set to 20ms, the semi-persistent scheduling period is fixed as 20 ms. If this parameter is set to 40ms, the semi-persistent scheduling period is fixed as 40 ms. If this parameter is set to ADAPTIVE, the eNodeB adaptively selects 20ms or 40ms as the

parameters.name: Sri False Detect Threshold Switch
parameters.description: Indicates whether to increase the scheduling request indicator (SRI) false detection threshold for UEs in the discontinuous reception (DRX) state. If this parameter is set to ON, the threshold increases and the SRI false detection probability decreases. If this parameter is set to OFF, both the threshold and the probability remain unchanged. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.id: No UL Scheduling TTI Number After GAP
parameters.name: No UL Scheduling TTI Number After GAP
parameters.description: Indicates the number of consecutive transmission time intervals (TTIs) within which the eNodeB does not perform uplink scheduling after a measurement gap. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD networks.

parameters.name: Uplink Delay-based Scheduling Strategy
parameters.description: Indicates whether to enable delay-based dynamic scheduling in the uplink. If this parameter is set to NO_DELAYSCH(No Delay Scheduling), delay-based dynamic scheduling is not enabled in the uplink. If this parameter is set to VOIP_DELAYSCH(VoIP Service Delay Scheduling), delay-based dynamic scheduling prioritization for VoIP services is enabled in the uplink and the uplink dynamic scheduling priori

parameters.name: Uplink Schedule Abnormal Ue Threshold
parameters.description: Indicates the threshold of consecutive cyclic redundancy check (CRC) errors in the uplink above which the eNodeB stops scheduling the abnormal UE. The parameter value range is from 6 to 120. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: Specific Packet Size Threshold
parameters.description: Indicates the size threshold for determining whether a packet is a special packet. This parameter can be set based on the size of special small packets, such as heartbeat packets. This parameter is used to reduce the impact of services with small packets on the calculation of performance counters related to uplink throughput. Changing this parameter value affects values of counters L.Thrp.Time.UE.

parameters.name: SR Masking Switch
parameters.description: Indicates whether to enable scheduling request (SR) masking in logical channels for UEs complying with 3GPP Release 9 or later when the SpsSchSwitch option under the UlSchSwitch parameter is selected. If this parameter is set to ON(On), SR masking in logical channels is enabled. If this parameter is set to OFF(Off), SR masking in logical channels is disabled. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD

parameters.name: PUSCH DTX Scheduling Strategy
parameters.description: Indicates the scheduling policy for the initial PUSCH transmission that is detected as discontinuous transmission (DTX) when PuschDtxSwitch of the UlSchSwitch parameter is on. If the PuschDtxSchStrategy parameter is set to NEW_TX, initial transmission instead of retransmission is performed when the initial PUSCH transmission is detected as DTX. If the PuschDtxSchStrategy parameter is set to ADAPTI

parameters.id: Max Number of UL RLC Segments for VoIP
parameters.name: Max Number of UL RLC Segments for VoIP
parameters.description: Indicates whether to enable upper limit control on service data unit (SDU) segmentation at the radio link control (RLC) layer in the uplink for VoLTE services scheduled in non-TTI bundling mode and the maximum SDU segments at the RLC layer. If this parameter is set to 0, the upper limit control on SDU segmentation at the RLC layer is disabled in the uplink for VoLTE services scheduled in non-TTI b

parameters.name: Initial Uplink SINR Adjustment
parameters.description: Indicates the initial SINR adjustment value for the SINR adjustment algorithm. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: Uplink SINR Adjust Step
parameters.description: Indicates the SINR adjustment step. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: Uplink SINR Filter Coefficient
parameters.description: Indicates the filtering coefficient for the uplink SINR. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: Uplink Enhanced VoIP Schedule Switch
parameters.description: Indicates whether to enable enhanced uplink scheduling for VoLTE services. UlVoipPreAllocationSwitch: Indicates whether to perform preallocation for VoLTE UEs during talk spurts when the number of RRC_CONNECTED UEs exceeds 50 in a cell. Voice preallocation is performed only if this option is selected. This option applies only to LTE FDD. UlVoipDelaySchSwitch: Indicates whether to perform delay-bas

parameters.id: Sinr Threshold of UL FSS by Interference
parameters.name: Sinr Threshold of UL FSS by Interference
parameters.description: Indicates the signal to interference plus noise ratio (SINR) threshold under which interference-based frequency selective resource allocation is enabled in the uplink. This parameter takes effect only when UlInterfFssSwitch of the UlSchSwitch parameter is on. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD networks.

parameters.id: UL Coordinated AMC DL RSRP Offset
parameters.name: UL Coordinated AMC DL RSRP Offset
parameters.description: Indicates the threshold of downlink RSRP difference used to maintain the interference measurement sets of UEs in intra-eNodeB and inter-eNodeB coordinated uplink AMC algorithms. This parameter applies only to LTE TDD. The interference measurement sets of UEs are maintained based on this parameter after the downlink RSRP measurement value is received. The eNodeB selects two intra-frequency neighbor

parameters.id: Statistic Num Threshold for TTIB Trigger
parameters.name: Statistic Num Threshold for TTIB Trigger
parameters.description: Indicates the threshold expressed in the number of times the channel quality of a UE consistently meets conditions for entering TTI bundling. Before a UE enters TTI bundling, the eNodeB takes statistics on the channel quality of the UE at intervals of 20 ms or longer. If the number of consecutive times the channel quality of the UE consistently meets the TTI bundling entry conditions is greater th

parameters.id: Statistic Num Threshold for TTIB Exit
parameters.name: Statistic Num Threshold for TTIB Exit
parameters.description: Indicates the threshold expressed in the number of times the channel quality of a UE consistently meets conditions for exiting TTI bundling. Before a UE exits TTI bundling, the eNodeB takes statistics on the channel quality of the UE at intervals of 20 ms or longer. If the number of consecutive times the channel quality of the UE consistently meets the TTI bundling exit conditions exceeds the valu

parameters.name: Hysteresis to Exit TTI Bundling
parameters.description: Indicates the hysteresis of the SINR threshold for exiting from TTI bundling against the SINR threshold for entering TTI bundling. This hysteresis reduces the probability of unnecessary exit from TTI bundling caused by radio signal fluctuations. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD.

parameters.id: TTIB Max Number of RLC Segments
parameters.name: TTIB Max Number of RLC Segments
parameters.description: Indicates whether to enable upper limit control on service data unit (SDU) segmentation at the radio link control (RLC) layer in the uplink for services scheduled in transmission time interval (TTI) bundling mode and the maximum SDU segments at the RLC layer. If this parameter is set to 0, the upper limit control on SDU segmentation at the RLC layer is disabled in the uplink for services scheduled

parameters.id: TTIB Max Number of HARQ Transmissions
parameters.name: TTIB Max Number of HARQ Transmissions
parameters.description: Indicates the maximum number of uplink hybrid automatic repeat request (HARQ) transmissions for UEs in the transmission time interval (TTI) bundling state. For details, see 3GPP TS 36.331. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: TTI Bundling Trigger Strategy
parameters.description: Indicates the policy of triggering transmission time interval (TTI) bundling when TtiBundlingSwitch of the UlSchSwitch parameter is on. If this parameter is set to SERVICE_VOIP, the eNodeB triggers TTI bundling for UEs running only VoIP services in the uplink. If this parameter is set to SERVICE_MULTIAPP, the eNodeB triggers TTI bundling for all UEs running VoIP services, including UEs running onl

parameters.name: Doppler Algo Switch
parameters.description: FastReportDopSwitch: Indicates whether to shorten the period that the baseband processing unit reports Doppler measurements to the MAC layer. If this option is selected, the Doppler measurement reporting period is shortened with the predefined reporting conditions. If this option is deselected, the Doppler measurements are reported at the predefined periods and with the predefined conditions. This

parameters.name: Enhanced VMIMO Switch
parameters.description: Indicates whether to enhance uplink MU-MIMO for non-massive MIMO cells or whether to optimize pairing for uplink MU-MIMO to pair more layers of UEs in massive MIMO cells. This parameter applies only to LTE TDD.

parameters.id: Ue Num Threshold in PDCCH PUSCH Balance
parameters.name: Ue Num Threshold in PDCCH PUSCH Balance
parameters.description: Indicates the threshold for the number of synchronized UEs in a cell above which the PDCCH and PUSCH resource allocation optimization mechanism is activated in large traffic volume scenarios. If this parameter is set to a value ranging from 0 to 10000 (indicating a threshold from 0 UE to 10,000 UEs), the mechanism is activated when the number of synchronized UEs in the cell is greater than or equa

parameters.id: Data Threshold in PDCCH and PUSCH Balance
parameters.name: Data Threshold in PDCCH and PUSCH Balance
parameters.description: Indicates the traffic volume threshold of a UE above which the UE is determined as a UE with large packets in the PDCCH and PUSCH resource allocation optimization mechanism when traffic is heavy. If this parameter is set to 0, none of the UEs is determined as a UE with large packets. If this parameter is set to a value ranging from 1 to 1000000 (indicating a threshold from 1 bit to 1,000,000 bits)

parameters.name: Head Overhead For Uplink Scheduling
parameters.description: Indicates the head overhead of data in uplink scheduling. The parameter value 0bit indicates that the data does not have head overhead. The parameter value 32bit indicates that the head overhead is 32 bits. This parameter can be set to 32bit in scenarios where RLC initial transmission is performed on a single service and the MAC layer does not send control units. The parameter value 48bit indicate

parameters.name: Minimal Period of Sparse Pre-allocation
parameters.description: Indicates the minimum interval between two preallocations for a UE with sparse packets. This is, the interval between two times that a UE with sparse packets is preallocated cannot be less than this parameter value. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: Data Size of Sparse Pre-allocation
parameters.description: Indicates the data amount preallocated to each UE with sparse packets. When this parameter is set to SAME_AS_OTHER_SERVICE, the PreAllocationSize parameter value is applicable to UEs with sparse packets. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: Uplink Interference Randomization Mode
parameters.description: Indicates the uplink interference randomization mode. For FDD: The value TWO_MODE_BASED_ON_PCI indicates that resources are allocated from the high end to the low end of the frequency range in cells with even PCI numbers and resources are allocated from the low end to the high end of the frequency range in cells with odd PCI numbers. The value THREE_MODE_BASED_ON_PCI indicates that the following t

parameters.name: SFN Uplink Load Period
parameters.description: Indicates the period during which the uplink load of an SFN cell is measured. The isolation threshold is adjusted based on the cell load in a measurement period. High load leads to low isolation threshold, and UEs are likely to enter independent scheduling mode. Low load leads to high isolation threshold, and UEs are likely to enter joint scheduling mode. This parameter is valid only when the SfnU

parameters.name: Max Layer HO-VMIMO
parameters.description: Indicates the maximum number of layers of UEs that can be paired for high-order VMIMO. This parameter applies only to LTE TDD cells.

parameters.id: Min UL Compensate Scheduling Period in Spurt
parameters.name: Min UL Compensate Scheduling Period in Spurt
parameters.description: Indicates the minimum interval of triggering uplink compensation scheduling for VoLTE UEs in talk spurts when UlVoipSchOptSwitch is selected. If this parameter is set to INTERVAL_ADAPTIVE, this minimum interval is adaptively adjusted based on the SR period. If this parameter is set to any other value, this value is the minimum interval. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.id: Min UL Compensate Scheduling Period in Silence
parameters.name: Min UL Compensate Scheduling Period in Silence
parameters.description: Indicates the minimum interval of triggering uplink compensation scheduling for VoLTE UEs in silence periods when UlVoipSchOptSwitch is selected. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: Uplink Target IBLER Adapt Type
parameters.description: Indicates whether to enable uplink target IBLER adaptation. SinrFlunIBlerAdaptSwitch: Indicates whether to enable SINR-fluctuation-based target IBLER adaptation. When the UlIblerAdjustSwitch option of the UlSchSwitch parameter is selected, SINR-fluctuation-based target IBLER adaptation is enabled only if the SinrFlunIBlerAdaptSwitch option is selected. This option applies only to LTE FDD and LTE T

parameters.name: Aperiodic CSI Uplink Transmit Mode
parameters.description: Indicates the transmission mode of aperiodic CSI in the uplink. If this parameter is set to CsiOnly and UEs have only aperiodic downlink CSI to transmit and do not have uplink service data to transmit, these UEs can be immediately scheduled on the PUSCH and only aperiodic downlink CSI is transmitted on the PUSCH. If this parameter is set to CsiWiUlService and UEs have only aperiodic downlink CSI t

parameters.name: Uplink VoIP Reserved RB Start
parameters.description: Indicates the start position of the RBs reserved for UEs running voice services in the uplink in large-traffic scenarios. This parameter is valid only when UlVoipRbRsvSwitch is on. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: Uplink VoIP Reserved RB Number
parameters.description: Indicates the number of RBs reserved for UEs running voice services in the uplink in large-traffic scenarios. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: IBLER Adapt Big Packet Switch
parameters.description: Indicates whether large-packet service identification is required in IBLER adaptation. If this parameter is set to ON(On), large-packet service identification is required in IBLER adaptation. If this parameter is set to OFF(Off), large-packet service identification is not required in IBLER adaptation. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: Vmimo Optimization Algorithm Switch
parameters.description: Indicates whether to enable uplink MU-MIMO optimization functions. VmimoOptResSwitch: Indicates whether to enable uplink MU-MIMO resource optimization. This option applies only to LTE TDD. HarqVmimoSwitch: Indicates whether UEs that perform retransmission in the uplink can be paired for MU-MIMO. This option applies only to LTE TDD. PreSchVmimoSwitch: Indicates whether pre-scheduled UEs in the upli

parameters.name: Uplink Interference Coordination A3 Offset
parameters.description: Indicates the offset for reporting the uplink ICS measurement event. This offset is the difference between the signal quality of a neighboring cell and that of the serving cell. A larger value indicates that a neighboring cell must have much better quality for reporting the event. A smaller value indicates that the event can be reported when a neighboring cell has a slightly better quality than th

parameters.name: Uplink MCS Low Threshold
parameters.description: Indicates the minimum MCS index when the minimum number of RBs are used due to power control. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.id: User Speed Uplink Scheduling Priority Weight
parameters.name: User Speed Uplink Scheduling Priority Weight
parameters.description: Indicates the uplink scheduling priority weight for low-speed UEs in high-speed or ultra-high-speed cells. The actual uplink scheduling priority weight factor equals the value of this parameter multiplied by the UlschPriorityFactor parameter.

parameters.id: Target RRU Select RSRP Offset Threshold
parameters.name: Target RRU Select RSRP Offset Threshold
parameters.description: Indicates the RSRP offset threshold for selecting the target RRU. This parameter takes effect when the SfnTarRruAdptSelSwitch option of the SfnAlgoSwitch parameter is selected.

parameters.name: SFN Uplink Pair RSRP Threshold
parameters.description: Indicates the RSRP threshold for pairing UEs when adaptive SFN is enabled in the uplink. This parameter is valid only when SfnUlSchSwitch is set to ADAPTIVE. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD.

parameters.id: Max Uplink Scheduling Allocation RB Number
parameters.name: Max Uplink Scheduling Allocation RB Number
parameters.description: Indicates the maximum number of RBs allocated to each UE in uplink scheduling. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD. Based on the descriptions in section 6.6.3.2 in 3GPP TS 36.101, with given system bandwidth and uplink carrier frequency, changing the value of this parameter can reduce spurious emission to other frequencies in the uplink.

parameters.id: UL SR Scheduling Data Vol Adapt Opt Upper Thld
parameters.name: UL SR Scheduling Data Vol Adapt Opt Upper Thld
parameters.description: Indicates the upper limit on the amount of data that can be scheduled in SR-based scheduling. This parameter, together with the UlSrSchDateLen parameter, determines the range within which this amount can be adaptively optimized. If this parameter is set to 0, adaptive optimization does not take effect. If this parameter is set to a value greater than 0 and less than the UlSrSchDateLen parameter va

parameters.name: TTI Bundling UE Retransmission Strategy
parameters.description: Indicates the retransmission strategy for UEs in TTI bundling states. RetxFssSchSwitch: Indicates whether to apply frequency selective scheduling to inter-bundle retransmissions for UEs in TTI bundling states. When this option is deselected, frequency selective scheduling does not take effect for retransmissions. When this option is selected, the eNodeB determines whether to apply frequency select

parameters.id: UL Retrans Sched Strategy for VoLTE User
parameters.name: UL Retrans Sched Strategy for VoLTE User
parameters.description: Indicates the uplink retransmission scheduling policy for VoLTE UEs. FIRST_RETRANS_EXPN_RB_SWITCH: Indicates whether to increase the number of RBs in the scheduling for initial uplink retransmission for VoLTE UEs. When this option is selected, the eNodeB increases the number to reduce the uplink retransmission delay and RBLER for VoLTE UEs and thereby to improve voice service quality. When this op

parameters.name: Uplink Extended VoLTE Schedule Switch
parameters.description: Indicates whether to turn on extended scheduling switches for VoLTE services in the uplink. This parameter includes the following options. UlVolteRetransSchOptSwitch: Indicates whether to optimize retransmission scheduling for voice UEs in the uplink. If this option is deselected, retransmission scheduling is not optimized for voice UEs in the uplink. If this option is selected, the eNodeB lowers

parameters.id: Uplink VoLTE Delta SINR for NACK
parameters.name: Uplink VoLTE Delta SINR for NACK
parameters.description: Indicates the uplink SINR adjustment value adopted when a VoLTE UE receives an NACK for the HARQ process. This parameter affects MCS selection for VoLTE UEs in the uplink. For LTE TDD cells, when the HARQ feedback result is NACK, the MCS index is reduced. For LTE FDD cells, the MCS index is reduced by a fixed amount based on the measured SINR. If this parameter is set to 0, this function does not

parameters.id: NB-IoT UL Max HARQ Transmission Number
parameters.name: NB-IoT UL Max HARQ Transmission Number
parameters.description: Indicates the maximum number of uplink HARQ transmissions. This parameter applies only to NB-IoT.

parameters.name: Preallocation System Bandwidth Coefficient
parameters.description: Indicates the coefficient used to determine the system bandwidth available for preallocation. It controls the degree of reduction in the system bandwidth available for preallocation.

parameters.name: Smart Preallocation Duration Coefficient
parameters.description: Indicates the coefficient used to determine the smart preallocation duration. It controls the degree of reduction in the smart preallocation duration. It works with the SmartPreAllocationDuration parameter, which specifies the smart preallocation duration.

parameters.name: High Speed SDMA Isolation Threshold
parameters.description: Indicates the UE isolation threshold for uplink space division in high-speed railway scenarios. This parameter applies only to LTE TDD.

parameters.name: Estimated TCP ACK Packet Count
parameters.description: Indicates the number of estimated downlink TCP packets of a TCP ACK message for a TCP service. If this parameter is set to 0, optimized TCP ACK estimation is disabled. If this parameter is set to a non-zero value, the eNodeB estimates the number of downlink TCP packets of a TCP ACK message and increases the uplink scheduling priority of the UE. This parameter applies only to LTE TDD.

parameters.name: VMIMO Pairing Strategy
parameters.description: Indicates the UE pairing policy for MU-MIMO in massive MIMO cells and the UE pairing policy used in the 8T8R uplink space-domain-preferred pairing algorithm. This parameter applies only to TDD.

parameters.name: UL VMIMO Edge Resource Ratio
parameters.description: Indicates the ratio of RBs preferentially allocated to CEUs after VMIMO interference coordination is enabled. This parameter applies only to LTE TDD.

parameters.id: Max Number of Layers for Massive MIMO VMIMO
parameters.name: Max Number of Layers for Massive MIMO VMIMO
parameters.description: Indicates the maximum number of layers of UEs paired for MU-MIMO in the uplink in a cell with massive MIMO. This parameter applies only to LTE TDD.

parameters.id: Uplink SR Scheduling Data Volume for VoLTE
parameters.name: Uplink SR Scheduling Data Volume for VoLTE
parameters.description: Indicates the amount of data allocated by the uplink scheduler at a scheduling request from a voice+data VoLTE UE. This allocation improves experience of the VoLTE UE when there are concurrent voice and data services. This parameter applies only to LTE TDD.

parameters.name: AMRC Decreasing Period
parameters.description: Indicates the period during which the eNodeB determines whether to perform AMRC-based rate reduction. During this period, if the uplink QCI 1 packet loss rate and TBS meet the conditions for AMRC-based rate reduction, the eNodeB triggers AMRC-based rate reduction.

parameters.id: SINR Threshold for VoLTE Rate Control
parameters.name: SINR Threshold for VoLTE Rate Control
parameters.description: Indicates the SINR threshold for triggering rate adjustment for voice services. If the uplink SINR of VoLTE UEs using the AMR-WB or AMR-NB voice codec is lower than this threshold, the eNodeB lowers the rate of voice services for such UEs, reducing the number of occasions when voice service experience is poor due to continuous packet loss. If this parameter is set to -100, SINR-based rate control

parameters.name: Rate Control CMR Process Strategy
parameters.description: Indicates whether the local end performs rate adjustment when the eNodeB detects that other NEs perform rate adjustment. When this parameter is set to BASIC_STRATEGY, the local end does not perform rate adjustment when the eNodeB detects that other NEs perform rate adjustment. When this parameter is set to ADAPTIVE_STRATEGY, the local end performs rate adjustment when the eNodeB detects that other

parameters.name: Rate Control Response Decision Threshold
parameters.description: Indicates the threshold for determining whether a UE has responded to a rate adjustment request. The threshold is expressed in a number of uplink voice packets. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: NB-IoT UL Subcarrier Spacing Type
parameters.description: Indicates the subcarrier spacing for the NPUSCH in the NB-IoT cell. This parameter applies only to NB-IoT.

parameters.name: Preallocation User Count Threshold
parameters.description: Indicates the upper limit to the number of RRC_CONNECTED UEs for which uplink preallocation takes effect. If the number of RRC_CONNECTED UEs in the cell exceeds this limit, uplink preallocation will no longer take effect in the cell. This limit does not apply to uplink preallocation for UEs that are running voice services, ping services or unlimited service, DRX UEs within On Duration, and UEs run

parameters.name: HTTP GET UL Scheduling Byte
parameters.description: Indicates the number of bytes in HTTP GET signaling messages scheduled in the uplink. The value 0 indicates that uplink preallocation of HTTP GET signaling messages does not take effect. This parameter applies only to LTE TDD.

parameters.name: Max Preallocated HTTP GET Count
parameters.description: Indicates the number of HTTP GET signaling messages that can be pre-allocated in the uplink. This parameter applies only to LTE TDD.

parameters.name: VMIMO Uplink PRB Threshold
parameters.description: Indicates the uplink PRB usage threshold for triggering uplink MU-MIMO pairing. This parameter applies only to LTE TDD.

parameters.id: VoLTE Call Setup Scheduling Enhancement Timer
parameters.name: VoLTE Call Setup Scheduling Enhancement Timer
parameters.description: Indicates the length of the timer governing the duration of scheduling optimization for VoLTE service setup. If this parameter is set to 0, the scheduling optimization does not take effect. If this parameter is set to a non-zero value, the scheduling optimization takes effect until this timer expires. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.id: Uplink Heavy Load Opt Sch Switch
parameters.name: Uplink Heavy Load Opt Sch Switch
parameters.description: Indicates whether to enable heavy-load scheduling optimization. If this parameter is set to ON, delayed scheduling is performed separately for VoLTE and data services in the uplink, and uplink abnormal UE penalty takes effect. If this parameter is set to OFF, heavy-load scheduling optimization does not take effect. This parameter applies only to LTE TDD.

parameters.id: PRACH SINR Thld for Coverage Enh
parameters.name: PRACH SINR Thld for Coverage Enh
parameters.description: Indicates the pre-equalization PRACH SINR threshold for using Msg3 coverage enhancement for UEs when coverage enhancement is enabled. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD.

parameters.id: PUSCH SINR Thld for Coverage Enh
parameters.name: PUSCH SINR Thld for Coverage Enh
parameters.description: Indicates the post-equalization PUSCH SINR threshold for using joint channel estimation for UEs when coverage enhancement is enabled. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD.

parameters.id: TTI Bundling SINR Thld for Coverage Enh
parameters.name: TTI Bundling SINR Thld for Coverage Enh
parameters.description: Indicates the post-equalization SINR threshold for using TTI bundling for UEs when coverage enhancement is enabled. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD.

parameters.id: Interval of Uplink SPS with Skipping
parameters.name: Interval of Uplink SPS with Skipping
parameters.description: Indicates the interval of uplink SPS that allows for the SPS skipping function. If this parameter is set to MS0, uplink SPS skipping is disabled. If this parameter is set to a value other than MS0, uplink SPS skipping is enabled, and this parameter value specifies the interval of uplink SPS that allows for skipping. For details, see 3GPP TS 36.331. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD.

parameters.id: TBS for Uplink SPS with Skipping
parameters.name: TBS for Uplink SPS with Skipping
parameters.description: Indicates the TBS for uplink SPS that allows for the SPS skipping function. This parameter takes effect when the IntvlOfUlSpsWithSkipping parameter in the CellUlschAlgo MO is set to a value other than MS0. If this parameter is set to a large value for certain bandwidths, the function does not take effect. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD.

parameters.id: High Load UL Scheduling Optimization Thld
parameters.name: High Load UL Scheduling Optimization Thld
parameters.description: Indicates the load threshold for uplink scheduling optimization. If the uplink load is greater than the value of this parameter, the optimization is triggered to improve user experience by increasing the UE priority. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.id: High Load UL Scheduling Optimization Switch
parameters.name: High Load UL Scheduling Optimization Switch
parameters.description: Indicates whether to trigger uplink scheduling optimization in heavy-load scenarios. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: Space-Domain-Preferred VMIMO Start Thld
parameters.description: Indicates whether to enable uplink space-domain-preferred MU-MIMO. If this parameter is set to 255, uplink space-domain-preferred MU-MIMO does not take effect. If this parameter is set to a value other than 255 and the PUSCH PRB usage of a cell is greater than this parameter value, uplink space-domain-preferred MU-MIMO starts. If the PUSCH PRB usage of a cell is less than this threshold to some ex

parameters.name: VMIMO Multi-Layer Pairing Correlation Thld
parameters.description: Indicates the two-, three-, and four-layer pairing correlation thresholds for uplink space-domain-preferred MU-MIMO. The MSB to the LSB of this parameter value correspond to the correlation thresholds for two-, three-, and four-layer pairing, respectively. For example, the parameter value 755 indicates that the correlation thresholds for two-, three-, and four-layer pairing are 0.7, 0.5, and 0.5,

parameters.id: PTT TTIB Max Number of UL RLC Segments
parameters.name: PTT TTIB Max Number of UL RLC Segments
parameters.description: Indicates whether to enable limit control on the number of RLC-layer data segments in the uplink for PTT services scheduled in TTI-bundling mode and the maximum number of RLC-layer data segments. If this parameter is set to 0, the limit control is disabled. If this parameter is set to a non-zero value, the limit control is enabled and this value is the maximum number of RLC-layer data segments tha

parameters.id: PTT Max Number of UL RLC Segments
parameters.name: PTT Max Number of UL RLC Segments
parameters.description: Indicates whether to enable limit control on the number of RLC-layer data segments in the uplink for PTT services scheduled in non-TTI-bundling mode and the maximum number of RLC-layer data segments. If this parameter is set to 0, the limit control is disabled. If this parameter is set to a non-zero value, the limit control is enabled and this value is the maximum number of RLC-layer data segments

parameters.id: Number of Bundled PTT Voice Packets
parameters.name: Number of Bundled PTT Voice Packets
parameters.description: Indicates the number of PTT voice packets that can be bundled. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: Uplink Min Expected Bit Rate
parameters.description: Indicates the expected minimum uplink rate when equivalent Max C/I is used as the scheduling policy. If this parameter is set to 65535, equivalent Max C/I cannot be used as the scheduling policy. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: Uplink Rate Guarantee Resource Ratio
parameters.description: Indicates the proportion of resources available for uplink rate guarantee. If this parameter is set to 0, uplink rate guarantee is disabled. If this parameter is set to a value other than 0, uplink rate guarantee is enabled, and the value indicates the proportion of resources available for uplink rate guarantee. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.id: Data Volume of Special UE Preallocation
parameters.name: Data Volume of Special UE Preallocation
parameters.description: Indicates the amount of data that can be preallocated to a special UE at a time. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.id: Minimal Interval of Special UE Preallocation
parameters.name: Minimal Interval of Special UE Preallocation
parameters.description: Indicates the minimum interval between two consecutive preallocations for a single special UE. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.id: Duration of Special UE Smart Preallocation
parameters.name: Duration of Special UE Smart Preallocation
parameters.description: Indicates the duration of uplink smart preallocation triggered by downlink scheduling for special UEs. If this parameter is set to 0, preallocation will not be performed in the uplink. This parameter is invalid when the SmartPreAllocationSwitch option of the CellAlgoSwitch.UlSchSwitch parameter is deselected. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: Local Cell ID
parameters.description: Indicates the local identity of the cell. It uniquely identifies a cell within an eNodeB. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.id: High RRC Reject Rate Thd for UL Uni-OLC
parameters.name: High RRC Reject Rate Thd for UL Uni-OLC
parameters.description: Indicates the threshold of the resource-insufficiency-induced RRC connection rejection rate, which is used to determine whether to start UMTS and LTE unified overload control. UMTS and LTE unified overload control starts when both of the following conditions are met: (1) The resource-insufficiency-induced RRC connection rejection rate is greater than the RrcRejectRateHighThd parameter value; (2) T

parameters.id: Low RRC Reject Rate Thd for UL Uni-OLC
parameters.name: Low RRC Reject Rate Thd for UL Uni-OLC
parameters.description: Indicates the threshold of the resource-insufficiency-induced RRC connection rejection rate, which is used to determine whether to stop UMTS and LTE unified overload control. UMTS and LTE unified overload control stops if all of the following conditions are met: (1) The number of RRC_CONNECTED UEs is less than the UeNumLowThd parameter value; (2) The resource-insufficiency-induced RRC connection r

parameters.id: High RRC Request Number Thd for UL Uni-OLC
parameters.name: High RRC Request Number Thd for UL Uni-OLC
parameters.description: Indicates the threshold of the number of RRC connection setup requests, which is used to determine whether to start UMTS and LTE unified overload control. UMTS and LTE unified overload control starts when both of the following conditions are met: (1) The number of RRC connection setup requests is greater than the RrcReqNumHighThd parameter value; (2) The resource-insufficiency-induced RRC connecti

parameters.id: Low RRC Request Number Thd for UL Uni-OLC
parameters.name: Low RRC Request Number Thd for UL Uni-OLC
parameters.description: Indicates the threshold of the RRC connection setup request number, which is used to determine whether to stop UMTS and LTE unified overload control. UMTS and LTE unified overload control stops if all of the following conditions are met: (1) The number of RRC_CONNECTED UEs is less than the UeNumLowThd parameter value; (2) The resource-insufficiency-induced RRC connection rejection rate is less tha

parameters.id: High UE Number Thd for UL Uni-OLC
parameters.name: High UE Number Thd for UL Uni-OLC
parameters.description: Indicates the RRC_CONNECTED UE number threshold used to determine whether to start UMTS and LTE unified overload control. UMTS and LTE unified overload control starts when the number of RRC_CONNECTED UEs is greater than this parameter value. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.id: Low UE Number Thd for UL Uni-OLC
parameters.name: Low UE Number Thd for UL Uni-OLC
parameters.description: Indicates the threshold of the RRC_CONNECTED UE number, which is used to determine whether to stop UMTS and LTE unified overload control. UMTS and LTE unified overload control stops if all of the following conditions are met: (1) The number of RRC_CONNECTED UEs is less than the UeNumLowThd parameter value; (2) The resource-insufficiency-induced RRC connection rejection rate is less than the RrcRej

parameters.name: Local cell ID
parameters.description: Indicates the local cell ID. It uniquely identifies a cell within an eNodeB.

parameters.name: Us Guarantee Algorithm Switch
parameters.description: Indicates whether to guarantee services for UEs running unlimited services in a cell. UsUeGuaranteeSwitch: Indicates whether all options related to service guarantee for UEs running unlimited services take effect. If this option is selected, functions and parameters of service guarantee for UEs running unlimited services take effect. If this option is deselected, functions and parameters of servic

parameters.id: US Data Minimal Period of Preallocation
parameters.name: US Data Minimal Period of Preallocation
parameters.description: Indicates the minimum interval between two consecutive preallocations for a UE running unlimited data services. When the DRX algorithm is enabled and the UE is in the DRX state, the actual minimum interval does not exceed the DrxInactivityTimer parameter value.

parameters.id: US VoIP Packet Size of Preallocation
parameters.name: US VoIP Packet Size of Preallocation
parameters.description: Indicates the amount of data preallocated to a UE running unlimited voice services. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.id: US Data Packet Size of Preallocation
parameters.name: US Data Packet Size of Preallocation
parameters.description: Indicates the amount of data that can be preallocated resources for a UE running unlimited services.

parameters.name: US Data Smart Preallocation Duration
parameters.description: Indicates the duration of smart preallocation each time it is performed for a UE running unlimited data services. If this parameter is set to 0, preallocation does not take effect. For an NB-IoT cell, the actual duration is 10 times the value configured on the GUI.

parameters.name: US Ul VoIP Ibler Target
parameters.description: Indicates the uplink target initial block error rate (IBLER) of UEs running unlimited voice services. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.id: NS Number Thd Based on US Handover
parameters.name: NS Number Thd Based on US Handover
parameters.description: Indicates the minimum number of UEs running normal services that is used in steering mobility management for such UEs when steering mobility management for UEs running unlimited services is enabled. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: US PUCCH SINR Target Offset
parameters.description: Indicates the offset of the target signal to interference plus noise ratio (SINR) on the PUCCH for UEs running unlimited services relative to the target SINR on the PUCCH for UEs running normal services. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.id: US PUCCH RSRP High Threshold Offset
parameters.name: US PUCCH RSRP High Threshold Offset
parameters.description: Indicates the offset of the reference signal received power (RSRP) upper limit on the PUCCH for UEs running unlimited services to the RSRP upper limit on the PUCCH for UEs running normal services. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.id: US Data Rat Freq Priority Group ID
parameters.name: US Data Rat Freq Priority Group ID
parameters.description: Indicates the ID of the intra-RAT frequency priority group for UEs running unlimited data services. If the UlUsDiffRatFreqPri option is selected for UEs running unlimited data services, the uplink and downlink are differentiated for UEs running unlimited data services and this parameter indicates the ID of the intra-RAT frequency priority group for UEs running unlimited data services in the downli

parameters.name: US Guarantee Duration Timer
parameters.description: Indicates the duration of service guarantee for UEs running unlimited services during UE steering when steering mobility management for UEs running unlimited services is enabled. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: US Gap Measurement Period
parameters.description: Indicates the interval at which the eNodeB triggers the A4-related measurement for a UE running unlimited services during inter-frequency handovers. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.id: US VoIP Rat Freq Priority Group ID
parameters.name: US VoIP Rat Freq Priority Group ID
parameters.description: Indicates the ID of the intra-RAT frequency priority group for UEs running unlimited voice services. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.id: NS Rat Freq Priority Group ID
parameters.name: NS Rat Freq Priority Group ID
parameters.description: Indicates the ID of an intra-RAT frequency priority group for UEs running normal services in the connected mode. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: Unlimited Service PA
parameters.description: Indicates the PA value allocated to UEs running unlimited services when the PDSCH power assignment is even. If this parameter is set to a value less than the PA value that is allocated to UEs when the PDSCH power assignment is even, this parameter does not take effect. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.id: US PUSCH SINR High Threshold Offset
parameters.name: US PUSCH SINR High Threshold Offset
parameters.description: Indicates the offset of the signal to interference plus noise ratio (SINR) upper limit on the PUSCH for UEs running unlimited services to the SINR upper limit on the PUSCH for UEs running normal services. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: Massive MIMO Power Ratio
parameters.description: Indicates the ratio of the power of moving UEs to that of static UEs during tests on massive MIMO for multiple UEs running unlimited services. If this parameter is set to 0, the eNodeB does not perform power optimization for UEs running unlimited services in massive MIMO scenarios. This parameter applies only to LTE TDD.

parameters.name: US UE PRACH Reuse Threshold
parameters.description: Indicates the SINR threshold for triggering the reuse of the PRACH for UEs running unlimited services. The value -300 indicates that this parameter does not take effect. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: NS User RB Restrict Ratio
parameters.description: Indicates the proportion of resource blocks (RBs) that UEs running normal services can use in a cell. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: US User Detect Timer
parameters.description: Indicates the length of the timer for detecting UEs running unlimited services.

parameters.name: Unlimited Service Downlink MinGBR
parameters.description: Indicates the minimum downlink guaranteed bit rate of non-GBR services for UEs running unlimited services. A large value of this parameter leads to a high downlink scheduling priority for UEs running unlimited services and a high probability that the service rate of such UEs is preferentially guaranteed. A small value of this parameter leads to a low downlink scheduling priority for UEs running un

parameters.name: Unlimited Service Uplink MinGBR
parameters.description: Indicates the minimum uplink guaranteed bit rate of non-GBR services for UEs running unlimited services. A large value of this parameter leads to a high uplink scheduling priority for UEs running unlimited services and a high probability that the service rate of such UEs is preferentially guaranteed. A small value of this parameter leads to a low uplink scheduling priority for UEs running unlimite

parameters.name: Restricted NS UL RB Count
parameters.description: Indicates the number of uplink RBs that can be scheduled for UEs running normal services per TTI. If the parameter value is not 100, the number of uplink RBs that can be scheduled for UEs running normal services per TTI cannot exceed the parameter value. If this parameter is set to 100, the eNodeB does not restrict the number of uplink RBs that can be scheduled for UEs running normal services. If

parameters.name: US Neighbor Interference Control
parameters.description: Indicates the interference suppression threshold in a neighboring cell of the local cell serving UEs running unlimited services. The parameter value 0 indicates that interference suppression is disabled.

parameters.name: Uplink Schedule Optimize Count
parameters.description: Indicates the number of uplink scheduling optimization times. When this parameter is set to 0, the function is disabled. When this parameter is set to other values, this parameter indicates the number of optimization times during the transition from a silent period to talk spurt. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.id: UL US VoIP Reserved Start RB
parameters.name: UL US VoIP Reserved Start RB
parameters.description: Indicates the start position of the reserved RB for UEs running unlimited voice services in the uplink. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.id: UL US VoIP Reserved End RB
parameters.name: UL US VoIP Reserved End RB
parameters.description: Indicates the end position of the reserved RB for UEs running unlimited voice services in the uplink. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: PRB Threshold of Subframe Control
parameters.description: Indicates the PRB threshold for intelligent subframe control. The eNodeB selects different subframes for intelligent control based on the PRB thresholds for intelligent subframe control. If this parameter is set to Percent10 or Percent30, the eNodeB checks the PRB usage before starting intelligent subframe control. If this parameter is set to Percent10ENH or Percent30ENH, the eNodeB does not check

parameters.name: US VoIP Keep On Length
parameters.description: Indicates the period of reserving the voice indicator for a UE running unlimited services after a voice service ends. If this parameter is set to 65535, the voice attribute is always reserved for a UE running unlimited services after a voice service ends. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.id: NS Idle Rat Frequency Priority Group ID
parameters.name: NS Idle Rat Frequency Priority Group ID
parameters.description: Indicates the ID of an intra-RAT frequency priority group for UEs running normal services in the idle mode. If the UsCellReselSwitch option of the UsAlgoSwitch parameter is selected, the NsIdleRatFreqPriGroupId parameter setting is delivered to steer UEs running normal services to camp on frequencies of different priorities. If the UsCellReselSwitch option is deselected, the NsIdleRatFreqPriGroupI

parameters.name: US Downlink Scheduling Priority Ratio
parameters.description: Indicates the proportion of the duration that the downlink scheduling weight factor takes effect for UEs running unlimited services. If this parameter is set to 1000, the downlink scheduling weight factor always takes effect for UEs running unlimited services. If this parameter is set to 0, the downlink scheduling weight factor does not take effect for UEs running unlimited services all the time.

parameters.name: US Uplink Scheduling Priority Ratio
parameters.description: Indicates the proportion of the duration that the uplink scheduling weight factor takes effect for large-packet UEs running unlimited services. If this parameter is set to 1000, the uplink scheduling weight factor always takes effect for large-packet UEs running unlimited services. If this parameter is set to 0, the uplink scheduling weight factor does not take effect for large-packet UEs running

parameters.id: US A3 Handover A2 Threshold Offset

parameters.description: Indicates the offset to the RSRP or RSRQ threshold for triggering event A3 of A2-based inter-frequency handovers for UEs running unlimited services. parameters.id: US A4A5 Handover A2 Threshold Offset

parameters.id: UL US Data RAT Freq Priority Group ID
parameters.name: UL US Data RAT Freq Priority Group ID
parameters.description: Indicates the ID of the intra-RAT frequency priority group for UEs running unlimited data services in the uplink. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.id: Us Neighbor Cell UL SINR High Thd Offset
parameters.name: Us Neighbor Cell UL SINR High Thd Offset
parameters.description: Indicates the high threshold offset of uplink SINR for NS UEs (UEs running normal services) in neighboring cells of a cell that serves US UEs (UEs running unlimited services). This parameter takes effect if the UsUeGuaranteeSwitch option of the UsAlgoSwitch parameter is selected and cell US UE guarantee is triggered. When this parameter takes effect, the eNodeB adjusts the high threshold of uplink

parameters.id: Us Neighbor Cell UL RB Restrict Ratio
parameters.name: Us Neighbor Cell UL RB Restrict Ratio
parameters.description: Indicates the percentage of uplink RBs configured for NS UEs (UEs running normal services) in neighboring cells of a cell that serves US UEs (UEs running unlimited services). This parameter takes effect if the UsUeGuaranteeSwitch option of the UsAlgoSwitch parameter is selected and cell US UE guarantee is triggered. When this parameter takes effect, the eNodeB limits the percentage of uplink RBs c

parameters.id: US A3 Handover A1 Threshold Offset
parameters.name: US A3 Handover A1 Threshold Offset
parameters.description: Indicates the offset to the RSRP or RSRQ threshold for triggering event A1 of event A3-based handovers for UEs running unlimited services. If the UsUeGuaranteeSwitch option of the UsAlgoSwitch parameter in the CellUSParaCfg MO is selected, the sum of this offset and the value of the A3InterFreqHoA1ThdRsrp or A3InterFreqHoA1ThdRsrq parameter in the InterFreqHoGroup MO is used as the value of the RS

parameters.id: US A4A5 Handover A1 Threshold Offset
parameters.name: US A4A5 Handover A1 Threshold Offset
parameters.description: Indicates the offset to the RSRP or RSRQ threshold for triggering event A1 of event A4- or A5-based handovers for UEs running unlimited services. parameters.name: US Data PDCCH SINR Offset
parameters.description: Indicates the PDCCH SINR offset for UEs running unlimited data services. This parameter is used to adjust the PDCCH aggregation level and PDCCH power for such UEs. If this parameter is set to 0, adjustment of the PDCCH aggregation level and PDCCH power does not take effect. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: US VoLTE PDCCH SINR Offset
parameters.description: Indicates the PDCCH SINR offset for UEs running unlimited voice services. This parameter is used to adjust the PDCCH aggregation level and PDCCH power for such UEs. If this parameter is set to 0, adjustment of the PDCCH aggregation level and PDCCH power does not take effect. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD. parameters.id: US VoLTE Initial DL Target IBLER
parameters.name: US VoLTE Initial DL Target IBLER
parameters.description: Indicates the initial value of the downlink target IBLER for UEs running unlimited voice services. If this parameter is set to 100, the CQI adjustment amount is not updated. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.id: US VoLTE Min UL Compensate Scheduling Period
parameters.name: US VoLTE Min UL Compensate Scheduling Period
parameters.description: Indicates the minimum interval of uplink compensation scheduling for UEs running unlimited voice services If this parameter is set to INTERVAL_OFF(OFF), uplink enhanced scheduling is disabled for UEs running unlimited voice services. If this parameter is not set to INTERVAL_OFF(OFF), uplink enhanced scheduling is enabled for UEs running unlimited voice services, and the value indicates the minimum

parameters.name: CRS Shutdown RSRP Offset
parameters.description: Indicates the offset for triggering event A3 related to CRS shutdown when CRS shutdown is enabled for UEs running unlimited services (US UEs). The offset is the difference between the signal quality of a neighboring cell and that of the serving cell. A larger value of this parameter results in a lower probability that a neighboring cell can be selected as a CRS shutdown cell. This parameter applie

parameters.name: CRS Shutdown Policy
parameters.description: Indicates the CRS shutdown policy. When this parameter is set to CRS_SHUTDOWN_DISENABLE, CRS shutdown is disabled. When this parameter is set to CRS_SHUTDOWN_BASED_MEASURE, measurement-based CRS shutdown is enabled. When this parameter is set to CRS_SHUTDOWN_BASED_NCELL_LIST, neighboring cell list-based CRS shutdown is enabled. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.id: Max. Number of Normal UEs Scheduled Per TTI
parameters.name: Max. Number of Normal UEs Scheduled Per TTI
parameters.description: Indicates the maximum number of NS UEs that can be scheduled in each TTI. If this parameter is set to 0, no NS UEs can be scheduled in the uplink or downlink. If this parameter is set to 255, SR-based scheduling of NS UEs for data services is restricted in the uplink and no restriction is imposed on scheduling in the downlink. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: NS Scheduling Not Allowed Subframe
parameters.description: Indicates the number of the subframe in which NS UEs cannot be scheduled. This option applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: Scheduling Guarantee Us UE Number
parameters.description: Indicates the number of unlimited service (US) UEs (UEs running US services) that require guarantee in uplink and downlink scheduling. When this parameter is set to 255, no guarantee is provided for US UEs. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.id: Gap Mode for UEs Running Unlimited Services
parameters.name: Gap Mode for UEs Running Unlimited Services
parameters.description: Indicates whether to allow US UEs (UEs running unlimited services) to perform unnecessary gap-assisted inter-frequency or inter-RAT measurement. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.id: RSRP Thld for Delayed HO in VoLTE Silent Period
parameters.name: RSRP Thld for Delayed HO in VoLTE Silent Period
parameters.description: Indicates whether to enable delaying the triggering of handovers during talk spurts to the silent period and also indicates the RSRP threshold used to determine whether handovers need to be immediately triggered when the eNodeB decides to delay the triggering of handovers during talk spurts to the silent period. If the RSRP in the serving cell is lower than this threshold, handovers are triggered

parameters.id: Large Packet Service DL Data Amount Threshold
parameters.name: Large Packet Service DL Data Amount Threshold
parameters.description: Indicates the downlink traffic volume threshold used to determine UEs that are running large-packet services. If the BigPackageIdentify parameter is set to ON, the eNodeB considers a UE as a large-packet unlimited-service UE when the accumulated amount of RLC data buffered for the UE is greater than or equal to this threshold. This parameter applies only to FDD.

parameters.id: US Not Schedule RBG RSRP Offset
parameters.name: US Not Schedule RBG RSRP Offset
parameters.description: Indicates the offset to the RSRP for the strongest neighboring cell relative to the RSRP for the serving cell. This offset is used in the function of avoiding allocating RBGs exposed to strong interference to unlimited-service UEs.

parameters.id: US Not Schedule RBG RSRP Threshold
parameters.name: US Not Schedule RBG RSRP Threshold
parameters.description: Indicates the serving-cell RSRP threshold used in the function of avoiding allocating RBGs exposed to strong interference to unlimited-service UEs.

parameters.name: Us Cell Schedule Optimization Switch
parameters.description: Indicates whether to enable scheduling optimization for cells where UEs running unlimited services reside. UsCellPdcchFixSymSwitch: Indicates whether to fix the CFI for cells where UEs running unlimited services reside. If this option is selected, the CFI is fixed for cells where UEs running unlimited services reside. If this option is deselected, the CFI is set based on the setting of the PdcchSy

parameters.name: US Guarantee Algorithm Extension Switch
parameters.description: JTUserCoCellPowerSwitch: Indicates whether to increase the power of the coordinating cell when joint transmission is performed for UEs running unlimited services. If this option is selected, the eNodeB increases the power of the coordinating cell when joint transmission is performed for UEs running unlimited services. If this option is deselected, the eNodeB does not increase the power of the coor

parameters.name: US SRS Guarantee Switch
parameters.description: Indicates the number of UEs for which SRS guarantee is performed during massive MIMO multi-UE guarantee tests. The default value 0_USERS_GUARANTEE(0 User Guarantee) indicates that the guarantee algorithm does not take effect.
