parameters.name: UE Mobility Identify Strategy
parameters.description: Indicates the basis for identifying moving UEs. This parameter applies only to LTE TDD.

parameters.id: US Smooth Handover Compensation Thld Offset
parameters.name: US Smooth Handover Compensation Thld Offset
parameters.description: Indicates the offset to the compensation threshold for smooth handovers of UEs running unlimited services when the UsNbInterfHoSwitch option of the UsAlgoSwitch parameter is selected. If this parameter is set to 0, the compensation threshold is not adjusted for such handovers. If this parameter is set to a non-0 value, the compensation threshold is added by the value of this parameter. This parame

parameters.id: RSRQ Thld for Delayed HO in VoLTE Silent Period
parameters.name: RSRQ Thld for Delayed HO in VoLTE Silent Period
parameters.description: Indicates the serving cell RSRQ threshold used for determining whether to trigger handovers immediately for UEs running unlimited VoLTE services during talk spurts after delaying the triggering of handovers during talk spurts to the silent period is enabled. If the RSRQ of the serving cell is smaller than this threshold, the eNodeB immediately triggers handovers for UEs running unlimited VoLTE ser

parameters.name: US VoLTE Algorithm Switch
parameters.description: Indicates whether to enable functions related to US VoLTE UEs. US_VOLTE_UE_STEERING_SW: Indicates whether to allow steering of US VoLTE UEs with QCI-1 bearers. Steering of US VoLTE UEs with QCI-1 bearers is allowed only if this option is selected. This option applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD. US_VOLTE_RTP_REORDER_SW: Indicates whether to enable RTP reordering for US VoLTE UEs. RTP reordering is

parameters.name: Restricted NS DL RB Count
parameters.description: Indicates the number of downlink RBs that can be scheduled for UEs running normal services per TTI. If this parameter is set to a value greater than or equal to 4 and less than 100, the number of downlink RBs that can be scheduled for UEs running normal services per TTI cannot exceed the parameter value. If this parameter is set to 100, the eNodeB does not restrict the number of downlink RBs that

parameters.id: Consec VoLTE Frame Number in 1st Talk Spurt
parameters.name: Consec VoLTE Frame Number in 1st Talk Spurt
parameters.description: Indicate the number of consecutive voice frames in the first voice segment. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.id: Consec VoLTE Frame Number in 2nd Talk Spurt
parameters.name: Consec VoLTE Frame Number in 2nd Talk Spurt
parameters.description: Indicate the number of consecutive voice frames in the second voice segment. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: US Neighboring Cell Restrict Strategy
parameters.description: Indicates the policy for restricting neighboring cells of the cell serving US UEs. If this parameter is set to BASED_ON_NRT, all intra-frequency neighboring cells of the cell serving US UEs are restricted. If this parameter is set to BASED_ON_MEASUREMENT, only the intra-frequency neighboring cells reported by US UEs are restricted. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: NS RB Scheduling Restriction Strategy
parameters.description: Indicates the policy for restricting the scheduling of RBs for UEs running normal services. DEFAULT_STRATEGY: Indicates that the scheduling of UEs running normal services is restricted when the number of UEs running unlimited services in the cell is the same as that configured using the MML command. NS_VOLTE_UNRESTRICTED: Indicates that the scheduling of UEs running normal services is restricted w

parameters.id: Downlink CCE Sch Priority Penalty Level
parameters.name: Downlink CCE Sch Priority Penalty Level
parameters.description: Indicates the level of penalty on scheduling priorities. The penalty takes effect on a per PDCCH aggregation level basis. The value NONE indicates that the penalty is disabled. The value LEVEL_ONE indicates that a low level of penalty is imposed only on UEs for which PDCCH aggregation level 8 is used. The value LEVEL_TWO indicates that a medium level of penalty is imposed on UEs for which PDCCH ag

parameters.id: Uplink CCE Sch Priority Penalty Level
parameters.name: Uplink CCE Sch Priority Penalty Level
parameters.description: Indicates the level of penalty on uplink scheduling priorities based on the PDCCH aggregation level. The value NONE indicates that penalty on uplink scheduling priorities based on the PDCCH aggregation level is disabled. If this parameter is set to LEVEL_ONE, the penalty is imposed on only the uplink scheduling priority of UEs with PDCCH aggregation level 8, and the penalty level is low. If this p

parameters.id: US UE DL Adaptive Power Boost Threshold
parameters.name: US UE DL Adaptive Power Boost Threshold
parameters.description: Indicates the downlink power boost threshold for eMTC and NB-IoT UEs running unlimited services. If this parameter is set to 0, downlink power boost is disabled for these UEs.

parameters.id: US UE Neighboring Cell Guarantee Timer
parameters.name: US UE Neighboring Cell Guarantee Timer
parameters.description: Indicates the length of the timer that governs the period of performance guarantee for the cell serving UEs running unlimited services (US UEs for short) through control over neighboring cells. If the length of time in which no UE is running unlimited services in the cell exceeds the sum of the values of this parameter and the UsDetectTimer parameter (which specifies the length of the timer for de

parameters.name: Local Cell ID
parameters.description: Indicates the local ID of a cell, which uniquely identifies a cell within an eNodeB. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD.

parameters.id: Max UE Number for Handover Out
parameters.name: Max UE Number for Handover Out
parameters.description: Indicates the maximum number of UEs that can be transferred within 10s. This parameter is used to prevent too many UEs from being transferred at a time to neighboring cells to cause significant impact on neighboring cells. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD.

parameters.name: Load Difference Threshold
parameters.description: Indicates the threshold of PRB usage difference between the serving cell and a neighboring cell. When the result of the PRB usage of the serving cell minus that of a neighboring cell in a cluster is greater than the parameter value, this neighboring cell can be a target cell for MLB. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD.

parameters.name: Load Balancing Threshold
parameters.description: Indicates the PRB usage threshold for triggering MLB. MLB is triggered if the PRB usage of the serving cell is higher than this parameter value. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD.

parameters.name: VMS A3 Offset
parameters.description: Indicates the offset for intra-frequency handovers between the inner and outer cells in VMS scenarios. This parameter also indicates the intra-frequency handover offset between cells served by the same AAU in massive MIMO (32T32R) scenarios. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD.

parameters.name: Local Cell ID
parameters.description: Indicates the local ID of a cell, which uniquely identifies a cell within an eNodeB. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.id: Upper Limit of DL PRB Usage for MBB User
parameters.name: Upper Limit of DL PRB Usage for MBB User
parameters.description: Indicates the upper limit on the proportion of transmission PRB resources allocated for MBB UEs in the PDSCH. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.id: Upper Limit of UL PRB Usage for MBB User
parameters.name: Upper Limit of UL PRB Usage for MBB User
parameters.description: Indicates the upper limit on the PUSCH PRB usage of MBB UEs. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: PRB Upper Limit Control Mode
parameters.description: Indicates the PRB upper limit control mode, which can be tight control or loose control. When this parameter is set to TIGHT_CONTROL, the PRB resources for WBB and MBB UEs are subject to their respective uplink and downlink PRB resource upper limits. That is, the amounts of PRB resources allocated to WBB and MBB UEs must not exceed the upper limits even if there are remaining PRB resources in the

parameters.id: WBB or MBB User Definition Mode
parameters.name: WBB or MBB User Definition Mode
parameters.description: Indicates the WBB and MBB UE definition modes. This parameter provides the SPID-based and QCI-based definition modes. When this parameter is set to SPID_BASED, the eNodeB regards UEs configured with SPIDs and whose SpecifiedUserFlag is set to SPECSERUSER as WBB UEs. Other UEs are regarded as MBB UEs. When this parameter is set to QCI_BASED, the eNodeB regards UEs that set up the bearers with QCIs

parameters.id: Upper Limit of DL PRB Usage for WBB User
parameters.name: Upper Limit of DL PRB Usage for WBB User
parameters.description: Indicates the upper limit on the proportion of transmission PRB resources allocated for WBB UEs in the PDSCH. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.id: Upper Limit of UL PRB Usage for WBB User
parameters.name: Upper Limit of UL PRB Usage for WBB User
parameters.description: Indicates the upper limit on the proportion of transmission PRB resources allocated for WBB UEs in the PUSCH. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.id: Dynamic Control MBB UE PRB Threshold
parameters.name: Dynamic Control MBB UE PRB Threshold
parameters.description: Indicates the MBB UE PRB usage threshold for triggering PRB restriction for WBB UEs. When the WBB_UE_DL_DYN_PRB_LMT_SWITCH option of the SpecUserAlgoSwitch parameter is selected, if the average PRB usage of MBB UEs is lower than or equal to this threshold, downlink PRB restriction will not be applied to WBB UEs. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.id: Dynamic Control UE Count High Pct Thld
parameters.name: Dynamic Control UE Count High Pct Thld
parameters.description: Indicates the MBB-to-WBB UE number ratio threshold for triggering high restriction on downlink PRBs for WBB UEs. When the WBB_UE_DL_DYN_PRB_LMT_SWITCH option of the SpecUserAlgoSwitch parameter is selected, if the MBB-to-WBB UE number ratio is higher than this threshold and the average PRB usage of MBB UEs is higher than the value of the DynCtrlMbbUePrbThd parameter in the CellWttxParaCfg MO, high

parameters.id: Dynamic Control UE Count Low Pct Thld
parameters.name: Dynamic Control UE Count Low Pct Thld
parameters.description: Indicates the MBB-to-WBB UE number ratio threshold for triggering low restriction on downlink PRBs for WBB UEs. When the WBB_UE_DL_DYN_PRB_LMT_SWITCH option of the SpecUserAlgoSwitch parameter is selected, if the MBB-to-WBB UE number ratio is higher than this threshold and lower than or equal to the value of the DynCtrlUeCntHighPctThld parameter in the CellWttxParaCfg MO and the average PRB usage

parameters.name: IPTV Guarantee User Count
parameters.description: Indicates the upper limit on the number of IPTV UEs for which rate acceleration is used for rate guarantee in a cell where IPTV admission control is used. When the number of UEs running IPTV services in the cell exceeds this limit, the eNodeB no longer accelerates rates for newly admitted IPTV UEs. If this parameter is set to 0, the IPTV admission control function does not take effect. That is, th

parameters.name: WBB Performance Optimization Switch
parameters.description: Indicates whether to enable WBB performance optimization. DL_CA_SCC_CONFIG_ACT_OPT_SW: Indicates whether to enable the algorithm for optimizing downlink CA SCC configuration and activation. If this option is selected, optimization of downlink CA SCC configuration and activation is enabled. Massive MIMO SCCs can be configured and activated only for UEs supporting uplink CA. If this option is desele

parameters.name: WBB Multi-Carrier Coordination A2 Offset
parameters.description: Indicates the offset to the threshold for event A2 that triggers handover of CA UEs running WBB services in multi-carrier scenarios from a high-frequency cell to a low-frequency cell.

parameters.name: Local Cell ID
parameters.description: Indicates the local ID of a cell, which uniquely identifies a cell within an eNodeB. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: Coverage Level
parameters.description: Indicates the UE's coverage level. COVERAGE_LEVEL0: Indicates the UE's coverage level is 0. COVERAGE_LEVEL1: Indicates the UE's coverage level is 1. COVERAGE_LEVEL2: Indicates the UE's coverage level is 2. COVERAGE_LEVEL3: Indicates the UE's coverage level is 3. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: PUCCH Repetition Number
parameters.description: Indicates the number of PUCCH transmission repetitions for UEs at a specific coverage level in the cell. This parameter takes effect only for UEs that will access the network after the parameter is set. If the CoverageLevel parameter in the CePucchCfg MO is set to COVERAGE_LEVEL0 or COVERAGE_LEVEL1, the following values of the PucchRepNum parameter are valid: - PUCCH_REP_NUM_R1 - PUCCH_REP_NUM_R2

parameters.name: eMTC SRI Period Adaptation Switch
parameters.description: Indicates whether to enable SRI period adaptation for eMTC UEs. If this parameter is set to QCI_ADAPTIVE, the SRI period adaptively changes for eMTC UEs based on the cell load and bearers with different QCIs. If this parameter is set to NON_QCI_ADAPTIVE, the SRI period adaptively changes for eMTC UEs based on only the cell load. If the parameter is set to OFF, the SRI period for eMTC UEs is the va

parameters.id: Full Duplex VoLTE PUCCH Repetition Number
parameters.name: Full Duplex VoLTE PUCCH Repetition Number
parameters.description: Indicates the number of PUCCH repetitions used by eMTC full-duplex VoLTE UEs. This parameter is valid only if the VOLTE_REPETITION_OPT_SWITCH option of the EmtcEnhancedVolteAlgoSw parameter in the CellEmtcAlgo MO is selected. TDD does not distinguish between full duplex and half duplex. For eMTC VoLTE UEs in LTE TDD, the PUCCH repetition count is determined by the HalfDuplexVoltePucchRepNum parame

parameters.id: Half Duplex VoLTE PUCCH Repetition Number
parameters.name: Half Duplex VoLTE PUCCH Repetition Number
parameters.description: Indicates the number of PUCCH repetitions used by eMTC half-duplex VoLTE UEs. This parameter is valid only if the VOLTE_REPETITION_OPT_SWITCH option of the EmtcEnhancedVolteAlgoSw parameter in the CellEmtcAlgo MO is selected. TDD does not distinguish between full duplex and half duplex. For eMTC VoLTE UEs in LTE TDD, the PUCCH repetition count is determined by the HalfDuplexVoltePucchRepNum parame

parameters.name: Local Cell ID
parameters.description: Indicates the local ID of a cell, which uniquely identifies a cell within an eNodeB. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: Coverage Level
parameters.description: Indicates the coverage level of the cell. The values of this parameter correspond to 0 dB, 5 dB, 10 dB, and 15 dB coverage enhancement. The value COVERAGE_LEVEL_0(COVERAGE_LEVEL_0) indicates 0 dB coverage enhancement. The value COVERAGE_LEVEL_1(COVERAGE_LEVEL_1) indicates 5 dB coverage enhancement. The value COVERAGE_LEVEL_2(COVERAGE_LEVEL_2) indicates 10 dB coverage enhancement. The value COVERAG

parameters.name: Timer for Contention Resolution
parameters.description: Indicates the period in which a UE waits for Msg4 during a random access (RA) procedure. This timer starts when a UE initially transmits or retransmits Msg3. If the UE receives Msg4 or NACK to Msg3 before the timer expires, the timer stops. If the UE does not receive either message until the timer expires, the RA fails. In this case, the UE must re-initiate an RA procedure. For details about this

parameters.name: Maximum Number of Preamble Attempt
parameters.description: Indicates the maximum number of preamble transmission attempts for the corresponding coverage level. For details, see 3GPP TS 36.321. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: Preamble Ratio
parameters.description: Indicates the proportion of preambles corresponding to a coverage level to all preambles of the cell. This parameter is used to calculate the number of preambles corresponding to a coverage level. The number of preambles corresponding to a coverage level (excluding the maximum coverage level) is calculated by rounding down the value of this parameter multiplied by the total number of preambles of

parameters.name: Preamble Repetition Number
parameters.description: Indicates the number of repeated preamble transmissions for the corresponding coverage level. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: Random Preamble Ratio
parameters.description: Indicates the proportion of random preambles corresponding to the cell coverage level to the total number of preambles for this coverage level. The number of random preambles corresponding to the cell coverage level equals the value of this parameter multiplied by the total number of preambles corresponding to the cell coverage level. Preambles are classified into random and dedicated preambles. R

parameters.name: RACH Threshold Increase Coefficient
parameters.description: Indicates the coefficient for increasing the RACH detection threshold under the corresponding coverage level. For example, if this parameter is set to the GUI value 400, the RACH detection threshold under the current coverage level increases by four times. If this parameter is set to the GUI value -50, the RACH detection threshold under the current coverage level decreases by 0.5 times. If this pa

parameters.id: High Load Threshold for Adaptive RACH
parameters.name: High Load Threshold for Adaptive RACH
parameters.description: Indicates whether to enable eMTC RACH adaptation and the high-load threshold for triggering eMTC RACH adaptation. If this parameter is set to 255, the function does not take effect. If this parameter is set to a value other than 255 and the load is higher than the value, the function takes effect. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: Mode Number
parameters.description: Indicates the number of a specific call history record (CHR) hierarchical classification output mode.

parameters.name: CHR Detail Cause Value
parameters.description: Indicates the call history record (CHR) generating cause value corresponding to a specific CHR hierarchical classification mode.

parameters.name: CHR Hierarchical Output Mode
parameters.description: Indicates the call history record (CHR) hierarchical output mode. If the parameter is set to Level_1_Output, level-1 CHRs, that is, only typical records, are output. If the parameter is set to Level_2_Output, level-2 CHRs, that is, all records, are output. If level-2 CHRs start to be output, the number of output records increases, thereby decreasing the duration when the local logs can be recorded

parameters.name: CHR Output Sampling Indicator
parameters.description: Indicates whether CHRs are output after being sampled. If this parameter is set to SamplingEnable, specific sampled CHRs are output. If this parameter is set to SamplingUnable, all specific CHRs are output without being sampled. If the value of this parameter is changed from SamplingEnable to SamplingUnable, the number of records increases, thereby decreasing the duration when the local logs can b

parameters.name: Clock Async Detection Switch
parameters.description: Indicates whether to enable clock asynchronization detection. If this parameter is set to ON(On), the eNodeB enables clock asynchronization detection. If this parameter is set to OFF(Off), the eNodeB disables clock asynchronization detection. This parameter applies only to LTE TDD.

parameters.name: Clock Async Interf Report Thld
parameters.description: Indicates the interference threshold for interference reporting. This parameter applies only to LTE TDD.

parameters.name: Clock Async PRB Usage Thld
parameters.description: Indicates the uplink PRB usage threshold for a cell. This threshold is used to filter out scenarios where interference occurs due to heavy traffic. This parameter applies only to LTE TDD.

parameters.id: Clock Async Silence Detect Interf Diff Thld
parameters.name: Clock Async Silence Detect Interf Diff Thld
parameters.description: Indicates the threshold of interference fluctuations during silence detection for locating eNodeBs with clock asynchronization. This parameter applies only to LTE TDD.

parameters.id: Clock Async Silence Detect Interf Thld
parameters.name: Clock Async Silence Detect Interf Thld
parameters.description: Indicates the interference detection threshold when interference fluctuates during silence detection. This threshold is used to locate eNodeBs with clock asynchronization. This parameter applies only to LTE TDD.

parameters.name: Post Processing Measure
parameters.description: Indicates the measure to be taken after eNodeB clock out-of-synchronization. If this parameter is set to NO_PROCESSING, the eNodeB does not take any measure after clock out-of-synchronization. If this parameter is set to CLK_ASYNC_ENB_DEACTIVATE, the eNodeB deactivates all LTE TDD cells after clock out-of-synchronization. This parameter applies only to LTE TDD.

parameters.name: Cluster ID
parameters.description: Indicates the ID of a cluster in Cloud BB scenarios. When static clusters are configured, the value of this parameter ranges from 0 to 999. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: Cluster Type
parameters.description: Indicates the feature type of a cluster, which can be CSPC, DL CoMP, CAMC, or UL ISC. This parameter applies only to LTE TDD when it is set to DLCOMP(DLCOMP), CAMC(CAMC), or ULICS(ULICS).

parameters.name: Cluster ID
parameters.description: Indicates the ID of a cluster in Cloud BB scenarios. When static clusters are configured, the value of this parameter ranges from 0 to 999. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: Mobile country code
parameters.description: Indicates the mobile country code (MCC) of a cell in the cluster. A PLMN ID is comprised of an MCC and an MNC. An MCC consists of three digits. An MNC consists of two or three digits. For example, if the MCC is 123 and the MNC is 45, the PLMN ID is 12345. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: Mobile network code
parameters.description: Indicates the mobile network code (MNC) of a cell in the cluster. A PLMN ID is comprised of an MCC and an MNC. An MCC consists of three digits. An MNC consists of two or three digits. For example, if the MCC is 123 and the MNC is 45, the PLMN ID is 12345. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: eNodeB ID
parameters.description: Indicates the eNodeB identity of the cluster cell. It uniquely identifies an eNodeB within a PLMN. The 28-bit E-UTRAN cell identity is comprised of the cell identity and the eNodeB identity (represented by the most significant 20 bits). The cell global identity (CGI) of an E-UTRAN cell is comprised of the E-UTRAN cell identity and the PLMN ID. For details about this parameter, see 3GPP TS 36.413.

parameters.name: Cell ID
parameters.description: Indicates the identity of the local cell. It uniquely identifies a cell within an eNodeB. The 28-bit E-UTRAN cell identity is comprised of the cell identity (represented by the least significant eight bits) and the eNodeB identity. The cell global identity (CGI) of an E-UTRAN cell is comprised of the E-UTRAN cell identity and the PLMN ID. For details about this parameter, see 3GPP TS 36.413. This

parameters.name: Cell Cluster Status
parameters.description: Indicates information about a cell in a cluster. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: Schedule Node Mobile Country Code
parameters.description: Indicates the MCC of the eNodeB on which the associated centralized scheduling node is deployed. A PLMN ID is composed of an MCC and an MNC. The MCC consists of three digits. The MNC consists of two or three digits. For example, if the MCC is 123 and the MNC is 45, the PLMN ID is 12345. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: Schedule Node Mobile Network Code
parameters.description: Indicates the MNC of the eNodeB on which the associated centralized scheduling node is deployed. A PLMN ID is composed of an MCC and an MNC. The MCC consists of three digits. The MNC consists of two or three digits. For example, if the MCC is 123 and the MNC is 45, the PLMN ID is 12345. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: Schedule Node eNodeB ID
parameters.description: Indicates the ID of the eNodeB on which the associated centralized scheduling node is deployed. A local cell ID and an eNodeB ID compose a 28-bit E-UTRAN cell ID, in which the eNodeB ID is represented by the 20 most significant bits. An E-UTRAN cell ID and a PLMN ID compose an E-UTRAN CGI (ECGI). For details about this parameter, see 3GPP TS 36.413. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE T

parameters.name: Cell UL CAMC Status
parameters.description: Indicates the status of uplink inter-eNodeB CAMC in a cell. This parameter applies only to LTE TDD cells.

parameters.name: LocalCellId
parameters.description: This parameter uniquely identifies a cell within an eNodeB. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD.

parameters.id: CL Zero Buffer Zone DL Shared Freq Indication
parameters.name: CL Zero Buffer Zone DL Shared Freq Indication
parameters.description: Indicates the downlink sharing spectrum scheduling indicator for the CL Zero Bufferzone feature. The parameter is used to configure the policy of using downlink shared spectrum. This parameter applies only to FDD.

parameters.id: CL Zero Buffer Zone UL Shared Freq Indication
parameters.name: CL Zero Buffer Zone UL Shared Freq Indication
parameters.description: Indicates the uplink sharing spectrum scheduling indicator for the CL Zero Bufferzone feature. The parameter is used to configure the policy of using uplink shared spectrum. This parameter applies only to FDD.

parameters.name: CL Shared Spectrum Start RB1
parameters.description: Indicates the start location of resource blocks (RBs) in CL Phase1 Refarming Zero Bufferzone. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD.

parameters.name: CL Shared Spectrum End RB1

parameters.id: CSFB UTRAN EventB1 RSCP Trigger Threshold
parameters.name: CSFB UTRAN EventB1 RSCP Trigger Threshold
parameters.description: Indicates the RSCP threshold for event B1, which is used in CS fallback to UTRAN. When CS fallback to UTRAN is applicable, this parameter is set for UEs and used in the evaluation of whether to trigger event B1. This parameter indicates the RSCP requirement for the UTRAN cells to be included in the measurement report. A UE sends a measurement report related to event B1 to the eNodeB when the RSCP

parameters.id: CSFB UTRAN EventB1 ECN0 Trigger Threshold
parameters.name: CSFB UTRAN EventB1 ECN0 Trigger Threshold
parameters.description: Indicates the Ec/N0 threshold for event B1, which is used in CS fallback to UTRAN. When CS fallback to UTRAN is applicable, this parameter is set for UEs and used in the evaluation of whether to trigger event B1. This parameter indicates the Ec/N0 requirement for the UTRAN cells to be included in the measurement report. A UE sends a measurement report related to event B1 to the eNodeB when the Ec/

parameters.name: CSFB GERAN EventB1 Trigger Threshold
parameters.description: Indicates the RSSI threshold for event B1 that is used in CS fallback to GERAN. A UE sends a measurement report related to event B1 to the eNodeB when the RSSI in at least one GERAN cell exceeds this threshold and other triggering conditions are met. For details, see 3GPP TS 36.331. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: CSFB CDMA2000 EventB1 Trigger Threshold
parameters.description: Indicates the pilot strength threshold related to event B1, which is used in CS fallback to CDMA2000. A UE sends a measurement report related to event B1 to the eNodeB when the pilot strength in at least one CDMA2000 cell exceeds this threshold and other triggering conditions are met. For details, see 3GPP TS 36.331. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.id: CSFB Adaptive Blind Ho A1 RSRP Trigger Threshold
parameters.name: CSFB Adaptive Blind Ho A1 RSRP Trigger Threshold
parameters.description: Indicates the RSRP threshold for event A1 associated with CSFB-triggered adaptive blind handovers. This parameter is set for a UE as a triggering condition of event A1 related to a CSFB-triggered adaptive blind handover. This parameter specifies the RSRP threshold of the serving cell above which a CSFB-triggered adaptive blind handover is triggered. If the RSRP value measured by a UE exceeds this

parameters.name: CSFB Protect Timer
parameters.description: Indicates the length of the CS fallback protection timer. If this parameter is set to 0, the timer does not take effect. If this timer expires, the eNodeB blindly redirects UEs. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: CSFB handover policy Configuration
parameters.description: Indicates the CSFB policy for a UE in connected mode. If the CSFB steering function is disabled, this parameter also applies to UEs in idle mode. The policy can be PS handover, CCO, or redirection.

parameters.id: CSFB handover policy Configuration for idle ue
parameters.name: CSFB handover policy Configuration for idle ue
parameters.description: Indicates the CSFB policy for a UE in idle mode. The policy can be PS handover, CCO, or redirection. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: Csfb User Arp Configuration Switch
parameters.description: Indicates whether to allow the eNodeB to change the ARPs for CSFB UEs. If this parameter is set to ON, the ARPs for CSFB UEs in common calls are specified by the NormalCsfbUserArp parameter in the CsFallbackPolicyCfg MO, and the ARPs for CSFB UEs in emergency calls are always 1. If this parameter is set to OFF, admission of CSFB UEs is performed based on the ARPs delivered from the EPC. For detail

parameters.name: Normal Csfb User Arp
parameters.description: Indicates the allocation/retention priority (ARP) of a CSFB service triggered by a common call. When this parameter is set to 1, the service priority is the same as that of an emergency call. For details about the ARP, see 3GPP TS 23.401. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: CSPC Algorithm Switch
parameters.description: Indicates whether to enable CSPC in cells under the centralized control node in Cloud BB scenarios. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD.

parameters.name: CSPC RSRP Measurement Mode
parameters.description: Indicates the measurement mode of the reference signal received power (RSRP) used in CSPC. The uplink RSRP is measured based on the uplink sounding reference signal (SRS) measurement. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD.

parameters.name: CSPC Cluster Mode
parameters.description: Indicates the mode of grouping cells into clusters for CSPC. If this parameter is set to STATIC_CONFIG, cells must be manually grouped into clusters for CSPC based on site scenarios. If this parameter is set to DYNAMIC_PARTITION_CONFIG, the centralized control node periodically groups cells into clusters for CSPC based on site scenarios. The DYNAMIC_PARTITION_CONFIG value does not take effect curr

parameters.name: CSPC Cluster Partition Period
parameters.description: Indicates the interval at which cells are grouped into clusters for CSPC. The interval can be configured based on site scenarios. This parameter currently does not take effect because dynamic clustering is not supported. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD.

parameters.name: CSPC Power Config Delay
parameters.description: Indicates the interval between the time that an eNodeB reports measurement information to the centralized control node and the time that the power configuration delivered by the centralized control node takes effect on the eNodeB. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: CSPC Schedule UE Specification
parameters.description: Indicates the maximum number of UEs that can be selected for CSPC. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.id: CSPC Enable Downlink PRB Ratio Threshold
parameters.name: CSPC Enable Downlink PRB Ratio Threshold
parameters.description: Indicates the physical resource block (PRB) usage threshold for enabling coordinated scheduling-based power control (CSPC). CSPC is enabled when the highest PRB usage among all cells in a CSPC cluster is greater than this parameter value. To prevent CSPC from being enabled and disabled frequently in the cluster, the PRB usage threshold for disabling CSPC is lower than this parameter value. This pa

parameters.name: TDD Cspc Algorithm Switch
parameters.description: Indicates whether to enable CSPC for cells under the centralized control node in Cloud BB scenarios. This parameter applies only to LTE TDD.

parameters.name: CSPC Capacity Factor
parameters.description: Indicates the acceptable capacity loss proportion in a network with CSPC enabled. This parameter affects the gain for cell edge UEs. Set this parameter in heavily-loaded networks to adjust cell downlink throughput and the downlink throughput gain of cell edge UEs. If this parameter is set to 100, network capacity loss is not considered, and the downlink throughput gain of cell edge UEs reaches the

parameters.name: Mobile country code
parameters.description: Indicates the mobile country code (MCC) of the local CSPC cell. A public land mobile network (PLMN) ID is comprised of an MCC and a mobile network code (MNC). The MCC consists of three digits. The MNC consists of two to three digits. For example, if the MCC is 123 and the MNC is 45, the PLMN ID is 12345. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: Mobile network code
parameters.description: Indicates the mobile network code (MNC) of the local CSPC cell. A public land mobile network (PLMN) ID is comprised of a mobile country code (MCC) and an MNC. The MCC consists of three digits. The MNC consists of two to three digits. For example, if the MCC is 123 and the MNC is 45, the PLMN ID is 12345. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: eNodeB ID
parameters.description: Indicates the eNodeB identity of the local CSPC cell. It uniquely identifies an eNodeB within a PLMN. The 28-bit E-UTRAN cell identity is comprised of the cell identity and the eNodeB identity (represented by the most significant 20 bits). The cell global identity (CGI) of an E-UTRAN cell is comprised of the E-UTRAN cell identity and the PLMN ID. For details about this parameter, see 3GPP TS 36.41

parameters.name: Cell ID
parameters.description: Indicates the cell identity of the local CSPC cell. It uniquely identifies a cell within an eNodeB. The 28-bit E-UTRAN cell identity is comprised of the cell identity (represented by the least significant eight bits) and the eNodeB identity. The cell global identity (CGI) of an E-UTRAN cell is comprised of the E-UTRAN cell identity and the PLMN ID. For details about this parameter, see 3GPP TS 36.

parameters.name: Neighbor mobile country code
parameters.description: Indicates the mobile country code (MCC) of the neighboring cell performing sounding reference signal (SRS) measurements on UEs in the local CSPC cell. A public land mobile network (PLMN) ID is comprised of an MCC and a mobile network code (MNC). The MCC consists of three digits. The MNC consists of two to three digits. For example, if the MCC is 123 and the MNC is 45, the PLMN ID is 12345. This pa

parameters.name: Neighbor mobile network code
parameters.description: Indicates the mobile network code (MNC) of the neighboring cell performing sounding reference signal (SRS) measurements on UEs in the local CSPC cell. A public land mobile network (PLMN) ID is comprised of a mobile country code (MCC) and an MNC. The MCC consists of three digits. The MNC consists of two to three digits. For example, if the MCC is 123 and the MNC is 45, the PLMN ID is 12345. This pa

parameters.name: Neighbor eNodeB ID
parameters.description: Indicates the eNodeB identity of the neighboring cell performing sounding reference signal (SRS) measurements on UEs in the local CSPC cell. It uniquely identifies an eNodeB within a PLMN. The 28-bit E-UTRAN cell identity is comprised of the cell identity and the eNodeB identity (represented by the most significant 20 bits). The cell global identity (CGI) of an E-UTRAN cell is comprised of the E-U

parameters.name: Neighbor Cell ID
parameters.description: Indicates the identity of the neighboring cell performing sounding reference signal (SRS) measurements on UEs in the local CSPC cell under the same eNodeB. It uniquely identifies a cell within an eNodeB. The 28-bit E-UTRAN cell identity is comprised of the cell identity (represented by the least significant eight bits) and the eNodeB identity. The cell global identity (CGI) of an E-UTRAN cell is c

parameters.name: Local Cell 1 ID
parameters.description: Indicates the ID of cell 1 in a Double Deck cell group. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD.

parameters.name: Local Cell 2 ID
parameters.description: Indicates the ID of cell 2 in a Double Deck cell group. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD.

parameters.name: Double Deck Cell Group Bandwidth
parameters.description: Indicates the bandwidth of a Double Deck cell group. This parameter applies only to FDD.

parameters.id: Double Deck Cell Group Paired Cell ID
parameters.name: Double Deck Cell Group Paired Cell ID
parameters.description: Indicates the ID of a paired cell in a Double Deck cell group. This parameter is used to display the information about a paired cell in the DSP command. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD.

parameters.id: Double Deck Cell Punctured RB State
parameters.name: Double Deck Cell Punctured RB State
parameters.description: Indicates the status of punctured RBs of a local cell in the Double Deck cell group. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD.

parameters.name: CN Operator ID
parameters.description: Indicates the ID of the operator that owns the NG object.

parameters.name: Default AMF Region ID
parameters.description: Indicates the default AMF region ID. For details, see 3GPP TS 23.501.

parameters.name: Default AMF Set ID
parameters.description: Indicates the default AMF set ID. For details, see 3GPP TS 23.501.

parameters.name: Default AMF Pointer
parameters.description: Indicates the default AMF pointer. For details, see 3GPP TS 23.501.

parameters.name: CN Operator ID
parameters.description: Indicates the ID of the operator.

parameters.name: Default DCN MME Group ID
parameters.description: Indicates the MME group ID of the default DCN.

parameters.name: Unit ID
parameters.description: Indicates the ID of a DFU.

parameters.name: NetWork ID
parameters.description: Indicates the network ID of a DFU. The network ID is unique for each application type on the entire network.

parameters.name: Application Type
parameters.description: Indicates the type of the application referenced by a DFU. The application provides the running environment for the DFU.

parameters.name: Application Reference
parameters.description: Indicates the ID of the application referenced by a DFU. The application provides the running environment for the DFU.

parameters.name: Unit Name
parameters.description: Indicates the name of a DFU.

parameters.name: Unit Status
parameters.description: Indicates the status of the link between a DFU and its central function unit.

parameters.name: Local IP
parameters.description: Indicates the local IP address of the link between a DFU and its central function unit.

parameters.name: Peer IP
parameters.description: Indicates the peer IP address of the link between a DFU and its central function unit.

parameters.name: Client ID
parameters.description: Indicates the ID of a DFU management link client.

parameters.name: VRF Index
parameters.description: Indicates the index of a VRF instance. UMTS currently supports the default routing domain only (the VRF index is 0).

parameters.name: IP Version
parameters.description: Indicates the IP protocol version of a DFU management link client.

parameters.name: Client IPv4 Address
parameters.description: Indicates the IPv4 address of a DFU management link client.

parameters.name: Unit ID
parameters.description: Indicates the ID of a DFU.

parameters.name: User Label
parameters.description: Indicates the user-defined information about a DFU management link client.

parameters.name: Server IPv4 Address
parameters.description: Indicates the IPv4 address of a DFU management link server.

parameters.name: DHCPv6 Server IP Address
parameters.description: Indicates the IP address of the DHCPv6 server.

parameters.id: ID of Blacklist for Direct IPsec Tunnel
parameters.name: ID of Blacklist for Direct IPsec Tunnel
parameters.description: Indicates the ID of a direct IPsec blacklist.

parameters.name: IP Version
parameters.description: Indicates the IP version of a direct IPsec blacklist.

parameters.name: Security Peer IPv4 Address
parameters.description: Indicates the security peer IP address of a direct IPsec blacklist. This address must be a valid IP address of class A, B, or C.

parameters.name: Security Peer IPv6 Address
parameters.description: Indicates the security peer IPv6 address of a direct IPsec blacklist. This IPv6 address must be set to a globally scoped unicast address.

parameters.name: Security Peer IP Address
parameters.description: Indicates the IP address of a security peer in the IPSec blacklist. When an IP address of a security peer is added to the blacklist, no more IPSec tunnels to the security peer are automatically set up.

parameters.name: User Label
parameters.description: Indicates the description of a security peer.

parameters.id: ID of Whitelist for Direct IPsec Tunnel
parameters.name: ID of Whitelist for Direct IPsec Tunnel
parameters.description: Indicates the ID of a direct IPsec whitelist.

parameters.name: IP Version
parameters.description: Indicates the IP version of a direct IPsec whitelist.

parameters.name: Security Peer IPv4 Address
parameters.description: Indicates the security peer IP address of a direct IPsec whitelist. This address must be a valid IP address of class A, B, or C. It can also be a network segment address.

parameters.name: Mask
parameters.description: Indicates the subnet mask of the security peer IP address of a direct IPsec whitelist. The subnet mask cannot be 0.0.0.0.

parameters.name: Security Peer IPv6 Address
parameters.description: Indicates the security peer IPv6 address of a direct IPsec whitelist. This IPv6 address must be set to a globally scoped unicast address. It can also be a network segment address.

parameters.name: IPv6 Address Prefix Length
parameters.description: Indicates the security peer IPv6 address prefix length of a direct IPsec whitelist.

parameters.name: Local cell ID
parameters.description: Indicates the local identity of the cell. It uniquely identifies a cell within an eNodeB. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: Distance-based Measurement Object Type
parameters.description: Indicates the measurement object type for distance-based handovers. The measurement object type can be E-UTRAN, UTRAN, or GERAN. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: Distance-based Handover Threshold
parameters.description: Indicates the threshold for distance-based handovers. If the distance between a UE and the cell center is greater than this threshold, a distance-based handover is triggered for this UE. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: Local Cell ID
parameters.description: Indicates the local cell ID. It uniquely identifies a cell within an eNodeB. This parameter applies only to LTE TDD.

parameters.name: D-MIMO A3 RSRP Offset
parameters.description: Indicates the threshold of the RSRP difference between a neighboring cell and the serving cell to trigger event A3 report for inter-cell D-MIMO when the neighboring cell has better signal quality than the serving cell. A large value of this parameter indicates that neighboring cells must have better signal quality to trigger measurement reporting for inter-cell D-MIMO. For details, see 3GPP TS 36.

parameters.id: D-MIMO JT Cell RSRP Difference Threshold
parameters.name: D-MIMO JT Cell RSRP Difference Threshold
parameters.description: Indicates the RSRP difference threshold for D-MIMO joint transmission UEs in selecting coordinating cells. If this parameter is set to a large value, neighboring cells must have better signal quality to be coordinating cells, and a small number of UEs are identified as joint transmission UEs. If this parameter is set to a small value, a large number of UEs are identified as joint transmission UEs.

parameters.name: D-MIMO Cluster ID
parameters.description: Indicates the D-MIMO static cluster index. This parameter applies only to LTE TDD.

parameters.name: Coordinate Process Resource ID
parameters.description: Identifies a co-processing resource. If this parameter is set to 255, no co-processing resource is specified for the cluster. This parameter applies only to LTE TDD.

parameters.name: Beamforming Weight Normalized Mode
parameters.description: Indicates the beamforming weight normalization mode. If this parameter is set to NEBF(NEBF), all physical antennas consume the same amount of transmit power, but the orthogonality among paired UEs is affected. If this parameter is set to PEBF(PEBF), the orthogonality among paired UEs is not affected, but physical antennas consume different amount of transmit power. In this case, the power resource

parameters.name: Calibration Record Time
parameters.description: Indicates the time when the status of D-MIMO channel calibration results changes. This parameter applies only to LTE TDD.

parameters.id: eNodeB ID of First Calibration Unit
parameters.name: eNodeB ID of First Calibration Unit
parameters.description: Indicates the eNodeB ID of the first channel calibration unit (sector equipment or sector equipment group). This parameter applies only to LTE TDD.

parameters.id: Local Cell ID of First Calibration Unit
parameters.name: Local Cell ID of First Calibration Unit
parameters.description: Indicates the local cell ID of the first channel calibration unit (sector equipment or sector equipment group). This parameter applies only to LTE TDD.

parameters.id: Sector Flag of First Calibration Unit
parameters.name: Sector Flag of First Calibration Unit
parameters.description: Indicates whether the first channel calibration unit is sector equipment or sector equipment group. The value SectorEqm(SectorEqm) indicates sector equipment. The value SectorEqmGrp(SectorEqmGrp) indicates sector equipment group. This parameter applies only to LTE TDD.

parameters.id: eNodeB ID of Second Calibration Unit
parameters.name: eNodeB ID of Second Calibration Unit
parameters.description: Indicates the eNodeB ID of the second channel calibration unit (sector equipment or sector equipment group). This parameter applies only to LTE TDD.

parameters.id: Local Cell ID of Second Calibration Unit
parameters.name: Local Cell ID of Second Calibration Unit
parameters.description: Indicates the local cell ID of the second channel calibration unit (sector equipment or sector equipment group). This parameter applies only to LTE TDD.

parameters.id: Sector Flag of Second Calibration Unit
parameters.name: Sector Flag of Second Calibration Unit
parameters.description: Indicates whether the second channel calibration unit is sector equipment or sector equipment group. The value SectorEqm(SectorEqm) indicates sector equipment. The value SectorEqmGrp(SectorEqmGrp) indicates sector equipment group. This parameter applies only to LTE TDD.

parameters.id: SectorEqm ID of First Calibration Unit
parameters.name: SectorEqm ID of First Calibration Unit
parameters.description: Indicates the sector equipment ID or the sector equipment group ID of the first channel calibration unit. This parameter applies only to LTE TDD.

parameters.id: SectorEqm ID of Second Calibration Unit
parameters.name: SectorEqm ID of Second Calibration Unit
parameters.description: Indicates the sector equipment ID or the sector equipment group ID of the second channel calibration unit. This parameter applies only to LTE TDD.

parameters.name: D-MIMO Cluster Id
parameters.description: Indicates the D-MIMO static cluster index. This parameter applies only to LTE TDD.

parameters.name: Cell Id
parameters.description: Indicates the unique ID of a cell. The 28-bit E-UTRAN cell identity is comprised of the cell ID (represented by the least significant 8 bits) and the eNodeB ID. The cell global identity (CGI) of an E-UTRAN cell is comprised of the E-UTRAN cell identity and the PLMN ID. For details, see 3GPP TS 36.413. This parameter applies only to LTE TDD cells.

parameters.name: eNodeB Id
parameters.description: Indicates the ID of an eNodeB. The 28-bit E-UTRAN cell ID is comprised of the cell ID and the eNodeB ID (represented by the most significant 20 bits). The CGI of an E-UTRAN cell is comprised of the E-UTRAN cell ID and the PLMN ID. For details, see 3GPP TS 36.413. This parameter applies only to LTE TDD.

parameters.name: Mobile Country Code
parameters.description: Indicates the MCC of a D-MIMO cluster cell. A PLMN ID is comprised of an MCC and an MNC. The MCC consists of three digits. The MNC consists of two or three digits. For example, if the MCC is 123 and the MNC is 45, the PLMN ID is 12345. This parameter applies only to LTE TDD.

parameters.name: Mobile Network Code
parameters.description: Indicates the MNC of a D-MIMO cluster cell. A PLMN ID is comprised of an MCC and an MNC. The MCC consists of three digits. The MNC consists of two or three digits. For example, if the MCC is 123 and the MNC is 45, the PLMN ID is 12345. This parameter applies only to LTE TDD.

parameters.name: D-MIMO Cluster Cell Status
parameters.description: Indicates the status of a D-MIMO cluster and the reason why a D-MIMO cluster fails to take effect. This parameter applies only to LTE TDD.

parameters.name: D-MIMO Calibration Result
parameters.description: Indicates the result of channel calibration of the D-MIMO cluster. This parameter applies only to LTE TDD.

parameters.name: DNS SERVER ID.
parameters.description: Indicates the DNS server ID.

parameters.name: VRF Index
parameters.description: Indicates the index of a VRF instance. UMTS currently supports the default routing domain only (the VRF index is 0).

parameters.name: IP Version
parameters.description: Indicates the IP protocol version.

parameters.name: DNS Client IPv4
parameters.description: Indicates the IPv4 address of the DNS client.

parameters.name: DNS Server IPv4
parameters.description: Indicates the IPv4 address for the DNS server.

parameters.name: DNS Client IPv6
parameters.description: Indicates the IPv6 address of the DNS client.

parameters.name: DNS Server IPv6
parameters.description: Indicates the IPv6 address for the DNS server.

parameters.name: DNS Server Port No.
parameters.description: Indicates the number of the port on the DNS server. The port number must be the same as that configured on the peer DNS server.

parameters.name: DSCP
parameters.description: Indicates the DSCP of the DNS packet.

parameters.name: Initial Domain Name
parameters.description: Indicates the initial domain name during a DNS query.

parameters.name: Fully Qualified Domain Name
parameters.description: Indicates the full domain name returned by the DNS server during a DNS query.

parameters.name: IP
parameters.description: Indicates the IP address returned by the DNS server during a DNS query.

parameters.name: DNS Server
parameters.description: Indicates the IP address of the DNS server used during a DNS query.

parameters.name: Resolution Result
parameters.description: Indicates whether the DNS resolution succeeds. If the value of this parameter is Success, the DNS of the initial domain name is successfully resolved. If the value of this parameter is Fail, the DNS of the initial domain name fails to be resolved.

parameters.name: Fail Reason
parameters.description: Indicates the cause of the failed DNS resolution.

parameters.name: Resolution Time
parameters.description: Indicates the time of the DNS resolution.

parameters.name: DRX Flexibility Control Switch
parameters.description: Indicates whether to enable DRX flexibility. If this parameter is set to OFF, DRX configuration for UEs is restricted based on the UE number. If this parameter is set to ON, DRX configuration for UEs is restricted based on CPU flow control. This parameter does not support LBBPc. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: Local cell ID
parameters.description: Indicates the local ID of a cell, which uniquely identifies the cell within an eNodeB.

parameters.name: DRX parameter group ID
parameters.description: Indicates the ID of the DRX parameter group.

parameters.name: Enter DRX Switch
parameters.description: Indicates whether bearers to which the parameter group applies support DRX. The value ON indicates that the bearers support DRX. The value OFF indicates that the bearers do not support DRX. For NB-IoT UEs, this parameter applies only to the service-based QoS management feature. If this parameter is set to ON, the bearers support QCI-level DRX. If this parameter is set to OFF, the bearers do not su

parameters.name: On Duration Timer
parameters.description: Indicates the length of the On Duration Timer. If the configured value does not meet the restrictions of CQI reporting intervals and SRS transmission intervals, the actual value of this parameter assigned to a UE may be greater than the configured value. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: DRX Inactivity Timer
parameters.description: Indicates the length of the DRX inactivity timer. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: DRX Retransmission Timer
parameters.description: Indicates the length of the DRX Retransmission Timer. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: Long DRX Cycle
parameters.description: Indicates the length of the long DRX cycle. Because of the impact of the SRS bandwidth and TA period specified by the TimeAlignmentTimer parameter, the actual value of this parameter assigned to a UE may be less than the configured value. In addition, the configured value will be rounded down to an integral multiple of 10. Therefore, you are advised to set this parameter to a value that is an inte

parameters.name: Short-Cycle DRX Supported Indication
parameters.description: Indicates whether short DRX cycles are enabled. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: Short DRX Cycle
parameters.description: Indicates the length of the short DRX cycle. According to 3GPP specifications, the length of a long DRX cycle must be an integer multiple of that of a short DRX cycle. In addition, the actual value of LongDrxCycle assigned to a UE may be less than the configured value because of the restrictions of the SRS bandwidth and TA period specified by the TimeAlignmentTimer parameter. Therefore, the actual

parameters.name: DRX Short Cycle Timer
parameters.description: Indicates the length of the DRX Short Cycle Timer. If this parameter is set to 1, the length of this timer is one short DRX cycle. If this parameter is set to 2, the length of this timer is two short DRX cycles. If this parameter is set to a large value, a UE for which short DRX cycles are enabled stays in short-cycle DRX for a long time. For details, see section 5.7 in 3GPP TS 36.321. This parame

parameters.name: Uplink DRX Retransmission Timer
parameters.description: Indicates the length of the uplink DRX Retransmission Timer. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: Extended Long DRX Cycle
parameters.description: Indicates the length of the extended long DRX cycle. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: Extended Long DRX Cycle Switch
parameters.description: Indicates whether to enable extended long DRX cycles. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: Category Type
parameters.description: Indicates the UE category type. If this parameter is set to LTE, EMTC_MODE_A, or EMTC_MODE_B, other parameters in this MO apply to LTE UEs, eMTC UEs in mode A, or eMTC UEs in mode B, respectively. If this parameter is set to NB-IoT, other parameters in this MO apply to NB-IoT UEs.

parameters.name: NB-IoT DRX Inactivity Timer
parameters.description: Indicates the length of the DRX Inactivity Timer of an NB-IoT UE. The unit is the PDCCH period of the coverage level corresponding to a UE. This parameter applies only to NB-IoT.

parameters.name: NB-IoT DRX Retransmission Timer
parameters.description: Indicates the length of the DRX Retransmission Timer for an NB-IoT UE. The unit is the PDCCH period of the coverage level corresponding to a UE. This parameter applies only to NB-IoT.

parameters.name: NB-IoT DRX Uplink Retransmission Timer
parameters.description: Indicates the length of the DRX Uplink Retransmission Timer for an NB-IoT UE. The unit is the PDCCH period of the coverage level corresponding to a UE. This parameter applies only to NB-IoT.

parameters.name: NB-IoT Long DRX Cycle
parameters.description: Indicates the length of the Long DRX Cycle for an NB-IoT UE. This parameter applies only to NB-IoT.

parameters.name: NB-IoT On Duration Timer
parameters.description: Indicates the length of the On Duration Timer for an NB-IoT UE. The unit is the PDCCH period of the coverage level corresponding to a UE. This parameter applies only to NB-IoT.

parameters.name: ECO ID
parameters.description: Indicates the ID of the ECO MO. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: End Point Group Config Flag
parameters.description: Indicates whether to configure the control-plane endpoint group, user-plane endpoint group, or both endpoint groups for the ECO MO. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.id: Control Plane End Point Group ID
parameters.name: Control Plane End Point Group ID
parameters.description: Indicates the ID of the control-plane endpoint group used by the ECO MO. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.id: User Plane End Point Group ID
parameters.name: User Plane End Point Group ID
parameters.description: Indicates the ID of the user-plane endpoint group used by the ECO MO. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: User Label
parameters.description: Indicates the descriptions of the ECO MO. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: ECO Interface CP Bearer ID
parameters.description: Indicates the ID of the control port (CP) bearer for the ECO interface. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: ECO Interface CP Bearer State
parameters.description: Indicates the status of the control port (CP) bearer for the ECO interface. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: CN Operator ID
parameters.description: Indicates the ID of the operator. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: Emergency call enabled switch
parameters.description: Indicates whether the operator supports emergency calls. It is recommended that this parameter be set to a value in accordance with the actual emergency call capability of the operator. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.id: Emergency call enabled switch in limited mode
parameters.name: Emergency call enabled switch in limited mode
parameters.description: Indicates whether the operator supports emergency calls initiated by UEs in the limited service state. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.id: The ARP of EMC dedicated bearer
parameters.name: The ARP of EMC dedicated bearer
parameters.description: Indicates the Allocation and Retention Priority (ARP) value of the dedicated bearer for an emergency call. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.id: The ARP of EMC default bearer
parameters.name: The ARP of EMC default bearer
parameters.description: Indicates the Allocation and Retention Priority (ARP) value of the default bearer for an emergency call. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: Emergency Call Optimization Switch
parameters.description: Indicates whether to enable optimization functions of emergency calls. TM_RESTRICTION_DISABLE_SW: Indicates whether to cancel TM mode selection restriction for emergency calls. If this option is selected, emergency calls do not always use TM2 but use the same TM mode as common calls. If this option is deselected, emergency calls always use TM2 in non-single-port scenarios. parameters.name: Local Cell ID
parameters.description: Indicates the local cell ID. It uniquely identifies a cell within an eNodeB. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: Coverage Level
parameters.description: Indicates the coverage level for UEs. If this parameter is set to COVERAGE_LEVEL_0, COVERAGE_LEVEL_1, COVERAGE_LEVEL_2, or COVERAGE_LEVEL_3, the coverage level for UEs is coverage level 0, coverage level 1, coverage level 2, or coverage level 3, respectively. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: Initial Number of MPDCCH Repetitions
parameters.description: Indicates the initial number of MPDCCH repetitions for UEs at a specified coverage level. For details, see 3GPP TS 36.213. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.id: Initial Number of MPDCCH Rep for Type1 CSS
parameters.name: Initial Number of MPDCCH Rep for Type1 CSS
parameters.description: Indicates the initial number of repetitions of the type-1 CSS MPDCCH for UEs at the specified coverage level. Given that UE coverage level information is unavailable in type-1 CSS, the number specified by this parameter for the highest coverage level supported by the cell takes effect. For details, see 3GPP TS 36.213. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: Max Number of MPDCCH Repetitions
parameters.description: Indicates the maximum number of MPDCCH repetitions for UEs at the specified coverage level. For details, see 3GPP TS 36.213. parameters.name: Initial Number of PDSCH Repetitions
parameters.description: Indicates the initial number of PDSCH repetitions for UEs at a specified coverage level. For details, see 3GPP TS 36.213. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.id: Initial Number of PDSCH Rep for Type1 CSS
parameters.name: Initial Number of PDSCH Rep for Type1 CSS
parameters.description: Indicates the initial number of repetitions of the type-1 CSS PDSCH for UEs at the specified coverage level. parameters.name: Initial Number of PUSCH Repetitions
parameters.description: Indicates the initial number of PUSCH repetitions for UEs at a specified coverage level. For details, see 3GPP TS 36.213. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: Local Cell ID
parameters.description: Indicates the local cell ID. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: eMTC SIB ID
parameters.description: Indicates the SIB type of an eMTC cell. SIB types supported by an eMTC cell include SIB2, SIB3, SIB4, SIB5, and SIB14. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: eMTC SIB Period
parameters.description: Indicates the SIB transmission period in an eMTC cell. This parameter is valid only when the EmtcSibId parameter is set. If this parameter is set to RF32 and the EmtcSibId parameter is set to SIB2, the transmission period of SIB2 in an eMTC cell is 320 ms. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: Local cell ID
parameters.description: Indicates the local ID of the cell. It uniquely identifies a cell within a BS. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: Local tracking area ID
parameters.description: Indicates the local tracking area identity of the cell, which uniquely identifies an operator's record of tracking area information within a cell. This parameter is used only in the eNodeB and is different from the TAI configured in the TAL on the MME. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: QoS Class Indication
parameters.description: Indicates the QoS class identifier (QCI) of an evolved packet system (EPS) bearer. Different QCIs indicate different QoS requirements, such as the packet delay budget, packet loss rate (PLR) and packet error rate (PER), and resource type (whether the service is a GBR service or not). For details, see Table 6.1.7 in 3GPP TS 23.203. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: OPRD
parameters.description: Indicates the license alarm detection period. The eNodeB checks license control items in each period and reports a license-related alarm if the corresponding reporting condition is met.

parameters.name: OTHD
parameters.description: Indicates the license alarm reporting threshold. A license alarm is reported if the proportion of the actually used value to the allocated value of the license control item exceeds this threshold.

parameters.name: RPRD
parameters.description: Indicates the license alarm clearing period. During this period, the eNodeB checks license control items and clears license alarms if the condition for clearing license alarms is met.

parameters.name: RTHD
parameters.description: Indicates the license alarm clearing threshold. A license alarm is cleared if the proportion of the actually used value to the allocated value of the license control item is below this threshold. If this parameter is set to 0, the capacity license alarm must be cleared manually.

parameters.name: Mobile country code
parameters.description: Indicates the mobile country code of the peer base station in the EN-DC X2 blacklist or whitelist. The value of this parameter is a string of three decimal digits. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: Mobile network code
parameters.description: Indicates the mobile network code of the peer base station in the EN-DC X2 blacklist or whitelist. The value of this parameter is a string of two or three decimal digits. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: gNodeB ID
parameters.description: Indicates the ID of the peer base station in the EN-DC X2 blacklist or whitelist. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: List Type
parameters.description: Indicates whether the EN-DC X2 list is a blacklist or whitelist. If a peer gNodeB is in the blacklist, an X2 interface between the local eNodeB and this gNodeB cannot be automatically set up and the X2 interface set up between the local eNodeB and this gNodeB is abnormal.
