SsrdSchOptSwitch: Indicates whether to enable scheduling optimization for intra-frequency soft

parameters.id: IoT Clock Jump Cell Reset Switch
parameters.name: IoT Clock Jump Cell Reset Switch
parameters.description: IOT_SRV_IMPACT_CELL_RESET_SW: Indicates whether the eNodeB reestablishes NB-IoT cells if a clock jump occurs. The eNodeB reestablishes NB-IoT cells when a clock jump occurs only if this option is selected. This option applies only to NB-IoT.

parameters.name: CA Algorithm Extend Switch
parameters.description: Indicates whether to enable carrier aggregation (CA) functions. This parameter extends the function of the CaAlgoSwitch parameter in the ENodeBAlgoSwitch MO. FTMtaAlgSwitch: Indicates whether to enable multiple timing advances (MTA) for uplink FDD+TDD CA. If this option is selected and uplink FDD+TDD CA is enabled, MTA is supported in uplink FDD+TDD CA scenarios. In this situation, if the capabili

parameters.name: UL Resource Management Optimization Switch
parameters.description: Indicates whether to enable functions related to uplink resource optimization. UL_RBCALC_OPT_SWITCH: Indicates whether to enable the optimization of uplink RB quantity calculation for cell-edge UEs and optimization of UL CoMP resource pools. If this option is selected, the eNodeB optimizes uplink RB quantity calculation for cell-edge UEs and the use of UL CoMP resources when the scheduler-controll

parameters.id: LTE User Preempt NB-IoT User Switch
parameters.name: LTE User Preempt NB-IoT User Switch
parameters.description: Indicates whether to allow LTE UEs to preempt the RRC connections of NB-IoT UEs during admission. When this parameter is set to ON, LTE UEs can preempt the RRC connections of NB-IoT UEs during admission. However, LTE UEs can no longer preempt the RRC connections of NB-IoT UEs when the number of RRC connections of NB-IoT UEs has dropped to the reserved minimum number. When this parameter is set to

parameters.name: Interference Optimization Switch
parameters.description: Indicates whether to enable interference optimization. UL_RB_INTRF_OPT_SWITCH: Indicates whether to optimize uplink RB-level interference. If this option is selected, gain compensation is provided for RBs under uplink interference. If this option is deselected, uplink RB-level interference is not optimized. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD.

parameters.name: V2X Algorithm Switch
parameters.description: Indicates whether to enable algorithms related to V2X services. QCI3_IS_V2X_SWITCH: Indicates whether QCI 3 services are V2X services. If this option is selected, QCI 3 services are V2X services. If this option is deselected, QCI 3 services are not V2X services. This option applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: MFBI Auto Configure Switch
parameters.description: Indicates whether to enable automatic MFBI configuration. CONFIG_SEC_BAND_FOR_BAND33: Indicates whether to enable automatic configuration of a secondary frequency band for band 33. If this option is selected when band 33 is configured as the primary frequency band, a secondary frequency band is automatically added or deleted. If this option is deselected when band 33 is configured as the primary f

parameters.name: Virtual Grid Algorithm Switch
parameters.description: Indicates whether to enable virtual grid algorithms. AI_GRID_FUN_SW: Indicates whether to enable virtual-grid-based measurement result prediction. If this option is selected, the eNodeB constructs a virtual grid model used to predict measurement results for algorithm optimization. If this option is deselected, the eNodeB does not construct such a virtual grid model. This option applies only to LTE

parameters.name: Clock Check Enhancement Switch
parameters.description: Indicates whether to enable enhanced LTE clock detection. If this parameter is set to ON, the eNodeB enables enhanced LTE clock detection. If this parameter is set to OFF, the eNodeB disables enhanced LTE clock detection.

parameters.name: RRU Location Switch
parameters.description: Indicates whether to enable RRU locating. FDD_RRU_LOCATION_SWITCH: If this option is selected, RRU locating is enabled for LTE FDD. If this option is deselected, RRU locating is disabled for LTE FDD. TDD_RRU_LOCATION_SWITCH: If this option is selected, RRU locating is enabled for LTE TDD. If this option is deselected, RRU locating is disabled for LTE TDD.

parameters.name: Clock Check Enhancement Sensitivity
parameters.description: Indicates the sensitivity of enhanced LTE clock detection. This parameter is valid only when the ClockCheckEnhSwitch parameter in the ENodeBAlgoSwitch MO is set to ON. Among the three values HIGH, MEDIUM, and LOW of this parameter, HIGH indicates the highest level of clock detection sensitivity, MEDIUM indicates a medium level of clock detection sensitivity, and LOW indicates the lowest level of c

parameters.name: Hardware Capability Extension Switch
parameters.description: Indicates whether to extend the hardware capability. BBP_TRANS_CAPB_ENH_SW: Indicates whether to enhance the BBP transmission capability. If this option is selected, BBPs receive downlink data packets based on the maximum BBP capability. If this option is deselected, BBPs receive downlink data packets based on the peak throughput over the air interface. This option applies only to UBBP boards.

parameters.name: Traffic Faulty Detect Period
parameters.description: Indicates the length for detecting service abnormality when the devices are suspected to experience soft failures. If service abnormality persists within the period of time specified by this parameter while the devices are suspected to experience soft failures, the devices are considered to experience soft failures.

parameters.name: Service Interface Alarm Configure Switch
parameters.description: Indicates whether to mask ALM-25888 SCTP Link Fault, ALM-25952 User Plane Path Fault, and ALM-25886 IP Path Fault. If the options of this parameter are selected, ALM-25888 SCTP Link Fault masking takes effect immediately, and ALM-25952 User Plane Bearer Link Fault (When the User Plane and Control Plane Are the Same Peer End, User Labels on the User Plane and SCTP Peer End Include GlobaleNBId_MCC-M

parameters.name: RF module sleep switch
parameters.description: Indicates the switch for RF module regular time sleep. Cells are unavailable after the eNodeB enters RF module regular time sleep. After the eNodeB exits RF module regular time sleep, it is in the normal state. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and NB-IoT.

parameters.name: RF module sleep start time
parameters.description: Indicates the time for entering RF module regular time sleep. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and NB-IoT.

parameters.name: RF module sleep stop time
parameters.description: Indicates the time for exiting RF module regular time sleep. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and NB-IoT.

parameters.name: RF module sleep status
parameters.description: Indicates the sleep status of the RF modules of the eNodeB. The value POWER_OFF indicates that cells on the eNodeB are unavailable. The value NORMAL indicates that the eNodeB is working normally. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and NB-IoT.

parameters.name: CHR UpLoading Time Switch
parameters.description: Indicates the time when CHRs are uploaded. If this parameter is set to FIXED_TIME, CHRs are uploaded at a fixed time based on the standard time. If this parameter is set to NON_FIXED_TIME, CHRs are uploaded at a specific interval since system startup.

parameters.name: SIG Output Mode
parameters.description: Indicates the mode of exporting periodically exported UE-level SIG events. (This parameter does not apply to non-periodically exported UE-level SIG events, periodically exported UE-level SIG events with instantaneous values, or cell-level SIG events.) If this parameter is set to ALL_OUTPUT(ALL_OUTPUT), the eNodeB exports UE-level SIG events periodically and upon bearer or UE release. If this param

parameters.name: CHR Output Control Switch
parameters.description: Indicates the switches that control the output of CHR and SIG logs of the eNodeB. STMSI_MASK_SW: If this option is selected, S-TMSI mask enabled. With this function, all S-TMSIs in internal and external CHRs are replaced by 0. If this option is deselected, this function is disabled. PUBLIC_TRC_ALIGN_SW: Indicates whether to align the output of the external CHR event PUBLIC INFO with the output of

parameters.name: SIG Report Switch
parameters.description: Indicates whether to report SIG logs and signaling soft collection results. If this parameter is set to ON, SIG logs and signaling soft collection results that have been subscribed to are normally reported. If this parameter is set to OFF, reporting of these SIG logs and signaling soft collection results is forcibly terminated and new subscriptions no longer take effect.

parameters.name: Event Subscription Info
parameters.description: Indicates the IDs of successfully subscribed events displayed in the result of the DSP ENODEBCHROUTPUTCTRL command.

parameters.name: Primary cipher algorithm
parameters.description: Indicates the highest-priority ciphering algorithm for the eNodeB. If this parameter is set to NULL, ciphering is not used. If this parameter is set to NOT_CFG, the eNodeB skips the algorithm of this priority when selecting the ciphering algorithm.

parameters.name: Second cipher algorithm
parameters.description: Indicates the second-priority ciphering algorithm for the eNodeB. If this parameter is set to NULL, ciphering is not used. If this parameter is set to NOT_CFG, the eNodeB skips the algorithm of this priority when selecting the ciphering algorithm.

parameters.name: Third cipher algorithm
parameters.description: Indicates the third-priority ciphering algorithm for the eNodeB. If this parameter is set to NULL, ciphering is not used. If this parameter is set to NOT_CFG, the eNodeB skips the algorithm of this priority when selecting the ciphering algorithm.

parameters.name: Fourth cipher algorithm
parameters.description: Indicates the fourth-priority ciphering algorithm for the eNodeB. If this parameter is set to NULL, ciphering is not used. If this parameter is set to NOT_CFG, the eNodeB skips the algorithm of this priority when selecting the ciphering algorithm.

parameters.name: eNodeB Index
parameters.description: Indicates the index of an eNodeB managed by the centralized clustering node. It uniquely identifies an eNodeB on the centralized clustering node. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: Mobile Country Code
parameters.description: Indicates the MCC of an eNodeB managed by the centralized clustering node. A PLMN ID is composed of an MCC and an MNC. The MCC consists of three digits. The MNC consists of two or three digits. For example, if the MCC is 123 and the MNC is 45, the PLMN ID is 12345. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: Mobile Network Code
parameters.description: Indicates the MNC of an eNodeB managed by the centralized clustering node. A PLMN ID is composed of an MCC and an MNC. The MCC consists of three digits. The MNC consists of two or three digits. For example, if the MCC is 123 and the MNC is 45, the PLMN ID is 12345. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: eNodeB ID
parameters.description: Indicates the ID of an eNodeB managed by the centralized clustering node. A local cell ID and an eNodeB ID compose a 28-bit E-UTRAN cell ID, where the eNodeB ID is represented by the 20 most significant bits. An E-UTRAN cell ID and a PLMN ID compose an E-UTRAN CGI (ECGI). For details about this parameter, see 3GPP TS 36.413. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: S1 Message Waiting Timer
parameters.description: Indicates the timer governing the period that the eNodeB waits for a response message from the MME when the UE is running non-QCI1 services. If the UE is running services with a QCI of 1, the S1MsgWaitingTimerQci1 parameter controls the period that the eNodeB waits for a response message from the MME.

parameters.name: X2 Message Waiting Timer
parameters.description: Indicates the length of the timer governing the period in which the eNodeB waits for an X2 response message from a peer eNodeB when a UE is not performing any QCI-1 service. If the eNodeB performs an X2-based handover for a UE performing a QCI-1 service, the period is determined by the value of the X2MessageWaitingTimerQci1 parameter.

parameters.name: UU Message Waiting Timer
parameters.description: Indicates the timer governing the period the eNodeB waits for a response message from a UE when the UE is running non-QCI1 services. If the timer expires, the eNodeB initiates a UE context release over the S1 interface.

parameters.name: CDMA2000 1xRTT HO Uu Prepare Timer
parameters.description: Indicates the timer for the eNodeB to wait for a handover preparation completion message when a UE is being handed over to a CDMA2000 1xRTT cell. The eNodeB starts the timer after sending a Handover From EUTRA Preparation Request message to the UE and stops the timer after receiving a UL Handover Preparation Transfer message from the UE. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: CDMA2000 1xRTT HO S1 Waiting Timer
parameters.description: Indicates the timer for the eNodeB to wait for a Downlink S1 CDMA2000 Tunneling message when a UE being is handed over to a CDMA2000 1xRTT cell. The eNodeB starts the timer after sending an UPLINK S1 CDMA2000 TUNNELING message to the MME and stops the timer after receiving a Downlink S1 CDMA2000 Tunneling message containing CDMA2000 HO Status. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: CDMA2000 1xRTT HO Complete Timer
parameters.description: Indicates the timer for the eNodeB to release resources for a UE after the UE is handed over to a CDMA2000 1xRTT cell. The eNodeB starts the timer after sending a MobilityFromEUTRACommand message. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: CDMA2000 HRPD HO Complete Timer
parameters.description: Indicates the timer for the eNodeB to release resources for a UE after the UE is handed over to a CDMA2000 HRPD cell. The eNodeB starts the timer after sending a MobilityFromEUTRACommand message. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.id: CDMA2000 HRPD HO S1 Waiting Timer
parameters.name: CDMA2000 HRPD HO S1 Waiting Timer
parameters.description: Indicates the timer for the eNodeB to wait for a Downlink S1 CDMA2000 Tunneling message when a UE is being handed over to a CDMA2000 HRPD cell. The eNodeB starts the timer after sending an UPLINK S1 CDMA2000 TUNNELING message to the MME and stops the timer after receiving a Downlink S1 CDMA2000 Tunneling message containing CDMA2000 HO Status. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.id: CDMA2000 HRPD HO Uu Prepare Timer
parameters.name: CDMA2000 HRPD HO Uu Prepare Timer
parameters.description: Indicates the timer for the eNodeB to wait for a handover preparation completion message when a UE is being handed over to a CDMA2000 HRPD cell. The eNodeB starts the timer after sending a Handover From EUTRA Preparation Request message to the UE and stops the timer after receiving a UL Handover Preparation Transfer message from the UE. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: RRCConnSetupCmp Waiting Timer
parameters.description: Indicates the timer for the eNodeB to wait for an RRC Connection Setup Complete message.

parameters.name: SecurityModeComplete Waiting Timer
parameters.description: Indicates the length of the timer governing the period in which the eNodeB waits for a Security Mode Complete message from a UE. If the UuMsgSimulSendSwitch parameter in the GlobalProcSwitch MO is set to ON and the UeCapbEnquirySecurityEnhSwitch option of the ProtocolMsgOptSwitch parameter in this MO is deselected, the SecCmpWaitingTimer parameter does not take effect and the UuMessageWaitingTimer

parameters.id: UE Capability Info Message Waiting Timer
parameters.name: UE Capability Info Message Waiting Timer
parameters.description: Indicates the length of the timer governing the period in which the eNodeB waits for a UE Capability Information message from a UE. For details about this message, see 3GPP TS 36.331.

parameters.name: First Forward Packet Timer
parameters.description: Indicates the timer for the eNodeB to wait for the first forwarded packet. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: End Marker Timer
parameters.description: Indicates the timer for the eNodeB to wait for the endmarker packet. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.id: S1 Message Waiting Timer for Qci1
parameters.name: S1 Message Waiting Timer for Qci1
parameters.description: Indicates the timer governing the period that the eNodeB waits for a response message from the MME when the UE is running services with the QCI of 1. If the timer expires, the eNodeB initiates a UE context release over the S1 interface. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.id: X2 Message Waiting Timer for Qci1
parameters.name: X2 Message Waiting Timer for Qci1
parameters.description: Indicates the length of the timer governing the period in which the eNodeB waits for an X2 response message from a peer eNodeB when a UE is performing a QCI-1 service. If this timer expires, the eNodeB processes in the same way as it processes when the timer specified by the X2MessageWaitingTimer parameter expires. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.id: UU Message Waiting Timer for Qci1
parameters.name: UU Message Waiting Timer for Qci1
parameters.description: Indicates the timer governing the period the eNodeB waits for a response message from a UE when the UE is running services with the QCI of 1. If the timer expires, the eNodeB initiates a UE context release over the S1 interface. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: Bearer Activity Threshold
parameters.description: Indicates the threshold used to determine bearer activity. The eNodeB consistently monitors the consecutive no-transmission duration for each bearer. If the duration for a bearer is less than or equal to the threshold, the eNodeB determines that the bearer is active. If this parameter is set to 65535, the eNodeB does not determine bearer activity for performance counter measurement. This parameter

parameters.name: RRC Reestablishment Activity Threshold
parameters.description: Indicates the switch that controls the measurement optimization of service drops for UEs in the active state and the threshold based on which the eNodeB determines whether RRC connection reestablishments are for UEs in the active state. When this parameter is used as the switch: If this parameter is set to a value other than 0, the measurement optimization is enabled, and the eNodeB collects stati

parameters.name: E-CID Waiting Timer
parameters.description: Indicates the length of the timer that controls how the eNodeB responds to an E-CID-based positioning request message after receiving the message from the E-SMLC. Before the timer expires, if the eNodeB has already collected all E-CID measurement results, the eNodeB immediately responds to the request. If the timer expires, the eNodeB sends all measurement results that are already collected to the

parameters.id: NSA DC X2 Message Waiting Timer
parameters.name: NSA DC X2 Message Waiting Timer
parameters.description: Indicates the timer governing the period in which the eNodeB waits for an X2 response message from a peer gNodeB. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: VoLTE Counter Algorithm Switch
parameters.description: Indicates whether to enable algorithms related to VoLTE counters. This parameter provides the following option: VOLTE_LINK_ABN_DETECTION_SW: If this option is selected, the eNodeB performs link abnormality detection for VoLTE UEs and counts the E-RAB releases due to link abnormality as abnormal E-RAB releases in E-RAB-related counter measurements. If this option is deselected, the eNodeB does not

parameters.name: eNodeB Counter Algorithm Switch
parameters.description: Indicates whether to enable algorithms related to eNodeB-level counters. This parameter provides the following options: MME_ABN_REL_SAME_TMSI_CHECK_SW: If this option is selected, the eNodeB checks accesses of other calls with the same TMSI in MME-triggered abnormal release scenarios. In MME-triggered abnormal release scenarios, if the eNodeB determines that the abnormal release is caused by the a

parameters.name: Adaptive Unsynchronized Timer Length
parameters.description: Indicates whether an adaptive asynchronization UE is selected when the adaptive asynchronization function is enabled. If a UE does not transmit or receive data for a period of time that is longer than the AdaptUnsyncTimerLen parameter value, the UE is a candidate adaptive asynchronization UE. When this parameter value is larger than or equal to the QCIPARA.UeInactiveTimerForQci parameter value, th

parameters.name: Adaptive Unsynchronized User Num Threshold
parameters.description: Indicates the threshold of the ratio of uplink-synchronized UEs in a cell or a baseband processing unit. If the ratio of uplink-synchronized UEs in a cell or a baseband processing unit exceeds this threshold, the eNodeB adaptively enables some UEs that do not transmit or receive data for a period of time greater than the AdaptUnsyncTimerLen parameter value to enter the asynchronization state. As a

parameters.name: Dynamic AC Barring Policy Mode
parameters.description: Indicates the policy of determining cell congestion for intelligent AC control, dynamic service specific access control (SSAC), and extended access barring (EAB). When this parameter is set to FLOWCONTROL, an eNodeB determines the congestion state of a cell based on the flow control status. When this parameter is set to CPULOAD, an eNodeB determines the congestion state of a cell based on the CPU

parameters.name: CPU Load Threshold
parameters.description: Indicates the CPU load threshold of a board. If the CPU load of a main control board or baseband processing unit serving the cells is greater than or equal to this parameter value, the cells are congested. If the CPU load is less than this parameter value, the cells are not congested. This parameter takes effect only when the DynAcBarPolicyMode parameter is set to CPULOAD(CPULOAD).

parameters.name: MCPTT Message Count Switch
parameters.description: Indicates the configuration level switch of the number of access messages for MCPTT services. If this parameter is set to OFF, service access is not affected by the number of access messages. If this parameter is set to HIGH, MEDIUM, or LOW, the service access number differs depending on the configuration level. The values of HIGH, MEDIUM, and LOW indicate the high, medium, and low allowed service

parameters.id: Dynamic AC Barring Trigger All Cell Switch
parameters.name: Dynamic AC Barring Trigger All Cell Switch
parameters.description: Indicates whether dynamic access class (AC) control is triggered and takes effect on all cells on a board. If this parameter is set to ON, dynamic AC control is triggered and takes effect on all cells based on the board flow control status. If this parameter is set to OFF, dynamic AC control is triggered and takes effect on heavy-load cells based on flow control. This parameter applies only to LTE

parameters.name: NSA Flow Control Strategy
parameters.description: Indicates the NSA flow control policy. If this parameter is set to USER_CAPACITY_PREFERRED, the policy is UE capacity preferred. In this case, when the CPU usage is high, the eNodeB performs flow control over SCG addition for NSA UEs, to preferentially ensure that more UEs can access the network. If this parameter is set to NSA_SCG_PREFERRED, the policy is SCG addition for NSA UEs preferred. In th

parameters.name: TDD Frame Offset
parameters.description: Indicates the offset of the start time of a cell frame against a reference clock source. This offset applies to all LTE TDD cells served by an eNodeB.

parameters.name: FDD Frame Offset
parameters.description: Indicates the offset of the start time of a cell frame against a reference clock source. This offset applies to all LTE FDD cells and all NB-IoT cells served by an eNodeB. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and NB-IoT.

parameters.name: Frame Offset Auto Correct Switch
parameters.description: Indicates whether to enable automatic frame offset correction. If this option is selected and the frame offset of a cell is different from that of its neighboring cells, the eNodeB automatically changes the frame offset of this cell to that of the neighboring cells. If this option is deselected, the eNodeB cannot automatically change the frame offset of a cell. This parameter applies only to LTE T

parameters.name: eNodeB ID
parameters.description: Indicates the eNodeB ID of an E-UTRAN neighboring cell. It uniquely identifies an eNodeB within a PLMN. This parameter is used to filter out neighboring cells with an incorrect eNodeB ID. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: Primary integrity algorithm
parameters.description: Indicates the highest-priority integrity protection algorithm supported by the eNodeB. If this parameter is set to NOT_CFG, the eNodeB skips the algorithm of this priority when selecting the integrity protection algorithm.

parameters.name: Second integrity algorithm
parameters.description: Indicates the second-priority integrity protection algorithm supported by the eNodeB. If this parameter is set to NOT_CFG, the eNodeB skips the algorithm of this priority when selecting the integrity protection algorithm.

parameters.name: Third integrity algorithm
parameters.description: Indicates the third-priority integrity protection algorithm supported by the eNodeB. If this parameter is set to NOT_CFG, the eNodeB skips the algorithm of this priority when selecting the integrity protection algorithm.

parameters.name: NULL Algorithm config switch
parameters.description: Indicates whether the eNodeB can use the null algorithm for integrity protection. If this parameter is set to Disable, UE access using the null algorithm is prohibited. If this parameter is set to Enable, UE access using the null algorithm is supported. If this parameter is set to EnableToEia0Eea0CapbOnlyUe, access of UEs with security capabilities including only EIA0 and EEA0 is allowed regardles

parameters.name: Inter Frequency Idle MLB Mode
parameters.description: Indicates the mode for eNodeB-level inter-frequency MLB for UEs in idle mode. ADAPTIVE_PROPORTION: Indicates whether to enable load balancing in adaptive proportions. If the ADAPTIVE_PROPORTION option of this parameter and the INTER_FREQ_IDLE_MLB_SWITCH option of the MlbAlgoSwitch parameter are selected, the eNodeB timely adjusts the proportions of UEs to be released among frequencies based on the

parameters.name: Inter Frequency Idle MLB Interval
parameters.description: Indicates the measurement period of eNodeB-level inter-frequency MLB for UEs in idle mode. If the INTER_FREQ_IDLE_MLB_SWITCH option of the MlbAlgoSwitch parameter in the ENodeBAlgoSwitch MO is selected, the eNodeB collects the number of uplink synchronized UEs at a period specified by the InterFreqIdleMlbInterval parameter. At the end of a measurement period, the eNodeB updates the policy for inte

parameters.id: Inter Frequency Idle MLB Statistic Threshold
parameters.name: Inter Frequency Idle MLB Statistic Threshold
parameters.description: Indicates the sample threshold of eNodeB-level inter-frequency MLB for UEs in idle mode. This parameter specifies whether to update the load balancing policy based on the statistics of eNodeB-level inter-frequency MLB for UEs in idle mode. If the INTER_FREQ_IDLE_MLB_SWITCH option of the MlbAlgoSwitch parameter in the ENodeBAlgoSwitch MO is selected, the eNodeB periodically measures the average num

parameters.id: DL CA LB Max Component Carrier Number
parameters.name: DL CA LB Max Component Carrier Number
parameters.description: Indicates the maximum number of CCs aggregated for a CA UE whose load is to be transferred for load balancing in the downlink. If this parameter is set to 2CC(2CC), load of CA UEs using two CCs can be transferred for load balancing in the downlink. If this parameter is set to 3CC(3CC), load of CA UEs using two or three CCs can be transferred for load balancing in the downlink. This parameter appli

parameters.id: CA UE Minimum Data Volume Ratio
parameters.name: CA UE Minimum Data Volume Ratio
parameters.description: Indicates the minimum data volume ratio between two CCs of a CA UE whose load is to be transferred. For example, if this parameter is set to 20, the minimum ratio of the data volume on a heavily loaded CC to that on a lightly loaded CC is 1/5. If this parameter is set to 0, the minimum ratio of the data volume on a heavily loaded CC to that on a lightly loaded CC is 0/1, that is, all data on the h

parameters.name: MPRU Dormancy Downlink EARFCN
parameters.description: Indicates the downlink EARFCN of the basic coverage carrier to be reserved after the MPRU enters dormancy. If this parameter is set to -1, MPRU dormancy is disabled. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.id: MPRU Dormancy Downlink PRB Usage Threshold
parameters.name: MPRU Dormancy Downlink PRB Usage Threshold
parameters.description: Indicates the downlink PRB usage threshold for MPRU dormancy. If the downlink PRB usage of a carrier is lower than the value of this threshold, the MPRU enters dormancy. If the downlink PRB usage of a carrier is higher than the sum of the value of this threshold and a preset offset (5%), the MPRU exits dormancy. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: MPRU Dormancy Minimum RSRP
parameters.description: Indicates the minimum RSRP of the basic coverage carrier to be reserved after the MPRU enters dormancy. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: MPRU Dormancy Start Time
parameters.description: Indicates the start time of MPRU dormancy. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: MPRU Dormancy Stop Time
parameters.description: Indicates the end time of MPRU dormancy. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.id: High-Priority UE MT Flow Control Level
parameters.name: High-Priority UE MT Flow Control Level
parameters.description: Indicates the MT flow control level for the cell DT and internal CHRs of high-priority UEs. A larger value (non-zero) of this parameter leads to a higher flow control threshold for the cell DT and internal CHRs of high-priority UEs. If this parameter is set to 0, the flow control level is not configurable. For the definition of high-priority UEs, see 3GPP TS 36.331. This parameter applies only to

parameters.name: CHR Flow Control Switch
parameters.description: Indicates whether to enable flow control on external CHRs. ChrFlowControlSwitch: Indicates whether to enable enhanced flow control on external CHRs. If this option is selected, the number of external CHR sampling points is reduced to decrease the system load and improve user experience. If this option is deselected, the number of external CHR sampling points is not reduced, and the system load is

parameters.id: SIG Log MT Flow Control Level
parameters.name: SIG Log MT Flow Control Level
parameters.description: Indicates the CPU flow control level of SIG logs on the main control board. A larger value of this parameter indicates a higher CPU threshold for triggering the main control board to discard SIG data and a lower probability of discarding SIG logs due to flow control. 0 indicates that SIG log reporting is disabled on the main control board. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.id: TRC Log MT Flow Control Level
parameters.name: TRC Log MT Flow Control Level
parameters.description: Indicates the CPU flow control level of TRC logs on the main control board. A larger value of this parameter indicates a higher CPU threshold for triggering the main control board to discard TRC data and a lower probability of discarding TRC logs due to flow control. 0 indicates that TRC log reporting is disabled on the main control board. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.id: NB-IoT Reserved Minimum User Number Ratio
parameters.name: NB-IoT Reserved Minimum User Number Ratio
parameters.description: Indicates the minimum proportion of UEs in RRC_CONNECTED mode reserved for NB-IoT. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and NB-IoT.

parameters.name: NB-IoT Extended Paging Optimization Switch

parameters.name: X2 Interface ID

If this parameter is set to ON, the eNodeB automatically changes the BaseBandEqmId parameter value within 5 minutes after all cells are successfully activated, to bind the cells to baseband resources. parameters.name: TDD BBP Resource Auto Deploy Algorithm

parameters.name: FDD BBP Resource Auto Deploy Algorithm

parameters.name: BBP Resource Auto Reconfig Timer
parameters.description: Indicates the maximum period of time available for cell activation on the bound BBP. When a cell fails to be activated within this period and the BbpResAutoConfigSw parameter is set to ON(On), the eNodeB automatically allocates available baseband resources to the cell until the cell is successfully activated. This parameter is also used to specify the internal protection time length, which is the

parameters.name: eNodeB Cell Number Capability Mode
parameters.description: Indicates how to define the maximum number of cells on a single base station. If this parameter is set to NORMAL_MODE, a single UMPTa or UMPTb supports a maximum of 36 cells, a single UMPTga supports a maximum of 72 cells, and a single UMPTg supports a maximum of 144 cells. parameters.name: CPRI Sharing Switch
parameters.description: Indicates whether to support CPRI sharing between baseband processing units (BBPs). When this parameter is set to ON, CPRI sharing is supported and CPRI ports of a BBP or CPRI interface board are shared between specified BBPs to enable baseband processing to be independent of CPRI ports. When this parameter is set to OFF, CPRI sharing is not supported.

parameters.name: eNodeB Cell Distributed Deployment Switch
parameters.description: Indicates whether to enable distributed cell deployment. This parameter takes effect only when a base station is equipped with two main control boards. If this parameter is set to ON, the cell management function can be deployed on two UMPT boards or UMPT+LMPT boards to increase the cell number capacity. If this parameter is set to OFF, the cell management function is deployed only on the primary

parameters.name: Backplane Bandwidth Lack Protection Switch
parameters.description: Indicate whether to establish cells with reduced capacity if the backplane bandwidth is insufficient. If this parameter is set to ON(On) and the backplane bandwidth is insufficient, cells are not established with reduced capacity. parameters.name: Service Mode
parameters.description: Indicates the service running mode of the eNodeB. The product specifications vary according to the serving running mode. AI_ENHANCEMENT_SWITCH: If this option is selected and the UMPTe or UMPTga board is used, the eNodeB works under the enhanced product specifications applicable when smart features are activated. parameters.name: eNodeB sharing mode
parameters.description: Indicates the eNodeB sharing mode, which can be independent operator mode, RAN sharing with common carrier, RAN sharing with dedicated carrier, hybrid RAN sharing, or RAN sharing with special dedicated carrier.

parameters.name: Start Time
parameters.description: Indicates the start time to write the changes generated by the ANGC function of SON into the database, including overlapping indicator changes of inter-frequency neighboring cells or the switch status changes of the cell to which intra-frequency neighboring cells belong. The results calculated by the ANGC function are written into the database after the time in the system reaches the start time sp

parameters.name: IMEISV TAC
parameters.description: Indicates the type allocation code (TAC) in the IMEISV of UEs. The TAC identifies the UE model. For details about the definition of IMEISV, see section 6.2.2 in 3GPP TS 23.003. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: IMEISV SVN
parameters.description: Indicates the software version number (SVN) which is an element of the international mobile station equipment identity and software version (IMEISV) and specifies the software version of UEs. For details about the definition of IMEISV, see section 6.2.2 in 3GPP TS 23.003. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: Ue Type Description
parameters.description: Indicates the description of the model of UE. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: US Ue Strategy Select
parameters.description: Indicates the policy based on which the eNodeB identifies UEs running unlimited services. If the UsBasedSpecificSPID option is selected, the eNodeB identifies UEs running unlimited services based on the SPIDs specified by the operator using the UsUeSpid parameter in the UsUeSpidConfig MO. This option applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD. If the UsBasedSpecificIPAdd option is selected, the eNodeB id

parameters.name: Configurate US SPID
parameters.description: Indicates the SPID for UEs running unlimited services. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: US Ue Inactive Timer
parameters.description: Indicates the length of the UE inactivity timer for UEs. If the eNodeB detects that such a UE has neither received nor sent data for a duration exceeding the value of this parameter, the eNodeB releases the RRC connection for the UE. If this parameter is set to 0, the UE inactivity timer is not used. If the parameter setting is changed, the change applies to UEs that newly access the network.

parameters.name: US IP Detect Interval
parameters.description: Indicates the packet interval at which the eNodeB parses the IP headers of the downlink packets for UEs running unlimited services. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: US Downlink scheduling priority factor
parameters.description: Indicates the weight factor used to calculate DL scheduling priorities for UEs running unlimited services. This parameter is used to provide preferential guarantee for UEs running unlimited services. If the parameter is set to a value in the range of 1 to 999, the priority is calculated using the specified weight factor. If this parameter is set to 1000, UEs running unlimited services have the hig

parameters.id: US Large Packet UlSch Priority Factor
parameters.name: US Large Packet UlSch Priority Factor
parameters.description: Indicates the weight factor used to calculate the connection priorities during UL scheduling for large-packet services of UEs running unlimited services. If the parameter is set to a value in the range of 1 to 999, the priority is calculated using the specified weight factor. If this parameter is set to 1000, UEs running unlimited services have the highest priority. This parameter applies only to

parameters.id: US Small Packet UlSch Priority Factor
parameters.name: US Small Packet UlSch Priority Factor
parameters.description: Indicates the weight factor used to calculate the connection priorities during UL scheduling for small-packet services of UEs running unlimited services. If the parameter is set to a value in the range of 1 to 999, the priority is calculated using the specified weight factor. If this parameter is set to 1000, UEs running unlimited services have the highest priority. This parameter applies only to

parameters.id: US UE S-TMSI Keep Alive Timer
parameters.name: US UE S-TMSI Keep Alive Timer
parameters.description: Indicates the length of the S-TMSI keep-alive timer for UEs running unlimited services. When the eNodeB detects such a UE based on the IP address of a dedicated server, the eNodeB starts the S-TMSI keep-alive timer for the UE. If the UE initiates an RRC connection setup procedure towards the eNodeB before the timer expires, the eNodeB treats the UE as an unlimited-service UE. If the UE initiates t

parameters.name: Big Package Identification
parameters.description: Indicates whether to use large-packet services as criterion for identifying UEs with unlimited services. If the volume of data to be transmitted for a service in the UE buffer exceeds a specified threshold, this service is a large-packet service. If this parameter is set to ON, a UE is identified based on the buffered data volume and the number of times the UE is scheduled. If certain conditions a

parameters.id: UL DL US User Detect Period
parameters.name: UL DL US User Detect Period
parameters.description: Indicates the identification period of UEs running unlimited data services in the uplink and downlink. If this parameter is set to 0, the detection in the uplink and downlink is disabled. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.id: US NB-IoT UE Status Response Timer
parameters.name: US NB-IoT UE Status Response Timer
parameters.description: Indicates the length of the RLC-layer status report response timer for NB-IoT UEs running unlimited services (US NB-IoT UEs). If you need to change the parameter value, contact Huawei technical support. This parameter applies only to NB-IoT.

parameters.id: NB-IoT US UE Scheduling Priority Weight Factor
parameters.name: NB-IoT US UE Scheduling Priority Weight Factor
parameters.description: Indicates the weight factor of NB-IoT basic scheduling priorities for UEs running unlimited services. This parameter is used to preferentially guarantee services for UEs running unlimited services. This parameter applies only to NB-IoT.

parameters.name: US UE Exit Detection Times
parameters.description: Indicates the number of times it is detected that a UE running unlimited services (referred to as a US UE) exits a specific SPID and a specific IP address before the UE is finally determined to have exited the US state. This parameter takes effect only if the UsBasedSpecificSpidIpAddress option of the UsStrategy parameter is selected. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: US Server Index
parameters.description: Indicates the index of the server which allows UEs who gain access to then be determined as UEs running unlimited services. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: US Server IP
parameters.description: Indicates the IP address of the server which allows UEs who gain access to then be determined as UEs running unlimited services. Server-IP-address-based unlimited-service-supported UE identification can be performed based on any of the following methods: (1) Server IP address; (2) Server IP address + server protocol type; (3) Server IP address + server protocol type + server port number. This para

parameters.name: US Server Port
parameters.description: Indicates whether to check the port number of the server which allows UEs who gain access to then be determined as UEs running unlimited services. The value 0 indicates that the port number of the server that a UE running unlimited services accesses does not need to be checked. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: US Protocol Type
parameters.description: Indicates whether to check the protocol type of the server which allows UEs who gain access to then be determined as UEs running unlimited services. If this parameter is set to None, the eNodeB does not check the protocol type of downlink packets. If this parameter is set to UDP, the eNodeB checks whether the protocol type of downlink packets is UDP. If this parameter is set to TCP, the eNodeB che

parameters.name: US Trace ID Index
parameters.description: Indicates the index of the trace ID for UEs running unlimited services (US UEs).

parameters.name: US Trace ID
parameters.description: Indicates the trace ID for UEs running unlimited services (US UEs). This parameter is valid only if the UsBasedSpecificTraceID option of the UsStrategy parameter is selected. If the UsTraceID parameter is set to 4294967295, the eNodeB identifies UEs with any trace ID as US UEs.

parameters.name: APN
parameters.description: Indicates the network identification code. The value of this parameter can contain a maximum of seven dots (.). Modification to this parameter takes effect at the next network access of a UE. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: Primary Domain Name Server
parameters.description: This parameter specifies the IP address of the primary DNS. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: Secondary Domain Name Server
parameters.description: This parameter specifies the IP address of the secondary DNS. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: Address Pool ID
parameters.description: Indicates the ID of the IP address pool corresponding to the APN. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: APN Template ID
parameters.description: Indicates the ID of an APN template. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: APN
parameters.description: Indicates the APN bound to the subscriber template. The value of this parameter can contain a maximum of seven dots (.). Modification to this parameter takes effect at the next network access of a UE. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: QoS class identifier
parameters.description: Indicates a compact EPC QoS attribute that is provided for a service data flow (SDF) as a reference to a specific packet forwarding behavior (such as packet loss rate and delay). The packet forwarding is performed based on the QCI-related parameters that are pre-configured on the access network node (such as the eNodeB). This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.id: APN Aggregate Maximum Bit Rate Downlink
parameters.name: APN Aggregate Maximum Bit Rate Downlink
parameters.description: Indicates the downlink aggregate maximum bit rate (AMBR) of the APN. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.id: APN Aggregate Maximum Bit Rate Uplink
parameters.name: APN Aggregate Maximum Bit Rate Uplink
parameters.description: Indicates the uplink aggregate maximum bit rate (AMBR) of the APN. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: Allocation and Retention Priority
parameters.description: Indicates a QoS attribute that specifies the relative importance compared to other bearers for allocation and retention of the bearer. Modification to this parameter takes effect at the next network access of a UE. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: Preemption Capability
parameters.description: Indicates a QoS attribute that specifies whether bearers can occupy resources for lower-priority service data flows. Modification to this parameter takes effect at the next network access of a UE. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: Preemption Vulnerability
parameters.description: Indicates a QoS attribute that controls whether resources for service data flows can be occupied by higher-priority service data flows. Modification to this parameter takes effect at the next network access of a UE. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: LocalCellId
parameters.description: Indicates the local ID of a cell, which uniquely identifies a cell within an eNodeB.

parameters.name: Rx Noise Power Threshold
parameters.description: Indicates the threshold for reporting an alarm indicating interference noise power imbalance between receive (RX) channels of the cell. The threshold is an average interference noise power difference between two RX channels of the cell. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD cells and NB-IoT cells deployed in a mode other than LTE in-band mode.

parameters.name: RX Channel Noise Detection Mode
parameters.description: Indicates the method of checking the alarm of interference noise power imbalance between receive channels in a cell. ALL_CHANNELS: Indicates that the eNodeB checks whether the interference power of all channels in a cell is balanced. parameters.name: Local cell ID
parameters.description: Indicates the local cell identity. It uniquely identifies a cell within an eNodeB.

parameters.name: Primary Baseband Equipment ID
parameters.description: Indicates the ID of the primary baseband equipment that serves a cell. If the primary baseband equipment is not configured for a cell, the eNodeB selects baseband processing units for the cell among all baseband processing units that have not been bound to cells. If this parameter is configured, the cell uses specified primary baseband equipment. In this case, the cell can use only the baseband pr

parameters.name: Local cell ID
parameters.description: Indicates the local cell ID. It uniquely identifies a cell within an eNodeB. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: Sector equipment ID
parameters.description: Indicates the ID of a piece of sector equipment that serves a cell. It uniquely identifies the sector equipment within an eNodeB.

parameters.name: Reference signal power
parameters.description: Indicates the reference signal power of cell-specific sector equipment. If this parameter is set to 32767, it is invalid, and the cell uses the reference signal power specified in the PDSCHCfg MO to transmit reference signals. For details, see 3GPP TS 36.213. This parameter is valid only when the MultiRruCellFlag parameter in the Cell MO is set to BOOLEAN_TRUE and the MultiRruCellMode parameter in

parameters.name: Baseband equipment ID
parameters.description: Indicates the ID of a piece of baseband equipment that serves the cell. If this parameter is set to 255 for a cell, baseband equipment is not specified for the cell. In this case, the eNodeB selects BBPs for a cell among all the local available BBPs. The BBP directly connected to the RRU serving the cell is preferentially selected. If this parameter is set to another value, baseband equipment is s

parameters.name: Reference Signal Power Margin
parameters.description: Indicates the reference signal power headroom of each physical antenna. This parameter is valid only when the MultiRruCellFlag parameter of the Cell MO is set to BOOLEAN_TRUE(True) and the MultiRruCellMode parameter in the Cell MO is set to SFN(SFN) or CELL_COMBINATION(Cell Combination). This parameter applies only to LTE TDD. If this parameter is set to 0, the parameter does not take effect. That

parameters.name: Sector CPRI Compression
parameters.description: Indicates the CPRI compression type of the sector equipment. CPRI compression is used in RRU cascading scenarios to enable more RRUs to be cascaded without changing the CPRI data rate. The parameter can be set to NO_COMPRESSION, NORMAL_COMPRESSION, ENHANCED_COMPRESSION, TRIPLEX_COMPRESSION_10M, 3_2_COMPRESSION, or NULL. The parameter value NO_COMPRESSION indicates that CPRI compression is not used

parameters.name: Auto Config Flag
parameters.description: Indicates whether to automatically or manually bind a baseband equipment ID to a cell. To enable automatic binding, set this parameter to AUTO_MODE_CFG. To enable manual binding, set this parameter to MANUAL_MODE_CFG. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: Weight Number
parameters.description: Indicates the weight number configured for cell-specific sector equipment. If this parameter is not set to 255, the value of this parameter has a mapping relationship with the DEVICENO parameter in the BFANT MO. parameters.name: Virtual Cell ID
parameters.description: Indicates a virtual cell ID used for DMRS and CSI-RS scrambling when adaptive SFN and TM10 are enabled. This parameter should be manually set to a planned value as required when adaptive SFN and TM10 are enabled. This parameter applies only to FDD.

parameters.name: Sector Equipment Combine Group ID
parameters.description: Indicates the ID of a sector equipment combination group, which contains multiple sets of sector equipment. The value 255 indicates that the sector equipment is not to be included in a combination. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: Cell Beam Mode
parameters.description: Indicates the beam mode of the cell. This parameter has four values: NORMAL, ADVANCED_BEAMFORMING, MASSIVE_MIMO_Ph1, and MASSIVE_MIMO_Ph2. The value NORMAL indicates that the cell is a normal cell. The value ADVANCED_BEAMFORMING indicates that the cell uses AAU-based advanced beamforming. The value MASSIVE_MIMO_Ph1 indicates that the cell uses phase-1 massive MIMO. The value MASSIVE_MIMO_Ph2 indic

parameters.name: RRU Cabinet No.
parameters.description: Indicates the cabinet number of the RRU.

parameters.name: RRU Subrack No.
parameters.description: Indicates the subrack number of the RRU.

parameters.name: RRU Slot No.
parameters.description: Indicates the slot number of the RRU.

parameters.name: Received total wideband power
parameters.description: Indicates the RTWP for the carrier. The normal value range is from -130 dBm to -40 dBm. If the value is out of this range, the SINR may be too low, or power saturation occurs (which leads to signal distortion), affecting air interface performance. The value 65535 is invalid, which indicates that the RTWP of the target module cannot be queried.

parameters.name: RX Channels No.
parameters.description: Indicates the RX channel number of the RRU. An RRU is configured with multiple RX channels.

parameters.name: eNodeB ID
parameters.description: Indicates the ID of the eNodeB.

parameters.name: Coordinated Information Effective Delay
parameters.description: Indicates the interval between the time that the eNodeB reports measurement information and the time that the coordinated information delivered to the eNodeB takes effect. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: Inter-eNodeB DlCoMP Algorithm Switch
parameters.description: Indicates whether to enable inter-eNodeB DL CoMP in cells under the centralized control node in Cloud BB scenarios. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: Coordinated Schedule Ue Specification
parameters.description: Indicates the number of UEs scheduled by the centralized control node. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: UL ICS Algorithm Switch
parameters.description: Indicates whether to enable UL ICS for a centralized control node. This parameter applies only to LTE TDD networks.

parameters.name: Local EPC ID
parameters.description: Indicates the local ID of the compact EPC. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: MME Group ID
parameters.description: Indicates the ID of the MME group in the compact EPC. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: MME Code
parameters.description: Indicates the code of the MME in the compact EPC. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: Full Name for Network
parameters.description: This parameter specifies the full name of a network service provider. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: Short Name for Network
parameters.description: This parameter specifies the abbreviation for the name of a network service provider. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: Cipher Algorithm
parameters.description: Indicates the algorithm that the compact EPC preferentially selects to encrypt NAS messages. For example, if this parameter is set to EEA2, the EEA2 algorithm is preferentially selected to encrypt NAS messages. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: Integrity Algorithm
parameters.description: Indicates the algorithm that the compact EPC preferentially selects to ensure NAS message integrity. If this parameter is set to EIA2, the EIA2 algorithm is preferentially selected to ensure NAS message integrity. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: IP Address Pool ID
parameters.description: This parameter specifies the ID of an IP address pool. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: Start IP Address
parameters.description: Indicates the start IP address. Modification to this parameter takes effect at the next network access of a UE. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: End IP Address
parameters.description: Indicates the end IP address. Modification to this parameter takes effect at the next network access of a UE. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: Mask
parameters.description: Indicates the mask of an IP address pool. Modification to this parameter takes effect at the next network access of a UE. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: Local Cell ID
parameters.description: Indicates the local ID of a cell, which uniquely identifies the cell within an eNodeB. This parameter applies only to NB-IoT.

parameters.name: PRB ID
parameters.description: Indicates the NB-IoT PRB identity. It uniquely identifies a PRB within a cell. This parameter applies only to NB-IoT.

parameters.name: Sector Equipment ID
parameters.description: Indicates the ID of the sector equipment that serves the cell. It uniquely identifies a set of sector equipment within an eNodeB. This parameter applies only to NB-IoT.

parameters.name: Reference Signal Power
parameters.description: Indicates the reference signal power of the sector equipment for the PRB (the precision of converting dBm to mW is 0.01 mW). If this parameter is set to 32767, this value is invalid for reference signal power. In this case, the reference signal power defined in the PDSCHCFG MO takes effect. For details, see 3GPP TS 36.213. In accordance with 3GPP specifications, the difference in reference signal

parameters.name: Baseband Equipment ID
parameters.description: Indicates the ID of the baseband equipment that serves the cell. The value 255 indicates that no baseband equipment is specified for the cell. In this scenario, any of the BBPs in the eNodeB can be selected to serve the cell. The BBP to which the cell's serving RRU is directly connected is preferentially selected.
