parameters.name: Auto Config Flag
parameters.description: Indicates whether to automatically or manually control the setting of baseband equipment ID. To allow for automatic setting, set this parameter to AUTO_MODE. To allow for manual object creation, set this parameter to MANUAL_MODE or AUTO_MODE. This parameter applies only to NB-IoT.

parameters.name: NPRS ID
parameters.description: Indicates the narrowband positioning reference signal (NPRS) ID of an NB-IoT cell. If this parameter is set to 65535, the specified NPRS ID is invalid. In this case, the NPRS ID is the same as the PCI. For details about the parameter, see 3GPP TS 36.455. This parameter applies only to NB-IoT.

parameters.name: Local Cell ID
parameters.description: Indicates the local ID of a cell, which uniquely identifies the cell within an eNodeB. This parameter applies only to NB-IoT.

parameters.name: PRB ID
parameters.description: Indicates the NB-IoT PRB ID, which uniquely identifies a PRB within a cell. This parameter applies only to NB-IoT.

parameters.name: Sector Equipment Group ID
parameters.description: Indicates the ID of the sector equipment group that serves the PRB. It uniquely identifies a sector equipment group within an eNodeB. This parameter applies only to NB-IoT.

parameters.name: Baseband Equipment ID
parameters.description: Indicates the ID of the baseband equipment that serves the PRB. When this parameter is set to 255, the baseband equipment is not specified for the PRB. In this scenario, any BBP in the base station can be selected to serve the PRB, and the BBP to which the RRU for the PRB is directly connected is preferentially selected. When this parameter is set to a value other than 255, the PRB can be served o

parameters.name: Auto Config Flag
parameters.description: Indicates whether to automatically or manually control the setting of baseband equipment ID. To allow for automatic binding, set this parameter to AUTO_MODE. To allow for manual binding, set this parameter to MANUAL_MODE or AUTO_MODE. This parameter applies only to NB-IoT.

parameters.name: Reference Signal Power
parameters.description: Indicates the reference signal power of the sector equipment group for the PRB. (All pieces of sector equipment in the sector equipment group have the same power and the precision of converting dBm to mW is 0.01 mW). The value 32767 indicates invalid reference signal power, and the reference signal power set in the PDSCHCFG MO is used for the PRB. For details, see 3GPP TS 36.213. This parameter is

parameters.name: Local Subscriber ID
parameters.description: Indicates the local ID of a subscriber. It uniquely identifies a subscriber within an eNodeB. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: OM IP
parameters.description: Indicates the O&M IP address of an RRN. Modification to this parameter leads to network exit and reaccess of the RRN. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: DHCP Server IP
parameters.description: Indicates the destination IP address of the DHCP server. The DHCP packets sent from the downstream base station to an RRN are relayed to this destination IP address. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: RRN Type
parameters.description: Indicates the RRN type. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: Extended DHCP Server IP
parameters.description: Indicates the destination IP address of the extended DHCP server. The DHCP packets sent from the downstream eNodeB to an RRN are relayed to this destination IP address. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: SyncEth Clock Switch
parameters.description: Indicates whether the RRN performs synchronous Ethernet clock broadcast. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: Relay Type
parameters.description: Indicates the relay type of an RRN, which can be L3 Relay (IP Based) or L2 Relay (MAC Based). This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: OM Interface ID
parameters.description: Indicates the interface ID assigned to the O&M channel of an RRN. This parameter is valid only if the RelayType parameter is set to L2(L2). This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: Service InterfaceID
parameters.description: Indicates the interface ID assigned to the service channel of an RRN. This parameter is valid only if the RelayType parameter is set to L2(L2). This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: RRN MAC Aging Time
parameters.description: Indicates the aging time of the dynamic MAC address of an RRN. This parameter is valid only if the RelayType parameter is set to L2(L2). If this parameter is set to 0, the dynamic MAC address is not aged. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: RRN VLAN Tag Switch
parameters.description: Indicates whether the RRN adds a VLAN tag in the O&M data. This parameter is valid only if the RelayType parameter is set to L2(L2). This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: RRN VLAN ID
parameters.description: Indicates the value of VLAN ID in the VLAN tag contained in the O&M data of an RRN. This parameter is valid only if the RelayType parameter is set to L2(L2) and the RrnVlanTagSwitch parameter is set to ON(ON). This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: RRN VLAN Priority
parameters.description: Indicates the value of VLAN Priority in the VLAN tag contained in the O&M data of an RRN. This parameter is valid only if the RelayType parameter is set to L2(L2) and the RrnVlanTagSwitch parameter is set to ON(ON). This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: OM IP Mask
parameters.description: Indicates the subnet mask of the O&M IP address of an RRN. This parameter is valid only if the RelayType parameter is set to L2(L2). This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: Enhanced Function Switch
parameters.description: Indicates whether to enable RRN enhancement functions. AUTOMATIC_ANTENNA_ADJ_SW: Indicates whether to enable automatic antenna alignment. Automatic antenna alignment is enabled only if this option is selected. This option applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD. INTERFERENCE_CANCELLATION_SW: Indicates whether to enable interference cancellation. Interference cancellation is enabled only if this option

parameters.name: Local WAP Channel Number
parameters.description: Indicates the channel number used by the local Wireless Access Protocol (WAP) of the RRN. Different countries and regions may use different channel policies. For example, indoor and outdoor WLANs use different channels. When the LocalWapRegionCode parameter is set to REGION_0, REGION_1, REGION_2, or REGION_3, the LocalWapChannelNumber parameter can be set to CHANNEL_AUTOMATIC. In this case, the WL

parameters.name: Local WAP Policy
parameters.description: Indicates the policy in which the local WAP of the RRN works. If this parameter is set to AUTOMATIC, local WAP is disabled after the RRN accesses a cell and local WAP is enabled when the RRN cannot access the cell. If this parameter is set to ALWAYS_ON, local WAP is always enabled. If this parameter is set to ALWAYS_OFF, local WAP is always disabled. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE

parameters.name: Local WAP Region Code
parameters.description: Indicates the region code of the country where the RRN is located. Different regions support different 2.4 GHz WLAN channels. The RRN supports five types of region codes. REGION_0 indicates North America, where channels 1 to 11 are available. REGION_1 indicates part of Europe, Japan, and China, where channels 1 to 13 are available. REGION_2 indicates France, where channels 1 to 9 are available. RE

parameters.name: RRN Information Parameter Type
parameters.description: Indicates the RRN information parameter type to be queried. If this parameter is set to BASICINFO, basic statistic information about the RRN is to be queried. If this parameter is set to KEYUPDINFO, the OP/KI update records of the RRN are to be queried. If this parameter is set to MACTABLEQUERY, a maximum of 40 valid MAC entries in the MAC forwarding table on the RRN are to be queried. If this par

parameters.name: Active Time
parameters.description: Indicates the time when the software is activated. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: Directory Name
parameters.description: Indicates the path where a file is saved on the FTP server. If this parameter is not set, the default path configured for the FTP server is used. The FTP server and the operating system on which the FTP server software runs determine whether an absolution or relative path is supported and supported path formats. For details, see "Example." This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: IP Address Mode
parameters.description: Indicates the IP address mode of the FTP server. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: External Device Type
parameters.description: Indicates the external device type to which the software applies. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: Guage Option
parameters.description: Indicates whether the RRN reports the download progress. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: FTP Server IP
parameters.description: Indicates the IP address of the FTP server. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: Password
parameters.description: Indicates the password for logging in to the FTP server. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: Reset Mode
parameters.description: Indicates the RRN reset mode. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: Software Status
parameters.description: Indicates the software status, which can be available or unavailable. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: Storage Area
parameters.description: Indicates the area where the software is stored. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: Software Version
parameters.description: Indicates the RRN software version. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: User Name
parameters.description: Indicates the user name for logging in to the FTP server. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: File Type
parameters.description: Indicates the type of files stored in an RRN, which can be inventory files or log files. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: RRN Information Report
parameters.description: Indicates an RRN information report. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: RRN Information Parameter
parameters.description: Indicates RRN information. This parameter provides the following fields: BasicInfo, KeyUpdInfo, MacTableQuery, and MacTableQuery-XXXX-XXXX-XXXX-Num. BasicInfo indicates that the basic information about the RRN is to be queried. KeyUpdInfo indicates that the OP/KI update records of the RRN are to be queried, MacTableQuery indicates that a maximum of 40 valid MAC entries from the start in the MAC fo

parameters.name: Reason Description
parameters.description: Indicates the failure cause in the external device software upgrade result. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: Operation Result
parameters.description: Indicates the operation result in the external device software upgrade result. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: Session ID
parameters.description: Indicates the session ID of the operation feedback. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: ID
parameters.description: Indicates the device ID in the external device software upgrade result. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: Type
parameters.description: Indicates the device type in the external device software upgrade result. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: Local Subscriber ID
parameters.description: Indicates the local ID of a subscriber. It uniquely identifies a subscriber within an eNodeB. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: LAN IP
parameters.description: Indicates the IP address of the LAN port on an RRN. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: LAN Mask
parameters.description: Indicates the subnet mask of the IP address of the LAN port on an RRN. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: Local Subscriber ID
parameters.description: Indicates the local ID of a subscriber. It uniquely identifies a subscriber within an eNodeB. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: Port No.
parameters.description: Indicates the transmission port number on the RRN. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: Port Switch
parameters.description: Indicates the switch controlling the transmission port on the RRN. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: Route ID
parameters.description: Indicates the ID of an IP route on an RRN. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: Local Subscriber ID
parameters.description: Indicates the local ID of a subscriber. It uniquely identifies a subscriber within an eNodeB. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: Destination IP
parameters.description: Indicates the destination IP address of the route from an RRN to the downstream base station. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: Destination Mask
parameters.description: Indicates the subnet mask of the destination IP address of the route from an RRN to the downstream base station. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: Next Hop
parameters.description: Indicates the next-hop IP address of the route from an RRN to the downstream base station. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: Local cell ID
parameters.description: Indicates the local cell identity. It uniquely identifies a cell within an eNodeB. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: Sector Equipment Group ID
parameters.description: Indicates the group ID of the sector devices that serve the cell, it uniquely identifies a group of sector devices within a cell. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: Sector Equipment Reference
parameters.description: Indicates the list of the sector devices that serve the cell. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: Baseband equipment ID
parameters.description: Indicates the number of the baseband equipment used by a cell. When this parameter is set to 255, the baseband equipment serving a cell is not specified. In this scenario, any baseband processing unit (BBP) in the base station can be selected to serve a cell, and the BBPs to which the cell's serving RRU is connected are preferentially selected. When this parameter is set to a value other than 255,

parameters.name: Reference signal power
parameters.description: Indicates the reference signal power of a sector equipment group for a cell (all sets of sector equipment in the sector equipment group have the same reference signal power). If this parameter is set to 32767, the parameter value is invalid, and the cell uses the reference signal power specified by the ReferenceSignalPwr parameter in the PDSCHCFG MO. For details, see 3GPP TS 36.213. This parameter

parameters.name: Sector Group CPRI Compression
parameters.description: Indicates the common public radio interface (CPRI) compression type for the sector equipment group. CPRI compression is used in RRU cascading scenarios to enable more RRUs to be cascaded without changing the CPRI data rate. The parameter value NO_COMPRESSION indicates that CPRI compression is not used. The parameter value NORMAL_COMPRESSION indicates that normal CPRI compression is used. The param

parameters.name: Auto Config Flag
parameters.description: Indicates whether to automatically or manually bind a baseband equipment ID to a cell. To enable automatic binding, set this parameter to AUTO_MODE_CFG. To enable manual binding, set this parameter to MANUAL_MODE_CFG. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: Sector Equipment Group Combine ID
parameters.description: Indicates the ID of a sector equipment group combination, which contains multiple sector equipment groups. This parameter takes effect only in scenarios with virtual 4T4R enabled. The value 255 indicates that the sector equipment group is not to be included in a combination. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: Virtual Cell ID
parameters.description: Indicates a virtual cell ID used for DMRS and CSI-RS scrambling when adaptive SFN and TM10 are enabled. This parameter should be manually set to a planned value as required when adaptive SFN and TM10 are enabled. This parameter applies only to FDD.

parameters.name: Sector Group Carrier PassThrough Compression
parameters.description: Indicates the compression type on CPRI over optical fibers and CPRI over Ethernet cables for the sector equipment group. This parameter applies to LampSite eNodeBs where both optical fibers and Ethernet cables are used for RRU cascading and the compression ratio on CPRI over optical fibers and that on CPRI over Ethernet cables are the same. This parameter is used to specify the compression ratio o

parameters.name: Local Subscriber ID
parameters.description: Indicates the local ID of a subscriber. It uniquely identifies a subscriber within an eNodeB. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: Subscriber Type
parameters.description: This parameter specifies the type of a subscriber. The value UE indicates a subscriber using a UE. The value RRN indicates a subscriber using an RRN. Modification to this parameter takes effect at the next network access of a UE. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: International Mobile Subscriber ID
parameters.description: Indicates the number that uniquely identifies a UE. It is stored on the SIM card of the UE and sent to the eNodeB during network access. Modification to this parameter takes effect at the next network access of a UE. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: RRN ID
parameters.description: Indicates the ID that uniquely identifies an RRN. It is equivalent to the IMSI. This ID is stored on the RRN, and sent to the eNodeB when the RRN accesses the network. Modification to this parameter takes effect at the next network access of a UE. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: Cell ID
parameters.description: Indicates the ID of the cell serving an RRN. The combination of this parameter and the eNodeB ID forms the E-UTRAN cell identifier. The combination of the E-UTRAN cell identifier and the PLMN ID forms the E-UTRAN cell global identifier (ECGI). For details, see 3GPP TS 36.413. Modification to this parameter takes effect at the next network access of a UE. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and

parameters.name: Individual Subscriber Authentication Key
parameters.description: Indicates a key for subscriber authentication during network access. Modification to this parameter takes effect at the next network access of the subscriber. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: Operator Variant Algorithm Configuration Field
parameters.description: Indicates an input parameter involved in calculation for subscriber authentication. Modification to this parameter takes effect at the next network access of the subscriber. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: Uplink Aggregate Maximum Bit Rate
parameters.description: Indicates the uplink AMBR available for all the non-GBR bearers of a subscriber. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: Downlink Aggregate Maximum Bit Rate
parameters.description: Indicates the downlink AMBR available for all the non-GBR bearers of a subscriber. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: Subscriber Template ID
parameters.description: Indicates the ID of the subscriber template bound to a subscriber. Modification to this parameter takes effect at the next network access of a UE. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: Subscriber Description
parameters.description: This parameter provides the description about a subscriber, including the functions and location. This parameter needs to be displayed and configured only if the SubscriberType parameter is set to RRN. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: Subscriber Template ID
parameters.description: Indicates the ID of a subscriber template. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: APN Template ID
parameters.description: Indicates the ID of an APN template. Modification to this parameter takes effect at the next network access of a UE. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: Template Name
parameters.description: Indicates the name of a subscriber template. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: Secondary APNTemplate Configuration Indicator
parameters.description: Indicates whether the second PDN connection configured in the user template takes effect. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: Secondary APN Template ID
parameters.description: Indicates the ID of the secondary APN template for second PDN connection configuration. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: Local Cell ID
parameters.description: Indicates the ID of a local cell, which uniquely identifies a cell within an eNodeB. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: Mobile country code
parameters.description: Indicates the MCC of a neighboring E-UTRAN cell. A PLMN ID is composed of an MCC and an MNC. The MCC consists of three digits. The MNC consists of two or three digits. For example, if the MCC is 123 and the MNC is 45, the PLMN ID is 12345. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: Mobile network code
parameters.description: Indicates the MNC of a neighboring E-UTRAN cell. A PLMN ID is composed of an MCC and an MNC. The MCC consists of three digits. The MNC consists of two or three digits. For example, if the MCC is 123 and the MNC is 45, the PLMN ID is 12345. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: eNodeB ID
parameters.description: Indicates the eNodeB ID of a blacklisted neighboring E-UTRAN cell, which uniquely identifies an eNodeB within a PLMN. A cell ID and an eNodeB ID compose a 28-bit E-UTRAN cell ID, where the eNodeB ID is represented by the 20 most significant bits. An E-UTRAN cell ID and a PLMN ID compose an E-UTRAN CGI (ECGI). For details about this parameter, see 3GPP TS 36.413. This parameter applies only to LTE

parameters.name: Cell ID
parameters.description: Indicates the cell ID of a blacklisted E-UTRAN cell, which uniquely identifies a cell within an eNodeB. A cell ID and an eNodeB ID compose a 28-bit E-UTRAN cell ID, where the local cell ID is represented by the 8 least significant bits. An E-UTRAN cell ID and a PLMN ID compose an E-UTRAN CGI (ECGI). For details about this parameter, see 3GPP TS 36.413. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LT

parameters.name: Auto Config Flag
parameters.description: Indicates whether a blacklisted neighboring E-UTRAN cell is automatically generated by the eNodeB or manually created. The parameter value AUTO_CREATED indicates that the neighboring E-UTRAN cell is automatically blacklisted by the system. The parameter value MANUAL_CREATED indicates that the neighboring E-UTRAN cell is manually blacklisted by operators using the MAE or MML commands. This paramete

parameters.name: Control Mode
parameters.description: Indicates the control mode of a blacklisted neighboring E-UTRAN cell, which determines the control policies of operators and the SON functions on this MO. If this parameter is set to MANUAL_MODE(Manual Mode), users can modify or delete this MO but the SON cannot automatically modify or delete this MO. If this parameter is set to AUTO_MODE(Auto Mode), both users and the SON can modify or delete thi

parameters.name: Mobile country code
parameters.description: Indicates the mobile country code of the external E-UTRAN cell. The PLMN consists of the MCC and the MNC. The MCC consists of three digits. The MNC consists of two to three digits. For example, if the MCC is 123 and the MNC is 45, then the PLMN ID is 12345.

parameters.name: Mobile network code
parameters.description: Indicates the mobile network code of the external E-UTRAN cell. The PLMN consists of the MCC and the MNC. The MCC consists of three digits. The MNC consists of two to three digits. For example, if the MCC is 123 and the MNC is 45, then the PLMN ID is 12345.

parameters.name: eNodeB ID
parameters.description: Indicates the eNodeB ID of the external E-UTRAN cell. It uniquely identifies an eNodeB within a PLMN. The 28-bit E-UTRAN cell ID is comprised of the cell ID and the eNodeB ID (represented by the most significant 20 bits). The cell global identity (CGI) of an E-UTRAN cell is comprised of the E-UTRAN cell ID and the PLMN ID. For details, see 3GPP TS 36.413.

parameters.name: Cell ID
parameters.description: Indicates the cell ID of the external E-UTRAN cell. It uniquely identifies a cell within an eNodeB. The 28-bit E-UTRAN cell ID is comprised of the cell ID (represented by the least significant eight bits) and the eNodeB ID. An E-UTRAN cell ID and a PLMN ID compose an E-UTRAN CGI (ECGI). For details, see 3GPP TS 36.413.

parameters.name: Downlink EARFCN
parameters.description: Indicates the DL EARFCN of the external E-UTRAN cell. For details, see 3GPP TS 36.104.

parameters.name: Uplink EARFCN indicator
parameters.description: Indicates whether to configure the uplink E-UTRA absolute radio frequency channel number (EARFCN) for the external E-UTRAN cell. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: Uplink EARFCN
parameters.description: Indicates the uplink E-UTRA absolute radio frequency channel number (EARFCN) of the external E-UTRAN cell. If the value of this parameter is not specified, the default uplink EARFCN is used, which is calculated based on the downlink EARFCN. For details about this parameter, see 3GPP TS 36.104. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: Physical cell ID
parameters.description: Indicates the physical cell identifier (PCI) of the external E-UTRAN cell. For details, see 3GPP TS 36.331.

parameters.name: Tracking area code
parameters.description: Indicates the tracking area code (TAC) of the external E-UTRAN cell. Two TAC values 0x0000(0) and 0xFFFE(65534) are reserved according to the protocol and will not be used in future versions. Therefore, do not use 0 or 65534 as a TAC value in TAC planning or configuration.

parameters.name: Cell name
parameters.description: Indicates the name of the external E-UTRAN cell.

parameters.name: External E-UTRAN Cell Slave Band
parameters.description: Indicates slave frequency bands of an external E-UTRAN cell. If the operating frequency of an external E-UTRAN cell belongs to multiple frequency bands, the downlink frequency of the frequency band with the highest priority is configured by the DlEarfcn parameter, and frequency bands with other priorities are configured by the EutranExternalCellSlaveBand parameter and added in descending order bas

parameters.name: Roaming Area Handover Indicator
parameters.description: Indicates whether the external cell can be selected for handovers during roaming. This parameter is set to NO(No) by default. If this parameter is set to YES(Yes), this external cell can be selected for handovers during roaming. If this parameter is set to NO(No), this external cell cannot be selected for handovers during roaming. If the PLMN of the external cell is included in the SPID-based hand

parameters.name: Specified Cell Flag
parameters.description: Indicates whether the external cell is a specified-service cell. Set this parameter based on the operator policy. If this parameter is set to SPECSERCELL, the external cell is a specified-service cell, and non-WBB UEs cannot be transferred to this cell. If this parameter is set to MBBSERCELL, the external cell is a cell that provides only MBB services, and WBB UEs cannot be transferred to this cel

parameters.name: ANR flag
parameters.description: Indicates whether an external cell is automatically detected by ANR. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: High Speed Flag
parameters.description: Indicates whether the adjacent cell is a high-speed or ultra-high-speed cell. The high-speed or ultra-high-speed attribute of an adjacent cell is modified through the X2 interface setup or update message of an X2 interface connecting an adjacent eNodeB. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD.

parameters.name: Uplink Frequency Offset
parameters.description: Indicates the frequency offset of the PRB uplink central frequency to the uplink frequency. This parameter takes effect only when UlEarfcnCfgInd is set to CFG(Configure). Otherwise, the offset is calculated based on the uplink/downlink symmetric system. For details, see 3GPP TS 36.101. This parameter applies only to NB-IoT.

parameters.name: Downlink Frequency Offset
parameters.description: Indicates the frequency offset of the PRB downlink central frequency to the downlink frequency. For details, see 3GPP TS 36.101. This parameter applies only to NB-IoT.

parameters.name: NB-IoT Cell Flag
parameters.description: Indicates whether an external E-UTRAN cell is an NB-IoT cell. When this parameter is set to TRUE, the external cell is an NB-IoT cell. When this parameter is set to FALSE, the external cell is not an NB-IoT cell. This parameter applies only to NB-IoT.

parameters.name: NCL Update Mode
parameters.description: Indicates the external-cell update mode. MFBI_UPDATE_MODE: If this switch is off, the secondary band for the external cell can be set by operators, updated through the X2 interface, and updated based on UE measurements. If this switch is on, the secondary band for the external cell can be set by operators and updated through the X2 interface, but it cannot be updated based on UE measurements. Afte

parameters.name: Support eMTC Flag
parameters.description: Indicates the mode of an external cell, which can be LTE only, eMTC only, and LTE/eMTC dual-mode. This parameter can be queried on the neighboring eNodeB providing the external cell, through an X2 interface. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: Aggregation Attribute
parameters.description: Indicates the aggregation attributes of an external E-UTRAN cell. MASTER_PLMN_RESERVED_FLAG: Indicates whether to reserve the primary PLMN ID of the external E-UTRAN cell. If this option is selected, the primary PLMN ID of the external E-UTRAN cell is reserved and this cell cannot be selected as a target cell for UEs served by the primary PLMN. If this option is deselected, this cell can be select

parameters.name: Control Mode
parameters.description: Indicates the control policy on ANR-related MOs, which can be defined by the user or be based on the automatic neighbor relation (ANR) algorithm. When this parameter is set to MANUAL_MODE, this MO can be modified or removed only by users. A failure message is displayed when a user adds an existing MO (with identical keywords). When this parameter is set to AUTO_MODE, this MO can be modified or rem

parameters.name: Mobile country code
parameters.description: Indicates the mobile country code of the external cell. A PLMN ID is comprised of an MCC and an MNC. The MCC consists of three digits. The MNC consists of two to three digits. For example, if the MCC is 123 and the MNC is 45, then the PLMN ID is 12345. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: Mobile network code
parameters.description: Indicates the mobile network code of the external cell. A PLMN ID is comprised of an MCC and an MNC. The MCC consists of three digits. The MNC consists of two to three digits. For example, if the MCC is 123 and the MNC is 45, then the PLMN ID is 12345. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: eNodeB ID
parameters.description: Indicates the eNodeB ID of the external E-UTRAN cell. It uniquely identifies an eNodeB within a PLMN. The 28-bit E-UTRAN cell ID is comprised of the cell ID and the eNodeB ID (represented by the most significant 20 bits). The cell global identity (CGI) of an E-UTRAN cell is comprised of the E-UTRAN cell ID and the PLMN ID. For details, see 3GPP TS 36.413. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and

parameters.name: Cell ID
parameters.description: Indicates the cell ID of the external E-UTRAN cell. It uniquely identifies a cell within an eNodeB. The 28-bit E-UTRAN cell ID is comprised of the cell ID (represented by the least significant eight bits) and the eNodeB ID. The cell global identity (CGI) of an E-UTRAN cell is comprised of the E-UTRAN cell ID and the PLMN ID. For details, see 3GPP TS 36.413. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD a

parameters.name: Share mobile country code
parameters.description: Indicates the mobile country code of the external E-UTRAN cell that is shared among multiple operators. A PLMN ID is comprised of an MCC and an MNC. The MCC consists of three digits. The MNC consists of two to three digits. For example, if the MCC is 123 and the MNC is 45, then the PLMN ID is 12345. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: Share mobile network code
parameters.description: Indicates the mobile network code of the external E-UTRAN cell that is shared among multiple operators. A PLMN ID is comprised of an MCC and an MNC. The MCC consists of three digits. The MNC consists of two to three digits. For example, if the MCC is 123 and the MNC is 45, then the PLMN ID is 12345. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: Local cell ID
parameters.description: Indicates the cell ID of the local cell. It uniquely identifies a cell within an eNodeB.

parameters.name: Mobile country code
parameters.description: Indicates the mobile country code of the E-UTRAN neighboring cell. The PLMN consists of the MCC and the MNC. The MCC consists of three digits. The MNC consists of two to three digits. For example, if the MCC is 123 and the MNC is 45, then the PLMN ID is 12345.

parameters.name: Mobile network code
parameters.description: Indicates the mobile network code of the E-UTRAN neighboring cell. The PLMN consists of the MCC and the MNC. The MCC consists of three digits. The MNC consists of two to three digits. For example, if the MCC is 123 and the MNC is 45, then the PLMN ID is 12345.

parameters.name: eNodeB ID
parameters.description: Indicates the eNodeB ID of the inter-frequency neighboring cell. It uniquely identifies an eNodeB within a PLMN. The 28-bit E-UTRAN cell ID is comprised of the cell ID and the eNodeB ID (represented by the most significant 20 bits). The cell global identity (CGI) of an E-UTRAN cell is comprised of the E-UTRAN cell ID and the PLMN ID. For details, see 3GPP TS 36.413.

parameters.name: Cell ID
parameters.description: Indicates the local ID of the inter-frequency neighboring cell. It uniquely identifies a cell within an eNodeB. The 28-bit E-UTRAN cell ID is comprised of the cell ID (represented by the least significant eight bits) and the eNodeB ID. The cell global identity (CGI) of an E-UTRAN cell is comprised of the E-UTRAN cell ID and the PLMN ID. For details, see 3GPP TS 36.413.

parameters.name: Cell individual offset
parameters.description: Indicates the cell individual offset for the inter-frequency neighboring cell. It affects the probability of triggering inter-frequency measurement reports. A larger value of this parameter indicates a higher probability. For details, see 3GPP TS 36.331. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: Cell offset
parameters.description: Indicates the offset for the inter-frequency neighboring cell, which is used in evaluation for cell reselections. A larger value of this parameter results in a lower probability of cell reselections to this neighboring cell. If this parameter is not set to dB0, it is delivered in SIB5. For details, see 3GPP TS 36.331. If this parameter is set to dB0, it is not delivered in SIB5. In this situation,

parameters.name: No handover indicator
parameters.description: Indicates whether handovers of UEs to the neighboring cell are prohibited. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: No remove indicator
parameters.description: Indicates whether to permit or prohibit removal of the neighbor relationship by ANR. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: Blind handover Priority
parameters.description: Indicates the priority of the neighboring cell during handovers. The parameter values are divided into three segments, indicating the blind-handover priority, frequency-based-handover priority, and 0. A larger value indicates a higher priority within the same segment. The parameter values 1 to 16 indicate the blind-handover priorities used only in non-frequency-priority-based blind handovers. A bl

parameters.name: ANR flag
parameters.description: Indicates whether this neighboring cell is automatically discovered by the ANR algorithm. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: Local cell name
parameters.description: Indicates the name of the local cell.

parameters.name: Neighbour cell name
parameters.description: Indicates the name of the inter-frequency neighboring cell.

parameters.name: Cell Measure Priority
parameters.description: Indicates the priority of measurement on the inter-frequency neighboring cell. The eNodeB preferentially contains the information about a neighboring cell with this priority set to HIGH_PRIORITY while delivering a measurement configuration. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: Overlap Indicator
parameters.description: Indicates whether the neighboring cell is identified as a neighboring cell overlapping the local E-UTRAN cell. The default value is NO. The parameter value YES indicates that the neighboring cell is identified as a neighboring cell overlapping the local E-UTRAN cell. The parameter value NO indicates that the neighboring cell is not identified as a neighboring cell overlapping the local E-UTRAN cel

parameters.name: Overlap Range
parameters.description: Indicates the overlapping coverage area between the local cell and a target cell for determining the location-based UE selection policy for inter-frequency MLB. This parameter applies only to LTE TDD.

parameters.name: High Speed Interference Avoid Flag
parameters.description: Indicates whether to inform adjacent low-speed neighboring cells of high-speed train passing to reduce interference to high-speed UEs when a high-speed train reaches a high-speed dedicated network cell. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: Neighbor Cell Classification Label
parameters.description: Indicates the neighboring cell classification label. The parameter values FORMAL and EXTENDED represent different neighboring cell management policies. If the number of handovers to a neighboring cell reaches a predefined threshold, the parameter is set to FORMAL for this neighboring cell; otherwise, the parameter is set to EXTENDED for this neighboring cell. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD

parameters.name: Aggregation Attribute
parameters.description: Indicates the carrier aggregation attributes of the neighboring cell. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD. BlindScellCfg: If this option is selected, the neighboring cell can be configured as an SCell or PSCell in a blind manner to work with the serving cell. If the option is deselected, the blind configuration is not allowed.

parameters.id: Local Cell to NCell MLB PRB Thld
parameters.name: Local Cell to NCell MLB PRB Thld
parameters.description: Indicates the PRB usage threshold used to determine whether to trigger MLB from the local cell to the neighboring cell. This parameter does not take effect when it is set to 0. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.id: Local Cell to NCell MLB UE Number Thld
parameters.name: Local Cell to NCell MLB UE Number Thld
parameters.description: Indicates the threshold of the number of UEs for triggering MLB from the local cell to the neighboring cell. The value 0 indicates that this parameter is invalid. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.id: NCell to Local Cell MLB UE Number Thld
parameters.name: NCell to Local Cell MLB UE Number Thld
parameters.description: Indicates the threshold of the number of UEs for triggering MLB from the neighboring cell to the local cell. The value 0 indicates that this parameter is invalid. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: Control Mode
parameters.description: Indicates the control policy on ANR-related MOs, which can be defined by the user or be based on the automatic neighbor relation (ANR) algorithm. When this parameter is set to MANUAL_MODE, this MO can be modified or removed only by users. A failure message is displayed when a user adds an existing MO (with identical keywords). When this parameter is set to AUTO_MODE, this MO can be modified or rem

parameters.name: Overlap Indicator Extension
parameters.description: Indicates whether the neighboring cell is an overlapping neighboring cell of the local cell. VIRTUAL_4T4R_OVERLAP_INDICATOR: If this option is selected, the coverage areas of this neighboring cell and the local cell overlap. If this option is deselected, the coverage areas do not overlap. This option applies only to LTE FDD.

parameters.name: Neighboring Cell Addition Time
parameters.description: Indicates the time the neighboring cell was added by ANR for the first time. In free mode, this time is the local time of the NE. In control mode, this time is the local time of the OSS when optimization suggestions are delivered. The format is YYYY-MM-DD. For example, the value 2018-01-01 indicates January 1, 2018. The value 2001-01-01 indicates that the neighboring cell was manually added. This

parameters.name: Downlink Frequency Offset
parameters.description: Indicates the frequency offset of the PRB downlink central frequency to the downlink frequency. For details, see 3GPP TS 36.101. This parameter applies only to NB-IoT.

parameters.name: Physical cell ID
parameters.description: Indicates the physical cell identifier (PCI) of the neighboring E-UTRAN cell. For details about this parameter, see 3GPP TS 36.331.

parameters.name: Downlink EARFCN
parameters.description: Indicates the downlink (DL) E-UTRA absolute radio frequency channel number (EARFCN) of the neighboring E-UTRAN cell. For details about this parameter, see 3GPP TS 36.104.

parameters.name: Over Distance Flag
parameters.description: Indicates whether a neighboring cell is an over-distant neighboring cell. If the parameter value is BOOLEAN_TRUE(True), the neighboring cell is an over-distant neighboring cell. If the parameter value is BOOLEAN_FALSE(False), it is not an over-distant neighboring cell. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: Local cell ID
parameters.description: Indicates the cell ID of a local cell. It uniquely identifies a cell within an eNodeB.

parameters.name: Downlink EARFCN
parameters.description: Indicates the DL EARFCN of the neighboring cell on the neighboring E-UTRAN frequency. For details, see the 3GPP TS 36.104.

parameters.name: Uplink EARFCN configure indicator
parameters.description: Indicates whether to configure the uplink E-UTRA absolute radio frequency channel number (EARFCN) for the inter-frequency neighboring cell. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: Uplink EARFCN
parameters.description: Indicates the uplink E-UTRA absolute radio frequency channel number (EARFCN) of the inter-frequency neighboring cell. If the value of this parameter is not specified, the default uplink EARFCN is used, which is calculated based on the downlink EARFCN. For details about this parameter, see 3GPP TS 36.104. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.id: Inter frequency cell resel priority configure indicator
parameters.name: Inter frequency cell resel priority configure indicator
parameters.description: Indicates whether to set the reselection priority of the neighboring E-UTRAN frequency. For details about how UEs process frequency priorities during cell reselection, see section 5.2.4.1 of 3GPP TS 36.304 (V12.4.0). This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: Inter frequency cell resel priority
parameters.description: Indicates the cell reselection priority of the neighboring E-UTRAN frequency. The value 0 indicates the lowest priority. It is contained in SIB5. A UE determines whether to reselect to a neighboring cell on the frequency based on the value of this parameter and the absolute priority of the serving cell. If the priority specified by this parameter is higher than the priority of the serving cell, th

parameters.name: EUTRAN reselection time
parameters.description: Indicates the evaluation duration for a UE to determine whether to reselect the inter-frequency neighboring cell to camp on. If the signal quality in an inter-frequency neighboring cell is better than that in the serving cell for the period specified by this parameter and a UE camps on the serving cell for more than 1s, the UE attempts to reselect the inter-frequency neighboring cell to camp on. parameters.id: Speed dependent resel parameter configuring indicator
parameters.name: Speed dependent resel parameter configuring indicator
parameters.description: Indicates whether to set the speed-dependent scaling parameters related to cell reselection. If this parameter is set to NOT_CFG, speed-dependent cell reselections are not supported by default. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.id: Scaling factor of treseleutran in medium mobility state
parameters.name: Scaling factor of treseleutran in medium mobility state
parameters.description: Indicates the scaling factor applied to the cell reselection duration for medium-mobility UEs. This parameter is delivered in SIB5. For details, see 3GPP TS 36.331. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.id: Scaling factor of treseleutran in high mobility state
parameters.name: Scaling factor of treseleutran in high mobility state
parameters.description: Indicates the scaling factor applied to the cell reselection duration for high-mobility UEs. This parameter is delivered in SIB5. For details, see 3GPP TS 36.331. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: Measurement bandwidth
parameters.description: Indicates the measurement bandwidth of the inter-frequency neighboring cell on the frequency. The setting of this parameter depends on the bandwidth configuration of the cell. In E-UTRAN, a cell bandwidth is also expressed in units of resource blocks (RBs). parameters.name: Frequency offset
parameters.description: Indicates the frequency-specific offset for the neighboring E-UTRAN frequency that applies to UEs in idle mode. It is contained in system information block type 5 (SIB5) and delivered to UEs in idle mode for cell reselection. For details, see 3GPP TS 36.331.

parameters.name: Inter frequency high priority threshold
parameters.description: Indicates the minimum RX level required for a neighboring cell on the neighboring frequency to become a candidate for cell reselection if the cell reselection priority of the neighboring frequency is higher than that of the serving frequency. parameters.name: Inter frequency lower priority threshold
parameters.description: Indicates the minimum RX level required for a neighboring cell on the frequency to become a candidate for reselection if the priority of the frequency is lower than that of the serving frequency. parameters.name: PMAX configure indicator
parameters.description: Indicates whether to set the maximum power that the UE can apply to transmission on the neighboring E-UTRAN frequency. If the value of this parameter is not specified, the maximum power is subject to the UE capability.

parameters.name: PMAX
parameters.description: Indicates the maximum power that the UE can apply to transmission on the neighboring E-UTRAN frequency. It is used in cell reselection criteria to calculate the compensated power. If the value of this parameter is not specified, the maximum power is subject to the UE capability. For details, see 3GPP TS 36.304.

parameters.name: Neighbor Cell Configuration
parameters.description: Indicates the inter-frequency neighboring cell configuration of the local cell. The value BitString00 indicates that some inter-frequency neighboring cells have the same MBSFN subframe configuration as the local cell. parameters.name: Presence antenna port1
parameters.description: Indicates whether all inter-frequency neighboring cells on this frequency are configured with at least two antenna ports. Set this parameter to BOOLEAN_TRUE if all inter-frequency neighboring cells on this frequency are configured with at least two antenna ports. Set this parameter to BOOLEAN_FALSE if one inter-frequency neighboring cell on this frequency is configured with only one antenna port.

parameters.name: Inter-Freq HO trigger Event Type
parameters.description: Indicates the event to trigger coverage-based inter-frequency handovers. This parameter can be set to EventA3, EventA4, or EventA5. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.id: Inter frequency high priority RSRQ threshold
parameters.name: Inter frequency high priority RSRQ threshold

parameters.name: Inter frequency low priority RSRQ threshold
parameters.description: Indicates the RSRQ-based minimum RX level required for a neighboring cell on the frequency to become a candidate for reselection if the RSRQ-based priority of the frequency is lower than that of the serving frequency. parameters.id: Minimum RX signal quality configuration indicator
parameters.name: Minimum RX signal quality configuration indicator
parameters.description: Indicates whether to set the minimum required RX level.

parameters.name: Minimum RX signal quality
parameters.description: Indicates the minimum RX level of an inter-frequency neighboring cell, which is required for it to become a candidate for cell reselection. It determines the probability of triggering cell reselection to inter-frequency neighboring cells on the frequency. The value of this parameter is contained in SIB5. For details, see 3GPP TS 36.331.

parameters.name: Frequency Priority for Connected Mode
parameters.description: Indicates the frequency priority based on which the eNodeB selects a target frequency for blind redirection or contains a frequency in a measurement configuration. If a blind redirection is triggered and the target neighboring cell is not specified, the eNodeB selects a target frequency based on this priority. parameters.name: Mobility Load Balancing Target Indicator
parameters.description: Indicates whether the neighboring E-UTRAN frequency can be a target frequency for MLB. The value ALLOWED indicates that the neighboring E-UTRAN frequency can be a target frequency for MLB. The value NOT_ALLOWED indicates that the neighboring E-UTRAN frequency cannot be a target frequency for MLB. parameters.id: Frequency Priority Based Ho Measure Flag
parameters.name: Frequency Priority Based Ho Measure Flag
parameters.description: Indicates whether to enable or disable measurement for frequency-priority-based inter-frequency handovers to neighboring frequencies. parameters.name: Idle MLB UE Release Ratio
parameters.description: Indicates the preset proportion of UEs in idle mode on the neighboring frequency. This parameter takes effect when both the INTER_FREQ_IDLE_MLB_SWITCH option of the MlbAlgoSwitch parameter and the Proportion option of the InterFreqIdleMlbMode parameter in the CellMLB MO are selected. parameters.name: MLB Frequency Priority
parameters.description: Indicates the priority of the neighboring E-UTRAN frequency for MLB. The value 0 indicates the lowest priority. The eNodeB selects a high-priority frequency as the target frequency for MLB. For LTE TDD, if the eNodeB performs MLB that distinguishes between the uplink and downlink transmission directions, the parameter indicates the downlink priority of the neighboring E-UTRAN frequency for MLB. parameters.name: Downlink Frequency Offset
parameters.description: Indicates the frequency offset of the PRB downlink central frequency to the downlink frequency. For details, see 3GPP TS 36.101. This parameter applies only to NB-IoT.

parameters.name: Uplink Frequency Offset
parameters.description: Indicates the frequency offset of the PRB uplink central frequency to the uplink frequency. This parameter takes effect only when UlEarfcnCfgInd is set to CFG(Configure). Otherwise, the offset is calculated based on the uplink/downlink symmetric system. For details, see 3GPP TS 36.101. This parameter applies only to NB-IoT.

parameters.name: Frequency Offset for Connected Mode
parameters.description: Indicates the frequency-specific offset for the neighboring E-UTRAN frequency that applies to UEs in connected mode. It is contained in the event A3/A4/A5 measurement configuration and delivered to UEs in connected mode. The offset affects the probability of reporting events A3, A4, and A5. For details, see 3GPP TS 36.331. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: Measurement Frequency Priority
parameters.description: Indicates the frequency measurement priority. A larger value indicates a higher priority. If the CovBasedInterfreqHoMode parameter is set to BASEDONSIGNALSTRENGTH or BASEDONFREQPRIORITY or the FixedMeasObjIDSwitch option of the MultiFreqPriControlSwitch parameter is selected, the eNodeB delivers frequencies for measurement based on the priority specified by this parameter in inter-frequency handov

parameters.id: Cov-based Inter-Freq HO Thd RSRP Offset
parameters.name: Cov-based Inter-Freq HO Thd RSRP Offset
parameters.description: Indicates the offset to the RSRP threshold for events A4 and A5 that trigger coverage-based inter-frequency handovers. In coverage-based handovers, the eNodeB delivers the RSRP threshold for event A4 or A5 to UEs, which is equal to the sum of the InterFreqHoA4ThdRsrp and IfHoThdRsrpOffset parameter values. parameters.name: Inter-Freq Mlb Threshold RSRP Offset
parameters.description: Indicates the offset to the RSRP threshold related to load-based inter-frequency handovers. parameters.name: Master Band Flag
parameters.description: Indicates whether the EARFCN is specific to the primary frequency band. Among the EARFCNs of the same frequency, if the MasterBandFlag parameter is set to TRUE for one EARFCN and FALSE for other EARFCNs, the former EARFCN is specific to the primary frequency band while the latter EARFCNs are specific to secondary frequency bands. In this case, only the EARFCN specific to the primary frequency band

parameters.name: Inter Frequency RAN Sharing Indication
parameters.description: Indicates whether an intra-RAT inter-frequency neighboring cell is a shared neighboring cell. If this parameter is set to BOOLEAN_TRUE, the neighboring E-UTRAN frequency is a shared frequency, and the shared operator information must be checked on the OSS before all inter-frequency neighboring cells are added. parameters.name: Inter-frequency Highspeed Flag
parameters.description: Indicates whether the inter-frequency cells on the frequency are low-speed, high-speed, ultra-high-speed, or extra-high-speed cells. This parameter indicates the handover direction when high- or low-speed handover algorithm is enabled for high-speed railway UEs. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD. parameters.name: ANR Indication
parameters.description: Indicates whether information about inter-frequency neighboring cells on the neighboring E-UTRA frequency can be maintained by ANR. If this parameter is set to ALLOWED, the information can be maintained by ANR. If this parameter is set to NOT_ALLOWED, the information cannot be maintained by ANR. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: Voip Priority
parameters.description: Indicates the frequency priority of providing VoIP services on the intra-RAT neighboring frequency. A larger value of this parameter indicates a higher priority. During coverage-based inter-frequency handovers of UEs with voice bearers, if the VoIP directional handover function takes effect, the eNodeB selects and delivers the neighboring frequencies based on the frequency priorities when starting

parameters.name: PS Service Priority
parameters.description: Indicates the priority of a neighboring E-UTRAN frequency for carrying PS services. A large value indicates a high priority. If PsMeasFreqPriSwitch is on, the eNodeB preferentially selects the neighboring E-UTRAN frequency with the highest PS service priority for measurement during a coverage-based inter-frequency handover procedure. parameters.name: VoLTE HO Target Frequency Indication
parameters.description: This parameter specifies whether the neighboring E-UTRAN frequency can be a target frequency for VoLTE UEs in handovers. If this parameter is set to ALLOWED, the neighboring E-UTRAN frequency can be a target frequency for VoLTE UEs in handovers. parameters.name: Backoff Target Indicator
parameters.description: Indicates whether a neighboring E-UTRA frequency can be selected as the target frequency for backoff MLB. If this parameter is set to ALLOWED(ALLOWED), the neighboring frequency can be selected as the target frequency for backoff MLB. If this parameter is set to NOT_ALLOWED(NOT_ALLOWED), the neighboring frequency cannot be selected as the target frequency for backoff MLB. This parameter applies on

parameters.name: MLB Inter-Freq Handover Event Type
parameters.description: Indicates the event type used to trigger MLB-based inter-frequency handovers. The handovers can be triggered based on event A3, event A4, or event A5. Event A3 only applies to LTE TDD. parameters.name: Mobility Target Indicator
parameters.description: Indicates whether the frequency can be selected as the target frequency for mobility. SpeedMobilityTargetInd: If both this option and the InterFreqSpeedHoSwitch option are selected, the frequency can be selected as a target frequency for speed-based inter-frequency handovers. If this option is deselected, the frequency cannot be selected as a target frequency for speed-based inter-frequency handov

parameters.name: MLB Inter-Freq Efficiency Ratio
parameters.description: Indicates the ratio of spectral efficiency of the local cell to that of a neighboring cell. If PRB-usage-based MLB is triggered in the local cell, the eNodeB considers the ratio of spectral efficiency of the local cell to that of a neighboring cell when determining load differences between the local and neighboring cell. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: SNR Based UE Selection Mode
parameters.description: Indicates the SNR-based UE selection mode during MLB. If this parameter is set to Random(Random), UEs are selected without considering the SNR. If this parameter is set to Best(Best), UEs with good SNRs are preferentially transferred. If this parameter is set to Worst(Worst), UEs with poor SNRs are preferentially transferred. This parameter takes effect only if FreqSelectStrategy is set to FAIRSTR

parameters.name: UL Traffic MLB Target Indicator
parameters.description: Indicates whether the neighboring E-UTRAN frequency can be selected as a target frequency for uplink-traffic-based MLB. If this parameter is set to ALLOWED, this frequency can be selected as the target frequency. If this parameter is set to NOT_ALLOWED, this frequency cannot be selected as the target frequency. This parameter applies only to LTE TDD.

parameters.name: UL Traffic MLB Priority
parameters.description: Indicates the priority of the neighboring E-UTRAN frequency to be selected as a target frequency for uplink traffic-based MLB. The value 0 indicates the lowest priority. The eNodeB selects a high-priority frequency as the target frequency for uplink traffic-based MLB. This parameter applies only to LTE TDD.

parameters.name: MLB Inter-Freq Handover A3 Offset
parameters.description: Indicates the offset of signal quality of a neighboring cell to that of the serving cell. This parameter is used to trigger event A3-based handovers for inter-frequency MLB. A larger value of this parameter indicates that better signal quality of the neighboring cells is required to trigger a handover for event A3-based inter-frequency MLB. parameters.id: Inter-Freq Service HO Thd RSRQ Offset

parameters.name: MLB Frequency UL Priority
parameters.description: Indicates the priority of a neighboring frequency in the uplink for inter-frequency MLB. The value 0 indicates the lowest priority. The eNodeB selects a high-priority frequency in the uplink preferentially as the target frequency for uplink MLB. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.description: Indicates the offset relative to the downlink PRB usage threshold used to trigger load transfer to inter-frequency neighboring cells on the neighboring frequency for MLB. parameters.name: Neighbouring Cell Number for ANR
parameters.description: Indicates the minimum number of neighboring cells on the neighboring E-UTRAN frequency. The value 0 indicates that the minimum number of neighboring cells on the specified frequency is not restricted. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: Measurement Performance Demand
parameters.description: Indicates the measurement performance demand for whether to broadcast the frequency in SIB5. If this parameter is set to NORMAL, the frequency is broadcast in interFreqCarrierFreqList without carrying the IE reducedMeasPerformance. The measurement performance of a UE is normal when the UE measures the frequency. If this parameter is set to REDUCED, the frequency is broadcast in interFreqCarrierFre

parameters.name: Inter-Freq Backoff Threshold RSRP Offset
parameters.description: Indicates the offset to the RSRP threshold for triggering handovers for inter-frequency backoff MLB. To trigger handovers for inter-frequency backoff MLB, the eNodeB delivers the RSRP threshold for event A4 or A5 to UEs, which equals the sum of this offset and the InterFreqLoadBasedHoA4ThdRsrp parameter value in the InterFreqHoGroup MO. parameters.name: Inter-Freq Backoff Threshold RSRQ Offset

parameters.id: VoLTE Qual Inter-Freq HO Target Indication
parameters.name: VoLTE Qual Inter-Freq HO Target Indication
parameters.description: Indicates whether the neighboring E-UTRAN frequency can be used as a target frequency for handovers due to poor voice quality. If this parameter is set to ALLOWED(ALLOWED), the neighboring E-UTRAN frequency can be used as a target frequency for handovers due to poor voice quality. parameters.id: Idle eMTC UE Release Ratio for MLB
parameters.name: Idle eMTC UE Release Ratio for MLB
parameters.description: Indicates the proportion of eMTC UEs in RRC_IDLE state transferred to different frequencies for MLB. This parameter takes effect when both the InterFreqIdleMlbSwitch option of the MlbAlgoSwitch parameter and the eMtcProportion option of the InterFreqIdleMlbMode parameter are selected. parameters.name: Inter-Freq CIO Adjustment Configuration Ind
parameters.description: Indicates how to set the upper and lower limits of the inter-frequency CIO adjustment range for the cell. If this parameter is set to NOT_CFG, the CIO adjustment range for the cell in inter-frequency MRO is not configured separately. Instead, the value range is the same as that in intra-frequency MRO. parameters.name: Inter-Freq CIO Adjustment Lower Limit
parameters.description: Indicates the lower limit of inter-frequency cell individual offset (CIO) adjustment range for the cell in mobility robustness optimization (MRO). This parameter takes effect only when the InterFreqCioAdjLimitCfgInd parameter is set to MANUAL_CFG.

parameters.name: Inter-Freq CIO Adjustment Upper Limit
parameters.description: Indicates the upper limit of inter-frequency cell individual offset (CIO) adjustment range for the cell in mobility robustness optimization (MRO). This parameter takes effect only when the InterFreqCioAdjLimitCfgInd parameter is set to MANUAL_CFG.

parameters.name: Inter Frequency 4T Indicator
parameters.description: Indicates whether a neighboring E-UTRA frequency is a 4T- or 2T-cell frequency. The values of FREQ2T and FREQ4T indicate that the corresponding frequency is a 2T- and 4T-cell frequency, respectively. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD.

parameters.name: Control Mode
parameters.description: Indicates the control policy on ANR-related MOs, which can be defined by the user or be based on the automatic neighbor relation (ANR) algorithm. When this parameter is set to MANUAL_MODE, this MO can be modified or removed only by users. A failure message is displayed when a user adds an existing MO (with identical keywords). When this parameter is set to AUTO_MODE, this MO can be modified or rem

parameters.name: Meas Priority for Freq-Priority-based HO
parameters.description: Indicates the measurement priority of the frequency for frequency-priority-based handovers. Before delivering frequencies to measure for frequency-priority-based handovers, the eNodeB selects frequencies based on the settings of this parameter. parameters.name: eMTC Inter-Frequency Cell Resel Priority
parameters.description: Indicates the cell reselection priority of the E-UTRAN frequency for eMTC UEs. The value 0 indicates the lowest priority. parameters.id: Power Offset for Resel to Inter Freq NB-IoT Cell
parameters.name: Power Offset for Resel to Inter Freq NB-IoT Cell
parameters.description: Indicates the power offset for NB-IoT UEs with a 14 dBm power level in inter-frequency cell reselection. If this parameter is set to NULL, this parameter is not delivered in system information. In this case, the UEs regard that the power offset is 0 dB by default. For details, see 3GPP TS 36.331. This parameter applies only to NB-IoT.

parameters.id: Inter-Freq HO A5 Thld1 RSRP Offset
parameters.name: Inter-Freq HO A5 Thld1 RSRP Offset
parameters.description: Indicates the offset to the RSRP threshold 1 for event A5 related to coverage-based inter-frequency handovers. During coverage-based inter-frequency handovers, the delivered RSRP threshold for event A5 is the sum of the InterFreqHoA5Thd1Rsrp parameter and this offset. parameters.id: Inter-Freq HO A5 Thld1 RSRQ Offset
parameters.name: Inter-Freq HO A5 Thld1 RSRQ Offset
parameters.description: Indicates the offset to the RSRQ threshold 1 for event A5 related to coverage-based inter-frequency handovers. During coverage-based inter-frequency handovers, the delivered RSRQ threshold for event A5 is the sum of the InterFreqHoA5Thd1Rsrq parameter and this offset. If the sum is less than -40, -40 is delivered. If the sum is greater than -6, -6 is delivered. This parameter applies only to LTE F

parameters.id: Inter-Freq Periodic MR Freq Group ID
parameters.name: Inter-Freq Periodic MR Freq Group ID
parameters.description: Indicates the ID of a frequency group for inter-frequency periodic MRs. The InterFreqPeriodicMrCtrlSw parameter in the CellUeMeasControlCfg MO controls whether to enable periodic MR reporting for neighboring frequencies in one or more frequency groups. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: Inter-Freq Redirection Switch
parameters.description: Indicates whether the eNodeB executes a redirection procedure to the frequency when the eNodeB determines to perform a handover to a cell on the frequency for a UE. If this option is selected, the eNodeB executes a redirection procedure in the preceding scenario. If this option is deselected, the eNodeB executes a handover procedure in the preceding scenario. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD

parameters.id: Power Ofs for NB-IoT Inter-Freq Redirection
parameters.name: Power Ofs for NB-IoT Inter-Freq Redirection
parameters.description: Indicates the power offset of NB-IoT UEs used to trigger inter-frequency redirection. If this parameter is set to NULL, this parameter is not delivered in RRC Connection Release messages. In this case, the UEs regard that the power offset is 0 dB by default. For details, see 3GPP TS 36.331. This parameter applies only to NB-IoT.

parameters.id: Min Required Quality Level for CE Mode A
parameters.name: Min Required Quality Level for CE Mode A
parameters.description: Indicates the minimum received signal quality required by UEs in CE mode A for cell reselection to inter-frequency neighboring E-UTRAN cells. It is used as an input parameter for cell reselection criterion. If this parameter is set to 0, SIB5 does not contain the q-QualMin IE, and UEs use the default value negative infinity. parameters.id: Min Required Quality Level for CE Mode B
parameters.name: Min Required Quality Level for CE Mode B
parameters.description: Indicates the minimum received signal quality required by UEs in CE mode B for cell reselection to inter-frequency neighboring E-UTRAN cells. It is used as an input parameter for cell reselection criterion. If this parameter is set to 0, SIB5 does not contain the q-QualMin IE, and UEs use the default value negative infinity. In this case, only the signal level is used for UEs to select and reselec

parameters.id: Min Required RX Level for CE Mode A
parameters.name: Min Required RX Level for CE Mode A
parameters.description: Indicates the minimum receive level required by UEs in CE mode A for cell reselection to inter-frequency neighboring E-UTRAN cells. It is used as an input parameter for cell reselection criterion. For details, see 3GPP TS 36.304. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.id: Min Required RX Level for CE Mode B
parameters.name: Min Required RX Level for CE Mode B
parameters.description: Indicates the minimum receive level required by UEs in CE mode B for cell reselection to inter-frequency neighboring E-UTRAN cells. It is used as an input parameter for cell reselection criterion. For details, see 3GPP TS 36.304. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: VoLTE Cov-based Inter-Freq HO A5 Thld 1 RSRP Ofs
parameters.description: Indicates the offset to the RSRP threshold 1 for event A5 related to coverage-based inter-frequency handovers of VoLTE UEs. For coverage-based handovers of VoLTE UEs, the delivered RSRP threshold 1 for event A5 is the sum of the InterFreqHoA5Thd1Rsrp, InterFreqHoA5Thd1RsrpOfs, and CovIfHoA5VolteThld1RsrpOfs parameter values. parameters.id: VoLTE Cov-based Inter-Freq HO A5 Thld 2 RSRP Ofs
parameters.name: VoLTE Cov-based Inter-Freq HO A5 Thld 2 RSRP Ofs
parameters.description: Indicates the offset to the RSRP threshold 2 for event A5 related to coverage-based inter-frequency handovers of VoLTE UEs. parameters.name: A3-based Inter-Freq HO Serving Cell RSRP Ofs

parameters.id: Cov-based IF HO Serving Cell RSRP Ofs for NSA DC
parameters.name: Cov-based IF HO Serving Cell RSRP Ofs for NSA DC

When an NSA DC UE reports inter-frequency event A3 and the serving cell's RSRP value is less than the sum of the values of the InterFreqHoGroup.A3InterFreqHoA2ThdRsrp and EutranInterNFreq.NsaCovIfHoServCellRsrpOfs parameters, an A3-based inter-frequency handover will be triggered.
