parameters.name: Aggregation Attribute
parameters.description: Indicates the aggregation attributes of the neighboring E-UTRAN frequency. VG_MODEL_FORBID_BUILD_FLAG: If this option is selected, virtual grid models cannot be built for the neighboring frequency. If this option is deselected, virtual grid models can be built for the neighboring frequency. This option applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.id: Freq-Pri-based HO A4 Thld RSRP Offset
parameters.name: Freq-Pri-based HO A4 Thld RSRP Offset
parameters.description: Indicates the frequency-specific offset relative to the RSRP threshold for event A4 related to frequency-priority-based inter-frequency handovers. If the offset is set to 0, the inter-frequency A4 RSRP threshold is set without distinguishing frequencies. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: Local cell ID
parameters.description: Indicates the cell ID of the local cell. It uniquely identifies a cell within an eNodeB.

parameters.name: Mobile country code
parameters.description: Indicates the mobile country code of the E-UTRAN neighboring cell. The PLMN consists of the MCC and the MNC. The MCC consists of three digits. The MNC consists of two to three digits. For example, if the MCC is 123 and the MNC is 45, then the PLMN ID is 12345.

parameters.name: Mobile network code
parameters.description: Indicates the mobile network code of the E-UTRAN neighboring cell. The PLMN consists of the MCC and the MNC. The MCC consists of three digits. The MNC consists of two to three digits. For example, if the MCC is 123 and the MNC is 45, then the PLMN ID is 12345.

parameters.name: eNodeB ID
parameters.description: Indicates the eNodeB ID of the intra-frequency neighboring cell. It uniquely identifies an eNodeB within a PLMN. The 28-bit E-UTRAN cell ID is comprised of the cell ID and the eNodeB ID (represented by the most significant 20 bits). The cell global identity (CGI) of an E-UTRAN cell is comprised of the E-UTRAN cell ID and the PLMN ID. For details, see 3GPP TS 36.413.

parameters.name: Cell ID
parameters.description: Indicates the local ID of the intra-frequency neighboring cell. It uniquely identifies a cell within an eNodeB. The 28-bit E-UTRAN cell ID is comprised of the cell ID (represented by the least significant eight bits) and the eNodeB ID. The cell global identity (CGI) of an E-UTRAN cell is comprised of the E-UTRAN cell ID and the PLMN ID. For details, see 3GPP TS 36.413.

parameters.name: Cell individual offset
parameters.description: Indicates the cell individual offset for the intra-frequency neighboring cell. It affects the probability of triggering intra-frequency measurement reports. A larger value of this parameter indicates a higher probability. For details, see 3GPP TS 36.331. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: Cell offset
parameters.description: Indicates the offset for the intra-frequency neighboring cell, which is used in evaluation for cell reselections. A larger value of this parameter results in a lower probability of cell reselections to this neighboring cell. If this parameter is not set to dB0, it is delivered in SIB4. For details, see 3GPP TS 36.331. If this parameter is set to dB0, it is not delivered in SIB4. In this situation,

parameters.name: No handover indicator
parameters.description: Indicates whether handovers of UEs to the neighboring cell are prohibited. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: No remove indicator
parameters.description: Indicates whether to permit or prohibit removal of the neighbor relationship by ANR. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: ANR flag
parameters.description: Indicates whether this neighboring cell is automatically discovered by the ANR algorithm. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: Local cell name
parameters.description: Indicates the name of the local cell.

parameters.name: Neighbour cell name
parameters.description: Indicates the name of the intra-frequency neighboring E-UTRAN cell.

parameters.name: Cell Measure Priority
parameters.description: Indicates the priority of measurement on the intra-frequency neighboring cell. The eNodeB preferentially contains the information about a neighboring cell with this priority set to HIGH_PRIORITY while delivering a measurement configuration. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: Cell Range Expansion
parameters.description: Indicates the maximum cell coverage offset. This parameter is specified to achieve coverage expansion of micro base stations. The offset that actually takes effect depends on UE capabilities. The parameter value is added to or subtracted from the handover parameter cell individual offset (CIO) to obtain a new CIO, which must meet protocol-defined constraints. The updated CIO is delivered to UEs so

parameters.name: Neighbor Cell Classification Label
parameters.description: Indicates the neighboring cell classification label. The parameter values FORMAL and EXTENDED represent different neighboring cell management policies. If the number of handovers to a neighboring cell reaches a predefined threshold, the parameter is set to FORMAL for this neighboring cell; otherwise, the parameter is set to EXTENDED for this neighboring cell. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD

parameters.name: Control Mode
parameters.description: Indicates the control policy on ANR-related MOs, which can be defined by the user or be based on the automatic neighbor relation (ANR) algorithm. When this parameter is set to MANUAL_MODE, this MO can be modified or removed only by users. A failure message is displayed when a user adds an existing MO (with identical keywords). When this parameter is set to AUTO_MODE, this MO can be modified or rem

parameters.name: Attach Cell Switch
parameters.description: Indicates whether to enable the macro-micro homing relationship of the intra-frequency neighboring cell. In HetNet networking, the macro cell and micro cell that greatly interfere each other are added to one cluster, and homing relationships are configured between the macro and micro cells in each cluster. A cluster consists of one macro cell and a maximum of eight homed micro cells. If this param

parameters.name: High Speed Cell Individual Offset
parameters.description: Indicates the individual cell offset for event A3 related to intra-frequency handovers for high-speed UEs in high-speed cells. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: Vector Cell Flag
parameters.description: Indicates whether an intra-frequency neighboring cell is a vector cell. A vector cell is a neighboring cell with coverage adjacent to that of the serving cell along a high-speed railway. This type of cell requires planning during network construction. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: Neighboring Cell Addition Time
parameters.description: Indicates the time the neighboring cell was added by ANR for the first time. In free mode, this time is the local time of the NE. In control mode, this time is the local time of the OSS when optimization suggestions are delivered. The format is YYYY-MM-DD. For example, the value 2018-01-01 indicates January 1, 2018. The value 2001-01-01 indicates that the neighboring cell was manually added. This

parameters.name: Aggregation Attribute
parameters.description: Indicates the aggregation attribute of an intra-frequency neighboring E-UTRAN cell. UL_INTRF_DET_COORD_NCELL_FLAG: If this option is selected, the neighboring cell is a coordinating cell for uplink interference detection of the serving cell. If this option is deselected, the neighboring cell is not a coordinating cell for uplink interference detection of the serving cell. This option applies only

parameters.name: Downlink Frequency Offset
parameters.description: Indicates the frequency offset of the PRB downlink central frequency to the downlink frequency. For details, see 3GPP TS 36.101. This parameter applies only to NB-IoT.

parameters.name: Physical cell ID
parameters.description: Indicates the physical cell identifier (PCI) of the neighboring E-UTRAN cell. For details about this parameter, see 3GPP TS 36.331.

parameters.name: Downlink EARFCN
parameters.description: Indicates the downlink (DL) E-UTRA absolute radio frequency channel number (EARFCN) of the neighboring E-UTRAN cell. For details about this parameter, see 3GPP TS 36.104.

parameters.name: Over Distance Flag
parameters.description: Indicates whether a neighboring cell is an over-distant neighboring cell. If this parameter is set to BOOLEAN_TRUE(True), the neighboring cell is a distant neighboring cell. If this parameter is set to BOOLEAN_FALSE(False), the neighboring cell is not a distant neighboring cell. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: Dynamic CRE Value
parameters.description: Indicates the cell range expansion (CRE) value in the current adjustment period after eICIC adaptation is enabled. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: Local cell ID
parameters.description: Indicates the ID of the local cell. It uniquely identifies a cell within an eNodeB. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: Downlink EARFCN
parameters.description: Indicates the DL EARFCN of the operator that shares the neighboring E-UTRAN frequency. For details, see the 3GPP TS 36.104. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: Mobile country code
parameters.description: Indicates the mobile country code (MCC) of the operator that shares the neighboring E-UTRAN frequency. A public land mobile network (PLMN) ID is comprised of an MCC and a mobile network code (MNC). The MCC consists of three digits. The MNC consists of two to three digits. For example, if the MCC is 123 and the MNC is 45, the PLMN ID is 12345. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: Mobile network code
parameters.description: Indicates the mobile network code (MNC) of the operator that shares the neighboring E-UTRAN frequency. A public land mobile network (PLMN) ID is comprised of a mobile network code (MCC) and an MNC. The MCC consists of three digits. The MNC consists of two to three digits. For example, if the MCC is 123 and the MNC is 45, the PLMN ID is 12345. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: Cell reselection priority configure indicator
parameters.description: Indicates whether to configure the cell reselection priority. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: Cell reselection priority
parameters.description: Indicates the cell reselection priority of the operator that shares the neighboring E-UTRAN frequency. The value 0 indicates the lowest priority. If the related SPID configuration is specified, the cell reselection priority specified in the SPID configuration is used. If no related SPID configuration is specified but this parameter is set, the eNodeB delivers the cell reselection priorities of all

parameters.name: Local cell ID
parameters.description: Indicates the ID of the local cell. It uniquely identifies a cell within an eNodeB. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: Downlink EARFCN
parameters.description: Indicates the DL EARFCN of the Operator Configuration for Serving Cell in E-UTRAN Frequency. For details, see the 3GPP TS 36.104. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: Cn operator ID
parameters.description: Indicates the ID of the operator. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.id: Cell reselection dedicated priority configure indicator
parameters.name: Cell reselection dedicated priority configure indicator
parameters.description: Indicates whether to configure a dedicated cell-reselection priority based on the PLMN ID of the local cell for the neighboring E-UTRAN frequency. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: Cell reselection dedicated priority
parameters.description: Indicates the cell reselection dedicated priority for an E-UTRAN frequency based on the PLMN ID of the local cell. The value 0 indicates the lowest priority. If the related SPID configuration is specified, the cell reselection priority specified in the SPID configuration is used. If no related SPID configuration is specified but this parameter is set, the eNodeB delivers the cell reselection prior

parameters.name: Downlink EARFCN
parameters.description: Indicates the downlink (DL) E-UTRA absolute radio frequency channel number (EARFCN) of the E-UTRAN cell with a specified physical cell identifier (PCI). This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: Start Physical Cell ID
parameters.description: Indicates the start physical cell identifier (PCI) of E-UTRAN cells with specified PCIs. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: Specified Physical Cell ID Range
parameters.description: Indicates the number of physical cell identifiers (PCIs) of E-UTRAN cells with specified PCIs. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: Specified PCI Group Policy Switch
parameters.description: Indicates the algorithm policy switch of a specified PCI group. This parameter provides the following option: NO_HO_BASED_X2_AUTO_SETUP_SW: Indicates whether to forbid handover-based X2 self-setup to an eNodeB that serves a cell with a PCI in the specified PCI group. This function is enabled only if this option is selected. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: Mobile country code
parameters.description: Indicates the mobile country code (MCC) of a target eNodeB. A public land mobile network (PLMN) ID is comprised of an MCC and a mobile network code (MNC). The MCC consists of three digits. The MNC consists of two or three digits. For example, if the MCC is 123 and the MNC is 45, the PLMN ID is 12345. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: Mobile network code
parameters.description: Indicates the mobile network code (MNC) of a target eNodeB. A public land mobile network (PLMN) ID is comprised of a mobile country code (MCC) and an MNC. The MCC consists of three digits. The MNC consists of two or three digits. For example, if the MCC is 123 and the MNC is 45, the PLMN ID is 12345. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: Tac
parameters.description: Indicates the tracking area code (TAC), which is used by the EPC to determine the area within which paging messages are sent. One tracking area is comprised of one or more cells. Two TAC values 0x0000(0) and 0xFFFE(65534) are reserved according to the protocol and will not be used in future versions. parameters.id: UL Inter eNodeB Coordinated AMC Switch
parameters.name: UL Inter eNodeB Coordinated AMC Switch
parameters.description: Indicates whether to enable inter-eNodeB coordinated uplink AMC in the centralized Cloud BB networking. This parameter applies only to LTE TDD.

parameters.name: eX2 Object ID
parameters.description: Indicates the eX2 object ID. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: End-Point Group Configuration Flag
parameters.description: Indicates whether to configure the control-plane or user-plane end point group. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: Control Plane End-Point Group ID
parameters.description: Indicates the ID of the control-plane end point group used by the eX2 object. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: User Plane End-Point Group ID
parameters.description: Indicates the ID of the user-plane end point group used by the eX2 object. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: eX2 Interface Backhaul Type
parameters.description: Indicates the transport type of the eX2 interface. SRIO- or Ethernet-based transport system connecting through the USU is called ideal backhaul. IPRAN- or PTN-based transport system shared with the S1 or X2 interface is called non-ideal backhaul. The transport type of eX2 interfaces between logical eNodeBs contained in a physical network (for example, a physical eNodeB) is called intra physical ne

parameters.name: eX2 Object Description
parameters.description: Indicates the description of the eX2 object. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: Control Mode
parameters.description: Indicates whether the MO can be automatically modified or removed by the eNodeB. If this parameter is set to MANUAL_MODE(Manual Mode), both operators and the eNodeB can modify or remove this MO. If this parameter is set to AUTO_MODE(Auto Mode), only the eNodeB can modify or remove this MO.

parameters.name: eX2 Interface ID
parameters.description: Indicates the eX2 interface ID. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: eX2 Interface State
parameters.description: Indicates the status of the eX2 interface. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: eX2 Interface CP Bearer ID
parameters.description: Indicates the control port (CP) bearer ID of the eX2 interface. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: eX2 Interface CP Bearer State
parameters.description: Indicates the status of the CP bearer for the eX2 interface. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: Port ID
parameters.description: Indicates the ID of a port that is connected to an external NE.

parameters.name: Cabinet No.
parameters.description: Indicates the number of the cabinet where the physical port is located.

parameters.name: Subrack No.
parameters.description: Indicates the number of the subrack where the physical port is located.

parameters.name: Slot No.

parameters.name: Choose UMTS Cell Load Info Trans Channel
parameters.description: Indicates the UMTS load transmission channel. The eNodeB sends RAN-INFORMATION-REQUEST PDUs to UTRAN cells to request multiple reports on the load status of UTRAN cells only when the parameter is set to BASED_ON_RIM. The function specified by the parameter value BASED_ON_ECO is temporarily unavailable. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.id: S1 handover in data forwarding switch
parameters.name: S1 handover in data forwarding switch
parameters.description: Indicates the switch used to control the data forwarding mechanism in S1-based incoming handovers. parameters.name: Inter RAT Link Setup Switch
parameters.description: Indicates the inter-RAT link setup switch. BTS_ENODEB_LINK_SETUP_SWITCH: Indicates whether to set up a link between a BTS and an eNodeB. This option applies only to LTE FDD.

parameters.id: The Timer of X2 delete by SON
parameters.name: The Timer of X2 delete by SON
parameters.description: Indicates length of the time in which the X2 interface configuration is retained on the local and peer eNodeBs when cells served by the two eNodeBs do not have a neighbor relationship with each other. parameters.name: RIM Coding Policy
parameters.description: Indicates the eNodeB coding scheme for Global eNodeB ID IE and Reporting Cell ID IE in the RIM message. If the EPC devices that exchange RIM messages with eNodeBs are provided by Huawei and the peer devices adopt the private coding scheme, set this parameter to Private Coding. In other cases, set this parameter to Standard Coding. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.id: L2GU Handover Required With LTE Cap Switch
parameters.name: L2GU Handover Required With LTE Cap Switch
parameters.description: Indicates whether the handover request message for a handover from E-UTRAN to UTRAN or GERAN contains the UE-EUTRA-Capability information element (IE). This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: Different Operator With Same MMEC Switch
parameters.description: Indicates whether MMEs of different operators that share the eNodeB can be configured with the same mobility management entity code (MMEC). If this parameter is set to OFF, MMEs of different operators that share the eNodeB cannot be configured with the same MMEC. If this parameter is set to ON, MMEs of different operators that share the eNodeB can be configured with the same MMEC.

parameters.id: Peer Request Based X2 Delete Switch
parameters.name: Peer Request Based X2 Delete Switch
parameters.description: Indicates whether to enable the X2 automatic removal based on a request from the peer eNodeB. If this parameter is set to ON(On), this function is enabled. parameters.description: Indicates whether the SN STATUS TRANSFER message contains the IE "Receive Status Of UL PDCP SDUs" during an S1- or X2-based outgoing handover. If this parameter is set to OFF, the SN STATUS TRANSFER message contains the IE "Receive Status Of UL PDCP SDUs" when the eNodeB receives out-of-order uplink PDCP packets for bearers in AM. parameters.name: Protocol Message Optimization Switch

parameters.name: X2 served cell type
parameters.description: Indicates the type of served cells, which is contained in protocol-defined messages exchanged in X2 Setup and eNB Configuration Update procedures. If this parameter is set to ACTIVE_CELL(Active Cell), the served cells include all the activated cells. If this parameter is set to CONFIGURED_CELL(Configured Cell), the served cells include all the configured cells. This parameter applies only to LTE F

parameters.id: eNB Triggered MME load re-balance switch
parameters.name: eNB Triggered MME load re-balance switch
parameters.description: Indicates whether to enable eNodeB-triggered MME load rebalancing. When this parameter is set to ON(On), the eNodeB releases the RRC connection for a UE with the cause value "loadBalancingTAUrequired" if the UE accesses the cell using an S-TMSI that is associated with an overloaded MME. This ensures that the UE can be routed to a lightly loaded MME if it initiates another access request. When this

parameters.name: Ue Release Resynchronization Times
parameters.description: Indicates the number of resynchronization failures after which the UE release timer is started in scenarios where the RRC connection is released for a UE caused by resynchronization failure. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: Ue Release Check Lost Switch
parameters.description: Indicates whether to perform the radio link failure (RLF) detection for a UE when the RRC connection for the UE is released because of UE inactivity. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: UE Link Abnormal Detect Switch
parameters.description: Indicates the UE link fault detection switch. If this switch is turned on, link fault detection is enabled for synchronized UEs. If this switch is turned off, link fault detection is not enabled for synchronized UEs. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.id: S1 Default Paging DRX Value Select
parameters.name: S1 Default Paging DRX Value Select
parameters.description: Indicates the value of the IE Default paging DRX contained in the S1 SETUP REQUEST and ENB CONFIGURATION UPDATE messages that the eNodeB sends over the S1 interface. For details, see 3GPP TS 36.413.

parameters.name: Enhanced PHR Report Control Switch
parameters.description: Indicates whether the RRCConnectionReconfiguration message sent from the source eNodeB to a UE contains the power headroom configuration during a handover where the eNodeB works as the target eNodeB. If this parameter is set to ON(On), the RRCConnectionReconfiguration message must contain the power headroom configuration. parameters.name: EUTRAN Load Transfer Switch
parameters.description: Indicates whether to send E-UTRAN cell load information. RimUtranSwitch: Indicates whether to send E-UTRAN cell load information through RAN information management (RIM) procedures to the UTRAN. If this option is selected, the eNodeB sends cell load information through RIM procedures to the UTRAN and notifies the UTRAN of cell load changes through RIM procedures. This option applies only to LTE FD

parameters.name: Protocol Procedure Support Switch
parameters.description: Indicates whether the eNodeB supports some protocol-defined procedures. SupportS1UeCapMatchMsg: If this option is selected, the eNodeB can process and respond to the UE RADIO CAPABILITY MATCH REQUEST message over the S1 interface. For details, see 3GPP TS 36.413. parameters.name: Prefer Signal Extend Switch
parameters.description: This switch is only valid when a UMPT and an LMPT are in one BBU, with the UMPT as the main control board and the LMPT as the extended board.

parameters.name: MME Select Procedure Switch
parameters.description: Indicates the MME selection policies used when UEs access the E-UTRAN. This parameter provides the following options: MMESELECTALGOSWITCHFORGUUE: Indicates the method in which the eNodeB selects MMEs for UEs transferred from a GERAN or UTRAN to the E-UTRAN by cell reselections. parameters.name: S1 Offline Commit Switch
parameters.description: Indicates whether to enable offline software commissioning over the S1 interface. If all S1 links are unavailable in the initial engineering stage, setting this parameter to ON enables cells to be activated for cell signal coverage tests. It is recommended that this parameter be used only in the engineering commissioning stage.

parameters.name: Protocol Compatibility Switch
parameters.description: Indicates whether the eNodeB applies compatibility handling to the protocol-defined procedures. parameters.name: X2 Sctp Establishment Type
parameters.description: Indicates the triggering type for establishing an SCTP link for an X2 interface. If this parameter is set to BASED_TNL, the establishment can be triggered based on transport resources. When the CP bearer is subscribed to, the eNodeB initiates the establishment of an SCTP link with the peer eNodeB. parameters.name: X2 SON Delete Switch

parameters.id: X2 SON Delete Timer for X2 Fault
parameters.name: X2 SON Delete Timer for X2 Fault
parameters.description: Indicates the length of the timer for automatically removing X2 interfaces based on X2 faults. If an X2 interface is faulty throughout the period specified by this timer, the eNodeB automatically removes the X2 interface. This parameter applies only to X2 interfaces between eNodeBs in the LTE system. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.id: X2 SON Delete Timer for X2 Usage
parameters.name: X2 SON Delete Timer for X2 Usage
parameters.description: Indicates the length of the timer for automatically removing X2 interfaces based on X2 usage or based on dynamic sharing of the X2 specification. In X2 self-removal based on X2 usage, an X2 interface is automatically removed if all of the following conditions are met: 1. parameters.id: X2 SON Delete Ho In Number Threshold

parameters.description: Indicates the threshold of the number of incoming handovers for automatically removing an X2 interface based on X2 usage. parameters.name: Intra-eNodeB HO Static Switch

If this switch is on, active UEs are not counted in the source cell after the handover data transfer completes. If this switch is off, active UEs are counted in the source cell after the handover data transfer completes. This parameter applies only to L

parameters.name: Maximum Sync-User Number Per BBI

parameters.name: X2 Setup Failure TimetoWait
parameters.description: Indicates the time to wait for sending an X2 setup request again when an X2 setup fails. When an X2 setup procedure fails, the eNodeB that accepted the X2 setup request sends an X2 Setup Failure message to the peer eNodeB. parameters.name: X2 Setup Failure Num Threshold
parameters.description: Indicates the threshold of the number of X2 setup failures. The eNodeB that initiates the X2 setup procedure measures the number of X2 setup failures. parameters.name: X2 Setup Failure Num Timer
parameters.description: Indicates the length of a period for measuring the number of X2 setup failures. If the number of X2 setup failures reaches the value of the X2SetupFailureNumThd parameter within a measurement period, the eNodeB that initiates the X2 setup no longer sends any X2 setup request within the period.

parameters.description: Indicates whether to enable eX2 automatic removal. BASED_ON_EX2FAULT(Based on EX2 Fault): eX2 automatic removal based on eX2 fault is enabled only if the option is selected. This option applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

If an eX2 interface is faulty throughout the period specified by this timer, the eNodeB automatically removes the eX2 interface. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: X2 SON Delete Mode
parameters.description: Indicates the X2 automatic removal mode. If this parameter is set to ALL_FREE_MODE(All free mode), all enabled X2 automatic removal functions work in free mode. In this mode, the eNodeB directly removes the X2 interfaces that are determined to be removed. parameters.name: X2 SON Setup Num Threshold
parameters.description: Indicates the threshold for triggering X2 self-setup. If the number of times an X2 interface needs to be set up between the local eNodeB and a peer eNodeB is greater than or equal to this threshold within the period specified by the X2SonSetupTimer parameter, the X2 interface self-setup is triggered on the local eNodeB. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: X2 SON Setup Timer
parameters.description: Indicates the length of the timer for the local eNodeB measuring the number of times an X2 interface needs to be automatically set up. This parameter provides the following options: PCI_CONFUSION_REEST_SWITCH: Indicates whether the eNodeB supports RRC connection reestablishment in PCI confusion scenarios. parameters.description: Indicates whether to enable S1-MME self-configuration. S1MMESonSetupSwitch(S1MMESonSetupSwitch): S1-MME self-setup is enabled only if this option is selected. S1MMESonDeleteSwitch(S1MMESonDeleteSwitch): S1-MME self-removal is enabled only if this option is selected.

parameters.description: Indicates the transmission mode of control-plane messages between a main control board and a baseband processing unit (BBP). If this parameter is set to ON, the function of checking related parameters is enabled when the QCI value is updated. If this parameter is set to OFF, this function is disabled when the QCI value is updated. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: CSFB Flow Optimization Switch

The optimization is enabled only if this option is selected. This option applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: X2 Dynamic Blacklist Aging Timer
parameters.description: Indicates the aging time of dynamic X2 blacklists that are automatically generated. When the aging time is reached, dynamic X2 blacklists automatically become invalid. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.description: Indicates the aging time of dynamic eX2 blacklists. If the accumulated time of dynamic eX2 blacklists reaches the aging time, the eNodeB automatically removes the blacklists. This parameter is valid only if the BASED_ON_EX2_IDEAL_MODE or BASED_ON_EX2_NON_IDEAL_MODE option of the eX2DynBlackListSwitch parameter is selected. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.id: Service Coord Interface in Non-ideal TX mode

parameters.description: Indicates the interface type to support coordination features in no-ideal backhaul mode. If this parameter is set to EX2(EX2), an eX2 interface is used for carrying coordinating services in non-ideal backhaul mode. If this parameter is set to X2, an X2 interface is used for carrying coordinating services in non-ideal backhaul mode. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

This parameter provides the following options: X2_SON_INTER_OP_SETUP_FBD_SW: If this option is selected, inter-operator X2 self-setup is forbidden. If this option is deselected, inter-operator X2 self-setup is allowed. LTE_NR_X2_SON_SETUP_SW: If this option is selected, X2 self-setup between LTE and NR is enabled. parameters.name: Initial Access Message Protect Threshold
parameters.description: Indicates the threshold of the number of initial access messages that the eNodeB allows to process in a second.

parameters.id: Delay Tolerance Initial Message Ratio Thld
parameters.name: Delay Tolerance Initial Message Ratio Thld
parameters.description: Indicates the threshold of the ratio of the number of initial access messages with the cause "delayTolerantAccess-v1020" that the eNodeB is allowed to process in a second to the total number of initial access messages.

parameters.id: High Priority Initial Message Ratio Thld
parameters.name: High Priority Initial Message Ratio Thld
parameters.description: Indicates the threshold of the ratio of the number of initial access messages with the cause "highPriorityAccess" that the eNodeB is allowed to process in a second to the total number of initial access messages.

parameters.id: MO Data Initial Message Ratio Threshold
parameters.name: MO Data Initial Message Ratio Threshold
parameters.description: Indicates the threshold of the ratio of the number of initial access messages with the cause "mo-Data" that the eNodeB is allowed to process in a second to the total number of initial access messages.

parameters.id: MO Signaling Initial Message Ratio Thld
parameters.name: MO Signaling Initial Message Ratio Thld
parameters.description: Indicates the threshold of the ratio of the number of initial access messages with the cause "mo-Signalling" that the eNodeB is allowed to process in a second to the total number of initial access messages.

parameters.name: Inactvty Tmr Expiration Processing Strategy
parameters.description: Indicates the processing policy applied when there is a conflict between the expiration of the inactivity timer and signaling procedures. parameters.id: HO and E-RAB Conflict Processing Strategy
parameters.name: HO and E-RAB Conflict Processing Strategy
parameters.description: Indicates the policy for handling conflicts between handover-related procedures and bearer-related procedures. A handover-related procedure refers to as an X2- or S1-based handover preparation phase. A bearer-related procedure refers to as a bearer setup, modification, or deletion procedure. parameters.name: Inter-RAT Power Sharing Time
parameters.description: Indicates the time segments in which dynamic power sharing between UMTS and LTE takes effect. Dynamic power sharing between UMTS and LTE can be triggered in different time segments based on traffic distribution on the live network. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD.

parameters.name: NB-IoT RRC Connection Punishment Threshold
parameters.description: Indicates the threshold for an RRC connection penalty on NB-IoT UEs. Certain UEs may repeatedly fail to access the network because of compatibility issues. If this parameter is set to 0, the RRC connection penalty function is disabled. If this parameter is set to a non-zero value, the function is enabled. parameters.name: eMTC RRC Connection Punishment Threshold
parameters.description: Indicates the threshold for an RRC connection penalty on eMTC UEs. Certain UEs may repeatedly fail to access the network because of compatibility issues. If this parameter is set to 0, the RRC connection penalty function is disabled. If this parameter is set to a non-zero value, the function is enabled. If the number of RRC connection setup requests that the eNodeB receives from a UE within the ti

parameters.name: LTE RRC Connection Punishment Threshold
parameters.description: Indicates the threshold for an RRC connection penalty on LTE UEs. Certain UEs may repeatedly fail to access the network because of compatibility issues. If this parameter is set to 0, the RRC connection penalty function is disabled. If this parameter is set to a non-zero value, the function is enabled. If the number of RRC connection setup requests that the eNodeB receives from a UE within the tim

parameters.id: X2 SON Delete gNodeB Addition Count Threshold
parameters.name: X2 SON Delete gNodeB Addition Count Threshold
parameters.description: Indicates the threshold of the number of SgNB additions for automatically removing X2 interfaces based on NSA X2 usage. If the measured number of successful SgNB additions corresponding to an X2 interface within a timer length is less than or equal to this threshold and no NSA UEs use the X2 interface, automatic removal of this X2 interface is triggered. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and

parameters.id: QCI of Non-ideal Mode Coordination Service
parameters.name: QCI of Non-ideal Mode Coordination Service
parameters.description: Indicates the QCI of coordination-based services in non-ideal backhaul scenarios. The value of this parameter must be the same on the entire network. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: Inter-eNodeB X2 Spec Exclusive Rate
parameters.description: Indicates the proportion of the maximum number of X2 interfaces exclusive to inter-eNodeB X2 interfaces in X2 self-removal based on dynamic sharing of the X2 specification. The maximum number of X2 interfaces exclusive to inter-eNodeB X2 interfaces is the round-up value of the product of this parameter value and the maximum total number of X2 interfaces. If X2 self-removal based on dynamic sharing

parameters.name: X2 Spec Sharing Sw
parameters.description: Indicates whether inter-eNodeB X2 interfaces can occupy unused X2 interface resources among the shared X2 interface resources. If this parameter is set to ON, inter-eNodeB X2 interfaces can be set up using the unused X2 interface resources among the shared X2 interface resources. If this parameter is set to OFF, inter-eNodeB X2 interfaces cannot be set up using the unused X2 interface resources am

parameters.id: LTE and NR Power Sharing Time
parameters.name: LTE and NR Power Sharing Time
parameters.description: Indicates the time segments in which dynamic power sharing between LTE and NR takes effect. Dynamic power sharing between LTE and NR can be enabled in different time segments based on traffic distribution on the live network. This parameter applies only to LTE TDD.

parameters.name: UE-EUTRA-Capability IE Size Thld
parameters.description: Indicates the size threshold of the IE "UE-EUTRA-Capability" which is used to trigger network-requested CA band combination reporting. Assume that the SupportNetReqCaComboSwitch option is selected. If this parameter is set to a non-zero value, network-requested CA band combination reporting is triggered when the size of the IE "UE-EUTRA-Capability" in UE capability information is greater than the

parameters.id: S1 Fault Cell Deactivation Waiting Time
parameters.name: S1 Fault Cell Deactivation Waiting Time
parameters.description: Indicates the waiting time for deactivating all cells served by an eNodeB when all its S1 interfaces fail.

parameters.id: CRS Antenna Port Opt Mapping Detection Result
parameters.name: CRS Antenna Port Opt Mapping Detection Result
parameters.description: Indicates the CRS antenna port mapping optimization detection result of the cell. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD.

parameters.name: Current CRS Antenna Port Mapping
parameters.description: Indicates the current mapping between cell-specific reference signal (CRS) ports and transmit (TX) channels in an RRU. As defined in 3GPP specifications, the CrsPortNum parameter can be set to CRS_PORT_1, CRS_PORT_2, or CRS_PORT_4. The value CRS_PORT_1 indicates that one CRS port (port 0) is configured. The value CRS_PORT_2 indicates that two CRS ports (ports 0 and 1) are configured. The value CRS

parameters.name: Optimal CRS Antenna Port Mapping
parameters.description: Indicates the optimal mapping between cell-specific reference signal (CRS) ports and transmit (TX) channels in an RRU. As defined in 3GPP specifications, the CrsPortNum parameter can be set to CRS_PORT_1, CRS_PORT_2, or CRS_PORT_4. The value CRS_PORT_1 indicates that one CRS port (port 0) is configured. The value CRS_PORT_2 indicates that two CRS ports (ports 0 and 1) are configured. The value CRS

parameters.name: CRS Opt Det Completion Status
parameters.description: Indicates the detection status of CRS optimization in the entire eNodeB. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD.

parameters.name: CRS Optimization Detection Progress
parameters.description: Indicates the execution progress of CRS optimization detection in the entire eNodeB. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD.

parameters.name: GSM ARFCN Group ID
parameters.description: Indicates the GSM ARFCN group ID used in GSM and LTE spectrum concurrency. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD.

parameters.name: GSM ARFCN
parameters.description: Indicates the GSM ARFCN used in GSM and LTE spectrum concurrency. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD.

parameters.name: ECHO Frame Timeout
parameters.description: Indicates the maximum wait time for an echo response. If no echo response is received during the period specified by this parameter, the timer has expired.

parameters.name: ECHO Frame Timeout Count
parameters.description: Indicates the maximum number of timeouts of the echo response waiting timer. If no echo response is received after the number specified by this parameter is reached, the GTP-U path in use fails.

parameters.name: DSCP
parameters.description: Indicates the differentiated services code point (DSCP) of a GTP-U control packet.

parameters.name: Static Check Switch
parameters.description: Indicates whether to enable static detection in compliance with GPRS Tunneling Protocol for User Plane (GTP-U). If this parameter is set to ENABLE, the GTP-U static check is enabled. If this parameter is set to DISABLE, the GTP-U static check is disabled.

parameters.id: Uplink GTP-U Sequence Number Padding Switch
parameters.name: Uplink GTP-U Sequence Number Padding Switch
parameters.description: Indicates the switch for padding the sequence numbers of uplink GTP-U service packets. If this parameter is set to ENABLE(Enable), consecutive sequence numbers in ascending order will be padded for uplink GTP-U service packets sent by the local end. If this parameter is set to DISABLE(Disable), the padding function will not take effect. This parameter is valid for the S1 interface only and its set

parameters.id: Downlink GTP-U Sequence Number Check Switch
parameters.name: Downlink GTP-U Sequence Number Check Switch
parameters.description: Indicates the switch for checking the sequence numbers of downlink GTP-U service packets. If this parameter is set to ENABLE(Enable), the local end performs statistics on the disorders and discontinuous sequence numbers on downlink GTP-U service packets. If this parameter is set to DISABLE(Disable), the check function will not take effect and the values of corresponding performance counters are in

parameters.id: Number of transmitted packets in a GTP-U ECHO test
parameters.name: Number of transmitted packets in a GTP-U ECHO test
parameters.description: This parameter indicates the number of transmitted packets in a GTP-U ECHO test.

parameters.id: Number of received packets in a GTP-U ECHO test
parameters.name: Number of received packets in a GTP-U ECHO test
parameters.description: This parameter indicates the number of received packets in a GTP-U ECHO test.

parameters.name: Static GTP-U ECHO test switch
parameters.description: Indicates whether to enable the GTP-U static detection function for a link. When this parameter is set to ENABLE(Enable), the GTP-U static detection function is enabled for a link. When this parameter is set to DISABLE(Disable), the GTP-U static detection function is disabled for a link. If the local and peer IP addresses specified using the DSP GTPUECHO command are the same as those of an IP path

parameters.name: HeNB TAC Range Group ID
parameters.description: Indicates the ID of the TAC range group of HeNBs in macro-micro handover scenarios. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: TAC Start Mark
parameters.description: Indicates the start TAC of the special TAC range group of HeNBs. This parameter value must be less than or equal to the TacEnd parameter value. 3GPP specifications define that the TAC values 0x0000(0) and 0xFFFE(65534) are reserved, and therefore these two TAC values cannot be used in later versions. You are advised not to set 0 or 65534 as the TAC value in network planning and configuration. This

parameters.name: TAC End Mark
parameters.description: Indicates the end TAC of the special TAC range group of HeNBs. This parameter value must be greater than or equal to the TacStart parameter value. 3GPP specifications define that the TAC values 0x0000(0) and 0xFFFE(65534) are reserved, and therefore these two TAC values cannot be used in later versions. You are advised not to set 0 or 65534 as the TAC value in network planning and configuration. T

parameters.name: Local cell ID
parameters.description: Indicates the local ID of a cell. It uniquely identifies a cell within an eNodeB. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: Low Speed Judge Number
parameters.description: Indicates the threshold of the number of consecutive low-speed judgments required for an initially admitted UE or a high-speed UE to be identified as a low-speed UE in a high-speed or ultra-high-speed cell. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: Doppler Factor
parameters.description: Indicates the impact of the Doppler effect on UE speed estimation in high-speed or ultra-high speed scenarios. The change in frequency for a UE moving relative to an eNodeB (that is, the Doppler shift) is equal to the Doppler frequency multiplied by cosθ, where θ is the angle between the UE movement direction and the signal emission direction. The angle is highly correlated with the UE location an

parameters.name: High Speed User Number Threshold
parameters.description: Indicates the minimum number of high-speed UEs required to determine that high-speed trains are passing by. It is recommended that this parameter be set, based on the operators' levels of traffic volume at high-speed railways, to the maximum appropriate value that can be used to identify high-speed trains in off-peak hours to minimize the impact on low-speed UEs. This parameter applies only to LTE

parameters.name: Handover History Judge High Threshold
parameters.description: Indicates the maximum duration of stay in the previous cell for a UE to be identified as a high-speed UE. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: Interference Avoid Cell Number
parameters.description: Indicates the maximum number of a high-speed cell's neighboring low-speed cells that perform interference avoidance when high-speed trains pass by. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD.

parameters.name: Interference Avoid Mode
parameters.description: RbBasedInterfAvoid: Indicates whether to enable downlink RB-based interference avoidance. When this option is selected, the proportion of available downlink PRBs is reduced in low-speed cells to reduce the downlink interference to high-speed UEs when high-speed trains pass by. This option applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD. PowerBasedInterfAvoid: Indicates whether to enable downlink power-based i

parameters.name: Interference Based Power Offset
parameters.description: Indicates the offset to the downlink transmit power or the offset used with the uplink high-SINR threshold in the low-speed cell adjacent to a high-speed cell. When high-speed trains pass by, the downlink transmit power of the low-speed cell or the uplink transmit power for low-priority services in this cell is decreased to reduce the downlink or uplink interference to high-speed UEs. This paramet

parameters.name: Interference Based RB Ratio
parameters.description: Indicates the maximum percentage of RBs that can be used in the low-speed cell, for which the RbBasedInterfAvoid or UlRbBasedInterfAvoid option of the InterfAvoidMode parameter is selected. When high-speed trains travel through a high-speed cell, the eNodeB stops scheduling non-GBR bearers for non-emergency calls in the low-speed cell to reduce interference to high-speed UEs if the number of downl

parameters.id: Period of Updating Vector Cell Flag
parameters.name: Period of Updating Vector Cell Flag
parameters.description: Indicates the interval at which an eNodeB updates and collects statistics about high-speed vector cell flags. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD.

parameters.id: Switch for Updating Vector Cell Flag
parameters.name: Switch for Updating Vector Cell Flag
parameters.description: Indicates whether to automatically update soft vector flags. If this parameter is set to ON, soft vector flags can be automatically updated based on statistics on the eNodeB. If this parameter is set to OFF, soft vector flags are manually updated. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD.

parameters.name: High-Speed Overlapping Band Indicator
parameters.description: Indicates the range of overlapping frequency bands between public cells and high-speed dedicated cells. The eNodeB cannot schedule PRBs within this range for public cells. This parameter takes effect only when the HighSpeedFlag parameter in the Cell MO is set to LOW_SPEED for public cells and the RbBasedInterfAvoid or UlRbBasedInterfAvoid option of the InterfAvoidMode parameter is selected. This p

parameters.name: High Speed Cell Sleep Mode
parameters.description: Indicates whether to allow high-speed cells to enter different sleep modes. HS_CARR_POWER_DECREASE_MODE: If this option is selected, the eNodeB disables power decrease in the local high-speed cell and its adjacent high-speed cells when a high-speed train passes these cells. After the train has left the local high-speed cell for a period, the eNodeB enables power decrease in this cell to conserve e

parameters.name: High Speed Optimization Switch
parameters.description: Indicates whether to enable optimization algorithms in high speed mobility scenarios. DL_AFC_OPT_SW: Indicates whether to enable the downlink AFC optimization algorithm. If this option is selected, this algorithm takes effect. If this option is deselected, the algorithm does not take effect. This option applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD. LOW_SPEED_VOLTE_HO_SW: Indicates whether to hand over low-

parameters.name: GAP measurement pattern
parameters.description: Indicates the measurement gap pattern. With gap-assisted measurement, the eNodeB configures periodic idle time for UEs in RRC_CONNECTED mode to measure cell signal quality on specified frequencies. There are two gap patterns: pattern 0 and pattern 1. In pattern 0, the gap width is 6 ms and the repetition period is 40 ms. In pattern 1, the gap width is 6 ms and the repetition period is 80 ms. For d

parameters.name: EUTRAN RSRP filter coefficient
parameters.description: Indicates the upper-layer filtering coefficient for RSRP measurements on E-UTRAN. A larger value of this parameter indicates a stronger smoothing effect and higher resistance to fast fading, but it may weaken the tracing capability towards varying signals. For details, see 3GPP TS 36.331. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: EUTRAN RSRQ filter coefficient
parameters.description: Indicates the upper-layer filtering coefficient for RSRQ measurements on E-UTRAN. A larger value of this parameter indicates a stronger signal smoothing effect and higher resistance to fast fading, but it may weaken the tracing capability towards varying signals. For details, see 3GPP TS 36.331. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: GERAN filter coefficient
parameters.description: Indicates the upper-layer filtering coefficient used for the measurement quantity in inter-RAT measurements of GERAN. A larger value of this parameter indicates a stronger signal smoothing effect and higher resistance to fast fading, but it may weaken the tracing capability towards varying signals. For details, see 3GPP TS 36.331. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: SMeasureInd
parameters.description: Indicates whether the measurement threshold needs to be set. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: SMeasure
parameters.description: Indicates the threshold below which measurements on neighboring cells are started. If the signal quality of the serving cell exceeds this threshold, the UE is not required to perform intra-frequency, inter-frequency, or inter-RAT measurements, leading to reduced power consumption. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: SpeedDependInd
parameters.description: Indicates whether rate-based cell handover measurement parameters need to be set. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: TCRmax in connected mode
parameters.description: Indicates the cycle during which evaluations of the UE medium- and high-mobility states in RRC_CONNECTED mode are performed. It is one of the key parameters in deciding on a UE's mobility state. If this parameter is set to a small value, transitions among mobility states may be frequent and the decision precision may be relatively low. If this parameter is set to a large value, transitions among m

parameters.name: TCRmaxHyst in connected mode
parameters.description: Indicates the cycle during which evaluations of the UE normal-mobility state in RRC_CONNECTED mode are performed. It is one of the key parameters in deciding on a UE's mobility state. If this parameter is set to a small value, transitions among mobility states may be frequent and the decision precision may be relatively low. If this parameter is set to a large value, transitions among mobility sta

parameters.name: NCR Medium in connected mode
parameters.description: Indicates the handover number threshold used in the UE medium mobility state evaluation. If the number of handovers performed during a period of time specified by the TcrMaxConnMode parameter exceeds the value of this parameter, the UE is considered to be in medium mobility state and its handover-related parameters are adjusted. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: NCR High in connected mode
parameters.description: Indicates the handover number threshold used in the UE high-mobility state evaluation. If the number of handovers performed during a period of time specified by the TcrMaxConnMode parameter exceeds the value of this parameter, the UE is considered to be in high-mobility state and its handover-related parameters are adjusted based on the UE speed. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.id: TTT Scaling factor for Medium mobility state in connected mode
parameters.name: TTT Scaling factor for Medium mobility state in connected mode
parameters.description: Indicates the scaling factor for the time-to-trigger defined for medium-mobility UEs. For a UE in medium mobility, the time-to-trigger used in event evaluation is multiplied by this scaling factor, to facilitate triggering of the handover. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.id: TTT Scaling factor for High mobility state in connected mode
parameters.name: TTT Scaling factor for High mobility state in connected mode
parameters.description: Indicates the scaling factor for the time-to-trigger defined for high-mobility UEs. For a UE in high mobility, the time-to-trigger used in event evaluation is multiplied by this scaling factor, to facilitate triggering of the handover. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: UTRAN RSCP filter coefficient
parameters.description: Indicates the filtering coefficient for RSCP measurements on UTRAN. A larger value of this parameter indicates a stronger smoothing effect and higher resistance to fast fading, but it may weaken the tracing capability towards varying signals. For details, see 3GPP TS 36.331. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: UTRAN ECN0 filter coefficient
parameters.description: Indicates the upper-layer filtering coefficient for Ec/No measurements on UTRAN. A larger value of this parameter indicates a stronger smoothing effect and higher resistance to fast fading, but it may weaken the tracing capability towards varying signals. For details, see 3GPP TS 36.331. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.id: Optimized Handover Prepare Fail Punish Timer
parameters.name: Optimized Handover Prepare Fail Punish Timer
parameters.description: Indicates the penalty timer length for not allowing handovers (excluding MLB) to the target cell when a handover preparation fails due to optimization-related causes during handovers (including frequency-priority-based handovers, service-based handovers, SPID-based handovers back to the HPLMN, and QoE-based handovers) to the target cell. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.id: Resource Handover Prepare Fail Punish Timer
parameters.name: Resource Handover Prepare Fail Punish Timer
parameters.description: Indicates the penalty timer length for not allowing handovers (excluding MLB) to the target cell when a handover preparation fails due to resource-related causes during handovers (including CSFB, coverage-based, uplink-quality-based, and distance-based handovers) to the target cell. If this parameter is set to 0, no penalty is performed. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.id: Non Resource Handover Prepare Fail Punish Times
parameters.name: Non Resource Handover Prepare Fail Punish Times
parameters.description: Indicates the number of penalty times none of the handovers is allowed to the target cell when a handover preparation fails due to non-resource-related causes on the target cell. If this parameter is set to 0, the target cell is not penalized or is penalized permanently if a handover fails due to non-resource-related causes. That is, the number of handover attempts to the target cell is unlimited.

parameters.id: Non Resource Handover Prepare Fail Retry Times
parameters.name: Non Resource Handover Prepare Fail Retry Times
parameters.description: Indicates the number of handover attempts to the target cell when a handover preparation fails due to non-resource-related causes on the target cell. If this parameter is set to 200, the number of handover attempts is unlimited. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: Dedicated Gap Pattern Type
parameters.description: Indicates the CSFB gap-assisted measurement mode. With gap-assisted measurement, the eNodeB configures periodic idle time for UEs in RRC_CONNECTED mode to measure cell signal quality on specified frequencies. If the parameter is set to GAP_PATTERN_TYPE_0, the gap width is 6 ms and the repetition period is 40 ms. If the parameter is set to GAP_PATTERN_TYPE_1, the gap width is 6 ms and the repetitio

parameters.name: SRVCC HO Failure Penalty Timer
parameters.description: Indicates the timer length for SRVCC penalty. If SRVCC to a neighboring GERAN cell fails, the subsequent SRVCC to this cell will be prohibited throughout the time specified by this parameter. If this parameter is set to 0, the eNodeB does not impose an SRVCC penalty on the neighboring GERAN cell. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.id: HO to NR Res Prep Failure Penalty Timer
parameters.name: HO to NR Res Prep Failure Penalty Timer
parameters.description: Indicates the penalty timer length for not allowing handovers to an NG-RAN cell when handover preparation fails due to resource-related causes during a handover to this NG-RAN cell. If this parameter is set to 0, penalty is not performed. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: Local cell ID
parameters.description: Indicates the local cell identity of the cell. It uniquely identifies a cell within an eNodeB.

parameters.name: Connect eNodeB ID
parameters.description: Indicates the ID of the eNodeB to which the RRU/RFU is connected.

parameters.name: RRU/RFU Cabinet No.
parameters.description: Indicates the cabinet number of the RRU/RFU.

parameters.name: RRU/RFU Subrack No.
parameters.description: Indicates the subrack number of the RRU/RFU.

parameters.name: RRU/RFU Slot No.
parameters.description: Indicates the slot number of the RRU/RFU.

parameters.name: Number of BBP Data Links
parameters.description: Indicates the number of BBP data links.

parameters.name: BBP Data Link ID
parameters.description: Indicates the BBP data link ID.

parameters.name: BBP Data Link Status
parameters.description: Indicates the status of the BBP data link.

parameters.name: ODI ID
parameters.description: Indicates the open DU interface (ODI) ID.

parameters.id: BBP Data Link Input Port No.
parameters.name: BBP Data Link Input Port No.
parameters.description: Indicates the input port number of the BBP data link.

parameters.id: BBP Data Link Output Port No.
parameters.name: BBP Data Link Output Port No.
parameters.description: Indicates the output port number of the BBP data link.

parameters.name: BBP Data Link Loopback Delay
parameters.description: Indicates the loopback delay on the BBP data link.

parameters.id: BBP Data Link Loopback Timeout Counter
parameters.name: BBP Data Link Loopback Timeout Counter
parameters.description: Indicates the number of loopback timeouts on the BBP data link.

parameters.name: Board Cabinet No.
parameters.description: Indicates the cabinet number of the board involved in data link transmission.

parameters.name: Board Subrack No.
parameters.description: Indicates the subrack number of the board involved in data link transmission.

parameters.name: Board Slot No.
parameters.description: Indicates the slot number of the board involved in data link transmission.

parameters.name: BBP Data Link Type
parameters.description: Indicates the type of the BBP data link. The parameter value BIDIRECTIONAL indicates that a data link is bidirectional, that is, the BBP data can be transmitted between the input port of the BBP data link (source port) and the output port of the BBP data link (target port). The parameter value FORWARD_DIRECTION indicates that the BBP data can be transmitted only from the input port of the BBP data

parameters.name: ICMPv6 Error Message Sending Type
parameters.description: Indicates whether to send ICMPv6 error messages. ICMPv6 error messages include Destination Unreachable message and Packet Too Big message. Both can be selected. The value DST_UNREACHABLE(Destination Unreachable) indicates that ICMPv6 Destination Unreachable messages will be sent. parameters.name: Interface ID
parameters.description: Indicates the ID of an interface.

parameters.name: SEND Switch
parameters.description: Indicates whether the interface opens the Send protocol and currently only supports the Nonce and Timestamp mechanisms.

parameters.name: SEND Delta
parameters.description: Indicates the maximum difference between the moment when the ND message is received by the local side and the time at which the ND message is sent to the peer.

parameters.name: SEND Drift
parameters.description: Indicates the percentage of the maximum value of the receiver-to-sender system time difference value.

parameters.name: SEND Fuzz-Factor
parameters.description: Indicates the maximum time to live for a message.if the time at which the ND message is received by the local side is greater than delta-value, but within the Fuzz-value time range, it can still be received by the interface.

parameters.name: DHCPv6 Relay Switch
parameters.description: Indicates whether to enable the DHCPv6 relay function on an interface. If this parameter is set to ON, the interface can receive multicast packets of DHCPv6 requests sent by lower-level base stations.

parameters.name: Local cell ID
parameters.description: Indicates the ID of the local cell. It uniquely identifies a cell within an eNodeB. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: Downlink EARFCN
parameters.description: Indicates the DL EARFCN of the inter-frequency blacklisted cell. For details, see 3GPP TS 36.104. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: Start physical cell ID
parameters.description: Indicates the starting physical cell ID of the inter-frequency blacklisted cell. For details, see 3GPP TS 36.331. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: Cell name
parameters.description: Indicates the name of the inter-frequency blacklisted cell. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: Physical cell ID range
parameters.description: Indicates the physical cell ID range of the inter-frequency blacklisted cell. For details, see 3GPP TS 36.331. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: Interfreq handover group ID

parameters.name: Interfreq A1A2 hysteresis

This parameter is used to prevent frequent triggering of event evaluation caused by radio signal fluctuation. parameters.description: Indicates the RSRP threshold for event A1 of A4/A5-based inter-frequency handover. When the measured RSRP value exceeds this threshold, a measurement report will be sent. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.id: A4A5 Based Interfreq A1 RSRQ Threshold

parameters.description: Indicates the RSRQ threshold for event A1 of A4/A5 based inter-frequency handover. When the measured RSRQ value exceeds this threshold, a measurement report will be sent. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.id: A4A5 Based Interfreq A2 RSRP Threshold

parameters.description: Indicates the RSRP threshold for event A2 of A4/A5-based inter-frequency handover. When the measured RSRP value is below the threshold, a measurement report will be sent. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.id: A4A5 Based Interfreq A2 RSRQ Threshold

parameters.description: Indicates the RSRQ threshold for event A2 of A4/A5-based inter-frequency handover. When the measured RSRQ value is below this threshold, a measurement report will be sent. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: Interfreq handover hysteresis
parameters.description: Indicates the hysteresis for inter-frequency measurements. This parameter is used to prevent frequent triggering of event evaluation caused by radio signal fluctuation. In this way, the probability of ping-pong handovers or handover decision errors is reduced. A larger value of this parameter results in a lower probability. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.id: Freq Priority Based Interfreq A1 RSRP threshold
parameters.name: Freq Priority Based Interfreq A1 RSRP threshold
parameters.description: Indicates the RSRP threshold for frequency-priority-based inter-frequency measurement event A1. When the measured RSRP value exceeds this threshold, an event A1 report will be sent. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.id: Freq Priority Based Interfreq A1 RSRQ threshold
parameters.name: Freq Priority Based Interfreq A1 RSRQ threshold
parameters.description: Indicates the RSRQ threshold for frequency-priority-based inter-frequency measurement event A1. When the measured RSRQ value exceeds this threshold, an event A1 report will be sent. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.id: A3 based Interfreq A2 RSRP threshold
parameters.name: A3 based Interfreq A2 RSRP threshold
parameters.description: Indicates the RSRP threshold for event A2 of A3-based inter-frequency handover. When the measured RSRP value is less than this threshold, a measurement report will be sent. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.id: Freq Priority Based Interfreq A2 RSRP threshold
parameters.name: Freq Priority Based Interfreq A2 RSRP threshold
parameters.description: Indicates the RSRP threshold for frequency-priority-based inter-frequency measurement event A2. If the measured RSRP value is less than this threshold, an event A2 report will be sent. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.id: Freq Priority Based Interfreq A2 RSRQ threshold
parameters.name: Freq Priority Based Interfreq A2 RSRQ threshold
parameters.description: Indicates the RSRQ threshold for inter-frequency measurement event A2. When the measured RSRQ value is below this threshold, a measurement report will be sent. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: Interfreq A5 RSRP threshold 1
parameters.description: Indicates the RSRP threshold 1 in the serving cell of event A5 for triggering inter-frequency handovers. parameters.name: Interfreq A5 RSRQ threshold 1

When the measured RSRQ in the serving cell is smaller than the value of this parameter and the RSRP or RSRQ in the neighboring cell is higher than the value of InterFreqHoA4ThdRsrp or InterFreqHoA4ThdRsrq, the UE reports event A5. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.id: Service-Request based handover A4 RSRP threshold
parameters.name: Service-Request based handover A4 RSRP threshold
parameters.description: Indicates the RSRP threshold used to trigger event A4 report for service request-based inter-frequency handovers. parameters.name: Service-Request based handover A4 RSRQ threshold
parameters.description: Indicates the RSRQ threshold used to trigger event A4 report for service request-based inter-frequency handovers. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.id: MLB Inter-Freq Handover A5 Threshold1 RSRQ
parameters.name: MLB Inter-Freq Handover A5 Threshold1 RSRQ
parameters.description: Indicates the RSRQ threshold 1 of the serving cell for event A5 related to inter-frequency measurements for MLB. If the measured RSRQ of the serving cell is lower than the MlbInterFreqHoA5Thd1Rsr parameter value and the measured RSRQ of a neighboring cell is higher than the InterFreqLoadBasedHoA4ThdRsrq parameter value, the UE reports event A5. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.description: Indicates the RSRQ threshold for event A1 of A3-based inter-frequency handover. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.id: A3 Based Interfreq A2 RSRQ Threshold
parameters.name: A3 Based Interfreq A2 RSRQ Threshold
parameters.description: Indicates the RSRQ threshold for event A2 of A3-based inter-frequency handover. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: Ul High Traffic Handover A4 Threshold of RSRP

When the measured RSRP exceeds the threshold specified by this parameter, inter-frequency measurement event A4 is reported. This parameter applies only to LTE TDD.

parameters.id: Ul High Traffic Handover A4 Threshold of RSRQ
parameters.name: Ul High Traffic Handover A4 Threshold of RSRQ
parameters.description: Indicates the RSRQ threshold for triggering inter-frequency measurement event A4 during handovers for uplink heavy traffic-based MLB. When the measured RSRQ exceeds the threshold specified by this parameter, inter-frequency measurement event A4 is reported. This parameter applies only to LTE TDD.

parameters.description: Indicates whether to enable inter-RAT joint shutdown. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD.

parameters.name: Start time
parameters.description: Indicates the start time of inter-RAT cell shutdown. If the switch for inter-RAT cell shutdown is turned on, inter-RAT cell shutdown can be performed during the period specified by the start time and stop time of inter-RAT cell shutdown. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.description: Indicates the pilot strength threshold for event B1 related to load- or service-based inter-RAT handover to CDMA2000 HRPD. When the measurement value exceeds this threshold, a measurement report will be sent. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.description: Indicates the B2 RSRQ threshold 1 used during optimized handovers from E-UTRAN to CDMA2000 eHRPD. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: Measurement report amount
parameters.description: Indicates the number of periodic measurement reports to be sent after an inter-RAT handover event is triggered. It is used to prevent the impact of measurement report loss and internal processing failure on the handover. For details, see 3GPP TS 36.331. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: Geran measurement report interval

parameters.name: UTRAN FDD measurement report interval

parameters.name: CDMA20001XRTT measurement trigger quantity
parameters.description: Indicates the quantity to be measured for inter-RAT handovers to CDMA2000 1xRTT. For details, see 3GPP TS 36.331. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: CDMA20001XRTT measurement report interval
parameters.description: Indicates the interval at which periodic measurement reports are sent to the eNodeB after the event for inter-RAT handover to CDMA2000 1xRTT is triggered. For details, see 3GPP TS 36.331. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

By contrast, RSRQ measurements greatly vary with the load and are likely to reflect the signal quality of the cell in real time. parameters.id: Inter RAT HO Trigger Event Type
parameters.name: Inter RAT HO Trigger Event Type
parameters.description: Indicates the type of the inter-RAT handover event except handovers to NG-RAN. The event type can be B1 or B2. This parameter applies only to coverage-based handovers. For details, see 3GPP TS 36.331. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: CDMA2000 1xRTT Measure Timer
parameters.description: Indicates the timer for measurements on CDMA2000 1xRTT cells. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: CDMA2000 1xRTT Judge PN Number
parameters.description: Indicates the number of CDMA2000 1xRTT cells whose reference signal strength is used to calculate the target reference signal strength. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: CDMA2000 HRPD Frequency Select Mode
parameters.description: Indicates the mode of selecting a CDMA2000 HRPD frequency. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: CDMA2000 1xRTT Frequency Select Mode
parameters.description: Indicates the mode of selecting a CDMA2000 1xRTT frequency. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: eCSFB PS Concurrent Mode
parameters.description: Indicates the eCSFB concurrency mode. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: eCSFB Measurement Mode
parameters.description: Indicates the measurement mode for eCSFB. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: eCSFB SectorID Select Mode
parameters.description: Indicates the mode of selecting a sector ID during eCSFB. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.id: Max Utran cell num in redirection
parameters.name: Max Utran cell num in redirection
parameters.description: Indicates the maximum number of UTRAN cell system information messages that can be transmitted during a flash redirection procedure. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.id: Max Geran cell num in redirection
parameters.name: Max Geran cell num in redirection
parameters.description: Indicates the maximum number of GERAN cell system information messages that can be transmitted during a flash redirection procedure. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.id: Max Geran cell num in CSFB EMC redirection
parameters.name: Max Geran cell num in CSFB EMC redirection
parameters.description: Indicates the maximum number of GERAN cell system information messages that can be transmitted during an emergency CSFB-based redirection procedure. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.id: Max Utran cell num in CSFB EMC redirection
parameters.name: Max Utran cell num in CSFB EMC redirection
parameters.description: Indicates the maximum number of UTRAN cell system information messages that can be transmitted during an emergency CSFB-based redirection procedure. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: CDMA2000 eHRPD SectorID Select Mode
parameters.description: Indicates the method of selecting reference cells during an optimized handover from E-UTRAN to CDMA2000 eHRPD. One method is selecting reference cells configured on the eNodeB. The other method is selecting neighboring CDMA2000 eHRPD cells with the best signal quality indicated by measurement reports. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.id: InterRAT Blind Redir PLMN Cfg Simplify Sw
parameters.name: InterRAT Blind Redir PLMN Cfg Simplify Sw
parameters.description: Indicates the PLMN determination mechanism used in blind redirections from E-UTRAN to UTRAN/GERAN when the PLMN for the neighboring frequency (or frequency group) is not configured. If this parameter is set to ON, the PLMN for the neighboring frequency (or frequency group) is the serving PLMN of UEs.
