parameters.name: NR Measurement Reporting Interval
parameters.description: Indicates the interval at which periodic measurement reports are sent to the eNodeB after the event for inter-RAT handover to NR is triggered. For details, see 3GPP TS 36.331. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.id: NSA DC SA NR HO No-Gap B1 Reporting Interval
parameters.name: NSA DC SA NR HO No-Gap B1 Reporting Interval
parameters.description: Indicates the interval at which NSA-DC UEs send reports of non-gap-assisted B1 measurements related to inter-RAT handovers to NG-RAN in SA networking. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.id: Inter-RAT HO NR Triggering Event Type
parameters.name: Inter-RAT HO NR Triggering Event Type
parameters.description: Indicates the event to trigger coverage-based handovers to NG-RAN. For details, see 3GPP TS 36.331. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: Local cell ID
parameters.description: Indicates the local ID of the cell. It uniquely identifies a cell within a BS. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: InterRAT handover common group ID
parameters.description: Indicates the ID of the common parameter group related to inter-RAT handover. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: InterRAT A1A2 hysteresis
parameters.description: Indicates the hysteresis of events A1/A2 for triggering inter-RAT measurement. This parameter is used to prevent frequent triggering of event evaluation caused by radio signal fluctuation. In this way, the probability of ping-pong handovers or handover decision errors is reduced. A larger value of this parameter results in a lower probability. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: InterRAT A1A2 time to trigger
parameters.description: Indicates the time-to-trigger of A1 or A2 for triggering inter-RAT measurement. When detecting that the signal quality in the serving cell meets the entering condition, the UE does not send a measurement report to the eNodeB immediately. Instead, the UE sends a report only when the signal quality continuously meets the entering condition during the time-to-trigger. This parameter helps decrease th

parameters.name: InterRAT A1 RSRP trigger threshold
parameters.description: Indicates the RSRP threshold for event A1 related to inter-RAT handovers except handovers to NG-RAN. When the measured RSRP value of the serving cell exceeds this threshold, an event A1 report will be sent. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: InterRAT A1 RSRQ trigger threshold
parameters.description: Indicates the RSRQ threshold for inter-RAT measurement event A1. When the measured RSRQ value of the serving cell exceeds this threshold, an event A1 report will be sent. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: InterRAT A2 RSRP trigger threshold
parameters.description: Indicates the RSRP threshold for event A2 related to inter-RAT handovers except handovers to NG-RAN. When the measured RSRP value of the serving cell is below this threshold, an event A2 report will be sent. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: InterRAT A2 RSRQ trigger threshold
parameters.description: Indicates the RSRQ threshold for inter-RAT measurement event A2. When the measured RSRQ value of the serving cell is below this threshold, an event A2 report will be sent. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: GERAN B2 RSRP Threshold 1
parameters.description: Indicates the RSRP threshold 1 in the serving cell of event B2 for triggering E-UTRAN-to-GERAN handovers. When the measured RSRP in the serving cell is smaller than the value of this parameter and the signal quality of the neighboring cell is better than the value of InterRatHoGeranB1Thd, the UE reports event B2. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: GERAN B2 RSRQ Threshold 1
parameters.description: Indicates the RSRQ threshold 1 in the serving cell of event B2 for triggering E-UTRAN-to-GERAN handovers. When the measured RSRQ in the serving cell is smaller than the value of this parameter and the signal quality of the neighboring cell is better than the value of InterRatHoGeranB1Thd, the UE reports event B2. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: UTRAN B2 RSRP Threshold 1
parameters.description: Indicates the RSRP threshold 1 in the serving cell of event B2 for triggering E-UTRAN-to-UTRAN handovers. When the measured RSRP in the serving cell is smaller than the value of this parameter and the signal quality of the neighboring cell is better than the value of InterRatHoUtranB1ThdRscp or InterRatHoUtranB1ThdEcn0, the UE reports event B2. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: UTRAN B2 RSRQ Threshold 1
parameters.description: Indicates the RSRQ threshold 1 in the serving cell of event B2 for triggering E-UTRAN-to-UTRAN handovers. When the measured RSRQ in the serving cell is smaller than the value of this parameter and the signal quality of the neighboring cell is better than the value of InterRatHoUtranB1ThdRscp or InterRatHoUtranB1ThdEcn0, the UE reports event B2. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.id: Del Inter-Freq Meas A2 Thld RSRP Offset
parameters.name: Del Inter-Freq Meas A2 Thld RSRP Offset
parameters.description: Indicates the offset of the RSRP threshold for event A2 to delete inter-frequency measurements relative to the actual RSRP threshold for GERAN event A2. RSRP threshold for event A2 to delete inter-frequency measurements = InterRatHoA2ThdRsrp + GeranA2ThdRsrpOffset (excluding -100) + DelIfMeasA2ThdRsrpOffset.

parameters.id: Del Inter-Freq Meas A2 Thld RSRQ Offset
parameters.name: Del Inter-Freq Meas A2 Thld RSRQ Offset
parameters.description: Indicates the offset of the RSRQ threshold for event A2 to delete inter-frequency measurements relative to the actual RSRQ threshold for GERAN event A2. RSRQ threshold for event A2 to delete inter-frequency measurements = InterRatHoA2ThdRsrq + DelIfMeasA2ThdRsrqOffset.

parameters.name: A2-based Inter-RAT Handover Trigger Quantity

If this parameter is set to BOTH, the eNodeB determines whether to trigger inter-RAT measurements or blind handovers based on either RSRP or RSRQ. parameters.name: NR B2 RSRP Threshold 1
parameters.description: Indicates the RSRP threshold 1 of the serving cell for event B2 related to inter-RAT handovers to NG-RAN. When the measured RSRP value of the serving cell is less than this threshold and the signal quality of the neighboring cell is greater than the threshold specified by the InterRatHoNrParamGrp.CovBasedNrB1RsrpThld parameter, event B2 will be reported. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and

parameters.id: Inter-RAT Handover to NR A1 RSRP Thld
parameters.name: Inter-RAT Handover to NR A1 RSRP Thld
parameters.description: Indicates the RSRP threshold for event A1 related to handovers to NG-RAN. When the measured RSRP value of the serving cell exceeds this threshold, event A1 will be reported. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.id: Inter-RAT Handover to NR A2 RSRP Thld
parameters.name: Inter-RAT Handover to NR A2 RSRP Thld
parameters.description: Indicates the RSRP threshold for event A2 related to handovers to NG-RAN. When the measured RSRP value of the serving cell is less than this threshold, event A2 will be reported. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: Local cell ID
parameters.description: Indicates the local ID of the cell. It uniquely identifies a cell within an eNodeB. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.id: InterRAT handover to GERAN group ID
parameters.name: InterRAT handover to GERAN group ID
parameters.description: Indicates the ID of the QCI-specific parameter group related to inter-RAT handover to GERAN. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: GERAN handover hysteresis
parameters.description: Indicates the hysteresis for event B1 related to inter-RAT handover to GERAN. parameters.name: CoverageBased GERAN trigger threshold
parameters.description: Indicates the RSSI threshold for event B1 related to coverage-based inter-RAT handover to GERAN. A UE sends a measurement report related to event B1 to the eNodeB when the RSSI in at least one GERAN cell reaches this threshold and other triggering conditions are met. For details, see 3GPP TS 36.331. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.id: Load Service Based Geran EventB1 trigger threshold
parameters.name: Load Service Based Geran EventB1 trigger threshold
parameters.description: Indicates the RSSI threshold for event B1 related to load- or service-based inter-RAT handover to GERAN. When the measured RSSI value exceeds this threshold, a B1 measurement report will be sent. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: Local cell ID
parameters.description: Indicates the local ID of a cell, which uniquely identifies the cell within an eNodeB. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: NR Handover Parameter Group ID
parameters.description: Indicates the group ID of parameters for handovers from the E-UTRAN to NR. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: NR B1B2 Hysteresis
parameters.description: Indicates the hysteresis for events B1 and B2 related to EUTRAN-to-NR handovers. This parameter prevents frequent handover measurement triggering and release caused by radio signal fluctuations and reduces the probability of incorrect handover decisions and ping-pong handovers. The larger the parameter value, the lower this probability. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: NR B1B2 Time-to-Trigger
parameters.description: Indicates the time-to-trigger for events B1 and B2 related to EUTRAN-to-NR handovers. parameters.description: Indicates the RSRP threshold for triggering event B1 related to coverage-based EUTRAN-to-NR handovers. If the measured RSRP value of any neighboring cell exceeds this threshold, B1 measurement reports will be sent to the eNodeB. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: Service-based NR B1 RSRP Threshold
parameters.description: Indicates the RSRP threshold for triggering event B1 related to service-based EUTRAN-to-NR handovers. If the measured RSRP value of any neighboring cell exceeds this threshold, B1 measurement reports will be sent to the eNodeB. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: NSA DC SA NR HO No-Gap HO B1 Time-to-Trigger

parameters.id: InterRAT handover to UTRAN Group ID
parameters.name: InterRAT handover to UTRAN Group ID
parameters.description: Indicates the ID of the parameter group related to inter-RAT handover to UTRAN. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: CoverageBased UTRAN ECN0 trigger threshold
parameters.description: Indicates the Ec/N0 threshold for event B1 related to coverage-based inter-RAT handover to UTRAN. This parameter specifies the requirement for Ec/N0 of the target UTRAN cell. For a cell with large signal fading variance, set this parameter to a large value to prevent unnecessary handovers. For a cell with small signal fading variance, set this parameter to a small value to ensure timely handovers.

parameters.name: CoverageBased UTRAN RSCP trigger threshold
parameters.description: Indicates the RSCP threshold for event B1 related to coverage-based inter-RAT handover to UTRAN. This parameter specifies the requirement for RSCP of the target UTRAN cell. When the measurement value exceeds this threshold, a measurement report will be sent. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: InterRAT policy config group ID
parameters.description: Indicates the group ID of the parameters related to the inter-RAT handover. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: UTRAN handover policy Configuration
parameters.description: Indicates the policy of handovers to UTRAN. PS_HO: Indicates whether to allow PS handovers to UTRAN. This option applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD. SRVCC: Indicates whether to allow transfers to UTRAN in SRVCC mode. This option applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD. REDIRECTION: Indicates whether to allow redirection to UTRAN. This option applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: GERAN GSM handover policy Configuration
parameters.description: Indicates the policy of handovers to GERAN GSM networks. SRVCC: Indicates whether a UE can be handed over to a neighboring GERAN GSM cell through SRVCC. This option applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.id: GERAN GPRS EDGE handover policy Configuration
parameters.name: GERAN GPRS EDGE handover policy Configuration
parameters.description: Indicates the policy of handovers to GPRS/EDGE networks. PS_HO: Indicates whether PS handovers to neighboring GPRS/EDGE cells are allowed. This option applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD. CCO_HO: Indicates whether CCO to neighboring GPRS/EDGE cells is allowed. This option applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD. This option applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD. OPT_HO: Indicates whether to allow optimized handovers to neighboring CDMA2000 HRPD cells. This option applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: No handover flag
parameters.description: Indicates whether to permit or forbid the inter-RAT handover under the QCI. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: NR Handover Policy Configuration
parameters.description: Indicates the policy for handovers to NG-RAN in the inter-RAT policy configuration group. PS_HO: Indicates whether to allow PS handovers to NG-RAN. This option applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD. REDIRECTION: Indicates whether to allow redirections to NG-RAN. This option applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.id: High Speed Intra Frequency A3 Time To Trigger
parameters.name: High Speed Intra Frequency A3 Time To Trigger
parameters.description: Indicates the time-to-trigger for event A3 related to intra-frequency handovers for high-speed UEs in high-speed cells. When the entering condition for intra-frequency handover event is met, the UE does not immediately report event A3 to the eNodeB. Instead, the UE sends a report only when the signal quality meets the entering condition throughout the time-to-trigger. This option applies only to L

parameters.id: Intra-Freq A2 RSRP Threshold for CE
parameters.name: Intra-Freq A2 RSRP Threshold for CE
parameters.description: Indicates the RSRP threshold for triggering event A2 related to coverage-based intra-frequency handover for eMTC UEs in coverage enhancement mode. If the measured RSRP value is less than this parameter value, such a UE sends a measurement report. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.id: Mode A Adjustment A1 RSRP Threshold
parameters.name: Mode A Adjustment A1 RSRP Threshold
parameters.description: Indicates the threshold for triggering event A1 based on which UEs switch the coverage mode to coverage enhancement (CE) mode A at coverage level 1. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.id: Mode A Adjustment A2 RSRP Threshold
parameters.name: Mode A Adjustment A2 RSRP Threshold
parameters.description: Indicates the threshold for triggering event A2 based on which UEs switch the coverage mode from normal coverage mode to coverage enhancement (CE) mode A or switch the coverage level from coverage level 0 to coverage level 1. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.id: Mode B Adjustment A2 RSRP Threshold
parameters.name: Mode B Adjustment A2 RSRP Threshold
parameters.description: Indicates the threshold for triggering event A2 based on which UEs switch the coverage mode to coverage enhancement (CE) mode B. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.id: Normal Coverage Adjustment A1 RSRP Threshold
parameters.name: Normal Coverage Adjustment A1 RSRP Threshold
parameters.description: Indicates the threshold for triggering event A1 based on which UEs switch the coverage mode to normal coverage mode or coverage level 0. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.id: Intra-Freq HO A2 RSRQ Threshold for CE Mode A
parameters.name: Intra-Freq HO A2 RSRQ Threshold for CE Mode A
parameters.description: Indicates the RSRQ threshold for event A2 related to coverage-based A3-based intra-frequency handovers for UEs in coverage enhancement (CE) mode A. If the measured RSRQ value is less than the threshold, such a UE sends a measurement report. This parameter also takes effect for UEs in CE mode B. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.id: eMTC Handover A3 Time to Trigger
parameters.name: eMTC Handover A3 Time to Trigger
parameters.description: Indicates the time-to-trigger of event A3 related to intra-frequency and inter-frequency handovers for eMTC UEs. When the entering condition for the event is met, the UE does not immediately report event A3. Instead, the UE sends a report only when the signal quality meets the entering condition throughout the time-to-trigger. This parameter helps decrease the number of occasionally triggered even

parameters.name: Max report cell number
parameters.description: Indicates the maximum number of cells to be included in the measurement report after an intra-RAT inter-frequency or intra-RAT intra-frequency measurement event for handover purposes or a periodic intra-RAT measurement for ANR purposes is triggered. For details, see 3GPP TS 36.331. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: Measurement report amount
parameters.description: Indicates the number of periodic measurement reports to be sent after an event for the intra- or inter-frequency handover within the E-UTRAN is triggered. It is used to prevent the impact of measurement report loss and internal processing failure on the handover. For details, see 3GPP TS 36.331. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: A3 measurement trigger quantity
parameters.description: Indicates the triggering quantity used to evaluate the triggering condition for intra-frequency handovers. The quantity can be RSRP or RSRQ. The measured RSRP values are stable, slightly varying with the load, and therefore there is little signal quality fluctuation. The measured RSRQ values vary greatly with the load and better reflect the signal quality of the cell in real time. For details, see

parameters.name: A3 measurement report quantity
parameters.description: Indicates the quantity to be included in the measurement report after an event for intra-frequency handover is triggered. The quantity can be RSRP, RSRQ, or both. The measured RSRP values are stable, varying little with the load, and therefore there is little signal fluctuation. The measured RSRQ values vary with the load and better reflect the signal quality of the cell in real time. Even when th

parameters.name: A3 measurement report interval
parameters.description: Indicates the interval between periodic measurement reports that are sent after an intra-frequency handover is triggered. The value of this parameter is also used as the interval between A3-related inter-frequency measurement reports. For details, see 3GPP TS 36.331. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: Measurement A4 report quantity
parameters.description: Indicates the quantity to be included in the measurement reports for inter-frequency handovers. The quantity can be RSRP, RSRQ, or both. The measured RSRP values are stable, varying little with the load, and therefore there is little signal fluctuation. The measured RSRQ values vary with the load and better reflect the signal quality of the cell in real time. This parameter applies to measurements

parameters.name: Interfreq measurement report interval
parameters.description: Indicates the interval at which periodic measurement reports are sent after an inter-frequency handover event is triggered. For details, see 3GPP TS 36.331. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: InterFreq A1A2 Measurement trigger quantity
parameters.description: Indicates the triggering quantity for events A1 and A2 related to A4- or A5-based inter-frequency handovers. RSRP measurements slightly vary with the load, and there is little signal quality fluctuation. By contrast, RSRQ measurements greatly vary with the load and are likely to reflect the signal quality of the cell in real time. If this parameter is set to BOTH, both RSRP- and RSRQ-based measure

parameters.id: A1A2 Measurement trigger quantity of Freq Priority
parameters.name: A1A2 Measurement trigger quantity of Freq Priority
parameters.description: Indicates the triggering quantity for events A1 and A2 related to frequency-priority-based inter-frequency handovers. RSRP measurements slightly vary with the load, and there is little signal quality fluctuation. By contrast, RSRQ measurements greatly vary with the load and are likely to reflect the signal quality of the cell in real time. If this parameter is set to BOTH, both RSRP- and RSRQ-base

parameters.name: A4 Measurement Trigger Quantity
parameters.description: Indicates the triggering quantity for events A4 and A5 related to all non-coverage-based inter-frequency handovers. RSRP measurements slightly vary with the load, and there is little signal quality fluctuation. By contrast, RSRQ measurements greatly vary with the load and are likely to reflect the signal quality of the cell in real time. If this parameter is set to BOTH, both RSRP- and RSRQ-based

parameters.id: Coverage Based Inter Frequency HO Waiting Timer
parameters.name: Coverage Based Inter Frequency HO Waiting Timer
parameters.description: Indicates the timer governing the period of time that the eNodeB waits for more measurement reports to evaluate whether to perform a coverage-based inter-frequency handover after it receives a measurement report. This parameter takes effect only when the CovBasedInterFreqHoMode parameter is set to BASEDONSIGNALSTRENGTH or BASEDONFREQPRIORITY. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: A3 InterFreq A1A2 Measurement TrigQuan
parameters.description: Indicates the triggering quantity for events A1 and A2 related to A3-based inter-frequency handovers. RSRP measurements slightly vary with the load, and there is little signal quality fluctuation. By contrast, RSRQ measurements greatly vary with the load and are likely to reflect the signal quality of the cell in real time. If this parameter is set to BOTH, both RSRP- and RSRQ-based measurement co

parameters.id: Freq Pri Ho Candidate UE Select Period
parameters.name: Freq Pri Ho Candidate UE Select Period
parameters.description: Indicates the interval at which the eNodeB selects candidate UEs in the cell to perform frequency-priority-based inter-frequency measurement. If this parameter is set to 0, the eNodeB does not periodically select candidate UEs in the cell. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: Freq-Pri-based Inter-Freq HO Waiting Timer
parameters.description: Indicates the time within which the eNodeB waits for measurement reports for frequency-priority-based inter-frequency handovers. The value 0 indicates that the eNodeB handles a measurement report upon receiving it. If this parameter is set to a value greater than 0, the eNodeB waits for other measurement reports after receiving any measurement report for a frequency-priority-based inter-frequency

parameters.id: Intra-RAT HO A1 A2 Meas Trigger Quantity for CE
parameters.name: Intra-RAT HO A1 A2 Meas Trigger Quantity for CE
parameters.description: Indicates the triggering type of A1/A2 event measurement for coverage-based intra-RAT handovers of UEs in coverage enhancement mode. For details, see 3GPP TS 36.331. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: Freq-Pri-based Incoming HO Protection Timer
parameters.description: Indicates the length of the timer that governs the period in which UEs handed over from other cells to the local cell through unnecessary handovers are not allowed to be handed over to other cells through frequency-priority-based handovers. If this parameter is set to 0, the protection mechanism does not take effect. The unnecessary handovers include intra-eNodeB handovers except coverage-, uplink

parameters.id: Max Num of HO Fwd PDCP Pkt with SN
parameters.name: Max Num of HO Fwd PDCP Pkt with SN
parameters.description: Indicates the maximum number of PDCP packets that can be forwarded with SNs during handovers when the actually effective PdcpSnSize value is less than 18 bits. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: IOPS Switch
parameters.description: Indicates whether to enable IOPS for the eNodeB. IOPS is enabled only if this parameter is set to ON(On).

parameters.name: Enter IOPS Mode Time Threshold
parameters.description: Indicates the time threshold for delaying entering the IOPS mode for the eNodeB. This parameter avoids ping-pong switching between the macro network mode and IOPS mode. The eNodeB enters the IOPS mode when all S1-C interfaces on the macro network are faulty for the duration exceeding the value of this parameter.

parameters.name: Exit IOPS Mode Time Threshold
parameters.description: Indicates the time threshold for delaying exiting the IOPS mode for the eNodeB. This parameter avoids ping-pong handovers between the macro network mode and IOPS mode. The eNodeB returns from the IOPS mode to the macro network mode when any faulty S1-C interface on the macro network is recovered and the duration exceeds the value of this parameter.

parameters.name: IPv6 Address ID
parameters.description: Indicates the IPv6 Address ID of an interface.

parameters.name: Interface ID
parameters.description: Indicates the interface number. When Transmission Configuration Mode in the GTRANSPARA MO is set to NEW, this parameter indicates the interface number (0 to 1499) of the INTERFACE MO.

parameters.name: IPv6 Address
parameters.description: Indicates the IPv6 address.

parameters.name: Prefix Length
parameters.description: Indicates the length of the prefix of the IPv6 address, the prefix length of a loopback address is internally fixed to 128 bits.

parameters.name: VRF Index
parameters.description: Indicates the index of a VRF instance.

parameters.name: User Label
parameters.description: Indicates the user-defined information about an IPv6 address.

parameters.name: Address Status
parameters.description: Indicates the status of the IPv6 address. The value IP6_DAD_OK(Valid) indicates that the IPv6 address is in effect. The value IP6_DAD_TENTATIVE(Tentative) indicates that the DAD detection of the IPv6 address is not complete. The value IP6_DAD_DUPLICATED(Duplicate) indicates that the IPv6 address conflicts with the address of a neighbor.

parameters.name: Valid Lifetime
parameters.description: Indicates the time interval during which the IPv6 address is in the valid state.

parameters.name: Preferred Lifetime
parameters.description: Indicates the time interval during which the IPv6 address is in the preferred state. Valid states are categorized into the preferred state and the deprecated state. In the preferred state, an address can be freely used; in the deprecated state, the connections previously established on this address are still usable, whereas any connection newly established on this address is not usable.

parameters.name: Cabinet No.
parameters.description: Indicates the cabinet number of the board to which the IPv6 address belongs.

parameters.name: Subrack No.
parameters.description: Indicates the subrack number of the board to which the IPv6 address belongs.

parameters.name: Slot No.
parameters.description: Indicates the slot number of the board to which the IPv6 address belongs.

parameters.name: Port Type
parameters.description: Indicates the type of the port.

parameters.name: Port No.
parameters.description: Indicates the number of the port.

parameters.name: VRF Index
parameters.description: Indicates the index of a VRF instance. UMTS currently supports the default routing domain only (the VRF index is 0).

parameters.name: Source IP
parameters.description: Indicates the source IP address of an IP path route. The source IP address must be the same as the configured device IP address.

parameters.name: Destination IP
parameters.description: Indicates the destination IP address of an IP path route.

parameters.name: Transport Resource Type
parameters.description: Indicates the type of transport resource carried on an IP path route. The value HQ indicates high-quality transport resources, and the value LQ indicates low-quality transport resources.

parameters.name: Next Hop IP
parameters.description: Indicates the next-hop IP address of an IP path route. The next-hop IP address and the configured device IP address must be on the same network segment, but cannot be the same.

parameters.name: Route Index
parameters.description: Indicates the index of a static IPv6 route. The value of RTIDX in the IPROUTE6 MOs configured by users ranges from 0 to 127. The value of RTIDX in the IPROUTE6 MOs configured by the system ranges from 10000 to 19999.

parameters.name: VRF Index
parameters.description: Indicates the index of a VRF instance.

parameters.name: Destination IPv6 Address
parameters.description: Indicates the destination IPv6 address of a static IPv6 route.

parameters.name: Prefix Length
parameters.description: Indicates the prefix length of the destination IPv6 address of a static IPv6 route.

parameters.name: Route Type
parameters.description: Indicates the type of IPv6 route. If this parameter is set to NEXTHOP, all the IP packets that meet the route direction are first forwarded to the specified next-hop IPv6 address.
