parameters.name: Next-Hop IPv6 Address
parameters.description: Indicates the next-hop IPv6 address of a static IPv6 route.

parameters.name: Interface ID
parameters.description: Indicates the ID of the IPv6 interface to which a static IPv6 route belongs. The value of ITFID in the IPROUTE6 MOs configured by users ranges from 0 to 1499. The value of ITFID in the IPROUTE6 MOs configured by the system ranges from 10000 to 19999.

parameters.name: Preference
parameters.description: Indicates the priority of a static IPv6 route. A smaller parameter value indicates a higher priority.

parameters.name: User Label
parameters.description: Indicates the user-defined information.

parameters.name: Control Mode
parameters.description: Indicates whether the object can be automatically modified or removed by the system. When this parameter is set to MANUAL_MODE, only users can perform operations on the object. When this parameter is set to AUTO_MODE, only the system can perform operations on the object.

parameters.name: Cabinet No.
parameters.description: Indicates the cabinet number of the board to which an IPv6 route belongs.

parameters.name: Subrack No.
parameters.description: Indicates the subrack number of the board to which an IPv6 route belongs.

parameters.name: Slot No.
parameters.description: Indicates the slot number of the board to which an IPv6 route belongs.

parameters.name: Actual Port Type
parameters.description: Indicates the type of the actual port.

parameters.name: Actual Port No.
parameters.description: Indicates the number of the actual port.

parameters.name: Route Protocol
parameters.description: Indicates the type of the static IPv6 route. A static host route is a manually configured route with a 128-bit prefix. A static gateway route is a manually configured route with a non-128-bit prefix, with the next hop IP address on a different network segment from the egress port IP address. A dynamic host route is a dynamically learned (not manually configured) route with a 128-bit prefix. A dyna

parameters.name: Route Status
parameters.description: Indicates the status of an IPv6 route.

parameters.name: Differentiated Services Code Point
parameters.description: Indicates a differentiated services code point (DSCP) for IP packets. Different types of traffic can be assigned different DSCPs within the range of 1 to 63. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: Traffic Description
parameters.description: Indicates a service description. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: QoS Policy Time Switch
parameters.description: Indicates whether to use different rate measures in two phases for QoS purposes. This switch is required only for video services, not for other services. If this switch is turned on for video services, the eNodeB provides an initial acceleration in the first phase and a normal rate guarantee in the second phase. If this switch is turned off, the eNodeB provides a normal rate guarantee from the sta

parameters.name: First QoS Policy Identity
parameters.description: Indicates the ID of the QoS policy used in the first phase of a video service. If the QosPolicyTimeSwitch parameter is set to ON, the QoS policy is used in the initial phase of the service; if this parameter is set to OFF, the QoS policy is used across the entire process of the service. The FirQosPolicyId parameter does not take effect if the QoS policy applies only to DSCP-based preallocation (wi

parameters.name: First QoS Policy Time Length
parameters.description: Indicates the time length of the first phase in which the eNodeB provides initial acceleration for video services. When the QosPolicyTimeSwitch parameter is set to ON, the FirQosPolicyTimeLength parameter must be set to a value greater than 0. A larger value indicates longer acceleration time. When the QosPolicyTimeSwitch parameter is set to OFF, the FirQosPolicyTimeLength parameter does not need

parameters.name: Second QoS Policy Identity
parameters.description: Indicates the QoS policy to be used after initial acceleration is complete for a video service. If the QosPolicyTimeSwitch parameter is set to ON, set the SecQosPolicyId parameter to an existing QosPolicyId value in the range of 0 to 127. If the QosPolicyTimeSwitch parameter is set to OFF, the SecQosPolicyId parameter does not need to be set. In this case, the system sets SecQosPolicyId to 255 by

parameters.name: Application Range
parameters.description: Indicates the scope of functions to which a QoS policy is applicable. VIDEO_AND_DWNLD_RATE_CTRL_SW: If this option is selected, the QoS policy is applicable to DSCP-based video service rate adaptation and busy-hour download rate control. If this option is deselected, the QoS policy is not applicable to DSCP-based video service rate adaptation and busy-hour download rate control. This option applie

parameters.name: Rat Type
parameters.description: Indicates the RAT corresponding to the inter-RAT neighbor relationship classification algorithm. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: Statistic Period For NCell Class
parameters.description: Indicates the statistical period for inter-RAT neighbor relationship classification. The number of times a target cell is measured by UEs in the source cell is measured within the statistical period. The eNodeB determines whether the inter-RAT neighboring cell is a formal or extended neighboring cell based on the measurement result. If the predefined criteria are met within the statistical period,

parameters.name: NCell Measure Number Threshold
parameters.description: Indicates the measurement times threshold for inter-RAT neighbor relationship classification. If the number of times a target cell is measured within the statistical period for inter-RAT neighbor relationship classification reaches this threshold, this inter-RAT neighboring cell is regarded a formal neighboring cell. If the number of times the target cell is measured does not reach this threshold

parameters.name: Mobile Country Code
parameters.description: Indicates the MCC of the external LAA cell. A PLMN ID is comprised of an MCC and an MNC. The MCC consists of three digits. The MNC consists of two or three digits. For example, if the MCC is 123 and the MNC is 45, the PLMN ID is 12345.

parameters.name: Mobile Network Code
parameters.description: Indicates the MNC of a neighboring LAA cell. A PLMN ID is comprised of an MCC and an MNC. The MCC consists of three digits. The MNC consists of two or three digits. For example, if the MCC is 123 and the MNC is 45, the PLMN ID is 12345.

parameters.name: eNodeB ID
parameters.description: Indicates the ID of the eNodeB serving the external LAA cell. It uniquely identifies an eNodeB within a PLMN. The 28-bit E-UTRAN cell ID is comprised of the cell ID and the eNodeB ID. The eNodeB ID is the most significant 20 bits of the E-UTRAN cell ID. The CGI of an E-UTRAN cell is comprised of the E-UTRAN cell ID and the PLMN ID. For details, see 3GPP TS 36.413.

parameters.name: Cell ID
parameters.description: Indicates the cell ID of an external LAA cell. It uniquely identifies an LAA cell in the eNodeB. The 28-bit E-UTRAN cell ID is comprised of the cell ID and the eNodeB ID. The cell ID is the least significant eight bits of the E-UTRAN cell ID. The CGI of an E-UTRAN cell is comprised of the E-UTRAN cell ID and the PLMN ID. For details, see 3GPP TS 36.413.

parameters.name: Tracking Area Code
parameters.description: Indicates the TAC of the external LAA cell. 3GPP specifications stipulate that the TAC values 0x0000(0) and 0xFFFE(65534) are reserved, and therefore these two TAC values cannot be used in later versions. You are advised not to set 0 or 65534 as the TAC value in network planning and configuration.

parameters.name: Physical Cell ID
parameters.description: Indicates the physical cell ID of the external LAA cell. For details, see 3GPP TS 36.331.

parameters.name: Downlink EARFCN
parameters.description: Indicates the EARFCN of the external LAA cell. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: LAA External Cell Status
parameters.description: Indicates the status of the external LAA cell. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD. The status can be: AVAILABLE UNAVAILABLE The cause of unavailability can be any of the following: The external LAA cell is not activated, the external LAA cell is removed, and the link is abnormal.

parameters.name: Broadcast Packet Rate Threshold
parameters.description: Indicates the threshold limiting the data rate for forwarding broadcast packets by the layer 2 LAN switch of an NE.

parameters.name: MAC Aging Time
parameters.description: Indicates the aging time of entries in a MAC forwarding table that is learned by a layer 2 LAN switch of an NE.

parameters.name: Dynamic MAC Learn Switch
parameters.description: Indicates whether to enable the function of dynamically learning the MAC forwarding table by the layer 2 LAN switch of an NE.

parameters.name: Source MAC Attack Check Switch
parameters.description: Switch for checking the source MAC address attack to the layer 2 LAN switch of an NE. When this parameter is set to ENABLE, the related alarm is reported when a layer 2 LAN switch is attacked by the source MAC address. When this parameter is set to DISABLE, the related alarm is not reported when the layer 2 LAN switch is attacked by the source MAC address.

parameters.name: Source MAC Attack Alarm Threshold
parameters.description: Indicates the threshold for generating the source MAC attack-caused alarm on the layer 2 LAN switch of an NE. When this switch is turned on and a MAC forwarding table has been configured with the maximum number of entries, the Base Station Being Attacked alarm is reported if the number of the dynamic forwarding table update attempts exceeds a specified threshold within 1 minute, and the specific p

parameters.name: Port Index
parameters.description: Indicates the index of a layer 2 LAN switch port on a layer 2 LAN switch of an NE.

parameters.name: Port Type
parameters.description: Indicates the port type used by a layer 2 LAN switch port on a layer 2 LAN switch of an NE.

parameters.name: Cabinet No.
parameters.description: Indicates the number of the cabinet housing the board that carries the layer 2 LAN switch port of Ethernet type on the layer 2 LAN switch for an NE.

parameters.name: Subrack No.
parameters.description: Indicates the number of the subrack housing the board that carries the layer 2 LAN switch port of Ethernet type on the layer 2 LAN switch for an NE.

parameters.name: Slot No.
parameters.description: Indicates the number of the slot housing the board that carries the layer 2 LAN switch port of Ethernet type on the layer 2 LAN switch for an NE.

parameters.name: Port No.
parameters.description: Indicates the number of Ethernet port corresponding to the layer 2 LAN switch port of Ethernet type on the layer 2 LAN switch for an NE.

parameters.name: User Label
parameters.description: Indicates the object descriptions of a layer 2 LAN switch port on a layer 2 LAN switch of an NE.

parameters.name: Switch Port State
parameters.description: Indicates the state of a layer 2 LAN switch port.

parameters.name: Received Non-Broadcast Packets
parameters.description: Indicates the number of packets received by a layer 2 LAN switch port.

parameters.name: Number of Transmitted Packets
parameters.description: Indicates the number of packets transmitted by a layer 2 LAN switch port.

parameters.id: Number of Packets Discarded in RX Direction due to MAC MISS
parameters.name: Number of Packets Discarded in RX Direction due to MAC MISS
parameters.description: Indicates the number of packets discarded by a layer 2 LAN switch port in the receive direction due to MAC MISS. MAC MISS means that searching for the forwarding table based on the destination MAC address of the packets fails. This parameter is valid only for layer 2 switch ports of the Ethernet type.

parameters.id: Dropped Packets In Reception direction Due to Broad Cast forwarding Rate Limit Overflow
parameters.name: Dropped Packets In Reception direction Due to Broad Cast forwarding Rate Limit Overflow
parameters.description: Indicates the number of broadcast packets discarded by a layer 2 port in the receive direction when the number of broadcast packets exceeds a specified threshold. This parameter is valid only for layer 2 switch ports of the Ethernet type.

parameters.name: CN Operator ID
parameters.description: Indicates the index of the operator. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.id: The proportion of the maximum number of users
parameters.name: The proportion of the maximum number of users
parameters.description: Indicates the proportion of the number of UEs in RRC_CONNECTED mode of the operator when the eNodeB is shared among operators. This parameter must be set based on the contract signed with operators. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.id: The proportion of the sharing number of users
parameters.name: The proportion of the sharing number of users
parameters.description: Indicates the proportion of users that the operator can share with other operators when the eNodeB is shared among operators. This parameter must be set based on the contract signed with operators. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD.

parameters.name: User Number Sharing Group ID
parameters.description: Indicates the ID of the sharing group of UEs in RRC_CONNECTED mode. Operators with the same UserNumSharingGroupId parameter value share the sum of the proportions of UEs in RRC_CONNECTED mode of each operator and the sum of the penetration rates of UEs in RRC_CONNECTED mode of each operator. The value 255 is an invalid ID, indicating that the operator is not configured with a sharing group of UEs

parameters.name: Uplink Traffic License Ratio
parameters.description: Indicates the proportion of the UL licensed traffic to the total licensed traffic of the eNodeB. The total licensed traffic is the sum of UL and DL licensed traffic. If this parameter is set to 100%, there is no DL licensed traffic, affecting service admission. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: Traffic Sharing Type
parameters.description: Indicates the mode of traffic sharing between the operators in RAN sharing scenarios. If this parameter is set to SHARING, all the operators share the total traffic of the eNodeB without proportional limits. If this parameter is set to DEDICATE and the ENodeBSharingMode parameter is not set to INDEPENDENT, all the operators share the total traffic of the eNodeB based on specific proportions. Howev

parameters.name: CN Operator ID
parameters.description: Indicates the ID of the operator.

parameters.name: TrfRatio
parameters.description: Indicates the proportion of traffic used by the operator when the eNodeB is shared among operators. This parameter must be set based on the contract signed by operators. If this parameter is set to 0, services except emergency calls of this operator are not admitted.

parameters.name: TrfSharingRatio
parameters.description: Indicates the proportion of traffic that the operator can share with other operators when the eNodeB is shared among operators.

parameters.name: Atom Rule ID
parameters.description: Indicates the ID of an intelligent optimization atom rule. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: Measurement Object Type
parameters.description: Indicates the measurement object type in intelligent optimization atom rules. If this parameter is set to Cell, the measurement objects are cell-level atom rules. If this parameter is set to eNodeB, the measurement objects are eNodeB-level atom rules. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: Condition Type
parameters.description: Indicates the relationship between measurement objects and thresholds in intelligent optimization atom rules. The parameter values BIGGERTHAN, EQUALTO, SMALLERTHAN, SMALLERTHANOREQUALTO, BIGGERTHANOREQUALTO, and NOTEQUALTO indicate the conditions of greater than, equal to, smaller than, smaller than or equal to, greater than or equal to, and not equal to, respectively. This parameter applies only

parameters.name: Threshold for Numerical Parameter
parameters.description: Indicates the threshold for selecting measurement objects with numerical values in intelligent optimization atom rules. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: Measurement Object
parameters.description: Indicates the measurement object in an intelligent optimization atom rule. USER_SPEC_OCCUPY_RATE: Indicates the proportion of UL-sync UEs to the specifications. UL_PRB_UTILIZATION_RATE: Indicates the uplink PRB usage. DL_PRB_UTILIZATION_RATE: Indicates the downlink PRB usage. PDCCH_CCE_UTILIZATION_RATE: Indicates the PDCCH CCE usage. ENB_USER_SPEC_EQU_OCCUPY_RATE: Indicates the maximum value among

parameters.name: Intelligent Optimization Feature ID
parameters.description: Indicates the ID of the intelligent optimization feature. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: Intelligent Optimization Feature Name
parameters.description: Indicates the name of the intelligent optimization feature. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: Intelligent Optimization Function ID
parameters.description: Indicates the ID of the intelligent optimization function. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: Intelligent Optimization Function Name
parameters.description: Indicates the name of the intelligent optimization function. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: Intelligent Optimization Feature ID
parameters.description: Indicates the ID of the intelligent optimization feature. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: Measurement Object Type
parameters.description: Indicates the measurement object type in intelligent optimization atom rules. If this parameter is set to Cell, the measurement objects are cell-level atom rules. If this parameter is set to eNodeB, the measurement objects are eNodeB-level atom rules. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: Local Cell ID
parameters.description: Indicates the ID of the cell with which intelligent optimization atom rules are applied. This parameter can only be queried by running the DSP LIOPTFUNCTION command. Information displayed in the DSP LIOPTFUNCTION command output is specific to the cell. This parameter setting does not take effect when the MeasureObjType parameter is set to eNodeB. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: Status
parameters.description: Indicates the status of intelligent optimization atom rules. This parameter can only be queried by running the DSP LIOPTFUNCTION command. If this parameter value is NORMAL, the intelligent optimization is in the normal state. If this parameter value is PENALTY, the intelligent optimization is under penalty, and all related intelligent optimization measures cannot be taken. This parameter applies o

parameters.name: Trigger List
parameters.description: Indicates information about the neighboring cells that request the local cell to perform intelligent optimization functions. The ECGI identifying a neighboring cell is displayed in format of Mcc-Mnc-eNodeBID-CellID. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: Rule ID
parameters.description: Indicates the ID of an intelligent optimization rule. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: Action Type
parameters.description: Indicates the type of parameter adjustment when the trigger conditions in an intelligent optimization rule are met. If this parameter is set to MODIFY, the intelligent optimization rule is used to modify parameters. If this parameter is set to RESUME, the intelligent optimization rule is used to restore parameters to the initial settings. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: Relationship Type of Atom Rule
parameters.description: Indicates the type of relationships between atom rules under an intelligent optimization rule. If this parameter is set to AND, optimization actions corresponding to the intelligent optimization rule are triggered only when all atom rules under this intelligent optimization rule meet related requirements. If this parameter is set to OR, optimization actions corresponding to the intelligent optimiz

parameters.name: Period
parameters.description: Indicates the evaluation period of an intelligent optimization rule. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: Action
parameters.description: Indicates a parameter adjustment action corresponding to an intelligent optimization rule. Note: When a network is no longer heavily loaded, restore the parameter value to the pre-optimization GUI value. The corresponding value of ActionType is RESUME and the corresponding value of Action is NULL. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: Intelligent Optimization Function ID
parameters.description: Indicates the ID of the intelligent optimization function. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: Penalty Time
parameters.description: Indicates the penalty duration of intelligent optimization rules under an intelligent optimization function. If related conditions for an intelligent optimization rule under an intelligent optimization function are met and related adjustment measures are taken, the penalty duration starts. During the penalty duration, parameter adjustment cannot be triggered even if conditions for an intelligent o

parameters.name: Adaptive RAT
parameters.description: Indicates the duplex mode to which an intelligent optimization rule applies. If this parameter is set to FDD, the intelligent optimization rule applies to FDD. If this parameter is set to TDD, the intelligent optimization rule applies to TDD. If this parameter is set to BOTH, the intelligent optimization rule applies to both FDD and TDD. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: Active Status
parameters.description: Indicates whether an intelligent optimization rule is activated. If the parameter value is set to ACTIVATED, the intelligent optimization rule is activated. If the parameter value is set to DEACTIVATED, the intelligent optimization rule is deactivated and does not take effect. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: Local Cell ID
parameters.description: Indicates the ID of the local cell with an intelligent optimization rule applied. This parameter can only be queried by running the DSP LIOPTRULE command. If the local cell ID is displayed as 65535 in the command output, this intelligent optimization rule takes effect on the eNodeB level. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: Executive Status
parameters.description: Indicates the state of parameter adjustment corresponding to an intelligent optimization rule. This parameter can only be queried by running the DSP LIOPTRULE command. If this parameter value is UN-EXECUTED, parameter adjustment is not performed. If this parameter value is EXECUTING, parameter adjustment is being performed. If this parameter is EXECUTED, parameter adjustment has been performed. Th

parameters.name: Rule ID
parameters.description: Indicates the ID of the intelligent optimization rule to which the intelligent optimization rule members are associated. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: Atom Rule ID
parameters.description: Indicates the ID of the intelligent optimization atom rule to which the intelligent optimization rule members are associated. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: Active Status
parameters.description: Indicates whether an intelligent optimization rule member is activated. If this parameter is set to ACTIVATED, the intelligent optimization atom rules apply to the evaluation of the associated intelligent optimization rule. If this parameter is set to DEACTIVATED, the intelligent optimization atom rules do not apply to the evaluation of the associated intelligent optimization rule. This parameter

parameters.name: IPv6 Address
parameters.description: Indicates the IPv6 address of an OM channel. This IPv6 address must be a link-local address.

parameters.name: Prefix Length
parameters.description: Indicates the prefix length of the IPv6 address of a local maintenance channel.

parameters.name: Address Status
parameters.description: Indicates the status of the IPv6 address of the local maintenance channel.

parameters.name: Valid Lifetime
parameters.description: Indicates the time period during which the IPv6 address of the local maintenance channel is in valid state.

parameters.name: Preferred Lifetime
parameters.description: Indicates the time period during which the IPv6 address of the local maintenance channel is in preferred state. The valid state is categorized into the preferred state and the deprecated state. In preferred state, the address can be freely used. In deprecated state, the connections previously established through this address are still usable, whereas any connection newly established through this a

parameters.name: Local Log Encryption Switch
parameters.description: Indicates whether to encrypt the operation logs and security logs stored on a base station.

parameters.name: Port Index
parameters.description: Indicates the index of a layer 2 LAN switch port on a layer 2 LAN switch of an NE.

parameters.name: Port Type
parameters.description: Indicates the port type used by a layer 2 LAN switch port on a layer 2 LAN switch of an NE.

parameters.name: Ethernet Port ID
parameters.description: Indicates the ID of the Ethernet port corresponding to an Ethernet-type layer 2 switching port controlled by a layer 2 LAN switch.

parameters.name: User Label
parameters.description: Indicates the object descriptions of a layer 2 LAN switch port on a layer 2 LAN switch of an NE.

parameters.name: Cabinet No.
parameters.description: Indicates the number of the cabinet housing the board that carries the layer 2 LAN switch port of Ethernet type on the layer 2 LAN switch for an NE.

parameters.name: Subrack No.
parameters.description: Indicates the number of the subrack housing the board that carries the layer 2 LAN switch port of Ethernet type on the layer 2 LAN switch for an NE.

parameters.name: Slot No.
parameters.description: Indicates the number of the slot housing the board that carries the layer 2 LAN switch port of Ethernet type on the layer 2 LAN switch for an NE.

parameters.name: Port No.
parameters.description: Indicates the number of Ethernet port corresponding to the layer 2 LAN switch port of Ethernet type on the layer 2 LAN switch for an NE.

parameters.name: Switch Port State
parameters.description: Indicates the state of a layer 2 LAN switch port.

parameters.name: Received Non-Broadcast Packets
parameters.description: Indicates the number of packets received by a layer 2 LAN switch port.

parameters.name: Number of Transmitted Packets
parameters.description: Indicates the number of packets transmitted by a layer 2 LAN switch port.

parameters.id: Number of Packets Discarded in RX Direction due to MAC MISS
parameters.name: Number of Packets Discarded in RX Direction due to MAC MISS
parameters.description: Indicates the number of packets discarded by a layer 2 LAN switch port in the receive direction due to MAC MISS. MAC MISS means that searching for the forwarding table based on the destination MAC address of the packets fails. This parameter is valid only for layer 2 switch ports of the Ethernet type.

parameters.id: Dropped Packets In Reception direction Due to Broad Cast forwarding Rate Limit Overflow
parameters.name: Dropped Packets In Reception direction Due to Broad Cast forwarding Rate Limit Overflow
parameters.description: Indicates the number of broadcast packets discarded by a layer 2 port in the receive direction when the number of broadcast packets exceeds a specified threshold. This parameter is valid only for layer 2 switch ports of the Ethernet type.

parameters.id: LTE and NR Spectrum Sharing Cell Group ID
parameters.name: LTE and NR Spectrum Sharing Cell Group ID
parameters.description: Indicates the ID of an LTE and NR spectrum sharing cell group. This ID uniquely identifies such a group within an eNodeB. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.id: Rate of Uplink Spectrum Allocated to NR
parameters.name: Rate of Uplink Spectrum Allocated to NR
parameters.description: Indicates the rate of uplink spectrum to be allocated to NR. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD.

parameters.id: LTE and NR Co Carrier Co CPRI Data Switch
parameters.name: LTE and NR Co Carrier Co CPRI Data Switch
parameters.description: Indicates whether LTE and NR share RRU carrier and CPRI data resources. If LTE and NR share optical fibers, they will share RRU carrier and CPRI data resources when this parameter is set ON. They will use their respective RRU carrier and CPRI data resources when this parameter is set to OFF. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD.

parameters.id: LTE and NR Uplink Spectrum Sharing Mode
parameters.name: LTE and NR Uplink Spectrum Sharing Mode
parameters.description: Indicates the mode of uplink spectrum sharing between LTE FDD and NR. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD.

parameters.id: LTE and NR Spectrum Sharing Priority
parameters.name: LTE and NR Spectrum Sharing Priority
parameters.description: Indicates the RAT priority in spectrum sharing between LTE and NR. This parameter is valid only when the SpectrumCloudSwitch parameter in the SpectrumCloud MO is set to LTE_NR_UPLINK_SPECTRUM_SHR and the LteNrUlSpectrumShrMode parameter in the LteNrSpctShrCellGrp MO is set to DYNAMIC_SHARING, or when the FddTddInd parameter in the Cell MO is set to CELL_TDD and the SpectrumCloudSwitch parameter in

parameters.name: LTE Guarantee PUSCH RB Number
parameters.description: Indicates the PUSCH RB quantity guaranteed for LTE when LTE FDD and NR Uplink Spectrum Sharing is used. If this parameter is set to a value less than the minimum number of PUSCH RBs required by LTE, the number of PUSCH RBs actually allocated to LTE is at least this minimum number. If this parameter is set to a value greater than the maximum number of PUSCH RBs that can be allocated to LTE, the num

parameters.name: NR Guarantee PUSCH RB Number
parameters.description: Indicates the PUSCH RB quantity guaranteed for NR when LTE FDD and NR Uplink Spectrum Sharing is used. If this parameter is set to a value less than the minimum number of PUSCH RBs required by NR, the number of PUSCH RBs actually allocated to NR is at least this minimum number. If this parameter is set to a value greater than the maximum number of PUSCH RBs that can be allocated to NR, the number

parameters.id: LTE Prior Res Ratio in LTE and NR Spectrum Shr
parameters.name: LTE Prior Res Ratio in LTE and NR Spectrum Shr
parameters.description: Indicates the total percentage of uplink and downlink spectrum resources to be preferentially allocated to LTE for MBB services in LTE FDD and NR spectrum sharing scenarios. The total percentage of uplink and downlink spectrum resources to be preferentially allocated to NR is equal to the result of 100% minus the value of this parameter. If this parameter is set to X%, X% of the uplink and downlin

parameters.id: LTE and NR Spectrum Handover Protect Duration
parameters.name: LTE and NR Spectrum Handover Protect Duration
parameters.description: Indicates the handover protection duration for LTE and NR spectrum sharing. This parameter applies only to LTE TDD.

parameters.name: PRB Usage Threshold
parameters.description: Indicates the PRB usage threshold for triggering LTE TDD and NR spectrum sharing. When the LTE PRB usage is greater than the PRB usage threshold plus the threshold offset, the LTE cells require the spectrum shared with the NR cells. When the LTE PRB usage is less than or equal to the PRB usage threshold minus the threshold offset, the LTE cells do not require the spectrum shared with the NR cells.

parameters.name: RRC Connected UE Number Threshold
parameters.description: Indicates the RRC_CONNECTED UE number threshold for triggering LTE TDD and NR spectrum sharing. When the number of LTE RRC_CONNECTED UEs is greater than the RRC_CONNECTED UE number threshold plus the threshold offset, the LTE cells require the spectrum shared with the NR cells. When the number of RRC_CONNECTED UEs is less than or equal to the RRC_CONNECTED UE number threshold minus the threshold o

parameters.name: PRB Usage Threshold Offset
parameters.description: Indicates the offset relative to the PRB usage threshold for triggering LTE TDD and NR spectrum sharing. When the PRB usage is greater than the PRB usage threshold plus the threshold offset, the LTE network requires the spectrum shared with the NR network. When the PRB usage is less than or equal to the PRB usage threshold minus the threshold offset, the LTE network does not require the spectrum s

parameters.id: RRC Connected UE Number Threshold Offset
parameters.name: RRC Connected UE Number Threshold Offset
parameters.description: Indicates the offset relative to the RRC_CONNECTED UE number threshold for triggering LTE TDD and NR spectrum sharing. When the number of RRC_CONNECTED UEs is greater than the RRC_CONNECTED UE number threshold plus the threshold offset, the LTE network requires the spectrum shared with the NR network. When the number of RRC_CONNECTED UEs is less than or equal to the RRC_CONNECTED UE number thresho

parameters.name: LNR Spectrum Sharing Switch
parameters.description: Indicates whether to enable LTE and NR spectrum sharing functions. LTE_SHR_SPCT_ACT_SILENCE_SW: Indicates whether to enable active silence for LTE carriers involved in spectrum sharing. If this option is selected, the light-load and extremely-light-load LTE cells involved in spectrum sharing will actively enter the silent state. If this option is deselected, LTE cells involved in spectrum sharing

parameters.name: Local Cell ID
parameters.description: Indicates the local ID of a cell, which uniquely identifies a cell within an eNodeB. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: LWA W1 Threshold
parameters.description: Indicates the threshold for LWA measurement events W1 and W2. When the RSSI value of a WLAN AP measured by a UE is greater than this threshold, an event W1 measurement report is triggered. This parameter can also be taken as the threshold 2 for event W2. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD.

parameters.name: LWA W2 Threshold 1
parameters.description: Indicates the threshold 1 for LWA measurement event W2. When the RSSI values of all WLAN APs in the mobility set of a UE are less than the threshold 1 of event W2 and the RSSI values of WLAN APs that are not in the mobility set are greater than threshold 2 of event W2, an event W2 measurement report is sent. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD.

parameters.name: LWA W3 Threshold
parameters.description: Indicates the triggering threshold for LWA measurement event W3. When the RSSI values of all WLAN APs in a mobility set measured by a UE are less than the threshold, an event W3 measurement report is sent. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD.

parameters.name: LWA W1 Time To Trigger
parameters.description: Indicates the time-to-trigger for LWA event W1. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD.

parameters.name: LWA W2 Time To Trigger
parameters.description: Indicates the time-to-trigger for LWA event W2. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD.

parameters.name: LWA W3 Time To Trigger
parameters.description: Indicates the time-to-trigger for LWA event W3. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD.

parameters.name: WLAN Measurement Hysteresis
parameters.description: Indicates the hysteresis for LWA measurement events. This parameter decreases the number of LWA measurement event triggering times due to radio signal fluctuations and reduces the probability of LWA offloading configuration decision errors and ping-pong configurations. A larger value of this parameter results in a lower probability. This parameter applies to W1, W2, and W3 measurements. This param

parameters.name: Cell LWA Algorithm Switch
parameters.description: Indicates whether to enable cell-level LTE WLAN Aggregation (LWA). This parameter provides the following option: LWA_DL_3C_SWITCH: Indicates whether to enable downlink 3C offloading in LWA. This function is enabled only if this option is selected. This option applies only to LTE FDD.

parameters.name: M1 ID
parameters.description: Indicates the M1 object ID. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: M1 Network Type
parameters.description: Indicates the type of network served by the M1 interface. If this parameter is set to MACRO_NETWORK, the type is macro network. If this parameter is set to IOPS_NETWORK, the network type is IOPS. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: M1 End Point Group ID
parameters.description: Indicates the ID of the endpoint group used by the M1 MO. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: User Label
parameters.description: Indicates the descriptions of the M1 MO. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: M2 ID
parameters.description: Indicates the M2 object ID. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: M2 Network Type
parameters.description: Indicates the type of network served by the M2 interface. If this parameter is set to MACRO_NETWORK, the type is macro network. If this parameter is set to IOPS_NETWORK, the network type is IOPS. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: M2 End Point Group ID
parameters.description: Indicates the ID of the endpoint group used by the M2 MO. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: User Label
parameters.description: Indicates the descriptions of the M2 MO. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: M2 Interface CP Bearer ID
parameters.description: Indicates the control port (CP) bearer ID of the M2 interface. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: M2 Interface CP Bearer State
parameters.description: Indicates the control port bearer status of the M2 interface. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: M2 Interface State
parameters.description: Indicates the M2 interface status. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: M2 Interface Session Number
parameters.description: Indicates the number of sessions on the M2 interface. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: MCE Name
parameters.description: Indicates the name of the Multi-cell/multicast Coordination Entity (MCE) to which the eNodeB is connected over the M2 interface. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: GlobalMceId
parameters.description: Indicates the global unique ID of the Multi-cell/multicast Coordination Entity (MCE) connected to the eNodeB through the M2 interface. The global unique ID of the MCE is represented as "MCC-MNC-MCE ID". MCC is short for mobile country code and MNC is short for mobile network code. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: M2InterfaceFaultReason
parameters.description: Indicates the fault reason of the M2 link. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: M2 Interface Session TMGI
parameters.description: Indicates the temporary mobile group identities (TMGIs) of all incoming sessions over the M2 interface. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: Local MCE ID
parameters.description: Indicates the local ID of an MCE. It uniquely identifies an MCE within a local NE. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: M3 ID
parameters.description: Indicates the ID of the M3 MO. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: M3 End Point Group ID
parameters.description: Indicates the ID of the end point resource group used by the M3 MO. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: Interface Setup Initiation Indication
parameters.description: Indicates whether to initiate the M3 interface setup process. Set this parameter to YES for core networks compliant with 3GPP Release 11 or later. Set this parameter to NO for core networks compliant with 3GPP specifications earlier than Release 11. For details, see 3GPP TS 36.444. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: Mobile Country Code
parameters.description: Indicates the MCC of the MCE. An MCC and an MNC constitute a PLMN ID. PLMN IDs are used to support multi-M3-link scenarios. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: Mobile Network Code
parameters.description: Indicates the MNC of the MCE. An MCC and an MNC constitute a PLMN ID. PLMN IDs are used to support multi-M3-link scenarios. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: Synchronisation Period
parameters.description: Indicates the synchronization period of the SYNC protocol. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: MBMS Control Switch
parameters.description: Indicates the switches to control eNodeB-level MBMS services. This parameter provides the following options: SessionForMultiMASwitch: A single MBMS session can be broadcasted in multiple MBSFN areas in an eNodeB only if this option is selected. This option applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD. M2DisconnProtectSwitch: Indicates whether to delete eMBMS sessions on the eNodeB with time delays after th

parameters.name: M2 Interface Disconnect Protect Time
parameters.description: Indicates the delay after which the eNodeB deletes MBMS sessions if the M2 interface is interrupted. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: MBSFN Area ID
parameters.description: Indicates the ID of a Multimedia Broadcast Single Frequency Network (MBSFN) area to which a cell belongs. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: Cell Reservation Info
parameters.description: Indicates whether the cell is a reserved cell for Multimedia Broadcast Multicast Service (MBMS) services. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: Local Cell ID
parameters.description: Indicates the local ID of the cell. It uniquely identifies a cell within an eNodeB. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: Local MCE ID
parameters.description: Indicates the local ID of an MCE. It uniquely identifies an MCE within a local NE. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: MBSFN Area ID
parameters.description: Indicates the ID of an MBSFN area. For details, see 3GPP TS 36.443. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: FDD TDD Indication
parameters.description: Indicates the duplex mode of the cells in an MBSFN area. CELL_FDD indicates the FDD mode, and CELL_TDD indicates the TDD mode. All the cells in an MBSFN area must work in the same duplex mode. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: Downlink Bandwidth
parameters.description: Indicates the downlink bandwidth of the cells in an MBSFN area. The bandwidth is represented by the number of RBs. For example, the value CELL_BW_N25 indicates a bandwidth of 25 RBs, and the value CELL_BW_N50 indicates a bandwidth of 50 RBs. For details, see 3GPP TS 36.104. All the cells in an MBSFN area must have the same downlink bandwidth. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: Common Subframe Allocation Period
parameters.description: Indicates the MBSFN subframe allocation period. For details about this parameter, see 3GPP TS 36.331. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: Uplink-Downlink Subframe Configuration
parameters.description: Indicates the uplink-downlink subframe configuration for LTE TDD cells in an MBSFN area. For details, see 3GPP TS 36.211. All cells in an MBSFN area must use the same uplink-downlink subframe configuration. This parameter applies only to LTE TDD.

parameters.name: Local MCE ID
parameters.description: Indicates the local ID of an MCE. It uniquely identifies an MCE within a local NE. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: MBSFN Area ID
parameters.description: Indicates the ID of an MBSFN area. For details, see 3GPP TS 36.443. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: Cell ID
parameters.description: Indicates the cell identity of an E-UTRAN cell. The cell identity is a string of 28 bits, of which the 20 leftmost bits represent the eNodeB ID and the 8 rightmost bits represent the cell ID. The PLMN ID and the cell identity constitute the ECGI. For details, see 3GPP TS 36.443. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: eNodeB ID
parameters.description: Indicates the eNodeB ID, which is a string of at most 20 bits. The ID is unique within a PLMN. The PLMN ID and the eNodeB ID together constitute the global eNodeB ID. For details, see 3GPP TS 36.443. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: Reserved Cell Indication
parameters.description: Indicates whether an E-UTRAN cell is a reserved cell for MBSFN. If the E-UTRAN cell is a reserved cell, multicast transmission is not performed in the cell. For details, see 3GPP TS 36.443. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: Mobile Country Code
parameters.description: Indicates the MCC of the MCE. An MCC and an MNC constitute a PLMN ID. PLMN IDs are used to support multi-PLMN and multi-operator scenarios. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: Mobile Network Code
parameters.description: Indicates the MNC of the MCE. An MCC and an MNC constitute a PLMN ID. PLMN IDs are used to support multi-PLMN and multi-operator scenarios. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: Local MCE ID
parameters.description: Indicates the local ID of an MCE. It uniquely identifies an MCE within a local NE. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: MBSFN Area ID
parameters.description: Indicates the ID of an MBSFN area. For details, see 3GPP TS 36.443. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: MBSFN Subframe Configuration ID
parameters.description: Indicates the ID of an MBSFN subframe configuration. A maximum of eight MBSFN subframe configurations are allowed for an MBSFN area. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: Four Frame Allocation
parameters.description: Indicates the MBSFN subframes allocated in four consecutive radio frames when the MBSFN subframe allocation mode is Four Frame. If the cells in the MBSFN area work in TDD mode, the subframes that can be allocated for MBSFN in each radio frame include SF3, SF4, SF7, SF8, and SF9. These subframes in the four radio frames are represented by bit 23 to bit 19, bit 17 to bit 13, bit 11 to bit 7, and bit

parameters.name: One Frame Allocation
parameters.description: Indicates the MBSFN subframes allocated in one radio frame when the MBSFN subframe allocation mode is One Frame. If the cells in the MBSFN area work in TDD mode, the subframes that can be allocated for MBSFN in a radio frame are SF3, SF4, SF7, SF8, and SF9. These subframes are represented by bit 5 to bit 1 in sequence. If a bit is set to 1, the corresponding subframe is allocated for MBSFN. If the

parameters.name: Radio Frame Allocation Offset
parameters.description: Indicates radio frame allocation offset, which is used together with the RadioFrameAllocPrd parameter to determine the radio frames that contain MBSFN subframes. For details about this parameter, see 3GPP TS 36.331. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: Radio Frame Allocation Period
parameters.description: Indicates the allocation period of the radio frames that contain MBSFN subframes. For details about this parameter, see 3GPP TS 36.331. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: Subframe Allocation Mode
parameters.description: Indicates whether one radio frame or four consecutive radio frames contain MBSFN subframes. For details about this parameter, see 3GPP TS 36.331. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: Local MCE ID
parameters.description: Indicates the local ID of an MCE. It uniquely identifies an MCE within a local NE. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: MBSFN Area ID
parameters.description: Indicates the ID of an MBSFN area. For details, see 3GPP TS 36.443. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: Modulation and Coding Scheme
parameters.description: Indicates the MCS for information transmitted over the MCCH. For details, see 3GPP TS 36.331. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: Modification Period
parameters.description: Indicates the interval between MCCH updates. For details, see 3GPP TS 36.331. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: PDCCH Length
parameters.description: Indicates the number of OFDM symbols (in an MBSFN subframe) used for the PDCCH. For details about this parameter, see 3GPP TS 36.331. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: Repetition Period
parameters.description: Indicates the interval between transmissions of MCCH information. For details, see 3GPP TS 36.331. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: Repetition Period Offset
parameters.description: Indicates the repetition period offset, which is used together with the RepetitionPeriod parameter in the Mcch MO to specify the radio frames in which MCCH information is transmitted. For details about this parameter, see 3GPP TS 36.331. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: Subframe Allocation Information
parameters.description: Indicates the subframes in a radio frame in which MCCH information can be sent. parameters.name: Local MCE ID
parameters.description: Indicates the local ID of an MCE. It uniquely identifies an MCE within a local NE. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: MCE ID
parameters.description: Indicates the ID of an MCE. It uniquely identifies an MCE within a PLMN. The PLMN ID and the MCE ID together constitute the global MCE ID. For details, see 3GPP TS 36.443. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: Mobile Country Code
parameters.description: Indicates the MCC of an MCE. An MCC and an MNC constitute a PLMN ID. For details, see 3GPP TS 36.443. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: Mobile Network Code
parameters.description: Indicates the MNC of an MCE. An MCC and an MNC constitute a PLMN ID. For details, see 3GPP TS 36.443. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: MCE Type
parameters.description: Indicates whether different types of RATs support distributed MCE. DISTRIBUTED_MCE(FDD_DISTRIBUTED_MCE): Indicates whether FDD supports distributed MCE. This option applies only to LTE FDD. TDD_DISTRIBUTED_MCE(TDD_DISTRIBUTED_MCE): Indicates whether TDD supports distributed MCE. This option applies only to LTE TDD.

parameters.name: MCE Name
parameters.description: Indicates the name of an MCE. For details, see 3GPP TS 36.443. The value of this parameter is a string of a maximum of 150 characters. parameters.name: Mlb Qci Group ID
parameters.description: Indicates the ID of a mobility load balancing (MLB) parameter group for a QCI. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: Uplink Minimum Qos Bit Rate
parameters.description: Indicates the uplink minimum guaranteed bit rate. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: Downlink Minimum Qos Bit Rate
parameters.description: Indicates the downlink minimum guaranteed bit rate. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: MME Capability Configuration ID
parameters.description: Indicates the MME capability configuration index.

parameters.name: S1 Configuration Type
parameters.description: Indicates the configuration type of the S1 interface. Set this parameter to S1_CFG if operators want to configure the MME capability according to the S1 MO. Set this parameter to S1INTERFACE_CFG if operators want to configure the MME capability according to the S1Interface MO.

parameters.name: S1 ID
parameters.description: Indicates the S1 object ID.

parameters.name: S1 Interface ID
parameters.description: Indicates the S1 interface ID.

parameters.name: NB-IoT CIoT EPS Optimization Capability
parameters.description: Indicates the MME's capability of supporting EPS optimized transmission for NB-IoT CIoT. If this parameter is set to NOT_SUPPORT, the MME does not support EPS optimized transmission for NB-IoT CIoT. If this parameter is set to CP, the MME supports control-plane EPS optimized transmission for NB-IoT CIoT. parameters.name: MME Support LTE Capability
parameters.description: Indicates the MME's capability of supporting LTE FDD and LTE TDD. If this parameter is set to NOT_SUPPORT, the MME does not support LTE FDD or LTE TDD. If this parameter is set to SUPPORT, the MME supports LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: MME Support eMTC-Dedicated EPC Capability
parameters.description: Indicates whether the MME supports eMTC UEs to access a dedicated EPC. If this parameter is set to NOT_SUPPORT, the MME does not support eMTC UEs to access a dedicated EPC. eMTC UEs access a common EPC if either of the following conditions is met: - The MmeCapInfo MO is not configured for any MME. - The MmeCapInfo MOs are configured and the MmeSupportEmtcDedEpcCap parameter in every MmeCapInfo MO

parameters.name: MME NSA DC Capability
parameters.description: Indicates whether the MME supports NSA DC. If this parameter is set to NOT_SUPPORT, the MME does not support NSA DC. If this parameter is set to SUPPORT, the MME supports NSA DC. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: MME Domain Name ID
parameters.description: Indicates the index of the MME domain name.

parameters.name: CN Operator ID
parameters.description: Indicates the ID of the operator.

parameters.name: MME Domain Name
parameters.description: Indicates the domain name of an MME or an MME pool. If MMEs are configured as an MME pool, you are advised to specify the domain name of the MME pool to simplify the configuration.

parameters.name: S1Interface ID
parameters.description: Indicates the ID of an S1 interface. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: MME supporting MDT or not
parameters.description: Indicates whether the MME at the other end of the S1 interface supports Huawei-proprietary positioning procedures, which are included in minimization of drive tests (MDT). The value DISABLE indicates that the MME does not support the procedures and therefore the eNodeB cannot obtain UE location information from the MME through the procedures. The value ENABLE indicates the opposite. This parameter

parameters.name: Control Mode
parameters.description: Indicates the control mode of the MmeFeatureCfg MO, which determines the control policies of operators and the SON functions in the MmeFeatureCfg MO. For an S1 interface that is manually set up, the parameter is set to MANUAL_MODE in the related MmeFeatureCfg MO. Operators, but not SON functions, can set this MO. parameters.name: MRO optimization period
parameters.description: Indicates the period of measurement for MRO. During the period, the number of handovers is measured and abnormal scenarios (including premature handover, delayed handover, and ping-pong handover) are identified. parameters.name: Ncell optimization threshold
parameters.description: Indicates the handover success rate threshold for enabling mobility-related parameter optimization. If the handover success rate is greater than this parameter value, mobility-related parameters are optimized to reduce the number of ping-pong handovers. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: MRO statistics number threshold
parameters.description: Indicates the threshold of the number of handovers (including outgoing handover attempts and delayed handovers) required for enabling optimization of intra-RAT mobility-related parameters. parameters.name: Pingpong handover threshold
parameters.description: Indicates the threshold of the duration during which a UE stays in the target cell to determine whether the handover is a ping-pong handover. parameters.name: Pingpong ratio threshold
parameters.description: Indicates the threshold for the percentage of intra-RAT ping-pong handovers. If the percentage of intra-RAT ping-pong handovers is greater than this parameter value, parameters are adjusted to reduce the number of ping-pong handovers. parameters.name: Abnormal coverage threshold

parameters.name: Neighbour cell RSRP threshold

parameters.name: UE PingPong Number Threshold
parameters.description: Indicates the threshold for the number of ping-pong handovers of a UE. If the number of consecutive ping-pong handovers reaches the threshold, the UE is a ping-pong UE. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.description: Indicates the threshold of event A2 rollback triggered by inter-frequency MRO. If the percentage of delayed handovers caused by late inter-frequency measurement to the sum of premature handovers and delayed handovers is less than the threshold, the event A2 rollback is triggered. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: MRO Optimization Mode
parameters.description: Indicates the mode in which MRO takes effect. If this parameter is set to FREE, the eNodeB automatically optimizes handover and cell reselection parameter settings. parameters.description: Indicates the G factor threshold used in target cell selection for handovers in smart carrier selection based on virtual grids. parameters.name: Local Cell ID
parameters.description: This parameter specifies the local ID of a cell. It uniquely identifies a cell within a eNodeB. This parameter applies only to NB-IoT.

parameters.name: Start Time

parameters.name: End Time

parameters.name: PRB UE Number Offset

For example, if the MCC is 123 and the MNC is 45, the PLMN ID is 12345. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: gNodeB ID
parameters.description: Indicates the gNodeB ID of an external NR cell. It uniquely identifies a gNodeB within a PLMN. For details, see 3GPP TS 38.413. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: CN Operator ID

parameters.description: Indicates the NR SUL frequency bands. If the option corresponding to a frequency band is selected, the SCG supports this frequency band. In this case, the ScgDlArfcnPriority, NsaDcB1ThldRsrp, and NrB1TimeToTrigger parameters for the frequency band become invalid. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: Aggregation Attribute
parameters.description: Indicates the aggregation attributes of the combination of the PCC frequency band and the corresponding NR SCG frequency band. CO_DEPLOYMENT_NSA_FLAG: If this option is selected, mobility management procedures specific to co-site deployment are allowed in the frequency band combination. If this option is deselected, mobility management procedures specific to co-site deployment are not allowed in t

parameters.name: DL Data Split SN Offset
parameters.description: Indicates the SN offset used when the eNodeB distributes PDCP packets to LTE or NR, whichever provides a lower data rate for UEs, during downlink dynamic data split. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: Stop Split Time-to-Trigger
parameters.description: Indicates the time-to-trigger for stopping data split in downlink dynamic data split. Data split is stopped when the ratio of the data rate of the RAT with the higher data rate to that of the RAT with the lower data rate is continuously higher than the value of the NsaDcAlgoParam.StopSplitRateRatioThld parameter within the time-to-trigger. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: DL Data Split Penalty Period
parameters.description: Indicates the penalty period for downlink dynamic data split. Dynamic data split is not allowed within the penalty period and is started after the penalty period ends. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: Stop Split Rate Ratio Threshold
parameters.description: Indicates the threshold for stopping data split in downlink dynamic data split. This threshold is a ratio of the data rate of the RAT with the higher data rate to that of the RAT with the lower data rate. Downlink dynamic data split is stopped when the ratio of the data rate of the RAT with the higher data rate to that of the RAT with the lower data rate exceeds this threshold for a time-to-trigge

parameters.name: X2 Transmission Max Rate
parameters.description: Indicates the maximum PDCP packet transmission rate over the X2 interface. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.id: Abnormal DL Data Split Penalty Period
parameters.name: Abnormal DL Data Split Penalty Period
parameters.description: Indicates the penalty period for exceptions in downlink dynamic data split. Dynamic data split is not allowed within the penalty period and is restarted after the penalty period ends. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.id: HO NSA Band Combination Selection Policy
parameters.name: HO NSA Band Combination Selection Policy
parameters.description: Indicates the band combination selection policy for handovers with SCG addition. If this parameter is set to LTE_SCC_NR_SCG_FIRST, the eNodeB preferentially delivers the LTE SCC and NR SCG band combination in a handover command message. The eNodeB selects proper LTE SCC bands based on the NR SCG sent from the gNodeB and delivers the band combination of both the LTE SCCs and NR SCG in the handover

parameters.name: NSA DC Algorithm Switch
parameters.description: Indicates whether to enable the base-station-level LTE-NR NSA DC algorithms. OVERHEATING_RPOTECTION_SW: Indicates whether the eNodeB preferentially releases SCGs for UEs that have reported overheating information and preferentially adds SCGs for these UEs after overheating ends. If this option is selected, the eNodeB preferentially releases and adds SCGs for UEs that have reported overheating info

parameters.name: Local Cell ID
parameters.description: Indicates the local ID of a cell, which uniquely identifies the cell within an eNodeB. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: NSA DC Algorithm Switch
parameters.description: Indicates whether to enable LTE-NR NSA DC algorithms. This parameter provides the following options: NSA_DC_CAPABILITY_SWITCH: LTE-NR NSA DC is enabled for the cell only if this option is selected. This option applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD. INTERFERENCE_AVOID_SW: LTE supports secondary harmonic signal and cross-modulation interference signal avoidance only if this option is selected. Avoidan

parameters.id: DL Data MCG Split Bearer Mode
parameters.name: DL Data MCG Split Bearer Mode
parameters.description: Indicates the downlink data transfer mode of the MCG split bearers. The data transfer modes include dynamic data transfer, MeNB only, and SgNB only. In dynamic data transfer mode, data is dynamically transferred to LTE and NR NEs. In the mode of data transfer to the MeNB, data is transferred only to LTE NEs. In the mode of data transfer to the SgNB, data is transferred only to NR NEs. This paramet

parameters.name: NSA DC Default Bearer Mode
parameters.description: Indicates the type of bearers set up for UEs that access the cell or are handed over to the cell in the LTE-NR NSA DC architecture. If this parameter is set to SCG_SPLIT_BEARER, SCG split bearers are set up for UEs by default. If this parameter is set to MCG_SPLIT_BEARER, MCG split bearers are set up for UEs by default. In separate-MPT co-transmission scenarios, split bearers are set up at the co-

parameters.id: NSA DC UE MCG UL AMBR Ratio
parameters.name: NSA DC UE MCG UL AMBR Ratio
parameters.description: Indicates the proportion of the uplink AMBR in the MCG for UEs in the LTE-NR NSA DC state. The proportion of the uplink AMBR in the SCG is 100% minus this parameter value. If this parameter is set to 255 (an invalid value), the proportion allocated to LTE and that allocated to NR are both 100%. This parameter cannot be set to 100 if the uplink data split policy is that uplink data is distributed d

parameters.name: UL Data Split Threshold
parameters.description: Indicates the threshold for triggering uplink data transfer for UEs in the LTE-NR NSA DC state. For details, see 3GPP TS 38.323. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.id: NSA DC UE MCG UL Power Rate
parameters.name: NSA DC UE MCG UL Power Rate
parameters.description: Indicates the index of the proportion of the uplink MCG power of UEs in the LTE-NR NSA DC state. Indexes 1 to 16 indicate proportions 0%, 5%, 10%, 15%, 20%, 30%, 37%, 44%, 50%, 56%, 63%, 70%, 80%, 90%, 95%, and 100%, respectively. If the sum of the proportion of the uplink MCG power and the proportion of the uplink SCG power is 1, the proportion of the uplink MCG power is the proportion indicated

parameters.id: NSA DC UE SCG UL Power Rate
parameters.name: NSA DC UE SCG UL Power Rate
parameters.description: Indicates the index of the proportion of the uplink SCG power of UEs in the LTE-NR NSA DC state. Indexes 1 to 16 indicate proportions 0%, 5%, 10%, 15%, 20%, 30%, 37%, 44%, 50%, 56%, 63%, 70%, 80%, 90%, 95%, and 100%, respectively. If the sum of the proportion of the uplink MCG power and the proportion of the uplink SCG power is 1, the proportion of the uplink SCG power is the proportion indicated

parameters.name: SCG Addition Buffer Delay Threshold
parameters.description: Indicates the buffer delay threshold. An NR SCG can be added or PCC anchoring can be triggered for an NSA DC UE only when the data for the UE has been buffered on the eNodeB for a period of time longer than this threshold. This option applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: SCG Addition Buffer Length Threshold
parameters.description: Indicates the buffer length threshold. An NR SCG can be added or PCC anchoring can be triggered for an NSA DC UE only when the traffic volume buffered on the eNodeB for the UE exceeds this threshold. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: SCG Addition Interval
parameters.description: Indicates the minimum interval at which the eNodeB attempts to add an NR SCG, add an LTE SCell before NR SCG addition, or trigger PCC anchoring for an NSA DC UE. If NR SCG or LTE SCell addition failed for an NSA DC UE, the eNodeB attempts to add an NR SCG or add an LTE SCell before NR SCG addition again at an interval, whose minimum value is specified by this parameter, when the traffic volume of

parameters.name: NR Data Volume Reporting Config
parameters.description: Indicates whether the MeNB sends event-triggered and periodic reports of the volume of data that is distributed to the NR side to the core network when an NSA DC UE uses an MCG split bearer to perform a service and whether the MeNB forwards NR data volume reports that the SgNB sends to the MeNB to the core network when an NSA DC UE uses an SCG split bearer to perform a service. Assume that an MCG

parameters.id: NSA DC UE MCG Uplink Maximum Power
parameters.name: NSA DC UE MCG Uplink Maximum Power
parameters.description: Indicates the maximum uplink MCG transmit power for LTE-NR NSA DC UEs. For details, see 3GPP TS 38.331. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.id: NSA DC UE SCG Uplink Maximum Power
parameters.name: NSA DC UE SCG Uplink Maximum Power
parameters.description: Indicates the maximum uplink SCG transmit power for LTE-NR NSA DC UEs. For details, see 3GPP TS 38.331. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.id: NSA TDM Power Control Trigger SINR Thld
parameters.name: NSA TDM Power Control Trigger SINR Thld
parameters.description: Indicates the threshold for triggering TDM uplink power control on NSA DC UEs. TDM uplink power control is triggered for an NSA DC UE only if the uplink SINR of the UE on the LTE side is less than or equal to this threshold. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD.

parameters.name: Upper Layer Indication Switch
parameters.description: Indicates whether to allow the upperLayerIndication-r15 IE to be broadcast in SIB2. If this parameter is set to ON, the upperLayerIndication-r15 IE can be broadcast in SIB2. However, whether the upperLayerIndication-r15 IE for a PLMN can be broadcast in the E-UTRAN cell is subject to the setting of the UPPER_LYR_IND_NO_BROADCAST_SW option of the CnOperator.OperatorFunSwitch parameter. The upperLay

parameters.id: NSA DC LTE SCell Activation Buffer Delay Thld
parameters.name: NSA DC LTE SCell Activation Buffer Delay Thld
parameters.description: Indicates the buffer delay threshold used to evaluate LTE SCell activation in NSA DC scenarios. LTE SCells can be activated for an NSA DC UE only when the data for the UE has been buffered on the eNodeB for a period longer than this threshold. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.id: NSA DC LTE SCell Activation Buffer Length Thld
parameters.name: NSA DC LTE SCell Activation Buffer Length Thld
parameters.description: Indicates the buffer length threshold used to evaluate LTE SCell activation in NSA DC scenarios. LTE SCells can be activated for an NSA DC UE only when the volume of data buffered on the eNodeB for the UE exceeds this threshold. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: NSA DC PCC Anchoring Policy
parameters.description: Indicates the NSA DC PCC anchoring policy. If this parameter is set to DEFAULT, NSA DC PCC anchoring adopts the default policy. If this parameter is set to BASED_ON_NR_COVERAGE, NSA DC PCC anchoring adopts the NR-coverage-based enhancement policy. In this policy, the eNodeB needs to consider NR coverage. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: VoLTE UE SCG Management Strategy
parameters.description: Indicates the SCG management policy for VoLTE UEs. If this parameter is set to VOLTE_PREFERRED, the eNodeB does not allow SCG addition for an NSA-DC-capable UE and immediately removes an existing SCG for an NSA-DC-capable UE when the NSA-DC-capable UE is performing a VoLTE service. If this parameter is set to ADAPTIVE, the eNodeB determines whether to remove an SCG for an NSA-DC-capable UE or add

parameters.id: Uplink Quality Thld for SCG Release
parameters.name: Uplink Quality Thld for SCG Release
parameters.description: Indicates the uplink SINR threshold for triggering SCG release for VoLTE UEs supporting NSA DC. If the uplink SINR of a VoLTE UE supporting NSA DC is less than or equal to this threshold, SCG release will be triggered for this UE. If no SCG has been added for this UE, SCG addition is not allowed for this UE. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.id: VoLTE Packet Loss Rate Thld for SCG Release
parameters.name: VoLTE Packet Loss Rate Thld for SCG Release
parameters.description: Indicates the uplink or downlink VoLTE packet loss rate threshold for triggering SCG release for VoLTE UEs supporting NSA DC. If the uplink or downlink VoLTE packet loss rate of a VoLTE UE supporting NSA DC is greater than or equal to this threshold, SCG release will be triggered for this UE. If no SCG has been added for this UE, SCG addition is not allowed for this UE. This parameter applies only

parameters.id: NSA DC UE Prealloc User Count Threshold
parameters.name: NSA DC UE Prealloc User Count Threshold
parameters.description: Indicates whether to enable preallocation for NSA DC UEs and the UE number threshold for performing preallocation for NSA DC UEs. If this parameter is set to 0, the function does not take effect. If this parameter is set to a non-zero value, the function takes effect and the parameter value specifies the UE number threshold for performing preallocation for NSA DC UEs. When the number of UEs in RRC

parameters.name: Harmonic Interference Avoidance Range
parameters.description: Indicates the frequency-domain range of NSA DC harmonic interference avoidance. If this parameter is set to NR_DL_COMMON_CHANNEL, the eNodeB does not schedule the corresponding uplink RBs based on the interference avoidance pattern received from the gNodeB. However, the eNodeB still schedules the RBs that may interfere the NR PDSCH. If this parameter is set to NR_DL_COMMON_AND_DATA_CHANNEL, the eN

parameters.name: User Number High Load Threshold
parameters.description: Indicates the UE number threshold used to determine the high-load state of the cell. If the number of UEs in the cell is greater than the value of this parameter, the eNodeB does not select this cell as a target cell for NSA DC PCC anchoring. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.id: IMD Intrf Freq Domain Avoidance Type
parameters.name: IMD Intrf Freq Domain Avoidance Type
parameters.description: Indicates the frequency-domain intermodulation interference avoidance type in NSA DC. If this parameter is set to NO_AVOIDANCE, frequency-domain avoidance is not performed. If this parameter is set to PRIOR_ALLOC_NO_INTRF_RB, the eNodeB preferentially schedules data on the non-interfering spectrum to avoid intermodulation interference. This parameter is valid only if the INTERFERENCE_AVOID_SW opti

parameters.id: NSA DC UE LTE Function Activation Switch
parameters.name: NSA DC UE LTE Function Activation Switch
parameters.description: Indicates whether LTE functions take effect for NSA-DC-capable UEs. FREQ_PRI_HO_SW: Indicates whether frequency-priority-based handovers take effect for NSA-DC-capable UEs. This function takes effect for NSA-DC-capable UEs only if this option is selected. This option is selected by default. This option applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD. MBOCS_SW: Indicates whether multi-band optimal carrier sele

parameters.id: NSA DC PCC Anchoring A1 RSRP Thld
parameters.name: NSA DC PCC Anchoring A1 RSRP Thld
parameters.description: Indicates the RSRP threshold for event A1 related to PCC anchoring for NSA-DC-capable UEs. If this parameter is set to a value other than 255, the eNodeB delivers A1 measurement configurations to UEs. If the measured RSRP values exceed this threshold, the UEs send A1 measurement reports to the eNodeB. If this parameter is set to 255, the eNodeB does not deliver A1 measurement configurations. This

parameters.id: NSA DC LTE SCell Config Interval
parameters.name: NSA DC LTE SCell Config Interval
parameters.description: Indicates the interval at which service-based LTE SCell configuration is triggered for UEs that have been configured with an NR SCG. The interval at which the eNodeB attempts to configure an LTE SCell for a UE that has been configured with an NR SCG must be greater than the value of this parameter. After an LTE SCell fails to be configured for a UE configured with an NR SCG, LTE SCell configuratio

parameters.id: NSA DC LTE SCell Meas Duration
parameters.name: NSA DC LTE SCell Meas Duration
parameters.description: Indicates the maximum duration of a single round of LTE SCell measurements for a UE for which an NR SCG has been added. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: PDCP SN Offset Switch
parameters.description: Indicates whether to enable the PDCP SN offset. If this parameter is set to OFF, PDCP SN offset does not take effect. If this parameter is set to ON, PDCP SN offset takes effect. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.id: Idle Mode NSA DC PCC Anchoring Policy
parameters.name: Idle Mode NSA DC PCC Anchoring Policy
parameters.description: Indicates the policy of NSA DC PCC anchoring for RRC_IDLE UEs. If this parameter is set to DEFAULT, the default policy is used for NSA DC PCC anchoring for RRC_IDLE UEs. If this parameter is set to PRIOR_TO_PLMN, an independent policy is used for NSA DC PCC anchoring for RRC_IDLE UEs though dedicated cell-reselection priorities are configured based on the serving cell's PLMN on the eNodeB. This pa

parameters.id: NSA DC Fast Retrans Trig Thld
parameters.name: NSA DC Fast Retrans Trig Thld
parameters.description: Indicates the triggering threshold for fast retransmission in downlink data split optimization in NSA DC scenarios. If the difference in the time that it takes to send out all data in the RLC buffer between both sides is greater than this threshold, fast retransmission is triggered. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: Measurement Gap Sharing Scheme
parameters.description: Indicates what percentage of the inter-frequency and inter-RAT measurement gap duration configured on the LTE side is used by NSA DC UEs for NR intra-frequency measurement. If this parameter is set to EQUAL_SPLITTING, the NR intra-frequency measurement gap duration is equal to the total gap duration multiplied by the proportion of NR frequencies to all frequencies to be measured. If this parameter

parameters.id: NSA DC UL Path Change to LTE Rate Coeff
parameters.name: NSA DC UL Path Change to LTE Rate Coeff
parameters.description: Indicates the rate coefficient of LTE/NR required for the NSA DC uplink path selection function to change the uplink path towards the LTE side. When the estimated LTE data rate is greater than the estimated NR data rate multiplied by the value of this parameter, the uplink path is changed towards the LTE side. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.id: NSA DC UL Path Change to NR Rate Coeff
parameters.name: NSA DC UL Path Change to NR Rate Coeff
parameters.description: Indicates the rate coefficient of LTE/NR required for the NSA DC uplink path selection function to change the uplink path towards the NR side. When the estimated LTE data rate is less than the estimated NR data rate multiplied by the value of this parameter, the uplink path is changed towards the NR side. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: NSA DC Algorithm Extension Switch
parameters.description: Indicates whether to enable extended LTE-NR NSA DC algorithms. SCG_ADD_PCC_ANCHOR_VOL_OPT_SW: If this option is selected, the eNodeB deducts the traffic volume of control PDUs when it evaluates the traffic volume for traffic-volume-based SCG addition or PCC anchoring. If this option is deselected, the function does not take effect. This option applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD. INSTANT_JUDGEMENT

parameters.name: NSA DC SCG Addition Policy
parameters.description: Indicates the SCG addition policy for NSA DC UEs.
