If this parameter is set to HIGHEST_PRIORITY_FREQ, the eNodeB immediately triggers SCG addition when receiving a measurement report of the highest-priority NR frequency. If this parameter is set to ALL_FREQ, the eNodeB triggers SCG addition after B1 measurement reports of all NR frequencies are received or the B1 measurement report waiting timer ex

parameters.name: SCG Addition Penalty Period Count
parameters.description: Indicates the number of penalty periods in which SCG addition is not allowed in incoming RRC connection reestablishment scenarios. If this parameter is set to 0, the penalty mechanism does not take effect. If this parameter is set to a non-zero value, SCG addition or NR-coverage-based PCC anchoring is not allowed in a period, whose length is equal to the product of NsaDcMgmtConfig.ScgAddPenaltyPer

parameters.name: Local Cell ID
parameters.description: Indicates the local ID of the cell. It uniquely identifies a cell within a base station. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.id: NSA DC QCI Parameter Group ID
parameters.name: NSA DC QCI Parameter Group ID
parameters.description: Indicates the ID of the QCI-specific NSA DC parameter group. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: Uplink Data Split Threshold
parameters.description: Indicates the uplink data split threshold when the UE performs LTE-NR NSA DC. If the UE PDCP buffer data size is greater than the threshold, the UE transfers data to the master and secondary base stations at the same time. For details, see 3GPP TS 38.323 and 3GPP TS 38.331. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: Uplink Data Split Primary Path
parameters.description: Indicates the primary path for uplink data split. If this parameter is set to MCG, the primary path for uplink data split is the path towards the MCG. If this parameter is set to SCG, the primary path for uplink data split is the path towards the SCG. For details, see 3GPP TS 38.323. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: Downlink Data PDCP Split Mode
parameters.description: Indicates the downlink PDCP-layer data split mode. If this parameter is set to SCG_AND_MCG, dynamic data split is adopted and data is dynamically transferred to the eNodeB and gNodeB based on the split algorithm. If this parameter is set to MCG_ONLY, data is transferred only to the eNodeB. If this parameter is set to SCG_ONLY, data is transferred only to the gNodeB. This parameter applies only to

parameters.id: NSA DC B1 RSRP Threshold Offset
parameters.name: NSA DC B1 RSRP Threshold Offset
parameters.description: Indicates the offset relative to the RSRP threshold for event B1 related to SCG addition by the eNodeB for UEs. The sum of this offset and the value of the NsaDcB1ThldRsrp parameter in the NrScgFreqConfig MO is taken as the RSRP threshold for event B1 related to SCG addition. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.id: PUSCH RSRP High Threshold for Auto Optimization
parameters.name: PUSCH RSRP High Threshold for Auto Optimization
parameters.description: Indicates the target upper limit of RSRP used in automatic optimization for PUSCH closed-loop power control. This parameter takes effect only when PuschRsrpHighThdSwitch is on. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.id: PUCCH PC SINR Offset for Auto Optimization
parameters.name: PUCCH PC SINR Offset for Auto Optimization
parameters.description: Indicates the target offset to the target SINR used in automatic optimization for PUCCH power control. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.id: P0 Nominal PUCCH for Auto Opt
parameters.name: P0 Nominal PUCCH for Auto Opt
parameters.description: Indicates the target eNodeB-expected PUCCH transmit power used in automatic optimization for correct PUCCH demodulation. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: Handover Times Threshold
parameters.description: Indicates the threshold of the number of handovers required for selecting a neighboring cell as a coordinated neighboring cell in automatic congestion handling. If the number of handovers from a serving cell to a neighboring cell exceeds the threshold in the last 5-minute period and the neighboring cell is ranked at the top according to the number of handovers, the neighboring cell is selected as

parameters.name: ACH Effective Type
parameters.description: Indicates the ACH effective type. TDD_ACH_SWITCH: If this option is selected, the ACH feature takes effect for LTE TDD cells. If both this option and the ACHSwitch option of the IOptAlgoSwitch parameter in the ENodeBAlgoSwitch MO are deselected, the ACH feature does not take effect for LTE TDD cells. This option applies only to LTE TDD. FDD_ACH_SWITCH: If this option is selected, the ACH feature t

parameters.name: PCC Downlink EARFCN
parameters.description: Indicates the downlink E-UTRA absolute radio frequency channel number (EARFCN) of the candidate PCC. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: Preferred PCC Priority
parameters.description: Indicates the PCC priority of a frequency. A small value of this parameter leads to a low PCC priority of a carrier working on the frequency specified by the PCCDlEarfcn parameter in the PccFreqCfg MO for the carrier to be selected as the PCC for CA UEs. A large value of this parameter leads to a high PCC priority of a carrier working on the frequency specified by the PCCDlEarfcn parameter for the

parameters.name: PCC A4 RSRP Threshold
parameters.description: Indicates the reference signal received power (RSRP) threshold for triggering event A4 during higher-priority carrier evaluation for PCC selection. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: PCC A4 RSRQ Threshold
parameters.description: Indicates the reference signal received quality (RSRQ) threshold for triggering event A4 during higher-priority carrier evaluation for PCC selection in scenarios where CA is configured based on frequencies. If the measured RSRQ of an inter-frequency neighboring cell in the CA group is greater than this parameter value, the CA UE reports event A4. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: NSA PCC Anchoring Priority
parameters.description: Indicates the NSA DC PCC anchoring priority. A larger value of this parameter indicates a higher priority. If this parameter is set to 0, this frequency cannot be selected as a target frequency for NSA DC PCC anchoring. The setting of this parameter is valid only if the NSA_PCC_ANCHORING_SWITCH or IDLE_MODE_NSA_PCC_ANCHORING_SW option of the NsaDcAlgoSwitch parameter in the NsaDcMgmtConfig MO is s

parameters.id: NSA DC PCC A4 RSRP Threshold
parameters.name: NSA DC PCC A4 RSRP Threshold
parameters.description: Indicates the RSRP threshold for event A4 related to NSA DC PCC anchoring. If the measured RSRP of an inter-frequency neighboring cell is greater than this parameter value, the NSA DC UE reports event A4. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.id: NSA DC PCC A4 RSRQ Threshold
parameters.name: NSA DC PCC A4 RSRQ Threshold
parameters.description: Indicates the RSRQ threshold for event A4 related to NSA DC PCC anchoring. If the measured RSRQ of an inter-frequency neighboring cell is greater than this parameter value, the NSA DC UE reports event A4. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: SCC Downlink EARFCN
parameters.description: Indicates the downlink E-UTRA absolute radio frequency channel number (EARFCN) of an SCell. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: Downlink EARFCN
parameters.description: Indicates the downlink EARFCN of the to-be-measured frequency selected by smart carrier selection. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: Local cell ID
parameters.description: Indicates the local ID of the cell. It uniquely identifies a cell within an eNodeB.

parameters.name: Default paging cycle
parameters.description: Indicates the default paging period for the cell. It is also called the default discontinuous reception (DRX) period. If the EPC specifies a DRX period for a UE, the UE compares this period with the value of this parameter and uses the smaller one as its DRX period. If the EPC does not specify a DRX period, the UE uses the value of this parameter, which is delivered in the system information, as i

parameters.name: NB
parameters.description: Indicates the number of paging occasions (a type of subframe) within a paging period. This parameter value also indicates the number of paging groups within a paging period. For details, see 3GPP TS 36.304.

parameters.name: Paging Sent Number
parameters.description: Indicates the number of paging messages transmitted to UEs over the air interface. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: Maximum Number of Paging Records
parameters.description: Indicates the maximum number of UEs that can be included in a paging message on each paging occasion. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: Paging Message Sending Strategy
parameters.description: Indicates the policy of sending paging messages. There are three policies: first in first out (FIFO), priority-based, and coverage-level-based. If the FIFO policy is used, paging messages that arrive earlier are preferentially transmitted on a paging occasion. If the priority-based policy is used, high-priority paging messages are preferentially transmitted on a paging occasion. If the coverage-le

parameters.name: Enhanced Paging Code Rate
parameters.description: Indicates the code rate used for paging messages when enhanced paging is enabled. An eNodeB identifies high-priority paging and CSFB-triggered paging and uses the code rate specified by this parameter to send high-priority paging messages and CSFB-triggered paging messages. If a paging message sent from the EPC contains the Paging Priority field, the paging is high-priority paging. This parameter

parameters.name: Enhanced Paging Switch
parameters.description: Indicates whether to enable enhanced paging. This parameter applies only to cells with a 10 MHz bandwidth or higher. ENHNCD_HIGH_PRI_PAGING_SWITCH: If this option is selected, enhanced paging is enabled for high-priority paging and high-priority paging messages are transmitted at the code rate specified by the EnhPagingCR parameter in the PCCHCfg MO. If this option is deselected, high-priority pag

parameters.name: NB-IoT Default Paging Cycle
parameters.description: Indicates the default paging period for the cell. It is also called the default discontinuous reception (DRX) period. For details, see 3GPP TS 36.304. This parameter applies only to NB-IoT.

parameters.name: NB-IoT nB
parameters.description: Indicates the number of paging occasions (a type of subframe) of an NB-IoT cell within a paging period. This parameter value also indicates the number of paging groups within a paging period. For details, see 3GPP TS 36.304. This parameter is correlated with the repetition count of initial PDCCH transmission and the repetition count needs to be considered when this parameter is set. This parameter

parameters.name: Paging Timeout Discard Timer
parameters.description: Indicates the length of the paging message discarding timer. If this parameter is set to 0, the timer does not take effect. If this parameter is set to a non-zero value, the timer takes effect. The eNodeB discards paging messages not yet sent and measures the number of discarded paging messages when this timer expires. If this timer is required, it is recommended that this parameter be set to a va

parameters.id: Default Coverage Level of NB-IoT Paging
parameters.name: Default Coverage Level of NB-IoT Paging
parameters.description: Indicates the default coverage level for paging messages. Paging messages in which coverage level information is not included by the core network are scheduled based on the coverage level specified by this parameter. This parameter applies only to NB-IoT.

parameters.name: eMTC Default Paging Cycle
parameters.description: Indicates the default paging cycle for eMTC. It is also called the DRX cycle. If the EPC delivers a DRX cycle, the eNodeB compares the cycle specified by this parameter with that delivered by the EPC and uses the smaller cycle for eMTC UEs. If the EPC does not deliver a DRX cycle, the eNodeB sends the cycle specified by this parameter to eMTC UEs through system information. Note: In accordance wit

parameters.name: Max Paging Queue Buffer Length
parameters.description: Indicates the maximum buffer length of a single paging queue. If this parameter is set to a value in the range of 0 to 299, the maximum buffer length of a single paging queue is not controlled. If this parameter is set to another value, the maximum buffer length of a single paging queue is controlled. When the number of buffered paging messages in a paging queue reaches this value, subsequent pagi

parameters.name: ROHC Highest mode
parameters.description: Indicates the operating mode of ROHC. In Unidirectional Mode (U-Mode), packets are sent only from the compressor to the decompressor, and a feedback channel is not mandatory. Therefore, U-Mode is less reliable than Bidirectional Optimistic Mode (O-Mode) and Bidirectional Reliable Mode (R-Mode), but its feedback-induced overhead is minimum compared with the overhead in O-Mode and R-Mode. In O-Mode,

parameters.name: Compression profiles
parameters.description: Indicates the compression profiles supported by the eNodeB. Under the ROHC framework, header compression algorithms vary with protocols. Profiles define the header compression protocols (such as RTP/UDP/IP or TCP/IP), which are under the same ROHC framework, for specific types of packet streams. Each profile has a unique identifier. As defined by LTE specifications, the eNodeB supports the followi

parameters.name: ROHC TCP SINR Trigger Threshold
parameters.description: Indicates the SINR threshold for triggering ROHC TCP. This parameter controls the activation scope of ROHC TCP. When ROHC TCP is enabled and a UE supports ROHC TCP, the eNodeB delivers the RRC connection reconfiguration message to the UE to activate ROHC TCP if the uplink SINR of the UE periodically measured by the eNodeB reaches the threshold. In this case, the UE enters the ROHC TCP state and pe

parameters.name: ROHC Optimization Switch
parameters.description: Indicates whether to enable ROHC-related optimization functions. ROHC_FEEDBACK_ENHANCEMENT_SW: Indicates whether an eNodeB sends NACK feedback immediately after ROHC decompression failures occur in the uplink when the HighestMode parameter is set to O_MODE in the PdcpRohcPara MO. The eNodeB immediately sends NACK feedback in the previous scenario only if this option is selected. This option applie

parameters.name: Local cell ID
parameters.description: Indicates the local ID of the cell. It uniquely identifies a cell within a BS.

parameters.name: Reference signal power
parameters.description: Indicates the cell reference signal power of each physical antenna (the precision of converting dBm to mW is 0.01 mW). However, the cell reference signal power delivered in SIB2 is that of each logical antenna. If the EMTC_SWITCH option of the EmtcAlgoSwitch parameter in a CellEmtcAlgo MO is selected and the value of this parameter is changed, the eNodeB will proactively release eMTC UEs that have

parameters.name: PB
parameters.description: Indicates the scaling factor index of the Energy Per Resource Element (EPRE) on the PDSCH. This scaling factor is determined by the value of this parameter and the antenna port. For details, see 3GPP TS 36.213. If the EMTC_SWITCH option of the EmtcAlgoSwitch parameter in a CellEmtcAlgo MO is selected and the value of this parameter is changed, eMTC UEs that already accessed the cell will be proact

parameters.name: Reference Signal Power Margin
parameters.description: Indicates the cell reference signal power headroom of each physical antenna. This parameter applies only to LTE TDD.

parameters.id: Offset of Ant0 to Tx Power
parameters.name: Offset of Ant0 to Tx Power
parameters.description: Indicates the offset of the TX power of physical channel 0 relative to the baseline TX power. The baseline TX power is determined by the system bandwidth, cell reference signal power, Pa, and Pb. If the TX power configurations should be the same between physical channels, set this parameter to 255. If the TX power configurations should be different between physical channels, set this parameter to

parameters.id: Offset of Ant1 to Tx Power
parameters.name: Offset of Ant1 to Tx Power
parameters.description: Indicates the offset of the TX power of physical channel 1 relative to the baseline TX power. The baseline TX power is determined by the system bandwidth, cell reference signal power, Pa, and Pb. If the TX power configurations should be the same between physical channels, set this parameter to 255. If the TX power configurations should be different between physical channels, set this parameter to

parameters.id: Offset of Ant2 to Tx Power
parameters.name: Offset of Ant2 to Tx Power
parameters.description: Indicates the offset of the TX power of physical channel 2 relative to the baseline TX power. The baseline TX power is determined by the system bandwidth, cell reference signal power, Pa, and Pb. If the TX power configurations should be the same between physical channels, set this parameter to 255. If the TX power configurations should be different between physical channels, set this parameter to

parameters.id: Offset of Ant3 to Tx Power
parameters.name: Offset of Ant3 to Tx Power
parameters.description: Indicates the offset of the TX power of physical channel 3 relative to the baseline TX power. The baseline TX power is determined by the system bandwidth, cell reference signal power, Pa, and Pb. If the TX power configurations should be the same between physical channels, set this parameter to 255. If the TX power configurations should be different between physical channels, set this parameter to

parameters.name: TX Channel Power Config Switch
parameters.description: Indicates whether to enable algorithms related to transmit channel power configurations. SINGLE_CA_PWR_SHARE_SW_FOR_4T: Indicates whether to enable single carrier power sharing for 4T. This option applies only to LTE FDD.

parameters.name: Cell Power Limit
parameters.description: Indicates the maximum transmit power of a single channel for a cell. If this parameter is set to 0, the maximum transmit power of a single channel for the cell is not limited. If this parameter is set to a value other than 0, the maximum transmit power of a single channel for the cell is limited. In this case, the eNodeB controls the number of scheduling resources to ensure that the power of a sin

parameters.name: EMF Power Limit Switch
parameters.description: Indicates whether to enable the on-demand TX power allocation under EME. If this parameter is set to ON, the maximum transmit power of a cell is limited by an EME policy. In this case, the eNodeB controls scheduling resources to ensure that the cell power does not exceed the preset limit. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: CRS Power Boosting Amplitude
parameters.description: Indicates the amount of increase in cell-specific reference signal (CRS) power. If this parameter is set to DB_0, the CRS power will not increase. If this parameter is set to DB_1DOT77, the CRS power will increase by 1.77 dB. If this parameter is set to DB_3, the CRS power will increase by 3 dB. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD.

parameters.name: Logical Port Swap Switch
parameters.description: Indicates whether to change the mapping between logical antenna ports and physical channels. If this parameter is set to OFF, the mapping between logical antenna ports and physical channels, which is specified by the CrsPortMap parameter in the Cell MO, cannot be changed. If this parameter is set to SWAP_MODE_1, the physical TX channels corresponding to logical antenna ports 0 and 2 are swapped, a

parameters.name: PDSCH Power Boosting Switch
parameters.description: Indicates whether to enable PDSCH power boosting. If this parameter is set to ON, PDSCH power boosting for TM9 UEs will be enabled. If this parameter is set to OFF, PDSCH power boosting will not be enabled. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD.

parameters.name: Maximum CRS Boosting Capability
parameters.description: Indicates the maximum allowed CRS boosting capability of a cell. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD.

parameters.name: Local cell ID
parameters.description: Indicates the local ID of the cell. It uniquely identifies a cell within a BS. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: PHICH duration
parameters.description: Indicates the PHICH duration type. If this parameter is set to NORMAL, the number of OFDM symbols occupied by the PDCCH is automatically adjusted. If this parameter is set to EXTENDED, the number of OFDM symbols occupied by the PDCCH is fixed. Specifically, this number is fixed to 3 or 4 for 1.4 MHz cells and 3 for cells with other bandwidths. For the mapping between the type and the duration, see

parameters.name: PHICH resource
parameters.description: Indicates a coefficient that is used to calculate the resources used by the PHICH for the cell. It corresponds to the Ng parameter in the protocol. For details on the usage of the Ng parameter, see 3GPP TS 36.211. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: PIM Cell Group Identity
parameters.description: Indicates the ID of a passive intermodulation (PIM) cell group. It uniquely identifies a PIM cell group within an eNodeB. A PIM cell group consists of two cells sharing an antenna system. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD.

parameters.name: Cell1 Local Cell ID
parameters.description: Indicates the local identity of cell 1 in the passive intermodulation (PIM) cell group. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD.

parameters.name: Cell2 Local Cell ID
parameters.description: Indicates the local identity of cell 2 in the passive intermodulation (PIM) cell group. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD.

parameters.name: Cell1 Sector Equipment Identity
parameters.description: Indicates the sector equipment identity of cell 1 in the passive intermodulation (PIM) cell group. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD.

parameters.name: Cell2 Sector Equipment Identity
parameters.description: Indicates the sector equipment identity of cell 2 in the passive intermodulation (PIM) cell group. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD.

parameters.name: PIM Mitigation Mode
parameters.description: Indicates the PIM mitigation mode. This parameter applies only to FDD.

parameters.name: Cell1 PIM State
parameters.description: Indicates the passive intermodulation (PIM) configuration state of cell 1 in the PIM cell group. This parameter applies only to FDD.

parameters.name: Cell2 PIM State
parameters.description: Indicates the passive intermodulation (PIM) configuration status of cell 2 in the PIM cell set. This parameter applies only to FDD.

parameters.name: Cell1 Punctured RB Count
parameters.description: Indicates the number of RBs to be blocked in cell 1. This parameter applies only to FDD.

parameters.name: Cell2 Punctured RB Count
parameters.description: Indicates the number of RBs to be blocked in cell 2. This parameter applies only to FDD.

parameters.name: PIM Frequency Group ID
parameters.description: Indicates the ID of a passive intermodulation (PIM) frequency group. It uniquely identifies a PIM frequency group within an eNodeB. This parameter applies only to FDD macro eNodeBs. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD.

parameters.name: PIM Downlink EARFCN
parameters.description: Indicates the downlink EARFCN of a carrier involved in passive intermodulation (PIM) mitigation. This parameter applies only to FDD macro eNodeBs. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD.

parameters.name: PIM Frequency Group ID
parameters.description: Indicates the ID of a passive intermodulation (PIM) frequency group. It uniquely identifies a PIM frequency group within an eNodeB. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD.

parameters.name: PIM Mitigation Mode
parameters.description: Indicates the PIM mitigation mode. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD.

parameters.name: PIM Downlink EARFCN
parameters.description: Indicates the downlink EARFCN of a carrier involved in passive intermodulation (PIM) mitigation. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD.

parameters.name: Local Cell ID
parameters.description: Indicates the local cell ID of a cell involved in passive intermodulation (PIM) mitigation. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD.

parameters.name: Cell PIM State
parameters.description: Indicates whether PIM mitigation is enabled for cells involved in PIM mitigation. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD.

parameters.name: Sector Equipment ID
parameters.description: Indicates the ID of the sector equipment that serves the cell involved in passive intermodulation (PIM) mitigation. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD.

parameters.name: Sector ID
parameters.description: Indicates the ID of the sector for the cell involved in passive intermodulation (PIM) mitigation. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD.

parameters.name: Cell Punctured RB Count
parameters.description: Indicates the number of RBs to be blocked in the cell. For SFN cells, the number of blocked RBs of a single physical cell is displayed. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD.

parameters.name: VRF Index
parameters.description: Indicates the index of a VRF instance.

parameters.name: IPv6 Address
parameters.description: Indicates the IPv6 address that Ping6 filtering needs to filter.

parameters.name: Prefix Length
parameters.description: Indicates the prefix length of the IPv6 address. Used to determine which bits must match when an IPv6 address matches.

parameters.name: Local MCE ID
parameters.description: Indicates the local MCE ID, which is unique on the local NE. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: MBSFN Area ID
parameters.description: Indicates the MBSFN area ID. For details, see 3GPP TS 36.443. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: PMCH ID
parameters.description: Indicates the PMCH ID. For details, see 3GPP TS 36.443. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: Allocation End Subframe
parameters.description: Indicates the end subframe for PMCH allocation. For details, see 3GPP TS 36.443. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: Data Modulation and Coding Scheme
parameters.description: Indicates the MCS of the PMCH. For details, see 3GPP TS 36.331. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: MCH Scheduling Period
parameters.description: Indicates the PMCH scheduling period. The PMCH scheduling period must be a multiple of the MBSFN subframe allocation period. The MBSFN subframe allocation period is specified by the CommonSubframeAllocPeriod parameter in the MbsfnArea MO. The PMCH scheduling period must not be greater than the value of the RepetitionPeriod parameter in the Mcch MO. For details, see 3GPP TS 36.331. This parameter a

parameters.name: QoS Class Identifier
parameters.description: Indicates the QCI of GBR bearers for MBMS services. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: Mode
parameters.description: Indicates the PMTU discovery mode, which can be active or passive. In active mode, the base station sends discovery packets to perform PMTU discovery. In passive mode, the base station automatically adjusts the PMTU size based on the received ICMPv6 Packet Too Big message.

parameters.name: Protocol Type
parameters.description: Indicates the protocol type of PMTU discovery packets.

parameters.name: Port No.
parameters.description: Indicates the destination port number specified for PMTU discovery packets. The UDP port numbers of 60000-62559, 64679-64710, 65020, 65040, and 65043 are reserved for certain features of the base station such as NTP and cannot be used as this parameter value.

parameters.name: Timeout Duration
parameters.description: Indicates the timeout duration of waiting for a response to a single PMTU discovery.

parameters.name: AgingTime
parameters.description: Indicates the aging time of a PMTU entry. The recommended value range is 30 minutes to 60 minutes. In passive mode, this parameter is invalid for the user-plane path, SCTP link, and IKE link. PMTU entries of these links always become aged between 2:00 a.m. and 3:00 a.m.

parameters.name: DSCP
parameters.description: Indicates the DSCP value used by PMTU detection packets.

parameters.name: Cabinet No.
parameters.description: Indicates the cabinet number of the board to which a PMTU entry belongs.

parameters.name: Subrack No.
parameters.description: Indicates the subrack number of the board to which a PMTU entry belongs.

parameters.name: Slot No.
parameters.description: Indicates the slot number of the board to which a PMTU entry belongs.

parameters.name: VRF Index
parameters.description: Indicates the index of a VRF instance.

parameters.name: Source IPv6 Address
parameters.description: Indicates the source IPv6 address of a PMTU entry.

parameters.name: Destination IPv6 Address
parameters.description: Indicates the destination IPv6 address of a PMTU entry.

parameters.name: Detection State
parameters.description: Indicates the discovery status of a PMTU entry with MODE set to ACTIVE. The value NULL indicates that the PMTU entry is not actively initiated by the base station.

parameters.name: Pmtu Value
parameters.description: Indicates the PMTU size of a PMTU entry.

parameters.id: IPv6 Address of Minimum MTU Hop
parameters.name: IPv6 Address of Minimum MTU Hop
parameters.description: Indicates the IPv6 address of the node where the minimum MTU is detected by a PMTU entry. If the IPv6 address is the source address of a path, the PMTU entry does not receive a PTB packet and uses the MTU corresponding to the outbound interface of the base station route for detection.

parameters.name: Remaining Aging Time
parameters.description: Indicates the remaining aging time of the PMTU entry.

parameters.name: Local Cell ID
parameters.description: Indicates the local ID of a cell, which uniquely identifies a cell within an eNodeB.

parameters.name: PRB ID
parameters.description: Indicates the NB-IoT PRB identity. It uniquely identifies a PRB within a cell. This parameter applies only to NB-IoT.

parameters.name: Deployment Mode
parameters.description: Indicates the NB-IoT PRB deployment mode. STAND_ALONE indicates that out-of-band LTE spectrum resources are used to deploy NB-IoT PRB. GUARD_BAND indicates that NB-IoT PRB is deployed on the LTE guardband. IN_BAND indicates that PRB is deployed on the LTE RB resources, which means that fewer RBs are available for LTE. This parameter applies only to NB-IoT.

parameters.name: Frequency Band
parameters.description: Indicates the frequency band to which the PRB belongs. For details, see 3GPP TS 36.104. This parameter applies only to NB-IoT.

parameters.name: Uplink EARFCN Configuration Indicator
parameters.description: Indicates whether to configure information about the PRB uplink EARFCN. This parameter applies only to NB-IoT.

parameters.name: Uplink EARFCN
parameters.description: Indicates the PRB uplink EARFCN, which is optional. This parameter takes effect only when UlEarfcnCfgInd is set to CFG(Configure). Otherwise, the eNodeB calculates this parameter value based on the rule that RB positions in the uplink and downlink are consistent. This parameter applies only to NB-IoT.

parameters.name: Uplink Frequency Offset
parameters.description: Indicates the frequency offset of the PRB uplink central frequency to the uplink frequency. This parameter takes effect only when UlEarfcnCfgInd is set to CFG(Configure). Otherwise, the eNodeB calculates this parameter value based on the rule that RB positions in the uplink and downlink are consistent. For details, see 3GPP TS 36.101. This parameter applies only to NB-IoT.

parameters.name: Downlink EARFCN
parameters.description: Indicates the PRB DL EARFCN. For details, see 3GPP TS 36.104. This parameter applies only to NB-IoT.

parameters.name: Downlink Frequency Offset
parameters.description: Indicates the frequency offset of the PRB downlink central frequency to the downlink frequency. For details, see 3GPP TS 36.101. This parameter applies only to NB-IoT.

parameters.name: LTE Bandwidth
parameters.description: Indicates the LTE cell bandwidth. This parameter takes effect only when DeployMode is set to GUARD_BAND. This parameter applies only to NB-IoT.

parameters.name: LTE Downlink EARFCN
parameters.description: Indicates the downlink EARFCN of an LTE cell. This parameter takes effect only when DeployMode is set to GUARD_BAND. This parameter applies only to NB-IoT.

parameters.name: LTE Cell ID
parameters.description: Indicates the LTE cell ID. This parameter takes effect only when DeployMode is set to IN_BAND. This parameter applies only to NB-IoT.

parameters.name: Uplink All Symbol Send Flag
parameters.description: Indicates whether all PRB uplink symbols are used for sending. When this parameter is set to TRUE, all NB-IoT PRB uplink symbols are sent. When this parameter is set to FALSE, not all NB-IoT PRB uplink symbols are sent. In in-band scenarios, NB-IoT PRB symbols and LTE SRS symbols must be staggered to avoid interference. This parameter applies only to NB-IoT.

parameters.name: Anchor Carrier Flag
parameters.description: Indicates whether the PRB is an anchor carrier. This parameter applies only to NB-IoT.

parameters.name: PRB Block Priority
parameters.description: Indicates the block priority of the PRB when it is a non-anchor carrier. If this parameter is set to HIGH_PRIORITY_BLOCK, the PRB is deactivated immediately. If this parameter is set to MEDIUM_PRIORITY_BLOCK, the access of new UEs is not allowed within 5 minutes and the PRB is deactivated immediately in the case of no existing UEs. Otherwise, the PRB is deactivated after 5 minutes irrespective of

parameters.name: NPRS Parameter Group ID
parameters.description: Indicates an NPRS parameter group ID. The value 255 indicates an invalid ID. This parameter applies only to NB-IoT.

parameters.name: PRACH Coverage Level Type
parameters.description: Indicates the PRACH coverage level supported by the PRB when it is a non-anchor carrier. A maximum of three coverage levels of PRACH resources are supported. COVERAGE_LEVEL_0: When this option is selected, the PRACH configuration of coverage level 0 in the PrbRachCeConfig MO is supported on the PRB. If this option is deselected, the configuration is not supported. COVERAGE_LEVEL_1: When this optio

parameters.name: Work Mode
parameters.description: Indicates the working mode of the carrier for an NB-IoT cell. This parameter must be set to UL_DL for the anchor carrier. This parameter applies only to NB-IoT.

parameters.name: LTE Downlink RB Index
parameters.description: Indicates the index of a physical layer RB. This parameter is valid only when the DeployMode parameter is set to IN_BAND. For details, see 3GPP TS 36.211. The value 255 indicates an invalid RB index. The DlEarfcn and DlFreqOffset parameters can be set only when this parameter is set to 255. This parameter applies only to NB-IoT.

parameters.name: LTE Uplink RB Index
parameters.description: Indicates the index of a physical layer RB. This parameter is valid only when the DeployMode parameter is set to IN_BAND and the UlEarfcnCfgInd parameter is set to CFG. For details, see 3GPP TS 36.211. The value 255 indicates an invalid RB index. The UlEarfcn and UlFreqOffset parameters can be set only when this parameter is set to 255. This parameter applies only to NB-IoT.

parameters.name: Local Cell ID
parameters.description: Indicates the local ID of a cell, which uniquely identifies the cell within an eNodeB. This parameter applies only to NB-IoT.

parameters.name: PRB ID
parameters.description: Indicates the NB-IoT PRB ID, which uniquely identifies a PRB within an NB-IoT cell. This parameter applies only to NB-IoT.

parameters.name: Downlink Gap Duration Coefficient
parameters.description: Indicates the coefficient for the duration of a downlink gap for NB-IoT. The duration of a downlink gap is equal to the interval between downlink gaps multiplied by this coefficient. For details, see 3GPP TS 36.211. This parameter applies only to NB-IoT.

parameters.name: Downlink Gap Period
parameters.description: Indicates the interval between downlink gaps for NB-IoT. For details, see 3GPP TS 36.211. This parameter applies only to NB-IoT.

parameters.name: Downlink Gap Threshold
parameters.description: Indicates the threshold for applying downlink gaps for NB-IoT. For details, see 3GPP TS 36.211. This parameter applies only to NB-IoT.

parameters.name: Local Cell ID
parameters.description: Indicates the local ID of a cell. It uniquely identifies a cell within an eNodeB. This parameter applies only to NB-IoT.

parameters.name: PRB ID
parameters.description: Indicates the NB-IoT PRB ID. It uniquely identifies a PRB within a cell. This parameter applies only to NB-IoT.

parameters.name: Coverage Level
parameters.description: Indicates the UE's coverage level. The value 0 indicates 0 dB coverage enhancement; the value 1 indicates 10 dB coverage enhancement; and the value 2 indicates 20 dB coverage enhancement. This parameter applies only to NB-IoT.

parameters.name: DL Initial Transmission Repetition Count
parameters.description: Indicates the PDSCH initial transmission repetition times for UEs corresponding to a certain coverage level. This parameter applies only to NB-IoT.

parameters.name: Downlink Initial MCS
parameters.description: Indicates the initial downlink MCS index of UEs of a coverage level. This parameter applies only to NB-IoT.

parameters.name: Uu Message Waiting Timer
parameters.description: Indicates the timer governing the period the eNodeB waits for a Uu response message from a UE. If the timer expires, the eNodeB initiates to release the UE. If this parameter is set to 0, the UuMessageWaitingTimer parameter in the ENodeBConnStateTimer MO, rather than this parameter, takes effect. If this parameter is set to 1 to 200, this parameter takes effect. This parameter applies only to NB-I

parameters.name: Proportion of Downlink Scheduling Duration
parameters.description: Indicates the proportion of downlink scheduling duration for a specific coverage level. This parameter applies only to NB-IoT.

parameters.name: Power Difference Thld
parameters.description: Indicates the threshold of the power difference between the non-anchor and anchor carriers at a specific coverage level. When the result of non-anchor carrier power minus anchor carrier power is less than this threshold, UEs at this specific coverage level cannot be assigned to a downlink-only carrier for services. If this parameter is set to -128, carrier assignment for UEs is not restricted by p

parameters.name: DL AMC MCS Adjustment Step
parameters.description: Indicates the MCS adjustment step used in downlink AMC based on path loss difference. If this parameter is set to 0 for a coverage level, downlink AMC based on path loss difference does not take effect for the coverage level. This parameter applies only to NB-IoT.

parameters.id: DL AMC Path Loss Adjustment Step
parameters.name: DL AMC Path Loss Adjustment Step
parameters.description: Indicates the path loss adjustment step used in downlink AMC based on path loss difference. If this parameter is set to 0, the downlink MCS index is adjusted at the step specified by the DlAmcMcsAdjustStep parameter in each downlink scheduling occasion for UEs at the coverage level where downlink AMC based on path loss difference has taken effect. The adjustment does not stop until the conditions

parameters.name: Local Cell ID
parameters.description: Indicates the local ID of a cell. It uniquely identifies a cell within an eNodeB. This parameter applies only to NB-IoT.

parameters.name: PRB ID
parameters.description: Indicates the ID that uniquely specifies a PRB in an NB-IoT cell. This parameter applies only to NB-IoT.

parameters.name: Coverage Level
parameters.description: Indicates the UE's coverage level. The value 0 indicates 0 dB coverage enhancement; the value 1 indicates 10 dB coverage enhancement; and the value 2 indicates 20 dB coverage enhancement. This parameter applies only to NB-IoT.

parameters.name: PDCCH Maximum Repetition Count
parameters.description: Indicates the maximum number of PDCCH repetitions. The PDCCH period factor multiplied by the maximum number of PDCCH repetitions is a PDCCH period (unit: ms). Multiple PDCCH periods without PDCCH resources are generated when this parameter is set to REP_1(REP_1) and the PdcchPeriodFactor parameter is set to G_4(G_4) or when this parameter is set to REP_4(REP_4) and the PdcchPeriodFactor parameter

parameters.name: PDCCH Period Factor
parameters.description: Indicates the PDCCH period factor. The PDCCH period factor multiplied by the maximum number of PDCCH repetitions is the PDCCH period. Multiple PDCCH periods without PDCCH resources are generated when this parameter is set to G_4(G_4) and the PdcchMaxRepetitionCnt parameter is set to REP_1(REP_1) or when this parameter is set to G_2(G_2) and the PdcchMaxRepetitionCnt parameter is set to REP_4(REP_4

parameters.id: PDCCH Initial Trans Rept Count Factor
parameters.name: PDCCH Initial Trans Rept Count Factor
parameters.description: Indicates the factor of the number of repeated PDCCH initial transmissions. The number of repeated PDCCH initial transmissions equals this parameter multiplied by the maximum number of PDCCH repetitions. This parameter applies only to NB-IoT.

parameters.name: PDCCH Offset
parameters.description: Indicates the start position offset for the NPDCCH search space. It is recommended that this parameter be set to different values for the three coverage levels when the percentages of UEs at each coverage level are basically the same. This parameter applies only to NB-IoT.

parameters.name: Local Cell ID
parameters.description: Indicates the local cell ID. It uniquely identifies a cell within an eNodeB. This parameter applies only to NB-IoT.

parameters.name: PRB ID
parameters.description: Indicates the ID that uniquely specifies a PRB in an NB-IoT cell. This parameter applies only to NB-IoT.

parameters.name: Coverage Level
parameters.description: Indicates the coverage level associated with RACH parameters. The value COVERAGE_LEVEL_0 indicates coverage level 0, value COVERAGE_LEVEL_1 indicates coverage level 1, and value COVERAGE_LEVEL_2 indicates coverage level 2. This parameter applies only to NB-IoT.

parameters.name: PRACH Transmission Period
parameters.description: Indicates the PRACH transmission period. If the PrachStartTimeCfgInd parameter in the RACHCfg MO is set to CFG, this parameter can be set to different values for different coverage levels of a cell. Ensure that PRACH resources for different coverage levels do not overlap. Otherwise, the random access success rate is affected. This parameter applies only to NB-IoT.

parameters.name: PRACH Subcarrier Offset
parameters.description: Indicates the frequency-domain PRACH subcarrier offset. If the number of the PRACH subcarriers at each coverage level of a PRB is not 48, it is required that this parameter be set to the same value for all coverage levels of the PRB or the sum of the value of this parameter and the number of PRACH subcarriers be the same for all coverage levels of the PRB. Otherwise, the NB-IoT cell cannot work. T

parameters.name: PRACH Repetition Count
parameters.description: Indicates the number of repeated preamble transmissions at the corresponding coverage level. Set this parameter to a proper value. Otherwise, PRACH resources for different coverage levels overlap or RA-RNTIs of different coverage levels conflict, leading to cell activation failures. This parameter is valid only for anchor carriers. This parameter applies only to NB-IoT.

parameters.name: PRACH Start Time
parameters.description: Indicates the PRACH start time. If the PrachStartTimeCfgInd parameter in the RACHCfg MO is set to CFG, the eNodeB can set different PRACH start time for different coverage levels of a cell, but the interval between these time points must be 40 ms or longer. Otherwise, the cell cannot be activated. This parameter applies only to NB-IoT.

parameters.name: PRACH Detection Threshold
parameters.description: Indicates the level of the PRACH detection threshold. The value LEVEL_0 indicates a low level, and the value LEVEL_3 indicates a high level. If the PrachRepetitionCount parameter in the CellRachCECfg MO is set to 1, 2, 4, or 128, LEVEL_3 always takes effect regardless of the parameter setting. This parameter applies only to NB-IoT.

parameters.name: PRACH Probability for Anchor
parameters.description: Indicates the probability of random access on the anchor carrier for UEs supporting multi-carrier access. If this parameter is set to ONE, UEs perform random access only on an anchor carrier. This parameter is valid only for anchor carriers. This parameter applies only to NB-IoT.

parameters.name: PRACH Subcarrier Number
parameters.description: Indicates the number of subcarriers used for the PRACH. The number of PRACH subcarriers for EDT is not configurable. Currently, the number is fixed at 12. This parameter applies only to NB-IoT.

parameters.name: PRACH CBRA Subcarrier Number
parameters.description: Indicates the number of PRACH subcarriers for contention-based random access. This parameter does not take effect if the CFRA_WITH_SR_SWITCH option of the NbCellAlgoExtSwitch parameter in the CellAlgoExtSwitch MO is deselected. This parameter applies only to NB-IoT.

parameters.name: Backoff High Load Threshold
parameters.description: Indicates the high load threshold for backoff in a cell at a coverage level. When the load of the cell is greater than or equal to the value of this parameter, backoff takes effect or the backoff indicator (used to indicate backoff time) increases by one level. For details about backoff time, see 3GPP TS 36.321. The value 0 indicates that this parameter does not take effect. This parameter applies

parameters.name: Backoff Low Load Threshold
parameters.description: Indicates the low load threshold for backoff in a cell at a coverage level. If the load of the cell is less than the value of this parameter, the backoff indicator (used to indicate backoff time) decreases by one level or backoff becomes invalid. For details about backoff time, see 3GPP TS 36.321. The value 0 indicates that this parameter does not take effect. This parameter applies only to NB-IoT

parameters.name: EDT PRACH Subcarrier Offset
parameters.description: Indicates the frequency offset of the PRACH subcarrier for early data transmission (EDT). This parameter must be set to the same value for different coverage levels and the location of the PRACH subcarrier for EDT cannot overlap that of the common PRACH subcarrier. Otherwise, the NB-IoT cell cannot work. This parameter applies only to NB-IoT.

parameters.name: PRACH Algorithm Switch
parameters.description: Indicates whether to enable PRACH-related algorithms. EDT_RANDOM_ACCESS_SW: Indicates whether random access for EDT is supported at the corresponding coverage level of the PRB. This parameter applies only to NB-IoT.

parameters.id: Multi-Tone UE NPRACH Range and MSG3 Init Tone
parameters.name: Multi-Tone UE NPRACH Range and MSG3 Init Tone
parameters.description: Indicates the factor for the range of dedicated NPRACH resources used by UEs with the multi-tone transmission capability and also indicates the initial number of tones used for the scheduling of Msg3. For details about this parameter, see 3GPP TS 36.331. This parameter applies only to NB-IoT.

parameters.name: Local Cell ID
parameters.description: Indicates the local cell ID. It uniquely identifies a cell within an eNodeB. This parameter applies only to NB-IoT.

parameters.name: PRB ID
parameters.description: Indicates the ID that uniquely specifies a PRB in an NB-IoT cell. This parameter applies only to NB-IoT.

parameters.name: Maximum Number of Paging Repetition
parameters.description: Indicates the maximum number of paging repetitions in the NPDCCH common search space. For details about this parameter, see descriptions of the npdcch-NumRepetitionPaging IE in 3GPP TS 36.331. When this parameter is set to NULL, the maximum number of PDCCH repetitions corresponding to the maximum coverage level configured for the carrier is used as the value of the npdcch-NumRepetitionPaging IE by

parameters.name: Downlink Scheduling Switch
parameters.description: Indicates whether to enable downlink scheduling for NB-IoT carriers. DL_GAP_SWITCH: Indicates whether to enable the downlink gap function in an NB-IoT cell. If this option is selected, the downlink gap function can be started in the cell. If this option is deselected, the downlink gap function cannot be started in the cell.

parameters.name: NB-IoT DL Bitmap Size
parameters.description: Indicates the downlink subframe pattern size of an NB-IoT cell. This parameter applies only to NB-IoT.

parameters.name: NB-IoT DL Bitmap10
parameters.description: Indicates a 10-bit bitmap used to specify the set of downlink subframes for downlink transmission in the NB-IoT cell. The value of this parameter needs to be converted into a binary number, and the 10 least significant bits of the number are used as the bitmap, with each bit representing one subframe. If the NB-IoT downlink subframe pattern is a configuration of 10 subframes, only this parameter i

parameters.name: NB-IoT DL Bitmap30
parameters.description: Indicates a 30-bit bitmap used to specify the set of downlink subframes for downlink transmission in the NB-IoT cell. The value of this parameter needs to be converted into a binary number, and the 30 least significant bits of the number are used as the bitmap, with each bit representing one subframe. If the NB-IoT downlink subframe pattern is a configuration of 10 subframes, this parameter is inv

parameters.id: PRB Index of DL PDCCH Carrier
parameters.name: PRB Index of DL PDCCH Carrier
parameters.description: Indicates the downlink carrier ID for the UE to receive RAR and Msg4 when the UE initiates random access on the current carrier. If this parameter is set to 65535, the UE receives RAR and Msg4 on the current carrier. This parameter is valid only for non-anchor carriers. This option applies only to NB-IoT.

parameters.name: Paging Weight
parameters.description: Indicates the paging weight of each carrier. For details, see 3GPP TS 36.331. If this parameter is set to W0 for all carriers including anchor and non-anchor carriers, paging is performed only on the anchor carrier. If this parameter is set to W0 for the anchor carrier and a value other than W0 for any non-anchor carrier, paging is not performed on the anchor carrier. If this parameter is set to W

parameters.name: DL Subcarrier Usage Offset
parameters.description: Indicates the offset to downlink subcarrier resource usage. This offset is used to determine whether to trigger load balancing between NB-IoT carriers. If the difference in downlink subcarrier resource usage between the carriers is greater than or equal to the sum of the values of this parameter and the PrbDlScUsageDiffThld parameter in the NbCellMultiPrbConfig MO, load balancing will be triggered

parameters.name: UL Subcarrier Usage Offset
parameters.description: Indicates the offset to uplink subcarrier resource usage. This offset is used to determine whether to trigger load balancing between NB-IoT carriers. If the difference in uplink subcarrier resource usage between the carriers is greater than or equal to the sum of the values of this parameter and the PrbUlScUsageDiffThld parameter in the NbCellMultiPrbConfig MO, load balancing will be triggered bet

parameters.name: Local Cell ID
parameters.description: Indicates the local ID of a cell, which uniquely identifies a cell within an eNodeB. This parameter applies only to NB-IoT.

parameters.name: Sector Equipment ID
parameters.description: Indicates the ID of the sector equipment that serves the PRB. It uniquely identifies a set of sector equipment within an eNodeB. This parameter applies only to NB-IoT.

parameters.name: PRB ID
parameters.description: Indicates the NB-IoT PRB ID. It uniquely identifies a PRB within a cell. This parameter applies only to NB-IoT.

parameters.name: Sector Equipment Group ID
parameters.description: Indicates the ID of the sector equipment group that serves the PRB. It uniquely identifies a sector equipment group within an eNodeB. This parameter applies only to NB-IoT.

parameters.name: Local Cell ID
parameters.description: Indicates the local cell ID. It uniquely identifies a cell within an eNodeB. This parameter applies only to NB-IoT.

parameters.name: PRB ID
parameters.description: Indicates the ID that uniquely specifies a PRB in an NB-IoT cell. This parameter applies only to NB-IoT.

parameters.name: Coverage Level
parameters.description: Indicates the coverage level of a UE. The value COVERAGE_LEVEL_0 indicates 0 dB coverage enhancement, value COVERAGE_LEVEL_1 indicates 10 dB coverage enhancement, and value COVERAGE_LEVEL_2 indicates 20 dB coverage enhancement. This parameter applies only to NB-IoT.

parameters.name: Uplink Initial MCS
parameters.description: Indicates the initial uplink MCS index for a UE at a coverage level. For details about MCS indexes, see 3GPP TS 36.211. This parameter applies only to NB-IoT.

parameters.name: UL Initial Transmission Repetition Count
parameters.description: Indicates the number of repeated initial transmissions in the uplink at a coverage level. This parameter applies only to NB-IoT.

parameters.name: ACK/NACK Transmission Repetition Count
parameters.description: Indicates the number of uplink repetitions of ACK/NACK responses to downlink transmissions at a coverage level. This parameter applies only to NB-IoT.

parameters.name: Msg4 ACK/NACK Trans Repetition Count
parameters.description: Indicates the number of ACK/NACK responses to MSG4 at a coverage level. This parameter applies only to NB-IoT.

parameters.id: NB-IoT Logical Channel SR Prohibit Timer
parameters.name: NB-IoT Logical Channel SR Prohibit Timer
parameters.description: Indicates the logical channel prohibition timer for a UE. This timer starts when the corresponding UE initiates service requests, prohibiting the UE from initiating service requests until it expires. The eNodeB configures this timer for a UE through an RRCConnectionSetup message. For details, see 3GPP TS 36.331. This parameter applies only to NB-IoT.

parameters.name: NB-IoT BSR Retransmission Timer
parameters.description: Indicates the length of the NB-IoT buffer status report (BSR) retransmission timer. This timer is started when an NB-IoT UE sends a BSR. This parameter applies only to NB-IoT.

parameters.name: Initial Msg3 MCS
parameters.description: Indicates the index of the MCS used for the transmission of Msg3 from UEs at a certain coverage level. For details about MCSs, see 3GPP TS 36.213. This parameter applies only to NB-IoT.

parameters.name: Proportion of Uplink Scheduling Duration
parameters.description: Indicates the proportion of uplink scheduling duration for a specific coverage level. This parameter is used to control how frequently uplink scheduling is performed. This parameter applies only to NB-IoT.

parameters.name: Uplink SPS Extended Inactivity Timer
parameters.description: Indicates the length of the extended inactivity timer used in uplink semi-persistent scheduling. After the eNodeB receives an updated BSR from a UE for which semi-persistent scheduling has been activated and the uplink semi-persistent scheduling inactivity timer (specified by UlSpsInactivityTimer in the PrbUlSchCeAlgo MO) has not expired, the eNodeB extends the semi-persistent scheduling inactivit

parameters.name: Uplink SPS Inactivity Timer
parameters.description: Indicates the length of the inactivity timer used for uplink semi-persistent scheduling. The eNodeB starts this timer after uplink semi-persistent scheduling is activated for a UE. When the timer expires, uplink semi-persistent scheduling is deactivated. If this parameter is set to 0, the timer length is infinite. If this parameter is set to 255, uplink semi-persistent scheduling does not take eff

parameters.name: Uplink SPS Interval
parameters.description: Indicates the interval at which uplink semi-persistent scheduling is performed. This parameter applies only to NB-IoT.

parameters.name: EDT Max TBS
parameters.description: Indicates the maximum TBS that can be used for the scheduling of Msg3 for EDT initiated by UEs at a specific coverage level. This parameter is valid only for the anchor carrier. For details, see 3GPP TS 36.213. This parameter applies only to NB-IoT.

parameters.name: EDT Msg3 MCS
parameters.description: Indicates the index of the MCS used in the scheduling of Msg3 for EDT initiated by UEs at a specific coverage level. For details, see 3GPP TS 36.213. This parameter applies only to NB-IoT.

parameters.name: EDT UL Transmission Repetition Count
parameters.description: Indicates the number of repetitions of Msg3 for EDT initiated by UEs at a specific coverage level. This parameter applies only to NB-IoT.

parameters.name: Private CA Band Combination ID
parameters.description: Indicates the ID of a private CA band combination within an eNodeB. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: Combination Band Index
parameters.description: Indicates the index of a band in the private CA band combination. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: Combination Band ID
parameters.description: Indicates the number of the band. For details about band numbers, see 3GPP TS 36.101. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: Combination Band Bandwidth
parameters.description: Indicates the bandwidth set supported in the band. If a bandwidth is selected, any carrier with this bandwidth in the band can be a component of the private CA band combination. Selected bandwidths must be identical to cell bandwidths supported by a UE. Otherwise, the eNodeB may mistakenly determine that a bandwidth that the UE does not support is supported in the private CA band combination, caus

parameters.name: Private CA Band Combination ID
parameters.description: Indicates the ID of the private CA band combination. It uniquely identifies a private CA band combination in an eNodeB. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: Maximum Aggregated Bandwidth
parameters.description: Indicates the maximum aggregated bandwidth supported by the CA band combination. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: Bandwidth Combination Set ID
parameters.description: Indicates the protocol-defined ID of a CA bandwidth combination set. As defined in 3GPP TS 36.101, an operating frequency band supports different bandwidth combinations, which are identified by using different set IDs. For details, see section 5.6A.1 in 3GPP TS 36.101. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: Combination Band 1 Band Identity
parameters.description: Indicates combination band 1. For details, see 3GPP TS 36.101. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: Combination Band 2 Band Identity
parameters.description: Indicates combination band 2. For details, see 3GPP TS 36.101. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: Combination Band 3 Band Identity
parameters.description: Indicates combination band 3. For details, see 3GPP TS 36.101. If the value is 0, combination band 3 is invalid. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: Combination Band 4 Band Identity
parameters.description: Indicates combination band 4. For details, see 3GPP TS 36.101. If the value is 0, combination band 4 is invalid. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: Combination Band 1 Bandwidth
parameters.description: Indicates the bandwidth set supported in the first band in the band combination. If a bandwidth is selected, the carrier with this bandwidth in the first band is supported in the private CA band combination. Selected bandwidths must be identical to configured cell bandwidths. Otherwise, the eNodeB may mistakenly determine that a bandwidth that a UE does not support is supported in the private CA b

parameters.name: Combination Band 2 Bandwidth
parameters.description: Indicates the bandwidth set supported in the second band in the band combination. If a bandwidth is selected, the carrier with this bandwidth in the second band is supported in the private CA band combination. Selected bandwidths must be identical to configured cell bandwidths. Otherwise, the eNodeB may mistakenly determine that a bandwidth that a UE does not support is supported in the private CA

parameters.name: Combination Band 3 Bandwidth
parameters.description: Indicates the bandwidth set supported in the third band in the band combination. If a bandwidth is selected, the carrier with this bandwidth in the third band is supported in the private CA band combination. Selected bandwidths must be identical to configured cell bandwidths. Otherwise, the eNodeB may mistakenly determine that a bandwidth that a UE does not support is supported in the private CA b

parameters.name: Combination Band 4 Bandwidth
parameters.description: Indicates the bandwidth set supported in the fourth band in the band combination. If a bandwidth is selected, the carrier with this bandwidth in the fourth band is supported in the private CA band combination. Selected bandwidths must be identical to configured cell bandwidths. Otherwise, the eNodeB may mistakenly determine that a bandwidth that a UE does not support is supported in the private CA

parameters.name: Combination Band 5 Band Identity
parameters.description: Indicates combination band 5. For details, see 3GPP TS 36.101. If the value is 0, combination band 5 is invalid. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: Combination Band 5 Bandwidth
parameters.description: Indicates the bandwidth set supported in the fifth band in the band combination. If a bandwidth is selected, the carrier with this bandwidth in the fifth band is supported in the private CA band combination. Selected bandwidths must be identical to configured cell bandwidths. Otherwise, the eNodeB may mistakenly determine that a bandwidth that a UE does not support is supported in the private CA b

parameters.name: Combination Status
parameters.description: Indicates whether the private CA band combination conflicts with solidified CA band combinations supported by an eNodeB. The solidified CA band combinations supported by the eNodeB include the solidified private CA band combinations and 3GPP-defined CA band combinations of the related protocol version that the eNodeB complies with. If a conflict occurs, the eNodeB preferentially uses the private C

parameters.name: Local cell ID
parameters.description: Indicates the local ID of the cell. It uniquely identifies a cell within a BS. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: Delta shift
parameters.description: Indicates the interval between cyclic shifts used for the PUCCH. The interval between cyclic shifts used for the PUCCH can be acquired based on the average delay spread in the cell, where the average delay spread is acquired based on the networking environment. The parameter value DS1_DELTA_SHIFT is not supported by the LBBPc. If a cell is established on an LBBPc but this parameter is set to DS1_D

parameters.name: ACK/SRI Channel Number
parameters.description: Indicates the number of resource indexes allocated to SRI and semi-persistent ACK at the RRC layer for the cell. If this parameter is set to 0, UEs may fail to access the cell. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: CQI RB number
parameters.description: Indicates the number of RBs allocated to the CQI at the RRC layer of cell. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: PUCCH Extended RB Number
parameters.description: Indicates the total number of RBs reserved for the PUSCH at both ends of the system band. This parameter is valid only if the PucchFlexCfgSwitch option of the PucchAlgoSwitch parameter is selected. For LTE FDD, consider the number of RBs used by the PRACH, SRSs, and PUCCH when you set this parameter. For LTE TDD, consider the number of RBs used by the PRACH and PUCCH when you set this parameter. I

parameters.name: Format1 Channel Allocation Mode
parameters.description: Indicates the mode for allocating PUCCH format 1/1a/1b code channel resources. The setting of this parameter takes effect only when the DeltaShift parameter is set to DS1_DELTA_SHIFT(ds1). If the Format1ChAllocMode parameter is set to FIXEDMODE(Fixed Mode), consecutive PUCCH format 1/1a/1b code channel resources are always allocated. If the Format1ChAllocMode parameter is set to RANDOMMODE(Random

parameters.name: SRI Period Adaptive Switch
parameters.description: Indicates whether to enable scheduling request indicator (SRI) reporting period adaptation. If this parameter is set to QCIADAPTIVE, the eNodeB adaptively changes the SRI reporting period based on the cell load and bearers with different QCIs. If this parameter is set to NOQCIADAPTIVE, the eNodeB adaptively changes the SRI reporting period only based on the cell load. If this parameter is set to O

parameters.name: Format2 Channel Allocation Mode
parameters.description: Indicates the channel resource allocation mode for PUCCH format 2/2a/2b. If this parameter is set to FIXEDMODE, consecutive channel resources are allocated for PUCCH format 2/2a/2b. If this parameter is set to RANDOMMODE, channel resource allocation is optimized for PUCCH format 2/2a/2b. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: PUCCH Allocation Policy
parameters.description: Indicates the PUCCH resource allocation policy. RbPriorityModeSW: Indicates whether to preferentially use RBs different from those already allocated when allocating new PUCCH code channel resources. If this option is selected, the eNodeB preferentially uses different RBs when allocating new PUCCH code channel resources. In this case, UEs are scheduled on all RBs, reducing inter-code-channel interf

parameters.name: Format3 RB Number
parameters.description: Indicates the maximum number of RBs that can be used by PUCCH resources in Format 3. This parameter takes effect only when the SCCAckResourceCfgSw option of the PucchAlgoSwitch parameter is selected. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: Max 2CC ACK Channel Number
parameters.description: Indicates the maximum number of code channels that can be used by SCC ACKs in 2CC CA scenarios. This parameter takes effect only when options Dl2CCAckResShareSw and SCCAckResourceCfgSw of the PucchAlgoSwitch parameter are selected. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: Fixed SRI Period
parameters.description: Indicates the SRI period for UEs. This parameter takes effect only when the SriPeriodAdaptive parameter in the PUCCHCfg MO is set to OFF. If this parameter is set to Disable(Disable), the SRI period is specified by the SriPeriodAdaptive parameter in the PUCCHCfg MO. This parameter specifies the SRI period for UEs if it is set to a value other than Disable. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD an

parameters.name: Format1 Code Channel Expansion Threshold
parameters.description: Indicates the threshold for increasing the number of code channels for PUCCH format 1 in the cell. When the number of remaining format 1 code channels is less than this threshold, the number of format-1 code channels will be increased. This parameter is valid only when the PucchSwitch option of the CellAlgoSwitch.PucchAlgoSwitch parameter is selected and the DeltaShift parameter is set to DS1_DELT

parameters.id: Semi-persistent ACK and SRI Sub Channel
parameters.name: Semi-persistent ACK and SRI Sub Channel
parameters.description: Indicates the number of code channels that reserved for the cell semi-persistent ACKs and SRIs. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: Local cell ID
parameters.description: Indicates the local ID of the cell. It uniquely identifies a cell within a BS. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: Subband number
parameters.description: Indicates the number of PUSCH sub-bands. For details, see 3GPP TS 36.211. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: Hopping mode
parameters.description: Indicates the hopping mode of the PUSCH. For details, see 3GPP TS 36.211. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: Hopping offset
parameters.description: Indicates the hopping offset of the PUSCH. For details, see 3GPP TS 36.211. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: Group hopping enabled
parameters.description: Indicates whether group hopping of the PUSCH is enabled. For details, see 3GPP TS 36.211. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: Group assignment PUSCH
parameters.description: Indicates the group assignment of the PUSCH. For details, see 3GPP TS 36.211. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: Sequence hopping enabled
parameters.description: Indicates whether sequence hopping of the PUSCH is enabled. For details, see 3GPP TS 36.211. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: Cyclic shift
parameters.description: Indicates the cyclic shift of the PUSCH. For details, see 3GPP TS 36.211. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: Qam64 enabled
parameters.description: Indicates whether 64QAM of the PUSCH is enabled. For details, see 3GPP TS 36.211. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: R12 UL 64QAM Enabled
parameters.description: Indicates whether the eNodeB supports UL 64QAM for UEs compliant with 3GPP Release 12 and later. This parameter is valid only when the Qam64Enabled parameter in the PUSCHCfg MO is set to BOOLEAN_TRUE. When R12Qam64Enabled is set to BOOLEAN_TRUE, the eNodeB supports UL 64QAM for UEs compliant with 3GPP TS 36.331 V12.7.0 or later as well as for UEs compliant with versions earlier than 3GPP TS 36.331

parameters.name: UL 256QAM Algorithm Switch
parameters.description: Indicates whether to enable uplink 256QAM. UL_256QAM_SWITCH: If this option is selected, uplink 256QAM is enabled. The maximum uplink modulation scheme can be 256QAM for UEs supporting uplink 256QAM. If this option is deselected, uplink 256QAM is disabled. The maximum uplink modulation scheme is 64QAM. This option applies only to LTE TDD.

parameters.name: UL 256QAM MCS Table Adaptive Period
parameters.description: Indicates the period for adaptation of the MCS table for uplink 256QAM. This parameter is valid only if the adaptive MCS table configuration policy is used. This parameter applies only to LTE TDD.

parameters.name: UL 256QAM MCS Table Configuration Strategy
parameters.description: Indicates the MCS table configuration policy for uplink 256QAM. The policy can be fixed or adaptive. If this parameter is set to FIXED_CONFIGURATION, the MCS table supporting 256QAM is always used for uplink scheduling of UEs supporting 256QAM. If this parameter is set to ADAPTIVE_CONFIGURATION, the eNodeB adaptively selects the MCS table supporting or not supporting 256QAM based on channel qualit

parameters.name: NR 5G QoS Identifier
parameters.description: Indicates the 5G QoS Identifier (5QI) of a QoS flow that needs to be mapped to a QCI. Different 5QIs represent different QoS specifications such as the packet delay budget, packet loss rate, average window, and service type (whether the service is a GBR service or not). For details, see 3GPP TS 23.501. When a new 5QI is configured on the core network: 1. If no Qci5qiConfig MO is added for this 5QI

parameters.name: Access Service Reflective QoS Switch
parameters.description: Indicates whether to enable the AS reflective QoS function. For details about reflective QoS, see 3GPP TS 23.501. If the parameter is set to ON, the UE can obtain the mapping between QoS flows and the DRBs by monitoring the QoS flow identity (QFI) of the data packet transmitted on each DRB. If this parameter is set to OFF, this function is disabled. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE T

parameters.name: QoS Class Identifier
parameters.description: Indicates the QCI that is mapped to the 5QI. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: Local cell ID
parameters.description: Indicates the local ID of the cell. It uniquely identifies a cell within an eNodeB. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: Downlink EARFCN
parameters.description: Indicates the downlink (DL) E-UTRA absolute radio frequency channel number (EARFCN) associated with the QCI. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: QCI Eutran Frequency Relation ID
parameters.description: Indicates the ID of the QCI and E-UTRAN frequency relationship group. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: Mobility Target Indicator
parameters.description: Indicates whether the neighboring E-UTRAN frequency can be a target frequency in QCI-specific mobility management. MlbTargetInd(MlbTargetInd): The neighboring E-UTRAN frequency can be a target frequency in QCI-specific MLB only if this option is selected. You are advised to select this option for the default bearer. Otherwise, MLB may not transfer UEs. This option applies only to LTE FDD and LTE T

parameters.name: Local cell ID
parameters.description: Indicates the local ID of the cell. It uniquely identifies a cell within an eNodeB. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: BCCH Group ID
parameters.description: Indicates the ID of the GERAN frequency group associated with the QCI. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: QCI GERAN Frequency Relation ID
parameters.description: Indicates the ID of the relationship group of the QCI and the GERAN frequency group. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: Mobility Target Indicator
parameters.description: Indicates whether the GERAN frequency group can be a target frequency in QCI-specific mobility management. MlbTargetInd(MlbTargetInd): The GERAN frequency group can be a target in QCI-specific MLB only if this option is selected. You are advised to select this option for the default bearer. Otherwise, MLB may not transfer UEs. This option applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: QoS Class Identifier
parameters.description: Indicates the QCI, which is an attribute of EPS bearers. Different QCIs represent different QoS specifications such as the packet delay budget, packet loss rate (PLR) and packet error rate (PER), and resource type (whether the service is a GBR service or not). For details, see Table 6.1.7 in 3GPP TS 23.203.

parameters.name: Service Type
parameters.description: Indicates the service type corresponding to the operator-defined QCI. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: Uplink Scheduling Priority Factor
parameters.description: Indicates the weight factor used in the calculation of connection priorities during uplink scheduling. This parameter is invalid when CnOperatorQciPara.UlschPriorityWeightFactor is valid for QCI6~QCI9. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: Downlink Scheduling Priority Factor
parameters.description: Indicates the weight factor used in the calculation of connection priorities during downlink scheduling. This parameter is invalid when CnOperatorQciPara.DlschPriorityWeightFactor is valid for QCI6~QCI9. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: Uplink MinGBR
parameters.description: Indicates the uplink minimum guaranteed bit rate. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: Downlink MinGBR
parameters.description: Indicates the downlink minimum guaranteed bit rate of the service. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: Pre-allocation Weight
parameters.description: Indicates the pre-allocation weight. The pre-allocation weight of a UE is the pre-allocation weight of services carried by the highest-priority logical channel. If services carried by highest-priority logical channels have different pre-allocation weights, the UE takes the highest pre-allocation weight. When resources are insufficient, pre-allocation weights affect the pre-allocation probabilities

parameters.name: InterRAT Policy Config Group ID
parameters.description: Indicates the group ID of the parameters related to the inter-RAT handover with the extended QCI. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: Prioritised Bit Rate
parameters.description: Indicates the prioritized bit rate of the logical channel. The UE scheduler guarantees prioritized bit rates of logical channels in descending order of logical channel priority. For details, see 3GPP TS 36.321. When the parameter is set to a value greater than PBR_256_KBps and not PBR_INFINITY, the parameter value takes effect on UEs complying with 3GPP R10 or later and PBR_256_KBps takes effect o

parameters.name: Logical Channel Priority
parameters.description: Indicates the priority of the logical channel. The smaller the value of the parameter configuration, the higher the priority. The UE scheduler guarantees prioritized bit rates of logical channels in descending order of logical channel priority. Resources are allocated in descending order of logical channel priority after the prioritized bit rates of all services are guaranteed. For details, see 3G

parameters.name: RLC PDCP Parameter Group ID
parameters.description: Indicates the ID of an RLC/PDCP parameter group. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: Free User Flag
parameters.description: Indicates whether the extended QCI is specific to free users or paid users. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: Flow Control Type
parameters.description: Indicates whether to enable flow control for the QCI. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: PTT Dedicated Extended QCI
parameters.description: Indicates whether this extended QCI is used as the dedicated QCI for PTT services. If this parameter is set to YES(Yes), the eNodeB ensures the service quality for services with this extended QCI the same as PTT services. If this parameter is set to NO(No), the eNodeB processes the data of services with this extended QCI the same as common services with an extended QCI. This parameter applies only

parameters.name: PTT Downlink Priority
