parameters.description: Indicates the relative downlink scheduling priority for dedicated bearers for PTT services. If this parameter is set to EQUAL_PRI_TO_QCI1, the downlink scheduling priority for PTT services is the same as that for VoIP services (with a QCI of 1). If this parameter is set to HIGHER_PRI_THAN_QCI1, the downlink scheduling priority for PTT services is higher than that for VoIP services (with a QCI of 1

parameters.name: PTT Uplink Priority
parameters.description: Indicates the relative uplink scheduling priority for dedicated bearers for PTT voice services. If this parameter is set to EQUAL_PRI_TO_QCI1, the uplink scheduling priority for PTT services is the same as that for VoIP services (with a QCI of 1). If this parameter is set to HIGHER_PRI_THAN_QCI1, the uplink scheduling priority for PTT services is higher than that for VoIP services (with a QCI of 1

parameters.name: Extended QCI Counter Index
parameters.description: Indicates the counter index to which the extended QCI is mapped. If this parameter is set to Index0, the counters (for example, uplink PDCP-layer service traffic volume) related to this extended QCI can be observed by the mapping counters (for example, the L.Thrp.bits.UL.ExtQCI.Index0 counter). If this parameter is set to NO_COUNTER, performance about this extended QCI is not measured. Each extend

parameters.name: UE Inactive Timer for QCI
parameters.description: Indicates the length of the UE inactivity timer for UEs that have bearers of a QCI. If the eNodeB detects that a UE has neither received nor sent data for a period exceeding the value of this parameter, the eNodeB releases the RRC connection for this UE. If this parameter is set to 0, the UE inactivity timer is not used. This parameter takes effect only for UEs that will access the network after t

parameters.name: Uplink Synchronization Timer for QCI
parameters.description: Indicates the timer used to govern the period in which the eNodeB maintains uplink synchronization for UEs that have bearers of a QCI. After this timer expires, the eNodeB does not send the Timing Advance Command to the UE. This parameter does not take effect if it is set to 0. That is, the eNodeB will constantly send the Timing Advance Command to the UE to maintain uplink synchronization for the

parameters.id: UE Inactivity Timer Dynamic DRX for QCI
parameters.name: UE Inactivity Timer Dynamic DRX for QCI
parameters.description: Indicates the length of the UE inactivity timer for UEs that have entered DRX mode and have bearers of the QCI when dynamic DRX is enabled. If the eNodeB detects that a UE has neither received nor sent data for a period exceeding the value of this parameter, the eNodeB releases the RRC connection for this UE. If this parameter is set to a large value, the amount of signaling is reduced but UE powe

parameters.name: QCI-specific UE Inactive Timer Priority
parameters.description: Indicates the priority of the QCI-specific UE inactivity timer. A larger value of this parameter indicates a higher priority. The eNodeB selects the longest UE inactivity timer with the highest QCI-specific priority as the UE inactivity timer for UEs running services with the specific QCI. The UE inactivity timer for QCI 69 is taken as the UE inactivity timer for the MCPTT UEs.

parameters.id: eMTC Mode A CL 1 RLC Para Group ID
parameters.name: eMTC Mode A CL 1 RLC Para Group ID
parameters.description: Indicates the ID of an RLC parameter group used for eMTC UEs in CE mode A at coverage level 1. This parameter is invalid when it is set to 255. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.id: eMTC Mode B CL 3 RLC Para Group ID
parameters.name: eMTC Mode B CL 3 RLC Para Group ID
parameters.description: Indicates the ID of an RLC parameter group used for eMTC UEs in CE mode B at coverage level 3. This parameter is invalid when it is set to 255. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.id: NB-IoT RLC PDCP Para Group ID
parameters.name: NB-IoT RLC PDCP Para Group ID
parameters.description: Indicates the ID of an RLC/PDCP parameter group for NB-IoT in coverage level 2. The parameter value 255 indicates an invalid ID. This parameter applies only to NB-IoT.

parameters.name: CIoT UE Inactivity Timer
parameters.description: Indicates the UE inactivity timer for MTC UEs, eMTC UEs, and UEs with the RRC connection setup cause delayTolerant. If the eNodeB detects that such a UE has neither received nor sent data for a period exceeding the value of this parameter, the eNodeB releases the RRC connection for the UE. If this parameter is set to 0, the timer length is infinite. This parameter takes effect only for UEs that wi

parameters.name: RLC Mode Reconfig Switch
parameters.description: Indicates whether to modify the DRB RLC mode during an inter-eNodeB handover if the DRB RLC modes of the source and target eNodeBs are different. If this parameter is set to ON, the target eNodeB delivers the IE fullConfig through the handover command when the target eNodeB receives a handover request from the source eNodeB and determines that their DRB RLC modes are different. If this parameter i

parameters.name: QCI-specific Best Effort GBR
parameters.description: Indicates the QCI-specific best-effort GBR. If this parameter is set to 0, the eNodeB does not guarantee the QCI-specific best-effort GBR for bearers with a specific QCI. If this parameter is set to a value greater than 0 and less than 1000, the eNodeB guarantees the QCI-specific best-effort GBR of 1000 Kbit/s for bearers with the specific QCI. If this parameter is set to a value greater than 1000

parameters.id: NB-IoT Coverage Level 0 RLC PDCP Para Group ID
parameters.name: NB-IoT Coverage Level 0 RLC PDCP Para Group ID
parameters.description: Indicates the ID of an RLC/PDCP parameter group for NB-IoT in coverage level 0. The parameter value 255 indicates an invalid ID. This parameter applies only to NB-IoT.

parameters.id: NB-IoT Coverage Level 1 RLC PDCP Para Group ID
parameters.name: NB-IoT Coverage Level 1 RLC PDCP Para Group ID
parameters.description: Indicates the ID of an RLC/PDCP parameter group for NB-IoT in coverage level 1. The parameter value 255 indicates an invalid ID. This parameter applies only to NB-IoT.

parameters.name: PDCP SN Size Reconfig Switch
parameters.description: Indicates whether to modify the PDCP SN size during an inter-eNodeB handover (in which the bearer PDCP type is E-UTRA PDCP on both the source and target eNodeBs). If this parameter is set to ON, the target eNodeB reconfigures the PDCP SN size through the handover command when the target eNodeB receives a handover request from the source eNodeB and determines that the PDCP SN sizes of the source an

parameters.id: UL Min GBR for Mode A
parameters.name: UL Min GBR for Mode A
parameters.description: Indicates the uplink minimum GBR of services for UEs in mode A. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.id: DL Min GBR for Mode A
parameters.name: DL Min GBR for Mode A
parameters.description: Indicates the downlink minimum GBR of services for UEs in mode A. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.id: UL Min GBR for Mode B
parameters.name: UL Min GBR for Mode B
parameters.description: Indicates the uplink minimum GBR of services for UEs in mode B. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.id: DL Min GBR for Mode B
parameters.name: DL Min GBR for Mode B
parameters.description: Indicates the downlink minimum GBR of services for UEs in mode B. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.id: NB-IoT UE Inactivity Timer for QCI
parameters.name: NB-IoT UE Inactivity Timer for QCI
parameters.description: Indicates the length of the UE inactivity timer for NB-IoT UEs that have bearers of a QCI. If the eNodeB detects that an NB-IoT UE has neither received nor sent data for a period exceeding the value of this parameter, the eNodeB releases the RRC connection for this UE. The parameter value 65535 indicates an invalid timer. In this case, the UE inactivity timer specified by the NBUeInactiveTimer par

parameters.name: Uplink Forward Packet Wait Timer
parameters.description: Indicates the time during which the eNodeB waits for uplink packets that are forwarded from a source eNodeB. For details about data forwarding upon handovers, see 3GPP TS 36.300. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: NB-IoT UE Mobility
parameters.description: Indicates the mobility status of UEs running services indicated by the current QCI. The status can be STATIONARY, LOW_SPEED_MOBILITY, or HIGH_SPEED_MOBILITY. This parameter applies only to NB-IoT.

parameters.name: NB-IoT UE RAI Activation Flag
parameters.description: Indicates the RAI activation flag of a UE. If this parameter is set to FALSE, the RAI of the UE is not activated. If this parameter is set to TRUE, the RAI of the UE is activated. When the RAI of the UE is activated and the uplink data buffer of the UE is empty, the PUSCH does not include the BSR only if there is upcoming uplink data. For details, see 3GPP TS 36.331. This parameter applies only to

parameters.name: DRX parameter group ID
parameters.description: Indicates the ID of a DRX parameter group. This parameter applies only to NB-IoT.

parameters.name: Downlink PDB for Extended QCI
parameters.description: Indicates the downlink packet delay budget (PDB) for an extended QCI. The PDB is used in delay-based differentiated scheduling for the extended QCI. If this parameter is not set to 0, the eNodeB tries its best to assure the downlink packet delay on services with the extended QCI, based on the PDB. If this parameter is set to 0, scheduling with delay preferentially assured is not required. This par

parameters.id: Short TTI RLC Parameter Group ID
parameters.name: Short TTI RLC Parameter Group ID
parameters.description: Indicates the ID of an RLC parameter group for short TTI. This parameter is invalid when it is set to 255. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD.

parameters.id: NSA DC RLC PDCP Parameter Group ID
parameters.name: NSA DC RLC PDCP Parameter Group ID
parameters.description: Indicates the ID of an RLC/PDCP parameter group for NSA DC services. This parameter is invalid when it is set to 255. If the ID is not exist in the RlcPdcpParaGroup MO, eNodeB will use RlcPdcpParaGroupId to replace. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: PDCP Discard Timer Reconfiguration Switch
parameters.description: Indicates whether to modify the PDCP discard timer setting during an inter-eNodeB handover (in which the bearer PDCP type is E-UTRA PDCP on both the source and target eNodeBs) if the RLC modes of the source and target eNodeBs are the same but the PDCP discard timer setting of the source eNodeB is different from that of the target eNodeB. If this parameter is set to ON, the target eNodeB delivers t

parameters.id: E-UTRA/5GC RLC PDCP Parameter Group ID
parameters.name: E-UTRA/5GC RLC PDCP Parameter Group ID
parameters.description: Indicates the ID of a parameter group which applies to E-UTRA/5GC UEs. An E-UTRA/5GC UE is served by an eNodeB which is connected to the 5GC. This parameter is invalid when it is set to 255. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.id: Outer Loop DSCP Transparent Trans Sw
parameters.name: Outer Loop DSCP Transparent Trans Sw
parameters.description: Indicates whether to enable transparent transmission of outer-loop DSCP for data transmission over bearers. If this parameter is set to ON, transparent transmission of outer-loop DSCP for data transmission over bearers is enabled. If this parameter is set to OFF, the eNodeB obtains the DSCP value based on the service mapping by default for data transmission over bearers. The DSCP is used for data

parameters.name: NB-IoT Sch Priority Weighting Factor
parameters.description: Indicates the priority weight factor used for scheduling NB-IoT UEs. This parameter is valid only when the Qci parameter is set to a value in the range of 128 to 254. This parameter applies only to NB-IoT.

parameters.id: eMTC Mode A CL 0 RLC Para Group ID
parameters.name: eMTC Mode A CL 0 RLC Para Group ID
parameters.description: Indicates the ID of an RLC parameter group used for eMTC UEs in CE mode A at coverage level 0. This parameter is invalid when it is set to 255. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.id: eMTC Mode B CL 2 RLC Para Group ID
parameters.name: eMTC Mode B CL 2 RLC Para Group ID
parameters.description: Indicates the ID of an RLC parameter group used for eMTC UEs in CE mode B at coverage level 2. This parameter is invalid when it is set to 255. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: Aggregation Attribute
parameters.description: Indicates the aggregation attributes of the QCI. RATE_GUARANTEE_FLAG: Indicates whether to enable rate guarantee for bearers of this QCI. Rate guarantee for bearers of this QCI is enabled only if this option is selected. This option applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: Timer Type
parameters.description: Indicates the timer type. This parameter applies only to NB-IoT.

parameters.name: QoS Class Identifier
parameters.description: Indicates the QoS class identifier (QCI), which is an attribute of EPS bearers. Different QCIs represent different QoS specifications, such as packet delay, packet loss rate, packet error rate, and service type (whether the service is a GBR service or not). For details, see Table 6.1.7 in 3GPP TS 23.203.

parameters.name: Timer Duration
parameters.description: Indicates the duration of the timer. If the parameter setting is changed, the change applies only to UEs that access the network afterwards.

parameters.id: Max Num of UE Sync or Out-of-Sync Indication
parameters.name: Max Num of UE Sync or Out-of-Sync Indication
parameters.description: Indicates the maximum number of consecutive synchronization or out-of-synchronization indications that a UE receives from lower layers. If the TimerType parameter is set to NB_N310, this parameter can be set to 1, 2, 3, 4, 6, 8, 10, or 20. If the TimerType parameter is set to NB_N311, this parameter can be set to 1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6, 8, or 10. For details, see 3GPP TS 36.331. This parameter applies o

parameters.name: Millisecond-level Timer Duration
parameters.description: Indicates the length of the UE timer. If the TimerType parameter is set to NB_T310, this parameter can be set to 0, 200, 500, 1000, 2000, 4000, or 8000. If the TimerType parameter is set to NB_T311, this parameter can be set to 1000, 3000, 5000, 10000, 15000, 20000, 30000, 40000, 60000, 90000, or 120000. If the parameter setting is changed, the change applies only to UEs that access the network af

parameters.name: Local cell ID
parameters.description: Indicates the local ID of the cell. It uniquely identifies a cell within an eNodeB. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: UTRAN Downlink EARFCN
parameters.description: Indicates the downlink (DL) UTRA absolute radio frequency channel number (UARFCN) associated with the QCI. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: QCI UTRAN Frequency Relation ID
parameters.description: Indicates the ID of the QCI and UTRAN frequency relationship group. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: Mobility Target Indicator
parameters.description: Indicates whether the UTRAN frequency can be a target frequency in QCI-specific mobility management. MlbTargetInd(MlbTargetInd): The UTRAN frequency can be a target frequency in QCI-specific MLB only if this option is selected. You are advised to select this option for the default bearer. Otherwise, MLB may not transfer UEs. This option applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: QoE-Based Handover Stat
parameters.description: Indicates the value N in the P/N rule for QoE-based handover decision. If the throughput is unsatisfactory for P consecutive times during the measurement period N, QoE-based handover is triggered. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: QoE-Based Handover Last
parameters.description: Indicates the value P in the P/N rule for QoE-based handover decision. If the throughput is unsatisfactory for P consecutive times during the measurement period N, QoE-based handover is triggered. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: QoS Policy Identity
parameters.description: Indicates the ID of a user-defined QoS policy. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: Traffic Type
parameters.description: Indicates a traffic type for service differentiation. Currently, there are three types of traffic: VIDEO, DOWNLOAD, and OTHER. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: Priority Queue Identity
parameters.description: Indicates the ID of a prioritized queue. The eNodeB can provide differentiated services for a maximum of eight prioritized queues. Multiple DSCPs can be mapped to one queue, but one DSCP cannot be mapped to multiple queues. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: Downlink Service Grant Bit Rate
parameters.description: Indicates the guaranteed bit rate of downlink services. This parameter must be set to a value greater than 0 if the TrafficType parameter value is VIDEO. Otherwise, commands containing this parameter fail to be executed. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: Downlink Service Maximum Bit Rate
parameters.description: Indicates the maximum bit rate for downlink services. If the downlink data rate of a UE exceeds the value of this parameter, rate control will be triggered for the UE. This parameter must be set to a value greater than 0 if the TrafficType parameter is set to DOWNLOAD. Otherwise, the command for QoS policy addition or modification cannot be successfully executed. This parameter applies only to LTE

parameters.name: Rate Control Switch
parameters.description: Indicates whether to limit the UE rate based on the UE-AMBR. When the eNodeB detects that the UE has sufficient traffic in the queue: If this parameter is set to ON, the eNodeB limits the UE rate based on the UE-AMBR. If this parameter is set to OFF, the eNodeB does not limit the UE rate based on the UE-AMBR. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: Local cell ID
parameters.description: Indicates the local ID of the cell. It uniquely identifies a cell within a BS.

parameters.name: PRACH Start Time Config Indication
parameters.description: Indicates whether to allow configuration of the PRACH start time. When this parameter is set to NOT_CFG, the PRACH start time is not configurable. The PRACH start time for coverage level 0 is always 8 ms. The PRACH start time for coverage level 1 is determined based on the following factors: the sum of the PRACH start time and PRACH time length for coverage level 0, and the restriction that the PR

parameters.name: Power Ramping Step CE1
parameters.description: Indicates the ramping step of preamble power at coverage level 1. If multiple access attempts over the NPRACH fail, the UE increases the TX power for random access preambles by a step specified by this parameter to ensure successful access. For details about this parameter, see 3GPP TS 36.321. This parameter is optional. The value NOT_CFG indicates that this parameter is not configured. This param

parameters.id: Preamble Initial Received Target Power CE1
parameters.name: Preamble Initial Received Target Power CE1
parameters.description: Indicates the eNodeB-expected target receive power level of the NPRACH preambles sent from NB-IoT UEs at coverage level 1. For details about this parameter, see 3GPP TS 36.321. This parameter is optional. The value NOT_CFG indicates that this parameter is not configured. This parameter applies only to NB-IoT.

parameters.name: Power ramping step
parameters.description: Indicates the step by which the TX power for random access preambles is increased each time after a RACH access failure. If multiple access attempts over the PRACH fail, the UE increases the TX power for random access preambles by a step specified by this parameter each time after an access failure to ensure successful access. For details, see 3GPP TS 36.321.

parameters.name: Preamble Initial Received Target Power
parameters.description: Indicates the eNodeB-expected target receive power of PRACH preambles when PRACH preamble format 0 is used and the requirements for preamble detection performance are met. For NB-IoT cells, the values DBM_130(-130dBm), DBM_128(-128dBm), DBM_126(-126dBm), DBM_124(-124dBm), and DBM_122(-122dBm) are added to extend the lower power limit, and the values DBM_88(-88dBm), DBM_86(-86dBm), DBM_84(-84dBm),

parameters.id: Message size of select group A
parameters.name: Message size of select group A
parameters.description: Indicates the threshold for determining the size of Msg3 when a UE selects a preamble from random access preamble group A during a random access procedure. For details, see 3GPP TS 36.321. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: PRACH Frequency Offset
parameters.description: Indicates the offset for the starting frequency-domain position of PRACH RBs. The PrachFreqOffset parameter takes effect only when the PrachFreqOffsetStrategy parameter is set to MANUAL or the PucchSwitch option of the PucchAlgoSwitch parameter is deselected for an LTE FDD cell whose PrachFreqOffsetStrategy is not set to FULLY_AUTOMATIC. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: Indication of PRACH Configuration Index
parameters.description: Indicates whether to configure a PRACH configuration index for a cell. If an LTE TDD cell is established on an LBBPc, the PRACH configuration index configured for the cell does not take effect. When the eMTC function takes effect, this parameter does not take effect. In this case, LTE PRACH configurations will be reconfigured, and the PRACH configuration index is determined by eNodeB based on the

parameters.name: PRACH Configuration Index
parameters.description: Indicates the PRACH configuration index of a cell. If cells are established on an LBBPc in a 4T4R scenario, the PRACH configuration indexes of these cells must be staggered in the time domain. If a cell is an ultra-high-speed cell and HighSpeedR14Switch is set to ON, the value of this parameter takes effect only for the 3GPP-defined IE prach-ConfigIndex, but not for the 3GPP-defined IE prach-Confi

parameters.name: Maximum number of preamble transmission
parameters.description: Indicates the maximum number of preamble transmission times. For details about this parameter, see 3GPP TS 36.321.

parameters.name: Timer for contention resolution
parameters.description: Indicates the period that a UE waits for message 4 (Msg4) during a random access (RA) procedure. This timer starts when a UE initially sends or resends message 3 (Msg3). If the UE receives Msg4 or the NACK to Msg3 before the timer expires, the timer stops. If the UE does not receive either message until the timer expires, the RA fails, and the UE must reinitiate an RA procedure. For details about

parameters.id: Maximum number of Msg3 HARQ transmissions
parameters.name: Maximum number of Msg3 HARQ transmissions
parameters.description: Indicates the maximum number of HARQ retransmissions of the message 3. For details about this parameter, see 3GPP TS 36.321. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: Random Preamble Ratio
parameters.description: Indicates the proportion of the number of random preambles in a cell to the number of preambles in the cell. The number of random preambles in a cell is calculated by this parameter value multiplied by the number of preambles in the cell. Preambles in a cell can be classified as random preambles and dedicated preambles, which are used for contention-based random access and non-contention-based ran

parameters.id: Random Access preamble Group A Ratio
parameters.name: Random Access preamble Group A Ratio
parameters.description: Indicates the proportion of the number of group A random preambles in a cell to the number of random preambles in the cell. The number of group A random preambles in a cell is calculated by this parameter value multiplied by the number of random preambles in the cell. Preambles in a cell can be classified as random preambles and dedicated preambles, and random preambles are classified into group A

parameters.name: PRACH Frequency Offset Strategy
parameters.description: Indicates the policy of determining the PRACH frequency-domain offset. If this parameter is set to AUTOMATIC(AUTOMATIC) or FULLY_AUTOMATIC(FULLY_AUTOMATIC), the eNodeB determines the PRACH frequency-domain offset. If this parameter is set to MANUAL(MANUAL), the PRACH frequency-domain offset is specified by the PrachFreqOffset parameter. In an LTE FDD cell, the eNodeB determines the PRACH frequency

parameters.name: NB-IoT Cyclic Prefix Length
parameters.description: Indicates the PRACH cyclic prefix length, which supports 66.7 us and 266.7 us. This parameter applies only to NB-IoT.

parameters.name: NB-IoT RSRP First Threshold
parameters.description: Indicates the RSRP level-1 threshold. When the measured RSRP value of a UE is higher than the RSRP level-1 threshold, the UE initiates random access in the cell at coverage level 0. When the measured RSRP value of a UE is between the RSRP level-1 threshold and RSRP level-2 threshold, the UE initiates random access in the cell at coverage level 1. When the measured RSRP value of a UE is lower than

parameters.name: NB-IoT RSRP Second Threshold
parameters.description: Indicates the RSRP level-2 threshold. When the measured RSRP value of a UE is higher than the RSRP level-1 threshold, the UE initiates random access in the cell at coverage level 0. When the measured RSRP value of a UE is between the RSRP level-1 threshold and RSRP level-2 threshold, the UE initiates random access in the cell at coverage level 1. When the measured RSRP value of a UE is lower than

parameters.id: UE RACH Information Report Ratio Threshold
parameters.name: UE RACH Information Report Ratio Threshold
parameters.description: Indicates the threshold of the proportion of the number of random access messages reported by the UE to the number of successful UE access attempts. RACH resource adjustment is not triggered when the proportion is smaller than the threshold.

parameters.id: VoLTE Handover Random Preamble Power Offset
parameters.name: VoLTE Handover Random Preamble Power Offset
parameters.description: Indicates the offset of the target power of preambles sent by VoLTE UEs to be handed over and initially received by the eNodeB to the target power of preambles sent by non-VoLTE UEs and initially received by the eNodeB. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: eMTC PRACH Period
parameters.description: Indicates the eMTC PRACH period. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: NB-IoT Path Loss Coefficient
parameters.description: Indicates the path loss coefficient, which is used in the uplink power control for SR transmission during non-contention-based random access. For details, see 3GPP TS 36.213. This parameter applies only to NB-IoT.

parameters.name: NB-IoT SR P0
parameters.description: Indicates the eNodeB-expected target transmit power for SR transmission during non-contention-based random access. The expected transmit power is for normal PRACH demodulation. For details, see 3GPP TS 36.213. This parameter applies only to NB-IoT.

parameters.name: Zero correlation zone config
parameters.description: Indicates the length index for the Zadoff-Chu sequence that generates random access preambles. When this parameter is set to 0, the number of preambles generated by a root sequence is 1. For details about this parameter, see 3GPP TS 36.211. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: RAT frequency priority group ID
parameters.description: Indicates the ID of the RAT/frequency priority group. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: RAT Type
parameters.description: Indicates the Radio Access Technology (RAT). This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: DL Earfcn or Bandclass
parameters.description: Indicates the downlink frequency. In CDMA2000, this parameter indicates the bandclass. Before configuring a priority for a frequency specified by this parameter, ensure that an external or local cell operating on this frequency has been configured. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: Priority
parameters.description: Indicates the priority of the intra-RAT frequency band or frequency. The value 0 indicates the lowest priority. The value of this parameter must be determined together with the priorities of other frequencies during the network planning. Cell reselection priorities in different RATs cannot be the same. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: GERAN Frequency Indicator
parameters.description: Indicates the GERAN frequency band. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: Inter-Frequency Offload UE Number Threshold
parameters.description: Indicates the UE number threshold used for SPID-specific inter-frequency offload. When user-number-based MLB is triggered in a cell operating on a specified frequency and the number of UEs in the cell is greater than this parameter value, the eNodeB attempts to transfer UEs with the specific SPID from the local cell to inter-frequency neighboring cells. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and L

parameters.name: UE Number Offload Prohibition Threshold
parameters.description: Indicates the UE number threshold for prohibiting admission of UEs with the specified SPID. If the number of UEs in a cell on a specified frequency is greater than or equal to this parameter value, the eNodeB prohibits the transfer of UEs with the specific SPID to the local cell. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: Inter-RAT Offload UE Number Threshold
parameters.description: Indicates the user number threshold used for SPID-specific inter-RAT offload. When the number of uplink-synchronized (UL-sync) UEs in a local cell is greater than or equal to this threshold, the eNodeB attempts to transfer UEs with the specific SPID to inter-RAT neighboring cells. When the number of UL-sync UEs in the local cell is greater than or equal to the sum of the cell-level user number thr

parameters.name: Frequency Priority for Connected Mode
parameters.description: Indicates the frequency priority for the connected mode. Operators can configure different frequency priorities for the connected mode by PLMN. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: Forward Counter Index
parameters.description: Indicates the counter index related to the data forwarded. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: PCC Mobile Country Code
parameters.description: Indicates the mobile country code of the PCC mapped to the counter index related to the data forwarded. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: PCC Mobile Network Code
parameters.description: Indicates the mobile network code of the PCC mapped to the counter index related to the data forwarded. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: SCC Mobile Country Code
parameters.description: Indicates the mobile country code of the SCC mapped to the counter index related to the data forwarded. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: SCC Mobile Network Code
parameters.description: Indicates the mobile network code of the SCC mapped to the counter index related to the data forwarded. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: RCS Server No.
parameters.description: Indicates the number of an RCS server.

parameters.name: RCS Server Name
parameters.description: Indicates the name of an RCS server. An RCS client searches for the RCS server on the network based on this RCS server name. Upon finding the RCS server, the RCS client establishes a connection with the RCS server. If the RCS server is a DCU, this parameter must be set to the NE name of the DCU.

parameters.name: RCS Connection Port List
parameters.description: Indicates the list of ports that are connected to external NEs.

parameters.name: Extended QoS Class Indication
parameters.description: Indicates the extended QCI of an E-RAB on an RRN. After an RRN successfully accesses the network, the eNodeB sets up a bearer with the extended QCI specified by this parameter for the RRN. QCIs 65, 66, 69, 70, 75, and 79 are standardized QCIs, and therefore values 65, 66, 69, 70, 75, and 79 are not recommended for this parameter. Otherwise, services of these QCIs are affected. This parameter appli

parameters.name: Default Bearer Indication
parameters.description: Indicates whether a bearer on an RRN is a default bearer. A maximum of one default bearer can be configured for an RRN. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: RLC PDCP parameter group ID
parameters.description: Indicates the ID of an RLC/PDCP parameter group. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: Schedule Type
parameters.description: Indicates the scheduling type of E-RABs of an RRN. The value PQ indicates that scheduling based on the absolute priority is adopted for a bearer. The value WFQ indicates that fair scheduling based on the value of the UlSchWeight or DlSchWeight parameter in the RelayExtendedQci MO is adopted for a bearer. This scheduling type is used for service data carried on the RRN. The value WFQ_L2OM indicates

parameters.name: Uplink Schedule Weight
parameters.description: Indicates the weight factor of uplink scheduling resource allocation for bearers with the scheduling type of WFQ. This parameter is valid when the SchedulingType parameter is set to WFQ or WFQ_L2OM. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: Downlink Schedule Weight
parameters.description: Indicates the weight factor of downlink scheduling resource allocation for bearers with the scheduling type of WFQ. This parameter is valid when the SchedulingType parameter is set to WFQ or WFQ_L2OM. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: Dscp Lower
parameters.description: Indicates the lower limit of the DSCP value contained in the IP packets mapped to a bearer on an RRN. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: Dscp Upper
parameters.description: Indicates the upper limit of the DSCP value contained in the IP packets mapped to a bearer on an RRN. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: RRN Pre-allocation Weight
parameters.description: Indicates the service preallocation weight of the RRN. If the SchedulingType parameter is set to PQ, the preallocation weight of services corresponding to the priority queuing (PQ) is used. If the SchedulingType parameter is set to WFQ or WFQ_L2OM, the preallocation weight of services corresponding to the largest weighted fair queuing (WFQ) is used. Preallocation possibilities are proportional to

parameters.name: PQ Type
parameters.description: Indicates the PQ bearer type when the SchType parameter is set to PQ(PQ). The value L3PQ indicates the PQ bearer of L3 Relay. The value L2OM indicates the RRN O&M PQ bearer of L2 Relay. The value L2HIGH indicates the high-priority PQ bearer of L2 Relay. The value L2LOW indicates the low-priority PQ bearer of L2 Relay. A maximum of one bearer of each type can be configured. This parameter applies o

parameters.name: Cabinet No.
parameters.description: Indicates the number of the cabinet where the RHUB is located.

parameters.name: Subrack No.
parameters.description: Indicates the number of the subrack where the RHUB is located.

parameters.name: Slot No.
parameters.description: Indicates the number of the slot where the RHUB is located.

parameters.name: RRU Chain No.
parameters.description: Indicates the ID of the RHUB chain. It uniquely identifies a chain within a base station.

parameters.name: RHUB Position
parameters.description: Indicates the position of the RHUB on the RRU chain/ring. It is calculated from the start port one by one.

parameters.name: RHUB Name
parameters.description: Indicates the name of the RHUB.

parameters.name: Location Name
parameters.description: Indicates the location information of an RHUB. Set this parameter to the location name of the site. The location name of the site is configured in a Location MO. Location names must be set to the same value for RF modules serving the same sector.

parameters.name: Ethernet Port 0 Rate
parameters.description: Indicates whether to configure the data rate of Ethernet port 0 on the RHUB. DISABLE indicates that the port is not used. You can set this parameter to other values to specify the data rate of this port.

parameters.name: Ethernet Port 1 Rate
parameters.description: Indicates whether to configure the data rate of Ethernet port 1 on the RHUB. DISABLE indicates that the port is not used. You can set this parameter to other values to specify the data rate of this port.

parameters.name: Ethernet Port 2 Rate
parameters.description: Indicates whether to configure the data rate of Ethernet port 2 on the RHUB. DISABLE indicates that the port is not used. You can set this parameter to other values to specify the data rate of this port.

parameters.name: Ethernet Port 3 Rate
parameters.description: Indicates whether to configure the data rate of Ethernet port 3 on the RHUB. DISABLE indicates that the port is not used. You can set this parameter to other values to specify the data rate of this port.

parameters.name: Maintenance Mode
parameters.description: Indicates the maintenance mode of an RHUB. The value INSTALL indicates device creation caused by network capability expansion, device reparenting, or access of a new device to the network. The value EXPAND indicates the subrack or carrier capacity expansion of a device. The value UPGRADE indicates a device upgrade. The value TESTING indicates that an installed device is being commissioned. ExpandS

parameters.name: Start Time of Status Setting
parameters.description: Indicates the start time of maintenance status of the RHUB. This time refers to the local time (including the DST offset) on the NE. If this parameter is not specified, the start time of the maintenance status is 2000-01-01 00:00:00.

parameters.name: End Time of Status Setting
parameters.description: Indicates the end time of maintenance status of the RHUB. This time refers to the local time (including the DST offset) on the NE. If this parameter is not specified, the maintenance status ends at 2037-12-31 23:59:59.

parameters.name: Maintenance Mode Setting Remark
parameters.description: Indicates the remarks of maintenance status of the RHUB.

parameters.name: RHUB Specification
parameters.description: Indicates the type of an RHUB. This parameter needs to be set only when the MAE-Deployment is used for offline configuration. If this parameter is not set, the operation of the entire base station is not affected. Set this parameter based on the actual RHUB hardware type. The MAE-Deployment verifies the configuration based on the actual RHUB type. The MAE-Deployment can identify configuration erro

parameters.name: Alarm Status(from RU)
parameters.description: Indicates the alarm status of the board hardware, which can be set to Normal, Warning, Minor, Major, or Critical. The alarm status of the PSU, PDB, and BDU is in the alarm status of the PMU.

parameters.name: Operational State(from RU)
parameters.description: Indicates the operational state of the board, which can be set to Enabled or Disabled. Enabled indicates that services can be carried on the board. Disabled indicates that no service can be carried on the board.

parameters.name: Availability Status(from RU)
parameters.description: Indicates the physical status of a board, which can be Uninstalled, Starting up, Normal, Inconsistent, Unconfigured, Power off, Fault, Communication lost, In test, or the combination of multiple states. For example, if a board is not configured and fails to communicate with the main control and transmission board, the availability status of the board is "Unconfigured, Communication lost." If a boa

parameters.name: Electronic Label(from RU)
parameters.description: Indicates the electronic label, which is a text file with a maximum of 2 KB used to record the manufacturing information about equipment such as the board, sub-board, and optical module. "BoardType" indicates the type of the board. "BarCode" indicates the bar code of the board and is the same as the code labeled on the board. "Item" indicates the BOM code. "Description" indicates the board descrip

parameters.name: Type(from RU)
parameters.description: Indicates the type of the board or the cabinet.

parameters.name: Serial Number(from RU)
parameters.description: Indicates the bar code of the board or the cabinet.

parameters.name: Description(from RU)
parameters.description: Indicates the description about the services and functions provided by the board or the cabinet.

parameters.name: Date of Manufacture(from RU)
parameters.description: Indicates the manufacturing date of the board or the cabinet.

parameters.name: Vendor(from RU)
parameters.description: Indicates the manufacturer of the board or the cabinet.

parameters.name: Issue Number(from RU)
parameters.description: Indicates the issue number of the board.

parameters.name: Config Type(from RU)
parameters.description: Indicates the type of a board.

parameters.name: Board Temperature(from RU)
parameters.description: Indicates the temperature of a board.

parameters.name: HPA Temperature(from RU)
parameters.description: Indicates the temperature of the power amplifier. A power amplifier is a component on an RF module. If there is no power amplifier on an RF module, this parameter value is NULL.

parameters.name: DEVTYPE(from RU)
parameters.description: Indicates the type of the device.

parameters.name: Software Version(from RU)
parameters.description: Indicates the software version of the board.

parameters.name: Hardware Version(from RU)
parameters.description: Indicates the hardware version of the board.

parameters.name: BootROM Version(from RU)
parameters.description: Indicates the BootROM version of the board.

parameters.name: WorkMode(from RU)
parameters.description: Indicates the working mode of the board. the value SINGLEOM indicates that the GTMU works as the main control board and provides the main control, transmission, and RF port functions. The value EVOLUTION indicates that the GTMU works as the evolved board and provides the transmission and RF port functions. NORMAL indicates that the main control and transmission board works in normal mode. TDS-EVOL

parameters.name: RLC PDCP parameter group ID
parameters.description: Indicates the ID of the RLC/PDCP parameter group.

parameters.name: Discard timer
parameters.description: Indicates the length of the PDCP discard timer. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD. For NSA DC UEs for which the NsaDcDefaultBearerMode parameter in the CellQciPara MO is not set to MCG_BEARER_EUTRA_PDCP and E-UTRA/5GC UEs, this parameter can be set to any value and the configured value takes effect. For other UEs, the following values do not take effect: DiscardTimer_10, DiscardTi

parameters.name: RLC-UM or RLC-AM mode
parameters.description: Indicates the RLC transmission mode. Only the AM and UM modes are available. In NB-IoT, the RCL protocols support only the AM mode. This parameter must be set to RlcMode_AM if RLC-related parameters are required in NB-IoT.

parameters.name: MaxretxThreshold for UE
parameters.description: Indicates the maximum number of RLC ARQ retransmissions for UEs, which limits the maximum number of AM PDU retransmissions. When the number of RCL ARQ retransmissions reaches the parameter value, an RRC connection reestablishment procedure is initiated. This option applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: MaxRetxThreshold for eNodeB
parameters.description: Indicates the maximum number of RLC ARQ retransmissions for the eNodeB, which limits the maximum number of AM PDU retransmissions. When the number of RLC ARQ retransmissions reaches the parameter value, the eNodeB releases the UE. This option applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: PollByte for UE
parameters.description: Indicates the UE-specific data volume threshold of PDUs to trigger polling. When the transmitted data volume reaches the value of this parameter, the Poll flag is set in the PDU header. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: PollByte for eNodeB
parameters.description: Indicates the eNodeB-specific data volume threshold of PDUs to trigger polling. When the transmitted data volume reaches the value of this parameter, the Poll flag is set in the PDU header. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: PollPdu for UE
parameters.description: Indicates the UE-specific number of PDUs to trigger polling. When the transmitted number of PDUs reaches the value of this parameter, the Poll flag is set in the PDU header. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: PollPdu for eNodeB
parameters.description: Indicates the eNodeB-specific number of PDUs to trigger polling. When the transmitted number of PDUs reaches the value of this parameter, the Poll flag is set in the PDU header. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: Poll retransmit timer for UE
parameters.description: Indicates the length of the Polling PDU retransmission timer for the UE. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: Poll retransmit timer for eNodeB
parameters.description: Indicates the length of the Polling PDU retransmission timer for the eNodeB. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: Status prohibit timer for UE
parameters.description: Indicates the length of the UE-specific timer for prohibiting status reporting from the receiver in AM. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: Status prohibit timer for eNodeB
parameters.description: Indicates the length of the eNodeB-specific timer for prohibiting status reporting from the receiver in AM. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: AM reordering timer for UE
parameters.description: Indicates the length of the UE-specific timer for reordering at the receiver in AM.

parameters.name: AM reordering timer for eNodeB
parameters.description: Indicates the length of the eNodeB-specific timer for reordering at the receiver in AM.

parameters.name: UM PDCP-SN size
parameters.description: Indicates the length of a PDCP sequence number of an uplink or downlink DRB in RLC UM. For NSA DC UEs for which the NsaDcDefaultBearerMode parameter in the CellQciPara MO is not set to MCG_BEARER_EUTRA_PDCP and E-UTRA/5GC UEs, the parameter value PdcpSnsize_7bits does not take effect. For other UEs, the parameter value PdcpSnsize_18bits does not take effect. When the configured parameter value doe

parameters.name: Uplink RLC-SN size
parameters.description: Indicates the length of a UL RLC sequence number in UM. The length is permanently 10 bits in AM. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: Downlink RLC-SN size
parameters.description: Indicates the length of a downlink RLC sequence number. In AM mode, the parameter value RlcSnSize_size5 does not take effect and the eNodeB automatically replaces it with RlcSnSize_size10. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: UM reordering timer for UE
parameters.description: Indicates the length of the UE-specific timer for reordering at the receiver in UM. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: UM reordering timer for eNodeB
parameters.description: Indicates the length of the eNodeB-specific timer for reordering at the receiver in UM. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.id: AM PDCP status report required indication
parameters.name: AM PDCP status report required indication
parameters.description: Indicates whether a PDCP status report is required upon handover in AM. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: RLC Parameter Adaptive Switch
parameters.description: Indicates whether to enable adaptive configuration of parameters related to Radio Link Control (RLC). If this parameter is set to ON, the eNodeB adaptively configures the eNodeB- and UE-specific polling PDU retransmission timer and eNodeB- and UE-specific timer for prohibiting status reporting for UEs that access the eNodeB after the parameter is set. When the number of UEs in a cell exceeds a cer

parameters.name: Preset eNodeB Poll Retransmit Timer
parameters.description: Indicates the length of the Polling PDU retransmission timer for the eNodeB when the RlcParaAdaptSwitch parameter is set to ON and the number of UEs on the network is large. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: Preset eNodeB Status Prohibit Timer
parameters.description: Indicates the length of the eNodeB-specific timer for prohibiting status reporting from the receiver when the RlcParaAdaptSwitch parameter is set to ON and the number of UEs on the network is large. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: Preset UE Poll Retransmit Timer
parameters.description: Indicates the length of the Polling PDU retransmission timer for the UE when the RlcParaAdaptSwitch parameter is set to ON and the number of UEs on the network is large. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: Preset UE Status Prohibit Timer
parameters.description: Indicates the length of the UE-specific timer for prohibiting status reporting when the RlcParaAdaptSwitch parameter is set to ON and the number of UEs on the network is large. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: Nonsupport Um UE Adaptive Switch
parameters.description: Indicates whether the eNodeB is compatible with the UE that does not support the RLC transmission in unacknowledged mode (UM) mode. Assume that an eNodeB configures the RLC transmission mode to UM mode for QCI 1, 4, 6, 7, 8, or 9, and a UE that does not support the RLC transmission in UM mode attempts to set up bearers of the corresponding QCIs. If this switch is turned on, the eNodeB finds the QC

parameters.name: Discardtimer Separate Config Switch
parameters.description: Indicates whether to enable separate configuration of the PDCP discard timer for the uplink and downlink.

parameters.name: Downlink PDCP Discard Timer
parameters.description: Indicates the length of the downlink PDCP discard timer in the eNodeB. If PDCP packets have been buffered for a period longer than the timer length, the eNodeB discards the packets. This timer takes effect only on DRBs. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD. For NSA DC UEs for which the NsaDcDefaultBearerMode parameter in the CellQciPara MO is not set to MCG_BEARER_EUTRA_PDCP and E-UT

parameters.id: CA UE RLC Parameter Adaptive Threshold
parameters.name: CA UE RLC Parameter Adaptive Threshold
parameters.description: Indicates the threshold used for adaptive selection of RLC parameters for CA UEs. When the number of UEs connected to the PCell of a CA UE exceeds the threshold, the following parameters take effect on non-GBR bearers in RLC AM for the CA UE: UeAmReorderingTimer, ENodeBAmReorderingTimer, UeStatusProhibitTimer, and ENodeBStatusProhibitTimer. When the number does not exceed the threshold, the parame

parameters.name: CA UE Reordering Timer(ms)
parameters.description: Indicates the length of the reordering timer that applies to non-GBR bearers in RLC AM for CA UEs in the 2CC CA, 3CC CA, and relaxed-backhaul-based CA states in their PCell when the number of UEs in RRC_CONNECTED mode does not exceed the value of CaUeRlcParaAdptiveThd. This option applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: CA UE Status Prohibit Timer(ms)
parameters.description: Indicates the length of the status reporting prohibition timer that applies to non-GBR bearers in RLC AM for CA UEs in the 2CC CA, 3CC CA, and relaxed-backhaul-based CA states in their PCell when the number of UEs in RRC_CONNECTED mode does not exceed the value of CaUeRlcParaAdptiveThd. This option applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: AM Mode PDCP SN Length
parameters.description: Indicates the length of a PDCP sequence number in RLC AM. For NSA DC UEs and E-UTRA/5GC UEs, the parameter value AmPdcpSnsize_15bits does not take effect, and the eNodeB preferentially replaces this value with AmPdcpSnsize_18bits. The value that takes effect depends on capabilities of UEs. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: eNodeB Reordering Timer Adaptive
parameters.description: Indicates whether to enable eNodeB receiver-end reordering timer adaptation. The timer length adapts based on the uplink transmission mode (TTI bundling or non-TTI bundling) and the maximum number of uplink HARQ transmissions only if this parameter is set to ON. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: UE PDCP Reordering Timer
parameters.description: Indicates the length of the UE-specific timer for PDCP reordering. For details, see 3GPP TS 36.331. This parameter is used for detection of PDCP packet loss. If the timer expires, the PDCP packet is regarded as lost, triggering reordering. This parameter also indicates the length of the UE-specific timer for PDCP reordering when UEs are in the LTE-NR NSA DC state. This parameter is used for reorde

parameters.name: Category Type
parameters.description: Indicates the UE category type. Other parameters in this MO apply to LTE UEs, eMTC UEs in mode A, eMTC UEs in mode B, NB-IoT UEs, short TTI UEs, and E-UTRA/5GC UEs if this parameter is set to LTE, EMTC_MODE_A, EMTC_MODE_B, NBIOT, SHORT_TTI, and EUTRA_5GC respectively.

parameters.name: NB-IoT PDCP Discard Timer
parameters.description: Indicates the length of the PDCP discard timer. For details about this parameter, see 3GPP TS 36.323. This parameter applies only to NB-IoT.

parameters.name: NB-IoT Downlink PDCP Discard Timer
parameters.description: Indicates the length of the downlink PDCP discard timer in the eNodeB. If PDCP PDUs have been buffered for a period longer than the timer length, the eNodeB discards the PDUs. This timer takes effect only on DRBs. For details about this parameter, see 3GPP TS 36.323. This parameter applies only to NB-IoT.

parameters.id: NB-IoT Poll Retransmit Timer for eNodeB
parameters.name: NB-IoT Poll Retransmit Timer for eNodeB
parameters.description: Indicates the length of the Polling PDU retransmission timer for the eNodeB. For details about this parameter, see 3GPP TS 36.322. This parameter applies only to NB-IoT.

parameters.id: NB-IoT Poll Retransmit Timer for UE
parameters.name: NB-IoT Poll Retransmit Timer for UE
parameters.description: Indicates the length of the Polling PDU retransmission timer for the UE. For details about this parameter, see 3GPP TS 36.322. This parameter applies only to NB-IoT.

parameters.id: Max Retransmission Thld for NB-IoT eNodeB
parameters.name: Max Retransmission Thld for NB-IoT eNodeB
parameters.description: Indicates the maximum number of RLC ARQ retransmissions for the NB-IoT eNodeB, which limits the maximum number of RLC ARQ retransmissions in AM mode for the NB-IoT eNodeB. When the number of RLC ARQ retransmissions reaches the parameter value, the eNodeB releases the UE. This parameter applies only to NB-IoT.

parameters.id: Max Retransmission Thld for NB-IoT UE
parameters.name: Max Retransmission Thld for NB-IoT UE
parameters.description: Indicates the maximum number of RLC ARQ retransmissions for NB-IoT UEs, which limits the maximum number of RLC ARQ retransmissions in AM mode for NB-IoT UEs. When the number of RLC ARQ retransmissions reaches the parameter value, the UE initiates an RRC connection reestablishment procedure. This parameter applies only to NB-IoT.

parameters.name: DL Beyond 3CC UE Reordering Timer
parameters.description: Indicates the length of the reordering timer that applies to non-GBR bearers in RLC AM for CA UEs in intra-eNodeB CA or CA based on eNodeB coordination with more than three CCs aggregated when the number of UEs in RRC_CONNECTED mode is less than or equal to the value of the CaUeRlcParaAdptiveThd parameter in their PCell. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.id: DL Beyond 3CC UE Status Prohibit Timer
parameters.name: DL Beyond 3CC UE Status Prohibit Timer
parameters.description: Indicates the length of the status reporting prohibition timer that applies to non-GBR bearers in RLC AM for CA UEs in intra-eNodeB CA or CA based on eNodeB coordination with more than three CCs aggregated when the number of UEs in RRC_CONNECTED mode is less than or equal to the value of the CaUeRlcParaAdptiveThd parameter in their PCell. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: eNodeB PDCP Reordering Timer
parameters.description: Indicates the length of the eNodeB-specific timer for PDCP reordering when UEs are in the LTE-NR NSA DC state. This parameter is used for reordering PDCP packets in the two data flows based on the sequence numbers before these packets are transmitted to the upper layer. This parameter also indicates the length of the eNodeB-specific timer for PDCP reordering when UEs connect to the 5GC. For detail

parameters.id: PDCP Out Of Order Delivery Indication
parameters.name: PDCP Out Of Order Delivery Indication
parameters.description: Indicates whether the NR PDCP is allowed to send out-of-order packets to the upper layer. If this parameter is set to TRUE, the NR PDCP receive end can directly deliver packets to the upper layer without reordering them. If this parameter is set to FALSE, the NR PDCP receive end must reorder these packets by the PDCP sequence numbers before these packets are transmitted to the upper layer. For det

parameters.name: eNodeB PDCP Reordering Switch
parameters.description: Indicates whether the base station supports PDCP reordering for NSA UEs in the following scenarios: 1. The NsaDcDefaultBearerMode parameter is set to MCG_BEARER. 2. The NsaDcDefaultBearerMode parameter is set to MCG_SPLIT_BEARER and no SCGs are added for the UEs. 3. The NsaDcDefaultBearerMode parameter is set to SCG_SPLIT_BEARER and no SCGs are added for the UEs. If this switch is turned on, the e

parameters.name: Local cell ID
parameters.description: Indicates the local cell ID. It uniquely identifies a cell within an eNodeB. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.id: RLF timer and constants group ID
parameters.name: RLF timer and constants group ID
parameters.description: Indicates the RLF timer and constants group ID. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: Timer 301
parameters.description: Indicates the length of the timer T301. For details, see 3GPP TS 36.331. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: Timer 310
parameters.description: Indicates the length of the timer T310. For details, see 3GPP TS 36.331. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: Timer 311
parameters.description: Indicates the length of the timer T311. For details, see 3GPP TS 36.331. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: Constant N310
parameters.description: Indicates the maximum number of successive "out of sync" indications received from L1. For details, see 3GPP TS 36.331. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: Constant N311
parameters.description: Indicates the maximum number of successive "in sync" indications received from L1. For details, see 3GPP TS 36.331. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: CE Timer 301
parameters.description: Indicates the length of the timer 301 in coverage enhancement mode. For details, see 3GPP TS 36.331. This timer is started when the UE sends the RRCConnectionReestabilshmentRequest message. Before the timer expires, it is stopped if the UE receives an RRCConnectionReestablishment or RRCConnectionReestablishmentReject message. After the timer expires, the UE enters the RRC_IDLE state. This option a

parameters.name: Timer 310 in CE Mode
parameters.description: Indicates the length of the timer T310 of the cell in coverage enhancement (CE) mode. For details, see 3GPP TS 36.331. This timer is started for a UE when the UE detects a fault at the physical layer. The timer is stopped if the UE detects the physical layer fault recovery, triggers a handover procedure, or initiates a reestablishment before the timer expires. After the timer expires, the UE enter

parameters.name: Timer 311 in CE Mode
parameters.description: Indicates the length of the timer T311 of the cell in coverage enhancement (CE) mode. For details, see 3GPP TS 36.331. This timer is started when the UE starts an RRC connection reestablishment. The timer is stopped if the UE selects an E-UTRAN or inter-RAT cell to camp on before the timer expires. After the timer expires, the UE enters the RRC_IDLE state. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD an

parameters.name: Timer302
parameters.description: Indicates the length of the timer T302. T302 specifies the time during which a UE whose RRC connection request is rejected has to wait before the UE can initiate a request again. This timer starts when the UE receives an RRCConnectionReject message and stops when the UE enters the RRC_CONNECTED mode or performs cell reselection. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: Timer320 for load balance
parameters.description: Indicates the length of the timer contained in the RRC connection release message when an RRC connection release procedure is triggered for MLB. This timer specifies the length of a period during which cell-reselection priorities contained in the RRC connection release message retain valid. After the timer expires, the cell-reselection priorities contained in the RRC connection release message bec

parameters.name: Timer304 for EUTRAN
parameters.description: Indicates the length of the timer T304 for intra-RAT handover. If the UE does not complete the handover before this timer expires, the UE reverts to the associated configuration and initiates an RRC connection reestablishment procedure. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: Timer304 for GERAN
parameters.description: Indicates the length of the timer T304 for inter-RAT handover to GERAN. If the UE does not complete the handover before this timer expires, the UE reverts to the associated configuration and initiates an RRC connection re-establishment procedure. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: Timer320 for other
parameters.description: Indicates the length of the timer contained in the RRC connection release message when an RRC connection release procedure is triggered for reasons other than MLB. This timer specifies the length of a period during which cell-reselection priorities contained in the RRC connection release message retain valid. After the timer expires, the cell-reselection priorities contained in the RRC connection

parameters.name: NB-IoT Ue inactive timer
parameters.description: Indicates the length of the UE inactivity timer for NB-IoT UEs. If the eNodeB detects that an NB-IoT UE has neither received nor sent data for a duration exceeding the value of this parameter, the eNodeB releases the RRC connection for the NB-IoT UE. This parameter takes effect only for UEs that will access the network after the parameter is set. This parameter applies only to NB-IoT.

parameters.name: Filter Repeated RRCConnReq Timer
parameters.description: Indicates the length of the timer for the eNodeB to filter repeated RRC Connection Request messages. For LTE FDD and LTE TDD, the actually used timer length is the sum of the length of T300 timer and the value of the FilterReptRrcConnReqTimer parameter. For NB-IoT, the actually used timer length is equal to min{T300 + FilterReptRrcConnReqTimer, MaxFilterTimer}. In V100R015C10 or an earlier version

parameters.name: Uplink Sync Timer Dynamic DRX
parameters.description: Indicates the timer used to govern the period in which the eNodeB maintains uplink synchronization for a DRX UE when dynamic DRX is enabled. After this timer expires, the eNodeB does not send Timing Advance Command to the UE. You are advised to set this parameter to a value less than the value of UeInactivityTimerDynDrxQci in the QciPara MO. In power saving mode, you are advised to set this parame

parameters.name: RRC Connection Release Timer
parameters.description: Indicates the time that the eNodeB waits for a response message after sending an RRC Connection Release message to a UE.

parameters.id: RRC Connection Release Offset Timer in DRX
parameters.name: RRC Connection Release Offset Timer in DRX
parameters.description: Indicates the offset of the value of the RRC connection release timer that actually takes effect for UEs in the DRX state relative to the RrcConnRelTimer parameter value in the RrcConnStateTimer MO. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.id: RRC Connection Release Offset Timer For SRLTE
parameters.name: RRC Connection Release Offset Timer For SRLTE
parameters.description: Indicates the offset of the value of the RRC connection release timer that actually takes effect for SRLTE UEs relative to the RrcConnRelTimer parameter value in the RrcConnStateTimer MO. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: Extended Wait Time
parameters.description: Indicates the waiting time for a UE to send an RRCConnectionRequest message again in either of the following conditions: 1. After the previous RRC connection setup request with the cause value delayTolerantAccess initiated by the UE was rejected when the MME is overloaded 2. After the RRC connection was released for the cause delayTolerantAccess. In NB-IoT, this parameter is used when the MME is o

parameters.name: Power Preference Indication Timer
parameters.description: Indicates the waiting time for a UE reporting UEAssistanceInformation after the UE reports Power Preference Indication with the value normal. The duration ranges from 0 to 600 seconds. This option applies only to LTE FDD.

parameters.name: Repeated RRC Reest Protection Timer
parameters.description: Indicates the length of the protection timer of repeated RRC connection reestablishments. If this parameter is set to a non-zero value and the interval between RRC connection reestablishment requests repeatedly initiated by a UE is less than this parameter value, the repeated requests and successful reestablishments are not counted. If this parameter is set to 0, this function does not take effect

parameters.id: RRC Release Timer Offset for Out-of-Sync UE
parameters.name: RRC Release Timer Offset for Out-of-Sync UE
parameters.description: Indicates the offset of the value of the RRC connection release timer that actually takes effect for out-of-synchronization UEs relative to the RrcConnRelTimer parameter value in the RrcConnStateTimer MO.

parameters.name: Bandwidth Preference Indication Timer
parameters.description: Indicates the length of the timer during which UEs are prohibited from reporting the bw-Preference-r14 IE to the eNodeB. For details, see 3GPP TS 36.331. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: Voice UE Release Delay Timer
parameters.description: Indicates the delay release timer for a voice UE. The eNodeB checks whether the UE sends and receives data. After QCI-1 bearers are released, the UE context cannot be released until the timer expires. If this parameter is set to 0, the timer does not take effect. If this parameter is set to a value other than 0, the UE context cannot be released until the timer expires after the QCI-1 bearers are

parameters.id: eMTC RRC Connection Release Timer Offset
parameters.name: eMTC RRC Connection Release Timer Offset
parameters.description: Indicates the offset of the eMTC RRC connection release timer that takes effect relative to the value of the RrcConnRelTimer parameter in the RrcConnStateTimer MO. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: Local cell ID
parameters.description: Indicates the local ID of the cell. It uniquely identifies a cell within an eNodeB. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: Joint Channel Calibration Switch
parameters.description: Indicates whether to enable joint TX channel calibration for a 4T4R or 4T8R cell served by a combined RRU. If this parameter is set to ON for a cell, initial channel calibration is started after the cell is activated and then channel calibration is performed periodically for the cell. If this parameter is set to OFF for a cell, channel calibration is disabled for the cell. If the setting of this p

parameters.name: Joint Channel Periodic Calibration Time
parameters.description: Indicates the local time to perform periodic TX channel calibration in a cell with combined RRUs and four TX antennas. This parameter works together with the TxChnCalPeriod parameter to determine the time to perform periodic TX channel calibration. For details, see descriptions of the TxChnCalPeriod parameter. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: Joint Channel Calibration Period
parameters.description: Indicates the interval at which periodic TX channel calibration is performed in a cell with combined RRUs and four TX antennas. This parameter works together with the TxChnCalTime parameter to determine the time to perform periodic TX channel calibration. The following examples clarify the criteria: (1) If the TxChnCalTime parameter is set to 03:00:00 and the TxChnCalPeriod parameter is set to 48

parameters.name: Aau Passive Port Calibration Period
parameters.description: Indicates whether to enable AAU passive port channel calibration in 3D beamforming, RPCU-based SDA antenna channel calibration, and channel calibration for SDL cells, and also indicates the period for periodic calibration when calibration is enabled. The calibration is enabled only when this parameter is set to a non-zero value. If this parameter is set to 65535, the eNodeB performs periodic calib

parameters.name: Calibration Signal CINR
parameters.description: Indicates the carrier-to-interference-and-noise ratio (CINR) of calibrated signals between two RRUs. This parameter applies only to LTE TDD cells.

parameters.name: Calibration Signal RSSI
parameters.description: Indicates the received signal strength indicator (RSSI) of channel calibration signals between two RRUs. This parameter applies only to LTE TDD.

parameters.name: S1 ID
parameters.description: Indicates the S1 object ID.

parameters.name: CN Operator ID
parameters.description: Indicates the ID of the operator that owns the S1 object.

parameters.id: Control Plane End Point Group ID
parameters.name: Control Plane End Point Group ID
parameters.description: Indicates the ID of the control-plane endpoint group used by the S1 object.

parameters.id: User Plane End Point Group ID
parameters.name: User Plane End Point Group ID
parameters.description: Indicates the ID of the user-plane endpoint group used by the S1 object.

parameters.name: MME Release
parameters.description: Indicates the compliance protocol release of the MMEs to which the eNodeB is connected through the S1 interfaces under this S1 object. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: User Label
parameters.description: Indicates the description of the S1 object.

parameters.name: End Point Group Config Flag
parameters.description: Indicates whether to configure the control-plane or user-plane endpoint group.

parameters.name: MME Selection Priority
parameters.description: Indicates the priority of an MME to which the eNodeB is connected through the S1 interface. A large parameter value indicates a high priority. After this parameter is set for MMEs, the eNodeB can select a high-priority MME for UEs attempting to access the network.

parameters.name: CN Operator Sharing Group ID
parameters.description: Indicates the ID of a carrier-sharing operator group that shares the S1 MO. If the eNodeB works in hybrid RAN sharing mode, set this parameter to a value within the range from 0 to 5. If the eNodeB works in independent operator mode, RAN sharing with common carriers mode, or RAN sharing with dedicated carriers mode, retain the default value 255, which is an invalid value.

parameters.name: MME supporting MDT or not
parameters.description: Indicates whether the MME at the other end of the S1 interface supports Huawei-proprietary positioning procedures, which are included in minimization of drive tests (MDT). The value DISABLE(disable) indicates that the MME does not support the procedures and therefore the eNodeB cannot obtain UE location information from the MME through the procedures. The value ENABLE(enable) indicates the opposit

parameters.name: S1 Interface ID
parameters.description: Indicates the S1 interface ID.

parameters.name: S1 Interface State
parameters.description: Indicates the status of the S1 interface.

parameters.name: S1 Interface Is Block
parameters.description: Indicates whether the S1 interface is blocked. An S1 interface is blocked after the execution of BLK S1INTERFACE and is unblocked after the execution of UBL S1INTERFACE.

parameters.name: S1 Interface CP Bearer ID
parameters.description: Indicates the ID of the control port bearer for the S1 interface.

parameters.name: S1 Interface CP Bearer State
parameters.description: Indicates the status of the control port (CP) bearer for the S1 interface.

parameters.name: S1 Interface ID
parameters.description: Indicates the S1 interface ID. If the S1 interface is set up based on the endpoint configuration mode, the value range is 40000 to 65534. If the S1 interface is set up based on the link configuration mode using the MAE or MML commands, the recommended value range is 0 to 39999.

parameters.name: S1 Interface CP Bearer ID
parameters.description: Indicates the ID of the control port bearer for the S1 interface.

parameters.name: CN Operator ID
parameters.description: Indicates the ID of the operator that owns the S1 interface.

parameters.name: MME Release
parameters.description: Indicates the compliance protocol release of the MME to which the eNodeB is connected through the S1 interface. The eNodeB sends S1 messages complying with the protocol release specified by this parameter. The value of this parameter must be the same as the MME-complied protocol release. If the parameter value is different from the MME-complied protocol release, the way in which the MME handles th

parameters.name: S1 Interface Is Blocked
parameters.description: Indicates whether the S1 interface is blocked. An S1 interface is blocked after the execution of BLK S1INTERFACE and is unblocked after the execution of UBL S1INTERFACE.

parameters.name: Control Mode
parameters.description: Indicates the control mode of the S1 interface, which determines the control policies of operators and the SON functions on the S1 interface. This parameter is set by the system and cannot be modified by operators. If the S1 interface was set up by operators by using the MAE or MML commands, this parameter is set to MANUAL_MODE and operators can configure the interface. If the S1 interface was set

parameters.name: Auto Config Flag
parameters.description: Indicates whether the S1 interface was created automatically or manually. This parameter is set by the system and cannot be modified by operators. The system sets this parameter to AUTO_CREATED when the S1 interface was created automatically using SON and to MANUAL_CREATED when the S1 interface was created manually by using the MAE or running MML commands.

parameters.name: MME Selection Priority
parameters.description: Indicates the priority of an MME to which the eNodeB is connected through the S1 interface. A large parameter value indicates a high priority. After this parameter is set for MMEs, the eNodeB can select a high-priority MME for UEs attempting to access the network.

parameters.name: CN Operator Sharing Group ID
parameters.description: Indicates the ID of a carrier-sharing operator group that shares the S1Interface MO. If the eNodeB works in hybrid RAN sharing mode, set this parameter to a value within the range from 0 to 5. If the eNodeB works in independent operator mode, RAN sharing with common carriers mode, or RAN sharing with dedicated carriers mode, retain the default value 255, which is an invalid value.

parameters.name: Served GUMMEIs
parameters.description: Indicates the Global Unique MME Identifiers (GUMMEIs) of all MMEs to which the eNodeB is connected. A GUMMEI of a serving MME consists of the MCC, MNC, MME group ID, and MME code. GUMMEIs are separated by commas (,).

parameters.name: S1 Interface State
parameters.description: Indicates the status of the S1 interface.

parameters.name: S1 CP Bearer State
parameters.description: Indicates the status of the control port bearer for the S1 interface.

parameters.name: MME Is Overloaded
parameters.description: Indicates whether the MME connected to the eNodeB over the S1 interface is overloaded. This parameter is valid after the S1 interface is established. Before the S1 interface is established, the MME load status is NULL. For details about the MME load status after the S1 interface is established, see 3GPP TS 36.413.

parameters.name: S1 Interface User Number
parameters.description: Indicates the number of users that have accessed the S1 interface.

parameters.name: MME Name
parameters.description: Indicates the name of the MME to which the eNodeB is connected through the S1 interface. This parameter is valid after the S1 interface is established and the MME name is contained in the S1 interface establishing response message or the MME configuration update message. In other conditions, the parameter value is NULL. For details, see 3GPP TS 36.413.

parameters.name: Served PLMNs
parameters.description: Indicates the IDs of all served PLMNs of the MME to which the eNodeB is connected. The ID of a served PLMN consists of the MCC and MNC. PLMN IDs are separated by commas (,).

parameters.name: MME Relative Capacity
parameters.description: Indicates the capacity of the connected MME relative to that of other MMEs. A larger value of this parameter indicates a larger capacity allowing UE access.

parameters.name: S1 Interface Fault Reason
parameters.description: Indicates the reason of the fault on the S1 link.

parameters.name: S1 reestablish min timer length
parameters.description: Indicates the minimum length of the S1 re-establishment timer.

parameters.name: S1 reestablish max timer length
parameters.description: Indicates the maximum length of the S1 re-establishment timer.

parameters.name: Application Index
