parameters.description: Indicates the index of an application. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: Application DNS
parameters.description: Indicates the domain name of the to-be-identified application or website. This parameter must be set only if the AppIdentType parameter is set to DNS. A single domain name specified by the AppDns parameter can be repeatedly configured for auxiliary application domain names associated with different main domain names. In other cases, it is not recommended that a single domain name be repeatedly con

parameters.name: Match Rule
parameters.description: Indicates the rule for matching a to-be-identified application (for example, a video) with the domain name. The service classification (SC) function uses the domain name to identify an application in two methods. If this parameter is set to Query, the query method is applied. If the IP address that a UE attempts to visit and a configured domain name match, the UE can obtain the service type (video

parameters.name: Application Name
parameters.description: Indicates the name of the to-be-identified application or website. For YouTube, Dailymotion, and Vimeo, the code rate can be correctly identified only if the parameter is set to YouTube, Dailymotion, and Vimeo_HLS, respectively, which are case-insensitive. The value NULL is invalid, and this parameter cannot be set to NULL. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: Application Identification Type
parameters.description: Indicates the application identification method. If the AppIdentType parameter is set to DNS, the AppDns parameter must be set. If the AppIdentType parameter is set to IPv4, the AppIpv4 parameter must be set. If the AppIdentType parameter is set to IPv6, the AppIpv6 parameter must be set. You are advised to set the IP address for an application when the application is not configured with a domain

parameters.name: Application IPv4
parameters.description: Indicates the IPv4 address of an application, which is used for application (website) identification based on IP addresses. This parameter must be set only if the AppIdentType parameter is set to IPv4. A single IPv4 address specified by the AppIpv4 parameter can be repeatedly configured for auxiliary application domain names associated with different main domain names. In other cases, it is not re

parameters.name: Application IPv6
parameters.description: Indicates the IPv6 address of an application, which is used for application (website) identification based on IP addresses. This parameter must be set only if the AppIdentType parameter is set to IPv6. A single IPv6 address specified by the AppIpv6 parameter can be repeatedly configured for auxiliary application domain names associated with different main domain names. In other cases, it is not re

parameters.name: Application Config Target Indicator
parameters.description: Indicates whether the configured DNS or IP address can be used for video service identification, air interface acceleration guarantee for network services, service tracing, or low-delay service identification. VideoIdentInd: The configured DNS or IP address is used for video service identification only when this option is selected. AccelerateInd: The configured DNS, IP address, or TCP port is used

parameters.name: Main Application DNS Flag
parameters.description: Indicates whether the domain name or IP address configured for acceleration guarantee is a main or auxiliary domain name or IP address. The value Null is invalid. This parameter takes effect only when the AccelerateInd option of the AppCfgTargetInd parameter in the ScAppParaCfg MO is selected. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: Accelerate Service Para Group ID
parameters.description: Indicates the ID of the acceleration guarantee parameter group. The value 255 is invalid. This parameter takes effect if both the following conditions are met: (1) The AccelerateInd option of the AppCfgTargetInd parameter in the ScAppParaCfg MO is selected. (2) The MainAppDnsFlag parameter in the ScAppParaCfg MO is set to Main or the AppIdentType parameter in the ScAppParaCfg MO is set to TCPPORT

parameters.name: Main Application DNS ID
parameters.description: Indicates the main application index corresponding to the configured domain name or IP address. The value 65535 is invalid. This parameter takes effect only when the AccelerateInd option of the AppCfgTargetInd parameter in the ScAppParaCfg MO is selected and the MainAppDnsFlag parameter is set to Aid in the same MO. If this parameter is set to 100 or 101 or the associated AppIdentType parameter is

parameters.name: Service End Time Threshold
parameters.description: Indicates the service end time threshold used in service tracing. If this parameter is set to a value in the range from 1 to 255, the configured value takes effect. If this parameter is set to 0, the value 255 takes effect. This parameter takes effect only when the ServiceTraceInd or AccelerateInd option of the AppCfgTargetInd parameter in the ScAppParaCfg MO is selected. This parameter applies on

parameters.name: Port Number
parameters.description: Indicates the server port number used for SC-based UE identification. The value 0 is an invalid value and indicates that the eNodeB identifies only the default port number. If this parameter is set to a non-zero value, only the configured port number takes effect. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: Protocol Type
parameters.description: Indicates the type of protocol used for UE identification in SC. If this parameter is set to BOTH, both TCP and UDP apply. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: App Index
parameters.description: Indicates the application index. In the command output of DSP SCAPPINFO for querying applications supported by SC, each piece of displayed application DNS information has an index. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: Application DNS Info
parameters.description: Indicates the information about the domain name of the to-be-identified application, and it can contain only the following characters: lower-case letters (a to z), digits (0 to 9), wildcard character (*), hyphens (-), full stops (.), and at-signs (@). This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: App Desc
parameters.description: Indicates the description that defines an application. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: Configuration Type
parameters.description: Indicates the configuration type of the to-be-identified DNS. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: PCC Downlink EARFCN
parameters.description: Indicates the downlink E-UTRA absolute radio frequency channel number (EARFCN) of the PCC. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: SCC Downlink EARFCN
parameters.description: Indicates the downlink E-UTRA absolute radio frequency channel number (EARFCN) of a frequency to be acting as an SCC. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD. Always set this parameter to 46790 for an LAA SCell. Since the LTE-U function has been removed, the values 255144 and 260894 are invalid. Although the configuration interface in this version supports synchronization and delivery o

parameters.name: SCC Priority
parameters.description: Indicates the priority with which the candidate SCC works as an SCC for that PCC. A smaller value of this parameter indicates a lower priority, and a larger value indicates a higher priority. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: SCC A2 Offset
parameters.description: Indicates the offset of the actual threshold for CA event A2 relative to the value of the CarrAggrA2ThdRsrp parameter in the CaMgtCfg MO. If the actual threshold is greater than -43 dBm, the value of -43 dBm takes effect. If the actual threshold is less than -140 dBm, the value of -140 dBm takes effect. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: SCC A4 Offset
parameters.description: Indicates the offset of the actual threshold for CA event A4 relative to the value of the CarrAggrA4ThdRsrp parameter in the CaMgtCfg MO. If the actual threshold is greater than -43 dBm, the value of -43 dBm takes effect. If the actual threshold is less than -140 dBm, the value of -140 dBm takes effect. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.id: SCell Blind Configuration Flag Addition Threshold
parameters.name: SCell Blind Configuration Flag Addition Threshold
parameters.description: Indicates the threshold for adding the setting of the flag used to identify whether a cell can be configured as an SCell in a blind manner. ANGC for CA compares the measured coverage overlap proportion of an inter-frequency neighboring cell and the serving cell with this parameter value. If the coverage overlap proportion is greater than or equal to this parameter value, the inter-frequency neighb

parameters.id: SCell Blind Configuration Flag Deletion Threshold
parameters.name: SCell Blind Configuration Flag Deletion Threshold
parameters.description: Indicates the threshold for removing the setting of the flag used to identify whether a cell can be configured as an SCell in a blind manner. ANGC for CA compares the measured coverage overlap proportion of an inter-frequency neighboring cell and the serving cell with this parameter value. If this flag setting has been added for the inter-frequency neighboring cell and the coverage overlap proport

parameters.id: SCell Blind Configuration Flag Control Mode
parameters.name: SCell Blind Configuration Flag Control Mode
parameters.description: Indicates the control policy for the flag used to identify whether a cell can be configured as an SCell in a blind manner. If this parameter is set to AUTO, ANGC for CA can add, modify, or remove the flag settings for cells on this frequency. If this parameter is set to MANUAL, the flag settings for cells on this frequency can only be manually added, modified, or removed. This parameter applies on

parameters.name: SPID Group ID
parameters.description: Indicates the SPID group ID, which identifies a group of UEs whose SPIDs belong to the same group. If this parameter is set to a value ranging from 0 to 255, the eNodeB cannot configure candidate SCCs of UEs that belong to the SPID group specified by this parameter as SCCs for CA. If this parameter is set to 65535, candidate SCCs of such UEs can be configured as SCCs for CA. This parameter applies

parameters.id: SCC A2/A4 RSRP Threshold Extended Offset
parameters.name: SCC A2/A4 RSRP Threshold Extended Offset
parameters.description: Indicates the extended offset to the RSRP threshold for SCell-related event A2 or A4. If this parameter is set to a non-0 value, the extended threshold for SCell-related event A2 or A4 is equal to the normal threshold for the event plus this offset. The normal threshold for event A2 is equal to the sum of the CarrAggrA2ThdRsrp parameter in the CaMgtCfg MO and the SccA2Offset parameter in the SccFr

parameters.name: CN Operator List
parameters.description: Indicates the operators corresponding to an SCC. The characters from the left to the right in the parameter value correspond to the operator indexes of the local eNodeB. The character can be assigned with a value either 0 or 1. If the character is assigned with a value 1, the SCC can be used by the corresponding operator. If the character is assigned with a value 0, the SCC cannot be used by the c

parameters.name: SC Algorithm Switch
parameters.description: Indicates the general switch of the service classification (SC) algorithm. This parameter provides the following options: SC_SERVICE_IDENTITY_SW: The eNodeB identifies services based on service characteristics only if this option is selected. This option applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD. SC_MODULE_LOAD_SW: The eNodeB identifies and measures services of specified UEs when operators use end-to-en

parameters.name: Video Initial Buffer Time
parameters.description: Indicates the evaluation time of video initial caching. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.id: Video SYN-ACK to ACK Delay Threshold
parameters.name: Video SYN-ACK to ACK Delay Threshold
parameters.description: Indicates the threshold of delays between SYN-ACK packets and ACK packets in the three-way handshake processes of video services. If the delay between a SYN-ACK packet and an ACK packet in the three-way handshake process of a video service in a cell exceeds the threshold, the L.Exp.Video.Time.SynackToAck.OverThld.Num counter is incremented by 1. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: SC Run State
parameters.description: Indicates the SC running status on a board. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: SC Abnormal Cause
parameters.description: Indicates the reason why the SC status is abnormal. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: SC Rule File Loading Error
parameters.description: Indicates the loading error information about the rule files. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: SC Running Rule File Version
parameters.description: Indicates the version of the rule files running on the eNodeB. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: SC Software Version
parameters.description: Indicates the software version of SC. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: Sc Qos ID
parameters.description: Indicates a QoS ID. An ID is allocated to each service (video) to be optimized. The value range is from 0 to 49. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: Application Dns
parameters.description: Indicates the domain name of the to-be-identified application or website. This parameter must be set only if the AppIdentType parameter is set to DNS. "NULL" is an invalid value and cannot be entered. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: Downlink Service Grant Bit Rate
parameters.description: Indicates the guaranteed bit rate (GBR) for downlink services. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: Application Identification Type
parameters.description: Indicates the application identification type. If the AppIdentType parameter is set to DNS, the AppDns parameter must be set. If the AppIdentType parameter is set to IPv4, the AppIpv4 parameter must be set. If the AppIdentType parameter is set to IPv6, the AppIpv6 parameter must be set. Currently, IPv6 is not supported. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: Application IPv4
parameters.description: Indicates the IPv4 address of a service, which is used for service identification based on IP addresses. This parameter must be set only if the AppIdentType parameter is set to IPv4. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: Application IPv6
parameters.description: Indicates the IPv6 address of a service, which is used for service identification based on IP addresses. This parameter must be set only if the AppIdentType parameter is set to IPv6. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: SCTP Host ID
parameters.description: Indicates the ID of the SCTP host.

parameters.name: VRF Index
parameters.description: Indicates the index of a VRF instance. UMTS currently supports the default routing domain only (the VRF index is 0).

parameters.name: IP Version

parameters.name: First Local IP Address
parameters.description: Indicates the first local SCTP IPv4 address, which is used by the base station to establish a signaling channel. That is, this address is the first local IPv4 address for automatically establishing an SCTP link.

parameters.name: First Local IPv6 Address
parameters.description: Indicates the first local SCTP IPv6 address, which is used by the base station to establish a signaling channel. That is, this address is the first local IPv6 address for automatically establishing an SCTP link.

parameters.id: IPSec Auto Configure Switch for First Local IP

The IPsec tunnel is used to encrypt data to be transmitted on the SCTP link that is set up using the first local IP address of the SCTP host. When the value of this parameter is changed from ENABLE to DIS

parameters.id: Security Host ID for First Local IP
parameters.name: Security Host ID for First Local IP
parameters.description: Indicates the ID of the security host referenced by the first IP address of the SCTP host.

parameters.name: Second Local IP Address
parameters.description: Indicates the second local SCTP IPv4 address, which is used by the base station to establish a signaling channel. That is, this address is the second local IPv4 address for automatically establishing an SCTP link.

parameters.name: Second Local IPv6 Address

The IPsec tunnel is used to encrypt data to be transmitted on the SCTP link that is set up using the second local IP address of the SCTP host. When the value of this parameter is changed from ENABLE to D

parameters.name: Security Host ID for Second Local IP
parameters.description: Indicates the ID of the security host referenced by the second IP address of the SCTP host.

parameters.name: Local SCTP Port No.
parameters.description: Indicates the number of the local SCTP port used in automatic setup of an SCTP link.

parameters.name: SCTP Parameters Template ID
parameters.description: Indicates the ID of the SCTP parameter template referenced by the SCTP link that is automatically set up.

parameters.name: User Label
parameters.description: Indicates the description of the SCTP host.

parameters.name: Simple Mode Switch
parameters.description: Indicates the simplified mode switch of an SCTP host. When this parameter is set to SIMPLE_MODE_OFF, the SCTP host is not used for simplified configuration. When this parameter is set to S1SIMPLE_MODE_ON, the SCTP host is used for S1 interface simplified configuration. When this parameter is set to X2SIMPLE_MODE_ON, the SCTP host is used for X2 interface simplified configuration. When this paramet

parameters.id: First End Point Group ID for Control Plane
parameters.name: First End Point Group ID for Control Plane
parameters.description: Indicates the control-plane end point group ID of the first operator corresponding to an SCTP host. This parameter takes effect only on LTE.

parameters.id: Second End Point Group ID for Control Plane
parameters.name: Second End Point Group ID for Control Plane
parameters.description: Indicates the control-plane end point group ID of the second operator corresponding to an SCTP host. This parameter takes effect only on LTE.

parameters.id: First End Point Group Type for User Plane
parameters.name: First End Point Group Type for User Plane
parameters.description: Indicates the user-plane end point group type of the first operator corresponding to an SCTP host. When this parameter is set to COMMON, the user-plane end point group of the first operator is a common group. When this parameter is set to CENTRALIZED_EX2, the user-plane end point group of the first operator is a dedicated group for the centralized eX2. This parameter takes effect only in LTE.

parameters.name: Operator Sharing Switch
parameters.description: Indicates whether multiple operators can share an SCTP host. This parameter takes effect only on LTE.

parameters.id: First End Point Group ID for User Plane
parameters.name: First End Point Group ID for User Plane
parameters.description: Indicates the user-plane end point group ID of the first operator corresponding to an SCTP host. This parameter takes effect only on LTE.

parameters.id: Second End Point Group ID for User Plane
parameters.name: Second End Point Group ID for User Plane
parameters.description: Indicates the user-plane end point group ID of the second operator corresponding to an SCTP host. This parameter takes effect only on LTE.

parameters.name: DTLS Policy ID
parameters.description: Indicates the sequence number of a DTLS configuration policy, if this parameter is set to a valid value, the DTLS function is enabled on the SCTP link. Currently, only NR supports the DTLS function. If this function is enabled on other modes, the SCTP link will be faulty.

parameters.name: DTLS Connection Policy
parameters.description: Indicates the DTLS connection policy. DTLS_ONLY indicates that the local end uses only DTLS connections. If the peer end does not support or is not configured with DTLS, the negotiation fails. DTLS_PRIORITY indicates that the local end attempts to establish a DTLS connection for the first time. If the peer end does not support or is not configured with DTLS, the local end uses the SCTP connection.

parameters.name: SCTP Authentication Chunk List
parameters.description: Indicates the list of SCTP chunk types for which the local end requires the peer end to support authentication. The IDs of SCTP chunks that can be authenticated by the base station are 0, and 3 to 9. For details, see RFC4895 and RFC4960. Currently, SCTP block authentication is supported only in DTLS over SCTP scenarios. This parameter applies only to NR.

parameters.name: SCTP Peer ID
parameters.description: Indicates the ID of the SCTP peer. The value of SCTPPEERID in the SCTPPEER MOs configured by users ranges from 0 to 65535. The value of SCTPPEERID in the SCTPPEER MOs configured by the system ranges from 70000 to 79999.

parameters.name: VRF Index
parameters.description: Indicates the index of a VRF instance. UMTS currently supports the default routing domain only (the VRF index is 0).

parameters.name: IP Version
parameters.description: Indicates the IP protocol version of an SCTP peer.

parameters.name: First Peer IP Address
parameters.description: Indicates the first peer SCTP IPv4 address, which is used by the base station to establish a signaling channel. That is, this address is the first peer IPv4 address for automatically establishing an SCTP link.

parameters.name: First Peer IPv6 Address
parameters.description: Indicates the first peer SCTP IPv6 address, which is used by the base station to establish a signaling channel. That is, this address is the first peer IPv6 address for automatically establishing an SCTP link.

The IPsec tunnel is used to encrypt data to be transmitted on the SCTP link that is set up using the first peer IP address of the SCTP peer. When the value of this parameter is changed from ENABLE to DISAB

parameters.id: Security Peer ID for First Peer IP
parameters.name: Security Peer ID for First Peer IP
parameters.description: Indicates the ID of the security peer referenced by the first IP address of the SCTP peer.

parameters.name: Second Peer IP Address
parameters.description: Indicates the second peer SCTP IPv4 address, which is used by the base station to establish a signaling channel. That is, this address is the second peer IPv4 address for automatically establishing an SCTP link.

parameters.name: Second Peer IPv6 Address
parameters.description: Indicates the second peer SCTP IPv6 address, which is used by the base station to establish a signaling channel. That is, this address is the second peer IPv6 address for automatically establishing an SCTP link.

The IPsec tunnel is used to encrypt data to be transmitted on the SCTP link that is set up using the second peer IP address of the SCTP peer. When the value of this parameter is changed from ENABLE to DIS

parameters.id: Security Peer ID for Second Peer IP
parameters.name: Security Peer ID for Second Peer IP
parameters.description: Indicates the ID of the security peer referenced by the second IP address of the SCTP peer.

parameters.name: Peer SCTP Port No.
parameters.description: Indicates the number of the peer SCTP port, which is used for automatically setting up an SCTP link.

parameters.name: Remote ID
parameters.description: Indicates the remote ID. This parameter is used by the system during the automatic configuration of this MO. If this parameter is manually configured, the system may fail to automatically modify or delete the MO.

parameters.name: Control Mode
parameters.description: Indicates whether the object can be automatically modified or removed by the system. If this parameter is set to MANUAL_MODE, only users can operate this object. If this parameter is set to AUTO_MODE, the system can modify or remove this object and users can only remove this object.

parameters.name: Auto Config Flag
parameters.description: Indicates whether the object is created by the system. MANUAL_CREATED means that the object is configured by the user manually. AUTO_CREATED means that the object is created by the system.

parameters.name: User Label
parameters.description: Indicates the description of the SCTP peer.

parameters.name: Block Flag
parameters.description: Indicates whether the SCTPPEER is blocked or not.

parameters.name: Simple Mode Switch
parameters.description: Indicates the simplified mode switch of an SCTP peer. The parameter takes effect only in LTE.

parameters.name: End Point Group ID
parameters.description: Indicates the end point group ID of an SCTP peer. The parameter takes effect only in LTE.

parameters.name: SCTP Parameters Template ID
parameters.description: Indicates the ID of the SCTP parameter template.

parameters.name: RTO Min Value
parameters.description: Indicates the minimum RTO value of an SCTP link. According to the SCTP protocol, if the calculated RTO is less than the value of this parameter, the round trip delay is set to the value of this parameter to reduce the probability of retransmission timeout.

parameters.name: RTO Max Value
parameters.description: Indicates the maximum RTO value of an SCTP link. According to the SCTP protocol, this parameter is the upper limit for the doubling operation of the retransmission timeout timer.

parameters.name: RTO Initial Value
parameters.description: Indicates the initial RTO value of an SCTP link. According to the SCTP protocol, this parameter is used to calculate the initial value of retransmission timeout.

parameters.name: RTO Alpha Value
parameters.description: Indicates the RTO alpha value of an SCTP link. A larger value indicates less sensitivity to the link delay. For details, see RFC4960. According to the SCTP protocol, this parameter is used as the smooth factor for calculating round-trip delay. In a new estimation, (RtoAlpha/100) is obtained based on a new measurement and 1-(RtoAlpha/100) is obtained based on the last estimation.

parameters.name: RTO Beta Value
parameters.description: Indicates the RTO beta value of an SCTP link. This parameter is used to calculate the round trip time variation (RTTVAR). A larger value indicates that the latest change is more important. For definitions of the beta value, see RFC4960.

parameters.name: Heart-beat Interval
parameters.description: Indicates the heartbeat interval, corresponding to the HBINTER parameter specified in RFC4960. SCTP periodically transmits heartbeat messages to an idle destination address to detect the reachability. According to RFC4960, the actual interval at which heartbeat messages are transmitted equals the value of this parameter plus RTO.

parameters.name: Max Association Retransmission
parameters.description: Indicates the maximum number of association retransmissions on an SCTP link. If the number of retransmissions exceeds the value of this parameter, the SCTP link is released and a link failure alarm is reported.

parameters.name: Max Path Retransmission
parameters.description: Indicates the maximum number of retransmissions over a path of an SCTP link. If no heartbeat response is received from the peer end when the number of retransmissions over a path exceeds the value of this parameter, the current path cannot be reached. If multiple paths are used on the SCTP link, path switching is automatically performed.

parameters.name: Switch Back Flag
parameters.description: Indicates whether the automatically established SCTP link switches back to the primary path when the primary path is restored and reachable. If the primary path is not reachable, the SCTP link switches to the secondary path. When this parameter is set to ENABLE, the SCTP link switches to the primary path if the primary path is restored and reachable. When this parameter is set to DISABLE and the p

parameters.name: Heart-beat Times When Switch Back
parameters.description: Indicates the number of consecutive heartbeat messages that must be transmitted on the primary path before transmission can switch back to the primary path when SWITCHBACKFLAG is set to ENABLE.

parameters.name: SACK Timeout
parameters.description: Indicates the interval between time when one end of an SCTP link receives data and time when it can respond the other end with an SACK message. A larger value indicates a longer interval between receiving data and sending an SACK message.

parameters.name: Checksum Algorithm Type
parameters.description: Indicates the checksum algorithm. The checksum algorithms at both ends of an SCTP link must be the same.

parameters.name: Maximum Stream No.
parameters.description: Indicates the maximum stream number of an SCTP link.

parameters.name: Maximum SCTP PDU Size
parameters.description: Indicates the maximum size of of an IPv4 SCTP PDU (Protocol Data Unit). It specifies the maximum length of an SCTP PDU (excluding the IP header) transmitted on an SCTP link, which is set using the parameter template. If the value of this parameter is greater than the size of the IP layer MTU of the base station or intermediate transmission equipment, SCTP packets are fragmented at the IP layer. Th

parameters.name: Local cell ID
parameters.description: Indicates the ID of a local cell. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: Sector Split Group ID
parameters.description: Indicates the ID of a sector split group. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: Cell Beam Index
parameters.description: Indicates the beam index of a cell. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: Cell Beam Tilt
parameters.description: Indicates the downtilt angle corresponding to the beamforming weight for a massive MIMO cell. This parameter does not take effect for non-massive-MIMO cells and it is recommended that this parameter be set to 0 for non-massive-MIMO cells. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: Cell Beam Azimuth Offset
parameters.description: Indicates the offset to the horizontal azimuth corresponding to the beamforming weight for a massive MIMO cell. The mechanical azimuth of the antenna is used as the normal line. The azimuth is a positive number for clockwise deviation from the normal line or a negative number for counterclockwise deviation from the normal line. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: Cell Beam Power Offset
parameters.description: Indicates the offset of the reference signal transmit power used when FDD massive MIMO (32T32R) is enabled relative to the reference signal power set for the cell using the ReferenceSignalPwr parameter. This parameter is valid only when the MM_INTELLIGENT_BEAM_SHAPING_SW option of the SectorSplitSwitch parameter is selected. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD.

parameters.name: Cell Beam Azimuth
parameters.description: Indicates the horizontal azimuth corresponding to the beamforming weight for a massive MIMO cell. The mechanical azimuth of the antenna is used as the normal line. The azimuth is a positive number for clockwise deviation from the normal line or a negative number for counterclockwise deviation from the normal line. This parameter takes effect only when the MM_INTELLIGENT_BEAM_SHAPING_SW option is s

parameters.name: Cell Beamwidth
parameters.description: Indicates the horizontal 3 dB beamwidth corresponding to the beamforming weight for a massive MIMO cell. This parameter takes effect only when the MM_INTELLIGENT_BEAM_SHAPING_SW option is selected and the PATTERN_ADJ_SWITCH option of the SectorSplitSwitch parameter in the SectorSplitGroup MO is deselected. The sector beamwidth is specified by the CellBeamwidth parameter in the SectorSplitCell MO.

parameters.name: Cell Beam Tilt Fraction Part
parameters.description: Indicates the fractional part of the downtilt angle corresponding to the beamforming weight of a massive MIMO cell. This parameter is used together with the CellBeamTilt parameter, which indicates the integer part of the downtilt angle. The CellBeamTiltFractionPart parameter indicates the fractional part (decimal part) of the downtilt angle. This parameter is valid only for massive MIMO scenarios.

parameters.name: Cell Beam Power
parameters.description: Indicates the cell beam power. This parameter takes effect only when the POWER_ALLOCATION_SWITCH option of the SectorSplitGroup.SectorSplitSwitch parameter is selected. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD.

parameters.name: Sector Split Group ID
parameters.description: Indicates the ID of a sector split group. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: Beam Template ID
parameters.description: Indicates the beam template ID. This parameter needs to be set to 0 for 8T cells. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: Beam Deployment Mode
parameters.description: Indicates the beam deployment mode for a multi-antenna cell. MODE_0 indicates that the number of outer-cell beams is the same as or one more than that of inner-cell beams. MODE_1 indicates that the number of outer-cell beams is two or three more than that of inner-cell beams. MODE_2 indicates that the number of outer-cell beams is four or five more than that of inner-cell beams. MODE_3 indicates s

parameters.name: Sector Split Switch
parameters.description: Indicates whether to enable functions related to sector split in massive MIMO scenarios. MM_INTELLIGENT_BEAM_SHAPING_SW: Indicates whether to enable intelligent beam shaping in massive MIMO scenarios. Intelligent beam shaping in massive MIMO scenarios is enabled only if this option is selected. The PATTERN_ADJ_SWITCH and POWER_ADJ_SWITCH options are valid only when the MM_INTELLIGENT_BEAM_SHAPING_

parameters.id: Massive MIMO Beam Azimuth Adjustment Step
parameters.name: Massive MIMO Beam Azimuth Adjustment Step
parameters.description: Indicates the beam azimuth adjustment step used for smart beam adjustment in massive MIMO scenarios. If this parameter is set to 0, only the beam width can be adjusted in smart beam adjustment in massive MIMO scenarios, and the beam azimuth cannot be adjusted. If this parameter is set to 60, the beam azimuth is adjusted based on the clustering result instead of being restricted by the adjustment s

parameters.name: TM4 Weight Scheme
parameters.description: Indicates the scheme for setting the weight of TM4 in massive MIMO. The eNodeB sets the weight of TM4 based on the AAU type and coverage requirements. The value DEFAULT_MODE is applicable to common scenarios. When this parameter is set to DEFAULT_MODE, the CellBeamTilt parameter is valid. The value COVERAGE_MODE_1 is applicable to coverage enhancement scenarios. When this parameter is set to COVER

parameters.name: Intelligent Beam Scheduling Switch
parameters.description: Indicates whether to enable algorithms related to intelligent beam scheduling. JOINT_SCHEDULING_SWITCH: Indicates whether to enable joint scheduling for intelligent beam scheduling in massive MIMO scenarios. Joint scheduling is enabled for intelligent beam scheduling in massive MIMO scenarios only if this option is selected. This option takes effect only for split cells in the same sector split gr

parameters.name: Massive MIMO EMF Power Limit
parameters.description: Indicates the maximum transmit power that can be used by UEs in massive MIMO cells. This parameter is used to prevent UE transmit power from exceeding the EMF limit. If this parameter is set to 0, the maximum transmit power of UEs in massive MIMO cells is not restricted. If this parameter is set to a non-zero value, the maximum transmit power of UEs in massive MIMO cells cannot exceed the power va

parameters.name: Massive MIMO Beam Scheme
parameters.description: Indicates the massive MIMO beam scheme. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD.

parameters.id: Power Sharing TM9 UE Max Pa Offset
parameters.name: Power Sharing TM9 UE Max Pa Offset
parameters.description: Indicates the offset relative to the maximum PA for the shared power received by TM9 UEs when intelligent beam scheduling is enabled. The actual maximum PA for the shared power received by TM9 UEs is the result of 90 minus the configured value. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD.

parameters.name: Beam Optimization PRB Usage Threshold
parameters.description: Indicates the PRB usage threshold for triggering TM9 beam optimization. When the average PRB usage of the split sector group is higher than the threshold, TM9 beam optimization is enabled to reduce interference from TM9 beams to UEs using other beams and increase the average downlink UE throughput. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD.

parameters.name: Power Sharing High Load Threshold
parameters.description: Indicates the load threshold for power sharing to take effect for high-load cells in sector split scenarios where LTE extreme power sharing is enabled. When the PRB usage of a high-load cell exceeds this threshold, the condition for the sharing to take effect is met. If this parameter is set to 100, this power sharing algorithm does not take effect. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD.

parameters.name: Power Sharing Load Multiple Threshold
parameters.description: Indicates the load ratio threshold for power sharing to take effect for high-load cells in sector split scenarios where LTE extreme power sharing is enabled. When the ratio of the load of a high-load cell to that of a low-load cell exceeds this threshold, the condition for the sharing to take effect is met. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD.

parameters.name: Server Index
parameters.description: Indicates the index of the server accessed by UEs. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: IPv4 Server IP Address
parameters.description: Indicates the IPv4 address of the server accessed by UEs. UEs can access the server based on the IP address, a combination of the IP address and protocol type, or a combination of the IP address, protocol type, and port number. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: Server Port Number
parameters.description: Indicates the server port accessed by UEs. The value 0 indicates that no detection is performed for the port number of IP packets. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: Protocol Type
parameters.description: Indicates the protocol type of the server visited by UEs. The value NONE indicates that no detection is performed for the protocol type of downlink packets. The value UDP indicates that the eNodeB checks whether the protocol type of downlink packets is UDP. The value TCP indicates that the eNodeB checks whether the protocol type of downlink packets is TCP. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD an

parameters.name: IP Version
parameters.description: Indicates the IP version. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: IPv6 Server IP Address
parameters.description: Indicates the IPv6 address of the server accessed by UEs. UEs can access the server based on the IP address, a combination of the IP address and protocol type, or a combination of the IP address, protocol type, and port number. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.id: IP Address Detection Purpose Control Switch
parameters.name: IP Address Detection Purpose Control Switch
parameters.description: Indicates the purpose of IP address detection. ACTIVE_TEST_SPEED_DETECT_SW: Indicates whether to check a specified IP address for active speed tests. The specified IP address is checked only if this option is selected. MAX_CARRIER_NUM_CONTROL_SW: Indicates whether to check a specified IP address for the control over the maximum number of carriers. This option is valid only when the MaximumNumberOf

parameters.name: Queue0 Weight
parameters.description: Indicates the scheduling weight of queue 0. A larger parameter value indicates a higher priority. If the value is 0, queue 0 is not scheduled. The sum of scheduling weight values of all queues must not exceed 100. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: Queue1 Weight
parameters.description: Indicates the scheduling weight of queue 1. A larger parameter value indicates a higher priority. If the value is 0, queue 1 is not scheduled. The sum of scheduling weight values of all queues must not exceed 100. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: Queue2 Weight
parameters.description: Indicates the scheduling weight of queue 2. A larger parameter value indicates a higher priority. If the value is 0, queue 2 is not scheduled. The sum of scheduling weight values of all queues must not exceed 100. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: Queue3 Weight
parameters.description: Indicates the scheduling weight of queue 3. A larger parameter value indicates a higher priority. If the value is 0, queue 3 is not scheduled. The sum of scheduling weight values of all queues must not exceed 100. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: Queue4 Weight
parameters.description: Indicates the scheduling weight of queue 4. A larger parameter value indicates a higher priority. If the value is 0, queue 4 is not scheduled. The sum of scheduling weight values of all queues must not exceed 100. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: Queue5 Weight
parameters.description: Indicates the scheduling weight of queue 5. A larger parameter value indicates a higher priority. If the value is 0, queue 5 is not scheduled. The sum of scheduling weight values of all queues must not exceed 100. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: Queue6 Weight
parameters.description: Indicates the scheduling weight of queue 6. A larger parameter value indicates a higher priority. If the value is 0, queue 6 is not scheduled. The sum of scheduling weight values of all queues must not exceed 100. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: Queue7 Weight
parameters.description: Indicates the scheduling weight of queue 7. A larger parameter value indicates a higher priority. If the value is 0, queue 7 is not scheduled. The sum of scheduling weight values of all queues must not exceed 100. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: Heartbeat Packet Length Threshold
parameters.description: Indicates the threshold of the length of an IP packet for identifying heartbeat services. If the length of any IP packet of a service sent in 2s after RRC connection setup exceeds this threshold, the service is not identified as a heartbeat service. This parameter takes effect when the SrvBasedSRSAdjAlgo option of the SrsCfgPolicySwitch parameter is selected. This parameter applies only to LTE TDD

parameters.name: Heartbeat Packet Number Threshold
parameters.description: Indicates the threshold of the number of IP packets of a service for identifying heartbeat services. If the number of IP packets of a service sent within 2s after RRC connection setup exceeds this threshold, the service is not identified as a heartbeat service. This parameter applies only to LTE TDD and takes effect when the SrvBasedSRSAdjAlgo option of the SrsCfgPolicySwitch parameter is selected

parameters.id: Mass Flow Big Packet Rate Threshold
parameters.name: Mass Flow Big Packet Rate Threshold
parameters.description: Indicates the threshold of the proportion of large downlink IP packets of a service to all IP packets in a measurement period. This threshold is used together with the MassFlowPacketNumberThld parameter to identify heavy-traffic services. If the proportion of large downlink IP packets of a service exceeds this threshold and the number of downlink IP packets of the service exceeds the MassFlowPacke

parameters.name: Mass Flow Monitor Duration
parameters.description: Indicates the measurement period for identification of heavy-traffic services. This parameter applies only to LTE TDD and takes effect when the SrvBasedSRSAdjAlgo option of the SrsCfgPolicySwitch parameter is selected.

parameters.name: Mass Flow Packet Number Threshold
parameters.description: Indicates the threshold of the number of downlink IP packets of a service, which is used together with the MassFlowBigPacketRateThld parameter to identify heavy-traffic services. If the proportion of large downlink IP packets of a service exceeds the value of the MassFlowBigPacketRateThld parameter and the number of downlink IP packets of the service exceeds the value of the MassflowPacketNumberTh

parameters.name: CN Operator ID
parameters.description: Indicates the ID of the operator. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.id: Service Interfreq Ho Policy Group Id
parameters.name: Service Interfreq Ho Policy Group Id
parameters.description: Indicates the ID of the service-based inter-frequency handover policy group. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: Downlink EARFCN Index
parameters.description: Indicates the index of a DL EARFCN in a DL EARFCN group for service-based inter-frequency handover. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: Downlink EARFCN
parameters.description: Indicates a DL EARFCN for service-based inter-frequency handover. Only the value with DlEarfcnIndex 0 in the DL EARFCN group is valid for LTE FDD cells when ServiceHoMultiTargetFreqSw is set to OFF(Off). All values of this parameter are valid for LTE TDD cells when ServiceHoMultiTargetFreqSw is set to ON(On). This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: Service Handover Frequency Priority
parameters.description: Indicates the priority for the frequency to be the target frequency for service-based and service-request-based inter-frequency handovers. A larger value indicates a higher priority. When setting measurement configurations for service-based and service-request-based inter-frequency handovers, the eNodeB selects the neighboring E-UTRA frequencies in descending order of priority. This parameter appl

parameters.name: CN Operator ID
parameters.description: Indicates the ID of the operator. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.id: Service-based inter-Freq handover policy group ID
parameters.name: Service-based inter-Freq handover policy group ID
parameters.description: Indicates the ID of the service-based or service-request-based inter-frequency handover policy group. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: Inter-Freq handover state
parameters.description: Indicates whether to allow service-based or service-request-based inter-frequency handovers of the policy group to a specified frequency. If this parameter is set to NO_HO, service-based or service-request-based inter-frequency handovers of services with a specific QCI to a specified frequency are not allowed. If this parameter is set to PERMIT_HO, such handovers are allowed. This parameter applie

parameters.id: Service-based InterFreq A4 Report Waiting Timer
parameters.name: Service-based InterFreq A4 Report Waiting Timer
parameters.description: Indicates the length of the inter-frequency A4 measurement report waiting timer. If an inter-frequency measurement is triggered, the duration for a UE performing inter-frequency measurement must be restricted. parameters.id: Service-based InterFreq A4 time to trigger
parameters.name: Service-based InterFreq A4 time to trigger
parameters.description: Indicates the time-to-trigger for service-based inter-frequency event A4. When the UE detects that the signal quality in the serving cell and that in at least one inter-frequency neighboring cell meets the entering condition for a service- or service request-based handover, it does not immediately send a measurement report to the eNodeB. Instead, the UE sends a report only when the signal quality

parameters.name: CN Operator ID
parameters.description: Indicates the ID of the operator. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.id: Service-based inter-RAT handover policy group ID
parameters.name: Service-based inter-RAT handover policy group ID
parameters.description: Indicates the ID of the service-based inter-RAT handover policy group. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: Inter-RAT handover state
parameters.description: Indicates whether the status of service-based inter-RAT handovers for services with a specific QCI. If this parameter is set to NO_HO, service-based inter-RAT handovers of services with the QCI from E-UTRAN to NG-RAN, UTRAN, and GERAN are not allowed. If this parameter is set to PERMIT_HO, then service-based inter-RAT handovers of services with the QCI from E-UTRAN to UTRAN and GERAN are allowed b

parameters.name: Service-based Inter-RAT HO Measure Mode
parameters.description: Indicates the mode of service-based EUTRAN-to-GERAN and EUTRAN-to-UTRAN handover measurements. Assume that conditions for delivering measurement configurations related to both the service-based inter-frequency handovers and service-based EUTRAN-to-GERAN or EUTRAN-to-UTRAN handovers are met. If the ServiceIrMeasMode parameter is set to SERVICE_IR_MEAS_ORDER, the eNodeB delivers the measurement conf

parameters.name: Local MCE ID
parameters.description: Indicates the local MCE ID, which is unique on the local NE. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: MBSFN Area ID
parameters.description: Indicates the MBSFN area ID. For details, see 3GPP TS 36.443. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: PMCH ID
parameters.description: Indicates the PMCH ID. For details, see 3GPP TS 36.443. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: Service ID
parameters.description: Indicates the eMBMS service ID, which is unique in a PLMN. For details, see 3GPP TS 36.443. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: Sector equipment ID
parameters.description: Indicates the ID of the sector equipment. It uniquely identifies a piece of sector equipment within an eNodeB. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: Main eNodeB ID
parameters.description: Indicates the ID of the main eNodeB. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: Main eNodeB Local cell ID
parameters.description: Indicates the local ID of a cell of the primary eNodeB. It uniquely identifies a cell within the primary eNodeB. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: Baseband equipment ID
parameters.description: Indicates the ID of the baseband equipment serving a cell. When this parameter is set to 255, the baseband equipment serving a cell is not specified. In this scenario, the LTE baseband processing units (LBBPs) serving a cell are selected among all LBBPs in the eNodeB, and the LBBPs to which the cell's serving RRU is connected are preferentially selected. When this parameter is set to a value other

parameters.name: Reference signal power
parameters.description: Indicates the reference signal power of the single frequency network (SFN) auxiliary eNodeB resource. The value 32767 indicates that this reference signal power parameter is invalid. In this case, the cell uses the reference signal power specified in the PDSCHCfg MO. For details, see 3GPP TS 36.213. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: Reference Signal Power Margin
parameters.description: Indicates the reference signal power headroom of each physical antenna. If this parameter is set to 0, the parameter does not take effect. That is, the reference signal power headroom of the cell equals the value of the ReferenceSignalPwrMargin parameter in the PDSCHCfg MO. If this parameter is set to a value other than 0, the reference signal power headroom of the cell equals this value regardles

parameters.name: Sector CPRI Compression
parameters.description: Indicates the CPRI compression type of the sector equipment. CPRI compression is used in RRU cascading scenarios to enable more RRUs to be cascaded without changing the CPRI data rate. The parameter can be set to NO_COMPRESSION, NORMAL_COMPRESSION, ENHANCED_COMPRESSION, TRIPLEX_COMPRESSION_10M, 3_2_COMPRESSION, or NULL. The parameter value NO_COMPRESSION indicates that CPRI compression is not used

parameters.name: Auto Config Flag
parameters.description: Indicates whether to automatically or manually control the setting of baseband equipment ID. To enable automatic binding, set this parameter to AUTO_MODE_CFG. To enable manual binding, set this parameter to MANUAL_MODE_CFG or AUTO_MODE_CFG. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: Sector Equipment Combine Group ID
parameters.description: Indicates the ID of a sector equipment combination group, which contains multiple sets of sector equipment. The value 255 indicates that the sector equipment is not to be included in a combination. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: Virtual Cell ID
parameters.description: Indicates a virtual cell ID used for DMRS scrambling and CSI-RS pattern configuration when adaptive SFN and TM10 are enabled. This parameter needs to be manually set to a planned value as required when adaptive SFN and TM10 are enabled. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD.

parameters.name: Cell Beam Mode
parameters.description: Indicates the beam mode of the cell. This parameter has two values: NORMAL and ADVANCED_BEAMFORMING. The value NORMAL indicates that the cell is a normal cell. The value ADVANCED_BEAMFORMING indicates that the cell uses AAU-based advanced beamforming. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD.

parameters.name: Sector equipment Group ID
parameters.description: Indicates the ID of the sector equipment group that serves the cell. It uniquely identifies a sector equipment group within a cell. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: Main eNodeB ID
parameters.description: Indicates the ID of the main eNodeB. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: Main eNodeB Local cell ID
parameters.description: Indicates the local ID of a cell of the primary eNodeB. It uniquely identifies a cell within the primary eNodeB. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: Baseband equipment ID
parameters.description: Indicates the ID of the baseband equipment serving a cell. When this parameter is set to 255, the baseband equipment serving a cell is not specified. In this scenario, the LTE baseband processing units (LBBPs) serving a cell are selected among all LBBPs in the eNodeB, and the LBBPs to which the cell's serving RRU is connected are preferentially selected. When this parameter is set to a value other

parameters.name: Reference signal power
parameters.description: Indicates the reference signal power of the single frequency network (SFN) auxiliary eNodeB resource. The value 32767 indicates that this reference signal power parameter is invalid. In this case, the cell uses the reference signal power specified in the PDSCHCfg MO. For details, see 3GPP TS 36.213. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: SFN Sector Equipment Reference
parameters.description: Indicates the sector equipment in the sector equipment group of an auxiliary eNodeB supporting inter-BBU SFN cells. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: Sector Group CPRI Compression
parameters.description: Indicates the common public radio interface (CPRI) compression type for the sector equipment group. CPRI compression is used in RRU cascading scenarios to enable more RRUs to be cascaded without changing the CPRI data rate. The parameter value NO_COMPRESSION indicates that CPRI compression is not used. The parameter value NORMAL_COMPRESSION indicates that normal CPRI compression is used. The param

parameters.name: Auto Config Flag
parameters.description: Indicates whether to automatically or manually bind a baseband equipment ID to a cell. To enable automatic binding, set this parameter to AUTO_MODE_CFG. To enable manual binding, set this parameter to MANUAL_MODE_CFG or AUTO_MODE_CFG. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: Sector Equipment Group Combine ID
parameters.description: Indicates the ID of a sector equipment group combination, which contains multiple sector equipment groups. This parameter takes effect only in scenarios with virtual 4T4R enabled. The value 255 indicates that sector equipment groups are not combined. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: Virtual Cell ID
parameters.description: Indicates a virtual cell ID used for DMRS scrambling and CSI-RS pattern configuration when adaptive SFN and TM10 are enabled. This parameter needs to be manually set to a planned value as required when adaptive SFN and TM10 are enabled. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD.

parameters.name: Sector Group Carrier PassThrough Compression
parameters.description: Indicates the compression type on CPRI over optical fibers and CPRI over Ethernet cables for the sector equipment group. This parameter applies to LampSite eNodeBs where both optical fibers and Ethernet cables are used for RRU cascading and the compression ratio on CPRI over optical fibers and that on CPRI over Ethernet cables are the same. This parameter is used to specify the compression ratio o

parameters.name: Local Cell ID
parameters.description: Indicates the local ID of a cell, which uniquely identifies a cell within an eNodeB. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD.

parameters.name: Sector Equipment ID
parameters.description: Indicates the ID of an edge physical cell's sector equipment used by an SFN cell. It uniquely identifies a set of sector equipment within an eNodeB. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD.

parameters.name: Mobile Country Code
parameters.description: Indicates the MCC of a neighboring SFN cell. A PLMN ID is comprised of an MCC and an MNC. The MCC consists of three digits. The MNC consists of two or three digits. For example, MCC = 123, MNC = 45, PLMN = 12345. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD.

parameters.name: Mobile Network Code
parameters.description: Indicates the MNC of a neighboring SFN cell. A PLMN ID is comprised of an MCC and an MNC. An MCC consists of three digits. An MNC consists of two or three digits. For example, if the MCC is 123 and the MNC is 45, the PLMN ID is 12345. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD.

parameters.name: eNodeB ID
parameters.description: Indicates the eNodeB ID of a neighboring SFN cell. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD.

parameters.name: Neighbor Cell ID
parameters.description: Indicates the ID of a neighboring SFN cell. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD.

parameters.name: Neighbor Sector Equipment ID
parameters.description: Indicates the ID of an edge physical cell's sector equipment of a neighboring SFN cell. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD.

parameters.name: Sidelink V2X Carrier ID
parameters.description: Indicates the sidelink V2X carrier ID. It uniquely identifies a sidelink V2X carrier within an eNodeB. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: Sidelink V2X EARFCN
parameters.description: Indicates the sidelink V2X EARFCN. This parameter can be set to a value ranging from 46790 to 55239. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: Maximum Sidelink V2X Transmit Power
parameters.description: Indicates the maximum transmit power of a UE for V2X sidelink transmission. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: Sidelink V2X Bandwidth
parameters.description: Indicates the operating carrier bandwidth for sidelink V2X. Sidelink adopts the same RX and TX bandwidths. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: Sidelink V2X Carrier ID
parameters.description: Indicates the sidelink V2X carrier ID. It uniquely identifies a sidelink V2X carrier within an eNodeB. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: PSSCH Configuration Index
parameters.description: Indicates the PSSCH ID. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: UE Speed Threshold
parameters.description: Indicates the UE speed threshold for sidelink V2X. For details, see 3GPP TS 36.331. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: Sidelink V2X Carrier ID
parameters.description: Indicates the sidelink V2X carrier ID. It uniquely identifies a sidelink V2X carrier within an eNodeB. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: Pool ID
parameters.description: Indicates the resource pool ID. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: Pool Type
parameters.description: Indicates the resource pool type. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: Pool Subframe Bitmap
parameters.description: Indicates the bitmap of the subframe used for the resource pool. For details, see 3GPP TS 36.331. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: PSCCH PSSCH Adjacency
parameters.description: Indicates whether adjacent RBs in the same subframe are used to transmit the PSSCH and PSCCH. For details, see 3GPP TS 36.331. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: Subchannel Count
parameters.description: Indicates the number of subchannels of the current resource pool. For details, see 3GPP TS 36.331. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: Subchannel PRB Count
parameters.description: Indicates the number of PRBs used for each subchannel. For details, see 3GPP TS 36.331. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: Subchannel Start RB Index
parameters.description: Indicates the index of the starting RB of the subchannel. For details, see 3GPP TS 36.331. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: PSCCH Pool Start RB Index
parameters.description: Indicates the index of the starting RB of the PSCCH resource pool. For details, see 3GPP TS 36.331. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: configuration index
parameters.description: Indicates the index of a simulated load configuration. One BS can store 10 simulated load configurations, which are identified by the indexes.

parameters.name: RB usage threshold
parameters.description: Indicates the RB usage threshold of a simulated load configuration. If the RB usage of a cell is below this threshold, the simulated load scheduling is performed.

parameters.name: Power usage threshold
parameters.description: Indicates the power usage threshold of a simulated load configuration. If the power usage of a cell is below this threshold, the simulated load scheduling is performed. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: Report period
parameters.description: Indicates the reporting period for simulated load. The value 0 indicates that simulated load is not reported. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: Statistic period
parameters.description: Indicates the measurement period for simulated load. The value 0 indicates that simulated load is not measured. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: Frequency selective switch
parameters.description: Indicates the switch that is used to determine whether to enable and disable the frequency-selective scheduling in simulated load configuration. If the switch is set to ON, the frequency-selective scheduling is enabled. If the switch is set to OFF, the frequency-diversity scheduling is used. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: Local Cell ID
parameters.description: Indicates the local ID of a cell, which uniquely identifies the cell within an eNodeB. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: Simuload PMI Template ID
parameters.description: Indicates the number of a PMI template used in interference simulation. This parameter applies only to FDD.

parameters.name: Cell Simuload PMI
parameters.description: Indicates the PMI used in interference simulation with the SimuLoadTransMode parameter set to TM4 or TM9. This parameter applies only to FDD.

parameters.name: Cell Simuload Rank
parameters.description: Indicates the rank for the PMI used in interference simulation with the SimuLoadTransMode parameter set to TM4 or TM9. This parameter applies only to FDD.

parameters.name: Cell Simuload PMI Config Duration
parameters.description: Indicates the duration of interference simulation using the PMI with the SimuLoadTransMode parameter set to TM4 or TM9. The total configured duration of interference simulation using the PMIs in all PMI templates configured for a cell is the PMI polling cycle. The configuration-dependent probability of scheduling a PMI is equal to the configured duration of interference simulation using this PMI d

parameters.name: Cell Simuload PMI Extend 0
parameters.description: Indicates the PMI for TM4 during virtual 4T4R feature load simulation. This parameter indicates the PMI for beam 0 (the left beam serving the virtual 4T4R cell) during load simulation. PMI values used for load simulation in a cell must be unique. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: Cell Simuload PMI Extend 1
parameters.description: Indicates the PMI for TM4 during virtual 4T4R feature load simulation. This parameter indicates the PMI for beam 1 (the left beam serving the virtual 4T4R cell) during load simulation. PMI values used for load simulation in a cell must be unique. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: PMI Type
parameters.description: Indicates the cell type for load simulation. If the cell is a normal cell, set this parameter to Normal. If the cell is an eMIMO cell, set this parameter to Virtual4T4R. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: Cell Simuload PMI Period
parameters.description: Indicates the PMI polling cycle used in load simulation with the SimuLoadTransMode parameter is set to TM4 or TM9. This parameter applies only to FDD.

parameters.name: Cell Simuload PMI Schedule Duration
parameters.description: Indicates the scheduling duration for the PMI used in interference simulation with the SimuLoadTransMode parameter set to TM4 or TM9. The total configured duration of interference simulation using the PMIs in all PMI templates configured for a cell is the PMI polling cycle. The actual probability of scheduling a PMI is equal to the scheduling duration for this PMI divided by the PMI polling cycle.

parameters.name: SO ID
parameters.description: Indicates the ID of the SO MO. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: End Point Group Config Flag
parameters.description: Indicates whether to configure the control-plane endpoint group, user-plane end point group, or both end point groups for the SO MO. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.id: Control Plane End Point Group ID
parameters.name: Control Plane End Point Group ID
parameters.description: Indicates the ID of the control-plane endpoint group used by the SO MO. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.id: User Plane End Point Group ID
parameters.name: User Plane End Point Group ID
parameters.description: Indicates the ID of the user-plane endpoint group used by the SO MO. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: User Label
parameters.description: Indicates the description of the SO MO. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: SO Interface CP Bearer ID
parameters.description: Indicates the ID of the control port (CP) bearer for the SO interface. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: SO Interface CP Bearer State
parameters.description: Indicates the status of the CP bearer for the SO interface. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.id: LTE and NR Spectrum Sharing Cell Group ID
parameters.name: LTE and NR Spectrum Sharing Cell Group ID
parameters.description: Indicates the ID of an LTE and NR spectrum sharing cell group. This ID uniquely identifies such a group within an eNodeB. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: Mobile Country Code
parameters.description: Indicates the MCC of a cell served by an auxiliary base station involved in spectrum sharing. A PLMN ID is comprised of an MCC and an MNC. An MCC consists of three digits. An MNC consists of two or three digits. For example, if the MCC is 123 and the MNC is 45, the PLMN ID is 12345. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: Mobile Network Code
parameters.description: Indicates the MNC of a cell served by an auxiliary base station involved in spectrum sharing. A PLMN ID is comprised of an MCC and an MNC. An MCC consists of three digits. An MNC consists of two or three digits. For example, if the MCC is 123 and the MNC is 45, the PLMN ID is 12345. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: eNodeB ID
parameters.description: Indicates the ID of an eNodeB serving as an auxiliary eNodeB in spectrum sharing. It uniquely identifies an eNodeB within a PLMN. The 28-bit E-UTRAN cell ID is comprised of the cell ID and the eNodeB ID (represented by the most significant 20 bits). The CGI of an E-UTRAN cell is comprised of the E-UTRAN cell ID and the PLMN ID. For details, see 3GPP TS 36.413. This parameter applies only to LTE FD

parameters.name: Cell ID
parameters.description: Indicates the ID of a cell served by an auxiliary base station involved in spectrum sharing. It uniquely identifies a cell within a base station. The 28-bit E-UTRAN cell ID is comprised of the cell ID (represented by the least significant eight bits) and the eNodeB ID. The cell global identity (CGI) of an E-UTRAN cell is comprised of the E-UTRAN cell ID and the PLMN ID. For details, see 3GPP TS 36

parameters.name: Local Cell ID
parameters.description: Indicates the local ID of an E-UTRAN cell. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: Spectrum Cloud Switch
parameters.description: Indicates whether to enable spectrum cloudification. If this parameter is set to OFF, spectrum cloudification is disabled. If this parameter is set to GL_SPECTRUM_CONCURRENCY, GSM and LTE spectrum concurrency is enabled. If this parameter is set to UL_SPECTRUM_SHARING, UMTS and LTE spectrum sharing is enabled. If this parameter is set to LTE_NR_UPLINK_SPECTRUM_SHR, LTE and NR uplink spectrum shari

parameters.name: GSM ARFCN Group ID
parameters.description: Indicates the GSM ARFCN group ID used by GSM in standard LTE bandwidths. This parameter references the frequency configuration in the GsmInterfArfcnCfg MO. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD.

parameters.name: LTE Interference Performance Optimize Switch
parameters.description: Indicates whether to optimize LTE interference performance in the GSM and LTE spectrum concurrency feature or UMTS and LTE spectrum sharing feature. DL_PFM_PRF_PDCCH_SWITCH: Indicates whether to enable PDCCH optimization to preferentially guarantee downlink performance. If this option is selected, PDCCH resource allocation preferentially guarantees the downlink performance. QPSK_RAISE_PWR_SWITCH:

parameters.id: Near Point User Path Loss Threshold
parameters.name: Near Point User Path Loss Threshold
parameters.description: Indicates the threshold for determining whether a UE is located near the cell center for uplink shared spectrum resource scheduling when the GSM and LTE Spectrum Concurrency (LTE FDD) feature is used. If the path loss reported by a UE is lower than the threshold, the UE is determined as a UE located near the center of the E-UTRAN cell. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD.

parameters.name: Downlink CCH Send Strategy
parameters.description: Indicates the CRS and PDCCH transmission policy used in the LTE cell. When GSM and LTE spectrum concurrency is enabled: If this parameter is set to ADAPTIVE, CRSs and PDCCHs are transmitted adaptively based on the GSM and LTE interference coordination result. If this parameter is set to CRS_AND_PDCCH_AVOIDED, CRSs and PDCCHs are not transmitted on the REs exposed to strong GSM interference. If thi

parameters.name: PDCCH Interferenced RE Compensation Rate
parameters.description: Indicates the compensation rate of REs in the case of GSM interference. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD.

parameters.id: UMTS and LTE Spectrum Sharing Config ID
parameters.name: UMTS and LTE Spectrum Sharing Config ID
parameters.description: Indicates the cell configuration ID of UMTS and LTE spectrum sharing, which is unique within an eNodeB. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD.

parameters.name: Co-coverage GSM Sharing Carrier Power
parameters.description: Indicates the power of GSM shared carrier in the GSM and LTE co-coverage area. The power value is used to calculate the difference in power spectrum density (PSD) between GSM and LTE, which can be used for selecting an appropriate GL guardband. This parameter is invalid when it is set to 65535. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD.

parameters.id: LTE and NR UL Static Spct Shr Switch
parameters.name: LTE and NR UL Static Spct Shr Switch
parameters.description: Indicates whether to enable uplink static spectrum sharing between LTE and NR. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD.

parameters.name: Spectrum Cloud Enhancement Switch
parameters.description: Indicates whether to enable spectrum cloudification enhancement. GL_SPCT_CONCURRENCY_PH2_SW: Indicates whether to enable enhanced GL spectrum concurrency phase 2. When this option is selected, the maximum number of ARFCNs of interfering GSM frequencies that can be configured in LTE in-band increases. UL_SPECTRUM_SHR_PH2_SW: Indicates whether to enable enhanced UL spectrum sharing phase 2. When thi

parameters.id: LTE and NR Spectrum Sharing Cell Group ID
parameters.name: LTE and NR Spectrum Sharing Cell Group ID
parameters.description: Indicates the ID of an LTE and NR spectrum sharing cell group. This ID uniquely identifies such a group within an eNodeB. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: Decrease CFI Rate
parameters.description: Indicates the threshold, expressed as a percentage of CFIs, for triggering reduction of the CFI configured for UMTS. The actual CFI may be different from the CFI configured for UMTS. There are two scenarios: (1) The actual CFI is smaller than the CFI configured for UMTS. (2) The actual CFI is greater than or equal to the CFI configured for UMTS. The percentage of the actual CFIs smaller than the C

parameters.name: Increase CFI Rate
parameters.description: Indicates the threshold, expressed as a percentage of CFIs, for triggering increase of the CFI configured for UMTS. If the percentage of actual CFIs greater than the CFI configured for UMTS is greater than the value of this parameter, the CFI configured for UMTS will be increased. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD.

parameters.name: Spectrum Sharing Mode
parameters.description: Indicates the spectrum sharing mode. If this parameter is set to LTE_NR_PWR_DYN_SHR_WITH_SPCT, LTE and NR share spectrum power when they share the spectrum. If this parameter is set to LTE_NR_PWR_INDEPENDENT, LTE and NR use separate spectrum power when they share the spectrum. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD.

parameters.id: Downlink Fixed High Quality RB Count
parameters.name: Downlink Fixed High Quality RB Count
parameters.description: Indicates the number of downlink fixed high-quality RBs for LTE when GSM and LTE Spectrum Concurrency (LTE FDD) is enabled. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD.

parameters.id: Uplink Fixed High Quality RB Count
parameters.name: Uplink Fixed High Quality RB Count
parameters.description: Indicates the number of uplink fixed high-quality RBs for LTE when GSM and LTE Spectrum Concurrency (LTE FDD) is enabled. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD.

parameters.name: Spid
parameters.description: Indicates the subscriber profile ID (SPID). According to 3GPP specifications, the SPID can be from 1 to 256. When this parameter is set to 0, the eNodeB does not obtain the SPID from the MME or the eNodeB is not configured with an SPID for UEs. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: Drx status
parameters.description: Indicates whether to use normal or special DRX. If this parameter is set to TRUE, ordinary DRX parameters are applied to UEs with the SPID. If this parameter is set to FALSE, special DRX parameters are applied to UEs with the SPID. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: RAT frequency priority indication
parameters.description: Indicates whether to set the priority for the intra-RAT frequency. If this parameter is set to CFG(CFG), UEs select the target frequency based on the priority setting. If this parameter is set to NOT_CFG(NOT_CFG), UEs do not select the target frequency based on the priority setting. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: RAT frequency priority group ID
parameters.description: Indicates the ID of the intra-RAT frequency priority group. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: PreallocationStatus
parameters.description: Indicates whether to support preallocation. If this parameter is set to TRUE and PreAllocationSwitch under the UlSchSwitch parameter in the CellAlgoSwitch MO is set to selected, resources can be preallocated to UEs. Otherwise, resources are not preallocated to UEs. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: InterFreq Mlb Switch
parameters.description: Indicates whether to enable or disable inter-frequency load balancing for the SPID. The value TRUE or FALSE indicates that inter-frequency load balancing is allowed or prohibited for UEs with the SPID, respectively. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: InterRat Mlb Switch
parameters.description: Indicates whether to enable or disable inter-RAT load sharing for the SPID. The value TRUE or FALSE indicates that inter-RAT load sharing is allowed or prohibited for UEs with the SPID, respectively. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.id: SPID-based Handover Back To HPLMN Switch
parameters.name: SPID-based Handover Back To HPLMN Switch
parameters.description: Indicates whether to allow SPID-based handovers back to the home public land mobile network (HPLMN). If this parameter is set to TRUE(TRUE), a roaming UE can be handed over to the HPLMN network when it moves back to the coverage of the HPLMN network based on the SPID.
