If this parameter is set to FALSE(FALSE), this UE cannot be handed over to the HPLMN network based on the SPID. This parameter appl

parameters.name: Intra-Freq Handover Offset Factor
parameters.description: Indicates the offset of the IntraFreqHoA3Offset parameter for specified-service UEs. The value of the IntraFreqHoA3Offset parameter for specified-service UEs equals the value of the IntraFreqHoA3Offset parameter in the IntraFreqHoGroup MO plus the value of this parameter. If the value of the IntraFreqHoA3Offset parameter for specified-service UEs is less than the lower limit or greater than the up

parameters.name: Inter-Freq A2 RSRP Threshold Factor
parameters.description: Indicates the offset of the A3InterFreqHoA2ThdRsrp or InterFreqHoA2ThdRsrp parameter for specified-service UEs. The value of the A3InterFreqHoA2ThdRsrp or InterFreqHoA2ThdRsrp parameter for specified-service UEs equals the value of the A3InterFreqHoA2ThdRsrp or InterFreqHoA2ThdRsrp parameter in the InterFreqHoGroup MO plus the value of this parameter. If the value of the A3InterFreqHoA2ThdRsrp or

parameters.name: Inter-Freq A2 RSRQ Threshold Factor
parameters.description: Indicates the offset of the A3InterFreqHoA2ThdRsrq or InterFreqHoA2ThdRsrq parameter for specified-service UEs. The value of the A3InterFreqHoA2ThdRsrq or InterFreqHoA2ThdRsrq parameter for specified-service UEs equals the value of the A3InterFreqHoA2ThdRsrq or InterFreqHoA2ThdRsrq parameter in the InterFreqHoGroup MO plus the value of this parameter. If the value of the A3InterFreqHoA2ThdRsrq or

parameters.name: Specified User Flag
parameters.description: Indicates whether UEs with the SPID are dedicated to specific services. This parameter is used to implement differentiated processing. Set this parameter according to the operator's policy. The value SPECSERUSER indicates that UEs are dedicated to specific services. The value NONE indicates common UEs. If the SpecifiedCellFlag parameter in the Cell MO is set to SPECSERCELL(Specified service cell),

parameters.name: Idle Mlb Switch
parameters.description: Indicates whether to enable the function of MLB by transferring RRC_IDLE UEs with the specified SPID. If this parameter is set to TRUE(TRUE), the eNodeB can transfer RRC_IDLE UEs with the SPID for MLB. If the parameter is set to FALSE(FALSE), the eNodeB cannot transfer RRC_IDLE UEs with the SPID for MLB. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: Offload Switch
parameters.description: Indicates whether to enable SPID-specific offload. INTER_FREQUENCY_OFFLOAD_SWITCH: Indicates whether to enable inter-frequency offload. In inter-frequency offload, the eNodeB transfers UEs from a local cell to its inter-frequency neighboring cells to decrease the local cell load without considering the load difference between the local cell and the neighboring cells. The eNodeB can transfer UEs wi

parameters.name: UL Scheduling Priority Coeff
parameters.description: Indicates the coefficient corresponding to the uplink scheduling priority factor configured for UEs with the SPID. The uplink scheduling priority factor for UEs with the SPID equals the value of the UlschPriorityFactor parameter multiplied by the value of this parameter. This parameter is valid only for QCIs 6 to 9. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: DL Scheduling Priority Coeff
parameters.description: Indicates the coefficient corresponding to the downlink scheduling priority factor configured for UEs with the SPID. The downlink scheduling priority factor for UEs with the SPID equals the value of the DlschPriorityFactor parameter multiplied by the value of this parameter. This parameter is valid only for QCIs 6 to 9. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: SPID-based AMBR Limit Factor
parameters.description: Indicates the SPID-based AMBR limit factor for UEs whose rate is limited in DACQ scenarios. This parameter is valid only when the EnhancementCtrlSwitch option of the DacqEnhancementSwitch parameter in the CellAlgoSwitch MO is selected. If this parameter is set to 0, the rate of UEs with this SPID is not limited. If the GUI value is set to 100, the SPID-based AMBR limit factor does not take effect.

parameters.name: PUCCH Format 3 for 2CC Indication
parameters.description: Indicates whether UEs of the SPID in the 2CC CA state support PUCCH format 3. If this parameter is set to FALSE, UEs of the SPID in the 2CC CA state do not support PUCCH format 3. If this parameter is set to TRUE, UEs of the SPID in the 2CC CA state support PUCCH format 3. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: SPID-specific Best Effort GBR
parameters.description: Indicates the SPID-specific best-effort GBR. If this parameter is set to 0, the eNodeB does not assure the best-effort GBR for UEs with a specific SPID. If this parameter is set to a value greater than 0 and less than 1000, the eNodeB guarantees the SPID-specific best-effort GBR of 1000 Kbit/s for UEs with the specific SPID. If this parameter is set to a value greater than or equal to 1000, the eN

parameters.name: Handover to GERAN Forbid Switch
parameters.description: Indicates whether to allow handovers to GERAN. Handovers to GERAN are allowed only if this parameter is set to OFF. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: Inter-RAT A2 RSRP Threshold Offset
parameters.description: Indicates the offset relative to the inter-RAT handover A2 RSRP triggering threshold for specified UEs. The UTRAN (or GERAN) A2 RSRP triggering threshold is equal to the sum of this offset, InterRatHoCommGroup.InterRatHoA2ThdRsrp, CnOperatorHoCfg.UtranA2ThdRsrpOffset (or CnOperatorHoCfg.GeranA2ThdRsrpOffset), and CnOperatorQciPara.InterRatA2RsrpThldOffset. The UTRAN (or GERAN) A2 RSRP triggering t

parameters.name: Maximum Number of Carriers
parameters.description: Indicates the maximum number of component carriers (CCs) that can be aggregated for UEs with the specified SPID. If this parameter is set to 0, there is no restriction on the maximum number of CCs. If this parameter is set to a non-zero value, this value is the maximum number. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: Uplink MinGBR
parameters.description: Indicates the uplink minimum guaranteed bit rate (GBR) for UEs with the SPID. The uplink minimum GBR for UEs with the SPID takes effect only if this parameter is not set to 0. If this parameter is set to 0, the QCI-specific uplink minimum GBR takes effect. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: SPID-Specific UE Inactivity Timer
parameters.description: Indicates the length of the UE inactivity timer for UEs with the SPID. If the eNodeB detects that such a UE has neither received nor sent data for a period exceeding the value of this parameter, the eNodeB releases the RRC connection for the UE. If this parameter is set to 0, the UE inactivity timer is not used. If this parameter is set to 65535, this parameter does not take effect and the UeInact

parameters.name: SPID Algorithm Switch
parameters.description: Indicates whether to enable SPID-related algorithms. CA_IDLE_MLB_SWITCH: Assume that the SpidCfg.IdleMlbSwitch parameter is set to TRUE. If this option is selected, idle mode MLB takes effect for CA-capable UEs of the SPID. If this option is deselected, idle mode MLB does not take effect for CA-capable UEs of the SPID. This option does not take effect if the SpidCfg.IdleMlbSwitch parameter is set

parameters.name: SPID Group ID
parameters.description: Indicates the ID of an SPID group, which identifies a group of UEs whose SPIDs belong to the same group. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: Start SPID
parameters.description: Indicates the start SPID value. The value of an SPID defined in 3GPP specifications ranges from 1 to 256. However, this parameter can be set to 0. SPID 0 indicates the UEs that are not configured with SPIDs or whose SPIDs cannot be identified by the eNodeB. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: End SPID
parameters.description: Indicates the end SPID value. The value of an SPID defined in 3GPP specifications ranges from 1 to 256. However, this parameter can be set to 0. SPID 0 indicates the UEs that are not configured with SPIDs or whose SPIDs cannot be identified by the eNodeB. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: Start SPID
parameters.description: Indicates the start value of the SPID segment. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: End SPID
parameters.description: Indicates the end value of the SPID segment. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: Mobile Country Code
parameters.description: Indicates the mobile country code (MCC) of the HPLMN to which SPID-specific UEs are allowed to be handed over. A public land mobile network (PLMN) ID is comprised of an MCC and a mobile network code (MNC). The MCC consists of three digits. The MNC consists of two or three digits. For example, if the MCC is 123 and the MNC is 45, the PLMN ID is 12345. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE

parameters.name: Mobile Network Code
parameters.description: Indicates the mobile network code (MNC) of the HPLMN to which SPID-specific UEs are allowed to be handed over. A public land mobile network (PLMN) ID is comprised of a mobile country code (MCC) and an MNC. The MCC consists of three digits. The MNC consists of two or three digits. For example, if the MCC is 123 and the MNC is 45, the PLMN ID is 12345. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE

parameters.name: SRB RLC Parameter Adaptive Switch
parameters.description: Indicates whether to enable adaptive configuration of parameters related to Radio Link Control (RLC) on SRBs. If this parameter is set to ON, the eNodeB adaptively adjusts the SRB polling PDU retransmission timer for the eNodeB based on the timer expiration information and the number of scheduled UEs in the uplink. This aims to match the timer length and the interval at which UEs send the status r

parameters.name: SRB Polling Timer Adjust Step
parameters.description: Indicates the adjustment step of the SRB polling PDU retransmission timer for the eNodeB when the SrbRlcParaAdaptSwitch parameter is set to ON or the SMALL_BAND_RLC_OPT_SWITCH option of the SmallBandOptSwitch parameter is selected. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.id: Preset eNodeB SRB Poll Retransmit Timer
parameters.name: Preset eNodeB SRB Poll Retransmit Timer
parameters.description: Indicates the initial value of the SRB polling PDU retransmission timer for the eNodeB when the SrbRlcParaAdaptSwitch parameter is set to ON or the SMALL_BAND_RLC_OPT_SWITCH option of the SmallBandOptSwitch parameter is selected. If the SrbPollTimerPreset parameter value is greater than the SrbPollTimerMaxAdjustValue parameter value, the SrbPollTimerMaxAdjustValue parameter value is taken as the i

parameters.id: SRB Polling Timer Adjust User Threshold
parameters.name: SRB Polling Timer Adjust User Threshold
parameters.description: Indicates the UE number threshold for triggering the SRB RLC parameter adaptation. If the SrbRlcParaAdaptSwitch parameter is set to ON(On) and the number of UEs in a cell is greater than the SrbPollTimerAdjUserNumThd parameter value, the adaptive adjustment of the SRB polling PDU retransmission timer for the eNodeB is triggered. If the SMALL_BAND_RLC_OPT_SWITCH(SMALL_BAND_RLC_OPT_SWITCH) option of

parameters.name: RRCConnRel Maximum Retransmit Times
parameters.description: Indicates the maximum number of RRC Connection Release message retransmissions. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.id: SRB Polling Timer Maximum Adjust Value
parameters.name: SRB Polling Timer Maximum Adjust Value
parameters.description: Indicates the maximum adjustment step of the SRB polling PDU retransmission timer for the eNodeB when the SrbRlcParaAdaptSwitch parameter is set to ON or the SMALL_BAND_RLC_OPT_SWITCH option of the SmallBandOptSwitch parameter is selected. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.id: HO Command RRC Release Msg Retran Adp Sw
parameters.name: HO Command RRC Release Msg Retran Adp Sw
parameters.description: Indicates whether to optimize invalid retransmission of handover signaling and RRC release messages. The eNodeB optimizes invalid retransmission of handover signaling and RRC release messages only if this parameter is set to ON(On).

parameters.name: SRB ID
parameters.description: Indicates the SRB ID of an SRB RLC/PDCP parameter group. The SRB ID can be SRB1 or SRB2 for LTE, eMTC, NB-IoT, and short TTI.

parameters.name: MaxRetxThreshold for UE
parameters.description: Indicates the maximum number of RLC ARQ retransmissions for UEs, which limits the maximum number of AM PDU retransmissions. When the number of RCL ARQ retransmissions reaches the parameter value, an RRC connection reestablishment procedure is initiated. If you need to change the parameter value, contact Huawei technical support. This option applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: MaxRetxThreshold for eNodeB
parameters.description: Indicates the maximum number of RLC ARQ retransmissions for the eNodeB, which limits the maximum number of AM PDU retransmissions. When the number of RLC ARQ retransmissions reaches the parameter value, the eNodeB releases the UE. If you need to change the parameter value, contact Huawei technical support. This option applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: PollByte for UE
parameters.description: Indicates the UE-specific data volume threshold of PDUs to trigger polling. When the data volume of transmitted PDUs reaches this parameter value, a Poll flag is set in the PDU headers. If you need to change the value of this parameter, turn to Huawei technical support personnel for assistance. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: PollByte for eNodeB
parameters.description: Indicates the eNodeB-specific data volume threshold of PDUs to trigger polling. When the data volume of transmitted PDUs reaches this parameter value, a Poll flag is set in the PDU headers. If you need to change the value of this parameter, turn to Huawei technical support personnel for assistance. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: PollPdu for UE
parameters.description: Indicates the UE-specific number of PDUs to trigger polling. When the number of transmitted PDUs reaches this parameter value, a Poll flag is set in the PDU headers. If you need to change the value of this parameter, turn to Huawei technical support personnel for assistance. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: PollPdu for eNodeB
parameters.description: Indicates the eNodeB-specific number of PDUs to trigger polling. When the number of transmitted PDUs reaches this parameter value, a Poll flag is set in the PDU headers. If you need to change the value of this parameter, turn to Huawei technical support personnel for assistance. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: Poll retransmit timer for UE
parameters.description: Indicates the length of the polling PDU retransmission timer for the UE. If you need to change the value of this parameter, turn to Huawei technical support personnel for assistance. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: Poll retransmit timer for eNodeB
parameters.description: Indicates the length of the polling PDU retransmission timer for the eNodeB. If you need to change the parameter value, contact Huawei technical support. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: Status prohibit timer for UE
parameters.description: Indicates the length of the UE-specific timer for prohibiting the receiver from sending status reports in AM. If you need to change the value of this parameter, turn to Huawei technical support personnel for assistance. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: Status prohibit timer for eNodeB
parameters.description: Indicates the length of the eNodeB-specific timer for prohibiting status reporting from the receiver in AM. If you need to change the value of this parameter, turn to Huawei technical support personnel for assistance. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: AM reordering timer for UE
parameters.description: Indicates the length of the UE-specific timer for reordering at the receiver in AM. If you need to change the parameter value, contact Huawei technical support.

parameters.name: AM reordering timer for eNodeB
parameters.description: Indicates the length of the eNodeB-specific timer for reordering at the receiver in AM. If you need to change the parameter value, contact Huawei technical support.

parameters.name: NB-IoT eNodeB Polling Retransmission Timer
parameters.description: Indicates the length of the polling PDU retransmission timer of the RLC layer for the NB-IoT eNodeB. If you need to change the value of this parameter, contact Huawei technical support for assistance. This parameter applies only to NB-IoT.

parameters.name: NB-IoT UE Polling Retransmission Timer
parameters.description: Indicates the length of the polling PDU retransmission timer of the RLC layer for the NB-IoT UE. If you need to change the value of this parameter, contact Huawei technical support for assistance. This parameter applies only to NB-IoT.

parameters.id: Max Retransmission Thld for NB-IoT eNodeB
parameters.name: Max Retransmission Thld for NB-IoT eNodeB
parameters.description: Indicates the maximum number of RLC ARQ retransmissions for the NB-IoT eNodeB, which limits the maximum number of RLC ARQ retransmissions in AM mode for the NB-IoT eNodeB. When the number of RLC ARQ retransmissions reaches the parameter value, the eNodeB releases the UE. This parameter applies only to NB-IoT.

parameters.id: Max Retransmission Thld for NB-IoT UE
parameters.name: Max Retransmission Thld for NB-IoT UE
parameters.description: Indicates the maximum number of RLC ARQ retransmissions for NB-IoT UEs, which limits the maximum number of RLC ARQ retransmissions in AM mode for NB-IoT UEs. When the number of RLC ARQ retransmissions reaches the parameter value, the UE initiates an RRC connection reestablishment procedure. This parameter applies only to NB-IoT.

parameters.name: IPv6 Source Route Index
parameters.description: Indicates the index of a source IPv6 route.

parameters.name: VRF Index
parameters.description: Indicates the index of a VRF instance.

parameters.name: Source IPv6 Address
parameters.description: Indicates the source IPv6 address of a source IPv6 route.

parameters.name: Route Type
parameters.description: Indicates the type of a source-based IPv6 route. The value NEXTHOP indicates that IP packets transmitted through the route are forwarded to a specified next-hop IP address. The value IF indicates that IP packets transmitted through the route are forwarded through a specified outbound interface to a specified next-hop IP address.

parameters.name: Next-Hop IPv6 Address
parameters.description: Indicates the next-hop IPv6 address of a source IPv6 route.

parameters.name: Interface ID
parameters.description: Indicates the ID of the specified outbound interface.

parameters.name: Preference
parameters.description: Indicates the priority of the source IPv6 routing entry. A smaller parameter value indicates a higher priority.

parameters.name: User Label
parameters.description: Indicates the user-defined information.

parameters.name: Cabinet No.
parameters.description: Indicates the cabinet number of the board to which a source IPv6 route belongs.

parameters.name: Subrack No.
parameters.description: Indicates the subrack number of the board to which a source IPv6 route belongs.

parameters.name: Slot No.
parameters.description: Indicates the slot number of the board to which a source IPv6 route belongs.

parameters.name: Actual Port Type
parameters.description: Indicates the type of the actual port.

parameters.name: Actual Port No.
parameters.description: Indicates the number of the actual port.

parameters.name: Valid State
parameters.description: Indicates the validity state of a source IPv6 route.

parameters.name: Number of Transmit Packets
parameters.description: Indicates the number of transmitted packets. When enhanced ping6 connectivity check is enabled, ping6 packets are directly forwarded without matching routes and the number of transmitted packets cannot be measured.

parameters.name: Cabinet No.
parameters.description: Indicates the cabinet number of the board where the SRIO port is located.

parameters.name: Subrack No.
parameters.description: Indicates the subrack number of the board where the SRIO port is located.

parameters.name: Slot No.
parameters.description: Indicates the slot number of the board where the SRIO port is located.

parameters.name: Port No.
parameters.description: Indicates the number of the SRIO port.

parameters.name: Local cell ID
parameters.description: Indicates the local ID of the cell. It uniquely identifies a cell within an eNodeB. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: SRS subframe configuration
parameters.description: Indicates the index of SRS subframe configuration for the cell. The value SCn, where n is variable, represents configuration n. For example, the value SC0 indicates subframe configuration 0, and the value SC1 indicates subframe configuration 1. For an FDD cell, value SC15 is reserved; for a TDD cell, values SC14 and SC15 are both reserved. Reserved values are not used for configuration. For the re

parameters.name: SRS ACK/NACK simultaneous transmission
parameters.description: Indicates whether the sounding reference signal (SRS) of a UE and the ACK/NACK or scheduling request (SR) on the PUCCH are allowed to use the same time resources for simultaneous transmission in the case of time domain conflict. This parameter does not take effect on eMTC UEs. In the case of time domain conflict, the SRS of eMTC UEs and the ACK/NACK or SR on the PUCCH are allowed to use the same t

parameters.name: SRS Configuration Indicator
parameters.description: Indicates whether to configure sounding reference signal (SRS) resources for UEs in a cell. The value BOOLEAN_TRUE indicates that SRS resources are available in the cell and can be configured for UEs in the cell. The value BOOLEAN_FALSE indicates that no SRS resource is available in the cell, and therefore no UE in the cell is configured with SRS resources. This parameter does not take effect on:

parameters.name: TDD SRS Configuration Mode
parameters.description: Indicates the SRS configuration for LTE TDD. If this parameter is set to ACCESS_FIRST, the SRS configuration designed to preferentially guarantee the maximum number of UEs that can access a cell and BHCA is used. If this parameter is set to EXPERIENCE_FIRST, the SRS configuration designed to preferentially guarantee user experience (for example, beamforming performance) is used. If this parameter

parameters.name: FDD SRS Configuration Mode
parameters.description: Indicates the allocation mode of sounding reference signal (SRS) resources in LTE FDD. This parameter must be set when the SrsCfgInd parameter is set to BOOLEAN_TRUE(True). If the FddSrsCfgMode parameter is set to DEFAULTMODE(Default Mode), SRS resource allocation is activated by default after a cell is established, and SRS resources are allocated to UEs that access the cell. If this parameter is

parameters.name: SRS Algorithm Optimization Switch
parameters.description: Indicates whether to enable SRS algorithm optimization. SrsSubframeRecfgOptSwitch: Indicates whether to perform SRS subframe reconfiguration optimization. This option applies only to LTE FDD. If this option is selected, the SRS subframe reconfiguration path is optimized to avoid the configurations that may cause UE compatibility issues. If this option is deselected, the SRS subframe reconfiguratio

parameters.name: SRS Configure Policy Switch
parameters.description: Indicates the SRS configuration policy. This parameter applies only to LTE TDD. SRSPolicyforUL2LayersMIMO: Indicates the two-antenna-port SRS configuration policy if two antenna ports are configured for a UE in the uplink. If this option is deselected, the eNodeB preferentially allocates short-term SRSs (including single-antenna-port SRSs). If this option is selected, the eNodeB preferentially all

parameters.name: Reserved Resource SRS Period 1
parameters.description: Indicates the SRS period for resources always reserved in the first half frame for inter-cell D-MIMO, DL CoMP, and UL CAMC. This parameter applies only to LTE TDD.

parameters.name: Reserved Resource SRS Period 2
parameters.description: Indicates the SRS period for resources always reserved in the second half frame for inter-cell D-MIMO, DL CoMP, and UL CAMC. This parameter applies only to LTE TDD.

parameters.name: SRS Resource Optimization Switch
parameters.description: Indicates whether to optimize SRS resource allocation for 2R access enhancement. If this parameter is set to ON(On), quadruple code division can be used for SRS resource allocation to enhance 2R access. If this parameter is set to OFF(Off), quadruple code division cannot be used for SRS resource allocation to enhance 2R access. This parameter applies only to LTE TDD.

parameters.name: SRS Interference Avoid Optimization Switch
parameters.description: Indicates how SRS allocation is optimized to avoid interference based on the physical beam serving UEs. The default value OFF indicates that the optimization does not take effect. If this parameter is set to CLOCKWISE_COMB1, comb 1 SRS resources are preferentially allocated to UEs in the clockwise direction to the boundary beam, and comb 0 SRS resources are preferentially allocated to UEs in the c

parameters.name: SRS Resource Expansion Switch
parameters.description: Indicates whether to enable SRS resource expansion. If this parameter is set to OFF, SRS resource expansion is disabled. If this parameter is set to SRS_RES_EXPANSION_MODE, SRS resource expansion is enabled. This parameter applies only to LTE TDD.

parameters.name: Cell srs bandwidth configuration
parameters.description: Indicates the cell-specific SRS bandwidth. It corresponds to the srs-BandwidthConfig parameter in the protocol. For details, see 3GPP TS 36.211. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: Primary Local Cell ID
parameters.description: Indicates the local cell ID of a primary cell. It uniquely identifies a cell within an eNodeB. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: Ssrd Local Cell ID
parameters.description: Indicates the local cell ID of a split cell. It uniquely identifies a cell within an eNodeB. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: MAC Entry Index
parameters.description: Indicates the index of an entry in a MAC forwarding table.

parameters.name: Switch Port Index
parameters.description: Indicates the index of the switch port corresponding to an entry in a MAC forwarding table.

parameters.name: Destination MAC Address
parameters.description: Indicates the destination MAC address of an entry in a MAC forwarding table. The format must be "XXXX-XXXX-XXXX".

parameters.name: MAC Type
parameters.description: Indicates the type of effective MAC addresses. The value of this parameter can be STATIC, DYNAMIC, or AUTO.

parameters.name: MAC Aging Time
parameters.description: Indicates the remaining aging time of an entry in a MAC forwarding table.

parameters.name: Local Cell ID
parameters.description: Indicates the local ID of a cell, which uniquely identifies a cell within an eNodeB. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD.

parameters.name: SFN Cell ID
parameters.description: Indicates the ID of an SFN cell in a super combined cell. This parameter value must be set based on network planning. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD.

parameters.name: Local Cell ID
parameters.description: Indicates the local ID of the cell. It uniquely identifies a cell within the eNodeB.

parameters.id: Stop Bundling DL TTI-Level PRB Thld
parameters.name: Stop Bundling DL TTI-Level PRB Thld
parameters.description: Indicates the downlink TTI-level PRB usage threshold used to determine whether to continue bundled scheduling in a TTI. If the PRB usage in the current TTI is higher than this threshold, the eNodeB stops bundled scheduling in this TTI. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.id: Trig Bundled Scheduling DL Avg PRB Thld
parameters.name: Trig Bundled Scheduling DL Avg PRB Thld
parameters.description: Indicates the average downlink PRB usage threshold for triggering bundled scheduling. When the average PRB usage of a cell is less than this threshold, bundled scheduling takes effect in the cell. When the average PRB usage of a cell is greater than or equal to the sum of this threshold and the PRB usage offset, bundled scheduling stops taking effect. If this parameter is set to 0, bundled schedul

parameters.name: Multi-RAT Symbol Shutdown Switch
parameters.description: Indicates whether to enable the functions related to multi-RAT symbol power saving in the cell. If this parameter is set to ON, multi-RAT symbol power saving is enabled. If this parameter is set to OFF, multi-RAT symbol power saving is disabled.

parameters.name: Symbol Shutdown Enhanced Switch
parameters.description: Indicates whether to enable enhanced symbol power saving functions in the cell. LNR_BUNDLED_SCHEDULING_SW: Indicates whether to enable LTE and NR bundled scheduling in multi-RAT symbol power saving. This option applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD. DEEP_SYMBOL_SHUTDOWN_SW: Indicates whether to enable deep symbol power saving for RF modules.

parameters.name: MBSFN Shutdown Start Time
parameters.description: Indicates the start time of MBSFN enhanced symbol shutdown. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: MBSFN Shutdown Stop Time
parameters.description: Indicates the stop time of MBSFN enhanced symbol shutdown. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.id: Resource Group Uplink Admission Control Algorithm Switch
parameters.name: Resource Group Uplink Admission Control Algorithm Switch
parameters.description: Indicates whether to apply UL admission control to a resource group.

parameters.id: Resource Group Downlink Admission Control Algorithm Switch
parameters.name: Resource Group Downlink Admission Control Algorithm Switch
parameters.description: Indicates whether to apply DL admission control to a resource group.

parameters.name: Uplink Handover Service Admission Threshold
parameters.description: Indicates the UL admission threshold for handover services. A large value of this parameter will result in a high UL admission success rate of handed-over services.

parameters.name: Downlink Handover Service Admission Threshold
parameters.description: Indicates the DL admission threshold for handover services. A large value of this parameter will result in a high DL admission success rate of handed-over services.

parameters.id: Uplink Golden New Service Admission Threshold
parameters.name: Uplink Golden New Service Admission Threshold
parameters.description: Indicates the UL admission threshold for new gold-level services. A large value of this parameter will result in a high UL admission success rate of new gold-level services.

parameters.id: Downlink Golden New Service Admission Threshold
parameters.name: Downlink Golden New Service Admission Threshold
parameters.description: Indicates the DL admission threshold for new gold-level services. A large value of this parameter will result in a high DL admission success rate of new gold-level services.

parameters.id: Uplink Silver New Service Admission Threshold
parameters.name: Uplink Silver New Service Admission Threshold
parameters.description: Indicates the UL admission threshold for new silver-level services. A large value of this parameter will result in a high UL admission success rate of new silver-level services.

parameters.id: Downlink Silver New Service Admission Threshold
parameters.name: Downlink Silver New Service Admission Threshold
parameters.description: Indicates the DL admission threshold for new silver-level services. A large value of this parameter will result in a high DL admission success rate of new silver-level services.

parameters.id: Uplink Bronze New Service Admission Threshold
parameters.name: Uplink Bronze New Service Admission Threshold
parameters.description: Indicates the UL admission threshold for new copper-level services. A large value of this parameter will result in a high UL admission success rate of new copper-level services.

parameters.id: Downlink Bronze New Service Admission Threshold
parameters.name: Downlink Bronze New Service Admission Threshold
parameters.description: Indicates the DL admission threshold for new copper-level services. A large value of this parameter will result in a high DL admission success rate of new copper-level services.

parameters.name: Uplink GBR Service Admission Threshold
parameters.description: Indicates the UL admission threshold for the guaranteed bit rate (GBR) service. A large value of this parameter will result in a high UL admission success rate of GBR services.

parameters.name: Downlink GBR Service Admission Threshold
parameters.description: Indicates the DL admission threshold for the guaranteed bit rate (GBR) service. A large value of this parameter will result in a high DL admission success rate of GBR services.

parameters.id: Uplink Iron New Service Admission Threshold
parameters.name: Uplink Iron New Service Admission Threshold
parameters.description: Indicates the UL admission threshold for new iron-level services. A large value of this parameter will result in a high UL admission success rate of new iron-level services.

parameters.id: Downlink Iron New Service Admission Threshold
parameters.name: Downlink Iron New Service Admission Threshold
parameters.description: Indicates the DL admission threshold for new iron-level services. A large value of this parameter will result in a high DL admission success rate of new iron-level services.

parameters.name: Uplink Pre-emption Algorithm Switch
parameters.description: Indicates whether to enable the UL pre-emption algorithm. If this parameter is set to ON, the UL pre-emption algorithm is enabled. In this case, the service with a higher priority that requests for admission may pre-empt the resources of admitted services with lower priorities when UL transmission bandwidth is insufficient. If this parameter is set to OFF, the UL pre-emption algorithm is disabled.

parameters.name: Downlink Pre-emption Algorithm Switch
parameters.description: Indicates whether to enable the UL pre-emption algorithm. If this parameter is set to ON, the UL pre-emption algorithm is enabled. In this case, the service with a higher priority that requests for admission may pre-empt the resources of admitted services with lower priorities when UL transmission bandwidth is insufficient. If this parameter is set to OFF, the UL pre-emption algorithm is disabled.

parameters.id: Physical Port Up Link OverBooking Switch
parameters.name: Physical Port Up Link OverBooking Switch
parameters.description: Indicates whether to enable UL overbooking admission control. It is used to determine the admission bandwidth of the resource group and facilitate admission control.

parameters.id: Physical Port Down Link OverBooking Switch
parameters.name: Physical Port Down Link OverBooking Switch
parameters.description: Indicates whether to enable DL overbooking admission control. It is used to determine the admission bandwidth of the resource group and facilitate admission control.

parameters.id: Physical Port Up Link Admission Switch
parameters.name: Physical Port Up Link Admission Switch
parameters.description: Indicates whether to apply UL admission control over a physical port. If this parameter is set to ON, UL admission control is applied to the physical port. If this parameter is set to OFF, UL admission control is not applied to the physical port.

parameters.id: Physical Port Down Link Admission Switch
parameters.name: Physical Port Down Link Admission Switch
parameters.description: Indicates whether to apply DL admission control over a physical port. If this parameter is set to ON, DL admission control is applied to the physical port. If this parameter is set to OFF, DL admission control is not applied to the physical port.

parameters.name: Emergency Call Preferential Admission Switch
parameters.description: Indicates whether to preferentially admit emergency calls. When this parameter is set to ON, transmission admission control is not performed for emergency calls and emergency calls will be successfully admitted. When this parameter is set to OFF and the transmission admission algorithm switch is turned on, transmission admission control is performed for emergency calls. When this switch is set to

parameters.name: TCE ID
parameters.description: Indicates the ID of the TCE for MDT. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: IP Mode
parameters.description: Indicates the IP address version. IPv4~0 indicates that the IP version is IPv4. IPv6~1 indicates that the IP version is IPv6.

parameters.name: TCE IPv4 Address
parameters.description: Indicates the IPv4 address of the TCE.

parameters.name: TCE IPv6 Address
parameters.description: Indicates the IPv6 address of the TCE.

parameters.name: TCP ACK Limit Switch
parameters.description: Indicates whether to enable the TCP ACK limit algorithm. When this switch is set to on, the base station limits the ACK data rate of downlink TCP services based on the value of DL Throughput Threshold. In this case, the ACK burst of downlink TCP services is prevented and the KPIs related to the downlink throughput rate are improved, but the packet forwarding capability of boards is affected. When

parameters.name: DL Throughput Threshold
parameters.description: Indicates the maximum downlink service throughput that can be set by the TCP ACK limit algorithm. When this switch is set to on, the ACK burst of downlink TCP services is prevented and the KPIs related to the downlink throughput are improved.

parameters.name: TCP MSS Control Switch
parameters.description: Indicates the switch used to enable or disable the TCP MSS function. If this switch is turned off, TCP packets are transparently transmitted without being processed. If this switch is turned on, the value of the MSS field in each packet for TCP link setups can be modified. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: TCP MSS Threshold
parameters.description: Indicates the threshold for the value of the MSS field in packets for TCP link setups. If the TCP MSS function is enabled, the eNodeB first checks the MSS field in each packet for TCP link setups. If the value of the MSS field is greater than the predefined threshold, the eNodeB changes the value of the MSS field to the predefined threshold. Then, the eNodeB recalculates the TCP checksum and retra

parameters.name: Uplink High Load Trigger Threshold
parameters.description: Indicates the threshold for triggering the UL high load. If the ratio of the UL transport load to the UL transport bandwidth of the BS keeps above this threshold for a period of hysteresis, the UL transport load of the BS enters the high-load state. In UL high-load state, the BS sends a UL S1 TNL Load Indicator, which is set to HighLoad, to each neighboring BS through the X2 interface.

parameters.name: Downlink High Load Trigger Threshold
parameters.description: Indicates the threshold for triggering the DL high load. If the ratio of the DL transport load to the DL transport bandwidth of the BS keeps above this threshold for a period of hysteresis, the DL transport load of the BS enters the high-load state. In DL high-load state, the BS sends a DL S1 TNL Load Indicator, which is set to HighLoad, to each neighboring BS through the X2 interface.

parameters.name: Uplink High Load Clear Threshold
parameters.description: Indicates the threshold for clearing the UL high load. If the ratio of the UL transport load to the UL transport bandwidth of the BS keeps below this threshold for a period of hysteresis, the UL transport load of the BS enters the medium-load state. In UL medium load state, the BS sends a UL S1 TNL Load Indicator, which is set to MediumLoad, to each neighboring BS through the X2 interface.

parameters.name: Downlink High Load Clear Threshold
parameters.description: Indicates the threshold for clearing the DL high load. If the ratio of the transport load to the transmission bandwidth in DL of the BS keeps below this threshold for a period of time, the DL transport load of the BS enters the medium-load state. In DL medium-load state, the BS sends a DL S1 TNL Load Indicator, which is set to MediumLoad, to each neighboring BS through the X2 interface.

parameters.name: Uplink Medium Load Trigger Threshold
parameters.description: Indicates the threshold for triggering the UL medium load. If the ratio of the UL transport load to the UL transport bandwidth of the BS is above this threshold, the UL transport load of the BS enters the medium-load state. In UL medium-load state, the BS sends a UL S1 TNL Load Indicator, which is set to MediumLoad, to each neighboring BS through the X2 interface.

parameters.name: Downlink Medium Load Trigger Threshold
parameters.description: Indicates the threshold for triggering the DL medium load. If the ratio of the DL transport load to the DL transport bandwidth of the BS is above this threshold, the DL transport load of the BS enters the medium-load state. In DL medium-load state, the BS sends a DL S1 TNL Load Indicator, which is set to MediumLoad, to each neighboring BS through the X2 interface.

parameters.name: Uplink Medium Load Clear Threshold
parameters.description: Indicates the threshold for clearing the UL medium load. If the ratio of the UL transport load to the UL transport bandwidth of the BS is below this threshold, the UL transport load of the BS enters the low-load state. In UL low-load state, the BS sends a UL S1 TNL Load Indicator, which is set to LowLoad, to each neighboring BS through the X2 interface.

parameters.name: Downlink Medium Load Clear Threshold
parameters.description: Indicates the threshold for clearing the DL medium load. If the ratio of the DL transport load to the DL transport bandwidth of the BS is below this threshold, the DL transport load of the BS enters the low-load state. In DL low-load state, the BS sends a DL S1 TNL Load Indicator, which is set to LowLoad, to each neighboring BS through the X2 interface.

parameters.name: TM9 CC Downlink EARFCN
parameters.description: Indicates the downlink EARFCN of a TM9-dedicated carrier. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD.

parameters.name: CRS Transmission Strategy
parameters.description: Indicates whether to transmit PDSCH CRSs across the entire channel bandwidth or using only central RBs on the TM9-dedicated carrier. If this parameter is set to ALL_RB_ON, the CRSs are transmitted across the entire channel bandwidth. If this parameter is set to CENTRAL_RB_ON, the CRSs are transmitted using only the six RBs in the center of the channel bandwidth. This parameter applies only to LTE

parameters.name: Work Mode
parameters.description: Indicates the working mode of the TM9-dedicated carrier. When this parameter is set to TM9_DEDICATED_SCC, the TM9-dedicated carrier can be configured only as an SCC. When this parameter is set to TM9_DEDICATED_CC, the TM9-dedicated carrier can be configured as a PCC or an SCC. When this parameter is set to R10PLUS_DEDICATED_CC, the TM9-dedicated carrier can only be used by UEs complying with 3GPP

parameters.name: Uplink OLC Algorithm Switch
parameters.description: Indicates the UL Over Load Control (OLC) algorithm switch. When this switch is set to ON, bandwidth of the services with a low priority will be released to guarantee the QoS of the services with a high priority when TX bandwidth changes or during the overload caused by non-flow-control services.

parameters.name: Downlink OLC Algorithm Switch
parameters.description: Indicates the UL Over Load Control (OLC) algorithm switch. When this switch is set to ON, bandwidth of the services with a low priority will be released to guarantee the QoS of the services with a high priority when TX bandwidth changes or during the overload caused by non-flow-control services.

parameters.name: Uplink OLC Trigger Threshold
parameters.description: Indicates the threshold for triggering the UL OLC. When the UL bandwidth usage reaches the threshold, low-priority services are removed to guarantee the quality of high-priority services.

parameters.name: Uplink OLC Release Threshold
parameters.description: Indicates the threshold for clearing the UL OLC. When the UL bandwidth usage is below this threshold, user services are no longer removed.

parameters.id: Number of Bearers Released During OLC
parameters.name: Number of Bearers Released During OLC
parameters.description: Indicates the number of released services during an OLC action period.

parameters.name: Downlink OLC Trigger Threshold
parameters.description: Indicates the threshold for triggering the DL OLC. When the DL bandwidth usage reaches the threshold, low-priority services are removed to guarantee the quality of high-priority services.

parameters.name: Downlink OLC Release Threshold
parameters.description: Indicates the threshold for clearing the DL OLC. When the DL bandwidth usage is below this threshold, user services are no longer removed.

parameters.name: TCP Port Number
parameters.description: Indicates the number of ports to which TCP acceleration is to be applied. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: TCP Port 1
parameters.description: Indicates port 1 to which TPE is to be applied. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: TCP Port 2
parameters.description: Indicates port 2 to which TPE is to be applied. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: TCP Port 3
parameters.description: Indicates port 3 to which TPE is to be applied. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: TCP Port 4
parameters.description: Indicates port 4 to which TPE is to be applied. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: TCP Port 5
parameters.description: Indicates port 5 to which TPE is to be applied. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: Port ID
parameters.description: Indicates the port ID of a tunnel interface. The value of PORTID in the TUNNELITF MOs configured by users ranges from 0 to 127. The value of PORTID in the TUNNELITF MOs configured by the system ranges from 10000 to 19999.

parameters.name: Mode
parameters.description: Indicates the mode of the tunnel interface.

parameters.name: VRF Index
parameters.description: Indicates the index of a VRF instance.

parameters.name: Local IPv6 Address
parameters.description: Indicates the local IPv6 address of the tunnel interface.

parameters.name: Remote IPv6 Address
parameters.description: Indicates the remote IPv6 address of the tunnel interface.

parameters.name: Control Mode
parameters.description: Indicates whether the object can be automatically modified or removed by the system. When this parameter is set to MANUAL_MODE, only users can perform operations on the object. When this parameter is set to AUTO_MODE, only the system can perform operations on the object.

parameters.name: QoS Class Identifier
parameters.description: Indicates the QoS class identifier (QCI). QCI 1 indicates the requirements for traditional voice services. QCI 2 indicates the requirements for traditional video (live streaming) services. QCI 3 indicates the requirements for traditional real-time gaming services and Internet of Vehicles (IoV) services. QCI 4 indicates the requirements for traditional video (buffered streaming) services. QCI 5 ind

parameters.name: Periodic BSR Timer
parameters.description: Indicates the length of the timer for periodic transmission of buffer status reports (BSRs). BSRs are sent periodically or as triggered by events. Periodic transmission of BSRs uses the timer specified by this parameter. When the timer expires, a BSR is sent. After the BSR is sent, the timer is restarted. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: BSR Retransmission Timer
parameters.description: Indicates the length of the buffer status report (BSR) retransmission timer. This timer is started after a BSR is sent. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: Access Control Parameter Group ID
parameters.description: Indicates the ID of an access control parameter group. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.id: Barring State for Specific Access ID
parameters.name: Barring State for Specific Access ID
parameters.description: Indicates whether access barring check is required for UEs with a specific access ID. If an option is deselected, UEs with the access ID indicated in this option are allowed to access. If an option is selected, access barring check will be performed for UEs with the access ID indicated in this option when these UEs initiate access. During an access barring check, the UE determines whether it is al

parameters.name: User Data Type Number
parameters.description: Indicates the number of a user data type. User data types numbered from 1 to 9, 65, 66, 69, 70, 75, 79, 80, and 85 are standard user data types that are automatically configured by a base station. User data types numbered 0, and from 10 to 255 excluding 65, 66, 69, 70, 75, 79, 80, and 85 are extended user data types.

parameters.id: User Data Type Transfer Parameter Group ID.
parameters.name: User Data Type Transfer Parameter Group ID.
parameters.description: Indicates the ID of a transport parameter group of services corresponding to a user data type. User data types numbered from 1 to 9, 65, 66, 69, 70, 75, 79, 80, and 85 are standard user data types. User data types numbered from 1 to 9 correspond to transport parameter groups with IDs 40 to 48, user data types numbered 65, 66, 75 and 85 correspond to the transport parameter group with ID 40, user d

parameters.id: User Data Type Transfer Parameter Group ID
parameters.name: User Data Type Transfer Parameter Group ID
parameters.description: Indicates the ID of a transport parameter group of services corresponding to a user data type. User data types numbered from 1 to 9, 65, 66, 69, 70, 75, 79, 80, and 85 are standard user data types. User data types numbered from 1 to 9 correspond to transport parameter groups with IDs 40 to 48, user data types numbered 65, 66, 75, and 85 correspond to the transport parameter group with ID 40, user

parameters.name: Priority Rule
parameters.description: Indicates the rule for prioritizing traffic to meet service requirements. If this parameter is set to IPPRECEDENCE, the protocol stack of the earlier version is adopted, which firstly converts a Type of Service (TOS) to a DSCP and then prioritizes traffic.

parameters.name: Priority
parameters.description: Indicates the priority of the service data, which is identified by a DSCP value. The priority of the service data has a positive correlation with the DSCP value.

parameters.name: Act Factor
parameters.description: Indicates the activity factor of the services corresponding to a QCI.

parameters.name: Primary Transport Resource Type
parameters.description: Indicates the type of primary transport resource used to transmit the user data when hybrid transmission is adopted. HQ indicates that high-quality transport resources are used, while LQ indicates that low-quality transport resources are used. When a new service requests admission and admission control is performed, one of the IP path routes with transport resources of the same quality is used as

parameters.name: Primary Port Load Threshold
parameters.description: Indicates the primary port load threshold of the user data in the hybrid transmission scenario. A larger value indicates that services are more likely to be admitted to the primary path.

parameters.id: Primary To Secondary Port Load Ratio Threshold
parameters.name: Primary To Secondary Port Load Ratio Threshold
parameters.description: Indicates the primary-to-secondary port load ratio threshold of user data in the hybrid transmission scenario. A smaller value indicates that services are more likely to be admitted to the primary path.

parameters.name: Index
parameters.description: Indicates the index of a UE compatibility processing action. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: UE Information Type
parameters.description: Indicates the information type to identify UEs. The information includes the specified TAC, the specified TAC and SVN, and the specified capability. If this parameter is set to IMEISV_TAC, the ImeisvTac parameter must be configured. If this parameter is set to IMEISV_TAC_SVN, the ImeisvTac and ImeisvSvn parameters must be configured. If this parameter is set to UE_CAPABILITY, the UeCapIndex parame

parameters.name: Imeisv Tac
parameters.description: Indicates the type allocation code (TAC) in the IMEISVs of UEs. Each TAC identifies a UE model. For details about IMEISVs, see section 6.2.2 in 3GPP TS 23.003 V10.1.0 or later releases. If the UeInfoType parameter is set to IMEISV_TAC or IMEISV_TAC_SVN, this parameter must be set. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: Imeisv Svn
parameters.description: Indicates the software version number (SVN) in the IMEISVs of UEs. Each SVN identifies a software version of UEs. For details about IMEISVs, see section 6.2.2 in 3GPP TS 23.003 V10.1.0 or later releases. If the UeInfoType parameter is set to IMEISV_TAC_SVN, this parameter must be set. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: UE Capability Index
parameters.description: Indicates the UE capability index. This parameter is mapped to the UeCapIndex parameter in the UeInfo MO. The index must be set if the UeInfoType parameter is set to UE_CAPABILITY. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: Black List Control Switch
parameters.description: Indicates whether to blacklist some features. LTE_ANR_SWITCH_OFF: If this option is selected, the following functions are disabled for defective UEs: intra-RAT event-triggered ANR, intra-RAT fast ANR, active PCI conflict detection, ANR based on specified PCI groups, and E-UTRAN measurement functions controlled by MlbBasedEventAnrSwitch. This option applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD. UTRAN_ANR_SW

parameters.name: White List Control Switch
parameters.description: Indicates whether to whitelist some features. RANK_DETECT_SWITCH_ON: Indicates whether the eNodeB performs rank detection for specified UEs. This function is enabled only if this option is selected. This option applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD. UL_AMRC_SWITCH_ON: Indicates whether to enable the function of uplink AMRC for specified UEs. This function is enabled only if this option is selected.

parameters.name: Ue Type Description
parameters.description: Indicates the user-defined description of UEs. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.id: White List Private CA Band Combination
parameters.name: White List Private CA Band Combination
parameters.description: Indicates whether a private CA band combination takes effect only on UEs in the whitelist. If an option is selected, the specified private CA band combination takes effect only on the whitelisted UEs. If the option is deselected, the combination takes effect on all CA UEs. For example, if PRIVATECACOMBID_0 is selected, the private CA band combination with an ID of 0 takes effect only on the whitel

parameters.name: UE Differential DRX Switch
parameters.description: Indicates whether to enable UE-specific differentiated DRX configuration. UE-specific differentiated DRX configuration is allowed only when this parameter is set to ON. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: Blacklist Control Extension Switch 1
parameters.description: Indicates whether to blacklist some features. UL_64QAM_SWITCH: Indicates whether to disable uplink 64QAM for defective UEs. If this option is selected, uplink 64QAM is disabled for defective UEs. If this option is deselected, no differentiated measures are taken for defective UEs. This option applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD. FULL_CONFIG_SWITCH: Indicates whether to disable the full configurati

parameters.name: UE-specific Configuration Index
parameters.description: Indicates the index of a UE-specific configuration. The index is the value of the UeSpecificConfigIndex parameter in the associated UeSpecificPara MO. The parameter value 0 indicates an invalid index. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: Blacklisted Neighboring Freq 1 EARFCN
parameters.description: Indicates the downlink EARFCN of blacklisted neighboring frequency 1. If this parameter is set to 0, this parameter does not take effect. If this parameter is set to a non-zero value, the following functions do not take effect for defective UEs: 1. The eNodeB does not deliver measurement configuration for this frequency. 2. The eNodeB does not add this frequency as an SCC. 3. The eNodeB does not p

parameters.name: Blacklisted Neighboring Freq 2 EARFCN
parameters.description: Indicates the downlink EARFCN of blacklisted neighboring frequency 2. If this parameter is set to 0, this parameter does not take effect. If this parameter is set to a non-zero value, the following functions do not take effect for defective UEs: 1. The eNodeB does not deliver measurement configuration for this frequency. 2. The eNodeB does not add this frequency as an SCC. 3. The eNodeB does not p

parameters.id: NSA DC Max Inter-Freq Measurement Object Num
parameters.name: NSA DC Max Inter-Freq Measurement Object Num
parameters.description: Indicates the maximum total number of inter-frequency measurement objects that can be contained in the inter-frequency measurement configurations delivered to specified NSA UEs in both the LTE PCell and NR PSCell. The default value 0 indicates that this parameter does not take effect. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: Index
parameters.description: Indicates the index of a UE compatibility processing action. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: Reserved Switch Parameter 0
parameters.description: Indicates reserved 32-bit switch parameter 0 that is reserved for future requirements. Note on parameter replacement: Reserved parameters are temporarily used in patch versions and will be replaced with new parameters. For example, the ID of a new parameter can signify the parameter function. Therefore, avoid using this parameter.

parameters.name: Reserved Switch Parameter 1
parameters.description: Indicates reserved 32-bit switch parameter 1 that is reserved for future requirements. Note on parameter replacement: Reserved parameters are temporarily used in patch versions and will be replaced with new parameters. For example, the ID of a new parameter can signify the parameter function. Therefore, avoid using this parameter.

parameters.name: Local cell ID
parameters.description: Indicates the local ID of a cell, which uniquely identifies a cell within a base station. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: LCID of MAC CE Message
parameters.description: Indicates the reserved LCID used by a Media Access Control control element (MAC CE) message. An eNodeB converts the specified value of this parameter to an enumerated value and then sends the enumerated value to the UE. The UE converts the received enumerated value back to the specified value of this parameter (that is, the actual reserved LCID). If this parameter is set to 17, 18, or 19, an eNode

parameters.name: A2 Handover Threshold Offset
parameters.description: Indicates the offset to the A2 threshold for UEs to request for restoring default DRX parameter settings. This offset is configured for UEs. UEs add this offset to another A2 threshold delivered from the eNodeB and use the sum as the threshold for triggering restoration of default DRX parameter settings. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: A3 Handover Threshold Offset
parameters.description: Indicates the offset to the A3 threshold for UEs to request for restoring default DRX parameter settings. This offset is configured for UEs. UEs add this offset to another A3 threshold delivered from the eNodeB and use the sum as the threshold for triggering restoration of default DRX parameter settings. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: UE Awareness Power Saving Switch
parameters.description: Indicates whether to allow UE-triggered power saving. If this parameter is set to ON, functions such as UE-triggered DRX parameter configuration and fast entering into the idle state are supported to save UE power. If this parameter is set to OFF, UE-triggered power saving functions are not supported. This parameter takes effect only on UEs that support UE-triggered power saving functions. This pa

parameters.name: UE Forbidden Messages Threshold
parameters.description: Indicates the threshold for disabling power saving coordination for a UE. If the number of MAC CE messages sent by a UE within 10s exceeds this threshold, power saving coordination will be disabled for the current connection of the UE. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: Specified User Cooperation Switch
parameters.description: Indicates whether to enable device-pipe synergy functions for specific UEs and support for high-power UEs. SpecUeIdentifySwitch: Indicates whether to identify specific UEs. If this option is selected, specific UEs can be identified in the cell. If this option is deselected, specific UEs cannot be identified in the cell. HighPowerUeSupportSwitch: Indicates whether the cell can serve high-power UEs.

parameters.name: DSDS Cooperation Reporting Switch
parameters.description: Indicates whether to enable algorithms of the coordinated control feature for dual-SIM dual-standby (DSDS) single-pass UEs. DSDS_STATUS_RPT_SWITCH: Indicates whether to allow DSDS UEs to timely report information about leaving and returning to the LTE network. If this option is selected, such UEs can report MCEs containing information about leaving and returning to the LTE network. If this option

parameters.name: DSDS LCID
parameters.description: Indicates the LCID in the MAC control element (MCE) for coordinated control of dual-SIM dual-standby (DSDS) single-pass UEs. This parameter cannot be set to the same value as the MacCeMsgLCID parameter in the UeCooperationPara MO. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: Special User Smart DRX Switch
parameters.description: Indicates whether to enable the power-saving function for specific UEs capable of device-pipe synergy. When this parameter is set to ON, smart DRX for such UEs is supported, reducing power consumption of these UEs. When this parameter is set to OFF, smart DRX is not supported for these UEs. This function requires support from specific UEs capable of device-pipe synergy. This parameter applies only

parameters.name: VoLTE Paging Priority
parameters.description: Indicates whether to enable VoLTE marking in PS paging and the paging priority for VoLTE UEs. If this parameter is set to OFF, PS paging call flag addition is disabled. If this parameter is set to a value other than OFF, PS paging call flag addition is enabled. For the value range, see the definition of the paging priority IE in 3GPP TS 36.413. If PS paging call flag addition is enabled, the eNode

parameters.name: Local cell ID
parameters.description: Indicates the local ID of a cell, which uniquely identifies a cell within an eNodeB. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: QoS Class Indication
parameters.description: Indicates the QCI of an EPS bearer. Different QCIs represent different QoS specifications such as the packet delay budget, packet error rate, packet loss rate, and resource type (whether the service is a GBR service or not). For details, see Table 6.1.7 in 3GPP TS 23.203. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: UE Info Index
parameters.description: Indicates the UE information index. This parameter is associated with the Index parameter in the UeCompat MO. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: DRX Parameter Group ID
parameters.description: Indicates the ID of a DRX parameter group. The parameter value 255 indicates an invalid ID. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: UE Capability Index
parameters.description: Indicates the UE capability index. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: Access Stratum Release
parameters.description: Indicates the access stratum capability of defective UEs, which corresponds to the field AccessStratumRelease in the information element (IE) UE-EUTRA-Capability defined in 3GPP TS 36.331. Parameter values 0 through 7 indicate the field value rel8, rel9, rel10, rel11, rel12, rel13, rel14, and rel15, respectively. Other parameter values are reserved and have no corresponding field values. If this p

parameters.name: UE Category
parameters.description: Indicates the UE categories of defective UEs, which correspond to the following fields in the information element (IE) UE-EUTRA-Capability defined in 3GPP TS 36.331: ue-Category, ue-Category-v1020, ue-Category-v1170, ue-Category-v11a0, ue-Category-v1250, and ue-Category-NB-r13. When setting this parameter, you need to combine bit values in binary format and then convert the binary number into a de

parameters.name: Feature Group Indicator
parameters.description: Indicates the FGIs of Release 8 or earlier supported by defective UEs, which correspond to the bit string in the field featureGroupIndicators in the information element (IE) UE-EUTRA-Capability in 3GPP TS 36.331. parameters.name: Blacklisted Neighboring Freq EARFCN
parameters.description: Indicates the downlink EARFCN of the blacklisted neighboring frequency. For defective UEs, the eNodeB performs as follows: 1. The eNodeB does not deliver measurement configuration for this frequency. 2. The eNodeB does not add this frequency as an SCC. 3. The eNodeB does not perform handovers or redirections to this frequency. 4. The eNodeB does not handle measurement reports about this frequency.

parameters.name: UeCompatIndex
parameters.description: Indicates the index of a compatibility processing action for defective UEs. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: Local Cell ID
parameters.description: Indicates the local cell ID. It uniquely identifies a cell within an eNodeB. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: DRX Parameter Group Index
parameters.description: Indicates the index of a DRX parameter group. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: DRX Parameter Group Status
parameters.description: Indicates whether to enable the DRX parameter group. When a UE requests the DRX parameter group, the eNodeB can deliver the DRX parameter group to the UE only if this parameter is set to ENABLE. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: On Duration Timer
parameters.description: Indicates the length of the On Duration Timer. Because of the impact of CQI reporting intervals and SRS transmission intervals, the actual value of this parameter assigned to a UE may be greater than the configured value. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: DRX Inactivity Timer
parameters.description: Indicates the length of the DRX Inactivity Timer. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: DRX Retransmission Timer
parameters.description: Indicates the length of the DRX Retransmission Timer. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: Long DRX Cycle
parameters.description: Indicates the length of the long DRX cycle. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: Short-Cycle DRX Supported Indication
parameters.description: Indicates whether to enable or disable short DRX cycles. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: Short DRX Cycle
parameters.description: Indicates the length of the short DRX cycle. According to 3GPP specifications, the length of a long DRX cycle must be an integer multiple of that of a short DRX cycle. In addition, the actual value of LongDrxCycle assigned to a UE may be less than the configured value because of the impact of the SRS bandwidth and TA period specified by the TimeAlignmentTimer parameter. Therefore, the actual value

parameters.name: DRX Short Cycle Timer
parameters.description: Indicates the length of the DRX Short Cycle Timer. If this parameter is set to a large value, a UE for which short DRX cycles are enabled stays in short-cycle DRX for a long time. For details, see section 5.7 in 3GPP TS 36.321. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: UE-specific Configuration Index
parameters.description: Indicates the index of a UE-specific configuration. If there are two or more UeSpecificPara MOs with the same combination of the MoId, ParaId, and ParaBitId parameter values but different indexes configured for the same type of UE, only the UeSpecificPara MO with the smallest index takes effect.

parameters.name: MO ID
parameters.description: Indicates the number of an MO in the UE-specific configuration. Set this parameter under the guidance of Huawei technical support.

parameters.name: Parameter ID
parameters.description: Indicates the number of a parameter within the specified MO. Set this parameter under the guidance of Huawei technical support.

parameters.name: Parameter Bit ID
parameters.description: Indicates the number of an option within the specified parameter when the parameter is of bit field type. If this parameter is set to a value greater than 31, this parameter is invalid. Other values are valid. Set this parameter under the guidance of Huawei technical support.

parameters.name: Configured Value
parameters.description: Indicates the value of the specified parameter or option. Set this parameter under the guidance of Huawei technical support. 1. The value of the ConfigValue parameter must be within the GUI value range of the parameter or option specified by MoId, ParaId, and ParaBitId unless the ConfigValue parameter value is processed in a special manner. For details about value meanings, see Terminal Awareness

parameters.name: UE-specific Configuration Description
parameters.description: Indicates the description of the UE-specific configuration.

parameters.name: Timer Type
parameters.description: Indicates the timer type. This parameter applies only to NB-IoT.

parameters.name: Timer Duration
parameters.description: Indicates the duration of the timer. If the parameter setting is changed, the change applies only to UEs that access the network afterwards.

parameters.name: Millisecond-level Timer Duration
parameters.description: Indicates the length of the UE timer. If the TimerType parameter is set to NB_CL0_T310, NB_CL1_T310, or NB_CL2_T310, this parameter can be set to 0, 200, 500, 1000, 2000, 4000, or 8000. If the TimerType parameter is set to NB_CL0_T311, NB_CL1_T311, or NB_CL2_T311, this parameter can be set to 1000, 3000, 5000, 10000, 15000, 20000, 30000, 40000, 60000, 90000, or 120000. parameters.id: Max Num of UE Sync or Out-of-Sync Indication
parameters.name: Max Num of UE Sync or Out-of-Sync Indication
parameters.description: Indicates the maximum number of consecutive synchronization or out-of-synchronization indications that a UE receives from lower layers. If the TimerType parameter is set to NB_CL0_N310, NB_CL1_N310, or NB_CL2_N310, this parameter can be set to 1, 2, 3, 4, 6, 8, 10, or 20. parameters.name: Local cell ID
parameters.description: Indicates the local ID of the cell. It uniquely identifies a cell within a BS.

parameters.name: Timer 300
parameters.description: Indicates the timer value of Timer 300. For details, see 3GPP TS 36.331. This timer is started when the UE sends RRCConnectionRequest. Before the timer expires, it is stopped if the UE receives RRCConnectionSetup or RRCConnectionReject. After the timer expires, the UE enters the RRC_IDLE state. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: Timer 301
parameters.description: Indicates the length of timer T301. For details, see 3GPP TS 36.331. This timer is started when the UE sends an RRC Connection Reestablishment Request message. This timer is stopped if the UE receives an RRC Connection Reestablishment or RRC Connection Reestablishment Reject message, or the selected cell becomes unsuitable. For details about a suitable cell, see 3GPP TS 36.331. If the timer expire

parameters.name: Timer 310
parameters.description: Indicates the length of timer 310. For details, see 3GPP TS 36.331. This timer is started when the UE detects any fault at the physical layer. The timer is stopped if the UE detects one of the following before the timer expires: (1) The physical-layer fault is rectified; (2) A handover is triggered; (3) The UE initiates an RRC connection reestablishment procedure. parameters.name: Timer 311
parameters.description: Indicates the length of timer 311. For details, see 3GPP TS 36.331. This timer is started when the UE starts the RRC connection reestablishment procedure. The timer is stopped if, before the timer expires, the UE selects an E-UTRAN or inter-RAT cell to camp on. After the timer expires, the UE enters the RRC_IDLE mode. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: Constant N311
parameters.description: Indicates the maximum number of successive "in sync" indications received from lower layers. For details, see 3GPP TS 36.331.

parameters.name: Constant N310
parameters.description: Indicates the maximum number of successive "out of sync" indications received from lower layers. For details, see 3GPP TS 36.331.

parameters.name: Timer 325
parameters.description: Indicates the length of timer 325. For details, see 3GPP TS 36.331. This timer starts when a UE receives an RRCConnectionReject message containing the deprioritisationReq IE. When the timer expires, the cell reselection priorities that have been reduced using RRCConnectionReject for E-UTRAN frequencies are restored. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: Constant N313
parameters.description: Indicates the maximum number of consecutive "out-of-sync" indications received for a PSCell from lower layers. For details, see 3GPP TS 36.331. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: Constant N314
parameters.description: Indicates the maximum number of consecutive "in-sync" indications received for a PSCell from lower layers. For details, see 3GPP TS 36.331. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: Timer 307
parameters.description: Indicates the length of timer 307. For details, see 3GPP TS 36.331. An eNodeB starts this timer when the intended UE receives an RRC Connection Reconfiguration message containing the MobilityControlInfoSCG IE. parameters.name: Timer 313
parameters.description: Indicates the length of timer 313. For details, see 3GPP TS 36.331. This timer is started for a UE when the UE detects any fault at the physical layer of a PSCell. This timer is stopped when the UE detects that the fault is rectified, the UE initiates a connection reestablishment procedure, the UE receives an SCG Release message, or the UE receives an RRC Connection Reconfiguration message contain

parameters.name: NB-IoT Timer 300
parameters.description: Indicates the timer value of Timer 300. For details, see 3GPP TS 36.331. This timer is started when the UE sends RRCConnectionRequest. Before the timer expires, it is stopped if the UE receives RRCConnectionSetup or RRCConnectionReject. After the timer expires, the UE enters the RRC_IDLE state. This parameter applies only to NB-IoT.

parameters.name: NB-IoT Timer 310
parameters.description: Indicates the timer value of Timer 310. For details, see 3GPP TS 36.331. This timer is started when the UE detects any fault at the physical layer. Before the timer expires, it is stopped if the UE detects that the physical-layer fault is rectified. After the timer expires, the UE enters the RRC_IDLE state. This parameter applies only to NB-IoT.

parameters.name: NB-IoT Timer 301
parameters.description: Indicates the length of the timer T301 in NB-IoT scenarios. For details, see 3GPP TS 36.331. This timer is started when the UE sends an RRC Connection Reestablishment Request message. This timer is stopped if the UE receives an RRC Connection Reestablishment or RRC Connection Reestablishment Reject message, or the selected cell becomes unsuitable. For details about an unsuitable cell, see 3GPP TS

parameters.name: NB-IoT Timer 311
parameters.description: Indicates the timer value of Timer 311 for NB-IoT. For details, see 3GPP TS 36.331. This timer is started when the UE starts an RRC connection reestablishment. If the UE has selected an NB-IoT cell before the timer expires, the eNodeB stops the timer. After the timer expires, the UE enters the RRC_IDLE state. This parameter applies only to NB-IoT.

parameters.name: Timer 300 in CE Mode
parameters.description: Indicates the timer value of Timer 300 in coverage enhancement mode. If this parameter is set to a value indicating a timer length less than or equal to 2000 ms, the value of this parameter is broadcast only in the t300 IE of SIB2 and this value takes effect for UEs in all CE modes. parameters.name: Timer 301 in CE Mode
parameters.description: Indicates the length of timer 301 in coverage enhancement mode. If this parameter is set to a value indicating a timer length less than or equal to 2000 ms, the value of this parameter is broadcast only in the t301 IE of SIB2 and this value takes effect for UEs in all CE modes.
