parameters.name: Timer 310 in CE Mode
parameters.description: Indicates the timer value of Timer 310 in cell coverage enhancement mode. If this parameter is set to a value indicating a timer length less than or equal to 2000 ms, the value of this parameter is broadcast only in the t310 IE of SIB2 and this value takes effect for UEs in all CE modes. If this parameter is set to a value indicating a timer length greater than 2000 ms, there are two consequences:

parameters.name: Timer 311 in CE Mode
parameters.description: Indicates the length of timer 311 in coverage enhancement mode. For details, see 3GPP TS 36.331. This timer is started when the UE starts the RRC connection reestablishment procedure. The timer is stopped if the UE selects an E-UTRAN cell to camp on before the timer expires. If the timer expires, the UE enters the RRC_IDLE mode.

parameters.name: NB-IoT Timer T322
parameters.description: Indicates the length of Timer 322. For details, see 3GPP TS 36.331. The UE starts this timer when it detects that the RRC Connection Release message includes the power offset for inter-frequency redirection. parameters.name: NB-IoT EDT Timer 300
parameters.description: Indicates the length of timer 300 for EDT services. For details, see 3GPP TS 36.331. This timer is started when a UE sends an RRCEarlyDataRequest or RRCConnectionResumeRequest message for an EDT service. If Msg4 is received before the timer expires, the timer is stopped. When the timer expires, the UE returns to the RRC_IDLE state and determines that EDT fails in the uplink. This parameter applies

parameters.name: Local Cell ID
parameters.description: Indicates the local ID of a cell, which uniquely identifies a cell within a base station. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD.

parameters.name: UL Coordinated PC IN Threshold
parameters.description: Indicates the interference noise threshold for triggering UL coordinated power control (CPC). If the uplink interference noise level in a cell exceeds the threshold, the cell meets the condition for UL CPC. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD.

parameters.id: UL Coordinated PC Rollback RSRP Threshold
parameters.name: UL Coordinated PC Rollback RSRP Threshold
parameters.description: Indicates the RSRP threshold used for UEs involved in UL coordinated power control (CPC) rollback. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD.

parameters.id: UL Coordinated PC User Number Threshold
parameters.name: UL Coordinated PC User Number Threshold
parameters.description: Indicates the UE number threshold for triggering UL coordinated power control (CPC). If the number of UL-synchronized UEs in a cell exceeds the threshold, the cell meets the condition for UL CPC. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD.

parameters.id: UL Coordinated Resource Allocation Band Mode
parameters.name: UL Coordinated Resource Allocation Band Mode
parameters.description: Indicates the mode of arranging the guard bands of cells for UL coordinated resource allocation. The mode determines the guard band positions. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD.

parameters.id: UL Coordinated Resource Allocation RB Load Thld
parameters.name: UL Coordinated Resource Allocation RB Load Thld
parameters.description: Indicates the load threshold for triggering UL coordinated resource allocation. If the PUSCH RB usage in a cell is higher than this threshold, the eNodeB allocates protected UEs only resources in the guard bands. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD.

parameters.name: UL CS A3 Offset
parameters.description: Indicates the offset for event A3 for UL coordinated scheduling (CS). For details, see 3GPP TS 36.331. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD.

parameters.name: UL CS Switch
parameters.description: Indicates whether to enable functions of UL coordinated scheduling (CS) for a cell. UL_COORD_RES_ALLOC_SWITCH: Indicates whether to enable UL coordinated resource allocation. UL coordinated resource allocation is enabled only if this option is selected. This option applies only to LTE FDD. UL_COORD_PC_SWITCH: Indicates whether to enable UL coordinated power control (CPC). UL CPC is enabled only if

parameters.id: UL Coordinated Resource Alloc IN Threshold
parameters.name: UL Coordinated Resource Alloc IN Threshold
parameters.description: Indicates the interference noise threshold for enabling uplink coordinated resource allocation (UL CRA). If the average interference noise level of the cells in the cluster for UL CRA is greater than this threshold, the interference condition for enabling UL CRA is met. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD.

parameters.name: UL CRA User Number Threshold
parameters.description: Indicates the UE number threshold for enabling uplink coordinated resource allocation (UL CRA). UL CRA takes effect in a cell if the number of served UEs is lower than this threshold. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD.

parameters.name: Uplink CRA Support MOCN Switch
parameters.description: Indicates whether to enable UL CRA in MOCN scenarios where air interface resources and traffic are fully shared. When this parameter is set to ON, UL CRA can be enabled. When this parameter is set to OFF, UL CRA cannot be enabled. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD.

parameters.name: Macro Cell Indicator
parameters.description: Indicates whether the local cell involved in uplink coordinated scheduling (CS) is a macro cell. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD.

parameters.name: Neighbour Cell eNodeB ID
parameters.description: Indicates the ID of the eNodeB serving a neighboring cell in the UL CS coordination set. A local cell ID and an eNodeB ID compose a 28-bit E-UTRAN cell ID, where the eNodeB ID is represented by the 20 most significant bits. An E-UTRAN cell ID and a PLMN ID compose an E-UTRAN CGI (ECGI). For details about this parameter, see 3GPP TS 36.413. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD.

parameters.name: Neighbour Cell ID
parameters.description: Indicates the local ID of a neighboring cell in the UL CS coordination set, which uniquely identifies a cell within a base station. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD.

parameters.name: Neighbour Cell Macro Cell Indicator
parameters.description: Indicates whether a neighboring cell in the UL CS coordination set is a macro cell. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD.

parameters.name: Neighbour Cell Physical Cell ID
parameters.description: Indicates the physical ID of a neighboring cell in the UL CS coordination set. For details about this parameter, see 3GPP TS 36.331. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD.

parameters.name: Neighbour Cell SFN Cell Indicator
parameters.description: Indicates whether a neighboring cell in the UL CS coordination set is an SFN cell. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD.

parameters.name: Round Trip Transmission Delay
parameters.description: Indicates the average round trip time of a link. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD.

parameters.name: SFN Cell Indicator
parameters.description: Indicates whether a local cell is an SFN cell. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD.

parameters.id: Neighbour Cell UL CS Relation Indicator
parameters.name: Neighbour Cell UL CS Relation Indicator
parameters.description: Indicates the specific UL CS function for which neighboring cells are grouped into a UL CS coordination set. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD.

parameters.name: Local cell ID
parameters.description: Indicates the local ID of a cell, which uniquely identifies a cell within an eNodeB.

parameters.name: PRB ID
parameters.description: Indicates the NB-IoT PRB identity. It uniquely identifies a PRB within an eNodeB. This parameter applies only to NB-IoT.

parameters.name: High Frequency Guard Band
parameters.description: Indicates the NB-IoT high frequency edge guard space size. Subcarriers are divided by 3.75 kHz. The guard space size is represented by the number of subcarriers, which is used to reduce the interference caused by non-orthogonal subcarriers. This parameter applies only to NB-IoT.

parameters.name: Low Frequency Guard Band
parameters.description: Indicates the NB-IoT low frequency edge guard space size. Subcarriers are divided by 3.75 kHz. The guard space size is represented by the number of subcarriers, which is used to reduce the interference caused by non-orthogonal subcarriers. This parameter applies only to NB-IoT.

parameters.id: Guard Band Between NPRACH and NPUSCH
parameters.name: Guard Band Between NPRACH and NPUSCH
parameters.description: Indicates the width of the guard band between the NPRACH and NPUSCH. This parameter applies only to NB-IoT.

parameters.name: Local cell ID
parameters.description: Indicates the local ID of the cell. It uniquely identifies a cell within an eNodeB. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: Up Interference Suppression Threshold
parameters.description: Indicates the threshold for determining whether the interference detected in an uplink subframe is strong. When interference detected in an uplink subframe is greater than this threshold, the uplink interference detection and suppression algorithm is automatically enabled and the uplink power control policy is automatically adjusted. Conservative scheduling is performed for access signaling. As a

parameters.name: P0 UE PUSCH Offset
parameters.description: Indicates the P0_UE_PUSCH adjustment, which represents the adjustment of the PUSCH transmit power of UEs. This parameter applies only to LTE TDD cells.

parameters.name: Rand Attach Signal MCS Offset
parameters.description: Indicates the MCS index adjustment of access signaling. This parameter applies only to LTE TDD cells.

parameters.name: P0 UE Pucch Offset
parameters.description: Indicates the P0_UE_PUCCH adjustment, which represents the adjustment of the PUCCH transmit power of UEs. This parameter applies only to LTE TDD cells.

parameters.name: Delta Msg2 Offset
parameters.description: Indicates the power offset adjustment for MSG3 transmission during uplink random access, which is sent to the UE in an RAR message. This parameter applies only to LTE TDD cells.

parameters.id: Strong Interference UE Threshold Boost Ratio
parameters.name: Strong Interference UE Threshold Boost Ratio
parameters.description: Indicates the increase ratio of the threshold for identifying UEs with strong interference and of the PRACH detection threshold. The value x of this parameter indicates that the PRACH detection threshold increases by x%. The value -x indicates that the PRACH detection threshold decreases by x%. This parameter applies only to LTE TDD cells.

parameters.name: Uplink Interference Statistic Period
parameters.description: TDD: Indicates the period during which interference detection statistics are collected for triggering the uplink interference suppression algorithm. If the average interference noise on each PRB in normal uplink subframes during the period specified by this parameter is greater than the interference suppression threshold, the eNodeB reports that interference occurs. parameters.name: Uplink Interference Statistic Period Number
parameters.description: Indicates the number of periods during which interference detection statistics are collected, for disabling the uplink interference suppression algorithm. parameters.name: VoIP MCS Offset
parameters.description: Indicates the MCS index adjustment for voice services. This parameter applies only to LTE TDD cells.

parameters.id: VoIP PUCCH Power Control Target SINR Offset
parameters.name: VoIP PUCCH Power Control Target SINR Offset
parameters.description: Indicates the SINR target offset of PUCCH power control for voice services. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: VoIP PUSCH PSD Control Target
parameters.description: Indicates the transmit power spectral density for the PUSCH of voice UEs when the SchedulerCtrlPowerSwitch option of the UlSchSwitch parameter is selected. A large value of this parameter indicates a high transmit power spectral density for the PUSCH of voice UEs. This parameter applies only to LTE TDD cells.

parameters.name: Remote Interference Uplink Enhance Switch
parameters.description: Indicates whether to enhance uplink channels when remote interference (atmospheric duct interference) occurs. RMT_INF_PUSCH_ENH_SW: Indicates whether to enhance the PUSCH when remote interference occurs. If this option is selected, the PUSCH is enhanced when remote interference occurs. If this option is deselected, the PUSCH is not enhanced when remote interference occurs. This option applies only

parameters.id: Delta SINR Thld for UL PUSCH Enhancement
parameters.name: Delta SINR Thld for UL PUSCH Enhancement
parameters.description: Indicates the threshold of the difference between the SINR before SINR balancing and that after balancing for starting enhanced PUSCH demodulation. If the SINR difference is smaller than or equal to this threshold, enhanced PUSCH demodulation is started. If the SINR difference exceeds this threshold, enhanced PUSCH demodulation is terminated. This parameter applies only to LTE TDD.

parameters.name: Access Signaling Power Control Switch
parameters.description: Indicates whether to enable signaling power control during network access. If this parameter is set to ON(On), a conservative power control policy is used to increase signaling power and thereby to ensure signaling reliability during network access. parameters.id: UL Interference Symbol Pwr Difference Thld
parameters.name: UL Interference Symbol Pwr Difference Thld
parameters.description: Indicates the threshold of the power difference between the symbol with the maximum receive power and that with the minimum receive power in a TDD uplink subframe. This threshold is used to identify atmospheric duct interference. If the power difference exceeds this threshold, the eNodeB determines that the uplink subframe is subject to atmospheric duct remote interference. This parameter applies

parameters.name: Uplink Interference Suppression Value
parameters.description: Indicates the amount of uplink interference that can be suppressed for pRRUs. If this parameter is set to 0, pRRU uplink interference suppression does not take effect. If this parameter is set to a non-0 value, pRRU uplink interference suppression is triggered. parameters.name: Channel Calibration Optimization Switch
parameters.description: Indicates whether to enable channel calibration optimization. If this parameter is set to ON, channel calibration optimization is enabled. If this parameter is set to OFF, channel calibration optimization is disabled. This parameter applies only to LTE TDD.

parameters.name: Remote Interference Downlink Enhancement Sw
parameters.description: Indicates whether to enable downlink enhancement in the case of remote interference (atmospheric duct interference). REMOTE_INTRF_BF_ENH_SW: Indicates whether to enable beamforming enhancement when remote interference occurs. If this option is selected, beamforming enhancement is enabled when remote interference occurs. If this option is deselected, beamforming enhancement is disabled when remote

parameters.name: Interference RB Ratio Threshold
parameters.description: Indicates the threshold of the percentage of interference RBs for identifying whether a cell suffers from severe atmospheric duct interference. This parameter also indicates whether to enable inter-frequency MLB of low-efficiency UEs when interference occurs. parameters.name: TPE ACK Split Count
parameters.description: Indicates the number of split ACKs in the TCP Proxy Enhancer (TPE). If this parameter is set to 0, ACK splitting is not performed in the TPE. If this parameter is set to a non-0 value, this parameter specifies the number of ACKs generated each time ACK splitting is performed in the TPE. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: TCP Acceleration Schedule Weight Factor
parameters.description: Indicates the weight factor of the basic scheduling priority for TCP acceleration services. This parameter is used to guarantee such services for acceleration-involved UEs in both the uplink and downlink. If this parameter is set to 0, pre-scheduling of UEs requiring TCP acceleration does not take effect. This parameter applies only to LTE TDD.

parameters.name: TCP Active Ordering Timer
parameters.description: Indicates the length of the proactive TCP packet ordering timer. If this parameter is set to 0, proactive TCP packet ordering does not take effect, and TCP packets are transparently transmitted. If this parameter is set to a value greater than 0: 1. When TCP packets reach the eNodeB in order, the eNodeB directly sends these packets to UEs without buffering the packets; 2. When TCP packet disorder

parameters.name: WTCP Enhancement Switch
parameters.description: Indicates whether to enhance WTCP proxy. WTCP_LOST_PACKET_SWITCH: If this option is selected, the eNodeB checks the size of the UE transmission window to prevent packet loss and does not intercept ACK responses to resent packets when the ACK responses sent by the WTCP proxy are lost. If this option is deselected, the eNodeB does not check the size of the UE transmission window and intercepts ACK r

parameters.name: WTCP Downlink RTT Timer
parameters.description: Indicates the TCP downlink RTT timer. If no ACK message for the corresponding TCP packet is received when this timer expires, scheduling acceleration over the air interface is enabled. If an ACK message for the corresponding TCP packet is received when this timer does not expire, scheduling acceleration over the air interface is disabled. If this parameter is set to 0, WTCP scheduling acceleration

parameters.name: RTO Protection Buffer Threshold
parameters.description: Indicates the threshold of the number of buffered WTCP packets for enabling WTCP proxy RTO protection. This parameter takes effect only if it is set to a value greater than 0. If the number of buffered WTCP packets reaches this threshold, WTCP proxy RTO protection is enabled to avoid RTO. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: X2 ID
parameters.description: Indicates the X2 MO ID.

parameters.name: CN Operator ID
parameters.description: Indicates the ID of the operator to which the X2 MO belongs.

parameters.id: Control Plane End Point Group ID
parameters.name: Control Plane End Point Group ID
parameters.description: Indicates the ID of the control-plane endpoint group used by the X2 MO.

parameters.id: User Plane End Point Group ID
parameters.name: User Plane End Point Group ID
parameters.description: Indicates the ID of the user-plane endpoint group used by the X2 MO. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: Peer Base Station Release
parameters.description: Indicates the protocol release with which the peer base station connected to the local base station through the X2 interface complies. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: User Label
parameters.description: Indicates the description of the X2 MO.

parameters.name: End Point Group Config Flag
parameters.description: Indicates whether to configure the control-plane or user-plane endpoint group.

parameters.name: CN Operator Sharing Group ID
parameters.description: Indicates the ID of a carrier-sharing operator group that shares the X2 MO. If the eNodeB works in hybrid RAN sharing mode, set this parameter to a value within the range from 0 to 5. If the eNodeB works in independent mode, RAN sharing with common carriers mode, or RAN sharing with dedicated carriers mode, retain the default value 255, which is an invalid value.

parameters.name: X2 Interface CP Bearer State
parameters.description: Indicates the status of the CP bearer for the X2 interface.

parameters.name: X2 Interface ID
parameters.description: Indicates the X2 interface ID.

parameters.name: X2 Interface State
parameters.description: Indicates the status of the X2 interface.

parameters.name: X2 Interface CP Bearer ID
parameters.description: Indicates the ID of the CP bearer for the X2 interface.

parameters.name: Mobile country code
parameters.description: Indicates the mobile country code (MCC) of an operator that the target eNodeB supporting X2 self-setup belongs to. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: Mobile network code
parameters.description: Indicates the mobile network code (MNC) of an operator that the target eNodeB supporting X2 self-setup belongs to. The value of this parameter is a string of two or three characters, each of which must be a digit in the range of 0 to 9. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: Mobile country code
parameters.description: Indicates the mobile country code of the neighboring eNodeB to be added to the list. The value of this parameter is a string of three characters, each of which must be a digit in the range of 0 to 9. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: Mobile network code
parameters.description: Indicates the mobile network code of the neighboring eNodeB to be added to the list. The value of this parameter is a string of two or three characters, each of which must be a digit in the range of 0 to 9. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: eNodeB ID
parameters.description: Indicates the ID of the neighboring eNodeB to be added to the list. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.id: X2 Black or White List Type
parameters.name: X2 Black or White List Type
parameters.description: Indicates whether the X2 list is a blacklist or whitelist. If a neighboring eNodeB is added to the X2 blacklist, an X2 interface between the local eNodeB and this neighboring eNodeB cannot be automatically set up or the X2 interface set up between the local eNodeB and this neighboring eNodeB is abnormal. If a neighboring eNodeB is added to the X2 whitelist or blacklist, the X2 interface between th

parameters.name: X2Interface ID
parameters.description: Indicates the X2 interface ID. If the X2 interface is set up based on the endpoint configuration mode, the value range is 40000 to 65535. If the X2 interface is set up based on the link configuration mode using the MAE or MML commands, the recommended value range is 0 to 39999.

parameters.name: X2 Interface CP Bearer ID
parameters.description: Indicates the ID of the control port bearer for the X2 interface.

parameters.name: CN Operator ID
parameters.description: Indicates the ID of the operator that owns the X2 interface.

parameters.name: Peer Base Station Release
parameters.description: Indicates the protocol release with which the peer base station connected to the local base station through the X2 interface complies. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: Control Mode
parameters.description: Indicates the control mode of the X2 interface, which determines the control policies of operators and the SON functions on the X2 interface. This parameter is set by the system and cannot be modified by operators. If the X2 interface was set up by operators by using the MAE or MML commands, this parameter is set to MANUAL_MODE and operators can configure the interface. If the X2 interface was set

parameters.name: Auto Config Flag
parameters.description: Indicates whether the X2 interface was created automatically or manually. This parameter is set by the system and cannot be modified by operators. The system sets this parameter to AUTO_CREATED when the X2 interface was created automatically using SON and to MANUAL_CREATED when the X2 interface was created manually by using the MAE or running MML commands.

parameters.name: CN Operator Sharing Group ID
parameters.description: Indicates the ID of a carrier-sharing operator group that shares the X2 Interface MO. If the eNodeB works in hybrid RAN sharing mode, set this parameter to a value within the range from 0 to 5. If the eNodeB works in independent mode, RAN sharing with common carriers mode, or RAN sharing with dedicated carriers mode, retain the default value 255, which is an invalid value.

parameters.name: Neighboring Base Station Type
parameters.description: Indicates the type of the neighboring base station to which the local base station is connected through the X2 interface. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: Neighboring Base Station ID
parameters.description: Indicates the ID of the neighboring base station to which the local base station is connected through the X2 interface. The combination of this parameter and NbrEnbPlmnId uniquely identifies the neighboring base station around the globe. If the neighboring base station is an eNodeB, this parameter specifies the eNodeB ID. If the neighboring base station is a gNodeB, this parameter specifies the gN

parameters.name: Neighbor Base Station PLMN ID
parameters.description: Indicates the PLMN ID of the neighboring eNodeB to which the local eNodeB is connected through the X2 interface.

parameters.name: X2Interface state
parameters.description: Indicates the status of the X2 interface. If the status is normal, the X2 interface has been successfully established. If the status is abnormal, the X2 interface establishment fails.

parameters.name: X2Interface state abnormal reason
parameters.description: Indicates the reason why the X2 interface is abnormal.

parameters.name: Last Fault Occur Time
parameters.description: Indicates the time when the last X2 fault occurred. When a lower-layer link fault occurred and persisted for 18 seconds, the time that is 18 seconds after the fault occurred is recorded and taken as the parameter value. When an X2 interface setup failed for three consecutive times, the time that the X2 setup failure occurs for the third time is recorded and taken as the parameter value. The time f

parameters.name: Query Type
parameters.description: Indicates the status type of X2 interfaces to be queried. If this parameter is not specified in the DSP X2INTERFACE command, information about X2 interfaces in all states is displayed in the command output. If the X2interfaceId parameter is specified in the MML command, the QueryType parameter does not take effect.

parameters.id: X2 User Plane Host IPv4 Address
parameters.name: X2 User Plane Host IPv4 Address
parameters.description: Indicates the IPv4 address of the user-plane host of the X2 interface. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.id: X2 User Plane Peer IPv4 Address
parameters.name: X2 User Plane Peer IPv4 Address
parameters.description: Indicates the IPv4 address of the user-plane peer of the X2 interface. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: X2 User Plane Link State
parameters.description: Indicates the user-plane link status of the X2 interface. The value Abnormal indicates that the user-plane link is disconnected. The value Normal indicates that the user-plane link is connected. The value Unknown indicates that the status or the IP PM delay of the link cannot be obtained. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.id: X2 User Plane Link Maximum One-Way Delay
parameters.name: X2 User Plane Link Maximum One-Way Delay
parameters.description: Indicates maximum one-way link delay of the X2 user-plane. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.id: X2 User Plane Link Two-Way Delay
parameters.name: X2 User Plane Link Two-Way Delay
parameters.description: Indicates the two-way link delay of the X2 user-plane. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: Transmit Available Bandwidth
parameters.description: Indicates the available bandwidth in the sending direction detected by the function of transmission congestion detection. If the TransmitCongDelay and TransmitAvailableBw parameter values are NULL and congestion detection in X2/eX2 links in non-ideal backhaul mode for bearer coordination services is enabled, the transmission congestion detection procedure fails. The failure cause can be one of the

parameters.name: Transmit Congestion Delay
parameters.description: Indicates the single-way transmission congestion delay detected by the function of transmission congestion detection. If the TransmitCongDelay and TransmitAvailableBw parameter values are NULL and congestion detection in X2/eX2 links in non-ideal backhaul mode for bearer coordination services is enabled, the transmission congestion detection procedure fails. The failure cause can be one of the fol

parameters.id: X2 User Plane Host IPv6 Address
parameters.name: X2 User Plane Host IPv6 Address
parameters.description: Indicates the IPv6 address of the user-plane host of the X2 interface. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.id: X2 User Plane Peer IPv6 Address
parameters.name: X2 User Plane Peer IPv6 Address
parameters.description: Indicates the IPv6 address of the user-plane peer of the X2 interface. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: X2 Usage Meas Duration
parameters.description: Indicates the length of measurement duration of X2 usage from the last measurement period to the current time. For a new X2 interface set up during this period, the length of the measurement duration is from the time the X2 interface is set up to the current time. The measurement period is specified by the X2SonDeleteTimerforX2Usage parameter in the GlobalProcSwitch MO. This parameter applies only

parameters.name: X2 Usage Statistics
parameters.description: Indicates the measurement value of an X2 interface during a period from the last measurement period to the current time. For an inter-eNodeB X2 interface, this parameter indicates the total number of incoming and outgoing handovers over the X2 within a measurement duration. For an EN-DC X2 interface, this parameter indicates the total number of successful additions of a gNodeB that is connected ov

parameters.id: X2 NSA Meas Result in Last Period
parameters.name: X2 NSA Meas Result in Last Period
parameters.description: Indicates the accumulated values of measurements of NSA services over the X2 interface in the last full period. The parameter value includes results of multiple measurement items in the following sequence: Measurements of eNodeB-initiated SgNB addition procedures: 1. Number of times the eNodeB sends SgNB Addition Request to gNodeBs 2. Number of times the eNodeB receives SgNB Addition Request Ackno

parameters.id: X2 NSA Meas Result in Current Period
parameters.name: X2 NSA Meas Result in Current Period
parameters.description: Indicates the accumulated values of measurements of NSA services over the X2 interface in the current period. The parameter value includes results of multiple measurement items in the following sequence: Measurements of eNodeB-initiated SgNB addition procedures: 1. Number of times the eNodeB sends SgNB Addition Request messages to gNodeBs 2. Number of times the eNodeB receives SgNB Addition Reques

parameters.id: X2 NSA Last Meas Period End Time
parameters.name: X2 NSA Last Meas Period End Time
parameters.description: Indicates the time when the X2 service measurement finishes in the last full measurement period. The measurement period is specified by the EnodeBAlgoExtSwitch.X2NsaCounterPeriod parameter. The time format is YEAR-MONTH-DAY HH:MM:SS. For example, 2000-1-1 10:20:05 indicates 10:20:05 on January 01, 2000. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD and LTE TDD.

parameters.name: Xw ID
parameters.description: Indicates the ID of the Xw object. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD.

parameters.id: Control Plane End Point Group ID
parameters.name: Control Plane End Point Group ID
parameters.description: Indicates the ID of the control-plane endpoint group used by the Xw object. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD.

parameters.name: End Point Group Config Flag
parameters.description: Indicates whether to configure the control-plane endpoint group or user-plane endpoint group for the Xw MO. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD.

parameters.id: User Plane End Point Group ID
parameters.name: User Plane End Point Group ID
parameters.description: Indicates the ID of the user-plane endpoint group used by the Xw object. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD.

parameters.name: User Label
parameters.description: Indicates the user-defined information of the Xw object. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD.

parameters.name: Xw Interface ID
parameters.description: Indicates the Xw interface ID. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD.

parameters.name: Xw Interface State
parameters.description: Indicates the Xw interface status. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD.

parameters.name: Xw Interface CP Bearer ID
parameters.description: Indicates the ID of the CP bearer for the Xw interface. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD.

parameters.name: Xw Interface CP Bearer State
parameters.description: Indicates the status of the CP bearer for the Xw interface. This parameter applies only to LTE FDD.

parameters.name: DTLS Policy ID
parameters.description: Indicates the sequence number of a DTLS configuration policy.

parameters.name: Cipher Suite
parameters.description: Indicates a DTLS cipher suite.

parameters.name: NR 5G QoS Indicator
parameters.description: Indicates a 5G QoS Identifier (5QI). When a 5QI is added on the core network: 1. If configuration for the corresponding Nr5qi value has not been added in the gNB5qiConfig MO, parameter configuration with Nr5qi being 9 is used by default. 2. If configuration for the corresponding Nr5qi value has been added in the gNB5qiConfig MO: gNB5qiConfig.Qci for the corresponding Nr5qi value must be already co

parameters.name: QoS Class Identifier
parameters.description: Indicates the QoS class identifier (QCI) of the radio bearer corresponding to a 5QI.

parameters.name: Counter Object Subscription Indicator
parameters.description: Indicates whether to subscribe to the 5QI counter objects. If this parameter is set to YES, counter objects are subscribed to. If this parameter is set to NO, counter objects are not subscribed to.

parameters.name: AS Reflective QoS Switch
parameters.description: Indicates whether to enable the AS reflective QoS function. When the switch is turned on, a UE can obtain the relationship between a QoS flow and a DRB by monitoring the QFI of the data packets transmitted on the DRB. When this switch is turned off, this function is disabled.

parameters.name: Rule Index
parameters.description: Indicates the index of a rule for a debugging message.

parameters.name: Message Protocol Type
parameters.description: Indicates the interface protocol type of a debugging message. If you need to change the value of this parameter, ask for assistance from Huawei technical support.

parameters.name: Message Type
parameters.description: Indicates the No. of the messages transmitted over 3GPP-defined interfaces. If you need to change the value of this parameter, ask for assistance from Huawei technical support.

parameters.name: Message Operate Type
parameters.description: Indicates the operation type of messages received or sent by the gNodeB. If you need to change the value of this parameter, ask for assistance from Huawei technical support.

parameters.name: Message Match Rule List
parameters.description: Indicates the ID of a matching rule list for messages received or sent by the gNodeB to be matched with a debugging message. The matching rule list ID is a hexadecimal number that consists of a maximum of 20 characters. The associated rule configuration is provided by the gNBAbnMsgMatchRule MO. If you need to change the value of this parameter, ask for assistance from Huawei technical support.

parameters.name: Message Modify Rule List
parameters.description: Indicates the ID of a modification rule list for messages received or sent by the gNodeB. The modification rule list ID is a hexadecimal number that consists of a maximum of 20 characters. The associated rule configuration is provided by the gNBAbnMsgModifyRule MO. If you need to change the value of this parameter, ask for assistance from Huawei technical support.

parameters.name: UE Information Index
parameters.description: Indicates the UE index. The value 0 indicates that all UEs are applicable.

parameters.name: Match Rule Index
parameters.description: Indicates the index of a debugging message matching rule.

parameters.name: Match Field Offset
parameters.description: Indicates the matching field offset of the message received or sent by the gNodeB to be matched with a debugging message. If you need to change the value of this parameter, ask for assistance from Huawei technical support.

parameters.name: Match Length
parameters.description: Indicates the matching length of the message received or sent by the gNodeB to be matched with a debugging message. If you need to change the value of this parameter, ask for assistance from Huawei technical support.

parameters.name: Match Content
parameters.description: Indicates the matching content of the message received or sent by the gNodeB to be matched with a debugging message. The matching content is a hexadecimal number that consists of 1 to 100 characters. If you need to change the value of this parameter, ask for assistance from Huawei technical support.

parameters.name: Modify Content
parameters.description: Indicates the modification content of the message received or sent by the gNodeB. The modification content is a hexadecimal number that consists of 1 to 100 characters. If you need to change the value of this parameter, ask for assistance from Huawei technical support.

parameters.name: Modify Field Offset
parameters.description: Indicates the modification field offset of the message received or sent by the gNodeB. If you need to change the value of this parameter, ask for assistance from Huawei technical support.

parameters.name: Modify Length
parameters.description: Indicates the modification length of the message received or sent by the gNodeB. If you need to change the value of this parameter, ask for assistance from Huawei technical support.

parameters.name: Modify Rule Index
parameters.description: Indicates the index of a debugging message-based modification rule.

parameters.name: Counter Check Switch
parameters.description: Indicates whether to enable counter check. The value DISABLE indicates that PDCP counter check is disabled. The value ENABLE_NOT_RELEASE indicates that PDCP counter check is enabled. When the DRB counter check is abnormal, the corresponding bearer is not released. The value ENABLE_RELEASE_DRB indicates that PDCP counter check is enabled. When the DRB counter check is abnormal, the corresponding be

parameters.name: Unauthenticated Emergency Call Switch
parameters.description: Indicates whether to allow unauthenticated emergency calls. The value ENABLE indicates that unauthenticated emergency calls are allowed. When this function is enabled, NEA0 and NIA0 (null ciphering and integrity protection algorithms) can be used during an unauthenticated emergency call. That is, an unauthenticated emergency call can be conducted irrespective of whether the NEA0 and NIA0 are enabl

parameters.name: gNodeB CU NG ID
parameters.description: Indicates the ID of a gNodeB CU NG object.

parameters.name: AMF Domain Name
parameters.description: Indicates the AMF domain name.

parameters.name: Application Index
parameters.description: Indicates the index of the acceleration application.

parameters.name: Application Identification Type
parameters.description: Indicates the acceleration application identification type. If this parameter is set to IPV4, the AppIpv4 parameter must be set. If this parameter is set to IPV6, the AppIpv6 parameter must be set.

parameters.name: Application IPv4
parameters.description: Indicates an IPv4 address for acceleration application (acceleration service) identification. This parameter is used during identification based on an IP address and is mandatory when AppIdentType is set to IPV4.

parameters.name: Application IPv6
parameters.description: Indicates an IPv6 address for acceleration application (acceleration service) identification. This parameter is used during identification based on an IP address and is mandatory when AppIdentType is set to IPV6.

parameters.name: Protocol Type
parameters.description: Indicates the protocol type for acceleration application identification. If this parameter is set to ALL, the gNodeB does not check the protocol type during acceleration application identification and applications of any protocol types are identified as acceleration applications. If this parameter is set to TCP, the gNodeB checks whether the protocol type is TCP during acceleration application ide

parameters.name: Port Number
parameters.description: Indicates the server port number for acceleration application identification. This parameter is valid only when ProtocolType is set to TCP or UDP. The value 0 indicates that the gNodeB does not check the server port number.

parameters.name: AS Optimization Switch
parameters.description: Indicates whether to enable the acceleration service optimization algorithm. If this parameter is set to ON, UEs running acceleration services are preferentially guaranteed. If this parameter is set to OFF, UEs running acceleration services are not preferentially guaranteed.

parameters.name: AS IP Detection Interval
parameters.description: Indicates the interval at which the gNodeB detects the IP headers of downlink packets to identify UEs running acceleration services. To be specific, the gNodeB detects IP headers every X packets, where X is the value of by this parameter.

parameters.name: AS Guarantee Duration
parameters.description: Indicates the duration during which UEs running acceleration services are preferentially guaranteed.

parameters.name: AS Preallocation Packet Size
parameters.description: Indicates the amount of uplink data preallocated for UEs running acceleration services.

parameters.name: AS Schedule Priority Factor
parameters.description: Indicates the weight factor used to calculate the basic scheduling priority for UEs running acceleration services. This parameter is used to preferentially guarantee UEs running acceleration services in the uplink and downlink. If this parameter is set to a value in the range from 1 to 999, the priority is calculated using the normal weight factor. If this parameter is set to 1000, UEs running acc

parameters.name: CA Frequency Group ID
parameters.description: Indicates the ID of a CA frequency group, which uniquely identifies the CA frequency group within a gNodeB.

parameters.name: Downlink NARFCN
parameters.description: Indicates the downlink NR-ARFCN of a CA cell.

parameters.name: CA A2 RSRP Threshold Offset
parameters.description: Indicates the frequency-specific offset of the RSRP threshold for CA event A2. If the summed value of this parameter and the NRCellCaMgmtConfig.CaA2RsrpThld parameter is greater than -43 dBm, the effective threshold for CA event A2 is -43 dBm. If the summed value is less than -140 dBm, the effective threshold for CA event A2 is -140 dBm.

parameters.id: CA SCC A5 RSRP Threshold 2 Offset
parameters.name: CA SCC A5 RSRP Threshold 2 Offset
parameters.description: Indicates the frequency-specific offset of the RSRP threshold 2 for CA event A5. If the summed value of this parameter and the NRCellCaMgmtConfig.CaA5RsrpThld2 parameter is greater than -43 dBm, the effective threshold 2 for CA event A5 is -43 dBm. If the summed value is less than -140 dBm, the effective threshold 2 for CA event A5 is -140 dBm.

parameters.name: SSB Frequency Position
parameters.description: Indicates the frequency-domain position of the SSB corresponding to a CA frequency. The value of this parameter depends on the description method of the SSB frequency-domain position (SsbDescMethod) of neighboring cells. When SsbDescMethod is set to SSB_DESC_TYPE_GSCN, the value range from 2 to 26639 applies. When SsbDescMethod is set to SSB_DESC_TYPE_NARFCN, other value ranges apply.

parameters.name: Detailed Cause Value
parameters.description: Indicates the detailed exception cause value for internal CHR recording. The value 0xFFFFFFFFFFFF indicates that the sampling output setting applies to all the exception cause values. In other cases, the sampling output setting applies only to the given exception cause value.

parameters.name: CHR Sampling Interval
parameters.description: Indicates the frequency by which internal CHR data is generated.

parameters.name: Ciphering Algorithm Priority
parameters.description: Indicates the priority of a ciphering algorithm. PRIMARY indicates the highest priority, SECOND indicates the second priority, THIRD indicates the third priority, and FOURTH indicates the fourth priority.

parameters.name: Ciphering Algorithm
parameters.description: Indicates a ciphering algorithm corresponding to a priority. If this parameter is set to NULL, data is not encrypted. If this parameter is set to NOT_CONFIG, the gNodeB skips the corresponding priority when selecting a ciphering algorithm.

parameters.name: Uu Message Waiting Timer
parameters.description: Indicates the timer governing the period in which the gNodeB waits for a Uu response message from a UE. If the timer expires, the gNodeB initiates a UE context release.

parameters.name: gNodeB CU NG ID
parameters.description: Indicates the ID of a gNodeB CU NG object.

parameters.name: Control Plane Endpoint Group ID
parameters.description: Indicates the ID of the control-plane endpoint group used by a gNodeB CU NG object. The value 4294967295 is invalid.

parameters.name: User Plane Endpoint Group ID
parameters.description: Indicates the ID of the user-plane endpoint group used by a gNodeB CU NG object. The value 4294967295 is invalid.

parameters.name: User Label
parameters.description: Indicates the user label of a gNodeB CU NG object.

parameters.name: CU NG Type
parameters.description: Indicates the configuration type of the control-plane endpoint used by a gNodeB CU NG object. If this parameter is set to DEFAULT_CP, message transmission over the NG interface will be based on the default control plane that corresponds to this parameter when an RRC connection setup message does not contain slice information or a Temp ID during initial access initiated by a UE. If an operator has

parameters.name: gNodeB CU NG Interface ID
parameters.description: Indicates the ID of a gNodeB CU NG interface.

parameters.id: gNodeB CU NG Interface CP Bearer ID
parameters.name: gNodeB CU NG Interface CP Bearer ID
parameters.description: Indicates the ID of the bottom-layer CP bearer of a gNodeB CU NG interface.

parameters.name: Served GUAMIs
parameters.description: Indicates the globally unique AMF ID (GUAMI) of the AMF connected over the NG interface. Each ID is represented by MCC-MNC-AMF Region ID-AMF Set ID-AMF Pointer. The GUAMIs of each serving core network are separated by commas (,).

parameters.name: AMF Name
parameters.description: Indicates the name of the AMF connected over the NG interface. This parameter is valid after the NG interface is established and the AMF name is contained in the NG interface establishment response message or the AMF configuration update message. In other conditions, the parameter value is NULL. For details, see 3GPP TS 38.413.

parameters.name: gNodeB Operator ID
parameters.description: Indicates the list of IDs of the operators that own the NG interface. Operator IDs are separated by commas (,).

parameters.name: gNodeB CU NG ID
parameters.description: Indicates the ID of a gNodeB CU NG object.

parameters.name: Operator ID
parameters.description: Indicates the ID of an operator.

parameters.name: Slice Service Type
parameters.description: Indicates the slice/service type. For details, see 3GPP TS 23.003.

parameters.name: Slice Differentiator
parameters.description: Indicates the slice differentiator. For details, see 3GPP TS 23.003. If this parameter is set to 16777215, a slice/service type is configured for the slice but the slice differentiator is not configured. If this parameter is not set to 16777215, this parameter indicates the specific slice differentiator.

parameters.name: gNodeB CU NG ID
parameters.description: Indicates the ID of a gNodeB CU NG object.

parameters.name: Operator ID
parameters.description: Indicates the ID of an operator.

parameters.name: gNodeB CU S1 ID
parameters.description: Indicates the ID of the gNodeB CU S1 object.

parameters.name: User Plane Endpoint Group ID
parameters.description: Indicates the ID of the user-plane endpoint group used by the gNodeB CU S1 object.

parameters.name: User Label
parameters.description: Indicates the user label of a gNodeB CU S1 object.

parameters.name: gNodeB CU S1 ID
parameters.description: Indicates the ID of a gNodeB CU S1 object.

parameters.name: Operator ID
parameters.description: Indicates the ID of an operator.

parameters.name: gNodeB CU X2 ID
parameters.description: Indicates the ID of the gNodeB CU X2 object.

parameters.name: Control Plane Endpoint Group ID
parameters.description: Indicates the ID of the control-plane endpoint group used by the gNodeB CU X2 object.

parameters.name: User Plane Endpoint Group ID
parameters.description: Indicates the ID of the user-plane endpoint group used by the gNodeB CU X2 object.

parameters.name: gNodeB CU X2 Interface ID
parameters.description: Indicates the ID of a gNodeB CU X2 interface.

parameters.id: gNodeB CU X2 CP Bearer ID
parameters.name: gNodeB CU X2 CP Bearer ID
parameters.description: Indicates the ID of the bottom-layer CP bearer of a gNodeB CU X2 interface.

parameters.id: gNodeB CU X2 Control Plane Peer IP
parameters.name: gNodeB CU X2 Control Plane Peer IP
parameters.description: Indicates the peer IP address of the control plane of the gNodeB CU X2 interface.

parameters.name: Neighboring eNodeB ID
parameters.description: Indicates the ID of the neighboring eNodeB on the peer end of a gNodeB CU X2 interface. The combination of this parameter and NeighboringEnodebPlmnId uniquely identifies the neighboring eNodeB around the globe.

parameters.name: Neighboring eNodeB PLMN ID
parameters.description: Indicates the PLMN ID of the neighboring eNodeB on the peer end of a gNodeB CU X2 interface.

parameters.name: gNodeB CU X2 ID
parameters.description: Indicates the ID of a gNodeB CU X2 object.

parameters.name: Operator ID
parameters.description: Indicates the ID of an operator.

parameters.name: gNodeB CU Xn ID
parameters.description: Indicates the ID of a gNodeB CU Xn object.

parameters.name: Control Plane Endpoint Group ID
parameters.description: Indicates the ID of the control-plane endpoint group used by the gNodeB CU Xn object.

parameters.name: User Plane Endpoint Group ID
parameters.description: Indicates the ID of the user-plane endpoint group used by the gNodeB CU Xn object.

parameters.name: gNodeB CU Xn Interface ID
parameters.description: Indicates the ID of a gNodeB CU Xn interface.

parameters.id: gNodeB CU Xn Interface CP Bearer ID
parameters.name: gNodeB CU Xn Interface CP Bearer ID
parameters.description: Indicates the ID of the bottom-layer CP bearer of a gNodeB CU Xn interface.

parameters.name: gNodeB CU Xn ID
parameters.description: Indicates the ID of a gNodeB CU Xn object.

parameters.name: Operator ID
parameters.description: Indicates the ID of an operator.

parameters.name: NR Band ID
parameters.description: Indicates ID of an NR band in a band combination. For details, see 3GPP TS 38.101-1 and 38.101-2.

parameters.name: LTE Band ID
parameters.description: Indicates ID of an LTE band in a band combination. For details, see 3GPP TS 36.101.

parameters.name: Aggregation Attribute
parameters.description: Indicates the aggregation attribute switches for LTE and NR band combinations. CO_DEPLOYMENT_NSA_FLAG: If this option is selected, mobility management procedures specific to collocated deployment are allowed for the frequency band combination. If this option is deselected, mobility management procedures specific to collocated deployment are not allowed for the frequency band combination. SINGLE_UL

parameters.name: DRX Parameter Group ID
parameters.description: Indicates the ID of a DRX parameter group.

parameters.name: Long Cycle
parameters.description: Indicates the length of the long DRX cycle. The DRX feature takes effect only if the value of LongCycle is less than or equal to one sixth of the value of UlTimeAlignmentTimer in the NRDUCellUlTaConfig MO.

parameters.name: Short Cycle
parameters.description: Indicates the length of the short DRX cycle. This parameter takes effect only when ShortCycleTimer is set to a value other than 0.

parameters.name: Short Cycle Timer
parameters.description: Indicates the number of short DRX cycle repetitions. If the parameter is set to 0, the ShortCycle parameter configuration does not take effect.

parameters.name: DU DRX Parameter Group ID
parameters.description: Indicates the ID of a DRX parameter group of the DU.

parameters.name: On Duration Timer
parameters.description: Indicates the length of the DRX On Duration timer. Because of the impact of CSI reporting intervals and SRS transmission intervals, the actual value of this parameter assigned to a UE may be greater than the configured value. Because of the impact of LongCycle or ShortCycle, the actual value of this parameter assigned to a UE may be smaller than the configured value.

parameters.name: DRX Inactivity Timer
parameters.description: Indicates the length of the DRX inactivity timer.

parameters.name: DRX Retransmission Timer
parameters.description: Indicates the length of the DRX downlink and uplink retransmission timers.

parameters.id: NR Spectrum Sharing Cell Group ID
parameters.name: NR Spectrum Sharing Cell Group ID
parameters.description: Indicates the ID of an NR spectrum sharing cell group, which uniquely identifies the NR spectrum sharing cell group within a gNodeB.

parameters.id: LTE Spectrum Sharing Cell Group ID
parameters.name: LTE Spectrum Sharing Cell Group ID
parameters.description: Indicates the ID of an LTE spectrum sharing cell group, which uniquely identifies the LTE spectrum sharing cell group within a gNodeB.

parameters.id: LTE and NR Uplink Spectrum Sharing Mode
parameters.name: LTE and NR Uplink Spectrum Sharing Mode
parameters.description: Indicates the mode of uplink spectrum sharing between LTE FDD and NR. This parameter applies only to NR SUL. Disuse statement: This parameter will be deleted in later versions. In this version, configuration synchronization and delivery of this parameter are still supported on interfaces. Therefore, avoid using this parameter.

parameters.name: NR Reserved RB End Index
parameters.description: Indicates the index of the end RB among the RBs reserved for NR when LTE TDD and NR spectrum sharing is enabled. This parameter, together with NrReservedRbStartIndex, specify the range of RBs reserved for NR. parameters.name: PRB Usage Threshold
parameters.description: Indicates the PRB usage threshold for triggering LTE TDD and NR spectrum sharing. If the PRB usage on the NR side is greater than the sum of the PRB usage threshold and the PRB usage threshold offset, the NR side uses spectrum shared with the LTE side. parameters.name: NR Reserved RB Start Index
parameters.description: Indicates the index of the start RB among the RBs reserved for NR when LTE TDD and NR spectrum sharing is enabled. This parameter, together with NrReservedRbEndIndex, specify the range of RBs reserved for NR. If the range of RBs reserved for NR exceeds the range of RBs corresponding to the NR cell bandwidth, the range of RBs corresponding to the NR cell bandwidth is reserved for NR. This parameter

parameters.name: PRB Usage Threshold Offset
parameters.description: Indicates the offset relative to the PRB usage threshold for triggering LTE TDD and NR spectrum sharing. If the PRB usage is greater than the sum of the PRB usage threshold and the PRB usage threshold offset, the NR side uses spectrum shared with the LTE side. parameters.name: MAC Parameter Group ID
parameters.description: Indicates the ID of a MAC parameter group.

parameters.name: Downlink Guaranteed Rate
parameters.description: Indicates the downlink guaranteed rate of services on a non-GBR radio bearer.

parameters.name: Uplink Guaranteed Rate
parameters.description: Indicates the uplink guaranteed rate of services on a non-GBR radio bearer.

parameters.name: Downlink Scheduling Priority Weight Factor
parameters.description: Indicates the weight factor in the formula for calculating the downlink scheduling priority of a non-GBR radio bearer.

parameters.name: Uplink Scheduling Priority Weight Factor
parameters.description: Indicates the weight factor in the formula for calculating the uplink scheduling priority of a non-GBR radio bearer.

parameters.name: Logical Channel Group ID
parameters.description: Indicates the ID of a logical channel group for radio bearers.

parameters.name: Logical Channel Priority
parameters.description: Indicates the logical channel priority of a radio bearer.

parameters.name: Downlink Minimum Acceptable Rate
parameters.description: Indicates the minimum downlink acceptable rate, which is used to calculate the downlink resource load of a cell. The value 1000001 is used for special applications. When this parameter is set to 1000001 for a GBR bearer, the gNodeB reads the GBR value carried by the core network as the minimum acceptable rate of the bearer. When this parameter is set to 1000001 for a non-GBR bearer, the effect of

parameters.name: Uplink Minimum Acceptable Rate
parameters.description: Indicates the minimum uplink acceptable rate, which is used to calculate the uplink resource load of a cell. The value 1000001 is used for special applications. When this parameter is set to 1000001 for a GBR bearer, the gNodeB reads the GBR value carried by the core network as the minimum acceptable rate of the bearer. When this parameter is set to 1000001 for a non-GBR bearer, the effect of this

parameters.name: Scheduling Type
parameters.description: Indicates the scheduling type of a bearer corresponding to each QCI. The value BASIC_SCH indicates basic scheduling for a bearer. The value VOICE_SCH or IMS_SIGNALING_SCH indicates differentiated scheduling for a bearer. The value LOW_LATENCY_SCH indicates delay optimization scheduling for a bearer.

parameters.name: NARFCN Cell Group ID
parameters.description: Indicates the ID of an NARFCN cell group, which uniquely identifies the NARFCN cell group within a gNodeB.

parameters.name: NARFCN Cell Group ID
parameters.description: Indicates the ID of an NARFCN cell group, which uniquely identifies the NARFCN cell group within a gNodeB.

parameters.name: NR DU Cell ID
parameters.description: Indicates the ID of an NR DU cell, which uniquely identifies the NR DU cell within a gNodeB.

parameters.name: LTE-NR Power Sharing Enable Time
parameters.description: Indicates the time segments in which dynamic power sharing between LTE and NR is enabled. Dynamic power sharing between LTE and NR can be enabled in different time segments based on traffic distribution on the live network. This parameter applies only to low-frequency TDD cells.

parameters.name: Reserved U8 Parameter 1
parameters.description: Indicates reserved U8 parameter 1 that is reserved for future requirements. Note on parameter replacement: Reserved parameters are temporarily used in the current version and will be replaced with new parameters (for example, of which the IDs can signify the parameter functions) in later versions. Therefore, avoid using this parameter.

parameters.name: Mobile Country Code
parameters.description: Indicates the MCC of the operator who owns the external E-UTRAN cell. A PLMN ID is comprised of an MCC and an MNC. The MCC consists of three digits. The MNC consists of two to three digits. For example, MCC = 123, MNC = 45, PLMN = 12345.

parameters.name: Mobile Network Code
parameters.description: Indicates the MNC of the operator who owns the external E-UTRAN cell. A PLMN ID is comprised of an MCC and an MNC. The MCC consists of three digits. The MNC consists of two to three digits. For example, MCC = 123, MNC = 45, PLMN = 12345.

parameters.name: eNodeB ID
parameters.description: Indicates the eNodeB ID of an external E-UTRAN cell. It uniquely identifies an eNodeB within a PLMN. The 28-bit E-UTRAN cell ID is comprised of the cell ID and the eNodeB ID (represented by the most significant 20 bits). The CGI of an E-UTRAN cell is comprised of the E-UTRAN cell ID and the PLMN ID. For details, see 3GPP TS 36.413.

parameters.name: Cell ID
parameters.description: Indicates the cell ID of an external E-UTRAN cell. It uniquely identifies an E-UTRAN cell within an eNodeB. The 28-bit E-UTRAN cell ID is comprised of the cell ID (represented by the least significant eight bits) and the eNodeB ID. The CGI of an E-UTRAN cell is comprised of the E-UTRAN cell ID and the PLMN ID. For details, see 3GPP TS 36.413.

parameters.name: Shared Mobile Country Code
parameters.description: Indicates the secondary operator's MCC of an external E-UTRAN cell in multi-operator sharing. A PLMN ID is comprised of an MCC and an MNC. The MCC consists of three digits. The MNC consists of two to three digits. For example, MCC = 123, MNC = 45, PLMN = 12345.

parameters.name: Shared Mobile Network Code
parameters.description: Indicates the secondary operator's MNC of an external E-UTRAN cell in multi-operator sharing. A PLMN ID is comprised of an MCC and an MNC. The MCC consists of three digits. The MNC consists of two to three digits. For example, MCC = 123, MNC = 45, PLMN = 12345.

parameters.name: Mobile Country Code
parameters.description: Indicates the mobile country code of the E-UTRAN neighboring cell. A PLMN ID is comprised of an MCC and an MNC. The MCC consists of three digits. The MNC consists of two or three digits. For example, MCC = 123, MNC = 45, PLMN = 12345.

parameters.name: Mobile Network Code
parameters.description: Indicates the mobile network code of a neighboring E-UTRAN cell. A PLMN ID is comprised of an MCC and an MNC. The MCC consists of three digits. The MNC consists of two or three digits. For example, MCC = 123, MNC = 45, PLMN = 12345.

parameters.name: eNodeB ID
parameters.description: Indicates the eNodeB ID of an inter-RAT neighboring E-UTRAN cell. It uniquely identifies an eNodeB within a PLMN. A 28-bit E-UTRAN cell identifier (ECI) is comprised of a cell ID and an eNodeB ID (represented by the most significant 20 bits). An E-UTRAN cell global identifier (ECGI) is comprised of an ECI and a PLMN ID. For details, see 3GPP TS 36.413.

parameters.name: Cell ID
parameters.description: Indicates the ID of the inter-RAT neighboring E-UTRAN cell. It uniquely identifies a cell within an eNodeB. The 28-bit E-UTRAN cell ID is comprised of the cell ID (represented by the least significant eight bits) and the eNodeB ID. The cell global identity (CGI) of an E-UTRAN cell is comprised of the E-UTRAN cell ID and the PLMN ID. For details, see 3GPP TS 36.413.

parameters.name: Downlink EARFCN
parameters.description: Indicates the DL EARFCN of the inter-RAT external E-UTRAN cell. For details, see 3GPP TS 36.104.

parameters.name: Physical Cell ID
parameters.description: Indicates the physical cell ID of the external E-UTRAN cell. For details about this parameter, see 3GPP TS 36.331.

parameters.name: Tracking Area Code
parameters.description: Indicates the TAC of the external E-UTRAN cell. According to 3GPP specifications, the TAC values 0x0000(0) and 0xFFFE(65534) are reserved, and therefore these two TAC values cannot be used in later versions. You are advised not to set 0 or 65534 as the TAC value in network planning and configuration.

parameters.name: Cell Name
parameters.description: Indicates the name of the neighboring E-UTRAN cell.

parameters.name: Aggregation Attribute
parameters.description: Indicates the aggregation attributes of an external E-UTRAN cell. MASTER_PLMN_RESERVED_FLAG: Indicates whether to reserve the primary PLMN ID of an external E-UTRAN cell. If this option is selected, the primary PLMN ID of the external E-UTRAN cell is reserved and the cell cannot be selected as a target cell for handovers of UEs served by the primary PLMN. If this option is deselected, the cell can

parameters.name: Mobile Country Code
parameters.description: Indicates the MCC in the external PLMN ID of a gNodeB. A PLMN ID is comprised of an MCC and an MNC. An MCC consists of three digits. An MNC consists of two or three digits. For example, if the MCC is 123 and the MNC is 45, the PLMN ID is 12345.

parameters.name: Mobile Network Code
parameters.description: Indicates the MNC in the external PLMN ID of a gNodeB. A PLMN ID is comprised of an MCC and an MNC. An MCC consists of three digits. An MNC consists of two or three digits. For example, if the MCC is 123 and the MNC is 45, the PLMN ID is 12345.

parameters.name: gNodeB ID Length
parameters.description: Indicates the length of the gNodeB ID in the NCI corresponding to the external PLMN ID of a gNodeB.

parameters.name: Flow Control Parameter Group ID
parameters.description: Indicates the ID of a flow control parameter group.

parameters.name: Flow Control Type
parameters.description: Indicates whether to enable flow control for bearers with a type of QCI. When this parameter is set to FLOW_CTRL for bearers with a type of QCI, flow control is enabled for the bearers with this type of QCI. When this parameter is set to NON_FLOW_CTRL for bearers with a type of QCI, flow control is not enabled for the bearers with this type of QCI. The QCI for GBR services is always NON_FLOW_CTRL.

parameters.name: Uplink Flow Control Minimum CIR
parameters.description: Indicates the uplink minimum CIR when flow control is performed on bearers with a type of QCI.

parameters.id: Uplink Flow Control Priority Weight Factor
parameters.name: Uplink Flow Control Priority Weight Factor
parameters.description: Indicates the weight factor for calculating the step of rate increase for bearers with a type of QCI when flow control is performed.

parameters.name: Frequency Band
parameters.description: Indicates a frequency band. For details about this parameter, see 3GPP TS 38.104. If the value of the NrDuCell.FrequencyBand parameter is equal to the value of this parameter, the configuration in this MO is applied.

parameters.name: Frame Offset
parameters.description: Indicates the offset of the start frame against a reference clock for all cells working in the given frequency band and their associated uplink and downlink decoupling cells. If this parameter is set to a value in the range of 0 to 261120, frame transmission is started at a time later than the reference clock, with a deviation equal to the parameter value. If this parameter is set to a value in th

parameters.name: gNodeB Frequency Priority Group ID
parameters.description: Indicates the ID of a gNodeB frequency priority group.

parameters.name: Frequency Index
parameters.description: Indicates the index of a frequency in the gNodeB frequency priority group.

parameters.name: RAT Type
parameters.description: Indicates the RAT corresponding to the frequency.

parameters.name: Downlink EARFCN
parameters.description: Indicates the downlink EARFCN of a neighboring E-UTRAN cell. For details about this parameter, see 3GPP TS 36.104.

parameters.name: Cell Reselection Priority
parameters.description: Indicates the cell reselection priority of the frequency. Value 0 indicates the lowest priority, and value 7 indicates the highest priority.

parameters.name: Cell Reselection Sub-Priority
parameters.description: Indicates the cell reselection sub-priority of the frequency. If this parameter is set to the invalid value 0DOT0, the sub-priority is not delivered. parameters.name: SSB Frequency Position
parameters.description: Indicates the SSB frequency domain position of an NR frequency. When SsbDescMethod is set to SSB_DESC_TYPE_GSCN, this parameter indicates the Global Synchronization Channel Number (GSCN) corresponding to the SSB of the NR frequency. When SsbDescMethod is set to SSB_DESC_TYPE_NARFCN, this parameter indicates the absolute frequency number corresponding to the SSB of the NR frequency.

parameters.name: SSB Frequency Position Describe Method
parameters.description: Indicates the frequency-domain position description method of the SSB on a neighboring frequency.

parameters.id: Dedicated Freq Priority for Connected Mode
parameters.name: Dedicated Freq Priority for Connected Mode
parameters.description: Indicates the connected-mode dedicated priority of a neighboring frequency. The connected-mode frequency priorities can be operator-specific. A larger value of this parameter indicates a higher priority. If this parameter is set to 0, the frequency is not selected as the candidate frequency for operator-specific priority-based handovers.

parameters.id: IP Address Sample and Pseudonymization Sw
parameters.name: IP Address Sample and Pseudonymization Sw
parameters.description: Indicates whether an operator allows the gNodeB to perform IP address resolution and pseudonymization and specifies the usage of the IP address after pseudonymization. CPE_PRFM_EVALUATION_SW(CPE Performance Evaluation Switch): Indicates whether the IP address after pseudonymization can be used for CPE performance evaluation.

parameters.name: Integrity Protection Algorithm Priority
parameters.description: Indicates the priority of an integrity protection algorithm. PRIMARY indicates the highest priority, SECOND indicates the second priority, and THIRD indicates the third priority.

parameters.name: Integrity Protection Algorithm
parameters.description: Indicates an integrity protection algorithm of a corresponding priority. If this parameter is set to NOT_CONFIG, the gNodeB skips the corresponding priority when selecting an integrity protection algorithm.

parameters.id: Necessary HO Prepare Fail Punish Timer
parameters.name: Necessary HO Prepare Fail Punish Timer
parameters.description: Indicates the penalty timer applied to handover (EPS fallback, coverage-based intra-RAT handover, or coverage-based inter-RAT handover) to a target cell. If a handover preparation fails due to resource-related causes, the handover to the target cell is prohibited within the timer. If this parameter is set to 0, penalty is not performed.

parameters.id: Optimized HO Prepare Fail Punish Timer
parameters.name: Optimized HO Prepare Fail Punish Timer
parameters.description: Indicates the penalty timer applied to handover (frequency-priority-based handover) to a target cell. If a handover preparation fails due to resource-related causes, the handover to the target cell is prohibited within the timer. If this parameter is set to 0, penalty is not performed.

parameters.id: Non-Res HO Prepare Fail Punish Times
parameters.name: Non-Res HO Prepare Fail Punish Times
parameters.description: Indicates the number of times penalty is performed following non-resource-related handover preparation failures. If a handover preparation fails due to non-resource-related causes during a handover to the target cell, the gNodeB prohibits the UE from being handed over to the target cell based on the number of penalty times. parameters.id: Max Num of HO Fwd PDCP Pkt with SN
parameters.name: Max Num of HO Fwd PDCP Pkt with SN
parameters.description: Indicates the maximum number of PDCP packets that can be forwarded with SNs during handovers when the PDCP SN size is less than 18 bits.

parameters.id: Max Rate of PDCP HO Trans
parameters.name: Max Rate of PDCP HO Trans
parameters.description: Indicates the maximum rate at which PDCP data is forwarded during intra-RAT inter-gNodeB handovers. If this parameter is set to 65535, it does not take effect and PDCP data is forwarded at the maximum rate supported by the system. It is recommended that this parameter be set to a value not greater than the maximum rate allowed by the physical transmission bandwidth of the link. Otherwise, packet l

parameters.id: Wait NSA DC UE PDCP Status Report Timer
parameters.name: Wait NSA DC UE PDCP Status Report Timer
parameters.description: Indicates the length of the timer that governs the period in which the base station waits for a PDCP status report from an NSA-DC-capable UE. In data forwarding scenarios triggered by an NSA UE handover or SCG addition or deletion, the base station starts this timer. If the base station already receives the PDCP status report from the UE before the timer expires, the base station no longer sends t

parameters.id: HO and PDU Session Conflict Handling Sw
parameters.name: HO and PDU Session Conflict Handling Sw
parameters.description: Indicates switches of handling conflicts between intra-RAT and inter-RAT outgoing handover preparation and PDU session procedures. VOICE_FB_FIRST_SWITCH: Indicates whether the NG-RAN preferentially processes voice fallbacks when a voice fallback request is received during an outgoing handover preparation procedure. When this option is selected, voice fallbacks are preferentially processed. If this

parameters.name: RAT Type
parameters.description: Indicates the RAT of the neighboring cell corresponding to the PLMN.

parameters.name: Mobile Country Code
parameters.description: Indicates the MCC in the PLMN of the neighboring cell. The value of this parameter is a string of three decimal digits.

parameters.name: Mobile Network Code
parameters.description: Indicates the MNC in the PLMN of the neighboring cell. The value of this parameter is a string of two or three decimal digits.

parameters.name: PLMN List Type
parameters.description: Indicates the type of a PLMN list. If this parameter is set to BLACKLIST, the cell of the blacklisted PLMN cannot be configured as a neighboring cell or an external cell by ANR. If this parameter is set to GREYLIST, the cell of the graylisted PLMN can be added as a neighboring cell and an external cell by ANR, but handovers to the cell of the graylisted PLMN are not allowed. If this parameter is s

parameters.name: Operator ID
parameters.description: Indicates the ID of an operator.

parameters.name: Slice Service Type
parameters.description: Indicates the slice/service type. For details, see 3GPP TS 23.003.

parameters.name: Slice Differentiator
parameters.description: Indicates the slice differentiator. For details, see 3GPP TS 23.003. If this parameter is set to 16777215, a slice/service type is configured for the slice but the slice differentiator is not configured. If this parameter is not set to 16777215, this parameter indicates the specific slice differentiator.

parameters.name: Slice Description
parameters.description: Indicates the description of a slice. The description is configured by the operator.

parameters.name: NG-C SON Switch
parameters.description: Indicates whether to enable NG-C self-configuration. NGC_SON_SETUP_SW(NG-C Self-Setup Switch): Indicates whether to enable NG-C self-setup. NG-C self-setup is enabled only when this option is selected. NGC_SON_DELETE_SW(NG-C Self-Removal Switch): Indicates whether to enable NG-C self-removal. NG-C self-removal is enabled only when this option is selected.

parameters.name: NR MCC
parameters.description: Indicates the MCC of the NR network operator.

parameters.name: NR MNC
parameters.description: Indicates the MNC of the NR network operator.

parameters.name: gNodeB ID
parameters.description: Indicates the ID of the gNodeB serving the NR cell.

parameters.name: Cell ID
parameters.description: Indicates the cell ID of an NR cell. A cell ID and a gNodeB ID compose a 3GPP-defined NR Cell Identity (NCI). A 3GPP-defined NCI and a PLMN ID compose an NR cell global identifier (NCGI). For details, see 3GPP TS 38.413.

parameters.name: LTE MCC
parameters.description: Indicates the MCC of the LTE network operator.

parameters.name: LTE MNC
parameters.description: Indicates the MNC of the LTE network operator.

parameters.name: eNodeB ID
parameters.description: Indicates the ID of the eNodeB serving the LTE cell.

parameters.name: LTE Cell ID
parameters.description: Indicates the E-UTRAN cell ID. It uniquely identifies an E-UTRAN cell within an eNodeB. The 28-bit E-UTRAN cell ID is comprised of the cell ID (represented by the least significant eight bits) and the eNodeB ID. The E-UTRAN cell global identifier (ECGI) is comprised of the E-UTRAN cell ID and the PLMN ID. For details, see 3GPP TS 36.413.

parameters.name: Aggregation Attribute
parameters.description: Indicates the aggregation attributes of an LTE and NR co-deployment cell combination in NSA networking. CO_DEPLOYMENT_NSA_FLAG: Indicates whether the current LTE and NR cell pair is a co-deployment cell pair. parameters.name: Statistics Strategy Switch
parameters.description: Indicates the switches controlling counter statistics collection policies. NSA_CBRA_STATISTICS_OPT_SW: Indicates whether to enable statistics collection optimization for contention-based random access in NSA scenarios. If this option is selected and the base station triggers NSA UE access, all contention-based random access statistics within a fixed period of time are counted in related counters a

parameters.name: Operator ID
parameters.description: Indicates the ID of an operator.

parameters.name: Operator Name
parameters.description: Indicates the name of an operator.

parameters.name: Mobile Country Code
parameters.description: Indicates the MCC of an operator. The value of this parameter is a string of three decimal digits.

parameters.name: Mobile Network Code
parameters.description: Indicates the MNC of an operator. The value of this parameter is a string of two or three decimal digits.

parameters.name: Operator Type
parameters.description: Indicates the type of an operator. An operator can be the primary operator or a secondary operator. One gNodeB can be configured with only one primary operator and multiple secondary operators.

parameters.name: NR Networking Option
parameters.description: Indicates the architecture option of an operator. The value SA indicates that the operator supports standalone networking. The value NSA indicates that the operator supports non-standalone networking. The value SA_NSA indicates that the operator supports standalone and non-standalone networking.

parameters.name: RE License Percentage
parameters.description: Indicates the proportion of the licensed number of REs for each operator when the gNodeB is shared among operators. This parameter must be set based on the contract signed among operators. Operator-based license control is applied only when this parameter is set to a valid value for all operators sharing the gNodeB. parameters.name: RRC Connected User License Percentage
parameters.description: Indicates the proportion of the licensed number of RRC_CONNECTED UEs for each operator when the gNodeB is shared among operators. This parameter must be set based on the contract signed among operators. Operator-based license control is applied only when this parameter is set to a valid value for all operators sharing the gNodeB. If this parameter is set to 255 for an operator sharing the gNodeB,

parameters.name: gNodeB ID Length
parameters.description: Indicates the length of the gNodeB ID for an operator. This parameter specifies the number of bits for the gNodeB ID in an NCI and uniquely identifies the NCI. For details, see 3GPP TS 38.423. The parameter value needs to be planned, and the same parameter value must be planned for all gNodeBs in the same PLMN.
