parameters.name: gNodeB ID
parameters.description: Indicates the protocol-defined gNodeB ID of an operator. It is unique within a PLMN. If the gNBIdLength parameter in the gNBOperator MO is set to 255 for an operator or the MultipleNCISwitch parameter in the gNBSharingMode MO is set to OFF, the parameter setting does not take effect. In this case, the value of the gNBId parameter in the gNodeBFunction MO is used as the gNodeB ID for this operator.

parameters.name: User Label
parameters.description: Indicates the operator-specific user label of a gNodeB. If the gNBIdLength parameter in the gNBOperator MO is set to 255 for an operator, the parameter setting does not take effect. In this case, the user label of a gNodeB is the same for all operators, namely, the value of the UserLabel parameter in the gNodeBFunction MO is used as the user label for all operators. parameters.name: Operator ID
parameters.description: Indicates the ID of an operator.

parameters.name: QoS Class Identifier
parameters.description: Indicates a QoS class identifier, which is an attribute of radio bearers.

parameters.description: Indicates the length of the downlink PDCP discard timer of the gNodeB. If PDCP packets have been buffered for a period longer than the timer length, the gNodeB discards the packets. This timer is valid only for data transmitted on DRBs. For details, see 3GPP TS 38.323.

parameters.name: Uplink PDCP Discard Timer
parameters.description: Indicates the length of the uplink PDCP discard timer for UEs. If PDCP packets have been buffered for a period longer than the timer length, the gNodeB discards the packets. This timer is valid only for data transmitted on DRBs. For details, see 3GPP TS 38.323.

parameters.name: gNodeB PDCP Reordering Timer
parameters.description: Indicates the length of the gNodeB-specific timer for PDCP packet reordering. When this timer expires, the PDCP packets are reordered by PDCP sequence number and then transmitted to the upper layer. For details, see 3GPP TS 38.323.

parameters.name: UE PDCP Reordering Timer
parameters.description: Indicates the length of the UE-specific timer for PDCP packet reordering. When this timer expires, the PDCP packets are reordered by PDCP sequence number and then transmitted to the upper layer. For details, see 3GPP TS 38.323.

parameters.description: Indicates the UE-specific threshold of the PDU data volume to trigger polling. It is recommended that this parameter be modified under the guidance of Huawei technical support.

parameters.id: gNodeB AM Byte Num Threshold for Trig Polling
parameters.name: gNodeB AM Byte Num Threshold for Trig Polling
parameters.description: Indicates the gNodeB-specific threshold of the PDU data volume to trigger polling. When the data volume of transmitted PDUs reaches the value of this parameter, the Poll flag is set in the PDU header. It is recommended that this parameter be modified under the guidance of Huawei technical support.

parameters.id: UE PDU Num Threshold for Trig Polling
parameters.name: UE PDU Num Threshold for Trig Polling
parameters.description: Indicates the UE-specific threshold of the PDU number to trigger polling. When the number of transmitted PDUs reaches the value of this parameter, the Poll flag is set in the PDU header. It is recommended that this parameter be modified under the guidance of Huawei technical support.

parameters.id: gNodeB PDU Num Threshold for Trig Polling

parameters.id: Polling PDU Retransmission Timer for gNodeB
parameters.name: Polling PDU Retransmission Timer for gNodeB
parameters.description: Indicates the length of the polling PDU retransmission timer for the gNodeB. It is recommended that this parameter be modified under the guidance of Huawei technical support.

parameters.id: AM Status Report Prohibit Timer for UE

parameters.id: AM Status Report Prohibit Timer for gNodeB
parameters.name: AM Status Report Prohibit Timer for gNodeB
parameters.description: Indicates the length of the gNodeB-specific timer for prohibiting status reporting in AM. It is recommended that this parameter be modified under the guidance of Huawei technical support.

parameters.name: RLC Reassembly Timer for gNodeB
parameters.description: Indicates the length of the gNodeB-specific timer for RLC reassembly. It is recommended that this parameter be modified under the guidance of Huawei technical support.

parameters.name: RLC Reassembly Timer for UE
parameters.description: Indicates the length of the UE-specific timer for reassembly. It is recommended that this parameter be modified under the guidance of Huawei technical support.

The parameter value is a hexadecimal number that consists of 0 to 32 characters, meaning a maximum of 128 bits (indicating 128 feature values). This parameter is an advanced parameter. To modify this parameter, contact Huawei Customer Service Center for technical support.

To modify this parameter, contact Huawei Customer Service Center for technical support.

parameters.description: Indicates the index of a UE-specific configuration.

parameters.name: UE Information Index
parameters.description: Indicates the UE index.

parameters.name: MO ID
parameters.description: Indicates the ID of an MO in the UE-specific configuration. Set this parameter under the guidance of Huawei technical support.

parameters.name: Parameter ID
parameters.description: Indicates the number of a parameter within the specified MO. Set this parameter under the guidance of Huawei technical support. This parameter is a user-level parameter, and the modification of one record of this parameter takes effect for only one user. For example, records of parameters in the NRDUCellAlgoSwitch MO have one-to-one relationship with users and therefore can be modified as a parame

parameters.name: Parameter Bit ID
parameters.description: Indicates the number of an option within the specified parameter when the parameter is of bit field type. A parameter value greater than 31 is an invalid value. A parameter value less than or equal to 31 is valid. For example, to change the value of bit 15, set this parameter to 15. The value 255 is invalid. Set this parameter under the guidance of Huawei technical support.

parameters.description: Indicates the value of the specified parameter or option. Set this parameter under the guidance of Huawei technical support. 1. The value of the ConfigValue parameter must be within the GUI value range of the parameter or option specified by MoId, ParamId, and ParamBitId unless the ConfigValue parameter value is processed in a special manner. 2. If the ParamBitId parameter value is valid, the Conf

parameters.name: Specific UE Config Description
parameters.description: Indicates the description of the UE-specific configuration.

parameters.name: Parameter Control Switch
parameters.description: Indicates the application scope of the blacklist and whitelist. TDD_VALID_SW: Indicates whether to enable the blacklisting and whitelisting functions in TDD mode. The functions are enabled only when this option is selected. FDD_VALID_SW: Indicates whether to enable the blacklisting and whitelisting functions in FDD mode. The functions are enabled only when this option is selected. For example, bla

parameters.name: X2 SON Configuration Switch
parameters.description: Indicates whether to enable X2 SON functions. X2SON_SETUP_SWITCH: Indicates whether to enable the LTE-NR X2 self-setup function. The function is enabled only if this option is selected. X2INIT_FAIL_DEL_SWITCH: Indicates whether to enable the function of X2 self-removal triggered by initial self-setup faults. The function is enabled only if this option is selected. X2SON_DEL_FOR_X2FAULT_SWITCH: Ind

parameters.id: X2 SON Delete Timer for X2 Fault
parameters.name: X2 SON Delete Timer for X2 Fault
parameters.description: Indicates the length of the timer for X2 self-removal triggered by X2 faults. If an X2 link is faulty throughout the period specified by this timer, the gNodeB automatically removes the X2 link.

parameters.name: X2 SON Security Mode
parameters.description: Indicates the security mode for X2 self-setup when the local gNodeB receives the control-plane SCTP IP address, security tunnel IP address, and GTP-U IP address of the peer eNodeB at the same time during an X2 self-setup. If this parameter is set to CP_UP, security tunnels will be automatically set up for both the user plane and control plane. If this parameter is set to UP, a security tunnel will

parameters.id: X2 SON Delete gNodeB Addition Count Threshold
parameters.name: X2 SON Delete gNodeB Addition Count Threshold
parameters.description: Indicates the threshold of the number of secondary gNodeB additions for automatically removing an X2 interface based on X2 usage. If the measured number of successful secondary en-gNodeB additions corresponding to an X2 interface within a timer length is less than or equal to this threshold, automatic removal of this X2 interface is triggered.

parameters.name: Mobile Country Code
parameters.description: Indicates the mobile country code (MCC) of the peer gNodeB to be added to the Xn blacklist or whitelist. The MNC, together with the MCC, forms the PLMN. The MCC consists of three digits. The MNC consists of two or three digits.

parameters.name: Mobile Network Code
parameters.description: Indicates the mobile network code (MNC) of the peer gNodeB to be added to the Xn blacklist or whitelist. The MNC, together with the MCC, forms the PLMN. The MCC consists of three digits. The MNC consists of two or three digits.

parameters.name: gNodeB ID
parameters.description: Indicates the ID of the peer gNodeB to be added to the Xn blacklist or whitelist.

parameters.name: Xn List Type
parameters.description: Indicates whether the Xn list is a whitelist or blacklist. If the peer gNodeB is in the Xn blacklist, the Xn interface between the two gNodeBs cannot be automatically set up. If the peer gNodeB is in the Xn whitelist, the Xn interface between the two gNodeBs cannot be automatically removed.

parameters.name: Xn SON Configuration Switch
parameters.description: Indicates whether to enable Xn self-configuration. XN_SON_SETUP_SW: Indicates whether to enable Xn self-setup. This function is enabled only when this option is selected. XN_SON_DEL_SW: Indicates whether to enable Xn self-removal. This function is enabled only when this option is selected. parameters.name: Frame Offset
parameters.description: Indicates the offset of the frame start time for all the cells served by the gNodeB relative to the time of the reference clock. If this parameter is set to a value in the range of 0 to 261120, the reference clock is delayed. The hysteresis is equal to the GUI value. If this parameter is set to a value in the range of 275943 to 307200, the time advance is equal to 307200 minus the GUI value. If th

parameters.name: SNR Threshold for AOA Measurement
parameters.description: Indicates the threshold of the signal-to-noise ratio for triggering angle of arrival (AoA) measurement. The AoA of signals transmitted or received by UEs needs to be measured to locate UEs. The gNodeB measures the AoA only when the signal-to-noise ratio of the signals reaches this threshold.

parameters.name: Frame Offset Auto Correction Switch
parameters.description: Indicates whether to enable automatic frame offset correction. If this parameter is set to ON and the frame offset of the local gNodeB is different from that of other gNodeBs, the local gNodeB automatically changes the frame offset to that of other gNodeBs. If this parameter is set to OFF, the gNodeB cannot automatically change the frame offset.

parameters.name: X2-U Transmission Type
parameters.description: Indicates the transmission mode of user-plane data between LTE and NR in NSA DC scenarios. If this parameter is set to ROUTING_TRANS, user-plane data between LTE and NR is transmitted based on route configurations. parameters.name: Clock Out-of-sync Detect Switch
parameters.description: Indicates the clock out-of-synchronization configuration switches. CLK_DETECT_SW: Indicates whether to enable clock out-of-synchronization detection. Clock out-of-synchronization detection is enabled only if this option is selected. This option applies only to low-frequency TDD cells. parameters.name: Clock Out-of-sync Intrf Report Thld
parameters.description: Indicates the threshold for reporting the clock out-of-synchronization interference value. If the average uplink interference is greater than this threshold, the base station reports the clock out-of-synchronization interference value. Then, the clock out-of-synchronization function detects the characteristic sequence. This parameter applies only to low frequency TDD cells.

parameters.name: Silence Detect Intrf Difference Thld
parameters.description: Indicates the interference difference threshold for silence detection in the clock out-of-synchronization detection. It is used to locate out-of-synchronization base stations. When the intersymbol interference difference between base stations performing silence detection is greater than this threshold, the silent base station is regarded as an out-of-synchronization base station. parameters.name: NSA DC Optimization Switch
parameters.description: Indicates whether to enable NSA DC optimization. NSA_DC_SRB3_SWITCH: Indicates whether to support the NSA DC SRB3 function. This function is enabled only if this option is selected. When this function is enabled, the gNodeB and UE can exchange signaling using SRB3. For details about this option, see 3GPP TS 37.340. parameters.name: Base Station Deep Dormancy Switch
parameters.description: Indicates whether to enable deep dormancy for the base station. BB_SHUTDOWN_POWERSAVING_SW: Indicates whether to enable energy saving by baseband shutdown. If this option is selected, the baseband can be shut down for energy saving when no cells are set up on the baseband, the carriers of deployed cells are shut down, or the deployed cells are blocked. parameters.id: LF Holdover Duration After GPS Failure
parameters.name: LF Holdover Duration After GPS Failure
parameters.description: Indicates the holdover duration after the GPS clock source is unavailable in low-frequency NR TDD cells.

parameters.name: Synchronization Difference Detect Switch
parameters.description: Indicates whether to enable clock synchronization deviation detection. If this parameter is set to ON, clock synchronization deviation detection is enabled on the local gNodeB. If this parameter is set to OFF, clock synchronization deviation detection is disabled on the local gNodeB. This parameter applies only to low-frequency TDD cells.

parameters.id: Max FH Fiber Length Adapt Switch
parameters.name: Max FH Fiber Length Adapt Switch
parameters.description: Indicates whether the gNodeB adaptively selects a time budget based on the length of optical fiber for fronthaul in eCPRI/CPRI scenarios. When this switch is turned on, the gNodeB automatically detects the length of optical fiber for fronthaul and adaptively selects a time budget based on the length. parameters.name: Max X2 Transmission Rate
parameters.description: Indicates the maximum transmission rate for PDCP data split and data forwarding over the X2 interface in NSA DC scenarios. The value that takes effect equals the GUI value multiplied by the step. The packet transmission rate at the PDCP layer is the value that takes effect converted into megabits per millisecond.

parameters.name: Service Interface Alarm Config Switch
parameters.description: Indicates whether to suppress the fault alarms of lower-layer links carrying terrestrial interfaces. parameters.name: CHR Switch
parameters.description: Indicates whether to enable CHR-related functions. STMSI_MASK_SW: Indicates whether to record S-TMSIs in CHRs. For details, see 3GPP TS 23.003. When this option is selected, S-TMSIs are not recorded in CHRs. When this option is deselected, S-TMSIs can be recorded in CHRs as required.

parameters.id: Auto Cell Bind Baseband Equipment Switch
parameters.name: Auto Cell Bind Baseband Equipment Switch
parameters.description: Indicates whether to automatically bind baseband equipment to the NR DU cell TRP. This parameter is valid only when the NRDUCellTrp.BasebandEqmId parameter is set to 255. If this switch is turned on, the system automatically changes the value of NRDUCellTrp.BasebandEqmId to the ID of the baseband equipment used by the cell after the cell is successfully set up. parameters.description: Indicates differentiated service processing algorithm switches. SPARSE_DIFF_PROC_SW: Indicates whether to enable differentiated processing for sparse-packet services. parameters.name: NR Cell ID
parameters.description: Indicates the ID of an NR cell, which uniquely identifies the NR cell within a gNodeB.

parameters.name: NSA DC Switch
parameters.description: Indicates whether to enable the LTE-NR non-standalone (NSA) dual connectivity (DC) function. The LTE-NR NSA DC function is enabled only if this switch is turned on on both the master base station and secondary base station. parameters.id: UL and DL Decoupling Algorithm Switch
parameters.name: UL and DL Decoupling Algorithm Switch
parameters.description: Indicates the NR uplink and downlink decoupling algorithm switch. UL_CARR_SEL_FOR_UE_EXP_SW: Indicates whether to enable user-experience-based uplink carrier selection.

parameters.name: Voice Strategy Switch
parameters.description: Indicates the 5G voice policy control switch. EPS_FB_SWITCH(EPS Fallback Switch): Indicates whether to enable voice fallback from NG-RAN to E-UTRAN.

parameters.name: Inter-RAT Service Mobility Switch
parameters.description: Indicates whether to enable inter-RAT mobility. When this switch is turned on, inter-RAT mobility from NG-RAN to E-UTRAN is enabled, and UEs can be reselected, handed over, or redirected from an NR cell to an E-UTRAN cell. When this switch is turned off, inter-RAT mobility from NG-RAN to E-UTRAN is disabled.

parameters.name: ANR Switch
parameters.description: Indicates whether to enable automatic neighbor relation (ANR) for a cell. NR_NR_ANR_SW: Indicates whether to enable intra-NR ANR. NR_EUTRAN_ANR_SW: Indicates whether to enable ANR with E-UTRAN. NR_NR_ANR_DEL_SW: Indicates whether to enable neighbor relationship removal by intra-NR ANR. parameters.description: Indicates whether to enable intra-RAT inter-frequency handover algorithms. COVERAGE_BASED_HO: Indicates whether to enable coverage-based inter-frequency handover. parameters.name: VoNR Switch
parameters.description: Indicates the voice over NR (VoNR) function switches. VONR_SW: Indicates whether to enable VoNR. VoNR is supported only if this option is selected. It is recommended that VoNR not be enabled in high-frequency scenarios. UL_DELAY_COV_OPT_SW: Indicates whether to enable coverage optimization by uplink delay configuration of voice services. This option applies only to low-frequency TDD cells. ANBR_SW

parameters.name: ROHC Switch
parameters.description: Indicates the switches related to robust header compression (ROHC). ROHC_SW: Indicates whether to enable ROHC. If this option is selected, ROHC is enabled. In this case, the ROHC Profiles parameter must be set to determine the profile that takes effect. If this option is deselected, ROHC is disabled. This option applies only in low frequency bands.

parameters.name: ROHC Profiles
parameters.description: Indicates ROHC profile configurations. PROFILE0X0001: Indicates the profile for RTP/UDP/IP. For details, see RFC 3095 and RFC 4815. This option applies only in low frequency bands. PROFILE0X0002: Indicates the profile for UDP/IP. For details, see RFC 3095 and RFC 4815. This option applies only in low frequency bands.

parameters.name: UE Power Saving Switch
parameters.description: Indicates the UE power saving switches. UE_DL_MIMO_LAYER_REDUCE_SW: Indicates whether to trigger downlink layer reduction for a UE. parameters.name: INACTIVE Strategy Switch
parameters.description: Indicates whether to enable RRC_INACTIVE state management. RRC_INACTIVE_SWITCH: Indicates whether to enable RRC_INACTIVE state management. If this option is selected, transition between RRC_CONNECTED and RRC_INACTIVE states is supported. If this option is deselected, RRC_INACTIVE state management is disabled.

parameters.name: Measurement Policy Switch
parameters.description: Indicates whether to enable measurement policy algorithms. parameters.name: MLB Algorithm Switch
parameters.description: INTER_FREQ_CONNECTED_MLB_SW: Indicates whether to enable MLB between inter-frequency cells for RRC_CONNECTED UEs. This function is enabled only when this option is selected. parameters.description: Indicates the ID of a cell, which uniquely identifies the cell within a gNodeB.

parameters.description: Indicates the RSRP threshold for triggering event A2 in a CA SCell. When the RSRP measured by a UE is below this threshold, event A2 is reported.

parameters.name: CA A5 RSRP Threshold 2
parameters.description: Indicates the RSRP threshold 2 for triggering event A5 in a CA SCell. If the signal quality of the serving cell is less than -31 dBm and the measured RSRP of a neighboring cell is greater than this threshold, UEs report event A5.

parameters.name: CA A6 Offset
parameters.description: Indicates the offset between the signal quality of a neighboring cell and that of the serving cell, which is used to determine whether to report event A6 in an SCell.

parameters.name: NR Cell ID
parameters.description: Indicates the ID of an NR cell, which uniquely identifies the NR cell within a gNodeB.

parameters.name: Overlapping RSRP Offset
parameters.description: Indicates the positive RSRP offset for a neighboring cell relative to that for the serving cell used in the overlapping area measurement event.

parameters.name: UL CoMP RSRP Offset
parameters.description: Indicates the positive RSRP offset for a neighboring cell relative to that for the serving cell used in the UL CoMP or SUL CoMP measurement event.

parameters.name: DL CoMP RSRP Offset
parameters.description: Indicates the positive RSRP offset for a neighboring cell relative to that for the serving cell used in the DL CoMP measurement event.

parameters.name: Time to Trigger
parameters.description: Indicates the time-to-trigger for CoMP-related measurement events. Set this parameter to reduce the probability of occasional event triggering.

parameters.name: Hysteresis
parameters.description: Indicates the hysteresis for CoMP-related measurement events. Set this parameter to reduce frequent event triggering and incorrect decisions caused by radio signal fluctuation.

parameters.name: SUL CoMP SRS RSRP Offset
parameters.description: Indicates the positive SRS RSRP offset for a neighboring cell relative to that for the serving cell used to trigger SUL CoMP.

parameters.name: NR Cell ID
parameters.description: Indicates the ID of an NR cell, which uniquely identifies the cell within a gNodeB.

parameters.name: Downlink EARFCN
parameters.description: Indicates the DL EARFCN of an inter-RAT neighboring E-UTRAN cell. For details about this parameter, see 3GPP TS 36.104.

parameters.name: Flow Control Parameter Group ID
parameters.description: Indicates the ID of a flow control parameter group.

parameters.name: AM PDCP Parameter Group ID
parameters.description: Indicates the ID of a PDCP parameter group in AM mode.

parameters.name: UM PDCP Parameter Group ID
parameters.description: Indicates the ID of a PDCP parameter group in UM mode.

parameters.name: RLC Mode
parameters.description: Indicates the RLC transmission mode, which can only be AM or UM. This parameter applies only to the scenario where the setup of the PDCP of the UE bearer is triggered by the current gNodeB. If the RLC mode of the related bearer over the terrestrial link (X2/Xn/NG) is obtained, this RLC mode is used, and this parameter does not take effect.

parameters.name: DRX Parameter Group ID
parameters.description: Indicates the ID of a DRX parameter group. If this parameter is set to a value in the range of 0 to 63, valid DRX parameters are configured for a QCI. If this parameter is set to 255, DRX is disabled for a QCI.

parameters.name: Inter-RAT HO Meas Group ID
parameters.description: Indicates the ID of a measurement parameter group related to inter-RAT handover.

parameters.id: Inter-RAT HO to E-UTRAN Meas Group ID
parameters.name: Inter-RAT HO to E-UTRAN Meas Group ID
parameters.description: Indicates the ID of a measurement parameter group related to inter-RAT handover to E-UTRAN.

parameters.name: Intra-freq Handover Measurement Group ID
parameters.description: Indicates the ID of a measurement parameter group related to intra-frequency handover.

parameters.name: Inter-freq Handover Measurement Group ID
parameters.description: Indicates the ID of a measurement parameter group related to inter-frequency handover.

parameters.name: NSA DC Configuration Group ID
parameters.description: Indicates the ID of an NSA DC configuration parameter group.

parameters.name: NR Cell ID
parameters.description: Indicates the ID of an NR cell, which uniquely identifies the NR cell within a gNodeB.

parameters.name: Mobile Country Code
parameters.description: Indicates the MCC of the operator who owns a neighboring NR cell. The MCC, together with the MNC, forms the PLMN. The MCC is a string of three decimal digits, and the MNC is a string of two to three decimal digits.

parameters.name: Mobile Network Code
parameters.description: Indicates the MNC of the operator who owns a neighboring NR cell. The MNC, together with the MCC, forms the PLMN. The MCC is a string of three decimal digits, and the MNC is a string of two to three decimal digits.

parameters.name: gNodeB ID
parameters.description: Indicates the gNodeB ID of a neighboring NR cell. It uniquely identifies a gNodeB within a PLMN.

parameters.name: Cell ID
parameters.description: Indicates the cell ID of a neighboring NR cell. It uniquely identifies an NR cell within a gNodeB.

parameters.name: Cell Individual Offset
parameters.description: Indicates the cell individual offset between an NR DU cell and a neighboring cell. It affects the probability of triggering measurement reports.

parameters.name: Blind SCell Configuration Flag
parameters.description: Indicates whether a neighboring NR cell can be blindly configured as an SCell. The neighboring NR cell can be configured as an SCell or PSCell in a blind manner only if this parameter is set to TRUE.

parameters.name: No Handover Flag
parameters.description: Indicates whether to allow UE handover based on a neighbor relationship.

parameters.name: No Removal Flag
parameters.description: Indicates whether removal of a neighbor relationship by ANR is permitted.

parameters.name: Neighboring Cell Reselection Offset
parameters.description: Indicates the cell reselection offset of an NR cell relative to a neighboring cell. This parameter is used to control the probability of cell reselection. If this parameter is set to a value other than 0 dB, this parameter is delivered in the q-OffsetCell IE of SIB3 and SIB4. For details about this parameter, see 3GPP TS 38.304.

parameters.name: Neighboring Cell Class Label
parameters.description: Indicates whether the neighbor relationship is formal or extended.

parameters.name: NR Cell ID
parameters.description: Indicates the ID of a cell, which uniquely identifies the cell within a gNodeB.

parameters.name: Minimum RX Level
parameters.description: Indicates the minimum RX level required for a reselection to an intra-frequency neighboring cell, which corresponds to the q-RxLevMin IE of intra-frequency neighboring cell in SIB2. For details, see 3GPP TS 38.331.

parameters.name: Intra-Freq Measurement Start Threshold
parameters.description: Indicates the measurement triggering threshold for intra-frequency cell reselection, which corresponds to the s-IntraSearchP IE in SIB2. For details, see 3GPP TS 38.331.

parameters.name: Cell Reselection Hysteresis
parameters.description: Indicates the hysteresis for the measured RSRP value of the serving cell during cell reselection, which corresponds to the q-Hyst IE in SIB2. For details, see 3GPP TS 38.331.

parameters.name: Cell Reselection Priority
parameters.description: Indicates the cell reselection priority of the serving frequency. Value 0 indicates the lowest priority. This parameter corresponds to the cellReselectionPriority IE in SIB2. For details, see 3GPP TS 38.331. The value of this parameter must be determined together with the priorities of other frequencies during network planning.

parameters.name: E-UTRAN Cell Reselection Timer
parameters.description: Indicates the timer used for E-UTRAN cell reselection. A UE initiates E-UTRAN cell reselection if the signal quality of the serving cell and that of the E-UTRAN cell constantly meet reselection threshold requirements before the timer expires and the UE has stayed in the serving cell for more than one second. If this parameter is set to 255, the UE in an NR cell is not reselected to the E-UTRAN cel

parameters.name: Non-Intra-Freq Measurement RSRP Threshold
parameters.description: Indicates the threshold for triggering inter-frequency or inter-RAT cell reselection measurements. If the cell reselection priority of a neighboring NR frequency or an E-UTRAN frequency is higher than that of the serving frequency, UEs always start inter-frequency or inter-RAT cell reselection measurements. If the cell reselection priority of a neighboring NR frequency or an E-UTRAN frequency is l

parameters.id: Serving Freq Low Priority RSRP Resel Thld
parameters.name: Serving Freq Low Priority RSRP Resel Thld
parameters.description: Indicates the threshold used in the evaluation of reselection to a low-priority inter-frequency or inter-RAT cell. Reselection to a low-priority inter-frequency or inter-RAT cell is performed if no cell on the serving frequency or on a high-priority frequency fulfills criteria 1 for inter-frequency or inter-RAT reselection. This parameter corresponds to the ThreshServingLowP IE in 3GPP TS 38.304.

parameters.name: Grid Group No
parameters.description: Indicates the ID of a grid group, which uniquely identifies a grid group.

parameters.name: Power Control Threshold
parameters.description: Indicates the power control threshold for the smart power lock feature. The average power within the average period must not exceed the maximum transmit power minus the value of this parameter.

parameters.name: NR DU Cell ID
parameters.description: Indicates the ID of an NR DU cell, which uniquely identifies the NR DU cell within a gNodeB.

parameters.name: Adaptive Edge Experience Enhance Switch
parameters.description: Indicates whether to enable the functions of the adaptive edge experience improvement feature. UL_WAVEFORM_ADAPT_SW: Indicates whether to enable the CP-OFDM and DFT-S-OFDM waveform adaption function in the uplink. parameters.name: MU-MIMO Switch
parameters.description: Indicates whether to enable the functions of the MU-MIMO feature in an NR DU cell. UL_MU_MIMO_SW: Indicates whether to enable the uplink MU-MIMO function. PDCCH_MU_SW: Indicates whether to enable the spatial multiplexing function on the PDCCH. DL_MU_MIMO_SW: Indicates whether to enable the downlink MU-MIMO function.

parameters.name: Spectrum Cloudification Switch
parameters.description: Indicates whether to enable the functions of the spectrum cloudification feature. LTE_NR_UL_SPECTRUM_SHARING_SW: Indicates whether to enable the LTE FDD and NR uplink spectrum sharing function. This option applies only to NR SUL. LTE_NR_FDD_SPCT_SHR_SW: Indicates whether to enable the LTE FDD and NR spectrum sharing function. This option applies only to NR FDD cells. LTE_NR_TDD_SPCT_SHR_SW: Indica

parameters.name: UL and DL Decoupling Switch
parameters.description: Indicates whether to enable the NR uplink and downlink decoupling feature. The NR uplink and downlink decoupling feature is enabled only if this parameter is set to ON.

parameters.name: Uplink Inconsecutive Scheduling Switch
parameters.description: Indicates whether to enable the uplink non-consecutive scheduling algorithm. UL_NON_CON_SCH_SW: If this option is selected, the uplink non-consecutive scheduling algorithm is enabled. If this option is deselected, the uplink non-consecutive scheduling algorithm is disabled. This parameter applies only to low-frequency TDD cells.

parameters.name: DL Enhanced HARQ Switch
parameters.description: Indicates whether to enable the downlink enhanced HARQ function in an NR DU cell. DL_EN_HARQ_SW: Indicates whether to enable the downlink enhanced HARQ function.

parameters.name: NSA DC Algorithm Switch
parameters.description: Indicates LTE-NR NSA DC algorithm switches. CROSS_MDLT_INTRF_AVOID_SW: Indicates whether NR supports cross-modulation interference avoidance. NR supports cross-modulation interference avoidance only if this option is selected. The value of gNodeBParam.NsaDcResCoordScenario determines the cross-modulation interference avoidance bitmap the gNodeB sends to the eNodeB. When gNodeBParam.NsaDcResCoordSc

parameters.name: Uplink 256QAM Switch
parameters.description: Indicates whether to enable the uplink 256QAM functions. If the UL_256QAM_OFF option is selected, the uplink 256QAM functions at the cell level are disabled. If the UL_256QAM_FIXED option is selected, the fixed uplink 256QAM function at the cell level is enabled. If the UL_256QAM_ADAPT option is selected, the adaptive uplink 256QAM function at the cell level is enabled.

parameters.name: Uplink Interference Random Schedule Switch
parameters.description: Indicates whether to enable the uplink interference randomization for scheduling feature.

parameters.id: UE Feature Based Pairing Enhancement Switch
parameters.name: UE Feature Based Pairing Enhancement Switch
parameters.description: Indicates whether to enable UE feature-based pairing enhancement. DL_MOBILE_MU_ENH_SW: Indicates whether to enable downlink mobile MU-MIMO enhancement. This option takes effect only for low frequency bands.

parameters.name: SU-MIMO Multiple Layers Switch
parameters.description: Indicates whether to enable multi-layer transmission for a UE, including downlink multi-layer transmission, uplink multi-layer transmission, and enhanced downlink single-user power control. DL_SU_MULTI_LAYER_SW: Indicates whether to enable downlink multi-layer transmission for a single user. This option does not take effect for SUL cells. UL_SU_MULTI_LAYER_SW: Indicates whether to enable uplink mu

parameters.name: CA Algorithm Switch
parameters.description: Indicates the CA algorithm switch. INTRA_BAND_CA_SW: Indicates whether to enable intra-band downlink CA. If this option is selected, the local cell serves as a PCell or an SCell for intra-band downlink CA. parameters.name: Downlink 256QAM Switch
parameters.description: Indicates whether to enable fixed downlink 256QAM. This parameter is used to control whether the high-order modulation function takes effect in a cell. If this switch is turned off, the downlink 256QAM function at the cell level is disabled. If this switch is turned on, the downlink 256QAM function at the cell level is enabled. This parameter applies only to FDD and TDD.

parameters.name: Symbol Shutdown Switch
parameters.description: Indicates the symbol shutdown switch, which is used to enable or disable the cell-level energy-saving feature. This parameter does not take effect when the carriers of the NR mode and other modes share the same RF module.

parameters.name: Full Channel Coverage Enhancement Switch
parameters.description: Indicates whether to enable enhanced full-channel coverage functions. SSB_PA_SW: Indicates whether to enable SSB power aggregation. When this option is selected and the MaxSsbPwrOffset parameter value is greater than 0, SSB power aggregation is enabled. When this option is deselected, SSB power aggregation is disabled. parameters.name: CoMP Switch
parameters.description: Indicates the switch that is used to enable and disable the CoMP function. INTRA_GNB_UL_COMP_SW: Indicates whether to enable intra-gNodeB UL CoMP. Intra-gNodeB UL CoMP is enabled only when this option is selected. INTRA_GNB_DL_JT_SW: Indicates whether to enable intra-gNodeB DL joint transmission. Intra-gNodeB DL joint transmission is enabled only when this option is selected. INTRA_GNB_OVERLAPPING

parameters.name: Power Saving Switch
parameters.description: Indicates the power saving switches. TIMING_CARRIER_SHUTDOWN_SW: Indicates whether to enable timing carrier shutdown. This function is enabled only when this option is selected. When this function is enabled, carriers are shut down at the preset time. parameters.name: RIM Algorithm Switch
parameters.description: Indicates whether to enable remote interference management (RIM). RIM_ADAPT_AVOID_SW: Indicates whether to enable adaptive remote interference avoidance. If this option is selected, adaptive avoidance is performed when remote interference is detected. If this option is deselected, adaptive remote interference avoidance is disabled. This option applies only to low-frequency TDD cells. RIM_ADAPT_AVO

parameters.name: Super Uplink Switch
parameters.description: Indicates whether to enable functions related to the super uplink function. SUPER_UL_TDM_SCH_SW: Indicates whether to enable UL and SUL time division multiplexing (TDM). This parameter applies only to SUL.

parameters.name: UE Link Abnormal Detect Switch
parameters.description: Indicates the UE link fault detection switch. If this switch is turned on, link fault detection is enabled for synchronized UEs. If this switch is turned off, link fault detection is not enabled for synchronized UEs.

parameters.name: Inter-RRU Channel Calibration Switch
parameters.description: Indicates whether to enable channel calibration. INTER_RRU_CHN_CALIB_SW: Indicates whether to enable channel calibration. Channel calibration is enabled only if this option is selected. This option takes effect only when NRDUCell.LampSiteCellFlag is set to YES.

parameters.name: Low Latency Switch
parameters.description: Indicates whether to enable low-latency optimization functions. NON_SLOT_SW: Indicates whether to enable low-latency non-slot symbol-level scheduling. This option applies only to low-frequency cells. GRANT_FREE_SW: Indicates whether to enable the grant-free function. This option applies only to low-frequency TDD cells. parameters.name: RAN Sharing Algorithm Switch
parameters.description: Indicates RAN sharing switches. RB_DYNAMIC_SHARING_SW: If this option is selected and UEs of each operator have sufficient service requirements, the shared data channel resources are used based on the configured RB resource proportion. parameters.name: Dynamic Power Sharing Switch
parameters.description: Indicates whether to enable dynamic power sharing. This parameter consists of the following options: LTE_NR_DYN_POWER_SHARING_SW: Indicates whether to enable power sharing between LTE carriers and NR carriers when the LTE and NR carriers share RF resources. parameters.name: Common Channel Interference Avoid Switch
parameters.description: Indicates whether to enable common channel interference avoidance. SSB_INTRF_AVOID_SW: Indicates whether to enable SSB interference avoidance. This option applies only to FDD and low-frequency TDD cells.

parameters.name: VMIMO Switch
parameters.description: Indicates whether to enable virtual MIMO. Virtual MIMO is enabled only if this parameter is set to ON. This parameter applies only to low-frequency LampSite TDD cells.

parameters.name: BWP Configuration Policy Switch
parameters.description: Indicates the BWP configuration policy switches. INIT_BWP_FULL_BW_SW: Indicates whether to configure the full-bandwidth initial BWP for UEs in the cell.

parameters.name: Service Differentiation Switch
parameters.description: Indicates service differentiation algorithm switches. SPARSE_DIFF_SCH_SW: Indicates whether to enable differentiated scheduling for sparse-packet services. This parameter takes effect only when the gNodeBParam.ServiceDiffProcSwitch.SPARSE_DIFF_PROC_SW option is selected. parameters.name: NR DU Cell ID
parameters.description: Indicates the ID of an NR DU cell, which uniquely identifies the NR DU cell within a gNodeB.

parameters.name: SCC Deactivation CQI Threshold
parameters.description: Indicates the CQI threshold for deactivating secondary cells based on channel quality. If the channel quality of a CA UE is lower than this threshold, the gNodeB deactivates the secondary cell. If this parameter is set to 0, the function of deactivating secondary cell based on channel quality is not enabled. This parameter is set on the secondary cell.

parameters.name: CA Enhanced Algorithm Switch
parameters.description: Indicates whether to enable enhanced CA algorithms. CARR_CSI_BEAM_SWEEPING_SW: Indicates whether to enable CA SCC beam sweeping. CSI beam sweeping is enabled when this option is selected. With this function, the base station obtains the CSI beam information of the UE on the PUSCH-less SCC so that the PMI, RI, or CQI can be transmitted on the optimal beam. parameters.name: NR DU Cell ID
parameters.description: Indicates the ID of an NR DU cell, which uniquely identifies the NR DU cell within a gNodeB.

parameters.name: Maximum Converged PDSCH Power
parameters.description: Indicates the maximum power offset of the PDSCH power relative to the reference power in the PDSCH power aggregation algorithm. This parameter applies only to low-frequency cells and takes effect only when the PDCCH_RATEMATCH_SW option of the NRDUCellPdsch.RateMatchSwitch parameter is deselected.

parameters.name: Maximum Common DCI Power Offset
parameters.description: Indicates the maximum offset of the power of DCI in common search space relative to the reference power after DCI power aggregation in the common search space of a cell is performed. parameters.name: TRS Power Offset
parameters.description: Indicates the maximum offset of the TRS channel power relative to the reference power after TRS power aggregation of a cell is performed. The actual effective value may be lower than the configured value because of the constraints of the power aggregation capability of the intermediate frequency (IF) and radio frequency (RF) or the power resource constraints during scheduling.

parameters.name: NR DU Cell ID
parameters.description: Indicates the ID of an NR DU cell, which uniquely identifies the NR DU cell within a gNodeB.

parameters.name: Common Control Resource RB Number
parameters.description: Indicates the number of RBs for common control resources of a cell. By default, the common control resources of a cell occupy the first symbol in each of such RBs. The frequency domain position of the common PDCCH changes according to the SSB position. This parameter is invalid when SpectrumCloudSwitch(NRDUCellAlgoSwitch) is set to LTE_NR_FDD_SPCT_SHR_SW.

parameters.name: NR DU Cell TRP ID
parameters.description: Indicates the ID of a TRP for an NR DU cell, which uniquely identifies the TRP for the NR DU cell within a gNodeB. It is used with the NrDuCellCoverageId parameter to uniquely identify the coverage area of the NR DU cell.

parameters.name: NR DU Cell Coverage ID
parameters.description: Indicates the ID of a coverage area of an NR DU cell, which is used with the NrDuCellTrpId parameter to uniquely identify the coverage area of the NR DU cell.

parameters.name: Sector Equipment ID
parameters.description: Indicates the ID of a set of sector equipment used by an NR DU cell coverage area, which uniquely identifies the set of sector equipment within a gNodeB. This parameter must be set by network planning engineers based on site requirements.

parameters.name: Max Transmit Power
parameters.description: Indicates the maximum transmit power of a single transmit channel for the carrier in the coverage area of an NR DU cell. This parameter applies only to low-frequency LampSite cells. If this parameter is set to a value in the range of 0 to 600, this parameter specifies the maximum transmit power of the carrier of the low-frequency LampSite RF module. parameters.name: NR DU Cell ID
parameters.description: Indicates the ID of an NR DU cell, which uniquely identifies the NR DU cell within a gNodeB.

parameters.name: TRS Period
parameters.description: Indicates the period of transmitting TRSs. If this parameter is set to MS0, TRS transmission is disabled. The values MS10, MS20, MS40, and MS80 indicate that TRSs are transmitted every 10 ms, 20 ms, 40 ms, and 80 ms, respectively.

parameters.name: CSI Period
parameters.description: Indicates the period for transmitting periodic CSI-RSs. This parameter takes effect only for UEs that initially access the network. This parameter applies only to low-frequency cells.

parameters.name: CSI Algorithm Switch
parameters.description: Indicates the switch for the CSI algorithm. PERIODIC_CSI_SWITCH: When this option is selected, periodic CSI is configured for UEs. When this option is deselected, aperiodic CSI is configured for UEs. In high frequency bands, only aperiodic CSI is supported. Therefore, this option must be deselected.

parameters.name: CSIRS Cell Resource Number
parameters.description: Indicates the number of resources for periodic CSI-RS transmission in a cell. This parameter applies only to low-frequency TDD cells.

parameters.description: Indicates the interference solution that needs to take effect.

parameters.name: Start RB Index of First Interference
parameters.description: Indicates the start RB index of the first interfered segment in narrowband interference or co-channel LTE interference. The value 273 indicates that the interfered segment does not take effect.

parameters.id: End RB Index of First Interference
parameters.name: End RB Index of First Interference
parameters.description: Indicates the end RB index of the first interfered segment in narrowband interference or co-channel LTE interference. The value 273 indicates that the interfered segment does not take effect.

parameters.name: Start RB Index of Second Interference
parameters.description: Indicates the start RB index of the second interfered segment in narrowband interference or co-channel LTE interference. The value 273 indicates that the interfered segment does not take effect.

parameters.id: End RB Index of Second Interference

parameters.description: Indicates the end RB index of the second interfered segment in narrowband interference or co-channel LTE interference. The value 273 indicates that the interfered segment does not take effect.

parameters.description: Indicates the ID of an operator.

parameters.description: Indicates the ID of a tracking area, which uniquely identifies an entry of tracking area information. This parameter is used only within the gNodeB and is not used in the information exchanged with the core network. It is different from the TAI configured in the TAL of the core network. If this parameter is set to 4294967295, the TAI of the operator corresponding to the cell is the value of Tracki

parameters.name: Policy Switch
parameters.description: Indicates the policy switches configured for different operators in non-independent operator mode. OP_SUL_SWITCH: Indicates whether Super Uplink or UL and DL Decoupling can be enabled for an operator. This option applies only to SUL.

parameters.name: Cell ID
parameters.description: Indicates the operator-specific cell ID of an NR cell. This cell ID and the gNodeB ID of the operator compose the 3GPP-defined NR cell ID (NCI) of the operator. The NCI and the PLMN ID compose the NCGI. For details, see 3GPP TS 38.413. If this parameter is set to 65535, this parameter is invalid. In this case, no exclusive cell ID is available for the operator. If this parameter is set to a value

parameters.name: Cell Primary Operator Flag
parameters.description: Indicates the primary operator of a cell. If the gNBSharingMode.MultipleNCISwitch parameter is set to ON, the primary operator must be specified. If the gNBSharingMode.MultipleNCISwitch parameter is set to OFF, there is no need to specify the primary operator.

parameters.name: Cell Resource ID
parameters.description: Indicates the NR DU cell resource ID, which is used to add cell resources for an operator in multi-operator sharing scenarios. The value 255 indicates an invalid value, which means that cell resources are not added for the operator.

parameters.name: NR DU Cell ID
parameters.description: Indicates the ID of an NR DU cell, which uniquely identifies the NR DU cell within a gNodeB.

parameters.name: Default Paging Cycle
parameters.description: Indicates the default paging cycle of a cell.

parameters.name: NR DU Cell ID
parameters.description: Indicates the ID of an NR DU cell, which uniquely identifies the NR DU cell within a gNodeB.

parameters.name: Uplink Maximum CCE Percentage
parameters.description: Indicates the maximum percentage of uplink available CCEs in a slot that is used for the transmission of both uplink and downlink scheduling information.

parameters.name: Occupied Symbol Number
parameters.description: Indicates the number of symbols occupied by the PDCCH.

parameters.name: Maximum Pairing Layer Number
parameters.description: Indicates the maximum number of pairing layers for PDCCH spatial multiplexing. This parameter can be set to specify the maximum number of PDCCH spatial layers only when the PDCCH_MU_SW option is selected. This parameter applies only to low-frequency TDD cells.

parameters.name: Number of Occupied RBs
parameters.description: Indicates the frequency domain range occupied by each PDCCH symbol in a cell. This parameter takes effect only when the rate matching function is enabled for PDCCH and PDSCH resources. If this parameter is set to 0, full band resources are occupied. If this parameter is set to a value greater than the downlink bandwidth (specified by DlBandwidth), the PDCCH uses full band resources by default.

parameters.name: PDCCH BLER Target
parameters.description: Indicates the target BLER value for PDCCH link adaptation. The PDCCH BLER needs to converge to this target value.

parameters.name: SUL Maximum CCE Percentage
parameters.description: Indicates the maximum percentage of CCEs available in the uplink for decoupling UEs when decoupling UEs are scheduled in slots used only for downlink scheduling in TDD cells.

parameters.name: PDCCH Algorithm Switch
parameters.description: Indicates the PDCCH algorithm switches. UL_DL_CCE_RATIO_ADAPT_SW: Indicates whether to enable uplink and downlink CCE percentage adaptation in a cell. If this option is selected, the gNodeB adaptively adjusts the maximum percentage of uplink CCEs based on uplink and downlink CCE requirements. If this option is deselected, the maximum percentage of uplink CCEs is specified by the NRDUCellPdcch.UlMa

parameters.name: Spectrum Sharing Start Symbol
parameters.description: Indicates the start symbol occupied by the PDCCH when LTE FDD and NR Spectrum Sharing is enabled. For details, see 3GPP TS 38.331. This parameter is valid only when the LTE_NR_FDD_SPCT_SHR_SW option of the NRDuCellAlgoSwitch.SpectrumCloudSwitch parameter is selected.

parameters.name: PDCCH Algorithm Extension Switch
parameters.description: Indicates PDCCH algorithm extension switches. UE_PDCCH_SYM_NUM_ADAPT_SW: Indicates whether to enable UE-specific PDCCH symbol number adaptation in a cell. If this option is selected, UE-specific PDCCH symbol number adaptation is enabled, and the NRDUCellPdcch.OccupiedSymbolNum parameter no longer takes effect. If this option is deselected, the number of UE-specific PDCCH symbols is specified by th

parameters.name: PDCCH Algorithm Enhancement Switch
parameters.description: Indicates the enhanced PDCCH algorithm switches. AGG_LVL_INIT_SELECT_OPT_SW: Indicates whether to enable initial aggregation level selection optimization in a cell. This function is enabled only when this option is selected.

parameters.name: Number of Guaranteed RBs
parameters.description: Indicates the number of guaranteed PDCCH RBs allocated to an NR cell when resources are sufficient in LTE FDD and NR spectrum sharing scenarios. When the number of PDCCH RBs required by an NR cell is greater than the value of this parameter, PDCCH RBs are allocated based on the service requirement. When the number of PDCCH RBs required by an NR cell is smaller than the value of this parameter, PDC

parameters.name: NR DU Cell ID
parameters.description: Indicates the ID of an NR DU cell, which uniquely identifies the NR DU cell within a gNodeB.

parameters.name: Downlink Target IBLER
parameters.description: Indicates the downlink target IBLER.

parameters.id: Downlink Maximum MIMO Layer Number Quota
parameters.name: Downlink Maximum MIMO Layer Number Quota
parameters.description: Indicates the maximum transport layer count quota for spatial multiplexing in downlink MIMO. This parameter does not take effect for low-frequency NR DU cells with NRDUCellTrp.TxRxMode set to 1T1R, 2R, 4R, 2T2R, 2T4R, 4T4R, or 8T8R. In this case, the maximum number of layers for downlink MIMO depends on the number of transmit antennas in the cell. If this parameter is set to LAYER_DEFAULT for low-

parameters.name: Downlink DMRS Configuration Type
parameters.description: Indicates the downlink DMRS type.

parameters.name: Downlink DMRS Maximum Length
parameters.description: Indicates the maximum number of downlink DMRS symbols.

parameters.name: Fixed AMC Step Value
parameters.description: Indicates the fixed step of PDSCH outer-loop adjustment.

parameters.name: Downlink Initial MCS After Handover
parameters.description: Indicates the downlink initial MCS after a UE handover.

parameters.name: Downlink Initial Rank After Handover
parameters.description: Indicates the initial downlink rank (number of PDSCH spatial multiplexing layers) during the period between the first SRS reporting and the first CQI reporting after the handover. If this parameter is set to RANK1, RANK2, RANK3, or RANK4, the rank value that takes effect is the GUI value or the maximum downlink MIMO capability reported by the UE, whichever is smaller. This parameter applies only t

parameters.name: Fixed Weight Type
parameters.description: Indicates the fixed weight type. It specifies the weight type for downlink data channel selection in MIMO. This parameter is valid only when all the following conditions are met: The DL_PMI_SRS_ADAPT_SW option of the NRDUCellAlgoSwitch.AdaptiveEdgeExpEnhSwitch parameter is deselected, the cell is a low-frequency TDD cell with the TX/RX mode being 4T4R, 8T8R, 32T32R, or 64T64R, and UEs support ante

parameters.name: SRS Pre-SINR Judge Threshold
parameters.description: Indicates the threshold used to determine whether the SINR of a UE SRS is low or high. This parameter applies only to TDD.

parameters.name: Rate Match Switch
parameters.description: Indicates whether to enable rate matching for the PDSCH. PDCCH_RATEMATCH_SW: If this option is selected, the NRDUCellPdcch.OccupiedRbNum parameter is set to a value greater than 0, and the value is less than the number of RBs corresponding to the cell bandwidth specified by NRDUCell.DlBandwidth, the PDSCH can use the resources on the PDCCH symbols. If this option is deselected, the PDSCH cannot us

parameters.name: DL Link Adaptation Algorithm Switch
parameters.description: Indicates the downlink adaptation algorithm switches. DL_MCS_TABLE_ADAPT_SW: Indicates whether to enable MCS index table adaptation. If this option is selected, the base station dynamically selects an MCS index table based on channel quality. If high-index MCSs are selected for a long time, the base station automatically selects the 256QAM MCS index table. If low-index MCSs are selected for a long

parameters.name: Downlink Initial MCS
parameters.description: Indicates the downlink initial modulation and coding scheme (MCS) after UE access.

parameters.name: Downlink Initial Rank
parameters.description: Indicates the initial downlink rank (number of PDSCH spatial multiplexing layers) during the period between the first SRS reporting and the first CQI reporting after the access. If this parameter is set to RANK1, RANK2, RANK3, or RANK4, the rank value that takes effect is the GUI value or the maximum downlink MIMO capability reported by the UE, whichever is smaller. This parameter applies only to

parameters.name: Downlink Additional DMRS Position
parameters.description: Indicates the position of the downlink additional DMRS. This parameter, the maximum symbol configuration, and UE capability determine the DMRS position in RRC messages. If this parameter is set to NOT_CONFIG, the effective DMRS position in RRC messages is POS0, indicating that additional DMRS is not configured. If this parameter is set to POS1, the effective DMRS position in RRC messages is POS1,

parameters.name: Downlink Initial MCS Adjust Value
parameters.description: Indicates the initial adjustment value of the MCS for downlink transmission. The MCS adjustment value is used to correct the CQI and reduce the amount that the selected MCS corresponding to the CQI deviates from the actual channel quality. The parameter can be used to adjust the initial adjustment value of the MCS.

parameters.name: Maximum Downlink HARQ Transmission Number
parameters.description: Indicates the maximum number of HARQ transmissions in the downlink.

parameters.name: Auto Parameter Optimization Switch
parameters.description: Indicates whether to enable automatic optimization for radio parameters. INIT_DELTA_CQI_AUTO_OPT_SW: Indicates whether to enable automatic optimization for the initial CQI adjustment amount. This function is enabled only if this option is selected. This option applies only to low-frequency TDD cells.

parameters.name: NR DU Cell ID
parameters.description: Indicates the ID of an NR DU cell. It uniquely identifies an NR DU cell within a gNodeB.

parameters.name: Power Saving Policy Index
parameters.description: Indicates the index of an NR DU cell power saving policy. It uniquely identifies a power saving policy for an NR DU cell.

parameters.name: Start Time
parameters.description: Indicates the power saving start time of an NR DU cell.

parameters.name: Stop Time
parameters.description: Indicates the power saving stop time of an NR DU cell.

parameters.name: Power Saving Type
parameters.description: Indicates the power saving type of an NR DU cell. When this parameter is set to TIMING_CARRIER_SHUTDOWN, the local cell shuts down the carrier at the preset time. When this parameter is set to LNR_SMART_CARRIER_SHUTDOWN, the local cell performs power saving based on the load on the NR and LTE networks. When this parameter is set to RF_SHUTDOWN, the local cell shuts down RF channels at the preset t

parameters.name: UE Number Threshold
parameters.description: Indicates the UE number threshold of power saving for an NR DU cell. The gNodeB automatically migrates services of the local cell to neighboring E-UTRAN cells, shuts down carrier of the local cell, and enables the cell to enter the LTE and NR intelligent carrier shutdown mode when the following conditions are met: NRDUCellPowerSaving.PowerSavingType is set to LNR_SMART_CARRIER_SHUTDOWN, the downli

parameters.name: Downlink PRB Threshold
parameters.description: Indicates the downlink PRB usage threshold of power saving for an NR DU cell. The gNodeB automatically migrates services of the local cell to neighboring E-UTRAN cells, shuts down carrier of the local cell, and enabled the cell to enter the LTE and NR intelligent carrier shutdown mode when the following conditions are met: NRDUCellPowerSaving.PowerSavingType is set to LNR_SMART_CARRIER_SHUTDOWN, a

parameters.name: Downlink PRB Offset
parameters.description: Indicates the downlink PRB usage offset of power saving for an NR DU cell. The gNodeB automatically enables the local cell to exit the RF channel shutdown mode when the following conditions are met: The value of NRDUCellPowerSaving.PowerSavingType is RF_SHUTDOWN, and within the configured power saving period, the cell already enters the RF channel shutdown state and the downlink PRB usage is great

parameters.name: NR DU Cell ID
parameters.description: Indicates the ID of an NR DU cell, which uniquely identifies the NR DU cell within a gNodeB.

parameters.name: Prach Configuration Index
parameters.description: Indicates the PRACH configuration index of an NR DU cell. For details about this parameter, see 3GPP TS 38.211. When this parameter is set to a value in the range of 0 to 255, the PRACH configuration index of the NR DU cell equals this parameter value. When this parameter is set to 65535, the PRACH configuration index of the NR DU cell is automatically generated. When this parameter is set to 189,

parameters.name: RSRP Threshold for SSB Selection
parameters.description: Indicates the RSRP threshold index for SSB selection. This parameter corresponds to the rsrp-ThresholdSSB IE specified in 3GPP TS 38.331. For details about this parameter, see 3GPP TS 38.321.

parameters.name: CBRA Preamble Percentage
parameters.description: Indicates the proportion of contention-based preambles to the sum of contention-based preambles and dedicated preambles. If this parameter is set to 255, the GUI value is invalid. In this case, the proportion is determined by the system. If this parameter is set to other values, the proportion is determined by the value of this parameter.

parameters.name: Maximum Preamble Transmission Count
parameters.description: Indicates the maximum number of preamble transmissions of a cell. For details about this parameter, see 3GPP TS 38.321.

parameters.name: PRACH Threshold Increase Rate
parameters.description: Indicates the percentage by which the PRACH preamble detection threshold increases. The value x indicates that the PRACH preamble detection threshold increases by x%.

parameters.name: Narrow Beam Probe Threshold
parameters.description: Indicates the SSB RSRP threshold for triggering narrow-beam probe after narrow-beam probe is enabled. If the RSRP reported by a UE is less than this threshold, the cell attempts to use the narrow beam to receive or transmit UE access messages. Otherwise, the cell still uses the wide beam. This parameter applies only to high-frequency TDD cells.

parameters.name: Random Access Algorithm Opt Switch
parameters.description: Indicates the random access optimization switches. CONTENTION_FREE_RA_OPT_SW: Indicates whether to optimize the handling of non-contention-based random access for UEs located beyond the planned cell radius. If this option is selected, the gNodeB optimizes the handling of non-contention-based random access for UEs located beyond the planned cell radius and allows these UEs to access the network. If

parameters.id: PRACH False Alarm Detect Distance Thld
parameters.name: PRACH False Alarm Detect Distance Thld
parameters.description: Indicates the distance threshold for PRACH false alarm detection. When the gNodeB detects that the distance is greater than this parameter value, the contention-based preamble is considered as a falsely detected preamble. parameters.name: NR DU Cell ID
parameters.description: Indicates the ID of an NR DU cell, which uniquely identifies the NR DU cell within a gNodeB.

parameters.name: Structure Type
parameters.description: Indicates the PUCCH format. For high-frequency TDD cells, this parameter is always set to a value indicating short format. For FDD and SUL cells, this parameter is always set to a value indicating long format.

parameters.name: Format3 RB Number
parameters.description: Indicates the number of PUCCH format-3 RBs. They are used to transmit HARQ-ACKs whose size is greater than two bits. This parameter takes effect only when the PUCCH format is long and the PUCCH_RBRES_ADAPTIVE_SWITCH option of the PucchAlgoSwitch parameter is deselected. This parameter applies only to low-frequency TDD cells, FDD cells with the INTRA_FR_INTER_BAND_CA_SW option selected, and SUL cel

parameters.name: Format1 RB Number
parameters.description: Indicates the number of PUCCH format-1 RBs. It is used to transmit SRs and HARQ-ACK whose size is less than or equal to two bits. This parameter takes effect only when the PUCCH format is long and the PUCCH_RBRES_ADAPTIVE_SWITCH option of the PucchAlgoSwitch parameter is deselected. This parameter applies only to SUL cells not enabled with LTE and NR sharing, low-frequency TDD cells, and FDD cells

parameters.name: Short PUCCH Symbol Number
parameters.description: Indicates the number of symbols used for short PUCCH in a cell. This parameter takes effect only for high-frequency cells with a short PUCCH format and with the PUCCH_RES_ADAPTIVE_SWITCH option of the PucchAlgoSwitch parameter deselected.

parameters.name: SR Period
parameters.description: Indicates the period of sending SRs. The period range differs depending on cell mode or subcarrier spacing. For details, see 3GPP TS 38.331. This parameter takes effect only for UEs that newly access the network. Specifically, for TDM UEs in SUL cells, SRs are received only in uplink timeslots available for NR. This parameter does not take effect if SR period adaptation is enabled.

parameters.name: Format3 CSI-dedicated RB Number
parameters.description: Indicates the number of RBs reserved for format-3 periodic CSI. This parameter takes effect only when the PUCCH format is long and the PUCCH_RBRES_ADAPTIVE_SWITCH option of the PucchAlgoSwitch parameter is deselected. This parameter applies only to SUL cells not enabled with LTE and NR sharing, low-frequency TDD cells, and FDD cells.

parameters.name: PUCCH Algorithm Switch
parameters.description: Indicates the PUCCH adaptation algorithm switch. It determines whether to enable PUCCH resource adjustment. PUCCH_RES_ADAPTIVE_SWITCH: Indicates whether to enable symbol number resource adjustment for short PUCCH. If this option is selected, the gNodeB automatically adjusts symbols of short PUCCH in the case of insufficient PUCCH resources or many idle PUCCH resources. If this option is deselected

parameters.name: SR Resource Algo Switch
parameters.description: Indicates the SR resource algorithm switch. It determines whether to enable SR resource adjustment. SR_PERIOD_ADAPT_SWITCH: Indicates whether to enable SR period adaptation. If this option is selected, SR period adjustment is enabled. If this option is deselected, the SR period is the value of the NRDUCellPucch.SrPeriod parameter.

parameters.name: Format4 RB Number
parameters.description: Indicates the number of PUCCH format-4 RBs. It is used to transmit HARQ-ACKs whose size is greater than two bits. This parameter takes effect only when the PUCCH format is long and the PUCCH_RES_ADAPTIVE_SWITCH option of the PucchAlgoSwitch parameter is deselected. This parameter applies only to low-frequency TDD cells, FDD cells with the INTRA_FR_INTER_BAND_CA_SW option selected, and SUL cells no

parameters.name: CSI Report Period
parameters.description: Indicates the CSI reporting interval.This parameter is valid only when the CSI_REPORT_PERIOD_ADAPT_SWITCH option of the CsiResoureAlgoSwitch parameter is deselected. For TDD and FDD cells, the value of this parameter or the value of NRDUCellCsirs.CsiPeriod is used as the CSI reporting interval, whichever is larger. For SUL cells, the value of this parameter or the value of NRDUCellCsirs.CsiPeriod

parameters.name: User Short PUCCH Symbol Number
parameters.description: Indicates the number of PUCCH format-2 symbols. This parameter can be set to ADAPTIVE only when the value of ShortPucchSymbolNum is greater than or equal to SYMBOL4 and the PUCCH_RES_ADAPTIVE_SWITCH option of the PucchAlgoSwitch parameter is deselected. This parameter applies only to high-frequency TDD cells.

parameters.name: CSI Resource Algo Switch
parameters.description: Indicates the CSI resource algorithm switches. CSI_REPORT_PERIOD_ADAPT_SWITCH: Indicates whether to enable CSI reporting period adaptation. If this option is selected, CSI reporting period adjustment is initiated. If this option is deselected, the CSI reporting period is the value of the NRDUCellPucch.CsiReportPeriod parameter. This option applies only to low-frequency cells.

parameters.name: Format4 CSI-dedicated RB Number
parameters.description: Indicates the number of RBs reserved for format-4 periodic CSI. This parameter takes effect only when the PUCCH format is long and the PUCCH_RBRES_ADAPTIVE_SWITCH option of the PucchAlgoSwitch parameter is deselected. This parameter applies only to SUL cells not enabled with LTE and NR sharing, low-frequency TDD cells, and FDD cells.

parameters.name: NR DU Cell ID
parameters.description: Indicates the ID of an NR DU cell, which uniquely identifies the NR DU cell within a gNodeB.

parameters.name: Initial Uplink SINR Adjustment
parameters.description: Indicates the initial uplink SINR adjustment value of UEs that are not paired. For paired UEs, the initial uplink SINR adjustment value is fixed to 0 dB.

parameters.name: Uplink DMRS Type
parameters.description: Indicates the uplink DMRS type. For details, see 3GPP TS 38.331 and 3GPP TS 38.211. This parameter takes effect only for UEs that initially access the network. If this parameter is set to TYPE2, this value applies only to low-frequency cells.

parameters.name: Uplink Additional DMRS Position
parameters.description: Indicates the position of the uplink additional DMRS (number of hidden symbols). When this parameter is set to NOT_CONFIG, no additional DMRS is configured for the uplink. When this parameter is set to POS1, the number of uplink additional DMRS symbols is 1. When this parameter is set to POS2, the number of uplink additional DMRS symbols is 2. This parameter takes effect only for UEs that newly ac

parameters.id: Uplink Maximum MIMO Layer Count Quota
parameters.name: Uplink Maximum MIMO Layer Count Quota
parameters.description: Indicates the maximum transport layer count quota for spatial multiplexing in uplink MIMO of a cell. This parameter does not take effect for low-frequency NR DU cells with NRDUCellTrp.TxRxMode set to 1T1R, 2R, 4R, 2T2R, 2T4R, 4T4R, or 8T8R. In this case, the maximum number of layers for uplink MIMO depends on the number of receive antennas in the cell.

parameters.name: Uplink PUSCH Algorithm Switch
parameters.description: Indicates whether to enable functions related to uplink PUSCH scheduling. UL_PAMC_SWITCH: Indicates whether to enable uplink PAMC. MSG3_TRANSFORMPRECODE_SWITCH: Indicates whether to configure a single carrier for the first uplink transmission and retransmission, for DCI_0_0 transmission, and when the transformPrecoder IE is not configured in PUSCH-Config. When this option is selected, the single-c

parameters.name: Uplink Target IBLER
parameters.description: Indicates the uplink target IBLER when the uplink IBLER adaption algorithm is disabled.

parameters.name: SINR Threshold for Waveform Selection
parameters.description: Indicates the SINR threshold for waveform selection. The UE uses DFT-s-OFDM only when the SINR of the UE is less than this threshold.

parameters.name: UL VoNR Reserved RB Number
parameters.description: Indicates the number of RB resources reserved for VoNR in the uplink. This parameter takes effect only when the UL_RB_RSV_SW option of the NRCellAlgoSwitch.VonrSwitch parameter is selected. This parameter applies only to low-frequency cells.

parameters.id: UL VoNR Reserved RB Start Position
parameters.name: UL VoNR Reserved RB Start Position
parameters.description: Indicates the start position of RB resources reserved for VoNR in the uplink. This parameter takes effect only when the UL_RB_RSV_SW option of the NRCellAlgoSwitch.VonrSwitch parameter is selected. This parameter applies only to low-frequency cells.

parameters.name: Uplink Preallocation Switch
parameters.description: Indicates whether to enable uplink preallocation. UL_BASIC_PREALLOCATION_SWITCH: Indicates whether to enable uplink basic preallocation. UL_SMART_PREALLOCATION_SWITCH: Indicates whether to enable uplink smart preallocation.

parameters.name: Uplink Smart Preallocation Duration
parameters.description: Indicates the duration for uplink smart preallocation.

parameters.name: NR DU Cell ID
parameters.description: Indicates the ID of a local cell, which uniquely identifies the NR DU cell within a gNodeB.

parameters.name: QoS Class Identifier
parameters.description: Indicates the QoS class identifier of radio bearers.

parameters.name: MAC Parameter Group ID
parameters.description: Indicates the ID of a MAC parameter group.

parameters.name: AM RLC Parameter Group ID
parameters.description: Indicates the ID of an RLC parameter group in AM mode.

parameters.name: UM RLC Parameter Group ID
parameters.description: Indicates the ID of an RLC parameter group in UM mode.

parameters.name: UE Inactivity Timer
parameters.description: Indicates the length of the UE inactivity timer in which the gNodeB monitors whether a UE transmits and receives data. If the gNodeB detects that a UE has neither received nor sent data within the timer length, the gNodeB checks whether the RRC_INACTIVE state takes effect for the UE. If it does, the UE state is changed to RRC_INACTIVE. If it does not, the UE is released. If this parameter is set t

parameters.name: DU DRX Parameter Group ID
parameters.description: Indicates the ID of a DRX parameter group of an NR DU cell. If this parameter is set to 0 to 63, the QCI has valid DRX parameters. If this parameter is set to 255, DRX is disabled for the QCI.

parameters.name: NR DU Cell ID
parameters.description: Indicates the ID of an NR DU cell, which uniquely identifies the NR DU cell within a gNodeB.

parameters.name: Cell Resource ID
parameters.description: Indicates the resource ID of an NR DU cell.

parameters.name: Downlink RB Max Ratio
parameters.description: Indicates the maximum proportion of PDSCH RBs that can be used by UEs served by an operator in a cell. If this parameter is set to 255, the maximum proportion of downlink PDSCH RBs that can be used by UEs served by an operator is not configured.

parameters.name: Downlink RB Average Ratio
parameters.description: Indicates the average proportion of PDSCH RBs that can be used by UEs served by an operator in a cell. If this parameter is set to 255, the average proportion of downlink PDSCH RBs that can be used by UEs served by an operator is not configured.

parameters.name: Uplink RB Max Ratio
parameters.description: Indicates the maximum proportion of PUSCH RBs that can be used by UEs served by an operator in a cell. If this parameter is set to 255, the maximum proportion of uplink PUSCH RBs that can be used by UEs served by an operator is not configured.

parameters.name: Uplink RB Average Ratio
parameters.description: Indicates the average proportion of PUSCH RBs that can be used by UEs served by an operator in a cell. If this parameter is set to 255, the average proportion of uplink PUSCH RBs that can be used by UEs served by an operator is not configured.

parameters.name: NR DU Cell ID
parameters.description: Indicates the ID of an NR DU cell. It uniquely identifies an NR DU cell within a gNodeB. This parameter applies only to low-frequency TDD cells.

parameters.name: RIM-RS Type1 Set ID Size
parameters.description: Indicates the size of the set ID of type-1 RIM-RS. If this parameter is set to a value in the range of 15 to 22, the size of the set ID of type-1 RIM-RS is the same as the parameter value. If this parameter is set to 255, it indicates an invalid value, and the type-1 RIM-RS cannot be sent or detected. This parameter applies only to low-frequency TDD cells.

parameters.name: RIM-RS Type1 Set ID
parameters.description: Indicates the set ID of type-1 RIM-RS. If this parameter is set to a value in the range of 0 to 4194303, the set ID of type-1 RIM-RS is the same as the parameter value. If this parameter is set to 4294967295, it indicates an invalid value, and the type-1 RIM-RS cannot be sent or detected. This parameter applies only to low-frequency TDD cells.

parameters.name: RIM-RS Frequency Candidate Number
parameters.description: Indicates the number of candidate frequency-domain resources for global RIM-RS characteristic sequence for remote interference management. This parameter applies only to low-frequency TDD cells. The value FREQ_NUM_1 indicates that only one candidate frequency-domain resource is available. The value FREQ_NUM_2 indicates that two candidate frequency-domain resources are available. The value FREQ_NUM

parameters.name: RIM-RS Type1 Sequence Candidate Number
parameters.description: Indicates the number of candidate resources for type-1 RIM-RS characteristic sequence for remote interference management. This parameter applies only to low-frequency TDD cells. The value SEQ_NUM_1 indicates that only one candidate sequence resource is available. The value SEQ_NUM_2 indicates that two candidate sequence resources are available. The value SEQ_NUM_4 indicates that four candidate seq

parameters.id: RIM-RS Type1 Scrambling ID for IS0
parameters.name: RIM-RS Type1 Scrambling ID for IS0
parameters.description: Indicates the scrambling ID of type-1 RIM-RS for sequence 0. If this parameter is set to a value in the range of 0 to 1023, the scrambling ID of type-1 RIM-RS for sequence 0 is the same as the parameter value. If this parameter is set to 4294967295, it indicates an invalid value, and the type-1 RIM-RS cannot be sent or detected for sequence 0. This parameter applies only to low-frequency TDD cells

parameters.id: RIM-RS Type1 Scrambling ID for IS1
parameters.name: RIM-RS Type1 Scrambling ID for IS1
parameters.description: Indicates the scrambling ID of type-1 RIM-RS for sequence 1. If this parameter is set to a value in the range of 0 to 1023, the scrambling ID of type-1 RIM-RS for sequence 1 is the same as the parameter value. If this parameter is set to 4294967295, it indicates an invalid value, and the type-1 RIM-RS cannot be sent or detected for sequence 1. This parameter applies only to low-frequency TDD cells

parameters.id: RIM-RS Type1 Scrambling ID for IS2
parameters.name: RIM-RS Type1 Scrambling ID for IS2

Note on parameter replacement: Reserved parameters are temporarily used in the current version and will be replaced with new parameters (for example, of which the IDs can signify the parameter functions) in later versions. Therefore, avoid using this parameter over the configuration interface.
