parameters.name: NR DU Cell ID
parameters.description: Indicates the ID of an NR DU cell, which uniquely identifies the NR DU cell within a gNodeB.

parameters.name: Minimum RX Level
parameters.description: Indicates the minimum RX level for a cell. This value is included in criteria S and used in the evaluation of cell selection. It maps to the q-RxLevMin IE in SIB1. For details, see 3GPP TS 38.304.

parameters.name: NR DU Cell TRP ID
parameters.description: Indicates the ID of a TRP for an NR DU cell, which uniquely identifies the TRP for the NR DU cell within a gNodeB.

parameters.name: Smart Power Lock Switch
parameters.description: Indicates smart power control switches. AVERAGE_POWER_CONTROL_SW: Indicates whether the average power control function of the smart power lock feature is enabled. This function is enabled only when this option is selected. AVERAGE_3DEIRP_CONTROL_SW: Indicates whether the grid-based power control function of the smart power lock feature is enabled. This function is enabled only when this option is

parameters.name: Average Period
parameters.description: Indicates the average power statistical period for the smart power lock feature.

parameters.name: Power Control Threshold
parameters.description: Indicates the power control threshold for the smart power lock feature. The average power within the average period must not exceed the maximum transmit power minus the value of this parameter.

parameters.name: NR DU Cell ID
parameters.description: Indicates the ID of an NR DU cell, which uniquely identifies the NR DU cell within a gNodeB.

parameters.id: NR Spectrum Sharing Cell Group ID
parameters.name: NR Spectrum Sharing Cell Group ID
parameters.description: Indicates the ID of an NR spectrum sharing cell group, which uniquely identifies the NR spectrum sharing cell group within a gNodeB.

parameters.name: NR DU Cell ID
parameters.description: Indicates the ID of an NR DU cell, which uniquely identifies the NR DU cell within a gNodeB.

parameters.name: SRS Period
parameters.description: Indicates the SRS period configured for a UE. The actual SRS period is dependent on the value of this parameter and other factors such as available SRS resources, slot assignment, and UE capability. The actual SRS period for a common UE is greater than or equal to the value of this parameter. For details, see 3GPP TS 38.214. This parameter is valid only when the SRS_PERIOD_ADAPT_SW option is desel

parameters.name: SRS Algorithm Switch
parameters.description: Indicates the SRS algorithm switch, which is used to control SRS resource allocation policies. SRS_PERIOD_ADAPT_SW: Indicates whether the gNodeB adaptively adjusts the SRS period. When this option is selected, the gNodeB adaptively adjusts the SRS period. When this option is deselected, the fixed SRS period is used.

parameters.name: SRS Slot Number
parameters.description: Indicates the number of cell-specific SRS slots configured for high-frequency SRS within 5 ms. This parameter applies only to high-frequency TDD cells.

parameters.name: NR DU Cell ID
parameters.description: Indicates the ID of an NR DU cell, which uniquely identifies the NR DU cell within a gNodeB.

parameters.id: NSA TDM Power Control Trigger SINR Hyst
parameters.name: NSA TDM Power Control Trigger SINR Hyst
parameters.description: Indicates the hysteresis for the SINR threshold of triggering TDM uplink power control for NSA UEs.

parameters.id: NSA TDM Power Control Trigger SINR Thld
parameters.name: NSA TDM Power Control Trigger SINR Thld
parameters.description: Indicates the threshold of triggering TDM uplink power control for an NSA UE. TDM uplink power control is triggered for an NSA DC UE only if the uplink SINR of the UE on the LTE side is less than or equal to this threshold.

parameters.id: NSA Uplink Fallback to LTE SINR Hyst
parameters.name: NSA Uplink Fallback to LTE SINR Hyst
parameters.description: Indicates the hysteresis for the uplink signal quality threshold used to determine whether to change the uplink data split mode of NSA DC to the LTE-only mode in an NR cell.

parameters.id: NSA Uplink Fallback to LTE SINR Thld
parameters.name: NSA Uplink Fallback to LTE SINR Thld
parameters.description: Indicates the uplink signal quality threshold used to determine whether to change the uplink data split mode of NSA DC to the LTE-only mode in an NR cell.

parameters.id: Hyper Cell TRP Handover Delta RSRP
parameters.name: Hyper Cell TRP Handover Delta RSRP
parameters.description: Indicates the SRS RSRP difference based on which handovers are triggered between TRPs for a hyper cell or combined cell. This parameter applies only to low-frequency TDD cells.

parameters.id: NSA UL Path Select SINR High Threshold
parameters.name: NSA UL Path Select SINR High Threshold
parameters.description: Indicates the upper threshold of uplink signal quality for determining uplink data transmission path selection for non-NSA DC data split UEs. If the NR uplink signal quality is continuously greater than the upper threshold, the NSA DC uplink data transmission path selection function switches uplink data transmission to NR.

parameters.id: NSA UL Path Select SINR Low Threshold
parameters.name: NSA UL Path Select SINR Low Threshold
parameters.description: Indicates the lower threshold of uplink signal quality for determining uplink data transmission path selection for non-NSA DC data split UEs. If the NR uplink signal quality is continuously lower than the lower threshold, the NSA DC uplink data transmission path selection function switches uplink data transmission to LTE.

parameters.id: NSA Split UL Path Select SINR Threshold
parameters.name: NSA Split UL Path Select SINR Threshold
parameters.description: Indicates the threshold of uplink signal quality for determining uplink path selection for NSA DC data split UEs.

parameters.id: NSA UL Path Select SINR Hyst
parameters.name: NSA UL Path Select SINR Hyst
parameters.description: Indicates the hysteresis to the uplink signal quality evaluation threshold for the NSA DC uplink data transmission path selection function.

parameters.id: NSA UL Path Select SINR Time-to-Trigger
parameters.name: NSA UL Path Select SINR Time-to-Trigger
parameters.description: Indicates the time-to-trigger of uplink signal quality evaluation for the NSA DC uplink data transmission path selection function.

parameters.id: NSA UL Path Change to LTE Rate Ratio
parameters.name: NSA UL Path Change to LTE Rate Ratio
parameters.description: Indicates the rate ratio of LTE to NR for the NSA DC uplink data transmission path selection function to switch uplink data transmission to LTE. When the estimated LTE data rate is greater than the estimated NR data rate multiplied by the value of this parameter, uplink data transmission is switched to LTE.

parameters.id: NSA UL Path Change to NR Rate Ratio
parameters.name: NSA UL Path Change to NR Rate Ratio
parameters.description: Indicates the rate ratio of LTE to NR for the NSA DC uplink data transmission path selection function to switch uplink data transmission to NR. When the estimated LTE data rate is less than the estimated NR data rate multiplied by the value of this parameter, uplink data transmission is switched to NR.

parameters.id: NSA Small Pkt UL Back to NR Penalty Time
parameters.name: NSA Small Pkt UL Back to NR Penalty Time
parameters.description: Indicates the penalty duration for reselecting an uplink data transmission path after uplink small-packet UEs transfer uplink data transmission to the NR side in the NSA DC uplink data transmission path selection feature. This parameter applies only in FDD and low-frequency TDD.

parameters.name: NR DU Cell ID
parameters.description: Indicates the ID of an NR DU cell, which uniquely identifies the NR DU cell within a gNodeB.

parameters.name: SUL NR DU Cell ID
parameters.description: Indicates the ID of the SUL NR DU cell involved in NR uplink and downlink decoupling.

parameters.name: RSRP Threshold
parameters.description: Indicates the RSRP threshold for selecting an uplink carrier for UEs in idle mode or during SgNB addition in EN-DC scenarios. If the RSRP is greater than the threshold, a UE performs access on the normal UL carrier. If the RSRP is lower than the threshold, the UE performs access on the SUL carrier.

parameters.id: UL and DL Decoupling Algorithm Switch
parameters.name: UL and DL Decoupling Algorithm Switch
parameters.description: Indicates the algorithm switch for the NR uplink and downlink decoupling feature. SEC_HARMONIC_INTRF_AVOID_SW: Indicates whether to enable secondary harmonic interference avoidance. UL_CARR_SEL_FOR_UE_EXP_SW: Indicates whether to enable user-experience-based uplink carrier selection. SUL_CHANNEL_DECOUPLE_SW: Indicates whether to enable decoupling of channels on the SUL carrier. INTRA_GNB_SUL_COMP_

parameters.name: SRS RSRP Threshold
parameters.description: Indicates the SRS RSRP threshold for selecting an uplink carrier for UEs in connected mode. If the SRS RSRP is greater than the threshold, the UE for which UL and DL Decoupling takes effect switches from the SUL carrier to the normal uplink (NUL) carrier. If the SRS RSRP is lower than the threshold, the UE for which UL and DL Decoupling takes effect switches from the NUL carrier to the SUL carrier

parameters.name: Decoupling Estimate Throughput Gain Factor
parameters.description: Indicates the estimated throughput threshold percentage for switchover from NUL to SUL in uplink and downlink decoupling scenarios. When UEs for which UL and DL Decoupling takes effect camp on the NUL carrier and the estimated uplink throughput of the SUL is greater than the estimated uplink throughput of the NUL multiplied by this parameter value, the UEs are handed over from the NUL carrier to t

parameters.name: NR DU Cell TRP ID
parameters.description: Indicates the ID of a TRP for an NR DU cell, which uniquely identifies the TRP for the NR DU cell within a gNodeB.

parameters.name: NR DU Cell ID
parameters.description: Indicates the ID of an NR DU cell. It uniquely identifies an NR DU cell within a gNodeB. When virtual MIMO is enabled for LampSite base stations, the NrDuCellId parameter of the slave TRP must be set to 65535.

parameters.name: Transmit and Receive Mode
parameters.description: Indicates the TX and RX modes of a TRP in an NR DU cell.

parameters.name: Baseband Equipment ID
parameters.description: Indicates the ID of the baseband equipment used by a TRP in an NR DU cell. If this parameter is set to 255, the baseband equipment used by the TRP in the NR DU cell is unspecified and will be selected automatically by the software. If this parameter is not set to 255, the baseband equipment used by the TRP in the NR DU cell is specified and the TRP can only use the baseband processing boards in th

parameters.name: Max Transmit Power
parameters.description: Indicates the maximum transmit power of a single TX channel of the NR DU cell TRP. This parameter is valid only when PowerConfigMode is set to TRANSMIT_POWER.

parameters.name: CPRI Compression
parameters.description: Indicates the CPRI data compression mode between the baseband processing board and RF module for an NR DU cell. This parameter is valid only when the CPRI protocol is used for data transmission between the baseband processing board and the RF module.

parameters.name: Baseband Resource Mutual Aid Switch
parameters.description: Indicates the baseband resource mutual aid switch for the TRP in an NR DU cell. This parameter is valid only when the baseband equipment ID is valid. When this parameter is set to ON, the cell can use other baseband equipment resources when the baseband equipment resources configured for the cell are faulty. After the baseband equipment recovers, the cell automatically reestablishes in the early m

parameters.name: Branch CPRI Compression
parameters.description: Indicates the mode of CPRI compression over a branch chain of a LampSite cell. This parameter is valid only when the CPRI protocol is used for data transmission between the RHUB and RF unit.

parameters.name: Antenna Polarization
parameters.description: Indicates the antenna polarization mode of a 2T2R/4T4R/8T8R cell. The value SINGLE_POLARIZATION indicates single polarization for a 2T2R/4T4R cell. The value DOUBLE_POLARIZATION indicates dual polarization for a 2T2R/4T4R/8T8R 4H1V cell. The value 2H2V_DOUBLE_POLARIZATION indicates dual polarization for an 8T8R 2H2V cell. The value DEFAULT indicates that the antenna polarization mode of a 2T2R/4T4

parameters.name: Power Config Mode
parameters.description: Indicates the power configuration mode of the NR DU cell TRP. This parameter does not take effect when TxRxMode in the NRDUCellTrp MO is set to 2R or 4R. This parameter must be set to TRANSMIT_POWER for low-frequency cells and the power specified by MaxTransmitPower is used. This parameter must be set to EIRP for high-frequency cells and the power specified by MaxEirp is used.

parameters.name: Max EIRP
parameters.description: Indicates the maximum equivalent isotropically radiated power (EIRP) of all TX channels of the NR DU cell TRP. This parameter is valid only when PowerConfigMode is set to EIRP.

parameters.name: TRP Type
parameters.description: Indicates whether the TRP for a virtual MIMO cell is a master TRP or a slave TRP. This parameter applies only to low-frequency LampSite TDD cells.

parameters.name: Master TRP ID
parameters.description: Indicates the ID of the master TRP for a virtual MIMO cell, which uniquely identifies the master TRP within the virtual MIMO cell. This parameter is valid only when TrpType is set to Slave. This parameter applies only to low-frequency LampSite TDD cells.

parameters.name: Frequency Range and Duplex Mode
parameters.description: Indicates the frequency range and duplex mode of the cell. The value FR1_TDD indicates that the current cell works in low-frequency TDD mode. The value FR2_TDD indicates that the current cell works in high-frequency TDD mode. The value FDD indicates that the current cell works in FDD mode. The value SUL indicates that the current cell works in SUL mode.

parameters.name: NR DU Cell TRP ID
parameters.description: Indicates the ID of a TRP for an NR DU cell, which uniquely identifies the TRP for the NR DU cell within a DU.

parameters.name: Coverage Scenario
parameters.description: Indicates the coverage scenario of antennas. The system adjusts beam patterns based on the setting of this parameter. You can run the DSP NRDUCELLTRP command to query the coverage scenario supported by different AAU types. This parameter applies only to low-frequency TDD cells.

parameters.name: Tilt
parameters.description: Indicates the configured downtilt angle mapping a weight for beamforming. This parameter applies only to low-frequency TDD cells. If this parameter is set to 255, the default downtilt angle supported by the hardware is used. The DSP NRDUCELLTRP command can be executed to query the tilt angle adjustment range supported by different types of AAUs. Before a cell is set up, if the value range of the t

parameters.name: Azimuth
parameters.description: Indicates the configured horizontal azimuth mapping a weight for beamforming. This parameter applies only to low-frequency TDD cells. The DSP NRDUCELLTRP command can be executed to query the azimuth adjustment range supported by different types of AAUs. If the CoverageScenario parameter is set to CUSTOMIZED_BEAM_SCENARIO, this parameter must be set to 0, and the azimuth that takes effect is the NR

parameters.name: Max SSB Power Offset
parameters.description: Indicates the maximum offset of the power used for sending all SSBs of the specific TRP for a specific cell relative to the reference power. If the configured value exceeds the maximum aggregation capability, the actual value is determined by the maximum aggregation capability. This parameter applies only to low-frequency TDD cells.

parameters.name: Scenario Beam Algorithm Switch
parameters.description: Indicates the switch of the scenario-based beam algorithm. SCENARIO_BEAM_DENSIFY_ALGO_SW: Indicates whether to enable beam densification (broadcast/RMSI beam densification). This parameter applies only to low-frequency TDD cells.

parameters.name: NR DU Cell TRP ID
parameters.description: Indicates the ID of a TRP for an NR DU cell, which uniquely identifies the TRP for the NR DU cell within a DU.

parameters.name: Beam Id
parameters.description: Indicates the beam ID of the customized and scenario-based beam. This parameter applies only to the TDD 64T low-frequency modules.

parameters.name: Tilt
parameters.description: Indicates the configured downtilt angle mapping a weight for beamforming. This parameter applies only to low-frequency TDD cells. Different types of AAUs support different tilt angle ranges. This parameter applies only to the TDD 64T low-frequency modules. For 64T low-frequency AAUs, the value range of Tilt is -3° to 15°.

parameters.name: Azimuth
parameters.description: Indicates the horizontal azimuth corresponding to the beamforming weight for a cell. This parameter applies only to low-frequency TDD cells. Different types of AAUs support different azimuth ranges. This parameter applies only to the TDD 64T low-frequency modules. For 64T low-frequency AAUs, the value range of Azimuth is -47° to 47°.

parameters.name: NR DU Cell TRP ID
parameters.description: Indicates the ID of a TRP for an NR DU cell.

parameters.name: Max Power Sharing Rate
parameters.description: Indicates the maximum percentage of power that the NR cell can share from other cells. This parameter applies only to low-frequency TDD cells.

parameters.name: NR DU Cell TRP ID
parameters.description: Indicates the ID of a TRP for an NR DU cell, which uniquely identifies the TRP for the NR DU cell within a DU.

parameters.name: NR IF Downlink Center Frequency
parameters.description: Indicates the downlink center frequency of intermediate frequency.

parameters.name: NR IF Uplink Center Frequency
parameters.description: Indicates the uplink center frequency of intermediate frequency.

parameters.name: NR IF Output Power
parameters.description: Indicates the output power of intermediate frequency.

parameters.name: NR IF Uplink Receive Gain
parameters.description: Indicates the gains of the uplink RX channel.

parameters.name: NR DU Cell TRP ID
parameters.description: Indicates the ID of a TRP in an NR DU cell, which uniquely identifies the TRP within an NR DU cell.

parameters.name: Coverage Scenario
parameters.description: Indicates the antenna coverage scenario. This parameter can be used to adjust the antenna beam pattern. The DSP NRDUCELLTRP command can be executed to query the coverage scenarios supported by different types of AAUs. This parameter applies only to high-frequency cells.

parameters.description: Indicates the configured downtilt angle mapping a weight for beamforming. If this parameter is set to 255, the default downtilt angle supported by the hardware is used. The DSP NRDUCELLTRP command can be executed to query the tilt angle adjustment range supported by different types of AAUs. This parameter applies only to high-frequency TDD cells. parameters.description: Indicates the maximum offset of the power used for sending all SSBs of the specific TRP for a specific cell relative to the reference power. If the configured value exceeds the maximum aggregation capability, the actual value is determined by the maximum aggregation capability. This parameter applies only to high-frequency cells.

parameters.name: Azimuth
parameters.description: Indicates the azimuth mapping a weight for beamforming. The DSP NRDUCELLTRP command can be executed to query the azimuth adjustment range supported by different types of AAUs. This parameter applies only to high-frequency TDD cells. Before a cell is set up, if the value range of the azimuth is beyond the range supported by the AAU, the cell fails to be set up. parameters.name: NR DU Cell ID
parameters.description: Indicates the ID of an NR DU cell, which uniquely identifies the NR DU cell within a gNodeB.

parameters.name: Operator ID
parameters.description: Indicates the ID of an operator. If this parameter is set to 255, the access control policy applies to a specific operator whose policies are not configured. If this parameter is set to a value in the range from 0 to 5, the access control policy is configured for a specific operator.

parameters.name: Access Category
parameters.description: Indicates the access category that require access control in a cell. For details, see 3GPP TS 22.261.

parameters.name: Access Control Parameter Group ID
parameters.description: Indicates the access control parameter group ID mapping to an access category.

parameters.name: NR DU Cell ID
parameters.description: Indicates the ID of an NR DU cell. It uniquely identifies an NR DU cell within a gNodeB.

parameters.name: Specified UE Cooperation Switch
parameters.description: Indicates whether to enable device-pipe synergy for specific UEs. SPEC_UE_IDENTIFY_SW: Indicates whether to identify specific UEs. If this option is selected, the gNodeB identifies UEs supporting device-pipe synergy in the cell. If this option is deselected, the gNodeB does not identify UEs supporting device-pipe synergy in the cell.

parameters.name: UE Access Switch
parameters.description: Indicates whether to enable UE access. 80M_UE_ACCESS_SW: Indicates whether UEs with a bandwidth of 80 MHz can access a 100 MHz cell. If this option is selected, UEs with a bandwidth of 80 MHz can access a 100 MHz cell. If this option is deselected, UEs with a bandwidth of 80 MHz cannot access a 100 MHz cell. This option applies only in TDD low frequency bands.

parameters.name: NR DU Cell ID
parameters.description: Indicates the ID of an NR DU cell, which uniquely identifies the NR DU cell within a gNodeB.

parameters.id: NR DU Cell DRX Algorithm Switch
parameters.name: NR DU Cell DRX Algorithm Switch
parameters.description: Indicates whether to enable the DRX algorithm for an NR DU cell. BASIC_DRX_SW: Indicates whether to enable DRX for UEs in an NR DU cell. LNR_DRX_SYNCHRONIZE_SW: Indicates whether to enable DRX synchronization for EN-DC UEs in an NR DU cell. This option takes effect only if the BASIC_DRX_SW option is selected.

parameters.name: BWP Power Saving Switch
parameters.description: Indicates whether to allow UEs in the local cell to enter the BWP2 power saving state. BWP2_SWITCH: Indicates whether the cell allows BWP2 power saving for UEs. When this option is selected, the cell allows UEs capable of this function to enter the BWP power saving state. When this option is deselected, the cell does not allow UEs to enter the BWP power saving state, even if the UEs support this f

parameters.name: NR DU Cell ID
parameters.description: Indicates the ID of an NR DU cell, which uniquely identifies the NR DU cell within a gNodeB.

parameters.name: Constant N310
parameters.description: Indicates the maximum number of consecutive bottom-layer "out-of-sync" indications received from a PCell by a UE. For details, see 3GPP TS 38.331.

parameters.name: Constant N311
parameters.description: Indicates the maximum number of consecutive bottom-layer "in-sync" indications received from a PCell by a UE. For details, see 3GPP TS 38.331.

parameters.name: Timer 304
parameters.description: Indicates the timer value of timer 304. For details, see 3GPP TS 38.331. This timer is started for a UE when the UE receives an RRC Connection Reconfiguration message containing the reconfigurationWithSync IE. This timer is stopped when the UE completes random access to an SpCell. If the timer expires, the UE sends an SCG Failure Information NR message to inform the eNodeB of the SCG failure.

parameters.name: Timer 310
parameters.description: Indicates the timer value of timer 310. For details, see 3GPP TS 38.331. This timer is started for a UE when the UE detects any fault at the physical layer of an SpCell. Before the timer expires, this timer is stopped when the UE detects that the fault is rectified, the UE initiates a connection reestablishment procedure, the UE receives an SCG Release message, or the UE receives an RRC Connection

parameters.name: Timer 300
parameters.description: Indicates the timer value of Timer 300. For details, see 3GPP TS 38.331. This timer is started when the UE sends an RRCSetupRequest message. Before the timer expires, it is stopped if the UE receives an RRCSetup or RRCReject message. After the timer expires, the UE enters the RRC_IDLE state.

parameters.name: Timer 301
parameters.description: Indicates the timer value of timer 301. For details, see 3GPP TS 38.331. This timer is started when the UE sends an RRCReestablishmentRequest message. This timer is stopped if the UE receives an RRCReestablishment message, or the selected cell becomes unsuitable. For details about an unsuitable cell, see 3GPP TS 38.331. After the timer expires, the UE enters the RRC_IDLE state.

parameters.name: Timer 311
parameters.description: Indicates the timer value of timer 311. For details, see 3GPP TS 38.331. This timer is started when the UE starts a reestablishment. The timer is stopped if the UE selects an NR or inter-RAT cell to camp on before the timer expires. After the timer expires, the UE enters the RRC_IDLE state.

parameters.name: NR DU Cell ID
parameters.description: Indicates the ID of an NR DU cell, which uniquely identifies the NR DU cell within a gNodeB.

parameters.name: Uplink Power Control Algorithm Switch
parameters.description: Indicates the uplink power control algorithm switch, which is used to specify the uplink power control policy. PUSCH_DYN_SCH_CLOSED_LOOP_SW: Indicates whether the gNodeB adjusts the PUSCH transmit power of the UE in dynamic scheduling mode. The gNodeB adjusts the PUSCH transmit power of the UE in dynamic scheduling mode only if this option is selected. PUCCH_OUTER_LOOP_SW: Indicates whether the gN

parameters.name: PO Nominal PUSCH
parameters.description: Indicates the nominal PO value of the PUSCH. For details, see 3GPP TS 38.213.

parameters.name: Path Loss Coefficient
parameters.description: Indicates the compensation factor for path loss. It is used in uplink power control. For details, see 3GPP TS 38.213.

parameters.name: PO Nominal PUCCH
parameters.description: Indicates the nominal PO value of the PUCCH. For details, see 3GPP TS 38.213.

parameters.name: Preamble Initial Received Target Power
parameters.description: Indicates the initial receive target power of the preamble. For details, see 3GPP TS 38.213.

parameters.name: Power Ramping Step
parameters.description: Indicates the preamble power increase step. For details, see 3GPP TS 38.321.

parameters.name: TPC Value In Msg2
parameters.description: Indicates the power adjustment value in Msg2. For details, see 3GPP TS 38.213.

parameters.name: Delta Preamble Msg3
parameters.description: Indicates the power offset of Msg3 relative to preamble. For details, see 3GPP TS 38.213.

parameters.name: SRS Power Control SINR Target
parameters.description: Indicates the target SINR value for SRS power control.

parameters.name: SRS PO
parameters.description: Indicates the nominal PO value of the SRS. For details, see 3GPP TS 38.213. If the PO_SRS_ADAPTIVE_SW option of the UlPwrCtrlAlgoSwitch parameter is selected, the value of this parameter is used as the initial value of the nominal PO value, which is then adaptively adjusted by the gNodeB.

parameters.name: NR DU Cell ID
parameters.description: Indicates the ID of an NR DU cell, which uniquely identifies the NR DU cell within a gNodeB.

parameters.name: Uplink Time Alignment Timer
parameters.description: Indicates the length of the uplink time alignment timer for UEs in the cell. A UE is considered not time-aligned in the uplink if the timer expires. In uplink and downlink decoupling scenarios, the TA timer of an NUL cell must be the same as that of the SUL cell.

parameters.name: NR DU Cell TRP ID
parameters.description: Indicates the ID of a TRP for an NR DU cell, which uniquely identifies the TRP for an NR DU cell.

parameters.name: Coverage Scenario
parameters.description: Indicates the antenna coverage scenario. This parameter can be used to adjust the antenna beam pattern. This parameter applies only to FDD.

parameters.name: Max SSB Power Offset
parameters.description: Indicates the maximum offset of the power used for sending all SSBs of the specific TRP for a specific cell relative to the reference power. If the configured value exceeds the maximum aggregation capability, the actual value is determined by the maximum aggregation capability. This parameter applies only to FDD.

parameters.name: Mobile Country Code
parameters.description: Indicates the MCC of an external NR cell. A PLMN ID is comprised of an MCC and an MNC. An MCC consists of three digits. An MNC consists of two or three digits. For example, if the MCC is 123 and the MNC is 45, the PLMN ID is 12345.

parameters.name: Mobile Network Code
parameters.description: Indicates the MNC of an external NR cell. A PLMN ID is comprised of an MCC and an MNC. An MCC consists of three digits. An MNC consists of two or three digits. For example, if the MCC is 123 and the MNC is 45, the PLMN ID is 12345.

parameters.name: gNodeB ID
parameters.description: Indicates the gNodeB ID of an external NR cell. It uniquely identifies a gNodeB within a PLMN. The NR Cell Identity (NCI) is comprised of the cell ID and the gNodeB ID. The gNodeB ID is represented by the most significant 22 to 32 bits of the NCI. The NR cell global identifier (NCGI) is comprised of the NCI and the PLMN ID. For details, see 3GPP TS 38.413.

parameters.name: PLMN Policy
parameters.description: Indicates the policy of configuring the PLMN in the Global gNB ID of a neighboring gNodeB for an operator. If this parameter is set to PRIMARY_PLMN_PREFER, the primary-operator PLMN of the gNodeB is specified in the Global gNB ID for the given operator. If this parameter is set to SELECTED_PLMN_PREFER, the given operator's PLMN is specified in the Global gNB ID for the given operator.

parameters.name: Mobile Country Code
parameters.description: Indicates the MCC of the operator who owns an external NR cell. The MCC, together with the MNC, forms the PLMN. The MCC is a string of three decimal digits, and the MNC is a string of two to three decimal digits.

parameters.name: Mobile Network Code
parameters.description: Indicates the MNC of the operator who owns an external NR cell. The MNC, together with the MCC, forms the PLMN. The MCC is a string of three decimal digits, and the MNC is a string of two to three decimal digits.

parameters.name: gNodeB ID
parameters.description: Indicates the gNodeB ID of an external NR cell. It uniquely identifies a gNodeB within a PLMN.

parameters.name: Cell ID
parameters.description: Indicates the cell ID of an external NR cell. It uniquely identifies an NR cell within a gNodeB.

parameters.name: Physical Cell ID
parameters.description: Indicates the physical cell ID of an external NR cell.

parameters.name: Cell Name
parameters.description: Indicates the name of an external NR cell.

parameters.name: RAN Notification Area ID
parameters.description: Indicates the RAN notification area ID of an external cell. This parameter is invalid when it is set to 65535.

parameters.name: Tracking Area Code
parameters.description: Indicates the TAC of a neighboring cell, which is used by the core network to determine the area within which paging messages are sent. One tracking area may contain one or more cells. TACs do not need to be planned when the external cell is an NSA cell and you are advised to set this parameter to the invalid value (4294967295). TACs must be planned when the external cell is an SA or SA_NSA cell a

parameters.name: SSB Frequency Position Describe Method
parameters.description: Indicates the description method of the SSB frequency domain position of a cell.

parameters.name: SSB Frequency Position
parameters.description: Indicates the frequency-domain position of the cell's SSB. When SsbDescMethod is set to SSB_DESC_TYPE_GSCN(Global Synchronization Channel Number), this parameter indicates the GSCN corresponding to the cell's SSB. When SsbDescMethod is set to SSB_DESC_TYPE_NARFCN(Absolute Frequency), this parameter indicates the NR-ARFCN corresponding to the cell's SSB.

parameters.name: NR Networking Option
parameters.description: Indicates the architecture option of an external NR cell. The value UNLIMITED indicates that the external cell is in its initial state. That is, the networking mode of the external cell is unknown, and the cell can serve as a target cell for handover. The value SA indicates that the external cell works in SA networking mode. The value NSA indicates that the external cell works in NSA networking mo

parameters.name: Frequency Band
parameters.description: Indicates the frequency band of an external cell. If this parameter is set to NULL, the frequency band of the external cell is not configured. For details, see 3GPP TS 38.104.

parameters.name: Additional Frequency Band
parameters.description: Indicates the additional frequency band of an external cell. If this parameter is set to NULL, the additional frequency band of the external cell is not configured. For details, see 3GPP TS 38.104.

parameters.name: PLMN Reserved Flag
parameters.description: Indicates whether to reserve the PLMN ID of an external NR cell. If this parameter is set to TRUE, the PLMN ID of the external NR cell is reserved and this cell cannot be selected as a target cell for UEs served by the PLMN. If this parameter is set to FALSE, this cell can be selected as a target cell for UEs served by the PLMN.

parameters.name: Cell ID
parameters.description: Indicates the unique primary-operator cell ID of an external NR cell within a base station. An NR Cell Identity (NCI), which is 36 bits long, consists of a cell ID and a gNodeB ID. An NR cell global identifier (NCGI) consists of an NCI and a PLMN ID. For details, see 3GPP TS 38.413.

parameters.name: gNodeB ID
parameters.description: Indicates the unique primary-operator gNodeB ID of an external NR cell. An NR Cell Identity (NCI) consists of a cell ID and a gNodeB ID. An NR cell global identifier (NCGI) consists of an NCI and a PLMN ID. For details, see 3GPP TS 38.413.

parameters.name: Mobile Country Code
parameters.description: Indicates the primary-operator MCC of an external NR cell. A PLMN ID is comprised of an MCC and an MNC. An MCC consists of three digits. An MNC consists of two or three digits. For example, if the MCC is 123 and the MNC is 45, the PLMN ID is 12345.

parameters.name: Mobile Network Code
parameters.description: Indicates the primary-operator MNC of an external NR cell. A PLMN ID is comprised of an MCC and an MNC. An MCC consists of three digits. An MNC consists of two or three digits. For example, if the MCC is 123 and the MNC is 45, the PLMN ID is 12345.

parameters.name: Shared Mobile Country Code
parameters.description: Indicates the secondary-operator MCC of an external NR cell in multi-operator sharing. A PLMN ID is comprised of an MCC and an MNC. An MCC consists of three digits. An MNC consists of two or three digits. For example, if the MCC is 123 and the MNC is 45, the PLMN ID is 12345.

parameters.name: Shared Mobile Network Code
parameters.description: Indicates the secondary-operator MNC of an external NR cell in multi-operator sharing. A PLMN ID is comprised of an MCC and an MNC. An MCC consists of three digits. An MNC consists of two or three digits. For example, if the MCC is 123 and the MNC is 45, the PLMN ID is 12345.

parameters.name: Shared PLMN Cell ID
parameters.description: Indicates the unique secondary-operator cell ID of an external NR cell within a base station. If this parameter is set to 65535, no exclusive cell ID is available for the operator, and the value of the NRExternalNCell.CellId parameter is used as the cell ID of the operator.

parameters.name: NR Cell ID
parameters.description: Indicates the ID of an NR cell, which uniquely identifies the NR cell within a gNodeB.

parameters.name: Handover Mode Switch
parameters.description: Indicates the handover mode switches, which correspond to the inputs based on which the gNodeB determines handover policies. EUTRAN_HO_SWITCH: Indicates whether NG-RAN can hand over UEs to E-UTRAN. NG-RAN can hand over UEs to E-UTRAN only if this option is selected. EUTRAN_REDIRECT_SWITCH: Indicates whether NG-RAN can redirect UEs to E-UTRAN. NG-RAN can redirect UEs to E-UTRAN only if this option

parameters.name: EPS FB Protection Timer
parameters.description: Indicates the length of the EPS fallback protection timer. If this timer expires, the gNodeB blindly redirects UEs.

parameters.name: Inter-RAT Handover Trigger Event Type
parameters.description: Indicates the type of the inter-RAT handover event. The event type can be B1 or B2. This parameter applies only to coverage-based handovers. For details, see 3GPP TS 38.331.

parameters.name: EPS FB Mode
parameters.description: Indicates the mobility policy for EPS fallback and emergency call fallback. If this parameter is set to HANDOVER, EPS fallback and emergency call fallback UEs preferentially fall back to E-UTRAN through handovers. If this parameter is set to REDIRECTION, EPS fallback and emergency call fallback UEs preferentially fall back to E-UTRAN through redirections.

parameters.name: RF Combination Capacity

parameters.name: Inter-RHUB RF Combination Capacity
parameters.description: Indicates the number of cells that use inter-RHUB RF combination.

parameters.name: RHUB Scope

parameters.name: RHUB List

parameters.name: RCS Client Name
parameters.description: Indicates the name of an RCS client. When a DCU functions as an RCS server and a BBU functions as an RCS client, this parameter must be set to the NE name of the BBU.

parameters.name: RCS Connection Port List
parameters.description: Indicates the list of ports that are connected to external NEs.

parameters.name: Local Cell Index
parameters.description: Indicates the local cell ID, which uniquely identifies a cell within an RCS client.

parameters.name: ExConnport PortID
parameters.description: Indicates the ID of a port which an external NE is connected to. This parameter uniquely identifies a port. The parameter value is in the format of cabinet number-subrack number-slot number-port number-subport number. When no allocation results are returned, the parameter value is NULL.

parameters.name: Mode
parameters.description: Indicates the RAT of a cell.

parameters.name: DL Center Frequency
parameters.description: Indicates the downlink frequency channel number of a cell.

parameters.name: DL Bandwidth
parameters.description: Indicates the downlink bandwidth of a cell.

parameters.name: CPRI Band Width
parameters.description: Indicates the BBU-DCU interconnection port bandwidth occupied by a cell. When no allocation results are returned, the parameter value is 0.

parameters.name: Local Cell Resource Status
parameters.description: Indicates the status of bandwidth resources of interconnection ports for a cell. If resources are properly allocated, the parameter value is Available. In other cases, the parameter value is Unavailable.

parameters.name: RFA Operator ID

parameters.name: Cell Active State
parameters.description: Indicates the activation state of a cell.

parameters.name: Pilot Power Ratio
parameters.description: Indicates the ratio of the unloaded power to fully loaded power of RFA cells.

parameters.name: MERC Carrier Gain Adjustment

parameters.name: Cell Manage State
parameters.description: Indicates the cell manage state of the cell.

parameters.name: NB-IoT Deployment Mode
parameters.description: Indicates the NB-IoT deployment mode. This parameter is valid only when AccessStandard is set to LM(LTE_FDD_NB-IoT) and applies only to NB-IoT.

parameters.name: NB-IoT Downlink EARFCN
parameters.description: Indicates the downlink EARFCN of NB-IoT. For details, see 3GPP TS 36.104. This parameter applies only to NB-IoT.

parameters.name: NB-IoT Uplink EARFCN
parameters.description: Indicates the uplink EARFCN of NB-IoT. For details, see 3GPP TS 36.104. This parameter applies only to NB-IoT.

parameters.name: NB-IoT Downlink Frequency Offset
parameters.description: Indicates the frequency offset of an NB-IoT downlink center frequency from an LTE FDD downlink center frequency. For details, see 3GPP TS 36.101. This parameter applies only to NB-IoT.

parameters.name: NB-IoT Uplink Frequency Offset
parameters.description: Indicates the frequency offset of an NB-IoT uplink center frequency from an LTE FDD uplink center frequency. For details, see 3GPP TS 36.101. This parameter applies only to NB-IoT.

parameters.name: NB-IoT Power Ratio
parameters.description: Indicates the proportion of NB-IoT carrier power to the total cell power. This parameter applies only to NB-IoT.

parameters.name: NB-IoT Pilot Power Ratio
parameters.description: Indicates the ratio of the unloaded power to fully loaded power of NB-IoT carriers.

parameters.name: Cell network Mode
parameters.description: Indicates the networking mode of a cell.

parameters.name: Micro RRU Max Transmit Power
parameters.description: Indicates the maximum theoretical transmit power of the single-antenna channel of a low-power RRU in a cell.

parameters.name: Middle RRU Max Transmit Power
parameters.description: Indicates the maximum theoretical transmit power of the single-antenna channel of a medium-power RRU in a cell.

parameters.name: High RRU Max Transmit Power
parameters.description: Indicates the maximum theoretical transmit power of the single-antenna channel of a high-power RRU in a cell.

parameters.name: Subframe assignment
parameters.description: Indicates the ratio of UL subframes to DL subframes in a TDD cell. For details, see 3GPP TS 36.211.

parameters.name: Special subframe patterns
parameters.description: Indicates the ratio of special UL subframes to special DL subframes in a TDD cell. For details, see 3GPP TS 36.211.

parameters.name: Carrier Max Input Power
parameters.description: Indicates the Carrier Max Input Power.

parameters.name: Associated Cell Id
parameters.description: Indicates the local ID of the associated cell of an RFA cell. It uniquely identifies a cell associated with the RFA cell within the base station.

parameters.name: Associated Cell Switch
parameters.description: Indicates whether an RFA cell has associated RFA cells. If this parameter is set to ON, the RFA cell has associated RFA cells. If this parameter is set to OFF, the RFA cell does not have associated RFA cells.

parameters.name: Receive End Frequency
parameters.description: Indicates the uplink end frequency of the NR RF access cell. The value must be the same as that of the source cell. The value of 4294967295 indicates an invalid value. In this case, the uplink start frequency and downlink start frequency comply with the default conversion rule of the 3GPP protocol.

parameters.name: Cell Latest Remove Time

parameters.name: Cell Latest Remove Operate Type

parameters.name: Center Frequency

parameters.name: MERC Carrier Uplink Output Power

parameters.name: RF Module Information
